Text: Jorlan and Hexascrub left to find a way to contact help. The trade lanes aren't far, so there might be a chance of success, but I'm wary to let anyone get their hopes up. In truth, we don't have any other options. We're not likely to last much longer here. The naga will find us eventually, and... well... you saw how many of them there were. You should go find the two of them on Biel'aran Ridge to the southeast. I'll keep everyone here safe as long as I can.

Title: The Legend of Captain Grayson
Objective: Find Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse in Westfall.
Text: Have you heard of Captain Grayson? Some say that he's the figment of a drunken sailor's imagination, but anyone in Westfall will tell you that Grayson is real! He's a ghost that haunts the Westfall Lighthouse far to the west, off the coast of the Longshore. Do you dare investigate?

Title: Dark Iron Scheming
Objective: Kill 5 Dark Iron Spies and capture the Dark Iron Attack Plans from Captain Beld at Ironband's Compound.
Text: A cadre of Dark Iron spies have taken over Ironband's Compound to the south, beyond Helm's Bed Lake. The mountaineers are normally able to keep them from getting into Dun Morogh, but everything is in disarray right now. The Dark Iron dwarves would be fools if they didn't take advantage of the chaos. We have to find out what they're planning and stop them before they do any damage. Will you see if you can discover what they're doing down at Ironband's Compound?

Title: Frostmane Aggression
Objective: Kill 5 Frostmane Seers and 7 Frostmane Snowstriders on Shimmer Ridge.
Text: The cataclysm has thrown the balance of power in Dun Morogh into question. Without warning, a wave of troggs emerged from the caves near Gnomeregan and overran the Frostmane trolls. The trolls have been migrating east ever since. There has always been a Frostmane presence up on Shimmer Ridge, to the northwest, but with the migration, the trolls now surround us. We can't allow the trolls to use this position to their advantage. While my men hold the line in the east, strike against Shimmer Ridge.

Title: Take Them Down!
Objective: Kill Hunter Bonetusk, Roogug, and Warlord Ramtusk.
Text: In order to maintain the relative safety in the Southern Barrens, we must put a stop to the current leadership of the Razorfen tribe. Although Charlga Razorflank commands her people through powerful mysticism, her true power is in the strength of the elders around her. Slay them. Hunt down Bonetusk, the pack leader. Stop Roogug, the overseer of Geomancers. Crush Ramtusk, the quilboar Warlord. Return to me when the deed is done.

Title: Preemptive Methods
Objective: Nalpak wants you to collect 5 Serpentbloom.
Text: There is an herb in these caverns that holds untold power. Perhaps you wish to help me collect it? It is a rare flower called Serpentbloom. I believe that in greater quantities it has the potential to prevent nightmares like Naralex's from ever occuring. Unfortunately, Serpentbloom can only be found in the darkest recesses of this place.

Title: Agamaggan
Objective: Talk to the Spirit of Agamaggan.
Text: I sense a being of immense power within these twisted thorns. The entire area has come alive at its presence. It must be the Spirit of Agamaggan! He was one of the first and most powerful beings to ever live - the Quilboar worship him fervently. All the vines you see across the land are a result of his blood; of his sacrifice to save Azeroth in the War of the Ancients. If there's any being that could steer the Quilboar towards their noble roots, it would be him. You must seek him out.

Title: Suspicious Hoofprints
Objective: Report about the suspicious prints at the Shady Rest Inn to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
Text: Rows of hoofprints lead away from the still-smoking skeleton of the Shady Rest Inn. There are at least a few visible impressions, with more rows of prints almost imperceptible in the soft mud of the marsh.

Title: A Tiny, Clever Commander
Objective: Slay Commander Nazrim.
Text: We've dealt with kobolds in these lands for years. Not much other than a nuisance. But they've been getting craftier at their stealing. I think one of them's ended up smarter than usual. Won't be that way for long, though! I want you to go to the camp south of here and make sure there's not a "big shot" kobold stirrin' up the other ones. Make sure to check the cave; it's a likely spot. And don't be shy about clearing out the other kobolds along the way.

Title: The Black Shield
Objective: Show the Blackened Iron Shield to Mosarn in Thunder Bluff.
Text: Ah, I remember now! Mosarn is a well-respected blacksmith in Thunder Bluff. I knew I had heard his name somewhere, before. In thanks, the Earthen Ring awarded me with a set of armor crafted by Mosarn. Very good work. Perhaps he can tell you more about the shield he crafted. It's not much of a lead, but since we didn't get anything useful out of Reethe, it's all we have.

Title: The Black Shield
Objective: Speak with Krog in Brackenwall Village.
Text: Oh, I think I might have dropped too much acid onto the shield. Let me just rub a little... Hm, kind of hard to read, but it looks like the name Mosarn. Never heard of him. Maybe Krog knows. Krog knows many people.

Title: The Black Shield
Objective: Collect 5 Acidic Venom Sacs from Darkmist spiders.
Text: Hmmm, there's writing right here on the rim of the shield, but it's hard to read from all the burned stuff. I need acid to make it clear. Venom from the darkmist spiders would do good. The spiders have taken over an old mine, the Darkmist Cavern, northwest of the village. Get me some of their sacs and I can clean this up.

Title: Lumbering Oafs
Objective: Slay 5 Marshtide Peasants.
Text: We are outnumbered by the Alliance. In their fear they send an army to crush a single settlement. But we will not give! Without resources, their soldiers will be at a disadvantage. Human peasants busy themselves in the woods outside Marshtide Watch, gathering lumber to rebuild their crumbling walls. Deny them the wood, and their lives.

Title: A Budding Young Surgeon
Objective: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Commander's Holy Symbol from Commander Springvale, 5 bundles of Moontouched Wood, and 5 Ghostly Essence.
Text: You have shown yourself to be a capable priest and a credit to the people of Gnomeregan. The high tinker and the king of Stormwind wish to honor your contribution to the Alliance. They have commissioned the royal enchanter to create a special staff. The materials for such a weapon can only be found in the cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. Travel there and find the lost holy symbol of Commander Springvale, a supply of moontouched wood, and ghostly essence from the spirits haunting the keep.

Title: The Defias Kingpin
Objective: Kill the Defias Kingpin.
Text: Hello there. I've heard a great deal about you. Listen closely, you're only going to have one solid shot at this. The new Defias Kingpin must be inside the hut orchestrating this entire operation. I want you to go inside and take her down, for the sake of the hundreds of innocent people the organization her father started has killed and terrorized. I'm shocked that she would let you get so close to her domain without fleeing and waiting until more favorable conditions, but it seems we're in luck.

Title: A Vision of Twilight
Objective: Locate an Eye of Twilight within the Black Breach.
Text: Cho'gall keeps track of his minions through these funny magical balls: "The Eyes of Twilight." If I could get me hands on one of those, I bet we could use it to look in on Cho'gall and see what his creeps are up to. Get me one! Search the Black Breach, east of here and just north of the river. Find me an Eye of Twilight, and do whatever you gotta do to bring it back here.

Title: In the Hall of the Mountain-Lord
Objective: Speak with Mountain-Lord Rendan at Iron Summit in Searing Gorge.
Text: The Thorium Brotherhood doesn't maintain a militia - just a few guards, and me, and that's it. If we're to successfully strike against the Dark Irons of the gorge, we're gonna need help. Mountain-Lord Rendan sits atop that tower across the gorge, to our south. He doesn't consort with Twilight folks or fire elementals, but he hasn't joined the brotherhood either. Maybe it's time we paid him a visit. With his help, we might just stand a chance.

Title: Tempered in Elemental Flame
Objective: Collect 8 Tempered Spears.
Text: First things first: We're going to need ammunition. Ammunition powerful enough to pierce the armored hide of a black drake. West of Thundermar is a Wildhammer town that's been overrun with unbound fire elementals. Any weapons left behind in that conflagration will have been tempered in elemental flame. Tougher than anything I could whip up at this forge! Find me spears in the Humboldt Conflagration. The pointier the better.

Title: Helcular's Command
Objective: Kill 15 Bloodfang Forsaken Hunters.
Text: Our dark rangers search the fields for worgen terrorists. These worgen have been sent out by their dark masters to hunt and kill us. And though a dark ranger is a formidable combatant, the worgen often attack in packs, which can overwhelm even a dark ranger. Search the fields around the ruins of Southshore for Bloodfang forsaken hunters. Kill any that you see! For the Forsaken and for Lordaeron!

Title: Join the Battle!
Objective: Report to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
Text: I received an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them! Find Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!

Title: Join the Battle!
Objective: Report to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
Text: I received an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them! Find Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!

Title: To the Depths
Objective: Report to Commander Thorak at Bladefist Bay in Durotar.
Text: The Earthen Ring has identified the watery realm of Vashj'ir as a source of the adversary's destructive energies. It is still uncertain what dangers might be faced there. Any information you could gather would be of great value. The Horde is sending warships to the region as we speak. To gain passage, speak to Commander Thorak at Bladefist Bay. May the spirits guide you.

Title: The Hunt Begins
Objective: Speak to Captain Saynna Stormrunner at Malfurion's Breach.
Text: The Shadow Wardens have joined the fight at the Molten Front, on your request. You should find Captain Saynna Stormrunner and see to it that they've found a way to best apply their skills.

Title: Putting a Price on Priceless
Objective: Investigate the Cache of Madness and find the Mysterious Gurubashi Bijou.
Text: Listen, friend. I don't know you, and you don't know me. But as long as we're both here, there's something Revilgaz wanted me to mention. Maybe you're taking a stroll through this troll-infested jungle-ocalypse. Maybe you happen to find a priceless troll artifact or two. Maybe you bring it back to me and I accidentally leave behind a little present for ya'. If you must know, it's for a project. And no, you can't ask what the project is.

Title: One of a Kind
Objective: Tol'mar wants you to recover a piece of the Drakkari Colossus in Gundrak.
Text: Dis whole mess coulda been avoided if da Drakkari had worshipped da gods instead of destroyin' dem. I heard dat dey have a special golem - one imbued with forbidden powah. Bring me back a piece from dat golem so we can learn from our bruddas and sistahs.

Title: Urgent News
Objective: Speak to Delora Lionheart at the Wreck of the Skyseeker.
Text: I'm sure Aysa won't love this plan, but it's the only plan we've got. Would you mind being the bearer of bad news for me? She needs to know what we're doing so she can get everyone to safety.

Title: Time Grows Short
Objective: Collect 1000 Seething Cinders from the Firelands.
Text: Tarecgosa is bound to you, but only temporarily. An aspect's power is required to permanently seal her essence. Malygos's successor will not be chosen until Azeroth's moons next eclipse, and the bond you share will not last until then. Fortunately, there is a way to buy us the time we need. Powerful elements exist that can extend the ritual's effects. Some of these can be found in the Plane of Fire, with which you've become familiar. Obtain them, and sustain Tarecgosa until the eclipse.

Title: Sacred Scroll
Objective: Bring the Illegible Scroll to Lorewalker Cho.
Text: The unfamiliar markings on this parchment have an elegance about them that Yoggtord and his gang don't seem capable of. You suspect that, like everything else these Hozu possess, this is stolen merchandise. Perhaps the original owner of the scroll is still nearby...

Title: One of a Kind
Objective: Chronicler Bah'Kini wants you to recover a piece of the Drakkari Colossus in Gundrak.
Text: At first glance, it be lookin' like da same old story here - trolls tappin' into forbidden powah by destroyin' da very beings dey should be worshippin'. If what I learned be true, den dey have a special golem - one like nuthin' created before! Bring me back a piece from dat golem ta study.

Title: The Lesson of the Iron Bough
Objective: Retrieve and equip a Trainee's Crossbow.
Text: First, you will need a weapon suited to your talents. Retrieve a crossbow from one of the weapon racks below, bring it to me, and show me that you know how to hold it properly.

Title: Clear the Way
Objective: Slay 10 Ale-Addled Hozen or Mischievous Virmen.
Text: Are you seeing this? Virmen, hozen, and water sprites... all pouring out of the brewery doors and windows! What the heck is going on in there!? There is another entrance, on the eastern side of the brewery. I'm going to run over there and try to figure out what's going on. In the meantime, see if you can't get rid of these creatures. There's nothing worse than a drunken hozen.

Title: Flight Training: Ring Round-Up
Objective: Fly through 6 cloud rings while riding your cloud serpent.
Text: Now that your serpent is fully grown, you are ready to begin flight training. As with all novices, you must start at the beginning. Your first task is simple. Fly through 6 of the cloud rings between the spires to the east.

Title: Knocking on the Door
Objective: Meet up with Chen Stormstout at the entrance of the Stormstout Brewery.
Text: Now, onward to the Stormstout Brewery! It's high time that I was reunited with the rest of the Stormstouts... and what better way to reunite than over a few mugs of ale? You know where the brewery is, right? Just follow this road to the west. You can't miss it. Of course, you're free to share the road with us - we'll be leaving any moment now.

Title: The Horror Comes A-Rising
Objective: Slay 7 Shuffling Mistlurkers and 2 Kyparites.
Text: We are protected from the mantid. Such was the agreement made so many millennia ago. There are forces from which we are not safe, however. The kyparites beneath the ground to the west will haunt us, chase us... even eat us. The mistlurkers eat our kind by the handful. Help our people, outsider. Defeat our enemies.

Title: Lesson 1: Sliced Peaches
Objective: Obtain a 5 Pandaren Peaches for Nomi's cooking lesson.
Text: I'm excited to start my training. We start with sliced peaches, right?

Title: The Soup of Contemplation
Objective: Train the recipe for Swirling Mist Soup from the Master of the Pot, then give her 5 Swirling Mist Soup.
Text: Watching over the pot, you get a lot of time to think. Let me show you how to make swirling mist soup and you'll know what I mean.

Title: The Unending Siege
Objective: Defeat 12 Sra'thik attackers at Niuzao Temple.
Text: The mantid continue to attack us. Their numbers ebb and flow, but they do not stop. It is no matter. The yak is stamina embodied. We will not bend to them. We will defend his home forever. Will you help us?

Title: Allies in the Shadows
Objective: Speak to Taran Zhu in Bleak Hollow.
Text: The Shado-Pan arrived here before we did, and they are already at work undermining the Thunder King's forces. I want you to meet with Taran Zhu, the leader of the Shado-Pan, and offer your services on behalf of the Kirin Tor. I doubt he is truly in need of the aid, but the gesture holds importance in itself.

Title: Impending Danger
Objective: Complete the mission, "Impending Danger."
Text: Our scouts have sighted a fel command ship looming on the horizon, Grandmaster. It appears to be headed on a collision course with the Wandering Isle. We should prepare our troops for the worst case situation - an all out attack. In the meantime, let us send our champions ahead to try and divert the Legion ship's attention.

Title: On The Prowl
Objective: Kill the Windward Saber.
Text: I have heard report of a great white beast that stalks the wood on the northwestern side of the wild serpent island. This savage creature is mate to the Windward Huntress, and already he has taken down several of the adult cloud serpent matriarchs. We cannot have such a fearsome predator roaming the island unchecked. Go and deal with this creature. Let us see if your training has paid off.

Title: WANTED: Kil'uun
Objective: Bring Kil'uun's Beak to Beastmaster Tagh.
Text: It's that damned bird! Every few hours, this blasted thing flies right past here, and none of these idiots will stop it. "It's got the crazy in its eyes," they tell me. Pah! Commander, this bird will be the end of me. If you see it, could you cut off its stupid head and give it to me? It'd make me feel better.

Title: In Need of a Hero
Objective: Save Squiggy by dousing fires with buckets of water.
Text: I...... I can't leave...... without... Squiggy...! He... he's... trapped! You need... to put out... the fire!

Title: Noodle Time: Bonus
Objective: Queue for a shift at the Halfhill noodle stand, then complete the bonus objective.
Text: Hello. Think you're a truly extraordinary noodle chef? Let's see what you've got!

Title: The Dark that Blinds Us
Objective: Take chalk rubbings of the northern, eastern, western, and southern Tribal Stones in the Whispering Fields.
Text: After years of research, there is still so much I do not understand about the Shadowmoon. To the southwest are stone monuments detailing the orcs' history. I'm not able to get close enough to examine the stones, but perhaps you can. If you could take a chalk rubbing of the words written on those stones, and I will reward you handsomely.

Title: The Voice of Iyu
Objective: Slay the Voice of Iyu.
Text: The botani and their wretched minions take and take and take. They want food, they take our land. They want an army, they take our people. It is important to strike fear into the shrubby hearts of these plant people. Look for their leader, the Voice of Iyu. It is a botani who speaks on behalf of their genesaur master. Kill their precious leader in the safety of his precious bloom.

Title: The Cure
Objective: Cure 5 Frostwolf Gladiators.
Text: Cowards! A curse on these wretched meatbags! The Bladespire have always taunted the orc clans by taking our wounded as slaves to fight like dogs in their pits. In retaliation for our assault they have poisoned their orc prisoners, leaving them to suffer and die an excruciating death. Only their geomancers carry the antidote, traveler. Use it to cure the Frostwolf prisoners.

Title: Last of the Talonpriests
Objective: Drink the Elixir of Shadow at Ishaal's Hut in the Shadowglade.
Text: Talonpriests live among us in secret, guarding the rites of the Talon King's return. The Adherent proclamation you acquired in Skettis revealed two of them living in the Shadowglade to the north. Orcs have moved into the region, and the Adherent's beam weapon left Veil Akraz a smoking crater. As you can see, my people are beset by enemies on all sides. Talonpriest Ishaal survived and is in hiding. Drink this elixir near his hut to peer into the shadows and make contact with him.

Title: Rangari in the Red
Objective: Find Khaano near the Crimson Fen in Gorgrond.
Text: Gorgrond is a very dangerous place and I've sent scouting squads out to investigate various regions. I've sent one squad to the marsh called the Crimson Fen and they've not come back yet. I'd like you to find the missing squad and get a report if possible.

Title: I See Dead Arakkoa
Objective: Use the Ghostogrifier 12000 and kill the spirit of Talonpriest Zekk.
Text: Say, while you're here would you mind helping me out with a major problem? The workers keep saying that they're seeing the ghost of the head arakkoa that used to be here. I don't believe it for a second but could you take my Ghostogrifier 12000 to her body and check? If they're not crazy, it'll prove it.

Title: I See Dead Arakkoa
Objective: Use the Ghostogrifier 12000 and kill the spirit of Talonpriest Zekk.
Text: I've got a strange problem and I'm hoping you might be able to help. I don't know who else could help, to be honest. My workers keep saying they're seeing the ghost of the arakkoa that used to head up this place. I know, I know, it's crazy but could you take my Ghostogrifier 12000 to her body and check? If there's a ghost around here, it'll find it. If there's not, then my workers are trying to slack off on the clock.

Title: Okrilla's Revenge
Objective: Poison the Dreadmaul ogre food supply.
Text: The Dreadmaul ogres think they have bested us? They will all suffer. Here take this poison, place a couple drops in their rat stew. The poison will slowly eat away at their insides. Causing a prolonged and painful death, just like they deserve.

Title: Gar'mak Bladetwist
Objective: Kill Gar'mak Bladetwist.
Text: With the intelligence you have gathered we have learned this assault is being led by a powerful Iron Horde orc named Gar'mak Bladetwist. He is hunkered down inside Okril'lon Hold. Killing him will not win this war, but it will surely break down the Iron Horde's communication. This will buy us valuable time while we gather more forces and outline a battleplan to deal with this new threat.

Title: Death to the Dreadmaul
Objective: Kill 8 Dreadmaul Ogres.
Text: The stupidity of the Dreadmaul ogres never ceases to amaze me. The Iron Horde is clearly using them to further their own nefarious agenda. Regardless, we must show the ogres what happens when you confront the true Horde. I think it's time we send the Dreadmaul ogres a message.

Title: Ransacking Nethergarde
Objective: Collect Master Aitokk's Axe, Neka's Poison Flask, and Overseer Struk's Shield.
Text: After the Iron Horde took Nethergarde we attacked. While we killed the Iron Horde at Nethergarde they brought more forces through the portal and took Okril'lon Hold. So many souls stripped of their bodies by those savages. We must not forget those that gave their lives at Nethergarde. If you find any mementos of the fallen, bring them back to me.

Title: Toothsmash the Annihilator
Objective: Kill Toothsmash the Annihilator
Text: If the battleplans you brought back are true, the Dreadmaul ogres are as much to blame for this devastation as the Iron Horde. It's time we send those ogres a message. It looks like the Iron Horde's main contact is a large ogre in Dreadmaul named Toothsmash. Killing him will put a dent in their battleplans.

Title: Attack on Nethergarde
Objective: Plant the Horde flags inside Nethergarde Keep.
Text: The Iron Horde controls Nethergarde Keep, but they are fools if they think we will let them retain such a strategic position. My best troops are more than eager to spill the blood of those savages, but we need a champion like yourself to lead the charge.

Title: Lunatic Lieutenants
Objective: Collect Iron Horde battleplans.
Text: It is time we learned more about our new enemy. Our scouts have identified a number of the Iron Horde's lieutenants. Their attack is too organized to be run by tribal knowledge alone. Surely their lieutenants have access to secret battleplans. You are the only soldier I can trust with this mission.

Title: Under Siege
Objective: Sabotage 3 Iron Demolishers.
Text: Those Iron Horde cannons are laying waste to our troops. I'm not sure how much more of this we can handle. Our forces are already spread too thin. There has to be a way to stop those war machines.

Title: Subversive Scouts
Objective: Kill 5 Iron Horde scouts.
Text: We have been unable to execute a vast majority of our battleplans. We are definitely being watched. The Iron Horde must have scouts planted throughout the Blasted Lands. Victory is slipping away from us.

Title: Attack of the Iron Horde
Objective: Kill 8 Ironmarch Grunts.
Text: We received reports of the Dark Portal turning red right before the attack. They call themselves the Iron Horde. Their army is extremely well equipped, and their numbers appear to be unending. They have already taken Okril'lon Hold and Nethergarde Keep. Our troops on the frontlines could use your help.

Title: Ending Executions
Objective: Kill 3 Ironmarch Executioners
Text: We arrived as soon as we could... but we be too late. Da Iron Horde has taken our warriors prisoner. No doubt they be trying ta squeeze info out of da troops. I fear once they are done with da interrogation they gonna execute their prisoners. Time be running out.

Title: Taking a Trip to the Top of the Tank
Objective: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil, then escort him to the top of the Iron Worldbreaker.
Text: We cannot risk the reactivation of the Dark Portal. Now is the time for the deathblow. Thaelin should have figured out how to get that tank working by now. Take him with you, and turn that tank against the Dark Portal itself. We will follow behind you.

Title: All Natural
Objective: Collect 30 Fresh Charcoal from ancients.
Text: So you have a smuggler's den, huh? I'd love to trade with ya, toots, I really would, but my laser cannon isn't even functional right now. I'll tell you what. See all the ancients around here? They got toasted good by the arakkoa's weapon, and they're practically walking piles of charcoal. Bring me some charcoal to power this thing and you've got a deal.

Title: Writing in the Snow
Objective: Deliver the tattered journal page to Rokhan in your garrison.
Text: This is a worn page from Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja's journal. It appears to be a sketch of the entrance of the Bloodmaul Slave Mines. Rokhan, in your garrison, would be very interested in this.

Title: Writing in the Snow
Objective: Deliver the tattered journal page to Bodrick Grey in your garrison.
Text: This is a worn page from Owynn Graddock's journal. It appears to be a sketch of the entrance of the Bloodmaul Slave Mines. Bodrick Grey, in your garrison, would be very interested in this.

Title: All Natural
Objective: Collect 30 Fresh Charcoal from ancients.
Text: Oh, you have a trading post? Fantastic! Let's make a deal. You help me power up my laser cannon, and I'll trade some of this... thermo... ultra... obsidiglass with you for some weapons. The ancients all around here are practically made of charcoal after the arakkoa weapon hit, you should go get some of that!

Title: The Talon King
Objective: Use the Effigy of Terokk to re-live Terokk's battle with the Bloodmane. Slay 30 Bloodmane Shortfangs, 20 Mature Bloodmane saberon, and Pridelord Karash.

Title: Rites of the Talonpriests
Objective: Place Terokk's Gavel on the Effigy of Terokk.
Text: That gavel was once known as Beakbreaker. In his final, darkest days, Terokk used it to perform grim, damnable acts of sacrifice.It is best not to dwell on those days.Terokk was sealed away deep within the shadows to rest, and perhaps to heal.Making contact with him will take a great deal of effort, so in the meantime, allow me to tell you of his more glorious exploits. Before this wretched curse took hold.Please, place the gavel upon the effigy.

Title: Cauterizing Wounds
Objective: Use a Burning Log to cauterize Nisha's wounds.
Text: You have saved my most precious companion, Nisha. I owe you a great debt. The Iron Horde lured me away to separate us. I shall not make the same mistake again. They have inflicted grievous wounds, and I fear we must cause her even more pain before the healing process can begin. Please use a burning log from the nearby fire to cauterize her wounds. I will hold her down.

Title: Back on Track
Objective: Speak to Dilbert Tinkertoss in Veil Zekk.
Text: Now that the batteries are out of the bog I can radio in some more copters to take them to camp. I'll stay here until they arrive, but you should go ahead to my brother Dilbert and let him know what happened. He must be worried sick!

Title: Sticky Situation
Objective: Retrieve 5 Submerged Batteries.
Text: A squadron of arakkoa spotted us while we were en route to the excavation site and took out our caravan. My brother made it to safety in the chaos. Lucky son of a tinker. I can't leave without the batteries for our drill, but they all fell into the bog and I can't even get them to budge. Any chance you could retrieve them for me?

Title: Back on Track
Objective: Speak to Trixxy Weldblast in Veil Zekk.
Text: You're a lifesaver, I'll tell you what. Say, how about you go on ahead to the excavation site and let my sister know I'm on my way. I'll get everything neat and tidy and go get a new cart to lug these over.

Title: The Tinkertoss Twins
Objective: Speak to Filbert Tinkertoss in Murkbog.
Text: Commander, two gnomish smugglers passed by while you were out - Filbert and Dilbert Tinkertoss. They were headed towards the bog to the east. They had all sorts of drilling equipment but didn't seem to have any weapons. What do you think of offering them protection in exchange for some of their materials? I'll jot down where they were headed in case you decide to go.

Title: Tangleheart
Objective: Speak to Glirin outside Tangleheart.
Text: The Rangari have been here for a tick, and they hear tell from the Laughing Skull o' a place called Tangleheart.Seems some really bad ancients come from there, and botani use a kind o' sap to grow them quickly.I think we could use that for yer outpost. Hey, wood is wood, right?I'll meet ya there.

Title: Tangleheart
Objective: Speak to Penny Clobberbottom outside Tangleheart.
Text: Hey there, peach. We've got the lumber mill good and ready, but we gotta find a way of choppin' wood fast out here.The Laughing Skull talked about Tangleheart, where the botani grow things quick as a quark.I'm headin' there now.

Title: Sticky Situation
Objective: Retrieve 5 Submerged Batteries.
Text: We were hauling batteries to the excavation site and I crashed my freakin' car! My sister didn't even look back. I took the turn a little fast, so what? It happens! Point is, the batteries went flying everywhere and I'm in no condition to lift them out. So what do you say? Wanna help me out?

Title: Best Deals Anywhere
Objective: Speak to Mixxy Weldblast in Murkbog.
Text: Commander, two goblin smugglers - Mixxy and Trixxy Weldblast - came through here recently and went off towards the bog to the east. They had drilling equipment but weren't carrying any weapons. I'd bet anything that they'll have materials we'd want, and that they could use some protection in return. Commander, I think seeking them out would be a good idea.

Title: When All Is Aligned
Objective: Fly upon Ka'alu and kill 80 Adherents.
Text: The ravenspeaker acolytes have been equipped with Apexis interfaces, they just need to get close enough. Come, let us take to the skies and secure the Terrace of Dawn. When all is aligned, we shall turn the false suns against one another and the spires shall burn like torches! I look forward to penning your actions into history.

Title: Peace Offering
Objective: Deliver the Crate of Cactus Apple Surprise to Dusk-Seer Irizzar in the Spires of Arak.
Text: We need allies amongst these spires, and quickly. Commander, I believe it would be wise if you sought out aid. There is a lone arakkoa outcast southeast of here living near a ravager nest. The ravagers do not attack him - I suspect he has information on the beasts we may be able to use. I have our last crate of cactus apple surprise ready for you. It is our best shot.

Title: Peace Offering
Objective: Deliver the Crate of Northshire Port to Dusk-Seer Irizzar.
Text: We could really use an ally to trade with, commander. There's an arakkoa outcast living in the middle of a ravager nest northeast of here... do you think he might ally with us? He must have some sort of secret to keeping those ravagers at bay. I have one last crate of my Northshire Port. Maybe that will help convince him that we're friendly.

Title: Chains of Iron
Objective: Defeat Captain Brak and find the Heart of the Magnaron.
Text: The artifact we seek is within our grasp. Be prepared for a fight. If they truly have learned how to control gronn, this may be more difficult than I anticipated. I will join you in this battle as soon as you arrive.

Title: A Harsh Reminder
Objective: Kill 8 denizens of the wasteland in Affliction Ridge.
Text: Welcome to the front lines, commander, where the wastelands and the jungle collide. The battle below rages on, but I believe one side is beginning to overwhelm the other. This cannot be allowed to happen. The gronnlings are gaining an upper hand and must be stopped before they pose a threat to Highpass. I will get closer to the battle while you thin their ranks. Meet me within Affliction Ridge when you are done.

Title: Reclaiming the City
Objective: Collect 100 Sargerei Insignias.
Text: The Shattrath offensive is going well, but Socrethar refuses to show himself. Despite our best efforts, we are unable to break into the inner city of Shattrath. The dome's defenses are simply too strong. However, we think we can lure Socrethar out of hiding. Defeat his lieutenants and warriors, and gather their medallions of service. When we show him proof of their demise, his pride will surely force him to face us.

Title: Socrethar's Demise
Objective: Kill Socrethar.
Text: Meet me down by the entrance to the Shattrath dome. There, we shall issue our challenge to the Sargerei leader. If he accepts, it is there that he shall meet his end. I must admit, I am looking forward to this.

Title: Rage and Wisdom
Objective: Speak to Rangari Erdanii at Affliction Ridge.
Text: An endless war wages between the creatures of the eastern wilds and the beasts of the western wasteland. Should one side overwhelm the other, all of Draenor would fall at the hand of the victor. I sent Rangari Erdanii to the heart of the battle between these two forces. It is likely that she will need your help, commander.

Title: Socrethar's Demise
Objective: Kill Socrethar.
Text: Meet me down by the entrance to the Shattrath dome. There, we will issue our challenge to the Sargerei leader. If he accepts our challenge, it is there that he shall meet his end. The creature that calls himself Socrethar was once my brethren. I can only hope that there is still some Light left within him.

Title: Garrison Campaign: The Fall of Shattrath
Objective: Speak to Lady Liadrin at the Spire of Light in Talador.
Text: Greetings. I bring another message from Archmage Khadgar. We can no longer ignore Socrethar's presence at Shattrath. He spreads dangerous beliefs, converting more draenei to his "new order" with each passing day. The time has come for us to confront him. Lady Liadrin should be expecting you at the Spire of Light in Talador. Good luck.

Title: Reclaiming the City
Objective: Collect 100 Sargerei Insignias.
Text: The Shattrath offensive is going well, but Socrethar refuses to show himself. And despite our best efforts, we are unable to break into the inner city, where he resides. However, we think we can lure Socrethar out of hiding. Defeat his lieutenants and warriors, then gather their medallions of service. When we show him proof of their demise, his pride will surely force him to face us.

Title: Garrison Campaign: The Fall of Shattrath
Objective: Speak to Exarch Maladaar at the Spire of Light in Talador.
Text: Greetings. I bring another message from Archmage Khadgar. We can no longer ignore Socrethar's presence at Shattrath. He spreads dangerous beliefs, converting more draenei to his "new order" with each passing day. The time has come for us to confront him. Exarch Maladaar should be expecting you at the Spire of Light in Talador. Good luck.

Title: WANTED: Venombarb
Objective: Kill Venombarb.
Text: Posted by: Falrogh Venombarb taunts me every day. Screeching and killing me buzz. Somebody, anybody, kill the beast. I don't want proof, I want peace and quiet.

Title: A Gathering of Shadows
Objective: Enter Veil Terokk with Reshad.
Text: Veil Terokk is just ahead. Let us hope the others have made the journey safely.

Title: WANTED: Spineslicer's Husk
Objective: Retrieve Spineslicer's Husk from Spineslicer.
Text: Posted by: Quartermaster Jolie We're running out of supplies to repair our troops' armor. I'll pay handsomely for the husk of the mighty ravager Spineslicer. It would provide us with repair materials for weeks.

Title: WANTED: Venombarb
Objective: Kill Venombarb.
Text: Posted by: Hutou Featherwind Venombarb is feared in the skies above Arak, even by the high arakkoa. She has made air travel difficult for our riders, preventing vital supplies from reaching Axefall. I require no proof of her demise, simply ensure her screech never again echoes among the spires. She nests above the howling crag to the northeast.

Title: WANTED: Keeho's Severed Paw
Objective: Retrieve Keeho's Severed Paw from Keeho the Savage.
Text: Posted by: Lieutenant Willem Keeho, a monstrous saberon, has taken to raiding Southport at night. We're losing men left and right. I offer a hefty bounty to anyone able to track down Kreeho and bring his severed paw to me.

Title: WANTED: Spineslicer's Husk
Objective: Retrieve Spineslicer's Husk from Spineslicer.
Text: Posted by: Killga I will greatly reward anyone who brings me Spineslicer's husk. I wish to fashion fine ravager armor, but do not have the skills to take down such a beast. Don't tear too many holes in it.

Title: WANTED: Keeho's Severed Paw
Objective: Retrieve Keeho's Severed Paw from Keeho the Savage.
Text: Posted by: Taskmaster Gornek The saberon known as Keeho poses a serious threat to Axefall. He has taken to slaughtering peons on the night shift and dragging their corpses to his den in the pridelands. Anyone who can bring me his severed paw as proof of his demise will be rewarded greatly.

Title: Syth's Secret
Objective: Retrieve the Eye of Anzu.
Text: Our deceased friend here was hiding more than a love of old scrolls and erotic sorcery-fiction. He had something truly valuable. If I'm reading his notes correctly, he claims to have found the Eye of Anzu - Terokk's scrying orb from the days after his fall. We need that orb! The notes say he stashed it in a ravager den just up the road.

Title: Skulltakers in Crimson Fen
Objective: Find Grulkor near the Crimson Fen in Gorgrond.
Text: Grulkor and his group are often not seen for weeks, returning only when they can carry no more trophies and supplies. He has been gone too long this time. He mentioned hunting in the Crimson Fen for the first time, see if he still lives.

Title: We Have Company
Objective: Investigate the Iron Horde camp in Sulfur Basin.
Text: Commander, I've spotted Iron Horde soldiers nearby. It is bold, even for them, to venture into such deadly territory. If we do not deal with their presence, they will surely be a threat to your camp. While I scout deeper into the canyons, may I request your help in investigating the camp?

Title: Seedbearers of Bad News
Objective: Burn 5 Ancient Seedbearer corpses.
Text: When these seedbearers are slain their seeds survive. From them spring new seedbearers, not over years, but hours. Leaving their remains here would soon cause the outpost to be overrun. We have learned that burning their remains prevents this from happening.

Title: A Lesson in Teamwork
Objective: Retrieve 10 Mysterious Artifacts.
Text: One of the most important skills an archaeology team needs is good teamwork. The key to teamwork is knowing when to give and when to take. The Highmaul ogres have been excavating mysterious artifacts from the gorge. I want you to team up with the Highmaul ogres in the name of good archaeology! Remember what I said about giving and taking? The ogres have given us their hard work to excavate the artifacts. Now I want you to take those artifacts from them and bring them here! It's teamwork!

Title: Chapter I: Plant Food
Objective: Destroy 8 Pollen Pods.
Text: There are strange, glowing objects within Tangleheart, seemingly pollinated by a variety of stinging creature.The botani sometimes collect whatever the pods produce. I can't be sure what it is, but it might be dangerous to us.- Frenna

Title: Heart of the Fen
Objective: Follow Khaano deeper into the Crimson Fen and deal with what comes.
Text: The pounding in my head is almost unbearable but I must see this through. With all the spore samples I've taken I know where to go and what to do. I will find the source and spread... no! Destroy it! I will do what needs to be done!

Title: A Heartfelt Search
Objective: Investigate the strange presence in the Crimson Fen.
Text: I can feel a powerful presence in the marsh $p, it is not far from here. Go see what is there while I finish my grim feast. I will catch up...

Title: Growing Wood
Objective: Collect 100 Ancient Growth Sap from botani or ancients.
Text: We got the lumber mill good an' built, but we be needin' more wood!The Rangari tol' me there's botani usin' some kinda sap to grow ancients fast as you like.Get yer hands on some o' that sap and I betcha I can put it work.What? Oh, Glyza here? Found 'er crashed here and she knows a thing or two about lumberjackin'. I'll take her back to the outpost later.I'll meet ya inside Tangleheart if I can find it.

Title: Wood is Wood
Objective: Kill 6 Emberbark Ancients.
Text: Them ancients in Bracken Tangle be crazier than a dwarf who don't like gold.The burn their leaves right off their 'eads and make their bark hard to fire.Ya know, that bark might come in 'andy 'round here.Chop down a few ancients and I'll send a lackey to gather their wood.

Title: Chapter II: The Harvest
Objective: Kill Ontogen the Harvester.
Text: I have seen a creature working with the ancient saplings, imbuing them with anger and hatred toward creatures unlike them.Perhaps it is this botani who is responsible for the unusually aggressive nature of ancients here in Tangleheart.Would killing this botani do us good? I fear I would be no match for it alone.- Frenna

Title: Chapter III: Ritual of the Charred
Objective: Kill 4 Ancients.
Text: I have seen a strange ritual performed by ancients. They step into fire, burning the leaves from their branches and charring their bark.I call it the Ritual of the Charred. If we want to weaken the ancients, we can get rid of them before they become even stronger.- Frenna

Title: A Grim Harvest
Objective: Bring Khaano 3 Spore Pods from the Fungal Stompers.
Text: The spores grow thick further into the marsh, but those larger fungus beasts are the key. Yes, kill them and take their spore sacs. I will need them to refine my... search.

Title: Mercy for the Living
Objective: Kill 6 Fungus Covered Shamblers.
Text: You can see that the dead were the lucky ones. Those that live wander about attacking anything not infected with these vile spores. I cannot bring myself to slay them, but if you could bring mercy to those poor people I would be very grateful.

Title: The Secret of the Fungus
Objective: Collect 5 Glowing Mushrooms.
Text: I'm beginning to sense a strong... connection... between the fungus and the creatures that inhabit it. There are certain mushrooms that are stronger than others. I believe if I had some samples of these I could use them, track the source of this foul fungus and... deal with it.

Title: Vengeance for the Fallen
Objective: Kill 7 Fungal Lurchers.
Text: I... almost made it out. Most of us... dead. The others... they are no longer themselves. These lurching spore beasts are the cause, dragging us further into the marsh... stop them.

Title: Mysterious Pod
Objective: Bring the Glowing Red Pod to Khaano at Crimson Fen in Gorgrond.
Text: This pod is similar to the ones growing on or near the bodies around here, except this one is pulsating weirdly. This is something Khaano would be interested in.

Title: All Due Respect
Objective: Retrieve the Feather of Syth and the Saga of Terokk.
Text: A group of Adherents came 'round just before the attack on Skettis. Disguised myself as a mushroom, I did. The fools walked right past me. My neighbor up the road was not so lucky. He had a fondness for texts, if I recall. Might be valuable information in his hut, if you give Reshad a moment to rummage around. Oh, and bring one of his feathers to the shrine near Veil Terokk, would you? He was such a dear, and I know it's what he'd want.

Title: A Lesson in Archaeology
Objective: Recover the Mysterious Artifact.
Text: As an archaeologist, it's important to make great discoveries and contributions to the field. Why? Because that's how you make a name for yourself! Even that hack Harrison Jones has a somewhat reputable name. If he can do it, then you can too! The Highmaul are hiding something big in that cave of theirs and we need to get in there and take it! Take this teleportation beacon and make your way to the back of the cave. Once you find the relic, place the beacon and my team will take care of the rest!

Title: Scout Forensics
Objective: Collect 5 Rangari Pouches from dead Rangari.
Text: My entire squad is gone. Some are dead; that much is obvious. The others though... they must be further in. Go and search the bodies of my squad that you find, each will carry a small pouch of personal items. I would like to return these to their families. I will go ahead and meet you inside the marsh.

Title: Control is King
Objective: Bring the Apexis Interface to Darkscryer Raastok in Veil Terokk.
Text: Apexis technology is fascinating, isn't it? Machines powered by solar energy. Energy which itself has been imbued with magic! Simply brilliant! Ah, but there's always a catch. And I think you may have found it. Bring the interface device back to Veil Terokk, will you? I'll be along shortly with the Apexis cores. If my theory is right, we may be able to turn the Adherents' own weapon against them!

Title: Pinchwhistle Gearworks
Objective: Speak to Hutou Featherwind to secure a flight to the Pinchwhistle Gearworks.
Text: Commander, a courier arrived this morning. He said he's from a goblin settlement to the southeast called the Pinchwhistle Gearworks. They've asked for our assistance with some sort of ecological disaster. We're spread thin but if we can earn their trust then we might be able to gain a valuable ally. Head down there and see what sort of assistance we can provide. I've already spoken to the flight master and he's set up a special flight to get you out there.

Title: Pinchwhistle Gearworks
Objective: Speak to Firn Swiftbreeze to secure a flight to the Pinchwhistle Gearworks.
Text: Commander, a goblin courier arrived this morning. He mentioned that he is from a settlement to the southeast called the Pinchwhistle Gearworks. They have requested our assistance with some sort of ecological disaster. If we can earn their trust it'll be worth the effort. Head down there and see what sort of assistance we can provide. I've already spoken to the flight master and he's set up a special flight to get you out there.

Title: Return to Veil Terokk
Objective: Speak with Reshad in Veil Terokk.
Text: "Percy should have brought with him a basket of goods, assuming he didn't dump it off somewhere along the way. The contents are a token of my gratitude and an apology for the altercation with your scout. I must urge you to return to Veil Terokk so we may press forward with our plans. - Reshad "

Title: The Epic Eleven
Objective: Do you think you're up to it?
Text: Do you think you're up to it?

Title: Honorable Victor
Objective: Win two battlegrounds.
Text: You have been chosen for an honorable trial. Find victory on the field of battle against your foes!

Title: Brutality in the Basin, Violence in the Valley
Objective: Win a Battle in Alterac Valley, and win a Battle in Arathi Basin.
Text: Light the flames of Honor by smashing your foes in glorious battle. Seize control of Arathi Basin and vanquish your foes in Alterac Valley to earn an epic reward.

Title: The Secrets of Gorgrond
Objective: Seek Yrel at the Wildwood Wash in Gorgrond. Speak with your Garrison Gryphon Master to fly there.
Text: Commander, Yrel and Maraad have a tactical suggestion. They recommend a small expedition group be sent into the savage wastelands of Gorgrond far to the north. Reports from their rangari suggest that land may hold ancient secrets or primal knowledge that we might use to exploit weaknesses in the Iron Horde that our enemy would not expect. If you wish to go I will have a gryphon prepared for you at once.

Title: News from Spires of Arak
Objective: Speak to Bodrick Grey at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: While you were gone, a rather shady looking human arrived at the outpost asking for you. He said he worked for... Grey was it?... and had some information regarding Spires of Arak that you would be interested in.He was heading back to your garrison and asked that I passed along the message, and so I have.And before you go, thank you for all you've done for us here, truly. You and your army have turned the tides of a war that you could have just as easily walked away from. We will not forget.

Title: The Secrets of Gorgrond
Objective: Meet Durotan in Gorgrond.
Text: Commander, Durotan calls for aid in leading a small strike team into Gorgrond to launch a counter attack against the Iron Horde strongholds there. The land is home to the Blackrock clan, industrial arm of the Iron Horde. It is also home to some of the most savage giants and monsters in all of Draenor. If you wish to answer this call to action, Gorgrond can be reached through the eastern side of Frostfire Ridge through Thunder Pass.

Objective: Plant the Alliance banner.
Text: We wouldn't have survived Tanaan without you. Many draenei and Alliance alike owe a great debt to you. King Wrynn personally requested that I place you in charge of our operations here in Draenor, and after seeing you in action, I'm inclined to agree. This is your garrison to found. Plant the banner and we'll begin construction immediately, commander.

Title: Trust No One
Objective: Follow Maladaar's trail to verify that Elodor has been infiltrated.
Text: Nothing is the same since I returned. There is always whispering - everywhere, whispering. Maraad cannot see it, but there are even traces of fel energy here in Elodor. We have been infiltrated! I must attend to the Exarch Council, but I need you to investigate. Follow the traces of fel energy that I will illuminate. If there are truly traitors in our midst, they will have to have some sort of hideout. Find it! I will wait for you with the other Exarchs.

Title: Surviving in a Savage Land
Objective: Speak to Taskmaster Gornek at Axefall.
Text: Dey may be Alliance, but Admiral Taylor and his men fought with honor on da battlefield. Dey deserve our respect, warchief be praised. If an entire garrison be fallin' to dark magic, our work be cut out for us, eh commander? We should be goin' back to base. It safe there. Safer, anyway.

Title: Honoring a Hero
Objective: Speak to Lieutenant Willem at Southport.
Text: By the Light... I can't believe this happened to Taylor and his men when they had a full garrison. It's going to take everything we have to keep your outpost safe, commander. We should get out of here. We can honor the fallen when we're safe.

Title: News from Spires of Arak
Objective: Speak to Rokhan at your garrison in Frostfire Ridge.
Text: Commander, scouts from Spires of Arak have brought back news to the garrison. There's word of a brewin' war between bird-men and the Shattered Hand orcs.Rokhan's askin' for your presence when your work is done here, should ya be willin' sir.

Title: Secrets of the Botani
Objective: Escort Cutter to Kaz the Shrieker at the Compost Heap.
Text: The botani must have stuck that big ogron there to protect something fancy. And what was that stumpy looking creature that it killed? The botani are mean, but they have some fun toys. Maybe Kaz might know what it was. Can we go find Kaz now? I saw a compost heap up the south hill. If Kaz came looking for me I bet she would start there.

Title: Chapter II: The Harvest
Objective: Kill Ontogen the Harvester.
Text: I have seen a creature working with the ancient saplings, imbuing them with anger and hatred toward creatures unlike them.Perhaps it is this botani who is responsible for the unusually aggressive nature of ancients here in Tangleheart.Would killing this botani do us good? I fear I would be no match for it alone.- Frenna

Title: Chapter III: Ritual of the Charred
Objective: Kill 4 Ancients.
Text: I have seen a strange ritual performed by ancients. They step into fire, burning the leaves from their branches and charring their bark.I call it the Ritual of the Charred. If we want to weaken the ancients, we can get rid of them before they become even stronger.- Frenna

Title: Iyu
Objective: Defeat Iyu.
Text: There is a genesaur here! It wants its artifact back. Kaz and Draka are fighting it now on the surface but they need you. Draka said I could fire the big gun. So I will stay here and do that.

Title: Chapter I: Plant Food
Objective: Destroy 8 Pollen Pods.
Text: There are strange, glowing objects within Tangleheart, seemingly pollinated by a variety of stinging creature.The botani sometimes collect whatever the pods produce. I can't be sure what it is, but it might be dangerous to us.- Frenna

Title: Will of the Genesaur
Objective: Recover the Will of the Genesaur.
Text: I am pretty sure those dwarves took the artifact in that iron fort there. Are you going to go get it?

Title: Down the Goren Hole
Objective: Slay 7 goren in Moira's Bastion.
Text: Dwarves are dumb. Don't they know that if you dig a deep hole you are going to have goren attack? If you are going to go into that iron fort you better kill a bunch of goren otherwise they are going to chew the walls enough to cause a cave-in. I would do it myself but I'm still stuffed from all that fruit the botani made me eat.

Title: Lost Lumberjack
Objective: Find Frenna within Tangleheart.
Text: Me friend was in the mole machine wit' me. Good ol' Frenna tried to make the best of it by writin' all o' her observations down in a journal. Penny here wants me to tell ya where she is. I cannae say for sure, but she was followin' me outta here and I don't think she made it.

Title: Growing Wood
Objective: Collect 100 Ancient Growth Sap from botani or ancients within Tangleheart.
Text: I found this dwarf, Thuldren, runnin' out of Tangleheart like his boots were on fire.Says his mole machine showed up here and he barely made it out alive. And another called Frenna might still be inside.One useful thing he told me is that the creatures in there have sap that can be used to grow things real fast.By the way, I'm gonna go lookin' for Thuldren's mole machine. Find me in Tangleheart when you're done.

Title: Doomshot
Objective: Collect 4 Doomshot.
Text: This ominously large explosive appears to be ammunition for the primary cannon that the Bastion is built around. The loading assembly must be on a lower floor, but this ammo did not make it that far.

Title: Blow up towers
Objective: xxxxx
Text: xxxxx

Title: Gar'mak Bladetwist
Objective: Kill Gar'mak Bladetwist.
Text: With the intelligence you have gathered we have learned this assault is being led by a powerful Iron Horde orc named Gar'mak Bladetwist. He is hunkered down inside Okril'lon Hold. Killing him will not win this war, but it will surely break down the Iron Horde's communication. This will buy us valuable time while we gather more forces and outline a battleplan to deal with this new threat.

Title: Enohar's Revenge
Objective: Poison the Dreadmaul ogre food supply.
Text: They... they killed my sister. Those beasts marched right through the front gates and... it was horrible. The Dreadmaul ogres stood beside them during the attack. They will all suffer. Here take this poison, place a couple drops in their rat stew. The poison will slowly eat away at their insides. Causing a prolonged and painful death, just like they deserve. Please, for my sister.

Title: Toothsmash the Annihilator
Objective: Kill Toothsmash the Annihilator
Text: If the battleplans you brought back are true, the Dreadmaul ogres are as much to blame for this devastation as the Iron Horde. It's time we send those ogres a message. It looks like the Iron Horde's main contact is a large ogre in Dreadmaul named Toothsmash. Killing him will put a dent in their battleplans.

Title: Mementos of the Fallen
Objective: Collect Strumner's Sword, Keri's Mug, and Krolan's Shield.
Text: There were so many of them. The guards couldn't stop them... nobody could stop them. So many souls stripped of their bodies by those savages. We must not forget those that gave their lives to try and defend Nethergarde. Please, if you find any mementos of the fallen, bring them back to me.

Title: Death to the Dreadmaul
Objective: Kill 8 Dreadmaul Ogres.
Text: The stupidity of the Dreadmaul ogres never ceases to amaze me. The Iron Horde is clearly using them to further their own nefarious agenda. Regardless, we must show the ogres what happens when you confront the Alliance. I think it's time we send the Dreadmaul ogres a message.

Title: We Burn the Dead
Objective: Burn 6 Bodies.
Text: I saw lots of bodies here. Kaz always said to burn the bodies. That way they can't come back as the mean greens. We should burn the bodies.

Title: For Nethergarde!
Objective: Plant the Alliance flags inside Nethergarde Keep.
Text: The Iron Horde controls Nethergarde Keep, but they are fools if they think we will not return to claim our land. My best troops are more than eager to spill the blood of those savages, but we need a champion like yourself to lead the charge.

Title: Admiral Taylor
Objective: Find Admiral Taylor at Admiral Taylor's Farm.
Text: Admiral Taylor had figured out who was behind all this. He told us to save who we could... he wanted to handle matters himself. We never heard from him again, but we have our orders. Please... please find him. He went towards the farm.

Title: Lunatic Lieutenants
Objective: Collect Iron Horde battleplans.
Text: It is time we learned more about our new enemy. Our scouts have identified a number of the Iron Horde's lieutenants. Their attack is too organized to be run by tribal knowledge alone. Surely their lieutenants have access to secret battleplans. You are the only soldier I can trust with this mission.

Title: The Southern Wilds
Objective: Speak to Prelate Reenu at The Draakorium.
Text: Posted by: Prelate Reenu Noble friends of the Alliance, the draenei of The Draakorium greet you peacefully. The Draakorium is being attacked by enemies from the nearby swamps. An Azerothian caravan passed through recently, and may have ventured into dangerous territory. Any capable adventurer who can assist us with this problem will be rewarded handsomely.

Title: Ending Executions
Objective: Kill 3 Ironmarch Executioners
Text: We arrived as soon as we could... but we are too late. Nethergarde has fallen. The Iron Horde has taken a number of Nethergarde warriors prisoner. No doubt they are trying to squeeze vital information out of our troops. I fear once they are done with their interrogation they will not hesitate to execute their prisoners. Time is running out.

Title: Subversive Scouts
Objective: Kill 5 Iron Horde scouts.
Text: We have been unable to execute a vast majority of our battleplans. We are definitely being watched. The Iron Horde must have scouts planted throughout the Blasted Lands. Victory is slipping away from us.

Title: Under Siege
Objective: Sabotage 3 Iron Demolishers.
Text: Those Iron Horde cannons are laying waste to our troops. I'm not sure how much more of this we can handle. Our forces are already spread too thin. There has to be a way to stop those war machines.

Title: Attack of the Iron Horde
Objective: Kill 8 Ironmarch Grunts.
Text: We received reports of the Dark Portal turning red right before the attack. They call themselves the Iron Horde, yet they seem to have no affiliation with the Horde we know. Their army is extremely well equipped, and their numbers appear to be unending. They have already taken Nethergarde Keep. Our troops on the frontlines could use your help.

Title: The Southern Wilds
Objective: Speak to Prelate Reenu at The Draakorium.
Text: I've heard disturbing news from our friends at The Draakorium, to the south. The town lies near a swamp, and recently, dangerous creatures have been venturing near its borders. You seem like a seasoned adventurer. If you are heading that way, would you mind checking in with our people there? I would feel much better if I knew they were safe.

Title: The Southern Wilds
Objective: Speak to Prelate Reenu at The Draakorium.
Text: First the Iron Horde, then the Shadowmoon orcs, and now there's trouble brewing to the south! My brother is a feyrider to the south, at the Draakorium. He says that creatures from the swamp are venturing onto our lands. What is this world coming to? Anyway, you look like a seasoned adventurer. If you are heading that way, would you mind checking in over there?

Title: Cut Them Down
Objective: Slay 3 Dew Masters.
Text: They steal children? Children?! Had you not rescued Kaz's child, he would be reduced to mulch just like the others. You should send them a message they will understand. Cut down their great dew casters. Rip them apart. Let them know that it is not okay to take our children.

Title: The Life Spring
Objective: Collect the Waters of Utrophis.
Text: It sounds like these... "dwarves"... you found managed to steal a powerful botani artifact. But the fools didn't know they need a special water to power it. To the north is a well along the Evermorn Rise. There you will find a guardian, a creature of water we have named Utrophis. Slay it and take its essence and you will be one step closer to claiming the power of the botani and their genesaur.

Title: Bushwhacker
Objective: Slay 7 Bloom Weavers.
Text: Kaz is using us, I am sure of it. She is a Laughing Skull and must NOT be trusted. For now, I am willing to play along until we can learn more. Kaz is going to ask for you to travel to Evermorn Springs. When there, I recommend you slay any botani you encounter. Culling the numbers of these horrific casters will hopefully save future orcs from such a infested fate. I will stay with Kaz and keep a close eye on her.

Title: The Best Poison
Objective: Collect 8 Reaver Vines.
Text: Do you like poisons? I am more of a "set everything on fire and loot what doesn't burn" kind of orc myself. But I do know a thing or two about poisons. When you venture into the Razor Bloom, look for a pungent, violent plant that we call Reaver Vine. Under just the right circumstances, and FIRE, the vine will make a lovely poison. Bring me some and I shall concoct a lovely poison for you.

Title: Cutter
Objective: Find Cutter.
Text: You found many Laughing Skulls. All friends, all loved, all dead. But you did not find my precious Cutter. They must have taken him to Evermorn Springs. Find him, and rescue him. He is a good boy, and deserves a better death than infesting. I am going to round up some ravagers and take the place by air. Look for me in Evermorn if you find Cutter before I do.

Title: Pollen Power
Objective: Collect 20 Potent Pollen.
Text: Those of us who grew up in Gorgrond have long learned a few secrets of the botani that can be used to grow our own plants. There is no such thing as a hungry Laughing Skull for this reason. The ravagers are the key. Outside of Evermorn Springs you will find ravagers of every type. Slay them and bring me the pollen they carry, and I can cultivate it to be of use to your garrison.

Title: Power of the Genesaur
Objective: Speak with Durotan at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
Text: Commander, you now have the Will of the Genesaur along with the genesis water and enough seeds to grow an army. Not to mention the Laughing Skulls you helped save. I would call this mission a success. I will investigate this fortress further and see if there are more materials we might glean from it. In the meantime, you may want to bring these artifacts you have obtained to Durotan back at the outpost. I will catch up once we have finished here.

Title: Punishable by Death
Objective: Kill 8 garrison traitors.
Text: Traitors, the lot! You're looking at the last bastion of forces still loyal to Admiral Taylor and the Alliance. I'll be damned if the defectors get away clean. You look like you're ready. Show them how we deal with their kind during times of war.

Title: Prime the Cannons
Objective: Recover 10 Ironcoat Cannonballs and 1 Armory Cannon.
Text: The armory is lost to the traitors. All we have left are these few cannons with no ammunition. Soldier, I need you to recover cannonballs so we can get these things running. Actually, one more cannon wouldn't hurt, either.

Title: Super Seeds
Objective: Collect Enriched Seeds.
Text: These seeds have been shielded with care by the botani. Great power can be felt surging out of these tiny vessels of life. These may prove useful.

Title: Mossy Fate
Objective: Search for Torg Earkeeper, Meka the Face Chewer, and Chag the Noseless in Razorbloom.
Text: Your wolf queen will not let me out of her sight. The children of the magnaron may have destroyed my village but it was the children of the genesaur who took my people. The botani and their minions drag our people to the Razorbloom, and if we see them again, it is not as they were in life. You have already helped the Skulls, so I ask your help again. Enter the Razorbloom and search for my people that were recently taken. Perhaps they may even be alive.

Title: The Pale Threat
Objective: Kill Greyseer and 6 Pale orcs.
Text: If we are to succeed in stopping Cho'gall from destroying the naaru, we will need to fight our way through the Underpale; a dark, winding cavern infested with the Pale. The Pale are fallen orcs that despise all that is good and holy. The longer they are left to their devices beneath the ground, the further their dark plots progress. Make your way into the Underpale, slay the vile creatures within and take out their leader, Greyseer.

Title: The Infested
Objective: Slay 6 Infested Orcs.
Text: I understand Kaz's desire to rescue her people, but her plan is reckless and she is not telling us everything. I came along to make sure she wasn't devising a plan against us and now I see this... this... horror. What did the botani do to these orcs? These infested souls need to be put to rest. Give them peace.

Title: The Nether Approaches
Objective: Collapse 10 Void Portals.
Text: By drawing upon the power of the void, the Warsong have thinned the veil that shields our world from the Twisting Nether. Portals are opening within the nether that threaten to connect the terrors of the void to Draenor. Should these portals fully open, the path will be clear for all manner of demons and void creatures to rampage across Nagrand. Go and collapse the portals before they become functional!

Title: Dark Binding
Objective: Free 8 elemental spirits.
Text: Even as we speak, the pale are enslaving an army of elementals in Shadowfall Canyon. Many have already been enslaved and if we do not lend our aid, more will follow. Go to Shadowfall Canyon and set free the elemental spirits which are not yet fully enthralled by the pale. As for those already enslaved, the only mercy we can give them now is a swift death.

Title: Spiritual Matters
Objective: Speak with the spirits at the Ancestral Grounds.
Text: The spirits of the dead have long been drawn to the mountain of Oshu'gun. As long as I can remember, the woods have been filled with ancestral spirits making a ghostly pilgrimage to the heart of the mountain. I fear that the souls drawn to Oshu'gun are being consumed by the growing void within the mountain. Make your way to the Ancestral Grounds and commune with the spirits there for guidance.

Title: The Pale Threat
Objective: Return to Vindicator Nobundo.
Text: In the time that you have been fighting against the void, I have been exploring the disturbance within Shadowfall Canyon. A dark mist has settled in the canyon; and I found twisted, pale creatures lurking there. We have much to discuss. Return to me from the Twisting Nether and we will speak more.

Title: The Dark Heart of Oshu'gun
Objective: Enter the Sanctum of the Naaru.
Text: Amongst the timeworn wreckage of the Genedar is the entrance to the vessel's inner chamber. The void energy appears to be most concentrated in that place. You must enter the inner chamber and face whatever evil lurks within. I fear whatever fate may have befallen the great naaru K'ure in that place, but regardless the evil there must be purged. May the Light be with you.

Title: Disrupt The Rituals
Objective: Destroy the Ritual Totems.
Text: Beneath the mountain of Oshu'gun the Warsong perform dark rituals. The Warsong shaman seek to empower their clan by drawing upon a great source of void energy within the heart of Oshu'gun. Though I do not know for certain the source of this power...I fear that the dying naaru K'ure may be involved. The Warsong rituals must be stopped or the veil that separates this world from the Twisting Nether will be ripped apart. Locate the ritual totems used to channel these rituals and destroy them.

Title: The Shadow Over Oshu'gun
Objective: Summon and defeat Invalidus.
Text: The void lord Invalidus stands atop the peak of Oshu'gun gorging itself upon the souls of the dead. Even the fallen void terrors that you slew only served to feed the monster. If we do not act now, Invalidus will grow too powerful to encounter alone. At each of the ritual sites in the Twisting Nether, there is a crystal filled with the powers of the void. Disturb the void crystal and Invalidus will sense your presence. Be ready, Invalidus will waste no time in attempting to feed on your soul.

Title: The Fate of Gordawg
Objective: Retrieve the Heart of the Fury.
Text: Looming monstrously between us and the inner chamber is the great fury we have sought to return to the Throne of Elements. Gordawg stands before us enthralled; a slave to Cho'gall. My heart is heavy with grief to see such a great creature mindless and enslaved by evil. There is no going back, in order to push forward you must go through Gordawg. It pains me, but Gordawg must be slain. Slay Gordawg and return the fury's heart to the Throne of Elements where it belongs.

Title: Silence The Call
Objective: Slay the Warsong ritual leaders.
Text: The Warsong shaman are using the elements to channel dark energy from the void. I am no shaman, but even I know that such practices are abhored by most orc clans. The power of the void is opposite to the Light, and a source of entropy and destruction. These rituals thin the veil between our world and the Twisting Nether. Should the rituals continue, this land will soon be overrun by the denizens of the Twisting Nether. Slay the shaman leading these dark rituals before destruction falls upon us!

Title: The Void March
Objective: Destroy 12 Void Creatures.
Text: Legions of void terrors are marching upon Oshu'gun and sacrificing themselves to the void lord Invalidus. As they die Invalidus grows stronger. It is as if the lesser creatures only serve to feed the void lord. We must stop Invalidus from becoming so powerful that it cannot be stopped. Slay as many void monsters as you can, to slow the growth of Invalidus. In the meantime, I will search for a way to encounter Invalidus before it is too late to stop it.

Title: Through The Nether
Objective: Travel to the Twisting Nether.
Text: The void rituals have been disrupted, but dark energy still flows into the nether beacons at the ritual sites. This can only mean that the beacons are being powered from within the Twisting Nether itself. The only way to sever the flow of void energy to the beacons is to travel into the Twisting Nether and stop whatever power lurks there! Use a beacon to travel to the Twisting Nether. Once there, us the shaman stone given to us by the furies to contact me. Light be with you.

Title: The Warsong Threat
Objective: Steal the Warsong Attack Plans.
Text: To all outrider stations: The warlord has commanded that all outriders prepare for a full assault upon the Alliance invaders in our land. Plans for the attack have been delivered to several of the remote outrider posts. Blood and glory shall be ours as we trample the Alliance invaders beneath our feet! The warlord commands and the Warsong obey! Lok'tar ogar!

Title: That Pounding Sound
Objective: Collect 12 Pairs of Leatherhide Ears from Leatherhide clefthoof.
Text: Commander. The frostwolf and I were just discussing the merits of various 'hunting' approaches. I assured her that the shadow hunters are well-equipped to deal with any situation, even ones out in the wild. She seems to think that we don't know what we're doing when it comes to bringing down game in 'her land.' We're not going to let her get away with saying that, right? Let's take down some clefthoof.

Title: Second in Command
Objective: Speak to Sir Edward at Admiral Taylor's Garrison.
Text: Wait... I remember something else. Sir Edward... he was shouting... looking for someone. I... I can't remember who. There were so many screams...

Title: Someone's Missing Axe
Objective: Take the Frostwolf Axe to Stalker Ogka at Wor'var.

Title: Shooting the Breeze
Objective: Collect 24 Breezestrider Horns from Breezestrider talbuk.
Text: Taz and I are having a spirited debate over who kills more efficiently: shadow hunters or frostwolves. Care to get in on the wager, commander? I've been focusing on talbuk because of their fierce majesty. They truly encapsulate the grandeur of Nagrand as any native of Draenor knows.

Title: King of the Breezestriders
Objective: Collect Tall Buck's Tail from Tall Buck.
Text: Let me guess, you found it in a talbuk's flank?  That axe was intended for Tall Buck, king of the Breezestriders. Another talbuk - the one you killed - jumped in the way as I was taking my shot. I suggest you go after the king. When I was hunting him, he seemed fond of the pond at Lonely Falls to the south.

Title: Queen of the Clefthoof
Objective: Collect the Horn of Banthar from Banthar.
Text: Ogka told me that they have Banthar here! Or rather, that she's still alive back now. Did what I just said make any sense? This is our chance, commander. We can defeat a younger, more powerful version of Banthar and really stick it to these frostwolves. We'll show Ogka how a true professional works.

Title: The Call of Oshu'gun
Objective: Fly to the Spirit Woods.
Text: The elements have spoken and a vision has been revealed. Together we shall travel to the great mountain Oshu'gun and put an end to the dark disturbance there. If what you saw in the vision is to be believed, then great danger awaits us. I will meet you in the Spirit Woods at the foot of Oshu'gun. When you are ready to depart, speak with Gixmo Moneycash and he will fly you to there.

Title: Someone's Missing Arrow
Objective: Take the Rangari Arrow to Rangari Laara at Telaari Station.

Title: King of the Breezestriders
Objective: Collect Tall Buck's Tail from Tall Buck.
Text: Let me guess, you found it in a talbuk's flank?  That arrow was intended for Tall Buck, king of the Breezestriders. Another talbuk - the one you killed - jumped in the way as I was taking my shot. I suggest you go after the king. When I was hunting him, he seemed fond of the pond at Lonely Falls to the south.

Title: A Piece of the Puzzle
Objective: Kill the Horrific Aberration in the basement of the inn.
Text: I... I remember now. Watch Commander Branson told us to stay in the inn... he said we would be safe here. Then... Then that THING broke through and slaughtered everyone! The last thing I remember seeing was it descending into the larder.

Title: Queen of the Clefthoof
Objective: Collect the Horn of Banthar from Banthar.
Text: Laara told me that they have Banthar here! Or rather, that she's still alive back now. Did what I just said make any sense? This is our chance, commander. We can defeat a younger, more powerful version of Banthar and really stick it to these rangari. We'll show Laara how a true professional works.

Title: Shocking Assistance
Objective: Collect 100 Shockscales from Shockscale eels.
Text: It's been a struggle to support the family since my wife died, and I got too ambitious when I got a contract for shockscales. Alas, there is no way I will hunt enough eels to fulfill it in time now.

Title: The Mysterious Flask
Objective: Speak to Aenir at your garrison.
Text: The liquid swirling around inside the flask clearly has strong alchemical properties, but its nature is beyond your training. You have heard that one of the Eventide villagers at your garrison has some knowledge of the alchemy of Draenor. Perhaps he could tell you more?

Title: The Young Alchemist
Objective: Find Abatha at the Verdant Mire.
Text: I learned a little about alchemy from my aunt. If you want to know more, though, you should speak with my cousin Abatha. She was apprenticing under my aunt before she passed away. Abatha lives near the Verdant Mire with her father and sister.

Title: A Parting Favor
Objective: Gather 6 Spectral Essences from restless spirits inside the garrison and use them to convince Alice Finn of her fate.
Text: I don't know what happened. My crew and I must have been the first to fall. My wife, the innkeeper, is in the same stupor you found me in. I can feel it... and there are others with her. Please, give the townsfolk peace and show their essences to my wife. That should bring her back from that cold abyss.

Title: Defection of Gronnstalker Rokash
Objective: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
Text: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine. I offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces. Will you accept it?

Title: The Missing Father
Objective: Find Telos in the Verdant Mire.
Text: I would be happy to help with your alchemical inquiries, but right now I am worried about my father. It's been quite some time since he went hunting down by the river, but he still hasn't returned home. I need to watch Lumiel. Will you please find him?

Title: What Happened Here?
Objective: Search for one of Bryan Finn's Schematics.
Text: Dis architect's spirit not be wantin' to fight us. Maybe we can break da haze over his mind and find out what happened. I bet one of da undead peasants has one of his schematics or somethin' we can show to him to clear his mind. It be worth a shot.

Title: Shooting the Breeze
Objective: Collect 24 Breezestrider Horns from Breezestrider talbuk.
Text: Kia and I are having a spirited debate over who kills more efficiently: SI:7 or rangari. Care to get in on the wager, commander? I've been focusing on talbuk because of their fierce majesty. They truly encapsulate the grandeur of Nagrand as any native of Draenor knows.
