We could put that gear to far better use in our artillery tower! Lets go hunt down their shipping containers. I brought some signal flares that we can use to call in an air pick-up when we've secured the shipment.

Title: The Only Way to Travel
Objective: Speak to Miall in Fort Wrynn.
Text: Call me cautious but I kept a few flares just in case we needed to quickly escape. I'm glad that wasn't needed but we could still use the ride back to the artillery tower. Are you ready ?

Title: Darkmoon War Deck
Objective: Return the War Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
Text: Now that you have gathered all of the cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight. On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded." You have heard that the entrance to this faire appears near Mulgore and Goldshire every month.

Title: Darkmoon Moon Deck
Objective: Return the Moon Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
Text: Now that you have gathered all of the cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight. On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded." You have heard that the entrance to this faire appears near Mulgore and Goldshire every month.

Title: Darkmoon Visions Deck
Objective: Return the Visions Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
Text: Now that you have gathered all of the cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight. On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded." You have heard that the entrance to this faire appears near Mulgore and Goldshire every month.

Title: Dropping Bombs
Objective: Call artillery strikes on the Gordunni Boulderthrower encampments within Gordal Fortress.
Text: The Gordunni have only a single path to their fortress and it is well-defended from a large attack. Thankfully they wont be expecting just the two of us to be attempting to break in. This is a great opportunity to take out their defenses and get some target practice for our gunners back at the artillery tower. Take these smoke grenades and use it to call in an artillery strike on their catapults as we head up.

Title: The Only Way to Travel
Objective: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl in Vol'jin's Pride.
Text: Call me cautious but I kept a few flares just in case we needed to evac. I'm glad that wasn't needed but we could still use the ride back to the arsenal. Are you ready?

Title: Darkmoon Iron Deck
Objective: Return the Iron Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
Text: Now that you have gathered all of the cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight. On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded." You have heard that the entrance to this faire appears near Mulgore and Goldshire every month.

Title: The Farseer Awaits
Objective: Find Farseer Drek'Thar at the Throne of Elements.
Text: Your presence has been requested at the Throne of Elements. Farseer Drek'Thar heard the call of the furies upon the wind and made the journey to commune with the elements. The Farseer has sent word that you are to join him at the Throne of Elements. Go and see what the elements would have of you.

Title: Called to the Throne
Objective: Commune with the furies at the Throne of Elements.
Text: It was not long after I arrived in Nagrand that the voice of Kalandrios called out to me upon the wind. It is a great honor to be called to the Throne of Elements, but my heart was heavy sensing the purpose. There is dark malaise in the air, it can be felt all around us. It surrounds all life here...enveloping...smothering... Come, it is time we commune with the furies and lend them our aid. An invisible shadow has been cast upon this valley and it may be up to us to remove it.

Title: The Land Provides
Objective: Collect 30 Frozen Plant Matter.
Text: The icevines of the Shivering Trench have developed a powerful resistance to cold temperatures. Integrating them into the construction materials of the garrison should prove useful.

Title: Khadgar's Plan
Objective: Speak with Khadgar near the gates of Shattrath.
Text: Shattrath must not fall into the hands of the Iron Horde. It is time again for me to get my hands bloody.We will tell Khadgar we are ready to enter the city and take back what is rightfully ours.

Title: The Shadow of the Worldbreaker
Objective: Obtain the Worldbreaker Schematics from Blackrock Orcs in the Blackrock Quarry.
Text: Looks like we'll soon have another obstacle in our way: that ridiculously large tank that they have pointed at the Dark Portal. The Iron Worldbreaker, I think they call it. If I had some documentation on how it might work, then I might be able to figure out how to shut it down. Maybe some o' those machinists and laborers have some documentation on how it works?

Title: Challenge of the Masters
Objective: Survive the Burning Blade's trial by combat.
Text: The time has come to challenge the Burning Blade masters. Go to the back of the cavern. There you will find the challenge ring and the masters watching over it from above. Pull the blade from the middle of the ring to issue your challenge. My clan values honor above all else and will respect your claim to trial by combat. As reward, you will be allowed to walk away with your life. Or, you will be dead.

Title: Meet Me in the Cavern
Objective: Meet up with Lantresor of the Blade inside the Masters' Cavern.
Text: It's time. Time to face the masters.

Title: The Blade Itself
Objective: Retrieve Lantresor's Blade from Instructor Luhk.
Text: When they clapped me in irons, the Burning Blade instructor, Luhk the Keen-Eyed, took my blade. He's an honorable orc, even if his training techniques are counter-productive. I want my blade back.

Title: Khadgar's Plan
Objective: Speak with Khadgar near the gates of Shattrath.
Text: We have the Iron Horde backed into a corner now, thanks to you.It is almost time to enter the city of Shattrath and repel them.First, we must meet Khadgar and some new allies.

Title: Blood of the Burning Blade
Objective: Kill 15 Burning Blade forces at Hallvalor.
Text: Hallvalor is the ancestral home of my clan, the Burning Blade. When the new warlord and his family came to power, I was exiled for being a half-breed. I want justice. I suspect you won't mind killing along the way. Not that you'll have any choice.

Title: Dreadpiston
Objective: Defeat Dreadpiston.
Text: The Iron Horde overtook a peaceful draenei outpost without mercy.They used a machine they call Dreadpiston to level the town in minutes.Destroy it.

Title: They Call Him Lantresor of the Blade
Objective: Find Lantresor of the Blade in Hallvalor.
Text: The Burning Blade clan at Hallvalor is supplying the Warsong with weapons and warriors. We cannot let this continue. There's a young blademaster who's been exiled from the Burning Blade for many years. They call him Lantresor of the Blade. My rangari recently saw him return to Hallvalor to challenge the blademaster leadership. Instead, they clapped him in chains. Maybe he's still alive. Maybe he'll help you deal with the Burning Blade.

Title: The Friend o' My Enemy
Objective: Kill 15 Burning Blade forces at Hallvalor.
Text: Hallvalor is the ancestral home o' the Burning Blade clan. Since they be such fast friends, the Warsong allow the blademasters an' their shaman to remain in Nagrand when all o' the other clans are forced out. Blah, blah, blah. I say, if they're the friend o' my enemy, then they're my enemy, and that's all I need to know!

Title: Dreadpiston
Objective: Defeat Dreadpiston.
Text: Nearby, a group of Iron Horde took over a key strategic position with surprising alacrity.They used a machine they call Dreadpiston to terrible effect in the siege, and I believe we need to destroy that machine before moving against the Iron Horde in Tuurem.

Title: Shredder Manual
Objective: Find the Iron Shredder Decommission Orders.
Text: Hey! I hear there's a curious object nearby. Scouts say it's some kind of shredder manual.Go check it out for me, will ya? I wonder if it has to do with this new prototype I've been hearin' about...

Title: Not Without My Honor
Objective: Find the Blademaster's Banner in a Burning Blade Locker.
Text: The blade is not the only important item a blademaster carries. Once he has passed his final tests in the Masters' Caverns, the blademaster is given the honor of wearing the Burning Blade's banner. When my petition to reclaim my rightful place with the clan fell upon deaf and craven ears, I was stripped of that honor. No doubt, my banner has been stored away somewhere in Hallvalor. They'll give it to some other aspiring blademaster if they don't burn it first.

Title: Ralshiara's Demise
Objective: Kill Ralshiara.
Text: It was said in the Journal of the Rising Sun that eating in the mornings cannot be done without harming a few eggs. The Bloodmane matron, Ralshiara, feasts upon sacred raven eggs for her snacks. How dare she! She must die for her sins! Take the path south over the mountains to reach the accursed home of the Bloodmane. Take this trinket, it fell to us from the heavens as a sign of the Raven Mother's favor and with it you might have a chance.

Title: An Old Friend
Objective: Speak with Gar'rok.
Text: Since the beginning, a shaman has been called to serve the Throne of Elements as its keeper. It is a lifelong calling and a new keeper is only called after the last has passed on. Gar'rok has been our loyal keeper for many years, cleansing the Elemental Plateau during countless cycles of rebirth. Our keeper is dying, and soon another will be called in his place. When he passes, he should not be alone. Go to him. Ease his pain.

Title: Back from Beyond
Objective: Speak with Shadow Sage Iskar in Veil Terokk.
Text: We must begin preparations for the Talon King's return. From within this realm, I can travel quickly to Veil Terokk. You, however, should be returned to the other side. You are powerful, and will attract unwanted attention.

Title: Shredder Manual
Objective: Find the Iron Shredder Decommission Orders.
Text: I've been hearing rumors of this new prototype shredder the Iron Horde's engineers have been working on.I think we ought to investigate. A shadow hunter spotted some sort of shredder manual, and it might have something to do with that prototype.

Title: Declawing The Bloodmane
Objective: Collect 6 Bloodclaw Shaman Paws.
Text: It is written in the Scroll of Sermons to "Bite the claw that strikes you." Take the path south from here that leads over the mountain to the Bloodmane valley in the west. There you will find those of their tribe who can use a primitive form of magic. Slay them and remove their paws. Once you have obtained a few bring them back to me in the nest so that they may be offered to the Raven Mother!

Title: The Debt We Share
Objective: Speak with Gar'rok.
Text: These mortal shells that we call bodies are not ours to keep. The body is a gift of earth that must one day be returned from whence it came. The time has come for this body to return to the elements. Know that you have lifted the weight from an old heart. As I pass on from this realm, I do so without regret. I have fought on behalf of my people and my land, I have served the elements, and I have loved. It would honor me if you would stay during these final moments.

Title: Guise of the Deceiver
Objective: Speak with Challe to discover the truth.
Text: In a cave not far from here, there lives an old woman named Challe. I knew Challe many years ago when I was young; though as I have become old and grey, she has kept her youth and beauty. Challe was jealous of my love for Dahaka and I have long suspected that Challe had a part in her death. However, without evidence I could not bring justice against her. Meet with Challe and tell her that I am dying. Tell her that I wish to know the truth of Dahaka's fate before I leave this world.

Title: Get to High Ground!
Objective: Report to Drek'thar in the Blackrock Quarry in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: This dam is about to burst. Hopefully. Farseer Drek'Thar fights atop the peak to the south of here. You should be safe near him. Don't worry about me.

Title: Words of the Raven Mother
Objective: Recover 8 Ravenspeaker Scroll Fragments.
Text: We came here to perform the ritual of calling to bring the return of the Raven Mother. We had distributed parts of the scroll to everyone and had just begun when we were attacked by the Bloodmane. Now most of the flock has been killed and fragments lay scattered across our homeland. The ritual was a failure but we will not allow these mongrels to break our faith. We must continue our prayers here but we would be grateful if you can recover the scroll fragments for us.

Title: The Egg Thieves
Objective: Collect 8 Dread Raven Eggs.
Text: The Bloodclaw are sadistic creatures. They have attacked the Ravenskar before and have stolen the eggs of the sacred ravens. While you are within the Bloodclaw lands keep an eye out for the eggs. I'll be waiting for you at the nest with as many baskets for them as I can gather.

Title: The Bloodmane
Objective: Slay Huntmaster Sorrowfang and 10 Bloodmane Razorclaws.
Text: We had just arrived and begun the service of the headless fowl when the Bloodmane attacked out of nowhere. Clearly, this means that the Raven Mother wishes to test the worthiness of her children. Fear not, we are steadfast and will fervently continue our prayers regardless of what may come!  Although, if you can get rid of the Bloodmane and their leader that would be a blessing as well.

Title: Shields Down!
Objective: Kill Packleader Kargora and destroy the Arkonite Shield.
Text: De time has come, commanda. Packleader Kargora an' de Arkonite Shield no longa protected. We need ta kill her an' destroy de shield crystal.

Title: Cult of the Ravenspeakers
Objective: Place the Plume of Anzu in the Offering Basket in Gnarlwood Pass.
Text: These outcasts are not the only cursed arakkoa holding their ground in Arak.A curious cult has formed in worship of Ka'alu, my consort and the keeper of my brood. They are considered to be quite... odd.Regardless, the outcasts will need their help. Without the wings of the ravens, Iskar can never take his fight to the spires.Take this feather and place it in the offering basket south of here. The so-called "Ravenspeakers" will surely take notice.

Title: I Help Ya Kill Dem
Objective: Kill 12 Warsong forces at Telaar.
Text: Warsong come in an' kill de draenei rangers. No lettin' dem have dis place. You an' me, Commanda. We gonna kill dem all. You be distractin' dem an' I usin' me Loa ta finish dem off. You see.

Title: Dropping In
Objective: Help Magister Serena destroy 3 Gordunni Boulderthrowers.
Text: Witch Lord Morkurk, the leader of the fortress, has catapults set up along the road into their compound. That won't be a problem for us. Take out the ogres around the catapults and mark them for me. This vortex spell I have prepared will handle the rest. We'll meet at the gate to the fortress once the catapults are gone.

Title: The Blessing of Samedi
Objective: Use the Fetish of Samedi on the corpses of the dead shadow hunters.
Text: Three of mah shadow huntas come here wit' me. De Warsong kill dem. We need ta help dey souls move on. Jus' in case ya find dem first, use dis on dere bodies. It send dere souls ta Samedi, Loa of de Grave.

Title: Target of Opportunity: Telaar
Objective: Speak with Shadow Hunter Kajassa at Telaar.
Text: We've received reports that the draenei enclave at Telaar has fallen to the Warsong. I sent a small group of shadow hunters to check on the situation. Kajassa is their leader. Will you meet her there?

Title: Shields Up!
Objective: Activate the four Telaari Crystals.
Text: The Warsong packleader is trying to raise Telaar's shield. If Kargora does that, the Warsong will have an impervious base. So far, they've only managed to initiate the shield. This has the undesirable side effect of protecting the packleader and her shaman at the main crystal. Activate the crystals on the perimeter of Telaar. That will force the shield to fully deploy. Once you do that, Kargora will be exposed.

Title: Orbs of Power
Objective: Destroy 5 Astral Wards.
Text: Minor issue, I'm afraid. Morkurk has placed powerful wards throughout Gordal Fortress that will prevent any sort of mass summoning - not wonderful considering our plan. Thankfully, no ogre would ever consider that a single enemy or two would attack, so we should be able to slip through their fortress relatively easily.

Title: Polishing the Iron Throne
Objective: Obtain Ga'nar's Shackle Key from Overseer Gotrigg in the nearby building.
Text: These stinking Blackrock cowards think they're humiliating me. They're just making me angrier. Overseer Gotrigg, in the hut over there, carries my shackle key. If I'm going to get out of there, I'm going to need that key. Then... vengeance can begin.

Title: The Final Step
Objective: Defeat Witch Lord Morkurk and retrieve the Arcane Nexus in Gordal Fortress.
Text: We have Morkurk cornered. He's all ours now. Use the scroll once you engage Morkurk... ...and enjoy the blizzard of your forces raining down on his head.

Title: The Foot of the Fortress
Objective: Speak to Magister Serena at the entrance to Gordal Fortress.
Text: Your forces are at the ready and the scroll is prepared. It's time for phase two - stealing a nexus crystal from a fortified ogre compound. We'll save the scroll to bring in reinforcements in our confrontation with the Gordunni Witch Lord. Let's meet at the base of the Gordal Foothills to head into the fortress proper.

Title: While We're in the Neighborhood
Objective: Collect 8 Gordunni Runebeads.
Text: Ogres from the empire are known for being cold and calculating. We are fortunate that their calculations are rarely spot on. Morkurk has been using enchanted bracelets to empower his minions with arcane strength. Since we're going to have to dispatch them anyways, we might as well get some reagents out of it.

Title: Vicious Viziers
Objective: Slay Vizier Vorgorsh, Vizier Zulmork, and Vizier Cromaug.
Text: We can't just skate in, kill Witch Lord Morkurk, and leave. His three lieutenants - Vorgorsh, Zulmork, and Cromaug - are all fiercely loyal to Morkurk, and are all respectable mages in their own right. I suspect that if we attempt to engage the Witch Lord immediately that they will rush to his aid and overwhelm us. We need to take out his lieutenants first.

Title: Rangari Roundup
Objective: Find the 5 Hidden Rangari.
Text: You have a keen eye. There are Rangari like myself hidden throughout the Nightmarsh. I need reports from each of them to ensure the area is safe. Perhaps you can help me?

Title: A Choice to Make
Objective: Use the Drafting Table to choose between the construction of a Corral or a Tankworks.
Text: We're ready to start building. All that we need is for you to make a choice. The blueprints are on the drafting table. Take a look. Then, let me know if we're going to construct a corral or a tankworks.

Title: New Babies
Objective: Coax 5 Tenderhoof Meadowstompers.
Text: That's better, but there's still something wrong. I'm getting desperate here. Can I call ya? Great. Look, I think I have it now. I know what's wrong. They miss their babies. Yeah! When they first came here, the, uh... the bastard hunters that... abandoned them said they left the babies behind. If we're going to save them from a life of misery, if we're going to save those babies,  and turn a tidy profit, we've got to get them some new babies!

Title: Elemental Attunement
Objective: Seek out the four elemental pillars.
Text: Many shaman have sought the favor of the Throne of Elements. Forming an elemental bond with the furies allows a shaman to not only know the will of the elements on Draenor, but also tap into a great font of elemental power. If you are to discover the truth behind Gordawg's disappearance, you will need to succeed where others have failed and undertake the Ritual of Binding. First, you must prepare yourself. Seek out the elemental pillars upon the plateau and attune your spirit with the elements.

Title: Guardians of the Plateau
Objective: Destroy the corrupted guardians atop the Elemental Plateau.
Text: The Elemental Plateau is sanctuary to the elemental spirits of Nagrand. The greatest among the elementals on the plateau are the guardians; mighty elemental spirits that stand watch over their domain. The guardians are pure and mighty spirits but a disturbance in the natural balance has caused them to grow unstable, corrupting the lesser elementals around them. In order to restore balance to the plateau, the guardians must be destroyed. Only then will the cycle of rebirth begin.

Title: A Rare Bloom
Objective: Retrieve the Ember Blossom from the Elemental Plateau.
Text: Many years ago I had a life-mate, Dahaka. We were only bound a short time before she was taken from me. I have lived long, but I have never known greater pain than that day. I was young and my grief was great; the earth quaked beneath my rage. I laid her to rest upon this cliff. It is here where I too will rest, but first a favor. A rare bloom grows in a cave within the fiery, molten earth of the plateau. It was her favorite. I would lay the flower upon her grave one last time before I die.

Title: Orbs of Power
Objective: Destroy 5 Astral Wards.
Text: There's a minor fire we'll need to put out before we can enact my plan. Morkurk has placed powerful wards throughout Gordal Fortress that will prevent any sort of mass summoning - awfully detrimental to our scroll of mass teleportation. Thankfully, no ogre would ever consider that a single enemy or two would have the gall to breach their walls.

Title: The Kaliri Whisperer
Objective: Recover the Old Gavel from Skizzik.
Text: An important contact lives in the nearby Shadowglade. He is meek, but trains kaliri of monstrous size which are quite dangerous. He once claimed they could knock a rylak out of the sky, but I'll believe that when I see it. Skizzik is holding a valuable treasure for me. Seek him out and get him back to Veil Terokk if you can. At the very least, recover the gavel I entrusted to him.

Title: The Final Step
Objective: Defeat Witch Lord Morkurk and retrieve the Arcane Nexus in Gordal Fortress.
Text: It's time to fight fire with fire. We have Morkurk cornered. His protections gone. Use the scroll once you engage Morkurk... ...and enjoy the fireworks.

Title: Vicious Viziers
Objective: Slay Vizier Vorgorsh, Vizier Zulmork, and Vizier Cromaug.
Text: We're after Witch Lord Morkurk, but we shouldn't charge straight at him. His three lieutenants - Vorgorsh, Zulmork, and Cromaug - are the only other capable mages left of the Gordunni, and are fiercely loyal to Morkurk. I suspect that if we engage the Witch Lord that they will rush to his aid. Let's take them out first.

Title: Mother of Thorns
Objective: Slay 5 Shadeback Ravagers and the Shadeback Thornmother.

Title: While We're in the Neighborhood
Objective: Collect 8 Gordunni Runebeads.
Text: Ah, the hubris of ogres. It always backfires. Morkurk has been using enchanted bracelets to empower his minions with arcane strength. We can disenchant these bracelets into reagents that will no doubt be useful to your arcane sanctum. What do you think about collecting some while we're here?

Title: Baby Bird
Objective: Gather 8 Ravager Grubs in the Shadowglade.

Title: Blades in the Dark
Objective: Slay Malrok Thornscar in Veil Akraz.
Text: Those orcs got hold of Ishaal's orb, did they? That would explain the dangerous-looking fellow who crossed into this realm shortly before you. Not everyone handles the transition as... gracefully as you did. The oaf is still grappling with his own mind, stumbling about and muttering nonsense. Soon he will be drawn to the orb again, which would presumably lead him to Veil Terokk. Better to take him out now while he's still befuddled.

Title: Earth, Wind and Fire...and Water
Objective: Collect 4 of each living essence from the Elemental Plateau.
Text: The Elemental Plateau has become unstable, and so the cycle of rebirth must begin. It is a natural part of our life cycle that impurities are accumulated in the elemental body over time. When enough contamination has taken place, an elemental will become unstable and in some cases volatile. A necessary part of rebirth is pure, living essence which can be found atop the Elemental Plateau, as well as in the body of an elemental spirit. Return to me with the essence and we shall begin the rebirth.

Title: A Feast of Shadows
Objective: Gather 10 Shadow Dust.
Text: Many arakkoa died in Veil Akraz. From the outside, all seems still. Empty. But in this place between worlds, death never goes unnoticed. Stray life essence seeps through from the other side; a feast for the beings who prowl here. Slay the shadow creatures here, and gather from their corpses the fine dust they produce. I will need much of it to perform the rites of the Talon King.

Title: Next Steps
Objective: Speak to Magister Serena at Fort Wrynn.
Text: We did it! We have all of the reagents for the scroll. Your arcane sanctum will be the talk of Draenor before long. I'll go back to Fort Wrynn to finish it and gather your men. Meet me there.

Title: The Foot of the Fortress
Objective: Speak to Magister Krelas at the entrance to Gordal Fortress.
Text: We've enkindled your forces and the scroll is ready. It's time for phase two - stealing a nexus crystal from a heavily fortified ogre compound. We'll save the scroll to bring in reinforcements in our confrontation with the Gordunni Witch Lord. Let's meet at the base of the Gordal Foothills and take what is more or less rightfully yours!

Title: Removing the Reinforcements
Objective: Destroy the Portal to Highmaul.
Text: My own investigations have uncovered a permanent arcane portal from here to Highmaul itself. It is guarded but shouldn't be too hard to disrupt once you've gotten some breathing room.

Title: Loola's Lost Love
Objective: Search Loose Mud for Old Loola's husband.
Text: Oh it was horrible. My husband and I were fishing in the marsh, I fell asleep and when I woke up he had been turned into a toad! I'm sure it was one of those Shadowmoon orcs I hear so much about. He jumped into the muddy waters before I could catch him. Will you help me find my lost love?

Title: Next Steps
Objective: Speak to Magister Krelas at Vol'jin's Pride.
Text: You are positively on fire! We have everything I need to create the scroll. Your arcane sanctum will be brimming with arcane energy in no time. I will teleport to Vol'jin's Pride to combine the reagents and marshal your forces. Meet me there when you can.

Title: Dropping In
Objective: Help Magister Krelas destroy 3 Gordunni Boulderthrowers.
Text: Witch Lord Morkurk is no fool. He has catapults set up throughout the foothills leading into their compound. No matter, I have a way to handle them. Take out the ogres guarding the siege weapons and mark them once they're clear. I'm readying a vortex spell that will handle things from there. We'll meet just outside their gate afterwards.

Title: The Lord of the Gordunni
Objective: Defeat Witch Lord Morkurk within Gordal Fortress and obtain "Fury of the Forge".
Text: Witch Lord Morkurk is the leader of the Gordunni. He's the one that set up the Iron Horde trade and, even worse, my former boss gave him one of my best maces! We got to get my mace back! I mean... we need to kill him to secure the jovite for your arsenal! Morkurk is an accomplished mage so you better be prepared. Here, take the rocket pack and use it if you need to dodge an attack quickly or something. Also, if you happen to find my mace I'd like to get it back.

Title: The Secrets of Gorgrond
Objective: Meet Durotan in Gorgrond.
Text: Commander, I will leave my forces to secure this pass, but I will not sit idle while our enemy prepares for another attack. I want to take the fight to the heart of the Iron Horde at Blackrock, and to do that we are going to need to go where few orcs dare tread. Gorgrond. It is a savage place, filled with giants and monsters of every sort. Will you dare these wilds with me so that we might strike at the foundries of the Iron Horde?

Title: Tastes Like Chicken
Objective: Collect 10 Raw Windroc from windroc in Nagrand.
Text: You got a moment? I've got an elekk-sized problem. Someone, um, sold me... yeah, sold me these two, but they're sick. I've tried everything, but nothing I do makes any difference! I think they must be starving. I heard that elekk like raw windroc. Gross if you ask me. Anyway, while you're out doing your thing, you mind picking me up some bird meat?

Title: Challenge of the Masters
Objective: Survive the Burning Blade's trial by combat and retrieve the Garrison Blueprints.
Text: The time has come to challenge the Burning Blade masters. Go to the back of the cavern. There you will find the challenge ring and the masters watching over it from above. Pull the blade from the middle of the ring to issue your challenge. My clan values honor above all else and will respect your claim to trial by combat. As reward, you will be allowed to walk away with your blueprints and your life. Or, you will be dead.

Title: Meet Me in the Cavern
Objective: Meet up with Lantresor of the Blade inside the Masters' Cavern.
Text: It's time. Time for you to get your blueprints. Time for us to face the masters.

Title: We Need An Army
Objective: Speak with Warmaster Zog.
Text: So the new warchief decided to send you Warmaster Zog to handle local operations. Zog! I heard that guy was notorious for organizing the Alliance AND the Horde to face off against the silithid at the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. He was a general back then. Anyway, if you go let him know about the barracks being done I'm sure he'll have some thoughts on how to put it to good use. You can find Zog up at the town hall.

Title: Prized Repossessions
Objective: Collect 6 Gordunni "Toothpick's" from Gordunni Bashers or Gordunni Cleavers within Gordal Fortress.
Text: The Gordunni were given copies of my blades as a gift from the Iron Horde. But what do they use them for? Toothpicks! Sure the blades are low grade copies but it's still MY design and I can't stand to think of them in those ogre hands for a moment longer! , While we are in here can you do me a favor and get those blades out of their hands!

Title: Supply Recovery
Objective: Recover 6 Iron Horde Shipments.
Text: We seem to have arrived at just the right time! The Gordunni have been enchanting armaments for the Iron Horde and it looks like they haven't picked up the latest shipment. We could put that gear to far better use! Lets go hunt down their shipping containers. I brought some signal flares that we can use to call in an air pick-up when we've secured the shipment.

Title: Punching Through
Objective: Slay Vizier Vorgorsh, Vizier Zulmork, and Vizier Cromaug.
Text: To secure the fortress we need to kill Witch Lord Morkurk, but I don't think we should go straight after him. His three lieutenants - Vorgorsh, Zulmork, and Cromaug - are all powerful mages, and all of them are fiercely loyal to Morkurk. I suspect that if we engage the Witch Lord that they will rush to his aid. Let's take them out so that cannot happen.

Title: Not Without My Honor
Objective: Find the Blademaster's Banner in a Burning Blade Locker.
Text: The blade is not the only important item a blademaster carries. Once he has passed his final tests in the Masters' Caverns, the blademaster is given the honor of wearing the Burning Blade's banner. When my petition to reclaim my rightful place with the clan fell upon deaf and craven ears, I was stripped of that honor. No doubt, my banner has been stored away somewhere in Hallvalor. They'll give it to some other aspiring blademaster if they don't burn it first.

Title: The Blade Itself
Objective: Retrieve Lantresor's Blade from Instructor Luhk.
Text: When they clapped me in irons, the Burning Blade instructor, Luhk the Keen-Eyed, took my blade. He's an honorable orc, even if his training techniques are counter-productive. I want my blade back. Then, I'll break myself free.

Title: Forbidden Love
Objective: Find Kral'za.
Text: My son, Kral'za, is beyond stubborn. After we split from the Shadowmoon Clan he refused to let go of his relationship with a young Shadowmoon orc. I forbid him to see her anymore. He ran off earlier today and has not returned. I don't trust Dol'mak. Like the other Shadowmoon orcs she continues to dabble in the void.

Title: Vignette: Gruuk
Objective: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.
Text: Goren are dangerous, especially in large numbers, and especially when we have a blind, under powered shaman with us. Fortunately, they have very short lifespans. Unfortunately, they multiply fast and grow faster. If we are going to do this we need to find the brood mother. Slaying her and her eggs should slow down the onslaught of goren. Check the burrows near the Forge Gates and I will to keep them off of Drek'Thar's scent.

Title: To Even the Odds
Objective: Find Shattered Hand weapons and give them to Battered Frostwolf Prisoners or Battered Karabor Prisoners.
Text: The Shattered Hand orcs are using their prisoners as living training dummies. Let's even the odds and give them some weapons.

Title: The Den of Skog
Objective: Kill Skog.
Text: Olin Umberhide appears to have discovered the parent of the gronnlings and is outmatched by himself. He will be slain without help.

Title: Fish Fight
Objective: Find a local fisherman that can help our cause.
Text: We have an accessible fishing spot here, but no bait seems to work! We need to find a local fisherman with some knowledge of the area to help us out. Think you are up to the task?

Title: Dropping Bombs
Objective: Call artillery strikes on the Gordunni Boulderthrower encampments within Gordal Fortress.
Text: The Gordunni have only a single path to their fortress and it is well-defended from a large attack. Thankfully they wont be expecting just the two of us to be attempting to break in. This is a great opportunity to take out their defenses and get some target practice for our artillery gunners back at the arsenal. Take these smoke grenades and use it to call in an artillery strike on their catapults as we head up.

Title: Going to the Gordunni
Objective: Travel to Gordal Fortress and meet up with Morketh Bladehowl.
Text: We have a good supply of jovite in the arsenal now but there just isn't enough of the material in the mine to keep us in stock for long. Down south of here there's a mountain that's just full of the stuff but there's one problem; Ogres! The Gordunni live on top of that mountain and they have begun trading the jovite to the Iron Horde. We need to go down there and secure the minerals for ourselves. I'll pack some supplies and meet you near their fortress down south.

Title: Lurking in the Shadows
Objective: Kill Shadowmoon Disrupters.
Text: There are reports of Shadowmoon clan members lurking around the ruins by the shore. This is a popular spot for young lovers to gaze at the stars and confess their affection for each other. As you can see we are not a village of warriors. I will pay you handsomely if you go to the ruins and make sure the Shadowmoon orcs keep their distance.

Title: Lunarblossom
Objective: Pick 5 Lunarblossoms.
Text: How I long to hold Kat'la. No star or moon can compare to her beauty. Alas, I am but a simple boar farmer. If only I could find time to sneak away from this pathetic excuse for a job and pick some lunarblossoms for Kat'la. I wouldn't dare confess my love to her without a gift.

Title: We Require More Resources
Objective: Gather 50 Garrison Resources.
Text: So what we got here is a good start, but you are looking for something that can support ARMIES! Truth is, we ain't building anything without the materials to build it, and our supplies from Azeroth are limited. I got some ideas on how to get you started but you are going to have to keep your eyes open for more materials when out in the field. Lots of useful stuff out there we can change into usable material.

Title: Ikky's Egg
Objective: Help Ikky hatch from the Kaliri Egg in Shadowglade.

Title: Ishaal's Orb
Objective: Retrieve Ishaal's Orb from Camp Thornscar.
Text: The Adherents came for me, but I was already hiding. I watched from the shadows as they ransacked my hut. Then I watched the Shattered Hand orcs arrive and butcher them like dinner fowl. Seems everyone is after us these days. One of those orc thugs made off with my scrying orb. I will be needing it back if I am to be of any use to Iskar.

Title: New Neighbors
Objective: Slay 15 Shattered Hand orcs in Camp Thornscar.
Text: The Shattered Hand clan is made up of orcs who can call no other clan home. They are sadistic warriors who maim their bodies, perhaps in a show of solidarity or perhaps because they simply enjoy the pain. It does not matter. What matters is that they are expanding their territory, butchering anyone in their path. They must be dealt with.

Title: What We Got
Objective: Have Skaggit get the peons working, investigate your Garrison Cache, and find Senior Peon II.
Text: Every fortress needs three things. One: peons! Find Skaggit and have him get our peons back to work. Two: building materials. I had the peons set up a cache for you where they will store resources they create while you are away. You should check it out. And three: raw experienced muscle! Constructing buildings in a garrison can take some time but I think we can speed up your first building by hiring Skaggit's recently promoted Senior Peon II. Find him and tell him I sent ya.

Title: Behind the Veil
Objective: Drink the Major Elixir of Shadows at Zellek's hut in Veil Akraz.
Text: Soon after the orcs swept in, Veil Akraz was laid to waste by a beam of light from Skyreach.  It seems they missed their true target. Zellek is still there, hiding in the realm of shadow. And... someone else as well. The orc assassin who used my orb. Take this. Drink it in Veil Akraz and find Zellek. Oh, and be careful. It's a little more potent than the last one. You'll see...

Title: The Ogron Live?
Objective: Slay Groog.
Text: Commander, our Frostwolf allies reportin' dat the Bladespire ogres have an outpost to our west led by an ogron. I heard tales of da ogron but never seen one. Dey be brutes, creatures from a time that was best left forgotten. Dey say most were slain during the forming of the original horde. What dey lack in wisdom they make up for in violence, force, and greed. I counsel dispatchin' dis creature as soon as possible.

Title: The Friend of My Enemy
Objective: Kill 15 Burning Blade forces at Hallvalor.
Text: Hallvalor is the ancestral home of the Burning Blade clan. Since they're such fast friends, the Warsong have allowed the blademasters to remain in Nagrand. We are fierce, but we won't win if the Burning Blade attack us. It would be wise to strike first.

Title: What We Need
Objective: Collect 10 Drudgeboat Salvage.
Text: I heard you guys hijacked and wrecked a ship on your way out of Tanaan. It's like my daddy always said: One man's wreck is another goblin's workshop. You should head down to the coast west of the garrison and see if you can't find any materials we might salvage. Oh, and uh... should probably watch yourself. I hear there are ogre raiders in the area.

Title: Fruitful Ventures
Objective: Collect 15 Nagrand Cherries.
Text: Oh no! They must be vegetarians. What these elekk need is fruit and lots of it. There are cherries all over the place around here under the trees. You wouldn't mind grabbing me some, would ya?

Title: Altar Altercation
Objective: Save the prisoners from the Altar.
Text: Save the prisoners from the Altar.

Title: Lost Lumberjacks
Objective: Find out what happened to Shelly and the missing lumberjacks.
Text: Shelly and her crew haven't returned from Gloomshade Grove. It's been days... I hope everything is okay.

Title: They Call Him Lantresor of the Blade
Objective: Find Lantresor of the Blade in Hallvalor.
Text: The garrison blueprints were taken to the Burning Blade village when the Warsong sacked your caravan. I can't construct this building without those plans. There's been talk of a young blademaster who's been exiled from the clan for many years. They call him Lantresor of the Blade. Our scouts recently saw him return to Hallvalor to challenge the blademaster leadership. Instead, they clapped him in chains. Maybe he's still alive. Maybe he'll help you recover the blueprints?

Title: Good Help is Hard to Find
Objective: Collect 8 Nagrand Antiquities.
Text: The excavation team is on strike! Foreman Thazwix and his cronies think they can squeeze the Steamwheedle Preservation Society for some extra dough by refusing to work. What I need is a scab, a strikebreaker; someone to put some pressure on them by doing the job they refuse to do! Go down into the gorge, dig up some antiquities for me, and I'll pay you what I would have payed those lazy numbskulls!

Title: Making Acquaintances
Objective: Follow Archmage Khadgar and speak with Magister Serena in Zangarra.
Text: It's nice to see someone else taking a vested interest in the arcane arts, you know. It's all too rare these days if you ask me. Unfortunately, I must meet Cordana to handle an important matter, but we're in luck! One of my good friends in the Kirin Tor has agreed to help you connect your arcane sanctum to the ley line network. She's waiting at my tower. Let's leave immediately and introduce you to one another.

Title: Making Acquaintances
Objective: Follow Archmage Khadgar and speak with Magister Krelas in Zangarra.
Text: It's nice to see someone else taking a vested interest in the arcane arts, you know. It's all too rare these days if you ask me! Unfortunately, I must meet Cordana to handle an important matter, but we're in luck! One of my good friends in the Kirin Tor has agreed to help you connect your arcane sanctum to the ley line network. He's waiting at my tower. Let's leave immediately and introduce you to one another.

Title: Gazmolf Futzwangler and the Highmaul Crusade
Objective: Speak with Gazmolf Futzwangler.
Text: I'm here in Nagrand recruiting for the Steamwheedle Preservation Society. We're the archaeological branch of the Steamwheedle Cartel. We're here to collect all of the artifacts, relics, antiquities and oddities that Nagrand has to offer! Currently, we're hiring surveyors, excavators, adventurers... you name it! If you're interested in getting your hands dirty, talk to Gazmolf Futzwangler over at Stonecrag Gorge. He's the goblin in charge of this expedition!

Title: Echo Hunters
Objective: Slay 10 Echo Hunters.
Text: I am no sorcerer, but I've picked up a few spells in my time - enough for me to pass unseen by the naked eye. Unfortunately, the vampire bats in these woods don't use their eyes. They will hear my shuffling robes and Percy's incessant clucking a mile away. Clear them away from the path, would you?

Title: A Lesson in Mineralogy
Objective: Collect 4 Earthen Cores.
Text: I built this machine to break down elementium minerals into base elements. You see, it's not just what's buried within the ground that can be valuable; but also the ground itself! Take, for example, the earth elementals below us; inside every earth elemental is an earthen core, dense in precious metal!. Those elementals are going to make us rich! Collect several earthen cores, place them in the Gold-O-Matic 9000, and I'll give you a cut!

Title: More Lazy Peons
Objective: Motivate 8 Lazy Peons.
Text: We have a rare opportunity to strike at the heart of the Warsong. But, we need your wisdom and leadership. The most important decision will be your choice between building a corral or a tankworks. This choice will setup our approach to the fight against the Warsong. Thazz'ril will head up our building efforts. Will you give him a hand? It looks like he's having trouble motivating his peons to work.

Title: Send Them Running
Objective: Slay Vicegnaw just outside Vol'jin's Pride.
Text: Your scouts have located the saberon's alpha male just outside our gates! Commander, I believe that dispatching this target will send any of these remaining vermin running back to their caves. I do not wish to ask more of you, but you are the only one capable of this task.

Title: The Might of the Warsong
Objective: Speak with Thrall at Wor'var.
Text: The Warsong. Surprise attack. Headed into... the Burning Blade....  They took the... blueprints....

Title: Not In Your House
Objective: Slay Ripgut just outside Fort Wrynn.
Text: , we have located the saberon's alpha male just outside our gates! We believe that slaying him will send any remaining saberon running with their tails between their legs, but the beast is positively massive! I do not wish to call upon you once more, but you are the only one capable of this task.

Title: Prune the Podlings
Objective: Take revenge on the podlings.
Text: The blood soaked body of Ryan is slumped up against the cave wall. Tiny teeth marks cover his body. The podlings clearly are a threat to you and your garrison. It's time to do a little pruning.

Title: A Pilgrimage Gone Awry
Objective: Gather 6 Prowler Blood, 6 Snapdragon Fronds, and a Riverhopper Eye.
Text: My sister and I were traveling to Auchindoun to pay our respects to my grandmother when we hit an overturned rock and lost control of our caravan. I managed to survive, but my sister...  Please, I need your help. If you could bring me some prowler blood, snapdragon flowers, and a riverhopper eye, I can fashion a potion to bring her back... I just know I can...

Title: A Pilgrimage Gone Awry
Objective: Gather 6 Prowler Blood, 6 Snapdragon Fronds, and a Riverhopper Eye.
Text: I am a humble pilgrim, I swear. Please don't hurt me! My sister and I were traveling to Auchindoun to pay our respects to my grandmother when we hit an overturned rock and lost control of our caravan. I managed to survive, but my sister...  Please, you have to help me. I'm desperate. If you could bring me some prowler blood, snapdragon flowers, and a riverhopper eye, I can fashion a potion to bring her back. I just know it....

Title: Warning the Exarchs
Objective: Talk to Exarch Maladaar at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: You set the book ablaze, but not before noting its contents. The demonic tome was dedicated to enchanting weapons with fel energy. It looked as though the goal was to ensnare the victim's soul. The Exarchs must be warned that traitors are among them! The Council should be meeting now just up the hill to the east.

Title: Taking the Fight to Nagrand
Objective: Speak with Stone Guard Brox at the caravan in Nagrand.
Text: Boss-mon, good to see ya. Durotan recommended dat we be gettin' a foothold in Nagrand, so I taken the liberty of dispatchin' some of da boys. Thrall's already reportin' that the outside be nearly complete. He been askin' me to let ya know they be ready for ya. A windrider be waitin' to catch ya up with the latest caravan shipment whenever you be ready.

Title: The Traitor's True Name
Objective: Plant the Focusing Lens atop the Exarch's Rise in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: We must give the traitor no place to hide. I have a focusing lens that will illuminate cloaked fel energy. If it were placed on a high point, it could act like a beacon, lighting up anyone in town who reeks of the fel taint. There is a prayer circle atop the Exarch's Rise to the north that will serve our purpose. Plant the focusing lens. If you reveal anything, deal with it. Then meet me below.

Title: The Sting
Objective: Acquire a Pristine Sporebat Stinger from a Moonglow Sporebat.
Text: The exarchs seem to trust you. Are you venturing into the Umbrafen? The Sporebats in this area are usually docile, but something's got them all riled up. When they attack, their stingers wrap around exposed limbs. I've seen them tear through reinforced leather like it was paper. How do they work, I wonder? Could you bring me a pristine sporebat stinger? I'd love to study it.

Title: Exarch Maladaar
Objective: Speak with Exarch Maladaar at the Fey Landing south of Elodor.
Text: The council is almost assembled: Othaar, myself, Hataaru and Naielle are ready. Only Exarch Maladaar remains. He has not been himself since he returned from his capture at the hands of the Iron Horde... but Vindicator Maraad was able to track him down. Find Maladaar at the Fey Landing, just south of the town center.

Title: Engorged Goren
Objective: Collect $1Oa Crystallized Goren Scales from Crystalmaw goren in the Elodor Dig.
Text: You must be the  that so impressed Exarch Hataaru. Can you help? The Elodor Dig just behind me is overrun by strange stone creatures. These so-called goren actually devour minerals, metabolize them, and grow crystalline structures from their arms and back. Like most of the wildlife on this world, they completely baffle us. Please slay as many as you can and gather their crystal scales for me. You'll be protecting our earthworkers and aiding our research at the same time.

Title: Naielle, The Rangari
Objective: Speak to Exarch Naielle in the Rangari Enclave.
Text: I am calling the Exarch Council to order to hear your petition. None of us doubt that this "Iron Horde" is a threat, but few can agree on what we should do about it. It is up to you and Vindicator Maraad to gather the Exarchs together. Exarch Naielle is the leader of the Rangari, the "Eyes of the Prophet." They are our scouts who silently stalk the farthest corners of Draenor. Seek her out in the Rangari Enclave northwest of here.

Title: Fun with Fungus
Objective: Use the Shimmershrooms to safely gather 12 Volatile Spores.
Text: It is our mission as rangari to explore and understand this world. Around you is the Umberfen. Many draenei lost their lives when we first discovered this place. The volatile spores burst whenever anyone approaches. But we watched... and we learned. Around the swamp you'll notice "Shimmershrooms," distinguished by their orange glowcaps. Their dust will make you invisible to the volatile spores. Grab the spores - gently! - and bring them to me. We will forge this savage world into a weapon.

Title: Hataaru, the Artificer
Objective: Speak with Exarch Hataaru outside of the Elodor Dig.
Text: I will also need you to call upon Exarch Hataaru. I understand you were helping him with our defenses at the gate. Hataaru is our Chief Artificer - he understands our technology better than any other and has been working tirelessly to recreate the glory of the civilization we left behind. He has moved to his workstation outside of the Elodor Dig, our crystal mines located just to the Southeast. Look for him at the mine entrance.

Title: Friend of the Exarchs
Objective: Choose a follower (either Andren, Chel, or Onaala) and then speak with Exarch Naielle.
Text: Only three members remain of the Exarch Council, but we are all deeply indebted to you. The vote is unanimous: Your Alliance will have our full support on Draenor. We are also going to place a draenei representative under your direct command. Three potential candidates are here in the courtyard. Speak to them and choose who you want - we will dispatch him or her immediately to your garrison!

Title: Migrant Workers
Objective: Speak with Foreman Zipfizzle in your garrison, then meet with the laborers outside of Elodor.
Text: , more recruits arrive at your garrison every hour. We will soon run out of food. I have made contact with Exarch Akama in hopes of securing rations from Elodor, the breadbasket of this valley. He has agreed, provided we supply labor for the harvest. Everyone wins. If you agree with my plan, speak with Foreman Zipfizzle here in the courtyard - he has gathered together available laborers. Akama and I will escort them and meet you at Elodor, far to the east!

Title: Speaker for the Dead
Objective: Meet Exarch Maladaar at the cliffs east of the Altar of Sha'tar. Complete the ritual to cleanse and interrogate Hataaru's corpse.
Text: This was a betrayal from within. There's no other explanation for it. None of the Exarchs trust each other now - especially me. But Othaar and Akama can damn their laws. We've got to rout out the traitor and the only way to do it is to speak to the corpse! Join me just outside the Altar of Sha'tar atop the eastern cliffs. Soulbinder Nyami and I will perform an exorcism to save Hataaru's immortal soul... and maybe learn who did this to him. Do you trust me?

Title: The Exarch Council
Objective: Speak with Exarch Othaar in Elodor.
Text: Good work at the gates! The Shadowmoon orcs have been seeking prisoners for some reason. Their aggression helps our cause. Come with me. I would like to introduce you to the Exarch Council, "The Hand of the Prophet." I have been trying to convince the Exarchs to support our cause and go on the offensive against the Iron Horde, but they are - as always - too cautious and slow to act. Come with me, I will introduce you to Exarch Othaar up the hill. Perhaps meeting an Alliance hero can sway the council.

Title: Gatekeepers of Auchindoun
Objective: Defeat Vindicator Dalu and Soulbinder Halaari.
Text: Auchindoun is under attack, stranger, and I intend to help defend it. The only problem is the only armor I could find was my grandfather's old set, and it isn't nearly enough to defeat the spirits blocking the path toward Auchindoun. Would you defeat them and let me through the gate with you? I will find a way to repay you!

Title: Defenstrations
Objective: Kill 8 Shadowmoon Raiders or Dark Priestesses.
Text: No sooner does power rush to the crystal outside than you hear distant war cries and shouts of alarm. Elodor is being attacked! If you want your laborers to come home in one piece, you'd best help with the defense of the town. Defeat the invasion and then return to the control console to reset the defenses.

Title: Circle the Wagon
Objective: Find Maraad and the lost laborers and escort them back to Elodor Fields.
Text: One of our wagons fell behind, and disappeared somewhere in the woods to the northwest. Vindicator Maraad and several of your workers are stranded out there. Find them and bring them back!

Title: Invisible Ramparts
Objective: Carry charged resonance crystals to the primary, secondary, and tertiary pylons.
Text: Exarch Akama is too cautious, but we shouldn't ignore a threat from the Shadowmoon clan. It is good you are here! Since we arrived on Draenor I have dedicated myself to recreating the technology we left behind. This large structure here is a defense ward. It should counter a Shadowmoon advance - provided we power it up. I have prepared resonance crystals at my workshop to the south. Carry one crystal at a time to the three pylons that surround the ward, then activate the control panel nearby!

Title: Gatekeepers of Auchindoun
Objective: Defeat Vindicator Dalu and Soulbinder Halaari in combat.
Text: I was taken captive by the Iron Horde when they raided our caravan en route to Auchindoun. I escaped, but these spirits won't let me through to join my fellow Sunsworn until someone defeats them in combat! Please, will you help me defeat them?

Title: Why Is The Brew Gone?
Objective: Retrieve 5 Footman Longswords and 5 Thunderbrew Kegs.
Text: Commander, we have a bit of a... uh... problem. This group o' saberon followed us from Gorgrond, and they've been stealin' our footmen's swords an' slaughtering our peasants! I hate to ask fer your time, but all of yer men are guardin' the camp from any further raids. Plus...  They took our beer!

Title: Mission Probable
Objective: Use the Command Table to send Olin Umberhide on a mission.
Text: Despite his recent captures, Olin Umberhide seems to be a tauren of some skill in combat. He certainly has learned how to get an enemy's attention. I have a mission available that might prove ideal for his skill sets. When you are ready, simply issue the order via the command table in front of me and we will dispatch him immediately.

Title: Logistical Nightmare
Objective: Retrieve 5 Sacks of Supplies and 5 Garrison Records.
Text: Commander, I am afraid I have... troubling... news. These saberon followed our encampment from Gorgrond, and have been stealing our supplies, ransacking our ledgers, and slaughtering our peons! I hate to ask of your time to deal with the matter, but all of our men are stationed guarding the camp from any further raids. We desperately need those supplies so we may enact your will!

Title: Clear!
Objective: Collect 6 Zapper Sacs from Lakebottom Zappers in Talador.
Text: Oh, the gnomanity! The Pleasure-Bot 8000 broke before it could bring me a single Draenor truffle. It swam here and shorted its power fluctuator. AGAIN! I have power going to it, but it isn't enough to override the fluctuator. Could you get me the sacs from the electric eels in the lake? I think that would be just the ticket!

Title: Looking For Help
Objective: Find a local fisherman that can help our cause.
Text: We have an accessible fishing spot here, but no bait seems to work! We need to find a local fisherman with some knowledge of the area to help us out. Head southeast and see if you can find anyone on the shoreline.

Title: Clear!
Objective: Collect 6 Zapper Sacs from Lakebottom Zappers in Talador.
Text: You gotta help me fix this robot. I'm friggin' hungry! I built the Pleasure-Bot 8000 to locate Draenor truffles, and what does it do? It swims to this stupid island and shorts its power fluctuator. I got it hooked up to these batteries, but it ain't enough juice to jump it. Be a doll and get me the zapper sacs from the electric eels in the lake, would ya? They oughta be enough.

Title: The Den of Skog
Objective: Kill Skog.
Text: So this gronn infestation ain't gonna solve itself. You're gonna have to show them who's boss, Horde style! With this many gronnlings around there is bound to be a full grown, big mama of a gronn. Find him... it... her... or whatever, and take it out, and the rest of those gronnlings might lose interest in our little operation here.

Title: A Charming Deception
Objective: Use 5 Illusion Charms to draw out Adherent Harriers.
Text: Reshad is more than he appears; a mottled old crow with his beak in a book, certainly, but we need him. Shadows gather beneath the lonely spire, in Veil Terokk. Reshad must make it there safely. Along the path you'll find charms primed with illusion spells. You need only touch them to take on Reshad's image. Adherent assassins are on the prowl for an old outcast with scrolls on his back. They will fall upon you. Oh, but won't they be surprised when the illusion fades?! Kee-hee-hee!

Title: Keli'dan the Breaker
Objective: Slay Keli'dan the Breaker.
Text: One of Ner'zhul's lieutenants remains, up ahead. The exit to the cave isn't much farther past him. I will go back and tell Khadgar that the cave is clear. We will rendezvous once you've taken care of Keli'dan!

Title: Shields Down!
Objective: Destroy the Arkonite Crystal and Collect the Garrison Blueprints from Packleader Kargora.
Text: Did you hear that? They got the shield up. There'll be no getting into Telaar now. You must get that shield down. The only way to do it is to destroy the Arkonite crystal. Don't worry about me. You're going to kill two birds with one stone; Packleader Kargora is the one who stole your blueprints.

Title: A Choice to Make
Objective: Use the Drafting Table to choose between the construction of a Corral or a Tankworks.
Text: We're just about ready to go here. All that's needed now is for you to make your choice. Take a look at the blueprints on the drafting table. Are we going to construct a corral or a tankworks?

Title: Thunderlord Invasion!
Objective: Speak with Legionaire Grimjaw in your garrison.
Text: Sir! Scouts have spotted Thunderlords approaching from the east. The men are armed and ready. We'll mount defensive positions as soon as you take the field.

Title: The Shadowmoon Clan
Objective: Slay 10 Shadowmoon Orcs or Void Wolves within the Umbral Halls.
Text: We will protect the wounded prisoners and make sure Kargath doesn't get through the rubble. You go ahead and clear the cave.

Title: Yrel
Objective: Escort Yrel to safety.
Text: Forgive me if I'm a bit flustered - I've never killed anyone before. My name is Yrel, and I am a student of Karabor. You say you have an ARMY with you? The Light must truly be watching over me today. I will follow you, then. Lead the way.

Title: Masters of Shadow
Objective: Slay Ungra, Taskmaster Gurran, and Ankova the Fallen.
Text: The bad orcs tried to catch me, but I snuck away. I'm good at hiding. All of the bad orcs are bad, but I've remembered the names of the meanest ones, just in case anybody came to save me.  Ungra, Gurran, and... umm... oh! Ankova. Will you protect me from them?

Title: We Be Needin' Supplies
Objective: Speak with Shadow Hunter Rala at Darkspear's Edge.
Text: Commander, our forces are not prepared for frost fightin'. I took da liberty and sent some of our shadow hunters north to establish a supply base. Ya might want to be headin' up dere and see what they be up to. Look for a hollow between the Crackling Plains and the Savage Crag.

Title: Nullin' Void
Objective: Close 10 Shadowmoon Portals by using the Rune of Endless Ravening near them.
Text: If I'm reading their spells correctly, it seems that these Shadowmoon orcs are opening portals to bring prisoners here to the slave camps. Brilliant magic, really. Unfortunately, it is easily nullified.  This rune will deal with their void magic. Activate it near their portals, and they will instantly be nullified.

Title: Blood Oath of Na'Shra
Objective: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
Text: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine. I offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces. Will you accept it?

Title: Blood Oath of Lokra
Objective: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
Text: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine. I offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces. Will you accept it?

Title: Durotan Been Askin' For Ya
Objective: Speak with Durotan at your Garrison
Text: Durotan been askin' for ya, mon.

Title: Operation: Just Arrowhead
Objective: Kill 15 Warsong forces at Telaar.
Text: It goes without saying that the Warsong in Telaar need to be dealt with. Rangari Ogir and his forces on the overlook will help you kill any of the orcs that are out in the open. You just start the fight, and they'll end it with extreme prejudice.

Title: Seek Out the Seer
Objective: Speak to Seer Malune on Duskfall Island in Talador.
Text: We've been watching you. Seer Malune, keeper of memories, has requested an audience with you, adventurer. She has long foretold the coming of a great hero to destroy the lurking shadow. We believe you are that hero. Come to Duskfall Island, not far southeast of here, and fulfill your destiny.

Title: Operation: Just Arrowhead
Objective: Kill 15 Warsong forces at Telaar.
Text: It goes without saying that we'll help you kill any of the Warsong out in the open down there. You just start the fight, and we'll end it with extreme prejudice.

Title: ... and My Hammer
Objective: Retrieve Mo'mor's Holy Hammer.
Text: When they captured me, the Warsong took my hammer. Will you help me to recover it? I ask only because it's a holy relic. It should be taken from these orc dogs for no other reason than to return it to Auchindoun. Perhaps then, a worthy vindicator of the Light will take it up to smite the enemies of the draenei.

Title: The Others
Objective: Rescue Arbiter Khan, Caregiver Felaani & Isel, and Hansel Heavyhands.
Text: There are yet a few survivors. I saw them pile onto Arbiter Khan during the fighting. More importantly, I can hear little Isel's sobs. She's nearby. I hope her mother is still alive. Your dwarf friend, Hansel, came in to try to rescue us. He thought he could take the Warsong on his own. I'm afraid I don't know what happened to him.

Title: Due Cause to Celebrate
Objective: Speak to Magister Serena at Fort Wrynn.
Text: Shall we return to your outpost? It would be a much better - and safer - place to celebrate. I'll teleport us there.

Title: Every Bit Counts
Objective: Speak to Ageilaa at the Jorune Mine in Talador.
Text: Manduil Skycaller was sent on a sensitive mission to Jorune Mine, but he hasn't returned for hours. I suspect he requires assistance. I will let him brief you on the situation when you find him, but he is likely deep within the mine. You should report to Ageilaa, a local draenei miner who has agreed to cooperate with us in exchange for helping her regain control of the mine.

Title: Mo'mor Might Know
Objective: Find Vindicator Mo'mor in Telaar.
Text: We know the Warsong packleader that attacked the caravan is in Telaar. She has the blueprints. We don't know where she is down there, but there's one who might. Vindicator Mo'mor was last seen alive, but taken prisoner. If he's still alive, he might know where the blueprints are.

Title: Due Cause to Celebrate
Objective: Speak to Magister Krelas at Vol'jin's Pride.
Text: This isn't exactly my idea of the best place to talk. Shall we return to your outpost? It will be a much better place to celebrate. I'll teleport us there.

Title: Vignette: Jehil the Climber
Objective: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.
Text: Goren are dangerous, especially in large numbers, and especially when we have a blind, under powered shaman with us. Fortunately, they have very short lifespans. Unfortunately, they multiply fast and grow faster. If we are going to do this we need to find the brood mother. Slaying her and her eggs should slow down the onslaught of goren. Check the burrows near the Forge Gates and I will to keep them off of Drek'Thar's scent.

Title: Every Bit Counts
Objective: Speak to Ageilaa at the Jorune Mine in Talador.
Text: The Jorune Mine, west of here, needs your help! My good friend Ageilaa sent me to look for help. Exarch Maladaar sent over what vindicators he could spare, but it isn't enough! Will you go to the mine and help us? We need the crystals from the mine to create more defenses like the crystals you see on the Burning Front.

Title: A Rediscovered Legend
Objective: Find Gladiator Akaani near Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.
Text: This Sparring Arena is a good start, but we will need trainers to help mold your forces into worthy fighters. There has been a reported spotting of a draenei to the west who matches the description of Akaani. This is interesting, as we all believed her dead. She was one of the finest warriors the draenei have ever fielded and a master of nearly any weapon forged or found. Commander, you could not ask for a more skilled trainer. I advise seeking her out, if it is really her...

Title: Come Together
Objective: Speak to Knight-Lord Dranarus at Vol'jin's Pride.
Text: Your work is done here. I will stay here for now and help clean up any remaining demons. You should return to your outpost and let Dranarus know of our success. He can relay that information to Azeroth.

Title: Come Together
Objective: Speak to Vindicator Icia at Fort Wrynn.
Text: Gul'dan and his cronies would do well to remember this day. We Auchenai are not to be trifled with. You should inform Vindicator Icia in your outpost of our success. She can reach out to the scattered refugees and their families.

Title: Speaker for the Dead
Objective: Speak to Exarch Maladaar at the Burning Front in Talador.
Text: Oh, praise the Light, you're here! Exarch Maladaar asked for me to find you. We need your help. Auchindoun is under attack by demons! Go to the Burning Front to the southwest as soon as possible! You're one of the few people he trusts to help lead the defense.

Title: Krav'ogra
Objective: Slay Slavemaster Ok'mok by using the Challenge Gong in Stonemaul Arena.
Text: Stonemaul has chieftain, and it has slavemaster. Today, we kill both. First, Slavemaster Ok'mok. Me fight in arenas since me your size. Me know cruelty. Slavemaster Ok'mok is cruelty. Want to be true gladiator? Go to Stonemaul Arena, bang challenge gong in center of arena, and face beasts of slavemaster. Maybe you make Ok'mok so mad he jump down himself to kill you. If he do, kill him instead.

Title: The Axe of Kor'gall
Objective: Kill Kor'gall and retrieve his axe, Serathil.
Text: Time for vengeance! We are going to kill Kor'gall and you are going to take his axe. Shatter this feeble barrier, follow the bridge beyond until you reach the chieftain's throne. You freed us, so the honor of first blood is yours. Strike the first blow and we will join you in the cutting.

Title: Nazgrel
Objective: Rescue Nazgrel.
Text: Escaping Stonemaul was the easy part. The ogre filth that rule the pits still have my son. For a while they used him as leverage to ensure I would fight in their arenas. But now that I have escaped they will try to train him to replace me. Please, rescue my son. If they see me they will kill him instantly.

Title: Slave Hunters
Objective: Collect the Pendants of Brol, Krag, and Mol.
Text: Anytime a gladiator escapes Stonemaul, they send their hardened slave hunters after us. I consider myself a capable warrior, years of surviving in an arena have taught me that. But these slave hunters keep pendants magically tethered to the slaves. With these pendants they can track us down anywhere we go, and kill us in our sleep or when our guard is down. I have no right to ask this, but can you enter Stonemaul and retrieve these pendants?

Title: The Lady of Light
Objective: Speak to Lady Liadrin at the Burning Front in Talador.
Text: , yes? You are the one in charge here? I am Knight-Lord Dranarus, at your service. Lady Liadrin has responded to a suspected demon presence near Auchindoun, southwest of here. She has asked specifically for your assistance in ensuring Auchindoun does not fall into Gul'dan's hands. If you could set forth at your nearest convenience, I am sure the Lady would be most grateful.

Title: Getting Gladiators
Objective: Rescue gladiators Bruto, Y'kish, and Pitfighter Vaandaam.
Text: When we fled Stonemaul, we had to leave others behind. If we try to rescue them and are recognized, the ogres will know our purpose, and the first thing they will do is kill our friends. The ogres do not know you, which might give you a fighting chance. Enter Stonemaul, find the other gladiators, and release them from their bonds. Do this and you will have our loyalty.

Title: Just the Beginning
Objective: Speak to Durotan in Talador.
Text: I forgive Orgrim. He acted as well all must - we do what our hearts tell us is right. We should return to your outpost and discuss our next course of action. There is nothing left for us here. I will ask the human to open a portal for us. We shall speak again there.

Title: Invasion Quest
Objective: xxxxxxx
Text: xxxxx

Title: Profession Quest
Objective: Construct a profession building.
Text: We have cleared out quite a bit of land, commander. We should continue to fortify the garrison. Speak with Baros again, he will help you construct your choice of profession buildings.

Title: A Rediscovered Legend
Objective: Find Kash'drakor near the Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.
Text: If your troops are going to learn to fight people you better get people to fight! And they better be good. Ever hear of Kash'drakor? He's a big famous Frostwolf orc warrior type that tried to kill us Skulls. He would have won too, if the ogres hadn't snatched him. To the north is the Stonemaul Arena where they took him and a bunch of other big bad mean fighter gladiators. If you can find a way to free them, they could be the best trainers you could hope for.

Title: Delegating on Draenor
Objective: Use the Command Table to send Qiana Moonshadow on a mission.
Text: There is more work to do on Draenor than we can possibly handle by ourselves. We need to start delegating. A group of night elves need a champion at Starfall Outpost. Qiana is a perfect fit for this mission.

Title: One Step Ahead
Objective: Speak to Vindicator Maraad in Talador.
Text: Commander, Vindicator Maraad took Yrel and Thaelin Darkanvil just up to the road from here to track the Iron Horde's forces in the forest. They are already at work formulating a strategy to stop their operations. They await your arrival on the cliffs to the northwest.

Title: One Step Ahead
Objective: Speak to Durotan in Talador.
Text: Boss, Durotan set off with Draka and Gazlowe to track da Iron Horde's movements along da coast. Dey waitin' for ya on the cliffs to da northwest.

Title: Just the Beginning
Objective: Speak to Yrel in Talador.
Text: It... is over. We should return to your outpost and discuss our next course of action. There are innocent people in danger across all of Talador that need our help. I will have Khadgar open a portal for us. Let us save our words for now.

Title: As the Smoke Rises
Objective: Find Crystal-Shaper Barum near Aruuna in Talador.
Text: Aruuna burns. The arakkoa swooped down from their spires and are turning everything to ash. Draenei, talbuk, even orc; they care not for allegiances. They merely want to watch the world burn. I barely escaped with my life, but my best friend, Barum, stayed behind to find his daughter. The others all say you are a great champion. Please, I beg of you, go to Aruuna and find them.

Title: It's a Matter of Strategy
Objective: Speak to Bron Skyhorn to secure a flight to Talador.
Text: Da Iron Horde have proved themselves worthy foes. They managed to get their fleet movin' to Talador from Gorgrond without my spies seein' a thing. Talador be a crossroads for the whole continent. We can't let them have it. Don't worry boss, we got a plan. Foreman Grobash be settin' up an outpost for our forces as we speak. They be ready for you when you arrive, commander.

Title: Operation: Surprise Party
Objective: Use Thaelin's Copter to get up to the Rangari Overlook.
Text: There weren't many survivors of the Warsong attack. The few remaining rangari have gone up to one of the bluffs overlooking Telaar. The rangari are waiting for you. They're planning a surprise counter-attack. My copter's taken a beating. The auto-pilot's set to take you up there. I think she's got one last trip in her. Maybe.

Title: Up and Running
Objective: Collect the Assorted Engineering Parts, Prop Rotor, and Transmission Flywheel.
Text: The Warsong struck us hard. We lost Telaar, but we have a rare opportunity to strike at the heart of the Warsong. We need your wisdom and leadership to pull it off. First though, we're going to get our survivors out of Telaar. My rangari are ready to strike. We just need to get you to them. Thaelin has a copter that can get you to them. Unfortunately, his hands are full just trying to keep the infernal thing running. Help him get it up and running?

Title: The Critical Path
Objective: Speak to Dungar Longdrink to secure a flight to Talador.
Text: The auburn forests of Talador sit at a critical crossroads of this continent, commander. The Iron Horde's fleet is already en route from Gorgrond to Shattrath on the west coast. Talador will fall if we don't reinforce them. I took the liberty of dispatching Foreman Eksos, who has already begun construction on an outpost for your forces not far from the Iron Horde landing point. He awaits your orders sir.

Title: The Rise of Aku'mai
Objective: Kill Aku'mai the Devourer
Text: We barely escaped the Twilight's Hammer sacrificial altar, but there are others who need help deeper within these caves. If these cultists complete their blood ritual, they will unleash Aku'mai the Devourer onto the world. You cannot let this happen.

Title: The Might of the Warsong
Objective: Speak with Rangari D'kaan at Telaari Station.
Text: The Warsong. Surprise attack. Headed... west.  They took the... blueprints....

Title: The Rise of Aku'mai
Objective: Kill Aku'mai the Devourer
Text: We barely escaped de Twilight's Hammer sacrificial altar, but others be needin' help deeper in. If de blood ritual be complete, they be unleashin' Aku'mai da Devourer. Don let this be happenin', mon.

Title: Taking the Fight to Nagrand
Objective: Speak with Lieutenant Balfor at the caravan in Nagrand.
Text: **Eyes Only -- Commander **With the fall of the rangari base at Telaar, Vindicator Yrel, recommended we establish a new foothold in Nagrand.I've taken the liberty of dispatching some of our men and supplies. Rangari D'kaan's already reporting that a new outpost is nearly complete. He has indicated that they are ready to receive you.A gryphon is waiting to catch you up with the latest caravan shipment whenever you're ready.-- Bodrick Grey, SI:7

Title: Gather Lumber
Objective: xxxxxx
Text: xxxxxx

Title: The Drudgeboat
Objective: Bring the Drudgeboat Schedule to Khadgar.

Title: Professional Processing
Objective: Learn a Profession Building Blueprint from Gazlowe and then have Rezlak begin construction of the building.
Text: Hey boss! We got ourselves quite a lot of raw materials ripe for some professional processing... if you know what I mean. Time to get us a building that can help put those materials to good, weaponizing use. I got a few extra plans we might be able to use to get you started, but you gotta' pick which one to make. Once you choose, talk to Rezlak and get construction started on it.

Title: Ring of Trials: Roakk the Zealot
Objective: Defeat Roakk in the Ring of Trials.
Text: The final match is at hand! You've decimated all of the best challengers! There's nowhere to go from here but the very top...the reigning champion of the Ring of Trials! The current champ is an arakkoa named Roakk the Zealot. Roakk is a lunatic! He says he's on some divine crusade for the sun or something. Crazy or not, he's one of the most dangerous fighters I've ever seen and has even fought in the Highmaul Coliseum! I'm not going to lie, you're probably going to die in there...good luck!

Title: Ring of Trials: Captain Boomspark
Objective: Defeat Captain Boomspark in the Ring of Trials.
Text: You've been making a name for yourself in the arena! Don't get too excited though...fame has its consequences! You've been challenged by an up-and-coming gladiator who is looking to make a name for himself, sound familiar? Your next fight is against Captain Boomspark, a mercenary who came here to fight for the Iron Horde. The Iron Horde ain't exactly throwing piles of gold around, so now he's here! He's got a shredder, so watch out for the blades... and the fire too... especially the fire!

Title: Ring of Trials: Crushmaul
Objective: Defeat Crushmaul in the Ring of Trials.
Text: So you want to fight in the Ring of Trials do you? It's your funeral, bub! Your first fight is against an exceptionally large and angry ogre named Crushmaul. That's not all though, you'll have to take out his armored boar companion too; Crushmaul never goes into the ring without him! I hope your affairs are in order, because the last gladiator that fought Crushmaul went home in a body bag... I'm counting on you! Get your ass inside the arena and speak with my associate Guzrug to start the fight!

Title: Ring of Trials: Hol'yelaa
Objective: Defeat Hol'yelaa in the Ring of Trials.
Text: You won your first two fights, but it's only going to get tougher from here! Your next fight is against Hol'yelaa, a former rangari who is as crazy as they come. No, really...
