Hol'yelaa is bonkers! Years ago, while on a scouting mission, he single handedly saved his entire rangari unit from a pack of Garn. But something inside of him snapped.... It wasn't long before Hol'yelaa went completely marbles and turned on his own unit! Alright, the pep talk is over! Get in there and kick some ass!

Title: The Crone
Objective: Speak the password to Ornekka at Crow's Crook.
Text: Do you remember our greeting? "Shadows gather when the raven swallows the day." It is more than an old verse - it is a call to action. Followers of the old ways are gathering, and I must join them. You are needed, too, I should think Follow this road down to Crow's Crook. There you will find the home of an old crone. Greet her as you greeted me, and she will guide the way. You will not see me, but I will be close behind.

Title: Adherents of the Sun God
Objective: Slay 8 Adherent Bladewings.
Text: The arakkoa from Skyreach are all ruled by the Adherents of Rukhmar. They revile those of us who bear the Curse of Sethe, and decree that we must be purged in the name of their sun god. Soon their gaze will turn to lands beyond Arak. Challenge their warriors. Buy me time to prepare my escape, and help me set into motion their downfall.

Title: Ring of Trials: Raketalon
Objective: Defeat Raketalon in the Ring of Trials.
Text: You may have defeated Crushmaul, but the party's over now...you've got another fight! The Highmaul take gladiatin' seriously; so when they built the Ring of Trials, they searched far and wide for the most brutal creatures they could find! You're up against a dread raven the ogres are calling Raketalon! I'm telling you, something about that bird just ain't right...I think it truly enjoys the act of killing! Raketalon toyed with the last gladiator for hours before eating him. Try not to die!

Title: Hidden in Plain Sight
Objective: Retrieve the Weathered Wingblades and Ragged Mask.
Text: I thought I would have more time to prepare! There are powerful relics hidden out there in Skettis - if I leave without them, I may as well have died. The first is a pair of wingblades being held by an effigy near the front gate. You likely walked right past them on your way in. Another effigy on the east side of the ruins bears a white mask over its face. Bring those relics to me, and their secrets shall be yours.

Title: The Shadows of Skettis
Objective: Speak the password to Reshad in Skettis.
Text: My people flee our homeland in droves. I sell trinkets to ease the journey. But I see that you are not interested in trinkets... No, what you seek are answers. Skettis lies just ahead. Once a great city built by Terokk as a refuge for the unwanted. Now a ruined slum. An old storyteller lives there - a scrollkeeper named Reshad. Find him and speak these words: "Shadows gather." He will know you are a friend. Now go. Your presence is bad for business.

Title: Arakkoa Exodus
Objective: Speak with Azik in Spires of Arak.
Text: I assume you're familiar with the arakkoa, commander? Great, flying birdfolk. Extremely territorial.Some, however, have withered wings - a disease, maybe. They seem to be outcast from arakkoa society. You find them now and then, squatting in forgotten ruins or peddling trinkets on the roadside.It seems the Iron Horde has incited the arakkoa by moving into their lands, and the outcasts are fleeing in droves.We should make contact with these outcasts - they could have valuable information.

Title: Orders From On High
Objective: Loot the Adherent Proclamation from Sun-Sage Rathyx.
Text: The Adherents of Rukhmar are the ruling body atop the spires. Their influence is absolute. Their proclamations taken as the will of Rukhmar Herself. The herald leading this purge is surely carrying out such orders - likely no more than a list of names and places they plan to erase. That list would prove invaluable in the days to come. Acquire it for me, and shut that herald up!

Title: Qiana Moonshadow
Objective: Speak with Qiana Moonshadow.
Text: If we are to win this war we are going to need more than foot soldiers. We need champions. Qiana Moonshadow's performance in Tanaan and Eventide Landing was quite impressive. Perhaps you should speak with her about taking on a greater role in the battle against the Iron Horde.

Title: Gathering the Spark
Objective: Harvest 3 Arcane Vortexes in Zangarra.
Text: We need to get our hands on arcane energy to complete our scroll. It needs that fiery kick. I have a device capable of capturing energy in the space below, so let's get moving. The infused creatures shouldn't be an issue for the two of us.

Title: Doorway to Draenor
Objective: Speak with Khadgar.
Text: I can only maintain a portal from Azeroth for so long. I'll bring through as many champions as I can, but it will not be easy.

Title: Open the Portal
Objective: xxxxx
Text: xxxxxx

Title: Creating the Ink
Objective: Gather 30 Pulsating Pustules from Sporebats and Fungal Giants in Zangarra.
Text: We're going to need a way to create an artificial nexus at your tower. I know where we can get what we need, but it's heavily protected. We don't have the firepower to just waltz in the front door. I have a plan - a scroll of mass teleportation. The fungal giants and spore creatures down below are covered in pustules filled with an oily substance. If we gather enough of the oil I can craft a makeshift ink substitute for the scroll.

Title: An Audience With The Archmage
Objective: Speak to Archmage Khadgar in Talador.
Text: I'm pleased to report that your Arcane Sanctum is up and running, commander! Everything is exactly as the blueprint says... except for this note Baros scrawled on the bottom. "Don't forget to connect the sanctum to the ley line network!" Commander, I'm a foreman, not a mage. I... have absolutely no idea how to do that. We've found Archmage Khadgar and some other Kirin Tor not far from here. To the east, near the mountains. Perhaps we should ask them for a hand?

Title: Gathering the Spark
Objective: Harvest 3 Arcane Vortexes in Zangarra.
Text: We need arcane energy to complete our scroll. It needs that to coalesce the scroll together. I have an artifact that can capture energy vortexes in the caldera below, so let's get moving.

Title: An Audience With The Archmage
Objective: Speak to Archmage Khadgar in Talador.
Text: Your Arcane Sanctum is coming along nicely, commander. Everything's built to spec... except for one detail Gazlowe scrawled in at the bottom of the blueprint. "Don't forget to connect the sanctum to the ley line network!" I, uh... I have no idea how to do that. I'm sorry commander, but magic just isn't my thing. We did spot Archmage Khadgar and some Kirin Tor not far from here. To the east, up near the mountains. Maybe we should ask them for help?

Title: Creating the Ink
Objective: Gather 30 Pulsating Pustules from Sporebats and Fungal Giants in Zangarra.
Text: We need a way to create an artificial nexus at your tower. I know where we can get the conduit to do that, but it's well-guarded. We need to keep our cool and do this the right way. I have a plan - a scroll of mass teleportation. The fungal giants and shamblers down below are covered with pustules full of an oily substance. We can use the oil to craft a makeshift ink substitute for the scroll.

Title: Forming the Scroll
Objective: Rip 3 Pieces of Bark off of Slumbering Ancients in Zangarra.
Text: We'll need arcane parchment to make the scroll. The arcane energy everywhere at this nexus froze the ancients in place and settled in their bark. If we take pieces from the few that haven't been destroyed by the fungal creatures, I can mold them into parchment.

Title: Forming the Scroll
Objective: Rip 3 Pieces of Bark off of Slumbering Ancients in Zangarra.
Text: For this plan to work, we'll need infused parchment. The latent arcane energy at this nexus quickly froze the ancients in place and settled in their bark. If we rip off strips from the few that haven't been destroyed by the fungal creatures, I can form them into parchment.

Title: Gas Guzzlers
Objective: Obtain 6 samples of Goren Gas from Glowgullet Shardshedders and Glowgullet Devourers within Kuuro's Claim.
Text: To complete my master's designs and to stock up the artillery tower we need to use an exotic resource, namely goren gut gas. The nearby mine at Kuuro's Claim just came down with an infestation of the things. Could you collect a few samples for me? The stuff is concentrated, so only a few are needed. Just kill one and give its body a good prod with this gas extractor.

Title: Ravenous Ravens
Objective: Kill 6 Lunarfall Ravens.
Text: Do you see that? There is a gigantic raven just past the tree line. I'm not getting anywhere near that. In fact, I'm not sure any of the men are sufficiently equipped to deal with a threat like that. Do you want to handle this one yourself, commander? Once those ravens are gone we can start sending more troops into the woods. So we will be killing two birds with one stone... or should I say kill five birds with...  You get the point.

Title: The Missing Caravan
Objective: Find the missing trade shipment.
Text: I've got a problem and you look like you're just the  for the job! A trade shipment was supposed to arrive yesterday, but it's nowhere to be found. I'm running low on merchandise here and I need somebody to go find out what happened! If I were to guess, I'd say the saberon are probably involved. Those brutes have been a pain in our side ever since we got here! Search for the wagon on the road near Sabermaw and hurry! Time is money!

Title: Obtaining Ogre Offensive Orders
Objective: Collect Crulgorosh's Orders and Thulgork's Orders at Mar'gok's Overwatch.
Text: My sister, Mirana, is scouting the upper bluff while I've checked out the lower area. There are two particular ogre mages that do a lot of bossing around in the lower area. They seem to have some orders or scrolls on them that would help us figure out what's really going on. Collect that information and meet with my sister on the long stairway up there.

Title: Removing the Paper Trail
Objective: Destroy 8 Boxes of Ogre Research at Mar'gok's Overwatch.
Text: This box is filled with writings and diagrams that oddly resemble research into the nullification of magic. It would be best to ruin these efforts by destroying any research found.

Title: Clearing out the Shadows
Objective: xxxxxx
Text: xxxxxx

Title: Reglakk's Research
Objective: Stop Grand Magister Reglakk.
Text: These ogres have been using ancient Titan artifacts to empower a small cadre of specialized units called the Breakers. This Magister Reglakk is here studying ways to improve the process. Let's put a stop to whatever rituals he has going up on the bluff.

Title: Kill Goren
Objective: xxxxxx
Text: xxxxxx

Title: A Gronnling Problem
Objective: Kill 8 Frostfire Gronnlings.
Text: It's gonna be quite a task to build you a fortress if there's gronnlings rampaging around.I don't think anyone else here can handle taking those big beasts out, so you might need to take care of it yourself.

Title: Looking for Lumber
Objective: Mark 8 trees.
Text: Some of the trees around here look small enough that the workers should be able to down them in no time. We can leave the hard labor to Shelly's men, but if you'd be willing to mark the trees for them to start with, we should be able to get this operation rolling much faster.

Title: Establish Your Garrison
Objective: Build your garrison.
Text: I'm impressed with how quickly you have pulled this group together, commander. I think it's time we start putting up some walls and establishing a firm perimeter around our base.

Title: For the Alliance!
Objective: Plant the Alliance banner.
Text: We wouldn't have survived Tanaan without your strength. Many draenei and Alliance alike owe you a great debt. Before we departed for the Dark Portal, King Wrynn personally recommended that I place you in charge of our operations here in Draenor. After seeing you in action, I'm inclined to agree. This is your garrison to found. Plant the banner and we'll begin construction immediately, commander.

Title: The Bounty of Bladespire
Objective: Speak with Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge
Text: The sacking of this fortress is as much your victory as ours. It is only fair you should share in the bounty. I will have resources set aside as we find them. All you need do is report to your garrison and have them dispatch peons to collect these materials.

Title: Build Your Barracks
Objective: Find the blueprints, learn the blueprints, and use the Architect Table to build your barracks.
Text: I must say, commander, this garrison has really come along. We have enough materials, all we need now are the blueprints I drafted up and I can begin construction on your barracks. Hmm... now where did I put those blueprints?

Title: Finding a Foothold
Objective: Follow Prophet Velen.
Text: So, you are the one that has led my children home? I have been waiting for you. The Iron Horde grows stronger every day. I have foreseen a great battle, but my visions are clouded. It's as if time is sitting on top of itself. One thing is certain, your presence here is of great importance.

Title: Going to the Gordunni
Objective: Travel to Gordal Fortress and meet up with Miall.
Text: We have a good supply of jovite now but there just isn't enough of the material in the mine to keep the artillery tower in stock for long. Down south of here there's a mountain that's just full of the stuff but there's one problem; Ogres! The Gordunni live on top of that mountain and they have begun trading the jovite to the Iron Horde. We need to go down there and secure the minerals for ourselves. I'll pack some supplies and meet you near their fortress down south.

Title: Quakefist
Objective: Kill Quakefist.
Text: I'm getting reports of a giant in the forest. A few of the Karabor peacekeepers have followed it to a cave. In all honesty I don't think any of our troops are willing to engage the beast. Maybe you could investigate? I'm sure the peacekeepers would appreciate the help.

Title: Gas Guzzlers
Objective: Obtain 6 samples of Goren Gas from Glowgullet Shardshedders and Glowgullet Devourers within Kuuro's Claim.
Text: , to make the best equipment for your arsenal I need not only the best materials, but to use the best techniques. Over the years I've developed a method to greatly strengthen my metal, but it does require an exotic resource: goren gut gas! The nearby mine at Kuuro's Claim just came down with an infestation of the things. Could you collect a few samples for the arsenal supplies? Just kill a few goren and give their bodies a good prod with this gas extractor.

Title: Out of Jovite
Objective: Obtain 12 chunks of Jovite Ore from within Kuuro's Claim.
Text: Crafting good equipment requires the best metal and some of the best metal is the jovite that comes from the mine in Kuuro's Claim, just east of here. In order to supply the arsenal I'm going to need this metal. Unfortunately the place was recently overwhelmed by a pack of goren so you're going to have to fight your way in to get the ore before they manage to devour it. Nothing that should be too much of a problem for you.

Title: Step Three: Prophet!
Objective: Speak with Prophet Velen near the crashed Iron Horde Ship in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: You have arrived in Shadowmoon Valley. It is time to speak with the prophet.

Title: REUSE
Objective: Slay Hurkan Skullsplinter in the Seat of Depravity.
Text: Teron'gor and his master Gul'dan were here! I tried to stop them... they escaped through the demonic gateway behind me before I could finish them! I think I can activate the portal open just long enough for you to enter. We have no way of knowing where it leads, but I fear it may end inside Auchindoun! You have to stop him once and for all!

Title: Obliterating Ogres
Objective: Kill 15 ogres at Mar'gok's Overwatch.
Text: With actual ogre mages present, the Highmaul have been increasing patrols and aggression. Thinning their ranks will go a long way to deterring the Highmaul from making a comeback in Nagrand. Head up to my sister Mirana afterwards, she should have more news.

Title: The Quarry Quandary
Objective: Obtain Morketh Bladehowl's assistance.
Text: Now that our arsenal is built we need a skilled smith to operate it. We recently caught an Iron Horde deserter who claims he used to be one of the Blackrock's best iron workers. Normally I'd ignore the ravings of a captive, but the weapons we took out of his pack had the finest workmanship I've ever seen. Commander, I think we should see if he's as good as he claims.

Title: Out of Jovite
Objective: Obtain 12 chunks of Jovite Ore from within Kuuro's Claim.
Text: Ared and I came this way because we needed a good supply of metal to build his designs and some of the best metal is the jovite that comes from the mine in Kuuro's Claim. In order to supply the artillery tower I'm going to need this metal. Unfortunately that place was recently overwhelmed by a pack of goren, so you're going to have to fight your way in to get the ore before they manage to devour it. Nothing that should be too much of a problem for you.

Title: Iridium Recovery
Objective: Gather 8 Iridium Dust from Iridium Geodes in Kuuro's Claim.
Text: My goods used to be for the very best, now the Iron Horde make copies out of poor metal and give them to everyone. I'm going to show them what a real smith can do in your arsenal, but first I'm going to need a powerful flux to make the metal as pure as it can get. The dust from crushed iridium geodes would work in a pinch but we need to find some first. They tend to congregate underground, so check out the mine in Kuuro's Claim nearby.

Title: Iridium Recovery
Objective: Gather 8 Iridium Dust from Iridium Geodes in Kuuro's Claim.
Text: Ared used to always teach me that the purity of the metal is key. If the metal isn't pure it will crack under stress and be of no use to anyone. For the artillery tower to function I'll need to make metal as pure as my master would, and for that I need a strong flux. The dust from crushed iridium geodes would work in a pinch, but we need to find some first. They tend to congregate underground, so check out the mine in Kuuro's Claim nearby.

Title: Tearing Up Talador
Objective: Commander, we have a bit of a problem.
Text: Commander, we have a bit of a problem. We found a location in Talador to set up an outpost but the team that was sent to begin construction have been arguing with each other on what to build. This situation could really put a setback in our plans unless it's dealt with swiftly. Take a gryphon to Talador and speak with Foreman Eksos before this gets any worse.

Title: Destination: Unknown
Objective: Destroy Mongrethod in the Remains of Xandros.
Text: Teron'gor and Gul'dan were just leaving through the portal as I arrived... and I... I know I won't be able to defeat them. I'll hold open the portal as long as I can. It will be up to you to strike the killing blow. Our fate is in your hands.

Title: At Your Command
Objective: Inspect the Drafting Table and choose which outpost structure to construct.
Text: Commander, the outpost is nearly fully operational. Gazlowe provided us with two different blueprints to fill this final plot - an Arsenal or an Arcane Sanctum. Either one would provide us with the additional firepower we need to stop the Iron Horde's advance. The plans are on the drafting table. It's your call.

Title: The Quarry Quandary
Objective: Speak to Apprentice Miall just outside of Fort Wrynn in Talador.
Text: Now that we have the artillery tower built, we're going to need some skilled hands to run it. I've heard that Ared, one of the best smiths in Shattrath, managed to escape the city's fall. He should be just outside the north wall with the rest of the refugees. See if you can convince him to work for us.

Title: Vignette: Yaga the Scarred
Objective: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.
Text: Goren are dangerous, especially in large numbers, and especially when we have a blind, under powered shaman with us. Fortunately, they have very short lifespans. Unfortunately, they multiply fast and grow faster. If we are going to do this we need to find the brood mother. Slaying her and her eggs should slow down the onslaught of goren. Check the burrows near the Forge Gates and I will to keep them off of Drek'Thar's scent.

Title: At Your Command
Objective: Choose which outpost structure to construct.
Text: I'm glad you're here! Fort Wrynn is nearly complete. We only need to fill this last plot. Baros provided us with blueprints for two different structures that would fit this space - an Artillery Tower or an Arcane Sanctum. It's your call, commander. The plans are on the drafting table for your perusal.

Title: Tearing Up Talador
Objective: Commander, we have a bit of a problem.
Text: Commander, we have a bit of a problem. We found a location in Talador to set up an outpost but the team that was sent to begin construction have been arguing with each other on what to build. This situation could really put a setback in our plans unless it's dealt with swiftly. Take a gryphon to Talador and speak with Foreman Eksos before this gets any worse.

Title: Gobnapped
Objective: Rescue 6 Goblin Traders.
Text: We never even saw the ambush coming... The saberon hit us so hard and fast we barely had time to think. Those overgrown mongrels dragged the others away and left me here for dead...they probably thought I was too close to dying. I hear they like their meat fresh... ....well I ain't going down that easy! Don't worry about me......I've been through worse! You're gonna have to go to Sabermaw and get the other merchants out though. They've probably got 'em all caged up in there...

Title: They've Got The Goods!
Objective: Recover 10 Stolen Goods.
Text: The Saberon...they weren't just after prisoners... ...they took all the merchandise too. Kidnapping is one thing...but stealing a goblin's merchandise? That's making things personal! ...Pyxni ain't going to be happy unless you get all of the stolen goods back. Make your way into Sabermaw and steal back all our merch. When you're done, make your way back to Pyxni at the Ring of Trials. She'll make it worth your while...

Title: My Precious!
Objective: Find Bazwix's stolen treasure.
Text: You've got to help me! I was hiding on the trade wagon that got ambushed just down the road from here. I snuck away before the saberon spotted me...but...but... THEY STOLE MY MOST PRIZED POSSESSION! You've got to help me get it back! I watched them drag it into Sabermaw and up that giant hill! Who knows what those filthy saberon will do to it! Please, I'm just a kid! You've got to help me out, right?

Title: Declawing The Competition
Objective: Collect 10 Saberon Claws.
Text: These saberon freaks have cost me a lot of money. I'm not one to forgive a debt and it's time to collect! The saberon that have been causing us the most trouble are the ones living in Sabermaw. They keep ambushing our trade shipments along the road.  It's time to declaw the competition. Bring me their claws; we'll sell the best ones as good luck charms here at the arena. If the claw sales don't cover their debt, we'll just have to charge them an arm and a leg too!

Title: WANTED: Razorpaw!
Objective: Defeat Razorpaw.
Text: Wanted for crimes against the innocent at the Ring of Trials! Razorpaw is responsible for leading several raids and ambushes against travelers on the road near Sabermaw. Last seen in the vicinity of the saberon den known as Sabermaw. Exercise extreme caution! Upon completion, this bounty will be fulfilled by Pyxni Pennypocket of the Steamwheedle Cartel.

Title: Into the Jaws of the Jungle
Objective: Move further into Heartblood.
Text: We've freed enough prisoners that I feel we're strong enough to move forward as a group. We cannot stay here long - Grommash Hellscream will be on our tail soon enough. Let me know when you're ready, and we'll press on.

Title: Restalaan, Captain of the Guard
Objective: Find Restalaan in Telmor.
Text: They killed Aedraa and took the crystal from her! The captain of the guard, Restalaan, tried to stop them and they took him into the cathedral! If we can just get this crystal, we can reunite the Heart of Auchindoun and turn its defenses on fully! We can't afford to fail now. , you're the only one left that can do it. You have to find Restalaan! He'll know where they took it.

Title: A Potential Ally
Objective: Use the Frostflurry Focus near the ring of fire in Kargathar Proving Grounds to free Exarch Maladaar.
Text: One of the captured draenei is receiving some... preferential treatment, if you can call it that. While others are tied down and tortured, this one is tied to a stake and burned for the orcs' amusement. Use this runestone. It should handily deal with the ring of fire that surrounds this draenei.

Title: Follow Spirit
Objective: xxxxx
Text: xxxx

Title: Temporal Juxtaposition
Objective: Wait for Zooti Fizzlefury's temporal ritual to complete.
Text: I think I figured out what those mysterious artifacts you collected were for. It would seem someone is attempting to affect a temporal shift by sending items back into this timeline from your own timeline. Technically that shouldn't be possible. But whoever this is found a way. I think I may try a ritual to bring the traveler through.

Title: Garrison Invasion!
Objective: Speak with Sergeant Grizzleface in your garrison.
Text: Your garrison is under attack! Use this magic device to get back there and defend it!

Title: Mysterious Hat
Objective: Bring the Mysterious Hat to Zooti Fizzlefury at Khadgar's Tower in Talador.
Text: Energy flows from this mystical hat with an unseen strength. It hums as it drifts back and forward in time where it rests on the ground. This is the sort of object that someone at Khadgar's Tower would find very interesting.

Title: Mysterious Boots
Objective: Bring the Mysterious Boots to Zooti Fizzlefury at Khadgar's Tower in Talador.
Text: Phasing back and forward in time, these flickering ornate boots are adorned with a lavish "V" on them. Someone at Khadgar's Tower might have insights to the nature of these strange items.

Title: Cleansing the Souls
Objective: Cleanse 10 Crazed Souls.
Text: Not all spirits are destroyed by the Soulgrinder. Some souls manage to survive more or less intact like myself. Others have become twisted and maddened. End their misery, take my soul shard and use it to purify them. Their rage will blind them to the effects of its energy so you must defeat them before you use it.

Title: Mysterious Ring
Objective: Bring the Mysterious Ring to Zooti Fizzlefury at Khadgar's Tower in Talador.
Text: This elegantly crafted ring is covered in ornate decorations and symbols, the most prominent of which being the letter "V" in a glowing rune. The ring seems to fade in and out of view as if passing back and forth through time. Someone at Khadgar's Tower may have an interest in such an artifact.

Title: Powering the Defenses
Objective: Find Soulbinder Tuulani in the Tomb of Lights.
Text: What few soulpriests we don't have on the front lines are working fervently to maintain Auchindoun's defenses. They aren't going to be able to keep it up much longer alone. Soulbinder Tuulani went inside the nearby Tomb of Lights to retrieve a backup power pylon and hasn't returned. I need you to find her and get her and the pylon back here safely.

Title: Winds of Change
Objective: Rescue Olin Umberhide.
Text: Commander, I have bad news. Olin Umberhide, the tauren who escaped with you from Tanaan, was ambushed when near the eastern perimeter of the Garrison. He was seen being dragged off by the pale. These are dangerous, disturbing creatures that some believe were once orcs. Now they are husks of barely living flesh bent by dark magics. Olin is resourceful, but outnumbered. I would advise travelling east to effect a rescue as soon as possible, before they eat him alive... slowly.

Title: Build Your Barracks
Objective: Find and learn the Garrison Blueprints: Barracks and then use the Architect's Table to build your barracks.
Text: You are going to want to build your barracks, which you're gonna need to properly bash faces.The first step is to go find the blueprints and learn 'em. I think I left some blueprints lying around here somewhere.Next ya gotta pick which plot you want us to build it on. Just point it out on my architect table and we'll get started constructing that thing right away.

Title: Powering the Defenses
Objective: Retrieve the Shard of Souls in the Tomb of Souls.
Text: I know what the Bonechewer are after. Auchindoun is protected by a powerful barrier, which can only be disabled using an ancient key. No being could ever hope to penetrate it. The Auchenai, my people, split the key into three shards long ago and hid each piece outside the mausoleum walls. We guard those shards with the same zeal as Auchindoun itself. Go into the Tomb of Souls and retrieve the key from Soulbinder X. The shards are no longer safe.

Title: Free their Minds
Objective: Use the Rylak Mind Controller on Controlled Rylaks.
Text: This device is what the goblins are using to control the rylaks. There is a button on the controller labeled do not touch. Get within range of a Controlled Rylak and touch the button.

Title: Mind Controlled Rylaks
Objective: xxxxx
Text: xxxxx

Title: Sunsworn Camp
Objective: Meet Lady Liadrin at Sunsworn Camp in Talador.
Text: We no longer have a need to work alongside the Auchenai, champion. I have arranged for their lead soulbinders to continue to advise us, but I believe any action is best left to us at this point. Meet me at Sunsworn Camp, southeast of here. I can sense more demonic taint in the area, and we may be able to track down the remaining power crystal shards at its source.

Title: Kill Thunderlord Master
Objective: xxxxx
Text: xxxxx

Title: Kaelynara Sunchaser
Objective: Confront Kaelynara Sunchaser.
Text: The focusing crystal is complete. When you are ready I will use the crystal to shatter Kaelynara's shield. However, it is unsafe to confront her within the mine. The moment her shield is down I will teleport us to a safe location outside of the Jorune Mine. She will be much easier to deal with when she is far away from the crystal. Speak with me when you are ready to begin.

Title: Light's Rest
Objective: Meet Exarch Maladaar at Light's Rest in Talador.
Text: With the brute force of our enemy neutralized, we must turn our sights on quelling the aftermath and preparing for any future assaults. We still need Auchindoun's defenses reinvigorated. Meet me at Light's Rest, not far south of here. We have reports coming in of demonic taint in the area, and we may be able to track down the remaining power crystal shards at its source.

Title: Mysterious Staff
Objective: Bring the Mysterious Staff to Zooti Fizzlefury at Khadgar's Tower in Talador.
Text: Fluctuations in reality surround this staff so much that it is hard to identify any recognizable markings aside from a large, lavish "V" on its apex. This might require help to identify by someone from Khadgar's Tower.

Title: Rylak Rescue
Objective: Kill Razz Ricketroz at Darktide Roost.
Text: I managed to squeeze even more information out of our little friend here. The Darktide Matriarch is at the top of the hill. One of their lead engineers is attempting to tame the matriarch with his technology. We must stop him.

Title: The Home Stretch
Objective: Get to the docks.
Text: If they weren't angry before, they sure are now. We won't survive a minute up on top o' this tank! Let's join up with the rest and get out of here!!

Title: Kaelynara Sunchaser
Objective: Confront Kaelynara Sunchaser.
Text: The focusing crystal is complete. When you are ready I will use the crystal to shatter Kaelynara's shield. However, it is unsafe to confront her within the mine. The moment her shield is down I will teleport us to a safe location outside of the Jorune Mine. She will be much easier to deal with when she is far away from the crystal. Speak with me when you are ready to begin.

Title: The Fewer, the Merrier
Objective: Slay 12 Blackrock Grunts.
Text: We're vastly outnumbered down here, but at least we have the element of surprise. For now. Every Blackrock orc we slay in this quarry reduces the probability that we will be overwhelmed later. Go, and thin their ranks before they thin ours.

Title: A Taste of Iron
Objective: Enter the Worldbreaker Side Turret and destroy 200 Iron Horde troops.
Text: The way I see it, there's two ways to keep this tank from going through the portal: break the tank, or USE the dang tank ta' BLOW UP the dang portal. I can get 'er workin', I just need time. Hop in that turret off the starboard bow and keep 'em off my back.

Title: Ga'nar of the Frostwolf
Objective: Find Ga'nar.
Text: We must move on, there isn't time to waste! One of the elders of my clan, Ga'nar, is out there somewhere. I can sense him, but I cannot find him. Keep an eye out for Ga'nar. He is a strong-willed orc, and will languish in captivity.

Title: The Battle of the Forge
Objective: Slay 15 Blackrock Orcs and 3 Ogron Warcrushers.
Text: Our troops are armed - the time to strike is now! Strike swift and true!

Title: The Prodigal Frostwolf
Objective: Report to Farseer Drek'Thar at the Blackrock Quarry in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: I can get back to Drek'Thar myself... after I run this stinking shovel through a few Blackrock stomachs.

Title: Keli'dan the Breaker
Objective: Slay Keli'dan the Breaker.
Text: One of Ner'zhul's lieutenants remains, up ahead. The exit to the cave isn't much farther past him. I will go back and tell Khadgar that the cave is clear. We will rendezvous once you've taken care of Keli'dan!

Title: Yrel
Objective: Escort Yrel to safety.
Text: Forgive me if I'm a bit flustered - I've never killed anyone before. My name is Yrel, and I am a student of Karabor. You say you have an ARMY with you? The Light must truly be watching over me today. I will follow you, then. Lead the way.

Title: Kill Your Hundred
Objective: Survive Kargath's Arena.
Text: I see only one way out of this trap, and it's right through the middle of that arena. This might be the end of us.

Title: The Shadowmoon Clan
Objective: Slay 10 Shadowmoon Orcs or Void Wolves within the Umbral Halls.
Text: We will protect the wounded prisoners and make sure Kargath doesn't get through the rubble. You go ahead and clear the cave.

Title: A Potential Ally
Objective: Use the Frostflurry Focus near the ring of fire in Kargathar Proving Grounds to free Farseer Drek'Thar.
Text: One of the captured orcs is receiving some... preferential treatment, if you can call it that. While others are tied down and tortured, this one is tied to a stake and burned for the amusement of his captors. Use this runestone. It should handily deal with the ring of fire that surrounds him.

Title: The Kargathar Proving Grounds
Objective: Follow Khadgar.
Text: The orcs in this area look like members of the Shattered Hand clan. You can tell by looking at their hands. Let's join up with the others. We must find a way out of here.

Title: The Chase is On
Objective: Get to the Kargathar Proving Grounds.
Text: Come on, let's move! Ariok's heroism can only buy us so much time.

Title: Masters of Shadow
Objective: Slay Ungra, Taskmaster Gurran, and Ankova the Fallen.
Text: The bad orcs tried to catch me, but I snuck away. I'm good at hiding. All of the bad orcs are bad, but I've remembered the names of the meanest ones, just in case anybody came to save me.  Ungra, Gurran, and... umm... oh! Ankova. Will you protect me from them?

Title: Bled Dry
Objective: Free the slaves from the 2 Bleeding Hollow Cages in Heartblood.
Text: They kept us in cages. They... drain our blood, for... rituals...  ...many left -- -- my... people...

Title: Altar Altercation
Objective: Speak with Ariok, then help him distract the Eye of Kilrogg.
Text: You see that altar down there? There's a magical eye settled at its peak, and I fear our group will not survive if it sees us. Distract the eye. Cause a commotion, kill some ritualists, whatever you have to do - just occupy that thing long enough for me to guide the rest of our group past its gaze.  Bring that strapping orc with you. The one that's not Thrall.

Title: Holding the Line
Objective: Slay 15 demons in the Burning Front.
Text: Auchindoun is under attack! The Auchenai are valiant warriors in their own right, but they cannot hold against these endless demon hordes alone. We came here to stop the Legion from engulfing Draenor... working together is our best shot. I need you to thin out the demons' numbers so we can regroup our forces safely and push forward into the Burning Front. We will stop their march here and now!

Title: Blaze of Glory
Objective: Use the Lucifrium Bead to destroy 8 Bleeding Hollow huts.
Text: We can't stay here forever. We NEED to keep moving. But first - we need a distraction.  This bead should burn anything flammable that you get close to. With your skill, and a bit of luck, you might be able to take the attention of the Bleeding Hollow orcs off our group.

Title: The Cost of War
Objective: Follow Archmage Khadgar.
Text: They called this operation a suicide mission, but I don't plan on throwing away any lives meaninglessly. Everybody, with me!

Title: An'dure The Giant
Objective: Retrieve the Crystal Giant Heart.
Text: In order to break through Kaelynara's arcane shield, we will need a focusing crystal of rare power and quality. Within the mine is a crystal giant known to the Draenei as An'dure. The giant has slept beneath the rocky earth for ages, but due to Kaelynara's recklessness it has awakened. The heart of a crystal giant is a truly powerful artifact. Defeat An'Dure and return to me with a crystal giant heart. Once I have the heart, I will have everything I need to construct the focusing crystal!

Title: An'dure The Giant
Objective: Retrieve the Crystal Giant Heart.
Text: In order to break through Kaelynara's arcane shield, we will need a focusing crystal of rare power and quality. Within the mine is a crystal giant known to the Draenei as An'dure. The giant has slept far beneath the earth for ages, but due to Kaelynara's recklessness it has awakened. The heart of a crystal giant is a truly powerful artifact. Defeat An'Dure and return to me with a crystal giant heart. When you return I will construct the focusing crystal and together we will stop Kaelynara.

Title: Lumberstruck
Objective: Protect your peasants as they gather 100 lumber.
Text: This box is empty, begging to be filled with wood. Protect your peasants as they gather materials from the region.

Title: Crystals of Unusual Power
Objective: Collect 10 Unrefined Power Crystals.
Text: Arcane crystals of this size and power are quite rare even on Draenor. It is no coincidence that the Draenei built Shattrath and Auchindoun so close to this mine. I am interested in learning more about these particular crystals and their arcane nature. Return to me with any unrefined power crystals that you may find and I will make sure that you are adequately compensated for your effort.

Title: The Beating Heart
Objective: Deliver the Heart of Gorgorek to Morthis Whisperwing at your garrison.
Text: One thing is certain. We now possess an item of great value to the Iron Horde. We had better secure this... "Heart of Gorgorek" at once.

Title: Garrison Campaign: Crows In The Field
Objective: Speak to Thisalee Crow at Skysea Ridge in Gorgrond.
Text: Our druids set up a wide network of scouts to follow up on your intel from Nagrand. We've identified a suspicious Iron Horde excavation near some salt pools on the western coast of Gorgrond. We have reason to believe that these orcs are pursuing a valuable artifact deep in the desert. I'm putting together a small mission for a focused, surgical strike. I'd like you to be part of that team.

Title: Caught In The Chaos
Objective: Rescue 8 Injured Miners.
Text: Not all of the Draenei miners made it out when the chaos erupted. Many of them are injured and still trapped inside the mine. Kaelynara's disruption has caused all hell to break loose. Arcane Wraiths are forming from the unleashed energy and attacking everything they see. The elementals that slumbered beneath the ground are emerging from the rocks frenzied and dangerous. Please find as many injured miners as you can and ensure that they return safely.

Title: Holding the Line
Objective: Slay 15 demons in the Burning Front.
Text: It is good to see you again, champion. Demons are assaulting Auchindoun and we are barely standing our ground against them. We need to push our front lines forward lest our losses reach critical mass. If your blade is with us, shove it into these foul creatures' throats.

Title: Arcane Essence
Objective: Retrieve 6 Arcane Essence.
Text: Kaelynara's lust for arcane power has consumed her and she threatens the safety of all in this mine. She must be stopped. Unfortunately, there is nothing we can do while she shields herself. We will need to find a way to penetrate her shielding spell. Perhaps if I were to build a focusing crystal, I could use it to lower her shield...I'll need you to search the crystal mine for the necessary components. First, I'll need arcane essence from the Crystal Ragers and Arcane Wraiths in the mine.

Title: Arcane Essence
Objective: Retrieve 6 Arcane Essence.
Text: Kaelynara will not stop until she has drained every last drop of arcane energy from the crystal...and destroyed this entire mine in the process. The arcane shield she guards herself with cannot be penetrated by normal means, but I have a plan. If I had a focusing crystal powerful enough to momentarily pierce her shield, Kaelynara could then be dealt with. Fortunately, we are in the perfect place to build one. Start by bringing me arcane essence from the creatures rampaging throughout the mine.

Title: Of Wolves and Warriors
Objective: Ride with Durotan.
Text: The return of many of my people is a boon to us, and I thank you for your part in their survival.Come, ride with me. We have much to discuss.

Title: Frenzied Manafeeders
Objective: Use the Arcane Dissipator on 8 Frenzied Manafeeders.
Text: There is a rare breed of moth in Talador known as the Manafeeder. These moths sustain themselves by feeding on arcane crystal dust from the mine. Typically speaking, these moths are nothing more than an occasional nuisance. However, they are now gorging themselves upon the intense arcane energy flooding out of the mine and have become highly territorial and aggressive. I have attuned this crystal to disperse arcane energy. Please use it on the Frenzied Manafeeders to soothe them.

Title: Trouble In The Mine
Objective: Speak with Vindicator Doruu.
Text: The Jorune Mine is in trouble! We recently unearthed an exceedingly large and powerful arcane crystal; however, something has gone terribly wrong and the energy from the crystal is flooding the mine. The Auchenai have already sent their Vindicators into the mine to assist us. Speak with Vindicator Doruu inside of the mine, he'll know how you can help.

Title: Downsizing the Darktide
Objective: Takedown the Darktide leadership.
Text: This pathetic excuse for life sold out all of his companions. All it took was a little squeeze of the neck. Find the leaders of this operation and bring me their heads. Haratha will accompany you on your quest.

Title: The Portal's Power
Objective: Enter the Soul Engine beneath the Dark Portal, then shut the Dark Portal down.
Text: This portal is fueled by powers neither mechanical nor arcane. Look to either side of us. The screaming souls of slain prisoners are being channeled into the heart of the portal itself. And they are channeling these souls through the body of Gul'dan. Find a way into the chamber beneath us, and do whatever it takes to get Gul'dan to stop his channeling. Our last hope rests on you.

Title: Onslaught's End
Objective: Disable the two fel spires of the Dark Portal.
Text: "Guard Gul'dan and his Shadow Council with your lives! The portal cannot function without our prisoners' fel magic. Fail me and watch all that you hold dear turn to ash. -Grommash Hellscream." The Iron Horde appear to be holding prisoners that are crucial to keeping the portal open. Search the nearby spires!

Title: The Shadow Gate
Objective: Defeat Grubnor Wargut and follow after Borgal.
Text: Dere be ogres in da cave, I smell de stink of 'em. Keep ye weapon handy, we gonna have ta move quick and take down de ogres before dey start tossing da mojo.  Watch ye self mon, something be going down in dere.

Title: Rally the Frostwolves
Objective: Ask Draka to sound the war horn.
Text: My brother, in his haste, has already taken some of my clan with him and has begun an assault on Bladespire Citadel before we were ready. Draka awaits by our war horn. Please let her know that it is time to rally the clan! With the aid of you and your forces, we might actually stand a chance at victory against the ogres.

Title: Den of Wolves
Objective: Ride the Frostwolf Rylak to Wor'gol.
Text: Durotan wishes for us to join him now that you have established your foothold. I hope he will accept your help.

Title: Ore Not to Be
Objective: Kill Munch.
Text: Okay, commander, here's the deal. You're gonna want spikes and all sorts of cool stuff on your garrison, right? To get started, we'll need some ore from a nearby cave.Check out that cave to the southeast of us. Knowing what I know from being here for a no time at all, I bet there's something big and nasty inside.Take care of it and the peons will get the ore for ya.

Title: Establish Your Garrison
Objective: Watch the construction of your garrison by using the Master Surveyor
Text: It's time for the main event! We've got the materials, we've got the manpower, we've got another thing that starts with "m." Let's build this thing! I got a gaggle of assistants up on that ridge to the west. They should have your personal surveying stand set up by now. Head on over there and you should be able to watch our progress from it.

Title: The Dark Portal
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at the foot of the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands.
Text: |cFF660000 ATTENTION HEROES ADVENTURERS DEFENDERS OF AZEROTH|r Archmage Khadgar, hero of the Second War, is assembling a coalition of Azeroth's strongest to bravely step through the Dark Portal and stop the Iron Horde's invasion of Azeroth. Champions who are interested in glory can meet Khadgar at the base of the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands. Safety not guaranteed.

Title: Releasing Rylak
Objective: Free the Caged Rylaks on Darktide Roost.
Text: These goblins have been conducting horrible experiments on the rylaks. This fool gave me the location for three of their prized experiments. Set these mutated rylaks free. Maybe freedom will help these tortured souls find some peace in life.

Title: Back to Work
Objective: Mark 6 Trees.
Text: Alright, boss. We're gonna need some lumber if we're gonna get this garrison started off right.If you mark some trees to be cut down, your peons will do the rest.

Title: Tanaan 01: Front of the Portal
Objective: - Gul'dan will ask you for freedom, which you ignore.
Text: - Gul'dan will ask you for freedom, which you ignore. -You plant your mana bomb but it doesn't work. -Khadgar concedes and you kill felbreakers to free Gul'dan. -A noble NPC leads the distraction sacrifice troops while you and Khadgar escape 'round back.

Title: For the Horde!
Objective: Plant the Horde Banner to Claim the Land.
Text: Without you, none of us would have made it to the shores of my homeland. You will be the one to lead our forces here on Draenor. This is your garrison to found.I leave it to you to plant the banner and claim this territory. When you are ready, I will have Khadgar open a portal to bring through a few necessary reinforcements.

Title: The Shadow Gate
Objective: Defeat Grubnor Wargut and follow after Borgal.
Text: Okay, we're gonna have to be quick. I've seen Borgal form magical portals before so he might try to use one to escape. If he does that our only option will be to follow after 'em. On top of that he always keeps his lieutenant Grubnor nearby so we may have a bit of a tussle in store.  Keep yer head down, something's going on in there.

Title: A Good Death
Objective: Use Rexxar's axe to kill Injured Rylaks at Darktide Roost.
Text: These fools have no honor. They seem to enjoy torturing these poor beasts. The only humane thing we can do at this point is find injured rylaks and put them out of their misery. Take this axe and aim for their vitals. These rylaks deserve a good death.

Title: Dirty Rats
Objective: Use the rats to destroy Unmanned Shredders on Darktide Roost.
Text: These shredders are more of a hassle than I expected. I've been peering through the eyes of the rats on the island. There are number of unmanned shredders west of here. The rats have an uncontrollable appetite for this bait. Throw it onto Unmanned Shredders and let the rats destroy them from the inside.

Title: We Must Construct Additional Pylons
Objective: Collect 6 Arkonite Crystals and an Arkonite Pylon from the Tomb of Lights.
Text: We came here to retrieve a reserve pylon to power Auchindoun's defenses, but we've been pinned to this position by the Shadow Council for hours! I need to get these injured back to Exarch's Refuge, but we still need the backup system! Please, gather Arkonite crystals and an Arkonite pylon from the tomb and meet me at the refuge as quickly as you can!

Title: Shredder Suppressor
Objective: Destroy Darktide Shredders on Darktide Roost.
Text: The rylaks have no defense against the Iron Horde's technology. A true hunter would not need machines to capture their prey. Destroy the Iron Shredders and the scum that pilot them. Spirit will join you on your quest.

Title: Bladefury's Orders
Objective: Deliver Bladefury's Orders to Thisalee Crow at Skysea Ridge.
Text: Lieutenant O'rok: Send an elite strike team to Cragplume Cauldron. Retrieve a high-value artifact from the crater and deliver it to my command post in northern Talador. With your remaining forces, go to Gorgorek's Fall. Protect and prepare the ancient magnaron specimen for retrieval. Immediate action is required. - Bladefury

Title: Darktide Defender
Objective: Kill 5 Darktide Pilferers and 5 Darktide Engineers.

Title: Frosted Fury
Objective: Collect 3 Frostshards.
Text: The furies of Draenor are different than the elementals of Azeroth. But don't be fooled. Some be wicked, boss-mon. Wicked. The trap we are making be needing some proper frostshards. You can get them, if ya willing, from the ice furies. Dey be wandering the Cracking Plains, freezin' all dat dey touch, an' bein' wicked. Bring us some o' these frostshards, boss-mon, an' we gonna whip ya up one deadly trap.

Title: The Real Prey
Objective: Find Iceblister Den and then slay Grosh the Mighty.
Text: Eh boss-mon. Time for us to be huntin' the real prey now. To the north, there be a cave. In the cave, there be right mean ogron dey call "Grosh the Mighty." That ogron got a big stash of pillaged hides and leathers we gonna be needin' for the troops at the garrison. I made a special poison from the stuff ya gathered. Dis be a magic poison, and it gonna put that ogron down to sometin' a bit more manageable. Take these vials to the cave and see if ya can't win us a treasure.

Title: Poulticide
Objective: Collect 10 Frostbloom Leaves.
Text: We be huntin' something so big, so savage, we gonna need anotha poison. We gonna need a big ol' poultice of poison! So... boss-mon? Ya think ya up for a little flower pickin'? We gonna need the leaves of them frostbloom plants that be growing along the shadows of rocks and ledges along the sides of the Cracking Plains. Be careful when pickin' them, boss-mon! They not always be by themselves...

Title: Lurkers
Objective: Collect 8 doses of Lurker Venom.
Text: Dis be a dangerous place, boss-mon. Filled with big monsters and savage giants. Well, like my family loa say, 'If ya can't beat it, poison it.' We gonna be needin' some venom from the lurkers out there on the Cracking Plains. Dem lurkers be mighty sneaky, and mighty creepy. Be watchin the ground for rumbles and shakes. I'll be stayin' here to make a cure in case you accidentally get too poisoned.

Title: The Beating Heart
Objective: Deliver the Heart of Gorgorek to Warmaster Zog at your garrison.
Text: One thing is certain. We now possess an item of great value to the Iron Horde. We had better secure this... "Heart of Gorgorek" at once.

Title: A Goren's Feast
Objective: Collect 8 Engorged Stomachs and examine their contents.
Text: Goren. This caldera is full of them. I can even smell their stench from here. I suspect that these goren are more than just primitive beasts, but in order to prove my theories, I need more data. During your mission, if you should slay a goren or two, would you examine their stomachs for me? I'd like to know what these curious creatures eat.

Title: Garrison Campaign: Crows In The Field
Objective: Speak to Thisalee Crow at Skysea Ridge in Gorgrond.
Text: Our druids set up a wide network of scouts to follow up on your intel from Nagrand. We've identified a suspicious Iron Horde excavation near some salt pools on the western coast of Gorgrond. We have reason to believe that these orcs are pursuing a valuable artifact deep in the desert. I'm putting together a small mission for a focused, surgical strike, and we could use a capable  like yourself. I'd like you to be part of that team.

Title: Ambushing the Enemy
Objective: Collect 5 Caravan Shipments and Lieutenant O'rok's Head.
Text: See that Iron Horde camp to the south, across the water? We've been watching their movements for days. We've seen a lot of correspondence between their lieutenant and the Iron Horde command in Nagrand. We need to disrupt their operation. Gather their supplies, and bring me their leader's head.

Title: The Descent
Objective: Investigate Cragplume Cauldron.
Text: Whatever lies at the bottom of this cauldron is of great use to the Iron Horde, and therefore, of great interest to us. I need you to investigate the bottom of this crater. You go ahead. I'll be right behind you.

Title: The Giant Cauldron
Objective: Speak to Choluna.
Text: A high value artifact at Cragplume Canyon, hmmm? Let's see if we can't beat the Iron Horde to it. Let's move fast. Speak to Choluna, and we'll be on our way.

Title: Heating Up
Objective: Use Aren's Thermometer near the Hissing Geyser inside Cragplume Cauldron.
Text: Greetings. I have been conducting research on the steam geysers of Gorgrond for some time now. Cragplume Cauldron is one of the largest caldera in this region, but we have been unable to do a geographical survey due to the dangerous creatures in this area. Since you are venturing into the depths, could you take a temperature reading for me? It would add greatly to our understanding of these natural caverns.

Title: Changing the Tide
Objective: Speak to Restalaan at Retribution Point.
Text: It is time to retaliate against this foe. Meet me at Retribution Point and we will take this fight to the Shadow Council. Teron'gor shall not feast on another soul so long as we stand in his way! His reign of terror ends today.

Title: The Totems That Bind
Objective: Collect 5 of Borgal's Totems.
Text: Before Borgal began to use the Soulgrinder, he used totems to bind spirits to his service. If we can get a few of those totems I may be able to use the spiritual connection he's forged with them to force a link. He'll be compelled to appear before us! Go find me a few of those totems and I might be able to pull this off, I think five should do it.

Title: Seeking the Truth
Objective: Locate Borgal Doomfist.
Text: Lissen mon, a few nights ago dem ogres found a bit o' old and powerful mojo. I was snooping around da cave across de lava flows when dere was a huge scream from da spirit world. I went in and saw Borgal, de ogre chief, he be draining da spirits from de slaves wid some big stone wheel dat I heard dem call de Soulgrinder. I tried ta take 'em out but a single shot from dat thing took all de strength from me. Dat mojo too much of a threat in de hands of dem ogres.

Title: Ashes Of The Past
Objective: Molthron within the Bloodmaul Territory wants you to bring him 6 Piles of Elemental Ash.
Text: The ogres are a plague upon my kind. They summon my kin and force them into servitude, working them without rest till their heat fades away and they crumble into dust. Their ashes must return to the lava flows so that they can be reborn! The Ogres keep the dust in pouches on their person thinking it would enhance their strength. Go slay them and recover the ashes of my people!

Title: Flames Of The Earth
Objective: Molthron within the Bloodmaul Territory wants you to use the Flamewrought Jewel to free 6 Magma Elementals.
Text: I've searched the depths of the earth and found the means to break the spells that hold my people captive, but it only functions to free one who is completely bound. I would be unable to prevent myself from becoming bound by the same magic. You, flesh creature, are not of the flames below so their binding spells should not affect you. Please take my jewel, use its power to free my people!

Title: Soulgrinder Survivor
Objective: Place Borgal's totems so that Orlana can begin the ritual, then kill Borgal.
Text: It is time for Borgal to die. We must travel to a location of power where I have room for the ritual. There is a ruined tower to the northwest that will be perfect for this. Meet us there and place the totems in the areas of power you will find there. Once they are placed I will do the ritual that will summon Borgal to us. Your job will be the difficult one, kill him!

Title: Gearing Up
Objective: Obtain Bwu'ja's garb, glave, and mask.
Text: Dem ogres whipped me real good. My arm be broke, a few ribs snapped, t'ink even me spleen be hurtin' from dat beatin'. Nothin' a troll can't handle though but I be needin' a moment ta recover. What I really be needin' is me gear dem ogres took from me. Dey got me garb in a chest near a hut to da south, me glave in a chest next to da tower wid da Bonecrushers, dey even got me mask, it over near da lava! Could ye go find dem while I take a breather?

Title: Out of the Chains
Objective: Obtain the Bloodmaul Slave Key and free Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja.
Text: Lissen mon, dem ogres, got da jump on me wid an artifact wid powerful mojo. Next t'ing I know I wake here wid broken bones an' dis chain on me leg. I called to da spirits ta break it, but da spirits here no answer. Gotta go wid da old methods ta get out. Dere be a big ogre in da cave here called Rugrum who has da key to me shackle. Could ye go put a blade in his belly and get me dat key?

Title: Garrison Campaign: The Search for Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja
Objective: Travel to the Stonefury Cliffs and search for Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja.
Text: It be a long time since we hear from Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja, commander. Last we know she be on assignment keeping an eye on dem Bloodmaul ogres up in Frostfire. Dem ogres just be a bunch a slavers so something really big must be happening ta keep her from reporting in. Go over ta de Stonefury Cliffs an' find her.

Title: A Threat We Can't Ignore
Objective: Plant the Underwater Explosives on the Iron Horde battleship.
Text: Ishnu-alah. I trust that Khadgar and Mathias have adequately briefed you on this situation here in Grommar. Time is of the essence, so I will be brief. The Iron Horde presence here represents an immediate threat to the safety of Shadowmoon Valley. Grommar has been receiving supplies and reinforcements via the harbor for some time now. The most concerning of these reinforcements are the battleships docked in the harbor. Place these explosives on the nearest battleship undetected and report back.

Title: Mutation Station
Objective: Assist Grulk in destroying the Mutation Lab by administering the Mutation Serum to him.
Text: Grulk very weak...barely stand. Grulk not always look this way. Grulk once was orc...Iron Horde make Grulk mutant. Grulk angry at Iron Horde...so Iron Horde lock Grulk in cage...hurt Grulk. Grulk HATE Iron Horde...Grulk want SMASH them...make them PAY! Take serum...use on Grulk to make Grulk strong! Help Grulk SMASH Iron Horde!

Title: To Capture Gul'dan
Objective: Confront Gul'dan.
Text: Gul'dan is in the cave further into the Gloomspire. We know that he's about to leave for Talador and Shadowmoon Valley. You must capture him by any means necessary. I'll see you back at Throm'var. Good luck.

Title: The Fel Crystals
Objective: Destroy the Fel Crystals.
Text: You have the key. Now use it to destroy the fel crystals. Once they are eliminated, the magical barrier blocking the entrance to the Gloomspire will come down. And once the barrier is down, you'll go inside to confront Gul'dan.

Title: Have a Heart
Objective: Collect the Heart of Fernus from Fernus.
Text: Did you notice the magical barrier protecting the cave's entrance? It's being powered by demon crystals. The Burning Legion has a habit of making demon parts serve as the keys to such devices. Travel west to the Ruins of Ata'gar. Look for a powerful demon therein and bring me its heart. I'll project an image of myself into the ruins. You won't have to come back here until we're done.

Title: Eliminate the Shadow Council
Objective: Kill 12 Shadow Council members at the Ruins of Ata'gar.
Text: These ruins are full of Shadow Council adherents. We can't afford to let them scatter all over Draenor once Gul'dan has been dealt with. No, we need to eliminate every one of them down to the last orc.

Title: The Totems That Bind
Objective: Collect 5 of Borgal's Totems.
Text: Before Borgal began to use the Soulgrinder, he used totems to bind spirits to his service. If we can get a few of those totems I may be able to use the spiritual connection he's forged with them to force a link. He'll be compelled to appear before us! Go find me a few of those totems and I might be able to pull this off, I think five should do it.

Title: Eliminate the Shadow Council
Objective: Kill 12 Shadow Council members at the Ruins of Ata'gar.
Text: Those ruins are going to be full of Shadow Council flunkies. We can't afford to let them scatter all over Draenor once you've dealt with Gul'dan. No, we need to eliminate every one of them down to the last orc.

Title: Gearing Up
Objective: Obtain Owynn's Dagger, Mace, and Gear.
Text: When I was captured they took my gear and left me in rags. My mace is being used to crack stones and they're even using me best dagger as a dinner fork! I'd hate to know what happened to me armor but I hope its still usable. I'll need a wee bit to recover from me wounds and without my stuff I'm no help in a fight. Could ye go find my gear for me? Last I saw my armors in a chest next to that big tower south of here, my dagger was to the south west, and my mace over near that lava field to the west.

Title: Soulgrinder Survivor
Objective: Place Borgal's totems so that Orlana can begin the ritual, then kill Borgal.
Text: It is time for Borgal to die. We must travel to a location of power where I have room for the ritual. There is a ruined tower to the northwest that will be perfect for this. Meet us there and place the totems in the areas of power you will find there. Once they are placed I will do the ritual that will summon Borgal to us. Your job will be the difficult one, kill him!

Title: Seeking the Truth
Objective: Locate Borgal Doomfist.
Text: Okay, now down to business. The Bloodmaul have unearthed some monstrous artifact I've heard them call the Soulgrinder. It's a nasty bit o' sorcery that their chief uses to give himself incredible magical power, but it comes at the cost of needing to feed upon souls to maintain it. Every day, more and more corpses pile up from the slaves killed to maintain it. We need to go find Borgal and get rid of this Soulgrinder!

Title: Cleansing the Souls
Objective: Cleanse 10 Crazed Souls.
Text: Not all spirits are destroyed by the Soulgrinder. Some souls manage to survive more or less intact like myself. Others have become twisted and maddened. End their misery, take my soul shard and use it to purify them. Their rage will blind them to the effects of its energy so you must defeat them before you use it.

Title: Out of the Chains
Objective: Obtain the Bloodmaul Shackle Key and free Owynn Graddock.
Text: They roughed me up real good an' I have a splitting headache but I'll survive. I need to get out of this bit o' chain here though. Could ye get the key to it for me? A big ogre called Nub has it, he's over on the far side of the terrace.

Title: Desecration of the Dead
Objective: Kill 15 Necrophytes and Fel Wolves.
Text: These filthy warlocks are desecrating the dead in the boneyard!  I WANT THEM DEAD! Destroy the necrophytes. Destroy their demonic abominations.

Title: Garrison Campaign: The Search for Owynn Graddock
Objective: Travel to the Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge and search for Owynn Graddock.
Text: Commander, I have bad news to report. Agent Graddock was out on assignment to keep an eye on the Bloodmaul and he missed his deadline to check back in. Something's not right. If Owynn was captured they may have locked him away with their slaves. Head over to Stonefury Cliffs and see if you can locate him.

Title: All is Revealed
Objective: Spy on the Shadow Council.
Text: Tell me when you're ready. We'll invoke the power of the ring to summon one of their 'eyes.' Through it, we'll discover where the Shadow Council is located and what they're really up to.

Title: The Fate of Gordawg
Objective: Retrieve the Heart of the Fury.
Text: Looming monstrously between us and the inner chamber is the great fury we have sought to return to the Throne of Elements. Gordawg stands before us enthralled; a slave to the pale and their mysterious master. My heart is heavy with grief to see such a great creature mindless and enslaved by evil. There is no going back, in order to push forward you must go through Gordawg. It pains me, but Gordawg must be slain. When the deed is done, we will return the fury's heart to the Throne of Elements.

Title: Stop the Flow
Objective: Destroy 7 Summoning Circles.
Text: The Shadow Council down in the boneyard are going to have magic circles. It's not enough to simply kill them; we also have to eliminate their infernal devices. If you destroy the circles, you'll stop the flow of demons they're summoning to inhabit the bones of the dead.

Title: A Collection of Coils
Objective: Gather 5 Coils of Sturdy Rope from Thunderlord Wranglers in the Bones of Agurak.
Text: None of the Thunderlord can escape my wrath! We need something to pull them out of the skies so that they can greet our blades. Their wranglers should carry rope with them for handling their beasts. Slay them, if they have any coils in good condition bring them to me.

Title: Scheduled Pickup
Objective: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani outside Telmor.
Text: You've proven yourself more than capable in battle. There may be Shadow Council forces all around Auchindoun, including near Telmor. I want you to join Soulbinder Tuulani at Telmor to make sure the crystal makes it safely to Auchindoun. I know I can trust you to get it done.

Title: They Took My Father
Objective: Collect Anchorite Dolruu's three notes.
Text: $p! I have a lead on what happened to my father. There have been reports that he was seen in the presence of Shadow Council orcs in ____. My father was a powerful Anchorite with a vast amount of ancient knowledge. I dread to think what those within the Shadow Council would do to him to get that knowledge. Can you go to ___? Hunt down their officers and see what they know?

Title: Scheduled Pickup
Objective: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani outside Telmor.
Text: You've proven yourself more than capable in battle. As you know, there may be Shadow Council forces anywhere around Auchindoun, including near Telmor. Tuulani's powers as a soulpriest have not yet fully manifested; she isn't capable of protecting the shard alone. I need you to join her at Telmor to make sure the crystal makes it to Auchindoun safely.

Title: Payback
Objective: Rout 12 Shadow Council forces in Telmor.
Text: We thought we were safe behind Leafshadow's cloaking veil.  Someone told the Shadow Council's forces how to disable it. We were able to hold them off at first... Most of the town was slaughtered in the attack. Please, you must avenge our fallen. Rout these invaders out from Telmor forever!

Title: Eye Need That
Objective: Collect the All-Seeing Ring from Ogzor the Necrothurge.
Text: The Mother of Wolves was infected with demon magic. The Shadow Council must have hoped to spread the corruption to the other frost wolves and then to Throm'var. The hunters are reporting they've seen glowing green eyes down in the Icescar Boneyard to the west. We both know what that means. I have an idea... we're going to use the Shadow Council's "eyes" against them to reveal their base. All we need is the lead warlock's All-Seeing Ring.

Title: A Clew of Worms
Objective: Kill 15 Wastes Rockworms.
Text: While I was scouting, I noticed that most of Frostwind Crag is crawling with an odd species of worm. The worst thing about them is that these things burrow under the ground and then spring on you from out of nowhere. I saw the worms attacking the frost wolves and other wildlife in the wastes. I'm certain the orcs would appreciate you helping out.

Title: What Must Be Done
Objective: Collect the Mother of Wolves' Remains and bury it at the graveyard outside of northern Throm'var.
Text: I believe we have seen this demonic corruption your friends speak of. The Mother of Wolves has not been herself lately. Now, her pack has her surrounded. The wolves are protecting our hunters and will not let them near. They're not likely to stop you, though. If the alpha mother is infected with this fel-energy, then she must be put down. You would greatly honor the Frostwolves by returning with her corpse and giving it a proper burial.

Title: The Sleeper Has Awakened
Objective: Kill Shui Halad.
Text: Something has awakened the great Shui Halad. She is causing the ground to quake.  Perhaps those who have disturbed the great worm are the same ones your friends are tracking down? Either way, Shui Halad must be put to eternal rest before her thrashing collapses all of the north into the ocean.

Title: Safe Passage
Objective: Hear Cordana Felsong's tale.
Text: Being a human and a night elf, the archmage and I aren't likely to be well-received by the orcs of the Frostwolf clan. We need you to make an introduction for us with the Throm'var farseer. There is much to discuss. Shall I bring you up to speed on the way to the village?

Title: Smash Blon'sky!
Objective: Defeat Blon'sky.
Text: Grulk not choose to be mutated. Grulk not monster like Blon'sky! Blon'sky evil... chose mutation for power! You go to Grommar? Smash Blon'sky before he hurt innocents, make Grulk happy!

Title: They Have My Son
Objective: Find the Key to Corki's Cage and set him free.
Text: Please! Can you help me. I received a ransom note from a very corrupt and uncouth orc within the ranks of the Iron Horde. He has my son! He made sure to include a number of graphic words to describe what would happen if the ransom is not paid. Clearly he thinks my people conjure gold from the nether. And if I try to rescue him myself, both of us will be killed in the process. Can you go to Gron'mar for me and rescue my son? His name is Corki.

Title: Vouchsafe Our Arrival
Objective: Meet Cordana Felsong outside of Thom'var in the Frostwind Crag.
Text: A matter of great importance has arisen. While you were away, Archmage Khadgar contacted me. He is investigating demonic influences to the north. Being a human, the Frostwolves will not accept Khadgar without you there to vouch for him, nor will they accept a night elf such as myself. I will wait for you outside Throm'var in the Frostwind Crag.

Title: Things Are Not Goren Our Way
Objective: Kill Stonetooth in the Garrison Mine.
Text: The abandoned mine shaft has been overrun with goren! They seem to be responding to commands from a big one farther down in the mine. If you can take him out, the rest will probably retreat. Once you have those goren cleared out, we can get that mine up and working!

Title: Looking For Help
Objective: Find a local fisherman to help our cause.
Text: We have an accessible fishing spot here, but no bait seems to work! We need to find a local fisherman with some knowledge of the area to help us out. Head northwest and see if you can find anyone on the shoreline.

Title: Clearing the Garden
Objective: Kill 8 Frostwall Nibblers.
Text: This cave is the perfect climate to grow herbs for our Garrison, there is just one little problem. All these damn nibblers! I need you to clear them out and we can get this garden growing.

Title: Mutation Station
Objective: Assist Grulk in destroying the Mutation Lab by administering the Mutation Serum to him.
Text: Grulk very weak...barely stand. Grulk not always look this way. Grulk once was orc...Iron Horde make Grulk mutant. Grulk angry at Iron Horde...so Iron Horde lock Grulk in cage...hurt Grulk. Grulk HATE Iron Horde...Grulk want SMASH them...make them PAY! Take serum...use on Grulk to make Grulk strong! Help Grulk SMASH Iron Horde!

Title: Hiding in the Shadows
Objective: Destroy the three Shadow Orbs in Gul'rok.
Text: Our final move must remain concealed from the Auchenai, my minions. Use the shadow orbs Gul'dan provided for us to veil Gul'rok in darkness. Prepare our forces, we march on Auchindoun on my order. We will feast on the souls of the draenei and usher our demonic allies into this world!

Title: Book Burning
Objective: Obtain 3 Shadow Council Spellbooks and burn them in the fire by Kor'thos Dawnfury in Gul'rok.
Text: Please... I don't have much time. The Shadow Council have allowed themselves to be turned into demons by Teron'gor and his warlocks! I have reason to believe that the shadowborne dementors are using spells given to them by Gul'dan to empower the demonic orcs. Take their spellbooks and cast them into the fire by me... it will be a pleasant sight to die to.

Title: Destination: Unknown
Objective: Destroy Mongrethod in the Remains of Xandros.
Text: Teron'gor and Gul'dan were just leaving through the portal as I arrived... and I... I know I won't be able to defeat them. I'll hold open the portal as long as I can. It will be up to you to strike the killing blow. Our fate is in your hands.

Title: Into the Heart of Madness
Objective: Speak to Soulbinder Nyami at the Seat of Depravity in Gul'rok.
Text: , Nyami ran off to 'take down Teron'gor herself.' You need to find her. She has no chance against him on her own. I must remain here and organize our ranks should another attack fall upon us. I'm counting on you.

Title: Retribution for the Light
Objective: Kill 15 demons in Gul'rok.
Text: There are agents of darkness everywhere, fighting tooth and nail to envelop the world. The Light relies on us to balance the scale. You have the power needed to destroy Teron'gor's demonic minions once and for all. Send them to the Twisting Nether in pieces!

Title: To Thunder Pass
Objective: Speak with Lokra at Wolf's Stand.
Text: There is no time to mourn our fallen or lick our wounds. Your scouts have already reported sighting a massive Iron Horde army making its way through Thunder Pass. I advise you let your garrison forces secure this area while you and I make for the pass east of here with the rest of the Frostwolves. It is time to show this Iron Horde what a united Frostwolf clan can do.

Title: Ogre Diplomacy
Objective: Kill 10 Ango'rosh in the Ango'rosh Ruins.
Text: They may be spirits, but the Ango'rosh are still ogres. Even with their books in hand, they won't respect you until you prove yourself, and there's only one way to earn that. By killing them. You should take out as many of the Ango'rosh spirits and their pets as you can while in the ruins.

Title: The Battle of Thunder Pass
Objective: Defend Frostfire Ridge from the Iron Horde.
Text: The Iron Horde has an army tenfold our number marching down the Thunder Pass as we speak. Durotan is amassing our forces at the mouth of the pass. He is doing what he can to mount a defense but war on this scale is not what we Frostwolves are masters of. He will need your expertise. Please, go to him.

Title: WANTED: Hilaani
Objective: Slay Hilaani and bring a Pile of Riverbeast Meat to Beastmaster Tagh.
Text: We need more meat, commander. I know what you're thinking. What about all of that meat right behind me? That's the problem. It'll be gone in a day if we're lucky. There's a riverbeast that lives in the lake to the south. Locals call her Hilaani. Massive, lots of meat. If you would take down the beast and bring me her meat, your wolves will be better off for it.

Title: WANTED: Hilaani
Objective: Kill Hilaani and bring the Pile of Riverbeast Meat to Patrick Messer.
Text: O'riley wants to thank our peasants for their hard work with a riverbeast dinner. $I don't want to waste your time asking you to slaughter the things all day, commander. We've gotten reports of a huge riverbeast called Hilaani that would feed the whole fort twice over living in the lake to the south. If you have a chance to bring cuts of her meat back, the men would be grateful.

Title: WANTED: Ra'tok the Hammer
Objective: Kill Ra'tok the Hammer in the Orunai Coast.
Text: The Iron Horde have no honor. They disgust me. We spotted one of their lieutenants wandering the cliffs not far from our base. I believe that she is tracking our movements to prepare for some sort of assault from the Orunai Coast. I understand you have much to do, commander. If you have the time, I believe it would be beneficial to our position's integrity.

Title: The Mark of Defiance
Objective: Use the Battle-Worn Frostwolf Banner on the corpses of 6 Thunderlord Orcs in Agurak's Fall.
Text: As you look upon the Frostwolf banner you remember struggles that have led you and the Frostwolves to this point. Ruk'gan has suffered in his battles with the Thunderlord and would appreciate an extra show of defiance. As the banner rustles in the wind you're inspired to mark the foes of the Frostwolf with its standard.

Title: An Eye for a Spy
Objective: Look through Thaelin's Observicopter.
Text: I'll get the prototype shredder working right now!Take a look through my Observicopter. You'll see what you're about to head into...

Title: WANTED: Ra'tok the Hammer
Objective: Dispatch Ra'tok the Hammer in the Orunai Coast.
Text: I've got an issue that could use your assistance, commander. A few of our men spotted an Iron Horde lieutenant wandering in the cliffs near here. We suspect she's directing their forces to strategic ground as they land on the Orunai Coast. I would feel much better about the safety of this fort if you could take her out.

Title: WANTED: Kil'uun
Objective: Hunt Kil'uun and bring its beak to Patrick Messer.
Text: I have a bounty set on a bird, commander. Yes, a bird. The issue is this thing is massive, and it was last sighted a stone's throw away from the Horde base to the south in the forest. The locals call it Kil'uun. If you'd like to track the creature down and bring back its beak I wager it would fetch a sack or two of gold for your coffers!

Title: Getting the Points
Objective: Gather 5 Barbed Thunderlord Spears within the Bones of Agurak.
Text: Those Thunderlords circling above us are a problem . They fly their pathetic Rylaks leisurely across the valley, thinking they are safe to rain spears down on our heads.
