Title: Flash! Aaaaaahhhh!
Objective: Use the Bilgewater Molotovs to destroy 6 Skyfire Gyrocopter X2s.
Text: The gnomes have brought their flying contraptions. I want my skies CLEAR! Get up there on whatever mount you have with you and destroy those paltry devices. You may use this grog I "acquired" from our goblin allies. It would be better served blasting down gyrocopters than in the gullet of those little green fiends.

Title: Precious Resource
Objective: Tighten 8 Faulty Valves in and around Gearslip's Gusher.
Text: What we have here is too much of a good thing! Our rig just can't handle the amount of oil we're pumping out of the ground. It's literally bursting at the seams! To be more accurate, it's bursting at the valves. I've been working double-time to get the valves repaired, but every time I finish the rounds, they're all broken again. It's as if someone is following me... That's ridiculous though.... Maybe you'll have better luck. Try getting as many of those valves tightened as you can.

Title: The Source of Korune Power
Objective: Collect a Sha-Touched Claw from the Korune Spellweaver.
Text: Why hullo there! Have ya ever seen tha like o' these statues? Fascinatin'! I was scouting up along the ruins earlier, and I spotted somethin' innerestin' up on the highest rise. I couldn't get close enough, but I think it might be one o' these mogu statues, 'cept it was movin'! I can't get through all those nasty blood elves, but you look like you could. Would you mind going up there and bringing me back anything of interest?

Title: Bug Off!
Objective: Spray 5 Agitated Shale Spiders with the Bug Off Sprayer and eradicate 12 Shale Shards.
Text: This cave is crawlin' with nasty shale spiders! How's a girl supposed to get any work done with them gobbling up the miners AND the ore?! This seemed like a good opportunity to use my newest invention, Bug Off. See, all you have to do is spray this stuff all over the shale spiders. They hate it and it doesn't seem to have many long term side-effects for the miners! What could possibly go wrong? Take this handy sprayer and get to work!

Title: Knowledge Is Power
Objective: Retrieve 6 Ritual Artifacts from around Conqueror's Terrace.
Text: The Zandalari here practice a different kind of magic. We must understand it before we can defeat it. Their control over the arcane and shadow is impressive. I wish to learn how they have achieved what so many others have not. I believe their ritual artifacts may hold the answers I seek. Bring me a sampling of the artifacts you find, and I will ensure you are rewarded properly.

Title: Very Disarming
Objective: Steal 7 Loa-Infused Blades from Conqueror's Terrace.
Text: Look around you. What do you see? I see an opportunity. The casters here work to imbue the Zandalari weapons with powerful magic. As if a sharp blade isn't enough to cut even the strongest foe down to size. In my scouting I've noticed the weapons are not very well guarded. This is where you come in... If we can steal a few of these weapons we may be able to use them. At the very least they are out of enemy hands.

Title: The Zandalari Colossus
Objective: Destroy the Zandalari Colossus.
Text: The trolls have dispatched one of their immense constructs on the southern road, blocking our passage around the island. See to it that the road is cleared.

Title: Trailing Light in the Dark
Objective: Relight 8 torches within the Diremoor.
Text: There is some dark magic in the Diremoor that extinguishes even our magical illuminations, and so our scouts struggle to find their way. As you pass through the swamp, relight any torches you find that our men might find their way. Perhaps they will help you find your way back as well.

Title: Preventing a Future Threat
Objective: Frighten 12 Hatchling Skyscreamers by running near them.
Text: The creatures the Zandalari ride don't start out so big, nor do they start out the vicious and loyal creatures they become.If you can frighten some of the hatchling skyscreamers away from the beach, perhaps they will have a chance at a real life.

Title: What's Inside Counts
Objective: Destroy Guardian Tak'u in Conqueror's Terrace.
Text: I noticed something strange on my last scouting mission. A group of Zandalari are performing a ritual on what appears to be a very large sentry. They may be trying to re-animate it. We need that ritual stopped and the sentry destroyed. Anything that large can't be good. I've sent a scout ahead to observe their actions. Meet with her and figure out how to stop them.

Title: Rise No More!
Objective: Kill 15 Risen Ancestors.
Text: Have you seen the ghosts wandering the graveyard? They are risen ancestors, the spirits of slain mogu who have been called back to this world. When angered, they attack swiftly and silently, and their numbers increase by the day. They do not belong here. Destroy them, and send them back beyond the grave.

Title: The Shuddering Moor
Objective: Kill the Mighty Devilsaur.
Text: There is an immense beast in the swamp. It has not yet marched upon us, but I place no stock that we will continue to be so fortunate. Strike it down before it grows hungry enough to brave our defenses.

Title: The Call of Thunder
Objective: Stop the Shan'ze Thundercallers' ritual.
Text: Within the graveyard, in the deepest ruins of their western crypt, the Thunder King's most powerful sorcerers are charging a lightning rod with crackling electricity. We suspect that this weapon is meant to rain destruction on our stronghold at Dawnseeker Promontory. There is no time to delay. You must stop their ritual at once.

Title: WANTED: Chief Engineer Cogwrench
Objective: Destroy Chief Engineer Cogwrench at the edge of Bilgewater Beach.
Text: Wanted for crimes against the Bilgewater Operation! Chief Engineer Cogwrench was last seen building what appeared to be a giant spider tank on the edge of Bilgewater Beach. Extreme caution should be used when approaching. A large reward has been posted for Cogwrench's destruction.

Title: Ashes of the Enemy
Objective: Burn 8 Mummified Remains.
Text: The mogu here at the Court of Bones are bolstering their army by resurrecting the spirits of their dead. We cannot allow them to revive their fallen warriors. Take this torch and burn any mummified corpses that you can find. We will destroy our enemies before they have a chance to rise.

Title: Into the Crypts
Objective: Use the Incantation of Gura in the Hall of the Exalted, then defeat Gura the Reclaimed.
Text: The Reliquary is having a field day out here, literally! Every day, the researchers find more relics to study and catalog. Recently, one of our adventurers found this scroll at the Court of Bones. I believe that this incantation can be used to call beyond the grave. And if my Mogu is up to date, I'd say you should use it in the last room in the Hall of the Exalted. Would you be willing to test out my theory?

Title: Storming the Beach
Objective: Kill any 10 Shieldwall Forces including SI: 7 Saboteurs in and around Bilgewater Beach.
Text: Our lumber supply is being jeopardized by constant attacks from Lion's Landing. We've been able to keep the attackers at bay, but it's time to really show 'em some muscle! Head down to the coast and start splitting some skulls!

Title: WANTED: Lieutenant Ethan Jacobson
Objective: Destroy Lieutenant Ethan Jacobson in the Southern Isles south of Quickchop's Lumber Farm.
Text: Wanted for crimes against the Domination Point forces! Lieutenant Ethan Jacobson is responsible for leading several ground assaults against the Bilgewater lumber operation. Last spotted occupying an island south of Quickchop's Lumber Farm.

Title: Soul Surrender
Objective: Save 6 Sunreaver Scouts or Silver Covenant Scouts.
Text: We assault the mogu at the Court of Bones, but I fear we merely send them fodder for their abominable rituals. The mogu do not merely kill their prisoners - they steal their souls and imbue them in machinations of stone, or reforge the fallen into ghostly tools of war. Horde or Alliance, it matters not. We cannot allow the mogu to bolster their numbers. Go into the crypts. Free any prisoners that are still living.

Title: Dark Offerings
Objective: Destroy 6 Zandalari Offerings.
Text: The spirtibinders of the Zandalari perform sacrificial rites to appease the loa and their vile gods. These dark rituals involve the sacrifice of our people.Destroy any offerings you can find among their tents in Za'Tual and perhaps we can stall the sacrifices.

Title: The Assault on Zeb'tula
Objective: Complete the Assault on Zeb'tula. Speak to Lor'themar Theron to begin the attack.
Text: Our scouting efforts along the coast have given us valuable intelligence about the island. However, we will accomplish nothing if we do not advance forward onto the mainland. I have assembled a team of our most elite aerial units to begin the attack. I would like you to join the assault. A champion such as yourself could turn the battle in our favor at the critical moment. When you are ready to begin the attack, speak to me.

Title: Old Enemies
Objective: Kill 10 Kirin Tor units or players on the Isle of Thunder.
Text: So Jaina and the Kirin Tor think they can push us out again? I will not stand by and allow them to repeat the events of Dalaran! This time we fight back! This time we do the pushing... Go to Violet Rise and slay any Kirin Tor agent you find.

Title: Pterrible Ptorment
Objective: Free the Tormented Skyscreamer.
Text: The Zandalari treat their skyscreamer pets as little more than scuttling vermin, bending them to their will with violence and torment.I can hear one writhing in pain at their hands.Find the tormented skyscreamer within Za'Tual and help it break free of its captors.

Title: Heinous Sacrifice
Objective: Destroy the Zandalari sacrificial altars.
Text: The Zandalari perform heinous rites against our people! They must be stopped!Delve into the heart of the Za'Tual and destroy their altars.

Title: Bilgewater Infiltrators
Objective: Kill 10 SI: 7 Saboteurs around Domination Point and Bilgewater Beach.
Text: There is nothing more unnerving than walking along, minding your own business, and hearing someone following you. I swear I hear it all over the place down here! We're being watched! I have a feeling the entire beach is just crawling with spies! I made some improvements to our infrared goggle tech to put an end to the sabotogery. That's right sabotogery! Now I just need you to try 'em out! Feel free to dispose of any spies you happen to catch.

Title: Save Our Scouts!
Objective: Rescue the three captured Sunreaver agents within the Ghost Iron Mines, and kill Metal Lord Mono-Han.
Text: The heavy mogu presence in the mines let us know it was a place of great importance - but we needed to gather more information on their activities there, so we sent agents into the mines to spy on them.Unfortunately, many were captured, and we've found that some are being tortured in the mines. You have to go rescue them - nobody deserves what they are going through...And, when you finish, kill whoever captured them. No mercy!

Title: Stone Cold
Objective: Destroy 8 Grave Guardians.
Text: Our assault on the Court of Bones continues. Our progress remains slow, but measurable. Unfortunately, we've received several reports of stone quilen statues coming to life without warning. I can't have these quilen threatening my research expedition. Venture into the Court of Bones and destroy any quilen statues that you can find.

Title: Maximum Capacitor
Objective: Interact with the three lightning drills in the Ghost Iron Mines to destroy them, and kill Metal Lord Mono-Han.
Text: The mines north of here are being used to extract Ghost Iron ore and energize it with lightning energy.We need to destroy the drills they use to extract the ore. They are impervious to normal attack, but can be overloaded using the proper methods.Oh - and while you're there, take out whoever is running the operation.

Title: Saur Loser
Objective: Defeat 10 Zandalari trolls in the Beast Pens.
Text: Inside the Beast Pens you will encounter some of the most skilled beast tamers in the Zandalari military. They are trained to kill with axe, beast, and claw. This is where they build their cavalry. We need you to kill any Zandalari you find in there before they can get their mounted monstrosities out into the open battlefield.

Title: The Skumblade Threat
Objective: Slay 10 Skumblade saurok.
Text: Ihgaluk Crag has no end of saurok. Those beasts attack my men and spread their disease into nearby water and wildlife, interfering with our operations. Thin their numbers. Once the Horde takes full control of this island, we can look for more permanent solutions.

Title: This Just Won't Do
Objective: Kill any 8 Zandalari trolls within Conqueror's Terrace.
Text: The Zandalari here are very powerful. They should not be underestimated. We cannot afford to ignore them as a threat simply because they do not wield swords. More arrive every day, and with them centuries of magic knowledge. This threat must be dealt with, and quickly. Aid us in clearing this area. Perhaps we can even learn something from them in the process.

Title: Dangers of Za'Tual
Objective: Slay 12 Trolls in Za'Tual.
Text: , what I ask of you is little short of genocide, but it is a task that must be done.Find trolls within their town or on the beach and slay them, for the good of us all.

Title: One Magical, Flying Kingdom's Trash...
Objective: Speak with Barnaby Fletcher to learn more about Portal Shards.
Text: Before we enter into a business relationship, I am required by the terms of my rehabilitation program to inform you that I am a recovering potion addict. There, now that THAT's out of the way, let's talk portals! You see, the big portals in the cities - the ones running all day and night - leak tons of magical energy. It crystallizes around the edges and is generally regarded as trash. But I noticed during my, uh... hiatus in the sewers of Dalaran, that these shards still had power. Interested?

Title: A Kind of Magic
Objective: Find the 3 Scout-o-Matics in Domination Point.
Text: Greetings ! Do you find war to be constantly challenging your survivability? Is today's Horde proving to be too much for your armor? Well, then look no further than the all new "Siege-o-Matic 4000". Try it out the latest prototype today! Just look for Scout-o-Matics , and .

Title: Bad Blood
Objective: Collect 5 Korune Artifacts from Silvermoon Runeseekers, Dominance Mages, or Dominance Knights.
Text: The Explorer's League is here to excavate the ruins, and it's my job to protect them. When we arrived, we found this place crawling with blood elves. Apparently,the Horde are just as interested in the mogu as we are. This gives quite an opportunity to thin our enemies' numbers, and steal their findings, too. Slay any blood elves you find in the ruins, and bring back whatever they are digging up.

Title: Grave Circumstances
Objective: Kill 10 Shan'ze Gravekeepers, Shan'ze Soulrippers, or Shan'ze Thundercallers.
Text: The Court of Bones crawls with mogu forces. Endlessly do they perform their rituals of lightning and thunder. If our mission to take this island is to succeed, then we cannot allow them to hold such a strategic position. They must be eliminated.

Title: Anger Remains
Objective: Kill 27 Angerlings.
Text: From the looks o' our initial survey, this entire area is humming with residual sha energy. You know what ta do. Destroy any last traces ye can find o' the stuff!

Title: Krasarang Steampot
Objective: Obtain 5 chunks of Polluted Viseclaw Meat from the Viseclaw crabs on Bilgewater Beach.
Text: The Boss-Lady desires crabs! Why are you looking at me like that? It's not uncommon for a classy person, such as her loveliness, to want crab for dinner. What did you think I meant? There are some big crabs wandering around on Bilgewater Beach that should be suitable for her refined palate. Bring Sezik the best crab meat you can find!

Title: Mystery Meatloaf
Objective: Obtain 7 Chunks of Mystery Meat from the local wildlife.
Text: We've been gettin' complaints right and left that the Boss-Lady gets all the good grub and leaves the scraps for the others. Between you and I, they may be onto somethin' here. I don't even get to eat as good as she does! We need somethin' Sezik can make a lot of that at least attempts to disguise how inedible the food is here... I got it! Mystery Meatloaf!

Title: Bloodlines
Objective: Free 6 Domination Mages by killing Korune Wardens.
Text: We managed to fend off the mogu wardens and their dogs, but many of the blood elves from the scouting party were not as lucky. Many of my people are trapped inside the ruins to the north. We are devising a solution to break them out, but I believe there may be a more straightforward approach. Go to the ruins and kill the wardens guarding each prisoner. If my intuition is correct, this will free our comrades.

Title: Ancient Guardians
Objective: Kill 5 Korune Guardians.
Text: Before the mogu overwhelmed our scouting party, we found relics scattered amongst the ruins to the north. I would like to collect some samples, but the mogu's terracotta watchdogs are too much for us to handle. If you could clear the area of their presence, we will be able to resume our work.

Title: A Shabby New Face
Objective: Speak with Barnaby Fletcher in Halfhill Market.
Text: A strange fellow in a pointy hat showed up this morning trying to sell some kinda special seeds. Claimed they were magic. I welcome a little competition - business is business, after all - but this gentleman had a certain... shabby look to him. Oh, and he stunk somethin' FIERCE. Would you check up on him, just to make sure he's on the level? He's over there by Jian Ironpaw, making a meal out of the samples.

Title: To Mogujia
Objective: Find Brann Bronzebeard at Mogujia. Speak to Fennie Hornswaggle at Lion's Landing for transportation.
Text: The Explorer's League sent an expedition north some days ago. We haven't heard from them since, and I'd sleep better at night knowing our folks aren't in some sort of trouble. Last I heard, Brann Bronzebeard was heading toward Mogujia in the Kun-Lai Summit. Find him and report back with their status. Fennie over there can give you a ride if you need one.

Title: To Mogujia
Objective: Find Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron at Mogujia. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
Text: Throm-ka. While we were busy defending our foothold here, Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron led a research expedition north into Kun-Lai Summit. Unfortunately, it seems they have encountered trouble. Warchief Garrosh Hellscream has already departed to lend his assistance, but he will require additional reinforcements. Go northward into the mountains of Kun-Lai. Speak to Tak-Tak for transportation.

Title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Crab
Objective: Bring the Colossal Viseclaw to Huntsman Blake.
Text: The colossal crab is alive, but stunned. You should bring it back to Huntsman Blake before it wakes up.

Title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Tiger
Objective: Bring the Krasari Elder to Huntsman Blake.
Text: The elder cat is alive, but stunned. You should bring it back to Huntsman Blake before it wakes up.

Title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Crane
Objective: Bring the Ancient Bloodcrown Crane to Jorn Skyseer.
Text: The ancient crane is alive, but stunned. You should bring it back to Jorn Skyseer before it wakes up.

Title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Crab
Objective: Bring the Colossal Viseclaw to Jorn Skyseer.
Text: The colossal crab is alive, but stunned. You should bring it back to Jorn Skyseer before it wakes up.

Title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Crane
Objective: Bring the Ancient Bloodcrown Crane to Huntsman Blake.
Text: The ancient crane is alive, but stunned. You should bring it back to Huntsman Blake before it wakes up.

Title: Beastmaster's Quarry: The Tiger
Objective: Bring the Krasari Elder to Jorn Skyseer.
Text: The elder cat is alive, but stunned. You should bring it back to Jorn Skyseer before it wakes up.

Title: Darkmoon Pet Battle!
Objective: Defeat Jeremy Feasel in a pet battle.
Text: Are you prepared to test the mettle of your pets...?

Title: A Colossal Victory
Objective: Speak with Huntsman Blake at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.
Text: The crab has fallen.

Title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crab
Objective: Obtain 30 Funky Rotten Fish from Unga Villagers in Unga Ingoo.
Text: Along with the crate, you get some advice on crab hunting: Crabs are strange, old creatures, with different motivations than us. Small crabs are easy to find and hunt, but the big ones hide beneath the sands, out of danger and out of our reach. To draw them out, we play on their sense of smell. The Unga villagers to the southwest allow their fish to ferment before they eat them. Bring enough rotten fish together, and you will catch yourself a colossal crab.

Title: A Colossal Victory
Objective: Speak with Jorn Skyseer at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.
Text: The crab has fallen.

Title: End of an Elder
Objective: Speak with Huntsman Blake at Krasarang Cove in Krasarang Wilds.
Text: The tiger has fallen.

Title: Ancient's Fall
Objective: Speak with Jorn Skyseer at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.
Text: The crane has fallen.

Title: Ancient's Fall
Objective: Speak with Huntsman Blake at Krasarang Cove in Krasarang Wilds.
Text: The crane has fallen.

Title: End of an Elder
Objective: Speak with Jorn Skyseer at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.
Text: The tiger has fallen.

Title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Tiger
Objective: Obtain 25 Unbruised Yak Haunches.
Text: Along with the trap, you get some advice on tiger hunting: Tigers are gluttons, and big game is hard to come by in this jungle. If you want to tempt the elder cats out of their hiding places, you need a tempting meal. Just on the other side of the Serpent's Spine, you can find a herd of yaks. Kill them, bring their meat to the jungle's edge, set up your trap, and wait.

Title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crab
Objective: Obtain 30 Funky Rotten Fish from Unga Villagers in Unga Ingoo.
Text: Along with the crate, you get some advice on crab hunting: Crabs are strange, primordial creatures, with wildly different motivations than you or I. Small crabs are easy to find and hunt, but the large ones hide beneath the sands, out of danger and out of our reach. To draw them out, we play on their sense of smell. The Unga villagers to the southeast allow their fish to ferment before they eat them. Bring enough rotten fish together, and you will catch yourself a colossal crab.

Title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crane
Objective: Obtain 5 Pristine Golden Crownfeathers and a Pristine Jet Crownfeather.
Text: Along with the snare, you get some advice on crane hunting: The greatest cranes of the Krasarang Wilds don't care about simple things like food. You need to play on the creatures' emotions if you want to draw them out of the jungle. There's plenty of cranes on the Cradle of Chi-ji and on the Narsong Spires, both to the west of here. Pluck some of those cranes' quills, then put them in a visible spot near the Crane Temple. Your quarry will come running to you.

Title: Two Step Program
Objective: Destroy Shredmaster Packle in Quickchop's Lumber Farm.
Text: Shredmaster Packle is responsible for much of the devastation down there. Rumor has it he modified the shredders to work more quickly with less regard for the collateral damage they can inflict. Imagine the agony the trees must endure being hacked at. It will be difficult to recover from this level of destruction. The first step in any recovery is acknowledging the problem. Step two is eliminating that problem.

Title: Circle of Life
Objective: Plant 11 Energized Seeds near Quickchop's Lumber Farm.
Text: We should attempt to offset the destruction being wrought on this continent as much as possible. For every tree they destroy, we will plant a new one! Take these seeds and begin the regrowth process. Do not linger for too long though. Nature is unpredictable, and no doubt the anger and hate exuding from Domination Point has seeped into the ground. I cannot guarantee that the plant that springs from these seeds will not be hostile.

Title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Tiger
Objective: Obtain 25 Unbruised Yak Haunches.
Text: Along with the trap, you get some advice on tiger hunting: Tigers are gluttonous creatures, and large game is hard to come by in this jungle. If you wish to tempt the most elder cats out of their hiding places, you may do so with a meal. Just on the other side of the Serpent's Spine, you will find a herd of yaks. Slay them, bring their meat to the jungle's edge, set up your trap, and wait.

Title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crane
Objective: Obtain 5 Pristine Golden Crownfeathers and a Pristine Jet Crownfeather.
Text: Along with the snare, you get some advice on crane hunting: The greatest cranes of the Krasarang Wilds are not tempted by simple things like food. You will need to play on the creatures' emotions if you wish to draw them from their hiding places in the jungle. Cranes abound on both the Cradle of Chi-ji and the Narsong Spires, both of which can be found east of here. Pluck those cranes' quills, then place them in a visible spot near the Crane Temple. Your quarry will come running to you.

Title: The Only Good Goblin...
Objective: Kill 10 Bilgewater Goblins in and around Bilgewater Beach.
Text: The destruction in Krasarang is unforgivable. The only way to put an end to this is to destroy the Bilgewater operation. This is for the greater good of Pandaria and the Alliance. Go to Bilgewater Beach and cut them down! No doubt the Horde will come to their assistance. Destroy them!

Title: It's Only Right
Objective: Retrieve 7 Shieldwall Soldier Dog Tags from the Fallen Shieldwall Soldiers in and around Bilgewater Beach.
Text: This is barbaric warfare! We've lost so many trying to keep the Bilgewater operation from spreading any further. Those fallen soldiers fought honorably and deserved to be given their last rights. At the very least we need to be able to notify their next of kin. Perhaps you can collect their identification tags so we can honor them in some small way.

Title: Necessary Breaks
Objective: Steal 7 Rusty Valves from the fuel operation on Bilgewater Beach.
Text: It goes against me nature to break things on purpose, but in this case it's necessary. That rig the goblins are usin' is held together by a wish an' some bubblegum. We need to exploit the situation a little more. We have some saboteurs down there already, but we can use someone of your expertise to hurry the job along. Get down there an' start breakin' and stealin' some valves!

Title: Siege Damage
Objective: Find a Bilgewater Blasting Cap on a Bilgewater Sapper, and then plant it on a Domination Point Demolisher.
Text: The Horde got the bright idea to send Bilgewater goblins to attack our quarry.They've been packing heavy explosives - heavy explosives that will react with the ammunition in their demolishers.Kill the Bilgewater goblins until you find an explosive, plant it on one of the demolishers... and BOOM! Siege ended.

Title: Burn Out!
Objective: Use the Unstable Explosive to destroy the Northestern Fuel Tank, Northern Fuel Tank, and the Northwestern Fuel Tank.
Text: Those goblins are gettin' out of hand! First they level the forest and set up that abomination of a rig. Then, they start dumpin' their oil barrels into the bay! We got to put a stop to this madness! At the very least we need ta set them back. We need to take out their fuel supply! Maybe you'll even get to kill a few goblins in the process!

Title: Hero Killer
Objective: Kill a Horde Hero.
Text: Look, you're tough. Tougher than the rest of the men and women I've got here. Which means I need you for a special mission.The Horde is throwing their best against us. Heroes of their armies - Blademasters, Tauren Chieftans, you name it.I need you to go take one out. It'll be a huge blow, not just to their offensive but also to morale.

Title: Supply Block
Objective: Destroy 8 Domination Point Supply Carts.
Text: The Horde decided to put goblins in charge of their logistics. And where you have goblins, you have carelessly placed explosives.Scouts have reported that they have their supplies in carts that also contain demolisher ammunition. Look at those crates the wrong way, and they'll blow sky high.With enough Horde resources destroyed, we'll put a time limit on their attack and save lives. So go and take out those carts!

Title: Tower Defense
Objective: Collect 20 Animatable Stone at the Lion's Landing Quarry from Bilgewater Goblins or by destroying stone slabs there with collateral damage.
Text: The gnomes are running our quarry operation to the northwest. The stone there is especially tough - the gnomes tell me the mogu used it to fashion their constructs.I don't know. What I do know is that we use that stone to build our towers, and the Horde has dispatched the Bilgewater goblins to steal it from us.Get out there and get some back. By the way - collateral damage may break up the stone slabs there. If so, pick that up, too.

Title: Hammer to Fall
Objective: Kill 5 Heavy Mooks.
Text: It looks like the Horde thinks they can hide behind their heavy hitting mooks. The mooks are tough, powerful, and dumber than an ogre with a hangover. Go down there and bring the hammer of the Alliance fury down on them!

Title: Resource Gathering
Objective: Collect 12 Lion's Landing Lumber by recovering it from piles of Hastily Abandoned Lumber.
Text: Oh, the poor peasants...They are cowards, yes, of course. But they don't know how to fight, and they go out to collect lumber for our efforts... the Horde targets them... It's just awful all around!But, we need that lumber if we're going to hold out. Go out and collect any they've dropped.

Title: Attack! Move!
Objective: Kill 12 Dominance Shamans or Dominance Raiders.
Text: Sure, they've got about plenty of grunts out there, pounding on our door, waiting to cut our heads off.I'm not worried about grunts. But they've got shamans and raiders, too. The shamans use their magic to empower the grunts, and the raiders are fast and specialize in taking out our buildings.I need you to get out there and kill some of those shamans and raiders.Go! Attack! Move!

Title: Under Pressure
Objective: Destroy 8 Horde Supply Crates.
Text: The Horde are consumed by pride and will fight to the death without a second thought. We need to find a way to break their will that does not involve massive loss of our numbers. Look for the Horde supplies along the coastline and near their ships. Smash their supplies. Nothing breaks the will of a defender like seeing their hope of food go up in a puff of smoke. When you are done, find Sully behind enemy lines. He has the next task for you.

Title: Don't Lose Your Head
Objective: Defeat Stone Guard Ruk'ra, Bombgineer Snicklefritz, and Or'Dac.
Text: My probes have detected three very dangerous targets in the courtyard of Domination Keep. They have an ogre emissary, a Kor'kron officer, and an insane goblin bomb maker. My siege-o-matics are not ready for one on one combat so it is up to you to eliminate the targets. Good luck! Report back to me on the Skyfire when done.

Title: Work Order: Lumber
Objective: Find Zino "The Shredder" Quickchop in the Lumber Farm.
Text: Everyday it's the same thing! "We're out of this!", "We need more of that!", "Why don't you ever do anything?!" I work! I do things! They can be so hurtful! I'm doin' my best down here! Oh yeah, we need more lumber! Go down and tell that good for nothin' Zino to get his shredders in gear!

Title: Work Order: Iron
Objective: Find Daxil "The Gem" Oregrind near Oregrind's Dig.
Text: When they said they found some amazing rocks in that mine I envisioned diamonds. Everyone knows all mines have diamonds, silly! At the very least rubies! Instead, all I got was this strange iron! What am I supposed to do with this? Oh well, no one said this job would be glamorous. I just do what I can to add a little class. We just got another work order for iron. Go see Daxil down near Oregrind's Dig and get it filled pronto!

Title: Runnin' On Empty
Objective: Retrieve 9 "Distilled" Fuel Barrels from the Blacksand Spillway.
Text: I've never seen this quality of oil! Problem is the oil needed a little extra refinin'. I heard of this system where you use ocean water to speed up the process. I don't have time to waste down here, so I just threw the barrels into the bay. Pretty good idea, I know. Problem is, I'm not sure how to pull it out of the bay... Maybe someone of your expertise could help me out.

Title: Power Metal
Objective: Obtain 7 chunks of Energized Ore from Oregrind's Dig.
Text: Sometimes we dig too deep. Sometimes, we uncover something so horrible we wish we hadn't started diggin'... Just kidding! I mean, don't get me wrong, we did find something unexpected. The ore we're finding down there is not your average run-of-the-mill iron. There is just one problem; Shale Spiders! We're struggling to keep these orders filled. Maybe you can lend us a hand?

Title: Stacked!
Objective: Gather 9 Pieces of Domination Point Lumber from the Lumber Farm.
Text: We just filled an order this morning. How could they possibly need more already?! My team has been workin' double-time to get these trees chopped and processed. Problem is we have an infestation of Lion's Landing troops down here. I already risked my neck once today, I'm not goin' back out there! Goob will go with you and help you fill this order. He's not the brightest, but he can do the heavy liftin'.

Title: We Will Rock You
Objective: Slay 10 Orcs at Domination Point.
Text: The orcs can NOT be allowed a foothold in this land. They will defile it just as they did Kalimdor. $p, I need boots on the ground and horde in their graves. Get down to the coastline and bring the full force of Alliance wrath down on their heads! Slay any orcs you find. Take the wind out of their sails. For the King!

Title: Hero Killer
Objective: Kill an Alliance Hero at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.
Text: There are some situations in which taking out one of their soldiers is more important than killing hundreds.They've deployed some of their heroes to the battlefield to help rally their defenders. Not only will killing them soften their defense, it will also leave their morale crippled.So go, take one down for me. You can handle it.

Title: Work Order: Fuel
Objective: Find Grizzle Gearslip in Bilgewater Beach.
Text: Our fuel supplies are running low. Without fuel we won't be able to operate the machinery that's building this place. They might even expect me to start helping them build! I was not built for manual labor! See these nails?! I just had them done! Get down to the refinery and get this fuel order filled! Hurry! They were fitting me for a tool-belt this morning. It didn't even match my outfit!

Title: Worker Harassment
Objective: Kill 30 Lion's Landing Peasants.
Text: Our goblin friends do not have the grasp of strategy necessary to win a long term engagement, I'm afraid.The key to eliminating any permanent establishment is to attack their ability to replenish their troops and to rebuild.In this case, that means taking out their Peasants. Kill them, and you weaken the foundation. The rest of the keep is bound to crumble.

Title: A Kind of Magic
Objective: Find the three Scout-o-Matics in Domination Point.
Text: Greetings $p! I have heard a lot about your success in the field. I would like to use your services to test my latest "Siege-o-Matic", a device of terrible and varied abilities. I promise it is mostly harmless to its users. When you are around Domination Point be on the look out for my Scout-o-Meters. They have been dispatched to get info on good siege targets. When you find one, activate it and I will pilot a Siege-o-Matic to your location. See you in the field... as it were.

Title: Hard Counter
Objective: Kill 8 Lion's Landing Mortar Team Engineers and destroy 2 Lion's Landing Mortar Tubes.
Text: We've managed to get some Demolishers on the beach, but the stupid dwarves are also out there with their stupid mortar tubes, preventing the Demolishers from pushing forward and assaulting the keep itself!Get out there, kill some dwarves, and blow up some mortar tubes.

Title: Sentry Wards
Objective: Place Sentry Wards on the Docks, in the Town Hall, and on the Second Floor of the Barracks at Lion's Landing.
Text: We've spotted heavy air support over their base, in the form of way too many dwarves on way too many griffons. Means we can't get any vision of the area from above.A troll... friend of mine gave us a set of Sentry Wards, which we can use to spy on their base and get a vantage point on what's going on in there.Bad news, friend - you're going to be the one going in there.

Title: Good Luck, Have Fun
Objective: Collect 10 Extra-Waxy Alliance Ears at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.
Text: I've got some customers lined up that wanna collect some good old fashioned ears. But not any old ears. They only want the absolute waxiest ears money can buy!Guess they think they're lucky or something'.Anyways, I need you to go get 'em for me. I don't want to hurt any animals, so you'll need to get 'em from the Alliance over at Lion's Landing.Have fun - and remember, only bring me the waxiest!

Title: We Require More Minerals!
Objective: Collect 20 Animatable Stone chunks from the Lion's Landing quarry. Lion's Landing Engineers carry them, or you can destroy stone slabs with collateral damage to blow them into chunks you can carry.
Text: Gnomes are excavating a stone quarry to the northeast.They're building stuff with it!They're too stupid to realize it's special mogu stone for creating animated statues.WE can mix with a little Goblin magic juice to make some real big explosions!But the stuff is heavy. They've got some of their stupid bomb-bots there for excavating the stone. Blow 'em up near slabs and you'll get chunks small enough to carry.Or, just kill 'em and take it. Whatever works.

Title: Another One Bites the Dust
Objective: Detonate the explosive cargo of The Defiant and Valor's Edge.
Text: The Alliance have planted themselves off our southern coast and continue to pepper our ground forces with cannon fire. Let us see how great their siege is without such support. Board the enemy vessels and destroy their reserve ammunition. This will take the teeth out of their bite.

Title: Don't Try So Hard
Objective: Kill 8 SI:7 Saboteurs.
Text: Ah, a ! I guess you'll do. My spies tell me there are Alliance spies sneaking around outside the fortress. But they are just... so... bad at it! I mean come on! Show a little pride in your work or something. Go kill a bunch of 'em as a lesson to the others. Here, take this batch of my latest Spy Stinker formula. If you can't see the spies just start tossing these outside the walls of the fortress to the south and you should flush them out.

Title: Tear It Up
Objective: Destroy 8 Alliance Supply Drops.
Text: The Alliance may be cowardly, but they are not fools. Their assault would be formidable, if it were directed at lesser creatures. To sustain a siege and put pressure on our troops they are air dropping in supplies to support their ground forces. Search the beaches and docks to the south for any airdropped supplies and smash them. Let the Alliance see their food and ammunition destroyed before their eyes and despair.

Title: Legacy of Ogudei
Objective: Collect 5 Ancient Mogu Essence.
Text: The ruins which we are occupying were built by Ogudei - an ancient mogu ruler. We know little about who he was, though the rise of the spirits in this area seems to indicate that it was related to spirit binding.When you destroy these spirits, a small amount of their essence will remain in this world. Bring it to us - we will analyze it and hopefully learn more about Ogudei's history - and his power.

Title: All Dead, All Dead
Objective: Defeat Captain Brent the Black and Captain Mulkey.
Text: Our Warchief has dispatched me to these shores to deal with this pitiful Alliance threat. These humans and their allies have proven to be very dependent on their leaders. No initiative of their own. As you walk the battlefield today look to the Alliance ships off our southern shores. Find their captains. Slay them. For the Horde!

Title: The Spirit Trap
Objective: Destroy 3 Spirit Traps.
Text: In the ruins there are a bunch of right nasty blue crystals. Look at 'em the wrong way and bloody angry ghosts run out at ya.I'm gonna be needing ye' to go in and clear some of them out so we can get our people back to work.

Title: Taking Advantage
Objective: Use the portal at Sparkrocket Outpost to meet with Kaelis Sunsoar at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.
Text: The fools in the Explorers' League have excavated an ancient mogu ruin to the northeast. And - of course - in their bumbling, they've disturbed the mogu spirits within.We are going to take advantage of their ineptitude. Take this portal and meet with Kaelis Sunsoar, my contact within the ruins.

Title: Ogudei's Lieutenants
Objective: Kill Meng-do, Strength of Mountains, and Gen-li, Twister of Words.
Text: When we dug through to an ancient section of the mogu ruins, that's when all this nasty business went down - and that's where the two worst o' these ghosties emerged.We need them gone, friend.

Title: Priorities, People!
Objective: Meet with Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.
Text: When I ordered the excavation of the tunnel to the northwest, I thought we'd find something useful. Gold, iron... anything!Instead, we found mogu artifacts, and I get a bunch of dwarves from the Explorers' League to baby-sit.I hear from the soldiers that there's trouble in the mines. I have orders from Wrynn that I have to support the Explorers' League, but I can't spare any troops. Can you get down there and find out what's going on?

Title: It Is A Mystery
Objective: Use Hilda's Anomaly Tracker to find and disperse an anomaly.
Text: There's somethin' down there that was spookin' the workers. Some kind o' anomaly... looks like a ghost, or a magic spell... like nothing I've ever seen.I did manage to get a reading on it and put together this device to try to track it down. The display on the device will let you know roughly how close you are.Once you get close enough, you can use it to draw out the anomaly and get rid of it for good!

Title: So, You Wanted to Test Daily Quests?
Objective: You wanna test dailies? Well alright then.
Text: You wanna test dailies? Well alright then.

Title: Shackles of the Past
Objective: Free 14 Troubled Slave Spirits.
Text: The mogu are a bunch of right bastards!They enslaved the pandaren who worked these caves even after their death. Ye' gotta go free their spirits! It's just not right.Be careful though... so much trauma, they don't know what's a friend and what's an enemy. So they'll probably fight back.

Title: Flying Tiger Gourami
Objective: Bring the Flying Tiger Gourami to Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf.
Text: You've caught a unique fish... with wings. Perhaps it deserves the expert opinion of Nat Pagle in Anglers Wharf.

Title: Death on Two Legs
Objective: Defeat 10 Alliance soldiers in Domination Point.
Text: The Alliance has made landfall. If we do not defeat them here, any hope of a Horde presence on this continent is lost. Go to the battlefield south of here and slay Alliance you find. Show them how any Horde who still stands on two legs will be the death of ten Alliance!

Title: Lion's Landing
Objective: Use the Flare Launcher in Krasarang Cove to signal the Alliance fleet.
Text: For too long the Horde has been allowed to run rampant across Azeroth. I will not see these new lands conquered by some barbaric "warchief." Are you ready to bring Alliance justice to the shores of Pandaria? Let us return to the landing site. Use the flare launcher to bring in the fleet proper, and begin Operation: Shieldwall.

Title: Pristine Monument Ledger
Objective: Put the artifact on display.
Text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition. Perhaps you will put it on display at the Seat of Knowledge, so that lorewalkers and archaeologists can study it.

Title: Domination Point
Objective: Light the Signal Fire on the beach of the Horde Landing Site to signal the Horde fleet.
Text: Now it is time to show this new land the true strength of the Horde. Return to the beach and light the remaining signal fire. Our fleet is waiting.

Title: Stag Mastery
Objective: Kill 10 Wilderland Stags.
Text: I always was a fan of a good stag hunt. Stags are tough, fast, and territorial. They may be plant eaters but they can give any hunter a run for his money. East of here is a whole mess of Wilderland Stags just waiting for a hunter like yourself to give 'em a good run. Happy hunting.

Title: Children of the Water
Objective: Slay Kracor, Thundergill, and Succula.
Text: We are all children of the water here in the Valley of the Four Winds. It nourishes us, it grows our vegetables, it brings us life. Some creatures, however, drink too deeply from the water. They grow too large, and must be eliminated before they cause havoc to those around them. I am but a simple stonecarver. You, on the other hand...

Title: Got Silk?
Objective: Report to Silkmaster Tsai at the Silken Fields in Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: Strange noises comin' from over at the Silken Fields. Strange smells, too. Almost makes you think that they could use a cash-strapped  to complete a few odd jobs for 'em. Make a few pieces of gold. Or not.

Title: Once in a Hundred Lifetimes
Objective: Speak to Klaxxi'va Ik in Klaxxi'vess.
Text: The time has come, wakener. The council's power will combine to bring an end to the corrupted empress. This ritual has not been witnessed in one hundred of your kind's lifetimes - and never by an outsider. In exchange for your deeds on our behalf, I invite you to behold this great moment in our history.

Title: They Call Him... Stormstout
Objective: Speak with Chen Stormstout at the Thunderfoot Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: Things were not always like this. Oh no, they were much, much worse. Not three weeks ago, we were under siege by saurok bandits. They stole our jade, befouled our food stores, and terrorized our cubs. We needed a hero, and a hero arrived. He drove back their forces, defeated their leader, and returned our stolen jade. All he asked in return was a serpent ride for his niece. I was never able to thank him. If you are headed to the Valley of the Four Winds, would you relay our thanks?

Title: Elder Charms of Good Fortune
Objective: Collect 90 Lesser Charms of Good Fortune.
Text: Greetings. I am privileged to offer you an excellent opportunity. Through the centuries, we've honed a method by which the very laws of chance themselves can be bent. With an Elder Charm of Good Fortune, valuable artifacts will find their way into your hands more frequently.

Title: Elder Charms of Good Fortune
Objective: Collect 90 Lesser Charms of Good Fortune.
Text: Greetings. I am privileged to offer you an excellent opportunity. Through the centuries, we've honed a method by which the very laws of chance themselves can be bent. With an Elder Charm of Good Fortune, valuable artifacts will find their way into your hands more frequently.

Title: A Celestial Task
Objective: Earned Revered standing with the Golden Lotus.
Text: Are you familiar with the August Celestials? Yu'lon, Chi-Ji, Xuen, and Niuzao watch over the four corners of Pandaria. They watch you as well. Their knowledge is most ancient, and most powerful. To those they favor, they can bestow enormous power. You may seek to earn their trust, but they need you for a more important task. The Vale of Eternal Blossoms is in danger. First, we must all defend the Vale. Then, we can turn our eyes to the Celestials themselves.

Title: His Name Was... Stormstout
Objective: Speak with Chen Stormstout at the Thunderfoot Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: An unusual pandaren came through town a few days back. He told a better tale than Pan, drank twice as much as Lee, and then beat me up in front of the bar. All while his little niece made fun of us. It was awesome. They said they were headed to the Valley of the Four Winds. You should meet him! Just... watch out for that right hook.

Title: A Celestial Task
Objective: Earned Revered standing with the Golden Lotus.
Text: Are you familiar with the August Celestials? Yu'lon, Chi-Ji, Xuen, and Niuzao watch over the four corners of Pandaria. They watch you as well. Their knowledge is most ancient, and most powerful. To those they favor, they can bestow enormous power. You may seek to earn their trust, but they need you for a more important task. The Vale of Eternal Blossoms is in danger. First, we must all defend the Vale. Then, we can turn our eyes to the Celestials themselves.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Raigonn
Objective: Complete the Gate of the Setting Sun Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a cracking group and lead them into the Gate of the Setting Sun. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein and lay waste to Raigonn. Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Darkmaster Gandling
Objective: Complete the Scholomance Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a fearless group and lead them into the depths of Scholomance. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and cleanse Scholomance of Darkmaster Gandling's evil presence. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: Audrey Burnhep
Objective: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.
Text: Greetings! My name is Audrey Burnhep. I've been hearing quite a lot about you recently. You're becoming quite the tamer! You should come speak with me in Stormwind. I have connections with some of the finest tamers in all of Azeroth, and I can help you grow even more!

Title: Varzok
Objective: Report to Varzok in Orgrimmar.
Text: Lok'tar. My name is Varzok. I have heard much your accomplishments as a tamer recently, and I would like to introduce you to trainers around Azeroth so that you may further hone your skills. Please speak with me in Orgrimmar so that we may begin.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Xin the Weaponmaster
Objective: Complete the Mogu'shan Palace Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a nimble group and lead them into Mogu'shan Palace. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and put an end to Xin the Weaponmaster. Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Durand
Objective: Complete the Scarlet Monastery Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a stout group and lead them into Scarlet Monastery. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and smite Durand with righteous fury. Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Wing Leader Ner'onok
Objective: Complete the Siege of Niuzao Temple Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble an eagle-eyed group and lead them into the Siege of Niuzao Temple. Activate the Challenger's Orb and ground Wing Leader Ner'onok. Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Sha of Hatred
Objective: Complete the Shado-Pan Monastery Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a tranquil group and lead them into the Shado-Pan Monastery. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and rescue Taran Zhu from the Sha of Hatred. Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Flameweaver Koegler
Objective: Complete the Scarlet Halls Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a cunning group and venture forth into the depths of Scarlet Halls. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and put a stop to Flameweaver Koegler's book-burning ways.

Title: Nazgrim's Command
Objective: Report to General Nazgrim at Strongarm Airstrip in the Jade Forest.
Text: You have a comfortable base of operations, no Alliance around for miles, and a few Horde veterans by your side. It looks like it's time to start painting this continent red. General Nazgrim should know where to start.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Yan-zhu the Uncasked
Objective: Complete the Stormstout Brewery Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a hearty group and lead them into Stormstout Brewery. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and evaporate Yan-zhu the Uncasked. Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Sha of Doubt
Objective: Complete the Temple of the Jade Serpent Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a hearty group and lead them into the Temple of the Jade Serpent. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and vanquish the Sha of Doubt. Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: Audrey Burnhep
Objective: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.
Text: I'm afraid I have nothing left to teach you. However, your journey as a trainer is far from over! eport to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind. She has connections with many of Azeroth's finest trainers, and will help you grow further.

Title: The Triumphant Return
Objective: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.
Text: You are now prepared as your trainer instructed. Travel back to Stormwind and have words with Audrey Burnhep. She will guide you further.

Title: The Peak of Serenity - Complete Your Training
Objective: Use Zen Pilgrimage to travel to the Peak of Serenity. Speak to Master Hight in the Shrine of the Ox when you arrive.
Text: The time has come for you to return to the Peak of Serenity to complete your training. Use Zen Pilgrimage to return there and speak with Master Hight when you arrive.

Title: The Triumphant Return
Objective: Report to Varzok in Orgrimmar.
Text: You are now prepared as your trainer instructed. Travel back to Orgrimmar and have words with Varzok. He will guide you further.

Title: Grand Master Zusshi
Objective: Defeat Seeker Zusshi in a pet battle.
Text: I knew you would return to face me once more. Let us see who is truly wiser in the ways of battle.

Title: Exceeding Expectations
Objective: Report to Varzok in Orgrimmar.
Text: Run off to your trainer, Varzok, in Orgrimmar. Perhaps he can find you more... worthwhile... challenges.

Title: A Brief Reprieve
Objective: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.
Text: Well done, well done indeed! If you would, please report to Miss Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind. Oh, and send her my regards. She's a beautiful young woman that could benefit from the company of an accomplished fighter such as myself.

Title: The Returning Champion
Objective: Report to Varzok in Orgrimmar.
Text: Word of your skill is spreading. I suggest you return to your trainer, Varzok, for further guidance.

Title: The Returning Champion
Objective: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.
Text: You belong in Outland with the other hotshots if ya ask me. Why don't ya go back to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind and see what's next in your new career as a tamer!

Title: Exceeding Expectations
Objective: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.
Text: Run off to your trainer, Audrey Burnhep, in Stormwind. Perhaps she can find you more...worthwhile...challenges.

Title: A Brief Reprieve
Objective: Report to Varzok in Orgrimmar.
Text: Well done, for an . Now, get back to Orgrimmar and talk to that brute Varzok. Maybe he can point you somewhere very far away from my family.

Title: Priorities!
Objective: Find 6 Barrels of Honeybrew in Honeydew Glade.
Text: Just look at this mess! All that brew gone to waste! Taran Zhu warned us against speaking to you outsiders, but I'll take any help I can get. We were on our way to Dawn's Blossom to deliver our brew when the fighting broke out. Now all of our brew has been lost! You want to make it up to us? Maybe you can find some of our Honeybrew barrels that haven't been broken. Then it wouldn't be a complete loss.

Title: The Returning Champion
Objective: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.
Text: Word of your skill is spreading. I suggest you return to your trainer, Audrey Burnhep, for further guidance.

Title: The Returning Champion
Objective: Report to Varzok in Orgrimmar.
Text: You belong in Outland with the other hotshots if ya ask me. Why don't ya go back to Varzok in Orgrimmar and see what's next in your new career as a tamer!

Title: The Returning Champion
Objective: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.
Text: You belong in Outland with the other hotshots if ya ask me. Why don't ya go back to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind and see what's next in your new career as a tamer!

Title: Goz Banefury
Objective: Defeat Goz Banefury in a pet battle.
Text: The power of twilight flows through me. I am a god! You have no hope of defeating me!

Title: Grand Master Obalis
Objective: Defeat Obalis in a pet battle.
Text: I see the triumphant tamer returns to again test  against me. Very well. I accept your challenge.

Title: Bordin Steadyfist
Objective: Defeat Bordin Steadyfist in a pet battle.
Text: The natives have taught me the strength of the earth. I know it's unending endurance. Let us battle once more, and you'll see that I'm tougher than ever!

Title: Battle Pet Tamers: Cataclysm
Objective: Defeat Brok, Bordin Steadyfist, and Goz Banefury in pet battles.
Text: You have defeated Northrend's finest tamers, but you need more preparation before you are ready to face the grand masters of Pandaria. Ready yourself and hone your skills by defeating these elite tamers: Brok in Mount Hyjal, Bordin Steadyfist in Deepholm, and Goz Banefury in Twilight Highlands. Once you have triumphed over them, you will be ready to journey to Pandaria to face the ultimate challenge.

Title: Grand Master Obalis
Objective: Defeat Obalis in a pet battle.
Text: You think yourself ready to challenge Pandaria? You truly believe that you can defeat the most powerful tamers in all of Azeroth? I shall be the judge of that notion. Face me atop the Vir'naal Dam in Uldum, and we shall see if you are truly ready.

Title: Doubt Begins To Surface
Objective: Snap Nazgrim out of it.
Text: The Alliance... so many airships. How can we possibly fight them all? I... don't feel... well...

Title: Brok
Objective: Defeat Brok in a pet battle.
Text: I do not yet understand the plight of these creatures well enough to help them sufficiently. Perhaps another battle would strengthen our bond?

Title: Battle Pet Tamers: Cataclysm
Objective: Defeat Brok, Bordin Steadyfist, and Goz Banefury in pet battles.
Text: Northrend has fallen to your hand, but you are not yet ready to face the grand masters of Pandaria. Defeat these tamers to harden your will for the coming challenges: Brok in Mount Hyjal, Bordin Steadyfist in Deepholm, and Goz Banefury in Twilight Highlands. Only by defeating them will you be ready to journey to Pandaria.

Title: Grand Master Shu
Objective: Defeat Wastewalker Shu in a pet battle.
Text: You venture into the heart of the wastes to face me again, only to suffer defeat at the hands of a true grand master. Noble, but foolish.

Title: The Empress' Gambit
Objective: Report to Malik the Unscathed outside the Heart of Fear.
Text: Grand Empress Shek'zeer has finally lost her patience with us. We have learned of an enormous army, massing in the shadows of the Heart of Fear, with orders to crush Klaxxi'vess. We have been fortunate to hold out this long, but we cannot survive a siege of this scale. Wakener, you have been invaluable to our efforts. Come, take your place on the field among we paragons. I will see you on the battlefield!

Title: Grand Master Aki
Objective: Defeat Aki the Chosen in a pet battle.
Text: You wish to test yourself against me once more? Very well, let us fight.

Title: Grand Master Yon
Objective: Defeat Courageous Yon in a pet battle.
Text: If you think I am going to let you walk away with another victory in hand, you are sorely mistaken. This time, I will stand over you as the superior trainer!

Title: Grand Master Mo'ruk
Objective: Defeat Mo'ruk in a pet battle.
Text: This time I'm gonna do the beating! You watch!

Title: Grand Master Hyuna
Objective: Defeat Hyuna of the Shrines in a pet battle.
Text: You seek to do battle once more? Very well, it will strengthen me to better protect the sacred sites of my people.

Title: Battle Pet Tamers: Pandaria
Objective: Defeat Hyuna of the Shrines, Farmer Nishi, Mo'ruk, Courageous Yon, Seeker Zusshi, and Wastewalker Shu in pet battles.
Text: You must now face the toughest tamers in all of Azeroth. They make their home in Pandaria, training ground of the grand masters. There are six grand masters left to defeat: Hyuna of the Shrines in The Jade Forest, Farmer Nishi in Valley of the Four Winds, Mo'ruk in Krasarang Wilds, Courageous Yon in Kun-Lai Summit, Seeker Zusshi in Townlong Steppes, and Wastewalker Shu in Dread Wastes. If you think yourself ready, seek out these champions of the trade and prove yourself!

Title: Grand Master Nishi
Objective: Defeat Farmer Nishi in a pet battle.
Text: My pets continue to grow in strength thanks to the fertile land we train on. You don't stand a chance!

Title: Learn and Grow VI: Gina's Vote
Objective: Plant and harvest 1 Scallion, then deliver 5 Scallions to Gina Mudclaw.
Text: My business is doomed! You see all of the Ironpaws at their cooking stations? Their tasty dishes draw many of the customers to this market, but they're all out of scallions! It may not look like much, but the scallion is an essential cooking ingredient. Without it, foods are less savory, less flavorful, and less aromatic. This is terrible. I'm not getting another scallion shipment for a week! Wait a second. You're a farmer, aren't you? You think you could help me?

Title: Farmer Fung's Vote III: Crazy For Cabbage
Objective: Plant and harvest 3 Green Cabbages, then deliver 15 Green Cabbages to Farmer Fung.
Text: Thanks to you, I got my precious yaks back! Unfortunately, I noticed that their time out in the wild left them rather gaunt. They must be starving, but I don't feed my prize yaks just any regular old grass. No sir, they eat only the leafiest green cabbages you can find here in the Valley. My stores are a bit low. If you bring me some cabbages for my yaks, I will reward you handsomely.

Title: Mung-Mung's Vote III: The Great Carrot Caper
Objective: Plant and harvest 2 Juicycrunch Carrots, then deliver 10 Juicycrunch Carrots to Mung-Mung.
Text: Mung-Mung don't care who steals carrots. Only care what Mr. Mudclaw does to poor Mung-Mung when he finds his crop is ruined!  Wait! Mung-Mung have bright idea. You go and grow some juicycrunch carrots. Then, we take your carrots and pretend they are Mr. Mudclaw's. Yes!

Title: Nana's Vote III: Witchberry Julep
Objective: Plant and harvest 3 Witchberries, then deliver 15 Witchberries to Nana Mudclaw.
Text: Now that we have the water, I can almost taste the icy cold witchberry julep! Now, we just need to find ourselves some sweet witchberries. My grandson's berries this season have been total slop, so I need to seek a decent harvest elsewhere. Say, do you have any witchberries in the ground this year? How about you bring me some from your farm? If your berries are up to the standard, we'll make ourselves a grand old batch of the old juice!

Title: Grand Master Aki
Objective: Defeat Aki the Chosen in a pet battle.
Text: You have fought hard and well against the trainers of Azeroth. Even the grand masters have fallen to your cunning tactics. I now await you in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, for you have earned the privilege to face me in battle. Come, and let us see if you have what it takes to defeat me.

Title: Nana's Vote II: The Sacred Springs
Objective: Use the Empty Pitcher at the Golden Falls to collect Thousand-Year Water.
Text: You caught me at a good time. I was just hankering to make a fresh batch of Witchberry Julep. Have you ever heard of this wondrous brew? Each sip takes ten years off your face! How do you think I still look so good? Anyway, I need a special ingredient - thousand-year water - which can be collected from the mouth of the waterfall to the north. I'm afraid the journey is too treacherous for an old matron like me, but if you can get your hands on a pitcher, I'll let you share my brew.

Title: Which Berries? Witchberries.
Objective: Plant Witchberries in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
Text: That young'un over there, Andi, is going to grow up to be a heck of a farmer some day. I can tell just by lookin' at him. I think I'll plant him some witchberries. Kids love witchberries - it'll be a nice surprise.

Title: Complete Your Training: The Final Test
Objective: Go the the Training Grounds at the Peak of Serenity and complete your final test.
Text: Welcome back. The time has come for you to complete the last step of your training. Head to the Training Grounds for your final test.

Title: It's Melon Time
Objective: Plant a Striped Melon in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
Text: Hmm...  Yup. It's melon time. Could you grab some seeds and help me plant a Striped Melon?

Title: Test
Objective: Plant and harvest 4 Juicycrunch Carrots. Juicycrunch Carrot Seeds can be purchased from Merchant Greenfield at Halfhill Market. After tilling and caring for your planting, you must wait until the next day to harvest grown Juicycrunch Carrots.
Text: All right friend, all of that farming was just for practice! Are you ready to try the real thing? Mei Mei Ironpaw over at the market is in need of some carrots for her stew. And you know who can grow those carrots? Us! How about you show me what you've learned by planting, growing, and harvesting four beds of Juicycrunch Carrots?

Title: Squash Those Foul Odors
Objective: Plant a Jade Squash in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
Text: Grandpa always said, "A squash a week, and your tail won't reek."  Yup. I think it's been about a week. Could you help me plant a Jade Squash?

Title: The "Jinyu Princess" Irrigation System
Objective: Bring the "Jinyu Princess" Irrigation System to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch or Halfhill market.
Text: "Hey there, greenthumb. Are you pouting over parched pumpkins? Crying over crusty cabbage? Are your leeks lame and your melons melancholy? Then it's time you brought home the Jinyu Princess! She'll wash over your garden like a sweet spring rain, dousing that drought with a deep draught of..."

Title: Battle Pet Trainers: Pandaria
Objective: Defeat Ziggy the Flightless, Nearly Headless Jacob, Okrut Dragonwaste, and Gutretch in pet battles.
Text: Outland's finest have fallen to your skill, but Northrend now awaits you! There are four trainers that you must now defeat: Ziggy the Flightless in Howling Fjord, Nearly Headless Jacob in Crystalsong Forest, Okrut Dragonwaste in Dragonblight, and Gutretch in Zul'drak. If you are able to best all of them, then Northrend's Grand Master will surely challenge you!

Title: "Thunder King" Pest Repellers
Objective: Bring the "Thunder King" Pest Repellers to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch or Halfhill Market.
Text: "DO NOT LET WEAK, DISGUSTING INSECTS INFEST YOUR GLORIOUS CROPS. CONQUER THEM WITH THE MIGHT OF THE THUNDER KING AND PROTECT YOUR LEGACY."

Title: Beegle Blastfuse
Objective: Defeat Beegle Blastfuse in a pet battle.
Text: One of my chickens flew for just a moment yesterday, I swear. We're finally hitting the big time! Oh, you'd like to battle again?

Title: The "Earth-Slasher" Master Plow
Objective: Bring the "Earth-Slasher" Master Plow to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch or Halfhill Market.
Text: "The Earth-Slasher. Master the land. Master your life."

Title: Gutretch
Objective: Defeat Gutretch in a pet battle.
Text: Me like fighting you. You not so easy like the others. We fight again?

Title: Nearly Headless Jacob
Objective: Defeat Nearly Headless Jacob in a pet battle.
Text: Time and time again you defy my wisdom. What is it that brings you back to these woods? Ah, you wish to do battle once more. Very well then.

Title: Grand Master Payne
Objective: Defeat Major Payne in a pet battle.
Text: The rebel  comes once again to test  might again that of a Grand Master. Your bravery will be your undoing this time!

Title: Okrut Dragonwaste
Objective: Defeat Okrut Dragonwaste in a pet battle.
Text: You dare interrupt our work? Then you must battle me again! Take out your pets, and I'll give you a taste of Hellscream's wrath!

Title: Battle Pet Tamers: Northrend
Objective: Defeat Beegle Blastfuse, Nearly Headless Jacob, Okrut Dragonwaste, and Gutretch in pet battles.
Text: Outland's finest have fallen to your skill, but Northrend now awaits you! There are four tamers that you must now defeat: Beegle Blastfuse in Howling Fjord, Nearly Headless Jacob in Crystalsong Forest, Okrut Dragonwaste in Dragonblight, and Gutretch in Zul'drak. If you are able to best all of them, then Northrend's Grand Master will surely challenge you!

Title: Narrok
Objective: Defeat Narrok in a pet battle.
Text: I wish to do battle once more. These young ones need to grow stronger.

Title: Battle Pet Tamers: Northrend
Objective: Defeat Beegle Blastfuse, Nearly Headless Jacob, Okrut Dragonwaste, and Gutretch in pet battles.
Text: Outland's finest have fallen to your skill, but Northrend now awaits you! There are four tamers that you must now defeat: Beegle Blastfuse in Howling Fjord, Nearly Headless Jacob in Crystalsong Forest, Okrut Dragonwaste in Dragonblight, and Gutretch in Zul'drak. If you are able to best all of them, then Northrend's Grand Master will surely challenge you!

Title: Battle Pet Tamers: Pandaria
Objective: Defeat Hyuna of the Shrines, Farmer Nishi, Mo'ruk, Courageous Yon, Seeker Zusshi, and Wastewalker Shu in pet battles.
Text: You must now face the toughest tamers in all of Azeroth. They make their home in Pandaria, training ground of the grand masters. There are six grand masters left to defeat: Hyuna of the Shrines in The Jade Forest, Farmer Nishi in Valley of the Four Winds, Mo'ruk in Krasarang Wilds, Courageous Yon in Kun-Lai Summit, Seeker Zusshi in Townlong Steppes, and Wastewalker Shu in Dread Wastes. If you think yourself ready, seek out these champions of the trade and prove yourself!

Title: Grand Master Payne
Objective: Defeat Major Payne in a pet battle.
Text: In my opinion, my fellow tamers have been far too lenient on your training. True pet taming requires militaristic discipline. I shall honor you with the pleasure of seeing firsthand what that discipline can produce. Come to the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown and see firsthand what you could become!

Title: Grand Master Antari
Objective: Defeat Bloodknight Antari in a pet battle.
Text: You capitalized on my mistake last time and emerged victorious. This time, you will not be so fortunate.

Title: Morulu The Elder
Objective: Defeat Morulu The Elder in a pet battle.
Text: I have learned much since our last encounter. Do you wish to test your skills once more?

Title: Ras'an
Objective: Defeat Ras'an in a pet battle.
Text: You want to fight again? I think I've gotten better!

Title: A Tamer's Homecoming
Objective: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.
Text: Yer ready to enter the full circuit of pet battlin', matey. Go back to yer trainer, Mish Burnhep, in Stormwind, and prepare for the adventure of a lifetime!

Title: Battle Pet Tamers: Outland
Objective: Defeat Nicki Tinytech, Ras'an, Narrok, and Morulu the Elder in pet battles.
Text: You've bested the master tamers of Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, but your next challenge will be far more trying. There are four tamers in Outland that you must now defeat: Nicki Tinytech in Hellfire Peninsula, Ras'an in Zangarmarsh, Narrok in Nagrand, and Morulu the Elder in Shattrath. You must defeat them to proceed on the path to greatness.

Title: A Tamer's Homecoming
Objective: Report to Varzok in Orgrimmar.
Text: If you beat me, then you must be ready for da big time! Go talk to Varzok in Orgrimmar.

Title: Nicki Tinytech
Objective: Defeat Nicki Tinytech in a pet battle.
Text: According to my calculations, I have a 32.333% chance of victory. I'll take it!

Title: Battle Pet Tamers: Outland
Objective: Defeat Nicki Tinytech, Ras'an, Narrok, and Morulu the Elder in pet battles.
Text: You've bested the master tamers of Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, but your next challenge will be far more trying. There are four tamers in Outland that you must now defeat: Nicki Tinytech in Hellfire Peninsula, Ras'an in Zangarmarsh, Narrok in Nagrand, and Morulu the Elder in Shattrath. You must defeat them to proceed on the path to greatness.

Title: Grand Master Antari
Objective: Defeat Bloodknight Antari in a pet battle.
Text: I've seen the likes of you before. A young, naive tamer that thinks that they deserve victory handed to them on a silver platter. Well no more! I will be your reckoning. I, Bloodknight Antari of Shadowmoon Valley, await the chance to show you how it feels to be obliterated in battle.

Title: Durin Darkhammer
Objective: Defeat Durin Darkhammer in a pet battle.
Text: My time under the Firelord has prepared me fer anything. Nothing you can throw at me will deter me!

Title: Grand Master Lydia Accoste
Objective: Defeat Lydia Accoste in a pet battle.
Text: You wish to face me again? You will regret this decision!

Title: Grand Master Lydia Accoste
Objective: Defeat Lydia Accoste in a pet battle.
Text: The master tamers around the Eastern Kingdoms have been talking about you. You think yourself unstoppable? You believe that you are the true grand master? Come, then. I await you in Deadwind Pass. Come, and know the crushing defeat that's always been yours.

Title: Grand Master Trixxy
Objective: Defeat Stone Cold Trixxy in a pet battle.
Text: Freeze! You've finally warmed up from our last encounter, have you? Let's change that.

Title: Kortas Darkhammer
Objective: Defeat Kortas Darkhammer in a pet battle.
Text: I hear that you fought my fool of a brother. He lost, eh? Looks like this is my time to shine!

Title: Deiza Plaguehorn
Objective: Defeat Deiza Plaguehorn in a pet battle.
Text: You have not yet turned to the true path of undeath. Perhaps another battle will show you the way.

Title: Everessa
Objective: Defeat Everessa in a pet battle.
Text: I believe I'm figuring out the secrets of this place. Soon I will be unstoppable!

Title: Elena Flutterfly
Objective: Defeat Elena Flutterfly in a pet battle.
Text: I see you're ready for another bout in the skies. Let's take flight!

Title: David Kosse
Objective: Defeat David Kosse in a pet battle.
Text: My research has helped my training regimen greatly. I will defeat you this time.

Title: Zoltan
Objective: Defeat Zoltan in a pet battle.
Text: With each passing day my power grows. Resistance is futile.

Title: Cassandra Kaboom
Objective: Defeat Cassandra Kaboom in a pet battle.
Text: I've loaded my pets with new gyrotechnic training modules. You're going down!

Title: Battle Pet Tamers: Eastern Kingdoms
Objective: Defeat David Kosse, Deiza Plaguehorn, Kortas Darkhammer, Everessa, and Durin Darkhammer in pet battles.
Text: Now that you've had a real chance to hone your skills, you're ready to venture out into the world of pet battles in full. There are five tamers throughout the Eastern Kingdoms that I'd like you to defeat: David Kosse in The Hinterlands, Deiza Plaguehorn in Eastern Plaguelands, Kortas Darkhammer in Searing Gorge, Everessa in Swamp of Sorrows, and Kortas' brother, Durin Darkhammer, in Burning Steppes.. If you are able to best them, you will be ready to venture further.

Title: Kela Grimtotem
Objective: Defeat Kela Grimtotem in a pet battle.
Text: You're so bold as to venture into the heart of Grimtotem lands once more to challenge me? You will regret your decision!

Title: Grazzle the Great
Objective: Defeat Grazzle the Great in a pet battle.
Text: You're back?! You're just asking to get eaten by a black dragon!

Title: Better Off Dread
Objective: Speak with Bowmistress Li on the Serpent's Spine.
Text: It's time we go to the source! Shado-Pan marksmen keep a constant watch over the Dread Wastes from the top of the Serpent's Spine. They would surely welcome the aid of a skilled  such as yourself. Seek out Bowmistress Li atop the Serpent's Spine on the border of Dread Wastes.

Title: Battle Pet Trainers: Kalimdor
Objective: Defeat Elena Flutterfly, Cassandra Kaboom, Golbo the Great, Zoltan, and Kela Grimtotem in pet battles.
Text: The very same trainers you bested before in Kalimdor have challenged you once more. No doubt they have not forgotten your last victory! Seek them out and show them your prowess!

Title: A Delicate Balance
Objective: Speak with Orbiss in the Sumprushes.
Text: The calling to be a Shado-pan is one to bring balance and harmony to this land. It is our duty to ensure balance is maintained. The yaungol activity in Townlong is threatening this balance and must be stopped before it is too late. We've had sightings of yaungol in the Sumprushes. The reports indicate they are attacking the mist lurkers in the area. Find out why and put an end to it!

Title: Grand Master Trixxy
Objective: Defeat Stone Cold Trixxy in a pet battle.
Text: Word around the master tamers in Kalimdor is you're the new hotshot that's making such a buzz. Why don't you come down to my training grounds in the Ice Thistle Hills in Winterspring so I can show you how it's done?

Title: Battle Pet Trainers: Kalimdor
Objective: Defeat Elena Flutterfly, Cassandra Kaboom, Golbo the Great, Zoltan, and Kela Grimtotem in pet battles.
Text: The same five trainers you defeated in Kalimdor have foolishly once more challenged you to battle. Show them no mercy!

Title: Battle Pet Tamers: Kalimdor
Objective: Defeat Traitor Gluk, Grazzle the Great, Kela Grimtotem, Zoltan, and Elena Flutterfly in pet battles.
Text: Now that you've had a real chance to hone your skills, you're ready to venture out into the world of pet battles in full. There are five tamers throughout Kalimdor that I'd like you to defeat: Traitor Gluk in Feralas, Grazzle the Great in Dustwallow Marsh, Kela Grimtotem in Thousand Needles, Zoltan in Felwood, and Elena Flutterfly in Moonglade. If you are able to best them, you will be ready to venture further.

Title: Pet Battle Trainers: Kalimdor
Objective: Defeat Steven Lisbane in a pet battle.
Text: It's time to put your battle skills to a true test. You will find Steven Lisbane wandering the roads in the southern parts of Northern Stranglethorn. Seek him out and see who the superior tamer is!

Text: Shado-Pan marksmen keep a constant watch over the Dread Wastes from the top of the Serpent's Spine. They would surely welcome the aid of a skilled  such as yourself. Take a kite and check in with Bowmistress Li.

Text: It's time to put your battle skills to a true test. You will find Steven Lisbane wandering the roads in the southern parts of Northern Stranglethorn. Seek him out and see who the superior tamer is!

Text: It's time to put your battle skills to a true test. You will find Steven Lisbane wandering the roads in the southern parts of Northern Stranglethorn. Seek him out and see who the superior tamer is!

Title: Varzok
Objective: Report to Varzok in Orgrimmar.
Text: I'm afraid I have nothing left to teach you. However, your journey as a trainer is far from over! Report to Varzok in Orgrimmar. He has connections with many of Azeroth's finest trainers, and will help you grow further.
