Objective: Speak with Inkmaster Wei at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.
Text: I have heard that the Inkmasters at the Arboretum are in need of aid from a scribe of great skill. You should speak with Inkmaster Wei, if you wish to help.

Title: Merda Stronghoof
Objective: Defeat Merda Stronghoof in a pet battle.
Text: Just as the land continues to grow, my team is stronger than ever. Are you sure you wish to combat me? There is no shame in admitting defeat now.

Title: Traitor Gluk
Objective: Defeat Traitor Gluk in a pet battle.
Text: You beat Gluk before, but now Gluk lay da smackdown on puny !

Title: Zonya the Sadist
Objective: Defeat Zonya the Sadist in a pet battle.
Text: The prey be walkin' to the predator's territory, unaware of the danger that  is in. You be givin' Zonya no trouble dis time.

Title: Cassandra Kaboom
Objective: Defeat Cassandra Kaboom in a pet battle.
Text: Cassandra Kaboom is a fierce tamer, known for her mechanical pets. She should serve as the next step on your journey to greatness. Find her in Southern Barrens near the Frazzlecraz Motherlode and challenge her. Beating Cassandra will surely prove yourself in the eyes of Varzok. Good luck.

Title: The Peak of Serenity - Begin Your Training
Objective: Use Zen Pilgrimage to travel to the Peak of Serenity. Speak to Master Hight in the Shrine of the Ox when you arrive.
Text: The time has come for you to venture to the Peak of Serenity to begin training in the ways of the Monk. Use Zen Pilgrimage to go there and speak with Master Hight when you arrive.

Text: You dare to challenge me again? This time, I do believe our battle is going to sway in my favor!

Title: Bill Buckler
Objective: Defeat Bill Buckler in a pet battle.
Text: So ye've come fer another round, have ye? I'll show ya why they be callin' me the shcourge o' the vale!

Title: All Aboard!
Objective: Speak to General Nazgrim aboard Hellscream's Fist.
Text: You hear all of that? There are Alliance that need killing and I need to round up a veteran crew. You're coming with me! We won't be returning until our assignment's complete, so round up your things and make ready. I'll be aboard a newly commissioned gunship over Bladefist Bay. Don't keep me waiting!

Title: Eric Davidson
Objective: Defeat Eric Davidson in a pet battle.
Text: Ah, so you've braved the woods again to face me in battle. I accept your brazen challenge to my vicious spawn.

Title: Practice Makes Perfect: Master Yoon
Objective: Speak with Master Yoon in the Peak of Serenity and complete your training with him.
Text: Welcome Back. I see you've returned to hone your skills. Speak with Master Yoon in the Training Grounds below us for a practice sparring session.

Title: Better Dead than Dread
Objective: Speak with Bowmistress Li on the Serpent's Spine.
Text: I am sure many of our associates will be requesting your services after your victory here. But I have received a request for aid from our defenders at the wall along the Dread Wastes.If you would assist them, then take a kite and check in with Bowmistress Li.

Objective: Speak with Master Cheng in the Training Grounds and complete your training with him.
Text: Greetings. Welcome to the Peak of Serenity. It is here that we monks train and hone our skills in the martial arts. The time has come for you to begin your training. Speak with Master Cheng in the Training Grounds below us to begin.

Title: Level Up!
Objective: Raise a pet to level 3.
Text: Good, good. It's important to keep your pets healthy and ready for battle. My next task for you is to fight a few battles and raise a pet to level 3. Once you do that, come back and see me and we can talk about catching your own pets!

Title: Analynn
Objective: Defeat Analynn in a pet battle.
Text: Determination is naught without proper challenge. Find Analynn wandering the roads in western Ashenvale. She is a bit...eccentric...but a fine trainer nonetheless! Fighting her will harden your team.

Title: A Present for Teacher
Objective: Receive Nomi's gift.
Text: I'm all caught up with the other kids now, even though I started very late. Now I can join the regular classes! I made you an apron to show you how much I appreciate all you've done for me. I hope you like it?

Title: Merda Stronghoof
Objective: Defeat Merda Stronghoof in a pet battle.
Text: Are you ready for a real measure of your prowess? Merda Stronghoof has made camp at da place dey call Karnum's Glade in the Cenarion Wildlands of Desolace. Fighting a trainer as powerful as her will put your skills to the test, eh?

Title: Traitor Gluk
Objective: Defeat Bill the Pirate in a pet battle.
Text: Are you up for an adventure? Bill the Pirate, local star tamer down in the Cape of Stranglethorn, has issued an open challenge to prepared trainers! You can find Bill the Pirate in the southern Cape of Stranglethorn, walking the local roads to find potential fights.

Title: Riding the Skies
Objective: Join the Order of the Cloud Serpent.
Text: I can no longer call myself your teacher. You have proven yourself worthy of your cloud serpent. Today, you shall join our ranks. Are you ready?

Title: Zonya the Sadist
Objective: Defeat Zonya the Sadist in a pet battle.
Text: , a rare opportunity has arisen that I think you will be interested in. Zonya the Sadist in southern Stonetalon Mountains has returned to the battle scene. I must suggest that you face her to further hone your own abilities as a tamer.

Title: Riding the Skies
Objective: Join the Order of the Cloud Serpent.
Text: I can no longer call myself your teacher. You have proven yourself worthy of your cloud serpent. Today, you shall join our ranks. Are you ready?

Title: Zunta, The Pet Tamer
Objective: Defeat Zunta in a pet battle.
Text: I can tell you have been honing your pet battle skills. I think it's time for you to take on a real challenge. Zunta can be found near the Tor'kren Farm south of Orgrimmar. He is an up and coming wild pet tamer and I think it's time you faced him in battle!

Title: Dagra the Fierce
Objective: Defeat Dagra the Fierce in a pet battle.
Text: Der be another trainer not far from here that you ought to fight to test your worth. Dagra the Fierce waits on the northern slope of Thorn Hill, east of The Crossroads. If you be beatin' her, you just might have what it takes.

Title: Test Quest
Objective: Put the artifact on display.
Text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition. Perhaps you will put it on display at the Seat of Knowledge, so that lorewalkers and archaeologists can study it.

Title: Rampage Against the Machine
Objective: Kill 200 Mantid while controlling Kovok in the Scar.
Text: Kovok has progressed at an astonishing rate. Perhaps the years in hibernation effected his growth process... Whatever the reason, this could not have come at a better time. I believe it is time to test his abilities. You have done so much to aid in his training. It is only fitting that you assist him in his first battle. I've already guided him to the edge of the scar. Find him and destroy Shek'zeer's army!

Title: Old MacDonald
Objective: Defeat Old MacDonald in a pet battle.
Text: I won't be such a pushover this time around!

Title: Strongarm Tactics
Objective: Slay Corporal Jackson Silver, Morgus Grimhatchet, and Master Mechanic Cogswing and Gyro-Engineer Lavenderp.
Text: Scouting reports from the Strongarm Airstrip are in, and I've underlined a few high-priority targets for you. Two gnomish mechanics have been keeping Alliance gyrocopters in the air. Take out the mechanics, and the gyrocopters' numbers will dwindle. A dwarven death knight wanders their perimeter. He's an adventurer like yourself - loosely allied and highly dangerous. Finally, a name I recognize: Corporal Jackson Silver. He's a hero of the Alliance and a deadshot with a crossbow. Good luck.

Title: Overthrone
Objective: Speak to Klaxxi'va Vor in Klaxxi'vess.
Text: The council is in harmony, wakener. Our ritual will bring about the demise of the empress and allow us to secure the future of our great empire. Behold the power of the Klaxxi!

Title: Choppertunity
Objective: Pick up Requisitioned Fireworks Launchers in Strongarm Airstrip, then use them on 12 Strongarm Gyrocopters.
Text: I spotted some shoulder-mounted rocket launchers on the way over here. They mighta been fireworks. I dunno. I'm just going to assume that they were shoulder-mounted rocket launchers until I'm proven wrong. Point is, in the arms of a skilled  like you, they could probably take down a chopper. If you find any lying around, try pointing them at those poorly-built gyrocopters.

Title: The Darkness Within
Objective: Slay Captain Doren.
Text: You didn't see Captain Doren while you were out there, did you? That sniveling Alliance leader must be in hiding somewhere. If he wasn't in that airbase, he can't be far. Search the perimeter - try searching the cave southwest of the main airfield. I want the Alliance gone from here!

Title: Lindsay
Objective: Defeat Lindsay in a pet battle.
Text: Think you can take me again? I'm always up for challenge!

Title: Assault on the Airstrip
Objective: Slay 15 Strongarm troops at Strongarm Airstrip.
Text: I have found their hidden airfield: the Strongarm Airstrip. It wasn't hard to spot, it's swarming with Alliance.  They think they've wiped us out, but we're Horde! We fight until we're corpses... and sometimes even afterwards. Let them taste our steel!

Title: Seeking Zin'jun
Objective: Locate Zin'jun somewhere in the Ascent of the Swirling Winds.
Text: Rivett claims to have seen Zin'jun abandon ship with the rest of the survivors. That means he's still out there somewhere. We can't leave him behind. He could be injured or worse yet, captured! Go track down Zin'jun and bring him back.

Title: Unreliable Allies
Objective: Encourage 12 Pandaren Volunteers to leave the Strongarm Airstrip.
Text: We originally welcomed the Alliance as friends. Several of our villagers volunteered to help them build an airstrip. Only recently, however, did it become clear to us that they were building a war base, within shouting distance of our village. What's worse - I fear that some villagers are being held against their will. If you find them, let them know that it is time to come home.

Title: Face to Face With Consequence
Objective: Kill 20 Sha Haunts and 7 Sha Harbingers.
Text: I do not know the history of this war that you fight, and I am not interested. This land responds to negative energy in kind. The hatreds, doubt, and violence you have brought here now ooze out of Pandaria like blood from an open wound. Your actions have wrought havoc all over these ruins! Clean up after yourself and meet me in the village below - I will do my best to explain what is happening here.

Title: Prowler Problems
Objective: Destroy 10 Sha-Infested Prowlers in Honeydew Glade.
Text: The animals have all gone crazy! Normally the prowlers steer clear of the village, but now we can't seem to keep them away. I've never seen them act this way before! The mayor has summoned in the Shado-Pan, but they're not all here yet. Can you take care of those prowlers before they maul one of our farmers?

Title: Priorities!
Objective: Find 6 Barrels of Honeybrew in Honeydew Glade.
Text: Just look at this mess! All that brew gone to waste! Taran Zhu warned us against speaking to you outsiders, but I'll take any help I can get. We were on our way to Dawn's Blossom when the fighting broke out. Now all of our brew has been lost! You want to make it up to us? Maybe you can find some of our Honeybrew barrels that haven't been broken. Then it wouldn't be a complete loss.

Title: Fire Is Always the Answer
Objective: Destroy 10 Stacks of Thunder Hold Munitions.
Text: It's not enough that we destroy their forces. Nothing must be left for them to salvage! Take this flare-gun and fire it into their munitions stockpiles. Leave them nothing!

Title: You're Either With Us Or...
Objective: Attempt to enlist the help of Mayor Honeydew in Honeydew Village.
Text: The assistance of the nearby village has now become a necessity. We will need to use the village to regroup and tend to our wounded. Perhaps the villagers will join our cause after seeing the brutality unleashed by the alliance. You will act as envoy for the Horde. Ensure the cooperation of their leader. Do not disappoint me!

Title: The Final Blow!
Objective: Slay Captain Doren in Thunder Hold.
Text: We've learned that their captain has barricaded himself in above us. The coward allowed his forces to die while he hid from our fury! Typical Alliance! No matter. He cannot delay his fate any longer. I will scale the walls with my marines while you lead a frontal assault up the ramps. Use your flare gun on munitions near the barricades to blast your way through. We will meet you up top and destroy this pathetic excuse for a captain together!

Title: Touching Ground
Objective: Use a Rappelling Rope to reach the ground.
Text: Nazgrim has taken command of the ground assault and has requested that you be sent to meet up with him immediately. We have several rappelling ropes setup near the guns. Fastest way down you're going to find, save the one that ends poorly.

Title: Finish Them!
Objective: Slay 15 Thunder Hold troops.
Text: We've softened them up. Now it's time to finish them off! That fortress must be cleansed of Alliance, and we've got nowhere to keep any prisoners.  You know what to do. The cowards will run if you give them the chance. See that you don't!

Title: Crumbling Behemoth
Objective: Destroy the Shao-Tien Behomoth.
Text: The mogu have succeeded in empowering an enormous stone statue with the intent of unleashing it upon us. In response, I would like to unleash you upon it. It approaches from the Golden Stair. Bring it to its knees...

Title: Paint it Red!
Objective: Use a Gunship Turret to kill 80 Thunder Hold troops and destroy 9 Thunder Hold cannons.
Text: They shot out our engines and we floated here - HERE! Right in the firing line of the enemy! You know what to do. Get below decks and man those guns! Show these scum that they're in OUR line of fire!

Title: Striking First
Objective: Stop the Shao-Tien Behemoth from being empowered.
Text: The mogu are empowering some giant stone monstrosity up on the Golden Stair, with the sure intent of unleashing it upon us. How about you go and let them know our opinion on the matter? Make sure the point strikes home.

Title: Breaking Their Spirits (Not Yet Implemented)
Objective: Stop the Shao-Tien Spirit Ritual.
Text: The mogu have piled the bodies of our brethren high at the top of the Golden Stair, and are conducting some foul ritual to tear their spirits from their bodies and turn them on us. Find this ritual and stop it. Leave them a firm reminder of what will happen if they attempt this again.

Title: Laosy Scouting
Objective: Rescue Lao Softfoot.
Text: Lao Softfoot got himself captured again up on the Golden Stair. I'm not going to make any excuses for him, he's a lousy rogue. We probably shouldn't just leave him there though. Could you go find him?

Title: Acts of Cruelty
Objective: Rescue 5 Golden Lotus Guards or Mistfall Villagers.
Text: I can hear the screams of the captured soldiers and villagers up on the Golden Stair. They're torturing them! Please, please, you have to save them!

Title: Unleashed Spirits
Objective: Kill 12 Unleashed Spirits.
Text: The Shao-Tien have unleashed their captive tortured spirits upon us. They flood down from the Golden Stair, with no end in sight. Kill as many of these unleashed spirits as you can. They are fragile, but if you are not alert, they can easily overrun you. Good luck.

Title: High Chance of Rain
Objective: Destroy the Stormcaller staves.
Text: The mogu are conjuring some kind of sinister storm upon the Golden Stair. Generally, mogu and lightning are not a particularly pleasant mix. I say we stop them. You should be able to find their Stormcaller staves pretty easily, considering the giant arcs of lightning extending up from them. Mind knocking them over or destroying them or something for me? I sure would sleep better.

Title: Onward and Inward
Objective: Report to Admiral Rogers at Paw'don Village in the Jade Forest.
Text: "Sha" energy, hm? Tread carefully,  - there's a hidden darkness to this continent. We'll stay behind to mop up the rest of the Horde, but we need you to continue with the main mission: the rescue of Captain Taylor, and the retrieval of Prince Anduin. Our aerial scouts think we've found the wreckage of the flagship near Paw'don Village. Go there and report to Admiral Rogers for instructions. You are welcome to use my gyrocopter.

Title: Unfair Trade
Objective: Free 8 Captive Pandaren Cubs from Twinspire Keep by slaying the demonic eyeballs that watch over them.
Text: Though we have only just met, we have a common enemy: this group called the "Horde." Several days ago, their leader made us a trade offer. When we refused, his servants abducted several of our cubs as bargaining chips. We have called in the Shado-Pan to help, but they are in Kun-Lai Summit, a journey of several days. Can you come to our aid?

Title: Smoke Before Fire
Objective: Use the Alliance Flare to call in an airstrike on the Pile of Munitions, the Twinspire Demolishers, the Wild Imps, and Xhu'daggab.
Text: Sully scouted the Horde establishment to the north, and he reports seeing a large pile of explosives, along with a small force of demolishers. That's not to mention the demons that their warlocks have summoned. Luckily, we came prepared. We've got air support from the Skyfire. We just need to show our pilots where to strike.

Title: Cannonfire
Objective: Destroy 7 Shao-Tien Cannons.
Text: Those mogu cannons up on the Golden Stair are bombarding us from a distance. Sure would be nice if they somehow spontaneously broke, don't you think?

Title: Fractured Forces
Objective: Slay Dalgan and Bellandra Felstorm.
Text: The Horde have made our jobs easier for us. Their infighting and segregation have split their camp in two: orcs in the west, and undead in the east. The orcs obey their commander Dalgan, while the undead follow Bellandra Felstorm, a powerful warlock. Hopefully, their internal squabbles will be enough of a distraction that you'll be able to sneak in there and kill both of them. Sully has already infiltrated the ruins; find him inside when you are done.

Title: The Cost of War
Objective: Slay 10 Sha Haunts and 5 Sha Harbingers in Garrosh'ar Point.
Text: This whole place is going up in flames and the Skyfire is reporting that more of those... shadows are crawling up out of the ground. We need to get our people out of here. Clear a path through the base on your way north and head for the town. I will rendezvous with you there.

Title: Envoy of the Alliance
Objective: Find and meet with the leader of Paw'don Village.
Text: North of this base is a cherry blossom orchard and a village tucked away behind it. We will need to quarter there and tend to our wounded while we plan our next move. Head to that village and make contact with the native leader. Agent Mishka and I will rendezvous with you there. Be courteous! I am authorizing you to represent the entire Alliance here. I'm banking that seeing a powerful Alliance hero like you should make a favorable impression.

Title: Koukou's Rampage
Objective: Kill Koukou.
Text: We have more than just our cellars to worry about. Koukou, our beloved mushan, has gone crazy! Just look at him! I've tried cajoling and pleading and yelling and soothing, but nothing has worked. I'm afraid he is no longer of his own mind. There is only one way to save him, and our brewery. Strike swift and sure. He will not feel a thing.

Title: Pillaging Peons
Objective: Kill 12 Twinspire Taskmasters or Twinspire Peons.
Text: How did my village become a battlefield? To the west, your Horde enemies cut down our precious orchard. Without our apple trees, we will have no harvest, no food, and no livelihood. If you are truly different than this Horde, show us! Help us protect our grove by killing those who defile the land.

Title: Priorities!
Objective: Collect 6 Applebloom Cider.
Text: Those "orc" things ransacked the brewery and made off with my family's finest barrels of cider. I know there is a war out there, but I am not a brewer who will stand idly by while his prized vintage is chugged by undeserving lips. The "Horde" will likely put up some resistance. Why don't you put that weapon to good use and help me recover my cider?

Title: Twinspire Keep
Objective: Slay 15 Horde troops in Twinspire Keep.
Text: I do not trust this Horde. They wield foul magic, and their intentions are clearly malevolent. We can no longer stand their presence in Twinspire Keep, so close to Paw'don. I beg you, visitor: thin their numbers before they do something awful to this village.

Title: Welcome Wagons
Objective: Use Sully's Flaregun to destroy 5 Horde War Wagons.
Text: Did you see the size of those war wagons? They're packing so many explosives, I cannae tell if the Horde is here to take over this continent or just blow it out of the sea! We need to neutralize those wagons before they leave Garrosh'ar Point. Here, take me pocket flares. Fire 'em into a wagon and watch the fireworks!

Title: The Right Tool For The Job
Objective: Use Sully's Flaregun to clear out the barricades and confront Ga'trul at the end of the dock.
Text: I've scouted the area and found no leads on the prince or Admiral Taylor. We need to neutralize this base quickly and continue our search elsewhere. Operations here are being led by an orc warlock; Ga'trul. He's barricaded the dock and is trying to escape through a demonic circle. Put that flaregun to work again and blow those barricades! I'll cover your back and move in when you reach Ga'trul.

Title: Touching Ground
Objective: Use a Skyfire Parachute to touch ground in Garrosh'ar Point, then speak to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary.
Text: Their town is burning and their men are scattered and broken. I need every available man on the ground NOW to finish them off. Grab one of the parachutes on the edge of the ship and get down there!

Title: A Not So Friendly Request
Objective: Speak with Sapmaster Vu at The Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.
Text: Scouts have reported a non-mantid presence near Kor'vess. Their intrusion and their theft of amber would normally be dealt with swiftly, but our forces are needed elsewhere. This task seems suited to you, Wakener. You will convince them to leave this land, or you will destroy them in the name of the Klaxxi'va.

Title: Unleash Hell
Objective: Use a Skyfire Gyrocopter to slay 60 of the Garrosh'ar troops and destroy 8 Garrosh'ar Shredders, and then sink the Bladefist Reaper and Stygian Scar.
Text: I will NOT let the Horde gain a foothold on these shores before we do! If you're looking to jump into the fray, I've got a spare gyrocopter for you at the end of the runway. An attack run is already programmed in, all you have to do is concentrate on shooting. Unleash hell upon these orcs!

Title: Eric Davidson
Objective: Defeat Eric Davidson in a pet battle.
Text: I heard all my friends talking about a scary worgen called Eric Davidson in Duskwood that nobody ever fights with their pets. I bet if you found and beat him, people might talk about you instead!

Title: Gambling Problem
Objective: Speak with Deck Boss Arie at Soggy's Gamble in Dread Wastes.
Text: If this war is to be won we cannot afford to leave anything unchecked, outsider. There is a disturbance along the coast that needs to be investigated. The presence there is not our kind and are of no value to us. However, their supplies could prove very valuable. If there is anything of use there we must get to it before the empress.

Title: Steven Lisbane
Objective: Defeat Steven Lisbane in a pet battle.
Text: If you thought I was tough, prepare yourself. The road only gets harder from here. Find Steven Lisbane wandering the roads in the southern parts of Northern Stranglethorn. Seek him out and see who the superior tamer is!

Title: Bill Buckler
Objective: Defeat Bill the Pirate in a pet battle.
Text: My longtime friend, fellow trainer, and infamous drunkard Bill Buckler of the Cape of Stranglethorn, has issued an open challenge to prepared trainers! You should answer his call and really put your skills to the test. He tends to wander the southern roads of the Cape.

Title: Old MacDonald
Objective: Defeat Old MacDonald in a pet battle.
Text: You're tough for just starting out! Old MacDonald taught me everything I know about battling. I think fighting him would be a great learning experience for you! He can be found just across the bridge leading to Westfall. Don't let his age fool you, he's already beaten quite a few up-and-coming trainers like yourself.

Title: Lindsay
Objective: Defeat Lindsay in a pet battle.
Text: Are you ready to show off what you can do? There's a little girl up in Redridge Mountains that has made a real storm on the battle scene. Find Lindsay at the dock at Camp Everstill. She may be young, but her impressive record is nothing to be scoffed at!

Title: Valley of the Four Winds
Objective: Speak to Private Tim P. O'Rary in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: Yarr, the Jade Forest be goin through some violent reconstruction, but the Valley of the Four Winds is ripe for explorin. I can help ye on yer way if ye wants to explore it. Be sure to check out me wares for some equipment that may help ye on yer journey.

Title: The Trainer's Challenge: Qua-Ro Whitebrow
Objective: Speak to Qua-Ro Whitebrow, then defeat him.
Text: Qua-Ro Whitebrow is commonly considered the best student of the Order. He seems quite without weakness. He is quick of intellect, strong of arm, hard-working, and talented. When you face him in the training ring, you will be testing yourself against our best. Speak to him to begin the duel. No matter the outcome, you will learn much from challenging him.

Title: The Trainer's Challenge: Ningna Darkwheel
Objective: Speak to Ningna Darkwheel, then defeat her.
Text: You show much promise. However, talent is worth little without discipline and humility. Today, you will face Ningna Darkwheel. Her natural strength makes her one of our most talented students. If you hope to defeat her, you will need to act with the utmost control. Speak to her in the training ring to begin the challenge. Good luck.

Title: The Trainer's Challenge: Suchi the Sweet
Objective: Speak to Suchi the Sweet, then defeat her.
Text: Today you will face Suchi the Sweet in the training ring. Despite her sweet exterior, she is a tough opponent. She attacks swiftly and surely, but such potent attacks can become tiring over time. If you hope to defeat her, you will need to concentrate your damage when she is weakened. Speak to Suchi to begin the duel. Good luck.

Title: The Trainer's Challenge: Big Bao
Objective: Speak to Big Bao, then defeat him.
Text: Are you ready for another lesson? Today, you will spar against Big Bao. He is large of stature and of heart, and he will not give up until he is wholly beaten. If you wish to defeat him, you will need to persevere. Speak to him in the training ring to begin the challenge. Good luck.

Title: The Big Brew-haha
Objective: Collect 100 Sri-La Stout.
Text: It's a disaster! When I went to visit the Dancing Serpent Inn yesterday, they were all out of brew. They said the shipment from Sri-La Village had been stolen. STOLEN! Turns out those Oona hozen have been making all kinds of trouble down at the docks, including taking all the brew to their cave at Oona Kagu along the coast. I can't handle a dry spell. A life without brew is not a life worth living! Someone needs to go and save the brew!

Title: The Trainer's Challenge: Ace Longpaw
Objective: Speak to Ace Longpaw, then defeat him.
Text: You are rising up the ranks of our students. Just as a sword must be forged through fire, so must our students test themselves against one another. Today, you will spar against one of our brightest disciples, Ace Longpaw. In order to defeat him, you will need to make use of your defensive capabilities. Speak to him in the training ring to begin the challenge. Good luck.

Title: The Big Kah-Oona
Objective: Kill Lord Oona.
Text: The leader of the Oona hozen is a brigand by the name of Lord Oona. I have heard fearsome tales of this roaming sea captain and his crew. Everywhere he takes his tribe, destruction follows. The Oona land their boats on fertile soil, pillage the local villages, and drain the land dry before moving on to their next conquest. We shall not allow the same to occur on our shores, not while I am still in charge. I need someone to go eradicate him now.

Title: Monkey Mischief
Objective: Kill 13 Oona hozen.
Text: Strange tales have reached our ears from Sri-La Village. It seems that a hozen tribe has made itself comfortable in Oona Kagu, a cave along the coast south of the fishing village. Too comfortable, in fact. The tribe members are stealing and pillaging resources all along the coast. We must teach them a lesson... one that can only be taught by force. They have already overstayed their welcome.

Title: Pooped
Objective: Collect 5 Big Bags of Poop.
Text: As it looks at you with bashful eyes, you can tell that someone has gotten out of its pen and had... an accident. Well, at the rate that the serpent's been eating, it had to come out the other end... somewhere. You had better find the serpent's poop and clean it up before the Serpent Masters find out.

Title: Lingering Doubt
Objective: Use the Sha Attunement Device at the Sha Disturbances in The Widow's Wail. The entrance to The Widow's Wail can be found to the north along the coast, south of Sri-La Village.
Text: I heard that there has been some strange behavior down at The Widow's Wail to the north. Hyacinth and I went to investigate, and I am certain that some presence of the sha has found its way into the cavern. I created this device to measure sha energy levels. If you are going that way, would you mind taking measurements of any sha disturbances? The disturbances look like streams of white and black sha energy pouring from the ground.

Title: The Seed of Doubt
Objective: Kill the Seed of Doubt.
Text: The problem with the sha of doubt, is its deceitful pervasiveness. Once the seed of doubt is planted, it can grow like an unwelcome weed. Such a seed has been planted in The Widow's Wail to the north, and like a weed, we must extinguish its presence immediately. I need you to destroy the lingering fragment of doubt before it can infect any more victims.

Title: Tiny Treats
Objective: Collect 100 Tiny Spider Eyes.
Text: As you near, your serpent opens its mouth and begins drooling. It looks quite hungry since you last left it. From the way it whimpers and slaps its tail, you can tell it is not looking for just any treat, but a special favorite snack. Your serpent loves to munch on tiny spider eyes, but this delicacy comes only from the Widowspawn spiders in the cave along the coast to the north. Well, what's a rider to do? Your serpent is waiting.

Title: Serpent's Scale
Objective: Collect 25 Serpent's Scale.
Text: I see you have gained your own hatchling. Have you been feeding it, cleaning after it, and playing with it properly? Only by doing so will it become strong and healthy. Now let me tell you a trainer's secret. To the north, in The Widow's Wail, you can find a mushroom known as Serpent's Scale. It is difficult to acquire, but this mushroom has powerful properties and important nutrients. Your serpent won't like eating it, but who likes eating their vegetables?

Title: Dark Huntress
Objective: Kill the Windward Huntress.
Text: I have learned that a vicious beast, a Windward Huntress, terrorizes the wood on the northwest side of the island. She has already slain several serpents, and injured more than one serpent rider sent to subdue her. She must be removed before she can pose a danger to anyone else. Can you perform this task?

Title: Weeping Widows
Objective: Kill 7 Weeping Widows.
Text: The spiders near Sri-La Village have grown very aggressive. They pose a severe problem to the anglers who fish along the coast. For their safety, I need you to go and eliminate the Weeping Widows in The Widow's Wail. You can find the cave along the coast to the north.

Title: Needle Me Not
Objective: Use the honey at the northern clearing in The Arboretum, and then kill the Orchard Needler.
Text: The Arboretum is our home, a safe haven where we raise young hatchlings and train our students. Unfortunately, there are other, more dangerous creatures who wish to make this their home as well. To the north, beyond the river, we have seen a great wasp feeding on the nectar blossoms. This creature has already stung several of our students. Use this honey to lure the wasp out of hiding. Then, destroy it before it harms anyone else.

Title: A Tangled Web
Objective: Destroy Widow's Webs to free 5 Sri-La Villagers.
Text: We have had a disturbing report from the Anglers fishermen of Sri-La Village. Many of their villagers are missing, taken by the spiders who live in The Widow's Wail, a cave along the coast to the north. The victims are dragged into the dark depths, wrapped in cocoons, and left to become the spiders' next meal. We believe that some of the people may still be alive. There is still time to save them! I need you to go and rescue as many villagers as you can find.

Title: Saving the Serpents
Objective: Collect 10 Rescued Serpents.
Text: Those Oona hozen have gone too far this time. Do you know what they are doing with wild cloud serpents? Captured hatchlings are forced to fight one another in the pits, for nothing more than the Oona's amusement. Savages! If the young hatchlings learn such aggressive behavior at a young age, they may become violent and corrupted adults. A malicious cloud serpent is not something we want to deal with. We must save the hatchlings.

Title: Madcap Mayhem
Objective: Kill the Shadowfae Madcap.
Text: There is another task I must ask of you. The leader of the woodland sprites is the Shadowfae Madcap. If there is trouble brewing, he is the mastermind pulling the puppet strings. We do not have time to deal with the sprites' tiresome pranks and insolence. Take out the Shadowfae Madcap, and be quick about it.

Title: Pooped
Objective: Collect 5 Tiny Bags of Poop.
Text: You can tell that someone has gotten out of its pen and had "an accident." Well, at the rate that the hatchling's been eating, it had to come out the other end... somewhere. You had better find the serpent's poop and clean it up before the Serpent Masters find out.

Title: Sprite Fright
Objective: Kill 7 Shadowfae Tricksters.
Text: Oh bother, how am I supposed to get my tasks done, now? Instructor Skythorn asked me to go kill some tigers at Windward Isle, but I heard the area was overrun with sprites! Ugh! I hate sprites! They totally give me the creeps! They're so small, and... and... they jump on you and... and... they have cold, dead little stick hands! Auuugh! You have to help me. Get rid of those things, please!

Title: The Shoe Is On The Other Foot
Objective: Re-steal 14 Stolen Boots.
Text: I loathe sprites! One time, one of those nasty buggers followed me all day, putting dirt in my tea and bugs in my hair. I mean, who does that!? Well, I think it's time for a little payback. Do you know what the sprites up at Windward Isle love more than anything in the world? Yeah, you guessed it. Shoes! And we're going to steal them. Won't that make them mad! Hah! Well, I'm scared to go near sprites, so you'll have to do it.

Title: Thinning The Pack
Objective: Kill 8 Windward Tigers or Windward Alphas.
Text: The past few seasons have been plentiful, and as a result, the wild tiger population on Windward Isle has exploded. The savage creatures have hunted out all the nearby game, and are beginning to encroach upon the cloud serpent nests. As a result, as the tigers thrive, the cloud serpents decline. If we are not careful, the predatory cats could completely wipe them out. We must thin the tigers' numbers.

Title: Julia Stevens
Objective: Defeat Julia Stevens in a pet battle.
Text: Think you can take me again?

Title: Inscribed Crane Staff
Objective: Bring your Inscribed Crane Staff to Inkmaster Jo Po in the Arboretum.
Text: As powerful it is, at some point you know you will outgrow this staff. When that time comes, one of the Inkmasters in the Arboretum would most likely be interested in taking it from you.

Title: Beyond the Wall
Objective: Speak with Taran Zhu at the Longying Outpost in Townlong Steppes.
Text: We received word the Shado-Pan have begun a counter attack in to Townlong Steppes. It sounds like they are going after the root of the yaungol invasion. The pandaren have not traveled in force in to Townlong for thousands of years. The Shado-Pan are strong and brave, but they are also proud and few. They will need help from heroes like yourself. Can you travel through the Gate of Winter's Blossom in the northwest? Find the Shado-Pan leaders and lend your help and experience?

Title: The Search for Restless Leng
Objective: Search Sik'thik Cages for Restless Leng.
Text: One of my best scouts, Restless Leng, went missing during a mission on the other side of Sik'vess. I'm hopeful that he was captured rather than killed, but with the mantid corrupted so heavily by sha, it doesn't seem likely. Still, can you investigate the cages around Sik'vess? I owe him a more thorough search than even this, but I have no men to spare without allowing our southern lines to break. Please, even if there's no life left in him, find him that I might know his fate.

Title: Inscribed Tiger Staff
Objective: Bring your Inscribed Tiger Staff to Inkmaster Glenzu in the Arboretum.
Text: As powerful it is, at some point you know you will outgrow this staff. When that time comes, one of the Inkmasters in the Arboretum would most likely be interested in taking it from you.

Title: Thinning the Sik'thik
Objective: Kill 12 Sik'thik mantid.
Text: For all our efforts to keep the mantid in the Dread Wastes, some have broken through, seemingly intent on Niuzao Temple. My men have been attempting to extinguish their presence to the west, at Sik'vess, but to no success. If you're half of the  Taran paints you to be, maybe you will fare better. Head west, and kill any Sik'thik mantid you find. And remember, this is no time for mercy. There are lives at the temple depending on us.

Title: Inscribed Serpent Staff
Objective: Bring your Inscribed Serpent Staff to Inkmaster Wei in the Arboretum.
Text: As powerful it is, at some point you know you will outgrow this staff. When that time comes, one of the Inkmasters in the Arboretum would most likely be interested in taking it from you.

Title: The Dreadsworn
Objective: Slay 6 Vor'thik Dreadsworn at Kypari Vor.
Text: The Klaxxi see far and hear much. They have shared their insight with me. The Vor'thik embrace the sha, using its power to fuel their march in this false swarm. Their warriors consume tainted amber and call themselves dreadsworn. There is no future for them. They are waste which needs disposing. And YOU will begin that process for us when you reach Kypari Vor.

Title: Crime and Punishment
Objective: Kill 8 Amber Harvesters on the Stinging Trail.
Text: The Stinging Trail nurtures young Kypari trees. The empress drains the saplings too early, outsider. They must grow before the amber can be taken. The Klaxxi'va demand punishment for this crime! It will please them if you rain death on the Ik'thik harvesters.

Title: By the Sea, Nevermore
Objective: Use the Klaxxi Tuning Fork on the Ocean-Worn Rocks to awaken the paragon.
Text: The Klaxxi'va have spoken to me, outsider. The paragon is hidden in the Briny Muck only, he is not so hidden anymore. The lizard men surround him. He cannot fall into their scaley hands. You will find him; you will awaken him. Do not return without him! If you do this the Klaxxi will be pleased with us.

Title: Valley of the Four Winds
Objective: Teleport to Valley of the Four Winds and speak to Private Tim P. O'Rary.
Text: Yarr, the Jade Forest be goin through some violent reconstruction, but the Valley of the Four Winds is ripe for explorin. Talk with me when ye be ready to go and I can give ye a ride ta where ya need to go. Talk to me cohort on the other side 'ta get some equipment to aid ya on yer journey.

Title: Better With Age
Objective: Gather 7 Amber-Filled Jars from the Amber Collectors on the Stinging Trail.
Text: It is a crime to harvest the young trees, but a much bigger crime to waste the amber. Young amber is not as strong, but the Klaxxi need it to continue the fight. We will bring them more and they will sing my praises! Gather the young amber. We will store it until it is aged and can be consumed.

Title: Ancient Vengeance
Objective: Slay 6 Vengeful Gurthani Spirits in the Terrace of Gurthan.
Text: I can hear them howling in rage... The spirits of the Gurthani mogu I slayed so long ago. They wander this ruined terrace, seeking vengeance. If they find me in this state, I will not have the strength to fend them off. Draw their attention and put them down. Finish what I started, and I will tell you who I am.

Title: The Pink Turnip Challenge
Objective: Plant a Pink Turnip in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
Text: Old Hillpaw bet me that my land couldn't grow a pink turnip. I'll show him. My land will grow the biggest, pinkest turnip that old coot's ever seen!

Title: The White Turnip Treatment
Objective: Plant a White Turnip in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
Text: Grandpa often told me to "Keep my drawers clean and my dirt cleaner." It sounds like a joke, but he makes a good point. Vegetables tend to leave behind bits of root that can contaminate your soil... but a nice, big, white turnip will clean that gunk right up. Think you could plant a white turnip for me?

Title: The Warlord's Ashes
Objective: Bring the Ashes of Warlord Gurthan to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

Title: Extending Our Coverage
Objective: Activate the Resonating Beacon in Amberglow Hollow.
Text: The Klaxxi'va hear another paragon. His cries are weak and lost in darkness. The signal must be strengthened. There is a tower in Amberglow Hollow that has been silent for many years. It must sing; the Klaxxi demand it! This time I will go with you. You will help me repair it. Take the resonating crystal and meet me in Amberglow.

Title: A Pumpkin-y Perfume
Objective: Plant a Mogu Pumpkin in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
Text: I heard a rumor around the market that Gina Mudclaw loves the smell of pumpkin blossoms. Maybe if I grow some pumpkins in my farm, she might come and visit a little more often. Could you plant a pumpkin for me?

Title: Why Not Scallions?
Objective: Plant a Scallion in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
Text: I heard Haohan mentioning that he was going to plant scallions today. I'm not sure if today's the best day for scallions, but I'd like to hope that he knows what he's doing. He is the head of the Tillers' union, after all. Could you plant a scallion for me?

Title: That Dangling Carrot
Objective: Plant a Juicycrunch Carrot in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
Text: Grandpa always said, "Carrots ain't nothin but a welcomin' mat for virmen." I don't think I ever saw him grow a single carrot. For once, I disagree with Grandpa. I like to live on the edge. Plus, I like to eat carrots. I like to eat carrots on the edge. Could you get some seeds and grow one for me?

Title: Red Blossom Leeks, You Make the Croc-in' World Go Down
Objective: Plant a Red Blossom Leek in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
Text: Grandpa once told me that the smell of leeks will keep crocolisks off of your property. He must have had a point... he always grew leeks, and I never saw a crocolisk anywhere NEAR his farm. We're pretty far from the water... but I suppose you can never be too sure.

Title: The Cabbage Test
Objective: Plant a Green Cabbage in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
Text: Grandpa always said that the bellweather of a true farmer lies in the quality of his cabbage. Any time a new farmer came into town, he'd buy a few heads of cabbage to see what they knew. Now, I'm the new farmer, and this is my big chance to prove myself. Could you plant some cabbage for me?

Title: An Angler's Quest
Objective: Read Nat's Fishing Journal.
Text: This journal provides a hazy recollection of Nat Pagle's grand adventures. Simply reading it will undoubtedly provide a useful insight into fishing.

Title: A Source of Terrifying Power
Objective: Bring the Sha-Haunted Crystal to Ambersmith Zikk at Klaxxi'vess.

Title: Not Fit to Swarm
Objective: Slay 30 Shek'zeer Swarmborn in the Clutches of Shek'zeer.
Text: Newly hatched mantid have only two instincts: kill and feed. They turn on one another, devouring the weak and leaving the strongest to mature. Those hatched during a swarm - the swarmborn - are turned loose on our enemies instead. The swarmborn in the Clutches of Shek'zeer have been tainted. They are born into shadows and nightmares. Driven by terror, not hunger. They are not fit to swarm. They must be purged.

Title: The Threat in the South
Objective: Speak with Bowmistress Li on the Serpent's Spine.
Text: With the Sha of Hatred dead, the greatest threat to this land is vanquished, but our travels along the southern border have made it exceedingly clear that the mantid forces in the Dread Wastes are on the move, and likely won't be held back for long. If you wish to continue to aid the Shado-Pan, I would recommend reporting in to Bowmistress Li on the Serpent's Spine. She oversees the great wall that separates the terrors in the Dread Wastes from our bountiful lands to the east.

Title: The Kun-Lai Kicker
Objective: Protect the Brewmoon Festival.
Text: Have you ever seen the Brewmoon Festival? The good folks of Binan Village host quite a party. And tonight's festivities are brew-catered by none other than your's truly here. I am making my famous Kun-Lai Kicker! Think you might come and join us for the festivities? It should be a completely relaxing event with absolutely no danger whatsoever.

Title: Volatile Greenstone Brew
Objective: Aid in the defense of Greenstone Village.
Text: I am working on a batch of my famous Volatile Greenstone Brew. Should be superb in countering the rascals and mischievous elementals we have been seeing around the mines lately. Tell you what, how about you round up some of your friends and bring them back here to try out a round. First one's on the house!

Title: Shadow of the Empire
Objective: Accompany Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver into the chamber below Klaxxi'vess.
Text: You only understand part of our order. You are an outsider, and have been treated as such. It is no longer appropriate that we keep our secrets from you. There is something you should see.

Title: The Dissector Wakens
Objective: Hold off the Zan'thik while Rik'kal wakens.
Text: You are... not like the others... I hear the Klaxxi calling...  I just need a moment.

Title: The Zan'thik Dig
Objective: Locate the unearthed paragon in the Amber Quarry on Zan'vess.
Text: We have just intercepted a message from an adjunct on Zan'vess. Yaungol laborers there have unearthed a paragon in the amber quarry on the back side of the island. Get there immediately and free him before the Zan'thik destroy him!

Title: The Wrath of Shek'zeer
Objective: Rout the Mantid Swarm by slaying Akkolon, Shox'tik, the Manifestation of Terror, and 25 mantid subjugates.
Text: The rest of the freed paragons are scattered around the Heart of Fear, fighting off the mantid swarm. They may need your help!

Title: Assault on Zan'vess
Objective: Complete the Assault on Zan'vess scenario. Speak with Klaxxi'va Vor or use the Looking For Dungeon tool to begin.
Text: The island settlement of Zan'vess is the last hope for the future of my kind. Although the mantid there are loyal to Shek'zeer, the kypari itself has been spared the sha corruption that has befallen the mainland. Still, under imperial orders, the Zan'thik are draining sap at an unsustainable rate. You have proven yourself a capable asset. The council wants you to lead an assault on the island. Disrupt their operations and keep the kypari healthy. Speak with me when you are ready to begin.

Title: Learning the Ropes
Objective: Win a pet battle.
Text: Now that you are a pet trainer, it's time to test your skills! Head out into the wild and pick a fight with a battle pet. Come back to me after you have won and I will continue your training. Good luck!

Title: The Matriarch's Maw
Objective: Bring the Enormous Kunchong Mandibles to Ambersmith Zikk at Klaxxi'vess.

Title: On The Mend
Objective: Heal your pets to full health by visiting Jenova Stoneshield the Stable Master.
Text: Now that you have won a battle, we need to heal up your pets so they can fight another day! Visit Jenova Stoneshield, our local stable master, to heal and revive your pets.

Title: Got one!
Objective: Catch a battle pet.
Text: Great work so far! You are going to be a pro at this pet stuff before you know it. Now it's time to catch a pet of your own! Head back out and find a battle pet to fight, engage it in battle, and throw your trap once it's low on health. Bring your catch back for me to see once you are finished. Remember, you need at least one pet at level 3 to use your trap!

Title: The Finer Things
Objective: Bring the requested goods to any member of the Pandaria Treasure Society in The Valley of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The Pandaria Treasure Society is interested in purchasing finely crafted goods from skilled jewelcrafters such as yourself. The items will be catalogued, and the most exceptional cuts stored in a secret vault, while the rest are sold to refresh our funds. Our goal is to eventually create a unique collection for a special event.

Title: Portrait of a Lady
Objective: Paint a Portrait of Madam Goya and bring it to Inkmaster Glenzu at the Arboretum, in the Jade Forest. The recipe can be found in your Inscription pane under Quests.
Text: Many great pieces of art are results of great love. A merchant in Halfhill wishes to have a portrait made for his beloved, as a birthday present. Will you accept this commission?

Title: On The Mend
Objective: Heal your pets to full health by visiting Shelby Stoneflint the Stable Master.
Text: Now that you have won a battle, we need to heal up your pets so they can fight another day! Visit Shelby Stoneflint, our local stable master, to heal and revive your pets.

Title: A Tribute to the Dead
Objective: Create an Inscribed Monument Stone and bring it to Inkmaster Jo Po at the Arboretum, in the Jade Forest. The recipe can be found in your Inscription pane under Quests.
Text: All things must come to an end - even the life of a good man. A family in Kun Lai has commissioned a monument for their beloved patriarch who has passed on recently. Will you accept the commission?

Title: Learning the Ropes
Objective: Win a pet battle.
Text: Now that you are a pet trainer, it's time to test your skills! Head out into the valley and pick a fight with a battle pet. Come back to me after you have won and I will continue your training. Good luck!

Title: Staves for Tian Monastery
Objective: Craft 3 Ghost Iron Staves and 2 Rain Poppy Staves. Bring them to Inkmaster Wei at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.
Text: It seems like the Tian Monsatery is training a lot of monks this year. We've received a huge commission for staves. And by huge, I mean HUGE. Could you take on part of the commission? I'd very much appreciate it. You will receive the rewards for your portion, of course.

Title: Set in Jade
Objective: Craft an Engraved Jade Disc and bring it to Inkmaster Jo Po at the Arboretum, in the Jade Forest. The recipe can be found in your Inscription pane under Quests.
Text: One of the greatest poets of our time is Master Kwang. He has composed a poem of great beauty, and a merchant in Halfhill would like to have these words inscribed in stone, to display proudly in her home. She has requested a scribe of great skill to take on this job. Will you accept the commission?

Title: Got one!
Objective: Catch a battle pet.
Text: Great work so far . You are going to be a pro at this pet stuff before you know it. Now it's time to catch a pet of your own! Head back out and find a battle pet to fight, engage it in battle and throw your trap once it's low on health. Bring your catch back for me to see once you are finished. Remember, you need at least one pet at level 3 to use your trap!

Title: The Beginner's Brew
Objective: Collect 1 Sweet Lakemelon from Haohan Mudclaw, 1 Fuzzy Peach from Gina Mudclaw, 1 Black Cherries from Fish Fellreed, and 1 Red Radish from Farmer Fung.
Text: Can you keep a secret? I've been trying my hand at brewing. All I've got is this old hand-made still, but it still works pretty good. I've got an idea for a new brew, but I need some ingredients. I'm awful shy around the townsfolk, but I've seen you making friends all around. Would you be willing to ask the farmers for some ingredients for me?

Title: A Thing of Beauty
Objective: Craft a Commissioned Painting and bring it to Inkmaster Wei at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest. The recipe can be found in your Inscription pane under Quests.
Text: We live in a world of magic.The few among us who are skilled can imbue this magic into the things we craft and give them power. Such things are valued. Fewer still, however, are those among us who can create things that are cherished through the ages not because they are imbued with power, but because of their great beauty. The Temple of the Jade Serpent has commissioned us for such a work, and I believe you are the worthiest among us. Will you accept the commission?

Title: A Worthy Brew
Objective: Ask Chen Stormstout to taste Ella's Brew.
Text: There's one final person who needs to taste my brew. I've heard that he's traveled far and wide, and tasted drinks from all over the world. He happens to be in town, and I'd like to know what he thinks of my skills.

Title: The Perfect Feather
Objective: Bring the feather to Old Hillpaw at Old Hillpaw's House or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: This beautifully pristine feather is unlike any you have seen before in the Valley. There is one person who might be interested in seeing this feather.

Title: Preserving Freshness
Objective: Bring Nam Ironpaw an Empty Tiger Meat Basket.
Text: To preserve maximum freshness, cooking ingredients need to be stored properly. Fortunately, Merchant Cheng over there sells good containers. I hate to send you on such a menial errand, but would you go purchase an empty tiger meat basket for me?

Title: Replenishing the Pantry
Objective: Bring Nam Ironpaw a Bundle of Groceries. Bundles of Groceries can be created by using containers sold by Merchant Cheng.
Text: People come from all over Pandaria to learn cooking from the Ironpaw family. We take great pride not only in being the best chefs, but also in passing what we know onto others. That's why we try to charge as little as possible for cooking lessons. This means, however, that we often find ourselves in shortage of cooking ingredients for the lessons. Would you donate some to the school, to help out students who cannot afford it?

Title: Incarnadine Ink
Objective: To attain the color Inkmaster Glenzu is seeking will require an unconventional source of pigment. His description evokes in your mind the color of blood - specifically the blood of tigers...
Text: The practice of caligraphy is an old custom in Pandaria. I am working on a piece about an ancient war, so I seek an ink that is suitable to the subject matter. I have searched high and low for the right hue, but it eludes me. Can you think of a way to achieve the color I am seeking?

Title: Mission: The Hozen Dozen
Objective: Kill 12 Springtail vermin.
Text: I've been watching the hozen since I arrived, and I don't like the pattern of activity that I'm seeing in their camp. Multiple hozen travel down the mountain under the cover of night, pillaging supplies from the farmlands below. We must stop their rampant theft. I have been thinning their numbers when I can, but one soldier alone is not enough. I need your help. Kill as many of the hozen as you can.

Title: Mission: Aerial Threat
Objective: Kill 12 Cliff Kites.
Text: I've identified another high risk target, one that most people would not suspect. The cliff kites soaring above the hills to the east are quite dangerous. I have seen them swooping down to the farms, snatching grain and seed when no one is looking. In order to protect the farms, we must thin their numbers.

Title: Mission: Predator of the Cliffs
Objective: Kill the Great Cliff Hawk.
Text: During my routine patrol of the mountains this morning, I spotted a huge white bird diving down to the farmlands. It lifted an entire yak in its talons and disappeared among the cliffs. Today a yak, tomorrow a farmhand! We must eliminate this bird before it chooses its next victim.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Flameweaver Koegler
Objective: Complete the Scarlet Halls Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a cunning group and venture forth into the depths of Scarlet Halls. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and put a stop to Flameweaver Koegler's book-burning ways.

Title: Mission: Culling The Vermin
Objective: Kill 12 Springtail vermin.
Text: I was sent to this valley to protect The Heartland from any potential threats. I've identified a high priority target. The Springtail vermin burrow into the mountain cliffs, high above the farmlands. Left unchecked, their numbers will multiply, and they will make their way down to the fields below. They must be eliminated.

Title: Ella's Taste Test
Objective: Ask Jogu the Drunk, Bobo Ironpaw, Farmer Yoon, and Nana Mudclaw what they think of Ella's Brew.
Text: Well, I finally got the brew made, but I won't know if it's any good unless some people taste it. Would you take my brew and see what the folks in Halfhill think? I... I couldn't face them myself.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Durand
Objective: Complete the Scarlet Monastery Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a stout group and lead them into Scarlet Monastery. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and smite Durand with righteous fury. Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Sha of Hatred
Objective: Complete the Shado-Pan Monastery Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a tranquil group and lead them into the Shado-Pan Monastery. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and rescue Taran Zhu from the Sha of Hatred. Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Darkmaster Gandling
Objective: Complete the Scholomance Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a fearless group and lead them into the depths of Scholomance. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and cleanse Scholomance of Darkmaster Gandling's evil presence. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Xin the Weaponmaster
Objective: Complete the Mogu'shan Palace Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a nimble group and lead them into Mogu'shan Palace. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and put an end to Xin the Weaponmaster. Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Raigonn
Objective: Complete the Gate of the Setting Sun Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a cracking group and lead them into the Gate of the Setting Sun. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein and lay waste to Raigonn. Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Wing Leader Ner'onok
Objective: Complete the Siege of Niuzao Temple Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble an eagle-eyed group and lead them into the Siege of Niuzao Temple. Activate the Challenger's Orb and ground Wing Leader Ner'onok. Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Yan-zhu the Uncasked
Objective: Complete the Stormstout Brewery Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a hearty group and lead them into Stormstout Brewery. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and evaporate Yan-zhu the Uncasked. Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: The Vale of Eternal Blossoms
Objective: Speak to Anduin at the Gate of the August Celestials.
Text: It's been many lifetimes since the gates to the valley were open. I wouldn't miss this for the world, and neither should you! Meet me at the southen edge of Kun-Lai Summit. I'll wait for you there.

Title: Contending With Bullies
Objective: Defeat Shonuf.
Text: We honor strength here, not brutality. It is unfortunate but there are some who come to my doorstep oblivious to this distinction. I have turned away one such challenger. In retaliation, he sacked the village of Yinying. Go to Yinying Village southeast of the temple, and face this "Shonuf." Give him a lesson in true strength.

Title: Unto Dust Thou Shalt Return
Objective: Use the Blades of the Anointed on the corpse of High Inquisitor Whitemane to send her permanently to her final rest.

Title: To Be a Master
Objective: Make Black Pepper Steak, Sea Mist Rice Noodles, Mogu Fish Stew, Steamed Crab, Chun Tian Spring Roll and Mad Brewer's Breakfast, then return to the Guide to the Ways.
Text: There will come a day when you have mastered all that we have to teach you. When that day comes, it will be time for you to teach others in turn. When you have proven to yourself that you have mastered all the Ways, come back and speak with me.

Title: A Witness to History
Objective: Speak with Sunwalker Dezco at the Gate of the August Celestials.
Text: I will gather up the other Tauren pilgrims and we will travel into the Vale together. Meet me at the Gate of the August Celestials at the southern edge of Kun-Lai Summit and speak with me there.

Title: Unto Dust Thou Shalt Return
Objective: Use the Blades of the Anointed on the corpse of High Inquisitor Whitemane to send her permanently to her final rest.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Sha of Doubt
Objective: Complete the Temple of the Jade Serpent Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a hearty group and lead them into the Temple of the Jade Serpent. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and vanquish the Sha of Doubt. Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: Blades of the Anointed
Objective: Collect the two Blades of the Anointed.
Text: The problem with the Scarlet Crusade is that they keep coming back, even after death. Behind those resurrections is High Inquisitor Whitemane. With her death, so goes the Crusade. To give her the final rest, we need two swords of legend, each with a lost but storied history. Luckily for me... er, us, these two blades of the anointed are at rest here within the monastery. Find them and once you've killed Whitemane, plunge the blades into her corpse to make the death permanent.

Title: A Witness to History
Objective: Speak with Anduin Wrynn at the Gate of the August Celestials.
Text: The celestials are allowing us back into the Vale! This will be a sight to behold. We shouldn't waste any time. Head to the Gate of the August Celestials at the southern edge of Kun-Lai Summit and speak with me there.

Title: I Don't Need Them, But I'll Take Them
Objective: Collect 10,000 Coins of Air for Griftah.
Text: If you wanna collect more, Griftah not gonna argue with dat. Dat bein' said, I don't need dem as much anymore, so I be givin' you less for dem.

Title: Pilfering and Fencing
Objective: Collect 20 Ancient Titan Relics from the naga at the Sundered Span
Text: Our ships are sunk. Our A.M.O.D.'s gone. We've lost a LOT on this mission... and the Bilgewater Cartel don't offer insurance. The debt collectors will be all over us! We gotta make up for these losses.The beach is swarmin' with naga tryin' to collect artifacts from the ruins. How 'bout we grab some of that treasure and make back our money? I'm sure we could find a buyer willing to take 'em off our hands.We'll split the proceeds 80/20. Sounds fair to me.

Title: There Is No Plan "B"
Objective: Locate all parts of the A.M.O.D.
Text: Look, I'll be honest with you. Our mech, the A.M.O.D., was the best we've ever made. It was mobile. It was powerful. It was one of a kind!What I'm trying to say is, without it, our whole plan is ruined! We have to salvage and rebuild it!That big oaf of a sea giant broke the A.M.O.D. apart and scattered its pieces all over the shore. Find its parts and I'll try to hammer them back together.

Title: Blades of the Anointed
Objective: Collect the two Blades of the Anointed.
Text: The problem with the Scarlet Crusade is that they keep coming back, even after death. Behind those resurrections is High Inquisitor Whitemane. With her death, so goes the Crusade. To give her the final rest, we need two swords of legend, each with a lost but storied history. Luckily for me... er, us, these two blades of the anointed are at rest here within the monastery. Find them and once you've killed Whitemane, plunge the blades into her corpse to make the death permanent.

Title: I'll Take Those, Thanks!
Objective: Obtain 10,000 Coins of Air for Griftah.
Text: These coins, dey be vanishin' inta air ya say? Dat be soundin' perfect, as I have jus the fella ta give dem to.

Title: No Goblin Left Behind
Objective: Locate and rescue the missing members of the Gob Squad.
Text: Our mission is dead in the water unless we move fast! I've found the perfect spot for a new base. While I secure the location, I need you to rescue the team and bring them back. We've trained for this a million times. Just direct them toward the rendezvous point and they'll find the way. We don't have much time, let's go!

Title: Shine Bright Like a Diamond
Objective: Purchase a Certified Organic Lamp Shining Kit from Griftah and use it to shine the Grimy Lamp.
Text: Oh, I be sorry. Dat lamp look like it could use some shinin'. I happen to have just da ting.

Title: Wanna Buy a Lamp?
Objective: Purchase the Dubious Lamp from Griftah.
Text: Ey dere, wanna buy a lamp? You be not regrettin' it.

Title: Righteous Fury
Objective: Destroy 3 Legion Devastators.
Text: The devastators bombarding our forces prevent us from advancing any further. I can only protect us from their blasts for so long. Champion, you must pierce their lines and remove the barriers protecting the devastators. If you can destroy the anchors that maintain the shields, I can cleanse them from afar.

Title: Headhunter Jo
Objective: Slay Headhunter Jo.
Text: He said he's hunting you. I'm not the prey, I'm the bait! Behind ye!

Title: Blessing of Kimbul
Objective: Acquire the Ring of Tides.
Text: The entrance to the temple is sealed by a magical barrier.According to my scrolls, the barrier can only be lowered by one who has gained the Ring of Tides.There is a statue somewhere in the temple grounds with the power to bestow the ring, but the ruins are overrun with jungle spiders. Tulu and I are not strong enough to explore the lower ruins ourselves.If you can gain the Ring of Tides and enter the temple, we may finally be able to face the naga head on!

Title: A Thorn in the Side
Objective: Slay 12 Ankylodons in the Preserve.
Text: You fools speak of "big game" hunting like it is a thing of wonder. Bah!None know big game hunting like my kin. Mastery of the hunt, passed down from parent to child, for generations.I am here to prove it.I wager that you could not slay more than eleven of the ankylodon beasts that wander this region.

Title: Hunting the Hunter
Objective: Track down Hemet Nesingwary.
Text: Your hunter king, Nesingwary, is a mighty fine bit of prey here. I even thought of hunting him myself.But someone else is on his trail now. And dat hunter, he is a dangerous one.If you wish to save your hunter king, you best start tracking quickly. If he made camp, you may be too late already. You cannot paint a target and wonder why you were shot!I believe he was last seen heading west...

Title: Die, Die, Diemetradon
Objective: Slay 8 Venomous Diemetradons.
Text: We are competing, you and I and these other savages. I find this... amusing. South of here you will find a number of diemetradons. I challenge you, to slay more of these creatures than I. Do you accept my wager?

Title: Predatory
Objective: Find 2 more hunters in the Preserves.

Title: Vess-Guard Duty
Objective: Kill Vess-Guard Vik'az in Zan'vess.
Text: Vess-Guard Vik'az co-ordinates the defense forces at Zan'vess. He is worth ten mantid in battle, and his presence inspires the Zan'thik who fight alongside him. Needless to say, we need him dead. He patrols the housing area at the center of the island.

Title: Specimen Request
Objective: Collect 6 Kyparite Shards from Muck Tunnelers in The Briny Muck.
Text: Kyparite worms have shown extreme adaptations in order to mimic the environment around them. They can also grow to immense sizes at rates which are nearly unheard of for most creatures. Their physiology could provide valuable insight into further mutations. Bring me sample shards from the muck tunnelers in the shallows near Zan'vess.

Title: Fear Takes Root
Objective: Destroy 15 Dreadspore Bulbs in Zan'vess and The Briny Muck.
Text: The fallout from Shek'zeer's madness will continue long after her reign has ended. We will struggle to heal our lands for many years to come, and even then our efforts may prove fruitless. A new species of sha-twisted flora has begun taking root near Zan'vess. Destroy any that you find, but beware - there is no telling what kind of sinister defenses it may have.

Title: Meltdown
Objective: Slay 6 Zan'thik Venomstings in Zan'vess. Use Korven's Experimental Grenade to counter their armor plating.
Text: The venomsting scorpions on Zan'vess are fed sap from a young age, causing a fascinating mutation in which their natural armor plating becomes infused with amber. Effectively, it's organic kyparite, the same substance used in forging most of the empire's weapons and armor. I think I've found a way to chemically break down kyparite, but it needs testing. Use these grenades on the Zan'thik venomstings and observe the results.

Title: Quiet Now
Objective: Interact with the Zan'thik Resonating Crystal at the Whispering Stones in Zan'vess to incite Adjunct Sek'ot, then slay him.
Text: On the southwestern corner of Zan'vess lie the Whispering Stones. Much like the towers here, they are critical in transmitting long-range sonic signals. An adjunct of the Empress operates the stones, keeping her in communication with the Zan'thik forces. Disrupt the signal, then silence him.

Title: Shortcut to Ruin
Objective: Kill Vess-Guard Na'kal outside the Heart of Fear.
Text: There is a champion among the loyalists, Vess-Guard Na'kal, whose strength comes not from experience or development, but from genetic modification. He was meant to be an example of the future of mantid - the sick idea that we can be born strong, without earning it. He's a mockery of my work! Gene augmentation was meant for mature, post-swarm veterans ONLY! End him. Perhaps it will serve as a lesson to Grand Empress Shek'zeer that taking shortcuts leads to ruin.

Title: Shackles of Manipulation
Objective: Collect 6 Zan'thik Shackles from Thought-Bound Miners and Thought-Bound Brutes in Zan'vess.
Text: The Zan'thik employ a sizable force of... indentured labor. Yaungol are bound in special shackles which enhance and prolong the effects of sonic manipulation. It is this technology that allows the Zan'thik manipulators to command such large quantities of thralls to endlessly toil for them in the quarries. I would like to study these shackles.

Title: Ordnance Disposal
Objective: Disable 8 Pheromone Mines around the Clutches of Shek'zeer and the Heart of Fear.
Text: If the Grand Empress's agents are still operating under security standards from my time, they would have hidden powerful pheromone mines all around the clutches. With mere whisper she could detonate them all simultaneously, engulfing the palace and rendering entire siege armies powerless. If we hope to have any success in a large scale standoff, we need to disable those mines. My... "gift" to you when we met will allow you to see the mines. Disturb them and get to a safe distance.

Title: Wing Clip
Objective: Collect 24 Needler Wings from Shek'zeer Needlers in the Clutches of Shek'zeer.
Text: The young fliers of this era are fascinating. Their exceptional agility and endurance were, in my time, the feats of incredibly skilled or mature fliers. This would seem to indicate some kind of evolution in wing structure... Or perhaps a result of advancements in training? Induced genetic mutation? Selective breeding? Gah! There's no way to know for certain without tissue samples. Bring me their wings! And try not to ruin them in the process, will you? I need them intact!

Title: Sampling the Empire's Finest
Objective: Use the Sap Jar at Imperial Feeders outside the Heart of Fear 4 times to fill it.
Text: The wonders of the kypari sap never cease to amaze me. Among its numerous properties and applications, the sap can be refined into a nutritious and extremely delectable elixir. Nowhere in the Empire will you find a finer execution of this brew than the palace itself. Surely, the homes of the loyalists have feeders brimming with this sweet nectar. Fill this jar at their feeders and return it to me. I long to sample the imperial ambrosia once more.

Title: Just for Safekeeping, Of Course
Objective: Collect the Codex of the Crusade.
Text: There is a book of great value to me here in the halls. Unfortunately, it's in the possession of Flameweaver Koegler. I've tried to get close to him before, but it's never quite worked out. You might have better luck. Just watch out -- I hear that he's gone well and truly insane. The Flameweaver plans to burn every tome they have in the library. He'll probably burn the Scarlet Halls down in the process.

Title: Free From Her Clutches
Objective: Break open Kunchong Cages to release 8 Kunchong Hatchlings in the Clutches of Shek'zeer.
Text: The Shek'zeer manipulators are corralling young kunchong into that clutch and exposing them to raw fear energies, twisting them and accelerating their growth. Disgusting! I will not allow it! Break open the cages and set those hatchlings free.

Title: Just for Safekeeping, Of Course
Objective: Collect the Codex of the Crusade.
Text: There is a book of great value to me here in the halls. Unfortunately, it's in the possession of Flameweaver Koegler. I've tried to get close to him before, but it's never quite worked out. You might have better luck. Just watch out -- I hear that he's gone well and truly insane. The Flameweaver plans to burn every tome they have in the library. He'll probably burn the Scarlet Halls down in the process.

Title: Rank and File
Objective: Kill 50 members of the Scarlet Crusade within the Scarlet Halls.
Text: First things first; let's kill us some crusaders. And when I say kill the Scarlet Crusade, I mean wipe them out, root and branch, rank and file.

Title: Stranger in a Strange Land
Objective: Seek out "The Black Prince" at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
Text: Excuse me. Is your name ? A figure in a dark cloak asked that I give this to you. She was a traveler from beyond the mists, like yourself, but - well, I didn't trust her. The message comes from a tavern in the veiled stair. I'll give you the note but... you should watch your back if you venture up there!

Title: Rank and File
Objective: Kill 50 members of the Scarlet Crusade within the Scarlet Halls.
Text: First things first; let's kill us some crusaders. And when I say kill the Scarlet Crusade, I mean wipe them out, root and branch, rank and file.

Title: The Ten Foot Pole
Objective: Hold back at least 10 Tiger Temple Monks using the Ten Foot Pole.
Text: Xuen once issued this challenge to the last Emperor of Pandaria: stand in the center of the room and hold off waves of monks using only a ten foot pole. My record is ten. Can you beat that?

Title: Stranger in a Strange Land
Objective: Seek out Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
Text: Excuse me. Is your name ? A figure in a dark cloak asked that I give this to you. She was a traveler from beyond the mists, like yourself, but - well, I didn't trust her. She mentioned the name "Wrathion." Does that ring any bells for you? I'll give you the note but... you should watch your back if you're going to deal with these people.

Title: UNUSED
Objective: Learn the recipe for Soft-Boiled Eggs from the Guide to the Ways and make 5 of them for her.
Text: I am not a master chef like my siblings. What I am is a great teacher. If you are dedicated, I can unlock your hidden potential, no matter how inexperienced you are. If you wish to learn, show me you can at least follow basic instructions. Learn the recipe for soft-boiled eggs, make five of them and bring them to me. I have fresh eggs which I will sell to you at a token price.

Title: Sonic Disruption
Objective: Kill 4 Dread Kunchong and 6 Shek'zeer Manipulators in the Clutches of Shek'zeer. The Sonic Disruption Fork will weaken and confuse the kunchong.
Text: Relying on sonic whispers to manipulate the kunchong was only the most primitive stage of my research, and yet the Empire seems to have adopted the practice wholly. The manipulators of the Shek'zeer are too impatient to form a proper bond with their kunchong. Their laziness will cost them dearly. Strike this tuning fork near the dread kunchong in the clutches - watch as they reel in confusion and lash out at their masters. Use this to your advantage and put them down.

Title: Everything I Know About Cooking
Objective: Deliver the Letter to Sungshin Ironpaw. She teaches in Halfhill Market.
Text: I'm so glad you enjoy my food. Are you interested in the recipes? If so, you should learn them properly, from my teachers in Halfhill Market. Everything I know about the kitchen, I learned from them. Say, if you happen to pass through there, would you deliver this note to Sungshin Ironpaw for me? She was my favorite teacher, and I want her to know that I miss her.

Title: Have a Drink
Objective: Train the recipe for Ginseng Tea from the Master of the Brew, then give him 1 Ginseng Tea.
Text: My siblings are so serious. I think life's too short to be so serious all the time. Let's have some tea together. Let me teach you how to make ginseng tea.

Title: Incoming...
Objective: Contact Wrathion once your naval fleet makes landfall on the southern coast of Pandaria.
Text: The Pandaren campaign is only beginning! We turn our attention now to the ongoing conflict between the Alliance and the Horde. My contacts in Ravenholdt tell me that the Alliance 7th Legion and a considerable Horde invasion force are converging toward Pandaria's southern shores. Like it or not, Pandaria may soon become a battlefield. We are done for now, but I want you to contact me when your fleet arrives. Then... together we will spring into action!

Title: Way of the Brew
