Objective: Bring 1 Ginseng to the Master of the Brew. Ginseng can be bought from Sungshin Ironpaw.
Text: The Pandaren Way of the Brew produces... Well, I'll let the Master of the Brew explain it. Bring him some ginseng and he will show you the way.

Title: Breath of the Black Prince
Objective: Go to the top of the stone steps at Mason's Folly and meet Wrathion there to accept your reward.
Text: You are among a rare breed. You are just what I am looking for - an individual with the potential to shape events on a global scale. Come now, I promised you a reward, and you shall have it! East of this tavern is a series of stone steps leading up to a vista that the locals have named "Mason's Folly." Meet me there.

Title: Way of the Oven
Objective: Bring 5 Wildfowl Breasts to the Master of the Oven.
Text: If you are looking for a hearty meal that will sustain you and increase your stamina, you should seek out the Way of the Oven. Bring some wildfowl breasts to the Master of the Oven and she will teach you. There are plenty of cranes in the Valley of the Four Winds and in the Jade Forest, but you can obtain wildfowl breasts from other birds as well.

Title: The Torch of Strength
Objective: Carry the Torch of Strength to the gates of the Temple of the White Tiger without it extinguishing.
Text: Xuen has this challenge he says helps "refine strength." I am starting to think the word "strength" means something different to him than the rest of us. Here, take this torch to the top of the gates of the temple. If you can get it there without the torch being extinguished, you pass the challenge. Whatever you do, do not try carrying the torch on a mount. It will blow out if you do. Trust me on that one.

Title: Fear Itself
Objective: Defeat the Sha of Fear in the Terrace of Endless Spring and acquire the Chimera of Fear.
Text: I've picked up a few motes of pandaren wisdom during my time here. I particularly enjoy this one: "The timid feel fear before trouble starts; the cowards feel fear as trouble happens. The bravest among us feel fear only after the troubles have been taken care of." Is that true? Let's find out. The Sha of Fear has fled into the Terrace of Endless Spring. Pursue it there, defeat it, and rip out its spirit - presuming it has one. Your bravery will be handsomely rewarded.

Title: Endurance
Objective: Train the recipe for Wildfowl Roast from the Master of the Oven, then give her 5 Wildfowl Roast.
Text: They say that the crane appointed sentry by its flock stands guard with a stone in its beak, so that, should it fall asleep, the stone drops and it awakens. To be skilled with the oven, you need to have endurance and patience. Learn the recipe for wildfowl roast and show me that you understand.

Title: All Webbed Up
Objective: Free 8 Tortaka Tribesman.
Text: The lower ruins of the temple are covered in thick webs and spider egg sacs.Some of our tribesman went down to the lower ruins to clear out the spiders, but they haven't come back.I fear for their safety.Please head into the lower ruins and free our brethren before it's too late.

Title: Wrath of the Tiger
Objective: Defeat the naga invasion.
Text: The Tortaka shall have my protection. Even as we speak, an army of the naga have risen from the depths to attack my temple.How soon the naga have forgotten their previous defeat!They seek to reclaim the Ring of Tides, a powerful artifact that I took as my trophy when I killed Azshara's previous champion, Mepjila.I will send you to the battlefield as my avatar to rain destruction upon the naga. They have forgotten what happens to those who trespass against my followers.Remind them.

Title: The Spirit of Cooking
Objective: Train the recipe for Shrimp Dumplings from the Master of the Steamer, then give him 5 Shrimp Dumplings.
Text: When I cook with steam, I infuse the food with my love. Let me teach you the recipe for shrimp dumplings.

Title: Way of the Steamer
Objective: Bring 5 Giant Mantis Shrimp to the Master of the Steamer.
Text: A great meal can lift your spirits, and none more so than food from the Way of the Steamer. Bring the Master some giant mantis shrimp and he will show you. You can fish for giant mantis shrimp in the ocean.

Title: They Came From The Sea
Objective: Question 8 Naga Spirits.
Text: You are free to rest your weary legs in our camp, but I'm afraid we have little more to offer you.Naga have driven us from our village by the sea. We can no longer fish or hunt crabs. I fear we may not survive long if we cannot take back our lagoon.But taking back the lagoon will not be enough. We must find out why the naga attacked us. What is it they are looking for?Take this ancient scroll and use it summon the spirits of the naga.They will only speak truth while under its spell.

Title: Mark of the Loa
Objective: Commune at Kimbul's Shrine.
Text: You have proven worthy of my blessing.This means should you choose me as your loa, you can call upon my power when needed.Commune at my shrine and make your decision.Know that whatever you choose, you will always be welcome within these walls.

Title: The Curse of Mepjila
Objective: Defeat the spirit of Mepjila.
Text: Centuries ago, the sea witch Mepjila attacked my temple with an army of naga invaders.My followers fought bravely, but I arrived too late to save them.I defeated the naga army with ease. But as I closed my jaws around Mepjila, she placed a curse upon the spirits of my followers, locking them in an eternal battle they can never win.This mask will give you the power to enter the spirit realm and end their nightmare.Defeat the spirit of Mepjila and the curse will be broken.

Title: Jungleweb Infestation
Objective: Slay 6 Jungleweb Crawlers and 30 Jungleweb Hatchlings.
Text: The walls of the temple could provide us with vital protection against the naga, but the temple is overrun with jungle spiders.We'll need to clear out the infestation before the tribe can take refuge at the temple.Venture into the lower ruins and lay waste to the spiders that have nested there.

Title: Restocking the Buffet
Objective: Collect 10 Whistlebloom Juicy Fruit.
Text: Imagine for a moment. You wake up in de Goldtusk Inn after a long day of drinking scorpid blood, slaughtering Sandfury, and sharing jokes with your best friend Zulsan.Ya not fully awake yet, and not feeling ya best. What do you need most at dat exact moment?An all-you-can-eat breakfast buffet, of course!I'm working on it, but I need some fruit to balance out my menu. Luckily, I've seen some in de oasis outside.Bring me some, and I'll give you lifetime access to de buffet.

Title: Hidden Motives
Objective: Locate the naga invasion plans.
Text: I do not understand why the naga would bother attacking a small fishing village.Why waste their time on our simple tribe? The naga seek power and we have none. It makes no sense!They must be after something else entirely...Search Darkwood Shoal and learn of their plans. Whatever the naga are after, it must be quite powerful.Perhaps if we find it first, we can use it against them!

Title: The Elder's Wisdom
Objective: Deliver the Invasion Plans to Elder Kuppaka.
Text: The naga are searching for a powerful artifact called the Ring of Tides.According to the invasion plans, the ring was lost long ago in a battle with Eraka no Kimbul, the great tiger loa.The temple of Eraka no Kimbul is just to the north. If the loa was strong enough to defeat the naga before, maybe he can do it again!We must let the tribe know what we've found!Take the invasion plans to Elder Kuppaka. He is the oldest, and wisest member of our tribe. He will know what to do.

Title: Frozen Chronoshard
Objective: Bring the Frozen Chronoshard to Wyrmrest to unlock a time portal.
Text: This shard of crystal is encased in a thin, frigid layer of permafrost. It still has that distinctive lich smell to it.

Title: Smoldering Chronoshard
Objective: Bring the Smoldering Chronoshard to Wyrmrest to unlock a time portal.
Text: This shard of crystal is hot to the touch. The void creature that carried it wasn't a wielder of flame in any noticeable way, so perhaps the chronoshard is related to fire in some other way.

Title: Rewind
Objective: Speak with Chromie again, then travel to the future and gather information from the other Wyrmrest emissaries.
Text: Now we know when the attack happens, and vaguely where it's coming from. Progress! All we need to do now is to find out more details and stop that attack!Let me know when you're ready to try again.

Title: Fel-Touched Chronoshard
Objective: Bring the Fel-Touched Chronoshard to Wyrmrest to unlock a time portal.
Text: This shard of crystal is scarred with deep rivets of green, malevolent energy. Being held by a dreadlord will do that to you.

Title: Gleaming Chronoshard
Objective: Bring the Gleaming Chronoshard to Wyrmrest to unlock a time portal.
Text: This shard of crystal glitters with a metallic sheen. Based on Chromie's reaction, it may be used to connect you to another time and place.

Title: Intercepting the Legion's Plans
Objective: Search the battlefield for Legion troops and kill them to get their Enigmatic Legion Orders. Retrieve the Army of the Light Code Book to decipher the orders.
Text: Our scout Skara writes in the missive that she learned of a major Legion initiative. She was after two encoded orders held by Legion troops near us to get the details and this must be when she was killed. The Legion splits their messages into encoded parts so that we cannot read them. Skara also writes that her partner Brae, a codebreaker, was slain trying to reach our lines with a code book that we will need to translate the Legion's orders. It is vital you find the orders and that code book!

Title: The Day That Chromie Dies
Objective: Speak with Chromie, then travel to the future to find out how she dies.
Text: Oh! I was just thinking about you! Talk about being at the right time in the right place!I was just reviewing some aberrations in the timeways, when I discovered something... unexpected. Something not-so-great.I'm going to die in the near future. Bad times.I was just about to jump ahead and see if I can figure out why, how, who... but I'd feel better with |5 like you by my side. Care to join me?

Title: The Many Advantages of Being a Time Dragon
Objective: Speak with Chromie a third time, then travel to the future and attempt to save her again.
Text: Well, unfortunately for... whomever is fixated on blasting me into oblivion, I am a fairly skilled master of the timeways! We have the advantage of trying that again, and again, and again, until I'm not dead anymore.We're going to need a little more than a few seconds to stop this attack. How does four hours sound?

Title: Totemic Restoration
Objective: Activate the power of the totems and restore Krag'wa.
Text: I am fed and my body is prepared. I can now be instilled with my power of old and for a time will be immune to their blood curses and leeching powers. Use the magic of the glowflies to channel my power from the totems into me.Soon you will see me restored. Then we will destroy the army that prepares across the river to take all that is mine by force.

Title: Supernatural Support
Objective: Choose which loa you wish to obtain a blessing from.
Text: The loa can bestow powerful boon's to their followers, aid that can be the difference between victory or defeat in our efforts here.Think carefully which of the two you would like to ask for their blessing. The loa will not give their assistance to those who are currently pledged to another loa.

Title: Mistress of Lies
Objective: Defeat Yazma and Vol'kaal in the Garden of the Loa.
Text: If you are done dealing with dese peasant loa, den perhaps you can help with my own loa: Shadra.My "high" priestess, Yazma, is behind all of dis. If she is having her minions slay other loa, den I can only guess she is also trying to sacrifice my own loa as well.Shadra's shrine is on de northwest side of de Garden of the Loa. You must stop her from slaying de Mistress of Spies.

Title: The Best Prevention
Objective: Slay 20 attackers in the Shattered Fields.
Text: If you've brought the High Exarch back to us, you are a welcome ally indeed. More is needed of you. You see our soldiers out there, fighting against all odds? Defend them. Slay the enemy. Strong words for a priest, perhaps, but every dead man'ari is one less blade at our throats. Show them that the Light protects its chosen even as it scorches the unfaithful. When you are finished, seek out Y'mera. She will have fewer troops, and more need of your abilities.

Title: Disturbance Detected: Black Temple
Objective: Relive the assault on the Black Temple.
Text: , right on time, as always.Good news first, because they're happening at the same time for me anyway. Thanks to the various timewarped objects past and future you discovered, we've figured out how to detect when a new one turns up.The bad news is, we know our technique works because something has changed in the Black Temple, and it's wreaking havoc across the timescape! We need you to ensure the fateful raid turns out exactly like it did before, and to remove the source of this disturbance.

Title: The Strength of One's Foes
Objective: Collect 10 Sigils of Power and 10 Sigils of Wisdom from raid bosses in the Mogu'shan Vaults, Heart of Fear, or Terrace of Endless Spring.
Text: Great leadership requires the power to shape the destiny of your people, and the wisdom to make the right decisions. Pandaria boasts great power and ancient wisdom, but rarely in the same place. Let's see if you and I can change that! Acquire sigils of power and wisdom from fallen foes in the Mogu'shan Vaults, the Heart of Fear, or the Terrace of Endless Spring. We will put them to a much better use than their current owners.

Title: Agile as a Tiger
Objective: Train the recipe for Sauteed Carrots from the Master of the Wok, then give her 5 Sauteed Carrots.
Text: To cook with the wok, you need to be nimble. Your first lesson is sauteed carrots.

Title: Way of the Pot
Objective: Bring 5 Jade Lungfish to the Master of the Pot.
Text: The cuisine of the Way of the Pot help expand your intellect. Bring some jade lungfish to the Master of the Pot and she will teach you. You can fish for jade lungfish in the Jade Forest.

Title: Bringing the Big Guns
Objective: Locate and secure Light's Judgment.
Text: Light's Judgment has a security feature to prevent it from falling into enemy hands. We can trigger its recall mechanism, which will teleport it back to a vessel. With the Xenedar out of commission, the gun should recall to your ship instead. You can make good use of its firepower. The process takes time, though, and will likely attract the Legion's attention. Be on your guard.

Title: Way of the Wok
Objective: Bring 5 Juicycrunch Carrots to the Master of the Wok.
Text: If you wish to make dishes that enhance agility, you should bring some carrots and rice to the Master of the Wok. The virmen around here tend to carry a lot of carrots around. You can also grow your own, if you have a farm.

Title: Strong as a Tiger
Objective: Train the recipe for Charbroiled Tiger Steak from the Master of the Grill, then give him 5 Charbroiled Tiger Steaks.
Text: With the grill, you can transform those raw tiger steaks into food that makes you stronger. Learn the recipe for charbroiled tiger steaks from me. Show me what you can do.

Title: UNUSED
Objective: Make a Charbroiled Tiger Steak for the Master of the Grill. You will need to learn the Way of the Grill and the recipe from him first.
Text: The Pandaren Way of the Grill produces foods that increase your physical strength. Learn the recipe for Charbroiled Tiger Steak from the Master of the Grill and show him the results of your learning.

Title: Staying Hidden
Objective: Investigate the Frogmarsh.
Text: Dere be trouble brewin', mon. Da blood trolls be on da move! Dey set up a large camp nearby and have been sending a small force to da isle south of here.If dey discover our position while we be havin' no defenses, it gonna be game over! We need ta see what dey be up to and get rid of dem.Our best bet be ta investigate da isle south a here. Ya want ta join me? I be ready ta head out.

Title: Extracting Answers
Objective: Collect 6 Venom-Coated Mandibles from the Ik'thik Swarmborn in Kypari Ik.
Text: Kypari Ik is just one of many locations that houses some of Empress Shek'zeer's offspring. In their juvenile state the young are reckless and difficult to control. They are also deadly. Swarmborn are hatched with a highly toxic venom that diminishes in potency with age. The venom can incapacitate even the strongest and most skilled fighter if it hits flesh. I would like you to bring me some of this venom.

Title: Trial of the Black Prince
Objective: Earn an Honored Reputation with the Black Prince. Level 90 mogu and mantid in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, Townlong Steppes and the Dread Wastes will earn reputation.
Text: I have on good authority that you are a champion among champions, but if you'll permit me this indulgence, I would like to test your mettle for myself. The mogu who assault the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, the mogu minions who inhabit Shan'ze Dao, and the sha-corrupted mantid swarming the Dread Wastes... these may provide an adequate challenge for one of your stature. Prove yourself to me. No rush - I expect this to take you some time.

Title: Cho's Missive
Objective: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at Onekeg in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: One of those adorable little grummles came by and said that Lorewalker Cho sent for you. You should meet up with him!The grummel said he's at Onekeg, to the north.

Title: The Shado-Pan
Objective: Speak to Shado-Master Chong at Shado-Pan Fallback in Firebough Nook.
Text: Our new recruits have spoken in hushed tones about a group of Pandaren they call the "Shado-Pan". They are apparently very strong, and secretive.That's where you come in. Rumor is they have a base of operations to the southeast, near Firebough Nook. You should travel there as an envoy of the Alliance. Give them any help they require.

Title: Muskpaw Ranch
Objective: Travel to Muskpaw Ranch in Kun-Lai Summit and speak with Lao Muskpaw.
Text: There's another Pandaren settlement out here, Muskpaw Ranch. I don't know if they're alright, what with everything that's been going on with the Yaungol invasion.You've been so helpful - you should go check up on them, friend!

Title: Muskpaw Ranch
Objective: Travel to Muskpaw Ranch in Kun-Lai Summit and speak with Lao Muskpaw.
Text: There's another Pandaren settlement out here, Muskpaw Ranch. I don't know if they're alright, what with everything that's been going on with the Yaungol invasion.You've been so helpful - you should go check up on them, friend!

Title: Damage Control
Objective: Destroy 5 Ik'thik Whisperers and deactivate the Kypari Ik Beacon.
Text: Kor'ik has been sending signals to the empress for weeks. Everything the Klaxxi have done, the empress knows about. That stops now! Kypari Ik will be the first to receive news of Kor'ik's demise. It would benefit us to make sure that message does not make it to the empress. Destroying the whisperers and beacon there will buy us enough time to come up with a plan before the empress can act.

Title: The Missing Merchant
Objective: Speak with Merchant Shi at Inkgill Mere in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: Usually, Merchant Shi comes through Kun-Lai Summit to trade with the Jinyu and Grummle. We've heard word that he hadn't been seen at Binan, and we haven't seen him here...I'm worried something has happened to him. Can you go to the Inkgill Mere and see if he's there?

Title: Cho's Missive
Objective: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at Onekeg in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: One of those grummles came by and said that Lorewalker Cho sent for you. You should go ahead and meet up with him, he might have something important to say.The grummel said he's at Onekeg, to the north.

Title: The Shado-Pan
Objective: Speak to Shado-Master Chong at Shado-Pan Fallback in Firebough Nook.
Text: Our new recruits have spoken in hushed tones about a group of Pandaren they call the "Shado-Pan". They are apparently very strong, and secretive.It's clear that, no matter what happens here in Kun-Lai, making an alliance with these Shado-Pan will be critical to our foothold in Pandaria.That's where you come in. Rumor is they have a base of operations to the southeast, near Firebough Nook.You will go there, and curry their favor. For the Horde!

Title: A Legend in the Making
Objective: Share a drink with Wrathion. He's buying.
Text: Our world finds itself at a crossroads. The next few months will shape everything to come - presuming we are to have a future at all. Ah! But I am getting ahead of myself. Let me back up. Come, share a drink with me. Let's talk about the future of Azeroth.

Title: Midnight in the Garden of the Loa
Objective: Fly with Hexlord Raal to the Garden of the Loa.
Text: Yazma and her henchtroll Vol'kaal have pulled most of their forces back to de Garden of de Loa.Something bad is afoot, I can feel it in my spirit. Pa'ku is in danger, along with all de loa who have followers dere.Come, let's fly dere and put an end to dese heresies.

Title: An End to the Suffering
Objective: Kill Darkmaster Gandling.
Text: The key to lifting the curse of this place rests in the final death of Darkmaster Gandling. Do it, and make him suffer!

Title: The Hunter
Objective: Rescue Gonk.
Text: Gonk is in danger. I can hear his call. My loa has saved my life so many times, it is about time I return de favor. Come, join me at de Lair of Gonk on de west side of de Garden of the Loa, and we will save a god.

Title: Zuldazar
Objective: Speak with Princess Talanji.
Text: King Rastakhan is an ancient ruler who is not quick to trust new allies. We must earn his trust if we are to earn his fleet.Zuldazar is the seat of power for the Zandalar empire and a good place to start in winning over these potential allies.

Title: Terrace of the Chosen
Objective: Meet Kaza'jin the Wavebinder near the Terrace of the Chosen.
Text: This betrayal has cut deep into the heart of Zandalar. Half of the Zanchuli Council and their followers have sided with Zul and his... blood god. Lucky for us not all of Zandalar is behind this betrayal. We need to topple Zul's cultists before they can rally too many to their cause. Zanchul is the place to start. Go and see if you can muster any of the Zandalari still loyal to their king.

Title: Raal
Objective: Kill Crazzak and free Hexlord Raal.
Text: Crazzak is a traitor in priest's clothing who thinks if he tortures enough of us it will hurt our loa. Dey even have my husband Raal up on de apex of Zanchul. Normally I would say dey could have him, but dey are using his connection to Pa'ku to weaken de loa. Can't have dat. Let's get to de top of Zanchul and rescue my worthless husband.

Title: Vol'dun
Objective: Speak with Princess Talanji.
Text: General Jakra'zet detests the Horde and cannot be trusted. As long as he remains in power, the city will never be safe.We are not alone in our suspicions. Speak to Princess Talanji to follow up.

Title: Nazmir
Objective: Speak with Princess Talanji.
Text: The blood trolls within the cursed swamp Nazmir threaten to destroy all of Zuldazar.Princess Talanji wants the Horde's help in an expedition to strike at the heart of the blood trolls and end their threat to Zuldazar.

Title: The Missing Merchant
Objective: Speak with Merchant Shi at Inkgill Mere in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: Usually, Merchant Shi comes through Kun-Lai Summit to trade with the Jinyu and Grummle. We've heard word that he hadn't been seen at Binan, and we haven't seen him here...I'm worried something has happened to him. Can you go to the Inkgill Mere and see if he's there?

Title: Walls Have Ears
Objective: Kill 8 spiders in Zanchul.
Text: Yazma, mistress of spies.Bah! A traitor who is into creepy crawlies. She chose to side with Zul, and she uses de children of her loa, Shadra, to watch and track everything we do.We have to kill all de spiders we see, or dat traitor Yazma will know every move we make.

Title: A New Fate
Objective: Speak to the Spirit of Master Shang Xi, and choose whether you leave with the Alliance or the Horde.
Text: These new allies have shed light on a great and important truth: it is not just Shen-zin Su that is ailing, but all of the land beyond the clouds. The world needs healing, and I think that you should be the ones to heal it. I would like you, Ji, and Aysa to leave and bring your strength and wisdom to the world. These Alliance and Horde have different ideals, but at the core of both lies noble intent. I will leave the choice of who you wish to accompany to you.

Title: Fire At Will
Objective: Enter a Lightforged Battery and slay 30 Frenzied Plaguewings.
Text: Look out there, the wings of the bats fill the sky. We must offer what ranged support we can, but our hands are full here. It looks like the Legion has not yet destroyed all of the artillery batteries. If you can get to one, you should be able to show those flying fiends the Light.

Title: Dirty Work for Dirty Drinks
Objective: Collect 20 Caustic Scorpid Blood from deathsnap scorpids in Dead Man's Pass.
Text: Guests gotta earn their keep at de Goldtusk Inn. What say you help me clear out some scorpids at one of our off-site excursion locations? De delightful Dead Man's Pass!Normally, you'd need to purchase our Warlord Package to be allowed access, but I'll make an exception dis time.I'll even throw in our Scorpid King Package. Unlimited scorpid blood drinks all day, every day!Dere's one catch: we're out of scorpid blood. Bring some back and I'll whip up a batch of drinks for us.

Title: Gozda'kun the Slaver
Objective: Kill Gozda'kun the Slaver in the Sandfury Hideout.
Text: Dat's it. De Sandfury are officially banned from de Goldtusk Inn!You can't just ransack a place, kidnap its staff, and mock its owner with an assortment of fruits and vegetables and expect to get away with it!We gotta teach those thugs what happens when you mess with de Goldtusk Gang!Gozda'kun de Slaver was bossing around de rest of de Sandfury during de attack.Take him out, and leave some Sandfury behind to spread de word.

Title: Rhan'ka's Lost Friend
Objective: Find Zulsan in Dead Man's Pass.
Text: When you head up to Dead Man's Pass, be sure to say hello to Zulsan.He's my best friend, even if he doesn't want to be near me most of de time. Ha!Seriously, though, he's been up on de cliffs for days. If you find him, convince him to come back down to de inn. We need him to restock our breakfast buffet.Oh, and a completely unrelated question dat has nothing to do with you not being able to find Zulsan and my needing to replace him: How wide is ya head?

Title: The Great Cranium Caper
Objective: Rescue the kidnapped members of the Goldtusk Gang in the Sandfury Hideout.
Text: Sandfury thugs attacked de inn after you left and kidnapped de whole Goldtusk Gang!We gotta get dem back.Man'zul was usually de brains behind our thefts back in Zuldazar, but I'll try to come up with a plan to get dem outta dis mess.I got it! You rescue 'em all!

Title: The Grinning Idols
Objective: Collect the Idol of Binding, Idol of Immortality, and Idol of Sacrifice.
Text: Before de curse, we were a loyal crew to a good captain. But de curse corrupted Pirate-King Zem'lan, made him cruel and controlling.Now, he treats us more like slaves than crewmates. Forced to fight and die for his gain, no treasure for ourselves. No speakin' up without punishment.Well, us four, we ain't gonna be his slaves no more.A few of de crew hold onto de idols dat Zem'lan used to curse us. Kill dem and take de idols. I wanna see if we can break dem. Just for fun.

Title: Meet the Goldtusk Gang
Objective: Meet the staff of the Goldtusk Inn.
Text: Greetings, traveler, and welcome to de Goldtusk Inn!Unless you're here to kill us... In which case, get out.Otherwise, sit down and enjoy de mess!I mean, don't mind de mess. EAT DE MESS! No, don't eat de mess. Ignore it!Ha, don't mind him. All exiles are welcome to rest at de Goldtusk Inn, de only luxury lodge in dese harsh dunes.Come, let me introduce you to de staff.

Title: A Lonely Spirit
Objective: Seek out Keula within the Necropolis.
Text: Da spirit of a child named Keula be wanderin' me temple grounds. Her ma'da gave her child up ta me long ago, she be thinkin' that a great sacrifice would spare her from me call, from going to da other side.Well she be right, I not claim her yet. But she be wrong too. Her child be da one to decide when ta be reunited with her ma'da, and it seem ta me dat da child be no longer be content ta wait.Dey both belong in my realm.Go, bring da child to her ma'da.

Title: Remnants of the Damned
Objective: Collect 6 Decaying Bloodstones for Bwonsamdi.
Text: Ever since da spirits have begun calling upon dis "G'huun," me temple has been covered with da unbearable taint of da undead.Da undead be an abomination, but da bloodstones dat create dem be powerful. Dey could be of use ta Bwonsamdi.If ya wish ta show me ya fervor, den cleanse me temple of their filth and bring me their bloodstones.

Title: Small Haulers
Objective: Free 6 Urchin Workers from the Ashvane Foundry.
Text: They said they would feed us. Said they'd keep us warm.But they were mean! And it was really hard work. And when we tried to rest, they yelled at us!I got away, but my friends are still in there.

Title: Suspicious Shipments
Objective: Inspect 5 Marked Goods in the Ashvane Foundry.
Text: Normally I wouldn't tell you nothin'... but I'll spill it for Cyrus.Ashvane's onto somethin' big.They got guys workin' round the clock in there. Even brought in some muscle to keep everyone uh... "motivated."I don't know anything about what they're makin', but I know it ain't passin' through here to Boralus.If I were dumb enough to go snooping around in there, I'd look at the goods themselves. See if they got shipping labels.But I ain't that dumb, so you gotta do it.

Title: Labor Dispute
Objective: Slay 10 Company Watchmen, Company Enforcers, or Company Fusiliers.
Text: The Ashvane Company has been workin' their people so hard they even tried to strike!The company brought in a bunch of goons to break it up and get everyone back to work.Heard they even shot a couple guys who tried to walk off the job.What say you give 'em a taste of their own brutality while you're in there?

Title: Sizing Up The Opposition
Objective: Speak with Turalyon.
Text: Turalyon was no doubt hoping for better news, but I fear I cannot provide it. Attempting to drive into the heart of the Legion now would cost us everything.There must be another way. I do not know what it is, but I trust that we will find it.Best not keep Turalyon waiting. We must move forward.

Title: Insatiable Appetite
Objective: Feed your direhorn.
Text: That was incredible! I've never seen such rapid growth!Your strange friend here be welcome to stay as long as he likes if he be willing to share his secret with the Kraal.As for you and your beast, he be looking awfully hungry again. I suspect you'll find it will take a lot more food to satisy him now.Good luck, Apprentice!

Title: The Ashvane Trading Company
Objective: Speak with Cagney at Eastpoint Station. Take the ferry from Will Melborne in Tradewinds Market.
Text: So, Ashvane's goons are walking around with a new powder that can blow a galleon clean in half and the military has no idea.We need to find out how much of this powder they have and where it's going.An old buddy of mine works the ferry down by the Ashvane Foundry. He may know something about this.You can take the ferry from Tradewinds Market to Eastpoint Station. Once you get there, look for a man named Cagney. Tell him I sent you. He owes me a favor.

Title: Stow and Go
Objective: Stow away on The Maiden's Virtue.
Text: You see that ship? I know that ship.Let's just say her captain and I have a little history.It's a smuggling vessel. Our illegal weapons are on there for sure. I'd bet my coat on it... and I love this coat.We need to find out where it's going...How are you in tight spaces?

Title: Flying Tiger Gourami
Objective: Bring the Flying Tiger Gourami to Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf.
Text: You've caught a unique fish... with wings. Perhaps it deserves the expert opinion of Nat Pagle in Anglers Wharf.

Title: zzOld
Objective: Speak to Fisherman Haito at the Anglers Wharf in the Krasarang Wilds.
Text: If you want to explore all the secrets of the deep ocean, and catch some big fish, speak to my brother Haito at the Anglers Wharf in Krasarang Wilds. I'm sure he'd love to show you a thing or two about reeling!

Title: Spinefish Alpha
Objective: Bring the Spinefish Alpha to Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf.
Text: You have fished up something special. It looks pretty aggressive. Maybe Nat Pagle at the Anglers Wharf might know more about it?

Title: Mimic Octopus
Objective: Bring the Mimic Octopus to Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf.
Text: You aren't sure how, but you've caught an extraordinary cephalopod. Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf would be very interested to see it.

Title: An End to the Suffering
Objective: Kill Darkmaster Gandling.
Text: The key to lifting the curse of this place rests in the final death of Darkmaster Gandling. Do it, and make him suffer!

Title: The Four Tomes
Objective: Destroy the four tomes: "In the Shadow of the Light", "Kel'Thuzad's Deep Knowledge", "Forbidden Rites and other Rituals Necromantic" and "The Dark Grimoire".
Text: There are four tomes of great necromantic evil studied in Scholomance: "In the Shadow of the Light", "Kel'Thuzad's Deep Knowledge", "Forbidden Rites and other Rituals Necromantic" and "The Dark Grimoire". As we make our way through this cursed place, find and destroy each book so that no other fool can come along later and learn their vile secrets.

Title: Interact - Doodad & Creature Test
Objective: Interact 3 Wards and speak with Wardkeeper Malo.
Text: Please complete this quest in order to testing the Interact - Doodad & Interact - Creature quest objective types.

Title: Corruption Runs Deep
Objective: Defeat the traitor in the Duskroot Fen.
Text: Today you learn that no one can be trusted in times of war, Wakener. Even those closest to the Klaxxi are susceptible to corruption. Who knows how long this traitor has been corrupted. He must be destroyed! You appear confused. Do you not see the traitor in our midst? Allow me to adjust your vision.

Title: Dropping Our Signal
Objective: Awaken the paragon in Duskroot Fen.
Text: The beacon in Amberglow Hollow seems to have been tampered with. Right before the signal cut out the Klaxxi'va picked up a signal for another paragon nearby. They believe he is hidden in that wretched little swamp, Duskroot Fen. I will meet you in the fen to set up a temporary beacon until I can get Amberglow operational again. You will wake the paragon and then you will help me.

Title: The Four Tomes
Objective: Destroy the four tomes: "In the Shadow of the Light", "Kel'Thuzad's Deep Knowledge", "Forbidden Rites and other Rituals Necromantic" and "The Dark Grimoire".
Text: There are four tomes of great necromantic evil studied in Scholomance: "In the Shadow of the Light", "Kel'Thuzad's Deep Knowledge", "Forbidden Rites and other Rituals Necromantic" and "The Dark Grimoire". As we make our way through this cursed place, find and destroy each book so that no other fool can come along later and learn their vile secrets.

Title: The Zanchuli Council
Objective: Speak with Wardruid Loti in the Zocalo.
Text: You there, Speaker of de Horde. My spies have told me of dark heresies being practiced in our sacred temple of Zanchul. De king sent Loti and Raal to deal with de situation, but those two bickering council members are soft on their own followers. We need someone more... ruthlessly neutral. Go meet Wardruid Loti down at de Zocalo and she can tell you de rest.

Title: Picking a Side
Objective: Choose a loa.
Text: Look, dis has gone on long enough. I am not one to hold a grudge, but I will be damned if I let you double dip with Raal's loa and my own. Time has come to pick a loa. De loa are not de sharing type.

Title: Pterrortorial Dispute
Objective: Slay 6 Bloodraged Pterrordaxes.
Text: De courtyard of Zanchul has been overrun by pterrordaxes driven mad by some dark ritual. Power is coalescing here, and it is hard to tell who or what is causing it. I need to track down de source. In de meantime, you take dis, de power of Gonk, and call his allies to help you in battle. Slay dese maddened pterrordaxes. When you are done, tell Raal to get his flock under control.

Title: Pests
Objective: Slay 8 Thieving Snappers in the Zocalo.
Text: Let me guess, de saurid stole something of yours as well, eh? Look, I don't have de time to run down every little thing dese ankle-biters snap off with. You want some coin? Help me kill some of dese snappers. Otherwise, leave me be.

Title: Competitive Devotion
Objective: Slay the 3 Corrupted Guardians of Zanchul.
Text: Okay, I know dis situation is serious, but she gave you de power of her loa? Sounds to me like Loti is more big on recruiting than on dealing with dis blood troll threat. Inside de temple behind me are three guardians. When I walked in dere, de things tried to kill me. Me! Someone has corrupted our own guardians. Here, I will lend you de voice of my own loa, Pa'ku, de pterrordax. Use it to crush dis corruption.

Title: Gonk, Lord of the Pack
Objective: Bargain with Gonk.
Text: You can find Gonk in his lair west of here, in de Garden of the Loa. You should be able to see his totems. Run near dem to improve your speed. I will continue to purge de heretics from dis temple. Mind your manners around de loa, or he may rip your throat out.

Title: Pa'ku, Master of Winds
Objective: Bargain with Pa'ku.
Text: Come, ride Ata de Winglord with me, and he will take us to Pa'ku. Oh, and mind your manners around dat loa. Pa'ku has been known to drop followers she is not fond of from a really great height onto really hard stone.

Title: Restraining Order
Objective: Shoo away 20 Pterrordax Hatchlings.
Text: "Something feels different"? Dat was all Raal said? His flock of pterrordaxes have swarmed de courtyard of Zanchul. Dey are being driven mad. Shoo dem away before dey hurt demselves or others.

Title: Curse of Jani
Objective: Survive the Trial of Jani.
Text: Thief and killer, know dat ya be standin' before da Patron of Scavengers, da Lord of Thieves, da God of Garbage, Master of Minions, and da Keeper of Secrets. Ya be standin' before me in raiment worth entire kingdoms of gold, bearin' weapons dat cost more than even me most devout and renowned followers will ever earn. I tink now be a good time ta teach ya a lesson. Maybe show ya high and mighty greatness what it means ta be snappin' in da gutters.

Title: The Bargain is Struck
Objective: Speak with King Rastakhan.
Text: Now dat you have declared a patron loa for your time here in Zuldazar, you should inform de king of your decision. He will appreciate dat you chose to follow de great Pa'ku.

Title: Offensively Defensive
Objective: Patrol the skies with Hexlord Raal.
Text: Let me guess, Loti had you kill any trolls dat smelled of blood magic, yes? Well, dat is barely a half measure. See, blood magic comes from de old ways, and our people have only been giving in to its allure since de walls fell on our northern border. Come, we will go for a little ride and patrol de border to Nazmir. Dat is where all dese bad ideas are coming from.

Title: Gathering Light
Objective: Meet Turalyon in the Krokul Hovel.
Text: Alleria and I long for more time with our son, but we cannot afford to wait any longer. We must strike now. The Army of the Light is scattered, but not defeated. Any survivors should have stayed near the crash site of the Xenedar. If there is any hope of victory, we must rally them and rescue Xe'ra. With the pit lords dealt with, we should have a safer route to the Xenedar. Meet me in the krokul hovel as soon as you can.

Title: Forbidden Practices
Objective: Find and slay 9 Crimson Cultists in the Terrace of the Chosen.
Text: You come at a good time. I have need of a weapon such as yourself. Yazma's spies say dere are blood cultists in our ranks. King Rastakhan has charged me with tracking down any trolls guilty of practicing blood magic and purging dem. Take dis totem, route out those with de stench of blood magic, and cleanse dem from dis holy place. When you are done, tell dat lazy Hexlord Raal to get off his perch and help keep dis place secure.

Title: Moonkin Monitoring
Objective: Observe the nearby dancing, moonfiring, and napping Moonkin Hatchlings and see what you can learn.

Title: Kitty?
Objective: Find Smoochums in Glenbrook Woods.
Text: You have to find our last guest before it's time for tea! Smoochums really likes the woods, I bet we'll find him there!

Title: Dire Situation
Objective: Slay Dregada.
Text: Good news, we found de source of de corruption. De bad news, it is a ritual on de apex of Zanchul. Blood magic wielding heretics are empowering some sort of dire troll up dere. How it made it all de way to de apex without us catching it is something I am sure Raal and I will be arguing about for de next year. Come, let us stop dis heresy.

Title: Shadow of the Triumvirate
Objective: Return to the Vindicaar.
Text: Talgath's words carry more gravity than I think he knew. In an attempt to hurt me one final time, he has given us the answer. The Crest of Knowledge is hidden away in the Seat of the Triumvirate, and it is not unguarded. If my suspicions are correct, we may be facing a greater threat than any of us dared imagine. A dark naaru. Let us return to the Vindicaar. We will plan our next steps there.

Title: Growing Pains
Objective: Feed the Direhorn Growth Hormone to your hatchling.
Text: These trolls are missing a real opportunity here! They complain about not having enough beasts to go around, yet have they really tried to mass produce them? Nope!With my Direhorn Growth Hormone, they'll be able to fill these pens to overflowing! Sure, the overcrowding might lead to disease and excess waste issues, but I'm sure those are solvable.Ha ha ha this is gonna be great!

Title: Falling to Pieces
Objective: Return the Glowing Amber to Kaz'tik the Manipulator.
Text: Why would the saurok have amber? More importantly, why would Oracle Hiss'ir be so protective of it? It is unlikely this came from the heavily guarded Zan'vess, so where did it come from? Perhaps the Klaxxi will know what to make of it.

Title: A Celestial Experience
Objective: Speak to Xuen and complete his tests.
Text: Nobody is allowed into the Vale without the approval of the August Celestials. Xuen, The White Tiger, appears ready to listen to me. But Taran Zhu of the Shado-Pan is reluctant to let the Alliance or Horde anywhere NEAR the Vale after all that's happened.  Maybe you can help me make my case. Speak to the White Tiger on our behalf. Be careful! He may set a number of challenges before you...

Title: The Klaxxi
Objective: Speak to Bowmistress Li at the Gate of the Setting Sun between the Vale of Eternal Blossoms and the Dread Wastes.
Text: The Klaxxi are only rumored to exist, far beyond the wall in the Dread Wastes. Few have ventured into that territory, and none have returned to tell the tale. If you are set on finding these... Klaxxi... there is a small group of Shado-Pan manning the wall to the far southwest who may know more.

Title: Understanding The Shado-Pan
Objective: Earn Revered standing with the Golden Lotus.
Text: The Shado-Pan rank among Pandaria's oldest defenders. For years we train in our snow-capped monastery high in the Kun-Lai Summit, perfecting the martial secrets passed down by our ancestors. Our numbers may seem few, but a single Shado-Pan can be deadlier than a hundred trained soldiers. To join the Shado-Pan order is a long journey full of hardship. If this is the path you seek, then you must first prove your worth. There is urgent work to be done here. Help the Golden Lotus defend the Vale.

Title: A Celestial Experience
Objective: Speak to Xuen and pass his tests.
Text: The human calf is arguing on our behalf. He is well-spoken; I can see why Baine Bloodhoof regards the prince so highly. Still, the argument does not go well. I am of little consequence, but you are a hero of the Horde. Perhaps you can intercede in our favor? Speak with the White Tiger and plead our case. Be careful! He may set a number of challenges before you...

Title: The Shado-Pan Offensive
Objective: Speak to Taran Zhu at Longying Outpost in the Townlong Steppes.
Text: We Shado-Pan have amassed our forces for the first time in many ages. The Sha of Hatred has escaped beyond the Serpent's Spine, and it is our sacred duty to imprison it once more. However, our warriors are great, but our numbers too few. Help from a capable  may not be turned away. If you wish to join the offensive, speak to Taran Zhu in the Townlong Steppes.

Title: The Klaxxi
Objective: Speak to Bowmistress Li at the Gate of the Setting Sun between the Vale of Eternal Blossoms and the Dread Wastes.
Text: The Klaxxi are only rumored to exist, far beyond the wall in the Dread Wastes. Few have ventured into that territory, and none have returned to tell the tale. If you are set on finding these... Klaxxi... there is a small group of Shado-Pan manning the wall to the far southwest who may know more.

Title: Temple of the White Tiger
Objective: Speak to Anduin Wrynn at the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: Have you heard the news, traveller? There's been an attack at one of our most sacred places, the Vale of Eternal Blossoms! Even now, there's a human prince within the White Tiger Temple arguing that you and the other races from beyond the mists should be allowed within. The temple is in the northeast of Kun-Lai. Maybe you can convince the White Tiger to allow you inside? I only hope the Vale has not been utterly destroyed...

Title: Understanding The Shado-Pan
Objective: Earn Revered standing with the Golden Lotus.
Text: The Shado-Pan rank among Pandaria's oldest defenders. For years we train in our snow-capped monastery high in the Kun-Lai Summit, perfecting the martial secrets passed down by our ancestors. Our numbers may seem few, but a single Shado-Pan can be deadlier than a hundred trained soldiers. To join the Shado-Pan order is a long journey full of hardship. If this is the path you seek, then you must first prove your worth. There is urgent work to be done here. Help the Golden Lotus defend the Vale.

Title: Temple of the White Tiger
Objective: Speak to Dezco at the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: Have you heard the news, traveller? There's been an attack at one of our most sacred places, the Vale of Eternal Blossoms! Even now, there's a human prince within the White Tiger Temple arguing that you and the other races from beyond the mists should be allowed within. The temple is in the northeast of Kun-Lai. Maybe you can convince the White Tiger to allow you inside? I only hope the Vale has not been utterly destroyed...

Title: The Golden Lotus
Objective: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The Golden Lotus have guarded the Vale for centuries, keeping it safe and hidden from harm. Recent events have unleashed terrible horrors upon our sacred vale, but allies of the Golden Lotus still stand against them, attempting to bring peace. If you wish to help, you had best join them at the Setting Sun Garrison.

Title: The Golden Lotus
Objective: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The Golden Lotus have guarded the Vale for centuries, keeping it safe and hidden from harm. Recent events have unleashed terrible horrors upon our sacred vale, but allies of the Golden Lotus still stand against them, attempting to bring peace. If you wish to help, you had best join them at the Setting Sun Garrison.

Title: The Shado-Pan Offensive
Objective: Speak to Taran Zhu at Longying Outpost in the Townlong Steppes.
Text: We Shado-Pan have amassed our forces for the first time in many ages. The Sha of Hatred has escaped beyond the Serpent's Spine, and it is our sacred duty to imprison it once more. However, our warriors are great, but our numbers too few. Help from a capable  may not be turned away. If you wish to join the offensive, speak to Taran Zhu in the Townlong Steppes.

Title: Defense At Niuzao Temple
Objective: Speak to Ogo the Elder at Niuzao Temple in the Townlong Steppes.
Text: Niuzao Temple, far to the west, is under attack by the mantid. The great Celestial holds them back for now, but he cannot stand alone forever. Go and help the defenders. The Temple must not fall!

Title: Trial At The Temple of the White Tiger
Objective: Speak to Xuen at the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: Xuen, the great Celestial of the North, seeks the greatest champions in the land. Today, he holds trials of battle at his temple in Kun-Lai Summit. If you wish to test yourself against skilled fighters from all across Pandaria, then go to him and enter the challenger's ring!

Title: Defense At Niuzao Temple
Objective: Speak to Ogo the Elder at Niuzao Temple in the Townlong Steppes.
Text: Niuzao Temple, far to the west, is under attack by the mantid. The great Celestial holds them back for now, but he cannot stand alone forever. Go and help the defenders. The Temple must not fall!

Title: Challenge At The Temple of the Red Crane
Objective: Speak to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in the Krasarang Wilds.
Text: The Temple of the Red Crane still reels from the aftermath of the sha's presence, and has only recently gathered to rebuild and retrain its warriors. If you wish to help at the temple, speak to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji.

Title: Trial At The Temple of the White Tiger
Objective: Speak to Xuen at the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: Xuen, the great Celestial of the North, seeks the greatest champions in the land. Today, he holds trials of battle at his temple in Kun-Lai Summit. If you wish to test yourself against skilled fighters from all across Pandaria, then go to him and enter the challenger's ring!

Title: Attack At The Temple of the Jade Serpent
Objective: Speak to Elder Sage Tai-Feng at the Jade Temple Grounds in The Jade Forest.
Text: Darkness enshrouds the Temple of the Jade Serpent, and Yu'Lon's priests beseech us for aid. They hold the sha in check, but just barely. You may be able to turn the tide.

Title: Attack At The Temple of the Jade Serpent
Objective: Speak to Elder Sage Tai-Feng at the Jade Temple Grounds in The Jade Forest.
Text: Darkness enshrouds the Temple of the Jade Serpent, and Yu'Lon's priests beseech us for aid. They hold the sha in check, but just barely. You may be able to turn the tide.

Title: Challenge At The Temple of the Red Crane
Objective: Speak to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in the Krasarang Wilds.
Text: The Temple of the Red Crane still reels from the aftermath of the sha's presence, and has only recently gathered to rebuild and retrain its warriors. If you wish to help at the temple, speak to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji.

Title: The Order of the Cloud Serpent
Objective: Speak to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.
Text: The Order of the Cloud Serpent is always searching for talented riders. If you wish to follow our way, you should speak to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum in the Jade Forest. I wish you luck.

Title: The Tillers
Objective: Speak to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: The Tillers do their business at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds. If you're interested in getting started, I hear there's a new farmer in town by the name of Farmer Yoon. I betcha he'll be looking for help.

Title: The Tillers
Objective: Speak to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: The Tillers do their business at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds. If you're interested in getting started, I hear there's a new farmer in town by the name of Farmer Yoon. I betcha he'll be looking for help.

Title: The Order of the Cloud Serpent
Objective: Speak to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.
Text: The Order of the Cloud Serpent is always searching for talented riders. If you wish to follow our way, you should speak to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum in the Jade Forest. I wish you luck.

Title: The Lorewalkers
Objective: Speak to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: So you are interested in learning more of the lore of this land? Very well! You should speak to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge. He can be found in the room above the entrance to the Mogu'shan Palace. Speak with Mishi for a ride.

Title: The Anglers
Objective: Speak to Fisherman Haito at the Anglers Wharf in the Krasarang Wilds.
Text: If you want to explore all the secrets of the deep ocean, and catch some big fish, speak to Haito at the Anglers Wharf in Krasarang Wilds. I'm sure he'd love to show you a thing or two about reeling!

Title: The Anglers
Objective: Speak to Fisherman Haito at the Anglers Wharf in the Krasarang Wilds.
Text: If you want to explore all the secrets of the deep ocean, and catch some big fish, speak to Haito at the Anglers Wharf in Krasarang Wilds. I'm sure he'd love to show you a thing or two about reeling!

Title: Somewhere Inside
Objective: Rescue 12 Shado-Pan Prisoners.
Text: I sent a dozen of my best men ahead to infiltrate the mantid siege. None have returned. Since you are taking the fight directly to the mantid, you will be in a position to free any who had the misfortune to be captured. You will do this?

Title: That's a Big Bug!
Objective: Kill Raigonn.
Text: The mantid have something they call Raigonn. It's a giant bug they're using to bust down the wall's gates! Let's keep that thing from getting into the vale!

Title: The Kunchong Whisperer
Objective: Kill Oracle Hiss'ir and 10 Muckscale tribe members.
Text: To really connect with Kovok you need to challenge him mentally and physically. You must respect his strength and intelligence; only then will he allow you to really train him. The muckscale tribe may provide an adequate test of his abilities and with you there he shouldn't be in danger. Additionally, this will allow us to decrease their numbers in the Briny Muck.

Title: A New Lesson for the Master
Objective: Kill Xin the Weaponmaster.
Text: A new king of the mogu has arisen: Xin the Weaponmaster. He single-handedly subjugated the mogu clans, and now they and their new leaders vie for his favor. I've never seen or read of any who are his equal in battle. Do not underestimate Xin. Our fate rests in your hands.

Title: The Lorewalkers
Objective: Speak to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: So you are interested in learning more of the lore of this land? Very well! You should speak to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge. He can be found in the room above the entrance to the Mogu'shan Palace. Speak with Mishi for a ride.

Title: Last Piece of the Puzzle
Objective: Use Cho's Heirloom at Cho's Family Shrine on Serpent's Overlook.
Text: I must say, despite their skirmishes with the hozen, I've never seen the jinyu so militant. This troubles me. We must discuss it another time, however. I have come to ask for your assistance. The fresco, where last we spoke, is nearly unveiled. I am certain that it holds ancient wisdom - knowledge that the emperor would have us remember. My meditations alone may not be enough to discern its meaning. Please, take this heirloom to the shrine of my ancestors. I shall require their assistance.

Title: Take Down the Wing Leader
Objective: Kill Wing Leader Ner'onok.
Text: The mantid have lain siege to Niuzao Temple. Even now, Wing Leader Ner'onok and his forces work to cross the final chasm. You must stop him before they reconstruct that bridge.

Title: Lighting the Way
Objective: Light the Signal Flame.
Text: We need reinforcements! Someone has to fight through and light the signal flame. It's all up to you. No pressure or anything.

Title: Relics of the Four Kings
Objective: Collect the Lantern of the Sorcerer King, Mad King Meng's Balance, Qiang's "The Science of War", and Subetai's Bow of the Swift.
Text: The mogu have reawakened and are a threat to all of Pandaria. They are on the cusp of becoming even more dangerous. There are four great mogu kings of legend: Zian of the Endless Shadow, Meng the Demented, Qiang the Merciless, and Subetai the Swift. Four artifacts of these kings are secreted away in the Vault of Kings Past, below. You must retrieve these relics before the mogu discover them and become unstoppable.

Title: Deep Doubts, Deep Wisdom
Objective: Kill the Sha of Doubt.
Text: There is an ancient pandaren saying that states, "With deep doubts comes deep wisdom." The Sha of Doubt has infested the Heart of Jade within the temple. It must be destroyed. I dare say that you are about to become all the wiser.

Title: Restoring Jade's Purity
Objective: Assist Wise Mari, Liu Flameheart, and Lorewalker Stonestep with their sha problems.
Text: , will you aid us? The temple's purity has been jeopardized. Even now the three masters struggle against their doubts. Please, I beg you, head in and help Wise Mari, Liu Flameheart, and Lorewalker Stonestep in their fight against the sha.

Title: Mazu's Bounty
Objective: Speak with Master Angler Ju Lien in Soggy's Gamble.
Text: That was some amazing work you and the captain did out there! It's an honor to have you on the crew. Oh! And Ju Lien survived! He swam ashore just after you started letting the harpoons fly. He was raving about some kind of gigantic egg or something that washed in with Jiao. Go check up on him, will you? He's probably hauled it out of the water by now.

Title: Lost Sheepie
Objective: Find Sheepie and return him to Chee Chee.
Text: Chee Chee's prize sheep, Sheepie, is missing! That bad sheep is always wandering off the farm. Stupid sheep! I looked everywhere and couldn't find him. Can you help me?

Title: A Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
Objective: Use the old sheepskin anywhere in the Skyrange or Kunzen Village, then kill Krungko.
Text: AAAIIIIEEUUGGHHHH!!!! This is the last straw! Those stupid hozen on the mountain killed my SHEEPIE! I know exactly who did this, and it is time for REVENGE. If you are willing to help me, take this old sheepskin. Use it to disguise yourself anywhere on the mountain to the north, wait for that little dooker Krungko to come out of hiding, and then break his bones!

Title: The Path to Respect Lies in Violence
Objective: Kill the Sha of Violence.
Text: You have proven yourself in battle. Still, if you would aid us further, I must ask something else of you. The Sha of Violence awaits beyond within the Sealed Chambers. Destroy it if you would earn my respect.

Title: Lost Sheepie... Again
Objective: Find Sheepie and bring him back to Chee Chee.
Text: That stupid sheep! He wandered off again! Can you find him for me again?

Title: Lesson 5: Pounded Rice Cake
Objective: Obtain 5 Rice for Nomi's Lesson.
Text: I love rice cakes. I'll do my best to make good ones!

Title: A Token of Appreciation
Objective: Receive Nomi's gift.
Text: Thanks for checking to make sure I'm doing well! I've been able to help out the Ironpaws today, and they said I could give this to you.

Title: Lesson 4: Dried Needle Mushrooms
Objective: Obtain 5 Needle Mushrooms for Nomi's Lesson.
Text: I'm not very fond of mushrooms... but I'll do my best to learn.

Title: Oh Sheepie...
Objective: Find Sheepie.
Text: Sigh... you guessed it... Sheepie is gone... AGAIN. Stupid sheep! Gives me so much trouble! I hate to ask you again, but I promise this will be the last time. Can you find him for me?

Title: Lesson 3: Toasted Fish Jerky
Objective: Obtain 5 Golden Carp for Nomi's Lesson.
Text: Cooking is harder than I thought. It's so easy to burn things.

Title: Lesson 2: Instant Noodles
Objective: Obtain 5 Instant Noodles for Nomi's Lesson.
Text: Instant noodles aren't that hard to cook, right?

Title: Your Next Move
Objective: Choose your next move in Zandalar.
Text: Princess Talanji plans to travel north to Nazmir. The blood trolls there are a threat she believes her father refuses to acknowledge.General Jakra'zet detests the Horde and cannot be trusted. As long as he remains in power, the city will never be safe.You will also need to win over King Rastakhan here in Zuldazar. This city is vast and has many secrets.

Title: The Bloodwatcher Legacy
Objective: Help Examiner Tae'shara Bloodwatcher recover a Xibalan fossil.
Text: Greetings. I have been sent on behalf of my father, High Examiner Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher, to oversee the extraction of all fossils, relics, and artifacts from this area. My sources inform me that an object that could advance the Horde's cause may be buried beneath this very site. I will require your help extracting it. You see, these nightborne are not precisely good with their hands. Nor do they enjoy getting dirty. Could you be a dear and set a good example?

Title: Whispers of a Frightened World
Objective: Meet Magni in Sholazar Basin and hear the warning.
Text: Champion, Magni needs your help! The Speaker has a message for you, perhaps from Azeroth herself. He seems to be having trouble understanding her, but I'm sure he can explain everything better. He said he was in Sholazar Basin, in Northrend. He should be contacting you shortly.

Title: Answering Their Attacks
Objective: Kill sethrak in the Abandoned Burrows.
Text: The sethrak's attacks on our burrows cannot go unanswered.They need to learn that not all within the desert will give up so easily.The only thing the sethrak understand is blood, so that's the language we'll use to teach them.I'm saying we need to kill the sethrak here. All of them.

Title: Unlikely Allies
Objective: Fly to the Sanctuary of the Devoted.
Text: I believe this is one of the Keepers' keys! Only Vorrik would know for sure.We need to head to the temple at once.My pterrordax can take us there when you're ready, but we need to hurry.

Title: Into the Dunes
Objective: Fly into the deserts of Vol'dun and search for Warguard Rakera.
Text: Whatever Rakera uncovered, it was important enough to earn her a death sentence to de sands.We must head into Vol'dun to find her.We cannot let whatever she knows about Jakra'zet die with her in de dunes.

Title: Searching for Survivors
Objective: Search for survivors near the crash site.
Text: It is good to see you are safe, but what of de others? Have dey been lost to de sands?You need to head back to de crash site and see if de others survived.I will ask around and see if these fox people can tell us anything about Rakera.

Title: Restorative Venom
Objective: Collect 15 Sandstinger Venom Glands.
Text: Meerah here found your friend in the dunes. The lightning strike nearly killed her. It might still, without treatment.The wasps within the grove have a painful sting, but their venom also has restorative properties.I can extract what I need from their glands.With an ample amount of venom, we should be able to soothe your friend's wounds.

Title: A Balm to Calm
Objective: Use the Restorative Balm on Bladeguard Kaja.
Text: As promised, here is the balm that should remedy your companion's injuries.Apply it liberally to any bits of exposed flesh.Its effects should be felt immediately.

Title: Aided Escape
Objective: Free Hakasi and Kipp from within The Serpent's Maw.
Text: The sethrak may be strong, but we're quick. Well, at least Mekaru and I are.We just barely made it back to the wagon with our tails attached.The others weren't so lucky, I guess. We've been waiting a while, and still no sign of them.If you're headed into the thick of it, would you mind looking for our friends?

Title: Knickknack Takeback
Objective: Collect 6 Knickknacks from sethrak within The Serpent's Maw.
Text: Nisha told me you came here in search of an exile. One named Rakera?We don't know her, but we might be able to help you find her.You help us, and we help you. Deal?We survive by scavenging. We trade what we find, but the sethrak that raided our burrows made away with many of our knickknacks.I always knew they were ruthless, but never imagined they'd be so greedy.Take back what the sethrak have taken, and I'll see that you are provided safe passage through the dunes.

Title: Secrets in the Sand
Objective: Recover the journal's missing pages.
Text: I found this journal buried in the sand.Kiro tried to toss it in the fire."Our wagon has no space for a diary, Meerah. What practical use does it have?"Don't tell him I said so, but I think it's fascinating! Can you imagine what kinds of secrets it holds?Quite a few pages are missing, but I bet you can recover them out on the dunes!

Title: Rumors of Exile
Objective: Follow Bladeguard Kaja.
Text: Talanji sent you, didn't she?De princess needs to know dat it is no longer safe to ask such questions so openly.Warguard Rakera spoke out, and no one has heard from her since.Rumor has it she was exiled to Vol'dun.

Title: Queenfeather
Objective: Slay Queenfeather and claim one of her feathers.
Text: Ah, so you are de one who inherited Bazkoji's herd. What is left of it, anyway.I know what killed him, and I tried to warn him. Queenfeather is a vicious ravasaur, bigger than de rest and smarter as well. Most of de eggs around here are hers.Usually I praise de strength of such a beast, but she has become a nuisance.You will find her guarding her nests in de feeding grounds. Kill her and bring back one of her head feathers as proof dat de deed is done.

Title: Discreet Discussions
Objective: Question Enforcers within Dazar'alor.
Text: General Jakra'zet cannot be trusted.He is up to something, but I do not know what.Any who question his actions earn demselves a trip to de sands.As long as he remains in power, my city will never be safe.Speak to his guards. See what you can find out, but be discreet. We do not want to alert Jakra'zet to our actions.

Title: Naptime
Objective: Stable your direhorn in the Beast Pen.
Text: Your not-so-little guy is looking a bit ragged after such an exciting day. I bet you both need a rest, hm?Come back later when you're a bit stronger.

Title: Headbutting 101
Objective: Assist your hatchling in fighting 12 creatures.
Text: Your beast is looking well fed. Good. Try and keep it dat way.Now, next you need to teach your little one to defend itself. Direhorns in de wild are prey for much larger creatures and de young are easy pickings for saurid and their like.Go out into de Savagelands and show your little one how to fend dem off.It's all in de horn.

Title: Teddies and Tea
Objective: Gather Mr. Munchykins, Trunksy, and Mayor Striggs for the tea party.
Text: There's nobody to play with here anymore. But you'll play with me, right ? It's time for tea! Help me find the other guests, please!

Title: Figuring out how to make quests
Objective: Make a breadcrumb quest.
Text: Whee! You get to make a breadcrumb quest! Now figure out what to do next.

Title: The Vindicaar Matrix Core
Objective: Link Light's Judgment into the Vindicaar Matrix Core.
Text: Much has happened on Argus that concerns me but none moreso than Xe'ra's fate. I wonder sometimes if we are doing the right thing? But we must carry on. I can rig the Matrix Core that powers the Vindicaar to allow you to call on the power of our guns when you have need of them on the planet. Go to the Matrix Core in the room at the heart of our ship. Once linked, whatever powers the core has installed now and in the future will be at your disposal.

Title: Chop, Chop!
Objective: Pick up a Sturdy Axe, then gather 5 Freshly-Chopped Wood from the nearby Sapling.
Text: Throm-ka.I'm always looking for someone who thinks they can swing an axe with the best of them.If you can remove that sapling without much trouble, I'm sure we can find a better use for your skills.

Title: A Beautiful Brooch
Objective: Bring the Beautiful Brooch to Tina Mudclaw at Haohan's House or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: It is a very old, antique brooch with very detailed molding and filigree worked into the edges. It looks very valuable. There's only one person who keeps losing jewelry to furry hooligans, and she would probably want to see this heirloom returned.

Title: An Exquisite Earring
Objective: Bring the Exquisite Earring to Tina Mudclaw at Haohan's House or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: You unhook the earring off the furry creature's ear. It looks like he was having some fun wearing the dangly hoop. TOO much fun. Perhaps the owner of this dainty bauble would like to see it returned. You don't have to tell her where you found it... or who was wearing it.

Title: Tina's Tasteful Tiara
Objective: Bring the Tasteful Tiara to Tina Mudclaw at Haohan's House or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: It's a dazzling diamond tiara. Who in the valley would be wealthy enough to own such a piece of jewelry? Whoever it is, they might be willing to give a nice reward.

Title: Trouble Brewing
Objective: Kill Yan-Zhu the Uncasked.
Text: With the brewery infested by hozen and... and who knows what else, I'm sure that the brewers are in trouble. Would you mind helping me find out what's going on, my friend?

Title: Family Secrets
Objective: Collect 5 Stormstout Secrets.
Text: Our secret recipes! I was gathering them up. But then... hozen?  How is Gao to brew anything? He needs those recipes or disaster is sure to strike!

Title: A Very Nice Necklace
Objective: Bring the necklace to Tina Mudclaw at Haohan's House or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: The beautiful necklace is only partly smudged by dirty hozen hands. There's only one person in the Valley who would own such a beautiful piece of jewelry.

Title: Buy A Fish A Keg?
Objective: Bring 10 Jade Witch Brew to Jogu the Drunk. Jade Witch Brew can be made using the cooking profession.
Text: My dreams grow dim recently. I need something powerful to kick myshelf back into gear! I heard there'sh a delishush drink that folksh are making nowadays. It'sh called Jade Witch Brew. I'd sure like to taste some.

Title: Buy A Fish A Brewery?
Objective: Bring 20 Mad Brewer's Breakfast to Jogu the Drunk. Mad Brewer's Breakfasts can be made using the cooking profession.
Text: All right, in order to continue my vishions, I must now have my own brewery. ... Just kidding! You should have sheen your own face! Hilarioush... hic! Anyway, I heard of a new drink that is unlike any other, and I would like a tashte. Have you heard of the Mad Brewer'sh Breakfasht? If you can bring me some of thish shtuff, you will be my friend for life.

Title: Buy A Fish A Drink?
Objective: Bring 1 Four Wind Soju to Jogu the Drunk. Four Wind Soju can be purchased from most bartenders in Pandaria.
Text: Heeeey buddy, how'sh it goin'? You wanna buy a jinyu a drink?

Title: Emergency Response
Objective: Use Cho's Fireworks near Admiral Taylor, Mishka and Sully.
Text: Your companions have made themselves at home in our land, and brought with them a dangerous conflict. The full extent of their destruction here we cannot yet know. Already it is... unspeakable. Nevertheless, to forsake your friends out of spite would be against our way. Any that yet live are doubtlessly wounded and in desperate need of care. These fireworks were to celebrate the statue's completion. Use them near your companions to signal Mishi, and she will bear them off to safety.

Title: Buy A Fish A Round?
Objective: Bring 5 Pandaren Plum Wine to Jogu the Drunk. Pandaren Plum Wine can be purchased from most bartenders in Pandaria.
Text: Heeeey it's my friend, the ! I guesh you've seen me hanging 'round, but I should 'splain that I'm not drunk. I mean, look at me now! Shober as a freshwater fish! Sure I like to drown my sorrowsh in some good brew now and then, but you can't inebriate a jinyu! Might as well try to drown a fish! No, the brewsh make me shleepy, and when I shleep, I have vishions of the future. The shtronger the brew, the more potent my dreamsh! If you bring me a drink, I'll owe you one.

Title: Julia, The Pet Tamer
Objective: Defeat Julia Stevens in a pet battle.
Text: I can tell you have been honing your pet battle skills. I think it's time for you to take on a real challenge. Julia Stevens can be found at the Maclure Vineyards south of Stormwind. She is an up and coming wild pet tamer and I think it's time you faced her in battle!

Title: The Old Map
Objective: Show the map to Fish Fellreed at Cattail Lake or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: The old, faded leather is falling apart, but still legible. Scrawled on it is some kind of map, and the following lines: Deep in the valley where four winds blow, The maiden laughs behind her golden fan. At the feet of her ancestors' stair, She whispers secrets into the echoing dark.

Title: The Heartland Legacy
Objective: Take Old Man Thistle's Almanac to Seedkeeper Shing Sing at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: At the very bottom of the treasure chest, you find a stack of scrolls and a soft leather sack with seeds. Unrolling the scrolls, you see they contain detailed farming notes, drawings of plants, numbers and calculations, locations of nearby water springs, and countless other snippets. There might be someone at the Tillers Union who would like to see this.

Title: Just A Folk Story
Objective: Speak to Grainsorter Pei, Stonecarver Mac, Mama Min, and Old Man Whitewhiskers.
Text: What!?! This don't make any sense!  What's this mumber jumber about a maiden and an ancestor and a buncha stairs? I can't make any reason outta this, can you? Well, there are lotsa folks 'round here who're much older than you and me. Can you go talk to the folks in Halfhill? I betcha they might know somethin'!

Title: Old Man Thistle's Treasure
Objective: Find the cave entrance and recover Old Man Thistle's hidden treasure.
Text: Well high golly! This is turning into a real life treasure hunt! There's gotta be some kind of entrance or opening to the north, where the mountains meet Cattail Lake. I'll meet ya at the entrance! Let's go get that treasure!

Title: Seeker's Folly
Objective: Brave the path of Seeker's Folly to find Lorewalker Cho, stopping to reflect at the three shrines along the way.
Text: I'm sure your pandaren friend has some ideas about what the mogu are after. He headed up the mountain a few days ago without a guide, and asked that only you be sent up after him. He was very specific: "The  must endure the trek alone, with only  thoughts.  will honor each shrine before meeting me at the top." The path is just northwest of the camp, marked by flags. Please be careful! Seeker's Folly is a dangerous trek even on a lucky day.

Title: Learning the Ropes
Objective: Win a pet battle.
Text: Now that you are a pet trainer, it's time to test your skills! Head out into the forest and pick a fight with a battle pet. Make sure to use your Track Pets skill so you can see pets you can fight on the minimap. Come back to me after you have won and I will continue your training. Good luck!

Title: Way of the Grill
Objective: Bring 5 Raw Tiger Steaks to the Master of the Grill.
Text: The Pandaren Way of the Grill produces foods that increase your physical strength. Bring some raw tiger steaks to the Master of the Grill, and he will teach you what you can do with them. There are many tigers in the Jade Forest and the Krasarang Wilds, but you can also find them in other places.

Title: On The Mend
Objective: Heal your pets to full health by visiting Erma the Stable Master.
Text: Now that you have won a battle, we need to heal up your pets so they can fight another day! Visit Erma, our local stable master, to heal and revive your pets.

Title: The Seal is Broken
Objective: Seal 12 Sha Fissures to banish the Sha of Doubt.
Text: I... I thought Sha of this immensity were a myth - we all did. Just a story to keep our children from fighting. No time to talk now. Those fissures - they're feeding it... it grows stronger by the moment! I must research the scrolls from my family archives. You, take this cannon and ride Mishi. You must find a way to contain this horror that has been unleashed!

Title: Direhorn Growth Hormone
Objective: Collect 10 Steaming Fresh Carrion.
Text: Nice little critter you got there. Seems a tad too small to be much more than a nuisance though.Wanna help a friend make a profit? There's an abundance of opportunity here, but these trolls won't listen to me!Tell you what, I can make a supplement of sorts that'll make hair grow on your chest! Er, your hatchling's chest!I know direhorn are vegetarians and all, but there's a reason all the biggest predators eat meat!Rapid growth requires protein. LOTS of protein.You interested?

Title: Leave None Standing
Objective: Slay 6 blood trolls.
Text: Now you see what my father refuses to acknowledge. De blood trolls are slaughtering us, and dey need to be stopped.Our plan is simple. We will go out dere and kill as many of dese blood trolls as we can. You go east, I go north.Meet with me after and we will see what is left to do. We will teach dese blood trolls to fear de Zandalari!

Title: Ready for Greatness
Objective: Make 5 Rice Pudding and give them to the Guide to the Ways.
Text: You seem to know your way around the kitchen. Demonstrate to me your skills and make me 5 bowls of rice pudding.

Title: The Way of the Grill
Objective: Make a Skewered Peanut Chicken and give it to the Master of the Grill.
Text: If you wish to cook foods that make you stronger, go seek the Master of the Grill. Cook him a skewered peanut chicken to show him that you have the basics.

Title: Ending the Blood Trolls
Objective: Kill Ateena, the Matriarch of the blood trolls.
Text: De loa are smiling on us today. De "matriarch" of dese blood trolls, a sick monster named Ateena, is up ahead.We have a change in plans. We will end dis threat now. We kill Ateena and de blood trolls will be thrown into chaos.She is a powerful hexxer. Go start de fight and I will ambush and catch her off guard.Let us get moving. We will be back in Zuldazar before de day is over.

Title: A Time of Revelation
Objective: Help Talanji chase down Ateena.
Text: I can feel Ateena's dark voodoo up ahead. We need to stop whatever she is planning with dis "G'huun".Be ready for anything. We do not know what power Ateena truly has.I do know one thing. If G'huun is threatening my people, den it will die, just like Ateena.

Title: Side Effects May Include...
Objective: Speak to Beastlord L'kala in Warbeast Kraal.

Title: How to Train Your Direhorn
Objective: Talk to Kraal Master B'khor and choose to train your direhorn.
Text: I have to get some of whatever you fed your baby! Wow!Now dat it's bigger, it is time to teach it to be a reliable battle companion.Let's see how it does against a tougher challenge, hmm?Talk to Kraal Master B'khor when you are ready to begin.

Title: Direhorn Daycare
Objective: Feed your hatchling.
Text: Handler Bazkoji had a real gift with de little ones. If dis hatchling is following you, it must mean Bazkoji is dead.I don't have time to find another handler. Are you up to de task?It's a lot of work, and de little ones get attached real fast. If you're going to care for it, it will be a commitment. That baby will be depending on you. I hope you will be up to de task of feeding and protecting it.First things first: food. Dere is plenty of fodder in de pens and river below.

Title: The Bones of Xibala
