Objective: Travel to Xibala and speak with Examiner Tae'shara Bloodwatcher.
Text: Far to the south you will find the bones of an ancient creature. This is Xibala, the progenitor, first of the devilsaurs. She was mother to Rezan, mother to all that came after. The Zandalari do not live there, as it belongs to beasts now. I have heard rumors of some of your Horde arriving in search of something among her bones. This is ill advised. Look into it, won't you?

Title: Prepare for a Siege
Objective: Speak with Baine Bloodhoof.
Text: It would seem we must make ready for a siege. For now, return to your Horde in Dazar'alor. Prepare for de coming conflict. Should de forces of Nazmir surge, I will send word.

Title: Interesting Times
Objective: Meet with Historian Ju'Pa in the Valley of Spirits of Orgrimmar.
Text: , I don't mean to alarm you, but we may be experiencing some... temporal disturbances.Have you ever heard the phrase 'I hope the past doesn't come back to haunt you?'Come visit me in the Valley of Spirits and we can speak more.

Title: Interesting Times
Objective: Meet with Historian Llore in the Royal Library of Stormwind.
Text: , I don't mean to alarm you, but we may be experiencing some... temporal disturbances.Have you ever heard the phrase 'I hope the past doesn't come back to haunt you?'Come visit me in the Stormwind Royal Library and we can speak more.

Title: We'll Meet Again
Objective: Travel to Zo'bal Ruins and speak with Hanzabu.
Text: Now, it be time for ya ta leave.Dere be many of dem blood troll souls for ya ta be sendin' to da Other Side for Bwonsamdi, and ya not gonna find any more of dem here.

Title: The Originals
Objective: Defeat Lord Kazzak in Blasted Lands, Azuregos in Azshara, and the Dragon of Nightmare at one of the portals to the Emerald Dream.
Text: Long ago, great terrors walked our lands, and drove even the smallest to flights of heroism.I speak, of course, about Lord Kazzak, Azuregos, and the Dragons of Nightmare.Legends have it that so sought after were their treasures, that armies would camp overnight to hunt them down.We have felt disturbances in the timeways, coincidentally located where these giants once roamed.Would you mind investigating for us? Strange things happen during this time of year.

Title: Soulbound
Objective: Speak to Bwonsamdi in the Court of Spirits and complete the ritual.
Text: Ya did well with me tasks. I be thinkin' ya show promise. Ya might be worthy of a deal.Very well, I pledge ta lend ya me powers ta use against ya foes. In exchange, ya be sendin' one million souls ta Bwonsamdi! No need ta look shocked, ya be plenty capable of doing dis.Come, meet with me at da Court of Spirits. Dere, we will finalize our agreement.

Title: A Culling of Souls
Objective: Defeat Blood Witch Najima.
Text: Only two types enter Bwonsamdi's temple anymore: those looking to make a deal with death, and de dead. You do not stink, so I guess you are de former.I am headed to de temple myself, so how about a trade? See de land across de bridge? Dere is a witch named Najima dat I have been tracking. De blood trolls are corrupt to de core, but their souls are useful as offerings to Bwonsamdi. She is too strong for me to deal with, but if you can slay her, I will take you to de temple.I give you my word.

Title: The Originals
Objective: Defeat Lord Kazzak in Blasted Lands, Azuregos in Azshara, and the Dragon of Nightmare at one of the portals to the Emerald Dream.
Text: Long ago, great terrors walked our lands, and drove even the smallest to flights of heroism.I speak, of course, about Lord Kazzak, Azuregos, and the Dragons of Nightmare.Legends have it that so sought after were their treasures, that armies would camp overnight to hunt them down.We have felt disturbances in the timeways, coincidentally located where these giants once roamed.Would you mind investigating for us? Strange things happen during this time of year.

Title: That Which Haunts the Dead
Objective: Defeat Hex Priestess Tizeja and Warlord Malaja.
Text: Bwonsamdi knows why ya be here. Ya be seekin' me favor.A test, ta see if ya be worth Bwonsamdi's time.Dere be spirits whose prayers sing of something called "G'huun." Dey pay me homage no more. I will not allow da desecration of me own temple!Go and subdue da strongest of da ancient spirits. If ya do dis for me, ya may be worth da trouble after all.

Title: The Shadow of Death
Objective: Search for clues to the location of the loa, Bwonsamdi.
Text: We have four loa, but we only know where one is: Bwonsamdi.As uncomfortable as it makes me, I am prepared to do anything to stop de blood trolls... even if it means dealing with de loa of death.Ages ago, Bwonsamdi had a temple here in Nazmir. My scrying has revealed a few locations to de north where I sense a magical presence. Search dem for clues.Hurry. Zuldazar will fall if we cannot obtain Bwonsamdi's help!

Title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
Objective: Obtain Valjabu's Tusk Ring.
Text: I don't know who you are, but I need your help.My precious Valjabu always told me he didn't care dat he took de vows of a priest... we would be together forever.Well, my time came to pass, and I knew I'd not be able to go on without him. I came back and have been waiting in dis spot for... it seems forever, and Valjabu never showed!I've been walking around dis world for far too long.Please, I beg you, bring a memento of my Valjabu back to me!

Title: Xibalan Ecology
Objective: Slay 8 Xibalan predators.
Text: I had really hoped this area would be more hospitable. The Zandalari have been no help whatsoever in clearing this space for archaeological exploration. Before we can even begin to uncover Xibala's secrets, we must make it safe for those less combat savvy to do their work. You will find the ruins ahead infested with all manner of carnivorous beasts. The few intrepid explorers who ventured within have all failed to return. Local ecology will not stand in the way of progress. Understand?

Title: The Orphaned Hatchling
Objective: Find someone in Warbeast Kraal who cares for young direhorn.

Title: The Seat of the Triumvirate
Objective: Seek the Crest of Knowledge.
Text: Even with the Sigil of Awakening in hand, the Crown cannot save us until it is whole. That is why we must enter the Seat of the Triumvirate, even knowing that L'ura awaits us there. This is a dire task, one that I would not ask if it were not completely necessary. We will descend together. Come.

Title: Getting the Message
Objective: Investigate the disturbance.
Text: Da loa be powerful, but we be needin' soldiers if we gonna have a chance of stopping dem blood trolls from building dat giant of theirs. If we not be able ta destroy dat thing before it be finished, den Zuldazar and all of our people gonna be dead!We need da help of da Horde!Word of da situation already be sent to da warchief. As soon as we be hearin' her reply, we can mov--Wait... what be dat noise?

Title: Bulwark of Torcali
Objective: Ride Old Rotana into battle against the blood trolls.
Text: We got Old Rotana up on her feet again. Load up an' take her reins. Give us some cover so Talanji can fight her way in from her side.

Title: Scrying for the Eye
Objective: Place 3 Scrying Vessels in Xibala.
Text: On behalf of the Horde we seek a relic called the Eye of Xibala.The locals have been no help whatsoever and Miss Tae'shara insists that we use her survey equipment.I abhor guesswork. Instead we shall use a more direct method: scrying.I will mark three locations on your map. I would like you to place a scrying vessel at each of them. I will use their measurements to isolate the relic's location and we will be on our way.

Title: Light's Exodus
Objective: Meet Prophet Velen in the Vault of Lights in the Exodar.
Text: Prophet Velen and the others have gathered within the Vault of Lights below. There is an entrance just down this path.We should find the Prophet at once so that we do not stall the invasion.

Title: The Hand of Fate
Objective: Meet your escort to the Exodar at Stormwind Harbor.
Text: $p,We have won many battles against the Burning Legion, but it is time to end this war once and for all.Final preparations have begun to depart for Argus.Make haste to Stormwind Harbor. A ship awaits you there to grant you and your allies passage to Azuremyst.

Title: A Beacon in the Dark
Objective: Take the Remnant of Nhal'athoth to Velen on the Vindicaar.
Text: That was... an intense experience.  It is difficult to focus. I need you to return to Velen. Give him this.  I feel as though he should have it, though I am not sure why. Tell him all that we have learned. I am sure Romuul will have been watching our progress. With any luck, a beacon is already headed our way.

Title: The Vindicaar
Objective: Board the Vindicaar.
Text: Everything is prepared for our assault. We need only establish the beacon to transport us to the vessel.Once the beacon arrives, place your hand upon its surface to board the Vindicaar, the instrument of our retribution.

Title: A Vessel Made Ready
Objective: Defeat Nhal'athoth and collect his heart.
Text: After some consideration, I have decided to allow Alleria another opportunity to pursue her destiny. I suppose you want to know what that means, mortal.  Meet us deep in the Shadowguard camp ahead- my brethren are preparing a summons that will provide adequate energy for Windrunner to begin again. Witness what happens when you harness the Void's power.

Title: Two If By Sea
Objective: Speak to Vereesa Windrunner to set sail for the Exodar.
Text: The Tomb of Sargeras was only the beginning. If we do not destroy the Legion utterly, they will return even stronger.We will travel to Azuremyst by sea to avoid drawing unnecessary attention. The less time the Legion has to react to our assault, the better.Just say the word when you are ready to depart.

Title: The Ruins of Guo-Lai
Objective: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai.
Text: The villagers seem to be safe and the mogu are losing their foothold. We should be able to handle the rest from here. Thank you for your kind aid. Anji lead a group to investigate and clear out the Ruins of Guo-Lai to the northwest this morning. I am certain she would appreciate someone as capable as yourself. You should go to her.

Title: Setting Sun Garrison
Objective: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Training Camp.
Text: The mogu will not be able to maintain this attack much longer. We should be able to handle it here, thanks to your kind aid. Might you be willing to find Anji at the Setting Sun Training Camp to the west? She's been tasked with preparing fresh-faced pandaren to aid the cause. You could show them a thing or two as well, I imagine.

Title: The Ruins of Guo-Lai
Objective: Speak to Angi Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai.
Text: I have my heartfelt thanks for your continued aid. Anji awaits at the Ruins of Guo-Lai to northwest. Go with courage in your heart, young .

Title: Research Project: The Pandaren Empire
Objective: Obtain 20 Pandaren Archaeology Fragments.
Text: Ah, adventurer. You come at a most opportune time. My daughter and I are researching the history of our people and have hit a roadblock in our research. Should you come across fragments of the pandaren past, please, bring them to us here. We would benefit greatly from the additional information.

Title: Mogu within the Ruins of Guo-Lai
Objective: Speak to Leven Dawnblade at the Ruins of Guo-Lai.
Text: Thank you for your help. I would enjoy your company for longer, but Leven is leading an attack on the mogu within the Ruins of Guo-Lai to the northwest, and awaits your capable hands. May the celestials protect you, young one.

Title: Mogu Make Poor House Guests
Objective: Kill 8 Shado-Tien attackers in Mistfall Village.
Text: Leven sent Rook here to stop mogu, but there are more than Rook can kill alone. You help? Rook will tell Leven you helped. Promise.

Title: Uncovering the Past
Objective: Solve 1 artifact from Pandaria.
Text: Interested in being a Lorewalker? There is lots of digging and reading and digging and more reading. I have entire days where I stare at a broken vase trying to figure out how it goes back together. Should give it a try. Go solve one artifact of Pandaria and we will appreciate you sharing the knowledge of how you did it.

Title: The Spring Drifter
Objective: Survive a trip on the Spring Drifter.
Text: Nobody really travels up the Ancient Passage on foot. That is just asking for a faceful of saurok if you are not careful. Tell you what, Egg Shell and I were just about to set off upriver to Binan Village. Want a lift?

Title: Research Project: The Mogu Dynasties
Objective: Obtain 20 Mogu Archaeology Fragments.
Text: Ah, an explorer. Just what I could use. I am on the verge of discovering the dark secrets of the mogu. Not all of the secrets, mind you. They kept a lot of dark secrets. But I am on the verge of discovering "a" secret at least. If, in your travels, you come across some fragments of the mogu past, bring them to me and I will happily reimburse you for them.

Title: Robbing Robbers of Robbers
Objective: Recover 7 Black Market Merchandise.
Text: Ah, a . I could make good use of your skills. A convoy was struck just up the road by a band of marauding saurok. These marauders made off with some... merchandise... her ladyship, the Madam Goya, had a mind to sell. One does not steal from her ladyship. If you recover these items I will gladly provide you a finders fee.

Title: Educating Saurok
Objective: Defeat Leechfingers.
Text: The Spring Road is under the protection of her ladyship, the esteemed Madam Goya. The saurok of Hatescale Burrow northeast of here require "education" in this fact. We have warned them before but sadly they seem to have a very short memory. Travel northeast to this burrow and find their shaman leader. Eliminate him and you will have the gratitude of her ladyship. As well as an appropriate bounty.

Title: Ways of Cooking
Objective: Learn the recipes for Charbroiled Tiger Steak, Jade Forest Fried Rice, Swirling Mist Soup, Shrimp Dumplings, Wildfowl Roast and Ginseng Tea from the masters in Halfhill Market.
Text: There are many ways of cooking, and each creates dishes with unique properties. The Pandaren Ways of Cooking are the Ways of the Grill, the Wok, the Pot, the Steamer, the Oven and the Brew. You seem to already have the basics of each way, from your experience in faraway lands. If you wish to progress further, speak with my siblings and learn the first advanced recipe each of them teaches. Find out which Way suits you the best.

Title: Figuring out how to make quests
Objective: Make a breadcrumb quest.
Text: Whee! You get to make a breadcrumb quest! Now figure out what to do next.

Title: Surprise Attack!
Objective: Meet up with Ban Bearheart outside Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes, and put a stop to the Mogu Invasion there.
Text: Those damnable Mogu...Those scouts were a distraction! While we were hunting their spies, the main force moved on Niuzao Temple. Corrupted serpents, Mogu everywhere... this is a disaster!Thankfully, Ban was able to make it past their lines with the most elite members of our order. If you can slip past, too, meet up with him. We need to put a stop to this!

Title: Everything I Know About Cooking
Objective: Deliver the Letter to Sungshin Ironpaw. She teaches in Halfhill Market.
Text: I'm so glad you enjoy my food. Are you interested in the recipes? If so, you should learn them properly, from my teachers in Halfhill Market. Everything I know about the kitchen, I learned from them. Say, if you happen to pass through there, would you deliver this note to Sungshin Ironpaw for me? She was my favorite teacher, and I want her to know that I miss her.

Title: So You Want to Be a Chef...
Objective: Learn the recipe for Sliced Peaches from the Guide to the Ways and make 5 of them for her.
Text: You wish to be a chef? If you are dedicated, I can unlock your hidden potential, no matter how inexperienced you are. If you wish to learn, show me you can at least follow basic instructions. Learn how to slice peaches and show me what you've learned. I have fresh pandaren peaches which I will sell to you at a token price.

Title: Relics of the Swarm
Objective: PH
Text: PH

Title: A Little Brain Work
Objective: Collect 3 Amber-Encrusted Brains from Ik'thik Amberstingers.
Text: Far to the south, the swarm breeds weapons of destruction - enormous, nearly unbreakable amber scorpions. Like all other creatures, they are subject to manipulation, but unlike other creatures, they have not yet submitted to my mind control. It appears that further research is necessary before I can dominate them for our own purposes. I must study their brains, and you must retrieve some specimens for me. Take this sonic emitter. I have found it to be quite effective against the beasts.

Title: Bad Genes
Objective: Kill 3 Ik'thik Genemancers and 6 Ik'thik Egg-Drones.
Text: Far to the south, Wakener, the Empress's genemancers set about their dark experiments. (Dark yes, but not as dark as mine!) They dissect and mutate the nearby wildlife, breeding creatures of their own design. (Their design, which will become my design!) We must not let them succeed! (No, no! Only I am allowed such power!) Their mutations are already being unleashed for war. Go! Destroy them at any cost!

Title: Mistblade Destruction
Objective: Kill 6 Mistblade Rippers.
Text: Korven has told me of his findings. There is an enormous amber deposit sitting at the bottom of the Lake of Stars. Unfortunately, a hostile saurok tribe lives at the edge of the lake, and revere the amber as their own. They will not allow us to enter their territory easily. Go south to the lake. Kill the Mistblade saurok, so that we can more easily harvest the nearby amber.

Title: The Scale-Lord
Objective: Kill the Mistblade Scale-Lord.
Text: The saurok at the Lake of Stars take their orders from their Scale-Lord, a vicious, merciless leader who guards his territory fiercely. If we can eliminate this leader, then we can gain access to the enormous amber lode beneath the lake. Go. Their leader gives his orders from his underground dwelling, at the southern edge of the lake.

Title: The Fight Against Fear
Objective: Kill 15 Horrorscale Scorpid.
Text: When we discovered the sha influence at Kypari Zar, I had hoped the corruption could still be cleansed. Unfortunately, the Klaxxi Council has confirmed that the sha of fear's corruption is deep-seated, and continues to spread. To the south, I have observed some of the local wildlife consumed by an unnamed terror. The sha can warp and twist its victims into unimaginable horrors. We must stop the corruption before it becomes worse. Seek out the sha-infected Horrorscale Scorpids. Eliminate them.

Title: Infection
Objective: Kill 6 infected wildlife. Infected wildlife may include Bonedust Moths, Bluehide Mushan, and Mutating Scorpid.
Text: The Empress's genemancers play with dangerous toys. To the south, they are injecting local wildlife with pheromone-laden parasites, in an attempt to create monstrous mutations for war. Carelessly, they have allowed their parasitic worms to escape into the local ecosystem. Left unchecked, the infection will spread from one animal to another, until we have an outbreak. I will inject you with a mild toxin. With it, you will be able to identify infected creatures. Kill the carriers at once.

Title: Mazu's Breath
Objective: Drink the Potion of Mazu's Breath.
Text: Here to help, are ya? Well, first thing's first.  Here it is! "Mazu's Breath." Cap'n's own formula. What? You thought I'd send you out to sea without a means of breathin'? I need deckhands, not corpses! Down the hatch with it, green. This'll give you a fighting chance out there on the shelf.

Title: The Shadowguard Incursion
Objective: Slay 15 Shadowguard Ethereals.
Text: As you have surely gathered by now, a certain subset of my people have tragically succumbed to the call of the Void. I had hoped to find more who possess the necessary strength of mind. I am disappointed to find such an utter lack of resistance. It cannot be helped. To advance your cause, and mine, we will need to eradicate these weak-willed beings.

Title: Mogu Incursions
Objective: Find and kill the Shan'ze Spymaster.
Text: We've heard reports of a group of Mogu infiltrating the coast here in Townlong. I have no idea what they are doing. Frankly, I don't care.You've proven yourself, so we've decided to give this mission to you.What's going to happen is this - you're going to go, find them, and kill them.Our scouts reported the first group landed to the north, between here and Deadtalker's Plateau. Go there and wipe them out.

Title: Crane Mastery: Needlebeak
Objective: Acquire the Needlebeak.
Text: So, now that you've got a vibe for how cranes fight, I've got a doozy for you. Needlebeak! Or at least, that's what I'm calling him. Biggest crane I ever saw. And its beak is so sharp it's like a sword. Northwest of here you'll find the big water fall that kicks off the Dojani River. Needlebeak likes to hang out by the waterfall. You bring me its beak as a trophy and I will talk you up a good game to Nesingwary.

Title: Profit Mastery: Chasheen
Objective: Collect Ancient Tiger's Blood.
Text: I am totally on to another great scam! When I was flying overhead I saw a really ancient tigress prowling about. Do you know how much her blood would go for on the black market? Not to mention if I convince some warlocks it adds extra potency to their summoning spells or something. If you bring me back some of her blood I will cut you in on the scam. She was prowling about on the far side of the Dojani River from here.

Title: Captain Jack's Dead
Objective: Bring Captain Jack's head to Chief Kah Kah at Grookin Hill.
Text: Gore from Captain Jack's head drips and mysteriously seeps into the ground as you examine your hard-won trophy. Strange, but no time to investigate that now. There's too much work to be done. The chieftain of your newfound friends will doubtlessly be impressed with this proof of your grookin' skills.

Title: Sources of Darkness
Objective: Deactivate 5 Void Harvesters.
Text: I think I understand what he was trying to show us. I feel a surge of power building ahead. They must be cultivating the Void, calling it here. We need to stop them before they plunge this entire city into shadow. Find the source and cut it off by any means necessary. Locus-Walker and I have unfinished business to attend to.

Title: Throwing Shade
Objective: Investigate the Umbra Hollows with Alleria and Locus-Walker.
Text: That was Locus-Walker. He taught me all that I know about the Void, and he still has more to teach me. If he is here, then the ethereals' presence only intrigues me further. I had thought him the only one of his kind, but now that I have seen another tangling with the Void... Come, we must play his game if we want to learn what he knows. He appears to have gone toward the Umbra Hollows to the north.

Title: Warmother
Objective: Slay Warmother Shazraka.
Text: Old Rotana be cursed by da warmother dese vile blood trolls brought with dem. We need to take her down so we can get dis old direhorn back in da field.

Title: The New Frontline
Objective: Slay Blood Troll forces.
Text: Kill anything ya see dat not a Zandalari!

Title: A Personal Message
Objective: Speak with Prophet Velen.
Text: The time has come for me to travel to the Broken Shore and see, for myself, the place where my father died.If I am to be the king my father was... the king Stormwind deserves, I must know firsthand the threat my people face.Please tell my advisors that I've gone to the Broken Shore. If I told them myself they'd only try and stop me.I'll wait for you at Deliverance Point. Farewell.

Title: Rokhan
Objective: Ride the Old Rotana into the fray and then find Rokhan.
Text: My scouts have informed me dat your Darkspear shadow hunter, Rokhan, has returned from Nazmir. He is pinned down at de far side of de gate. We need to break dis onslaught with a flanking maneuver. Old Rotana is in position. Mount up and smash through de side of those blood troll ranks. Once down dere, try to find Rokhan. Oh, and $p, be careful. A lot of dark magic is being tossed around down dere.

Title: Ticks
Objective: Slay 6 Bloodbelly Fliers.
Text: Kill those bloodbellies before dey take off with all of my soldiers! I will have my troops prepare for a flanking charge.

Title: A Nation Divided
Objective: Inspect the Scouting Map in the Harbormaster's Office.
Text: Kul Tiras must be unified before it can be of any help to the Alliance.Let's get you briefed on the current situation in each of our major territories.Then you can take a look at the map behind me and make the call on where you want to go first.

Title: They Want Us Alive
Objective: Cure 8 Wounded Captives.
Text: Blood troll poisons are made to paralyze, not kill. See, dey want us alive. I do not feel good thinking about why. I am making antitoxins as quickly as I can, but I need someone like yourself to get out dere and test dem. Take what I have made so far and see if we can get those soldiers back on their feet.

Title: The Blood Gate
Objective: Journey to the Blood Gate.
Text: We just received word that the Northern border is under heavy attack by an army of blood trolls. King Rastakhan has called for reinforcements. You are more familiar with that threat than any of us. Go and do what you can to help them.

Title: Arkhaan's Peril
Objective: Enter the Void Tear and deal with Arkhaan.
Text: Whatever called to him, it cannot have good intentions. We need to go in after him. Before we step through this portal... ensure you are prepared to fight. The Void's influence is rarely peaceful.

Title: Arkhaan's Plan
Objective: Follow Arkhaan to Isolon.
Text: Arkhaan remembers. He remembers something that will... yes... will save us. Follow Arkhaan. Isolon calls! We will offer soft words to the Light. The Light will banish the darkness.  Arkhaan will watch that one closely.

Title: Long Overdue
Objective: Mark the Argussian Heartwells for the Vindicaar's guns, kill the Legion garrison, and retrieve the Fel Heart of Argus from High Inquisitor Raalgar.
Text: I have learned much. High Inquisitor Raalgar has moved to a base near the Legion citadel across the mountains. This is where he keeps the Fel Heart of Argus, the source of his immortality, and it is powered by wells leading directly to the core of Argus. He is preparing to attack so you will strike first. Mark the location of the wells and I will rain holy fire upon them with the Vindicaar's guns. With that connection to the fel on Argus broken, Raalgar can be killed and the Fel Heart retrieved.

Title: The Aid of the Loa
Objective: Hold council with Talanji and Rokhan to decide your next steps.
Text: De blood trolls are stronger than ever, thanks to dis G'huun... and now dey are empowering a giant construct!We need a plan to destroy dat construct, G'huun, and de blood trolls. It is not going to be easy.But I have an idea.

Title: The Smoking Gun
Objective: Fire Flynn's Pistol at the Water Barrel in the Harbormaster's Office.
Text: The Ashvane Company doesn't know it yet, but throwing you into Tol Dagor was the biggest mistake they've ever made.That new powder we swiped could be the key to bringing them down.First, how about we give everyone a little demonstration of just how powerful this stuff is?Go ahead, take a shot at that barrel over there.

Title: The Pulsing Madness
Objective: Dispel 5 Void Manifestations.
Text: This broken still retains some of his sanity, though not all of it. I can sense some Void influence nearby, but it is isolated to small pockets. Dispelling these manifestations should help our friend here clear his mind. Perhaps we can use the prayer fragments you found, as they still contain some Light energy. I will try and make sense of his chattering in the meantime. Maybe we can learn something about what is happening here.

Title: Back to Westwind Rest
Objective: Return to Farmhand Bo at Westwind Rest in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: Well, far as I figure, we've got quite a lot of rebuildin' to do.I'm not one for joining any big causes, but my farmhands aren't gonna have much to do 'round here, to be honest. And, since you helped them out, they want to join your "Alliance." So, who am I to stop 'em?Bring 'em with you, back to Farmhand Bo. I'll miss 'em, but they're better off with you.

Title: Round 'Em Up
Objective: Round up 3 Wild Plains Yaks and return them to Eastwind Rest.
Text: Lok'tar.We've made progress, but we're going to need mobility if we want to maintain our foothold here in Kun-Lai.I don't see many worgs, kodo, or the like around here. What I do see are yaks. Our pandaren allies have said they make good mounts, so they'll have to do.Go round some up and return them here, so we can get our people riding them!

Title: Back to Eastwind Rest
Objective: Return to Farmhand Ko at Eastwind Rest in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: Well, far as I figure, we've got quite a lot of rebuildin' to do.I'm not one for joining any big causes, but my farmhands aren't gonna have much to do 'round here, to be honest. And, since you helped them out, they want to join your "Horde". So, who am I to stop 'em?Bring 'em with you, back to Farmhand Ko. I'll miss 'em, but they're better off with you.

Title: Best Meals Anywhere!
Objective: Collect 160 Kun-Lai Meaty Bits.
Text: Yeah, yeah.Everyone knows us goblins do tinkering. And explosives. And... well, ya' know, the less reputable stuff.But what nobody knows is that I'm really a great chef! It's a hobby of mine.Gather us up some meaty bits from the creatures around here, and I'll cook us up the best meals ANYWHERE!And I promise, I'll only use three or four percent rocket fuel.

Title: Sanctum of the Sages
Objective: Speak with a 7th Legion Mage in the Sanctum of the Sages.
Text: Sounds like you'll be working with us for awhile.Cyrus will charter a naval transport between here and Stormwind, but I expect you'll want something a bit faster for day to day use.Head back upstairs and take a left when you get outside. You'll find an old study where the Tidesages used to conduct their magic rituals.Surely your Alliance mages have already sensed its power.Inform them they may open their portals there. The harbor guards will keep the room secure.

Title: The Road to Kun-Lai
Objective: Travel through the Veiled Stair to Binan Village.
Text: Ah! Greetings friend of Lorewalker Cho. I have a message for you.  The Lorewalker waits for you in Kun-Lai. Very dangerous to travel there, yes, very dangerous. Look for guides along the road to help you find your way.

Title: Setting Sun Garrison
Objective: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison.
Text: We've taken losses from the mogu forces descending the Golden Stair and their flanking attackers at Whitepetal Lake. Our lines are thin. I'm dispatching Anji and Kun to the Setting Sun Garrison to double our efforts at training new recruits. I'd like you there with them. Show them what a true  is made of.

Title: The Road to Kun-Lai
Objective: Travel through the Veiled Stair to Binan Village.
Text: Ah! Greetings friend of Lorewalker Cho. I have a message for you.  The Lorewalker waits for you in Kun-Lai. Very dangerous to travel there, yes, very dangerous. Look for guides along the road to help you find your way.

Title: Mistfall Village
Objective: Speak to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village.
Text: Everything I've heard suggests the village has been unaffected by the Shao-Tien offensive at the lake, but I won't take any risks. I'm dispatching you and Che Wildwalker to keep watch at the village, and aid the townsfolk while you're there.

Title: Setting Sun Garrison
Objective: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison.
Text: Anji and Kun stopped by on the way to the garrison. Lovely pair, don't you think? So different, yet so devoted to each other... ah, it makes my heart swoon just thinking about it. They asked for you by name. Maybe they want to put you through some of the training paces? I certainly hope they don't have something more naughty in mind...

Title: Attack on Mistfall Village
Objective: Speak to Rook Stonetoe at Mistfall Village.
Text: I can see smoke from the village. And it's not my fault this time! Best go and help.

Title: The Ruins of Guo-Lai
Objective: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai.
Text: I've instructed Anji and Kun to resume investigation of the Ruins of Guo-Lai. We have no reports of any significant mogu presence there today, but it seems to be one of their central interests here in the Vale, and want it under thorough watch consider their attack on the lake. That's why I'm sending you as well. Head west, past the lake, to the ruins. Anji will instruct you further.

Title: Attack on Mistfall Village
Objective: Speak to Sun Tenderheart at Mistfall Village.
Text: Mogu have been sighted at Mistfall Village to the southwest. I dispatched Rook and Sun immediately, but I need another capable hand there as soon as possible. Don't delay. The villagers need you.

Title: Guo-Lai Encampment
Objective: Speak to Leven Dawnblade at the Ruins of Guo-Lai.
Text: Leven came by in quite a huff! Said something about mogu in the ruins. Best be off to find him I think. Angry Leven is not a fun Leven.

Title: Mistfall Village
Objective: Speak to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village.
Text: My scouts have spotted no mogu near Mistfall Village today, but I've been hearing of some troubles with local wildlife and spirits in the graveyard. I dispatched Che to assess the situation, but he'll most likely need your help. Find your way southwest to the village and meet Che there. Do what you can.

Title: Mistfall Village
Objective: Speak to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village.
Text: Che stopped by on the way to the village and ask if I'd seen you. I told him no. You can go see him if you want. But now you're not obligated to see him! I am so marvelously considerate, am I not?

Title: Guo-Lai Infestation
Objective: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai.
Text: Anji came by and asked for you. Said she was heading to the northeast ruins. Oh, Anji, such a fiery spirit, that girl! Probably better for your long-term health if you not keep her waiting.

Title: Wicked Wikkets
Objective: Collect 6 Alliance Service Medallions from Battleworn Paratroopers.
Text: good wikket, they say...  help hozen, they say... No more grookin' , they say. That ok. Look out there. Wicked wikkets fallin' like rain, ripe for the grookin'! Go, join the fun. But remember, Chief Kah Kah gets all the shinies! That's hozen rule number two.  Hmm, all hozen rules are number two...

Title: What's in a Name Name?
Objective: Kill 7 Riverstride Jinyu.
Text: So, you wanna be a hozen. Huh, wikket? Hozen defend their lands from enemies, like jinyu. Kah Kah fought many jinyu fights, and won them all. Hozen only give name name to good grookers. Go grook jinyu and maybe they call you  . Jinyu creepin' down by the river. Ook 'em in the dooker!

Title: Brain Food
Objective: Bring 4 Mushan Tongues to Kaz'tik the Manipulator at Klaxxi'vess.
Text: Kovok is growing at an accelerated rate, but his brain may not be able to keep up. He'll require a special diet to ensure that he does not outgrow the capacity to control his own body. Mushan tongue is rich in the nutrients that promote brain growth in kunchong, but they normally eat the beasts whole and fill up quickly. If we feed Kovok only mushan tongues every couple of days or so, it should balance out his growth. Greatback mushan graze the hills east of here, near the Gurthani Terrace.

Title: Debugging the Terrace
Objective: Stomp out 6 Eyes of the Empress around the Terrace of Gurthan. Killing anything will grant you Pheromone Tracking, helping you detect them.
Text: If this Empress is truly possessed by fear and paranoia, she will have sent scouts to every corner of the land in order to cement her control. These scout grubs are likely everywhere, but difficult to spot with the naked eye. Better to track them by the pheromone trails they leave behind. I've already... gifted you... a reactive toxin that will reveal these trails to you for a brief time after experiencing the thrill of victory. Go now to the Terrace of Gurthan and root out these spies.

Title: Nope Nope Nope
Objective: Use the Shado-Pan Dragon Gun to destroy 20 Dreadspinner Eggs in Gurthani Terrace.
Text: I recovered this weapon on a recent scouting run near the wall. It would seem ideal for helping your Shado-Pan with their infestation problem in Gurthani Terrace. The more they are focused on keeping spiders off the wall, the less time they are killing fear-gripped swarmborn.

Title: An Ancient Empire
Objective: Collect 8 Gurthani Tablets.
Text: My brothers speak of an ancient mogu empire that once dwelled in the ruins to the east. Once, this tribe knew untold secrets of sorcery and subjugation. I have a curious mind, Wakener, and I wish to learn of the empires that ruled after my time. Knowledge of the past will determine our future. Go search the ruins for their ancient tablets. I will study their secrets and make them our own.

Title: Sap Tapping
Objective: Collect 6 Amber Sap.
Text: I found a grove of young amber trees to the east, Wakener. I've placed tapping devices on these trees, but I have been too busy to retrieve the sap. I need someone to find the extractors. Activate them, then bring me samples of the amber.

Title: Welcome to Dawn's Blossom
Objective: Speak with Kai Wanderbrew, Master Windfur, and Peiji Goldendraft in Dawn's Blossom.
Text: Cho's off on another one of his adventures, and this one requires a big order of jade. I'm going to have to call in some favors. How 'bout in the meantime you introduce yourself to some of the locals. Kai Wanderbrew is a good guy to know, as is Master Windfur. Oh, and say hi to Peiji Goldendraft up at the inn. Between the three of them, you should get the feel for life in Dawn's Blossom.

Title: Dreadspinner Extermination
Objective: Slay 8 Dreadspinner Tenders in the Terrace of Gurthan. Speak with Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver for an air-drop.
Text: Back in Gurthani Terrace where you found me, dreadspinners continue to occupy the attention of Shado-Pan marksmen who could otherwise be thinning out this wretched swarm. Eradicate those spiders and offer some relief to the archers on that wall.

Title: The Challenger's Ring: Tenwu of the Red Smoke
Objective: Challenge Tenwu of the Red Smoke, and then defeat him in combat at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
Text: So... you've been challenged by the infamous Tenwu of the Red Smoke.That's what he calls himself, at least. He's a good fighter, and a good rogue, but it's a wonder he manages to sneak up on anyone with how loudly he brags about himself.Anyways, I think you should answer the challenge. Maybe it'll give him a touch of humility. Maybe not. Either way, if you win, he'll probably be willing to go with you on your missions.And I get some entertainment.

Title: The Challenger's Ring: Hawkmaster Nurong
Objective: Challenge Hawkmaster Nurong, and then defeat him in combat at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
Text: You've really been building up respect with the Shado-Pan.Nurong's interested in trying out his skills against you.The good news is, if you win, I'll allow him to go with you on your missions.The bad news is, I really don't think you'll win.

Title: Prophet Khar'zul
Objective: Defeat Prophet Kharzul.
Text: Prophet Khar'zul is a powerful caster, but he is also underestimating your abilities. Khar'zul and his forces must be destroyed to protect this village. His death will send a strong message to the Thunder King that we will not be defeated! You'll find him on the Isle of Reckoning.

Title: Putting An Eye Out
Objective: Collect 1 Pristine Mire Beast Eye.
Text: Ah! Wakener! You must help me! (You will help me, or else I will help myself to you!) I need more materials for my experiments, yes yes! (Blood and guts, hearts and brains, tongues and eyes, eyes, eyes!) To the west, I have seen creatures of mist and fog. They possess such big, round, wonderful globes! Big for seeing, round and unblinking! Go now, little Wakener. Bring me back a single pristine eye!

Title: Something Different
Objective: Win a PvP Brawl.
Text: Even the most bloodthirsty combatants eventually grow weary and turn their backs to the unending struggle of war. They seek a new way to test their mettle and destroy their enemies.Join the Brawl in progress and fight your opponents in a limited time event that tosses traditional rules aside.

Title: Foiling the Legion's Jailbreak
Objective: Find High Inquisitor Raalgar before the Legion frees him.
Text: High Inquisitor Raalgar has some connection to the fel here on Argus that makes him unkillable. Long ago, the naaru imprisoned him on the Arcatraz. When the forces of Kael'thas Sunstrider attacked the citadel, we were forced to flee on the Exodar. Some Legion prisoners escaped the Arcatraz when last the Legion invaded Azeroth, but Raalgar did not. Stop them from freeing him and I will study the source of his immortality so it can be broken. I can get you close. The rest is up to you.

Title: Mark of the Sentinax
Objective: Collect 50 Marks of the Sentinax.
Text: The Sentinax rains down terror upon the Broken Shore, unleashing hordes of demons that menace our forces. The fiends seek to stop us from taking the Tomb.They will fail.Lure out the strongest among their vile ranks. Slay them and seize the marks they bear. Make the Legion fear our strength!

Title: Champions of Legionfall
Objective: Return to your class order hall and recruit a new champion.
Text: The battle to reclaim the Broken Shore is straining our resources. We cannot afford to relent, lest the Legion undo all that we have accomplished.The members of your order have given much, but more is needed.Rally your champions and do what you must to bolster their ranks. There may be untapped power in this land that will turn the tide of war in our favor.

Title: Improper Burial
Objective: Use the Ceremonial Torch on Zandalari corpses.
Text: De blood trolls are gathering de corpses of my people for their blood magic. Dis ends today.I will take care of de corpses here. Take dis torch. Its fires are blessed by priests of Bwonsamdi, de loa of death.Burn any corpses of my people dat you see. Each corpse burned means less power for dese monsters' blood magic.

Title: Tomb of Sargeras: The Deceiver
Objective: Defeat Kil'jaeden in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: Carried by only the most powerful of his servants, the Seal indicates the presence of the Deceiver, Kil'Jaeden. He must be defeated.

Title: Dark Skies
Objective: Kill 200 Mantid and 3 Kunchong or Dread Behemoths while flying with Xaril the Poisoned Mind.
Text: The swarm begins, Wakener! The mantid amass at the Heart of Fear. Already they fill the skies with their wings and rend the earth with their claws. They shall not stop the dark march until their bodies are laid open and bleeding upon the ground. This we shall gladly do. We will attack them from above. While I fly, use my poisons to destroy their advance. Do not mix the two serums until you are ready to attack. The reaction can be quite... violent. Speak to me when you are ready to go.

Title: Tomb of Sargeras: The Deceiver
Objective: Defeat Kil'jaeden in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: Carried by only the most powerful of his servants, the Seal indicates the presence of the Deceiver, Kil'Jaeden. He must be defeated.

Title: Tomb of Sargeras: The Deceiver
Objective: Defeat Kil'jaeden in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: Carried by only the most powerful of his servants, the Seal indicates the presence of the Deceiver, Kil'Jaeden. He must be defeated.

Title: Dark Wings, Dark Things
Objective: Collect 150 Scarab Wings.
Text: I require another ingredient to create my first poison, Wakener. This ingredient you can easily find on the scarabs nearby. Kill them and bring me their wings.

Title: The Poisoned Mind
Objective: Speak to Xaril the Poisoned Mind. Kill 200 mantid and 3 kunchong while flying with him.
Text: Before we return to Klaxxi'vess, I wish to look upon the empire. The Klaxxi Council told me that the enemy gathers outside the Empress's palace. My poisons are ready. What better way to announce my return than with death and destruction? Just be careful not to mix the two serums... at least not while you're holding the vessels. Speak to me when you are ready to fly.

Title: Venomous Intent
Objective: Collect 8 Venomous Stingers.
Text: If we are to strike against the Empress, we must arm ourselves with weapons. My own choice of weapon is of a particularly toxic design. The scorpions wandering the ledge produce a deadly venom that they store in their tails. Bring me their stingers, and I will show you how I earned the title of paragon.

Title: A Shade of Dread
Objective: Collect 8 Dreadshade.
Text: The last ingredient is perhaps the deadliest. The dreadshade flower grows all along these hills. It is by eating these poisonous plants that the local wildlife has become so venomous. A single drop of dreadshade nectar can stop a kunchong's heart. Go and bring me some of these flowers. Do not be tempted to taste them.

Title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Bloodeye Bruiser!
Objective: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Hurp'derp!
Text: I'll tell you what, buddy, this place is a far cry from the rolling plains of Nagrand or the bloodbowl in Zul'Drak, but hey, I go where the gold's at! So welcome to Twi-Hi, pal. You're new to this pit, so let me set you straight. I'm the fight promoter and this feisty troll next to me is Wodin, my bodyguard. You're the entertainment. When you wanna fight, let me know and I'll set up the match. If you're ready and got a group of friends with you, we can start! What do you say?

Title: Tomb of Sargeras: The Deceiver
Objective: Defeat Kil'jaeden in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: Carried by only the most powerful of his servants, the Seal indicates the presence of the Deceiver, Kil'Jaeden. He must be defeated.

Title: Target of Opportunity: Sra'thik Hivelord
Objective: Defeat the Sra'thik Hivelord.
Text: Near the ocean, on the eastern side of Sra'vess, there is a cavern that leads to a network of caves.From there, the Sra'thik Hivelord maintains Sra'vess and plots against us. If we manage to take him out, we'll disrupt their operations for days.Let's go to it.

Title: The Arena of Annihilation
Objective: Enter and complete the Arena of Annihilation scenario. Afterwards, collect your reward from Wodin the Troll-Servant.
Text: Ah, I can still remember running fights out of a muddy hole in the ground back in Nagrand. We've come a long way, eh, Wodin? I tell you, there's nothing more these Tiger monks like than a good scrap. So much so that they've paid good coin for me to set up shop here and help draw the strongest fighters from all around! So how about it? You and a couple friends up for a few rounds in the Arena of Annihilation...? Big money, big prizes!

Title: Friends, Not Food!
Objective: Rescue a Shado-Pan Trainee in each of the north, central and south Kunchong feeding pits.
Text: Our scouts have sent a very troubling report.Three of our trainees have gone missing, and our scouts found them...They've been captured by the mantid and sent to their Kunchong pits.Their Kunchong FEEDING pits. We're lucky that the Kunchong don't eat that often.I need you to get in there, give them these escape kites, and get them out!

Title: Fumigation
Objective: Plant Shado-Pan Gas Bombs within the 5 targeted structures on Sra'vess.
Text: Our alchemists have cooked up a set of gas bombs that will discourage mantid from staying anywhere that we set them off.If we plant these in the critical structures of Sra'vess, they'll need to evacuate. That should sow some chaos and delay any action from the mantid there for days.Get to it.

Title: Target of Opportunity: Sra'thik Swarmlord
Objective: Kill the Sra'thik Swarmlord at Sra'vess in Townlong Steppes.
Text: While we're here, we should do one more thing.The Sra'thik Swarmlord is responsible for directing the mantid forces from the air. If we leave it alive, it's going to cause trouble for the garrison.So we're not going to leave it alive. Let's take it out.

Title: A Morale Victory
Objective: Destroy the Southern, Central, Eastern and Western Idols at Sra'vess.
Text: The mantid have statues built on Sra'vess. We don't know exactly what they use them for. They may have some sort of religious significance, or maybe they assist with their sonic communication.When you fight your opponent, you don't just engage them physically, you also engage them mentally. Whatever they use them for, the fact is that those statues are important to them.Which is why I want you to blow them up. Losing something important will be a substantial hit to morale.

Title: Sra'vess Wetwork
Objective: Kill any 15 non-elite mantid near Sra'vess.
Text: The mantid outnumber us quite badly. Hundreds of them for each of us.And, they surround us on two sides - at Gao-Ran in the south we're holding them off, but to the west, on the island they call Sra'vess, they continue to mass unabated.We're not stupid. We're not going to launch a full scale attack on them. We can't sustain an intense battle on multiple fronts.Instead, we're going to send you, and one of our Wu Kao, to do some dirty work. Sounds fun, doesn't it?

Title: The Mariner's Revenge
Objective: Launch the Mist-Hopper Jr. from the dock in Soggy's Gamble and use it to bring down Jiao.
Text: I'm not gonna sit in a damn rocking chair while my crew gets devoured by a leviathan! Come on, let's get to the dock and launch a dinghy. I got a special one set up just for this kind of situation. My own little Mist-Hopper Jr. We'll give that thing a case of harpoon fever.

Title: Slitherscale Suppression
Objective: Kill the Slitherscale Lizard-Lord.
Text: The Slitherscale take orders from their leader, the Slitherscale Lizard-Lord. He can be found celebrating his victories on the southeastern corner of Windward Isle. If we can destroy this leader, we can deal their tribe a great blow. Without their lord, the Slitherscale will think twice before attacking the gentle cloud serpents of the east.

Title: The Bigger They Come...
Objective: Kill any 4 elite mantid at Sra'vess.
Text: Killing the smaller mantid works mostly as a distraction. It forces them to replenish their numbers before they consider any serious offensive.The big ones, though - we kill a few of those, and we really disrupt operations on the island. That buys ourselves a substantial amount of time. With mantid, it's like their size is directly proportional to their importance in the empire.So kill some of the big ones for me, while you're out there.

Title: Reeltime Strategy
Objective: Assist Master Angler Ju Lien in Soggy's Gamble.
Text: I never thought I'd see the day, but for the first time since... well, EVER, Master Angler Ju Lien asked for some help with his lines. Apparently the sea is going crazy today and he can't keep up. See if you can give him a hand. He's fishing just south of here.

Title: Dog Food
Objective: Help Dog to eat the remains of 10 Rockshell Snapclaws.

Title: Destroy the Siege Weapons!
Objective: Destroy the four mantid siege weapons at Sra'vess in Townlong Steppes.
Text: The mantid don't just attack in swarms.They're smart. They use alchemy, bombs... and what's worst, they've got siege weapons. Those have the potential to be incredibly destructive if they attack with them.We've got reports that they're building up a force of siege weapons to the west at Sra'vess. Go and destroy them.

Title: On the Crab
Objective: Attach a Mist-Hopper Buoy to 8 Full Crab Pots on the Shelf of Mazu.
Text: I just got word that a string of pots we dropped this morning hit it BIG. We're on the crab! Problem is, the rips are getting stronger and we lost track of some of the pots. They're just sitting out there, filled with spiky blue GOLD! I need you back out there. Hook one of these buoys up to any of the full traps you find and send it to the surface for us.

Title: Shark Week
Objective: Collect 200 Thresher Teeth by pulling them from the jaws of Longfin Threshers on the Shelf of Mazu.
Text: Crabbing is our big money-maker, but we send all kinds of goods back around the wall. Oils, plants, even rare minerals - the sea's bounty is rich out here! Right now the big craze in the markets back home is thresher teeth. Apparently they make great necklaces? Threshers are all over the Shelf of Mazu to the west. Bring me lots of teeth!

Title: Tomb of Sargeras: The Fallen Avatar
Objective: Defeat the Fallen Avatar in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: Only the Fallen Avatar stands in our way to the final battle. Slay him, and be done with it.

Title: Old Age and Treachery
Objective: Recover the charter from the Wreck of the Mist-Hopper.
Text: Look, I ain't got reason to trust you, but there's a task I can't give to my crew. I need you to search the wreck of our old ship, the Mist-Hopper, and bring back the charter. It'd be sealed up in a silver tube, in a footlocker. It's sort of, uh... incriminating. I can't risk any of the crew finding it if they decide to visit the ol' girl. She's resting on the Shelf of Mazu, to the west. I'd suggest riding a rip current out there, if you got the stomach. They're all over the shelf.

Title: Meet the Cap'n
Objective: Speak with "Soggy" Su-Dao in Soggy's Gamble.
Text: Alright, I got another job for ya. You see that lion seal in the pen over there? Name's Dog. He's been Soggy's pet for years. Dog's acting up lately - I think he's getting restless in that pen. Why don't you go talk to Soggy and let him know. I'd say it's about time you meet the cap'n anyway.

Title: You Otter Know
Objective: Use the Bag of Clams to feed 8 Coldwhisker Otters in Lonesome Cove.
Text: You know what happened to the bait in those pots? Otters. That's what happened. They prefer fresh clams, but they'll pick our crab traps clean if they're hungry enough. The otters in Lonesome Cove are protected by law and we run a legitimate operation here. As much as I'd love to chum those little rats and call it a day, we just make sure they aren't hungry enough to raid the crab pots. Toss 'em a few clams to keep them busy while you're out there.

Title: Tomb of Sargeras: The Fallen Avatar
Objective: Defeat the Fallen Avatar in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: Only the Fallen Avatar stands in our way to the final battle. Slay him, and be done with it.

Title: Tomb of Sargeras: The Fallen Avatar
Objective: Defeat the Fallen Avatar in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: Only the Fallen Avatar stands in our way to the final battle. Slay him, and be done with it.

Title: Walking Dog
Objective: Take Dog to visit the hot geysers, the whale corpse, and the wreck of the Mist-Hopper on the Shelf of Mazu.
Text: Dog ain't my "pet." He's a member of this crew, and my best friend. Saved my life more than once, you know. But I'm gettin' too old to walk him anymore, and he still needs his exercise. Take Dog for a trip around the shelf for me, would ya? He loves to swim through the hot geysers just southeast of the shallows. He absolutely has to... er... "leave his mark" on the dead whale at the far western edge of the shelf. Oh, and he'll want to visit our old shipwreck, too. He likes to reminisce.

Title: Tomb of Sargeras: Free The Tormented
Objective: Defeat the Desolate Host in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: The souls inside the Tomb are being twisted by an Engine of Horror. Destroy it, and free them from this torment.

Title: Tomb of Sargeras: Free The Tormented
Objective: Defeat the Desolate Host in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: The souls inside the Tomb are being twisted by an Engine of Horror. Destroy it, and free them from this torment.

Title: Tomb of Sargeras: Free The Tormented
Objective: Defeat the Desolate Host in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: The souls inside the Tomb are being twisted by an Engine of Horror. Destroy it, and free them from this torment.

Title: Tomb of Sargeras: The Fallen Avatar
Objective: Defeat the Fallen Avatar in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: Only the Fallen Avatar stands in our way to the final battle. Slay him, and be done with it.

Title: Tomb of Sargeras: Free The Tormented
Objective: Defeat the Desolate Host in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: The souls inside the Tomb are being twisted by an Engine of Horror. Destroy it, and free them from this torment.

Title: Tomb of Sargeras: The Tomb's Mistress
Objective: Defeat Mistress Sassz'ine in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: Slay the Naga Mistress who is tainting the denizens of the ocean beneath the Tomb.

Title: Tomb of Sargeras: The Tomb's Mistress
Objective: Defeat Mistress Sassz'ine in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: Slay the Naga Mistress who is tainting the denizens of the ocean beneath the Tomb.

Title: Tomb of Sargeras: The Tomb's Mistress
Objective: Defeat Mistress Sassz'ine in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: Slay the Naga Mistress who is tainting the denizens of the ocean beneath the Tomb.

Title: Tomb of Sargeras: The Tomb's Mistress
Objective: Defeat Mistress Sassz'ine in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: Slay the Naga Mistress who is tainting the denizens of the ocean beneath the Tomb.

Title: Lost Souls
Objective: Release 10 Lost Souls.
Text: Never in my life have I beheld such destruction... such misery. The very ground we walk on us paved with the bones of our allies.Even now I can see the lost spirits of Alliance soldiers wandering the ruins.I cannot leave this place without putting the souls of our brave soldiers to rest. We owe them... I owe them that much.

Title: Imprisoned Inquisitor
Objective: Travel to the Vindicaar and ask Grand Artificer Romuul about High Inquisitor Raalgar.
Text: This report states that the Legion seeks to free an imprisoned Legion inquisitor called Raalgar, a demon from here on Argus who cannot be killed because of a secret magic he alone possesses. Because of his immortality, he is held in the Arcatraz in Tempest Keep. The Light Mother told us of that naaru stronghold, but I've never set eyes upon it myself. Turalyon mentioned the Vindicaar has some connection to Tempest Keep. Perhaps your ship's engineer knows more.

Title: Journey to Nazmir
Objective: Meet with Rokhan near flight master Rokota in Dazar'alor.
Text: It is time to put an end to de blood trolls in Nazmir before their monstrous horde descends upon Zuldazar.My most loyal followers are willing to come with me to dat cursed place. But it will not be enough.I am relieved dat you and de Horde are willing to help. Rokhan and his darkspears are getting ready to leave.I will finish my preparations here. Meet with Rokhan and make your way to Nazmir, I will see you there.

Title: The Mysterious Missive
Objective: Search near the Xenedar for someone with knowledge of the Sealed Missive.

Title: Arkhaan's Prayers
Objective: Collect 5 Fragmented Prayers.
Text: "You must resist the shadow's pull. Come to me, brothers and sisters. Be whole within the Light. Let Arkhaan show you the way home."

Title: Into The Darkness
Objective: Look for signs of blood trolls ahead with Princess Talanji.
Text: We are in Nazmir to stop de blood trolls from destroying Zuldazar. Dis is de start of our campaign to end dem.Dese monsters want my kingdom and its people destroyed. We are going destroy dem first.My father thinks de blood troll threat will go away on its own, like it did in de past. But things are different now.Rokhan and de others are moving north of here to establish a camp for us to stay in, den dey will join us in de fight.Are you ready?

Title: Get Your Bearings
Objective: Visit the Ferry Dock, the Snug Harbor Inn, the Tradewinds Counting House, and the Flight Master in Tradewinds Market.
Text: I think a proper introduction is in order!My name is Taelia, member of the Proudmoore Guard and squire of Sir Cyrus Crestfall.Cyrus asked me and Flynn to break you out of that Ashvane prison and get you settled in here at the market, but he neglected to mention that you're with the Alliance.I must say, it's an honor.Let's get you up to speed.

Title: A Walk to Remember
Objective: Escort King Anduin to Soul Ruin at the Broken Shore.
Text: It's good to have you at my side.I've come to the Broken Shore to see, for myself, the price that my father... that the Alliance has paid to protect our world.As long as I am blind to the suffering and sacrifices of my people, I will never be able to lead them to peace.Time is short, we should move onward.

Title: Arkhaan's Pain
Objective: Slay 12 Broken in Oronaar Collapse.
Text: Darkness envelops us... the Light has gone from this place...  Arkhaan could not save them. Brothers. Sisters. Whispers twisted them. The Light cannot see them. It turns away from us. Arkhaan failed.

Title: Out Like Flynn
Objective: Escape Tol Dagor with Flynn.
Text: I'm relieved you woke up! Having to carry you would have made this job far less appealing.The name's Flynn, and my client in Boralus is paying me a king's bounty to break you out of here.You, my friend, are incarcerated in Tol Dagor. Used to be a legit prison... 'til the Ashvane Trading Company bought it. Now it's Priscilla's own personal fortress, riddled with scum on both sides of the bars.Wasn't hard to bribe my way into this cell. Now we just have to get out.Not to worry. I have a plan!

Title: Fresh Pots
Objective: Bait 10 Empty Crab Pots in Lonesome Cove. Each pot requires 2 Sea Monarch Chunks.
Text: We got a load of empty crab pots out there that need fresh bait. Now, we COULD pull them one at a time and bait them up here in comfort. A nice chair to sit on, maybe a hot cup of tea to keep you warm. Sounds nice, doesn't it? Never gonna happen. Head to Lonesome Cove, immediately southwest, and bait those pots with two chunks of fresh sea monarch. By "fresh" I mean killed right there in the water. Oh, and by "pots" I mean traps. If you wanna be part of the crew, you'd better learn the lingo.

Title: A Bloody Delight
Objective: Collect 100 Volatile Blood from Dread Remoras.
Text: A warrior is not ready for battle until he tastes the blood of his enemies. I am still too weak to hunt, so you must go in my stead. Only the blood from the fiercest predators will do. I can smell their presence in the waters outside this cave! Bring this to me, and then perhaps you shall see why they call me the Bloodseeker.

Title: The Scent of Blood
Objective: Kill 12 Muckscale Flesheaters and the Muckscale Serpentus.
Text: I'm afraid that I wet my hands with saurok blood while you were away. I'm sorry, but I could not help myself. Now, watch them attack me. Pitiful! Do they think to take vengeance for their fallen? Do they come challenge ME? I, who have won a hundred wars? I, who stood alone against thousands and still shouted for my enemies to come? No, these... saurok... will crumple before me like paper before the flame! I shall show you my might, Wakener. Fight alongside me and see. Here they come!

Title: Fine Dining
Objective: Collect 8 Clacker Tails.
Text: In my living years, I was the greatest warrior of the swarm. Help me regain my strength, and I shall show you. I smell the salt sea nearby, and where you can find the sea, you will find briny clackers. Bring me their tails. I must feast upon their flesh.

Title: A Strange Appetite
Objective: Collect 12 Starfish Meat.
Text: Food. I must have food. In my time, the meat of the starfish brought not only strength, but also clarity of mind. This is what I must eat. Bring this to me from the nearby shallows. Wait much longer, and I will devour you instead.

Title: The Tiger Palm
Objective: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and practice using it.
Text: I hope your people are all alright... the crash was unbelievably loud and destructive!Yes, you'll do fine. They've said that they need more people to fight, and they don't want me to hurt myself. I'm not afraid, but I don't want to intrude. So, I'll teach you.As you may have discovered, your experiences in combat will unlock new potential within you. Go, see if you can master a new ability. Show it to me. You'll get the hang of things.

Title: Skeer the Bloodseeker
Objective: Awaken Skeer the Bloodseeker in the underwater cave.
Text: Our efforts to secure the shallows before Zan'vess have paid off. We have spotted another paragon buried in amber, hidden in the waters to the southwest. Adding another paragon to our numbers is vital. Another champion from ages past could turn the tide in our favor. I would go immediately, but unfortunately, I am needed here. Since you are already a Wakener, you can carry out this task in my stead.

Title: The Dread Vos
Objective: Kill 12 Enslaved Amberdiggers or Vos'thik Slavelashers, and release the paragon, Korven the Prime.
Text: Another paragon calls to us.. This time, the emanations grow from The Dread Vos, an ancient lake to the south. Finding him will not be easy, for the way is guarded by our enemies. I give you this task. If you succeed, you will live. If you fail, I will send another.

Title: Calligraphed Sigil
Objective: Speak to Laoxi inside Aldrassil in Shadowglen.
Text: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our Pandaren visitor, Laoxi. It seems he would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to him afterwards.

Title: Monk Training
Objective: Speak with Pao, the Monk class trainer, inside the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.
Text: As you advance within your class, you will want to take advantage of the training that your class trainer can provide you. For young monks here on Sunstrider Isle, your trainer is Pao, our Pandaren visitor. Speak with her and see what training she has available for you. Pao - as with all the trainers on Sunstrider Isle - is inside the Sunspire on the lower level.

Title: The Art of the Monk
Objective: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger's Palm. Look for a Training Dummy and practice using Tiger's Palm.
Text: The true secret to the art of the monk is unlocking the knowledge and power hidden inside yourself. Go, get more experience, and learn a new skill. Then demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.

Title: The Arts of a Monk
Objective: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Practice using Tiger Palm against a Tiki Target.
Text: As ya get bettah' at fightin', you'll start to find new tings that ya nevah knew you could do. Wanna see? Go, train up some, and learn someting new. 'Den come back and ya can show me.

Title: Family Tree
Objective: Light the Incense Bundle at the Circle of Stone.
Text: So there you have it, traveler, or as much of it as would make for a proper introduction, hmm? What of you, then? Are your people so much different than mine? Surely, there must be things we share in common. Let us see...

Title: Tiger Palm
Objective: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache and practice using it.
Text: You have done well. As you continue along your path, you will grow, learning new techniques that you couldn't have imagined before.Your first lesson is the power of experience. Go, learn a new ability, and demonstrate it for me.

Title: Calligraphed Note
Objective: Read the Calligraphed Note and speak to Shoyu in Camp Narache.
Text: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you. I believe she was sent by our Pandaren visitor, Shoyu. You should read it.

Title: More Than Expected
Objective: Report to Vol'jin at Darkspear Hold.
Text: Ya definitely more den expected, mon. I'm sure dere's more important stuff we can be usin' ya talents on now. Ya don't need ta hang out with da newbloods no more. Head down to da village to da southeast and make yaself known. Lend a hand here and there and I'm sure ya make yer way up to sometin' more prestigious quick enough.

Title: A Rough Start
Objective: Retrieve 6 Wildmane Cat Pelts.
Text: Lets put dose skills ta use. I'll start ya off easy, mon. There be cats killing our boars. Dat food ain't for sharin'. Dose boars are gonna need ta be alive if ya be wanting food tonight. Dey're all over the island. Bring me some cat pelts.

Title: Proving Pit
Objective: Speak to a Darkspear Jailor, then enter the proving pit and kill a Captive Spitescale Scout.
Text: Ya done quite well for ya'self. I'm sure I could teach ya a trick or two here and dere, but I not be wastin' ya time on tiki targets no longer. l put one last trial before ya den, mon. Head over to da provin' pit in the middle of dis area and fight a real baddy - one dat wants ta kill ya back. Just let the jailor by the pit know when ya ready.

Title: Tiger Palm
Objective: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Locate a Training Dummy outside the Sunspire and practice using it.
Text: Good. You are off to a bright start. This road will be long, and as you become more accomplished, you will begin to discover that you can do things you could never have imagined before. Go, get more experience, and learn a new technique. Once you have, demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.

Title: The Basics: Hitting Things
Objective: Destroy 6 Tiki Targets.
Text: Alright, mon. We start with da basics. I need ta know dat you know how ta swing dat weapon you're totin' around. Go thrash dose tiki targets. Take it slowly. Natural-like. I'll watch ya fighting form and we'll go from dere.

Title: Calligraphed Parchment
Objective: Read the Calligraphed Parchment and speak with Gato in the Valley of Trials.
Text: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you. Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from our Pandaren friend, Gato. He visits from afar to grant us the honor of his wisdom, and to teach the ways of the monk. Do not shame your people by failing at his lessons!

Title: Tiger Palm
Objective: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Tiger Palm 2 times.
Text: As you walk the road of your training, you will begin to discover within yourself the power to unlock new techniques. You need not even learn them from me, or another more experienced monk - you will find that they come to you on their own.For now, you should go and practice the basics. Gather more experience, and develop a new technique - once you have, you can practice it on the dummies nearby to master it.

Title: The Rise of the Darkspear
Objective: Meet with Zabrax in the Darkspear Training Grounds.
Text: Tha Darkspear tribe have long been victims. Outcasts. We found ourselves fleein' our homes time 'n time again... but dis time, it's not fleein' dat drives us here. Vol'jin has offered us leadership through wisdom, and it has kept us alive dis long. Now dat same wisdom offers portents of a chaotic future for tha Horde unda Garrosh Hellscream. No, dis time we not fleein'. Dis time, we are fightin' for a home dat will last. It's time to begin ya trainin'. Speak with Zabrax to the east.

Title: Kick, Punch, It's All in the Mind
Objective: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm, then use it on one of the Training Dummies outside the entrance to Anvilmar.
Text: The truth is, you already have the talent and ability to learn what you need to. What I can help you do is show you where to unlock it.First, you must practice until you begin to understand a new technique. The first technique you learn will be the Tiger Palm. Go, learn more until you have unlocked the potential within yourself, and then practice your new move!Remember - it's all in the mind!

Title: Peering Into the Past
Objective: Speak to Lorewalker Cho at the Circle of Stone.
Text: Just a moment, now. Allow me to gather my things. Wouldn't want me to lose these notes now, would we? Especially after you risked life and limb for them! There, all set. Let us be off, shall we? I must say, I feel much safer traveling with you after seeing how you handled that saurok!

Title: Novice Elreth
Objective: Speak to Novice Elreth at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: Actually, before I go - you should speak with Novice Elreth. She had some work for you, and you would do well to help others and improve your skills.The next time you see me, I will be in Undercity.

Title: Scribbled Scroll
Objective: Read the Elegant Scroll and speak to Ting, Strong of Stomach in Deathknell.
Text: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. The pandaren visitor, Ting, sent it for you. Maybe you monks can read this garbage, but I can't. You should go talk to her. She's in the Inn across the way.

Title: Elegant Rune
Objective: Read the Elegant Rune and speak to Lo in Coldridge Valley.
Text: , this rune was given to me to pass on to ye. Take some time to read it when ye have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from our visitor from afar, Lo. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar.

Title: Tiger Palm
Objective: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm, then practice using it on a Training Dummy.
Text: As you overcome great challenges in your journey to master struggles both internal and external, you will begin to uncover new abilities hidden inside yourself. Go, now, and develop a mastery of yourself, such that you uncover the Tiger Palm technique. Then, go practice it on a training dummy.

Title: Delivering Lost Knowledge
Objective: Speak with the artifact researcher in your class order hall.
Text: The very nature of this ancient night elf tome causes the book to seek out knowledge. This could prove to be a serious boon to your efforts to research your artifact weapon.I'd wager the scholars in your order hall would find it of great use, possibly unlocking new avenues of empowerment.I suggest you take it to them immediately. We need every advantage possible against the Legion!
