Title: Seeking Lost Knowledge
Objective: Use the tome at several night elf ruins on the Broken Shore.
Text: During the assault, our forces uncovered an ancient night elf tome. The fact that it survived so long in these harsh lands is quite remarkable.Its enchantments have faded over the ages, but I sense the book is almost... hungry, as if reaching out to places where the night elves practiced magic long ago.Bringing the tome to nearby ruins may reveal secrets that could give us an edge against the Legion.

Title: Consecrating Ground
Objective: Repair the Argunite Matrix beneath Triumvirate's End.
Text: We have everything we need. In the alcove below you will find the shattered remains of the Argunite Matrix. Replacing the Keystone will restore it to full capacity. The pylons you activated will then be able to repel those who still hunt my people. At long last this battle will be over. I hope it brings them peace.

Title: They Sent Assassins
Objective: Kill 8 Goblin Assassins.
Text: Have you ever seen a goblin? They're wretched little green-skinned monsters that love only two things: gold and themselves. The Blackrock orcs have enlisted the aid of goblin assassins to kill our soldiers. If you look to the field in the north you can barely make out their silhouettes, sneaking about in the grass. I need you to head out there and kill every goblin that you see. They need to learn that nobody messes with the Alliance!

Title: The Rear is Clear
Objective: Report to Marshal McBride in front of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
Text: Excellent work! The rear is now officially clear. We'll take care of the stragglers. I want you to go back to Marshal McBride, standing in front of Northshire Abbey, south of here, and let him know that the goblin situation is under control. Farewell.

Title: Join the Battle!
Objective: Report to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
Text: I received an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them! Find Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!

Title: Palm of the Tiger
Objective: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm, then practice using it on a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey.
Text: Now that you've had the chance to test your abilities in battle, it's time to explain one more reason why training is so important. As you get more experience, you'll be able to do new techniques you never thought of.Go, get some experience, learn a new skill, and demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.

Title: The Arts of a Monk
Objective: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Once you've learned it, use it twice at a Training Dummy in New Tinkertown.
Text: When you fight, you grow in skill. As you grow in skill, you will begin to figure out new moves. Go, explore, learn, and show me what you figure out.

Title: Behind Our Lines
Objective: Kill General Temuja.
Text: Scouts bring me reports of a powerful Imperion that slipped through our lines in the south and is now heading for the road in the eastern vale. I need someone I can trust to stop it. Find it and kill it quickly.

Title: Meet the High Tinker
Objective: Introduce yourself to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.
Text: I don't know if you'll remember Mekkatorque or not. Nevin and the other gnomes have mentioned that memory loss is pretty common for you survivors. Anyways, High Tinker Mekkatorque is the leader of all the gnomes. He has made a habit of meeting with every rescued survivor personally. You should introduce yourself to him. He'll be with his war council beneath the tent in the center of town.

Title: Beating Them Back!
Objective: Kill 6 Blackrock Worgs.
Text: So you're the new recruit from Stormwind, eh? I'm Marshal McBride, commander of this garrison. Glad to have you on board...  . It is , right? You've arrived just in time. The Blackrock orcs have managed to sneak into Northshire through a break in the mountain. My soldiers are doing the best that they can to push them back, but I fear they will be overwhelmed soon. Head northwest into the forest and kill the attacking Blackrock worgs! Help my soldiers!

Title: The Future of Gnomeregan
Objective: Meet with Xi, Friend of the Small in New Tinkertown.
Text: It's a victory for us every time we're able to help another survivor escape from the contaminated halls of Gnomeregan. s like you will play an important part in the future of Gnomeregan. To that end, our leader, High Tinker Mekkatorque, has assembled a team of trainers to help you learn your arts. Xi, Friend of the Small has visited us from a faraway land and will help oversee your training and adjustment to life on the surface. She's waiting for you on the small practice field across the road.

Title: Calligraphed Letter
Objective: Read the Calligraphed Letter and speak to Bao in Northshire Abbey.
Text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from dealing with the Blackrock spies. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Bao, a pandaren who is visiting us from a faraway land. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

Title: Kor'thik Aggression
Objective: Slay 17 Kor'thik Mantid at Kor'vess.
Text: I'm no brewer - just looking at all those heaps of ingredients makes my head spin. Just put the brew in front of me when it's finished, thank you. No, I'm here to make sure that the brewers don't get cut in half while they're trying to make that perfect brew. It's not an easy job. The Kor'thik mantid across this basin have been attacking us nightly. If you're already heading over there, why don't you return the favor and attack a few of them?

Title: If These Stones Could Speak
Objective: Use the Stone Monoliths at the Circle of Bone.
Text: This is a very ancient place, traveler. Only recently have I pieced together a method of translating the forgotten language carved into these stones. Oh, the thrill of discovery! This never gets old, I assure you. Here, you are the guest. You do the honors. I insist. Use this key to unlock the secrets the stones contain.

Title: Fate of the Stormstouts
Objective: Ask the inhabitants of The Sunset Brewgarden if they've seen any Stormstouts.
Text: $p! It is so great to see you healthy, and traveling so far. It would seem that our paths are quite tightly intertwined. I'm here looking for my family. I am told that several Stormstouts came across the wall to help face the mantid threat. I mean to find them, and join them. Have you seen anyone named Stormstout come through here? Would you mind helping me ask around?

Title: Lions for Lambs
Objective: Kill 8 Blackrock Spies.
Text: The invading orcs aren't fools. They are sizing us up, making sure that when they attack it will be to their advantage. In the forest, to the northwest, are Blackrock spies. They peer at us through spyglasses, watching our every move - waiting. I want you take the fight to them! Kill the Blackrock spies! We must show them that we know they are watching us and that we are prepared!

Title: A Mile in My Shoes
Objective: Speak to Lorewalker Cho at the Circle of Bone.
Text: Oh, where have my manners gone? Technically, I suppose I am the host here. Allow me to tell you a little bit about myself and my people before asking questions of you.

Title: The Challenger's Ring: Chao the Voice
Objective: Challenge Chao the Voice, and then defeat her in combat at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
Text: It looks like you're quite the fighter.Chao heard about it, and she's been talking about how she'd kick your...Well, let's just say I think you should challenge her and try to get her respect.

Title: Whitepetal Lake
Objective: Speak to He Softfoot at Whitepetal Lake.
Text: Reports suggest that things are quiet at Whitepetal Lake today, but I've dispatched Ren Firetongue and He Softfoot to make sure it stays they way. If you want to aid the effort further, head to the west to the lake, meet up with He, and help him keep things secure from any hostile threats.

Title: The Challenger's Ring: Lao-Chin the Iron Belly
Objective: Challenge Lao-Chen the Iron Belly and then defeat him in combat at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
Text: Lao-Chin seems to have his head in the clouds... or, rather, in his beer.After all of his recent battles, he seems completely obsessed with with trying to develop the perfect brew for fighting.That's well and good, but we need him to actually do some fighting!You should go challenge him, see if you can snap him out of his rut.If you beat him, he'll probably want to go out and help fight just to try to one-up you!

Title: A Visit with Lorewalker Cho
Objective: Befriend Lorewalker Cho by assisting him around his house: Trim his tree, paint his wall, and feed his birds.
Text: Stranger, I may be able to help you find your prince. But first, I would like to know a little more about you and your people. Come, help me with my chores, and we will chat. You have the look of a grizzled war veteran, but certainly you have a few minutes to help a bookish Pandaren like myself putter around the house, yes?

Title: Cheng Bo!
Objective: Kill Cheng-Bo at Fire Camp Gai-Cho in Townlong Steppes.
Text: Cheng Bo is the Warbringer of Fire Camp Gai-Cho. While you've made a dent in their operations, you now have an opportunity to strike a major blow.Slay the Warbringer!

Title: Stay a While, and Listen
Objective: Drink from Cho's Teapot.
Text: Rush rush rush - are your people always in such a hurry? Sit and have some tea with me a moment, and we will discuss your plight.

Title: Feral: The Folly of Levia Laurence
Objective: Ask around the city for information on Levia Laurence.
Text: Levia Laurence was once a member of the Kirin Tor. Dabbling in shadow magic got her banned from the city, but she knows the streets too well to keep her out for good.Levia has disappeared, and I'm gravely concerned. Her work may have attracted the attention of the Legion. It has before. It would be very dangerous if her knowledge fell into their hands.She was last seen at the Scribe's Sacellum. Ask around there and see if you can pick up her trail.|cFF660000Specialization: Feral Druid|r

Title: The Deadtalker Cipher
Objective: Collect a Scroll of Spiritbinding Rites from the yaungol at Deadtalker's Plateau.
Text: We need to understand what went wrong with the Deadtalkers.For so many years, the Deadtalkers were simply responsible for maintaining the burial grounds and holding funerals for fallen warriors.From a recent raid, we've recovered a tablet from the grounds that is clearly written using a cipher, but it isn't one we've encountered before. If you can gather a ciphered scroll from one of the Deadtalkers, we can begin to put together the cypher and understand what's happened.

Title: The Enemy of My Enemy... Is Still My Enemy!
Objective: Use Highly Explosive Yaungol Oil Barrels to kill 100 mantid or yaungol on the Gai-Cho Battlefield.
Text: The mantid are our enemies. As are the yaungol at Fire Camp Gai-Cho.It is fortunate, then, that they are also each other's enemies. Mantid from Kri'vess constantly attack the Gai-Cho yaungol, who hold them off at their front gates.I want you to wreak havoc. "Borrow" some highly explosive oil barrels from camp Gai-Cho, and toss them down onto the battlefield from the air.I don't care which ones you kill, just kill a lot of them.

Title: Uruk!
Objective: Kill Uruk at Deadtalker's Plateau in Townlong Steppes.
Text: Uruk is the Deadtalker of the Townlong yaungol. Your mission will not be truly complete until you defeat him. Go to it!

Title: Retribution: Fate of the Tideskorn
Objective: Search Jandvik for the vrykul mentioned in the scrolls.
Text: A scout from Stormheim arrived yesterday with a significant discovery - these ancient scrolls. Within they contain a Valkyra prophecy of a new vrykul ruler - one who could turn the Tideskorn against the Legion.It complicates matters that this vrykul may in fact be Skovald's heir.Take the scrolls, find the heir, and bring her to the Valkyra. I think the outcasts they refer to are the vrykul of Jandvik, so that would be a good place to start.|cFF660000Specialization: Retribution Paladin|r

Title: Subtlety: The Thieving Apprentice
Objective: Travel to Xylem's Tower within Bear's Head in Azshara.
Text: The Focusing Iris has been stolen from the Dalaran Vaults! The thief was a mage of some skill, but we've been unable to track him.Fortunately, the thief dropped a note from his master, addressing him as one of his "apprentici." I know of only one mage who uses that particular pluralization - Archmage Xylem.I'll need you to investigate. In Azshara you will find his tower where he trains his apprentices. Go there, and see what Xylem is up to.|cFF660000Specialization: Subtlety Rogue|r

Title: Shadow: The Twisted Twin
Objective: Meet with Karam Magespear at the Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran.
Text: I have a request from an old friend, Karam Magespear, to help find his brother, Raest. Karam fears that Raest is dealing with dark powers, and wishes to stop him.Originally Raest trained with the Kirin Tor, but such were his aspirations of power that he turned to the forbidden art of Necromancy. He was discovered and expelled from our order.Find Karam in the Legerdemain Lounge and see if you can lend a hand.|cFF660000Specialization: Shadow Priest|r

Title: Spirit Dust
Objective: Return 8 spirits to their remains at the Deadtalker Plateau in Townlong Steppes.
Text: The spirits that the Yaungol are entrapping from the remains of their ancestors still have a bit of the essence of life within them.If you defeat the spirits in battle, you can collect essence from the spirits as dust, and then return it to the corpses in the area, which will send the spirits, finally, to the next life.This is the only way to set right what the Deadtalkers have done. It will also help keep us safe.

Title: They're So Thorny!
Objective: Collect 5 Emergency Supplies from the Water Sprites.
Text: The crate, once full of desperately needed supplies, has been thoroughly pillaged. A quick scan of the area shows evidence left behind by the thieves. Icy thorns, just like the ones on the water sprites on the shoreline to the east. This is a life or death situation for your band of survivors. Those supplies need to be retrieved from these thieving pests and returned to camp.

Title: Havoc: The Thieving Apprentice

Title: Assault Deadtalker's Plateau
Objective: Kill 8 Deadtalker Corpsedefilers and 1 Deadtalker Crusher.
Text: We have always left the Deadtalkers alone. For so long, they were just responsible for maintaining the sacred burial grounds of the yaungol tribes.Now, though, they are practicing dark magic, defiling the corpses of their former clanmates...I know not where they learned those dark magics, or why they no longer treat their dead with respect, but we do not have time to find out.We need to stop them.

Title: Assault Fire Camp Gai-Cho
Objective: Kill 16 Gai-Cho Yaungol, Earthtalkers or Pitchthrowers.
Text: The Yaungol are a constant nuisance, but the group at Fire Camp Gai-Cho, to the northeast, conspired with the Osul yaungol in their recent incursion into Kun-Lai.We cannot allow such an incursion to go unpunished.Go, attack Fire Camp Gai-Cho. We need to make sure they remain occupied, so that they cannot rise up and threaten The Ox Gate again.

Title: Through the Portal
Objective: Collect 1000 Ancient Arcane Powder.
Text: Ah, just the  I wanted to see! We've finally figured out why the portal is not working. We need more arcane powder! It would take us months to get a shipment sent out to us, but luckily, the mogu on this island carry plenty for their own spells. They tend to use some older stuff, so we're going to need a lot of it.

Title: Eradicating the Zan'thik
Objective: Kill 6 Zan'thik Impalers and 6 Zan'thik Manipulators in Zan'vess.
Text: The warriors of Zan'vess are some of the most feared and respected in the empire, for good reason. Impalers are unmatched in their mastery of the polearm - no doubt Malik trained among the Zan'thik in his time. Their manipulators command terrifying sonic power with the ease and subtlety of a breath. Both will need to be dealt with.

Title: The Challenger's Ring: Yalia Sagewhisper
Objective: Challenge Yalia Sagewhisper and defeat her in the Challenger's Ring.
Text: The Shado-Pan brothers and sisters continue to whisper of your deeds. In fact, Yalia herself has taken quite an interest in your studies. She wishes to challenge you in the training ring. You would do well to impress her. If you do, she just may be willing to help you in the future.

Title: Culling the Swarm
Objective: Slay 40 Shek'zeer Mantid in the Clutches of Shek'zeer. Speak with Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver for an air-drop.
Text: The Empress continues to amass her forces. Without intervention, they WILL overrun that wall - even if it means smothering it in the corpses of a million swarmborn. Let us find a better place for those corpses. Let me know when you are ready to depart for the clutches - I will gladly drop you in from above.

Title: Citizens of a New Empire
Objective: Gather 10 Vor'thik Eggs from Kypari Vor.
Text: At Shek'zeer's command, the great kypari tree of Kypari Vor was twisted into a totem of horror. Like those outside of the palace, the clutch nearby is now used to corrupt our swarmborn. Recover the eggs of the Vor'thik before they are tainted. We shall raise them here. They will be the citizens of a new empire, free from the sha.

Title: The Mogu Menace
Objective: Kill 12 Shan'ze Serpentbinders or Shan'ze Beastmasters.
Text: Our scouts have discovered a heavy mogu force at Shan'ze Dao to the northwest. The island was supposedly uninhabited, so their presence is disturbing news. Even more disturbing is the fact that they are performing sinister experiments on the island. I need a capable  to check out the situation. The Shan'ze are likely to give you trouble, and if they do, kill them.

Title: The Mogu Menace

Title: The Ballad of Liu Lang
Objective: Bring The Ballad of Liu Lang to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
Text: Dear $p, At long last thanks to your research we have the full Ballad of Liu Lang. If you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection. Thank you for your diligence! Sincerely, Lorewalker Cho

Title: Klaxx Attack
Objective: Bring Klaxx Attack to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
Text: Dear $p, We have all been quite disturbed by your findings regarding the Klaxxi. If you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection. Thank you for your diligence! Sincerely, Lorewalker Cho

Title: Heart of the Mantid Swarm
Objective: Bring Heart of the Mantid Swarm to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
Text: Dear $p, While we appreciate your efforts to investigate the lore of Pandaria, the documents you sent us on the mantid managed to rob me of several nights sleep. Terrifying stuff. If you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection. Thank you for your diligence! Sincerely, Lorewalker Cho

Title: The Seven Burdens of Shaohao
Objective: Bring The Seven Burdens of Shaohao to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
Text: Dear $p, It would seem you have discovered the full tale of Shaohao, the last emperor of Pandaria. If you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection. Thank you for your diligence! Sincerely, Lorewalker Cho

Title: The Song of the Yaungol
Objective: Bring The Song of the Yaungol to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
Text: Dear $p, Your research in to the yaungol has proven most insightful. If you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection. Thank you for your diligence! Sincerely, Lorewalker Cho

Title: Founding of the Order of the Cloud Serpent
Objective: Bring Founding of the Order of the Cloud Serpent to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
Text: Dear $p, We have a wonderful story assembled from the lore you recovered on the Order of the Cloud Serpent. If you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection. Thank you for your diligence! Sincerely, Lorewalker Cho

Title: Concentrated Fear
Objective: Gather 4 Dread Amber Foci from Vor'thik Fear-Shapers at Kypari Vor.
Text: Amber is power. It brings life. This... dread amber you brought me has been twisted. It is concentrated fear. The Vor'thik know this well. Their kypari has been completely engulfed by sha, and they use the dread amber to quicken their own swarmborn. Bring me the crystals used by the Vor'thik fear-shapers in their rituals. The Klaxxi will study them and decide on a protocol for disposal.

Title: What is Worth Fighting For
Objective: Bring What is Worth Fighting For to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
Text: Dear $p, You have recovered the story of our people's freedom from the mogu empire. If you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection. Thank you for your diligence! Sincerely, Lorewalker Cho

Title: Feed or Be Eaten
Objective: Begin Kovok's training by feeding him 6 Succulent Turtle Filets found on the Brineshell Snappers in the Briny Muck.
Text: After years of working with the Kunchong I developed a theory; raising one from infancy would strengthen the bond and therefore strengthen the sonic connection. I had just begun training Kovok when I was chosen for encasement. He is still very young and will need diligent training to reach his full potential. I'm entrusting Kovok to you, but be warned; if any harm comes to him your life is forfeit. First, you must feed him to gain his trust. The turtles in the area should be suitable for this.

Title: The Dark Heart of the Mogu
Objective: Bring The Dark Heart of the Mogu to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
Text: Dear $p, We have always known the mogu to be dark and sinister. Your research however would imply that they are far worse. If you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection. Thank you for your diligence! Sincerely, Lorewalker Cho

Title: Legends of the Brewfathers
Objective: Bring Legends of the Brewfathers to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
Text: Dear $p, Your research in to the Brewfathers has proven most... thirstifying. If you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection. Thank you for your diligence! Sincerely, Lorewalker Cho

Title: Fish Tales
Objective: Bring Fish Tails to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
Text: Dear $p, I have thoroughly enjoyed reading your research in to the jinyu. A fascinating people and quite clever too. If you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection. Thank you for your diligence! Sincerely, Lorewalker Cho

Title: Hozen in the Mist
Objective: Bring Hozen in the Mist to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
Text: Dear $p, Your research into the hozen has proven quite enlightening. If you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection. Thank you for your diligence! Sincerely, Lorewalker Cho

Title: Reunited
Objective: Assist Kaz'tik the Manipulator as he unearths his greatest weapon.
Text: You look at me and see I am no great warrior. Why was I chosen to be a Paragon? Not all weapons can be seen, Wakener. One should not judge by appearance alone. Before I explain further, I need to know that you are trustworthy. Something precious to me was hidden at the time of my preservation. I am nothing without it. Defend me as I unearth my greatest weapon, and you will have my trust.

Title: Better With Age
Objective: Gather 7 Amber-Filled Jars from the Amber Collectors on the Stinging Trail.
Text: It is a crime to harvest the young trees, but a much bigger crime to waste the amber. Young amber is not as strong, but the Klaxxi need it to continue the fight. We will bring them more and they will sing my praises! Gather the young amber. We will store it until it is aged and can be consumed.

Title: By the Sea, Nevermore
Objective: Use the Klaxxi Tuning Fork on the Ocean-Worn Rocks to awaken the paragon.
Text: The Klaxxi'va have spoken to me, outsider. The paragon is hidden in the Briny Muck only, he is not so hidden anymore. The lizard men surround him. He cannot fall into their scaly hands. You will find him; you will awaken him. Do not return without him! If you do this the Klaxxi will be pleased with us.

Title: Extending Our Coverage
Objective: Activate the Resonating Beacon in Amberglow Hollow.
Text: The Klaxxi'va hear another paragon. His cries are weak and lost in darkness. The signal must be strengthened. There is a tower in Amberglow Hollow that has been silent for many years. It must sing; the Klaxxi demand it! This time I will go with you. You will help me repair it. Take the resonating crystal and meet me in Amberglow.

Title: Crime and Punishment
Objective: Kill 8 Ik'thik Harvesters on the Stinging Trail.
Text: The Stinging Trail nurtures young Kypari trees. The empress drains the saplings too early, outsider. They must grow before the amber can be taken. The Klaxxi'va demand punishment for this crime! It will please them if you rain death on the Ik'thik harvesters.

Title: Great Vessel of Salvation
Objective: Bring 3 Motherseeds to the collection pit in Rikkitun Village, with the assistance of the Rikkitun Chanters.
Text: I know what you and the girl-panda seek. We can perform the rite for you... in time. First, I require aid. The seeds fall from our great mother-tree. It is our responsibility to collect them, even in dangerous times like these. Escort my chanters to the motherseeds, that they may bring them back to the collection pit.

Title: Blood of Ancients
Objective: Obtain a Chunk of Solidified Amber.
Text: Lya and I agree on one thing: "Blood of Ancients" is almost certainly the sap from the great trees of the area. I should know - I brew with the stuff all the time. The most ancient tree of all is the one that Grand Empress Shek'zeer calls her home, now known as the Heart of Fear. Find some amber from that tree, and our brew should be complete.

Title: Bind the Glamour
Objective: Allow Chief Rikkitun to enchant the Forked Blade.
Text: It has been a very, very long time since our tribe has been called on to perform this rite. I will do the best I can.

Title: Fires and Fears of Old
Objective: Use the Ruining Fork on Iyyokuk the Lucid, then protect him until he is able to escape.
Text: We've found the blades, bound them together with wood and shade, and blessed them with an ancient incantation. If I'm not mistaken, it's time to use this thing. The sprites spoke of an ancient piece of sap within the Amber Hibernal, a mantid cave near their empress' palace. That must be the "Blood of Ancients" that the prophecy spoke of. Whatever's inside that sap must be important. Good luck.

Title: Fiery Wings
Objective: Slap Rikkilea Flitterlings, then catch 88 flecks of Flitterling Dust.
Text: I think that old paper said something about "fiery wings." Those little dragons around here have wings. They're kind of fiery, in a way. You're quicker than me. Try catching some of those dragons... or at least slapping the powder off of them. No point in killing a harmless little dragon, if all you want is the sparkle from their wings.

Title: Balance: The Twisted Twin
Objective: Meet with Karam Magespear at the Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran.
Text: I have a request from an old friend, Karam Magespear, to help find his brother, Raest. Karam fears that Raest is dealing with dark powers, and wishes to stop him.Originally Raest trained with the Kirin Tor, but such were his aspirations of power that he turned to the forbidden art of Necromancy. He was discovered and expelled from our order.Find Karam in the Legerdemain Lounge and see if you can lend a hand.|cFF660000Specialization: Balance Druid|r

Title: Incantations Fae and Primal
Objective: Slay Ahgunoss and Mygoness.
Text: I suspect we are going to need the help of these sprites. We have two enchanted daggers, bound together with wood and shade. Now we need someone to perform ancient "incantations" on our artifact. Before we ask for favors, let's show the sprites that we mean well. I heard their leader talking about a pair of mistlurkers that kidnapped several of their villagers. If we slay these fog beasts... we may get the "incantation" we need in return.

Title: Legion Threat: The Missing Mage
Objective: Speak with Archmage Modera in Dalaran.
Text: It appears you have grown strong enough to take on another Legion threat. If you could speak to Archmage Modera in Dalaran as soon as possible, the Council would be in your debt.

Title: Promises of Gold
Objective: Report to Chief Rikkitun at Rikkitun Village in Dread Wastes.
Text: As soon as the creature died, a strange group of sprites appeared and took its pearl away. The sprites have a village nearby, called Rikkitun Village. Perhaps you should investigate.

Title: Legion Threat: Suramar
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
Text: It appears you have grown strong enough to take on another Legion threat. I'd like you to meet with the Council of the Six in Dalaran as soon as possible. Thank you.

Title: Legion Threat: Dalaran Infiltration
Objective: Speak with Archmage Ansirem in Dalaran.
Text: It appears you have grown strong enough to take on another Legion threat. If you could speak to Archmage Ansirem in Dalaran as soon as possible, the Council would be in your debt.

Title: Legion Threat: The Necromancer
Objective: Speak with Archmage Karlain in Dalaran.
Text: It appears you have grown strong enough to take on another Legion threat. I'd like you to meet with Archmage Karlain as soon as possible. Thank you.

Title: Legion Threat: Azshara
Objective: Speak with Archmage Kalec in Dalaran.
Text: It appears you have grown strong enough to take on another Legion threat. If you could speak to Archmage Kalec in Dalaran as soon as possible, the Council would be in your debt.

Title: Blood: Aid of the Illidari
Objective: Find Kor'vas Bloodthorn in the streets of Dalaran.
Text: Thankfully, we are not quite alone in uncovering the Legion's plots to infiltrate the city. Kor'vas Bloodthorn of the Illidari has taken to patrolling the city streets on her own to find the source behind the recent attacks. I do not entirely trust these 'demon hunters', but they have at least proved adept at their namesake. I suggest you find her and see what she has uncovered before the Legion strikes once more.|cFF660000Specialization: Blood Death Knight|r

Title: Windwalker: Rumblings Near Feltotem
Objective: Find Navarrogg at the Misty Coast in Highmountain.
Text: The Highmountain have passed along a dire warning from their drogbar allies. The Feltotem are spreading their demonic corruption into the wildlife around them, infecting the land itself. We believe this is something that should be looked into sooner rather than later. The drogbar chieftain, Navarrogg, is handling this personally and we'd like you to meet him near the Feltotem village.|cFF660000Specialization: Windwalker Monk|r

Title: Evie Stormstout
Objective: Meet Chen Stormstout at The Sunset Brewgarden, then listen to his eulogy.
Text: I was too late. She was so small... and I was too late. She should be given a proper burial. A little warrior like her deserves better than this.

Title: Fate of the Stormstouts
Objective: Ask the inhabitants of The Sunset Brewgarden if they've seen any Stormstouts.
Text: Greetings. I am Chen Stormstout. I'm looking for my family. I am told that several Stormstouts came across the wall to help face the mantid threat. I mean to find them, and join them. Have you seen anyone named Stormstout come through here? Would you mind helping me ask around?

Title: Wood and Shade
Objective: Find the Mark of the Empress and the Heartroot of Kypari Kor.
Text: "Rending daggers of the great ones shall be bound with WOOD and SHADE." Hmm. I've learned a lot about the Kor'thik mantid in my time here. I know that they maintain shrines within their settlement, Kor'vess. One is a heartroot of the very tree that they inhabit. The other is a dark pillar, connecting them with their queen. These shrines are the wood and shade. If my predictions are right... the daggers should react in their presence.

Title: Han Stormstout
Objective: Find Han Stormstout in the Morrowchamber beneath Kor'vess.
Text: There will be time for mourning later. For now, there are other Stormstouts to be found. They say that Han Stormstout was last seen exploring Kor'vess. I suspect he headed into that mantid burrow, just across the way. You should meet me down there. I don't doubt that I can handle a few mantid by myself... but I'd feel better with you by my side.

Title: Bound With Shade
Objective: Harvest 100 drops of Shade by slaying sha creatures and wildlife near The Sunset Brewgarden.
Text: About that scroll you found... I keep looking at that line in the second stanza - "bound with wood and shade". The "shade", in particular, intrigues me. I must admit, I've often considered taking some of the area's residual sha essence and incorporating it into a brew. I suspect that this is the shade which our recipe calls for. You will find large amalgamations of sha to the southeast of our tree... though you may also be able to harvest some from the local wildlife.

Title: Bound With Wood
Objective: Obtain 8 pieces of Fragrant Corewood.
Text: Hmm... "bound with wood". We don't typically brew with wood. Sap, yes... but not wood. We have, on rare occasions, infused our drinks with corewood from the treants to the west of here. Most of them have fallen to the mantid... but their remains should suffice for our recipe.

Title: Rending Daggers
Objective: Obtain the Blade of Kz'Kzik and the Blade of Ilikkax.
Text: Forget about them, and forget their BREW. We've got real work to do. The scroll mentions "rending daggers of the great ones". I've got a feeling I know where to find them. A pair of mantid lieutenants patrol the Horrid March, to the south. Each one carries a ceremonial dagger. Bring those daggers back here. We may be on the brink of something big.

Title: I Bring Us Great Shame
Objective: Find the Lost Keg, the Lost Mugs, and the Lost Picnic Supplies.
Text: I have failed my fellow brewers. I took some supplies out to the clearing, east of our tree... and I left them there. Now, with the sha corrupting the land, and the mantid on the prowl, it is too dangerous for me to bring them back. If you would help me look for them, perhaps I could regain some of my lost honor.

Title: Daggers of the Great Ones
Objective: Obtain 3 Large Mushan Teeth.
Text: That recipe said: "rending daggers of the great ones"...  Mushan! That's it! There's plenty of mushan roaming out there with these great, big teeth... they're as long as daggers. That's gotta be what the recipe calls for.

Title: Sacred Recipe
Objective: Bring the Scroll of Auspice to Lya of Ten Songs at The Sunset Brewgarden.
Text: "When the horror comes a-rising And the heavens hum with war Our great vessel of salvation Must be broken from its core." The scroll continues on for several stanzas. Perhaps somebody at The Sunset Brewgarden will be able to decipher its cryptic message.

Title: Buried Beneath
Objective: Look through the spyglass in Rensai's Watchpost.
Text: Taoshi set up a spyglass on the ridge edge to show me what her scouting uncovered. Go over and take a look.

Title: Sunset Kings
Objective: Meet Sapmaster Vu at Rikkitun Village.
Text: Olon had a clever idea. He thinks that we should visit the sprites to the west, and ask them if they have any of these ingredients. Some of the elements to this recipe are seeming... strange. The Rikkitun sprites have a village to the west of Kor'vess. I hope to see you there.

Title: The Funky Monkey Brew
Objective: Defeat Captain Ook.
Text: Pirates! Our shores have been scoured by the most ill-tempered, ill-mannered, ill-hygienic, and ill-good hozen that ever was found in Pandaria. And to make matters worse, they claim to serve the legendary Captain Ook! We see them every night partying and brewing punch on their island Unga Ingoo. I say we take their brew for a change! I think I can even improve their mix. Gather up some friends and meet me on the southern side of Unga Ingoo. It is time for a Brew Run!

Title: The Heavens Hum With War
Objective: Slay Azzix K'tai.
Text: The mantid don't ever make my job easy, but now they've gone too far. We can fend off the occasional attack from Kor'vess, but now... now they're starting to surround us. What's worse, they're draining the amber from our tree. This will not stand! We need that amber! To make beer! They've dug a burrow into the south side of the tree. I'm short-handed here. Could you take care of them for me?

Title: A Cry From Darkness
Objective: Slay the corrupted paragon at Kypari Vor.
Text: So, you survived the imperial clutches. You are... resilient. The Klaxxi hear another paragon to the north, among the sha-scorched roots of Kypari Vor. This one cries out in terror and agony. It cannot be saved. The Klaxxi want him put down. Go and defeat him or do not return here.

Title: Lao-Chin and Serevex
Objective: Kill Serevex with the aid of Lao-Chin the Iron Belly.
Text: Lao-Chin is facing off against the leader just above the entrance in the tree, on the north side of Sik'vess. He is to bring back the second crystal that we need to get into the mantid tunnel. Go there and lend him your aid.

Title: Nurong and Rothek
Objective: Kill Rothek with the aid of Hawkmaster Nurong.
Text: Hawkmaster Nurong has gone ahead to the northwest of Sik'vess to make sure the last mantid leader cannot escape. Catch up with him and help him kill the mantid leader. Nurong will bring back the final crystal once you've aided him in this.

Title: Riding the Storm
Objective: Use the Bronze Claws to mount 8 Shan'ze Cloudrunners. Attack them to free them of their corruption.
Text: Shan Bu, the leader of the Shan'ze, is performing some kind of dark ritual at the summit of the island to the northwest. We believe that the subjugated Shan'ze Cloudrunners are powering the spell. How, we still do not know. We believe that the Shan'ze Cloudrunners can still be saved from the corruption that taints them. Take these bronze claws. Use them to mount the back of a Shan'ze Cloudrunner. Attack them. Beat some sense back into their heads!

Title: Between a Saurok and a Hard Place
Objective: Bring Between a Saurok and a Hard Place to Lorewalker Cho.
Text: Dear $p, We have received your research on the saurok and believe we have pieced together clues about their past. If you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection. Thank you for your diligence! Sincerely, Lorewalker Cho

Title: Grave Consequences
Objective: Kill 24 Shan'ze Ancestors. Shan'ze Ancestors may be found inside Mogu Burial Urns.
Text: We've found ancient mogu burial urns among the ruins on Shan'ze Dao. This is normally no problem, except these urns are home to angry mogu spirits. Not only do these urns pose a danger to anyone unlucky enough to find one, but they could be used for destruction if they were to fall into the wrong hands. We must rid Shan'ze Dao of their presence.

Title: In Sprite Of Everything
Objective: Kill the Darkwoods Faerie.
Text: The sprites of Shan'ze Dao have always been capricious tricksters, but now they have fallen under the mogu's influence. Even as we speak, they gather under a new leader. We cannot allow this to happen. Their mischievous pranks were one thing, but united, their dark magic is too powerful and too dangerous to comprehend. Take out their leader before it is too late.

Title: Born Free
Objective: Free 6 Wild Cloudrunners from their chains.
Text: Do you know the story of the great cloud serpents of Pandaria? Someday you must hear it. Unfortunately, there is no time to tell it now. What you must know is that the wild cloudrunner serpents of Townlong are in trouble. The mogu are capturing wild serpents and corrupting their minds, bending them to their sinister will. Go to Shan'ze Dao, to the northwest. Free the adult serpents from their chains. Save them!

Title: Little Hatchlings
Objective: Free 20 Cloudrunner Hatchlings.
Text: I have seen the cruel experiments that the Shan'ze are performing on their island to the northwest. The Shan'ze raise baby serpents from the egg. They keep the young in tiny cages, surrounded by squalor and filth. The cruelest gaolers starve and torture them. We must save as many hatchlings as we can. You have my full permission to punish any mogu that gets in your way!

Title: When The Dead Speak
Objective: Kill the Shan'ze Deathspeaker.
Text: The Shan'ze's experiments are overseen by a powerful necromancer known as a Shan'ze Deathspeaker. If we are to put an end to their operations, we must eliminate their leader.

Title: Illusions Of The Past
Objective: Kill 3 Shan'ze Illusionists.
Text: , I need your strength to eliminate the Shan'ze Illusionists on Shan'ze Dao, to the northwest. It wearies me to ask of you this difficult task. The illusionists are among the strongest of the Shan'ze's elite sorcerors. They will not be easy to defeat, but I know no  who is better suited to the task.

Title: Holy: The Bradensbrook Investigation
Objective: Go to Bradensbrook in Val'sharah.
Text: We have uncovered forged orders from the Shore. They have a fel influence about them. They guide the reader to believe they are legitimate. It orders Black Rook Hold to attack a "demonic enclave" just south of their walls. There's only one enclave they could be talking about, Bradensbrook!Is it possible these would be able to convince the undead to attack Bradensbrook? You should head there immediately and either warn them, or render aid.|cFF660000Specialization: Holy Paladin|r

Objective: Go to Bradensbrook in Val'sharah.

Title: The Crown of the Triumvirate
Objective: Protect Velen while he locates fragments of the Crown of the Triumvirate.
Text: We begin our search now. The Crown of the Triumvirate was created to spread the Light's touch to all. With it, our culture thrived. When I fled Argus with the Draenei, I took one shard of the Crown with me to ensure that it would not fall into the wrong hands.  Kil'jaeden and Archimonde's fragments are still here. I will seek them out, but you will need to safeguard me while I search. Stay close, my friend.

Title: The Council's Call
Objective: Seek out the Council of Six in the Violet Citadel.
Text: I'm sorry that I haven't kept your apprised of the situation. We needed more actionable information before bringing the matter before you.The Council of the Six has been investigating Legion threats outside of the Broken Shore. I believe this scroll to be the final piece of information we need.Meet me in Dalaran at the Violet Citadel. We will need the other members of the Council.

There's only one enclave they could be talking about, Bradensbrook!Is it possible these would be able to convince the undead to attack Bradensbrook? You should head there immediately and either warn them, or render aid.|cFF660000Specialization: Restoration Shaman|r

Title: Bronze Claws
Objective: Collect 20 Bronze Claws.
Text: Among the Shan'ze's fiercest and most loyal creations are their quilen. These beasts will hunt until they kill their prey, or die in the process. I need you to not only cull their numbers, but also to retrieve their bronze claws. Their claws are strong and razor sharp, and we can use them to make weapons and hooks for our cause.

Title: Dark Arts
Objective: Collect 8 Shan'ze Tablets.
Text: It is said that Shan'ze Dao was once home to a great mogu temple. There, the Shan'ze studied and practiced the art of subjugating the dead or inanimate. Much of their knowledge still remains on the island to the northwest, buried among the ruins. We need to get our hands on their knowledge - both to keep it out of their hands, and to understand the nature of their experiments.

Title: Egg Rescue!
Objective: Collect 8 Cloudrunner Eggs.
Text: Eggs. Yes, you heard me right. I said eggs, and these aren't for eating. Have you ever seen a cloud serpent egg? These rare eggs look like jewels, and were once worth their weight in solid gold. Shan'ze Dao to the north normally teems with wild cloud serpents, but the mogu and the sprites have their eggs on lock-down. We need to save as many of these precious eggs as we can. I'm counting on YOU.

Title: Spiteful Sprites
Objective: Kill 30 Darkwoods Pixies or Darkwoods Charmers.
Text: The Darkwoods sprites on Shan'ze Dao have fallen to the mogu's domination. The once sly tricksters are now the full servants of the Shan'ze. They grow bolder each day, stealing and killing to satisfy their masters. They must be eliminated, but be careful. They may look harmless, but they are actually quite vicious.

Title: The Mogu Menace
Objective: Kill 12 Shan'ze Serpentbinders or Shan'ze Beastmasters.
Text: Our scouts have discovered a heavy mogu force at Shan'ze Dao to the northwest. The island was supposedly uninhabited, so their presence is disturbing news. Even more disturbing is the fact that they are performing sinister experiments on the island. I need a capable  to check out the situation. The Shan'ze are likely to give you trouble, and if they do, kill them.

Title: The Challenger's Ring: Snow Blossom
Objective: Challenge Snow Blossom and defeat her in the Challenger's Ring.
Text: News of your feats has been traveling around the camp. In fact, Snow Blossom would like to test your skill in battle. You had best prepare yourself. She is not easily defeated. If you can prove your worth to her, you will win a valuable friend.

Title: Onyx Hearts
Objective: Collect 4 Onyx Hearts.
Text: The Shan'ze Serpentbinders dominate the minds of wild cloud serpents, but they also create their own dark creatures from stone, metal, blood, and ancient sorcery. Their creations, the Onyx Stormclaws, guard the island to the northwest. I wish to study the magic binding these creatures. Bring me their hearts, so that I can better understand what sorcery we are up against.

Title: Enemies Below
Objective: Speak with Commander Bagran.
Text: Orgrimmar's Ragefire Chasm has been taken by the Dark Shaman. , we cannot allow this to pass unpunished, lest they next set their sights on Undercity. Go speak with Commander Bagran just inside the Chasm. Help him in any way you can, for our fates are intertwined.

Title: Enemies Below
Objective: Speak with Commander Bagran.
Text: There are enemies of the Horde beneath this very city. The Searing Blade plots to take Orgrimmar for their own, and have already taken Ragefire Chasm! We need to storm their forces and retake what is ours! Go speak with Commander Bagran just inside Ragefire Chasm. He will have further orders for you.

Title: Enemies Below
Objective: Speak with Commander Bagran.
Text: Orgrimmar's Ragefire Chasm has been taken by the Dark Shaman. , we cannot allow this to pass unpunished, lest they next set their sights on Thunder Bluff. Go speak with Commander Bagran just inside the Chasm. Help him in any way you can, for our fates are intertwined.

Title: Choking the Skies
Objective: Burn 10 Kor'thik Fleetwing corpses.
Text: Nurong wants me to pass out torches for burning the bodies. The flying mantid are fragile, and won't last long in the hot smoke.

Title: Enemies Below
Objective: Speak with Stone Guard Kurjack.
Text: Orgrimmar's Ragefire Chasm has been taken by the Searing Blade. , we cannot allow this to pass unpunished, lest they next set their sights on Thunder Bluff. Go speak with Stone Guard Kurjack just inside the Chasm. Help him in any way you can, for our fates are intertwined.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Ragefire Chasm
Objective: Speak with Commander Bagran.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Ragefire Chasm, just beneath the great city of Orgrimmar, immediately! The Dark Shaman are poised to launch an attack at any moment and the city guards cannot hold for much longer! If you so choose, head to Ragefire Chasm and speak with Commander Bagran, head of the defense initiative, to end the threat to Orgrimmar once and for all.

Title: Paragon 5
Objective: Recover the fifth paragon.
Text: The emanations are growing stronger. I feel them coming from the cave below us. I wish to study the beast that you have slain, so I will grant you the honor of awakening the next paragon. After all, the danger should be past. Go now, wallstrider, before I change my mind.

Title: Into the Monastery
Objective: Meet Ban Bearheart inside the Shado-Pan Monastery.
Text: This... is unspeakable. If the monastery has truly been taken over by the Sha, we will need a great effort to purge the monks inside of corruption.Gather a group of your allies, and meet me inside the Monastery.

Title: Into the Monastery
Objective: Meet Ban Bearheart inside the Shado-Pan Monastery.
Text: This... is unspeakable. If the monastery has truly been taken over by the Sha, we will need a great effort to purge the monks inside of corruption.Gather a group of your allies, and meet me inside the Monastery.

Title: Defeat the Abomination
Objective: Defeat the Abomination of Anger.
Text: Now that the pool of life is cleansed, the way to the crypt's interior is open. Make your way down there and defeat the abomination.

Title: The Root of the Problem
Objective: Kill the Coldbite Matriarch.
Text: Kypari Zar is dying. A creature of terrible darkness corrupts it from deep beneath its roots. The tree cannot be saved, but at least we can lessen its pain. Look. The vile creature has carved a path to its own lair. We need only follow it down the hill, just behind this tower.

Title: Sweet Tooth
Objective: Collect 50 Starshade.
Text: We cannot summon a god without a worthy offering. I have noticed a rare flower growing among the fields to the north. The Starshade is a potent flower whose bloom holds a powerfully sweet, intoxicating liquor. A single taste of this heady substance invigorates and strengthens the body. Surely, this god will appreciate its worth.

Title: Kunchong Treats
Objective: Collect 4 Meaty Turtle Haunches.
Text: As Kovok grows, he will require equal parts discipline and reward. I lack no shortage of discipline, but our supply of meat is almost empty. To the south, you will find turtles roaming north of the Lake of Stars and Kypari Zar. Hunt them. Kovok likes the taste of their flesh.

Title: Kypari Zar
Objective: Activate the Sonar Tower, then defend Korven the Prime as he examines the tree.
Text: What is that tree on the hill to the west? Can it be... Kypari Zar?  When I returned from my final ravage, before being elevated to a paragon, I was given the honor of planting that very tree. I see it has grown into a great kypari, but... it seems something is amiss. There is an old sonar tower at the base of the tree. Take me there, Wakener. I can use the tower to take a closer look.

Title: Relics of the Swarm
Objective: Collect 8 Mantid Relics.
Text: This strange-looking carving is covered in a complex written language that might be mantid in origin. You notice more relics strewn carelessly among the camps and inside the lake. Perhaps the Klaxxi would be interested in examining these artifacts. Who knows? Perhaps it will earn you some favor.

Title: Feeding the Beast
Objective: Kill 8 Coldbite Crocolisks.
Text: I must join the Klaxxi Council and the other paragons immediately, but I am barely strong enough to stand. I must feed, Wakener. I sense the beating hearts of creatures on the northern bank of the lake. Kill them for me, and I shall do the rest.

Title: Living Amber
Objective: Collect 8 Living Amber, then feed them to Korven the Prime.
Text: Liquid amber is most efficient for restoring a newly awakened paragon's strength, and is usually provided at a wakening ceremony. Unfortunately, it seems you did not receive these instructions, so we shall have to improvise. I can sense a vast quantity of fossilized amber in the lake below us. It will serve, but I am too weak to dig it up myself. Do this for me, and I will see to it that you are rewarded.

Title: Welcome to Zuldazar
Objective: Ride with the Princess Talanji.
Text: Champion of de Horde, welcome to de city of Zuldazar, capital of de Zandalari Empire, de jewel of all troll civilizations. I would have you ride by my side so we might discuss matters without prying ears close at hand.

Title: To the Forge It Goes...
Objective: Take the Gladiator's Tattered Cloak to the Obliterum Forge in Dalaran and use the forge to obliterate it, then take the result to Violet Shadowmend in Winderunner's Sanctuary.
Text: This cloak is too tattered to be usable, but can be obliterated at the Obliterum Forge in Dalaran.

Title: Amber Is Life
Objective: Kill 7 Mistblade Rippers and the Mistblade Scale-Lord.
Text: In order for our efforts against the mantid empire to continue, we require more amber. There is a great deposit of amber underneath the lake to the south, but the area is inhabited by a savage saurok tribe. I cannot spare anyone else. You must go to the lake and test the tribe's strength. Thin their numbers and eliminate their leader, who is probably hiding in his underground cavern. Surely this is not too great a task for you?

Title: The Lorewalkers
Objective: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: Dear $p, We have uncovered something tremendous in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. A great repository of books, scrolls, and lore that has remained untouched since the days of the mogu empire. Please, join us at your earliest convenience. You can find this Seat of Knowledge by traveling to the infamous Mogu'shan Vaults, and then flying to the landing just above the entrance. I look forward to your arrival! Sincerely, Lorewalker Cho

Title: The Humble Grummle
Objective: Bring The Humble Grummle to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
Text: Dear $p, We have received your research on the grummles and believe we have a solid idea of their etimology and history. If you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection. Thank you for your diligence! Sincerely, Lorewalker Cho

Title: The Horde Way
Objective: Walk with Garrosh Hellscream.
Text: I recently received word that some of your kind might be coming our way. I've recently been trying to bolster the strength of the Horde. A few pandaren might do us good. Walk with me.

Title: Beneath the Heart of Fear
Objective: Kill Adjunct Ek'vem, Adjunct Ikkess, Adjunct Suruz, and Adjunct Tsikzi, and then free Xaril the Poisoned Mind.
Text: The Klaxxi have detected the existence of another paragon, Wakener. This one was kept well-hidden from us, and for good reason. The Empress already has possession of this one, and her adjuncts work to destroy it even now. They are performing their sorcery in a chamber deep beneath the palace, and they must be stopped. We hold Klaxxi'vess. You must go in our stead. Find the entrance to their chamber from the ledge to the west.

Title: Your Private Collection
Objective: Clean off the Empty Bookshelf.
Text: Pandaria is rich with history, legends, stories, and lore of every sort. While you are traveling throughout the world I would ask that you keep an eye open for artifacts and pieces of information that you feel would be pertinent to our work here. When you accumulate enough knowledge, we will compile it in to a volume for your personal collection here. You can, of course, return whenever you like to review the volumes we are making for you.

Title: In Her Clutch
Objective: Locate and waken the mantid paragon in The Clutches of Shek'zeer.
Text: The crystal sings to the Klaxxi. They sense a paragon in the clutch, east of the tower. Clutch-keepers are trying to pollute this one. The Klaxxi will not permit this. Go and find the paragon. Place your hands on his chamber, and the Klaxxi will channel their whispers through you to break him free. Protect him if you can.

Title: Hellscream's Gift
Objective: Complete Garrosh's test by defeating Oggax, Gadoon, and Frozengore.
Text: I need to know if you can fight... that you can kill, and live. Eventually, each of you will be called upon for war, and I need to know that you can be counted on. I mentioned a gift earlier. It lies here, within the Ring of Valor. Step into the arena, right through this door behind me. I will test your skills.

Title: Joining the Horde
Objective: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream in Orgrimmar.
Text: Here we are... Orgrimmar, heart of the Horde. We can be helpful beyond the edges of the Wandering Isle. There are innumerable problems out there, just waiting for us to solve them. This is what Master Shang Xi would have wanted. There's no better place to start doing that than here, with the aid of the Horde. Let's find out who their leader is. We need allies.

Title: Amber Arms
Objective: Gather 6 Amber Blades from Shek'zeer Bladesworn around the Heart of Fear and The Clutches of Shek'zeer.
Text: You! Filth! You work for me now! The amber blades of the Shek'zeer Bladesworn are the finest weapons in the empire. If you are not impaled upon them immediately after leaving here, bring me as many of the blades as you can carry! I want to make sure we have weapons in reserve, should we need them.

Title: Dead Zone
Objective: Use the Klaxxi Resonating Crystal on the Inactive Sonic Relay at the Heart of Fear.
Text: A Klaxxi'va whispers to the tower. It carries their whisper far; to other towers, to mantid, to paragons. The whisper bounces back, and the Klaxxi hear it. This way, they see all. A tower near the palace is quiet. This will not do. It must sing for the Klaxxi. It is my job to fix the tower, but if you serve the Klaxxi, you should serve me as well. You fix the tower, and I will wait here!

Title: The Dread Clutches
Objective: Slay 6 Shek'zeer Clutch-Keepers in the Clutches of Shek'zeer.
Text: The imperial clutches have become an abomination! Clutch-Keepers rush the development of new swarmborn, saturating them in this vile "sha" energy before sending them away to the wall. The Klaxxi wish to stem the tide of swarmborn production in these dread clutches. Put the keepers to death!

Title: The Klaxxi Council
Objective: Travel to Klaxxi'vess at the center of the Dread Wastes. You may speak with Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver in the Terrace of Gurthan for a ride, or travel on your own.
Text: I must report to the Klaxxi. They would not have woken me unless the situation were dire. You have not been entirely useless. For that, I will spare your life. The council may even find a use for you.

Title: Psycho Mantid
Objective: Investigate the mantid infighting at the Terrace of Gurthan.
Text: You aren't going to believe what I saw! Two mantid fighting each other, whipping some serious magic back and forth. One of them didn't look like any mantid I've ever seen. Completely different color and dress to him, like some kind of... oracle or something. The other one was a total psycho, splashing sha energy around like it was a keg of Stormstout Special. Look, I gotta get back to my post, but those two are still fighting in the cave behind me and I have a feeling it's a big deal. Check it out?

Title: Wakening Sickness
Objective: Bring 100 Sapfly Bits to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver in the Terrace of Gurthan.
Text: You will forgive my current state. I have slept for many years. A Klaxxi'va should have been here to attend my Wakening with kypari sap... but you will have to do. I sense the buzzing of sapflies to the south. They gorge on the nourishing sap I need. Bring them to me.

Title: Preserved in Amber
Objective: Use the Klaxxi Tuning Fork on the Ancient Amber Chunk in the Terrace of Gurthan.
Text: Take... this...  Awaken... the Wind-Reaver... It is the only way... to end the swarm.

Title: Path Less Traveled
Objective: Speak to Uncle Cloverleaf in Onekeg.
Text: The toughest roads often have the most to teach us. I will no doubt learn a great deal from following the path of Shaohao. Many years ago Shaohao traveled to the highest peak in Kun-Lai to seek the guidance of the Jade Serpent. I too will travel to Seeker's Point in search of wisdom. Perhaps you would be interested in a journey such as this? If so speak with Uncle Cloverleaf. He will help you prepare.

Title: Falling Down
Objective: Use the Shado-Pan Rope to descend into the Terrace of Gurthan and search for the fallen Shado-Pan marksman.
Text: It's bad enough trying to hold off the mantid, but now we've got spiders swarming up from the ruins below. One of my best marksmen caught a blast of webbing around his leg and got pulled straight down! We think he's alive, but I don't have the manpower to send anyone in after him. We're stretched thin up here. If you want to help, use the rope behind me to drop down into the ruins. You're not afraid of heights are you? How about spiders?

Title: Nope
Objective: Slay 6 Dreadspinner Tenders and use the Shado-Pan Dragon Gun to destroy 20 Dreadspinner Eggs in the Terrace of Gurthan.
Text: We're holding, but just barely. Anything you can do to stem the tide of dreadspinners coming up the wall would be a big help. Feel like tearing open spider eggs one at a time by hand? I didn't think so. Take one of our dragon guns and light it up down there. I wanna hear those puppies pop.

Title: A New Enemy
Objective: Collect 5 Corrupted Insignia from the Dark Shaman cultists.
Text: The horde is using dark magic to control beasts and corrupt their brethren down here. I intend to put a stop to it, but first I need to know what it is we're fighting against. That's where you come in. Fight through the caverns and collect the insignia that the cultists carry. With them, I can study what type of magic is at work here.

Title: No Man Left Behind
Objective: Rescue 5 SI:7 Rangers in Ragefire Chasm.
Text: I sent recon out over an hour ago and none of them have reported back. And now these damned hounds are pouring out of the chasm. I don't know what's going on down there, but I'm not going anywhere till I get my men back. I want you to head in there and find them, preferably while they are still alive.

Title: Animal Control
Objective: Kill Adarogg and Slagmaw.
Text: I'm glad you're here. The horde is amassing an army and I'm not going to wait to find out why. We need to strike fast and take down some of the larger beasts they have down here. I want you to head in there and take care of Adarogg and Slagmaw before the horde can use them as weapons against us.

Title: The Dark Shaman
Objective: Defeat Dark Shaman Koranthal and Lava Guard Gordoth.
Text: These dark shaman have been down here for months, raising beasts and performing dark rituals. I don't know what they aim to achieve with all of this, but it's clear that they are no friend of the Alliance. And I need your help stopping them. Fight your way through the chasm and kill Dark Shaman Koranthal and Lava Guard Gordoth.

Title: Dread Space
Objective: Speak with Bowmistress Li on the Serpent's Spine.
Text: Shado-Pan marksmen keep a constant watch over the Dread Wastes from the top of the Serpent's Spine. They would surely welcome the aid of a skilled  such as yourself. Take a kite and check in with Bowmistress Li.

Title: Enemies At Our Door
Objective: Defeat 10 Amani Beserkers, 5 Amani Behemoths, and 3 Gurubashi Bloodriders.
Text: The Zandalari have begun their attack! You must help defend the village! If we can't push them back, we will never find the Thunder King's remains!

Title: Lao-Chin's Gambit
Objective: Speak with Lao-Chin the Iron Belly at Winter's Blossom in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: Alright. Thanks to you, we have the wall under control. Good job.I'll stay up here for a little while and make sure no more yaungol get up onto the wall.You, though, should go back down and see what Lao-Chin has cooked up. I hate to say it, but maybe he had a good idea after all...

Title: Finish This!
Objective: Finish the battle for the Ox Gate.
Text: We've heard back from Suna, on the wall. Something's going on...It looks like they are preparing for their final push. It's time to finish this, friend.

Title: Where are My Reinforcements?
Objective: Speak with Ban Bearheart outside the Shado-Pan Monastery in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: This has simply gone too far. I cannot ignore our abandonment any longer.After all that's happened here, and all you've been through in Firebough, we must travel to the monastery.Whatever they are doing in there can wait! We can take my balloon up the mountain to the Monastery. It's anchored back by the camp, to the northeast.

Title: The Path Forward
Objective: Call down a Lightforged Beacon.
Text: We must continue on, but I feel Mac'Aree is far from finished with us. We should take advantage of this relative safety while we still can. I will place a signal beacon that will allow the Vindicaar to lock onto our location. Romuul will send us our means of returning to the Vindicaar if there is a need.

Title: Using Lost Knowledge
Objective: Start a Research Work Order.
Text: I'm not sure you realize what this tome could mean for us. We can find even more knowledge on your artifacts to help the war effort!Let's begin immediately. On your command, we stand by to begin researching again.

Title: Alone in the Abyss
Objective: Speak to Grand Artificer Romuul to disembark the Vindicaar.
Text: Champion, we will suffer the same fate as the Army of the Light if the Legion fires that infernal weapon upon us. We must descend into the siege camp below and destroy it while we still can!

Title: Speaker of the Horde
Objective: Establish your Embassy.
Text: Your Horde has grown powerful, eclipsing some of de troll empires in its magnitude. For saving my daughter, you have earned de right to a presence in my city. Since my daughter has taken such a fondness to you, you may join her in de Great Seal beneath us. De servants there will answer to you now. Talanji seems excited by whatever she has planned for your people. I look forward to being amused by it later. Zolani can show you a way down dat does not involve falling.

Title: Deterrent
Objective: Collect 6 Amani Heads from Tal'aman and 6 Sandfury Heads from Tal'farrak.
Text: General Jakra'zet had orders to ensure dis place had protection. Guard protection. I see none of dat. Jakra'zet is a stubborn general, and one I have had my eye on for a while now. Regardless, we must remind dese lesser tribes who rules dis city with a message dey will understand. I charge you with collecting heads. Enter Tal'farrak and Tal'aman, and collect a quota of heads.

Title: Rastakhan
Objective: Meet King Rastakhan.
Text: You stand before General Jakra'zet, lord of de armies of Zandalar, enforcer of her seas and bringer of war.And I do not like you.It took years to earn my place here after your Horde laid waste to my people. You will not undo what I have built.I will see you kneel before King Rastakhan. I will watch you beg as he lets me take your head for a trophy. I will fling your corpse into de wastes of Vol'dun.Her "Highness" may object... but she is not queen yet.Come. Let us fly to your fate.

Title: Punishment of Tal'farrak
Objective: Collect the tongues of Ghaz'ragon.
Text: De Sandfury tribe may have had a hand in some crime around here, but it is really their false belief system dat makes dem do dis sort of thing. Enter Tal'farrak, bang de gong within, and face de hydra dey keep as a sacred pet. Bring me dis thing's tongues.

Title: The Shadow of the Sentinax
Objective: Bring the Broken Sentinax Beacon to Warmage Kath'leen in Deliverance Point.
Text: This device appears to be used to relay messages to the large demon ship up above. Unfortunately, it is cracked and unresponsive. Perhaps someone at Deliverance Point will know more about these beacons.

Title: Punishment of Tal'aman
Objective: Challenge 4 Amani Disciples.
Text: Look, Zolani is going about dis all wrong. If you want de Amani, or anyone, to pay attention, take out their leaders. Go into Tal'aman and look for their mighty gong. Challenge four of their disciples to combat and slay dem.

Title: The Wolf's Tale
Objective: Find Goldrinn outside of the Stormrage Barrow Dens.
Text: Goldrinn sure didn't take any time getting out of here, did he? Let's go see if we can find him outside.

Title: Shakedown
Objective: Slay 15 Dockside Ruffians.
Text: Where are de guards?Princess Talanji has convinced King Rastakhan to permit outsiders in our port. For de first time in centuries, we have allowed non-trolls to set foot on our shores and peddle their wares.And now trolls of lesser tribes seem to think dey can take advantage of these merchants?I will not allow dis sort of behavior. While I investigate why de merchants are not protected, I want you to work your way through de bazaar and slay any thugs you find.Send dem a message.

Title: The Alliance Way
Objective: Walk with King Varian Wrynn.
Text: I only recently received word that some of your kind might be coming our way. I'd be glad to call you an ally, if you're willing to join our cause. Walk with me.

Title: The Dark Shaman
Objective: Defeat Dark Shaman Koranthal and Lava Guard Gordoth.
Text: These dark shaman have been down here for months, raising beasts and performing dark rituals. I don't know what they aim to achieve with all of this, but it's clear that they are no friend of the Horde. That's where you come in. Fight your way through the chasm and kill Dark Shaman Koranthal and Lava Guard Gordoth.

Title: No Orc Left Behind
Objective: Rescue 5 Kor'kron Scouts in Ragefire Chasm.
Text: This was supposed to be a routine sweep. Clean up a few troggs, make sure there is no threat to the city and then be in the tavern by midday. Instead I've a group of scouts missing, flame hounds pouring out of the chasm and Xorenth going on about "the next twilight's hammer."  Go in there and get my scouts back so we can figure out what is going on down here.

Title: Open the Golden Doors
Objective: Defeat the Mogu Crypt Guardian.
Text: Defeat the mogu crypt guardian to open the golden doors.

Title: Joining the Alliance
Objective: Speak with King Anduin Wrynn at Stormwind Keep.
Text: We have a duty. It is our responsibility to spread the Tushui philosophy beyond the edges of the Wandering Isle... and there is no better place to start doing that than here: Stormwind City, heart of the Alliance. Let's find out who their leader is. We need allies.

Title: Do a Barrel Roll!
Objective: Pick up a keg near Lao-Chin, roll it downhill at the yaungol, and ignite it near them to destroy 4 Osul Treelaunchers and 50 Osul Invaders.
Text: When I trained as a Brewmaster, I didn't expect to use my knowledge like this...Did you know beer catches fire when lit? Well, with yaungol oil mixed in, it's downright explosive.I've mixed the oil in with these kegs. Roll them at the yaungol over by the gate, and ignite them when you get close.It'll take a few seconds for the keg to blow, but when it does...Well, let's just say I wouldn't want to be over there.Which is why I'll be over here. Mourning the loss of this brew.

Title: Ancient Mogu Crypt
Objective: Kill the possessed Shado-Pan Leader and cleanse the Pool of Life.
Text: Our scouting party got DESTROYED. Help!

Title: An Old Pit Fighter
Objective: Spar with King Varian Wrynn.
Text: I need to know if you can fight. There may come a time where you will be called upon for military matters, and I need to know that you can protect my kingdom. I've heard stories about pandaren fighting techniques, but I've never seen them in person. Shall we?

Title: Heroes of the Shado-Pan
Objective: Return with Hawkmaster Nurong to Taran Zhu at Rensai's Watchpost.
Text: You said that Taran Zhu is in Townlong and was asking for me? Must be something important...

Title: Hostile Skies
Objective: Shoot down 50 Kor'thik Swarmers and Voress'thalik.
Text: We're about to get hit hard... Pick up that cannon there and lend a hand, if you would. There will be no shortage of targets.

Title: Taoshi and Korvexxis
Objective: Kill Korvexxis with the aid of Taoshi.
Text: Taoshi is setting up an ambush for one of the mantid leaders on the south side of Sik'vess. She is tasked with retrieving his crystal so that we can use it to open the door. Two are stronger than one. I want you there to make sure it goes smoothly.

Title: Animal Control
Objective: Kill Adarogg and Slagmaw.
Text: The chasm is overrun with flame hounds and lava worms, and they will be entrenched indefinitely with such a large supply of trogg flesh for food. This infestation needs to be taken care of now, before they endanger the city. You look like you can handle yourself. I want you to clear a path through the beasts and make certain to take out the largest threats, Adjules and Magnaw.

Title: Joining the Hunt
Objective: Ride with Taran Zhu, Taoshi, and Lao-Chin to Rensai's Watchpost.
Text: We are one stronger. Your help is invaluable. Let's move on westward to Rensai's Watchpost to find the last member for our party.

Title: Raising Spirits
Objective: Throw 8 Iron Belly Spirits to nearby Dusklight Skirmishers and Dusklight Rangers.
Text: The kegs are full of my worst stock. Good for burning, crap for drinking. I've broken out some tankards of my best spirits and had them carried out amongst the kegs though - those are for my well-deserving men! Spirits to raise their spirits after endless, grueling fighting. Would you be up for spreading the good cheer?

Title: Devastation Below
Objective: Defeat Voress'thalik with the aid of Hawkmaster Nurong.
Text: Let's get down there and finish that big bug off, you and I.

Title: Grounded Welcome
Objective: Kill 12 grounded Kor'thik Fleetwings.
Text: All of my men are down at Farwatch Overlook to the southwest, holding off mantid that are trying to fly across the chasm. As long as my marksmen have arrows, they'll ground any mantid that clear the chasm. If you're here to help, I could use some more men clearing the mantid out once they're on the ground. Are you willing?

Title: The Taking of Dusklight Bridge
Objective: Help Lao-Chin the Iron Belly hold the far side of the Dusklight Bridge.
Text: Let's press these insects back across the bridge and break their spirits! Follow my lead.

Title: Up In Flames
Objective: Kill 10 Kor'thik Timberhusks with the aid of Lao-Chin's kegs.
Text: The mantid coming across the bridge have thick carapaces that shrug off most of our attacks. They have a weakness though: fire. Lao-Chen's men brought kegs to the battlefield for exactly this purpose. Kick the kegs into groups of mantid, and Lao-Chin's archers will light them up. They should be easy to finish off from there.

Title: Herding Cats
Objective: Collect 8 Litters of Xuen.
Text: Xuen trusted me to watch kittens. I like kittens. They are small things and funny. But I lost kittens. They are strong and many. Xuen sure to say I can no longer watch kittens. I must find kittens. Will you help? Take my special cage and it will put them in a safe place.

Title: A New Enemy
Objective: Collect 5 Corrupted Insignia from any cultist in Ragefire Chasm.
Text: The power of these Dark Shaman has attracted many allies. Former members of the Horde that now work towards some dark purpose. We need to make an example of them before we have another twilight's hammer on our hands. Kill any cultist you come across and bring me their insignia.

Title: Taking Stock
Objective: Gather 120 Shado-Pan Fire Arrows.
Text: I was dispatched back to camp to gather pitch-tipped arrows for our archers at the bridge, and this is what I came to. I trained with most of these pandaren... I wasn't prepared for this. Still, the archers at the bridge need our help. If you could help gather arrows from the wreckage, then maybe we can salvage something from this horror.

Title: The Sha of Hatred
Objective: Defeat the Sha of Hatred.
Text: The end of our hunt is upon us. We have gathered the strongest the Shado-Pan have to offer, and with your strength to aid us, we will defeat the Sha of Hatred and choke out its influence on the world. When we enter the tunnel, stay close, and keep hatred clear from your heart. The fight ahead will put all of us to the test. Whatever happens, it has been an honor traveling beside you.

Title: Free the Dissenters
Objective: Rescue 6 Inkgill Dissenters in Inkgill Mere.
Text: Not all of my fellow villagers from Inkgill are corrupted. Many heeded my warnings and did not drink of the sha-tainted waters. They are in hiding, terrified, and intimidated by the guards. Please, tell them there is hope! Go into the village to the north. Speak with them and send them to me.

Title: A Proper Poultice
Objective: Obtain 11 Mao-Willows.
Text: A dry bandage doesn't do much good, other than maybe keeping bugs out of the wound. In some camps, that's the best you can hope for. Not in my camp, though. I prefer to make a paste from whatever soothing herbs I can find, and layer that between bandages. The most soothing herbs I've been able to find in the field are the Mao-Willows from the fields in the northeast. If you run into any, bring them back.

Title: Enraged By Hatred
Objective: Kill 9 Seething Fleshrippers.
Text: These scorpions are infected with sha. It seems to have driven them out of their hole and into our camp, seething with hatred at invaders in their territory. We need to clear the scorpions and secure the camp. Kill any you find.

Title: Returning from the Pass
Objective: Report in to Taran Zhu at the Gao-Ran Battlefront.
Text: I still have some cleanup to do here in the pass - there are some mantid still making it through. You're a valuable person to have at hand though, and I know Taran wouldn't appreciate me keeping you longer for such basic work. Taran should still be in the main camp with Gao-Ran. Report back in. I'll catch up with you a bit later.

Title: Joining the Fight
Objective: Bring the Quiver of Shado-Pan Fire Arrows to Lao-Chin the Iron Belly at Dusklight Bridge.
Text: Lao-Chin's archers will need these arrows down at the bridge. Can you bring them?

Title: The Big Guns
Objective: Destroy 3 Sra'thik War Wagons.
Text: The mantid now surround the Temple with their infernal war wagons. The sooner we are rid of those things, the better. You could destroy them with your own weapons and spells, but this will work much faster.  Beware of retaliation from mantid that remain be inside the war wagon when it explodes. In fact, I'd stay as far away from those things as possible.

Title: The Siege Swells
Objective: Defeat 25 Sra'thik attackers at Niuzao Temple.
Text: Today's mantid swarm is among the worst I've seen. We are lucky to have Niuzao join us in battle. Help him. Return to the courtyard, and join in the defense of our temple.

Title: The Overwhelming Swarm
Objective: Defeat 4 Sra'thik Kunchong.
Text: I command the sentinels of Niuzao. Every defender out there can hold his own against the mantid swarm. The kunchong, however, are something different.
