They are massive, violent, and without a question the biggest threat to my sentinels' lives. Only Niuzao stands a chance against them. Niuzao... and perhaps you.

Title: Savior of the Inkgill
Objective: Speak with Waterspeaker Gorai at the southwestern edge of Jinyu Mere.
Text: I will go now to return to my kinsmen. Please visit us back at the southwestern edge of the Mere, so that we may thank you.

Title: The Field Armorer
Objective: Obtain 120 Rankbite Shell Fragments.
Text: The Shado-Pan fight. As such, their armor often gets cut, scratched, torn, and burned. And it's my job to repair it. I'm no armorer, but I can repair a broken piece of mail as long as the hole's not too big. I prefer to use shell fragments from the tortoises that live in the wild fields to the northeast. Get some for me, and I can keep more Shado-Pan armored and alive.

Title: In Battle's Shadow
Objective: Throw 10 Loose Stones up to Niuzao Stonemasons.
Text: Niuzao's appearance on the battlefield is a blessing... in more ways than one. With the distraction that he's caused, our stonemasons have seized the opportunity to build up our crumbling walls. They could use your help. Toss any loose bricks you find up their way. And hurry! Niuzao will not rampage forever.

Title: Paying Tribute
Objective: Obtain 6 stores of Niuzao Food. Your Niuzao Strongarm will carry the food for you.
Text: Our patron Niuzao is a mountain on wheels... very difficult to move, even more difficult to stop. My point: once we get him moving, the mantid will have their arms full trying to slow him down. The easiest way to get him moving is to put food in front of him. Luckily for us, food in our temple is plentiful... even in wartime. I will send one of my strongarms with you, to shoulder the load.

Title: A Blade is a Blade
Objective: Obtain 10 Sra'thik Weapons.
Text: This is no time to hold to tradition. Our masons' calloused hands bleed and tremble. Our blacksmiths cannot forge weapons as quickly as our sentinels can break them. It is time to fight smart. Many of the mantid come bearing weapons, and when they die, they simply leave them on the battlefield. It would be a shame to see them go to waste.

Title: Fallen Sentinels
Objective: Heal 8 Wounded Niuzao Sentinels above 50% health. You may use the Yak's Milk Flasks or your own healing spells and abilities.
Text: Our sentinels can fight for days on end, but even they have their limits. Since the mantid swarm began, too many of them have pushed themselves beyond their abilities. Please, aid them in whatever way you can. If you are unable to heal them yourself, you may give them some of this. A mouthful of nutritious yak's milk will give them the strength they need.

Title: Return to the Vindicaar
Objective: Return to the Vindicaar.
Text: That pit lord won't trouble our new allies any longer.  Until another takes its place, at least. If there's one thing I've learned in our endless war against the Legion, it's to savor victories as you find them. Come, let us take a moment to regroup back at your vessel. Alleria and I have been waiting a long time for a reunion with our son.

Title: Vengeance Point
Objective: Defeat the Legion siege on Vengeance Point and report to Izal Whitemoon.
Text: On my way here, I ran across a squad of demon hunters headed northwest to Vengeance Point. You can bet the Legion will try to stop them from establishing a forward position.I spoke to an elf named Izal Whitemoon. Not the friendliest sort, but I'm sure she'd be grateful if you lent the Illidari a hand... whether she admits it or not.

Title: The Word of Zul
Objective: Deliver the Words of Zul to various individuals in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: I have a mundane task for you. Our esteemed Prophet Zul has words to distribute to very specific individuals in de port. And he requested you be de one to deliver dem. Don't ask me why he didn't just have you deliver these when you were here de first time. De prophet is notorious for not sharing all of his visions.

Title: Prisoners No More
Objective: Rescue 10 Darkfallen Slaves from the Annihilan Pits.
Text: Hatuun's people have endured arduous times. Their numbers dwindle as those ripped from beyond the walls of their sanctuary become servants to the annihilan lords in the pits just beyond, sentenced to a life of labor, torture and ultimately, death.Seek out these captives, release them from their bonds and show our allies we stand as one against the Burning Legion.

Title: Threat Reduction
Objective: Slay Kar'aaz, Xeth'tal, and Magraloth in the Annihilan Pits.
Text: In time, Hatuun and his people will set aside their bitterness and become valuable allies. But their trust must be earned. He says their village is beset by a demon called Aggonar and his cruel kin. We need these fiends out of the way before we can seek out Alleria and the others. The chieftain lent us his horn. Use it to call down his people's vengeance upon the demon lieutenants while I carve a path to Aggonar's lair.

Title: From Darkness
Objective: Walk with High Exarch Turalyon.
Text: I'm afraid it's only a matter of time before our presence is known. We must begin our preparations at once.

Title: Khazaduum, First of His Name
Objective: Retrieve the Argunite Keystone from the Echo of Khazaduum.
Text: The Argunite Matrix that powered this part of Mac'Aree was shattered by a hulking beast. We had never seen another like him. He was called Khazaduum and he was a most faithful servant of the Legion. He volunteered to undergo an experimental transformation to become the first of his kind. His arrival was the end of this battle. As a prize he took the Argunite Keystone from the shattered matrix. Take it back and we can finally end this bloodshed.

Title: A Strike at the Heart
Objective: Slay Aggonar.
Text: These pits have long been a blight upon the lives of our new allies. The demons hunt them down and torture the poor souls for sport.  It is time to make them pay for their cruelty and restore hope to this Light-forsaken place. We strike on your mark.

Title: Aalgen Point
Objective: Speak with Heidirk the Scalekeeper at Aalgen Point.
Text: You wanna hold territory on this chunder puddle of an island, right? Right. That means linkin' up with camps on the outskirts, mate.I know this bloke called Heidirk. Scrappy fella, loves to get into the thick of it. Headed out to the eastern coast with those drakes of his.Have a look for him. Remind him he owes me a pint or two!

Title: Meld Into the Shadows
Objective: Return to the Hall of Shadows, and meet Lord Jorach Ravenholdt.
Text: We should meet back up with the rest of the council and tell them of what we have achieved this day. At your leisure, return to us. We shall be waiting.

Title: Revelations
Objective: Speak with the Zandalari Prisoner.
Text: The prisoner is being kept upstairs. It will be difficult to get information from him, but even the slightest detail about their location will help. The elders have begun questioning him already. With their help we should be able to figure out our next move. Go speak with him and see if he has any useful information.

Title: Preparing Zouchin Village
Objective: Assist Elder Shu and Steelbender Doshu in preparing Zouchin Village for battle.
Text: The village elders seem to think the Thunder King's remains are being kept nearby. They have also expressed some concern with our presence here. They fear this will provoke another attack on their village. While our priority is in getting the remains back we cannot leave the villagers defenseless. Speak with Elder Shu and Steelbender Doshu and see what can be done to help.

Title: Handle With Care
Objective: Bring Elder Shu 50 Volatile Blooms.
Text: I've seen the numbers these invaders have brought with them, this will not be an easy victory. I do know of one thing that may help us gain an advantage. There is a plant that grows around the village that can be used to make a rather effective explosive liquid. If you can gather enough I can begin brewing the mixture. The plant you are looking for is appropriately named volatile bloom. Handle it with care.

Title: It Takes A Village
Objective: Relieve the Exhausted Defenders from their guard posts.
Text: The villagers have been guarding Zouchin since the first attack. They are exhausted and many are injured. If the Zandalari attack again the last thing we need is for the defenders to fall asleep on the job. Relieve them of their posts so that they might have time to heal and see their families. You'll find them stationed around the village.

Title: Make A Fighter Out of Me
Objective: Kill 4 Amani Skirmishers, 4 Gurubashi Hexxers, and 3 Drakkari Frostweavers in Zouchin Province.
Text: Shhh! Don't speak so loudly! My father might hear you.  My father is delusional! He thinks I should be studying my tea pouring while our village is under attack. It's ridiculous! I have just as much courage as any man. I just don't know how to fight... yet. That's where you come in. Let me travel with you! I'm a fast learner and I won't get in the way I promise! Pleaseeeeee! If we get separated I'll meet you back in the village.

Title: Criteria Effects Test Quest
Objective: Interact with the quest objectives and make sure their icons work.
Text: Hello friend! Let's test some things, shall we? Click on the gear! Chat with the bubble! Heal the Green Sparkle! Kill the kill target! Click on the gearbody's corpse! The loudspeaker should announce your progress. After each objective, you will explode. (Sorry about that last bit.)

Title: Pick a Yak
Objective: Use the Yak Lasso on Wild Townlong Yaks, then fight against them to see if they are suitable for Bluesaddle.
Text: I can't find a single good yak here. ALL the yaks are bad! Some are too stinky, some too fight-y, others just scared. You look like a lucky . Here, take a lasso. See if you can find a good yak for me.

Title: Seeking Father
Objective: Search for Sentinel Ku-Yao.
Text: I've searched everywhere... but I haven't found my father. I KNOW he's alive still. He just needs his crossbow... then he'll be OK. I've heard that you Shado-Pan guys sometimes fight the mantid on Sra'vess. I don't have any way of getting there. If you ever go over there, can you look for my dad?

Title: Fisherman's Tale
Objective: Speak with Mishi to travel to the Path of Conquerors. From there find Shin Whispercloud at Whispercloud Rise.
Text: The villagers of Zouchin know the coast better than anyone in Kun-Lai. If the Zandalari are hiding on one of the islands, they will know. Mishi will take you as far as Emperor's Path. I will go ahead to speak with the village elders. Follow the path to Whispercloud Rise. Shin Whispercloud will help you reach the village.

Title: What's Yours Is Mine
Objective: Retrieve 6 Stolen Weapons from the Zandalari Invaders.
Text: The elders want us to mount a defense? We're not monks; we need weapons if we hope to fight! Scavenge some arms from those barbarians for me. I should be able to melt them down and make something more suitable for our villagers to fight with. Bring me as many as you can carry and I'll take care of the rest.

Title: Bad Yak
Objective: Help Bluesaddle replace his defective yak.
Text: Is this the place where they replace defective yaks? Can anybody help me out, here?

Title: The Wisdom of Niuzao
Objective: Speak with Ogo the Younger at Niuzao Temple in the Townlong Steppes.
Text: Niuzao, the Black Ox, rests in the temple to the west. He may know why the mantid are attacking. He may, in fact, know much more than that. I will rendezvous with you at Niuzao Temple.

Title: The Terrible Truth
Objective: Investigate the Niuzao Catacombs, then slay the Dread Shadow that dwells within.
Text: It is with a heavy heart that I confirm your suspicions. The mantid are indeed under the sway of the Sha of Fear. It was OUR sworn duty to confine that creature beneath our temple. Unfortunately, our vigil faltered, our defenses buckled, and the sha escaped. It is with the mantid now. See for yourself. The mantid burrowed into the western side of our island.

Title: My Father's Crossbow
Objective: Obtain Ku-Yao's Crossbow.
Text: I came here to visit my dad at the temple. As soon as I got here, I saw the most terrifying thing I've ever seen. It was a mantid, walking right past me, carrying my father's crossbow. Something's happened to my dad! We've got to find out what it is... but first, we'll need his crossbow back. I saw him heading west, behind the temple.

Title: A Trail of Fear
Objective: Kill 12 Dreadlings within the Niuzao Catacombs.
Text: You now know Niuzao's secret. We are not only the wardens of this temple... we were the wardens of the Sha of Fear that was buried beneath it. The Sha itself may have escaped... but it left traces behind. If you're truly going down into the catacombs, you should eliminate those traces, before they escape and cause greater problems than those we already face.

Title: Father's Footsteps
Objective: Find Father's Bedroll, Father's Shield, Ha-Cha, and Sentinel Yalo.
Text: Yes, the boy's father - Sentinel Ku-Yao - has gone missing. He could be any number of places... we have no shortage of enemies these days. You're free to look around, if you wish. You might start by looking for his yak, or by asking Sentinel Yalo what he knows.

Title: Give Them Peace
Objective: Give peace to 10 Fear-Stricken Sentinels by closing their eyes and placing them on their bellies.
Text: I overheard. Our secret is out, then. When I learned that the mantid had burrowed beneath our temple, I reacted hastily. I sent dozens of guardians to defend what they could, but they were not prepared. They succumbed to fear, and never returned. A pandaren deserves to die embracing the ground, as he does in sleep... not flat on his back with his eyes transfixed in terror. Please. Give them the peace they deserve.

Title: Niuzao's Price
Objective: Kill the mantid of the Sra'thik Incursion so that Tai Ho can search their bodies for pieces of Niuzao's statuette.
Text: Niuzao owns a statuette which he values greatly: a small icon, in his image, sculpted by one of his long-since fallen sentinels. This statuette was recently stolen by the Sra'thik mantid, and taken to their encampment to our north. Bring back this statuette. Then we will give you - and your Shado-Pan associate - the answers you seek.

Title: Natural Antiseptic
Objective: Obtain 5 Full Mushan Bladders.
Text: The Shado-Pan are rare, elite, and quite expensive to train and replace. We can't afford to have any falling to a poisoned weapon or an infected cut. That's why I need you to get... something. Let me be blunt. Mushan urine is a great, natural antiseptic. They produce a large amount of it, which is lucky... because we tend to use a lot.

Title: Greenstone Village
Objective: Rescue all the villagers.
Text: Please help! We paid some adventurers to run off all the elemental spirits and now they're back for revenge!

Title: Round 4: Master Windfur
Objective: Defeat Master Windfur.
Text: Well done, challenger. You have reached the final round. Your last opponent is a powerful master of the winds. He has defended his people for many years and stood as champion on more than one occasion. Face this Master Windfur in the main arena when you are ready. And challenger... good luck.

Title: Round 4: The P.U.G.
Objective: Defeat Hackiss, Healiss and Tankiss.
Text: And now the final round. I have selected three challengers for you to face. This may seem unfair... to a weakling. You are not a weakling, correct? Go to the main temple, stand in the grand arena, and face these three challengers. Prove you are stronger than their combined power! Good luck, Challenger!

Title: The Motives of the Mantid
Objective: Slay mantid in Kri'vess so Tai Ho can look for clues on their bodies.
Text: . You may be of assistance. The Shado-Pan wishes to know why the mantid are attacking so violently. We have our suspicions, but we cannot be sure. Furthermore, we do not want the mantid to know that we are investigating them. That's where you come in. I need you to kill the mantid of Kri'vess, in the north. I will lurk behind you in the shadows, and search for clues on their bodies.

Title: Along the Southern Front
Objective: Ride with Taran Zhu and Taoshi to Dusklight Hollow.
Text: I'm heading westward with Taoshi to gather the strongest I can find to confront the Sha of Hatred. I would like you to come with me.

Title: Set the Mantid Back
Objective: Use Gunpowder Casks to explode the Kri'thik Weapons and the Kri'thik Supplies in Kri'vess.
Text: Every day, the mantid build up munitions for use on their enemies. We cannot stop them, just you and I... but we can set them back.  I need to keep a low profile. Would you do the honors?

Title: Hui's Vengeance
Objective: Defeat Vengeful Hui.
Text: I am ashamed to ask, but for Greenstone's sake... might we now trouble you to face Vengeful Hui on our behalf...?

Title: Cutting the Swarm
Objective: Use a Dragon Launcher to kill 50 swarming mantid.
Text: The mantid numbers have been increasing since you left for the cleft. Let's put these orbs you gathered to use. Get down on the battlefront and man one of the cannons. Let none through.

Title: Thieves and Troublemakers
Objective: Kill 10 Agitated Nettleskins.
Text: I can't catch the little buggers for the life of me. Kill any you can get your hands on. And keep a close eye on your valuables, they like to steal anything that isn't tied down.

Title: In Skilled Hands
Objective: Bring the Shado-Pan Crossbow Bolt Bundle to Hawkmaster Nurong.
Text: , take these crossbow bolts and then bring them to Hawkmaster Nurong at Farwatch Overlook to the southwest. Nurong is praised among all the Wukao for being a flawless shot. His efforts are credited with holding the line here for these many months. I'm hoping you can work with him and judge for yourself. He may be the final Shado-Pan we need for the hunt.

Title: In the Wrong Hands
Objective: Recover Initiate Chao's Sword.
Text: Look... um... this is really embarrassing. I set down my sword for like ONE SECOND to gather some orbs, and a big sprite sprung out of nowhere, snatched it, and bounded off down the western gap. I can't go back to camp without it. Losing your weapon is a sure way to get kicked out of the Shado-Pan. It's sacred. Please, can you try to find this big sprite and get my sword back? It would mean a lot to me.

Title: Rendezvous
Objective: Use the Signal Crystal to call down a Lightforged Beacon from the Vindicaar.
Text: There is much to be done before this nightmare can end, but we need to regroup before we draw more attention from the Legion. I managed to retain a signal crystal during the crash used to call transport beacons from the Xenedar. With luck, we should be able to use it to establish a link between here and your forces as well.

Title: Defenseless and Afraid
Objective: Collect Stolen Pylon Cores from enemies in Triumvirate's End and use them to activate 3 Ancient Pylons.
Text: This is the battle that raged while I awaited the Genedar. So many ran to join me, but Kil'jaeden inspired still more to stand in their way. My people were slaughtered without mercy. To cover our retreat I ordered for this arena's defenses to be activated. It is clear that they were unable. To turn the tide in this battle, to give these spirits rest, we must do what they could not. Find a way to activate the pylons.

Title: Improvised Ammunition
Objective: Recover 16 Volatile Dread Orbs from the Ambermarsh.
Text: I've got another job for you. The dragon cannons we depend on to keep the thicker swathes of mantid back are running low on ammo. The camp's cannoneers developed an improvised explosive that's made from the globe seeds down the western ridge. They dispatched a couple initiates to bring some back hours ago, but have heard nothing from them. I want to send someone a bit more capable to make sure that this gets taken care of. Are you my  for this?

Title: Mac'Aree, Jewel of Argus
Objective: Descend to Mac'Aree with Velen.
Text: The shattered ruin below us is all that remains of Mac'Aree. We called it the Jewel of Argus. It was here that my fellows in the triumvirate guided our people to prosperity. That was a long time ago.  Join me on the surface. We will begin our search for the Crown of the Triumvirate.

Title: Terror of the Dread Wastes
Objective: Defeat Norvakess, the Terror of the Dread Wastes.
Text: That thing is huge! The Shado-Pan holding the battlefront were never trained for something like this... let's get down there and take it out ourselves.

Title: Draconic Secrets
Objective: Interrogate Trizormu in Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight, then follow the Lich King's plan.
Text: Arthas never found the prize he sought, Deathlord.It is ours by right.The dragons must know where the resting place of their kin resides.Find a member of the bronze flight, the tenders of history. Do not be merciful.

Title: Delivering Lost Knowledge
Objective: Speak with the artifact researcher in your class order hall.
Text: The very nature of this ancient night elf tome causes the book to seek out knowledge. This could prove to be a serious boon to your efforts to research your artifact weapon.I'd wager the scholars in your order hall would find it of great use, possibly unlocking new avenues of empowerment.I suggest you take it to them immediately. We need every advantage possible against the Legion!

Title: To the Forge It Goes...
Objective: Take the Gladiator's Tattered Cloak to the Obliterum Forge in Dalaran and use the forge to obliterate it, then take the result to Marshal Frazer in Greyfang Enclave.
Text: This cloak is too tattered to be usable, but can be obliterated at the Obliterum Forge in Dalaran.

Title: The Deceiver's Downfall
Objective: Enter the Tomb of Sargeras and defeat Kil'jaeden.
Text: Once he was as a brother to me. Then he bartered the soul of my world for his own power. Hounded my people across the stars. Twisted my son into a monster.Now he has come to oversee the final assault on Azeroth. To end this world as he has countless others.Kil'jaeden.We must ensure he does not escape our grasp this time. Storm the tomb. Break the Legion's hold. End the Deceiver's reign.

Title: The Lost Glacier
Objective: Travel to the Lost Glacier.
Text: Do you know why the red dragonflight seeks to prevent us from finding our prize?The bones of a great red dragon teem with the essence of life, even decades after its passing.You will consume this life essence, blight it, and turn it to undeath.And then you will raise a dragon.Fly now into the north. Find this glacier, and your destiny.

Title: Paragon of the Dreamweavers
Objective: Speak with Sylvia Hartshorn in Val'sharah.
Text: The grateful druids of the Dreamweavers have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your exceptional aid.

Title: Paragon of Highmountain
Objective: Speak with Ransa Greyfeather in Highmountain.
Text: The grateful Highmountain Tribes have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your exceptional aid.

Title: Fashion History and a Philosophy of Style
Objective: Learn from Eliezer Hammerbeard how to create "flair and drama" in your wardrobe.
Text: Greetings. I am a fashion historian and I have astonishing advancements in tailoring, leatherworking, and blacksmithing that I must share with you. Why? A true legend is only as good as their ability to form an epic silhouette on the battlefield and--let's be honest--this is not where you shine. Speak to me again if you wish to learn.

Title: Paragon of the Valarjar
Objective: Speak with Valdemar Stormseeker in Stormheim.
Text: The impressed vrykul of the Valarjar have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your exceptional aid.

Title: Paragon of the Legionfall Armies
Objective: Speak with Captain Ruysantos on the Broken Shore.
Text: Your loyal forces in the Armies of Legionfall have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your exceptional aid.

Title: Paragon of the Wardens
Objective: Speak with Marin Bladewing in Azsuna.
Text: The impressed Wardens have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your exceptional aid.

Title: Paragon of the Nightfallen
Objective: Speak with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Suramar.
Text: A very grateful Thalyssra has requested your presence. She wishes to reward you for your exceptional aid.

Title: The Endless Swarm
Objective: Kill 12 Krik'thik attackers at the Gao-Ran Battlefront.
Text: Gao-ran's men need help down on the southern front. If you want to stand by the Shado-Pan, that's where you should do it.

Title: Rummaging Through the Remains
Objective: Recover 20 Krik'thik Limbs.
Text: I do have another task for you, though it's a might grim. I really need to get to the bottom of this mantid poison, but to do that, I need more information directly from the source. While you're down on the southern battlefield, could you bring me back some mantid limbs so that I can examine their intact poison glands.

Title: Treatment for the Troops
Objective: Collect 10 Violet Citron.
Text: A new face! Pleasure to meet you. I'm Septi. I keep the Shado-Pan fighting. The mantid have poison that chews through the skin and infects the blood. It makes for a slow, excruciating death when not treated. I need pollen from the violet citron flowers. The nearest place to find them is around Dampsoil Burrow just north of the battlefront. If you happen to go in that direction, could you bring some back for me?

Title: Trap Setting
Objective: Rearm 8 Shado-Pan Spike Traps.
Text: Good to meet you. We have traps all along the pass to help us catch mantid that might be sneaking through, but their numbers have been so great that most of the traps have already been triggered. Taoshi said you might be able to reset some of them while you're out there. Can you help?

Title: The Restless Watch
Objective: Deliver return orders to Scout Wei-Chin, Scout Long, Scout Ying, and Scout Jai-Gan.
Text: I'm being told that our scouts have been on duty in Shallowstep Pass for more than 2 days straight, no rest. No wonder mantid are slipping through. Even the most dedicated scouts would slip with those kinds of shifts. I want you to go out there and deliver orders to the scouts that they are to return to the battlefront immediately for rest and rations. I'll arrange for a new shift to be posted.

Title: Unwelcome Intruders
Objective: Kill 12 Krik'thik Deep-scouts with Taoshi's help.
Text: Those are mantid scouts down there. Gao-Ran's Battlefront is meant to keep them out of eastern Townlong Steppes. If we allow them north of the barricade, we may lose our foothold here. Let's clear them out. I'll be with you.

Title: Back on Their Feet
Objective: Heal 8 Injured Gao-Ran Blackguards.
Text: , I could use your help. With their long shifts, our warriors down at the southern front of the battlefront are fighting to the point of exhaustion, and many of them have been exposed to the mantid poison. We need more people to tend to the wounded. I've prepared some bandages with the herbs you brought me, but if you have some healing skills, those might work even better. Please, get our men back on their feet so that they can get back here to safety.

Title: Behind the Battlefront
Objective: Meet with Taoshi at Dampsoil Burrow.
Text: This battlefront has been undermanned and unsupplied for too long during my absence in Kun-Lai. We need to get things back in order here before we can pick up the trail of the Sha of Hatred. Taoshi is my best. I've sent her north to investigate rumors of mantid that have somehow made it through the battlefront. I need someone I can trust to get out there and work with her to plug any holes in our defenses. If my reports on you are correct, I can trust you with this, right ?

Title: Breach in the Defenses
Objective: Use the Shado-Pan Flare to aid in killing 10 Krik'thik Scentlayers.
Text: Normally, it only takes a few scouts to hold this pass. Most of this territory is in sight of the wall, so archers would devastate any mantid force attempting to push through here. The problem is, most of the archers are occupied with the onslaught at the gate. Take this flare - it will help you locate the mantid that are sneaking through the eastern pass under our diminished watch. Kill any you find. We can't let them lay a trail that might lead the mantid swarms farther into the steppes.

Title: Round 2: Kang Bramblestaff
Objective: Defeat Kang Bramblestaff.
Text: Your next challenger is a Bramblestaff. Strength is in their blood. I remember a full century of only Bramblestaff champions. No pressure, little . Go to the eastern arena north of here and face this young challenger. See first hand if strength is earned or inherited.

Title: Round 1: The Streetfighter
Objective: Defeat the Streetfighter.
Text: Welcome, challenger, to my tournament of champions! Today we test the strengths of Pandaria's most dedicated heroes. Your first opponent awaits you under the eastern gazebo. Defeat her, and you may proceed to the next round. Fight with strength, fight with honor.

Title: Round 3: Master Boom Boom
Objective: Defeat Master Boom Boom.
Text: Your next challenger found his strength on a beach. Particularly in a box labeled "dynamite." He proves however that found strength can be as deadly as personal strength. When you are ready, face this Master Boom Boom in the Western Arena.

Title: Round 3: The Wrestler
Objective: Defeat The Wrestler.
Text: Your next challenger is a favorite of mine. He draws strength from raw force and determination. Plus he has a mask. Face him in the western arena when you are ready, and good luck.

Title: Round 2: Clever Ashyo & Ken-Ken
Objective: Defeat Clever Ashyo and Ken-Ken.
Text: You may know your next challengers. They were arguing fiercely when they arrived, so I have charged them with fighting side by side. This will teach them the strength of friendship, and possibly entertain me in the process. Go to the north eastern arena and face this jinyu and hozen. Do not be gentle, they need to learn to work together.

Title: The Tongue of Ba-Shon
Objective: Assist Lorekeeper Cho in performing the Binding of Ba-Shon.
Text: Thank you for coming. I am sorry to have been so cryptic, but I could not risk alerting the mogu to my work here. They are seeking something in the valley. Plundering the tombs of their old kings for relics of power. I could not observe them long before having to flee, but I did manage to recover a relic of my own. The Tongue of Ba-Shon will let us communicate securely over long distances, but only after I have bound it to myself. I think I'm ready to begin, if you are.

Title: Round 1: Brewmaster Chani
Objective: Defeat Brewmaster Chani.
Text: Welcome, Challenger, to my tournament of champions! Today we test the strengths of Pandaria's most dedicated heroes. Your first opponent awaits you under the eastern gazebo. Defeat her, and you may proceed to the next round. Fight with strength, fight with honor.

Title: Cleansing the Mere
Objective: Point out Pools of Corruption in Inkgill Mere to Waterspeaker Gorai to let him know you are ready to defend him while he completes the cleansing ritual.
Text: Pools of the same murky substance that came out of Mei emerged in the lake recently.I will travel into the Mere with you. Point out the pools of corruption that you are ready for me to cleanse.You will need to deal with whatever comes out and protect me as I complete the ritual.

Title: Father and Child Reunion
Objective: Return to Merchant Shi and Wu-Peng at the southeastern shore of Inkgill Mere in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: They survived? My father is alive!I thought we would all die here in this horrible mere, at the hands of these insane Jinyu.I will find my way back - meet me back at camp.

Title: The Fall of Shai Hu
Objective: Defeat Shai Hu. He can be found at the Waterspeaker's Sanctuary, the island in the center of Inkgill Mere in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: I can hear the voice of the Mere - it has been purified.But, this chapter in my people's history will never be closed - not until we defeat Shai Hu.He has retreated to the central island in the Mere, corrupting our holiest of sites.Beware - he is strong. But, after all we have done, I am confident we will be stronger.

Title: Gourmet Kafa
Objective: Mark 10 Kafa'goot "Deposits" on Kota Peak.
Text: It was a crazy idea: kafa berries go in the goot, seeds come out. Kafa'kota is already rare and worth a fortune, but my cousin's invention--Kafa'goot--is GOURMET. But it's over now. Uncle Keenbean is upset and peak is a muss. All that's left is to collect the rest of the Kafa'goot and never make it again. I won't ask you to gather it--kind of a mussy task, not fit for hero-- just mark it so we can find it easily when the mountain is safe again.

Title: Trouble Brewing
Objective: Kill 5 Kafa-Crazed Yetis in the caves on Kota Peak.
Text: Lots of yetis in Kota, yup. Usually not too dangerous. Usually just eat goots. Then stupid Cousin Gootfur over at Kota Basecamp fed kafa to the goots, and the yeti ate them goots. Now they're moody, cranky, sleep a lot but never seem rested. Typical kafa addicts. Gonna come outta those caves soon, I'm sure. Come lookin' for more kafa. Then we all in trouble.

Title: Kota Blend
Objective: Collect 100 Kafa'kota Berries from Kota Peak. They can be found in bushes growing on the mountainside or piled up in the yeti caves.
Text: Kota Peak is famous for its kafa bushes - no other can survive at this elevation. Grummles make very good living selling Kafa'kota Blend, but it's dangerous now thanks to our cousin. He's got the wildlife up there hooked on kafa with his scheming. Kafa'kota is more scarce than ever with goots gobblin' it up and yetis hoarding it in their caves. Uncle Keenbean will pay you good for any berries you bring down from Kota. Here, take a sample. Eat it. See for yourself the power of kafa.

Title: Preparing the Remains
Objective: Return to Li Hai and tell him about the funeral.
Text: Thank you much, friend. After this tragedy, it is good that fortune has smiled on us and sent you.You have gotten justice for my fallen friends, and gathered the necessary materials to honor them. I will gather their bodies, prepare the materials for their funerals, and meet you at the graveyard.In the meantime, however, please return to my cousin and ask him to gather the villagers for the funeral.

Title: The Burlap Grind
Objective: Speak with Kota Kon at Kota Basecamp to ride her, then kill 100 Hozen along The Burlap Trail.
Text: Alright, it's time to take Kota Kon out for her "walk." We brewed two fresh pots of kafa just for her and she's all fueled up!

Title: What Lies Beneath
Objective: Speak to Yalia Sagewhisper to begin the ceremony.
Text: If my suspicions are correct, this place still reels from some lingering darkness. Whatever happened here... it could not have been the natural course of events. Even the yaungol are not so brutal as to slaughter their own kind to the point of... this. I will use the totems that you brought me to perform a cleansing ritual. I need someone to assist me in the ceremony. Let me know when you are ready.

Title: A Funeral
Objective: Attend the funeral and light the Incense of Life.
Text: As I said, I will gather the town - we will be at the funeral.As the one who has done so much to honor our friends, we feel it is only right that you will be the one to light the Incense of Life and usher their spirits to the life beyond.

Title: Shut it Down
Objective: Kill 12 Kafa-Crazed Mountain Goats on Kota Peak.
Text: My cousin over at Kota Basecamp mussed up. He mussed up bad. He was too lazy to cut seeds out of kafa berries by hand, but he noticed goots eat the berries up and give back the seeds... in a day or so. He fed everything he had to the goots on Kota Peak and now they're nuts! Chargin' everything that moves. Kota used to be safe for Grummles to gather kafa. Not anymore. Not with them goots. Will you help?

Title: A New Fate
Objective: Return to the Temple of Five Dawns. A cart is waiting near the Skyfire Crash-Site to take you there.
Text: , I'm thankful the plan worked, but just barely. We would be sinking to the bottom of the ocean with all of Shen-zin Su if you hadn't been here. I don't think I can ever forgive Ji for this kind of recklessness. There will be plenty of time for reflection, but for now, we need to return to the Temple of Five Dawns. We need to let them know that Shen-zin Su has been saved, and we need to sort out the fates of these new allies.

Title: The Healing of Shen-zin Su
Objective: Rescue and defend healers until Shen-zin Su's wound is healed.
Text: This is what comes of such recklessness. How could he think this was even a possibility? Nevermind, there's no time for that now. We need to act to save Shen-zin Su. Find any healers you can! Rescue them, relieve them - whatever you need to do to get them over here healing the wound. Keep the healers safe at all costs!

Title: A Grummle's Luck
Objective: Find 8 Stolen Luckydos.
Text: The yaungols stole our luckydos! Mean riders with spears took them from our caravan of brothers coming down the Burlap Trail. This is very bad fortune. If the yaungol discover the secrets of luckydos all grummles will be in big trouble. Recover our luckydos from Fire Camp Ruqin north of here and we will pay many fortunes to you.

Title: The Death of Me
Objective: Remove the spear from Orbiss.
Text: I have resolved to remove this spear from my side. For this, I require your assistance. Your grasping hands are stronger than mine.

Title: Paragon of the Court
Objective: Speak with Veridis Fallon in Azsuna.
Text: The grateful Court of Farondis has requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your exceptional aid.

Title: Further Advancement
Objective: Seek out Archivist Zubashi
Text: As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Archivist Zubashi to continue advancing the Order Hall.

Title: Carried On the Wind
Objective: Return to the Maelstrom and speak with Consular Celestos.
Text: Farseer $p, Consular Celestos has requested your presence back at the Maelstrom. Please see him at your earliest convenience.

Title: A Foot in the Door
Objective: Kill 8 Osul Chargers.
Text: , you bear the marks of many a past battle. Good! We need more seasoned people like you to hold back the front. We've managed to secure a foothold here, but the yaungol are desperate to remove our presence. If you wish to prove your worth, go down the hill and show the yaungol that we will not back down.

Title: Further Advancement
Objective: Seek out Leafbeard the Storied
Text: As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Leafbeard the Storied to continue advancing the Order Hall.

Title: Further Advancement
Objective: Seek out Archon Torias
Text: As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Archon Torias to continue advancing the Order Hall.

Title: Checking In
Objective: Check on Sage Liao at the Zaochin Strand in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: When the trolls came, they brought their mercenary... friends with them. I saw them go past us, to the fishing camp in the northwest. My cousin, a healer, lives there - can you check in with him and make sure he and his village are well?

Title: Gathering of the Storms
Objective: Speak with Consular Celestos to begin the Gathering of the Storms scenario. Complete the scenario and return to Celestos.
Text: Thunderaan has asked me to send you to the Throne of the Four Winds to assist him with a situation. Speak with me again when you're ready to leave, Farseer.

Title: Further Advancement
Objective: Seek out Survivalist Bahn.
Text: As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Survivalist Bahn to continue advancing the Order Hall.

Title: Further Advancement
Objective: Seek out Number Nine Jia
Text: As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Number Nine Jia to continue advancing the Order Hall.

Title: Further Advancement
Objective: Seek out Chronicler Elrianne.
Text: As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Chronicler Elrianne to continue advancing the Order Hall.

Title: Further Advancement
Objective: Seek out Sir Alamande Graythorn
Text: As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Sir Alamande Graythorn to continue advancing the Order Hall.

Title: Further Advancement
Objective: Seek out Journeyman Goldmine.
Text: As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Journeyman Goldmine to continue advancing the Order Hall.

Title: Further Advancement
Objective: Seek out Loramus Thalipedes.
Text: As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Loramus Thalipedes to continue advancing the Order Hall.

Title: Further Advancement
Objective: Seek out Archivist Melinda
Text: As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Archivist Melinda to continue advancing the Order Hall.

Title: Further Advancement
Objective: Seek out Winstone Wolfe.
Text: As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Winstone Wolfe to continue advancing the Order Hall.

Title: Further Advancement
Objective: Seek out the Einar the Runecaster.
Text: As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Einar the Runecaster to continue advancing the Order Hall.

Title: The Bounties of Legionfall
Objective: Speak with Captain Ruysantos on the Broken Shore for your reward.
Text: t, thanks to your efforts, our forces have been able to secure additional resources from the battlefield.The more you continue to dominate the battlefield the more resources our forces can spare.

Title: The Nether Disruptor
Objective: Complete the construction of the Nether Disruptor.
Text: Well done . In testament to the efforts of all forces fighting here, we have come together to complete the construction of the Nether Disruptor.All that remains is for you to inspect our work, and complete the construction.

Title: The Command Center
Objective: Complete the construction of the Command Center.
Text: Well done . In testament to the efforts of all forces fighting here, we have come together to complete the construction of the Command Center.All that remains is for you to inspect our work, and complete the construction.

Title: The Mage Tower
Objective: Complete the construction of the Mage Tower.
Text: Well done . In testament to the efforts of all forces fighting here, we have come together to complete the construction of the Mage Tower.All that remains is for you to inspect our work, and complete the construction.

Title: The Broken Shore: Investigating the Legion
Objective: Discover a hidden Legion threat while on the Broken Shore.
Text: While we focus efforts on the Broken Shore, we must be careful to guard against other threats. We have been getting disturbing reports on the Legion starting or supporting indirect threats to Azeroth.While you are on the Broken Shore, please keep an eye out for strange objects or intelligence that could give us a clue as to what and where these threats are.I know it is not a lot to go on, we will do our best from here as well.

Title: Relieved of Their Valuables
Objective: Find 3 Hidden Wyrmtongue Caches on the Broken Shore.
Text: Not all demons on this shore stomp around in the open. Some slink about in the shadows, finding more subtle ways to advance the Legion's cause.I have been observing the behavior of smaller demons, these wyrmtongues. They seem to spend considerable time acquiring objects of power. We cannot allow them to use these items against us.The wyrmtongues stash their goods in chests spread around the Broken Shore. I suggest you relieve them of their ill-gotten gain.

Title: Lessons from History
Objective: Read the Tablet of Thunder in the Tomb of Conquerors.
Text: The Thunder King was a vicious Emperor and with the Zandalari at his side he was unstoppable. His return would surely return this land to turmoil and misery. You must locate his remains and take them somewhere safe. The Tablet of Thunder should help you figure out how to access his tomb.

Title: The Scent of Life
Objective: Gather an Opalescent Blue Crab Shell and 8 Stolen Pandaren Spices.
Text: Many have perished here. We will need to honor them properly, which means gathering the makings of incense of life.It doesn't just smell nice - it has restorative properties, and can even help plants grow. Maybe I can get a whiff of the ingredients to get me back on my feet.The materials can be found on creatures around here - except for the spices, which were stolen by the mercenaries who pillaged the village.

Title: By the Falls, For the Fallen
Objective: Gather 3 Waterfall-polished Stones.
Text: I do not wish to dishonor my friends and leave them in unmarked graves.Yet, we have never needed to bury so many at once, and I am in no condition to gather materials.Please, visit the lakes that hug the mountains edge along the road to the south. Underneath the waterfalls there, you will find stones that have been polished to a sheen by the falling water. They will make suitable headstones.

Title: Stealing Their Thunder King
Objective: Find the Bottom Fragment of Lei Shen's Tablet and restore the Tablet of Thunder.
Text: Our only hope is to find the Thunder King's remains before they do. He must be buried within the Tomb of Conquerors. Getting to his remains will not be easy. The tomb will no doubt be defended by guardians and other unfriendly surprises intended to ward off thieves. Once inside we will need to figure out where his remains have actually been placed.

Title: Chasing the Storm
Objective: Find the Blood-Revealed Map on a Zandalari Warrior.
Text: We need to figure out where they are taking the Thunder King's remains. It won't be possible for them to resurrect him in the Valley of the Emperors. They would need to be somewhere remote and secure. It appears that getting out of here may also prove to be a challenge.... Fight your way out and look for information concerning the location of the remains.

Title: The Fearmaster
Objective: Kill the Fearmaster.
Text: I am not gonna take this anymore. My wife, bless her, poured her heart and soul in to that ranch making it what it is today. Them yaungol got a leader over there being all smug and what not. I'll pay you handsomely if you knock that smug smile off his filthy, stinking, good for nothing face.

Title: Breaking the Emperor's Shield
Objective: Stop the Spiritbinding Ritual in the Tomb of Secrets.
Text: The Mogu have been scattered and sparse in number for many years. Their purpose in the valley makes sense now. With this many restless spirits they can build themselves an army using the guardians buried in each tomb. Combined with the Zandalari forces this would be devastating! The Tomb of Secrets houses elite warriors called the Emperor's Shield. They must not be resurrected! You'll find the tomb on the highest rise to the southwest.

Title: The Tomb of Shadows
Objective: Collect a rubbing of the Shen Dynasty Tablet, the Wai Dynasty Tablet, and the Qiang Dynasty Tablet in the Tomb of Shadows.
Text: Given the artifacts you found on the altar, I would guess they were attempting to perform a Spiritbinding ritual. Most of the texts involving Spiritbinding were locked away in the Tomb of Shadows. Perhaps we will find the answers we seek there. Look for anything that might help us. You'll find the tomb on the first rise closest to the ritual altar.

Title: It Was Almost Alive
Objective: Tear a page from the open book to give to Lorewalker Cho.
Text: A ritual took place here, and from the looks of it wasn't successful. Among the abandoned items a book lies open. The text on the pages is foreign to you. Carrying the whole book may be difficult, but a single page might be enough. If you can get the page to Lorewalker Cho he may be able to tell you what it says.

Title: Justice
Objective: Kill Captain Ripflesh and 6 Blackmane Mercenaries.
Text: After the mercenaries robbed us, most left.But one of them... after the others took all we had, he ran the rest of us through. For sport!Get justice for the fallen. Perhaps news of their death will raise my spirits enough to go on.You'll find them just west of here.

Title: Staying Connected
Objective: Use the Tongue of Ba-Shon in the Valley of Emperors.
Text: The Tongue of Ba-Shon should allow us to communicate from long distances. If the relic works the way I think it will, I should be able to stay here and continue my meditations while you do some scouting in the Valley of Emperors. Mishi will take you to the edge of the valley so that we can test my theory. I would hate for you to be in the tombs with no way to contact me. That would be horrible!

Title: Orbiss Fades
Objective: Obtain 8 Gushing Mists by walking through mist geysers in the Upper Sumprushes.
Text: I knew death would come. I did not know that it would come this fast. I must buy time. The mist of the Upper Sumprushes is warm and fragrant. Such mist is nutritive to my kind. Gather this mist however you can... in jars, in vials, within the interior of your bags. Bring it back to me, and I can use it to remain corporeal for a bit longer.

Title: Emergency Care
Objective: Heal Sage Liao to get him back on his feet.
Text: I... am alive... but barely. They killed the rest. My friends... and family...I must return to the village... But, I do not have long, and cannot move on my own... are you a healer? I... have a healing potion in my hut... search my belongings. You can use your magic, if you have it.

Title: Golgoss
Objective: Summon Golgoss by planting the Mist-Shaman's Torches into the Peat Clump in the Upper Sumprushes.
Text: The leader of the yaungol mist-shaman is named Jahesh. He is known for his strength. One of my kind is also known for his strength. His name is Golgoss. Golgoss sleeps within the mists of the Upper Sumprushes. Help me to summon him, and he will join me in avenging our people.

Title: Arconiss Thirsts
Objective: Obtain 4 Clotted Rodent's Blood.
Text: Arconiss fights with unmatched fury, but his extended stay beneath the mists has left him weakened. The rodents of the swamp are plentiful, and their bodies are filled with nourishing blood. Return with blood enough to reignite Arconiss' spirit.

Title: Mists' Opportunity
Objective: Slay Jahesh of Osul.
Text: Now is the time to strike. Golgoss, Arconiss, and I will go east, into Jahesh's domain. Meet us there, and prepare for battle. Today, we restore the pride of our people.

Title: An End to Everything
Objective: Destroy 5 Tormented Spirits.
Text: These spirits must have been released when the tombs were opened... Death was not final for the Mogu. Instead, death was merely a stop over on the path to a new body. Spiritbinders used a foul magic to transfer spirits from one shell to the next. Years of being trapped in the tombs has left them confused. They need to be destroyed before their confusion turns to anger or worse, they find a new shell.

Title: Arconiss
Objective: Summon Arconiss by planting the Mist-Shaman's Torches into the Peat Mound in the Upper Sumprushes.
Text: If I am to fight Jahesh, leader of the yaungol mist-shaman, I must have Arconiss by my side. Arconiss' ferocity is second to none. He rests beneath the mists of the Upper Sumprushes. Find his resting place, and then use these torches to awaken him.

Title: Golgoss Hungers
Objective: Obtain 10 Snarlvines.
Text: Golgoss' strength is great, but he requires nutrition before he can use it. The snarlthorn bushes in the Upper Sumprushes have heavy, fibrous branches. These should sate his appetite.

Title: The Torches
Objective: Obtain 6 Mist-Shaman's Torches.
Text: Until recently, the yaungol shaman would come here to work alongside us. Now, they bend my people to their will. If we refuse, they kill us. Even if we oblige... they kill us. The yaungol mist-shaman's magic flows through his torch. Take his torch away, and he has nothing.

Title: Gao-Ran Battlefront
Objective: Speak to Lord Taran Zhu at the Gao-Ran Battlefront in the Townlong Steppes.
Text: With your help, we have quelled the spirits of this place. At last, they may rest in peace. Our journey into this cursed land, I am afraid, has only begun. I have some important matters to finish up here, but we will be moving out soon. I need someone to go ahead and tell Lord Taran Zhu that we are joining him. Find him at the Gao-Ran Battlefront. Tell him what has transpired here.

Title: A Spear Through My Side, A Chain Through My Soul
Objective: Slay Dmong Naruuk, the shaman who holds Orbiss hostage.
Text: My fate is sealed. The yaungol put this spear in my side. The wound will kill me. The yaungol hold me in place with their twisted, corrupted magic. The indignity of it hurts worse than my spear-wound. My death, I cannot stop. My imprisonment... you may be able to help me with this.

Title: Totemic Research
Objective: Collect 9 Palewind Totems.
Text: As we entered the village, I couldn't help but notice yaungol totems lying around this camp. I have a suspicion that there are dark forces at work here, and those totems may be the key to drawing them out. Could you bring me some of these totems for further inspection? I would like to study them.

Title: The Point of No Return
Objective: Find Suna Silentstrike.
Text: One of our rangers reported seeing Suna up the hill to the northwest. I am relieved to find her safe. I had feared what she would do in her grief. Would you go speak to her on my behalf? Take this totem with you. If you encounter any danger along the way, you may find it useful.

Title: Hatred Becomes Us
Objective: Use the Totem of Harmony to exorcise sha spirits from 8 Crazed Shado-Pan Rangers. Defeat the Seething Hatreds to purify your allies.
Text: I should have suspected a sha presence earlier! We are safe as long as we stand inside the Totem of Harmony's protective wards, but many of our people were not so lucky. They were trapped outside the camp when the sha's powers manifested, and now they turn upon each other! Take one of my totems with you. Place the totem near a crazed ally to purify them, but beware. You may have to face the darkness that gripped them.

Title: Spiteful Spirits
Objective: Kill 10 Spiteful Spirits.
Text: The spirits of the fallen villagers have risen! I can feel the hatred emanating from the spirits. , if we are to survive here, we must defend ourselves. This is the only way we can put them to rest.

Title: Last Toll of the Yaungol
Objective: Take Xiao Tu to the smoke trails at Hatred's Vice.
Text: Ban has asked me to explore the village to determine what happened here. I noticed smoke rising up from the east, the west, northwest, and the south. I need someone I trust to watch my back. What do you say? Want to help me on my first scouting mission?

Title: Greater Power for Greater Threats
Objective: Unlock all traits on any of your artifact weapons.
Text: , the war against the Legion grows in intensity beyond what we have imagined. It is critical that we increase our strength to match that of our foes.It is imperative that you strengthen your artifact as much as possible. It is the only way you can stay ahead of the threat the Legion poses.

Title: Supplies From the Dreamweavers
Objective: Speak with Sylvia Hartshorn in Val'sharah for your reward.
Text: Hero!Your dedication to defending Val'sharah has given us a much needed respite from the vile influence of the Legion. We were able to scavenge some supplies as a result of your efforts.Here, take them and know that, should you continue to aid us, we will set aside more rewards such as these as we find them.

Title: Supplies From the Valarjar
Objective: Speak with Valdemar Stormseeker in Stormheim for your reward.
Text: Greetings, little hero.The mighty Odyn has proclaimed that you should receive these gifts of war. At every turn you continue to prove your valor and your efforts to aid the Valarjar have not gone unnoticed.For the Valarjar! For Odyn! For !

Title: Supplies From the Nightfallen
Objective: Speak with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Suramar for your reward.
Text: Outlander, I have some supplies for you. These goods are yours, earned by your continued efforts to our forces here in Suramar.I shall set aside similar treasures should you choose to aid our people more.You have my deepest thanks.

Title: Supplies From the Court
Objective: Speak with Veredis Fallon in Azsuna for your reward.
Text: Prince Farondis has asked me to thank you for your continued efforts to aid our lands.Please take these supplies as a token of our gratitude, and a promise of more to come, should you continue to help us.

Title: Supplies From the Wardens
Objective: Speak with Marin Bladewing in Azsuna for your reward.
Text: Your dedication to our efforts has yielded results. We have supplies for you.Continue your dedication and there will be more.

Title: Supplies From Highmountain
Objective: Speak with Ransa Greyfeather in Highmountain for your reward.
Text: Champion, your help to our people has far exceeded any of our expectations, and has provided us some much needed breathing space.Please, take these supplies to aid you in the war against the Legion. With your continued aid, we should be able to gather more and prepare them for you.

Title: The Prophet's Gambit
Objective: Follow Prophet Velen.
Text: I can feel their presence just ahead. It is as faint as the lightest breeze that once rolled across these hills, but it is not of the Legion, of that I am certain. We must see if these broken are potential allies. It is a great risk, but our numbers are too few to ignore the chance.

Title: Armies of Legionfall
Objective: Escort Archmage Khadgar at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.
Text: Thanks to your leadership, the  order has grown even mightier than I had dared hope. Alongside champions of the other orders, we now have a fighting force capable of driving the Burning Legion from our world.It's time to end this invasion! Using the Pillars of Creation, we will dissipate the Felstorm and seal the Tomb of Sargeras.

Title: The Nation of Kul Tiras
Objective: Speak with Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Stormwind Harbor.
Text: Kul Tiras is the greatest naval power in Azeroth, and a former ally. But we've had little contact with them since Jaina's father, Lord Admiral Daelin Proudmoore, was defeated at Theramore.Many have criticized Jaina's decision that day, saying she believed so deeply in the promise of peace between the Alliance and Horde that she betrayed her own father.Perhaps she feels the time has come to atone for this.Loath as I am to put Jaina in harm's way... Kul Tiras must join the Alliance.Good luck.

Title: Assault on Broken Shore
Objective: Complete the Assault on Broken Shore scenario.
Text: It has been a long and costly war. It is time we put an end to it.We will drive the Burning Legion from their seat of power and close their gateway into Azeroth. Our first step is to gain a foothold on the Broken Shore.Divided, the Alliance and Horde faced defeat. But united as the Armies of Legionfall, we will claim victory!

Title: The Old Knight
Objective: Meet with Cyrus Crestfall.
Text: These days Cyrus is the Harbormaster, but he used to be one of Daelin Proudmoore's most trusted knights!I lost my mother when the Scourge hit Lordaeron. My father sent me here to be raised away from the war. I don't know much about him... just that he was a Stormwind knight who gave his life fighting the Lich King.Daelin hand-picked Cyrus to raise me and forced him to take a desk job. It's the only reason he wasn't at Theramore.He's probably checking in that other Alliance ship. Let's go!

Title: Power Outage
Objective: Refill the Fel Hammer's Power Core with fel energy.
Text: Kor'vass asked for a bunch of other stuff, but it won't hurt her to learn a bit of patience. Don't you agree?She did mentioned that the ship'ss weaponss array is severely damaged and dangerously low on power. Knowing her, I'm sure that'ss an exaggeration.I suppose you may as well take this power core I confiscated. You can replenish it from those disgusting Legion geyserss and energy globess floating around the Tomb.

Title: Tides of War
Objective: Attend the War Council in Stormwind Keep.
Text: Champion!An urgent War Council is underway. Your presence is requested in Stormwind Keep.

Title: Nothing Up My Sleeve
Objective: Use Akazamzarak's Hat to perform a magic trick.
Text: Now, you may think that a sack of gold would be a good reward for your troubles, but I've got something better in mind for you.I'm gonna teach you my best trick!I know, I know, I'm a very generous goblin. Let me show you how it's done!

Title: Down the Rabbit Hole
Objective: Enter Akazamzarak's Hat and find out what's happening to his rabbits.
Text: Alright, bub. I'm gonna need you to go in there and find out what's going wrong. I'd go in myself, but... well, it's complicated.Anyway, we got no time to lose! Just jump in the hat and find out what's goin on.I'll be ready to pull you out once you've got everything handled.

Title: Amal'thazad's Message
Objective: Speak with Amal'thazad in Acherus.
Text: Deathlord, Amal'thazad has requested your presence at Acherus.He has been in contact with the Lich King, and making improvements on the citadel.For his benefit, or yours, I know not.

Title: Retaliation
Objective: Kill 7 Felborne Insurgents.
Text: Of course I will help you! Although to be honest, I am not certain where a new arcane shield generator can be found these days. So many of our craftspeople have been executed... I will think on it.Would you mind helping me as well? I have been observing a nearby group of Felborne for some time. Their activities have become increasingly brazen of late.I think it's time to teach them how it feels to be violently suppressed.

Title: Frozen Memories
Objective: Take the portal to the top of Acherus, listen to the Lich King's plan, then witness his vision in Icecrown.
Text: Close your eyes, Deathlord. Can't you feel his presence already?Stand in the rune circle atop Acherus, Deathlord.I will show you what I have seen.

Title: The Dragonhunter
Objective: Defeat Dargul in Neltharion's Lair in Mythic difficulty and create a hammer from his Red-Hot Draconic Slag
Text: The Dragonhunter lived in a time before history was was written and her tale was passed down orally to us. It seems that dragons tormented her people and after her village temple was destroyed, she rallied the local tribes, became a queen and killed all of the dragons. She was then banished for some reason and wandered until her death, alone. What proves the story is a piece of draconic slag from left over from a metal idol in her birth village. Dargul the Underking has it now. Forge a hammer from it.

Title: Hammer of Forgotten Heroes
Objective: Go to the Firmament Stone in Highmountain and forge the Hammer of Forgotten Heroes.
Text: , this is exciting, I have to admit. I've put everything you've gathered into this chest of supplies and the only place with the power and magic to handle the creation of the final hammer is the Firmament Stone. I believe that blacksmiths of your rarified skills will know it? I realize that there are dwarf stereotypes out there about smithing but I really don't care for all of the banging and heat. Suppose that is why I followed the scholarly path. Good luck to you!

Title: The Hellslayer
Objective: Defeat Helya and forge a hammer from the Frostveined Shale in the Trial of Valor.
Text: The Hellslayer's tale is a classic story of revenge. Odyn wished to take the souls of the bravest as champions but Helya sent her kvaldir to take the souls first. The people of Stormheim suffered as their pawns. The kvaldir came to the Hellslayer's ship at night and killed her son and took his soul to serve Helya for eternity. The Hellslayer took up her axe and the spear of her son and sought vengeance. Finish her quest. Defeat Helya and forge a hammer from the Frostveined Shale.

Title: Prime Wardenscale
Objective: Find Celea in Azsuna and create the Wardenscale where the magic aligns.
Text: I feel like it is finally time for use to create something truly remarkable. To create the armor that will set you apart from the rest, we need to make the best wardenscale. Find the nightelf, Celea, in Azsuna. She has attuned and sanctified the ground where she waits to focus the magic of our world and only there can you make what we need. Go with speed.

Title: Armor of the Ancients
Objective: Obtain 100 Ancient Demonsteel from humanoids in Broken Shore.
Text: It is not just the hammers and my careful research that we need. We also need a lot of the very highest quality of ancient metal to make the final hammer. Enemies across Broken Shore that are able to wear armor often collect bits of Ancient Demonsteel here and there. Collect enough of it in your battles for our purposes.

Title: The Godfighter
Objective: Take White Lightningsteel from Odyn in the Halls of Valor in Mythic difficulty and forge it into a hammer.
Text: The Godfighter championed the mortals against what he saw as oppression and abuse by immortal beings. The legends say the gods feared him but he did fall in time. My research shows that the gods he fought were the gods of Stormheim. Odyn, in particular. The Godfighter's shield took so much damage from lightning bolts that it became lightningsteel. After the Godfighter died, Odyn took the shield and melted it down as a trophy. Get that lightningsteel from him and forge a hammer from it.

Title: Slaying the Scavengers
Objective: Kill 8 Ashfang Hyenas.
Text: The rotting corpses are attracting hyena scavengers. In addition to spreading diseases from feeding on the dead, the feral creatures will attack us on sight. Go and eradicate the beasts. It is unfortunate, but ultimately for the best.

Title: The Legend of the Four Hammers
Objective: Go to Dalaran and find the Legend of the Four Hammers.
Text: , we should be honest with each other before we begin. You are a blacksmith by trade and this a noble profession. Yet I value style and fashion. Heavy armor and weapons create a certain bulkiness in a hero's profile that I think does no service whatsoever to the cut of one's clothes. Fret not--I can at least teach you something about taste in finer materials. Go to Dalaran and find a book translated by my brother about 3 forgotten heroes. We will find the finest metals ever forged!

Title: The Exile
Objective: Kill Urang, Ku-Tong, and Battat.
Text: What is there to say, stranger? I fought Jung Duk and lost. I was the fool to believe he would fight fairly. Now, my own brothers turned against me, and here I am, speaking to our enemies. I know you have come for Osul blood. I only ask that you hunt down the three who betrayed me. Urang, who poisoned my drink. Ku-Tong, who bent my spear. And Battat, whose dagger slipped into my side as my victory was assured. Do this, and I can die in peace.

Title: In Search of Suna
Objective: Speak to Ban Bearheart after arriving at Hatred's Vice.
Text: I have bad news. When I returned, Suna was already gone. The others say that she took her things and headed down the road to the east, muttering about hunting down the source of the yaungol aggression. I cannot allow her to venture into dangerous territory alone. I've already prepared a group of soldiers to push further east. We are leaving shortly. Hop on the caravan if you wish to travel with the Shado-Pan. You can also meet us there if you wish.

Title: Dust to Dust
Objective: Use the Shado-Pan Torch on 20 Palewind Villagers.
Text: If we are to make camp here, we cannot leave all of these yaungol bodies lying to rot. Take this torch and set fire to the villagers' corpses. The incense from the torch should purify the earth and air around them as well. Even our enemies deserve to be laid to rest.

Title: Ranger Rescue
Objective: Unlock Drywood Cages to save 4 Longying Rangers and Lin Silentstrike.
Text: I must ask a most important task of you. Somewhere among the cages in the Osul camp is my husband, Lin. He is the light of my world. Please find him and return him to me, and save as many of our fellow Shado-Pan as you can as well. You should find keys to those cages on the Osul Marauders.

Title: Pitching In
Objective: Use Ban's Explosives to destroy 6 Osul Ballistas.
Text: The yaungol's siege weapons - those ballista spearthrowers down there - are tearing apart our defenses both at Longying Oupost and in Kun-Lai Summit. Those terrible weapons must be destroyed. Take these explosives. I've covered them in the pitch that you collected. Toss them at those ballistas, and we'll give the yaungol a little taste of their own medicine.

Title: First Assault
Objective: Kill 6 Osul Sharphorns.
Text: Now that we have had time to assess our enemies' weaknesses, it is time for us to deal the yaungol a direct blow. Go and confront the Osul Sharphorn up the mesa to the west. Let them know that we are here, and that we are not scared of their threats.

Title: Seeing Red
Objective: Kill 8 Osul Marauders or Osul Spitfires.
Text: Ahead of us is the main thrust of the yaungol army. Here, they prepare their vast army to attack the villages of Kun-Lai. If we strike at the Osul now, we can cut them at their very core. Remember, for every of their number that we strike down here, we save one of our own back at home.

Title: Jung Duk
Objective: Plant the Shado-Pan Banner on the Ceremonial Pile, then kill Jung Duk.
Text: THIS. IS. WAR. I will have the heads of everyone who took Lin from me. EVERYONE! We will begin with the Osul leader, Jung Duk. Take this Shado-Pan war banner and place it at the center of their camp. Jung Duk will have no choice but to face you. Show him no mercy.

Title: Risking It All
Objective: Remove the thorn from Shen-zin Su.
Text: Wait, what?! How could he be so reckless? Blowing the ship free is insane! They could kill Shen-zin Su, and all of us with it. I know we don't have much time, but we need to think of another way...

Title: Running Rampant
Objective: Scare 8 Long-Haired Yaks or Steppebeasts.
Text: There is one thing that every army needs, and that is a supply line. The enemy camp to the west contains a large beast herd, which serves as the yaungol army's main source of food. Luckily for us, the yaks and mushan beasts of this region are easily scared. Sneak in, give the beasts a good slap, and watch the results.

Title: Sotelo's Quest
Objective: Use Sotelo's Plunger.
Text: Push the plunger. PUSH IT!

Title: My Husband...
Objective: Meet up with Suna Silentstrike at Longying Outpost in the Townlong Steppes.
Text: Lin...I don't care what Ban, Lao-Chin, or even Taran Zhu says. I'm moving ahead into Townlong. I may not be able to save Lin myself, but I'm not going to sit around waiting for everyone else to catch up.Once Taran Zhu opens the doors to his precious monastery, we'll save Lin. Until then, I'll scout ahead and make sure he's alright.

Title: Profiting off of the Past
Objective: Collect 11 more Mogu Relics.

Title: Regaining Honor
Objective: Retrieve Zhen's Banner.
Text: , the yaungol warchief, Humongous, killed Shado-Master Zhen. He has his banner. You have to kill Humongous and regain Zhen's honor! If you don't, I will.

Title: Perfect Pitch
Objective: Collect 8 Dark Pitch.
Text: When the Osul tribe goes to war, they coat their spears and arrows with a highly flammable, ever-burning pitch. They use this terrible weapon to shed not only blood, but to raze the homes of their enemies. I need you to collect some of this pitch while you are in their camp. We will use it to show the yaungol that when you play with fire, you can get burned.

Title: Bright Bait
Objective: Collect 7 Suncrawlers in the forest north of Anglers Wharf.
Text: Certain fish are only attracted to bright lights. The forest north of here is home to a local pandaren firefly called a suncrawler. You should be able to find them on the base of the tree trunks all around that area. Bring me back a handful of them and I can use them for bait!

Title: Piranha!
Objective: Fish up 5 Wolf Piranha from the Krasarang River in Krasarang Wilds.
Text: Certain fish are very difficult to catch. The wolf piranha falls squarely into this category. Lucky for me that you showed up! Put those fishing skills to the test and bring me back a few from the krasarang river due northwest of here.

Title: Jumping the Shark
Objective: Kill a frenzied reef shark with your bare hands.
Text: There is only one way to kill sharks where I come from, with your bare hands! I dumped a good amount of chum in the water just off the dock here, this place should be crawling with the local reef sharks in no time. Hop on the first one you see and take it out!

Title: A Terrible Sacrifice
Objective: Gather 6 Barrels of Yaungol Fire Oil.
Text: I have an idea, and... am prepared to make a terrible sacrifice.As much as I know that we need my stout brew, to fortify our defenders for the long-term security of the Ox Gate...It is too painful to discuss details now, but please - while you are up here defending the wall, gather the barrels of oil they are using to light their arrows. We will need them.

Title: Off the Wall!
Objective: Kill 12 Osul Veteran Archers or Osul Fire-Warriors.
Text: The yaungol on the wall here are providing covering fire for the ones below. I don't know what Lao-chen is thinking, but I want you to deal with these archers.The good news is, up here we've got the spirit of the Ox helping us. When they're weakened, the ox spirit will stun them and you can use it to knock 'em off the wall.You'll find the archers just out that door.

Title: Unbelievable!
Objective: Speak to the Shado-Pan Monastery Sentinel to gain entrance to the Shado-Pan Monastery.
Text: I simply refuse to believe the guards will not grant us entry to the monastery should we impress upon them the seriousness of the situation.Friend, go east, to the sentinel in front of the Monastery, and demand admittance. I will come with you.

Title: A Fair Trade
Objective: Bring the Bundle of Kafa'kota Berries to the Lair of Kota Kon, near the top of Kota Peak.
Text: Eep! Please, great Kota Kon, forgive grummle. Let me go, I'll bring lots of kafa right away! Promise!

Title: Lord of the Shado-Pan
Objective: Rid Taran Zhu of his possession by the Sha of Hatred.
Text: Our lord, Taran Zhu, has been overcome by a sha of pure hatred. The whole monastery has been lost! , you must find a way to free him of this possession. Last I knew, he was meditating in the Grove of Falling Blossoms.

Title: Trouble Brewing
Objective: Kill 5 Kafa-Crazed Yetis in the caves on Kota Peak.
Text: Lots of yetis in Kota, yup. Usually not too dangerous. Usually just eat goots. Then they ate the goots full of kafa...  Now they're moody, cranky, sleep a lot but never seem rested. Typical kafa addicts. Gonna come outta those caves soon, I'm sure. Come lookin' for more kafa. Then we all in trouble.

Title: The Burlap Grind
Objective: Feed the Flask of Kafa to Kota Kon at Kota Basecamp, then kill 100 Hozen along The Burlap Trail.
Text: Okayyy... well, she's not eating anybody. That's a good start. She must want more kafa, but we gotta give her somethin' to do with all the extra energy... I got it! The Burlap Trail! She can smash hozen out there all day!  What do you think, pretty girl? Wanna smash hozens?! I think so. Here, feed her my emergency flask of kafa. She likes you.

Title: Kota Blend
Objective: Collect 100 Kafa'kota Berries from Kota Peak. They can be found in bushes growing on the mountainside or piled up in the yeti caves.
Text: Kota Peak is famous for its kafa bushes - no other can survive at this elevation. Grummles make very good living selling Kafa'kota Blend, but it's dangerous now thanks to my cousin here. He's got the wildlife up there hooked on kafa with his scheming. Kafa'kota is more scarce than ever with goots gobblin' it up and yetis hoarding it in their caves. I pay you good for any berries you bring down from Kota. Here, take a sample. Eat it. See for yourself the power of kafa.

Title: Gourmet Kafa
Objective: Mark 10 Kafa'goot "Deposits" on Kota Peak.
Text: It was genius: kafa berries go in the goot, seeds come out. Kafa'kota is already rare and worth a fortune, but my invention--Kafa'goot--is GOURMET. But it's over now. Uncle is upset and peak is a muss. All that's left is to collect the rest of the Kafa'goot and never make it again. I won't ask you to gather it--kind of a mussy task, not fit for hero-- just mark it so I can find it easily when the mountain is safe again.

Title: The Legend of the Wardenscale
Objective: Capture the Father of Owls on the Isle of the Watchers.
Text: One of my favorite legends is of the Father of Owls on Isle of the Watchers. It is said that his spirit comes to comfort his creatures during times of trouble. With the Legion's arrival on the Isle of Watchers, many of the owls are being slain so you can find him there. We need to "borrow" him for a short time as he has seen many of the battles where famous warriors and villains have worn armor made of Wardenscale. With his spirit, you can identify items we can extract it from and use it for style!

Title: Mail of the Ancients
Objective: Obtain 100 Ancient Gravenscale from humanoids in Broken Shore.
Text: There is some wardenscale scattered here and there in the Broken Isles. Various enemies and local monsters seeking to ape the superior races like ourselves will have picked it up and worn it. The kind we need is amongst the oldest ever made. It is ancient gravenscale. Keep all that you find and and bring it to me. We will harvest what useful bits we can from it.

Title: The Owl and the Traitor
Objective: Find and repair Cordana Felsong's Mantle in the Vault of the Wardens in Mythic difficulty.
Text: I've scoured the tales and legends for armor that might have Wardenscale components and one Cordana Felsong is a name that caught my attention. Evidently she has a family mantle that has what we need. Kill her and find it on her traitor's corpse. The owl will make sure that you spot it. It is likely chipped from years of hard use so restore it to prime condition and bring it back to me.

Title: The Owl and the Dreadlord
Objective: Find and restore the Legplates of Mephistroth by defeating him in the Cathedral of Eternal Night in Mythic Difficulty.
Text: The demon Mephistroth is one of the most powerful of the Nathrezim--the dreadlords. I can see in your eyes that you know what I am going to ask you to do. But it is for your own good! You can't keep wandering the lands looking like you do. Most recently, Mephistroth has been dispatched by the Legion to the Cathedral of Eternal Night. No doubt, he will be wearing some legplates that I believe contain Wardenscale. Take them, shine them up, and bring them to me.

Title: The Owl and the Observer
Objective: Kill Viz'aduum in the Return to Karazhan dungeon on Mythic difficulty, and retrieve and repair the Bracers of the First War.
Text: I've researched some foul creatures in my time but Viz'aduum the Watcher may top the list. I mean, he is a giant, disgusting, dangerous eyeball! Currently he haunts Karazhan--do you know the place? In Medivh's time, much of our common knowledge was stored there. Alas, the time has passed... I digress.
