Viz'aduum is in possession of armor from the First War--bracers to be specific--and they are incredibly valuable. It pains me but take them, repair them, and then we must use their wardenscale.

Title: Wisp-Touched Elderhide
Objective: Use the Legendary Tanner's Kit in Hrul Sharptooth's dwelling in Thunder Totem.
Text: Dreadleather, with knowledge carefully reverse-engineered from ancient texts, can be worked into elderhide. It is partly a matter of advanced craftsmanship and partly a simple magic of the earth. With the ancient wisps you caught and the materials you've captured and the research I have done, I have put together a Legendary Tanner's Kit for you. Take it to the heirloom hides of Hrul Sharptooth in Thunder Totem. The wisp will help you use the kit there to create Elderhide.

Title: Leather of the Ancients
Objective: Obtain 100 pieces of Ancient Dreadleather from humanoids in Broken Shore.
Text: , we are going to need high quality leather to work with. Ancient Dreadleather is the best hereabouts and local tanning techniques were exceptional in the past. To the untrained eye, it may look like normal dreadleather. That is where the wisp comes in. Many of your enemies across Broken Shore will have some amount of ancient dreadleather. As you defeat them, you will start to recognize armor made from it and you can harvest the leather for our purposes.

Title: The Wisp and the Sea
Objective: Retrieve the Waterlogged Handmaiden's Gloves from the Wrath of Azshara on Mythic Difficulty, then treat them.
Text: Queen Azshara and her handmaidens are the subjects of many a tragic tale. Her power and her hubris lead her badly astray but, even so, her handmaidens are loyal to her to this day. There is power in such a thing. The Wrath of Azshara is an abomination but, truthfully, it is actually one of her handmaidens who willing gave her life to protect her queen. Few know this. The Ancient Wisp knows this truth and if you take it to battle the Wrath of Azshara, you may find the handmaiden's gloves. Restore them.

Title: The Wisp and the Nightmare
Objective: Get the spellsash from Xavius in the Emerald Nightmare and repair it.
Text: Xavius, the Nightmare Lord in Val'Sharah, derives some of his power from his spellsash. It is enchanted and tied to the world beneath his feet and cannot be removed from his body. However, with the ancient wisp's help, the spellsash can be removed if you can but defeat Xavius in combat. Trivial for one of your skill, I'm sure. Take the wisp to the Emerald Nightmare, take the spellsash, and use your skills to repair any damage you've caused in the battle.

Title: The Thread of Souls
Objective: Defeat Grand Magistrix Elisande in the Nighthold and extract Soul Thread from her wraps.
Text: Have you ever had a chance to lay eyes on Elisande, Grand Magistrix of the Nightborne? Stunning! Fashion-forward! Nice posture! You'd do well to take a page from her book! In fact, you'd tell well to take the thread from her Suramari Soul Wraps! These hold great symbolic value to her people so it's doubtful she will give them willingly. So be it, take her out and get that thread.

Title: The Wisp and the Shadow
Objective: Defeat the Shade of Xavius in Darkheart Thicket on Mythic Difficulty and dye his shroud.
Text: , have you heard of the nightmare lord, Xavius, whose shade haunts Darkheart Thicket? I have heard that this shade is sometimes seen wearing a colorless shroud. This shroud is steeped in powerful magic and the wisp will draw it out for you. If you can fight the shade, take the shroud, and use your skills to dye it, I will show you how to work wonders!

Title: The Legend of the Elderhide
Objective: Capture Ancient Wisps in Val'sharah.
Text: Leatherworking is one of the oldest forms of craftsmanship in the world. Hides of animals were the first clothing. Legends tell of a particular form of leather curing that has been lost to us in modern times. Combining magic of the earth with some of the finest leathers ever found, this technique has been recreated by yours truly through careful analysis and my understanding of style. To begin, you must capture some ancient wisps to channel the exact nature magic for the curing process.

Title: The Thread of Starlight
Objective: Defeat Advisor Melandrus in the Court of Stars and extract Starlight Thread from his bracers.
Text: Melandrus of the Nightborne is First Blade of Elisande. Perhaps you've heard of him? He is a great hero to the Nightborne but, to be absolutely honest, he is a mess with regards to style. His accoutrements are somewhat better and a particular pair or bracers are rather nice. In fact, the thead that binds them will be absolutely perfect for your pending outfits. Why don't you get that for me and we will talk further.

Title: Prick of a Thistle
Objective: Kill Commander Katith'rax on Darkstone Isle.
Text: Their commander's name is Katith'rax. He's the one who organized these attacks, and now the one who leads them. Luckily, it doesn't seem as though he's far off. Right off the coast is a small island. Seems as though he hides there, barking orders without getting his hands dirty. I, on the other hand, enjoy getting my hands a little dirty. Don't you?

Title: Nature's Touch
Objective: Heal 5 Injured Druids in Impsorrow Approach.
Text: Apparently we're not the only druids that have run into these demons. The Legion took a ton of captives and brought them back to their camp. Our brothers and sisters lay wounded and hurting... You can heal! Let's go save them!

Title: To Track a Demon
Objective: Collect 3 Impsorrow Missives from demons in Impsorrow Approach.
Text: I took the initiative to scout around before I grabbed that wyrmtongue. It seems like their forces are holed up in a camp in Impsorrow Approach. What I've struggled to figure out, however, is who their commander is and if he's nearby. If he's leading from elsewhere, the troops need to have some commands on them. Let's go see if we can find any... on their dead bodies!

Title: Drapings of the Ancients
Objective: Obtain 100 Ancient Imbued Silkweave from humanoids in Broken Shore.
Text: , we are going to need a high quality cloth to work with. Thankfully, the weaving quality of nightborne craftspeople from long ago was very good. It is a lost art to some degree but I feel like you can take their masterworks and do even more with it. Some of the hostiles in these parts still wear Ancient Imbued Silkweave Armor. Start to unstitch the silkweave cloth from any of that armor that you find on Broken Shore.

Title: The Legend of the Threads
Objective: Bring Eliezer his lost copy of Nights with the Nightborne
Text: Tailoring is the noblest of professions because clothing is universal. Most dress with nary a thought. If you analyze the legends, some races stand out from all others. The Nightborne are masters of style! Much of the brilliance is in their materials--in particular their thread and their looms. We will take advantage of both. Before you gather materials, I need to confirm my list. Find the fashion treatise I brought with me. Perhaps I dropped it by the flight master?

Title: The Thread of Shadow
Objective: Defeat Advisor Vandros in the Arcway in Mythic difficulty and extract Shadow Thread from his robes.
Text: Vandros of the Nightborne. There is an elf who knows how to dress. Ever since he was a young noble in the Court of Farondis, Vandros has been known for snappy, fashion forward outfits. I've never been able to see his garments up close but my research tells me that his tailor's technique is not so much in the fabric as it is in the thread. It appears to be spun of the very shadows themselves. You have your methods to obtain it, I'm sure. Get his robes and get the thread.

Title: The Preservation of Nature
Objective: Find Thisalee Crow near Deliverance Point on Broken Shore.
Text: I fear this attack on Goldrinn is only the beginning. Whoever is ordering these attacks must be found and defeated. Wasn't Thisalee with you? She never returned... brash child. I assume she is already on the Broken Shore, trying to track down this commander. Please, find her. Do not let her take this on alone.

Title: Starweave and Shadowcloth
Objective: Make a bolt of Starweave and a bolt of Shadowcloth.
Text: At last, you are ready for true tailoring knowledge. I truly think you've earned it. I've fashioned the materials you've gathered into a satchel of Legendary Tailor's Materials. Go to the Queen's Grace Loom and weave two bolts of cloth. With my careful research of fashion, heroes, and legends. I believe the new cloth you will make will echo through the ages. Hurry!

Title: Champion of Chi-Ji
Objective: Defeat a Champion of Chi-Ji.
Text: While you will always hold a place of honor among our order, you are still welcome to participate in our duels. One of our current champions awaits you in the Dome Balrissa. I know that they would be honored to duel with you.

Title: The Motherlode
Objective: Investigate the cave that Excavator Karla told you about.
Text: Pst... Come 'ere! I just got a tip about a cave on this island that is a treasure trove of loot! This could be my biggest score yet.Problem is, I uhh... sprained my ankle. Yeah, I would be right there with you battling those demons to get this treasure, but I shouldn't be putting any weight on this leg of mine. Shucks.How about you go check on this cave and report back to me. I'll mark your map where the cave entrance is. I've been told it's pretty hidden, so you've got to look around.

Title: Shut it Down
Objective: Kill 12 Kafa-Crazed Mountain Goats on Kota Peak.
Text: I mussed up. Bad. It's hard work cutting seeds out of kafa berries! But I noticed goots eat the berries up and give back the seeds... in a day or so. I fed everything I had to the goots on Kota Peak and now they're nuts! Chargin' everything that moves. Kota used to be safe for Grummles to gather kafa. Not anymore. Not with them goots. Will you help?

Title: Mindel Sunspeaker
Objective: Defeat Mindel Sunspeaker.
Text: Our highest-ranked trainee is an outsider like you. It is both strange and exciting to live in a time when so many foreigners have embraced the way of the Crane. Your challenger's name is Mindel Sunspeaker, and he awaits you within Angkhal Pavilion.

Title: Fat Long-Fat: Rematch
Objective: Defeat Fat Long-Fat atop Dome Belrissa.
Text: Fat Long-Fat has requested another match with you. I find this strange. And concerning. He will be waiting atop the Dome Belrissa.

Title: Huck Wheelbarrow
Objective: Defeat Huck Wheelbarrow.
Text: Usually our trainees are adventurers like yourself, or monks from Tian Monastery, or occasionally retired Shado-Pan. Very rarely, though, we will greet trainees that have no fighting experience whatsoever. Huck Wheelbarrow is one such trainee. He has requested a duel with you. Look for him on the island's western shore.

Title: Thelonius
Objective: Defeat Thelonius.
Text: When we last spoke, I promised to tell you the secret of Fat Long-Fat. I still plan to tell you that secret... after I determine your worth. I will meet you on the western shore, and we will duel.

Title: Ellia Ravenmane: Redemption
Objective: Defeat Ellia Ravenmane atop the Pedestal of Hope.
Text: Ellia Ravenmane, your rival, has returned. She demands that you meet her atop the Pedestal of Hope. You need to understand... something horrible has happened to her. She has changed. You will see for yourself when you arrive at the pedestal. Good luck.

Title: Yan Quillpaw
Objective: Defeat Yan Quillpaw at the Pedestal of Hope.
Text: You have already defeated Kuo-Na Quillpaw. You have not yet fought her brother, Yan. He will meet you at the Pedestal of Hope, and he will not hold back. His reputation as a trainer is at stake.

Title: Tukka-Tuk
Objective: Defeat Tukka-Tuk.
Text: You are making a name for yourself. I received a challenge from one of our more skilled competitors. He believes you are not as strong as you seem. His name is Tukka-Tuk, the hozen. If you've ever fought against hozen before, you know that their apparent juvenility belies their battle acumen. Good luck.

Title: Minh Do-Tan
Objective: Defeat Minh Do-Tan.
Text: Your next challenger is another relatively new trainee. His name is Minh Do-Tan, and he has won his last two matches. He will be waiting for you near the crane statue to the south.

Title: Kuo-Na Quillpaw
Objective: Defeat Kuo-Na Quillpaw.
Text: Most of the duels within the Cradle take place between two trainees. Rarely, when a trainee exhibits a rare amount of skill, they will have an opportunity to duel their trainer. Today, you duel against Kuo-Na. She will be waiting for you at the Pedestal of Hope.

Title: Ellia Ravenmane: Revenge
Objective: Defeat Ellia Ravenmane at Dome Balrissa.
Text: Your "rival" has appeared again. Ellia Ravenmane has been avoiding her duties on the island, instead focusing on personal training, with the intent to defeat you in battle. "I will destroy ," she said. I have honored her request for a rematch, but I will be keeping a close eye on her. Her motives may be shifting in a dangerous direction.

Title: Fat Long-Fat
Objective: Defeat Fat Long-Fat at the top of Angkhal Pavilion.
Text: You have been matched with a... special trainee. His name is Fat Long-Fat.  Fat Long-Fat... operates outside of the normal rules of combat. He does not fight every day, and when he does, he chooses his competitor. Today, for some reason... he has selected you. You will find him atop Angkhal Pavilion.

Title: Julia Bates
Objective: Defeat Julia Bates.
Text: We welcome all kinds here within the Cradle, as long as they recognize and subscribe to the ideologies of the Red Crane. One of our new, more exotic trainees comes from the human kingdoms to the northeast. She goes by the rather foreign-sounding name of Julia Bates. She is your next challenger. You will find her on the island's western shore.

Title: Dextrous Izissha
Objective: Defeat Dextrous Izissha.
Text: Jinyu normally avoid our order, but every few years, we find one that subscribes to the way of the Crane. One such jinyu is Dextrous Izissha. Izissha is your next challenger. He waits for you on the island's southwestern shore.

Title: Ellia Ravenmane: Rematch
Objective: Defeat Ellia Ravenmane near the base of the Pedestal of Hope.
Text: Ellia Ravenmane requested a rematch with you. She seems to identify you as her "rival". We discourage rivalries here within the Cradle of Chi-Ji, but we rarely decline a rematch request. You will find Ellia near the Pedestal of Hope, on the island's eastern side.

Title: Ellia Ravenmane
Objective: Defeat Ellia Ravenmane at the Angkhal Pavilion.
Text: We regularly organize one-on-one duels with trainees that we think are well-suited for one another. We have found one such trainee for you. Her name is Ellia Ravenmane. This will be her first duel, too. She will be waiting for you at the pavilion just to the south of here.

Title: To the Wall!
Objective: Speak to Kite Master Len at Winter's Blossom in Kun-Lai Summit to take a kite up to the Ox Gate. Once there, speak to Suna Silentstrike.
Text: They are attacking again!Archers... on the wall!I need you to get up there. My wife Suna went to scout the wall with that fool Lao-Chen. Perhaps if he had spent more time preparing defenses and less building that ridiculous ale lift contraption...It matters not. Get a kite from Len, to the west, and then get up there and find my wife. She'll know what to do next.

Title: Honor, Even in Death
Objective: Kill 12 Kun-Lai Scavengers.
Text: Hmm... If Shado-Master Chong trusted you, perhaps you can help us.The yaungol are our enemies.Still, we must prove we are better than they. We will show them honor in death.As after most battles, the carrion birds have begun gathering. Thin their numbers, so the bodies of our foes will not be desecrated. They've gathered at the battlefield to the west.

Title: Students of Chi-Ji
Objective: Duel 10 Students of Chi-Ji.
Text: Our order prides itself on excellence in combat. We hone these combat skills by dueling one another, here on the Cradle of Chi-Ji. Prove yourself in the eyes of the Red Crane. Venture south, into the center of the island, and duel with your fellow students.

Title: Destroy the Leaders
Objective: Kill the Zandalari Blademaster and Zandalari Mage
Text: And, now they fear you.Their leaders, a Blademaster and a Mage, lie deeper in the ruins. Kill them.Make them hurt. For us.

Title: Chasing Hope
Objective: Touch 3 Spirits of the Crane.
Text: Chi-Ji is always with us. Even when he is not here in the Cradle, pieces of his spirit run through the forests and beaches of the island, watching us and testing us. Prove your dexterity in the eyes of Chi-Ji. Find and catch the spirits of the crane.

Title: Provoking the Trolls
Objective: Kill 10 Zandalari Stalkers and 5 Zandalari Hexers
Text: We've managed to push them back this far, but I doubt that we will remain safe for long if we do not deal with them once and for all.My husband, coward or fool that he is, does not wish to provoke them. I will not be cowed so.We will do just that. Slay their forward scouts. Perhaps we can provoke - and then defeat - their leader.

Title: A Line Unbroken
Objective: Lay Shado-Master Zhiyao, Liu of the Thousand Blows and Shiya Boldblade to rest.
Text: When we regrouped after their initial attack, we numbered three less. You can fight, and we must plan our defense should these cursed yaungol attack again.If you would help us, grant our fallen comrades their last rites, and recover their armor. You will find their bodies to the west, near the gate.And try to keep the birds off them.

Title: Gifts of the Great Crane
Objective: Obtain 10 Gifts of the Great Crane.
Text: The cranes of Krasarang are a gift from Chi-Ji. Even the very feathers they leave behind are a gift for us to appreciate. We use these feathers to adorn our garments and to fletch arrows. But first... they must be gathered.

Title: To Winter's Blossom
Objective: Speak with Lin Silentstrike at Winter's Blossom in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: The battle against the Sha is eternal - we can not leave this place.But I am troubled by the absence of reinforcements from the Monastery given that we sent for them days ago.You have performed admirably, perhaps you could travel to Winter's Blossom, our base camp on the way to the Shado-Pan Monastery. Speak with Lin Silentstrike once you arrive - he should know what is happening. To get there, travel north of the village and follow the road through Shado-Li Basin to Winter's Blossom.

Title: Snapclaw
Objective: Kill Snapclaw in a cave at the bottom of Narsong Trench and return with his claw as proof.
Text: A giant, poisonous crab is wrecking havoc on our local abalone stores. I need you to go down into narsong trench and take it out!

Title: Viseclaw Soup
Objective: Kill Viseclaw Fishers on the beach and return with 16 eyes to make some yummy soup.
Text: Nothing tastes quite like viseclaw soup. It's a krasarang specialty! I was just about to start up on a new batch when I realized I am missing a key ingredient, the eyes! I need you to kill the viseclaw fishers on the beach and return with their eyes for the soup!

Title: Scavenger Hunt
Objective: Use the Goblin Fishing Raft to fish up 15 Rusty Shipwreck Parts out of the floating debris near the shipwrecks.
Text: YOU! You're just who I have been looking for! I need more parts for my goblin fishing bombs but I hurt my leg and can't collect them myself. You see those shipwrecks nearby? I bet they have just what I need if you can get to it and fish it out. Take my fishing raft and see what you can find! My buddy has been trying to help me out too so you might find some extra rafts near the wreckage, feel free to use em' too.

Title: Tread Lightly
Objective: Use "Scrutiny" to set off 10 Riverblade Spike Traps from a safe distance.
Text: My students tell me the surrounding area is littered with deadly traps, no doubt set by the saurok. Stumbling into one gets you a face full of spikes. As the saying goes: "The Way is rife with danger - tread lightly, and with scrutiny."  Here, this is scrutiny. It should be long enough to set the traps off at a safe distance.

Title: Ahead on the Way
Objective: Kill the Maw of Despair in both the eastern and western pagodas at the Temple of the Red Crane.
Text: Huge maws of despair are spewing out sha from the pagodas on either side of the temple. Meanwhile, your impromptu training in the Way continues. "She who mends torn umbrella will be more dry than she who strikes at rain." While I take issue with that particular lesson--sometimes punching the rain can be quite effective--the meaning holds true in this case. Take out those maws of despair and give my order a chance at reclaiming the temple grounds.

Title: Seeker's Folly
Objective: Brave the path of Seeker's Folly to find Lorewalker Cho, stopping to reflect at the three shrines along the way.
Text: I'm sure your pandaren friend has some ideas about what the mogu are after. He headed up the mountain a few days ago without a guide, and asked that only you be sent up after him. He was very specific: "The  must endure the trek alone, with only  thoughts.  will honor each shrine before meeting me at the top." The path is just northwest of the camp, marked by flags. Please be careful! Seeker's Folly is a dangerous trek even on a lucky day.

Title: The Burlap Trail: To Kota Basecamp
Objective: Protect a group of grummles from the Burlap Waystation to the Kota Basecamp. At least one grummle must survive.
Text: This here's hozen lands. Very dangerous. But grummles must trek through. Supplies must reach the Serpent's Spine. Go, protect the next wave of grummles on their trek to Kota Basecamp. If at least one survives, good fortune will find its way to you.

Title: Unmasking the Yaungol
Objective: Lure Kobai into the Blinding Rage Trap, steal the Mask of Malevolent Fury from him, and then defeat Malevolent Fury.
Text: Simply killing Kobai will accomplish nothing, as he is possessed by a particularly powerful and destructive Sha - Malevolent Fury.You will use the trap I have fashioned from the Blinding Rage Essences you brought. Lure him into the trap, and then steal his mask. Once you put it on, Malevolent Fury will appear and attempt to take control of you.Defeat him, and we will have made a victory of this tragic situation. You can find him to the north of the retreat, where he taunts us in insane rage.

Title: Misery
Objective: Put Nahassa out his misery.
Text: While you are in the water below, you should slay Nahassa, the mortbreath patriarch. He suffers. I can feel his death cries ululating up to the surface of the lagoon. Find his cave, and put him out of his misery. Not because it will solve Marista's crocolisk problem. Simply out of mercy.

Title: Holed Up
Objective: Rescue Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough, Old Lady Fung, and Sya Zhong.
Text: Oh, thank you! There's no way I could have made it back on my own. Come to think of it, there must be others around Firebough Nook that need to be rescued. Shall we go collect them and then head to the safety of Shado-Pan Fallback?

Title: Holed Up
Objective: Rescue Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough, Old Lady Fung, and Sya Zhong.
Text: I can't believe you made it here!I don't know how much longer I could have stayed hidden in here. I'm sure that there are others. , we have to rescue them! Then we can go to Shado-Pan Fallback. The master there will know what to do!

Title: One Traveler's Misfortune
Objective: Search the Abandoned Wreckage for supplies.
Text: Did you have to throw our supplies at them?! Why not use your weapon? Maybe fancy spells or kicks? Why the supplies?! Now we don't have enough to last us, especially with Nephew Bentnail here. His appetite is like a yeti's! You threw it, you get us more. There is wreckage down the path. Maybe you will find supplies there.

Title: Holed Up
Objective: Rescue Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough, Old Lady Fung, and Sya Zhong.
Text: Oh thank you, thank you, thank you. If you hadn't come along... Wait! There must be other survivors in the Nook like me! Please, I beg you. Rescue the rest of my citizens and deliver us safely to Shado-Pan Fallback.

Title: Wisdom Has A Price
Objective: Obtain 5 Shark Fillets.
Text: Crocolisks attacking? I know a story about that. And I will share it with you, but first... I grow hungry. Shark meat should do the trick. You should find enough sharks in the water beneath us.

Title: Buried Hozen Treasure
Objective: Find the Buried Hozen Treasure.
Text: The map you hold is crinkled, dirty, and poorly drawn, but you can see a big X on a beach. Is there buried treasure somewhere on this island?

Title: Like Bombing Fish In A Barrel
Objective: Use the Goblin Fishing Bombs to kill 3 Sting Rays and bring back their stingers to Fiznix. The Rays can be found in the shallows west of Anglers Wharf.
Text: Turns out these rays are not as easy to catch as I thought! You seem like a pretty smart guy, think you can help me out? I made the bombs but have been having trouble using the raft with my hurt leg. The rays are common in the shallows just west of here. Take the bombs and use my raft to bring me back their stingers! Oh yeah, watch out for the hammerheads!

Title: Holed Up
Objective: Rescue Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough, Old Lady Fung, and Sya Zhong.
Text: Thank the heavenly spirits for you! I don't know how much longer I could've lasted. There are other Firebough Nook survivors, I'm sure of it. Will you help rescue them and get us to the safety of Shado-Pan Fallback?

Title: Balance Without Violence
Objective: Throw 6 Flailing Carp into Nayeli Lagoon.
Text: Some of the fish that the Unga hozen have gathered don't seem do be dead yet. There may still be time to throw them back into the water.

Title: Balance
Objective: Slay 10 Unga Fish-Getters.
Text: The story did not end happily. The Narsong crocolisk is no more. This time, however, you may have a chance to change the ending. The hozen to the south are overfishing these waters. With the fish gone, the crocolisks are hungry and desperate - and so they attack Marista. Go now! Stop those hozen from their reckless fishing!

Title: Build Your Own Raft
Objective: Obtain 4 Spare Planks and some Tough Kelp.
Text: Hmm. They don't seem to be... calming down. We're going to have to try something different. You'll need a raft. Go grab some wood planks and seaweed, and bring them over to me. I'll put something together for you.

Title: The Lorewalker on the Lake
Objective: Board your raft, then report to Wise Ana Wu in the middle of Nayeli Lagoon.
Text: Your raft is down in the water below. Take it out to the middle of the lake, where you should find a woman. Her name is Ana Wu. Whenever I have a question that I can't figure out on my own, I'll ask her. She should be able to tell us why these crocolisks won't stop attacking.

Title: Turnabout
Objective: Collect 5 Blind Rage Essences from Blind Rages in Firebough Nook.
Text: Our true enemies are the sha, not the yaungol.The sha are emotion manifest. Destructive, yes. But undisciplined. Undisciplined force cannot last. The flood, in dispersion, loses its force. The wildfire burns its fuel.And, discipline and wisdom can turn their destructive energy against themselves.Bring me the essences of the sha in the village, and I will explain further.

Title: Sudden, Unexpected Crocolisk Aggression
Objective: Slay 8 Mortbreath crocolisks at Kea Krak.
Text: Normally, my day consists of catching fish, and then eating the fish I caught, followed by sleeping. Note that I did not include "fight with a crocolisk" in that list of activities. You look like a handy . Can you go get rid of some of these crocolisks, so I can get back to my regular routine? The crocolisks normally keep to themselves up at Kea Krak, to the northwest.

Title: The Defense of Shado-Pan Fallback
Objective: Kill 15 Sha-Infested Yaungol.
Text: I sent for reinforcements from the Shado-Pan Monastery, but have heard nothing back. We have already lost the town.A few lucky villagers may have survived, but we are pinned down here.We do not have time to entertain strangers. If you can fight, help my men defend this tower. If not, leave, for you will not survive long here.

Title: Particular Plumage
Objective: Obtain 6 Emerald Tailfeathers, 6 Crimson Tailfeathers, and 6 Dusky Tailfeathers.
Text: When the crocs started attacking, they scared a bunch of the lories out of their nests, up in that island to our northwest. I can use those lories' feathers to make some specialized lures, which will come in handy if and when I get to stop defending my brethren from these reptiles. You up for some feather hunting?

Title: In Tents Channeling
Objective: Kill the Ordo Embercaller, Ordo Pyromancer, Ordo Firespeaker, and Ordo Blazecaster.
Text: The yaungol of Fire Camp Ordo are the worst threat we're facing. I need you to head west and take out their leader. The coward is hiding in a cave, which is protected by a fire shield cast by his four underlings. Take them out and the shield will come down. You'll find them in their tents, channeling.

Title: The Ordo Warbringer
Objective: Kill the Ordo Warbringer.
Text: You've taken the shield down at Fire Camp Ordo. Get back over there before they get that shield up again. Slay the Warbringer of the Ordo!

Title: The Ordo Warbringer
Objective: Kill the Ordo Warbringer.
Text: You've taken the shield down at Fire Camp Ordo. Go back there before the shield goes up again. Time to head into the cave and slay their chief!

Title: The Ordo Warbringer
Objective: Kill Ordo Warbringer.

Title: Huff & Puff
Objective: Use the Fishing Spear to kill 5 Prickly Puffer fish in Sarjun Depths and return with their spines.
Text: Have you heard of the prickly puffer fish ? Of course you haven't, you're new around these parts! They can be found in the sarjun depths, due west of here. Take this fishing spear and see if you can bring me back of few of their poison tipped spines.

Title: The Ordo Warbringer
Objective: Kill the Ordo Warbringer.

Title: Barrels of Fun
Objective: Use Explosive Barrels found in Fire Camp Ordo to destroy the East, South, and West Oil Rigs.
Text: I love blowing stuff up. It's in my blood! The yaungol to the west at Fire Camp Ordo have a ton of explosive barrels just lying around. I say we put them to good use and destroy their oil-pumpin' machines while having some fun!

Title: Pandaren Prisoners
Objective: Free 8 Pandaren Prisoners.
Text: Look, I know the Horde needs recruits, and there's just not enough of us here right now to make a fighting presence of this town.But I know that the yaungol over at Fire Camp Ordo, to the west, have taken many of my people as prisoners. And I also know that if you would be willing to rescue them from their captivity, they'd more than likely be willing to join the Horde.What do you say?

Title: The Guo-Lai Halls
Objective: Investigate the mogu presence in the Guo-Lai Halls.
Text: The mogu are up to something, I can feel it. They've been sending scouts down into the Guo-Lai Halls. According to the caretakers, the Halls are home to ancient treasures of emperors past. Not only riches, but artifacts of great power. We must prevent the mogu from accessing these treasures! Go down the ramp to the northwest and stop them!

Title: In Tents Channeling
Objective: Kill the Ordo Embercaller, Ordo Pyromancer, Ordo Firespeaker, and Ordo Blazecaster.
Text: The yaungol of Fire Camp Ordo are a dire threat. I need you to head northwest and take out their leader. Unfortunately, his four subordinates are maintaining a fire barrier that prevents us from getting to him in the adjoining cave. Take them out and the shield will come down. You'll find them in their tents, channeling.

Title: It Does You No Good In The Keg
Objective: Bring beer to Zhu's Wardens, the Crane Wing Priests, the Shado-Pan, and the tauren settlers.
Text: I been thinkin'. We got all this beer that Chen brewed, and we got all these people that you've gathered. We should bring the two together. There's a bunch o' folks out there in the fields, riskin' their lives for Pandaria. You an' I should at least bring 'em a keg or two. They might raise their mugs in victory. They might enjoy one last drink before gettin' skivvered by a mantid. Either way, I wouldn't want 'em to fight without a good brew in their belly.

Title: Pandaren Prisoners
Objective: Free 8 Pandaren Prisoners.
Text: Look, I know the Alliance needs recruits, and there's just not enough of us here right now to make a fighting presence of this town.But I know that the yaungol over at Fire Camp Ordo, to the northwest, have taken many of my people as prisoners. And I also know that if you would be willing to rescue them from their captivity, they'd more than likely be willing to join the Alliance.What do you say?

Title: Barrels of Fun
Objective: Use Explosive Barrels found in Fire Camp Ordo to destroy the West, South, and East Oil Rigs.
Text: Oh, well now, let's have us some fun! Those Ordo yaungol to the northwest have saved us the trouble o' havin' to make some bombs. They already have them there. Let's put their explosive barrels to good use and destroy their oil-pumpin' machines, shall we?

Title: Moving On
Objective: Speak to Fei and travel to Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: Your journey in this land has already proven most eventful, traveler. And mine, it appears, is destined to continue for a time. A chain of events began when your people arrived here, and while some of those happenings are traumatic to behold, I feel there must be a larger purpose behind your presence. For now it is wisest that you leave this place and explore Pandaria's other regions. Speak to me when you are ready to leave.

Title: The Final Power
Objective: Kill Warlord Zhao-Jin the Bloodletter.
Text: I never thought it would come to this! Leven went to face Warlord Zhao-Jin the Bloodletter at the top of the palace steps, but our reinforcements cannot get through! We are the only ones who stand between him and the Vale's greatest... and most deadly... powers. Please, you must find a way to stop him!

Title: The Shrine of Two Moons
Objective: Speak to Jaluu the Generous, Mokimo the Strong, Elder Liao, and Madam Vee Luo in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: Look at this creature, traveler. Only moments after we arrived, this mogu assassin attacked with no warning. His blade was intended for the leader of the Golden Lotus. It is very lucky indeed that we were here to stop the attack. Seeing this attempt on Zhi's life, I fear for the safety of those who have already entered the valley. The caretakers are settling your people into the city to the northeast. Go and speak to the leaders. Make sure they are safe.

Title: What Comes to Pass
Objective: Speak to Sun Tenderheart at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: You had better report back to the Golden Pagoda immediately.

Title: The Might of Three
Objective: Slay 100 mogu invaders at the Summer Fields in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: This is it. This is the end. If we don't drive the mogu from the valley, they will seize the remnants of their ancient power and use it to break Pandaria to their will. But our forces are few, and tired, and small. We bleed, while their warriors are made of stone. , although all odds are against us, still I must ask you to go and help our forces slay the mogu invaders. I have prayed to the Celestials, begging their aid. I can only hope that they answer our call.

Title: The Mogu's Message
Objective: Speak to Zhi the Harmonious at The Silent Sanctuary in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The battle against the mogu rages fiercely with neither side giving quarter. We cannot hold our position forever. Something must be done to strike a blow at the mogu, a blow from which they cannot recover. Go check in with Zhi the Harmonious at The Silent Sanctuary. I wish to hear his thoughts on this matter.

Title: Battle Helm of the Thunder King
Objective: Retrieve the Battle Helm of the Thunder King.
Text: The second artifact of power is the Battle Helm of the Thunder King. Emperor Lei Shen wore the helm into every battle. It became so well-known that his enemies would flee at the mere sight of it. When the Emperor died, they placed the helm in the very bottom of the Guo-Lai Halls to the west, surrounded by thousands of terracotta soldiers. Thus, they could look upon their leader and follow him into death.

Title: Battle Spear of the Thunder King
Objective: Retrieve the Battle Spear of the Thunder King.
Text: I have received some troubling news. The mogu are plotting to steal three artifacts of power from the Vale. We must retrieve the artifacts immediately and hide them for safekeeping. The first artifact is the Battle Spear of the Thunder King. Upon emperor Lei Shen's death, the spear was placed in an ancient shrine to the northwest. Bring the spear back to me.

Title: Leaving an Opening
Objective: Speak to Leven Dawnblade at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: This is serious. Kun and I will keep an eye on things here, but you should go to the Golden Pagoda. Go, swiftly!

Title: The Secrets of Guo-Lai
Objective: Meet with He Softfoot in the Guo-Lai Halls and uncover the mogu's purpose in the western chamber.
Text: I just received information from a guard stationed near the Ruins of Guo-Lai that the Shado-Tien leader entered the halls, killing two of my men in the process. They're intent on something inside. We need to stop them. He Softfoot has already followed them in. He should be waiting for you at the entrance to the western chambers. Move quickly. I don't like the thought that the mogu may be a step ahead of us.

Title: Battle Axe of the Thunder King
Objective: Retrieve the Battle Axe of the Thunder King.
Text: The final artifact is the Thunder King's axe. Lei Shen charged into battle with his spear in one hand, and his axe in the other. It is said that he could throw his axe with brutal accuracy, and when it hit its target, it made a sound like crashing thunder. After his death, the axe was placed in a ceremonial chamber to the southwest. Needless to say, we must not let it fall into the mogu's hands.

Title: The Guo-Lai Halls
Objective: Investigate the mogu presence in the Guo-Lai Halls.
Text: As you pass by the great door, you hear sounds from deep inside. Anji mentioned that advance mogu scouts had been sighted in this area. Perhaps they made their way down to the depths below. Your senses tingling, you decide to investigate.

Title: Killing the Quilen
Objective: Kill 9 Stone Guardians.
Text: We've taken care of the scout problem for now, but there are still advance mogu forces inside the Guo-Lai Halls down the hill. Unfortunately, their vicious guard dogs are protecting their operations deeper in the ruins. Go and dispatch of their beasts. Be on your guard - they can be quite good at blending into their surroundings.

Title: Stones of Power
Objective: Collect 7 Revelite Crystals.
Text: Many thousands of years ago, the rulers of the Vale sought energy from a powerful crystal known as Revelite. With this substance, they were able to power cities, factories, and engines of war. Zhi the Harmonious has asked us to collect some crystals and bring them back to the city. Keep an eye out for them while you are in the ruins.

Title: Barring Entry
Objective: Speak to Lao Softfoot at the entrance to Ruins Rise and follow him up the trail. Then, plant the Explosive Keg at the Ruins Rise Cave Entrance.
Text: Lao Softfoot and I scouted up the ruins to the north. It looks like the mogu are infiltrating the valley through a cave just up the hill, and already they are sending formidable reinforcements through. There are too many enemies to take them head on, so you'll have to meet Lao Softfoot at the entrance to the ruins. He'll help you sneak in under the cover of stealth. Then, plant this keg of explosives at the mouth of the cave. The rest should take care of itself.

Title: Out with the Scouts
Objective: Kill 8 Shao-Tien Precursor.
Text: We'd been briefed on mogu sightings in the Vale, but the situation is worse than we had anticipated. Scouts are swarming all over the ruins to the northwest, gathering intel and stealing treasures. Your objective is clear - dispatch of any scouts you see. An army cannot move if we take out its eyes.

Title: The Ruins of Guo-Lai
Objective: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: According to Zhi the Harmonious, the mogu are moving into the Vale from the Ruins of Guo-Lai to the west. I sent Anji and Kun to investigate the situation, but they have not yet returned. I need a capable  like you to go check on them.

Title: The Shrine of Seven Stars
Objective: Speak to Jaluu the Generous, Kuru the Light-Hearted, Lucky Lin, and Matron Vi Vinh in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: Look at this creature, traveler. Only moments after we arrived, this mogu assassin attacked with no warning. His blade was intended for the leader of the Golden Lotus. It is very lucky indeed that we were here to stop the attack. Seeing this attempt on Zhi's life, I fear for the safety of those who have already entered the valley. The caretakers are settling your people into the city to the southeast. Go and speak to the leaders. Make sure they are safe.

Title: FLAG - Player Began Finale
Objective: Listen to Xiao and his companions.
Text: Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs. I'm just a visitor... like you. Now if you'll excuse me, my friends and I trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.

Title: Into the Vale
Objective: Speak to Matron Vi Vinh at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: Ah, I have been waiting for your arrival, traveler. I wish we could meet in better times, but alas, I fear the situation in the Vale is quite dire. But let us not speak of that now. Go visit Matron Vi Vinh at the Shrine of Seven Stars. She should be able to settle you in.

Title: The Gratitude of Stoneplow
Objective: Find the Commander's Cache and collect your reward.
Text: One last thing. Don't worry, it's not another favor. You've killed enough mantid today. We recently received a shipment of high-quality armor from Kun-Lai Summit. I was planning to keep them for my men... but I can't think of anybody more deserving than you. You'll find them on the second floor of the inn, here in town.

Title: Retreat!
Objective: Report to Loon Mai at Stoneplow in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: I'm going to withdraw what few forces I have. We may have to fall back to the Stormstout Brewery, or even Halfhill. That call is Commander Loon Mai's to make. You go ahead. Deliver word to the Commander. My Shado-Pan will be shortly behind.

Title: The Mantidote
Objective: Use Ken-Ken's Mask on 5 Ik'thik Wing Commanders, then defeat the Manifestations of Fear that come out.
Text: You see those huge mantid commanders out there? They have a strange aura about them. It reminds me of the sadness we saw at Zhu's Watch. Perhaps... they're under the influence of the sha, too? I kept Ken-Ken's mask - the one he used to remove the sha from Yi-Mo. I believe that, if we use it on the mantid, we can convince them to turn back.

Title: The Savior of Stoneplow
Objective: Speak with Miss Fanny at Stoneplow. Then, with her help, defeat the Mantid Colossus.
Text: That commander speaks hastily. He has the weapon he needs to win this battle. He has YOU. "But it's too hard," you might say. You would be wrong. It is not too hard. NOTHING IS TOO HARD. Go now. Go, and save Stoneplow!

Title: They Stole My Luck!
Objective: Return Ji-Lu the Lucky's Lucky Virmen's Foot, Yak Shoe, Four Winds Clover, and Gold Coin.
Text: My journeys through Kun-Lai have taught me two things. First, never sneak up on a sleeping yak. Second, having luck on your side is both necessary and hard to come by. The grummles believe in carrying a lucky trinket at all times. In my mind, if one trinket can sometimes bring luck, then many trinkets would guarantee it! After arriving in One Keg my lucky trinkets were stolen by those little menace sprites. I'd be truly grateful if you could retrieve them for me.

Title: The Swarm Begins
Objective: Slay 15 Ik'thik Warriors or Ik'thik Infestors.
Text: Without the wall to protect us, we barely stand a chance. If you hadn't gathered so many people to help us, we wouldn't have a prayer. Check in with Captain Oakenshield - he should be up near the break in the wall. Kill as many mantid as you can on the way there. If we win, we win. If we lose, we go down fighting. For Pandaria!

Title: Students No More
Objective: Find the martial arts students, then help them defeat an Ik'thik Bloodrager, Egg-Matron, Tendon-Slicer, and Fearmonger.
Text: Those five students - the ones who were looking for the Hidden Master - they went up to the front lines, alone. I'd send Shado-Pan to aid them, but I haven't got any left. There's dangerous creatures up there near the wall. If you find those students, make sure that they haven't fallen to any of them.

Title: Mogu?! Oh No-gu!
Objective: Kill the Mogujia Soul-Caller.
Text: I know your friends are worried about the animating statues over at Mogujia, but I'll tell you what you should really be worried about.Where there are animated statues, there are Mogu. I don't know if you've seen one before, but if you haven't...Well, let's just say Mogu are bad, bad, news.While you're dealing with whatever else you're doing, you need to get the Mogu behind the trouble!

Title: It Does You No Good In The Keg
Objective: Bring beer to Zhu's Wardens, the Crane Wing Priests, the Shado-Pan, and the night elf settlers.
Text: I been thinkin'. We got all this beer that Chen brewed, and we got all these people that you've gathered. We should bring the two together. There's a bunch o' folks out there in the fields, riskin' their lives for Pandaria. You an' I should at least bring 'em a keg or two. They might raise their mugs in victory. They might enjoy one last drink before gettin' skivvered by a mantid. Either way, I wouldn't want 'em to fight without a good brew in their belly.

Title: Mogu?! Oh No-gu!
Objective: Kill the Mogujia Soul-Caller.
Text: I know your friends are worried about the animating statues over at Mogujia, but I'll tell you what you should really be worried about.Where there are animated statues, there are mogu. I don't know if you've seen one before, but if you haven't...Well, let's just say mogu are bad, bad, news.While you're dealing with whatever else you're doing, you need to get the mogu behind the trouble!

Title: Oil Stop
Objective: Fill the Empty Oil Vial at a Yaungol Oil Derrick.
Text: When the yaungols came, they began to dig up oil. What is this "oil", I wonder? Perhaps it is thing of much undiscovered luck. This I must know. Here, take this vial, and fill it with yaungol oil from one of their windmills. I will give you many fortunes if you bring me some.

Title: Resupplying One Keg
Objective: Recover 8 Stolen Supplies from Howlingwind Cavern.
Text: If you're looking for the best supplies in Kun-Lai you've come to the right place! Oh sure, it looks a bit empty. Don't let appearances deceive you.. Oh, who am I kidding?! Between the hozen attacks, and the sprites pillaging what few supplies we do get, my stock has dwindled to a dangerous level. If you could help me recover some of my supplies I should have enough to contribute to your journey.

Title: A Zandalari Troll?
Objective: Kill the Zandalari Soulraiser.
Text: While you've been destroying the reanimated mogu statues, the unmistakable accent of a Zandalari troll has been taunting you. It's clear that the threat to Westerly Rest will not end until he's been dealt with.

Title: Traffic Issues
Objective: Defeat 8 Fire Camp Ruqin Yaungols.
Text: Yaungols are attacking our Burlap Trail. This is most bad fortune for grummles. We use that trail to carry supplies to the Serpent's Spine. Without supplies, the defenders of the wall are in danger. Grummles are packers and explorers, not fighters. Could you be a luckydo for us and stop the yaungol blockade?

Title: Roadside Assistance
Objective: Light 8 Lucky Burlap Incense sticks along the road to One Keg.
Text: A luckydo remembers to bring incense on a journey in to the mountains. The smellier the luck the better. Can you journey up the road to One Keg and light the incense you find along the way? This will give good fortune to grummles that must travel the road. Brother Lintpocket can give you many rewards. Speak to him when you arrive.

Title: Armored Carp
Objective: Use the Fishing Spear to catch 5 Armored Carp in the waters south of Anglers Wharf.
Text: Armored Carp are a delicacy around these parts. Unfortunately we can't fish them up since they snap our hooks with their powerful jaws. Take this fishing spear and see if you can catch a few for us.

Title: Unleash The Yeti!
Objective: Kill 4 Cagemasters.
Text: Your yeti ride gave me an idea. The Ook of Dook has a pet yeti he named Chomp Chomp. He uses this yeti to scare other hozen in to making him the leader hozen. We need to get rid of that yeti. Go to Dooker Dome northwest of here and defeat some of the Cagemasters so Chomp Chomp is not tied up as much. Yakshoe and I will meet you there with lots of incense and a dirty yak.

Title: The Leader Hozen
Objective: Enrage Chomp Chomp and then defeat the Ook of Dook.
Text: The time has come to face the Ook of Dook. We beat him, and the hozen won't have someone telling them to ravage. Here is the plan: Yakshoe will lead Tassle in to arena and scare away Chomp Chomp. Then, you sneak in and fight the Ook of Dook while his hozen are distracted by the yeti rampaging through their home. We'll meet you back at Kota Basecamp with a big reward. Good fortune to you, friend of grummles.

Title: Hozen Love Their Keys
Objective: Get the Yeti Shackle Key from Cho Cho the Wicked and release Old Poot Poot.
Text: The hozen have a yeti! They call it Old Poot Poot and keep it at the back of their cave. Hozen are normally scared of yeti, but now they feed it grummles. They have a Hunter Chief, Cho Cho the Wicked. Can you see if he has a key on him to the yeti shackles? Bad fortune for hozen if a yeti is loose in their fort.

Title: Thumping Knucklethump
Objective: Slay 8 Knucklethump Smashers or Jibstabbers at Knucklethump Hole.
Text: The Knucklethump hozen have new chief, the Ook of Dook. He sees fear in the west, anger in the south, hatred in the north, and yaungols in the east. And so he sets his hozen to ravage, gathering food and supplies for coming famine. They are many Knucklethumps and dangerous. Please, Luckydo, can you defeat their fighters?

Title: The Snackrifice
Objective: Rescue 5 Imprisoned Grummles by cutting them down or releasing them from cages.
Text: They took my grummles! Hozen don't eat grummles, but yeti do. And the Knucklethumps have a yeti. Please rescue my grummles. Cut them down or let them out of cages. Rescue them any way you can. Many fortunes and rewards if you do this.

Title: Bros Before Hozen
Objective: Rescue Brother Yakshoe.
Text: While you were gone, I saw a group of grummles coming down the Burlap Trail. It was led by my Brother Yakshoe. But then the Knucklethumps attacked. They took my brother and his grummles north. Please! Save my brother. He always has bad fortune and no luck, but he is my brother. Look for him at the alter in front of Fort Silverback.

Title: Grummle! Grummle! Grummle!
Objective: Lead 5 Packless Grummles to Supply Crates near the Dooker Dome.
Text: Now that grummles are rescued, we need to rescue our supplies. The Ook of Dook is only chief because he has supplies. Go to the Dooker Dome area north west of here. Take some grummles with you. Keep them safe and get them near supply crates. Grummles know what to do from there. Rabbitsfoot and I will meet you there.

Title: Breaking Broketooth
Objective: Kill 8 Broketooth Chargers and 6 Broketooth Tossers.
Text: Hozen only ravage when they think their supplies are too few for their number of mouths. Problem is, hozen always have more mouths than food. We have very few grummles these days. It is a hard thing to ask, but can you be a friend to grummles, and destroy some of the Broketooth hozen south of here? It is the only way to prevent them from destroying the landscape.

Title: The Broketooth Ravage
Objective: Retrieve Rabbitsfoot's Luckydo from Mo Mo.
Text: They took my luckydo! Their leader hozen here, Mo Mo, stole my rabbitsfoot. This is most bad fortune for grummles. My rabbitsfoot is a big luckydo for grummles everywhere. If hozen learn how to get luck from my rabbitsfoot then all is lost. Please can you get it back?

Title: No Pack Left Behind
Objective: Recover 8 Grummlepacks from Camp Broketooth or The Deeper.
Text: The Broketooth hozen south of here killed all of my grummles. What is worse, their packages are undelivered. Fortune frowns on a grummlepack undelivered. Please, give my grummles peace on the great trail of beyond and bring their grummlepacks to me. I will see they are delivered.

Title: The Rabbitsfoot
Objective: Rescue Brother Rabbitsfoot from the Broketooth Outpost.
Text: The Broketooth hozen stole our Rabbitsfoot! He was the grummle with the biggest luckydo. This is very bad fortune indeed. Please, we need our Rabbitsfoot back. We need his good fortune back. Can you search the Broketooth Outpost for him?

Title: Strange Spherical Stone
Objective: Infuse the stone with several Golden Lotus.
Text: This beautiful stone clearly has magical potential... at least to one trained in alchemy. You are certain that with the right herbs native to Pandaria, this stone could become very useful.

Title: A Monkey Idol
Objective: Use the Corpses of Tak Tak, Dak Dak, and Ko Ko on their respective altars.
Text: Before, grummles keep hozen from ravaging by bribing with food. But now the Broketooth hozen south of here have their big magic idols. The Ook of Dook has trained them to use their idols to get power from sacrifices. They are using them to kill grummles! You must destroy these idols! For every idol, there is a chief. Kill the chief and throw corpse on their altar.

Title: Who Knew Fish Liked Eggs?
Objective: Collect a Pristine Egg from the Narsong Spires and use it to catch a Silver Goby.
Text: Great cranes have been nesting in this area for generations. The Narsong Spires provide a sheltered area to rear their young. Their pristine eggs are revered as bait for catching the silver goby. Retrieve a crane egg and see if you can catch a goby!

Title: Instant Courage
Objective: Inspire 3 Hiding Guides in Howlingwind Cavern to help you.
Text: It is very bad fortune to travel mountain paths without a good guide. We grummles make the best guides, but many have run away. They fear the mountain pass now. Many good grummles disappear up there. Grummles are good at many things, but are not very brave. Maybe with fire lotus incense you can make them brave. Then they will show you the way.

Title: A Zandalari Troll?
Objective: Kill the Zandalari Soulraiser.
Text: While you've been destroying the reanimated mogu statues, the unmistakable accent of a Zandalari troll has been taunting you. It's clear that the threat to Westerly Rest will not end until he's been dealt with.

Title: Profiting off of the Past
Objective: Collect 12 Mogu Relics.
Text: Let me guess, you're here to deal with the mogu statues that are being reanimated. What a coincidence, I'm here to, um... conduct research on the mogu. I tell you what, if you bring me as many of the mogu relics in there that you can carry, I'll give you a cut. Of the research... funding.

Title: Deanimate the Reanimated
Objective: Destroy any 14 Terracotta Warriors or Terracotta Guardians.
Text: I've got much to do here. I could use your help. There's a place to the northwest. The pandaren here call it Mogujia. Something's causing the statues there to animate, and our pandaren friends here are pretty spooked about it. If they're not dealt with soon, we might have a serious problem. We just moved in. It's not like we can afford to fight a war with an army of statues right now.

Title: Deanimate the Reanimated
Objective: Destroy any 14 Terracotta Warriors or Terracotta Guardians.
Text: The admiral's asked me to take care of a major problem, but my specialty's in healing, not fighting! The pandaren in the camp here have told me that something is animating the statues to the northeast at Mogujia. Will you help me out? We can't afford to have a fight with an army of statues right now.

Title: The Burlap Trail: To Burlap Waystation
Objective: Protect a group of grummles travelling to the Burlap Waystation. At least one grummle must survive.
Text: Bad fortune for grummles today. Hozen have begun to ravage! They attack our supply line to the Serpent's Spine. Can you help? We are not fighters. We are grummles. Good fortune to those who help grummles. Go with a group of grummles to the Burlap Waystation. Keep them safe. Make sure at least one grummle survives. Grummles shall reward. Grummles always reward.

Title: Fishing for a Bruising
Objective: Kill 8 Riverblade Beach Raiders at Anglers Expedition, just west of Anglers Wharf.
Text: The riverblade saurok clan is attacking one of our local fishing expeditions! They need help right away! Thin those saurok out and help that expedition return safely!

Title: Handle With Care
Objective: Recover 6 Packed Explosive Charges.
Text: We can help you get your ship free, but we'll need more of the explosives we were trying to take back from the Alliance to make it happen. I ordered the men to grab all the explosives they could before making our escape. If you sift through the wreckage and bodies to our south, there should be some explosive bundles among them, those that didn't already blow up anyway. Get me enough of them and I think I can put something together for ya.

Title: Preying on the Predators
Objective: Kill 9 Pei-Wu Tigers.
Text: The forest has become far more dangerous ever since Shen-zin Su began shaking. The tigers are agitated and have begun attacking the refugees, and on occasion, me as well. If these injured and weak survivors are to make it to safety here at the hut, we need to help clear the forest for them.

Title: Wrecking the Wreck
Objective: Speak to Makael Bay in the Pei-Wu Forest.
Text: To dislodge the alliance ship, we need to find our engineer. He parted ways with us when we were escaping the wreckage. You should be able to find him somewhere in the western forest. Tell him Korga sent you and he'll get in line to help.

Title: Yakity Yak
Objective: Kill 9 Burilgi Despoilers at the Muskpaw Ranch.
Text: For now, the yaungol invaders seem content to steal yaks. Surveying the area, however, you notice they could easily move on the Yak Wash at any moment. Thinning their numbers may help show the yaungol that this area is protected.

Title: Jagged Abalone
Objective: Harvest 9 Jagged Abalone Meat from the Jagged Abalone in Narsong Trench to the northeast.
Text: Pandaren have been harvesting jagged abalone in this area for generations. Now it's time for you to learn the ritual. The abalone can be found just northeast of here in narsong trench. Be careful, we have noticed increased shark activity in that area recently.

Title: The Late Mrs. Muskpaw
Objective: Bring the Muskpaw Keepsake to Lao Muskpaw.
Text: This well worn trinket has several markings on it confessing love and adoration from the late Mrs. Muskpaw. Perhaps Lao would like his wife's trinket back.

Title: Blue Dwarf Needs Food Badly
Objective: Collect 160 Kun-Lai Meaty Bits.
Text: Oi!We need ta' get us some food, if we're gonna survive here for long!Ye' may not know it, but I'm somethin' of a cook me'self. Why don'tcha go out there and fetch us some meaty bits. I can cook 'em up and feed us for weeks! Or, days, at least.

Title: ... and the Pot, Too!
Objective: Collect 12 Root Vegetables and 1 Cast Iron Pot.
Text: Sure, I'm willing to help you guys out. But we need to eat, too! I don't even have a pot to cook in! Let alone ingredients to put in it! Here's a list of the things that I need. Now get!

Title: Shocking!
Objective: Fish up 7 Dojani Eels from the Dojani River in Krasarang Wilds.
Text: Have you ever had a fresh dojani eel ? No? Well you have not lived then! Head north up to the dojani river and fish up a few for us. Be careful, those eels can zap you if you're not careful!

Title: What Lurks Below
Objective: Find an Ancient Fishing Pool at Krasari Falls to the northwest and fish in it to lure the beast out of hiding.
Text: Legend tells of a great beast in the forest to the north. My son is missing and I fear he may have wandered too near its lair.... Head northwest to Krasari Falls and look for a mysterious whirlpool - this is the key to revealing what is hidden there. Kill the wretched beast and recover any clues to my son's whereabouts.

Title: Round 'Em Up
Objective: Round up 3 Wild Plains Yaks and return them to Westwind Rest.
Text: Mobility is going to be key to maintaining our foothold in this new land. Problem is, there's no way to maintain mobility without mounts, and... well, we don't have many of those here, now do we?The local yaks seem to make good mounts. At least, the local pandaren say they do. Why don't you go round some up for us?

Title: Trouble on the Farmstead
Objective: Speak with Farmer Chow at the Chow Farmstead in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: I... I escaped from Farmer Chow's, to the southeast of here. It's been taken over by yaungol, but the old man and his wife just won't give it up!Please, go there and help him... Maybe if you do, he'll be willing to send some folks back here and help you guys farm up some food for the new town?

Title: Farmhand Freedom
Objective: Free 12 Farmstead Slaves by killing Ordo Overseers.
Text: Those Ordo yaungol are working my farmhands to death! It just ain't right. Please, save them before it's too late.

Title: Helping the Cause
Objective: Check in with Bold Karasshi, Amber Kearnen, and Mishka.
Text: Welcome back! It seems the Jinyu have taken to our training even better than I had hoped. We're in the final stages of our preparations now. I need someone to go check in with Amber, Bold Karasshi, and Mishka. See if they need any help to complete their training. You'll find Karasshi and Mishka here in Pearlfin Village. Amber is training recruits in Slingtail Pits to the northwest.

Title: Trouble on the Farmstead
Objective: Speak with Farmer Chow at the Chow Farmstead in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: I... I escaped from Farmer Chow's, to the southeast of here. It's been taken over by yaungol, but the old man and his wife just won't give it up!Please, go there and help him out. Maybe if you do, he'll be willing to send some folks back here and help you guys farm up some food for the new town?

Title: FLAG - Pest Problems Training
Objective: Listen to Xiao and his companions.
Text: Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs. I'm just a visitor... like you. Now if you'll excuse me, my friends and I trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.

Title: An Unexpected Advantage
Objective: Retrieve the missing Water-Damaged Gears and Rusty Locking Bolts from the Hozen Ambushers to the East.
Text: Things seem to be goin' our way more and more lately. I was out doin some explorin' when I came upon this little beauty.  Problem is she's one of a set and the other one is still in pieces. I'd have gotten it together by now if those pesky Grimleers hadn't ambushed me and taken some of the gears and bolts. Hey, ye seem to be pretty good at handlin' the natives. Ye wouldn't mind goin' and helpin' ol'Sully out would ye?

Title: Blanche's Boomer Brew
Objective: Complete the "Brewing Storm" Scenario.
Text: Can you smell it in the air? A storm is brewing! And so am I! Meet me at the hilltop when the storm hits and together we'll whip up a keg of my most famous brew. Can I count on your help?

Title: We're Treasure Hunters
Objective: Look for the rumored treasure on the Felrage Strand.
Text: I have a feeling you're just using me for tips on where all the best treasure is. From now on I'm naga tell you anything. Did I say, "naga" just then? I meant to say, I'm not gonna to tell you naga. I mean nada! Darn it!Okay. Seems you got me on this one. I'll tell you what, fetch me whatever is in that chest near those naga freaks and I'll make it worth your while.

Title: Ship Graveyard
Objective: Look for the rumored treasure deep in the Forlorn Depths.
Text: I haven't told you that I was part of the original landing party when we lost almost everything. I don't care what treasure is left there, I'll never go back to that beach. Never.

Title: Tomb Raidering
Objective: Look for the rumored treasure outside the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: I said to myself over and over, "Don't go near the citadel. Don't go near the citadel." But what did I do? I went to the citadel. Almost had my hands on that sweet treasure chest before I got chased off by a bunch of crazy demons. I made it out of there with just my helmet and my life!

Title: Grave Robbin'
Objective: Look for the rumored treasure in the Soul Ruins.
Text: I am not a grave robber, but is it technically grave robbing if the treasure is sitting on a field of bones? It's not like it's buried or nothin'. I'm just gonna sit this one out, just in case.

Title: Learn and Grow I: Seeds
Objective: Speak with Merchant Greenfield at Halfhill Market and acquire a Packet of Green Cabbage Seeds.
Text: Well, first things first! I'm going to need lots of help 'round here. If we're going to be partners, you've got to learn how to harvest crops, and if you wanna harvest crops you gotta plant seeds! Now it's my understanding that a mister, uh... Grainfell? No, that wasn't it... Greedfill? That doesn't sound right... Greenfield! That's his name! He's the man to see for seeds. Greenfield's got a stall over at Halfhill Market, directly southeast of here - go see him and pick up some vegetable seeds.

Title: FLAG - Weed War Training
Objective: Listen to Xiao and his companions.
Text: Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs. I'm just a visitor... like you. Now if you'll excuse me, my friends and I trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.

Title: A Second Hand
Objective: Speak to one of your best friends and ask them to work on Sunsong Ranch.
Text: Despite your best efforts, the work is starting to pile up around here. Perhaps you could ask one of your best friends if they'd like to help out at Sunsong Ranch.

Title: Spiders, Huh?
Objective: Look for the rumored treasure in the Creeping Grotto.
Text: I feel like they're still crawling all over me. I squished one egg and all of a sudden I'm covered head to toe in baby spiders..That treasure is just sitting there now. The next guy better not be arachnaphlipic... arachnaphonetic? Arachniphant? Afraid of spiders!

Title: Growing the Farm III: The Mossy Boulder
Objective: Speak to Haohan Mudclaw in The Heartland or at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: Now that we're officially members of the Tillers Union, Mr. Mudclaw said he'd be happy to help us upturn this big ole' rock in the middle of our field. Once we clear away that stone, I've got something special planned. Run down and give him a holler to let him know that we're ready.

Title: Haohan's Vote V: Chief Yip-Yip
Objective: Kill Chief Yip-Yip at Kunzen Cave to the northwest.
Text: You ready for the final step of the plan? The leader of the Kunzen hozen is a brute by the name of Chief Yip-Yip. It's said that he is nearly impervious to pain. I've injected the melons with a toxic mixture, so don't try eating them! Once you get his attention, throw these melons onto the ground. Yip-Yip won't be able to resist a sweet striped melon. When he takes a bite, he'll be temporarily weakened, and you should find yourself an opening to attack.

Title: Growing the Farm II: The Broken Wagon
Objective: Speak to Fish Fellreed at Cattail Lake or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: Hey . I've been looking at that wagon every day, day in and day out, since the day I moved in. Quite an eyesore, don't you think? I heard in town that Fish Fellreed is quite handy with tools. She might be able to fix it up, and then we could turn that patch of land into a plot for farming. Why don't you talk to her and see if she'd be willing to do the job?

Title: Lost and Lonely
Objective: Collect 20 Tasty T-Bone from the Skyrange Mushan on the Skyrange in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: The starving, mangy dog whines piteously and attempts a brief wag of its tail. It looks like it could use a good meal right about now.

Title: Haohan's Vote III: Pure Poison
Objective: Collect 1 Bloodbloom, 1 Cave Lily, 1 Ghostcap, and 1 Violet Lichen.
Text: All right. This is our big chance! Mr. Mudclaw's farm is in big trouble. Those mountain hozen are coming down at night, wrecking his crops and eating his hard-earned harvest. We've got to get rid of them for good, and I know just how to do it. Back in the day, my grandpa showed me how to mix a wounding poison to deal with the pests on the farm. The virmen warrens to the north hold the key ingredients for my mixture. Don't look so worried! I'm pretty sure this is going to work.

Title: Haohan's Vote IV: Melons For Felons
Objective: Plant and harvest 4 Striped Melons, then deliver 20 Striped Melons to Farmer Yoon.
Text: All right, now I happen to know that those mountain hozen love a delicious, sweet melon. Mr. Haohan's last harvest of melons got stolen, so we're going to have to grow some of our own. Once we have our harvest, we'll use them to lure the nasty hozen's leader out of its cave!

Title: Growing the Farm II: Knock on Wood
Objective: Collect 100 Waxed Planks.
Text: Sure! I know just the wagon that you're talkin' about! I can fix it right up, but I'll need wood. There's a whole lot of it down at the bottom of the lake. If you fish it right out - haha, get it? Fish? Oh I just crack myself up sometimes. Anyway, you bring me here some 'o that wood and then I'll get right to work!

Title: Haohan's Vote II: The Real Culprits
Objective: Investigate 8 Suspicious Footprints.
Text: What are YOU doing here, citypaw? Look, I've got my hands full with a break-in at my shed to the west. Some rascals came in the middle of the night and ransacked the place. I've got missing seeds, broken tools, and eaten inventory to deal with. I'll just add it to my list of other troubles: a whole wagon of melons stolen, a broken water pump, animals ruining my harvest... I wish that I could just get to the bottom of all this already!

Title: Haohan's Vote I: Bungalow Break-In
Objective: Speak to Haohan Mudclaw at The Heartland or at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: This is going to be tough. The last vote we need comes from Haohan Mudclaw, the head of the Tillers Union. I know he wasn't too keen on us to start, but we've learned so much about farming, I'm sure he'll have a change of heart! Go speak to him. You can be very convincing, right?

Title: Tummy Trouble
Objective: Use Gooseberries to cure sick Halfhill Villagers.
Text: I like Farmer Yoon just dandy as a neighbor, but getting my vote is another matter entirely. He does know that my father is the head of the Union, right? Anyway, I've got bigger problems to worry about. Lotta folks been getting sick from eating bad vegetables. Since they bought the produce from my market, my reputation is in jeopardy. Now I've got an idea to cure the stomach rumbles, but it ain't pretty. If you'd be willing to... um... hurry things along, I just might be indebted to you.

Title: Nana's Vote I: Nana's Secret Recipe
Objective: Speak to Nana Mudclaw at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: The next vote we'll need is from Nana Mudclaw. She's Haohan's grandmother, and she's been a Tiller longer than you and I have been alive! She's still working at the Tillers building in Halfhill. Why don't you pay her a visit?

Title: Challenge Accepted
Objective: Set the Yaungol Banner at Fire Camp Bataar ablaze to summon Ur-Bataar, and then defeat him in combat.
Text: The yaungol have always been a difficult, proud people, but never this violent or aggressive.I do not know what has prompted this change in their behavior, but we don't have time to find out, now. We fear for our lives and livelihoods as long as Ur-Bataar, leader of the Bataari yaungol, lives.Go, set the banner in his camp ablaze to challenge him, and then defeat him in battle. Only then will we be secure.

Title: Farmer Fung's Vote I: Yak Attack
Objective: Speak to Farmer Fung at The Heartland or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: The next voting member on the Tiller's council is Farmer Fung, and it's easy to see why. That man's vegetables are the biggest in the valley! I only hope that someday I can grow pumpkins as big as his. If we hope to join the Tillers, he would be the next person to convince.

Title: Farmer Fung's Vote II: On the Loose
Objective: Return 5 Escaped Shagskins to Farmer Fung's yak pen at the very north end of the Verdant Belt.
Text: You want my vote for Farmer Yoon? Ha! You're joking, right? Listen, I'm not going to vote for some citypaw with no lick a' knowledge about farming the earth. It would be an embarrassment to farm alongside you or that Yoon shmuck. Now let me deal with my own problems. Some devil let my prize yaks loose, and now they're running wild northwest of Halfhill. If I could just get my yaks back, then maybe I'd be able to sleep at night.

Title: Eastwind Rest
Objective: Speak with Farmhand Ko and Elder Shiao in Kun Lai Summit.
Text: I am injured, but we can't stop here.The hozen were... unreliable. The pandaren would be much better allies.You have seen the refugees in this village, and heard of the yaungol invasion, no?Well, we've heard from the locals that Eastwind Rest, a nearby village, was destroyed by the Yaungol.Apparently some survivors have gathered along the road out of town.Go. Take the road west. Gather the survivors.We'll help them rebuild. Then, they will see the advantage of joining the Horde!

Title: Westwind Rest
Objective: Speak with Farmhand Bo and Elder Tsulan in the Yaungol Advance.
Text: Jade Forest was a disaster.Anduin's gone. We lost some good people. We didn't stop the Horde from advancing into the continent.But I think I've found a way to get the locals on our side. You just helped fight off some of these "yaungol", no?I hear yaungol sacked Westwind Rest, a local village. We've been told that two groups of survivors have camped out along the road west out of town.We help them out, maybe they'll consider siding with the Allliance.

Title: Growing the Farm I: A Little Problem
Objective: Gather 6 Spideroot for Gai Lan.
Text: So you need to whack some wily weeds? No problem, neighbor! Only thing is, I'm running low on weed killer. I make my own concoction - very potent, totally organic and good for the earth. Plants love it! Well... except for those pesky weeds. They hate the stuff! If you bring me some Spideroot from the terraces just west of us, I'll make a fresh batch and go down to Yoon's farm myself. I would gather some myself but... well... I hate spiders. You'll see what I mean.

Title: General Nazgrim has Awakened
Objective: Speak with General Nazgrim at Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: It would seem that your General Nazgrim has awakened from his injuries. He and his people are upstairs. He has requested your presence.

Title: Admiral Taylor has Awakened
Objective: Speak with Admiral Taylor at Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: It would seem that your Admiral Taylor has awakened from his injuries. He and his people are upstairs. He has requested your presence.

Title: Challenge Accepted
Objective: Set the Yaungol Banner ablaze to summon Ur-Bataar, and then defeat him in combat.
Text: The yaungol have always been a difficult, proud people, but never this violent or aggressive.I do not know what has prompted this change in their behavior, but we don't have time to find out, now. We fear for our lives and livelihoods as long as Ur-Bataar, leader of the Bataari yaungol, lives.Go, set the banner in his camp ablaze to challenge him, and then defeat him in battle. Only then will we be secure.

Title: General Nazgrim has Awakened
Objective: Speak with General Nazgrim at Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: It would seem that your General Nazgrim has awakened from his injuries. He and his people are upstairs in the apothecary's house across the way. He has requested your presence.

Title: General Nazgrim has Awakened
Objective: Speak with General Nazgrim at Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: It would seem that your General Nazgrim has awakened from his injuries. He and his people are upstairs in the apothecary's house back in Binan Village. He has requested your presence.

Title: Admiral Taylor has Awakened
Objective: Speak with Admiral Taylor at Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: It would seem that your Admiral Taylor has awakened from his injuries. He and his people are upstairs in the apothecary's house across the way. He has requested your presence.

Title: Admiral Taylor has Awakened
Objective: Speak with Admiral Taylor at Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: It would seem that your Admiral Taylor has awakened from his injuries. He and his people are upstairs in the apothecary's house back in Binan Village. He has requested your presence.

Title: Residual Fallout
Objective: Destroy 10 Sha Echoes.
Text: Pandaria is a mystical land, traveler. It bears repeating that some of its secrets remain hidden, even to Lorewalkers. Sealing those fissures did not mend what has been broken. If the legends are true, it will take much more to release this land from the grasp of the Sha. The aggression of that battle awakened a host of living negative emotions. What you see here is likely the first of many such manifestations. For now, we can only try to diminish their presence here.

Title: Emergency Response
Objective: Use Cho's Fireworks near General Nazgrim, Shademaster Kiryn, Shokia, and Rivett Clutchpop.
Text: Your companions have made themselves at home in our land, and brought with them a dangerous conflict. The full extent of their destruction here we cannot yet know. Already it is... unspeakable. Nevertheless, to forsake your friends out of spite would be against our way. Any that yet live are doubtlessly wounded and in desperate need of care. These fireworks were to celebrate the statue's completion. Use them near your companions to signal Mishi, and she will bear them off to safety.

Title: The Waterspeaker's Staff
Objective: Recover Waterspeaker Gorai's Stolen Inkgill Ritual Staff from Orachi in Inkgill Mere.
Text: There is great dissent in Inkgill. Elder Shai Hu drank the sha-corrupted waters of the mere, and forced the others to do the same. When I protested, Orachi of the town guard confiscated my ritual staff and banished me. Now, I am not only an exile, I am unable to speak with the waters that once gave me guidance! I am not a fighter. But if you are, perhaps you can recover my staff from Orachi? He is in town to our north.

Title: Jaded Heart
Objective: Use Celestial Jade Chunks to defeat 6 Sha Remnants.
Text: The more powerful remnants of that horrible manifestation may be too much for you to handle on your own. I fear I'd be of little help in terms of actual combat, but I can suggest a solution.
