The great jade statue was soon to become a living serpent - one of our revered celestials. Its construction imbued it with special powers that may sufficiently weaken these adversaries.

Title: Get Back Here!
Objective: Return to General Nazgrim at Grookin Hill.
Text: Oh, before I forget, I have something I was asked to deliver to you. A letter from one of your companions, I assume. I was made to understand that your presence was urgently required, so I took the liberty of arranging your passage. Speak to Ginsa Arroweye just south of here when you're ready. She has a kite waiting.

Title: Get Back Here!
Objective: Report to Admiral Taylor in Pearlfin Village.
Text: Oh, before I forget, I have something I was asked to deliver to you. A letter from one of your companions, I assume. I was made to understand that your presence was urgently required, so I took the liberty of arranging your passage. Speak to Ginsa Arroweye just south of here when you're ready. She has a kite waiting.

Title: Love's Labor
Objective: Deliver the jade to Historian Dinh, Surveyor Sawa, Kitemaster Shoku, and Taskmaster Emi.
Text: Can I trouble you for another favor? We're way behind schedule, and this jade shipment is the last we need to finish the great statue. I've got my hands full, so could you run this ore over to the other foremen? Historian Dinh, Surveyor Sawa, and Kitemaster Shoku can all be found around the base of the statue. Taskmaster Emi is directing production at the top of the statue. We're on a deadline, so make sure you do it fast! Time's a wasting!

Title: Yakity Yak
Objective: Kill 9 Burilgi Despoilers at the Muskpaw Ranch.
Text: Yaungols! They come through here taking what they want and destroying whatever's left. I can't have these thugs destroy the last pieces of the Yak Wash here. It's all my boy and I have left. Head over to our old ranch and dish out some pain on them yaungols. I bet if you kill enough of them they'll think twice before attacking anything in this area.

Title: Back in Yak
Objective: Bring the Washed Yaks to Lucky Eightcoins at the Grummle Bazaar in Kun-Lai Summit. Return to Muskpaw Jr. if you lose your yaks.
Text: I wasn't lying about your reward. Here, take these washed yaks to the grummle caravan master Eightcoins. You can find him at the Grummle Bazaar west of here. He'll credit us and give you a delivery fee. He may be short, but he is our biggest customer. Return to me if you lose the yaks. More often than not they just come right back here anyway. Once they've been cleaned that is.

Title: Comin' Round the Mountain
Objective: Escort the cart and guides safely up Neverest Mountain.
Text: The mountain pass is very dangerous. You need much luck to survive. Nephew Bentnail will show you the way. Perhaps today is a lucky day to travel though. Wind blows from the east; this is good sign. Grummles always travel best when east wind blows. Climb in the cart when you are ready to leave.

Title: At the Yak Wash
Objective: Bring 6 Escaped Yaks to the Wash Entrance at Lao & Son's Yak Wash.
Text: Look, my father is crazy. I love him, but he's crazy. These yaungol managed to completely obliterate our ranch and scattered our yaks every which way. If I know my father though, he's going to try to go head to head with the yaungol to get the yaks back. Can you help us round up some of the yaks so my father doesn't do anything stupid? Just ride them over to the Yak Wash so we can clean them up and sell them to the grummles.

Title: Fresh Needle Scent
Objective: Gather 100 Pungent Sprite Needles.
Text: Say, if you really are here to help, I could use me some needles off them sprites in Pranksters' Hollow. The grummles don't believe in luck they can't smell. They'll pay better for yaks that have that fresh needle scent.

Title: The Missing Muskpaw
Objective: Find Muskpaw Jr. in Pranksters' Hollow.
Text: What the heck are you supposed to be? A ? Never heard of one of them. You here to help or to steal my yaks? Look, if yer' insistin' on helpin' out, go find my boy. He got himself grabbed by a bunch of sprites and probably doesn't even know we lost the ranch. They dragged him off to Pranksters' Hollow south east of here. Go rescue him an' I'll see about giving you a reward of some sort.

Title: Gauging Our Progress
Objective: Check in with Shademaster Kiryn, Rivett Clutchpop, Shokia, and Riko.
Text: The time for war is at hand! We've been training these natives non-stop since you left, and I believe they're as good as they're going to get. See for yourself. Check in with the others and return with your findings. We must rely on our enemy being somehow... even less prepared.

Title: Last Piece of the Puzzle
Objective: Use Cho's Heirloom at Cho's Family Shrine on Serpent's Overlook.
Text: These hozen are behaving most unnaturally. Marching in formation? In armor? This troubles me. We must discuss it at another time, however. I have come to ask for your assistance. The ancient fresco, where last we spoke, is nearly unveiled. I am certain that it holds ancient wisdom - knowledge that the emperor wanted us to remember. My meditations alone may not be enough to discern its meaning. Please, take this heirloom to the shrine of my ancestors. I shall require their assistance.

Title: Carved in Stone
Objective: Collect 12 Guo-Lai Runestones.
Text: You see the shiny stones in the walls? Rook wants some. The mogu been collecting them, so they have some to take too maybe. If you find stones, you please bring them to Rook? Rook will be your friend.

Title: A Gift For Gina
Objective: Obtain a Goldenfire Orchid.
Text: Have you seen Gina Mudclaw, the market girl? She has it all - looks, brains, and nice big tummy. Could you deliver a gift for me? I wanted to pick some orchids that grow on top of the big hills to the west, but I can't climb that high. Could you pick a few and bring them to Gina? Oh, and when you see her... tell her I said "hi".

Title: A Gift For Fung
Objective: Obtain a Bloody Plainshawk Leg from a Monstrous Plainshawk, and then bring it to Kol Ironpaw in the Halfhill Market.
Text: Farmer Fung is pretty mean, and just a little scary. Mah always said that he was one of the best farmers in the valley, though. I think I know the perfect gift for a mean, kind of scary guy like him. There's some big plainshawks that circle the hills to the west of here. You should get one, find a big piece of meat, and then ask Kol Ironpaw to grill it up!

Title: The Ritual
Objective: Speak with Waterspeaker Gorai, and then complete the Ritual.
Text: From the moment I first rose from the river, I knew I was destined to be Waterspeaker.I was taught many rituals, and have performed all of them, save one.There was one, an extremely ancient one, that we were told to call upon if our people ever turned against us.This must have happened in our people's distant past, because we haven't needed to use it in our village's memory.I suppose now is the time to do so.

Title: The Soul-Gatherer
Objective: Kill Shadowmaster Sydow and recover the beads from his corpse.
Text: A single large mogu performing a ritual on the lake caught your attention while you were killing the other mogu in the area. It seems unwise to let his ritual complete.

Title: A Gift For Old Hillpaw
Objective: Find a Blue Freshwater Pearl.
Text: Old Hillpaw has about a million chickens on his farm... but that's not what he REALLY loves. I saw. He collects blue feathers. I don't realy know where to get a blue feather around here, but I do know where to find some blue pearls! Check the oysters in Cattail Lake to the northwest. I'm sure a blue pearl will look nice with his feather collection!

Title: A Gift For Haohan
Objective: Obtain an Enormous Cattail Grouper Tooth.
Text: Haohan Mudclaw is the big boss of the Tillers union and the richest guy in the Valley! He's been nice to let me stay here, so I want to do something nice for him. He likes expensive stuff, like ruby shards, but I don't have a lot of money, so I need to get him something else. I know! I've seen a great big fish in Cattail Lake! We should get one of its teeth as a gift!

Title: A Gift For Ella
Objective: Obtain Spicy Shrimp Dumplings.
Text: That poor Ella. She's so shy! I saw her standing in the Halfhill Market, looking really hungry, but afraid to talk to any of the chefs. We should bring her some food! And not any boring food - something special. The Kunzen hozen make spicy shrimp dumplings from ingredients they've stolen from our farms. I don't like spicy food, but Ella might!

Title: A Gift For Fish
Objective: Obtain a Yak Statuette from the inside of a Kunzen hozen hut.
Text: That Fish Fellreed is kind of weird. First of all, her name's Fish. That's weird. Once you talk to her, though, she's really a nice lady. Did you know that she's an animal lover? I've got an idea! The Kunzen hozen, in the mountains to the west, make little animal statues and put them in their huts to scare off bad guys. I bet Fish would LOVE something weird like that!

Title: A Gift For Jogu
Objective: Obtain 8 of Yoon's Apples and 50 of Yoon's Craneberries, then bring them to Bobo Ironpaw to brew into Apple-Berry Hooch.
Text: Sometimes I feel sad for Jogu. He's the only jinyu around, and I don't think he has any friends. Other than his smelly bottle, of course. You know what? I've got an idea. Farmer Yoon has a basket of craneberries inside his house, and a few apples as well. I'm sure you could bring them to the stillmaster in the Halfhill Market and get him to brew something special for Jogu.

Title: A Gift For Sho
Objective: Obtain a bowl of Yu-Ping Soup.
Text: Sho - that girl who lives up in the mountains - is in town today. I saw her walking toward the Halfhill Market. Such a long walk... she must be hungry! And I think I know just the thing that she'll like. The hozen up on the Skyrange cook a soup out of fish and apples. It sounds gross, I know... but it's awesome. You'll find it near their big, scary totem.

Title: A Gift For Chee Chee
Objective: Obtain an Authentic Valley Stir Fry.
Text: That crazy Chee Chee is actually pretty neat. Mah always said that hozen were nothing but trouble, but... I guess he's just a better hozen then the rest of them. We should do something nice for him! Those mountain hozen in the west make some really fancy stir fry, and keep bowls of it inside their little hozen houses. I bet Chee Chee would love some!

Title: Repossession
Objective: Collect 8 Stolen Supplies.
Text: Of course, the first priority is finding my son. But, if we save ourselves only to starve, then what have we accomplished, in the end?Please, I need you to recover some of the supplies that the Jinyu took from our caravan.

Title: Enraged Vengeance
Objective: Kill 15 Enraged Jinyu.
Text: I don't think I've ever been as... as furious as now. What betrayal! I fought them off when they attacked, killed a few here, but Merchant Shi is too much of a coward to let me go and finish the job! You, do it for me. Kill them. Kill them all.

Title: My Son...
Objective: Find Wu-Peng in the Inkgill Mere.
Text: My son - can you find my son?When the Jinyu attacked, he ran off in the confusion. I don't know if they've done anything with him, or if he's still alive, even.Nothing else matters if I can't find him.I'd ask Mei... but something's wrong with her. She seems too... impulsive since the attack. I just can't trust that she'd bring him back safely.

Title: A Gift For Tina
Objective: Obtain an Uncut Chrysoberyl.
Text: That Tina Mudclaw is in the Halfhill Market today, visiting her sister. She's really nice, but she's really hard to get gifts for! There's a little jewel that can be found in the cliffs to the north. It's called a chrysoberyl, and it changes color when you hold it. I'll bet she doesn't have one of THOSE! Look inside the virmen caves. I bet you'll find one really fast.

Title: Going on the Offensive
Objective: Speak with Lyalia at the Sentinel Basecamp in the Krasarang Wilds.
Text: Ha! So my father just wasted twenty years of our lives on a fool's errand! I'm taking charge. When Tyrande sent us here she was very specific that we not come back until we find the source of the Light that she saw in her visions. It's obvious now that the Pools of Youth were not it. We are pressing westward and could use your help. Meet us at the Sentinel Basecamp further west when you are ready.

Title: Sufficient Motivation
Objective: Motivate 10 Lazy Hozen.
Text: Training these savages has been quite a task. Finding ways to motivate them was easy enough; the problem is keeping them motivated.. and focused... and awake. Now that you're back, you can help me in getting the less disciplined Hozen moving, if you catch my drift. I'll leave the method up to you.

Title: Hit Medicine
Objective: Use the Dit Da Jow or your own healing to aid 8 Injured Binan Warriors.
Text: Our warriors are fighting to keep the yaungol at bay in the Kun-Lai Pass to the northwest. Take this liniment. It is a powerful medicine that has been passed down in my family over the generations. Use the dit da jow to heal the injured warriors if you do not have healing powers of your own to use on them.

Title: Going West
Objective: Travel to Dawnchaser Retreat.
Text: Leza now walks with the ancestors of this strange land. I must look now to the living. Kor has led a group of our scouts west deeper into the jungle. Track him down and lend what aid you can to him. We will join you as quickly as we are able.

Title: Into the Wilds
Objective: Locate Koro Mistwalker near the Temple of the Red Crane at the southern end of Krasarang River.
Text: Deep in the wilds rests the Temple of the Red Crane, home of the great Chi-Ji and his most devout followers. I suspect they'll know something about what happened here. The temple is located on the southern coast of the wilds, where the Krasarang River meets the sea.

Title: The Scouts Return
Objective: Speak to Rell Nightwind at the Glassfin Village in the Jade Forest.
Text: , your friends have returned from their scouting mission. They need to see you immediately. I'm afraid... Well, I'd better say no more. You will see for yourself.

Title: All of the Arrows
Objective: Collect 12 Arrows for Commander Hsieh.
Text: As soon as their reinforcements arrive, the yaungol are going to overrun our position here. If they do that, the village will be lost. Would you be willing to retrieve as many arrows off the battlefield as you can carry? I have a plan that just might save us with your help.

Title: Call Out Their Leader
Objective: Slay 10 Bataari Tribe Members in the Kun-Lai Pass until the Bataari Fire-Warrior appears. Then kill him.
Text: Clearly, you are a hero come to aid us. Slay the Bataari Tribe in the Kun-Lai Pass to the northwest until the Bataari Fire-Warrior is angered enough to appear. Dispatch him.

Title: Into the Wilds
Objective: Locate Koro Mistwalker near the Temple of the Red Crane at the southern end of Krasarang River.
Text: Deep in the wilds rests the Temple of the Red Crane, home of the great Chi-Ji and his most devout followers. I suspect they'll know something about what happened here. The temple is located on the southern coast of the wilds, where the Krasarang River meets the sea.

Title: Darkmoon Tiger Deck
Objective: Return the Tiger Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
Text: Now that you have gathered all of the Tiger cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight. On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded." You have heard that the entrance to this faire appears near Mulgore and Goldshire every month.

Title: Darkmoon Serpent Deck
Objective: Return the Serpent Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
Text: Now that you have gathered all of the Serpent cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight. On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded." You have heard that the entrance to this faire appears near Mulgore and Goldshire every month.

Title: Darkmoon Crane Deck
Objective: Return the Crane Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
Text: Now that you have gathered all of the Crane cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight. On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded." You have heard that the entrance to this faire appears near Mulgore and Goldshire every month.

Title: Blanche's Boomer Brew
Objective: Help create the Boomer Brew. If the Brewkegs catch on fire, fix them!
Text: Brew Blanche's Boomer Brew by Protecting the Brewkegs.

Title: Darkmoon Ox Deck
Objective: Return the Ox Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
Text: Now that you have gathered all of the Ox cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight. On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded." You have heard that the entrance to this faire appears near Mulgore and Goldshire every month.

Title: The Waters of Youth
Objective: Give Vaeldrin's message to Lyalia.
Text: She is headstrong, my little Lyalia. I should have known she would try to challenge the Lord Reclaimer. Since her mother died, I forsook much of the time I should have spent with her in search of immortality, insisting that we could live forever, together. And now my obsession has cost my little Lyalia her life. Please, when she wakes, tell her I love her.

Title: No Reprieve
Objective: Kill 8 Shao-Tien mogu near the Five Sisters.
Text: We've been granted a brief respite from the mogu attacks as they attempt to recoup near the Five Sisters to our north. I would like you to see to it that they not be granted a similar reprieve. Show no mercy.

Title: Walking on Sunwalkers
Objective: Kill 3 Sunwalker Infiltrators.
Text: The tauren! I refuse to let those flea bitten beasts claim the Pools of Youth for the Horde. None of their races have earned the right to immortality. They are by nature a series of short lived mortals who lack the humility and knowledge of how to properly support a long lived society. They have infiltrators hunting for the pool. Kill those infiltrators before they find it. Their numbers are small so it shouldn't be that hard to cripple their eyes and ears.

Title: The River to Ban-Lu
Objective: Meet with Waterspeaker Ryuli to the southeast.
Text: We still do not know where Ban-Lu has gone to, but I do know who might.To the southeast lives a jinyu, Waterspeaker Ryuli.Perhaps he has seen Ban-Lu, or can ask him to inquire with the river about where Ban-Lu has been seen recently?All this travel has done a number on my old joints, Grandmaster. I shall rest here a bit longer, and then catch up with you later on.

Title: Master Who?
Objective: Meet Master Bu at Morning Breeze Village outside Temple of the Five Dawns.
Text: Greetings. I've just received word that Master Bu has returned from a long spirit journey, and is currently resting his feet at Morning Breeze Village outside of the Temple of Five Dawns.It's been quite a long time since anyone has seen or heard from him, but he's asking to speak to you.We will handle the situation here while you are absent, Grandmaster.

Title: Keep it Secret, Keep it Safe
Objective: Return to Ari in the Hall of the Guardian.
Text: The shield generator you found is much more than it appears. I do not think my elders would approve of such advanced technology being shared with outlanders...And yet... We owe you our lives and our freedom.You may use it, with my blessing. Just... please be discreet about its existence, Archmage .

Title: The Trial of Ban-Lu
Objective: Find Ban-Lu at the bottom of the waterfall.
Text: Ah, the ripples I feel in the water are strong! The droplet does not fall far from our location.Ban-Lu is quite close.He waits for you now, at the bottom of the waterfall to the east.

Title: Lilies for Ryuli
Objective: Collect 6 Moon Lilies for Waterspeaker Ryuli.
Text: I have not seen Ban-Lu, but the waters will surely know where he is.There is a flower that grows in the lakes of the mountain slopes near the Temple of the White Tiger, that only blooms in the presence of someone pure of heart.Bring me six of these Moon Lilies and I shall use them to speak to the river.

Title: The Shadow of Ban-Lu
Objective: Meet Master Bu at the Shado-Pan Monastery.
Text: That was good of you to assist Smelly Mountaintop, Grandmaster, and we have learned more about the fate of Ban-lu.I won't bother you with escorting me to Shado-Pan Monastery. I can manage on my own.Meet me there and we'll continue our search.

Title: Into the Hornet's Nest
Objective: Use the teleporter pad.
Text: I hope you are up for an adventure. Shall we see where that teleporter goes?

Title: Clean-up on Aisle Sha
Objective: Help Commander Shen-Li with the remaining Sha.
Text: I've spoken with the Shado-pan and they are willing to give us information if we can assist them with a task of their own.Speak with Commander Shen-Li. While you're assisting them, I shall continue to meditate.

Title: Setting Sun Garrison
Objective: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison.
Text: I offer you my heartfelt appreciation for your aid. Anji awaits you in the Setting Sun Garrison to the west. May the day favor you, young .

Title: Blind Them!
Objective: Kill the Sunwalker Scout.
Text: Horde sunwalkers! We saw one of their scouts patrolling by the oubliette not long before you arrived. I don't know how he got here but I can guarantee you he isn't alone. They never are. Kill the sunwalker scout before he reports our position.

Title: The Blastmaster
Objective: Inform Blastmaster Sparkfuse at the harbor entrance that the powder barrels have been rigged.
Text: Regroup at the harbor entrance to inform Blastmaster Sparkfuse of your success. He will trigger the powder barrels and signal the airship forward. Make certain that none of your group is on those ships when they go up!

Title: Minimum Safe Distance
Objective: Return to the Sea Wolf and report to Captain Drok.
Text: As soon as you and your companions are clear, we're delivering our payload and reducing Theramore Isle to rubble. Return to the Sea Wolf and Captain Drok as soon as possible.

Title: Hope Springs Eternal
Objective: Speak with Loon Mai in Stoneplow.
Text: The Shado-Pan are likely dealing with similar outbreaks elsewhere in Pandaria. Seek out Loon Mai, the Shado-Pan Watch Commander in Stoneplow on the western end of the Valley of the Four Winds. Let him know that we have the situation here under control; the Shado-Pan need not send any aid. Quite the opposite, in fact - I will be sending many of my followers on pilgrimage, to bring a message of hope to those in need. Thank you again. Farewell.

Title: Sea Snakes
Objective: Gather 6 Murkscale Heads from Murkscale Strikers in Krasarang River.
Text: The rivers here are crawling with venomous aquatic snakes. Several evacuees were bitten as they fled from the temple, and already some are beginning to succumb to the poison. We are administering anti-venom as quickly as possible, but we'll need more venom glands. I won't ask you to remove the glands in the field - that would take too long. Just bring back the heads and I'll take care of the rest.

Title: Return to the Broken Peak
Objective: Meet Master Bu at the Peak of Serenity.
Text: Of course, this is no mere story. Ban-Lu served as the personal mount of each of the previous Grandmasters, accompanying them through their travels as a faithful and trusted companion.But... he has not revealed himself since you have become Grandmaster. This is troubling.The last time he was seen was at the Peak of Serenity, after the fall of Grandmaster Hight.It is there that we must begin our search for him.

Title: Smelly's Luckydo
Objective: Collect 3 parts of Smelly's Luckydo.
Text: You! Please help! Stupid hozen stole Smelly's luckydo!Now, Smelly always unlucky. Just turned around and look, pack is on fire.Not going to put fire out because then something ELSE unlucky happen. Maybe something worse!You beat up hozen, yes? Get back luckydo? Smelly will help you, any way he can!

Title: The Tale of Ban-Lu
Objective: Listen to Master Bu's story.
Text: Oh, hello, you must be the new Grandmaster.You young ones have no patience these days, always running off to fight your great battles.No time for stories, even good ones, eh?Why don't you put your fists down for a moment and allow an old man to tell you a tale.Maybe buy an old man a drink while you are at it?

Title: A Golden Ticket
Objective: Read the Golden Letter in Trueshot Lodge.
Text: Huntmaster, we've gotten word from the Lodge that there is a letter wrought from golden light sitting on one of the tables, and it's got your name on it.No one is sure how it got there, and someone's wolf may have tried to open it and gotten a mouth full of singed fur. Seems like it's meant only for you.We'll hold down the fort here while you investigate.

Title: The Gates Are Closed
Objective: Return to Archmage Khadgar at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
Text: Sigryn must be reached before she can confront Odyn, but our path is blocked. Odyn will close the Gates of Valor as soon as he becomes aware of Sigryn's assault. You will have to find another way into the Halls.I have no talent with portals, but your friends at the Kirin Tor seem to be very adept. Go now to them, and find a way through.I thank you for what you've done to help Sigryn this far. I only hope we can save her from herself.

Title: Night of the Wilds
Objective: Ask the Herald of Odyn to take you to the Fields of the Eternal Hunt.
Text: The Night of the Wilds is upon us.Tonight, we will feast in honor of the beasts of legend, and they will rise once more in the Fields of the Eternal Hunt.One among us will set out into the fields to put their spirits to rest once more.My herald awaits you, hunter, if you will join us.

Title: Keymaster Orlis
Objective: Kill Keymaster Orlis and search his body.
Text: The Felborne insurgents appear to be guarding a teleporter pad within the glade ahead. I wonder where it leads?It is probably safe to assume that we'll need to kill Keymaster Orlis in order to gain access.

Title: The Trail of Ban-Lu
Objective: Follow the trail of Ban-Lu.
Text: It seems a lifetime ago that Grandmaster Hight was walking these grounds.While Ban-Lu has served every previous Grandmaster, he and Hight were the greatest of friends.For many years they traveled the land, connecting with its people and maintaining our fragile peace.I cannot imagine how deeply Ban-Lu must have been affected by his passing.There must be some clues to his whereabouts around here. Look sharply.

Title: Livin' on the Ledge
Objective: Return to the Fel Hammer and speak with Matron Mother Malevolence.
Text: Slayer $p, Matron Mother Malevolence requests an audience with you back at the Fel Hammer. Please see her at your earliest convenience.

Title: A Creative Solution
Objective: Talk to Ari.
Text: The Nightborne Soulstone may be our best hope if we can come up with a way to safely use it without Kathra'natir escaping. If he were to get loose in Dalaran...We should consult with our friend, Ari. She will know what modifications need to be done.

Title: The Vault of the Tirisgarde
Objective: Find 5 Ancient Artifacts within the Hall of the Guardian.
Text: Dalaran's weapons are arcane in origin, but that doesn't mean we can't try something different.Our order's vaults contain a vast store of magical devices... Why don't you take a look around and see if there's anything we can use?

Title: To Fel and Back
Objective: Speak with Kyra Lightblade to secure a ride to Felwing Ledge. Then complete the Felwing Ledge scenario.
Text: Mardum has its fair share of secrets, one of which we found not too long after we took control of the Fel Hammer. It's a breeding ground of sorts, festering with fel bats. We've been capturing the pups and trying to train them up for our efforts against the Legion. But the other day, we caught an even greater prize, something worthy of your position, Slayer. Speak with Kyra and she'll provide you a ride to the ledge.

Title: Bargaining with Shadows
Objective: Meet Ritssyn Flamescowl in the Chamber of the Guardian beneath Dalaran.
Text: From the clues you've been able to piece together, it appears that Levia was looking to conduct a ritual in the libraries beneath Dalaran - most likely to summon this "Agatha" she has become so infatuated with. I'm afraid this is a little out of my area of expertise, so I'm going to have to call in a favor.I'll send for assistance from the Council of the Black Harvest. One of their warlocks will meet you in the Chamber of the Guardian to assist with your investigation.I hope we're not too late.

Title: Jorach's Calling
Objective: Return to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt in the Hall of Shadows.
Text: And with that, the first phase of my machination is complete. Let's return to Jorach and tell him it is time to continue.

Title: False Orders
Objective: Plant the False Orders in the marked locations.
Text: We must take some precautions. As soon as you assassinate the gunner, the crew will be looking for you. I had Tethys forge some orders in her handwriting that should buy us some time. Plant the orders in the marked locations. That will take care of the danger.

Title: The Pirate's Bay
Objective: Meet up with Lilian Voss and Tethys at Dead Man's Bay in Azsuna.
Text: While we've made some progress on the Broken Shore, I think it is time for the more subtle tactics of the Uncrowned. We've received word of a large cave off the main island, where powerful demons meet to plot our downfall. One of our rogues, Lilian Voss, has formulated a plan with Tethys to take care of them, but they require your aid. They are waiting for you at Dead Man's Bay in Azsuna.

Title: Defense of Aviana
Objective: Assist Thisalee in the defense of the Shrine of Aviana in Hyjal, then return to her in the Dreamgrove.
Text: The situation is dire. The Legion is attacking the Shrine of Aviana in Hyjal, AGAIN! They must be after something specific, but I'm not sure what.Us Druids of the Talon are skilled scouts and infiltrators, but are lacking in... durability. They won't be able to hold out for long! We must go to help!

Title: What's the Cache?
Objective: Kill Master Gunner Prix and obtain the Fel-Infused Gunpowder Cache.
Text: Our goal is to retrieve a cache of gunpowder which has been infused with some sort of fel power. I don't know how the pirates here acquired it, but it is more dangerous than they know. I assure you that it will be more... effective in our hands. Master Gunner Prix should be toward the back of the cove, near the water. Take what we need from her.

Title: Hope For a Cure
Objective: Return to the Spirit of Brewmaster Blanche in the Temple of Five Dawns.
Text: Hopefully you found enough fel poison samples with which to brew a cure.Let's meet back to the Temple of Five Dawns!

Title: You Can't Take the Sky from Me
Objective: Deal with Infazzar the Shade, and retrieve the Idol of Aviana.
Text: The Shrine of Aviana has fallen to the demons, and the Idol of Aviana has been stolen.That idol acts as a link between the Druids of the Talon and the powers of flight granted to us by Aviana.The Druids of the Talon have decided to rebuild a new shrine in a more secure location: here in the Dreamgrove.Meanwhile, I'm going to get our idol back. Meet me in Azsuna, near where we've tracked Infazzar to, if you want to help.

Title: Fly, Spy!
Objective: Slay Hedric Evencane and free Thalen Songweaver in Foothold Citadel.
Text: The First of Garrosh is going the level Theramore Isle... but not until we free the spy whose intelligence made this operation possible. Enter Foothold Citadel and slay Captain Evencane for his shackles key. Our spy, the Sunreaver mage Thalen Songweaver, is being held beneath the barracks.

Title: Tanks for Nothing!
Objective: Destroy any manned tanks and bomb any unmanned ones.
Text: The last threat to the airship is Theramore's arsenal of steam tanks. Destroy any active tanks and set bombs on any unmanned vehicles.

Title: Going on the Offensive
Objective: Get Incursion Sentinel's Report.
Text: Ha! So my father just wasted twenty years of our lives on a fool's errand! I'm taking charge. When Tyrande sent us here she was very specific that we not come back until we find the source of the Light that she saw in her visions. It's obvious now that the Pools of Youth were not it. I want you to look for my scout. I sent her to investigate the Crane Temple but she hasn't returned. Get her report and rendezvous with us at the Sentinel Basecamp further west.

Title: The Mantid
Objective: Kill 10 Ik'thik Mantid.
Text: The mantid! They came out of nowhere and smashed our convoy to ruin, scattering our people this way and that. Now they are preparing to hit Stoneplow. Please, destroy some of these beasts before they get sufficient numbers to flank our home. If my cousin, Ambassador Len, is still alive and at our convoy he should be able to reward you for your help.

Title: Gryphon, Down
Objective: Slay Baldruc and his gryphons.
Text: The Fist of Garrosh will hold position over the harbor until all other threats from the ground are eliminated. Your next target: Baldruc, Theramore's gryphon master. That mad dwarf and his beasts can't be allowed to attack the airship from above. Slay Baldruc, along with his winged charges.

Title: No Sister Left Behind
Objective: Rescue 8 captives of the mogu.
Text: We were searching the ruins south of here when the mogu fell upon us out of nowhere. Some of us were able to retreat to this encampment but many others were captured. The mogu have also caught a number of the Horde who happened to be in the area as well. Please, rescue any sentinels that you can. Leave the Dawnchasers to their fate.

Title: The Lord Reclaimer
Objective: Find Lyalia and kill Groundbreaker Brojai.
Text: They have my daughter! Brojai... that Lord Reclaimer! I can see him clearly through Lyalia's eyes. That foolish girl must have tried to take him head on. Please! Go to the Ruins of Korja and try to free her. I'll get Kang and try to draw out Brojai from the ruins with a distraction.

Title: Sever Their Supply Line
Objective: Kill 8 Korjan Reclaimers.
Text: The mogu reclaimers are using portals to connect to Kun-Lai Summit, bringing in reinforcements and supplies. What is worse, they are sending their captives through these portals. Go to the Ruins of Korja and destroy as many of these Korjan Reclaimers as you can find.

Title: Re-Reclaim
Objective: Recover 10 Mogu Artifacts.
Text: Mogu do NOT use arcane magics. They are thugs. They have always been thugs. Only when they ruled their empires in the old stories did they ever know any kind of magic. But these mogu are using arcane portals and old artifacts. We need to stop them! $p, look for any artifacts the mogu are using to cast their magics with. I saw piles of these items being collected near the Ruins of Korja south of here.

Title: Profit Mastery
Objective: Obtain 12 Vials of Tiger Blood.
Text: Two words: Tiger Blood! This is gonna sell better than saronite back on the black market. Especially once I finish spreading a rumor about how it makes you all buff and stuff. And this jungle is just full of tigers. Can you round up a few vials of tiger blood for me? I'll cut you in on the scam.

Title: Crane Mastery
Objective: Kill 12 Carp Hunters.
Text: Thing about hunting birds is you need ammo - and I ain't got any. Thing about hunting with Nesingwary is you need to prove you can keep your tally and bragging rights up. Can't hunt, can't brag. And I like bragging so this is no good. Can I hire you to go kill me some carp hunters? You'll find them up and down the river west of here. There are a bunch of them so don't hesitate to hunt while doing other stuff.

Title: The Stoneplow Convoy
Objective: Use Imperial Lotus Poultice on 7 Stoneplow Envoys.
Text: Help me. These poor pandaren are in need of healing, and my powers are weakened. I did find an old tome in my collection that allowed me to convert the herbs you collected earlier into a healing poultice. Use this on the injured pandaren and it should get them back on their feet.

Title: Warn Stoneplow
Objective: Travel to Stoneplow Village in Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: My father gave me his life. Tyrande gave me her trust. My sentinels gave me their allegiance. It is time I repaid them all. With Brojai dead we can mop up the remaining mogu. The next threat is the mantid. Go north to Stoneplow and lend them your help. Tell them I will be bringing what sentinels I can muster to aid in the defense of their city against the mantid.

Title: Immortality?
Objective: Observe Vaeldrin as he tests the water of youth.
Text: Something is... off. The water feels strange. When we arrived here I felt the presence of the Light, strong and vibrant, far to the north. I thought it would be the Pools of Youth. But this... this water is tainted somehow. Stained with mogu magics. I think it best I try only a sip and we see what happens.

Title: Lotus Tea
Objective: Gather 20 Imperial Lotus Leaves.
Text: The mogu really like their poisons and curses. Mama Bramblestaff always said lotus tea cures any mogu curse. I saw some imperial lotus plants in the nearby Ruins of Dojan. We should go gather some of their leaves and keep them on hand just in case the mogu get unruly. Also, this will give me a chance to introduce my fists to some mogu faces.

Title: Where are the Pools
Objective: Obtain the Dojani Orders.
Text: Perhaps these mogu know where the pools are. Our scouts have reported seeing a commander along the southern side of the Ruins of Dojan. Kill him and take whatever information he is carrying. They should lead you to the pool.

Title: Squirmy Delight
Objective: Gather 5 Intact Skitterer Glands.
Text: The hidden master may have to wait. Look at these people. They are so THIN! They must be starving. You know what we need? A big steaming bowl of Squirmy Delight. If you find yourself near a river, try rounding up some intact skitterer glands and I'll cook up a batch.

Title: Poisoned!
Objective: Gather 5 Mogu Poisoned Blades from Mogu Reavers in the Lost Dynasty.
Text: Poison... I... I can feel it... burning. Please... grab... grab some of the mogu swords. We need... need poison samples. For an... ant... antidote.

Title: Threat from Dojan
Objective: Kill 6 Dojani Reclaimers, 8 Dojani Surveyors, and 4 Dojani Enforcers.
Text: While you were at the ruins dusting off tablets for my father I lost five scouts to wandering mogu patrols. These creatures apparently have little interest in peace and are about as trustworthy as the Horde. They are too numerous and we are too weak, however. Go to the ruins west of here and cull the mogu numbers. They won't be expecting a .

Title: The Pools of Youth
Objective: Obtain some of the Water of Youth.
Text: North! Go north to the Pools of Youth. Get some of the water but be on your guard. The mogu list this as a "high value" target. Kang Bramblestaff will meet you there if he has not already arrived by your side.

Title: The Lost Dynasty
Objective: Obtain 6 Dynastic Tablets.
Text: I wonder if I could bother you for another task. My daughter, the good Sentinel Commander Lyalia here, refuses to let me go into the field. I have spent everyday in that oubliette staring at the ruins to our north, itching to investigate. If we are where I suspect we are those ruins could contain the key we need to finding the fabled Pools of Youth! Please! Go to those ruins and salvage any tablets that still have writing on them.

Title: To the Waterline!
Objective: Rig powder barrels in the hold of all six ships.
Text: This is Sky-Reaver Stormhowl, captain of the airship Fist of Garrosh and commander of this operation. Your first task is to burn the 7th Fleet to the waterline while it's still at anchor Captain Drok's marines will hold the harbor entrance while your team works. Rig powder barrels in the hold of every ship and then regroup at the harbor entrance to inform Blastmaster Sparkfuse, who will trigger the exposives and signal the airship forward.

Title: Fiery Tongue, Fragile Feet
Objective: Kill 6 Stillwater Crocolisks.
Text: I was kicking the water for fun again when one of those vicious crocolisks lunged out to try to bite my foot off! Rude! I have proceeded to rest my weary soles a few feet farther from the water, but I already look back on my water-kicking days longingly. Would you be so kind as to kill a crocolisk or eight for me? I assure you they deserve it for frightening me though.

Title: Stick in the Mud
Objective: Gather 12 Whitepetal Reeds.
Text: I came out for a beautiful day of fishin', but I didn't think to bring a pole. There are so many things to remember for fishin', I just can't keep it all in my head. Those reeds along the river look alright for makin' a pole out of. If you'd gather me some number of them, I'd be willin' to think on you favorably when it comes time to price my merchandise. Oh, and I'll pay you too, of course. How's that sound?

Title: Simian Sabotage
Objective: Use the Barrel of Fireworks near the Pile of Stolen Weapons, the Pile of Stolen Tools, the Pile of Stolen Beer, and the Pile of Stolen Grain.
Text: The hozen steal from us, and we keep stealing our stuff back. It has to stop sometime.  Find some of our stolen supplies in their mountain camp to the west, and place these fireworks beside them. Hopefully, if they see the explosions, they'll think our supplies are defective and stop stealing altogether. It's worth a shot, right?

Title: Under Watchful Eyes
Objective: Kill 8 Shao-Tien Surveyors.

Title: Getting your Hands Dirty
Objective: Gather 12 Fresh Whitepetal Worms.
Text: Some of the best fishin' in all of pandaria in this lake right here. I brought enough brew to last me all day, but I didn't think to bring any bait. Who can really remember such things? If you'd be willing to gather me some bait along the shore, I'd be willin' to think on you favorably when it comes time to price my merchandise. Oh, and I'll pay you too, of course. How's that sound?

Title: A Weighty Task
Objective: Recover 8 Mogu Artifacts.
Text: For the life of me, I can't figure out why the mogu would have built all their statues and such down in that lake. I'm sure there wasn't always water down there, but it still seems wickedly inconvenient should it ever have rained. Ah well, who's to fathom the strange intentions of the mogu... Would you be so kind as to swim down there and bring back any artifacts that seem even vaguely carry-able? I'd certainly appreciate it.

Title: Stalling the Ravage
Objective: Slay 12 Kunzen Hozen.
Text: The Kunzen hozen, up in the mountains to the west, have been acting up, lighting their fires and shouting their chants. Based on what I've heard and seen around here, that means that a ravage is coming. There's not much we can do to stop the ravage, but we can at least thin their numbers before they attack.

Title: Talon's Call
Objective: Speak with Thisalee Crow in the Dreamgrove.
Text: The Legion is launching a renewed assault against the Shrine of Aviana in Hyjal!Thisalee Crow is organizing a counter-offensive, she requests your presence in the Dreamgrove at once.We will handle the offensive here. Good luck, Archdruid!

Title: The Kunzen Hunter-Chief
Objective: Slay the Kunzen Hunter-Chief.
Text: From what I've gathered, the Kunzen hozen have two chiefs. One is harmless - he deals with potions, medicines, and ancient fables. The other one is in charge of the Kunzen's hunters - and the only thing they've been hunting lately is our crops. The Hunter-Chief is a problem waiting to be solved. I'm sure the local farmers would be grateful if you went up there and, you know, "took care" of him.

Title: Vengeance: Seeking Kor'vas
Objective: Find Kor'vas Bloodthorn in the streets of Dalaran.
Text: Thankfully, we are not quite alone in uncovering the Legion's plots to infiltrate the city. One of your Illidari, Kor'vas Bloodthorn, has taken to patrolling the city streets on her own to find the source behind the recent attacks. I do not entirely trust your kind, but I will concede that you have at least proved adept at your namesake. I suggest you find Kor'vas and see what she has uncovered before the Legion strikes once more.|cFF660000Specialization: Vengeance Demon Hunter|r

Title: Deadmines, Part Three?
Objective: Find Marcus "Bagman" Brown outside the Deadmines in Westfall.
Text: I've heard suspicious rumors of movement in the Deadmines. After everything you pulled off in the Wailing Caverns, you'd be the perfect person to look into this!I have a friend in Westfall. He may not look like much, but he's quick as a whip and may have more information on what is happening in Westfall. We've already dealt with the Van Cleefs... twice. So what could be making that sort of ruckus down there?

Title: Pet Battle Challenge: Deadmines
Objective: Defeat Cookies' Leftovers in the Deadmines.
Text: The Deadmines could still use some cleaning up, seems you didn't clear the place out last time.We'll use the ol' mine cart trick again. Cept, we're going to put some flair into it. How do you feel about fire? No? Okay, fine. Just let me know when you're ready.

Title: The Deadmines Strike Back
Objective: Defeat Cookies' Leftovers in the Deadmines.
Text: Breanni sent you? For her, info is always free. Just don't call me a snitch.I've been hangin' around the Deadmines for years. For the most part, it's a pretty easy livin'. But a few days ago, I started hearing noises of all sorts comin' from the mines. If you want to get in unnoticed, I'll grab us a mine cart and we can get most of the way down without so much as an awkward glace in our direction.Just let me know when you're ready to head in.

Title: Thorim's Flame
Objective: Convince the Drekirjar Shrine-Keeper to let you take Thorim's Flame.
Text: Not too long ago, the Drekirjar and the Thorignir respected each other. This only changed when Skovald came into power. An ancient Drekirjar spirit watches over this peak, which seems to be a sacred graveyard of some sort. He is the keeper of the ceremonial flame, which happens to be exactly what we need to call down the broodmother. Why don't we go convince him to let us take the flame? I'm sure he'll be nothing but... amiable.

Title: Overwhelming Power
Objective: Kill 12 demons.
Text: We will find no sanctuary on this world. Even now the full might of the Burning Legion rises to defend Argus. The siege camp below overflows with demon filth that stand between us and the weapon trained on the Vindicaar. They must be dealt with before it can fully charge, or Argus will be our grave.

Title: Return of the Archmage
Objective: Speak to Meryl in the Hall of the Guardian.
Text: With Dalaran protected once again, we can all breathe a little easier.It is time for us to return to the Hall of the Guardian. I'm sure Meryl is anxiously awaiting word of our success.

Title: Legionfall Supplies
Objective: Complete World Quests or slay Rare Elites on the Broken Shore to earn Legionfall War Supplies.
Text: If we don't build up some respectable fortifications, we'll lose our foothold on the Broken Shore.That ain't gonna happen on my watch, mate!We started construction on three key structures: the Mage Tower, the Nether Disruptor, and the Command Center. Each will play a key role in helping us pound the tar out of the Burning Legion.To make progress, we need Legionfall War Supplies... and I mean lots of 'em! You bring 'em to me, and I'll handle distribution. Got it?

Title: The King's Path
Objective: Accompany King Anduin to the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: Now that I have seen the Broken Shore and the terror of the Burning Legion first hand, my eyes have been opened to the truth.I speak not of the unfathomable evil of the enemy, but of the bravery and sacrifice that such evil brings about in the hearts of our people.My father once told me that every king must carry the weight of his own crown. Mine has never felt heavier than it does at this very moment...Please take me to the place where my father died, so that I may honor his sacrifice.

Title: A Kingdom's Heart
Objective: Accompany King Anduin on his walk through Stormwind.
Text: My father was a legend. He oversaw the rebuilding of Stormwind, stood toe-to-toe with dragons, led the Alliance to numerous victories.Then, one day, he was just... gone.I wear his crown, I hold his title. But I've done nothing to earn them... or the faith of my people.I've spent the war sequestered in the keep, surrounded by guards and advisors. I need to walk the streets of Stormwind, to know whether it is hope or fear that beats in the hearts of my people.I welcome your company.

Title: Consoling the King
Objective: Look for King Anduin Wrynn inside Stormwind Cathedral.
Text: Anduin hasn't been the same since you brought him his father's compass. He has become listless... distracted.We attempted to console him, to no avail. Yesterday morning, he left the keep without so much as a word.I ordered the guards to follow him, of course. He went to pray at the cathedral, where he's remained ever since.You brought this melancholy upon him! You must convince the boy to resume his duties. There's a war to be won!

Title: Return to Sender
Objective: Return 9 Rejected Letters.
Text: You've arrived just in time! Unlike the mail as of late, I'm afraid. We are severely understaffed, and demand is at an all-time high. We simply can't keep up! I'd love to chat, but I need help catching up before I can rest for even a moment. First thing's first. Several parcels of rejected mail have broken loose again; will you help me round them all up and return them to their senders?

Title: The Giver of Quests
Objective: asdf
Text: asdf

Title: Summons to the Keep
Objective: Meet with Genn Greymane at Stormwind Keep.
Text: Greetings.Your presence has been requested in the royal court. The crown has urgent need of you!Please return to Stormwind at your earliest convenience.King Greymane is anticipating your swift arrival.

Title: Return of the Slayer
Objective: Return to Kor'vas aboard the Fel Hammer.
Text: If you're anything like me, I'm sure you'd prefer to remain here on solid ground.Unfortunately, it is probably best to return to the Fel Hammer right away so Kor'vass can finish the repairss.

Title: Return of the Battlelord
Objective: Talk to Odyn in Skyhold.
Text: Battlelord , Odyn will want to hear the tale of your glorious victories here!I will assist you in returning to Skyhold when you are ready.

Title: A Found Memento
Objective: Bring the compass to King Anduin Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.

Title: Meld Into the Shadows
Objective: Return to the Hall of Shadows, and meet Lord Jorach Ravenholdt.
Text: We should meet back up with the rest of the council and tell them of what we have achieved this day. At your leisure, return to us. We shall be waiting.

Title: Cindergut Peppers
Objective: Obtain 4 Cindergut Peppers.
Text: A certain few pandaren around here prefer their dishes unbearably spicy. Unfortunately, my access to such peppers is limited. The Kunzen hozen, in the mountains to the west, often carry cindergut peppers. A few of those and I'll be set for a few days. Say, could you collect some for me? You might want to wear gloves if you'll be handling them directly.

Title: Fatty Goatsteak
Objective: Obtain 4 Fatty Goatsteaks.
Text: You know what? I think I want to grill up some goatsteak today. No, not from the puny little shaghorns they keep around here. They don't have nearly enough fat on them.  You think I got to this size eating no-fat-havin' goats? Now, the shaghorns up on the Skyrange, to the west... those'll do just fine.

Title: The Lesser of Two Evils
Objective: Slay the Springtail Warren-Mother.
Text: Like any farming community, we have the occasional virmen troubles. The most powerful Springtail virmen live high up in the cliffs to the north, and only come down when they run out of veggies to nibble on. Frankly, I've dealt with virmen before. They're nothing but a pest that must be kept in check, and there's no better way to do that than by killing their warren-mother. Easy as that.

Title: Stealing is Bad... Re-Stealing is OK
Objective: Re-steal 16 Stolen Vegetables.
Text: The hozen, up in the mountains to the west, continue to steal vegetables from my fellow farmers. Being so close to Halfhill, I very rarely suffer hozen attacks, but my friends have not been so lucky. Seems to me like they steal way more than they can eat. If you can find any intact vegetables up there in those mountains... steal them back!

Title: The Mile-High Grub
Objective: Prepare 20 bowls of Mushan Tail Stew over the bonfire in the Kunzen Village.
Text: Have you ever tried Mushan Tail Stew? Chances are, if you have, that it was stringy and tasteless. You see, there's a trick to making the perfect Mushan Tail Stew: you need to cook it at high elevation. I've already gathered the ingredients. Take this pot up to the Kunzen Village, up in the mountains to the west, and prepare the stew over their bonfire.

Title: The Truffle Shuffle
Objective: Obtain 8 Shadelight Truffles, and plant 8 Shadelight Spores.
Text: I like to bake with truffles... when I can find them. They only grow up on the Skyrange, and in very, very scarce amounts. They're a fantastic ingredient, but we can't risk over-farming them. That's why we need to replace what we've taken. Bring me a handful of adult truffles, and plant some of these spores in their place.

Title: Not in Chee-Chee's Backyard
Objective: Kill 8 members of the Kunzen tribe in the Kunzen Village.
Text: Not all hozen are the same. Chee-Chee's tribe was forest hozen... came from Jade Forest. Pretty easy to get along with. The Kunzen invaders... they come from mountains, far to the north. Not nearly as nice as Chee-Chee. They come into our green land, take our things, leave big mess behind. Chee-Chee wants to kill them. You like to help?

Title: Where It Counts
Objective: Throw 8 Kunzen Ritual Candles, kick 4 Blazing Embers, and slay 1 Kunzen Ritualist.
Text: I've been watching those Kunzen hozen, and I've noticed a consistent pattern. Whenever they're getting ready to attack, they participate in strange, barbaric rituals around their totem. If we can disrupt this ritual, not only will we put off any impending attacks, we can deal a huge blow to their morale! So get in there, rough them up, and make as much of a mess as possible!

Title: You Have to Burn the Ropes
Objective: Burn 6 Kunzen Ropes.
Text: I, umm... well... Oh, never mind. It was a stupid idea. It's just that, I was thinking that maybe we can stop the Kunzen hozen from attacking us without having to, you know... KILL anything. I noticed a few ropes on the side of the mountain. I think they're using them to climb down to our farms and... No, forget it. It was a silly idea anyways.

Title: The Thousand-Year Dumpling
Objective: Obtain 7 jars of Preserved Vegetables.
Text: One of my most popular recipes is the Thousand-Year Dumpling, which is filled with preserved vegetables. I normally let the vegetables ferment in a hole underneath my house, but when I looked for them this morning, they were gone! I blame those thieving virmen. Bring them back, and I'll let you help me cook!

Title: The Kunzen Legend-Chief
Objective: Obtain a Kunzen Legend-Book from a Kunzen Legend-Chief.
Text: I've heard people talk about the hozen like they're just some tribe of barely-functional idiots... but that's not true! They have brains, too - they just don't all like to use them that much. I've heard that the Kunzen tribe has two chiefs - one in charge of fighting, and one in charge of stories, lore, and history. What I wouldn't give to see what kind of stories they tell...

Title: Pest Problems
Objective: Speak with Wika-Wika, then stomp on 25 Black-Nose Marmots.
Text: One of my farmhands, Wika-Wika, has been tilling the soil in my westernmost field. I understand he's had some problems with pests. He's got plenty of pesticide to spray the bugs that eat my crops, but I'm afraid he has no way to deal with the marmots. Would you lend him a hand? With rampant hozen and virmen attacks, I can't afford to lose crops to simple pests.

Title: Chasing the Chicken
Objective: Pick up Hillpaw's Chickens until you find his Prize-Winning Chicken.
Text: Say, you there! , was it? I've got a problem, and I need someone with better legs than mine to help me solve it. My prize-winning chicken has flown the coop! Now she's out in the open, mingling with the other hens, wild birds, and...  ill-intentioned roosters. My farm is west of here, south of the Skyrange. Could you find her, and bring her back to me?

Title: Free Spirits
Objective: Enter Spirit Vortexes and free 15 pandaren spirits inside.
Text: I came upon one of the Shao-Tien Soul-Render's daggers. It radiates a strong magic. I've been told it should allow you to enter their spirit vortexes. The mogu use these to harvest spirits and bind them to their will, but I'm hoping you can use it to free the spirits. Enter any of the spirit vortexes you can find up on the Golden Stair, and free all the captive spirits you find.

Title: They Don't Even Wear Them
Objective: Obtain a Stolen Circlet, a Ransacked Ring, and a Burglarized Bracelet.
Text: A few weeks ago, a group of those jumpy little Springtail virmen broke into my lockbox and stole several handfuls of my jewelry. I've since found a few pieces, but they still have most of my collection. If you're headed up to the Springtail Crag, in the cliffs to the north, you should keep an eye out for them. I'd love to get my jewelry back.

Title: Weed War II
Objective: Speak to Gai Lan, then pick 100 Weeds on his farm. You can pick Weeds while mounted.
Text: Ssshhay... d'you know that guy over on the farm, with the... the *hic*... the weed problem? Gai Lan, I think his name was. I love that guy, man. Anywayshh, he said that if I *hic* sent an adventurer over to go pick his weeds, he'd get me some ale. It's jusht a few weeds, not too many, probably. *hic*

Title: Water, Water Everywhere
Objective: Speak with Wing Nga to borrow a kite, then throw water onto 35 Dusty Spots in the Heartland.
Text: How'd you like to make yourself useful? The season's been awful dry lately. I need someone to water the crops out in the Heartland. Here's the thing: I need you to water ALL of the crops. I keep a few kites with Wing Nga, the flightmaster across the way. Grab one of those kites, then throw water on any areas that look dry and dusty.

Title: Normal Quest Test Case
Objective: Give me stuff.
Text: Yes?

Title: Money Matters
Objective: Obtain Spicemaster Jin Jao's Payment, Trader Jambeezi's Payment, Innkeeper Lei Lan's Payment, and Lolo Lio's payment.
Text: I love working in the market, although there's one aspect of this job I really dislike: collecting debts. While most pandaren debts are simply due to laziness, there are a few unsavory characters around town who simply don't want to pay, and there's some who are just too poor. A few people here in town owe me money. Could you go talk to them, and remind them about what they owe?

Title: Longshot
Objective: Recover 12 Spent Shado-Pan Arrows.
Text: I would not normally ask this of grizzle  such as you, but since you are to be on the battlefield below the Golden Stair anyway, would you recover spent arrows for the archers?

Title: The Displaced Paleblade
Objective: Kill 8 Paleblade Saurok.

Title: High Standards
Objective: Erect 6 Golden Lotus Standards.
Text: If I had to pick the most important quality for a battle standard, it would be that it's standing up... and not on fire, but mostly the first one. So needless to say, I'm a bit concerned about our standard situation at the moment. If some unknown  were to be so kind as to take a walk out on the battlefield to our northwest and stand our standards back up, both myself and my extremely sexy yet somewhat commanding wife would be very grateful.

Title: Set in Stone
Objective: Destroy 6 Mogu Effigies.
Text: The mogu have been sending their narcissistic stone effigies onto our battlefield today. They're brining them to life up on the Golden Stair. The bigger they are, the harder we hit'm. You in?

Title: The Moving Mists
Objective: Kill 8 Fog Walkers.

Title: Thundering Skies
Objective: Kill 3 Subjugated Serpents.
Text: The mogu have bent the will of sky serpents and turned them against us. The defenders won't fare well against them, but you would. Head northwest towards the Golden Stair and remove them from the sky.

Title: Given a Second Chance
Objective: Heal 6 Wounded Defenders.
Text: A foolish contingent attempted to mount an offensive on the Golden Stair through the eastern pass, and were bombarded by cannons. Those that made it back are in bad shape, and there are still wounded out in the field. Here are some bandages. Use these, or any other healing skills you possess, and help get our wounded defenders back to safety. Please hurry, there is little time.

Title: The Eternal Vigil
Objective: Kill 8 Shao-Tien mogu on the Golden Terrace.
Text: Good to have you with us. If you're joining the fight, I need more men out up at the Golden Stair to clear out the mogu setting up base there. Can I count on you?

Title: Stone Hard Quilen
Objective: Kill 6 Granite Quilen.
Text: Leven always says the only good quilen is a dead quilen, and I'm inclined to agree. You here to aid the cause?

Title: The Calm After the Storm
Objective: Bring the Doomstone to Neptulon in the Maelstrom.
Text: You have saved the elements from the Legion's control, and for that we thank you. However, it came at a great cost to both your health and your fellow shaman. Many came back to us wounded, dragged along by their fellow shaman. We have seen the havoc the Doomstone can wreak. It does not belong in the hands of any being, mortal or otherwise. While you were asleep, the elemental lords and I discussed its fate. Bring it to Neptulon. He will explain.

Title: Darkbinder Dilemma
Objective: Kill Darkbinder Elissath.
Text: Ah, Delas sent you. I see. It's good she didn't come herself. It would break her heart to see what is happening to our family. A demon is defiling our dead in the ruins nearby. She's using her fel magic on our ancestors, turning them into mindless horrors that do the bidding of the Burning Legion. I can't deal with the harpies and this demon, but maybe you could help? Get rid of the darkbinder that torments our dead, and I will grant you access to whatever's left of the Moonfang family relics.

Title: The Battle Ring
Objective: Defeat 20 Shado-Pan Trainees in the Battle Ring.
Text: We have some fresh trainees that are far from being a danger to you, but in numbers, they may prove enough of a challenge. And if not, they could use the lesson in humility. Step into the battle ring when you're ready. Don't go easy on them.

Title: Pillars of Creation
Objective: Use the Pillars of Creation to seal the Tomb of Sargeras.
Text: Our campaign on the Broken Shore has reached a turning point. The Armies of Legionfall stand ready to breach the Tomb of Sargeras and seal the Legion's gateway to our world.The time to strike is now.The Aegis of Aggramar has been secured in the Cathedral. The echo of Magna Aegwynn said that the other Pillars of Creation are needed to seal the tomb. It is fitting that you have the honor of locking those ancient relics in place and closing down the Felstorm once and for all.

Title: Intolerable Infestation
Objective: Slay 50 demons in Faronaar or Felsoul Hold.
Text: While we purge Legion filth from the Broken Shore, the fiends maintain their hold on nearby lands. Their presence can no longer be tolerated.The fetid strongholds of Faronaar and Felsoul Hold infest Azsuna and Suramar. Choose an attack point and cut a swath through their insidious ranks.Return to me with demon blood on your hands, then we can resume our campaign to drive Kil'jaeden from the Tomb.

Title: Shard Times
Objective: Collect 2500 Nethershards on the Broken Shore.
Text: As you have surely noticed, a slain demon leaves behind Nethershards, solidified residual energy from the Twisting Nether. I require a significant quantity of them for an experiment I'm conducting... $1oa shards, to be precise. Why are you looking at me like that? We've had this conversation before. I did the math. I need exactly $1oa shards. Fewer would be inadequate. More would be absurd. Don't question my methods. Go!

Title: Championing Our Cause
Objective: Successfully complete a Legionfall mission at your Class Order Hall.
Text: Important work has been done by your order, t. Your champions have succeeded time and again in undermining the Legion's invasion.As we make preparations for our assault on the Tomb of Sargeras, we need to keep the demons off balance. By pressuring them at every turn, we will expose vulnerabilities that can be exploited to our advantage.Send out your order's champions. Their missions are vital to the success of our campaign... especially as our confrontation with Kil'jaeden draws closer.

Title: Defending Broken Isles
Objective: Defeat a Legion Assault in the Broken Isles.
Text: In our zeal to reclaim the Broken Shore from the Legion, we cannot allow the rest of this land to fall into the demons' foul grip.Kil'jaeden has dispatched his forces across the Broken Isles, threatening the homelands of the allies you have made. You must answer their call in this hour of need.Turn back these demon assaults with haste, t. The Armies of Legionfall will see that the Broken Shore remains secured.

Title: Strike Them Down
Objective: Slay 100 demons on the Broken Shore.
Text: The Felstorm continues to rain demon scum upon these shores. Kil'jaeden believes his army infinite, his resources inexhaustible.We will show him how wrong he is.Cut a swath of retribution through their ranks, t. Strike down demon after demon, until your weapons are bathed in their blood. And when they cry out for mercy, send them screaming back into the Nether.

Title: Begin Construction
Objective: Use the Construction Table to donate Legionfall War Supplies to the construction of the Mage Tower, Nether Disruptor, or Command Center.
Text: We've got the supplies. Now someone needs to decide what to do with 'em.Hmm. Looks like it's your call, being the t and all!Time to pick a building to focus on.

Title: Self-Fulfilling Prophecy
Objective: Complete 8 World Quests on the Broken Shore.
Text: In my life, I have witnessed many visions. Some filled me with hope... others, with despair.Victory over Kil'jaeden lies within our grasp. I have foreseen it. But visions only show us where our path might lead. They require effort to become reality.That effort falls upon your shoulders. You have done much, but more is needed. Fight on the battlefields of the Broken Shore and forge a destiny free from the Legion's grasp!

Title: Cathedral of Eternal Night: Altar of the Aegis
Objective: Defeat Lord Mephistroth and place the Aegis of Aggramar upon the Altar of Eternal Night.
Text: Champion, we are ready to assault the Tomb of Sargeras.I studied the writings of Aegwynn, the Guardian who defeated the Dark Titan's avatar. She said that if her wards were compromised, a failsafe could be triggered by placing the Aegis of Aggramar upon an altar in the Cathedral of Eternal Night.You are the hero who acquired the Pillars of Creation. Gather your allies and enter the Cathedral. Be warned: Mephistroth will use all his power to stop you from placing the Aegis. You must prevail!

Title: The Wrathsteed of Xoroth
Objective: Complete the ritual on the Summoning Platform in Dreadscar Rift to enslave the Wrathsteed.
Text: The time has come and the preparations have been made. When you are ready, we will tear a hole into Xoroth, and force the Arax'ath and the Wrathsteed out of hiding.Follow me to the summoning platform. From there we will initiate the ritual.Prepare yourself. This will not be an easy undertaking.

Title: The Dreadlord's Calling
Objective: Collect a Xorothian Calling Stone from Zuriwa the Hexxer within the Dark Stockades in the Broken Shore.
Text: According to the cultist, the leader you seek should be in her tower overseeing the operations in the Dark Stockades.

Title: If You Build It
Objective: Collect 5 Felslate, 3 Chaotic Spinel and an Unbending Potion. These can be gathered and crafted using profession skills or purchased on the Auction House.
Text: If we wish to achieve a sustained connection to Xoroth, we'll need a particularly resilient portal. Unfortunately, we can't just summon this one up from the ground.I will need you to gather the requisite materials. Once we have them, I will have the mo'arg begin construction at once.Here's the list of what you'll need.

Title: Fel to the Core
Objective: Collect an Overcharged Fel Core from the commander of a Legion Assault on the Broken Isles.
Text: While it has become relatively easy for a warlock to open a brief window into the realms of the Legion, a sustained portal requires significantly more power.For this, we will need a power source brimming with fel energy.I know that the commanders of the Legion use powerful fel cores to control their warships. If you can defeat the commander of one of these ships, you should be able to take their core.

Title: The Minions of Hel'nurath
Objective: Use your Succubus' Seduction to question Xorothian Cultists within the Dark Stockades in the Broken Shore.
Text: The dreadlord Hel'nurath gifts his lieutenants with calling stones to call and bind the dreadsteeds of Xoroth to their service. I believe one such stone will help us draw out the Wrathsteed.Some Xorothian cultists have been spotted helping the Legion's efforts on the Broken Shore. It would be safe to assume their leader has one of Hel'nurath's stones.Your succubus should be able to entice the truth out of the cultists. Find one who knows of their leader's whereabouts.

Title: Take Out the Head...
Objective: Slay Rare Elite Demon Commanders on the Broken Shore.
Text: The Broken Shore swims with Legion filth, each demon deserving of a swift and merciless end.But some are more insidious than the rest. Powerful combatants rallying others to their perfidious cause.Strike down these demon champions and you will fill the hearts of their kin with fear and doubt. Break the Legion's spirit and we will break its back.

Title: Give Me Fuel, Give Me Fire
Objective: Collect 50 Owlbeast Blood from Owlbeasts within Lostlight Grotto in Val'sharah.
Text: A powerful core will not alone be able to power the portal. Like any powerful engine, it will require fuel - though an engine of fel energy must burn life force to thrive.We will need blood potent in magical energy to keep our fel core running and sustain our connection to Xoroth. Fortunately, I have experience in these matters, and I know just the place where we can get some.You'll need a jar or something.

Title: Bloodbringer's Missive
Objective: Speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer in Dreadscar Rift.
Text: Warlock! We have news from Dreadscar Rift.A message arrived by raven from Mor'zul Bloodbringer, with instructions that you meet him in Dreadscar Rift immediately!

Title: Secured Surroundings
Objective: Meet Nighthuntress Syrenne at Deliverance Point.
Text: With Lexera defeated, her band of trappers will quickly disband. Those that refuse will meet my blade.These shores will be free of those who wish to corrupt Azeroth's wildlife.Our work here is done for now. Let us meet at Deliverance Point. There is more I wish to discuss in secured surroundings.

Title: He Knows What He's Doing
Objective: Lure 8 enemies into He's Poison Traps.
Text: You know He Softfoot? Sneaky guy, don't talk much. He put traps all over ruins for mogu. He said Rook just need to trick mogu into traps. Rook don't really know how. Maybe you do it? You find traps, you get bad guys into traps? Can you not tell He though, please?

Title: Offering a Warm Welcome
Objective: Burn 6 Mogu Tents in the Ruins of Guo-Lai.
Text: There is no more sure message we can send them then to burn the tents the sleep in. Scour the ruins. Destroy every tent you find.

Title: The Imperion Threat
Objective: Kill the Shao-Tien Imperion.
Text: Scouts spotted a Shao-Tien Imperion entering the Guo-Lai Halls. I need someone I can trust to make sure he doesn't come out of there alive. I think you're the  for the job.

Title: Painting the Ruins Red
Objective: Kill 8 mogu in the Ruins of Guo-Lai.
Text: The mogu think they can inhabit these ruins uncontested. Let's show them the error in their ways.

Title: Hard as a Rock
Objective: Destroy 10 Mogu Statues.
Text: Hey! You know what awesome thing happened to me this morning? I was strolling through the ruins with Anji, eyes on the ground so I wouldn't step on anymore of those creepy spider pods, when one of the statues came to life and tried to smash me! Anji ended up doing the smashing. But I'm not satisfied. I think that you should go out there and smash all the statues, whether they're moving or not. It's the only way to be sure.

Title: The Key to Success
Objective: Find a Shao-Tien Cage Key and free 6 Golden Lotus Prisoners.
Text: The mogu have taken prisoners. They'll be tortured or worse. Find any way you can to free them from their cages.

Title: No Stone Unturned
Objective: Destroy 6 Mogu Statues.
Text: The mogu have forced spirits into their old statues to bring them to life, control them, and turn them against us. The only way to free the bound spirits is to destroy their vessels.

Title: Gaohun the Soul-Severer
Objective: Kill Gaohun the Soul-Severer.
Text: Big mogu leader is here! Up behind village. If we kill big mogu leader, Leven be happy with us for sure! You been good at helping Rook. Want to help more maybe? Please?

Title: Baolai the Immolator
Objective: Kill Baolai the Immolator.
Text: Big mogu leader is here! Up behind village. If we kill big mogu leader, Leven be happy with us for sure! You been good at helping Rook. Want to help more maybe? Please?

Title: Stunning Display
Objective: Collect 12 Stunned Whitepetal Carp.
Text: I've been talking to Tantan here... again... and he insists that fishing is some kind of fabulous. I was skeptical, but I gave it another go. I'm not a big fan of that whole holding a stick and waiting method though, so I tried something a bit more direct. Would you be a doll and go collect any of the still intact fish floating belly up in the lake for me?

Title: Stonebound Killers
Objective: Kill 8 Stonebound Quilen.
Text: Mogu stone dog creatures chasing villagers and hurting them. Rook try to smash some, but they too fast. You help smash some too?

Title: In Enemy Hands
Objective: Beat 8 Possessed Whitepetal Defenders until they're freed of mogu possession.
Text: The Shao-Tien Mindbenders have taken over the minds of our defenders down at Whitepetal Lake to the west. Get down there and kill the mogu that are controlling them, but don't kill the defenders! Killing their captors should free them from their mind control. Sooner would be better. Anji might try to go down there to help soon, and her ability to restrain herself when in the heat of things is not one of the qualities I married her for.

Title: Rude Awakenings
Objective: Kill 8 Dominated Paleblade Flesheaters.
Text: The mogu are taking over the minds of the saurok at the lake to our west and turning them against us! The thing is, they were already against us, so I'm not sure they really thought this thing through fully. Anyway, Anji's the fighter in this pair, I'm more the lover, so I'm looking for someone to do all the weapon swinging and spell flinging and war crying and such. Can you go kill some saurok for me?

Title: Small Comforts
Objective: Read the Rite of Release at the bodies of 6 Fallen Golden Lotus Defenders.
Text: The mindbenders at Whitepetal Lake are pulling the spirits from the corpses of the dead to inflict who-knows-what kind of torments upon them. I've written on this scroll a rite that will release their spirits from their bodies and send them on their way. Where they go and what happens to them from there I don't know, but it will at least free them from the cruel hands of the mogu. Read this rite over any of the fallen you find. We'll recover their bodies later.

Title: Backed Into a Corner
Objective: Rescue 6 Cornered Mistfall Villagers.
Text: Many villagers are cornered and scared, unable to defend themselves. You will need to defend them. Rescue them. Go quickly friend, save as many as you can!

Title: Mogu Make Poor House Guests
Objective: Kill 6 Shado-Tien attackers in Mistfall Village.
Text: Leven sent Rook here to stop mogu, but there are more than Rook can kill alone. You help? Rook will tell Leven you helped. Promise.

Title: Wu Kao Scouting Reports
Objective: Recover 3 Wu Kao Scouting Reports.
Text: There were some scouting reports unaccounted for after the attack. If we're lucky, they're still out in the village, but the mogu may have gotten their hands on some of them as well. If you could bring back any scouting reports you find, it would definitely put my mind at ease. We can't afford to let the mogu in on our positions or any of the artifacts we've found, lest the men be in even more danger than they already are.

Title: My Town, It's On Fire Again
Objective: Use Mistfall Water Buckets to douse 60 fires.
Text: I don't know if you noticed, but my town is on fire... again. We have water buckets all over town, but no one can get out to put out the fires. Please, please, help us!

Title: A Thousand Pointy Teeth
Objective: Kill 9 Knifetooth Swarmers.
Text: The water has been frothing with danger this day! Some sort of swarming, meat-eating fishy nastiness has taken up residence in our lake! Deplorable. And just when I was considering stripping down to my nothings to take a mid-day dip! You are adept in the ways of slaughtering any manner of nasty, are you not? Would you put your skills to use this day, in the name of pandaren everywhere desiring a swim? It's a truly noble cause, especially with me among their ranks!

Title: Freeing Mind and Body
Objective: Free 6 Dominated Guards by killing their controllers.
Text: Mogu stealing peoples minds! Making them do evil things. Don't kill them, just kill the mogu, then they forget about all the mogu mind stealing and stop being evil. You should fix people like Rook is.

Title: Burning Away the Filth
Objective: Burn 10 Shao-Tien Banners.
Text: The mogu have erected their filthy banners around the lake to the west, claiming it as their own. Take this torch and show them what we think of their banners.

Title: The Thunder Below
Objective: Slay Milau.
Text: Roars have been echoing out from inside the Guo-Lai Halls. The mogu have awakened some ancient beast, and it will not be long before they attempt to release it upon my men. Find your way to the Hall of the Serpent and slay the beast before it can be unleashed upon us. I would trust no other with such a dangerous and important task.

Title: The Arcanic Oubliette
Objective: Find and disable the 3 Oubliette Shackles.
Text: An Alliance member? Here? Elune be praised. My team has encountered a snag. We opened a portal to this land using some ancient scrolls we had found that predated Azshara's rule. Unfortunately, the coordinates provided on the tablets were warded and the portal that meant to take us to our destination landed us in this oubliette. We have been trapped here for days, and it is slowly leaching our energies to power itself. Can you find the nearby shackles that bind the oubliette and disable them?

Title: A Crocolisk Tale
