Objective: Bring the Enormous Crocolisk Tail to Yan at New Cifera in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: How could this crocolisk have grown so large? Certainly, rumors exist of very old crocolisks that have grown to enormous sizes... but this female can't be more than a dozen years old. Perhaps someone in New Cifera can shed some light on the subject.

Title: The Crumbling Hall
Objective: Retrieve the Ancient Guo-Lai Artifact.
Text: An ancient mogu artifact has been uncovered in the Guo-Lai Vault, beyond the Hall of Statues. We've made repeated attempts to retrieve it, but none have been successful. We cannot let this artifact fall into the hands of the Shao-Tien. I need someone capable to retrieve it, and quickly. Are you in?

Title: The Silent Approach
Objective: Kill 6 Shao-Tien mogu at Whitepetal Lake.

Title: A Smashing Impression
Objective: Destroy the Shao-Tien Ritual Statues.
Text: Sometimes I feel sorry for these mogu... maybe ripping out the spirits of other races is just their way of coping with family issues at home? Maybe we should be more sympathetic to where all this aggression stems from? Or we could just smash all their soul-stealing ritual objects down at the lake. That sounds more fun to me personally.

Title: Striking the Rain
Objective: Kill 18 Haunts of Despair at the Temple of the Red Crane.
Text: Now as for that "striking the rain" part... well, sometimes you have to. "Hope is the sun behind a stormy sky - ever in the heart, but veiled to the eye." There seems to be no end to the sha pouring out of the temple. But in order to see beyond the veil of despair, you must carve through it. With any luck, you'll find a sun behind the clouds...

Title: Sha Can Awe
Objective: Kill sha near 10 Hopeless Monks or Acolytes to inspire them.
Text: The sha have the mysterious ability to evoke powerful, often overwhelming, emotional responses in their victims. As we fled the temple, senior members of the Crane Wing order stayed behind to cover our escape. They are no doubt being subjected to intense emotional trauma, and I fear they are not all strong enough to resist falling into despair. $p, we have to show them there is still hope! Show them that despair CAN be defeated!

Title: In the House of the Red Crane
Objective: Enter the basement of the Temple of the Red Crane and defeat the Sha of Despair.
Text: "Broken are the bodies wherein hopeless hearts reside - the blight of despair strikes forth from inside." This was the last piece of wisdom the Red Crane imparted to me, just hours before the Sha outbreak. It makes sense now... $p, when the Sha attacked, they broke forth from the temple's basement... All of his teachings - the very Way of the Crane itself... it's all been preparation for facing the Sha of Despair. The Red Crane has been expecting this conflict for centuries!

Title: A Godly Invitation
Objective: Speak with Odyn at your order hall in Skyhold.
Text: Battlelord $p, Odyn has requested an audience with you back in Skyhold. Please meet with him at your earliest convenience.

Title: Crystals Not Included
Objective: Collect 10 Argunite Crystals.
Text: Turalyon is safe, and we can start to fight back. First things first, we must secure what supplies we can from the crash. Even though we are blessed by the Light, our ships still rely on crystal technology. From powering our defenses to arming our weapons, we will need to collect as much as we can to fight back against the enemy. Venture out into the crash and retrieve what crystals you can. While you are out there, keep an eye out for Y'mera. She was separated from us, and will need help.

Title: Whispers of a Frightened World
Objective: Meet Magni in Sholazar Basin and hear the warning.
Text: "Champion! Azeroth needs our help."

Title: The Trial of Rage
Objective: Speak with Odyn to begin the Trial of Rage scenario. Complete the scenario and claim your prize.
Text: I wish to extend to you a prestigious invitation. Every year I hold a trial for my finest warrior to prove that I command the strongest in this land. I have chosen you to be my champion in this trial. Should you succeed in completing the trial, I have a prize that will be worthy of your accomplishments awaiting you at the end. Take what time you need to prepare yourself. Come back and speak with me when you're ready to begin.

Title: The Matter Resolved... For Now...
Objective: Speak with Archmage Modera in Dalaran.
Text: You should return to the Kirin Tor. I have no doubt they will want to hear of our success. I will find Lord Erdris, and then I will contact you.

Title: A Conduit No More
Objective: Destroy the Legion's Conduit at the Temple of a Thousand Lights.
Text: One final task remains to sever the Burning Legion's connection to other worlds. I'll provide you transportation to get you close to the source of power, but you must deliver the final blow to the conduit.

Title: Battle for Azsuna
Objective: Defeat Fel Commander Xeritas in Azsuna.
Text: The vile demon commanding the assault must be stopped. I can get us close, but once we're there I'll rely on you and your allies to help bring down the demonic forces.

Title: Blinding the Riverblades
Objective: Kill 8 Riverblade Pathstalkers in the areas surrounding Crane Wing Refuge.
Text: "A hooded falcon catches no quarry." This is one of the first mantras we teach young monks at the temple. It means that even a foe as swift and lethal as a falcon can be neutralized by depriving its senses. The saurok have scouts all over the region acting as eyes for their raiding parties. It's time we put their eyes out, don't you think?

Title: Bloodied Skies
Objective: Kill 30 Krik'thik Swarmers using a Setting Sun Turret.
Text: We have cannons set up on the top of the towers flanking the main gate. They are our best method to clear the skies when the flying mantid try to pass over the wall, like they are now. Looks like you're on.

Title: The Murksweats
Objective: Gather 6 Murkscale Heads from Murkscale Strikers in Krasarang River.
Text: Take a good look. The river nearby is swarming with these snakes. Their venom causes a condition the locals call "the murksweats." Several refugees were bitten as they fled the temple and have already begun to show symptoms: nausea, vomiting, and intense sweating as the body rejects all fluids, causing dehydration and potentially death. We are administering anti-venom as quickly as possible, but we'll need more venom glands. Don't bother removing the glands yourself - just bring back the whole head.

Title: Sparkle in the Eye
Objective: Recover 8 Shining Rubies.
Text: I've been staring down into the waters of the lake, pondering life, love, and everything beautiful, and suddenly I realized that the sparkles in the water aren't just a reflection of my radiant personality, there are actually some sort of shining objects down there! Surely valuable. Would you mind taking a drip and relieving the lake's depths of its mysterious sparkles? Pretty please?

Title: Watery Woes
Objective: Obtain 18 Glade Glimmers and 5 Spindly Bloodfeathers.
Text: I love fishing. I'd be enjoying myself much more, however, if I had my bait and my lures. They were thrown away in a... a misunderstanding with my wife, Rin.  Should I let a whole day of fishing be ruined, just because of a little domestic squabble? No! All I need is bugs and feathers, after all, and this glade is filled with those two things. Care to help a fisherman out?

Title: Clearing in the Forest
Objective: Kill 6 Shao-Tien mogu in Winterbough Glade.
Text: The Shao-Tien are on their heels. Most of them retreated to Winterbough Glade after their last defeat. We should press the advantage. Take the fight to these mogu in the clearing to the northwest. Let us leave them no minute of rest as long as they remain in the Vale.

Title: Enemy at the Gates
Objective: Use a Shado-Pan Sky Serpent to kill 60 Krik'thik attackers, 3 Krik'thik War Wagons, and 3 Krik'thik Catapults.
Text: The mantid forces are pouring against the wall. I've arranged for some flying serpents to cut away at their forces from the air. Would you be willing to take the reigns on one of them?

Title: Roll Club: Serpent's Spine
Objective: Complete the Serpent's Spine roll course.
Text: Get to the bottom of the wall in the fastest time possible. Speak to me when you're ready to roll.

Title: Unsafe Passage
Objective: Help Koro Mistwalker escort a group of refugees from the Temple of the Red Crane to Crane Wing Refuge. Speak with Koro first to begin.
Text: As we say at the temple: "Never fight a tiger with a hozen on your back." We will deal with the sha, but first we must see to the more immediate... nuisance.  Groups of refugees from the temple are heading for a camp to the north, but they're being ambushed by saurok. Help me see the next group to the camp and we'll figure out our next move from there.

Title: Mung-Mung's Vote II: Rotten to the Core
Objective: Collect 10 Partially Chewed Carrots.
Text: Dem virmen's back! They been biting Mr. Mudclaw's carrots. Ruining his crop. And who is gonna pay? Mung-Mung, that's who! You go get the chewed up carrots before Mr. Mudclaw sees. They all over the fields to the southwest, and down under the ground in the virmen's tunnels, too. Otherwise, Mung-Mung in big trouble. You do this for me?

Title: Growing the Farm I: The Weeds
Objective: Speak to Gai Lan at The Heartland in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: Hey , I've been thinkin' recently about expanding my farm. See that plot there that's just covered in weeds? If we can get rid of those weeds, we could use that land for planting. I heard there's a farmer by the name of Gai Lan who knows a thing or two about weed whackin'. His farm is just out west. Go talk to him and see if he'd be willing to help us.

Title: Mung-Mung's Vote I: A Hozen's Problem
Objective: Speak to Mung-Mung at Haohan Mudclaw's House in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: I've been thinkin' about how to get into the Tiller's good graces. Now, the Tiller's Union accepts new farmers each year, and there are five members on the voting council. We already got Gina's vote, but we'll have to prove ourselves to the other four members of their board. Why don't you go over and say hello to Mung-Mung? He works with Mr. Mudclaw out on the Mudclaw's farm to the northwest.

Title: Learn and Grow IV: Harvesting
Objective: Harvest 2 EZ-Gro Green Cabbages from your field and bring them to Farmer Yoon in Sunsong Ranch.
Text: It's time for our hard work to pay off! Normally we'd have to wait a day before the crops are ready to harvest. Fortunately, those seeds Greenfield gave us were specially designed to grow FAST. The yield won't be worth much, but they're good for stepping new farmers through the process. Our cabbages should be ready to harvest. I'll let you do the honors, of course!

Title: Learn and Grow II: Tilling and Planting
Objective: Till 2 plots of Untilled Soil to create Tilled Soil. Then, use the EZ-Gro Green Cabbage Seeds on 2 plots of Tilled Soil.
Text: Okay, now we've got our seeds, it's time to plant them. First, we have to prepare the soil! You gotta till the soil and break it up to make a nice bed for our little sprouts. Till those two plots of soil over there, then plant the seeds in them.

Title: A Helping Hand
Objective: Destroy 8 Unbudging Rocks.
Text: I've been pushing and shoving and hammering all morning, but it's hopeless. These rocks won't budge! "It will be a breeze," Grandpa said. "Farming's like breathing!" he said. Maybe for him, but not for me! How am I supposed to succeed at this whole FARMING thing if I can't even clear my farm for planting? Hey, wait a minute. You look like you've got some muscle on you. Would you be willing to help me out? Just until I can catch my breath.

Title: Vyraxxis, the Krik'thik Swarm-Lord
Objective: Kill Vyraxxis, the Krik'thik Swarm-Lord.
Text: A giant mantid is terrorizing the inside of the wall. It seems doubtful that the defenders will be able deal with it without you.

Title: Learn and Grow V: Halfhill Market
Objective: Investigate the Dark Soil underneath Farmer Yoon's house, then give a gift to Gina Mudclaw at the Halfhill Market.
Text: All right friend, all of that farming was just for practice! Are you ready to try the real thing? There's a lady by the name of Gina Mudclaw who runs the Halfhill Market, which is across the street to the south. I heard she's looking to buy some vegetables. Since it's your first time meeting her, you shouldn't go empty-handed. Why don't you look around the ranch and see if there are any items hiding around? Might be that we'll find a good gift to take to our new neighbor!

Title: The Family Farm
Objective: Join Farmer Yoon.
Text: D-did you hear what they said? It's almost like they don't want me here. Like...I'm not good enough. Sure I've never run a farm before, but I know how to plant a seed and how to pick a turnip.  You know what? I'm going to show them that I can also become a master farmer! I'm going to turn this farm into one of the most prosperous in the Valley! It's too much work for one pandaren, though. Come on! Will you help me?

Title: Under the Setting Sun
Objective: Kill Kri'chon, the Corpse-Reaver.
Text: A giant beast has burrowed under the gate into the courtyard. The defenders need your help!

Title: Survival Ring: Thunder
Objective: Enter the Survival Ring and survive for 90 seconds without leaving.
Text: This is one of the challenges I put upon my warriors during peaceful times to keep them strong and fast. Let's see how you fare. Survive the ring for 90 seconds without getting pushed out or killed. Stay on your toes.

Title: Learn and Grow III: Tending Crops
Objective: Use the Rusty Watering Can to water 2 Parched EZ-Gro Green Cabbages at Sunsong Ranch.
Text: My grandfather used to say "Yoonie, a cabbage is like a woman: ignore her and she'll turn rotten. Pamper her and she'll grow big and plump and you can put a ribbon on her and take her to market to show her off to your frie-" look, he was from a different time, okay? The point is, now that our cabbages have sprouted, they need attention! Today they look a little dry, so you should water them. Here's the old watering can grandpa left. It will always be near the field if you need it.

Title: The Butcher
Objective: Kill Bai-Jin the Butcher.
Text: Scouts reports place the displaced Shao-Tien Imperion at the north end of the wall. Angi Autumnlight spelled out your goal in no uncertain terms: find this leader and kill him.

Title: Along the Serpent's Spine
Objective: Kill 10 Krik'thik mantid on the Gate of the Setting Sun.
Text: There are mantid on top of the wall. The defenders on the ramparts are calling for help!

Title: Roll Club: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
Objective: Complete the Vale of Eternal Blossoms roll course.
Text: Follow the flags. Make the checkpoints. Round the loop. Get back to me before your time is up. Speak to me when you're ready to roll.

Title: Upon the Ramparts
Objective: Kill 10 Krik'thik mantid on top of the Gate of the Setting Sun.
Text: Some of the mantid have made it on top of the wall. There's some risk they'll route the soldiers we have posted there if their numbers are large enough. I need you to get on top of the wall and help clear out any that have broken through.

Title: Mantid Under Fire
Objective: Use a Hot Oil Cauldron to kill 80 mantid near the Gate of the Setting Sun.
Text: The mantid are attacking again, and we're a bit short-handed up on the wall. In hopes that you'd help, I saved one of the more fun posts for you: the hot oil! It's a bit more violent and a bit less scandalous than it sounds. It's simple really. Get up on the wall, find one of the oil stations, and dump it on any of the mantid pouring up against the wall. It's very effective.

Title: Lost Scouts
Objective: Recover 3 Shado-Pan Scout reports.
Text: We sent some scouts towards the Five Sisters to the north to try and find whatever mogu leader has risen up to direct their movements in the valley. Few have returned. I'd like to think they're just off downing too much ale or being irresponsible with some young pandaren, but they may actually be in some trouble. Can you scout for the scouts? And see if they've turned up any information on that leader while you're at it?

Title: Warn Stoneplow
Objective: Travel to Stoneplow Village in Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: So much death. And more to come, if Ambassador Han's stories of the mantid are to be believed. We must help. We must do our part to save lives. Travel to Stoneplow. Warn them of the coming mantid attack. I will join you with what forces I can muster once I have laid Kor's body to rest.

Title: Survival Ring: Blades
Objective: Enter the Survival Ring and survive for 60 seconds without leaving.
Text: This is one of the challenges I put upon my warriors to keep them strong and fast. Let's see how you fare. Survive the ring for 60 seconds without getting pushed out or killed. Stay on your toes.

Title: Survival Ring: Flame
Objective: Enter the Survival Ring and survive for 60 seconds without leaving.
Text: This is one of the challenges I put upon my warriors to keep them strong and fast. Let's see how you fare. Survive the ring for 60 seconds without getting pushed out or killed. Stay on your toes.

Title: Battle for Highmountain
Objective: Defeat Fel Commander Erixtol in Highmountain.
Text: Our defenses have grown in strength, yet the Legion continues to press their assault on Thunder Totem. There is but one way to put an end to this madness - we must strike at the heart of their forces together and bring these attacks to an end.

Title: The Archmage Accosted
Objective: Confront Archmage Xylem.
Text: With the barrier dispelled, Archmage Xylem is finally within reach!Hopefully he'll be cooperative in returning the Iris...

Title: Hiding In Plain Sight
Objective: Assassinate the infiltrating homunculi.
Text: Greetings, Shadowblade.I hope you are not too upset that I began without you, I have a bit of trouble controlling myself around the mindless undead.Yes, you heard me right. Taerir, the very Taerir that has been standing in the Hall of Shadows for many months now, was the undead pawn of a dreadlord.And there are more of them - in our cities, rising through the ranks of the aristocracy, growing in power and influence, and nearly undetectable.

Title: A Portal Away
Objective: Return to Archmage Kalec in Dalaran.
Text: Xylem may have escaped, but a trace of his portal remains.Now that you have freed his apprentices from his corruption, I will set them to work trying to find a way to reach him. Once I find something, I will alert the Kirin Tor.I only ask that when you do confront the Archmage, that you try to spare his life. I believe that the good man he once was still exists beneath the shadow that has taken him.Farewell.

Title: Tactical Planning
Objective: Meet with Odyn in Skyhold's Great Mead Hall.
Text: Battlelord ! We should discuss our next moves!

Title: Furthering Knowledge
Objective: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
Text: As we follow the stories further back there are strong whispers of even greater potential.We have discovered much along the way and we can impart that knowledge. With the help of more order resources we will continue to bring in information from members traveling far and wide.These shaman like you are the key to finally unlocking the full potential of these weapons and soon enough we will be back to the time consuming task of chasing down rumors to discover more.

Title: Furthering Knowledge
Objective: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
Text: , thank you and the Tirisgarde for this opportunity. Learning about this weapon of yours has been an absolute joy.To repay your confidence and trust in my abilities I have organized our researchers notes into an easily digestible course. If you have the resources I know we will continue to output even more valuable insights.I assure you it has been worth every minute.

Title: An Urgent Message
Objective: Activate the console to receive the message from Mardum.
Text: We received an urgent message from one of Belath's scouts down on Mardum! I think you had better listen to it.

Title: Furthering Knowledge
Objective: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
Text: The amount of power in these artifacts is astounding and we have only just begun our journey.Our researchers have been busy preparing notes for you and with a few more resources I am sure they can prepare something to boost your artifact knowledge.This is only the first step, with more resources we should be able to help you catch up even more.

Title: Furthering Knowledge
Objective: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
Text: I am amazed by what we have learned so far. I believe I can prepare for you some notes based on our initial research to get you caught up quickly.It will take just a few more resources to prepare the notes properly.These steps we take now should provide a boost to our knowledge and we can delve even deeper into the hidden potential of these weapons.

Title: Furthering Knowledge
Objective: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
Text: The amount of power in these artifacts is incredible and we have only scratched the surface.Our researchers have been busy preparing notes for you and with a few more resources I am sure they can prepare something to boost your artifact knowledge.This is only the first step, with more resources we should be able to help you catch up even more.

Title: Furthering Knowledge
Objective: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
Text: Studying these ancient magic and metals has given us great insight into the potential of these weapons.Just as these weapons were forged with time and effort so can we forge you instruction on how best to wield and unlock them. With a few more order resources we will have a course completed for you to increase your knowledge.This is only breaking the surface of what we will unlock, and as we break through the layers of lost knowledge it will take time to delve deeper.

Title: Furthering Knowledge
Objective: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
Text: I am surprised and awed each day I delve deeper into the history of these weapons.Our researcher has been going extremely well and we have been busy preparing notes for you. With a few more resources I am sure we can prepare something to boost your artifact knowledge a little.Remember though, this is only a first step. These weapons have been around longer than most recorded history so much deeper knowledge will take time.

Title: Furthering Knowledge
Objective: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
Text: The amount of power in these artifacts is incredible and we have only scratched the surface.Our researchers have been busy preparing notes for you and with a few more resources I am sure they can prepare something to boost your artifact knowledge.This is only the first step, with more resources we should be able to help you catch up even more.

Text: The amount of power in these artifacts is incredible and we have only scratched the surface.Our researchers have been busy preparing notes for you and with a few more resources I am sure they can prepare something to boost your artifact knowledge.This is only the first step, with more resources we should be able to help you catch up even more.

Title: Furthering Knowledge
Objective: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
Text: Through pain and blood we have cut through the initial layers of research.We have been busy preparing notes for you and with a few more resources we can get you something to boost your artifact knowledge.This is only the first step, more resources will be required to catch you up further.

Title: Furthering Knowledge
Objective: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
Text: We've got the skinny on a bit of the artifact power already and I am working an angle to capitalize on it.We've been extorting a group of scribes to put together notes for you, yet they are holding out for a few more resources before they deliver.The good news is that we can squeeze them for a few more courses, but after that it will be back to doing our own research.

Title: Return to Rest
Objective: Honor 6 Pandaren Gravestones.
Text: The spirits of our ancestors are reliving one of the most revered battles in our history at the Tu Shen Burial Grounds to the east. Do as I ask, and honor their gravestones. Remind them that they are respected even these many years later, and that they are deserving of peaceful rest.

Title: Knowledge is Power
Objective: Provide Order Resources to unlock artifact knowledge.
Text: Throughout our campaign on the Broken Isles, you have infused your ancient artifact with power. But as the Legion invasion intensifies, it becomes crucial to unlock more of your weapon's potential.There is a time for slow, steady progress. But today, we must move with the wind at our backs.By devoting our order's resources to studying the weapon's history, I believe we can rapidly enhance the value of the power you apply to the artifact.Shall we begin, t?

Title: Sterile Surroundings
Objective: Return to Netherlight Temple.
Text: With the threat of infection dismissed, your allies should be able to press their assault here on the Broken Shore and gain an advantage over the Burning Legion.Let's leave this place and speak somewhere more... sterile. I hear your order occupies an impressive temple.

Title: Lao-Fe the Slavebinder
Objective: Kill the Spirit of Lao-Fe, the Slavebinder.
Text: You can hear the spirit of Lao-Fe, the Slavebinder shouting taunts from the cave at the top of Tu Shen Burial Mound. Defeating him will surely serve to ensure victory for the spirits of the pandaren monks.

Title: The Pandaren Uprising Relived
Objective: Kill 8 Ancient Mogu Spirits.
Text: In the Tu Shen Burial Ground to the east, the spirits of ancient mogu are locked in battle with the spirits of our pandaren ancestors that rose up against them. The spirits have seen no rest since the return of the mogu to the valley. If you would be willing to go to the graveyard and force the mogu to relive their defeat again, we might offer some lasting peace to the spirits of our ancestors.

Title: Aetha
Objective: Defeat Aetha, the Spirit of the Golden Winds.
Text: It seems Aetha has been levitating the livestock and dropping them into the river again. The mayor has requested that we remind her that these kinds of jokes are not welcomed. Would you be so generous as to travel to the ridge above the village and teach her this lesson? You cannot kill her, you can only send her away for a time, but this should prove a potent reminder.

Title: Cracklefang
Objective: Kill Cracklefang.
Text: Hi! So, I have a dilemma. I've only got one good wolf name.... wait for it... Cracklefang! I know, amazing right?! But now there are TWO big nasty wolves in the forest, which is all kinds of confusing. I need you to kill one of them so I can free up the name. Should be simple enough, yeah? Especially for someone of your incredibleness. So, are you on board? I'm hoping for yes!

Title: Vicejaw
Objective: Kill Vicejaw and return Ren's Longstaff.
Text: Vicejaw! Sounds absolutely violent, does it not? I came up with it myself, and I think it's very suiting. I tried to wrestle my staff away from him for hours, but he simply would not let go! Okay, it was really more like a few seconds. I like to be truthful to my friends, even if it makes my stories significantly more boring. Anyway, would you be so kind as to release your oh-so-potent wrath upon this crocolisk with a vice-like jaw, and then kindly bring my staff back? Preferably in-tact!

Title: Ruffling Some Feathers
Objective: Gather 80 Silken Feathers.
Text: The hawk numbers in the vale are thriving. This is opportune for our fletchers, for we will need a great number of feathers if we are to keep the archers upon the wall stocked with arrows. If you would not mind, could you aid us in gathering these feathers?

Title: Quid Pro Quo
Objective: Defeat Quid, the Spirit of the Misty Falls.
Text: Quid is a very powerful and very ancient water spirit, though you might not know it with his child-like ways. This morning, Quid nearly killed several villagers in the bar when he jokingly caused several of the water kegs to explode. As long as the water flows, Quid will remain. He cannot be slain. But he can be reminded that we do not take his dangerous antics in jest. Would you be willing to carry this message to him on behalf of the village?

Title: Pomfruit Pickup
Objective: Gather 12 Pomfruit.
Text: I need more pomfruit! Go knock some loose from the trees for me, would you? Take this, I use it when I go harvesting. Things go quicker when the fruit comes to you!

Title: The Greater Danger
Objective: Kill 8 Korjani Reclaimers.
Text: I apologize for my harsh words earlier. Dezco might have been right to wait and move west with a unified strength. The mogu hit us hard when we were searching the ruins west of here. They ambushed us using summoning portals and some dark magics. I haven't seen such evil sorcery used since Outland. We need a respite. Head west, kill their summoners, cut their supply line.

Title: Re-Reclaim
Objective: Recover 10 Mogu Artifacts.
Text: Mogu are thugs. They have always been thugs. Only when they ruled their empires in the old stories did they ever know any kind of magic. But these mogu are using arcane portals and spells. We need to stop them! $p, look for any artifacts the mogu are using to cast their magics with. I saw a number of their collectors and reclaimers to the west and north that were gathering these items.

Title: Troubling the Troublemakers
Objective: Kill 8 Stonebark sprites.
Text: The wood sprites are back. I need you to kill them before they cause anymore trouble.

Title: Wulon, the Granite Sentinel
Objective: Kill Wulon, the Granite Sentinel.
Text: One of the quilen statues in Guo-Lai Halls came to life and nearly killed my precious Kun. I won't have it! No one threatens my Kun. I want you to go in there and smash the thing to pieces. I'd do it myself, but I need to attend to my lover's wounds first.

Title: The Ashweb Matriarch
Objective: Kill Bloodtip, the Ashweb Matriarch.
Text: My dear Kun spotted more spiders pouring out of the Guo-Lai Halls this morning, and when he went to investigate, he uncovered another spider matriarch inside. I need you to kill it.

Title: Blood on the Rise
Objective: Kill 8 Shao-Tien mogu on Ruin's Rise.
Text: A small group of mogu have been sighted on Ruin's Rise, to the north. Extinguish them.

Title: Runes in the Ruins
Objective: Collect 12 Guo-Lai Runestones.
Text: In the walls of the ruins themselves, there are precious runestones that we can make use of back in the eastern vale. If you see any while you are within the ruins, would you be so kind as to bring them back to me?

Title: That's Not a Rock!
Objective: Kill 50 Ashweb Spiderlings. Use Kun's torch to burn them inside their pods.
Text: Okay, these spiders are seriously creeping me out. Especially those egg sacs they leave lying around that I keep accidentally stepping on only to be covered in very little but very creepy spiderlings. Ug, makes me shudder just thinking about it. I say you burn them. Burn them all.

Title: Runelocked
Objective: Retrieve the Ancient Mogu Artifact.
Text: Hello, friend. One of Leven's men brought word to me of a mogu artifact in the eastern ruins, but said he couldn't figure out how to retrieve it. I suspect it's guarded by one of their rune locks. If you go to the artifact, you should find four runes somewhere nearby that when activated will release the lock. If you could bring the artifact back to me, I would be very grateful.

Title: Knowledge is Power
Objective: Provide Order Resources to unlock artifact knowledge.
Text: Throughout our campaign on the Broken Isles, you have infused your ancient artifact with power. But as the Legion invasion intensifies, it becomes crucial to unlock more of your weapon's potential.There is a time for slow, steady progress. But today, we must hasten our efforts.By devoting our order's resources to studying the weapon's history, I believe we can rapidly enhance the value of the power you apply to the artifact.Shall we begin, t?

Text: Throughout our campaign on the Broken Isles, you have infused your ancient artifact with power. But as the Legion invasion intensifies, it becomes crucial to unlock more of your weapon's potential.There is a time for slow, steady progress. But today, we must hasten our efforts.By devoting our order's resources to studying the weapon's history, I believe we can rapidly enhance the value of the power you apply to the artifact.Shall we begin, t?

Title: Furthering Knowledge
Objective: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
Text: We have learned so much already about these artifacts it is incredible.Our researchers have been busy preparing notes for you and with a few more resources I am sure they can be used as a crash course in gaining more artifact knowledge.This is only the first step, with more resources we should have additional courses to help you catch up on your studies.

Title: Knowledge is Power
Objective: Provide Order Resources to unlock artifact knowledge.
Text: Boss, you've been working every angle on the Broken Isles, infusing that ancient artifact of yours with power. But those demons won't give up, and we really need to unlock more of your weapon's potential... and I mean pronto!Slow, steady progress is one thing. But today, we need to get busy.Here's the deal. You fork over our order's resources so I can study the weapon's history, and I'll get you a way to up the value of the power you apply to that artifact.How does that sound, t?

Title: Thwarting the Twins
Objective: Speak with War Councilor Victoria to be teleported to Raest's location and defeat him.
Text: I have news from Archmage Karlain! The Kirin Tor have found Raest Magespear and can open up a portal to his location!If you are ready to face him, I can have the mages here open the portal into the Twisting Nether.

Title: Knowledge is Power
Objective: Provide Order Resources to unlock artifact knowledge.
Text: Throughout our campaign on the Broken Isles, you have infused your ancient artifact with power. But as the Legion invasion intensifies, it becomes crucial to unlock more of your weapon's potential.There is a time for slow, steady progress. But today, we must hasten our efforts.By devoting our order's resources to studying the weapon's history, I believe we can rapidly enhance the value of the power you apply to the artifact.Shall we begin, t?

Title: Battle for Stormheim
Objective: Defeat Lord Commander Alexius in Stormheim.
Text: Your efforts have destroyed the Legion's forces upon Shield's Rest, yet they continue to press their assault.There is only one way to end this - you must venture into the midst of our foe, find their commander, and remove his vile head!

Title: In Ashen Webs
Objective: Kill 8 Ashweb Spiders.
Text: We used to have the trainees clear out the ruins of spiders as part of their training, but now we send them straight to the mogu front. The spiders have gotten out of control. Care to put things back in control?

Title: Source of the Corruption
Objective: Find the source of the corruption at Heroes' Rest and end it.
Text: There was something wrong with those three, they had a fel taint about them that was... unsettling. I believe they were somehow woken later than the other risen. Curse the Legion and their meddling!The reinforcements are streaming out of Black Rook Hold from Heroes' Rest. We must make our way there and see if we can stop the source of these new troops.

Title: Lushroom Rush
Objective: Collect 12 Lushrooms.
Text: Building a new village makes for hungry workers it seems! I have a hearty stew recipe prepared, but I need some lushrooms from the Tu Shen Burial Ground to the east. Apparently there are roused spirits causing trouble up there though, and I'm not very well suited for the violent life. If you're heading up the burial grounds today, could you collect some lushrooms for me?

Title: Blooming Blossoms
Objective: Collect 10 Eternal Blossoms.
Text: Would you do a humble merchant a favor? I've been needin' to refresh my stock of eternal blossoms. They grow in the woods nearby. Could you help me out, perhaps?

Title: Cart Ride
Objective: Ride a delivery cart to XXX Village.
Text: The vale has been quiet all morning. I'm sending Rook with a cart of supplies out to the XXX Village. You should join him.

Title: Encroaching Storm
Objective: Kill 8 Thundermaw Wolves.
Text: The villagers have lost another yak this morning to one of the thundermaw wolves from across the river. The wolves grow bold. This is a sign that they are breeding beyond the vale's ability to sustain them. It's time to thin their numbers again. If you are willing to aid me in this, you would have my sincere appreciation.

Title: Meating Expectations
Objective: Retrieve 10 slabs of Fairlands Gazelle Meat.
Text: Hard workers deserve hearty meals, but I'm all out of good meat! Can you head out into the forest and get me some fresh gazelle meat?

Title: My Town, It's on Fire
Objective: Put out 30 Brazier Fires.
Text: I don't know if you noticed, but my town is burning... The sprites have started kicking the braziers! They're going to set fire to the whole town! Please help us! Stamp out any fires you see!

Title: Sprite Plight
Objective: Kill 8 Slateskin Troublemakers.
Text: Sprites again! I hate these things. We need to stop them before they hurt someone or burn down half of the village! If you see any of the pests, please deal with them!

Title: Steer Clear of the Beer Here
Objective: Recover 10 Stolen Mistfall Kegs.
Text: Someone left some beer out up on the southern rise and now the sprites have developed a taste for our brew. They've been sneaking into town all morning, stealing whatever kegs they find. Bring back what you can. A pandaren worker without brew is just... it won't be very productive. We need the men in good spirits.

Title: Flight Training: In Due Course
Objective: Fly through 10 Race Flags at the Checkpoints floating above the Mistveil Sea.
Text: Now that you have learned the basics of the race, you should go learn the course. Explore the spires and collect a race flag from each of the checkpoints. Fly through each checkered flag to collect it.

Title: Tortoise Mastery
Objective: Gather 5 Intact Tortoise Shells.
Text: Granted, tortoises are not big game but they can be mean game. They also work as the perfect bait for bigger game! Gotcher found some ol' tablets sayin' that the Torjari Pit is a sacrificin' site. The old empire used ta' feed unruly sorts to the waters as it were. Well ah mean to see me what's down in that water. Gather up some fresh tortoise shells and meet me at the pit. Let's see if ol' legends be true.

Title: Riding the Skies
Objective: Join the Order of the Cloud Serpent.
Text: I can no longer call myself your teacher. You have proven yourself worthy of your cloud serpent. Today, you shall join our ranks. Are you ready?

Title: Labor for Labor
Objective: Gather 8 pieces of Fire Wood.
Text: My wife, Leza, is going into labor but she is very very sick. I need to keep her warm but we've exhausted our supply of dry firewood. Could you grab some twigs and branches from the nearby trees for me? Time is of the essence!

Title: Parental Mastery
Objective: Destroy Torjar's Bane.
Text: If them tablets were correct, all ay got ta do is a small dance ritual and the big thing o' the deep will be summoned. When it comes out, we'll get 'em and show me pop we are both true big game hunters like him.

Title: Poisoned!
Objective: Gather 5 Mogu Poisoned Blades.
Text: The... mogu. Do not trust. Poison. Get sample... sample blades. Bring to Dezco... in Thunder Cleft, west of here.

Title: Mushan Mastery: Darkhide
Objective: Obtain Darkhide's Head.
Text: My boy here is a talented hunter... in training. Let's show him an old 'Nessy style hunt shall we? I saw a mighty big mushan east of here with a hide dark as night. It looked like it had taken down a number of hunters in its day. If you want a big game hunt, go try an' take it on.

Title: Mushan Mastery
Objective: Kill 15 Dustback Mushans.
Text: Mushan! Would ya look at the size o' 'em. Old as the dirt they walk on probably. A fine trophy. If you are lookin' to test your mettle as a big game hunter, start with them.

Title: Stalker Mastery
Objective: Kill 15 Gorge Stalkers.
Text: Tigers! No matter what land I go to I hear about these big fanged beasts. And yet I haven't had a chance to hunt any of them. Let's go hunt some tigers. I'll go east, you go west. I think I saw some near Dustback Gorge. I'm sure there are tons near those mushan.

Title: Into the Wilds
Objective: Locate the missing Zhu's Watch Courier in the southern area of the Dojani River, then continue on to the Temple of the Red Crane and speak with Koro Mistwalker.
Text: Deep in the wilds, on the southern coast where the Krasarang River meets the sea, rests the Temple of the Red Crane, home of the great Chi-Ji and his most devout followers. They should be told of what happened here. If you're headed that way, I have a favor to ask; We often send supplies to the temple, but our last courier has not returned. Please look for signs of him as you travel - where the road forks at the Dojani River, he'd have gone south. When you reach the temple, find Koro Mistwalker.

Title: Fox Mastery
Objective: Kill 15 Sly Foxes.
Text: So, when I was scouting east of here I saw a collection of foxes. That's what I first learned to hunt when back on the Wandering Isle. If you want to see the challenge a young pandaren hunter faced when growing up, head east and face off against a bunch of foxes. They tend to be clever and cunning so be on your guard.

Title: Thieving Raiders
Objective: Recover 5 pieces of Pillaged Jinyu Loot.
Text: Saurok! These vile creatures are obsessed with killing and stealing. They attacked our settlement without provocation or warning. Please, can you aid us? Help us recover our lost possessions from these Riverblade raiders that march along the river and we will gladly reward you.

Title: The Mantid
Objective: Kill 10 Ik'thik Precursors.
Text: The mantid! They came out of nowhere and smashed our convoy to ruin, scattering our people this way and that. Now they are preparing to hit Stoneplow. Please, destroy some of these beasts before they get sufficient numbers to flank our home. If my cousin, Ambassador Len, is still alive and at our convoy he should be able to reward you for your help.

Title: Cutting off the Heads
Objective: Slay the risen squad leaders in Bradensbrook.
Text: Erdris Thorn was a key commander of Ravencrest's forces. To hear him confusing us for the Legion fills me with a great sadness. He will be a difficult foe to defeat.We must stop his squad leaders from forming up for a focused assault on Bradensbrook. Defeating them should delay his forces long enough for us to find and deal with him. Let us begin our grim task.

Title: Raid Leader Slovan
Objective: Kill Slovan.
Text: The raiders are led by a particularly violent saurok known as Slovan. The Crane Temple usually comes to our aid when he attacks but now we find ourselves outmatched and outmaneuvered. Please, aid us by destroying this raid leader. You can find him in his den behind the Krasari Falls.

Title: For Family
Objective: Search for Kor Bloodtusk.
Text: Kor should have caught up by now. He said he was going to secure the Ruins of Korja east of here and meet us to help with the mantid threat. He may need help against Groundbreaker Brojai. Could you assist him? Kang and I will follow shortly.

Title: Barreling Along
Objective: Lead Mudmug back to Halfhill.
Text: No, no, no, don't you worry about pickin' 'em up. I can hold these here barrels. I may not be the handsomest pandaren, or the smartest, or any fun to be around in the slightest, but I'm stronger than a mushan beast. I'mma just need you to lead the way.

Title: Dread Infiltrators
Objective: Speak with Lilian Voss in the Hall of Shadows.
Text: Shadowblade, we have received a raven with most troubling news.One of our own, an ally that walked our very Hall of Shadows, is not who they seem.I believe Lilian has already begun dissecting their corpse. You'd best hurry.

Title: Leather to Legendary
Objective: Obtain 50 Leystone Ore and 1 Saber's Eye.
Text: Lately I've been working with the ore of this land, leystone it's called. I've found its qualities to hold remarkable strength and durability. We'll need a lot of it for this. There is felslate, but that's a probably too tainted for what you're looking to do with this barding. You know, I also like to adorn my pieces with something sparkly, like a jewel. I hear saber's eyes are especially sparkly. Why don't you grab one of those for this as well.

Title: Aid on the Front Lines
Objective: Give aid to the wounded on the east, west, and south defense lines of Bradensbrook.
Text: When we settled here, that Hold was just a quiet creepy place that we avoided. Then the elves came back from the dead. With your help we thought it was mostly handled. But now it feels like an army is attacking us!We could use more healing at our defense lines. More undead arrive and we have less and less protectors each wave. Any aid to our wounded would be welcomed!

Title: Quieting the Spirits
Objective: Slay risen elves and spirits near Bradensbrook.
Text: An overwhelming attack on Bradensbrook is imminent. Together I believe we can blunt the spear before it is cast.While we are dealing with the commanders, we should put down as many unquiet spirits as we can.With their leaders down and their numbers culled, that should give us time to find Erdris Thorn.

Title: Shadowsong's Return
Objective: Find Jarod Shadowsong outside Bradensbrook in Val'sharah.
Text: Well our lines are doing a lot better, thanks to you. A good thing too, because we need the rest!That being said, we noticed a big group of bigger, meaner risen coming from the farmstead. They would've given us a hard time, but that Shadowsong fellow has returned and killed them all. He's holding off reinforcements coming from the hold.I'm guessing he could use a hand. We can hold here until you and Shadowsong sort this out.

Title: Holy: The Bradensbrook Investigation
Objective: Go to Bradensbrook in Val'sharah.
Text: We have uncovered forged orders from the Shore. They have a fel influence about them. They guide the reader to believe they are legitimate. It orders Black Rook Hold to attack a "demonic enclave" just south of their walls. There's only one enclave they could be talking about, Bradensbrook!Is it possible these would be able to convince the undead to attack Bradensbrook? You should head there immediately and either warn them, or render aid.|cFF660000Specialization: Holy Priest|r

Title: Hiding In Plain Sight
Objective: Assassinate the infiltrating homunculi.
Text: Greetings, Shadowblade.I hope you are not too upset that I began without you, I have a bit of trouble controlling myself around the mindless undead.Yes, you heard me right. Taerir, the very Taerir that has been standing in the Hall of Shadows for many months now, was the undead pawn of a dreadlord.And there are more of them - in our cities, rising through the ranks of the aristocracy, growing in power and influence, and nearly undetectable.

Title: A Few Things First
Objective: Obtain 25 Leystone Ore and a Suramarian Sapphire.
Text: Lately I've been working with the ore of this land, leystone it's called. I've found its qualities to hold remarkable strength and durability. We'll need a lot of it for this. There is felslate, but that's a probably too tainted for what you're looking to do with this barding. You know, I also like to adorn my pieces with something sparkly, like a jewel. I've heard that the elves of Suramar have particularly beautiful ones. Perhaps you could acquire one for this project.

Title: Leather to Legendary
Objective: Have Alard upgrade the barding and return with it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker at your order hall.
Text: Let's begin, shall we? I mean, I'll be doing all the work, but you get to watch!

Title: The Stoneplow Convoy
Objective: Use Imperial Lotus Poultice on 7 Stoneplow Envoys.
Text: I tried to save as many of the Stoneplow envoys as I could but these "mantid" dragged many of them off into the jungle. These are civilians in need of our help. Please take the herbs you gathered earlier. I've infused them with what gifts of the Light are still granted me. Use them on as many of the Stoneplow envoys as you can.

Title: Restoring the Balance
Objective: Kill 8 Slitherscale Rippers or Slitherscale Eggdrinkers.
Text: The situation at the islands remains dire. The Slitherscale saurok have not responded to our attempts at peace, so only one option remains. In order to protect the wild cloud serpents, we must rid the island of their presence. Only then can the cloud serpents be left to live in peace.

Title: Preservation
Objective: Collect 8 Stolen Eggs.
Text: Oh no! We must stop them! , is it? The Order needs your help! Do you know what those horrible Slitherscale saurok are doing? They have the audacity to steal cloud serpent eggs straight from the matriarch's nests! While the cloud serpents become ever rarer, those brutes are... are...  ...they're eat their eggs for dinner! It's horrible! Go to Windward Isle to the northeast and recover any unbroken eggs that you can. As students of the Order, it's our duty!

Title: For the Tribe
Objective: Rescue 8 Dawnchaser Captives.
Text: We fell back to the refuge when the mogu attacked but lost a number of our people along the way. Travel west and north of here and look for any captives you can rescue that could help us in our fight. Leave any Alliance you find to their fate.

Title: Disarming the Enemy
Objective: Collect 5 Slitherscale Harpoons.
Text: If we are to stop the poachers, we need to take more aggressive action. If we can remove the enemies' primary tools for killing and capturing serpents, we may be able to stop their operation altogether. I need you to go into their territory on the eastern end of Windward Isle and steal their weapons. A cat without claws cannot strike.

Title: Feeding Time
Objective: Collect 3 Saltback Meat and feed them to your hatchling companion.
Text: Ouch! It seems, without a doubt, that the little beast is hungry. You recall that some meaty-looking turtles can be found on the wild cloud serpent island to the northeast. Perhaps some turtle meat will fill the hatchling's voracious appetite.

Title: Emptier Nests
Objective: Leash and return 6 Windward Hatchlings to their nests.
Text: Oh, thank goodness, another cloud serpent trainer! I just received word that the wild hatchlings at Windward Isle to the northeast are in serious trouble! While the adults fight those terrible saurok, who is watching the cute little babies? No one, that's who! WE HAVE TO SAVE THEM! I'm sending every trainer I can find to go and help. If you aren't too busy, can you make sure the hatchlings are safely delivered back to their mothers' nests?

Title: The Easiest Way To A Serpent's Heart
Objective: Collect 5 Tiger Flanks.
Text: Uh-oh, looks like someone is in a bad mood today! Luckily, you know just the thing that will cheer up the little beast. Cloud serpents love the taste of tiger meat, but the tender flanks can be... challenging... to acquire. Luckily, you recall there are some fat, juicy tigers to the northwest, on Windward Isle. Sure, you might suffer some scratches and a little mauling, but it's all worth it for your serpent, right?

Title: Full Speed Ahead
Objective: Follow Instructor Windblade.
Text: It is time for our training session. Follow me around the spires. Let's see if you can keep up while staying mounted.

Title: Just a Flesh Wound
Objective: Use Windwool Bandages or Heavy Windwool Bandages to heal 8 Injured Hatchlings at Windward Isle. These can be made by Tailors or bought on the Auction House.
Text: Many of the baby hatchlings at Windward Isle have been injured as a result of all the fighting. I have been told that you may be able to help them, with your access to powerful bandages. Please go northeast and use some of the best bandages you can acquire to save the injured hatchlings.

Title: The Sky Race
Objective: Complete the Sky Race by flying through 10 checkpoints, then passing underneath the Finish Line at The Arboretum.
Text: The time for the great race is upon us! Traverse the course among the spires and pass through the checkered flags on each of the 10 balloon checkpoints. Make sure to pass underneath the finish line when you are done. The competition will be fierce, but I wish you luck. Speak to me when you are ready to begin.

Title: Sweet as Honey
Objective: Collect 30 Honeycomb from Angry Honeykeepers in The Arboretum.
Text: From the cloud serpent's behavior, you have a hunch that it wants a sweet treat. The fragrant trees in The Arboretum are home to many honey hives. It will be a simple matter to collect combs from the nearby honeykeepers.

Title: A Feast for the Senses
Objective: Collect 5 Fish Cakes.
Text: I have heard that you know a thing or two about cooking. As it so happens, serpents love to eat Fish Cakes. If you use your culinary skills and bring me 5 of these dishes, the cloud serpents around here will be very happy.

Title: Catch!
Objective: Use the Bouncy Ball. Then, catch and return the ball to your hatchling 8 times.
Text: You have a feeling the serpent is tired of being cooped up all day. How about playing a little game of catch?

Title: Fragments of the Past
Objective: Visit archaeology dig sites around Pandaria and use your survey ability to retrieve 6 Serpentrider Relics.
Text: The Order of the Cloud Serpent's history stretches back thousands of years, and although we have tried to preserve the old ways, there are ancient techniques that have been lost over time. You can help us recover some of this knowledge by searching Pandaria's dig sites for clues to our past. Use your archaeology skill to survey around Pandaria and bring me whatever you find.

Title: The Hammer of Dalaran
Objective: Speak with Alard Schmied in Dalaran.
Text: Should we wish to make this barding worthy of the steed who will bear it, we'll need to upgrade it. Right now it's just good for not getting you kicked off your mount. Speak with Alard Schmied in Dalaran. He's a fine smith and will know how to modify this barding into something more befitting our needs.

Title: Snack Time
Objective: Fish 10 Sugar Minnow from any fresh or salt water in Pandaria.
Text: Cloud serpents love to eat, and one of their favorite treats is the sugar minnow. These fish can be found in salt or fresh water anywhere in Pandaria. I trust you have some skill in fishing, and your own fishing pole to catch them? Bring me a fresh catch and I'm sure the hungry beasts around here will be very grateful.

Title: Worthy of the Title
Objective: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in your order hall.
Text: Highlord, Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker wishes to speak with you about an important matter. Please seek him out at Light's Hope Chapel in your order hall at your earliest convenience.

Title: Preparations Underway
Objective: Obtain a Stonehide Leather Barding from a leatherworker. You may also obtain it from the auction house if you're not a leatherworker or don't know a leatherworker.
Text: As you may or may not recall, I once helped young paladins obtain their first armored mount. It was a tedious task that involved months of obtaining materials and sending them all over Azeroth. Thankfully, times have changed and we now have most of those materials at hand. That being said, I wish to help you obtain a new mount, something worthy of your title as Highlord. In order for us to begin, I only require that you obtain a barding for us. Something strong, thick, and heavy.

Title: Flight Training: Full Speed Ahead
Objective: Follow Instructor Windblade.
Text: The next task will be a little harder. Are you ready?

Title: Salvation
Objective: Use the Manaroot Salve on fel-infected animals.
Text: The valley is swarming with fel-corrupted creatures who are beyond saving, yet there still may be some that could use our help.Take this manaroot salve and apply it to any animals you see. If the fel magic hasn't taken hold, the salve might be able to mend their wounds.

Title: A Tadpole's Request
Objective: Obtain 10 Winterfin Clams.
Text: Glrrrr! Mrr, mrr, glrrgli!

Title: The Ways of the World
Objective: Slay Mrrga.
Text: Mrrga!  Mrrga... Mrrga...

Title: Adopt a Tadpole
Objective: Select your favorite Winterfin tadpole and beckon it to follow you.
Text: One day every year, usually in mid-spring, the Winterfin tadpoles are given free reign of the village. I'm not sure why this tradition persists, as it usually results in heavy damage to the their buildings and food stores. I usually try not to interfere too much with the goings-on of the tribe, but today, I take exception. Go out and see if you can keep an eye on one of the tadpoles.

Title: An Impossible Foe
Objective: Speak with War Councilor Victoria to be teleported to the Imp Mother's Den and defeat Agatha.
Text: ! We have just received word from the Council of Six. They have found Agatha!Modera asked that she be able to brief you through this image crystal.Good luck!

Title: They Grow Like Weeds
Objective: Speak to Instructor Windblade at The Arboretum.
Text: Ahh, it is you again. Instructor Windblade is looking for you. You can find her on the ridge to the east. She has some news about your cloud serpent.

Title: The Rider's Journey
Objective: Return to Instructor Skythorn at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.
Text: Excellent, just excellent! I will return the other eggs to their nests, undisturbed. In the meantime, deliver your egg to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum.

Title: It's A...
Objective: Watch your egg hatch.
Text: Oh my! This egg is going to hatch at any second! Well, looks like this little guy is eager to meet you. Are you ready?

Title: End of the Risen Threat
Objective: Defeat Lord Erdris Thorn. Speak with War Councilor Victoria to be teleported to Jarod Shadowsong's location.
Text: Commander Shadowsong sends word that he is prepared to face the late Lord Erdris. I have a letter from him for you. I'm prepared to teleport you to his location, but there's a snag. In order to combat the worst of the fel corruption, you will need to use some Nethershards on the way in. Make sure you have some before speaking with me.

Title: The Rider's Journey
Objective: Return to Instructor Skythorn at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.
Text: Excellent, just excellent! I will return the other eggs to their nests, undisturbed. In the meantime, deliver your egg to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum.

Title: Choosing the One
Objective: Speak to Instructor Tong at Windward Isle in the Jade Forest.
Text: I have examined each egg. Out of the lot that you brought me, I have chosen the three eggs with the most promise. You may choose only one egg to take with you. Are you ready to make your final selection?

Title: Egg Collection
Objective: Collect 6 Serpent Eggs.
Text: Ahhh, I should have known! You have the look of a hungry initiate. I would gladly help you choose a serpent egg, but the Slitherscale have thoroughly raided the cloud serpent nests. I'm terribly sorry. I don't know what to tell you. Unless you're crazy enough to sneak into the saurok camp to the east and retrieve some stolen cloud serpent eggs, I'm afraid I can't help you.

Title: The Rider's Journey
Objective: Return to Instructor Skythorn at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.
Text: Excellent, just excellent! I will return the other eggs to their nests, undisturbed. In the meantime, deliver your egg to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum.

Title: Empty Nests
Objective: Leash and return 6 Windward Hatchlings to their nests.
Text: When the attacks began, the young hatchlings scattered in terror. They are roaming around the island, lost and scared. If you want to help, take this rope and leash the lost little ones. Take them back to their nests. Return them home.

Title: Beating the Odds
Objective: Kill 8 Slitherscale Rippers or Slitherscale Eggdrinkers.
Text: At first, the Slitherscale were too frightened to approach the wild serpents. Then, I caught them snatching the eggs under the cover of night. Now, they are slaughtering adults and hatchlings alike! If we do not do something, these gentle creatures will be completely wiped out. Then there won't even be an Order of the Cloud Serpent to join! Go and slay these vile Slitherscales, and then we will talk.

Title: Wild Things
Objective: Find Instructor Tong at Windward Isle in the Jade Forest.
Text: Welcome to the Order of the Cloud Serpent. I can see from the spark in your eye that you wish to join the Order. Let me get a good look at you.  Hmm. I see honesty and earnestness in your heart. You have journeyed far to come here, but I am afraid you must go yet further. Your path into the Order begins now. Speak to Instructor Tong at Windward Isle to the northeast to take the first step.

Title: Going West
Objective: Find the Sunwalker Scout near the Crane Temple.
Text: Leza now walks with the ancestors of this strange land. I must look now to the living. Kor has led a group of our scouts west deeper into the jungle. I sent a scout of my own to investigate the crane temple. Please, seek out my scout, get their report, then meet up with Kor and lend what aid you can to him. We will join you as quickly as we are able.

Title: Herbal Remedies
Objective: Find 20 Imperial Lotus Leaves.
Text: Kang's remedy isn't working. There is something else at work here. A power deep beneath the soil. It is sapping us of hope, hitting us with depression and despair. Kang tells me this land has lotus plants. I might be able to make a tea that would hopefully lend Leza some strength. Please, search the ruins south and west of here for lotus leaves. I will pay you for your efforts.

Title: Into the Wilds
Objective: Locate the missing Zhu's Watch Courier in the northern area of the Dojani River, then continue on to the Temple of the Red Crane and speak with Koro Mistwalker.
Text: Deep in the wilds, on the southern coast where the Krasarang River meets the sea, rests the Temple of the Red Crane, home of the great Chi-Ji and his most devout followers. They should be told of what happened here. If you're headed that way, I have a favor to ask; We often send supplies to the temple, but our last courier has not returned. Please look for signs of him as you travel - where the road forks at the Dojani River, he'd have gone north. When you reach the temple, find Koro Mistwalker.

Title: The Mogu Agenda
Objective: Recover the Dojani Orders.
Text: Mogu don't often gather in numbers like this. We should find out what they are up to. I thought I heard someone shouting orders near the center of the ruins. We should probably see if he has information.

Title: Threat from Dojan
Objective: Kill 6 Dojani Reclaimers and 8 Dojani Surveyors, and 4 Dojani Enforcers.
Text: Mogu? They seem like the elves, ancient and an over developed sense of entitlement. Everyone of Azeroth must learn, sooner or later, that the Horde is not "visiting" this world. We are here. We are staying. Teach them this lesson. Quell their numbers in the ruins south and west of here. Break their amassing forces before they decide to attack. Learn what you can of how these creatures fight, and how they die.

Title: Life
Objective: Speak with Sunwalker Dezco, and wait for the newborn.
Text: My child is coming. I must help as I may. Stay nearby, hero. If my wife and child survive, I would have them look on the face of the one who saved them.

Title: Silver Filigree Flask
Objective: Fill the vial with a potent alchemical mixture.
Text: You have found a beautiful silver flask decorated with ornate filigree. With the right materials and your skill in alchemy, it could become quite magical.

Title: Blind Them!
Objective: Kill the Darnassian Outrider.
Text: These sunwalkers are a tiresome lot. I need soldiers with horde blood in their veins and honor in their hearts. Not some pacifist sun spirit filth. The Alliance are here. Followed us no doubt, or somehow tracked the same visions Leza had that led us here. It doesn't matter. I don't want them to know how divided we are at the moment. Go kill their scout south of here before it can report back. Hellscream's eyes upon you.

Title: The Pools of Youth
Objective: Recover water from the Pools of Youth.
Text: The mogu found the Pools of Youth! Mama Bramblestaff used to tell me old stories about those. During the mogu empire they would use the waters to extend life. Thing is those stories never ended well for some reason. As if the waters were cursed. Either way, we should investigate. There is a good chance those waters might help Leza. It looks like the Pools of Youth are on the northwestern side of the ruins.

Title: Crane Mastery
Objective: Kill 8 Carp Hunters.
Text: Thing about hunting birds is you need ammo - and I ain't got any. Thing about hunting with Nesingwary is you need to prove you can keep your tally and bragging rights up. Can't hunt, can't brag. And I like bragging so this is no good. Can I hire you to go kill me some carp hunters? You'll find them up and down the river west of here.

Title: Skitterer Stew
Objective: Gather 5 Intact Skitterer Glands.
Text: Leza has a fever. No mother in labor should have a fever. Mama Bramblestaff once told me that Skitterer Stew could heal almost any illness. Let us put this knowledge to the test. Gather some intact skitterer glands for me while I get the herbs we'll need and I'll whip up a batch.

Title: Search Party
Objective: Search the Krasari Ruins for Chezin Dawnchaser.
Text: I sent a diplomat to look for allies in the ruins east of here. My diplomat has not returned and now Kang tells me this jungle is filled with a sinister people known as the mogu. Chezin is my friend and Leza's brother. To lose a brother would cause her to give in to despair. She already has enough to worry about with her fever. Could you investigate the ruins east of here and find out what happened?

Title: Profit Mastery
Objective: Obtain 12 Vials of Tiger Blood.
Text: Two words: Tiger Blood! This is gonna sell better than saronite back on the black market. Especially once I finish spreading a rumor about how it makes you all buff and stuff. Thing is, I ran out of ammo. Can you round up a few vials of tiger blood for me? I'll cut you in on the scam.

Title: Well of Eternity RP Tracker
Objective: Recover the Branch of Nordrassil from the Firelands.
Text: I am duty-bound to look into your claims immediately, which means my mission here now must fall to you. A surge of ancient magic, far too strong to have occurred naturally, drew me here. I have since discovered a most troubling development. A bough from Nordrassil has been ripped from the tree and taken deep into the Firelands. There, a powerful ritual threatens to corrupt Nordrassil, consuming it in flame. You must find a way to interrupt the ritual and reclaim the world tree's branch.

Title: Stoneplow Thirsts
Objective: Deliver a cask of The Emperor to Loon Mai at Stoneplow in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: Excuse me... ? Did I hear your name correctly? I've come from Stoneplow, in the west. They sent me to pick up some emergency beer rations, but the Stormstout Brewery is all boarded up! It looks like your handsome friend there - no, not Mudmug, the other one - has a few casks with him. Could you spare a keg for a town in need?

Title: Sharpening Your Fangs
Objective: Collect 60 Elementium Gem Clusters from creatures in the Dragon Soul Raid encounter.
Text: Do you understand why I have you assassinate the dragons, yet spare the mortals? It isn't their fault. They must seek out their own destiny, free from the meddling of my kind. We are nearing the end of our mission, and it is time for you to seek out your own destiny as well. I can continue to augment your weapons, but collecting shadowy gems won't be enough. My work will require entire clusters. Gather them from my father's minions...

Title: Victory in the Depths
Objective: Take the Vial of Preserved Dragonsblood, along with your daggers Fear and Vengeance, to Wrathion at Ravenholdt Manor in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Text: Done! You'll want to get this back to Wrathion as soon as possible, along with those two daggers of yours. I don't know what he plans to do with this stuff. Between you and me, sometimes that little dragon kid creeps me out. Good luck!

Title: A Score to Settle
Objective: Dark Ranger Marrah wants you to slay Prince Keleseth inside Utgarde Keep.
Text: Utgarde's forces are organizing under the advisory of Prince Keleseth, a san'layn ambassador of the Scourge. We cannot allow the vrykul to benefit from his counsel any further. Silence him.

Title: Cleansing Drak'Tharon
Objective: Drakuru wants you to use Drakuru's Elixir at his brazier inside Drak'Tharon. Using Drakuru's Elixir there will require 5 Enduring Mojo.
Text: 'Ey, mon, you be here! Dis is good, mon! Drak'Tharon soon be cleansed of them foul undead and restored to her noble purpose. In return for your help, the keep's most valuable treasures be yours, mon! Once ya be reachin' its top, ya must summon me, and I'll perform the ritual. Alas, my summonin' will be comin' at a cost. Ya must collect mojo from the survivors.

Title: Patricide
Objective: Destroy Deathwing and retrieve a Fragment of Deathwing's Jaw.
Text: Your next target has claimed the lives of all of my other assassins. I need you to kill my father himself. You must destroy Deathwing. We are out of time. His madness has already corrupted all the others of my kind, and his darkness will consume the world if he is not stopped. If you by some miracle succeed, and can retrieve for me a piece of him - perhaps a fragment of the armor he uses to disguise his true chaotic nature - the reward I give you will be without equal.

Title: Investigate the Broken Shore
Objective: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Menace on the Broken Shore".
Text: All of us know the price we paid the last time we set foot upon the Broken Shore.  I recommend dispatching a scouting team to investigate the Legion's strength. We need to know what we're facing in that accursed place.

Title: An Urgent Warning
Objective: Speak to Moira Thaurissan.
Text: Been held prisoner... since the assault on... the Broken Shore...The demons... th-they are gathering... preparing...Had to escape... to warn you. They must... be stopped!

Title: An Urgent Warning
Objective: Speak to Skylord Omnuron
Text: Been held prisoner... since the assault on... the Broken Shore...The demons... th-they are gathering... preparing...Had to escape... to warn you. They must... be stopped!
