Objective: Collect 6 Zen Lotus.
Text: Your friend Taylor is in critical shape. Unfortunately, his wounds are tainted by hozen poison, which is very difficult to cure. Luckily, through many generations of fighting the hozen, my people have developed medicines to treat such injuries. The flowers growing on the surface of Glass Lake are needed to make the antidote. , go quickly and bring back some blooms. Your Admiral's life depends on it.

Title: Borrowed Brew
Objective: Taste the mouthwatering brew.
Text: A delicious smell wafts out from the bottle on the table. A little taste couldn't hurt, right?

Title: The Pearlfin Situation
Objective: Speak to Elder Lusshan, Pearlkeeper Fujin, Instructor Sharpfin, and Ot-Temmdo at Pearlfin Village.
Text: I've been thinking. We are cut off from support and a long way from home. Although these Pearlfin jinyu mistrust our presence, they do not appear to be hostile. If we could convince them that we are their friends, an alliance between our races could prove extremely valuable. , you must go speak to the jinyu around the village. Convince their leaders that we are not to be feared, and that we only wish for peace.

Title: The Elder's Instruments
Objective: Collect the Waterspeaker's Staff, Ceremonial Robe, Jade Crown, and Rosewood Beads from Slingtail Stickypaws.
Text: Oh dear, oh dear... The Elder mustn't find out! I must have left the Elder's ceremonial instruments behind during the escape. But... Moonwater Retreat is crawling with hozen by now! What sort of Pearlkeeper am I, to have lost them so carelessly?  Stranger, could you find it in your heart to help me?

Title: The Perfect Color
Objective: Gather 8 Freshly Fallen Petals.
Text: As you have seen, this grove is abundant with beautiful pink petals. As each petal ages, the tone deepens and fades. If you would be so kind, I am in need of a few petals that have freshly fallen. Only the ones that have just fallen will have precisely the right color I am after. From it I can forge an ink that will be breathtaking. Can you help me?

Title: Road Rations
Objective: Collect 6 Tortoise Flanks.
Text: We do not have time to wait around for the Admiral to recover. Sully and I are planning to search for Anduin to the north, but we'll need supplies for our journey. The lake here is teeming with wildlife, which we have received permission to hunt. Go and gather some supplies while Sully and I finalize our preparations.

Title: Catch and Release!
Objective: Use Hozen Traps in Camp Nooka-Nooka, then break them to free 5 trapped Hozen.
Text: As you place one fish in each jar, your optimism grows. This just might work! Ideally, rescuing the Hozen from your makeshift trap will soften their stance towards you. Time to set some bait.

Title: Tracking Event: Spies Leave
Objective: See the scouts off, then speak to Big Lu.
Text: It's time for Sully and I to leave. We'll keep our eyes out for any sign of the White Pawn and report back shortly. I'm afraid I must leave you in charge while Admiral Taylor is recovering. Learn as much as you can from these jinyu while we are away. I expect a full report when we return.

Title: Swallowed Whole
Objective: Free 5 hozen from the Engorged Crocolisks, and gather 5 Speckled Trout from Lake Kittitata.
Text: Now, back to your dilemma. I believe you can help your people build relations with our hozen, as my people have. The trail behind me will lead you to a body of water the hozen use to gather the fish that feeds them. Around this time every year, fearsome beasts call those waters home and many hungry hozen are lost to them. If you were to rescue some of the victims and gather some fish, perhaps you will be regarded more favorably.

Title: Kang Bramblestaff
Objective: Find Kang Bramblestaff.
Text: Kang's pride regularly becomes overconfidence, which often leads him down dangerous paths. His current path is as dangerous as any - he is headed deep into the Krasarang Wilds. I wouldn't normally ask a favor of a stranger, but... would you make sure that he is well? It would give me relief to know that a brave  was looking out for him.

Title: Quill of Stingers
Objective: Gather 6 Wasp Stingers from Orchard Wasps.
Text: To achieve perfect paint strokes, one must have the right tools. My own have fallen into disrepair, their bristles becoming as unmanageable as hozu hair. Have you seen the wasps throughout the Arboretum? Their stingers can be fashioned into quills that provide just the right level of sharpness in each line. Could you gather some for me please?

Title: Building a Better Hozen Trap
Objective: Collect 8 Slickies and 8 Intact Pottery Jars from Lake Kittitata.
Text: One thing is now painfully clear. The Hozen love their 'slickies'. While deep in your meditative trance, scattered images and impressions came to your mind. Now fully awake, you struggle to make sense of the experience. The beginnings of an absurd plan begin to take shape in your head. It might just be crazy enough to work...

Title: A Poor Grasp of the Basics
Objective: Unearth 7 pieces of farm equipment.
Text: Virmen - they no just eat our food. They trying to start farms of their own. The problem is... well, they ookin' dumb. You no believe Muno? Last night, they break into tool sheds... steal equipment. When we wake up, we find rakes and wheelbarrows planted in ground. They was WATERING them. They was trying to GROW WHEELBARROWS. Please, while you out there, unbury our stuff.

Title: Avocation of Antonidas
Objective: Recover the three discs of Antonidas' unfinished project and return them to Kalec in your order hall. Speak to Archmage John Nicholas in Northrend, at the Purple Parlor about the Tri-Disc of the Arcane. Speak with Khadgar about the Tri-Disc of Fire. And speak with Archmage Cedric near the Dalaran Crater about the Tri-Disc of Frost.
Text: Archmage, I've found something you may be interested in. An old journal of the late Archmage, Antonidas. In it, he speaks of a project he was working on that I think we may be able to finish. It was a sort of flying disc that could attune itself to the rider's magical attunement. But I need your help tracking down the pieces. From what I could gather, he gave them to trusted friends and allies through the years. Perhaps you could persuade them to give us the pieces.

Title: Avocation of Antonidas
Objective: Recover the three discs of Antonidas' unfinished project and return them to Kalec in your order hall. Speak to Archmage John Nicholas in Northrend, at the Purple Parlor about the Tri-Disc of the Arcane. Speak with Khadgar about the Tri-Disc of Fire. And speak with Archmage Cedric near the Dalaran Crater about the Tri-Disc of Frost.
Text: Archmage, I've found something you may be interested in. An old journal of the late Archmage, Antonidas. In it, he speaks of a project he was working on that I think we may be able to finish. It was a sort of flying disc that could attune itself to the rider's magical attunement. But I need your help tracking down the pieces. From what I could gather, he gave them to trusted friends and allies through the years. Perhaps you could persuade them to give us the pieces.

Title: Destroying the Nest
Objective: Enter the Feltotem Caverns and ruin Tugar's plot.
Text: We have to put an end to Tugar's plot. These abominations must be destroyed, as well as their source! I think I know where. A group of neutral drogbar had a settlement nearby, but were pushed out by concerted demon and fel tauren attacks. That must be the place. Go there and stop their fel monster production at its source!

Title: Avocation of Antonidas
Objective: Recover the three discs of Antonidas' unfinished project and return them to Kalec in your order hall. Speak to Archmage John Nicholas in Northrend, at the Purple Parlor about the Tri-Disc of the Arcane. Speak with Khadgar about the Tri-Disc of Fire. And speak with Archmage Cedric near the Dalaran Crater about the Tri-Disc of Frost.
Text: Archmage, I've found something you may be interested in. An old journal of the late Archmage, Antonidas. In it, he speaks of a project he was working on that I think we may be able to finish. It was a sort of flying disc that could attune itself to the rider's magical attunement. But I need your help tracking down the pieces. From what I could gather, he gave them to trusted friends and allies through the years. Perhaps you could persuade them to give us the pieces.

Title: War'zuul the Provoker
Objective: Kill War'zuul the Provoker.
Text: There'ss some obnoxious demon lord up there who's been yelling for hourss.Would you please shut him up already? I'm getting a terrible headache!

Title: A Shrouded Path Through Time
Objective: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
Text: The shrouded star flickers upon the land with its intermittent light ushering in an eerie mist upon the land. This star and the mists bring deep shadows to the land hiding its secrets and dangers. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

Title: Informing the Council
Objective: Return to Shinfel Blightsworn in Dreadscar Rift.
Text: I'll deal with this prisoner, but you should head back to Dreadscar Rift.Let the others know what we've discovered. We will need their help dealing with Kanrethad on the Broken Shore.

Title: Call of the Scarab
Objective: Report to Field Marshal Snowfall in Silithus.
Text: The Call of the Scarab event is occurring today. Speak with your faction's leader near the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.

Title: Presence of Power
Objective: Repel the Legion threat from the Temple of a Thousand Lights, then Slay Portal-Keeper V'thaal and Zor'thaduun.
Text: The demons appear to be harnessing an ancient power within the Temple itself. They've managed to twist and corrupt these sacred grounds with fel magic. We must remove the demonic presence before we press our final advance.

Title: The Speaker Awaits
Objective: Speak with Betild Deepanvil in Netherlight Temple.
Text: High Priest, we've received word from Netherlight Temple of a most curious visitor: Magni Bronzebeard, the very Speaker himself!What could he want from our order? You'd best head back to Netherlight, we'll hold down the front here.

Title: The Sunken Vault
Objective: Take Brann's vessel in Azsuna to the Sunken Vault.
Text: 'Ello, High Priest. The Speaker has just been telling us of a calling of sorts, coming from deep in the core of Azeroth.The voice is telling 'im there's a lost Titan vault out there, near the Maelstrom. We dun know what's inside, but he's got tha feelin' it's got somethin' ta do with the Light, and you!Brann's got a vessel waitin' for ye, off the coast of Azsuna. Of course, I'll be accompanying ye as well, for cataloguing purposes. Can't go and let a chance like this go to waste!

Title: Call of the Scarab
Objective: Report to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.
Text: The Call of the Scarab event is occurring today. Speak with your faction's leader near the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.

Title: A Time for Everything
Objective: Give the Curative Brew to Iron-Body Ponshu.
Text: Our order is recovering thanks to your quick actions, Grandmaster.There is just one more monk we need to attend to before it is too late!

Title: Stirring in the Shadows
Objective: Meetup with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stratholme. Once inside, locate the remains of Lord Rivendare and his mount and perform the ritual to claim it as your own.
Text: We must now purify the barding by both material and immaterial means. For the material, we need to travel to Stratholme. When it thrived, before the plague, it produced holy water capable of cleansing even the darkest of magics. There still may be caches of it lying untouched there that we can use. Then it's just a matter of imbuing enough holy power into the barding to make sure it overcomes the will of Rivendare's mount, Shadowmane. Travel to the service gate of Stratholme when you're ready.

Title: Conflagration
Objective: Kill Barastagax the Flameripper.
Text: That fiend! Up on the hill, a demon who calls himself "The Flameripper" is using the power of my realm. Your shaman die as he draws power from the Firelands, mixing the fire of our world with the unholy flame of his. He is extremely powerful, Farseer. You must take him down, whatever the cost!

Title: Lin Tenderpaw
Objective: Find Lin Tenderpaw.
Text: Lin is more talented than she thinks she is. Strong of fist but weak of spirit. With more confidence, she could be better than all of us. Perhaps she will find the surety she needs on her trip into the west. She's probably on her way to Stoneplow as we speak. Stop and speak to her, if you find yourself on that side of the Valley.

Title: Ken-Ken
Objective: Find Ken-Ken.
Text: So... Ken-Ken. The hozen. Personally, I'm impressed he's progressed so far in his training. He's got a brain between his ears, which is more than can be said for most of his kind. He said he was headed east, but, seeing as we're already on the far east side of the valley, I can't imagine he went too far from here. Look for him at Zhu's Watch, in Krasarang Wilds, down the path to the south. See what he's found.

Title: Clever Ashyo
Objective: Find Clever Ashyo.
Text: I'm not sure where Clever Ashyo got his "Clever" title from. All jinyu are clever, and I wouldn't say that he's any more clever than most of them. Quite the opposite, actually. At least he's a capable fighter. He did well enough at Tian Monastery to be selected for our training mission. If you want to help him look for the Hidden Master, you can find him along the Valley's northern border.

Title: Shadow Hunter Urko'jin
Objective: Retrieve the Totem of Seafaring from Darkspear Hold in the Echo Isles and bring it to Shadow Hunter Urko'jin in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
Text: We need to fill the remaining slots in the new blockade fleet before the night elves can reestablish their spy network in the city. The Darkspears have yet to contribute much to the war effort, but if we can convince Shadow Hunter Urko'jin to add his forces to the fleet, that will change. Problem is, Urko'jin won't go to war without the blessing of the spirits. Pay a visit to Darkspear Hold in the Echo Isles, retrieve the totem of seafaring, and deliver it to Urko'jin in the Valley of Spirits.

Title: Working at the Source
Objective: Argent Confessor Paletress wants you to slay Svala Sorrowgrave.
Text: We are hard at work ensuring that we minimize our losses to the Scourge war machine. The vrykul here are undermining that mission by willingly joining the Lich King's ranks. Please, brave champion, you must defeat their spiritual leader, Svala, before she leads her people into the eternal shadow!

Title: One Hand Clapping
Objective: Meditate at the Cairn of Scales.
Text: You have much yet to learn, but your feet are now on the path to enlightenment. Take what I have taught you here and apply it at the lake to the west. With patience and practice, harmony and enlightenment can be attained. Then, wisdom will flow freely into your mind. Also, you will be far enough away that your snoring will not interfere with my own studies. Farewell, stranger.

Title: Captain Cartheron
Objective: Speak with Captain Cartheron at Ratchet in the Northern Barrens and offer him 100 gold as a down payment for his crew's service.
Text: We'll need more ships to round out the blockade fleet, and I know just the blood elf we need. Captain Cartheron is his name and his men are some of the most experienced sailors in the Horde. Problem is, Cartheron and his men will want payment up front for their services. Bring your gold with you to Ratchet in the Northern Barrens and find out how much it'll cost to hire Captain Cartheron's crew and how much bonus pay he's going to demand.

Title: Kang Bramblestaff
Objective: Find Kang Bramblestaff.
Text: Kang's pride regularly becomes overconfidence, which often leads him down dangerous paths. His current path is as dangerous as any - he is headed deep into the Krasarang Wilds. I wouldn't normally ask a favor of a stranger, but... would you make sure that he is well? It would give me relief to know that a brave  was looking out for him.

Title: The Threads that Stick
Objective: Gather 7 Pristine Silk Strands.
Text: Ah, welcome traveler. I have need of your services! Syra Goldendraft was looking for some silk. Personally I hate silk as it always gets stuck in my fur. I really want to impress her though. If you bring me some silk from the Silkwood to the west of here I will gladly pay you for your help.

Title: Whatever it Takes!
Objective: Stormherald Eljrinn in the Halls of Lightning wants you to defeat Loken. You are then to return to Stormherald Eljrinn with Loken's Tongue.
Text: One way or another, Loken shall fall. The honor and glory of his defeat shall be yours. Return to me with his lying tongue, and earn my unending gratitude.

Title: Clearing the Way
Objective: Stormherald Eljrrin in the Halls of Lightning wants you to kill 3 Stormforged Menders, 3 Stormforged Tacticians, and General Bjarngrim.
Text: Loken's forces prepare for war. What they are not ready for is to be attacked themselves. Now is the moment to strike. Take out General Bjarngrim and his army, lest they mount an offensive on all life on Azeroth!

Title: The Silkwood Road
Objective: Defeat 8 Silkwood Stalkers.
Text: West of here is the Silkwood Road. It has fallen into shadow as the spiders there have turned to a more evil and gluttonous path. I would face these villains myself but someone has to defend the noodle shop from... um... dangers and such. Go, hero, and conquer these beasts! Should you succeed perhaps I shall regale you with some of my epic tales of heroism. I'll also pay you.

Title: Spies in Our Midst
Objective: Uncover and eliminate 6 Night Elf Spies by questioning Suspicious Citizens.
Text: This is unacceptable! The warchief needs every ship he can get to secure Kalimdor! How DID the night elves find out about the new fleet in time to destroy it? There's only one way... Orgrimmar is full of the enemy's eyes and ears, and it is our job to root them out. Belloc Brightblade has provided me with a tool that he says can help reveal the spies. Use it, but don't trust it alone. Use your judgment.

Title: Cairn of Bone
Objective: Use the Meditation Candle at the Cairn of Bone.
Text: Your mind felt clear. You thought you were focused. Maybe it was the droning of the nearby insects that put you to sleep. That must've been it! Out of the corner of your eye, you see another of the stone formations just north of here. Perhaps it's quieter at that one...

Title: Wisdom of the Ages
Objective: Speak to Lorewalker Cho at the Cairn of Stone to practice meditation.
Text: You must learn to approach your life's trials with humility and an open mind, stranger. Wisdom cannot fit through the narrow slits of the skeptic's eye. Meet me at the Cairn of Stone and I shall teach you the ancient art of meditation. Once you are at peace, you may find that the answers you seek are not as distant as you might think them to be.

Title: Stormherald Eljrrin
Objective: King Jokkum wants you to enter the Halls of Lightning and speak with Stormherald Eljrrin.
Text: I have sent an emissary to the Halls of Lightning to take the battle to Loken. He undoubtedly needs assistance, given the strength of Loken's armies. Lend him any aid you can so that we may finally stop the traitor.

Title: Diametrically Opposed
Objective: Stormherald Eljrrin in the Halls of Lightning wants you to defeat Volkhan.
Text: I shall speak plainly to you, little . My people have not been the same since our ties with Thorim were severed. Volkhan will not rest until either he, or we, are no more. We only want peace, but it seems we have no choice but war.

Title: Where Are Those Ships?
Objective: Speak to Overseer Moxx at Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale and kill 6 Night Elf Raiders on the ships outside the town.
Text: With most of our fleet leading the attack on Theramore and engaging the enemy elsewhere, we're going to need more ships to complete our blockade of Kalimdor. The warchief ordered the shipwrights at Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale to work overtime to meet the demand, but none of the new craft have arrived yet. Travel there and put the question to their overseer. Tell them the warchief wants his ships!

Title: They Call Him Swifthands
Objective: Speak to Captain "Swifthands" Sutton and persuade him to join you by defeating First Mate Williams.
Text: The third privateer we should hire for the fleet will be "Swifthands" Sutton, a notoriously fierce fighter in close combat. Where Blastbarrel loves his cannons, Captain Sutton prefers to close in for the kill. You'll find Sutton hanging around in Stormwind Harbor, looking for work. Be warned, he'll probably set some sort of task for you before he agrees to join us.

Title: Champion of the King
Objective: King Varian Wrynn has tasked you with the completion of the Trial of the Champion.
Text: With this tournament we grow ever closer to our final confrontation with the Lich King. , you are to represent the Alliance in this grand arena. Prove yourself against Azeroth's finest. Go forward with honor.

Title: Claiming Kalimdor
Objective: Report to General Nazgrim at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
Text: Victory shall soon be ours! Our forces have engaged the enemy all over Kalimdor. Warchief Garrosh Hellscream has commanded all able-bodied s to report for duty in support of our latest offensive. Make your way to Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar and present yourself to General Nazgrim for immediate assignment! For the Horde!

Title: Corrupt Constructs
Objective: Kaldir Ironbane in the Halls of Stone has asked you to kill 3 Dark Rune Giants and Krystallus.
Text: The iron dwarves are busy at work carving out massive stone constructs that I fear will soon be used as powerful weapons. You must defeat their overseer, Krystallus, and the dark rune giants already walking the halls before it is too late!

Title: The Merchants' Plight
Objective: Speak to Angry Merchants around Stormwind Harbor and gather 7 Merchant's Petitions.
Text: If King Wrynn thinks that the attack on the Bravery is an isolated incident, he's mistaken. Look around the harbor and you'll see all the angry merchants who can't get their goods or money to Kalimdor. Perhaps the king will listen to their voices if he won't heed mine alone. Go talk to them. Hear their grievances and gather their petitions before you return to Stormwind Keep.

Title: Captain Rufus Hardwick
Objective: Purchase Diluted Lime Sulfur, Dogwood Extract, and Soothing Shampoo from the Alchemy shop in the Mage Quarter, then speak with Captain Rufus Hardwick.
Text: The Gilnean captain, Rufus Hardwick, would serve our cause well. The usual promises of plunder and booty might sway his crew, but to secure the good captain's help, we'll need to offer our assistance with a more delicate matter. Find an alchemist's shop and purchase a supply of diluted lime sulfur, extract of dogwood, and a soothing shampoo. Bring these items to the captain, but do nothing that will embarrass him. The fleet is depending on you.

Title: Champion of the Tournament
Objective: Highlord Tirion Fordring has tasked you with the completion of the Trial of the Champion.
Text: With this tournament we grow ever closer to our final confrontation with the Lich King. , fight with valor and honor. Every fighter here has gathered for the common good. Together, we will stop Arthas!

Title: Gunner Blastbarrel
Objective: Travel to Ironforge, speak with Ardan Blastbarrel, and then help him gather 6 of his crew members from around Ironforge.
Text: The second ship we'll want is captained by one of the best dwarves ever to to man a cannon, Ardan Blastbarrel. If there's anyone who can blow Horde ships out of the water, it'll be him and his crew. You'll find Blastbarrel in the Military Ward of Ironforge. Speak with him and see if you can convince him to commit his crew to our cause.

Title: The Forlorn Watcher
Objective: Kaldir Ironbane in the Halls of Stone has asked you to put the Maiden of Grief to rest and to obtain a Crystal Tear of Grief.
Text: I would gladly give my life for the Makers or their creations. However, since Loken's betrayal it seems all of Ulduar has turned on the world. One in particular, the Maiden of Grief, seems to reel in agony at her new orders. Please lay her to rest and bring me one of her tears.

Title: Aunty Lin Windfur
Objective: Speak with Lin Windfur in Panda Town.
Text: We will start heading back to town once everyone gets organized. No way is anyone going to mess with me now! I'll boot them in the head! I'm sure I won't be in trouble after this. Thank you so much for your help. Can you tell Aunty Lin back in Panda Town that we are okay and on our way back? She has tons of old cool stuff she might give you as a reward.

Title: For Posterity
Objective: Tol'mar in Gundrak wants you to collect 6 Drakkari History Tablets.
Text: Da land of da ice trolls is a shadow of its former glory. If you be havin' the courage, search for history tablets to see what brought the Drakkari Empire to such an end. Perhaps one day we be givin' dis land back to a new line of frost trolls.

Title: To Catch a Thief
Objective: Infiltrate Ravenholdt Manor and locate the missing black dragon egg.
Text: Just beyond this cave lies Ravenholdt Manor. You need to get inside without being seen!  There - now I'll be able to keep an eye on you and communicate as you venture into the compound. Now sneak into that manor, locate the egg, and don't get caught...

Title: Seeking Answers
Objective: Use the candles to meditate at the Cairn of Blood.
Text: So much to ponder, traveler... You first must learn how to ask before your mind can discern the truth. I have completed my meditations for today, but my candles remain at the Cairn of Blood. Go there. Clear your mind. We will speak again when you are prepared to hear my words.

Title: Lay of the Land
Objective: Explore the region.
Text: Grah!! For every one of these muck-flingers we kill, another two spring from the woods to take its place. I wouldn't share this with the others, but it's clear that we won't last long here. I must stay and defend what remains of our belongings. You scout out the region and seek a solution to our primate problem. Go now. Our hope goes with you...

Title: For Posterity
Objective: Chronicler Bah'Kini in Gundrak wants you to collect 6 Drakkari History Tablets.
Text: Gundrak looks doomed. You know dis to be true. If you be havin' the courage, search for history tablets to see what brought the Drakkari Empire to such an end. Perhaps one day we be bringin' dem back to der former glory.

Title: Diamondine Sigil of Kazum
Objective: Bring the Diamondine Sigil of Kazum to Field Marshal Snowfall in Silithus.
Text: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was carved from stone, then fused into a faultless diamond.

Title: Brothers and Sisters
Objective: Heal 8 Injured Shaman in Garrison of the Fel.
Text: Your people were trying to stop the Legion before you arrived, but flesh is weak and they accumulated too many wounds. Without your aid, they will surely perish at the hands of the demons. Go, help them.

Title: Restoring Equilibrium
Objective: Obtain 3 Stabilizing Crystals.
Text: Kor'vass sent a report on the status of the Fel Hammer. It suffered major damage, and is now even uglier than before if that'ss even possible...It hass also begun listing to one side - rather comically, I might add. For some reason, Kor'vass doesn't find this nearly as entertaining as she should.Anyway, there are stabilizer crystalss around the Tomb of Sargerass she could use for repairss.Say the word and I will direct a squadron of illidari batriderss to accompany you. I'd come too, but...

Title: Elemental Cores
Objective: Collect 3 Fire Power Cores, 3 Water Power Cores, 3 Earth Power Cores, and 3 Air Power Cores.
Text: The eredar here are abusing the power of all of Azeroth's elements, forcing them to their command using their fel magics. They succeed to do this through curiosities the Legion has developed, cores of power that correspond to each element. Do not allow the Legion to continue abusing our world. Kill them and take the sources of their power.

Title: Demonic Disruption
Objective: Speak to Farseer Nobundo to go to the Broken Shore, then meet Therazane at the Garrison of the Fel.
Text: While scouting on the Broken Shore, we have stumbled upon something quite unsettling. The Legion is attempting to harness the powers of Azeroth's elements. What is more, they are succeeding. We must stop them at all costs. I can open a portal for you to meet Therazane at the Garrison of the Fel. She will update you on the situation.

Title: Tidal Sigil of Skwol
Objective: Bring the Tidal Sigil of Skwol to Field Marshal Snowfall in Silithus.
Text: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was crafted from coral and smoothed by the tides.

Title: Salt of Shards
Objective: Bring the Salt of Shards to Field Marshal Snowfall in Silithus.
Text: The Abyssal Lord left behind a small pile of faintly-iridescent sand.

Title: Glimmering Sigil of Whirlaxis
Objective: Bring the Glimmering Sigil of Whirlaxis to Field Marshal Snowfall in Silithus.
Text: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was carved with biting winds.

Title: Coreforged Sigil of Skaldrenox
Objective: Bring the Coreforged Sigil of Skaldrenox to Field Marshal Snowfall in Silithus.
Text: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was forged in flame.

Title: Song of Zephyrs
Objective: Bring the Song of Zephyrs to Field Marshal Snowfall in Silithus.
Text: A swirling essence coalesces at the feet of the Duke.

Title: Pearl of Fathoms
Objective: Bring the Pearl of Fathoms to Field Marshal Snowfall in Silithus.
Text: The pearl is immaculately smooth, and surprisingly dense.

Title: Cinder of Cynders
Objective: Bring the Cinder of Cynders to Field Marshal Snowfall in Silithus.
Text: The cinder seethes with the hatred that its former owner held for you.

Title: Tidal Sigil of Skwol
Objective: Bring the Tidal Sigil of Skwol to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.
Text: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was crafted from coral and smoothed by the tides.

Title: Diamondine Sigil of Kazum
Objective: Bring the Diamondine Sigil of Kazum to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.
Text: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was carved from stone, then fused into a faultless diamond.

Title: Song of Zephyrs
Objective: Bring the Song of Zephyrs to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.
Text: A swirling essence coalesces at the feet of the Duke.

Title: Glimmering Sigil of Whirlaxis
Objective: Bring the Glimmering Sigil of Whirlaxis to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.
Text: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was carved with biting winds.

Title: Pearl of Fathoms
Objective: Bring the Pearl of Fathoms to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.
Text: The pearl is immaculately smooth, and surprisingly dense.

Title: Coreforged Sigil of Skaldrenox
Objective: Bring the Coreforged Sigil of Skaldrenox to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.
Text: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was forged in flame.

Title: Salt of Shards
Objective: Bring the Salt of Shards to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.
Text: The Abyssal Lord left behind a small pile of faintly-iridescent sand.

Title: Cinder of Cynders
Objective: Bring the Cinder of Cynders to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.
Text: The cinder seethes with the hatred that its former owner held for you.

Title: Just Checkin'
Objective: To'kini wants you to speak to Bah'kini in Gundrak.
Text: There have been fearsome sounds echoing from Gundrak. They have been increasing in volume and frequency of late. My long-time student is currently recording events from inside Gundrak. Perhaps you could find the time to check in on her for me?

Title: Gal'darah Must Pay
Objective: Tol'mar wants you to slay Slad'ran, Moorabi, and Gal'darah in Gundrak.
Text: It musta been da most awful thing I ever seen. Da great Akali - slain right before my eyes. Horrible... My job be to observe only. But dis cannot stand! Gal'darah and his followers must pay! Avenge Akali's death, mon. It be da right thing ta do.

Title: Unfinished Business
Objective: Har'koa wants you to speak with Tol'mar in Gundrak.
Text: While it is true that the Prophet of Akali will trouble this world no more, there yet remains work to be done. The greater part of Akali's blood has empowered another, and it is in him that the true danger lies. Quickly, make your way to Gundrak and speak with Tol'mar. He will be able to direct you further in this cause.

Title: Gal'darah Must Pay
Objective: Chronicler Bah'Kini wants you to slay Slad'ran, Moorabi, and Gal'darah in Gundrak.
Text: Da mighty Akali has been slain. My role in life be to record, not fight. But dis cannot stand! Gal'darah and his followers must pay! Avenge Akali's death, mon. It be da right thing ta do.

Title: Gathering Evidence
Objective: Visit Stormwind Harbor and speak with Sentinel Eloria, Lumian Starwhisper, Nayeth Frostmoon, and Finelar Mistwalker.
Text: A ship called the Bravery routinely ferries passengers and cargo from Stormwind port to Rut'theran Village, right outside Darnassus. Well, the ship has just returned with distressing news. Both passengers and crew say that Horde vessels stopped and boarded the Bravery in the waters off Teldrassil, mistreated those on board, and stole some of the cargo before turning the ship around. We have to find out what happened. Would you go to Stormwind Harbor and listen to the stories of the passengers?

Title: Containment
Objective: Lieutenant Sinclari in the Violet Hold wants you to put an end to the blue dragon invasion force. You are to speak to her again once Cyanigosa is slain.
Text: My forces are in absolute shambles, and Malygos' assailants just keep coming. I fear that the worst has yet to come. You must engage them until their leader, Cyanigosa, comes. Only her death will stop the invasion and save Dalaran. Speak to me again when you are ready.

Title: Pupil No More
Objective: Seer Ixit in Ahn'Kahet has tasked you with the assassination of Elder Nadox.
Text: I once called Elder Nadox my teacher. That changed forever when I was forced to watch him mercilessly slaughter my friends and family as a servant of the damned. Find him within the depths and make him pay for his crimes.

Title: Terror on the High Seas
Objective: Speak to Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth in the throne room of Stormwind Keep.
Text: Word has reached Stormwind of terrible crimes committed against ships carrying Alliance citizens. The Horde stands accused of stopping Alliance ships, boarding them, mistreating passengers, and stealing cargo. Heroes of the Alliance, your help is needed to determine the truth of these allegations! Seek out Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth at Stormwind Keep if you would answer the call.

Title: Discretion is Key
Objective: Rhonin wants you to go to the Violet Hold in Dalaran and speak with Lieutenant Sinclari.
Text: Listen to me. It's just been brought to my attention that there's been an incident at the Violet Hold. It would appear that the blues are launching a full scale invasion of Dalaran! I need you to get to the prison and speak with Lieutenant Sinclari at once. She'll give you the details. That is not all. I need this handled with utmost discretion. We mustn't alarm the citizens of Dalaran if it can possibly be avoided. Do I make myself clear? Very well. Now, go!

Title: What the Scourge Dred
Objective: Kurzel inside Drak'Tharon Keep wants you to slay King Dred and bring her his tooth.
Text: One of the fleeing Drakkari trolls told me of a great raptor king, Dred, that was immune to the plague. If you could find King Dred and bring me one of his teeth, perhaps I could fashion it into a weapon.

Title: Reclaiming Ahn'Kahet
Objective: Seer Ixit in Ahn'Kahet wants you to kill 3 Eyes of Taldaram, a Bonegrinder, and Prince Taldaram.
Text: Prince Taldaram and his army of Scourge use the same wards we once used to hide our empire to keep themselves safe from the native denizens of the icy depths. Deactivate the wards and slaughter the Scourge guarding them. My forces will help the natives slaughter the rest.

Title: Acid Rain
Objective: Using the Recovered Gyrocopter, kill 25 Hozen Gutrippers and 25 Hozen Nibstabbers.
Text: Since you've been gone, more and more of these creatures are approaching our camp. They appear to be amassing for a major assault! We're going to have to take some drastic measures if we hope to see tomorrow. Here, take my poisoned throwing stars and figure out a way to thin out their numbers.

Title: Lay of the Land
Objective: Visit the Shrine of the Sun, the Shrine of the Moon, and Kill Dook Ookem.
Text: Curse these furry pests! Kill one, and two more rise in its place... Nothing has changed. Orders are orders, no matter how few of us stand and regardless of the odds. I have plans to make and problems to solve. I want you to get out there and learn the lay of the land. Don't return until you have something useful to report. And silence that yammering fool while you're out there! Dismissed!

Title: Into the Nexus
Objective: Archmage Berinand has asked you to speak with Warmage Kaitlyn in the Nexus.
Text: I sent Warmage Kaitlyn into the Nexus to investigate the chaos that is Malygos' domain, but she hasn't reported back in days. Would you mind going there and lending her aid? I'm certain she could use help if she hasn't been eaten by dragons.

Title: Fix the Flavor
Objective: Use Cleansing Orchids near the lake water in the Valley of the Mad Brewer and defeat the resulting contaminations.
Text: These orchids you gathered might help us fix the larger issue. In the valley east of here is the lake Brewmaster Shadowpour contaminated. Travel there and toss these herbs in the water to draw out the contamination so you can defeat it. Speak to my friend Jian when you are done. He's a friendly water sprite that has helped the brewmaster and myself make a number of recipes.

Title: The New Master
Objective: Travel to the Tasters' Arena and challenge Brewmaster Shadowpour to a tasters' duel.
Text: I figured it out! With the toxins you provided I not only recreated Shadowpour's recipe but also fixed the problem he was having that was causing illness. Do you know what this means? All that flavor and none of the lethal side effects! Now to deal with the Brewmaster. I've loaded up Chalky with samples. Can you take these to challenge Shadowpour to a tasters' duel? You'll be subjected to his brews but I will help you cheat by bringing my sobering fire.

Title: Scouting Report: The Friend of My Enemy
Objective: Listen to Riko's report.
Text: We weren't only looking for Alliance, you know. We were also looking for those snooked-up, tik-flikklin' jinyu! Well, we found 'em all right...

Title: Missed Me By... That Much!
Objective: Find the missing supply crate at Serenity Falls.
Text: Listen. I sent out a coupla supply drones from the gunship, and they've all been lost or crashed. Almost all, that is. One of 'em buzzed right through the camp here and crashed out by them waterfalls. How 'bout you see what you can do about bringin' the contents of that crate back here, hmm? We're all outta drones, but my rocket boots might get come in handy... or footy, as the case may be. Hah! I just kill me...

Title: Forensic Science
Objective: Collect 8 Viscous Chlorophyll.
Text: These creatures are everywhere - and very hostile! We'll need to deal with them before any more Alliance show up. This one's taken quite a beating, but I've still made some determinations about its anatomy. With the proper reagents, I'll be able to fashion a poison that should be quite effective against this species. In fact, I'll just need to modify a bit of the poison I have with me. Go and find me some viscous chlorophyll down by the water. Any semi-sentient flora should do.

Title: Drunken Tigers
Objective: Kill 9 rabid tigers in the Orchis Hollow.
Text: Orchids may be the cure for my people, but they are an intense opiate for the local tigers. These beasts are often drawn to orchid fields and the intoxicating effects the flowers have on them. When you add the toxins Shadowpour introduced to the water supply it results in very dangerous and rabid animals. It won't be long before they are threatening the Jade Temple. Can you thin some of their numbers please?

Title: Scouting Report: Like Jinyu in a Barrel
Objective: Listen to Shokia's report.
Text: With our leader turned to jade, our hozen guide disappeared, and a prisoner of war in tow, there was only one thing that Kiryn and I could do: March into our enemy's territory and deliver some vengeance. Want to know how it went?

Title: Get a Sample
Objective: Obtain 8 Toxin Samples from smashed pandaren and bring them to Jian in the Valley of the Mad Brewer.
Text: It is time the Mad Brewer got a taste of his own poison. To the east are a number of pandaren who attended a near fatal "tasting" session of Shadowpour's. Can you head into the valley and see if they have any samples left of what they taste tested last night. If you get enough samples I can try to recreate his concoction. Give the samples to my friend Jian. He should be able to modify them a bit. Oh, and be careful. It would appear his beverage had some hateful side effects.

Title: Need a Chaser
Objective: Defeat Orchid Chasers and obtain 15 of the Pollinated Orchids they spawn.
Text: It appears now that my master managed to poison the entire local water supply with his flavor experiments. I might have a treatment but need some supplies. In lighter cases my people have found orchids to be a wonderful remedy. Defeat the orchid chasers in the Orchis Hollow and collect some of the pollinated orchids they carry. We will use them to cleanse the central water source.

Title: Save the Cuddlies
Objective: Lasso 5 Drunk Red Pandas in Fox Grove and bring them to Apprentice Ji Alerage.
Text: The Fox Grove has become a dangerous place for the local red pandas. Sadly due to my actions helping that crazy Brewmaster Shadowpour, the foxes of the grove have developed an inebriation bite. The result is the little red pandas keep getting drunk until they can no longer defend themselves. Please! Can you help me? If you round up some of them I have an aroma about this fire that will help sober them up. That should keep them safe for at least a short while.

Title: The Gatewatcher's Talisman
Objective: Reclaimer A'zak in Azjol-Nerub wants you to retrieve the Gatewatcher's Talisman from Krik'thir the Gatewatcher.
Text: Krik'thir, guardian of the gates to Azjol-Nerub, was not a traitor. He fell in the War of the Spider defending our home from the Scourge. As per his station, he was in possession of the key to the hidden empire. I'd like you to retrieve it so it may be returned to its people.

Title: Lethal Hangovers
Objective: Kill 8 intoxicated foxes in the Fox Grove.
Text: I told him not to do it! But "no one stands in the way of Brewmaster Shadowpour". My master went and contaminated the local water supply trying to "add flavor" to the water. The toxins trickled down here to the Fox Grove where the brew has an irreversible effect on the foxes. It warps their minds and sends them into a frenzy. Now they are a permanent danger to any travelers and local wildlife. Can you help me cull some of their numbers please?

Title: The Faceless Ones
Objective: Kilix the Unraveler in the Pit of Narjun wants you to kill Herald Volazj and the three Forgotten Ones that accompany him in Ahn'Kahet.
Text: In my peoples' struggle against the forces of the undead, they dug deeper as they lost ground. In desperation, they dug too deep. We inadvertently exposed a tendril of the old god's will, which was made manifest in the creatures known only as the Faceless. In the end, we could not fight on two fronts against such powerful enemies. Our misfortune cost us the war against the undead, and ultimately, our home. Enter Ahn'kahet, and cleanse our former home of these Faceless atrocities.

Title: The Tainted Marsh
Objective: Drain the fel energies from the spirits of the Blind Marshlands.
Text: I wasn't able to scout inside the village yet, however, there are more dangerous experiments going on to the south. They were befouling the unquiet spirits in the marshlands with more fel magic! I will rework this fel totem to draw out the fel energies they infused in those spirits. Please, cure what spirits you can, perhaps it will even give them some peace. If you want, I can even send you there!

Title: Uniting the Isles
Objective: Speak to Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
Text: There are a great number of factions here on the Broken Isles. We must unite them if we want to stand a chance against the Legion. Prove your worth to them and report back to me.

Title: The Crone's Wrath
Objective: Defeat 15 demons on Darkcloud Pinnacle.
Text: These demons come into my home, take my things, and capture my people? They will see my wrath. Destroy them, child. Surely you are capable of at least that.

Title: Breaking Chains
Objective: Free 8 Captured Grimtotem from Prison Cages.
Text: The Legion shall not make fools of the Grimtotem. Free my people, and we will grace you with our aid in the coming battle.

Title: Snakes and Stones
Objective: Find either the Doomstone or Arikara on Darkcloud Pinnacle.
Text: When the demons attack, they captured two very powerful possessions of mine: my companion Arikara and the Doomstone. While death matters not to Arikara, the Legion surely has ulterior plans for him. And the Doomstone... such an artifact of power belongs in my hands, not theirs. We must split up to find them. For the world's sake, do be careful. I don't need you clumsily destroying everything.

Title: The Power of Thousands
Objective: Take Magatha's portal and meet her in Thousand Needles.
Text: I know I am not well liked here, and my Grimtotem and I were not invited to join you and your shaman here. However, I come to you with a proposition. The Legion is attacking my home. I've lost possession of some things that are... dear to me, and I have nowhere else to turn to. It pains me to ask... but I request your aid. If you help, I offer my people in service against the Legion.

Title: Mission: Search and Rescue
Objective: Rescue 8 squads of Captured Warriors.
Text: I will make these naga pay for their audacity.They and their skrog lackeys captured our warriors while we were fighting the Legion. They have no honor!We must rescue our fallen soldiers before they are sold as slaves, or worse...

Title: Operation Felrage
Objective: Kill Warlord Kaz'jatar and Felbeard.
Text: I am very concerned to discover naga aligned with the Burning Legion. That is something new and cannot be ignored.The naga warlord, Kaz'jatar, and his skrog toady, Felbeard, are responsible for the Felrage's attacks on our forces.We must teach them that it does not pay to consort with demons!

Title: Missing in Action: Lord Darius Crowley
Objective: Search for Lord Darius Crowley.
Text: Are you familiar with Lord Darius Crowley? He is the worthy Gilnean warrior who was leading our forces against the Felrage naga nearby.Unfortunately the naga captured many of our soldiers during a recent skirmish. Lord Darius went after them and has not returned. I fear something terrible has happened to him.Please try to find him!

Title: Mission: Search and Rescue
Objective: Rescue 8 squads of captured warriors.
Text: I will make these naga pay for their audacity.They and their skrog lackeys captured our warriors while we were fighting the Legion. They have no honor!We must rescue our fallen soldiers before they are sold as slaves, or worse...

Title: A "Humble" Request
Objective: Meet your visitor at Storm's Eye Overlook.
Text: t, we've received a... visitor. She orders entry, but the guards will not let her pass without approval. Please head up to the overlook as soon as you are able.

Title: A Fool's Errand
Objective: Kill "Hill Bandits" to find Doloria's stolen "Jewelry" and buy her "release".
Text: Oh yea sure, I'm, um, held here against my, you know, will, or something.Look bud, between you and me old Max here has no chance, but his heart is in the right place. I keep trying to run away and hide but he keeps finding me! I just don't have it in me to upset him with the truth.I've got an idea. Why don't you go kill some of those really big two headed "Hill Bandits" for me. Let's say they stole some jewelery from me, and you can use it to buy my freedom.Take your time, don't get hurt. Much.

Title: Oh Doloria, My Sweet Doloria
Objective: Seek out Doloria in the Legerdermain Lounge in Dalaran.
Text: What ho! We are quite the dashing pair of adventurers, aren't we?Now that we have secured my belongings, a new path unfolds before us. I did not journey here simply to thwart the demon invasion, no! I came here in search of my beloved, my loved, Doloria. Whilst resting between slaying of dragons, I had a dream, nay, a vision. It told me Doloria had been kidnapped and taken to a floating city in the sky!It must be Dalaran. Quickly, squire! Mount up and meet me at Dalaran's famous inn. Make haste!

Title: Efficient Excavations
Objective: Bring 'Efficient Excavations' to Belloc Brightblade in Schnottz's Landing.
Text: This manual describes outlandish theories on how to most efficiently manage large groups of workers as they engage in massive excavation projects. After a quick skim of the material, it becomes clear to you that the author of the book is the figure in charge of the over-aggressive pillagers here. A map on the back cover indicates that the author has a bunker in the southwest region of Uldum. Perhaps an introduction is in order.

Title: Don't Forget the Eggs!
Objective: Reclaimer A'zak in Azjol-Nerub wants you to destroy 6 Nerubian Scourge Eggs.
Text: Throughout Azjol-Nerub, the scourged nerubians carefully nurture eggs that will soon hatch, providing them nerubian young to slaughter and raise. The eggs have been tainted with foul magics. Our only recourse is to dispose of them.

Title: Seein' Red
Objective: Kill Konk.
Text: I was just about ta curl up an' die, mon. Now, dis! Snuff an' me go way back. Oh, da memories... No way I can face Snuff in da afterlife without avengin' his death first, mon! Dese hooligans be led by one named Konk. We gotta sniff him out an' den snuff him out - for Snuff!

Title: Death to the Traitor King
Objective: Reclaimer A'zak in Azjol-Nerub has tasked you with defeating Anub'arak. You are to return to A'zak with Anub'arak's Broken Husk.
Text: Anub'arak, the traitor king, makes his home in the once proud Kingdom of Azjol-Nerub. He has twisted and perverted our homeland into the wretched squalor it is today. He rules over an army of undead nerubians who have pledged themselves to serving the Lich King. Bring an end to his reign.

Title: Ears of the Lich King
Objective: Defender Mordun inside Utgarde Keep wants you to slay Prince Keleseth.
Text: Prince Keleseth acts as Arthas' eyes and ears in the Fjord. I don't like that one bit! Go and give him a round o' pain. You'll be doing the world a favor by doing so.

Title: Medical Supplies
Objective: Recover 8 Crates of Medical Supplies.
Text: We need supplies to tend to our wounded, but the supply crates containing them were scattered in the crash. If you can bring back any crates you find, I would be very grateful.

Title: New Allies
Objective: Return to the Temple of Five Dawns. A cart is waiting near the Wreck of the Skyseeker to take you there.
Text: , I did what had to be done. And the plan worked. Things could have been much worse had we not acted. I only wish Aysa could understand that. There will be plenty of time for reflection, but for now, we need to return to the Temple of Five Dawns. We need to let them know that Shen-zin Su has been saved, and we need to sort out the fates of these new allies.

Title: An Ancient Evil
Objective: Defeat the Vordraka, the Deep Sea Nightmare.
Text: , I was looking for you! One of the escaping sailors just spotted Aysa in the wreckage of the ship, facing some enormous beast. She might need your help - you should go to her, quickly!

Title: A Hidden Message
Objective: Charge your Cryptomancer's Decoder Ring and use it to decode the Corastrasza's Singed Cipher.
Text: Corastrasza, currently stationed at the Vermillion Redoubt in the Twilight Highlands, has intercepted a coded message of grave importance. I'll let her explain the full situation, but we need your expertise to unravel the cipher! Take your decoder ring to an ethereal thaumaturge in your capital city - he should know how to charge it. Acquire the encoded cipher from Corastrasza and use the ring to decode it for her. Hurry! Time is ticking...

Title: The Healing of Shen-zin Su
Objective: Rescue and defend healers until Shen-zin Su's wound is healed.
Text: This is more horrific than I imagined, but we can handle this. We need to gather the healers and close the wound. We need to save Shen-zin Su. Find any healers you can! Rescue them, relieve them - whatever you need to do to get them over here healing the wound. Keep the healers safe at all costs!

Title: Proving Your Worth
Objective: Pickpocket a cryptomancer's decoder ring from Hagara the Stormbinder at the Eye of Eternity within the Dragon Soul raid encounter.
Text: Hello! You've earned a reputation among the flight as having - shall we say - 'nimble fingers.' We need someone of your skills for a matter of utmost delicacy. Before I reveal more, we need to know you're the right  for the job. When the course of battle takes you to the Eye of Eternity, I need you to pickpocket Hagara the Stormbinder to retrieve a cryptomancer's decoder ring. Are you up to the task?

Title: This Time, Leave a Trail
Objective: Rappel down into the cave, then follow Lilian's instructions.
Text: Here goes nothing, t. If anybody can pull this off, you can! ...Probably. Just use the rappel point behind me to get into the cave. What? Don't make that face. I'll give you more instructions once you're in the cave.

Title: Servant to No One
Objective: Test Akazamzarak's Servants on 5 people in Dalaran.
Text: I like workin' with ya. How's about we keep this gold train a-rollin'? Archmage Khadgar spends an inordinate amount of time sending his servants off to do who knows what. What if an enterprising duo such as ourselves found a cheaper alternative?  This bad boy will form a servant right out of thin air - and a few pounds of the dust you swept up. Why not take it into town and try her out? See for yourself!

Title: Kvaldir on Call
Objective: Blow Helya's Horn and direct the kvaldir to destroy the three Legion portals.
Text: You empowered Helya's Horn in Helheim, and now is the time to use it. I have located three Legion portals we should eliminate.Seek out the vrykul shipwreck on Felrage Strand. Call the kvaldir and have them do what they do best: destroy!

Title: Missing in Action: Eitrigg
Objective: Find Eitrigg.
Text: Are you familiar with Eitrigg? He is the worthy orc warrior who was leading our forces against the Felrage naga nearby.Unfortunately the naga captured many of our soldiers during a recent skirmish. Eitrigg went after them and has not returned. I fear something terrible has happened to him.Please try to find him!

Title: This Time, Leave a Trail
Objective: Rappel down into the cave, then follow Tess's instructions.
Text: Are you ready, t? I will walk you through every step of the plan. You'll be perfectly safe! First thing's first: You see that rappel point behind me? That's your way down into the cave. Good luck!

Title: Operation Felrage
Objective: Kill Warlord Kaz'jatar and Felbeard.
Text: I do not like to see naga aligned with the Burning Legion. That is something new and cannot be ignored.The naga warlord, Kaz'jatar, and his skrog toady, Felbeard, are responsible for the Felrage's attacks on our forces.We must teach them that it does not pay to consort with demons!

Title: Avocation of Antonidas
Objective: Recover the three discs of Antonidas' unfinished project and return them to Kalec in your order hall. Speak to Archmage John Nicholas in Northrend, at the Purple Parlor about the Tri-Disc of the Arcane. Speak with Khadgar about the Tri-Disc of Fire. And speak with Archmage Cedric near the Dalaran Crater about the Tri-Disc of Frost.
Text: Archmage, I've found something you may be interested in. An old journal of the late Archmage, Antonidas. In it, he speaks of a project he was working on that I think we may be able to finish. It was a sort of flying disc that could attune itself to the rider's magical attunement. But I need your help tracking down the pieces. From what I could gather, he gave them to trusted friends and allies through the years. Perhaps you could persuade them to give us the pieces.

Title: Feltotem's Fall
Objective: Defeat Tugar Bloodtotem. Speak with War Councilor Victoria, she will teleport you to Navarrogg to begin.
Text: Our Highmountain contact, Navarrogg, reports that Tugar Bloodtotem has finally resurfaced. He's sent a message crystal along with some instructions for me. I can teleport you to Navarrogg and he will take you to Tugar's location, but there is one problem. Navarrogg requires additional magical power to fend off Tugar's fel magicks. You will need some Nethershards before you go.

Title: Finders Keepers
Objective: Sweep up 8 piles of Arcane Dust in the Hall of the Guardian.
Text: Would you look at this place? It's a mess! Everywhere you look there's just pile after pile of arcane dust!  These poor saps don't realize what that stuff's worth! I tell ya what, if you help me summon up some brooms to collect this powdered gold, I'll split the profits with you 80/20.

Title: Lady Remor'za
Objective: Kill Lady Remor'za.
Text: Our allies reported a coven of extremely powerful Felborne abjurers occupying the Weeping Terrace.Their leader, Lady Remor'za, and her followers are specialists in ancient nightborne magic and can become nearly invincible to attacks.However, as mages, we should be able to defeat them using Spellsteal. Let us show them the power of the Tirisgarde!

Title: Stocking Stalks
Objective: Gather 10 Broken Bamboo Stalks.
Text: My men are malnourished, injured, and exhausted, but they are Horde. Every one will fight to their dying breath. As our new ally, we will stand by you when the time comes, but we would stand stronger with weapons. I have my men out gathering bamboo stalks to fashion into spears. If you can spare the effort, we could use the extra pair of capable hands.

Title: Bidden to Greatness
Objective: Open the gates to Pei-Wu Forest.
Text: It is up to all of you to remove the thorn from the side of Shen-zin Su. Do not let your differences come between you. Trust in each other. Within the Pei-Wu Forest is a lone hermit. Head directly to his hut. He knows intimately of the dark things that now lurk in the trees.

Title: Unwelcome Nature
Objective: Kill 8 Thornbranch Scamps.
Text: You faced forest sprites in the Dawning Valley, but the forest sprites in this grove are a different breed. Crueler and more dangerous. If you would clear some of these sprites out, the spirits would thank you.

Title: Evil from the Seas
Objective: Kill 8 Darkened Horrors or Darkened Terrors.
Text: I do not know what this evil is that is infesting the forest, but I know exactly how to deal with it. So do you, I think.

Title: None Left Behind
Objective: Rescue 3 Injured Sailors.
Text: Your friend has been doing everything she can to save my crew. I'm deeply appreciative. We're still dealing with more than we can handle here: quenching the fires on the wreckage, getting my people out, fighting off these evil sea creatures, and trying to prevent the prisoners from escaping. We're simply in over our heads. I still have men on the ship that we need to get clear before the wreckage collapses on them. I know this is asking a lot, but can you help?

Title: Small, But Significant
Objective: Retrieve 8 Kun-Pai Ritual Charms.
Text: I am tired. I must rest. We have a ritual to perform, but we require some of the charms from this grove. If you wander the grove, you should see them all over hanging from the trees. If it does not offend one as young as you, will you permit me to sit and recover my strength while you gather these charms?

Title: The Suffering of Shen-zin Su
Objective: Board the Hot Air Balloon and Speak to Shen-zin Su.
Text: Now is not the time to grieve. The balloon is ready, and Shen-zin Su awaits. We shall be the first pandaren to speak to Shen-zin Su in hundreds of years. It is a great honor.

Title: Worthy of Passing
Objective: Defeat the Guardian of the Elders.
Text: The four elemental spirits will help you speak with the land and uncover its plight, but first, I have one small task to ask of you. Join me, my pupil. Accompany this old pandaren to the western grove.

Title: Passing Wisdom
Objective: Listen to Master Shang Xi.
Text: This journey shall soon be yours to undertake without me. Stay for a few moments and listen to an old man's words. Let my knowledge serve as a foundation for yours, that you might be greater than I ever was.

Title: The Direct Solution
Objective: Kill 20 hozen in Fe-Feng Village.
Text: Alright , this is the second time we've had to deal with ravaging hozen. I think it's time we take care of this problem the Huojin way. No more patience. No more mediation. We go to the source. We're going into the hozen village to the north and we're punishing those smelly troublemakers. I've been looking forward to a chance to fight by your side again.

Title: Stronger Than Stone
Objective: Gather 12 Abandoned Stone Blocks.
Text: Gather me stone blocks from the Ridge of Laughing Winds to the south. You have seen my strength twice, yet I still spy doubt within your eyes. It will not last.

Title: Dafeng, the Spirit of Air
Objective: Speak to Dafeng, the spirit of air, in the Chamber of Whispers.
Text: If you listen long enough, the wind will carry the answer to you. Dafeng, the spirit of air, has been scared from the skies by Zhao-Ren, the Onyx Serpent. He hides within the Chamber of Whispers, at the south side of the plateau. Go to him. Ji and I will join you there.

Title: Monkey Advisory Warning
Objective: Recover 8 Stolen Firework Bundles.
Text: The monkeys have been stealing from the village during their attacks. We should be fine without some of the extra food stores, but the idea of monkeys with fireworks... I'm a little bit concerned. Not to mention, who knows when some fireworks will come in handy? Help me recover the stolen fireworks from their village?

Title: Battle for the Skies
Objective: Defeat Zhao-Ren, the Onyx Serpent with the aid of Ji's fireworks.
Text: Dafeng, the spirit of air, is terrified by Zhao-Ren, the Onyx Serpent. We must help him face that fear, or face it for him ourselves. When I told Ji of the serpent, he said he had an idea and would begin preparations outside of the chamber. Despite his rash nature, I must admit, I envy his passion and conviction. Let us go outside and confront the Onyx Serpent.

Title: Stronger Than Bone
Objective: Bring the Jade Tiger Pillar to Jojo Ironbrow in Morning Breeze Village.
Text: This giant jade tiger pillar doesn't seem to fit in amidst the hozen buildings. What it does seem is very hard. Very solid. You know just the person to bring this to.

Title: Balanced Perspective
Objective: Cross the ropes and speak to Aysa Cloudsinger on Morning Breeze Lake.
Text: Aysa has been meditating on the lake since we've arrived, all her thoughts focused on Dafeng. I don't know what she hopes to discover out there, but she's no fool, and Master Shang Xi has entrusted this task with her. You will need to cross the ropes leading from the end of the dock to reach her. It shall test your balance, but I think you're up to the task.

Title: Do No Evil
Objective: Kill Ruk-ruk, the Fe-Feng Chief.
Text: , I need you to understand that the way of the Huojin is not the way of violence. When fighting is needed, we will not hesitate, but when fighting is not needed, neither do we instigate. However, the direct solution is often cutting the head off the snake, as they say. The hozen have a leader instigating these attacks. If we remove Ruk-Ruk, we won't have to wipe the hozen out entirely. I know you are not of the Huojin, but are you with me in what must be done?

Title: Tools of the Enemy
Objective: Retrieve 8 Paint Soaked Brushes.
Text: The hozen have stolen our brushes and are painting over our scrolls of wisdom with their own wisdoms, if you can call them that. If you're here to help, stop them and bring our brushes back before they can do more harm.

Title: Not In the Face!
Objective: Request Shu's help in waking Wugou, the spirit of earth.
Text: Alright , I was thinking about what we'd try next if the whole gong thing didn't work, and it came to me just like that! Water in the face always worked on me. It's got to be twice as effective for someone so dry and earthy! Mind going over and asking Shu, the spirit of water, if he'll help us out? He should be playing in the pool next to the waterfall, just on the other side of that tree.

Title: Morning Breeze Village
Objective: Meet with Ji Firepaw in Morning Breeze Village.
Text: The fourth and final spirit is Dafeng, the spirit of air. When he is not in the skies, he can be found on the Ridge of Laughing Winds to the west. I've sent both Aysa and Ji to help you find him. When you are ready, I will summon winds to carry you to the top of the temple. From there, cross the bridges to the west and find Ji in Morning Breeze Village.

Title: Stronger Than Wood
Objective: Gather 12 Discarded Wood Planks.
Text: Gather me wood planks from construction near the Ki-Han Brewery. You do not yet know the extent of my strength, so I shall display it to you.

Title: The Spirit and Body of Shen-zin Su
Objective: Bring Shu and Wugou, the spirits of water and earth, to the Temple of Five Dawns. A cart is waiting near the road to take you there.
Text: Well, that wraps it up here, doesn't it ? Now that we've got these two roused and all friendly towards you, we just need to get them back to the Temple of Five Dawns. You go ahead. I'm going to say my goodbyes, then I'll follow you up shortly.

Title: Rewritten Wisdoms
Objective: Burn 5 Defaced Scroll of Wisdom.
Text: , we must help Elder Shaopai. There are few more deserving of our kindness. On the way here, you surely noticed the scrolls of wisdom hanging in the grotto to the south. The hozen have defiled many of them, and sadly, they are not recoverable. We will deal with the problem directly - burn the defiled scrolls. Wipe the hozen writings away entirely. Do not worry for Elder Shaopai. The people shall come together and help him rewrite the wisdoms in time. I shall see to that.

Title: Missing Mallet
Objective: Recover the Dai-Lo Recess Mallet at the Ki-Han Brewery.
Text: , I've got it! It's simple really. Let's make a ruckus so loud that there's no way he can sleep through it. Why look at that, a conveniently placed gong! Makes me think this may just be how they've awoken him in the past. We just need the matching mallet to get it ringing as loud as possible. The village leader tells me the mallet is over at the Ki-Han Brewery on the river, to the southwest. It's not far. Mind picking it up for me while I give the village some fair warning?

Title: Still Good!
Objective: Recover 3 Uprooted Turnips, 3 Stolen Carrots, and 3 Pilfered Pumpkins.
Text: The virmen to the south have been running off with all of our crops, but they're taking more than they can eat. They must be stockpiling them somewhere - the ones they like anyway. Will you go out and recover any of the uprooted crops you can find? I've got an island's worth of people to feed, and every single vegetable makes a difference.

Title: Rascals
Objective: Kill 10 Virmen.
Text: I'll keep trying to find ways to wake this stubborn little guy up, but there is no shortage of trouble on the island it seems. The crops to the south are infested with virmen, rabbit-like thieves and pillagers. Rascals! They breed faster than we can kill them! I have the perfect solution for such a situation: kill them faster! With you here, that shouldn't be a problem.

Title: Raucous Rousing
Objective: Ring the gong.
Text: You ready for this? I'm thinking maybe we should have looked for something to cover our ears, but it's a bit late for that now. Just remember that the intense ringing you'll be hearing for the next few hours is the ringing sound of victory! The honor's all yours. Ring the gong whenever you're ready!

Title: Wugou, the Spirit of Earth
Objective: Slap the ox.
Text: ! Well, the plus side is that finding Wugou was easy enough. Waking him... not so much. I think he's going to wake quite sore from all the pushing and hitting I've done trying to rouse him. Are you a deep sleeper at all? What wakes you up in the morning? Rolling out of bed always seems to do it for me, so I figure let's just go for that! I tied off some ropes to the ox cart. We send it running and give him a good roll, and we should be good! Care to give the ox a good slap to get it going?

Title: Fish Fry
Objective: Collect 12 Mature Carp from Hozu Fishcatchers
Text: Fortune favors the bold! Your calculated aggressive actions have yielded unexpected rewards. If you can slay these fishcatchers after a successful haul, you'll inherit their slippery spoils. Thinning out the enemy while feeding your allies - the picture of efficiency!

Title: The Feltotem Menace
Objective: Find and deal with Tugar Bloodtotem.
Text: If I had known Tugar was alive and behind this I would've alerted you sooner! He is a hateful creature, and an easy recruit to the Legion's cause. If he is truly successful with his fel experiments we need to stop him now. He is taunting us from up there. Let's go!

Title: Shield Amplification
Objective: Use the Nightborne Soulstone on defeated Felborne within the Weeping Terrace.
Text: It will not hurt to reinforce the Nightborne Soulstone's shield just a bit more, and to do that we must infuse it with energy.Ryanna has assured me that fel essence will work beautifully for our needs. Yes - this method IS rather distasteful. However as the sin'dorei well know, desperate times call for desperate measures.It is as simple as this: we have an urgent need for magical energy, and our enemies possess it in abundance.Do what must be done.

Title: Rise Up
Objective: Kill 8 demons, then reach the top of the ramp.
Text: Here we are, t. On this island is a cavern full of exceptionally powerful demons and their leaders. If our plan succeeds, these demons will be... "blown to smithereens", as Tethys so nicely put it. There's no time to explain the plan in full right now, but Tess has agreed to walk you through it. First you must get up to the top of this ramp. Slaughter a few on your way.

Title: Holding Our Ground
Objective: Repel the Legion threat from Thunder Totem.
Text: Though we anticipated a strong Legion presence, our attacks on their camps have angered their forces even further than anticipated. Our forces rally on both land and in the skies above Thunder Totem in an attempt to regain our footing.Do what you can to reduce their forces. Once we've secured Thunder Totem we'll begin our plan for a final attack.

Title: Fel Ingredients
Objective: Acquire 5 Vials of Liquid Felflame, 3 Flasks of Fel Blood, and 3 pinches of Demonic Ash.
Text: Our scouts have located a Felskorn encampment within the Garrison of the Fel. We will need as many samples of fel poison as we can find if we are to concoct a cure for our stricken monks.Take samples of anything that looks remotely useful!

Title: Village of the Corruptors
Objective: Kill Feltotem Infusers in Feltotem.
Text: The Feltotem continue to create these totems for further "experiments". Let us deal with these infusers in the traditional manner.Their deaths will right a great wrong and provide clues as to their ultimate goal.

Title: They Stole Excaliberto!
Objective: Find Excaliberto and return it to Maximillian.
Text: I was scouting the nearby demon village when I was attacked. They took my artifact! Of course, if I leave here, the shore will be undefended. The nearby demons have it. Go, slay them and bring it back to me!

Title: A Bit of Espionage
Objective: Speak to Aludane Whitecloud in Krasus' Landing for a flight to Broken Shore.
Text: With the gunpowder in tow, it's time to move on to our next plan. Meet us on the Broken Shore. You can get a flight directly to our next location from Krasus' Landing. We will meet you there, t.

Title: Rise Up
Objective: Kill 8 demons, then reach the top of the ramp.
Text: Here we are, t. On this island is a cavern full of exceptionally powerful demons and their leaders. If our plan succeeds, these demons will be... "blown to smithereens", as Tethys so nicely put it. There's no time to explain the plan in full right now, but Lilian has agreed to walk you through it. First you must get up to the top of this ramp. Slaughter a few on your way.

Title: In Safer Hands
Objective: Bring the Focusing Iris to Archmage Kalec in Dalaran.
Text: There is still the matter of the Focusing Iris. Please return it to your Kirin Tor friends, with my apologies.As for myself, I think I'm done chasing artifacts for a while. One possession by immortal shadowy evil is enough for me, thank you.

Title: A Good Start
Objective: Kill 4 Hozen Mudflingers, 4 Hozen Skullthumpers, and 3 Hozen Fishcatchers
Text: Regardless of our predicament, our orders stand. We are to learn the lay of this land and prepare it for Hellscream's fleet. But first, we must deal with these savages! You see these corpses I've stacked up around the camp? I want mountains of them! We are the Horde! These vermin have not learned to fear us yet, but we will fix that soon enough...

Title: Stealing Their Thunder
Objective: Defender Mordun has asked you to acquire the head of Ingvar the Plunderer.
Text: The vrykul are fearless in a fight. Seems they actually yearn fer a death in battle. With their numbers and that ferocity, we're doomed - plain and simple. There's one they esteem though, goes by the name of Ingvar. Bring him down and you'll deal a mighty blow to their spirit.

Title: Cryin' My Eyes Out
Objective: Collect Zin'Jun's belongings from the Hozen Groundpounders.
Text: I coulda taken out da whole lot of 'em, mon. Shot 'em one by one, den played dead when dey be gettin' close. Fell for it every time, dey did - well almost every time... One of 'em finally got wise. Called my bluff. Before I knew it, dey was usin' my eyes as marbles. Ran off with my goods an' left me here ta die, da savages... Help me, mon. Lemme die wit my dignity intact.

Title: Disarmament
Objective: Defender Mordun wants you to steal 5 Vrykul Weapons.
Text: Take it from me, them vrykul weapons be downright nasty! Deceptively well-balanced, wickedly sharp - just plain deadly. I need you to pilfer some o' them weapons before they're used on us!

Title: Family Heirlooms
Objective: Collect 8 Pearlfin Heirlooms from dead Pearlfin Villagers in Moonwater Retreat.
Text: We recently lost a fierce battle against the hozen at Moonwater Retreat. We evacuated as many of our people as we could, but still, there were many we could not save. We have no tokens of our lost over which to send our prayers. If someone could go and retrieve heirlooms from the dead bodies, we could properly lay them to rest, and move on. It would mean so much to us if you could do this.

Title: Pit Fighter
Objective: Speak with Korgol Crushskull at the Darkmoon Faire.
Text: There must be more to being a master pit fighter than this... Perhaps Korgol Crushskull who runs the Darkmoon Deathmatch at the Faire will know.

Title: Kung Din
Objective: Obtain the Slingtail Key by slaying Kung Din.
Text: I hope you are capable of this next task, for our lives depend on it. There is only one key that will unlock our chains. Unfortunately, the key hangs around the neck of the hozen's pet tiger, Kung Din. They keep the tiger in the great pit to the north. The only way to retrieve the key will be to kill the beast.

Title: Bottletoads
Objective: Scoop toad eggs from 8 Gurgling Toadspawn on the top level of the Pools of Purity.
Text: Have you heard about the crisis we're having at the pools? Toads have moved in and are spawning like crazy! It's become a real problem for the lotus farmers. Coincidentally, I make a jam out of gelatinous toadspawn. I call it "Bottletoads" and it's a big hit with the kids around here. Can't keep any in stock. If you're heading to the pools, you'd be doing everyone a favor by uh... liberating some of those toad eggs. Into this bottle. For me. Just look for bubbles and scoop right in!

Title: To Bridge Earth and Sky
Objective: Protect Pei-Zhi during his ritual at the Terrace of Ten Thunders.
Text: We are ready to open the tan-chao and guide all of these spirits back to peace. If I may, I would have your assistance once more. The mogu will surely sense the ritual taking place and will do everything in their power to halt it. I need only a few moments without interference, and once the path is open it will surge too greatly to be closed. If you are willing to help one more time, please accompany me to the ritual site.

Title: Guess Whose Back
Objective: Bring Krosh's Back to Yan in New Cifera.

Title: The Wayward Dead
Objective: Use the Staff of Pei-Zhi to absorb 10 Wayward Ancestors in the Terrace of Ten Thunders.
Text: The process of mass conjuring, as the mogu are doing here, is not without byproduct. Some spirits arrive too distraught or unruly to be harnessed, so they are confined and left to wander until their desperation leaves them more malleable. I suspect the mogu have such a holding area somewhere nearby, likely guarded by spiritclaws. Please, take my staff again and use it to collect these wayward spirits. You needn't fight them - present the staff and they should be drawn in.

Title: A Humble Offering
Objective: Gather 10 Tidemist Caps from Tideview Thicket.
Text: I'm almost ready for the ritual, there's just one more thing we need: An offering. Relax, I don't mean a sacrifice. Just a bit of food. There are sure to be mushrooms growing in Tideview Thicket to the northwest that are suitable for this. Please bring some.

Title: Ritual Artifacts
Objective: Bring Pei-Zhi a Chipped Ritual Bowl, a Pungent Ritual Candle, and a Jade Cong from the Terrace of Ten Thunders.
Text: So many spirits held in captivity here... I can feel them everywhere. Even the walls are a cage for the long-dead. , we cannot simply break the sorcery over this place - doing so would release countless agonized souls to wander the earth. They will need a beacon, something to guide them. With your help, I can create a tan-chao: a bridge from this world to the heavens. For this ritual, I'll need a bowl, a candle, and a jade cong. You should be able to find them all within the ruins.

Title: Pei-Back
