Objective: Confront Shan Jitong and rescue Pei-Zhi at the Seat of the Spirit Waker in the Terrace of Ten Thunders.

Title: An Urgent Plea
Objective: Recover the Staff of Pei-Zhi and interrupt the mogu ritual in the center of the Terrace of Ten Thunders.
Text: Please... help... heart of the ruins... a ritual... conjuring... ...should not be here... My staff... on the altar... take it. Please hurry.

Title: Vessels of the Spirit
Objective: Recover 8 Spirit Bottles from Shan'ze Spiritclaws in the Terrace of Ten Thunders.
Text: The Spiritclaws are a sect of mogu assassin-priests who, at the height of the mogu empire, were the most elite and most feared of the emperor's troops. All have mastered a deathblow which ensnares the spirit of the enemy, trapping it in a jade bottle for delivery to a Spiritbinder. If you encounter any Spiritclaws further ahead in the ruins, take note: their belts hang with a cursed weight. Relieve them of their burden and bring the bottles back to me.

Title: Back to Nature
Objective: Throw Spirit Bottles on the ground in Tideview Thicket to release 8 Beast Spirits.
Text: I'm afraid I have another favor to ask. The bottles you recovered contain neither the spirits of mogu ancestors nor recently slain foes; they contain spirits of beasts. It seems the spiritclaws have resorted to poaching in an effort to fuel their simulacra. This complicates our task, for I cannot take the beasts with me through the bridge. Take the bottles west to Tideview Thicket and smash them to return the spirits to nature. Some may be blind with rage and will need to be subdued.

Title: Break the Cycle
Objective: Kill 8 Shan'ze Spiritbinders in the Terrace of Ten Thunders.

Title: Simulacrumble
Objective: Kick 6 Vacant Destroyers in the Terrace of Ten Thunders.

Title: Breadcrumb Into Ruins
Objective: Head into the Ruins of Gan Shi, northwest of the .
Text: The spirits released from these statues are being pulled--rather violently--toward the coastal ruins up ahead. It seems unlikely that they'll be allowed to rest...

Title: Some "Pupil of Nature"
Objective: Investigate the Woods of the Lost, northeast of the Greenstone Quarry.
Text: Wood sprites are not prone to wandering, so I'm surprised they ventured down as far as the mason's quarter. Something must be forcing them out of their natural habitat. These particular sprites are native to the Woods of the Lost, just north of here. I'd go myself, but I've heard those woods are haunted. So yeah, that's out. I guess we'll never know.  Orrrr... A big brave adventurer like YOU could go check it out! What do you say?

Title: The Sprites' Plight
Objective: Slay 10 Stonebound Destroyer the Woods of the Lost and discover their source.

Title: Monstrosity
Objective: Collect sketches of each piece of the ancient statue.
Text: It's plain to see that this statue and the surrounding ruins are of ancient origin. Clearly, this land has a deep history, which means it could not have been born of the cataclysm. And yet these waters have been explored for ages now, with no record of anything here but open sea. Perhaps if you were to sketch the pieces of this broken statue, you might shed light on the continent's origins.

Title: What Goes Down, Must Come Up!
Objective: Use the Goblin Drone Dispenser near the Exposed Root to recover supplies.
Text: Rivett left behind what looks to be an important piece of equipment. Along its shaft you are able to make out the words: Goblin Drone Dispenser. With a simple calibration, the device is set to deliver drones to Nazgrim's basecamp. Easy enough.... There's just one problem. The only supply crates worth transporting have fallen to the cliff ledge below the crash impact. As you ponder the issue, you see the long, coiled tail of a Cliff Glider fly by the corner of your eye...

Title: My Kingdom for a Horse
Objective: Return Pimento.
Text: Oh, woe is me! Soon after making landfall I began exploring, riding my trusty steed Pimento into the heart of a demon infested village to the north. While performing my investigations, I tied Pimento up to go further on foot, only to return and discover a powerful demon had captured her! There he was, riding her like she was his own. Please find her and send her back to me.

Title: SI:7 Report: Lost in the Woods
Objective: Listen to Rell's report.
Text: Please. You need to hear what we've been through. The whole damned Alliance needs to hear what we've been through. There may not be much time left.

Title: Scouting Report: On the Right Track
Objective: Listen to Kiryn's report.
Text: MOST of what Riko said is true. We didn't dare pursue Gorrok - the Horde's numbers here are far too few. Our forces can only sustain so many losses, and frankly, we don't know how powerful that witch really is. Let me pick up where the hozen left off...

Title: The Shrouded Coin
Objective: Bring the Shrouded Timewarped Coin to Mistweaver Xia on the Timeless Isle.
Text: A swirling mist envelops the coin and it begins to float above your hand. The mist briefly parts to reveal a shiny new coin, yet in the next instant the coin appears worn from years of exchange. As the coin settles back in to your hand, visions of jungles and mist shrouded peaks waft into your mind, and through the vision you recognize the four Celestials gathered in the courtyard of an island.

Title: Seek Me Out
Objective: Look for Maximillian of Northshire in Highmountain.
Text: The letter from Maximillian is written on something which looks to be torn off a ship's sail. Included are directions to the beach in northern Highmountain.

Title: A Knight's Belongings
Objective: Fetch Maximillian's armor.
Text: Amidst the squalls and the crashing waves, my mighty ship swayed and tumbled. Lesser knights would have trembled in terror, frozen stiff. Not me! Nay! Heroically, I stripped my armor off my back and stored it safely in my sack.Why did I strip down to these simple undergarments, you ask? Only an ignorant squire would. I was wary of sinking to the bottom should my ship fall foul of course! Ha ha!Unfortunately, the sacks of armor were thrown overboard by the waves.

Title: Kneel and Be Squired!
Objective: Kneel before Maximillian.
Text: You must kneel before me if we are to begin our journey together once more. Kneel, squire, and be squired!

Title: The Burning Birds
Objective: Collect Fel Infusing totems.
Text: The Feltotem are experimenting on these falcosaurs! They didn't get the results that they wanted and have carelessly left their experiments lying around to further poison the animals. We should collect their leftover totems to prevent further corruption and to find out what they were doing.

Title: Further Training
Objective: Complete Maximillian's quests and slay "demons" to earn the rank of Squire First Class.
Text: The journey here was perilous, Squire. It was fraught with danger. Storms, demons, storm demons... I shudder at the memory. Of course, I overcame all such dangers at great loss to my person. This is where I need your assistance.You must venture forth--nay, sally forth--and recover my armor, my weapon, and of course my grand steed. Once you have successfully completed these tasks three, will you be promoted to Squire, First Class!

Title: Unnatural Consequences
Objective: Kill Nighthuntress Lexera.
Text: Lexera and her trappers have taken over the valley.She is stronger than she looks, and she fights with the strength of a dreadlord. Do not go in unprepared.I can handle these demons. Go, find Lexera, and make her feel the consequences of her unnatural endeavors.

Title: Ready to Strike
Objective: Meet Nighthuntress Syrenne on the Broken Shore.
Text: I followed one of the trappers, who unknowingly led me to the Broken Shore.Lexera was there, surrounded by an army of demons and loyal nightborne.I wasn't able to get close, but from what I could tell, she and her army of trappers are taming the fel-corrupted beasts.It is an abomination of nature, and she must be stopped!Meet me on the Broken Shore and be ready to strike. I will gather additional manaroot. I have a feeling we'll need it.

Title: Destruction: Rumblings Near Feltotem
Objective: Find Navarrogg at the Misty Coast in Highmountain.
Text: The Highmountain have passed along a dire warning from their drogbar allies. The Feltotem are spreading their demonic corruption into the wildlife around them, infecting the land itself. We believe this is something that should be looked into sooner rather than later. The drogbar chieftain, Navarrogg, is handling this personally and we'd like you to meet him near the Feltotem village.|cFF660000Specialization: Destruction Warlock|r

Title: Taking Control
Objective: Kill Torturer Relyn and use his Control Orb to free Nighthuntress Syrene.
Text: I've been withering away in this cage, prisoner to a wretch called Reyln.He leads a group of nightborne that are using fel magic to corrupt and control the native wildlife.The Burning Legion's reach has already spread too far for my liking.Kill him and recover his control orb, so I can be released from this arcane prison!

Title: The Nighthuntress Beckons
Objective: Ride D'Bynn and let him lead you to Nighthuntress Syrene's location.

Title: Felbound Beasts
Objective: Kill Nightborne Trappers and free Felbound beasts.
Text: So Reyln is taking orders from Lexera? Why am I not surprised. She seemed far too comfortable with the demons who infested our city.We cannot let her succeed in corrupting Suramar's wildlife. I swore to protect the city of Suramar from all enemies, even those within its walls.If you can deal with her trappers, I will do my best to track Nighthuntress Lexera down.

Title: Soothing Wounds
Objective: Use Manaroot that is foraged from leylines within the Crimson Thicket to soothe D'Bynn's wounds.
Text: Perhaps you can forage something nearby that will soothe the manasaber's wounds?

Title: Barrel Toss
Objective: Use Storm Brew to destroy 5 Fel Brew Spreaders.
Text: The Legion is defending the Felskorn lair with fel emitters. Fortunately we have Storm Brew to spare, so there should be plenty available with which to destroy them.Take this barrel, throw it at the spreaders, and watch them go BOOM!

Title: Devastating Effects
Objective: Investigate Suramar.
Text: The Burning Legion will not rest until they have destroyed everything and everyone. Their presence here has had a devastating effect on our lands, and now it seems our wildlife as well.I have heard numerous reports of sickly animals in the thicket that surrounds the demon-infested city of Suramar.Make your way there and see if the rumors are true.

Title: A Call from the Caverns
Objective: Find Muyani in the skull-shaped rock above Wailing Caverns.
Text: Oh, good, I'm glad you stopped by. We've heard disturbing rumors of corruption continuing to flourish in the Wailing Caverns. You seem like just the right person to investigate.Since Naralex's awakening, one of his disciples has been watching over the area to ensure that deviate creatures remain in check. She is the one that has been sending us these dire warnings.Meet up with her in the eye of the skull-shaped rock above Wailing Caverns and see if you can help her handle this situation.

Title: Scouting Report: Hostile Natives
Objective: Listen to Riko's report.
Text: I bet I know your first question: "What the ook happened to Sergeant Gorrok?" Don't worry, don't worry. He's totally alive. Not dead or anything.  Well, we THINK he's alive, but he ALSO might be very, very dead.  Fine! Let me tell you exactly what happened.

Title: A Common Enemy
Objective: Return to Khadgar in the Violet Citadel.
Text: I have one more request to ask of you, outsider.Return to your leaders and report to them what transpired here. Though your people may never truly be allies with the Tideskorn, know that we have a common enemy - one which my people will fight to the last vrykul.When the time comes, I hope to see you on the battlefield.

Title: Pet Battle Challenge: Wailing Caverns
Objective: Defeat the Budding Everliving Spore in Wailing Caverns.
Text: The deviate critters of the Wailing Caverns continue to flourish in the damp darkness, but I've been doing my best to keep their numbers down. I've found a few pets and supplies while clearing out the caverns, I might be willing to part with a sack of supplies if you can beat my best run. You'll have to clear out the cavern without healing or reviving any of your pets to best me. Good luck!

Title: Without a Trace
Objective: Press the detonator to erase the remaining evidence.
Text: The explosives are set. All we have to do now is pull the trigger.

Title: The Jade Witch
Objective: Defeat the Jade Witch.
Text: The Jade Witch must still have Shin. I... I can't do it! I don't want to see the witch. Can you please go talk to her and see if she has Shin? You're an adult, I don't think she would try to turn you into jade.

Title: Burial at Sea
Objective: Bring the 3 Vanguard Corpses to the Immobile Catapult at the Wreck of the Sky Shark.
Text: These savages are... ruthless. They've dragged off our dying soldiers to be tormented in their camps. This is no way for our valiant brothers to die. I shall join them soon enough. Please, put my mind at ease and their bodies to rest. Find their remains at the camps surrounding the wreckage. Put them out of the reach of these creatures.

Title: Explosive Evidence
Objective: Plant 4 Makeshift Dynamite near the sunken ship at Sapphire's End. Makeshift Dynamite must be placed at least 10 yards apart.
Text: I must ask you to do one more thing for me. The personal effects on this ship cannot be left for others to find. We'll have to destroy it. I cobbled together some Makeshift Dynamite from the scraps you brought me. Place the dynamite anywhere on the ship, but take care not to put them too close together. They might be...uh...a little unwieldy, so you should spread them out in case of premature detonation.

Title: SI:7 Report: Fire From the Sky
Objective: Listen to Sully's report.
Text: Yeah, we found Amber, she's alive, and all that. That's about where the good news stops though. Let's see if I can pick up where ol' Rell left off...

Title: SI:7 Report: Take No Prisoners
Objective: Listen to Amber Kearnen's report.
Text: The final leg of our journey took us west, to a large hozen village. We set up a small camp in the mountains, outside of their line of sight...

Title: SI:7 Report: Hostile Natives
Objective: Listen to Little Lu's report.
Text: I... I can tell you what happened next! We continued north, into the forest...

Title: A Lesson in Bravery
Objective: Defeat 8 Leafy Tricksters south of the Jade Witch Hut.
Text: Can you help teach me to be brave like you? When we played our prank on the witch we made a bunch of Leafy Tricksters angry. I think the witch did something to them. Can you show me how you stand up to them?

Title: An Offering
Objective: Widow Greenpaw has asked for you to bring her a fish from the pool behind the Jade Witch's Hut in the Jade Forest.
Text: Well young one, if you would do me a kindness before I help. Behind my hut is a small pond. I keep a stock of very rare fish that I need for ritual. It was a favorite of my late husband. Could you please bring me one?

Title: The Jade Witch
Objective: Speak with the Widow Greenpaw at the Jade Witch Hut.
Text: The Jade Witch must still have Shin. I... I can't do it! I don't want to see the witch. Can you please go talk to her? You're an adult. I don't think she would turn you into jade.

Title: Down Kitty!
Objective: Destroy 8 Jade Guardians.
Text: I tried to fight one of the jade tigers in the woods but they were too scary. They stare at you and you turn to a jade statue! Honest truth! Chen's sister's friend Ni heard it from Kai's mom. I want to be brave like you though. Can you show me how to beat up those jade tigers?

Title: The Double Hozu Dare
Objective: Inspect 7 Lifelike Jade Statues south of the Jade Witch Hut.
Text: Shin is still missing! I never... I mean the other kids never should have double hozu dared him to knock on the witch's door. We saw a bunch of jade statues south of the Jade Witch's hut. Can you come with me and see if any of them are Shin?

Title: The Witch in the Woods
Objective: Find An Windfur on the road north of the Jade Witch Hut.
Text: Oh please ! Can you help me? Some of the village children were playing in the woods and haven't come back. Could you please keep an eye out for them if you are going out there? I told those village rascals to leave that old widow up in the woods alone. My guess is they are probably harassing her. They think she is a witch.

Title: Sixteen Fluid Ounces of Prevention
Objective: Use the Spirit-Touched Water Barrel to extinguish the four fires near the Zeppelin Wreckage.
Text: Better safe than sorry. The pillars of smoke surrounding the crash site will be a beacon to any Alliance who might have seen your Zeppelin in distress. Until you and your depleted crew get your bearings, you could do without that kind of trouble. Extinguishing the wreckage fires is just plain common sense.

Title: Wet Work!
Objective: Collect 5 Water Globules from Spiritsong Lake and combine them with the Horde Barrel.
Text: If any Alliance naval forces have come ashore, the smoky fires from your crash will lead them right to you and what remains of your crew. There must be a way to extinguish those flames... This barrel seems to have survived the catastrophe intact. Perhaps it's still water-tight. Only one way to find out!

Title: Horde Justice
Objective: Kill 15 Hozu at the Wreck of the Sky Shark.
Text: Your mind races as you struggle to come to terms with your predicament - shipwrecked on an uncharted land, nearly all of the crew lost.... As you look at the corpse of this unfortunate creature you realize that the area is crawling with his kind, and that they're pillaging whatever supplies haven't been destroyed. It's time to introduce these vermin to some good old-fashioned Horde justice.

Title: Standard Protocol
Objective: Gather 8 Unstable Solenoids.
Text: The Sky Shark has been totally destroyed. With Alliance forces about, standard protocol requires the destruction of any sensitive technologies. These solenoids most certainly fall under that category. The Horde's directives are clear, round up the solenoids for destruction.

Title: The Double Hozen Dare
Objective: Rescue 6 Scared Pandaren cubs.
Text: There is a witch in the woods but no one believes me. She turned my friend Shin into jade! We were all so scared we tried to run back but she sicced her big jade monsters on us. A bunch of my friends tried to get away by climbing trees. Can you help me save my friends?

Title: Barrel of Monkies
Objective: Sally Fizzlefury wants you to kill 5 drunken monkies.
Text: These monkeymen are driving me insane! I was just trying to get some insight into panderan brewing tactics and these hozu things keep drinking the brews before I can properly chemical test them. Can you please go take a few of them out as a lesson to the others? I'll make it worth your while.

Title: Mother's Orders
Objective: Kill Mother Mirenda.
Text: That big ugly thing looks like it's leading the attack here. Let's take her down!

Title: Kegplosion
Objective: Kill 5 Enraged Spirit Walkers before they eat Sally Fizzlefury's face.
Text: Oh no ! In what can only be described as a contrived act of contention, the nearby spirit walkers have become enraged. Please do something about them before they eat our faces!

Title: Invasion of the Bottle Snatchers
Objective: Sally Fizzlefury wants you to recover 5 stolen brewskies from the Brewhunters near the farm in Shen-zin Su.
Text: As if the hozu weren't enough now we have a bunch of renegade dwarven brewmaster wannabes floating around. Can you please recover the brewskies they stole? It would cripple the Ironforge economy if this many "entrepreneurs" started popping up.

Title: Eyir's Forgiveness
Objective: Witness Eyir's judgment of Sigryn in the Vault of Eyir in Skold-Ashil.
Text: I'm sorry for everything I've put you through, outsider. After my actions here, I fear all of this may have been in vain.Come with me back to Skold-Ashil. There I will accept whatever judgment Eyir deems fit of me.

Title: The Befouled Barrows
Objective: Close 3 Legion Portals in the Stormrage Barrow Dens.
Text: You were taking too long, so I took the liberty to scout out the barrows in advance. The Legion has set up portals, pulling more and more demons through them by the second. We need to shut them down so we can save Goldrinn! I'm not sure my usual methods are going to do much to take them down, but I think you can do it! I think some nice vine-work is in order.

Title: Unanswered Questions
Objective: Join Sigryn at the Vault of Eyir in Skold-Ashil.
Text: What is done, is done. There are none left to challenge the throne of the Tideskorn.My brother's words still haunt me, though. If Eyir knows who ordered my family killed, I deserve to know it.Come, let us return.

Title: To Tame the Drekirjar
Objective: Defeat Jarl Velbrand in Hrydshal.
Text: The Bonespeaker's words trouble me, outsider. The darkness he speaks of, Skovald's fel curse, could he have passed it onto me somehow?No, it cannot be so. The Runeseer must be mistaken...Come, the next challenger awaits. I will no doubt need your assistance bringing him to heel as well.

Title: To Silence the Bonespeakers
Objective: Defeat Runeseer Faljar in Haustvald.
Text: Sigryn's claim to the throne will be challenged by two rivals - Runeseer Faljar of the Bonespeakers and Jarl Velbrand of the Drekirjar.I would begin in Haustvald with the Runeseer. He was a close ally of Skovald and is a powerful mystic. With the Bonespeakers at his charge, he would prove a staunch opponent if he cannot be made to yield.Go now, and claim your destiny in the name of the Valkyra!

Title: The Forgotten Heir
Objective: Find Torvald in Vrekt.
Text: My brother... lives?The last time I saw him, the assassins were closing in on him. I can't imagine how he defeated them...We should travel to Vrekt. I would look upon my brother with my own eyes.

Title: The God-Queen's Fury
Objective: Speak with War Councilor Victoria to be teleported to Sigryn's location and defeat her.
Text: t, the Kirin Tor have found a way to get you into the Halls of Valor to pursue the God-King's heir. Archmage Khadgar has asked me to stress upon you the importance of stopping Sigryn, as the prophecies hint that she may still be the key to uniting the Tideskorn against the Legion.It will require an incredible amount of energy to teleport you directly to the Halls, so be sure that you are prepared. It may be some time before we can send you again.Speak to me when you are ready to proceed.

Title: Let Sleeping Dogs Lie
Objective: Save Goldrinn from the Stormrage Barrow Dens.
Text: You see those big eredar guys? That's the barrow that Goldrinn is in! I don't know what the Legion is doing to him in there, but I'm sure we don't want them to succeed. Let's get in there and save Goldrinn!

Title: My Stars!
Objective: Collect 100 of Kiryn's Throwing Stars from Devious Wood Sprites.
Text: A number of Kiryn's articles have been scattered around the area by wood sprites, but this one stands out as important to you. The bag once hung from her waist, loaded with throwing stars. Without them, her arsenal will be considerably diminished. If you were to retrieve the weapons from the pests that inhabit this region, it could only help your cause.

Title: Bring Me A Shrubbery!
Objective: Collect 5 Sanguine Hibiscus and return them to T'shu in the Underbog.
Text: My people use sanguine hibiscus for a number of purposes. It grows naturally only in the Underbog, and many of the bog's denizens have taken a liking to it. If you could bring me some, I would be very grateful.

Title: Regroup!
Objective: Rescue Shademaster Kiryn, Rivett Clutchpop, Shokia, and Sergeant Gorrok from Honeydew Glade.
Text: They have an airbase! I have underestimated this Alliance Captain for the last time. So many good warriors lost... There must have been a few survivors who were able to bail during the crash. We need every able-bodied fighter we can get. Find as many survivors as you can in the forest below, and I will investigate the wreckage itself. Rally everyone together at the nearby village for a counter-attack.

Title: Advancing the Campaign
Objective: Force Commander Danath Trollbane has asked you to speak with Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
Text: The time has come to lay the final blow against the fel orcs. Advance Scout Chadwick awaits your presence inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel. Make haste, their forces could strike against Honor Hold at any moment!

Title: The General's Edge
Objective: Bring Nazgrim's axe to General Nazgrim.
Text: As you gradually gather your senses and begin to take in your surroundings, this object stands out amongst the strewn wreckage. It occurs to you that this is the first time you've seen Nazgrim's axe outside of his tight grasp. Somehow, this fact makes your predicament even more unsettling... You know that dead or alive, the General would want his weapon back in his possession.

Title: Into the Mists
Objective: Speak to General Nazgrim on Hellscream's Fist.
Text: You smell that? It's the smell of our home, the lands our kind have bled and died to preserve. And listen... you hear that? It's the sound of peace and safety - a haven we've carved, where our enemies fear to tread. Remember these things. You won't experience them again anytime soon. We have ourselves a war to win. Now go get settled, we're shovin' off!

Title: Advancing the Campaign
Objective: Shadow Hunter Ty'jin has asked you to speak with Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
Text: I mostly listen. I listen so that the Warchief doesn't have to. I've heard of the status of our campaign against the Hellfire Citadel. It is time to take the Shattered Halls, seat of power for the fel orcs. Go speak with Stone Guard Stok'ton, he's in charge there.

Title: Hard to Kill
Objective: Kalecgos has asked you to defeat Kael'thas in Magisters' Terrace. You are to take Kael's head and report back to Larethor inside the Magisters' Terrace.
Text: As you've now witnessed, the Legion forces work tirelessly, manipulating the Sunwell's power to achieve their malevolent ends. Kael'thas has risen from the ashes of defeat and once more leads them in their efforts. He must be stopped.

Title: Twisted Associations
Objective: Exarch Larethor in the Magisters' Terrace wants you to kill Selin Fireheart and Priestess Delrissa.
Text: The Legion and Kael'thas' forces are becoming increasingly intertwined. This concerns me very deeply. From what we can gather Selin Fireheart and Priestess Delrissa work closely together to unite the two armies. You need to stop them.

Title: The Scryer's Scryer
Objective: Tyrith wants you to use the orb on the balcony in Magisters' Terrace.
Text: Go to the terrace... use the orb. ...They're...feeding the sunwell....  Hurry... They must be stopped... before they can....

Title: Severed Communications
Objective: Exarch Larethor inside the Magisters' Terrace wants you to find Tyrith, a blood elf spy.
Text: We've had a contact embedded in Magisters' Terrace gathering intelligence for us for some time now, but we've lost contact with him. The information he was collecting is vital to our mission.

Title: Magisters' Terrace
Objective: Captain Theris Dawnhearth wants you to find Exarch Larethor inside the Magisters' Terrace.
Text: We recently sent in an expeditionary force to the Magisters' Terrace to stop the Legion forces there. However, we haven't heard from them since, and I fear the worst. Will you go there and try to find Exarch Larethor? He's in charge of the expedition.

Title: A Radical Notion
Objective: Exarch Larethor in the Magisters' Terrace wants you to kill Vexallus and obtain its essence.
Text: We cannot afford to lose this war. I'd like to empower our sentries so that brave men and women don't have to die. The Legion has gotten a hold of a powerful elemental being. Its essence could be just what we need.

Title: Maximum Security Breakout
Objective: A'dal has asked you to slay Harbinger Skyriss in the Arcatraz of Tempest Keep.
Text: Harbinger Skyriss is the heart of the problem in the Arcatraz. He corrupted Warden Mellichar and made him release many of the prisoners. It is only a matter of time before the Harbinger himself is let loose. , you cannot let a servant of the Old Gods live!

Title: The Source of Our Livelihood
Objective: Speak to Ji at the Dai-Lo Farmstead. A cart is waiting near the road to take you there.
Text: We have done as Master Shang asked of us. I will return to the temple to inform the master of our progress. You should continue south on the road to the farmlands to seek out Wugou, the spirit of earth. Ji awaits you at the Dai-Lo Farmstead, and he'll surely need your help. I must warn you, Ji can be reckless in his directness. Remember well the things I have taught you: discipline and patience.

Title: The Sun Pearl
Objective: Retrieve the Sun Pearl.
Text: Shu, the spirit of water, is eternally young, as are all the spirits of Shen-zin Su. I have been friends with Shu all of my life, but I no longer have it within me to play with him. I am old, and lack the energy. For all his complexities, Shu is simple to please: he desires friendship. When I returned to play with Shu each season, I would always bring a Sun Pearl as a gift, and then we would play together. You can find a Sun Pearl in the pools to the southeast. Perhaps you can be his new friend.

Title: Shu, the Spirit of Water
Objective: Coax Shu, the spirit of water, into a game.
Text: Shu, the spirit of water, is sulking in the deep pool to the north. Cross the rocks and then drop the sun pearl in the center of the pool. He will know what this means.

Title: Hey There Dalliah
Objective: A'dal has asked you to kill Wrath-Scryer Soccothrates and Dalliah the Doomsayer in the Arcatraz of Tempest Keep.
Text: Two powerful agents of the Burning Legion, Wrath-Scryer Soccothrates and Dalliah the Doomsayer, have begun rallying the demons on board together into a small army. You cannot let their forces grow any larger, or the Arcatraz may soon become yet another Legion stronghold.

Title: Finding an Old Friend
Objective: Speak to Old Man Liang at Liang's Retreat in the Singing Pools.
Text: It seems Shu, the spirit of water, had a play companion when he came to the pools throughout the years. An old pandaren we know as Old Man Liang. Liang moved away from the main town and stopped practicing in the pools some time ago. I am told he lives in a small house northeast of here, up the hill. Liang may know what has driven Shu away, and where the spirit might be found. Go to Liang. Ask of Shu.

Title: A New Friend
Objective: Water walk into 5 of Shu's Water Spouts.
Text: He wants you to play with him. Go for it!

Title: Unbound Darkness
Objective: A'dal has asked you to slay Zereketh the Unbound in the Arcatraz of Tempest Keep.
Text: We imprisoned the most dangerous beings we came across in our travels. Zereketh is a powerful void lord. If he escapes into Netherstorm, he will feed off of the abundant void energy.

Title: The Black Morass
Objective: Travel through the Caverns of Time to the Black Morass during the opening of the Dark Portal and speak with Sa'at.
Text: The Infinite Dragonflight have abandoned all pretense of subtlety. They plot to destroy the Guardian, Medivh, and prevent the Dark Portal from ever opening. While outwardly, this may appear a boon to the forces of the Alliance, it is in actuality catastrophic and will result in your world ending. You must venture through the timeway leading to the Black Morass. Go west and then south, past my future self, until you reach the tunnel that houses the swamp specimens. Cross over and speak with Sa'at.

Title: The Opening of the Dark Portal
Objective: Sa'at inside the Black Morass of the Caverns of Time has tasked you with defending Medivh until he succeeds in opening the Dark Portal.
Text: Here the Guardian Medivh feverishly works to open the Dark Portal. Scattered across the morass, rifts will materialize. Infinite will pour out of the rifts and attempt to destroy Medivh's shields and, ultimately, Medivh. Kill their rift lords and leaders until Medivh succeeds!

Title: The Black Morass
Objective: Travel through the Caverns of Time to the Black Morass during the opening of the Dark Portal and speak with Sa'at.
Text: The Infinite Dragonflight have abandoned all pretense of subtlety. They plot to destroy the Guardian, Medivh, and prevent the Dark Portal from ever opening. While outwardly, this may appear a boon to the forces of the Alliance, it is in actuality catastrophic and will result in your world ending. You must venture through the timeway leading to the Black Morass. Go west and then south, past my future self, until you reach the tunnel that houses the swamp specimens. Cross over and speak with Sa'at.

Title: The Reluctant Queen
Objective: Bring Sigryn before Eyir in Skold-Ashil.
Text: Wait, how is it you know about my parentage? Be careful what you say around here, there are those who would hunt me down if they knew my bloodline.I don't know who you are, nor do I believe I'm part of any prophecy. However, if you seek to undo the damage my father has wrought on the Tideskorn, then I feel obliged to assist you.Meet me in Valdisdall. From there we can make our way to Skold-Ashil and request an audience with Eyir. Perhaps she can shed some light on this prophecy.

Title: Arcane: Fate of the Tideskorn
Objective: Search Jandvik for the vrykul mentioned in the scrolls.
Text: A scout from Stormheim arrived yesterday with a significant discovery - these ancient scrolls. Within they contain a Valkyra prophecy of a new vrykul ruler - one who could turn the Tideskorn against the Legion.It complicates matters that this vrykul may in fact be Skovald's heir.Take the scrolls, find the heir, and bring her to the Valkyra. I think the outcasts they refer to are the vrykul of Jandvik, so that would be a good place to start.|cFF660000Specialization: Arcane Mage|r

Title: A Giant Problem
Objective: Destroy The Ship
Text: Destroy The Ship

Title: A Most Somber Task
Objective: A'dal has asked you to slay Warp Splinter in the Botanica of Tempest Keep.
Text: I must now ask you to complete a most somber task. Warp Splinter used to act as guardian to all of the Botanica. He is now impure, and must be taken down.

Title: Culling the Herd
Objective: A'dal has asked you to kill 6 Mutate Fleshlashers, 6 Mutate Fear-shriekers, 6 Mutate Horrors, and to obtain a Rapidly Evolving Frond from Laj in the Botanica of Tempest Keep.
Text: It seems that Kael'thas' forces have twisted the Botanica's specimens beyond saving. I do not want to see them unleashed upon Outland as so many others have. There is one, Laj, who I would like to examine. He is different somehow. Perhaps we can learn from him.

Title: Alchemist Korlya
Objective: Kill Alchemist Korlya.
Text: The zealots within the Garrison of the Fel are led by Alchemist Korlya. It seems likely that's the Felskorn Brewmaster Blanche observed poisoning our brew.Please kill her.

Title: Storming the Legion
Objective: Talk to Tak-tak to travel to the Broken Shore.
Text: I did my best to fight the demons off, but there were too many even for my skill...As I lay dying, I overheard the dreadlord commanding a Felskorn alchemist to contaminate my brew and then return to the Broken Shore.If you could acquire some of the poison, I'm sure we can concoct an antidote!

Title: Maul Gormal
Objective: Kill Subjugator Gormal in Camp Gormal.
Text: Thanks to you, there's a small militia of farmers hiding nearby. Hanae said something about giving them "liquid courage" which, I'm pretty sure, means they're sauced and ANGRY. The mogu think they can walk all over us - we'll give them a fight that will open their eyes. Follow the trail through the ruins and down to the beach. Find their leader. When you engage him, we'll be there to back you up.

Title: The Sting of Learning
Objective: Kill 6 Water Pincers.
Text: There are dangers in the pools. The latest and most vicious are the water pincers. A time has come for their numbers to be diminished, and I am no longer up to the task. If you could clear out some of the water pincers, I would be very appreciative. Beware their numbers... sometimes it's best to lure them from the pool-side rather than wading all the way in.

Title: The Challenger's Fires
Objective: Light your Unlit Challenger's Torch at the Brazier of Flickering Flame, then use it to light the 3 braziers near Master Li Fei.
Text: You're strong of mind and strong of will, but you lack the skills to face me in combat. You must fight with your body, but in truth, it is your character that is being tested. Let us even the playing field. Take this torch, light it in the brazier next to me, and then use it to light the three unlit braziers around the pool.

Title: The Lesson of the Balanced Rock
Objective: Defeat 6 Tushui Monks atop the balance poles.
Text: I require peace to perform my meditation. Practice your arts while I meditate on Shu's location. Other monks practice balance and combat upon the balance poles in the surrounding pools. Engage them and defeat them.

Title: Lost Treasure
Objective: Retrieve the Blinding Fury for A'dal from the Cache of the Legion in the Mechanar of Tempest Keep.
Text: I sense that one of my kind's artifacts has been taken and stashed away in the Cache of the Legion. We cannot give them time to discover its power. If you would kill the Gatewatchers and retrieve it for me, I would be most grateful.

Title: Stronger Than Reeds
Objective: Gather 8 Hard Tearwood Reeds.
Text: Gather me reeds from the nearby pools. Do not question why. Do, and then observe the results.

Title: Saving the Botanica
Objective: A'dal wants you to kill Commander Sarannis, High Botanist Freywinn, and Thorngrin the Tender inside the Botanica of Tempest Keep.
Text: Kael'thas' forces in the Botanica were unsuccessful in handling the numerous creatures contained within. We must take action to right their wrongs. The first step is to eliminate their forces so that they cannot cause further problems.

Title: From Bad to Worse
Objective: Defeat 8 Deepscale Tormentors.
Text: After their ship crashed, evil creatures swept up from the sea to pick through the wreckage. Our aid may seem but a drop in the pond at the thought of the misfortune they've faced today. Defeat their tormentors. These people desperately need our help.

Title: The Calculator
Objective: A'dal has asked you to slay Pathaleon the Calculator in the Mechanar of Tempest Keep.
Text: One more task yet remains. Pathaleon the Calculator oversees many of his master's operations. He is personally responsible for much of the recent torment that has plagued this world. I ask that you eliminate him.

Title: The Lesson of Dry Fur
Objective: Cross the balance poles and ring the training bell.
Text: Through meditation, I intend to find a route to locating Shu. In the meantime, you would benefit from practice and discipline. Your first task is the task of all trainees entering the pools: cross the balance poles to the west and ring the bell without falling into the pool. Should you fall, the pool's curse will make it difficult to get on a pole again, so you will need to return to the edge of the pool to start over. Oh, and beware the cranes.

Title: With Great Power, Comes Great Responsibility
Objective: A'dal has asked you to slay Mechano-Lord Capacitus in the Mechanar of Tempest Keep.
Text: The Mechanar employs my race's technology to create manacells, objects which provide great amounts of power. I need you to eliminate Mechano-Lord Capacitus so that Kael'thas' forces cannot harvest that power.

Title: A Very Special Cloth
Objective: Kill Warbringer O'mrogg and bring his warcloth to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
Text: Warbringer O'mrogg has killed more brave soldiers than any enemy I've ever encountered. He is ruthless, cunning, and extremely powerful. Take him down and bring me his warcloth so that we may fashion it into a banner and show them the fury of the Horde!

Title: O'mrogg's Warcloth
Objective: Kill Warbringer O'mrogg and bring his warcloth to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
Text: Stormwind wants to see proof of our successes in the war effort. Rather than showing him body bags, I thought we'd present him the warcloth of O'mrogg, Kargath's fiercest warrior. Think you can handle him?

Title: Turning the Tide
Objective: Bring Warchief Kargath's Fist to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
Text: There is only one true way to end the fel orc threat to Honor Hold and the Alliance. Their Warchief must be slain. Bring me his namesake weapon, so that we can always remember his death.

Title: The Will of the Warchief
Objective: Bring Warchief Kargath's Fist to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
Text: Kargath was once one of the Horde's greatest heroes. He now wears the false mantle of Warchief. Bring me his namesake weapon so that we can remember the champion he once was, rather than the monster he's become.

Title: Fel Ember
Objective: Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel wants you to bring him a Fel Ember.
Text: Caza'rez is dying a coward's death. Grand Warlock Netherkurse placed a terrible curse upon him. Perhaps if you were to bring me one of the embers from his braziers, we could use it to counteract the magic before it's too late?

Title: Honor the Dying
Objective: Caza'rez inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel wants you to kill 4 Shattered Hand Legionnaires, 2 Shattered Hand Centurions, and 2 Shattered Hand Champions.
Text: Their elite warriors are ruthless... so... powerful.  You have to kill them... or we will never defeat Kargath...

Title: How to Save a Life
Objective: Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel wants you to bring him a Fel Ember.
Text: Gunny is dying from a powerful curse. Grand Warlock Nethekurse augments his power with a pair of mystical braziers. If you bring me an ember from that brazier, perhaps it can counteract the dark magic?

Title: One Last Favor
Objective: Gunny inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel wants you to kill 4 Shattered Hand Legionnaires, 2 Shattered Hand Centurions, and 2 Shattered Hand Champions.
Text: Ol' Gunny doesn't have much longer... Do me one last favor, and kill the biggest, meanest fel orcs ye can find. For old times' sake, aye?

Title: Flying Colors
Objective: Report to High Elder Cloudfall at the Banquet Grounds in the Jade Forest.
Text: The Rumpus was your final test. You have mastered the disciplines taught at this monastery. Just as your training began with a banquet, so shall it end. High Elder Cloudfall should be waiting at the banquet grounds. I'll be right behind you.

Title: Find Spy To'gun
Objective: Locate Spy To'gun in the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.
Text: The Shadow Council has already killed most of our spies, but To'gun was foolish enough to escape only to go back in! You must find him. He may be reckless, but we need to find out what he knows.

Title: Trouble at Auchindoun
Objective: Report to Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth at Auchindoun in Terokkar Forest.
Text: I have spies within Auchindoun and they have been sending me disturbing reports. That place has been nothing but trouble ever since it exploded a couple of years ago. Something in there has gone horribly wrong - again - and the Shadow Council is now on a war footing. Though the reports were lacking on details, their preparations appear to be directed inward. You must make your way to the Shadow Labyrinth. My field commander, Mahfuun, will fill you in on what needs to be done.

Title: Flying Colors
Objective: Report to High Elder Cloudfall at the Banquet Grounds in the Jade Forest.
Text: Well, I've done all that I can with you. Sounds like the others have, too. High Elder Cloudfall will be waiting at the banquet grounds, ready to celebrate your departure. Not that we're happy you're leaving... he just enjoys celebrations.

Title: The Codex of Blood
Objective: Read from the Codex of Blood in the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.
Text: Two years ago the Shadow Council summoned forth a being that shattered Auchindoun in its wake. Read the Codex of Blood to find out what happened. Be warned, Grandmaster Vorpil guards it with his life.

Title: Into the Heart of the Labyrinth
Objective: Destroy Murmur and inform Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.
Text: The Shadow Council has lost control of the cosmic being that they summoned here almost two years ago. Known only as Murmur, it threatens to overrun the Shadow Council and break free into the outside world!

Title: Ambassador Hellmaw
Objective: Kill 12 Cabal Ritualists and Ambassador Hellmaw, then return to Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.
Text: When the Cabal found our spies, they fed them to Ambassador Hellmaw one by one. Our men deserve justice. Slay the ritualists binding him, then dispose of Hellmaw. It is a most deserving fate.

Title: The Soul Devices
Objective: Steal 5 Soul Devices and deliver them to Spy Grik'tha inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.
Text: They've been torturing me, trying to get me to tell them everything that I know. They fed the others to Hellmaw, and I was to be next. But I told them nothing! They're using special devices to make their summoning more powerful. You must steal these devices!

Title: UNUSED
Objective: Report to High Elder Cloudfall at the Banquet Grounds in the Jade Forest.
Text: Your training is over, young one. The cycle is complete. Thankfully, this particular cycle ends exactly where it started... with a banquet. I will meet you over at the banquet grounds. I will likely be dancing on a table.

Title: Adacic Grubs - REWORK
Objective: Stomp out 50 Adacic Grubs
Text: Your request to harvest wood does not seem unreasonable. There is something you can do for me, too.There is a species of moth whose grubs feed on trees. Normally their numbers are too low to cause damage, but once a century they reproduce in overwhelming numbers.They have just begun their mass emergence. All of my keepers are fighting the nightmare and cannot be spared. I fear I am unable to protect the forest giants on my own.Will you stomp the grubs out?

Title: Flying Colors
Objective: Report to High Elder Cloudfall at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.
Text: You have passed every test we prepared for you. It is now time for you to move on to bigger and better things. ...but not before another banquet. The High Elder will be waiting for you at the banquet grounds to celebrate your graduation from our monastery.

Title: Not Felling Well
Objective: Use Blanche's Still and then give the Curative Brew to 8 Fel-Poisoned Initiates.
Text: Let's see... Yseralline Seed for healing, Bruiseweed for curing poison, and Elemental Earth for disease resistance. Oh and just a touch of ground Felwort for attunement.Yes, I think this will counteract the Legion's poison. It will probably taste terrible, but what medicine doesn't?Hurry, Grandmaster . Our most stricken friends don't have much time left.

Title: A Brewing Situation
Objective: Direct the Stormstout Brewers to distribute Celebration Brew to the temple balcony, in front of the Laughing Crane, and near the troop training grounds.
Text: Greetings, Grandmaster. I'm an expert at producing tricky brews, and Almai and I have been working with Stormstout Brewery to craft Storm Brew for the order.In fact, we have already begun production!That calls for a party, don't you think? We brought enough of my prized Celebration Brew for everyone!

Title: An Urgent Situation
Objective: Find Meryl's visitor in the Hall of the Guardian.
Text: Archmage! We have an important guest. Please meet me in my chamber when you have a moment.

Title: Nature's Advance
Objective: Return to Rensar Greathoof in the Dreamgrove.
Text: , you must return to the Dreamgrove and bring the news of my attack. Tell the other druids that aggressions such as this will continue against us unless we find a way to stop the Legion. I thank you for the aid. I feel the fel energies leaving my veins, though it may take some time.

Title: Grovebound
Objective: Return to Rensar Greathoof in the Dreamgrove.
Text: Now THAT was some good stuff right there. Now that we've taken out the commander, the druids and the ancients should be safe for a while. Revenge was an added bonus. We should get back to Rensar and tell him what we accomplished.

Title: Edict of the God-King
Objective: Defeat God-King Skovald in Halls of Valor on Mythic difficulty.
Text: Our scouts send troubling reports from Stormheim. God-King Skovald has received a new directive from Gul'dan. In response, Skovald's forces have stepped up their attacks. We must know the details of Gul'dan's message. Despite his new orders, the god-king remains obsessed with the titan keeper Odyn. Intercept Skovald in the Halls of Valor and you may determine what his Legion masters have demanded of him.

Title: The Nighthold: The Eye of Aman'Thul
Objective: Aid Khadgar in transporting the Eye of Aman'Thul.
Text: The battle is won, but the war is far from over.In order to stem the tide of demons flooding into Azeroth, we must use the Pillars of Creation to seal the Tomb of Sargeras.That... might be difficult to carry.Perhaps I can use the power of the Eye itself to teleport it to Dalaran. I suppose there is only one way to find out!

Title: Between Worlds
Objective: Establish a portal to the Twisting Nether at the Stair of Destiny in Outland.
Text: Kruul boasts damnation, but his power has not yet fully manifested. His minions have taken his heart to hasten his rebirth in the nether. We do not have much time. Go to the place of Kruul's fall at the Stair of Destiny in desolate Outland, where the link to his soul is strongest. There you must pry open the way to his realm. I must prepare for the battle to come. Good luck, champion.

Title: Protection: Aid of the Illidari
Objective: Find Kor'vas Bloodthorn in the streets of Dalaran.
Text: Thankfully, we are not quite alone in uncovering the Legion's plots to infiltrate the city. Kor'vas Bloodthorn of the Illidari has taken to patrolling the city streets on her own to find the source behind the recent attacks. I do not entirely trust these 'demon hunters', but they have at least proved adept at their namesake. I suggest you find her and see what she has uncovered before the Legion strikes once more.|cFF660000Specialization: Protection Warrior|r

Title: Confirming Suspicions
Objective: Find Prophet Velen in Dalaran.
Text: That heart is the last remaining piece of Highlord Kruul - once one of the Legion's best warlords. Many years ago Kruul's armies nearly descended upon the Dark Portal to crush the Azerothian assault on Outland. We Illidari intercepted before he could strike. I fear that the Legion aims to use the heart to hasten Kruul's resurrection in the nether. We must find the Prophet Velen at once - only he can tell us for sure.

Title: Wailing Critters
Objective: Defeat the Budding Everliving Spore in Wailing Caverns.
Text: I'm glad you're here. Tiny wails have been heard in the caverns for some time since Naralex was awakened. At first, we suspected that some deviate critters had survived. Upon further investigation, we found them to be growing and multiplying beyond our wildest expectations. The corpse of Verdan the Everliving may have something to do with it, we're not sure. That's why we're sending you in. I've also seen suspicious footprints leading into the caverns recently. We may not be alone, be careful.

Title: Gathering Information
Objective: Question citizens in the Bank of Dalaran to find out what was stolen.
Text: The Legion has sent one demon after another to try to break into the Kirin Tor vaults in the city, but we don't know what they're after. Looks like they finally made it in. We need to find out what was taken, and quickly, before they get a chance to put whatever it is to use. Probe any survivors for information - I'll use my spectral sight to make sure there aren't still any straggling demons lurking about.

Title: The Nighthold: Lord of the Shadow Council
Objective: Defeat Gul'dan in The Nighthold.
Text: As we speak, Gul'dan is using the Nightwell's power to pull Sargeras into our world.Gather your companions and fight your way to the top of The Nighthold.I will prepare Light's Heart and join you when the time is right.Together, we will put an end to Gul'dan once and for all.

Title: Breaching the Sanctum
Objective: Speak with Oculeth to start the assault.
Text: It is time. Valtrois is ready to destroy the barrier guarding the breach in the Sanctum. I will teleport you to the breach, then it falls on you to secure the area. Take these telemancy orbs. If you find you need support, use them to summon Withered. We must strike before the enemy can ready new defenses. Let me know when you are ready and we will begin.

Title: Panic at the Brewery
Objective: Help Almai find Brewmaster Blanche and defend Stormstout Brewery.
Text: We were not prepared for a surprise attack. I fear Brewmaster Blanche has been captured, or worse...Please help me, Grandmaster!

Title: Severing the Sveldrek
Objective: Kill and raise 8 Sveldrek vrykul.
Text: So here's the order of things, as far as I've been told. Mortal walks into Icecrown. Mortal is brutally defeated. Mortal gets raised as Scourge. These fools can't expect to trounce in here, do whatever they want, and leave without any consequence. Time to make them truly as mindless as they act.

Title: Harnessing Power
Objective: Kill Andjor Dragontamer and retrieve Rimefang's Harness.
Text: These fools are using the power of Rimefang's harness to subjugate the frost wyrms. Their leader, Andjor, sits inside on the back of the broodmother and mocks us. He should breathe no longer.

Title: The Storm's Fury
Objective: Destroy the Burning Legion forces within Shield's Rest.
Text: No longer do we have time to prepare, the moment of action is upon us!Come with me, little one. With you guiding my aim we shall cleanse this isle by thunder and lightning!

Title: Xiao, the Eater
Objective: Challenge and defeat Xiao at the Tian Monastery.
Text: You may have already met my best student, Xiao, at the banquet tables. I personally would have graduated him several times over, but Instructor Xann insists that he needs more discipline. If you ask me, discipline means very little if you win every fight you enter. I'm curious to see if Xiao can keep his streak alive against you.

Title: The Highlord's Return
Objective: Defeat Highlord Kruul in the Twisting Nether. Speak with War Councilor Victoria to get there.
Text: I have a missive for you from Kor'vas, as well as instructions for getting you there. I can teleport you to them to begin the fight, but you will need some Nethershards to force your way into the Twisting Nether. When you have enough, speak with me and you can begin.

Title: A Test of Endurance
Objective: Report to Instructor Myang on the western side of the Tian Monastery.
Text: I have taught you everything that I can. It is time you spoke with Instructor Myang. The fights that she stages are less traditional than the sparring matches I am used to. Nevertheless, the path of a traveling adventurer like yourself is unpredictable, and a broad knowledge of fighting styles is an admirable trait. Farewell, and best of luck on the remainder of your training.

Title: Husshun, the Wizened
Objective: Challenge and defeat Husshun at the Tian Monastery.
Text: The jinyu are long-standing allies of the pandaren, and we welcome any of their kind into our monastery. Husshun, one of their elder shaman, is one of our newest trainees. His skills as a monk are mediocre at best, but he is still a fierce combatant. He should provide you with the challenge that you deserve.

Title: And a Heavy Fist
Objective: Slay 10 Greenwood Tricksters in the Waxwood Forest.
Text: The greenwood sprites in the Waxwood Forest to the west pose no direct threat to us, this is true. However, their numbers have increased as of late, as have their wily antics. Part of our duty as wardens of this forest is to maintain the balance. Your duty is to do so by returning these sprites to the earth.

Title: Zhi-Zhi, the Dextrous
Objective: Defeat Zhi-Zhi at the Tian Monastery.
Text: Upon the hills to my right, you will find a hozen named Zhi-Zhi. He, too, won enough sparring matches to move up the ranks. I think he will provide you with more of a challenge. Challenge him, and try to defeat him.

Title: Becoming Battle-Ready
Objective: Defeat 8 Tian Pupils in sparring matches at the Tian Monastery.
Text: Alright. I'd like to see what you're really made of. You'll find my pupils all over the monastery. Challenge them to fights. Push them to their limits. They have been instructed to do the same to you. Win or lose, you both will come out of the fight stronger.

Title: A Strong Back
Objective: Obtain a Boiling Cauldron from Mother Wu in the Waxwood Forest, then return to Groundskeeper Wu in the Tian Monastery.
Text: Some of our trainees have... larger-than normal appetites. We have occasionally had difficulty supplying enough food for all of them. In times like these, we have to ask for help. A kindly older woman, who lives in a small house to the northwest, has agreed to make some stew for our trainees. All you need to do is go and get it.

Title: Burning Bright
Objective: Slay 6 Waxwood tigers.
Text: Might I ask a favor of you, trainee ? Before I came to the monastery, I was a stranger to battle. During my time as a trainee, I performed adequately, but I was never placed in any real danger. Now, as a graduate and a wage-earning guard, I am expected to protect this perimeter at all costs. I can handle greenwood sprites, but the tigers in the western Waxwood are something different altogether. Would you mind taking care of them for me?

Title: A Proper Weapon
Objective: Obtain 6 Rattan Switches from the area around the market in the Tian Monastery.
Text: First things first, though. A proper trainee needs a proper weapon. And a scrupulous trainee builds his own... or at least gathers the materials. The switches which grow nearby should suffice for any respectable weapon. You'll also need to shop for black walnut extract to treat the wood. While you're there, get some ale, for...  ...well, you know what ale is for.

Title: A Steady Hand
Objective: Obtain 80 vials of Blushleaf Extract from Blushleaf Clusters in the Waxwood Forest.
Text: The black walnut extract you purchased from Miss Whiteblossom is but one of many extracts we keep in stock for various applications. Blushleaf extract can be gathered from the flowers in the Waxwood Forest to the west. Several units can be extracted from one flower, but only those with calm nerves and steady hands can remove all of the extract from one flower.

Title: The Rumpus
Objective: Set off the Monastery Fireworks in the Ring of Inner Focus, then survive the Rumpus for two minutes.
Text: Master Stone Fist has trained you in the art of one-on-one combat. Now you learn the art of one-on-many. How does fifty sound? Lower yourself into the Ring of Inner Focus below, then, when you're ready, set off this firework. My assistants will come at you, several at a time. All you need to do is survive.

Title: Groundskeeper Wu
Objective: Report to Groundskeeper Wu at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.
Text: We don't have many rules here, but we do have one particular rule that is worth remembering. If you want to eat...  ...you have to work. Groundskeeper Wu can give you your chores for the day. He's in the market, to the west.

Title: A Courteous Guest
Objective: Gather 8 Ripe Oranges from the orange groves south of Tian Monastery.
Text: I heard, I heard! The High Elder wants you to train with us! There's going to be a banquet for us, the trainees... and you should probably bring a gift, as a sign of courtesy. The oranges in the grove south of the temple are extra-sweet right now. Bring some back, for the banquet.

Title: UNUSED
Objective: Speak with the four High Elder spirits in Tian Monastery.
Text: I have but one task for you, and it is a simple one. I would like you to speak with the spirits of the high elders that came before Cloudfall. Their spirits have left their bodies, but they have not left this place. Go, speak with them, absorb their wisdom, and curry their favor. I anxiously await your return.

Title: UNUSED
Objective: temp
Text: temp

Title: Your Training Starts Now
Objective: Report to Instructor Xann at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.
Text: Hey, new ! Glad to see you survived the banquet! Trial One: Complete!  You'd better speak up with Instructor Xann. He'll be expecting you for your daily exercises.

Title: Perfection
Objective: Perform 12 practice strikes in the Monastery Training Arena by following the leader's example.
Text: Perfection can be achieved through repetition. Every single student in the training arena below will eventually perfect his or her form... assuming they don't give up first. This is a fact. I encourage you to join them. As an honorary guest of the monastery, you are not required to perform the requisite 10,000 daily strikes. Simply follow the leader's example for a few minutes.

Title: Tian Monastery
Objective: Speak with Lin Tenderpaw at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.
Text: People come from all over Pandaria to train at the Tian Monastery, just to the north of here. Probably because they never turn anybody down. They'll accept jinyu, hozen... or even a foreign  like you! My childhood friend, Lin, just joined the monastery's order a few weeks ago. If you're interested in learning how our monks train, maybe you should go talk with her!

Title: The Great Banquet
Objective: Speak with High Elder Cloudfall at the banquet grounds in the Tian Monastery.
Text: The banquet should be starting any time now. Go find the High Elder and pay your respects. I'll be right behind you.

Title: Attention
Objective: Destroy 2 Training Bags. Follow Instructor Xann's instructions to determine which bags to attack.
Text: Your next test also involves concentration and attention. I want you to practice your abilities on the training bags in the pit below. The bags are hung in groups of two. When I call out "Left", attack the bag on the left. When I call out "Right", attack the bag on the right. If you fail to follow my simple directions, this task will become much harder. Now beat on those practice bags until they burst.

Title: The High Elder
Objective: Speak with High Elder Cloudfall at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.
Text: How strange, to have such a foreign-looking  visiting our temple. Are you here to study? You... you look very strong. You wouldn't have any trouble getting accepted into the monastery. You should talk to the High Elder, up on the balcony above.

Title: Storming the Steamvault
Objective: Speak with Watcher Jhang in the Steamvault.
Text: We have not as of yet been able to stop the naga in the Steamvault, where most of their pumping infrastructure is located. Thankfully, the expedition I sent there is hard at work trying to change that fact. Will you travel to the Steamvault and offer Watcher Jhang and her crew your aid?

Title: Windcaller Claw and the Water Thief
Objective: Kill Hydromancer Thespia and return to Windcaller Claw inside the Steamvault.
Text: The Steamvault is the heart of the naga's efforts to pump the water out of Zangarmarsh, and Hydromancer Thespia personally oversees those efforts. Taking her out would seriously hinder their operation.

Title: A Proper Fate
Objective: Kill Warlord Kalithresh and return to Watcher Jhang inside the Steamvault.
Text: Warlord Kalithresh is in charge of the entire Steamvault operation. I need you to kill him. The naga have left us with no option but violence. Show him no mercy.

Title: The Art of War
Objective: Speak to General Nazgrim in Grommash Hold.
Text: Lok'tar ogar. I am Nazgrim. You are hereby ordered to present yourself at Grommash Hold immediately. All in service to the Horde are to swear an oath of allegiance to their new Warchief. Do not keep him waiting.

Title: Eyes of Desire
Objective: Dealer Vijad inside the Sethekk Halls wants you to bring him 3 Cobalt Eyes.
Text: I have a buyer who is interested in the eyes of the Cobalt Serpents that have taken up residence here. If you were to bring me some of these rare gems, I would cut you a portion of the profits. Do we have a deal?

Title: Containment is Key
Objective: Kill 3 Bog Overlords, 6 Coilfang Lepers, and obtain an Irradiated Gear from Mekgineer Steamrigger, then return to Naturalist Bite inside the Steamvault.
Text: The naga are working with leper gnomes to spread a horrific disease across Zangarmarsh. It's already spread throughout the Steamvault. Clear out anything that's been contaminated and bring me the central gear from Mekgineer Steamrigger, quickly!

Title: Allies in Dalaran
Objective: Accept a gryphon ride to Dalaran and speak with Isirami Fairwind at A Hero's Welcome.
Text: Welcome to Northrend. I have been asked to arrange travel for you to Dalaran so that you can meet with our allies there. Ride the gryphon to Dalaran and once you land, make your way to our inn there, A Hero's Welcome. Find Isirami Fairwind and speak with her immediately. She can help you bind your hearthstone to the city so you can use the Silver Enclave's portal to travel back to Stormwind quickly.

Title: Friends in Dalaran
Objective: Accept a ride to Dalaran from the flight master and speak with Uda the Beast at The Filthy Animal.
Text: Welcome to Northrend. I have been asked to arrange travel for you to Dalaran so that you can meet our friends in the city. Speak with me and accept a ride to Dalaran. Once you land, make your way to The Filthy Animal. Make contact with Uda the Beast immediately. She can help you bind your hearthstone to the city so you can use the portal in Sunreaver's Sanctuary to travel back to Orgrimmar quickly.

Title: The Art of War
Objective: Speak to General Nazgrim in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
Text: Lok'tar Ogar, old friend. It has been too long since last we spoke. It is good to see that you emerged safely from the depths of Vashj'ir. I am stationed here in Grommash Hold. All in service to the Horde are to swear allegiance to their new Warchief. You would do well not to keep him waiting.

Title: Brother Against Brother
Objective: Free Lakka from captivity. Return to Isfar inside the Sethekk Halls when you've completed the rescue.
Text: The Sethekk departed Skettis when Auchindoun exploded. My brother, Syth, was one of their leaders and told us we had to go into the ruins and face our god. In time, Syth had me cast out of the Halls for doubting them, but he refused to let me take our sister Lakka. Will you help me rescue her?

Title: Terokk's Legacy
Objective: Bring Terokk's Mask and Terokk's Quill to Isfar inside the Sethekk Halls.
Text: Terokk, hero of the Arakkoa, mysteriously vanished one day, leaving only his mask and spear behind. Darkweaver Syth still holds his mask and Talon King Ikiss guards his spear. It would mean a great deal to my people if these items were returned to us.

Title: Dark Memento
Objective: Bring Velonara's spare hood to Death Hunter Moorgoth.
Text: The flowers were... a nice gesture.  I have a spare hood. Nothing fancy, but perhaps Moorgoth would like to have it. Just don't let him get his hopes up or anything. I'm merely repaying a kindness. I would appreciate it if you kept all this between us. Giving presents to admirers falls a bit outside the dark ranger rules of conduct.

Title: We Must be Prepared!
Objective: Talk to Lady S'theno at the Illidari Camp on the Broken Shore.
Text: The Legion ships are gone, for now. It's only a matter of time before they attack again, and we must be prepared.We need to get going on repairs immediately! Lady S'theno took the lead on the search for parts. That one will do anything to remain on solid ground, ha!She is waiting for you on the Broken Shore.

Title: The Nighthold: Talisman of the Shal'dorei
Objective: Collect 4 Echoes of Time from Elisande in The Nighthold on Normal Difficulty.
Text: When the Nighthold was built, my people forged a talisman that allowed access to these halls. With the talisman's power, one could traverse the palace unhindered, taking the fight directly to the magistrix. Using fragments of the Nightwell's power, we could locate the talisman and end this foolish war...

Title: The Nighthold: Talisman of the Shal'dorei
Objective: Collect 4 Echoes of Time from Elisande in The Nighthold on Heroic Difficulty.
Text: When the Nighthold was built, my people forged a talisman that allowed access to these halls. With the talisman's power, one could traverse the palace unhindered, taking the fight directly to the magistrix. Using fragments of the Nightwell's power, we could locate the talisman and end this foolish war...

Title: Treasure Master Iks'reeged
Objective: Slay 1 Felwing Devourers.
Text: Board the ship then kill fel bats.

Title: The Nighthold: Talisman of the Shal'dorei
Objective: Collect 4 Echoes of Time from Elisande in The Nighthold on Mythic Difficulty.
Text: When the Nighthold was built, my people forged a talisman that allowed access to these halls. With the talisman's power, one could traverse the palace unhindered, taking the fight directly to the magistrix. Using fragments of the Nightwell's power, we could locate the talisman and end this foolish war...

Title: Fate of the Nightborne
Objective: Speak to Oculeth and meet Thalyssra in the Nighthold.
Text: Shortly after your victorious return from the Nighthold, urgent business took Thalyssra back to the palace. She has requested that you meet her there. Speak to me when you are prepared to join her.

Title: Touch of a Titan
Objective: Bring 50 Essences of Aman'Thul to Arcanomancer Vridiel.
Text: Harnessing the strength of the titans may be the only thing that lets us push back the Burning Legion. Bring me more of this power, and we will improve your odds of defeating Gul'dan.

Title: Dispersion of the Discs
Objective: Complete the trial to purge the excess energy from within the disc fragments.
Text: These discs are radiating with power! It must be their proximity to one another. We must take them from here should they resonate further and cause a catastrophe in these sacred halls. I'll send them to the one place I know where we can reign their energies in, preventing any sort of explosion. I'm speaking of the Eye of Eternity. There we will be able to safely finish what Antonidas was unable to complete. Speak with me again when you're ready to leave.

Title: To the Broken Shore
Objective: Head to the Broken Shore.
Text: We've received word from those fighting on the Broken Shore. It seems the source of the contagion can be pinpointed to a specific island off the western coast. Many of our allies have already been infected. We must work quickly to ensure that the contagion doesn't spread.

Title: Safekeeping
Objective: Take the Contagion Counteragent to Alonsus Faol in Netherlight Temple.
Text: It would seem that a delicate balance of holy and shadow magic is the key to curing this contagion. Obviously the remedy will need a bit of work to reduce undesired side effects, like dying. In the meantime, take the counteragent back to Netherlight Temple and keep it safe. I will work diligently on discovering the source of this contagion.

Title: Countering the Contagion
Objective: Counter the contagion by killing Ozzuk the Corrupter and destroying his fel spreaders.
Text: I have tracked the source of the contagion to these very shores. The Burning Legion are using fel spreaders to pump out infectious fel creep, causing anyone who comes into contact with it to become sick.Take out Ozzuk the Corrupter and his fel spreaders so that the contagion can be contained.

Title: Touch of a Titan
Objective: Bring 50 Essences of Aman'Thul to Arcanomancer Vridiel.
Text: Oh my! You've managed to acquire an item of legend to carry on your adventures. I've long theorized that such items draw their power directly from the titans, and this may prove to be a chance to test such speculation! It is said that the Nightwell draws power from the Eye of Aman'Thul, and after centuries in close proximity I believe that titan's power now dwells within the inhabitants of the Nighthold. Bring me remnants of this energy, and I will empower your equipment.

Title: Crafting a Cure
Objective: Infuse the Untested Cure with magic before administering it to Roland Abernathy.
Text: I used what you gathered for me to craft what I hope will be a reliable cure. The only thing that's missing is some powerful magic, which I hope you'll be able to provide. The concoction is there on my alchemy table. Please hurry. Roland grows weaker by the minute.

Title: Mischievous Sprites
Objective: Use Dispel Magic on Soothoof Hillstriders to reveal Mischievous Sprites and collect their Shimmering Dust.
Text: It's a little-known secret that the dust sprites use for their various tricks has restorative properties. Some within the alchemy community balk at this claim, but they only refute it because they've never been able to get their hands on the rare ingredient. Sprites often shroud themselves in illusions to avoid detection. The nearby goats have a curious shimmer about them that suggests they may be sprites in disguise. Dispel whatever magic surrounds them to reveal their true form.

Title: Sampling the Source
Objective: Collect Contaminated Specimens from pools of Gaseous Fel around the western coast of Highmountain.
Text: My companion has fallen terribly ill, as you can see.He must have caught whatever these taurens had. Their entire camp has been wiped out!It appears to be fel in origin, and impervious to all known treatments.I've been working tirelessly to find a cure, but I don't think Roland here has much time left.I could use an extra hand. Some samples from the source should speed things up.Just be sure to avoid direct contact with the contagion. Levitate should be helpful.

Title: Shambling Specimens
Objective: Use Shackle Undead on Shambling Corpses in order to collect specimens with the Corpse Collector.
Text: This fel contagion appears to have three stages. The first is marked by a persistent, phlegmy cough. The second shows the skin turning a sickly shade of green. The third involves a complete transformation where the victim turns into a mindless corpse. It is within this stage that I believe the most information about the sickness can be gathered. I have a contraption that can safely store the specimens, but they will need to be shackled before they can be collected.

Title: Administering Aid
Objective: Apply the Contagion Counteragent to sickly Legionfall Fighters.
Text: Unfortunately, it would seem many of your allies have already taken to fighting on these fel corrupted shores.They will never be able to gain the upper hand in battle while so many are suffering from the contagion.Take the counteragent and use it to administer aid to your allies.Roland and I will handle the injuries here.

Title: A Curious Contagion
Objective: Find Aelthalyste in Highmountain.
Text: It has been brought to my attention that a rather curious contagion is spreading through a small coastal region within Highmountain. The local tribes have abandoned the area for fear of catching this ailment that currently has no known cure. One of our own was traveling through the area when her companion fell ill. She has requested the Conclave's assistance. Seek her out, High Priest, and do whatever you can to stop this sickness from spreading.

Title: Escape from Durnholde
Objective: When you are ready to proceed, let Thrall know. Follow Thrall out of Durnholde Keep and help him free Taretha and fulfill his destiny.
Text: I have plans for my people, stranger. One day, they shall overthrow their oppressors and rise as one. They will break free from the bonds that hold them and from that uprising shall be born the orcish Horde. We will leave when you are ready.

Title: The Darkmoon Field Guide
Objective: Do you have a copy of the Darkmoon Field Guide, friend? It's a most useful book to carry with you.
Text: Do you have a copy of the Darkmoon Field Guide, friend? It's a most useful book to carry with you. It can help you find and identify valuable artifacts throughout your travels in Azeroth. Its detailed descriptions make it easy to decide if you've found your five hundredth brass button or that rare treasure the Darkmoon Faire's collectors crave.

Title: Taretha's Diversion
Objective: Travel to Durnholde Keep and set 5 incendiary charges at the barrels located inside each of the internment lodges using the Pack of Incendiary Bombs given to you by Erozion.
Text: It was Taretha who created the original diversion at Durnholde, allowing Thrall to escape. Now the Infinite have captured Taretha. The diversion will not happen without our involvement. You must use the incendiary devices that I give you and burn down the internment lodges.

Title: Snap Judgment
Objective: Kill 16 Razorback Snappers at the Pools of Purity.
Text: These pools are very special: they nurture life like nothing else in Pandaria. Unfortunately this means they draw all kinds of attention from local fauna. Recently, dragon turtles have discovered that toadspawn pools are common on the tier just above us. They're running wild up there, trampling the lotuses and snapping at my workers. They aren't much of a threat on their own, but in groups they can be pretty nasty. Please, if you can spare your strength, help clear them out.

Title: The End of the Exarch
Objective: Kill Exarch Maladaar and return to the Draenei Spirit inside the Auchenai Crypts.
Text: Exarch Maladaar performs his unholy work in the deepest part of the crypts. He poses a threat to both of our worlds if he is not stopped. You must slay him for the benefit of us all, dead and alive.

Title: Hitting Them Where It Hurts
Objective: Steal 3 piles of Hellfire Supplies, then return to Advance Scout Chadwick in Hellfire Ramparts.
Text: The fel orcs have stockpiled many of their supplies here. Stealing them would be a severe blow to their war effort and a great boon to ours. Are you up to the task?

Title: Everything Will Be Alright
Objective: Greatfather Aldrimus standing outside the Auchenai Crypts of Auchindoun has asked that you enter the Auchenai Crypts and speak with the Draenei Spirit.
Text: You've had quite an adventure. And before you've even set foot inside of the Auchenai Crypts. I am one of the fortunate spirits. I was neither bound to Levixus nor a part of Exarch Maladaar's vile experiments in necromancy. While you have destroyed Levixus, Maladaar lives on, continuing to torment the spirits inside the crypts. What I ask is simple. Enter the Auchenai Crypts and speak with the Draenei Spirit there. You must destroy Exarch Maladaar.

Title: The End of the Exarch
Objective: Kill Exarch Maladaar and return to the Draenei Spirit inside the Auchenai Crypts.
Text: Exarch Maladaar performs his unholy work in the deepest part of the crypts. He poses a threat to both of our worlds if he is not stopped. You must slay him for the benefit of us all, dead and alive.

Title: Hitting Them Where It Hurts
