Objective: Steal 3 piles of Hellfire Supplies, then return to Stone Guard Stok'ton in Hellfire Ramparts.
Text: The fel orcs have stockpiled many of their supplies here. Stealing them would be a severe blow to their war effort and a great boon to ours. Are you up to the task?

Title: The Dead Watcher
Objective: Kill Shirrak the Dead Watcher, then return to the Draenei Spirit.
Text: A terrifying otherworldly being haunts both the spirit and physical worlds. We call it Shirrak. It can only be harmed in your realm. Please help rid us of this nightmare.

Title: Raging Spirits
Objective: Slay 5 Angered Skeletons, 5 Raging Skeletons, and 3 Auchenai Necromancers, then return to the Tormented Soulpriest in Auchenai Crypts.
Text: The Auchenai have turned their backs on everything we used to stand for. They've taken to raising the dead as unholy minions! This cannot stand. Put the spirits back to rest, and massacre those responsible for raising them into undeath.

Title: Eckert the Mad
Objective: Speak with Artificer Morphalius in the Mana Tombs in Auchindoun.
Text: I'm a skilled engineer, a brilliant inventor, the heart of any party, and the best dancer Azeroth has ever seen. Do they call me those things? No. But you have one run-in with an ethereal and all of the sudden everyone and their mother calls you "the mad". I saw one right here just yesterday, I swear it! He said if I followed him to the Mana Tombs in Auchindoun there would be vast treasure and ancient knowledge awaiting me!

Title: Unbound
Objective: Set 10 Captured Nectarbreeze Farmers free in Camp Gormal.
Text: Can you see them? Farmers from the orchard, tied up and under inspection. Being hauled off in chains. The mogu value strength above all else. Anyone deemed fit for work will be sent to toil under their cruel whips. As for the others, well... Let's not waste any more time.

Title: Spitfire
Objective: Use the Nectarbreeze Cider to put out 12 fires around Nectarbreeze Orchard.
Text: We've tended these orchards and made cider from their nectar for generations. In that time, we've learned a special trick for putting out fires in a pinch.  The cider itself - when mixed with crushed gingerleaf and saliva - quickly becomes sticky and viscous. Perfect for smothering flames. Please, while you're out there, try to get the flames under control. I've already mixed in the gingerleaf, just swig and spit.

Title: The Splintered Path
Objective: Follow the path of fallen trees from the northwest corner of Nectarbreeze Orchard and find the mogu raiders camp.
Text: First... before the war-cries... we heard the trees. Groaning, creaking, and finally crashing down as the mogu cut their way through the woods. They were making the return trip easier... They're dragging our friends back down that path, to the ruins west of the village! Those ruins have been empty for years - our children play there. Why would the mogu come back to them now?

Title: Grek's Crazy Night
Objective: Speak with Artificer Morphalius in the Mana Tombs in Auchindoun.
Text: Grek had bad night last night. Shiny mummy man came into Grek's house and told Grek that he had to go to Mana Tombs in Auchindoun. But Grek still trying to read wanted poster!  Grek knows! You go find shiny mummy man and tell him Grek sent you. It perfect plan!

Title: Kill Mogu Firestarters
Objective: Kill 8 Mogu Firestarters in Nectarbreeze Orchard.
Text: As if the attack weren't bad enough, the mogu are setting these ancient orchards ablaze. I cannot understand what they hope to achieve, but we must stop them. Clear out the orchard so these people have a livelihood to return to.

Title: An Air of Worry
Objective: Speak with Shao the Defiant at Nectarbreeze Orchard.
Text: My sight has long since faded, but when the wind is right I can still smell the blossoms of Nectarbreeze Orchard as if they were in my own palm. Today, though, their fragrance is muddled with smoke. Please, if you are able, check in on the orchard and see that things are okay. Perhaps my old nose is playing tricks on me. You'll find the orchard to the southwest, beyond the statue of the Jade Serpent.

Title: Rally the Survivors
Objective: Speak with 5 Nectarbreeze Farmers around Nectarbreeze Orchard and send them to the safehouse.
Text: The people of this village are simple farmers - not fighters like you and I. Still, they are stubbornly defending their homes as best they can. Search the village for anyone still on their feet and tell them to rally here at Hanae's place.

Title: Defiance
Objective: Kill 8 Gormali Raiders and 8 Gormali Incinerators in Nectarbreeze Orchard.
Text: The damn mogu hit us out of nowhere! Anyone they don't kill on sight is being dragged away into the woods. This is the only safehouse, and its all I can do to hold the door. What do you say, friend? Are you willing to stand up and fight for the weak?

Title: Orchard-Supplied Hardware
Objective: Retrieve 6 Orchard Tools from Nectarbreeze Orchard.
Text: They may not be weaponmasters, but many of these farmers can wield a simple hoe or a rake as an extension of their own will. That mastery coupled with the right motivation could muster a force capable of standing against the mogu. If you can bring back some tools from the orchard, I'll distribute them to anyone willing to fight.

Title: The Golden Dream
Objective: Bring a Sprig of Dreamleaf to Yan in New Cifera.
Text: Ashyo must have experienced what we call the golden dream. Many of us working here have seen it, too - often after a long day of toiling in the pools. It is said this vision--and the feeling of elation it brings--is a reward to the mind for working the body. There IS an easier way, though we rarely resort to it anymore: a tea can be brewed using lotus root and dreamleaf, which grows around the shrine on the upper tier. Bring the dreamleaf to Yan back in town and he can brew the tea for you.

Title: Ashyo's Vision
Objective: Speak with Ashyo at the Pools of Purity and observe his ritual.
Text: Have a look at that!  This must be the water supply for the whole valley! Think about it: the pandaren use this water to grow vegetables the size of a house. Where could it come from? What is so special about it? The elders among my people know a technique for speaking with the water and divining the future. Perhaps this same technique can provide insight into the water's source... It's worth a shot at least!

Title: Intriguing Specimens
Objective: Bring Pandemonius' Essence and Tavarok's Heart to Mamdy the "Ologist".
Text: There is a creature not far inside these halls called Pandemonius who is able to twist void energies to sustain and empower itself. A bit further in lies Tavarok, a being that takes those same void energies and converts them into a crystalline structure stronger than any I've ever seen! I absolutely must obtain samples for further study.

Title: Safety Is Job One
Objective: Artificer Morphalius wants you to kill 10 Ethereal Crypt Raiders, 5 Ethereal Sorcerers, 5 Nexus Stalkers and 5 Ethereal Spellbinders.
Text: Shaffar's ethereals have completely blocked us out of the Mana-Tombs. Thankfully, I've got a plan. While we can't go in through the front door, there are sure to be several transporters inside. I want you to clear the way for my crew first and then I want you to activate one of their transporters to teleport us inside. Activate the teleporter in the chamber right before Shaffar's chambers when the way has been cleared. Don't worry, I'll make it worth your while...

Title: Undercutting the Competition
Objective: Bring Shaffar's Wrappings to Artificer Morphalius.
Text: With his ward in place and his forces ready, Nexus-Prince Shaffar has been able to pillage this place for all it's worth without so much as an ounce of trouble. Unsurprisingly, Nexus-Prince Haramad isn't pleased by this, and has placed a hefty bounty on Shaffar's head.

Title: Defending the Wilds
Objective: Speak with Watcher Jhang in the Underbog.
Text: The Earthen Ring often finds itself working closely with the druids of the Cenarion Circle. Now is one such time. Travel north to the Underbog and speak with Watcher Jhang. She is in charge of an expedition in the Coilfang Reservoir to stop the naga there and save Zangarmarsh.

Title: Safety is Job One
Objective: Kill 10 Ethereal Crypt Raiders, 5 Ethereal Sorcerers, 5 Nexus Stalkers, and 5 Ethereal Spellbinders, then return to Artificer Morphalius.
Text: It's nearly safe for our men to come in here and take what's rightfully ours. The real danger now is Shaffar's personal army that he has crawling all over this place. I need you to take care of his forces for me while I regain my strength.

Title: A Necessary Evil
Objective: Kill Hungarfen, then report back to Naturalist Bite.
Text: Hungarfen and Quagmirran used to jointly rule over the spore giants. With Quagmirran gone, the burden rests solely on Hungarfen's tendrils. We have no choice but to put the giant down before he can be enslaved and turned into a weapon.

Title: Warlord Kalithresh's Prized Possession
Objective: Kill Ghaz'an and bring his scale to Watcher Jhang.
Text: Warlord Kalithresh has been utilizing the Underbog as a sort of breeding ground for Ghaz'an, a powerful hydra that he plans to unleash upon Zangarmarsh once it is fully grown. I fear nobody will be able to stop the naga if the beast reaches its full size. Find Ghaz'an and slay him for the good of us all.

Title: Stalk the Stalker
Objective: Bring the Brain of the Black Stalker to T'shu.
Text: The spore giants may be attacking my people today, but the marsh walkers have taken more innocent lives than any creature I've ever seen. They are our ancient enemies. Their brood mother, the Black Stalker, resides deep within this bog. If you were to destroy her and bring me her brain as proof, I would tell tales of your bravery to my grandchildren.

Title: Defense of the Fel Hammer
Objective: Use the Illidari Gateway to return to the Fel Hammer.
Text: We need to get back to the Fel Hammer ASAP!

Title: Return to Acherus
Objective: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine in Acherus.
Text: You've grown a lot since we last met. Now that we have the harness, let's see if Mograine has a plan to use it.

Title: Rescuing the Expedition
Objective: Discover what happened to Earthbinder Rayge and Windcaller Claw. Then, return to Watcher Jhang.
Text: The last members of my expedition are somewhere in here. We're going to need the knowledge they've gathered and their skills if we're to have any chance at defeating the naga. See if you can find Earthbinder Rayge and Windcaller Claw, and make sure they're ok.

Title: Scouting Party
Objective: Find Lady S'theno and 10 Illidari Scouts.
Text: We will have our work cut out for us finding the missing scouts and Lady S'theno. I suspect that one does not wish to be found.Do your best!

Title: Operation: Portals
Objective: Close 3 Legion portals.
Text: This is a serious invasion, but nothing a Slayer like you can't handle. Time to put those weapons to work!

Title: Fighting on All Fronts
Objective: Complete 5 missions from your Order Hall.
Text: We are nearly ready to siege the gates. Your efforts here have been monumental.But let us not forget that you are also the t. Your forces rely on you to command them. No single person can stand against the Legion.Continue your duty. Guide the s of Azeroth, and victory will be assured.

Title: You Beat the Ball of Meat
Objective: Take the scrap of hair to the Brawler's Guild.
Text: Your champions return with a scrap of bloody, tangled, and quite smelly hair.

Title: Stabilizing Suramar
Objective: Complete 10 world quests in Suramar.
Text: Elisande's plan has backfired. She thought to stamp out our rebellion by making an example of the Waning Crescent.Instead, she ignited the flame of the shal'dorei better than I ever could.We must maintain a cohesive campaign against Elisande and the Legion by fighting them in every corner of Suramar.Show the people that there is still hope - that there are still heroes willing to fight for them!

Title: Attacking the Darkness
Objective: Return to the Brawler's Guild.
Text: Your champions have returned looking somewhat shaken by their encounter with the Shadowmaster.

Title: Taking Charge
Objective: Talk to Kyra Lightblade and choose to fly down to Mardum.
Text: Mardum has been quiet for months. I wonder why the Legion is attacking us now? Could be in retaliation for destroying their battleship on the Broken Shore...We had better head down ourselves and save the day, don't you agree?

Title: The Heart of the Matter
Objective: Bring The Invader's Claw and The Slave Master's Eye to Watcher Jhang.
Text: From what Nahuud has told me, two mighty creatures, Rokmar the Crackler and Quagmirran, were among the first enslaved by the naga when they arrived. They helped to subjugate many of the native races of Zangarmarsh. Though it pains me greatly to ask you to do so, you must put them down.

Title: Jailbreak
Objective: Kill 10 Slingtail Fishrippers.
Text: Without healing, your friend Taylor will die. My village is just east of here, in the middle of the large lake. I will take Taylor myself, but the fighting is most dangerous in that direction. I need you to help clear a path through the hozen, so that I may run safely into my village. Can you do this?

Title: A Brother Betrayed
Objective: Kill Mennu the Betrayer, then return to Nahuud.
Text: My village was able to escape the naga onslaught at first. We would have all made it to Nagrand had it not been for my brother. He sold our souls for his own freedom. Now he works here as a slave driver, whipping his own brothers until their backs bleed. Make Mennu pay.

Title: Checking Up
Objective: Speak with Watcher Jhang in the Slave Pens.
Text: These marshes are beautiful, wouldn't you agree? That is, except for the naga forces draining the water away. I sent a small expedition to the Coilfang Reservoir to investigate the naga, and they haven't returned. I'm concerned that something has happened to them. Would you travel to the Slave Pens underneath Serpent Lake and find Watcher Jhang?

Title: Lost in Action
Objective: Discover what happened to Naturalist Bite and Weeder Greenthumb. Then, return to Watcher Jhang.
Text: You have to help me! We were sent here to investigate the various parts of the reservoir, but my friends haven't come back yet, and it's been a long time. That's why I need you to discover what became of them. Naturalist Bite and Weeder Greenthumb went this way.

Title: Freeing Our Brothers
Objective: Free 6 Jinyu Prisoners or Alliance Prisoners.
Text: You may be an outsider, but you and I have a common enemy in the hozen. Many members of my tribe are trapped in cages nearby. I have also seen your... Alliance... soldiers as well. I cannot leave without freeing my brethren, just as you cannot leave yours. The Slingtail hold the keys to those cages. Find the keys and free our friends.

Title: Against the Odds
Objective: Find the lost SI:7 agents.
Text: You and I are the only mission operatives who made it to base camp. I saw the other SI:7 eject over the forest to the north. You'd better go quickly and rescue any survivors.

Title: The Mission Continues
Objective: Speak to Nodd at Sapphire's End in the Jade Forest.
Text: The King's flagship went aground not far from here. Apparently, the ship signaled Anduin's safe arrival shortly after landing, but when they sent men to retrieve the Prince, he was gone. I want to investigate the wreckage for clues. Nodd and Sully are already at the crash site. Go east along the beach and see if they need help.

Title: The Missing Admiral
Objective: Find Admiral Taylor.
Text: Alright. According to the clues you found, that was Anduin's ship, and Admiral Taylor was the captain.And Admiral Taylor's last entry says he was going to fight off the hozen and protect the vessel after the shipwreck.The locals say these hozen sometimes take prisoners, and I didn't see Taylor's corpse anywhere among the wreckage. So you'll probably find Taylor at the hozen encampment to the northeast.Get going, we have no time to lose!

Title: Ancient Power
Objective: Collect 8 Ancient Hozen Skulls.
Text: Hozen skulls are prized tokens among my village. We use them to perform ceremonial rites, and the older the skull, the more potent its magic. Luckily for us, the hozen are careless, filthy beasts. They leave the skulls of their dead scattered among their huts and campfires. Collect these skulls for me, and I will reward you handsomely.

Title: Hozen Aren't Your Friends, Hozen Are Your Enemies
Objective: Kill 14 Hozen at the Wreck of the Vanguard.
Text: We've located an Alliance wreck to the south. Unfortunately, the locals have informed us that it's currently being scavenged by a group of creatures called "hozen."By pillaging our wrecked ships, these creatures have already shown that they aren't friendly. We can't have them taking spoils from our ships, stealing our supplies, and worse, potentially capturing or killing any survivors.Get down there and take them out! When you're done, meet up with Nodd Codejack, our SI:7 agent in the area.

Title: The White Pawn
Objective: Search the Wreck of the Vanguard in Jade Forest for clues about its cargo, and recover the Encoded Captain's Log.
Text: Alright, soldier. I've got a critical mission for you.Get down to the coastline south of here - in the cove there you'll find a wrecked Alliance vessel. I need you to search it and find out if it was the ship that was carrying Anduin.Then, recover the Captain's Log and see if it has any information on where we can find him.Since the log is from a military ship, it'll be written using a cipher - take it to Nodd Codejack afterwards. He's keeping watch on the wreck from the other end of the cove.

Title: Sunken Junk
Objective: Collect 8 Waterlogged Scraps.
Text: Hey ! The coast here is littered with scraps of tools and metal from the shipwreck. The ordinary person might think that this is junk, but I'm sure I can salvage most of it. I once repaired a submarine using only a bronze tube and a luffa! Get me some of the waterlogged scraps along the shore by the ship. I need them for my next project.

Title: The Path of War
Objective: Kill 12 Slingtail Treeleapers or Slingtail Mudseers.
Text: I see you want to save your friend. I can help you, if you will help me. First of all, it should be obvious that the fewer the Slingtail roaming around, the easier it will be to escape. Kill the hozen guards around us, and we will be one step closer to freedom.

Title: Grove Stalkers
Objective: Kill 8 Grove Stalkers.
Text: We're still trying to take stock of our crew after the fighting. I'm afraid many of them are stranded out in the woods, probably wounded and fighting to survive. We know that the forest to the north is full of vicious tigers. Go clear them out of the woods. You'll give more of our men and women a chance to make it back alive.

Title: Critical Condition
Objective: Revive 6 Wounded Pilots in Paw'don Glade. You can also use healing spells or bandages to revive them.
Text: We may have won the first battle, but a critical task still remains. Dozens of Skyfire pilots were shot down during the initial aerial battle. Without medical aid, their condition will deteriorate over time, until they finally perish. We are their only hope for survival. Go into the orchard and revive as many pilots as you can find. We will leave no one behind.

Title: Tipping the Scales
Objective: Kill 12 Hozen Ravagers.
Text: These blasted native monkey savages have been assaulting us since the day we put to shore! We were holding our own until they kidnapped half our men, including the Admiral. Just look at their numbers! They're endless, and we're standing on our last legs. If you're here to get us out of this mess, go help take down some monkeys. It's them or us!

Title: Saving Snowpuff
Objective: Collect 4 Gingerleaf for Snowpuff.
Text: Th-th-those blasted monkey hooligans d-d-dragged me inta these woods. I thot I were dunnert, but mah faithful Snowpuff came flyin' to mah rescue! She fought 'em off and then they all jumped 'er! Wot with them apes prowlin' around, she's...  ...she's done for! Wahaahaaaaaa! Unless... Listen , I saw Gingerleaf growing all over these woods. I beg ya, bring me some o' that healing herb and Snowpuff just might make et!

Title: Flightmaster Down
Objective: Speak to Donovar Murall in Veridian Grove.
Text: I've taken stock of the missing, and among them is Donovar Murall, our Flightmaster. He is not only a vital part of our crew, he is a dear friend as well. Please find him and bring him back alive.

Title: The King's Command
Objective: Find Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth in the war room at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
Text: Greetings. I have been asked to assemble a team for a high priority mission. Please come to Stormwind Keep immediately for a briefing with King Varian Wrynn. I will be waiting in the King's war room.

Title: The Mission
Objective: Report to Admiral Rogers on The Skyfire.
Text: Well, you heard the King. Admiral Taylor's last transmission came from somewhere in the southern seas. We will begin our search from the air! Locating the Prince - the White Pawn - is of critical priority. The Skyfire is fueled, supplied, and ready to depart. She and her crew idle in the sky just north of the harbor. Make your last preparations, then meet Admiral Rogers on the deck. We will depart without delay.

Title: The Blood Furnace
Objective: Speak with Gunny in the Blood Furnace.
Text: This war is far from over. We need to stop the flow of new recruits to the fel orc front if we are to have any hope of victory. Travel to the Blood Furnace and speak with Gunny, he's secured a small area within and I'm sure he could use your assistance. Be forewarned, Gunny is...unusual.

Title: Invading the Citadel
Objective: Speak with Stone Guard Stok'ton in Hellfire Ramparts.
Text: With the Legion to one side and the fel orcs to the other, Thrallmar is going to be overrun if we don't do something about it. Head west to the Hellfire Ramparts and speak with Stone Guard Stok'ton. He's in charge of a covert operation to start a Horde invasion on the entire citadel.

Title: Invading the Citadel
Objective: Speak with Advance Scout Chadwick in Hellfire Ramparts.
Text: With the Legion to one side and the fel orcs to the other, Honor Hold is going to be overrun in a matter of time if we don't do something about it. Head west to the Hellfire Ramparts and speak with Advance Scout Chadwick. He's in charge of a covert operation to start an Alliance invasion on the entire citadel.

Title: The Blood Furnace
Objective: Speak with Caza'rez in the Blood Furnace.
Text: Caza'rez awaits you within the Blood Furnace. He's already cleared out a small area and has our scryers hard at work figuring out what's going on down there. But I don't trust that scrying will be enough. I'm sure Caza'rez has plans in mind for a solid blade or two. I want you to go there and lend him your expertise in dealing with the fel orcs.

Title: The Breaker
Objective: Kill Keli'dan the Breaker and return to Gunny.
Text: So they've got this big ol' demon stashed away in this place, is what they're telling me. And there's an orc that's in charge of keeping him under wraps. Killing an orc is killing an orc, am I right? Doesn't matter what he did or what he's doin', orcs are always ripe for the slaughter!

Title: Collect Things
Objective: Collect 6 Stuff Tails for the Quest Wizard.
Text: The Quest Wizard demands Stuff Tails! Go now and fetch them.

Title: Take Care of It
Objective: Resolve the dispute any way you see fit.
Text: This looks bad... you'd better do something.

Title: Heart of Rage
Objective: Fully investigate the Blood Furnace and then report back to Gunny.
Text: As it turns out, the eggheads back at Honor Hold can't see much into this place. Bunch of lying lazy mages, is what they are. Either way, we don't really know exactly what's going on in here. So, you're going in to find out!

Title: Heart of Rage
Objective: Fully investigate the Blood Furnace and then report back to Caza'rez.
Text: We know that the fel orcs are growing their forces by infusing orcs with demon blood. I need you to venture deep inside these unholy halls and find out how that's happening. We can't risk sending an army into this place until we know exactly what we're dealing with.

Title: Make Them Bleed
Objective: Collect 10 Fel Orc Blood Vials and a Fel Infusion Rod for Caza'rez.
Text: The Maker serves the purpose of creating more fel orcs by infusing them with demon blood. My superiors believe that we may be able to reverse the process, but we need samples of their blood and The Maker's infusion rod before we can know for sure.

Title: Make Them Bleed
Objective: Collect 10 Fel Orc Blood Vials and a Fel Infusion Rod for Gunny.
Text: The Maker uses demon blood and a special rod to turn brown and green orcs into red ones. We'd like to see if we can take that blood, mess around with it a bit, and make it turn orcs of all colors into harmless docile lumps. You're going to bring me some samples of their blood so we can see. Don't forget to grab that rod!

Title: Mind the Gap
Objective: Kill Keli'dan the Breaker and return to Caza'rez.
Text: In all of the Blood Furnace, there is one area where our scryers cannot reach despite their efforts. This 'gap', as they've been calling it, is fairly large, and must be where Magtheridon is being held captive.. You must find the source of the interference and dispose of it.

Title: Return to Karazhan: New Shoes
Objective: Deliver the Box of 'New' Horseshoes to Koren the Blacksmith in Karazhan.
Text: Thus far my Karazhan cleanup project hasn't exactly been a rousing success. Time to try something new. New, as in new shoes... horseshoes, that is! A box of horseshoes was left outside the tower. It's a problem finding a delivery person willing to set foot inside... mortality rates being what they are. If you would, grab the crate and take it to Koren in the stables. Just be careful passing Attumen. The huntsman doesn't take kindly to outsiders.

Title: Return to Karazhan: High Stress Hiatus
Objective: Help Darius soothe the old casts egos by finding a Positive Review amongst the audience members to simmer tensions between Romulo and Julianne, stealing a Bouquet of Roses from one of the new acts for Tinhead's vanity and finding where the understudy stashed Little Red's cape in the Chess room.
Text: The new plays in the opera house have been well received by everyone... except cast members of the older shows. Egos are bruised and tensions are running high! Romulo and Julianne are ready to poison each other. Tinhead is rusting with tears over his lack of adoration. Little Red's cape was stolen by a disgruntled understudy, who ran off to play chess of all things. Actors, am I right? We need them ready to perform in case the audience demands a revival. Please, help me calm their nerves!

Title: No Bones About It
Objective: Take the Charred Bone Fragments to Darius.
Text: The Charred Bone Fragments still smolder with ancient power. Darius would be extremely interested in examining them and hearing of your defeat of Nightbane.

Title: Return to Karazhan: Rebooting the Cleaner
Objective: Disable the Curator and find the Box of Spare Motivator Crystals.
Text: The Guardian Medivh created the Curator to watch over Karazhan, but I fear the unit is behaving erratically. Prolonged periods of operation may have caused a malfunction. Please go up to the Menagerie and disable the Curator. Also, search the area for a box of spare motivator crystals and return to me. Even with my basic knowledge I should be able to replace its motivator, and we can enlist the Curator's help in cleaning up the tower.

Title: Return to Karazhan: Book Wyrms
Objective: Clean up the Karazhan Library.
Text: My incorporeal condition has allowed me to enter the tower safely for the first time. I must say, it's a bit of a shambles in there! I could use some help tackling my cleaning checklist. We should start with the library. All those musty tomes are bound to attract mana wyrms! Please shelve any books that have fallen to the floor, or worse, taken flight. And if you find mana wyrms nibbling at the pages... step on them!

Title: Return to Karazhan: Clearing Out the Cobwebs
Objective: Clean out spiders from the Servant's Quarters.
Text: I admit it... even as a spirit, I am deathly afraid of spiders. All those legs! Dripping fangs! Sticky webs coming out of their...  I'm sure a world-saving hero like you doesn't mind them, though. Which is good, since a whole brood of spiders has taken over the Servant's Quarters. You'll handle this, right? If you don't get them all, they'll keep multiplying.

Title: Insurrection: As Strong As Our Will
Objective: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
Text: In the wake of Elisande's attack, the need is stronger than ever to add to the ranks of the Nightfallen rebellion. Plans are in motion that may help with this in an unconventional way. Report to First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran for more details.

Title: Insurrection: Breaking the Nighthold
Objective: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
Text: First Arcanist Thalyssra sends word that her forces are ready. It is time for you to lead the attack against the Nighthold. Report to Shal'Aran in Suramar for details.

Title: Insurrection: Elisande's Retort
Objective: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
Text: The combined forces of the elves stand ready to begin their siege on the gates of the Nighthold. Report to First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran to begin the siege.

Title: Insurrection: March on Suramar
Objective: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
Text: First Arcanist Thalyssra has sent word: the time has come to launch our assault on Suramar. The elven armies of the Horde, Alliance, Kirin Tor and Nightfallen are assembled. They only await your arrival to begin their assault. Report to Shal'Aran and meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra and prepare for battle.

Title: Insurrection: Crafting War
Objective: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
Text: Refugees are flooding in to Shal'Aran, and many are willing to fight for Thalyssra's rebel army. They need weapons, training and help from anyone who can provide it. Go to Shal'Aran and lend your assistance.

Title: Insurrection: An Elven Problem
Objective: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
Text: The Alliance and Horde have arrived in Suramar. First Arcanist Thalyssra needs your help in providing an introduction. Meet with Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.

Title: Insurrection: Waxing Crescent
Objective: Speak with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
Text: First Arcanist Thalyssra has sent word: there has been communication from Ly'leth. Your help is needed. Journey to Shal'Aran in Suramar and lend what aid you can.

Title: Insurrection: Missing Persons
Objective: Speak with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
Text: First Arcanist Thalyssra has requested your aid in searching for her missing people. She has a lead from a very unexpected ally. Meet with her at Shal'Aran in Suramar.

Title: The Advisor and the Arcanist
Objective: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
Text: This new First Arcanist appointed by Elisande. This... Andaris. If she is as dangerous as I have heard, then Ly'leth may well be lost.I am sorry, I should not entertain such thoughts. It is just that we have received a troubling message.Help me distribute the latest batch of the arcan'dor fruit, then we will discuss the message.

Title: Insurrection
Objective: Speak with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
Text: First Arcanist Thalyssra has received dark tidings regarding the Nightfallen rebellion and requires your assistance. Journey to Shal'Aran in Suramar and meet with her.

Title: A United Front
Objective: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
Text: Our rebel fighters have been armed and morale is high - even the Alliance and Horde elves have ceased their squabbling.We are nearly ready to march on the city.Hand out this week's fruit, and then we can begin preparations.

Title: A Taste of Freedom
Objective: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
Text: We are as ready as we will ever be. Once we put Valtrois' plan into action, we can attack the Sanctum of Order and put an end to Andaris. She will never expect us to have trained our withered against fel magic, and her hubris will be her downfall.Come, let us feed the people one last time.

Title: Before the Siege
Objective: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
Text: So many years of my life spent studying within the Nighthold...Never had I considered that I would one day have to fight my way back in.Time is short. The battle will be upon us soon.Please, continue our tradition and feed another refugee the fruit of the arcan'dor.

Title: Feeding the Rebellion
Objective: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
Text: More nightborne flee Suramar every day to join our cause.Our ranks are swelling, and with the aid of great heroes like yourself and the armies of the Horde and Alliance, our chances have never been better.Help me hand out more fruit of the arcan'dor - each one is a life free from slavish dependence on the Nightwell!Afterwards, we shall speak on how best to assist our new allies in their siege.

Title: One Day at a Time
Objective: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
Text: Thank you for coming, outlander. It is good to see you again.I have a situation in the city that needs your attention, but first...Let us talk of hope.The fruit of the arcan'dor can truly free my people from the Nightwell. However, it only grows so fast. It will take time to distribute this cure.I think it only right that you help me pass out the fruit as it is ready. Please take this, and give it to anyone.

Title: Eating Before the Meeting
Objective: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
Text: Having Vanthir around has done much to lift the spirits of the people here. I dare say some have begun to relish their newfound freedom, even if they miss their beloved city.I will not rest until I can give it back to them.You and I have an important meeting to attend. Before we go, let us distribute more of the arcan'dor's fruit.I want people to know that although I must leave for now, I have not abandoned them.

Title: A Message From Ly'leth
Objective: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
Text: The arcan'dor bears fruit once again. Just in time, too - Ly'leth has sent us a message, and it seems she may have a lead on Vanthir. He is long overdue for this gift, assuming we manage to find him.Give a fruit to another citizen here in Shal'Aran while I finish decrypting Ly'leth's message.

Title: Continuing the Cure
Objective: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
Text: Given the events at the Waning Crescent, the refugees here are more eager than ever to receive the gift of the arcan'dor and be free of the Nightwell forever.Fortunately, the tree has borne more fruit. Again, I ask that you honor us by giving this fruit to anyone here in Shal'Aran.When you are finished, we shall discuss further developments within the city. Silgryn reports that Arluelle has proven a fine student, and the two are making progress in evacuating citizens.

Title: Dark Tidings
Objective: Take the Ominous Letter to Stone Guard Stok'ton.
Text: Giving the lifeless form of Vazruden the Herald the once-over, you discover a rolled letter, its seal yet unbroken. An elaborate "I" is pressed within the blood-red ink. Cracking the note open, the message that you read is most disturbing. Stone Guard Stok'ton will definitely want to take a look at this!

Title: Kill Stuff
Objective: Kill stuff for Questvendor.
Text: I really need you to kill some stuff for me. It's pretty important.

Title: Dark Tidings
Objective: Take the Ominous Letter to Advance Scout Chadwick.
Text: Giving the lifeless form of Vazruden the Herald the once-over, you discover a rolled letter, its seal yet unbroken. An elaborate "I" is pressed within the blood-red ink. Cracking the note open, the message that you read is most disturbing. $Advance Scout Chadwick will definitely want to take a look at this!

Title: Demons in the Citadel
Objective: Kill Omor the Unscarred and bring his hoof to Stone Guard Stok'ton.
Text: One of our scouts brought back unpleasant news. We've spotted a powerful agent of the Burning Legion in the ramparts! I need you to kill this demon before he has a chance to relay news of our efforts to his superiors.

Title: Demons in the Citadel
Objective: Slay Omor the Unscarred and bring his hoof to Advance Scout Chadwick.
Text: One of our scouts spotted what he thought was an agent of the Burning Legion somewhere in the ramparts. If that is true, then Honor Hold may be in grave danger of a combined assault! If you find this fiend in there, kill it on sight.

Title: War on the Ramparts
Objective: Slay Watchkeeper Gargolmar, Vazruden the Herald and Vazruden's drake, Nazan. Return Gargolmar's Hand and Nazan's Head to Advance Scout Chadwick.
Text: Hellfire Citadel's entire defensive network relies on the ramparts as a sort of early warning system. You need to take out Watchkeeper Gargolmar and Vazruden the Herald. Without them, taking the ramparts will be simple.

Title: Fanning the Flames
Objective: Retrieve a Fluttering Breeze.
Text: Strange thing about wind, it can be hard to wrap your hands around it. Best practice for me has been finding some sort of living wind. If it can punch you, you can punch it back, and it won't slip through your grasp. Head over to the Shrine of the Summer Breeze to the south and summon just such a living wind using this wind stone. Best it, gather a Fluttering Breeze from it, and come back over this way so that we can figure out what's next.

Title: War on the Ramparts
Objective: Slay Watchkeeper Gargolmar, Vazruden the Herald and Vazruden's drake, Nazan. Return Gargolmar's Hand and Nazan's Head to Stone Guard Stok'ton.
Text: Watchkeeper Gargolmar and Vazruden the Herald are in charge of defending these ramparts. If you take them out, their forces will be in complete disarray. Slay them both and bring me proof so the invasion can begin!

Title: The Lesson of Stifled Pride
Objective: Defeat 6 Huojin Trainees or Tushui Trainees.
Text: Facing a living opponent is a very different thing from the stationary targets in the yard. Living opponents strike back. There is the very real fear of failure, and sometimes, even death. You must have the courage to overcome those fears. Challenge the other trainees within the temple or down the steps below, and defeat them.

Title: Ji of the Huojin
Objective: Speak to Ji Firepaw in Wu-Song Village.
Text: Another of my most talented students is awaiting you in Wu-Song Village to the northwest. He is of a different mind than Aysa, but in their differences, they bring balance to each other. Ji Firepaw will instruct you on gathering the offerings for the spirit of fire. Trust in his wisdom.

Title: Eyes on the Prizes
Objective: Use the Darkmoon Craftsman's Kit to make 5 Darkmoon Prizes from Coarse Thread, Shiny Baubles, and Blue Dye.
Text: The games are more popular than ever, and that means we're giving out prizes faster than we ever have before! We're going to need more prizes, and fast. If you've some skill in leatherworking, I can give you a kit. You'll need to buy some of the pieces from any trade goods merchant in Elwynn Forest or Mulgore, but they're inexpensive. Are you willing to help?

Title: The Singing Pools
Objective: Speak to Aysa Cloudsinger in the Singing Pools.
Text: It is crucial that we bring all of the three remaining spirits back safely. I am too old to do this myself, and for all their strengths, both Aysa and Ji are single-minded in their ideals. You possess all the qualities of a hero, and a balance that they do not. It is you that must do this. Shu, the spirit of water is somewhere in the singing pools to the east. Find Aysa there and work with her to locate him. We are all depending on you.

Title: Writing the Future
Objective: Use the Bundle of Exotic Herbs to make Prophetic Ink and then combine the ink with Light Parchment to create Sayge's Fortunes.
Text: As the popularity of the Darkmoon Faire grows, more and more people seek me out to peer into their futures. Most times, they ask for knowledge best left hidden in the mists of time, but it is not my place to give such advice. My stock of written fortunes is running low and you look to have a steady hand. Take these herbs, make ink from them, and pen a few fortunes for me. You can get the parchment you'll need from any trade goods vendor in Elwynn Forest or Mulgore.

Title: Rearm, Reuse, Recycle
Objective: Collect 6 pieces of Tonk Scrap from around the Darkmoon Faire grounds.
Text: Faire-goers just love the steam tonks! And when the Darkmoon Faire closes, these grounds will be littered with tonk scrap. It'd be a shame to let all that good metal just sit in the dirt. If you help me collect some of the larger scraps, I can use them to reforge broken tonk parts. It's a lot less expensive than buying new metal every time. What do you say?

Title: Tan My Hide
Objective: Scrape 4 Staked Skins around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire.
Text: The Darkmoon Faire always needs more leather for tents, boots, and just about anything you can imagine! I've trapped some creatures and staked the skins out for the next part of their treatment. You seem to have some knowledge of skinning. I'll reward you if you help me with the job of scraping some of those new skins.

Title: Banners, Banners Everywhere!
Objective: Use Coarse Thread, Red Dye, and Blue Dye with a Darkmoon Banner Kit to make a Darkmoon Banner, then set it up in a pile of Loose Stones on the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire.
Text: Isn't it wonderful to see Darkmoon banners everywhere? It's my favorite part of setting up, but we have so many old and tattered ones that need to be replaced. If you've some skill with a needle and thread, would you mind making a banner from this kit and putting it up in some loose stones scattered around the grounds of the faire? It's missing a few pieces, but you should be able to get what you need from any trade goods vendor in Elwynn Forest or Mulgore.

Title: Keeping the Faire Sparkling
Objective: Find Bits of Glass around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire and craft it into 5 Sparkling 'Gemstones'.
Text: The Darkmoon Faire's performers and animals go through more jewelry than I'd ever imagined. Thankfully, the gems are just cut glass, but someone has to craft all of it. If you've some skill as a jewelcrafter, perhaps you'd be willing to help craft some of the sparkling glass gems for our performers. Sometimes you can find odd and amazing bits of glass around the grounds. Those make stunning gems when cut by someone with an eye for this craft.

Title: Herbs for Healing
Objective: Gather 6 Darkblossoms from around the Darkmoon Faire grounds.
Text: The little purple flowers that grow wild around the grounds aren't just pretty. They play a role in everything from treating wounds to seasoning food. You seem to have some talent for harvesting herbs. Would you like to help me rebuild my stocks of darkblossom?

Title: Spoilin' for Salty Sea Dogs
Objective: Catch 5 Great Sea Herring in the ocean around Darkmoon Island.
Text: We've just introduced another exciting new menu item, the salty sea dog. It's so popular, we can barely keep up with the demand! You look like a decent angler and a spry . Would you help me restock my fish supplies? We wouldn't want to disappoint all those faire-goers looking to try a new food, would we?

Title: Putting the Crunch in the Frog
Objective: Prepare 5 Crunchy Frogs by breading your Plump Frogs with Simple Flour and then frying them in the cauldron behind Stamp Thunderhorn.
Text: The Darkmoon Faire's crunchy frog is famous all over Azeroth! We've just had a fresh batch of frogs delivered. How'd you like to help whip up a few and practice your cooking skills in the process? You can get the flour you'll need to bread the frogs from any trade goods vendor in Elwynn Forest or Mulgore.

Title: Putting Trash to Good Use
Objective: Collect 6 Soothsayer's Dusts by disenchanting Discarded Weapons found around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire.
Text: People don't just come to the faire for fun and fortunes. Most want something to take home with them, so I help to create the magical trinkets visitors purchase with their prize tickets. For that, I need a steady supply of soothsayer's dust. Take a look around the grounds and you'll see a lot of discarded weapons. Those are just the kinds of items that can be broken down into dust with enchanting skills like yours. Would you like to help?

Title: Fun for the Little Ones
Objective: Bring 15 Fossil Fragments collected with Archaeology to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire.
Text: Children are always full of questions about what an archaeologist does and how it works, so I prepared a demonstration for them. I take artifacts and fossils and bury them in the sandbox beside the tent. The children get to dig and make their own discoveries, learn how bones fit together, and see how archaeology can teach them about history. If you have any spare fossils, would you consider donating them to my side project?

Title: Putting the Carnies Back Together Again
Objective: Use the Darkmoon Bandage to heal 4 Injured Carnies.
Text: Working the Darkmoon Faire is a dangerous job. It's no surprise that many of our workers get injured setting up, taking down, and transporting all of its attractions. Some of the injured workers can be found around here, near the wagons. Others have gone to the healing tent for treatment. Would you take these bandages and see if you can help any of the injured workers?

Title: A Fizzy Fusion
Objective: Use the Cocktail Shaker to combine Moonberry Juice and Fizzy Faire Drink to create 5 servings of Moonberry Fizz.
Text: I'm sure you've made a lot of potions in your time as an alchemist. How would you like to help with something a bit more light-hearted? I've always wanted to try creating a fruit-flavored version of our popular fizzy drinks. If you're willing to give it a try, you can buy some of the base drink from me and mix it with some moonberry juice. Any innkeeper in Elwynn Forest or Mulgore should be able to sell you enough juice to make your creation.

Title: Fun for the Little Ones
Objective: Bring 15 Fossil Fragments to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire.
Text: Children are always full of questions about what an archaeologist does and how it works, so I prepared a demonstration for them. I take artifacts and fossils and bury them in the sand behind the tent. The children get to dig and make their own discoveries, learn how bones fit together, and see how archaeology can teach them about history. If you have any spare fossils, would you consider donating them to my side project?

Title: Talkin' Tonks
Objective: Repair 5 Damaged Steam Tonks around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire.
Text: The steam tonks are one of the Darkmoon Faire's most popular amusements. Our visitors love to test their skills for hours and hours, but the tonks take a real beating from all that fun. You look like you know your way around a wrench. Mind helping me fix some of the damaged tonks and return them to working order? I'll compensate you for your time.

Title: Baby Needs Two Pair of Shoes
Objective: Use the Iron Stock to craft 4 Horseshoes, then apply the Horseshoes to Baby at the Darkmoon Faire.
Text: You may have seen my horse, Baby, over near the wagons. She pulls the cart that hauls some of the animals in our Zoo Bizarre. She's a hard worker and she tears through shoes like you wouldn't believe. It's about time for a new set. I've already bought the raw materials. All you need to do is shape them over an anvil and apply them to Baby's feet. It's a quick job and worth some tickets, wouldn't you say?

Title: Putting the Crunch in the Frog
Objective: Prepare 5 Crunchy Frogs by breading your Plump Frogs with Simple Flour and then frying them in the cauldron behind Stamp Thunderhorn.
Text: The Darkmoon Faire's crunchy frog is famous all over Azeroth! We've just had a fresh batch of frogs delivered. How'd you like to help whip up a few and practice your cooking skills in the process? Shadi Mistrunner sells flour, up on the central rise in Thunder Bluff. Get some flour from her and use it to coat these frogs, then cook them in the pot behind me.

Title: Keeping the Faire Sparkling
Objective: Find Bits of Glass around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire and craft it into 5 Sparkling 'Gemstones'.
Text: The Darkmoon Faire's performers and animals go through more jewelry than I'd ever imagined. Thankfully, the gems are just cut glass, but someone has to craft all of it. If you've some skill as a jewelcrafter, perhaps you'd be willing to help craft some of the sparkling glass gems for our performers. Sometimes you can find odd and amazing bits of glass around the grounds. Those make stunning gems when cut by someone with an eye for this craft.

Title: Redundancy
Objective: Meet Aethas on the Broken Shore.
Text: A construct progenitor? What a creative solution to our problem!We probably could channel Kathra'natir's power without releasing him now, but I want to add another layer of protection before we try, just in case. I will not have anyone accusing me of subterfuge!Meet me on the Broken Shore when you are ready.

Title: Cubic Coalescing
Objective: Activate the Mysterious Cube
Text: Success! The cube's magic has been restored! I'm excited to see what it does!Since you did all the legwork, you should have the honor of activating it. Care to give it a try?

Title: On Daumyr's Wings
Objective: Ride Daumyr to the Broken Shore.
Text: The time is nigh. With these new dragons in our army, we are prepared for our assault on the Broken Shore. A large detachment of demons have appeared near one of our camps, and there are far too many of them for any of our allies to overcome. Who better to defeat these demons than those without fear of death? Those with quite the large secret weapon? Take Daumyr. We will meet you there.

Title: Making Preparations
Objective: Take the Death Gate near Highlord Darion Mograine, then meet Minerva Ravensorrow.
Text: Deathlord, we have uncovered an heirloom of great significance and power. Rimefang's harness has appeared in Icecrown Citadel. We must obtain it, rather than let it fall into the hands of others. I assume you'd like to retrieve the harness personally? We've sent one of our own, Minerva Ravensorrow, ahead to scout. You've met her before, yes? She has impressed us greatly, and we believe she can become quite powerful under your tutelage. I will open a death gate for you. It is best you meet her there.

Title: Return to Karazhan: Cubic Cynosure
Objective: Obtain a Mana Focus from the Mana Devourer within Karazhan
Text: Drat! The ancient mana doesn't seem to be working. I need to think the problem through, focus and... Wait, that's it! Focus! We need to focus the energy of the ancient mana to activate the cube. I've heard tell of a mana wyrm in Karazhan with the means to focus its powers. Might be just what we need! Watch out, though. My sources tell me this wyrm is humongous!

Title: Elixir Master
Objective: Bring a variety of flasks to an alchemy trainer in any capital city.
Text: Elixirs are all about potency! If you want to become an elixir master, I can teach you. I can't just train anyone, and I require proof that you are devoted before we continue. Several flasks should be sufficient to show your dedication. Remember , you can only learn ONE specialization, so if you complete your elixir training, then potion and transmutation specialization will no longer be available.

Title: Transmutation Master
Objective: Bring the requested materials to an alchemy trainer in any capital city.
Text: Iron to gold, water to fire... if you want to become an transmutation master, then I can show you the way. The training is very expensive, so you'll have to bring me some of the finest transmuted materials in the world. Remember , you can only learn ONE specialization, so if you complete your transmutation training, then potion and elixir specialization will no longer be available.

Title: Banners, Banners Everywhere!
Objective: Use the Darkmoon Banner Kit to construct a Darkmoon Banner, then set it up in a pile of Loose Stones on Thunder Bluff's central rise.
Text: Isn't it wonderful to see Darkmoon banners everywhere? It's my favorite part of setting up, but we have so many old and tattered ones that need to be replaced. If you've some skill with a needle and thread, would you mind making a banner from this kit and putting it up in some loose stone on the central rise in Thunder Bluff? You can get the rest of the supplies you'll need from Shadi Mistrunner on the central rise of Thunder Bluff.

Title: Gnomish Engineering
Objective: Bring 6 Mithril Tubes, an Accurate Scope, and 2 Advanced Target Dummies to an engineering trainer in any capital city.
Text: A skilled engineer can choose ONE specialization, and I can teach you the ways of gnomish engineering. You look like you know what you're doing, but I'll need some samples of your work. Bring me six mithril tubes, an accurate scope, and two advanced target dummies. Submit these items to an engineering trainer in any of the capital cities and you'll be an official gnomish engineer with access to all the schematics!

Title: A Fizzy Fusion
Objective: Use the Cocktail Shaker to combine Moonberry Juice and Fizzy Faire Drink to create 5 servings of Moonberry Fizz.
Text: I'm sure you've made a lot of potions in your time as an alchemist. How would you like to help with something a bit more light-hearted? I've always wanted to try creating a fruit-flavored version of our popular fizzy drinks. If you're willing to give it a try, you can buy some of the base drink from me and mix it with some moonberry juice. Galissa Sundew should be able to sell you all the moonberry juice you need.

Title: Gnomish Engineering
Objective: Bring 6 Mithril Tubes, an Accurate Scope, and a 2 Advanced Target Dummies to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
Text: If you're ready to make some truly fantastic devices, then you've come to the right place. And I can see you're a skilled engineer, but I want some samples of your work. What I hope to do though is to analyze your craftmanship for ways to emphasize gnome-oriented techniques in your future efforts. I need the following samples: six mithril tubes, an accurate scope, and two advanced target dummies. Submit these items to me and you'll be an official gnomish engineer with access to all the schematics!

Title: Putting Trash to Good Use
Objective: Collect 6 Soothsayer's Dusts by disenchanting Discarded Weapons found around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire.
Text: People don't just come to the fair for fun and fortunes. Most want something to take home with them, so I help to create the magical trinkets visitors purchase with their prize tickets. For that, I need a steady supply of soothsayer's dust. Take a look around the grounds and you'll see a lot of discarded weapons. Those are just the kinds of items that can be broken down into dust with enchanting skills like yours. Would you like to help?

Title: Goblin Engineering
Objective: Bring 20 Big Iron Bombs, 20 Solid Dynamite, and 5 Explosive Sheep to an engineering trainer in any capital city.
Text: A skilled engineer can choose ONE specialization, and I know the secrets of goblin engineering. You look like you're ready to blow things up, but I'll need some samples of your work. Bring me twenty big iron bombs, twenty sticks of solid dynamite, and five explosive sheep. Submit these items to an engineering trainer in any of the capital cities and you'll be an official goblin engineer with access to all the schematics!

Title: Rearm, Reuse, Recycle
Objective: Collect 6 pieces of Tonk Scrap from around the Darkmoon Faire grounds.
Text: Faire-goers just love the steam tonks! And when the Darkmoon Faire closes, these grounds will be littered with tonk scrap. It'd be a shame to let all that good metal just sit in the dirt. If you help me collect some of the larger scraps, I can use them to reforge broken tonk parts. It's a lot less expensive than buying new metal every time. What do you say?

Title: Herbs for Healing
Objective: Gather 6 Darkblossoms from around the Darkmoon Faire grounds.
Text: The little purple flowers that grow wild around the grounds aren't just pretty. They play a role in everything from treating wounds to seasoing food. You seem to have some talent for harvesting herbs. Would you like to help me rebuild my stocks of darkblossom?

Title: Tan My Hide
Objective: Scrape 4 Staked Skins around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire.
Text: The Darkmoon Faire always needs more leather for tents, boots, and just about anything you can imagine! I've trapped some creatures and staked the skins out for the next part of their treatment. You seem to have some knowledge of skinning. I'll reward you if you help me with the job of scraping some of those new skins.

Title: Putting the Carnies Back Together Again
Objective: Use the Darkmoon Bandage to heal 4 Injured Carnies.
Text: Working the Darkmoon Faire is a dangerous job. It's no surprise that many of our workers get injured setting up, taking down, and transporting all of its attractions. We send the most gravely wounded to the Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff for help, but many still have minor hurts that can be tended to here. Would you take these bandages and see if you can help any of the injured workers?

Title: Writing the Future
Objective: Use the Bundle of Exotic Herbs to make Prophetic Ink and then combine the ink with Light Parchment to create Sayge's Fortunes.
Text: As the popularity of the Darkmoon Faire grows, more and more people seek me out to peer into their futures. Most times, they ask for knowledge best left hidden in the mists of time, but it is not my place to give such advice. My stock of written fortunes is running low and you look to have a steady hand. Take these herbs, make ink from them, and pen a few fortunes for me. I'll see to it that you're rewarded.

Title: Eyes on the Prizes
Objective: Use the Darkmoon Craftsman's Kit to make 5 Darkmoon Prizes from Coarse Thread, Shiny Baubles, and Blue Dye.
Text: The games are more popular than ever, and that means we're giving out prizes faster than we ever have before! We're going to need more prizes, and fast. If you've some skill in leatherworking, I can give you a kit. You'll need to buy some of the pieces from a trade goods merchant like Shadi Mistrunner up on the central rise of Thunder Bluff, but they're inexpensive. Are you willing to help?

Title: Talkin' Tonks
Objective: Repair 5 Damaged Steam Tonks around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire.
Text: The steam tonks are one of the Darkmoon Faire's most popular amusements. Our visitors love to test their skills for hours and hours, but the tonks take a real beating from all that fun. You look like you know your way around a wrench. Mind helping me fix some of the damaged tonks and return them to working order? I'll compensate you for your time.

Title: Tools of Divination
Objective: Bring the Soothsayer's Runes to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
Text: This collection of well-worn runestones has seen much use. The pieces seem old; you can't recognize any of the markings on their surfaces. Perhaps a scholar or a collector would know more about them. Bring them to Professor Thaddeus Paleo next time you're at the Darkmoon Faire.

Title: Baby Needs Two Pair of Shoes
Objective: Use the Iron Stock to craft 4 Horseshoes, then apply the Horseshoes to Baby at the Darkmoon Faire.
Text: You may have seen my horse, Baby, over near the wagons. She pulls the cart that hauls all the animals in our Zoo Bizarre. She's a hard worker and she tears through shoes like you wouldn't believe. It's about time for a new set. I've already bought the raw materials. All you need to do is shape them over an anvil and apply them to Baby's feet. It's a quick job and worth some tickets, wouldn't you say?

Title: Plenty of Plump Frogs
Objective: Catch 5 Plump Frogs near Stonebull Lake.
Text: Just about everyone in Azeroth has heard of our world famous crunchy frogs. We can barely keep up with the demand! You look like a decent angler and a spry . Would you help me restock my frog supply? The ones that make the best crunchy frogs are the plump ones that live down near Stonebull Lake. I'll make it worthwhile for you.

Title: The Captured Journal
Objective: Bring the Captured Insignia to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
Text: This book is covered in battered leather stained with blood and mud. Leafing through the pages, you discover that it is a personal journal of a Horde adventurer with a high opinion of herself and her adventures. Professor Thaddeus Paleo of the Darkmoon Faire might want to see something like this.

Title: The Enemy's Insignia
Objective: Bring the Captured Insignia to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
Text: This battered badge carries the insignia of an enemy officer. While worth little more to you than the metal it's made from, this piece would have significant value to a collector of military memorabilia. Professor Thaddeus Paleo of the Darkmoon Faire is famous all over Azeroth for his large collection of military artifacts.

Title: Tools of Divination
Objective: Bring the Soothsayer's Runes to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
Text: This collection of well-worn runestones has seen much use. The pieces seem old; you can't recognize any of the markings on their surfaces. Perhaps a scholar or a collector would know more about them. Bring them to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire.

Title: It's Hammer Time
Objective: Score 30 points by whacking Gnolls.
Text: So you want to whack some gnolls? Well you've come to the right place. Your goal is simple, score 30 points in a minute. Use the mallet I give you and get ready to whack. Speak to me when you are ready to start.

Title: A Captured Banner
Objective: Bring the Banner of the Fallen to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
Text: This tattered banner bears a faded guild crest. This old banner must've seen more than its share of battles. Professor Thaddeus Paleo of the Darkmoon Faire collects banners and other relics of combat and he might be interested in acquiring this one.

Title: The Captured Journal
Objective: Bring the Adventurer's Journal to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
Text: This book is covered in battered leather stained with blood and mud. Leafing through the pages, you discover that it is a personal journal of an adventurer with a high opinion of himself and his adventures. Professor Thaddeus Paleo of the Darkmoon Faire might want to see something like this.

Title: A Captured Banner
Objective: Bring the Banner of the Fallen to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
Text: This tattered banner bears a faded guild crest. This old banner must've seen more than its share of battles. Professor Thaddeus Paleo of the Darkmoon Faire collects banners and other relics of combat and he might be interested in acquiring this one. Show the banner to him next time you visit the Darkmoon Faire.

Title: Your Time Has Come
Objective: Speak to Coridormi in Stormwind.
Text: Young , be still and hear my words. I am called to collect you, to deliver you, to one whose eye none can escape. Find me in Stormwind, mortal, for your time has come.

Title: The Enemy's Insignia
Objective: Bring the Captured Insignia to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
Text: This battered badge carries the insignia of an enemy officer. While worth little more to you than the metal it's made from, this piece would have significant value to a collector of military memorabilia. Professor Thaddeus Paleo of the Darkmoon Faire is famous all over Azeroth for his large collection of military artifacts. Show the badge to him the next time you visit the Darkmoon Faire.

Title: Your Time Has Come
Objective: Speak to Ziradormi in Orgrimmar.
Text: Young , be still and hear my words. I am called to collect you, to deliver you, to one whose eye none can escape. Find me in Orgrimmar, mortal, for your time has come.

Title: The Master Strategist
Objective: Take A Treatise on Strategy to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
Text: This tome of strategy is the masterwork of the famous human general, Anduin Lothar. In his own words, the commander describes the proper deployment of forces and strategies needed to win almost any battle. Professor Thaddeus Paleo of the Darkmoon Faire would probably love to have a look at such a rare book. Look for him at the faire's home on Darkmoon Island.

Title: Target: Turtle
Objective: Land 3 rings on the Darkmoon Turtle.
Text: Hey there! Step right up! Why not show everyone how skilled you are? Just land three rings on the Darkmoon Turtle and you'll get a prize. For one game token you can buy a stack of rings and show the world why we call you the "Eagle Eyed ."

Title: A Woundrous Weapon
Objective: Bring the Ornate Weapon to Professor Thaddeus Paleo when the Darkmoon Faire is running.
Text: An inspection of the weapon reveals expert craftsmanship and intricate inlay work, but this is no ceremonial blade. Faint marks and nicks along the blade attest to its use in combat. The Darkmoon Adventurer's Guide lists several types of rare and valuable weapons, leaving no doubt that Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire would be interested in taking a look at this piece.

Title: An Exotic Egg
Objective: Bring the Monstrous Egg to Yebb Neblegear when the Darkmoon Faire is running.
Text: You're not certain what kind of creature this egg harbors, but it sure doesn't look like the egg of any ordinary animal. The Darkmoon Adventurer's Guide says that an intrepid adventurer might come across any number of strange eggs in his travels. It further notes that the Darkmoon Faire's Zoo Bizarre is always interested in acquiring such specimens. When the Faire open, take this egg to Yebb Nebelgear near the animal pens.

Title: An Intriguing Grimoire
Objective: Bring the Mysterious Grimoire to Sayge when the Darkmoon Faire is running.
Text: This massive spellbook reveals very little of its origins. Its pages are filled with a variety of spells and enchantments, only a few of which are familiar. The Darkmoon Adventurer's guide says the tome may be of some interest to Sayge, the Faire's famous fortuneteller. Look for him near his tent on Darkmoon Island.

Objective: Take A Treatise on Strategy to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
Text: This tome of strategy is the masterwork of the famous human general, Anduin Lothar. In his own words, the commander describes the proper deployment of forces and strategies needed to win almost any battle. Professor Thaddeus Paleo of the Darkmoon Faire would probably love to have a look at such a rare book.

The Darkmoon Adventurer's Guide says that an intrepid adventurer might come across any number of strange eggs in his travels. It further notes that the Darkmoon Faire's Zoo Bizarre is always interested in acquiring such specimens. Take the egg to Yebb Neblegear at the Darkmoon Faire.

Objective: Bring the Mysterious Grimoire to Sayge at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
Text: This massive spellbook reveals very little of its origins. Its pages are filled with a variety of spells and enchantments, only a few of which are familiar. The Darkmoon Adventurer's Guide says the tome may be of some interest to Sayge, the famous gnoll fortuneteller at the Darkmoon Faire.

Title: A Curious Crystal
Objective: Bring the Imbued Crystal to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
Text: Power swirls inside this strange crystal. Perhaps it was once a magical focus, an energy source, or simply a good luck charm. There's no way to know for certain. The Darkmoon Adventurer's Guide indicates that the crystal would be of interest to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire.

Title: A Curious Crystal
Objective: Bring the Imbued Crystal to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
Text: Power swirls inside this strange crystal. Perhaps it was once a magical focus, an energy source, or simply a good luck charm. There's no way to know for certain. The Darkmoon Adventurer's Guide indicates that the crystal would be of interest to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire.

Title: A Wondrous Weapon
Objective: Bring the Ornate Weapon to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
Text: An inspection of the weapon reveals expert craftsmanship and intricate inlay work, but this is no ceremonial blade. Faint marks and nicks along the blade attest to its use in combat. The Darkmoon Adventurer's Guide lists several types of rare and valuable weapons, leaving no doubt that Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire would be interested in taking a look at this piece.

Title: Those Scrying Eyes
Objective: Inspect 4 Duskwatch Scrying Orbs in the Terrace of Enlightenment.
Text: Until recently, Ly'leth was sending magical messages to us regularly from within the Nighthold. She took care to hide these messages - only the most vigilant scryers could have detected them.They could not be within the palace... too much interference from the Nightwell...Of course! The Terrace of Enlightenment! The Duskwatch must have set up a listening post there.Check the scrying orbs for traces of Ly'leth's messages. We must learn what she was trying to tell us!

Title: The Nightborne Apprentice
Objective: Meet Arcanist Ryanna in the Crimson Thicket.
Text: I would be happy to introduce you to my new apprentice if you do not mind traveling a bit. She is currently in the field keeping an eye on an enclave of Felborne resistance fighters who have sworn loyalty to the Legion.As the first nightborne to join the Tirisgarde, I am sure she is eager to prove her skills!

Title: One Step Behind
Objective: Return to Khadgar in the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
Text: It looks like Raest is out of our reach, but at least his cultists should prove less of a threat.We should return to the Kirin Tor. They should be able to help us plan our next move.

Title: Where it's Thinnest
Objective: Meet Karam Magespear at Felbreach Hollow in the Broken Shore.
Text: Though I have never heard of this "Nethersworn" cult, what this manifesto speaks of can't be good.I do have a theory, however. The writing speaks of "the place its skin is thinnest." I think they might be referring to the place where the veil between Azeroth and the Twisting Nether is weakest - the Tomb of Sargeras.With our forces having established a foothold at the Broken Shore, this would be an opportune time for Raest and his cultist allies to reach the tomb. I would suggest you stop them.

Title: The Call of the World-Shaman
Objective: Speak with Thrall just south of the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.
Text: The Earthen Ring calls to you once more. Thrall has cast aside his mantle as warchief of the Horde, but in his new role he needs the support of his people more than ever. He has requested one of the Horde's finest to accompany him in his next endeavor, a ritual of healing that will profoundly impact our world. You will find him under the boughs of Nordrassil in Mount Hyjal, on the southern side of the tree. Heed the call!

Title: Runes of Rending
Objective: Bypass the wards in Felbreach Hollow and confront Raest Magespear.
Text: My brother and his cultists are engaged in some kind of ritual at the far end of the cave. I tried to intervene, but my brother has left magical wards to block the way.If you can find a way past them, we may be able to stop him in time!

Title: Tonk Commander
Objective: Use your Darkmoon Tonk to destroy 30 Tonk Targets in the time allowed.
Text: Welcome to our humble little steam tank battle simulator! For one token, you can demonstrate your tactical mastery by navigating the course and destroying the targets.

Title: The Fallen Guardian
Objective: Confront and slay Alysra at the Ruins of Lar'donir in Mount Hyjal.
Text: Fandral Staghelm was kept prisoner here in Hyjal. It was the green dragon Alysra - one of my very own! - who was in charge of keeping Fandral secure. We can only conclude that the Twilight's Hammer has gotten to her. You must confront her. Destroy her if you must - I cannot bear to see it. She was last seen in the Ruins of Lar'donir, west of the World Tree.

Title: The Call of the World-Shaman
Objective: Speak with Thrall just south of the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.
Text: The Earthen Ring calls to you once more. As a member of the Alliance, I know that you may have reservations working with the one you call Thrall, the former Warchief of the Horde. But he has specifically requested an Alliance hero to accompany him in his next endeavor, a ritual of healing that will profoundly impact our world. Cast aside your doubts, and heed the world-shaman's call. You will find him under the boughs of Nordrassil in Mount Hyjal, on the southern side of the tree.

Title: He Shoots, He Scores!
Objective: Score 25 points in 60 seconds.
Text: Think you're a good shot? Quick on the trigger? It'll cost you just a single game token to test your skills. What do you say? How good are you?

Title: Delegation Tracker
Objective: Recover the Branch of Nordrassil from the Firelands.
Text: I am duty-bound to look into your claims immediately, which means my mission here now must fall to you. A surge of ancient magic, far too strong to have occurred naturally, drew me here. I have since discovered a most troubling development. A bough from Nordrassil has been ripped from the tree and taken deep into the Firelands. There, a powerful ritual threatens to corrupt Nordrassil, consuming it in flame. You must find a way to interrupt the ritual and reclaim the world tree's branch.

Title: The Humanoid Cannonball
Objective: Accumulate 5 Cannon Target Points by landing near the target.
Text: For just one Darkmoon Game Token, you can ride the Blastenheimer 5000 Ultra Cannon. But the fun doesn't end there! We've placed a target in the water near the boardwalk. If you can score five points from your landing, you can win some prize tickets! A bullseye gets you five points, a close shot three, and landing at least near it gets you one. Happy landings!

Title: The Collector's Agent
Objective: Disrupt the meeting between Sanath Lim-yo and the thief in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
Text: According to Dran, the "collector" who wants the crate is none other than the insane Archmage Xylem of Azshara. The archmage's faithful servant is to meet with the man who has the crate in a secluded corner of the courtyard in the Ruins of Lordaeron. Quickly, take the zeppelin to Tirisfal Glade! You must get there in time to intercept the exchange and retrieve the crate before Xylem gets his hands on it. If you can get the crate, meet me at the Wyvern's Tail in the Valley of Honor.

Title: A Friend in Need
Objective: Speak with Edgar Goodwin at the Broken Tusk in Orgrimmar.
Text: There's something wrong with my friend, Edgar. Normally, he loves the Hallow's End festivities, but he's been sullen and reclusive lately. He spends all his time in the Broken Tusk in Orgrimmar drinking with the orcs. Would you mind stopping by and seeing if there's anything you can do to cheer him up?

Title: A Friend in Need
Objective: Visit Anson Hastings at the Gilded Rose in Stormwind's Trade District.
Text: You know, I haven't seen Anson out here yet. Lately, he's been spending all his time drinking himself into a stupor at the Gilded Rose. Something must really be bothering him! Would you mind checking in on him?

Title: Taking Precautions
Objective: Obtain 2 Strange Dust, 5 Crystal Vials, and 5 Blood Nettle.
Text: So someone else hired you to retrieve this crate? I don't like the sound of that. That crate's contents belong in the care of the Reliquary. The items it holds are very powerful and very dangerous. We have to find the meeting that Dran set up between the thief and the collector, but first, we'll need to protect ourselves from the effects of handling that crate. Acquire some strange dust, get vials from an alchemy merchant, and pick some blood nettle in the Valley of Wisdom.

Title: Items of Utmost Importance
Objective: Recover 6 Training Supplies from Amberleaf Scamps.
Text: Amberleaf scamps swarmed my cart and stole most of the training supplies I was bringing up to the training grounds. They've always been troublemakers, but they've never been this aggressive before. I don't know what happened. Please, help me recover my supplies.

Title: What Now?
Objective: You may return the crate to either Edgar Goodwin at the Broken Tusk in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
Text: You've finally found the crate that Edgar Goodwin sent you to retrieve. However, it appears the Reliquary representative's warnings about the nature of the crate's contents were correct. There's no doubt that your employer lied to you about the dangers involved in the job. Do you really want to hand the crate over to him, or would you rather give it to Delian Sunshade, who believes it better to keep the crate's contents locked away?

Title: The Passion of Shen-zin Su
Objective: Bring the Spirit of Fire to the Temple of Five Dawns.

Title: Shopping Around
Objective: Make your way to Droffers and Son Salvage in Orgrimmar's Drag district and look for evidence of the crate-thief's visit.
Text: Look, I told that shady character that there might be a shop more open to his, uh, wares in the Drag. Droffer's and Son Salvage is the name of the place. Look for Dran Droffers. He oversees the 'salvage' of rare and valuable objects from all over Azeroth.

Title: The Spirit's Guardian
Objective: Speak to Master Li Fei in the Shrine of Inner-Light.
Text: You've done very well this far, my student. You have the materials you need to rekindle Huo, the spirit of fire. In the cave to the southwest he awaits, but he is guarded by Master Li Fei, the pandaren elder you met in the Cave of Meditation. Go to Master Li Fei with the offerings. Prove yourself, then meet with Huo.

Title: Huo, the Spirit of Fire
Objective: Reignite Huo, the spirit of fire.
Text: You are worthy of passing. Huo, the spirit of fire rests in the chamber beyond. Let him feast upon the kindling you've gathered, and use the wind to fan his flames. Doing so should endear you to him. Once he is ignited, if he is willing, lead him to the Temple of Five Dawns, the building standing high in the center of the island.

Title: The Missing Driver
Objective: Rescue the Cart Driver.
Text: My driver went running off after the sprites just after they attacked. I don't think they'll really do him any harm, but I need him back to help me clean up the mess by the cart. He chased them off towards the cliffs to the north. If you head that direction, you should find him quickly.

Title: Kindling the Fire
Objective: Gather 5 Dry Dogwood Roots.
