Objective: Recover 5 Fire Hawk Hatchlings.
Text: Our scouts are bringing back reports of fire hawk hatchlings all over the peak... their eggs must have hatched very recently. Better yet, it seems that they're extremely docile. I know it may sound a strange and perhaps unsavory request, but if you were able to bring some of those hatchlings back to me, I might be able to train them to aid us in our war efforts. Are you willing?

Title: Fire in the Skies
Objective: Use the Trained Fire Hawk to kill 100 of the Flamewaker Salamanders, 40 of the Cinderweb Spiders, and 3 of the Molten Lords that are amassing in the Firelands.
Text: Look at that! It's incredible! Born less than two days ago and already full grown. Sadly, I suspect their life cycle is similarly short, so we'll have to take advantage of any time we have. His training went remarkably well. I want you to be the one to take him out and unleash him on the bulk of the enemy forces gathered near Ragnaros' keep. Show no mercy.

Title: Peaked Interest
Objective: Retrieve a Fire Hawk Egg from the top of Fireplume Peak.
Text: These fire hawks are beings of fire, but they exhibit much of the same behavior that we've seen in birds back home. It makes me wonder from where they originate. Back to the point - I think we might be able to train them. Domesticate them if you will. Use them against our enemies. I'd like you to retrieve one of their eggs from the top of Fireplume Peak. If you can bring it back to me safely, I will see to the rest.

Title: Well Armed
Objective: Speak to Ricket at Malfurion's Breach.
Text: Ricket should be at Malfurion's Breach with Damek, as you requested. I'm not sure you fully know what you're getting into with those two though. Speaking of which, you should probably go check on them... make sure they haven't managed to blow up the Sentinel Tree itself. As long as you keep them busy with the elementals, the chances of "accidents" at the breach should lessen dramatically.

Title: Calling the Ancients
Objective: Obtain 125 Marks of the World Tree.
Text: The ancients await in Hyjal. The Firelands will prove a dangerous place for them considering their... composition, but their strength will be of great use to us if we are to face any of Ragnaros' lieutenants. Gather your marks, and seek out Elderlimb at the Sanctuary of Malorne. If they are to march with us, he would be the one leading them through the portal.

Title: Living Obsidium
Objective: Retrieve 10 Obsidium Meteorites.
Text: Have you seen those fireballs falling out of the sky? I saw one crash in the fields to the north, and the rock that landed was made of pure Living Obsidium! I can use the material to craft ultra-sturdy heat proof armor and weapons for our troops. Can you bring me a lode? Go to the Magma Springs and touch one of the magnetic stones. Just watch where you're standing when the rain of fire hits, and gather up the rocks before they crumble from the impact.

Title: The Flame Spider Queen
Objective: Obtain 8 samples of Flame Venom and 8 samples of Searing Web Fluid.
Text: The Widow's Clutch, to the northeast, is named after Beth'tilac, the enormous queen of the flame spiders. Her webs and her poison are a nagging threat to our main offensive force. We believe that if we study the flame spiders here on the Molten Front, we can use that information to find success against Beth'tilac. Use whatever methods you can to gather their venom and their web fluid, then return to my trusted friend Anren.

Title: Nourishing Waters
Objective: Speak to Ayla Shadowstorm at Malfurion's Breach.
Text: I have dispatched the sacred moonwell waters to Malfurion's Breach, as you requested. Ayla is well trained in tending to them. You should return to her and see the boons she weaves for you there.

Title: Filling the Moonwell
Objective: Obtain 125 Marks of the World Tree.
Text: We've constructed this moonwell, but it serves little purpose until it is filled with the sacred waters of the Well of Eternity. With an active moonwell, we would be able to bless our food stores, and we may also be able to use the blessing to offer you some protection from fire as well. When you've obtained enough marks, speak to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne. She'll be able to secure transport of the sacred waters.

Title: Additional Armaments
Objective: Obtain 125 Marks of the World Tree.
Text: These druids be lackin' the tools ta properly handle the job out 'ere. I got meself a buddy back at day ol' stag shrine through the portal though. If we were ta be gettin' reunited, we'd sure have some real toys ta use against ol' Ragboy and 'is cronies. Take some of dem mark things an' go find Matoclaw. Ask her fer Ricket. We need'r here so we can be causin' some real trouble.

Title: Hunting Lesson: Felspider
Objective: Defeat 3 Felspiders in Azsuna with your Bloodgazer Hatchling and 2 Critter pets.

Title: How Hot
Objective: Use Tholo's Thermometer to measure the temperature of the three large lava pools on Fireplume Peak.
Text: The fire hawks of Fireplume Peak can withstand incredible temperatures. While you'll often find them circling the skies above, they're also known to swim in molten lava. Isn't that right, Anren? We'd like to know just how hot that lava can get. Fireplume Peak has three large lava pools. Use this to measure the temperature of each.

Title: Hounds of Shannox
Objective: Obtain 6 small piles of Houndbone Ash.
Text: On the Firelands' largest island, our troops have been having trouble against Shannox, the flamewaker hunter. Not only does he have impeccable aim, but he keeps trained hounds that give our troops no end of trouble. Tholo, in all his wisdom, thinks it would be a good idea to study the biology of these hounds. I, of course, agree with Tholo. You will find several hounds in the Molten Flow, beneath the Furnace. We will need their ashes to study.

Title: Bound for Warmer Weather
Objective: Speak to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.
Text: We should be okay here for now, and they have need of you in the Firelands. You should go through the portal and help them out.

Title: Fandral's Methods
Objective: Obtain a Flame Druid Staff, a Flame Druid Spellbook, a Flame Druid Reagent Pouch, and a Flame Druid Idol.
Text: The Druids of the Flame... an order of druids that, up until a few weeks ago, Tholo and I had never even heard of. Now, under the leadership of Fandral Staghelm, they threaten our mission's success with their mastery of fire. It would appear that they store some supplies in the Igneous Depths, to the northeast. Perhaps, if we can get some of those supplies, we will have more luck when we take the fight to Fandral.

Title: Teamwork Lesson: Xavius
Objective: Defeat Xavius in the Emerald Nightmare with your Sharptalon Hatchling out.

Title: Need... Water... Badly...
Objective: Bring Anren Shadowseeker to the entrance of the Molten Front.
Text: Need... water... badly...

Title: Teamwork Lesson: Dresaron
Objective: Defeat Dresaron in Darkheart Thicket in Val'sharah with your Sharptalon Hatchling out.

Title: Sharptalon Bonding
Objective: Buy a Dirty Spoon from Mel Lynchen in Dalaran for your Sharptalon Hatchling.

Title: Hunting Lesson: Vale Flitter
Objective: Defeat 3 Vale Flitters in Val'sharah with your Sharptalon Hatchling and 2 Aquatic pets.

Title: Hunting Lesson: Auburn Ringtail
Objective: Defeat 3 Auburn Ringtails in Val'sharah with your Sharptalon Hatchling and 2 Flying pets.

Title: The Unfavorable Faction
Objective: Complete 3 PvP World Quests with your Bloodgazer Hatchling out.

Title: Hunting Lesson: Juvenile Scuttleback
Objective: Defeat 3 Juvenile Scuttlebacks in Azsuna with your Bloodgazer Hatchling and 2 Flying pets.

Title: Bloodgazer Bonding
Objective: Buy a Purple Blossom from Aerith Primrose in Dalaran for your Bloodgazer Hatchling.

Title: The Uncongenial Faction
Objective: Complete 3 PvP World Quests with your Sharptalon Hatchling out.

Title: Teamwork Lesson: Serpentrix
Objective: Defeat Serpentrix in Eye of Azshara in Azsuna with your Bloodgazer Hatchling out.

Title: Allies in Val'sharah
Objective: Complete 5 World Quests in Val'sharah with your Sharptalon Hatchling out.

Title: Hunting Lesson: Fledgling Kingfeather
Objective: Defeat 3 Fledgling Kingfeathers in Azsuna with your Bloodgazer Hatchling.

Title: Dangerous Prey
Objective: Complete 1 Rare Elite World Quest with your Bloodgazer Hatchling out.

Title: Hunting Lesson: Terror Larva
Objective: Defeat 3 Terror Larvae in Val'sharah with your Sharptalon Hatchling.

Title: Destructive Prey
Objective: Complete 1 Rare Elite World Quest with your Sharptalon Hatchling out.

Title: Allies in Azsuna
Objective: Complete 5 World Quests in Azsuna with your Bloodgazer Hatchling out.

Title: Sharptalon Team Up
Objective: Defeat 3 Pet Battle World Quests in Broken Isles with your Sharptalon Hatchling.

Title: Bloodgazer Team Up
Objective: Defeat 3 Pet Battle World Quests in Broken Isles with your Bloodgazer Hatchling.

Title: Hunting Lesson: Erudite Manafiend
Objective: Defeat 3 Erudite Manafiends in Azsuna with your Bloodgazer Hatchling.

Title: The Smell of Undead
Objective: Take your Sharptalon Hatchling to the Inn in Undercity.

Title: Raising Your Bloodgazer
Objective: Raise your Bloodgazer Hatchling to level 25.

Title: The Smell of Draenei
Objective: Take your Bloodgazer Hatchling to the Inn in the Exodar.

Title: Hunting Lesson: Spring Strider
Objective: Defeat 3 Spring Striders in Val'sharah with your Sharptalon Hatchling.

Title: Direbeak Reunion
Objective: Return the Direbeak Hatchling to Gull Rock in Stormheim.

Title: The Smell of Night Elves
Objective: Take your Sharptalon Hatchling to the Inn in Darnassus.

Title: The Smell of Blood Elves
Objective: Take your Bloodgazer Hatchling to the Silvermoon City Inn in Silvermoon.

Title: Raising Your Sharptalon
Objective: Raise your Sharptalon Hatchling to level 25.

Title: At One
Objective: Speak to Kalecgos to agree to his proposition.
Text: I was charged with her protection, yet it was she who sacrificed herself for my sake. I cannot bear to lose her. I must make a solemn request of you. Never has a mortal borne the essence of a true dragon, but with your permission I would make an exception. Please, while there is life in her, will you allow me to bind Tarecgosa to you?

Title: Hunting Lesson: Stormstruck Beaver
Objective: Defeat 3 Stormstruck Beavers in Stormheim with your Direbeak Hatchling and 2 Mechanical pets.

Title: Teamwork Lesson: Krosus
Objective: Defeat Krosus in the Nighthold with your Direbeak Hatchling out.

Title: Direbeak Team Rumble
Objective: Defeat 3 Pet Battle World Quests with your Direbeak Hatchling and 2 Humanoid pets.

Title: Some Good Will Come
Objective: Care for the panther cub, after all, you did kill it's mother.
Text: So much violence, so much death. Brothers have died, a mother has died, and now a panther cub will die if there is no one to take care of it. Will you take a break from the violence and help care for a panther cub?

Title: Flamewakers of the Molten Flow
Objective: Slay 8 Flamewakers within the Molten Flow.
Text: Of all Ragnaros' minions, the flamewakers appear to be the most devoted. Most of them dwell within this cave, preparing for another attack. Our foothold may be strong, but we will not tolerate any surprise attacks from these worms. No, we will strike first. Tear them apart.

Title: Fire Flowers
Objective: Obtain 5 Luciferns.
Text: My fellow druid, Choluna, has asked us to collect any specimens of plant life that we might find here in the Firelands... ...I don't know whose idea it was to bring scholars to a warfront. Nevertheless, you will already be in the cave - killing things - so be on the lookout for anything growing out of the ground.

Title: Enlighten Us
Objective: Take the Fire Lasher to the burnt tree.
Text: Your Fire Lasher has been quite restless. He keeps visiting the old burnt tree, though for what reason, I cannot fathom. , would you do me a favor and take your Fire Lasher to the tree? Perhaps you can figure out what interests him so much about that place.

Title: A Bitter Pill
Objective: Find the Subterranean Magma Worm's breath bubbles, then defeat it by making it swallow the Bitter Pill.
Text: As far as I'm concerned, there's no problem that can't be solved with bombs. And if a bomb doesn't solve your problem on the first try... use a bigger bomb. So there's this big worm that's been eating people near the lava pools up north. Search for breath bubbles to find it. Attack it until it prepares to bite, then place this bomb down in front of it. Then sit back and watch the fireworks. Hmm... there was one other thing I wanted to say... oh yeah! Don't get eaten.

Title: Hide and Seek
Objective: Find and expose the hidden Fire Lasher in Malfurion's Breach.
Text: Good to see you again. Your Lasher here has invented a new game - hide and seek! It looks like he wants to play with you. Wait until he hides himself, then look for him somewhere in the camp. If he's too well-hidden, I've created this special mist that will reveal his general direction. Don't tell him I gave it ito you.

Title: A Shiny Reward
Objective: Get your reward from a chest in the statue at Janeiro's Point.
Text: There is a stash of loot located in the statue on Janeiro's Point just northwest of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale. Head to the statue and claim your prize.

Title: Steal Magmolias
Objective: Collect 8 Magmolias from the Magma Springs to the north.
Text: We've discovered a new species of flower growing in the Magma Springs to the north. Amazingly, they sustain themselves in pure molten lava! Please go and retrieve some specimens for me. I'm sure that further study of these plants will shed some light on your little friend here. Speaking of which, he seems quite eager to go with you. Let's hope he behaves himself.

Title: Booty Bay's Interests
Objective: Recover an artifact that might keep the Zul'Gurub trolls out of Booty Bay.
Text: I've been sent here by Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay to make sure this troll menace is halted. Or that it is at least halted at the gates of Booty Bay. I want action and I want results. I want you to get in there and kill. I want you to get in there and find me something that will help keep these trolls out of Booty Bay. You do that and we'll make sure you get paid.

Title: Little Lasher
Objective: Bring the Crimson Lasher to Avrilla.
Text: The little red flower wiggles its tendrils happily. It seems to like you! Perhaps Avrilla would like to see what grew out of the acorn.

Title: Releasing the Pressure
Objective: Obtain 100 Flamewaker Scales.
Text: Having been burned so badly, Arch Druid Hamuul is suffering from edema - swelling of the body's tissues. It takes a great deal of his attendants' effort to keep his swelling down enough for him to breathe. Normally, to reduce this swelling, we make cuts in his flesh, but he is weak. I cannot cut him today. I need your help. Flamewaker scales will aid with the swelling, but you need a lot of them.

Title: Embergris
Objective: Retrieve 5 Embergris from Charred Soldiers and Charred Vanquishers.
Text: The Crimson Lasher has developed some cracking blisters on its vines. Without treatment, this condition could be life threatening. Luckily, the Charred Soldiers and Charred Vanquishers in the area produce a waxy substance known as Embergris, which should soothe the Lasher's pain. Bring me some of this substance, and kill those nasty fire elementals while you're at it.

Title: Making Contact
Objective: Head to Booty Bay and find Bwemba's contact.
Text: You aren't one of the zombies... A troll? I did see one, just before the outbreak... He warned us, told us to be on our guard... But it was too late. Your troll friend headed to Booty Bay to warn them...

Title: Planting Season
Objective: Plant the Acorn in the Un'Goro Soil at Malfurion's Breach.
Text: The acorn seems to be unharmed.  No point in beating around the bush. Let's plant it and see what comes out. Luckily for you, we brought some leftover soil with us to help establish our base. You'll find the soil at the graveyard directly east.

Title: Relieving the Pain
Objective: Obtain 4 Flame-Wreathed Hearts from Seething Firelords.
Text: The Arch Druid has an immense tolerance for pain. I've treated burn victims that spend twenty-two hours a day screaming in pain, and their burns weren't even half as bad as what Hamuul has suffered. Nevertheless, I can sense that he is in greater discomfort than normal today. Bring me the hearts of the large fire elementals to the southeast. I can use them to prepare a soothing salve for our patient.

Title: Strike at the Heart
Objective: Kill the Lieutenant of Flame.
Text: One of Ragnaros' Lieutenants has shown itself at Ragnaros' Reach. It is time to strike. Captain Saynna has requested that you be there to help see the fight through. Witherbranch and some others will have joined the battle by the time you arrive. You should make haste to the northwest and find them.

Title: Treating the Wounds
Objective: Obtain 4 Sulfur-Laced Wrappings from Fiery Behemoths in Sethria's Roost.
Text: We have an ample supply of medical supplies here at the Sanctuary, but we mustn't lose sight of the fact that we are at war. Hamuul isn't the only person who has need of bandages. The fiery behemoths that roam Sethria's Roost wear flame-resistant wrappings that will serve Hamuul as ably as any bandage. Bring me those wrappings, and I will prepare them for use on the Arch Druid.

Title: A Lieutenant of Flame
Objective: Report to Captain Saynna Stormrunner at Ragnaros' Reach.
Text: Captain Saynna has requested your presence at Ragnaros' Reach. A Lieutenant of Flame has shown himself and she thinks you are our greatest chance at striking against him. Make your way there as soon as you're able.

Title: Eat Your Heart Out
Objective: Retrieve 3 Lava Burster Hearts.
Text: Hello . Checking in on your Fire Lasher? He seems quite hungry, but no mixture of fertilizer or plant growth seems to interest him. Some plants are carnivorous, and I'd like to test this rather unconventional theory. Would you retrieve some Lava Burster Hearts for me? The Lava Bursters frequent the fields to the north.

Title: Booty Bay's Interests
Objective: Recover an artifact that might keep the Zul'Gurub trolls out of Booty Bay.
Text: Look. You've helped out plenty so far, but that's not going to be enough. I need these crazy trolls stopped, or at least stopped from getting into Booty Bay. I'm going to send a man in to oversee the action, but I want you to go into Zul'Gurub and make something happen. At the very least, I want you to find me something that will help keep these trolls out of Booty Bay. You do that and we'll treat you right.

Title: The Mysterious Seed
Objective: Take the Acorn to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.
Text: A small, dried acorn has fallen out of the Flame Druid's robe. Why would a Druid of the Flame be carrying it around? Perhaps someone at Malfurion's Breach would like to see it.

Title: Teamwork Lesson: Fenryr
Objective: Defeat Fenryr in Halls of Valor in Stormheim with your Direbeak Hatchling out.

Title: The Unkindly Faction
Objective: Complete 3 PvP World Quests with your Direbeak Hatchling out.

Title: Direbeak Bonding
Objective: Buy a pair of Fake Teeth from Clockwork Assistant in Dalaran for your Direbeak Hatchling.

Title: Hunting Lesson: Rose Taipan
Objective: Defeat 3 Rose Taipans in Stormheim with your Direbeak Hatchling.

Title: Hunting Lesson: Golden Eaglet
Objective: Defeat 3 Golden Eaglets in Stormheim with your Direbeak Hatchling and 2 Flying pets.

Title: Hunting Lesson: Tiny Apparition
Objective: Defeat 3 Tiny Apparitions in Stormheim with your Direbeak Hatchling.

Title: Allies in Stormheim
Objective: Complete 5 World Quests in Stormheim with your Direbeak Hatchling out.

Title: Dire Prey
Objective: Complete 1 Rare Elite World Quest with your Direbeak Hatchling out.

Title: The Smell of Tauren
Objective: Take your Direbeak Hatchling to the Inn in Thunder Bluff.

Title: Direbeak Team Up
Objective: Defeat 3 Pet Battle World Quests in Broken Isles with your Direbeak Hatchling.

Title: Raising Your Direbeak
Objective: Raise your Direbeak Hatchling to level 25.

Title: The Smell of Orcs
Objective: Take your Snowfeather Hatchling to the Broken Tusk in Orgrimmar.

Title: The Smell of Dwarves
Objective: Take your Direbeak Hatchling to the Stonefire Tavern in Ironforge.

Title: Teamwork Lesson: Ursoc
Objective: Defeat Ursoc in the Emerald Nightmare with your Snowfeather Hatchling out.

Title: Snowfeather Reunion
Objective: Return the Snowfeather Hatchling to the Misty Coast in Highmountain.

Title: Hunting Lesson: Mudshell Conch
Objective: Defeat 3 Mudshell Conches in Highmountain with your Snowfeather Hatchling and 2 Flying pets.

Title: Hunting Lesson: Coralback Fiddler
Objective: Defeat 3 Coralback Fiddlers in Highmountain with your Snowfeather Hatchling and 2 Elemental pets.

Title: Teamwork Lesson: Naraxas
Objective: Defeat Naraxas in Neltharion's Lair in Highmountain with your Snowfeather Hatchling out.

Title: Snowfeather Team Rumble
Objective: Defeat 3 Pet Battle World Quests with your Snowfeather Hatchling and 2 Undead pets.

Title: I'll Just Leave This Here
Objective: Place Energy Disruptors at the energy sources in Teloth'aran, Kel'balor and Elor'shan in Suramar.
Text: Valtrois has a plan for the Sanctum's energy barrier. Several key Arcway locations throughout Suramar harness the power necessary for it. These Energy Disruptors she made will remotely break the links simultaneously on activation, causing the barrier to fall. Take these devices and install them at the leylines, then return here for the surprise assault on the Sanctum.

Title: Snowfeather Bonding
Objective: Buy a Tiny Pack from Susana Averoy in Dalaran for your Snowfeather Hatchling.

Title: The Unfriendly Faction
Objective: Complete 3 PvP World Quests with your Snowfeather Hatchling out.

Title: Visitor in Shal'Aran
Objective: Meet the stranger outside Shal'Aran.
Text: Someone came to Shal'Aran while you were in the City. She asked for you specifically. I did not recognize her face, nor her voice, but she seemed trustworthy and earnest. She is just outside the cavern. Meet with her and determine her purpose for coming here.

Title: Emergency Extraction
Objective: Accompany Kalecgos to Coldarra.
Text: Now, back to the matter at hand... I am convinced that the vision in the Nexus is one of Deathwing's illusions designed to bring conflict into our flight at a very fragile time. The Worldbreaker would only be strengthened were we to fall to infighting. Still, a gnawing sense of unease tempts me to take a path of caution. It would be wise for me to take Tarecgosa and withdraw until the time of choosing.

Title: Snowfeather Team Up
Objective: Defeat 3 Pet Battle World Quests in Broken Isles with your Snowfeather Hatchling.

Title: Deadly Prey
Objective: Complete 1 Rare Elite World Quest with your Snowfeather Hatchling out.

Title: Nordrassil's Bough
Objective: Collect the Branch of Nordrassil at Amber Ledge in Borean Tundra.
Text: Much has transpired since last we spoke. I have taken it upon myself to visit the Nexus and recover Anachronos's artifact, but not before using it for myself. Now I too have witnessed that which you have seen. Before discussing the matter further, allow me to express my gratitude to you for your assistance, both here and in the Plane of Fire.

Title: Voodoo Zombies
Objective: Rescue 10 Hideaway Survivors.
Text: Da people... Dey all zombies, voodoo zombies! Dis ain't gonna be pretty. You gotta kill dem. But once dey killed, dere is a moment where I can save dem. Change dem back into da person dey were before. We gotta act fast. Da zombies don' rest.

Title: Break the Godbreaker
Objective: Kill Jin'do the Godbreaker inside of Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty.
Text: When Jin'do was last ripped from dis world, he survived as a shade, weak and broken, in da spirit world. But Jin'do always had power over da spirits. One by one, he broke dem to his will, and wit' each soul devoured, Jin'do got closer ta' rippin' a hole through to dis world. Ta be here now... Da spirits be wit' us, we must end Jin'do.

Title: Bad Supplies
Objective: Check out the food preparation area in Hardwrench Hideaway.
Text: Some of da survivors mentioned food. We better check da food supplies. I gotta a bad feelin' about dis.

Title: Hunting Lesson: Spiketail Beaver
Objective: Defeat 3 Spiketail Beavers in Highmountain with your Snowfeather Hatchling.

Title: Defend Grom'gol
Objective: Help defend Grom'gol Base Camp for three minutes.
Text: I hope you like to fight. Your troll friend has been through here and warned us that the Gurubashi were on the rampage. I never thought the battle would be this glorious though. Come, join in our fight and let's show these Gurubashi trolls the might of the Horde!

Title: How's the Hunter Holding Up?
Objective: Check on Grent Direhammer.
Text: Tings ain't looking good. Dat panther was under some powerful magic. We better check on dat hunter an' see how he be doin'.

Title: Warn Grom'gol
Objective: Make your way to Grom'gol Base Camp.
Text: Dis death ain't be in vain. We figure out dat Kilnara be on da prowl. Tings don't look good. We better check out Grom'gol Base Camp to da west. Maybe we find my contact dere.

Title: Bury Me With Me Boots...
Objective: Collect Grent Direhammer's boots.
Text: Ah... It's you. Mauti... He's dead? Then my brother has been avenged. I've only one request from ya... This scamp here, he's been pawing at me bare feet. No dwarf should go to the earth with bare feet. Please, bury me with me boots.

Title: To Hardwrench Hideaway
Objective: Head to Hardwrench Hideaway in The Cape of Stranglethorn.
Text: Bwemba... Is that you? Your contact was here. He was eager to get to the next location and warn them. And really, who could blame him? I gave him use of a wyvern to reach the goblins of Hardwrench Hideaway, in the Cape of Stranglethorn. I will give you use of one of my wyverns to reach Hardwrench. Talk to me when you are ready to go.

Title: The Hunter's Revenge
Objective: Give Grent Direhammer the closure he needs by killing Mauti.
Text: The beast that's been hunting us... I've been hunting it. We call him Mauti. He's a clever one. But he made a grave mistake when he killed my brother. Now that mistake is going to cost him. Ol' Direhammer has got his scent. I've noticed him roaming just above Kurzen's Compound. If we act fast, we can take him down. Are you ready?

Title: Follow That Cat
Objective: Find where Mauti has taken Grent Direhammer.
Text: Well, that explains why Mauti seemed smaller... The real Mauti has run off with Grent Direhammer, but being the wise hunter that he is, he has fired flares off so you can track him. Find Direhammer before it's too late!

Title: Follow That Cat
Objective: Find where Mauti has taken Grent Direhammer.
Text: Well, that explains why Mauti seemed smaller... The real Mauti has run off with Grent Direhammer, but being the wise hunter that he is, he has fired flares off so you can track him. Find Direhammer before it's too late!

Title: NO LONGER USED
Objective: Gaze into the Timeless Eye.
Text: Here we are, mortal. The rift emits intense energy that will shield the magic of your artifact. When you are ready, I will activate the Eye. Doing so will require all of my focus. You must witness the vision on your own. Hurry now. It is unsafe for us to tarry here.

Title: Mauti
Objective: Bring Bwemba to the remains of Mauti.
Text: I got da feeling dat somethin' ain't right wit' dat panther. It ain't natural. I gonna need to perform some rituals over da body. Put Mauti down, an' den let's see what we can find out.

Title: To Bambala
Objective: Head to Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn Vale to find the Darkspear emissary.
Text: Da first place we check gonna be da place most likely to be attacked first, Bambala. Bambala be dangerously close to da troll city Zul'Gurub... It make for an easy target. Maybe we find da emissary dere. Hopefully it ain't too late.

Title: Actionable Intelligence
Objective: Speak to Kalecgos at Nordrassil in Mount Hyjal.
Text: Impossible! Not even Arygos would dare to go to such lengths. I do not question your integrity, but you must understand - your mortal mind can easily be deceived. Regardless, Kalecgos must be informed of these events. You must travel to Nordrassil at once to seek him out. I shall remain here to conceal the evidence of our activities. Speak of this to no one else!

Title: Track the Tracker
Objective: Find Grent Direhammer in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
Text: We've been fending off serpents for days now. But the serpents are nothing compared to what else is out in that jungle. We hunters are being hunted. A large panther named Mauti has been dragging my men off into the bush. We sent Grent Direhammer, one of our best hunters, to track this beast down. Direhammer headed off to the east, perhaps you can find them there.

Title: Delegation
Objective: Recover the Branch of Nordrassil from the Firelands.
Text: I am duty-bound to look into your claims immediately, which means my mission here now must fall to you. A surge of ancient magic, far too strong to have occurred naturally, drew me here. I have since discovered a most troubling development. A bough from Nordrassil has been ripped from the tree and taken deep into the Firelands. There, a powerful ritual threatens to corrupt Nordrassil, consuming it in flame. You must find a way to interrupt the ritual and reclaim the World Tree's branch.

Title: Nesingwary Will Know
Objective: Warn the hunters at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
Text: So da Gurubashi be on da rampage an' dey usin' serpents to lead da charge. You know who be good at keepin' da animal population in check? Da hunters at Nesingwary's Expedition. Head over dere and see how dey doin'. See if dey know a good way to get rid of da serpents. If dey don't know, den you gotta at least warn dem dat dese serpents, it ain't all natural.

Title: Spirits Are With Us
Objective: Prepare the bonfire in front of the serpent shrine near Bambala for Bwemba's ritual.
Text: Dere was something about da way da serpents attacked. Something unnatural... Even da poison had a hint of some bad mojo. Dere be a shrine near here wit' a bonfire. We can use dat to perform a ritual. Whatever be makin' dese serpents attack, dey probably still watchin' over dem. Da only problem, is dat I only be here in spirit form. I need you to be my hands. I need you to go to da fire an' prepare it for me. Den I'll handle da rest.

Title: Allies in Highmountain
Objective: Complete 5 World Quests in Highmountain with your Snowfeather Hatchling out.

Title: Serpents and Poison
Objective: Kill Jungle Serpents and inspect the poisoned Headhunters to allow Bwemba to heal them.
Text: Da warning helped. We gathered more Headhunters to help defend. But Headhunters... Dey not used to hunting heads on serpents. So we soon be overwhelmed. Dese serpents, dey seem to come from everywhere. An' it probably only gonna get worse. Help us and kill da serpents and have Bwemba use her mojo to cure da ones dat are sick from poison.

Title: Bwemba's Spirit
Objective: Warn the people of Stranglethorn and find the other Darkspear emissary.
Text: Dese be troublin' times for us Darkspear. Da Zandalar be reuniting all da troll clans an' plan to take back da lands dey lost. We tryin' to warn all dat we can. But it might be too late. Another Darkspear gone down to Stranglethorn to warn da people. But it ain't safe to travel alone in Stranglethorn. Help me find him and make sure da people in Stranglethorn are warned of da rise of da troll tribes. I gonna bind my spirit wit' ya. When ya get to Stranglethorn, I be able to aid ya.

Title: The Captive Scouts
Objective: Free the captive scouts: Hazlek, Bakkalzu, Norkani, and Kasha. They are being held captive by the Amani high priests.
Text: After we arrived, I dispatched my scouts to learn more about da Zandalari presence here in Zul'Aman. Many returned with useful information, but four still be missin'. If we do not act quickly, da new warlord's lieutenants will offer dem as sacrifices in honor of da Zandalari emissaries. Find my scouts, and free dem before da priests offer dem as sacrifices!

Title: Hunting Lesson: Northern Hawk Owls
Objective: Defeat 3 Northern Hawk Owls in Highmountain with your Snowfeather Hatchling.

Title: Blackrock Depths: Jewel of the Depths
Objective: Travel to Blackrock Depths and obtain a Core of Bael'Gar, Core of Roccor, Essence of Incendius, and Essence of Magmus. Once you have all four items, combine them at the Black Forge near the entrance to Molten Core at the bottom of Blackrock Depths and bring the Blackrock Ruby back to Wixxrak in Everlook.
Text: Welcome to Everlook. Could I interest you in a new weapon of sorts? You know, I'm not just into selling weapons of mass dismemberment here at the shop. I like rare jewels as well. Perhaps you and I can come to an arrangement of sorts in procuring a jewel I've had my eye on getting for quite some time. I have some great blacksmithing plans here you might be interested in, you know, in trade for your services. Now, onto the details...

Title: Aura of Uncertainty
Objective: Help Khadgar unravel the mystery behind the fragments.
Text: We may not know the Legion's intent just yet, but after analyzing your findings we will know soon enough.

Title: The Smell of Humans
Objective: Take your Snowfeather Hatchling to the Gilded Rose in Stormwind.

Title: Raising Your Snowfeather
Objective: Raise your Snowfeather Hatchling to level 25.

Title: Dances With Ravenbears (UNUSED)
Objective: Help the Blackfeather ravenbears perform their tribute ritual.
Text: Caw! Caw ca-caw!

Title: Inside the Winter Storm
Objective: Grapple across from the tower and climb to the top of the mountain path.
Text: There, it looks like there's a good spot to launch to right across from here. This path should take you all the way to the top.According to my intel, your dragons should be up there. Let's just hope that they're still in a state to help you.

Title: A Familiar Axe to Grind
Objective: Show the axe blade to Hoddruc Bladebender at Chiselgrip.
Text: The construction of this blade feels familiar, but you can't quite recall where you may have seen something like it before. Perhaps someone at Chiselgrip might know more about its construction.

Title: REUSE
Objective: Raise your Snowfeather Hatchling to level 25.

Title: Something's Not Quite Right...
Objective: Remove the disguise of 5 Nightborne Infiltrators.
Text: Something is troubling me, champion. Beyond these simple japes, the Kirin Tor has had to break up a few fights between the elves. I am worried something - or someone - might be influencing them. Your disguise was made by the nightborne, yes? It is not unreasonable to assume they can do something similar. Fortunately, Thalyssra has told me much about how the illusion works, and I believe this crystal can remove their disguise. Why don't you check the camps, just to be safe?

Title: Worth Its Weight in Steel
Objective: Gather 30 Axe Blades from orcs and ogres around the Burning Steppes. Return them to Hoddruc in Chiselgrip when you've collected them all.
Text: Listen, ye seem like one who may be interested in getting a copy of those axe plans. Could probably make a pretty penny at the auction house on it. But I can't just hand 'em over to ya. Not fer free. That axe blade ye brought me, I could use more of those. Good steel in those blades. Don't worry, I just need a few... What do ye say?

Title: Deadmines: Sea'in Red
Objective: Collect 100 Bloodied Defias Bandanas for Captain Bramblebeard.
Text: Arr, finally! I been stuck up here f'years with naught company but me own thoughts. Tis good to clap me eyes on another swashbuckling soul. Are ye up for a plot of revenge and skullduggery? These meddlin' Defias thugs murdered me and me crew years ago before they took over this cave. I propose a series of counter-murders to bring about balance! Bring me proof ye've dealt with enough of the thieves to clog a bilge pump!

Title: Lone Wolf
Objective: Meet Thisalee Crow in Moonglade.
Text: My eyes and ears fly across Azeroth, bringing me back news of many things. My ally Goldrinn took to the barrows of Moonglade in mourning upon the death of Varian Wrynn. He has been untouched in the dream... until now. Demons have been seen invading the very same barrows, killing many more of our mortal druids in the process. You must go. Save Goldrinn, avenge our people! Take my hatchling Thisalee with you. Her tenacity and bloodlust is welcome in my clutch. You shall have my aid.

Title: Order of Incantations
Objective: Speak with Xylem's apprentices in Bear's Head to decipher the code to open the barrier to his tower.
Text: The barrier shielding the tower can only be opened by activating the imbued gems in the correct order. The order is only known to Xylem and his inner circle of apprentices. No others have yet been able to decipher the code, and mistakes are met with deadly consequences.The aspiring apprentices spend a lot of their time around the tower. Some may have seen or heard something that might point to a solution.Let us hope, for your sake, their information proves valuable.

Title: The Archmage Accosted
Objective: Confront Archmage Xylem.
Text: With the barrier dispelled, Archmage Xylem is finally within reach!Hopefully he'll be cooperative in returning the Iris...

Title: Return to Karazhan: The Tower of Power
Objective: Defeat Viz'aduum the Watcher in Karazhan.
Text: Your champions discovered that the area surrounding Karazhan is under an invasion from the Legion. This does not bode well.Climb the tower, and defeat all in your path.

Title: Inside the Winter Storm
Objective: Grapple across from the tower and climb to the top of the mountain path.
Text: There, it looks like there's a good spot to launch to right across from here. This path should take you all the way to the top.According to my intel, your dragons should be up there. Let's just hope that they're still in a state to help you.

Title: Closing the Eye
Objective: Speak with War Councilor Victoria to be teleported to Archmage Xylem's location and defeat him.
Text: We have received reports from the apprentices at Xylem's Tower that they've been able to use the remant of Xylem's portal to pinpoint his location.We have orders from the Council of Six to open a portal directly to him, though whatever magic he's channeling on the other end is powerful enough to allow us to only keep it open for a brief window.The apprentice, Joanna asked I give you this message before you proceed. Speak to me when you're ready.

Title: A Message From Our Enemies
Objective: Listen to Andaris's Message in Shal'Aran.
Text: ! The messages from Ly'leth we traced throughout the Terrace - we could not have known at the time, but somebody was watching. This crystal was delivered by a courier early this morning.  I am afraid the message contained within is not for the faint of heart. It has not been shown to anyone else, but you deserve to see it for all you have done for us.

Title: Professionally Good Looking
Objective: Collect the Fanciful Hat, Well-Tailored Robes, and Magnificent Mantle from Raethas Dawnseer, Lobos and Phloem in Azshara.
Text: The archmage has recently locked himself away in his tower. If you wish to enter, you'll need help from some of his apprentices. I'm afraid you won't get it dressed like that.Xylem has a thing for... outfits, and his apprentices use them to show rank. If you wish his apprentices to help you, you'll need to appear their superior. Such is their desire to impress the archmage, many of his apprentices will battle each other for the best pieces.I think you know where this is going.

Title: Arms: The Thieving Apprentice
Objective: Travel to Xylem's Tower within Bear's Head in Azshara.
Text: The Focusing Iris has been stolen from the Dalaran Vaults! The thief was a mage of some skill, but we've been unable to track him.Fortunately, the thief dropped a note from his master, addressing him as one of his "apprentici." I know of only one mage who uses that particular pluralization - Archmage Xylem.I'll need you to investigate. In Azshara you will find his tower where he trains his apprentices. Go there, and see what Xylem is up to.|cFF660000Specialization: Arms Warrior|r

Title: A Challenge From Our Enemies
Objective: Meet Andaris at the Lunastre Estate in Suramar City.
Text: Make no mistake. This message cannot be taken lightly. Any threat made against our people will be dealt with swiftly. We must travel to the estate at once to discover what has become of Ly'leth.

Title: Fire Hawk Down
Objective: PH - Shoot down 5 fire hawks.
Text: PH - Shoot down 5 fire hawks.

Title: How's the Hunter Holding Up?
Objective: Check on Grent Direhammer.
Text: Tings ain't looking good. Dat panther was under some powerful magic. We better check on dat hunter an' see how he be doin'.

Title: Solar Core Destruction
Objective: Detonate the Solar Core.
Text: The fight has taken us to Fandral's doorstep. His druids are channeling energies of the Firelands into a vessel called the Solar Core. Should this vessel detonate on Azeroth, none of us will have a home to return to. We need to strike at the Solar Core now, while it is still vulnerable. You can find the infernal device to the northeast.

Title: The Shadow Wardens
Objective: Obtain 150 Marks of the World Tree.
Text: The Shadow Wardens are back in the Regrowth. I know that they take the loss of Fandral from their custody very seriously, so it wouldn't take much prodding to bring them to the Firelands to hunt the Druids of the Flame, and perhaps aid us otherwise in the process. Should you come upon enough marks, you should seek out Captain Saynna Stormrunner at the Sanctuary of Malorne and secure her aid.

Title: The Forlorn Spire
Objective: Protect one of the druids attempting to take the Forlorn Spire.
Text: Captain Saynna Stormrunner is launching an attack against the Forlorn Spire. If you head to the northeast, you'll find her at the bottom of the ramp leading up towards that rise. Go there and escort one of her druids to the tower with any forces that she can spare. You'll have quite a fight ahead of you - make sure the druid lives to see the end of it or they'll not be able to seize the tower.

Title: Into the Fiery Depths
Objective: Speak to Theresa Barkskin in the Igneous Depths.
Text: One of our druids moved ahead into the Igneous Depths in pursuit of a Druid of the Flame. Go to her. Help her.

Title: The Warden's Charge
Objective: If you want to help the Wardens attack the Forlorn Spire, seek out Captain Saynna Stormrunner in northeastern Ashen Fields.
Text: Captain Saynna Stormrunner is launching an attack against the Forlorn Spire. If you head to the northeast, you'll find her at the bottom of the ramp leading up towards that rise. I've assigned her a large number of our men, but her chances of success would be greatly increased if you join her cause. It's your decision.

Title: Enduring the Heat
Objective: Find your way to the Igneous Depths, then destroy all 8 of the blue runes within.
Text: Shalis has gone with one of our druids to stop a Druid of the Flame that is performing a summoning ritual in the Igneous Depths, below us. They have been tasked with killing the druid, but I need you to stop the ritual. You'll find the entrance to the cavern east of the Magma Springs. Once inside, you'll see 8 blue runes spread throughout the cavern. You can use these runes to protect you from the fiery creatures, but you need to stamp all of them out to end the ritual. You will need to be swift.

Title: Into the Fire
Objective: Escort a Windcaller through the Furnace and secure the entrance to the Molten Flow.
Text: Skylord Omnuron and his druids are seeking to push through the Furnace to our northwest. They've been able to fly over the dangers, but they really need someone on the ground to help them secure the territory past the fire... someone like you. If you want to aid the Druids of the Talon, wait for one of Omnuron's Windcallers to start pushing through the fire, stay close to him, and keep him safe from any attackers within the flames.

Title: Calling for Reinforcements
Objective: Obtain 20 Marks of the World Tree.
Text: We suffered heavy losses during the backdraft after our invasion attempt. Our second attempt cannot fail. We need reinforcements before we attempt another invasion. Please, work with Matoclaw to obtain enough resources to afford reinforcements. Then, we take our second and final stab at the Firelands.

Title: The Sanctuary Must Not Fall
Objective: Stand by Malfurion as he resurrects Malorne.
Text: Malfurion is working on a miracle for us. He believes that, in this time of peril, he can resurrect Malorne to protect the Sanctuary. I have faith in him. In the meantime, we need to hold this perimeter. Stand by, and make sure no harm befalls my fellow arch druid.

Title: The Fate of Runetotem
Objective: Speak with Dorda'en Nightweaver at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
Text: I apologize for speaking curtly with you earlier. The loss of Hamuul was shocking to me, and difficult to cope with. They brought in his body while you were away. He is alive, but - as you might imagine - he is very, very badly burned. The scars are deep. He may not live. I have arranged for some of our finest healers to attend to him. If it is not too much to ask, would you speak with Dorda'en Nightweaver? He and his fellow attendants may need your help.

Title: Into the Depths
Objective: Kill Leyara.
Text: Leyara has been spotted in the Igneous Depths. A group of Shadow Wardens has cornered her. Go there immediately. I will join you as soon as I make one necessary preparation.

Title: Through the Gates of Hell
Objective: Pass through the portal atop Nordune Ridge and help Malfurion secure a foothold on the Molten Front.
Text: There will be time to mourn for Hamuul later. His is the first of many inevitable casualties in this war.... but our attack cannot wait, nor should the momentum we have gained over the last several days be wasted. The portal atop Nordune Ridge is now open. Our reinforcements are prepared, and they await only my order to pass through the portal. We will meet again on the other side of the portal. Once there, we shall ensure that our foothold is secure.

Title: A Ritual of Flame
Objective: Fight the waves of Charred Invaders on Nordune Ridge until the portal is opened.
Text: We appear to have everything under control. Our invasion portal to the Firelands will be opened momentarily, and the elementals have not put up much fight. Assist our druids by dispatching the last few of these elementals. Then, once the gate has been opened, we can make our move.

Title: To the Sanctuary!
Objective: Report to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
Text: We should not worry about this "Druid of the Flame" for the time being. We must be concerned with the continuance of our operation. Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne. If Ragnaros was prepared for our arrival, then I anticipate that his forces will launch a counterattack soon.

Title: Caught Unawares
Objective: Help Elderlimb, Thisalee Crow, Tholo Whitehoof and Anren Shadowseeker escape the flames.
Text: Our invasion plan looks to have backfired. Several of our birds have already reported in, speaking of fires breaking out across the vales of central Hyjal. Now, many of our druids are stranded out in the field, unprepared for such a large-scale attack. Thisalee was near Ashen Lake, and several others were out in the Regrowth, to the northeast. Go! Find them, and make sure that they do not succumb to this backdraft!

Title: Let's Go Fly a Kite
Objective: Purchase a Dragon Kite Two-Pack from Blax Bottlerocket in Orgrimmar's Drag then use it to fly kites with your Orcish Orphan. If your orphan is not present, call for him.
Text: The other day, when some of us were out with the matron, I saw a goblin pushing a cart filled with toys. He had dolls, copper racers, leather balls, and some kites. I've always wanted to get a dragon kite and the matron said that if I saved all my money I could buy one, but that's going to be a long time. I think the goblin's name was Blax Bottlerocket or something. If we can find him, could we get some kites and fly them together? I saw him pushing his cart around the Drag.

Title: Leyara
Objective: Find Leyara, the Druid of the Flame.
Text: Before we depart, I have another matter to which you should attend. A Druid of the Flame has been spotted in the ruins to the northwest. I suspect it is the same one that attacked us at the portal several days ago. Now would be an ideal time to see what it is that she truly wants... and if necessary, dispose of her. See to this flame druid, then we can continue on our planned course.

Title: A Troll Among Trolls
Objective: Speak to Zungam in Zul'Aman.
Text: Lissen mon, there be sumthin' else needs doin fer ol' Prigmon. Zungam, my good-fer-nuthin' cousin, be stuck inside Zul'Aman. He still be alive too - I seen his signal flare just last night! I should be lettin' him rot fer gettin' me tied up in this mess, but he be owin' me big money. Do what ya can to help him out, then leave the collectin' to me!

Title: The Wardens are Watching
Objective: Attack a Druid of the Flame to weaken it, then lure it into your Shadow Warden's trap.
Text: We must tread carefully. Fandral's Druids of the Flame practice their fiery magic beyond the pillars to the north. I need you to capture one of those druids alive for questioning. We must seize every opportunity to learn of their plans. One of my wardens will accompany you. Follow her instructions if you wish to survive.

Title: Wicked Webs
Objective: Free 8 victims out of Cinderweb Cocoons.
Text: Some of our scouts have not reported back for duty. We fear they have succumbed to the deadly spiders in the vicinity. Hope may not be lost, however. The spiders often wrap up their live prey in cocoons for later consumption. Go search the pillars to the north for cocooned victims. You may yet be able to save some of our brethren.

Title: You Scream, I Scream...
Objective: Purchase ice cream at Cone of Cold and then share it with your orphan.
Text: There's a brand new ice cream shop in Orgrimmar, and it's not just any old ice cream either. This ice cream is made by a crazy goblin mage! You don't think it's going to disappear if I don't finish it in fifteen minutes, do you? I bet it tastes really good. Let's go try it! I heard some of the other kids talking about it, and they were saying the store is called the Cone of Cold and it's in the Orgrimmar Embassy.

Title: The Hex Lord's Fetish
Objective: Obtain the Hex Lord's Fetish from Hex Lord Malacrass in Zul'Aman.
Text: Dis new warlord of da Amani, he be nothin' but an overgrown brute without da protection of a strong witch doctor and he has just dat. Da new warlord's ally be Hex Lord Malacrass, da most feared witch doctor to walk among da Amani in decades. Without da hex lord's say-so, Daakara won't be submitting his people to da control of da Zandalari. Defeat Hex Lord Malacrass, bring me his favorite fetish, and I be seein' that ya get a fittin' reward.

Title: reuse me
Objective: Defeat Viz'aduum the Watcher in Karazhan on Normal difficulty.
Text: Defeat Viz'aduum the Watcher in Karazhan (Normal).

Title: Tuskin' Raiders
Objective: Collect 10 Forest Troll Tusks from the trolls in Zul'Aman.
Text: 'Ey mon! You be new around 'ere, eh? Lemme ask a favor of ya. Budd's been refinin' his forest troll disguise. Says that he be close now - just be needin' one last touch. Tusks. My skinnin' talents be wasted 'ere. Somethin' about yankin' troll tusks be makin me queasy. Bring me back 10 troll tusks, eh mon?

Title: On a Wing and a Prayer
Objective: Bring the Timeless Eye to Coldarra.
Text: Time well spent, mortal. While you struggled in the Plane of Fire, my watchers and I were able to determine when and, most importantly, where our vision was obscured. We discovered that the shroud was placed over the Nexus, far to the north in the realm of the blue dragonflight. I have attuned the Timeless Eye to show you the occurrences that remain hidden to us here. Bring it to Coldarra at once and seek out a place suitable for its activation. Go, child. Time is of the essence...

Title: Through a Glass, Darkly
Objective: Look into the Eye of Eternity at the Nether Vortex in the Nexus.
Text: Your tale rings true. Much has changed since the death of Malygos - little of it for the better. I know of the device you carry, and I recognize Anachronos' magic in its creation. There is but one place in all of Coldarra that would allow this Timeless Eye to be used discreetly. You will require my assistance if you hope to succeed. Speak with me again inside the Nexus and you shall have it.

Title: Aviana's Grace
Objective: Contact Aviana in the Shrine of Aviana.
Text: If this was only the distraction, where is the main force? Who else is under attack? We need to figure out who else is in danger! Aviana should know, she's got eyes everywhere. Let's go ask her. We should be able to contact her in the back room.

Title: Uncovering Orders
Objective: Recover the Fragment of Spite from Blackrook Hold (Mythic), the Fragment of Power from Violet Hold (Mythic), and the Fragment of Torment from Vault of the Wardens (Mythic).
Text: It would seem secret orders have been parceled out by the Legion's masters. If they're determined to conceal their plan from us, it must pose a dire threat. We know high-ranking demons and their allies are mobilizing in places of power. Odds are good that they have received similar crystals. Perhaps you can find one intact, or at least gather enough fragments that we can reassemble one and determine the Legion's target.

Title: Resource Management
Objective: Talk to Aerylia to travel to the Path of Suffering on the Broken Shore.
Text: Now that you possess Helya's Horn, the kvaldir are yours to command. We may as well put them to good use for a change.I've dispatched my Val'kyr, Danica, to the Broken Shore. She has identified a few Legion targets that should be eliminated.Aerylia will send you there when you are ready to leave.

Title: X Marks... Your Doom!
Objective: Visit Halazzi's Chamber, Jan'alai's Platform, and Akil'zon's Platform in Zul'Aman.
Text: How did those fools fail? I told them to be careful - even gave them disguises to help them blend in. Ahh, well. The bright side of their failure is that this opportunity falls to you. Succeed, and you'll be well on your way to joining my crew and sharing in the immeasurable fame that will soon be mine. Not that I need any more, mind you. There are yet a few portions of my map that require further exploration before our excavation can be initiated....

Title: Flight of the Storm Crows
Objective: Speak to Skylord Omnuron at Malfurion's Breach.
Text: Many of the Druids of the Talon have made their way to the Molten Front, at your beckoning. You should go to Skylord Omnuron at Malfurion's Breach and see how their wings are faring in those burning skies.

Title: Shipwrecked Survivors
Objective: Speak with First Sergeant Steelfang.
Text: It appears that we have allies here on the Broken Shore. A small band of shipwrecked soldiers have been surviving here since the first assault. Their strength and tenacity will bolster our ranks. Make your way to their encampment along the beach and bring them here. Tell them that reinforcements have arrived, and the battle against the Burning Legion waits for no one.

Title: Unwanted Evidence
Objective: Bring the Fel Crystal Fragment to Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.

Title: Promises, Promises...
Objective: Retrieve Budd's Map of Zul'Aman from High Priest Nalorakk's terrace in Zul'Aman.
Text: My inscrutable theories confirm rumors of vast treasure in Zul'Aman. There'll be mounts and mansions for everyone! First things first, though. You must earn your share, after all.... Our initial efforts here haven't gone as well as I hoped. In fact, my map, and the recruits I lent it to, have gone missing. They were after a troll-beast named Nalorakk. Forget the crew, I need that map! Succeed, and you'll go down in history as the one who helped Budd Nedreck unlock the secrets of Zul'Aman!

Title: Druids of the Talon
Objective: Obtain 150 Marks of the World Tree.
Text: Skylord Omnuron and his Druids of the Talon have been a fearsome force for us back in Hyjal. I know that they prefer the familiar skies of that battlefield, but the time may come when we need them here nonetheless. If you get your hands on enough marks, you should appeal to Omnuron that his druids should be on the main front. Omnuron watches out for his own, but he also understands the importance of this effort.

Title: Hostile Elements
Objective: Kill 8 Charred Soldiers or Charred Vanquishers.
Text: The elementals continue to press on us, and I do not expect them to subside any time soon. You'll find them pouring across the Ashen Fields to the north. Thin their ranks.

Title: Vigilance on Wings
Objective: Equip a Twilight Firelance and fly Aviana's Guardian. Kill 10 Twilight Lancers by flying into them. Press the flap button to flap your mount's wings!
Text: The agents of Twilight continue their assault within this pocket of the Firelands. We must not let our offensive fall! Take wing, and destroy as many of those lancers as you can! Do not forget to pick up and equip your lance first.

Title: Oooh, Shinies!
Objective: Speak to Budd in the Ghostlands.
Text: Come closer! Let ol' Griftah look at yer shiny things.... Hmm. Yeh, yeh, not bad, but ya can do better. Much, much better.  There be priceless shinies everywhere, ya just gotta know where to look! It be yer lucky day; I know a fella who can help ya find more shinies than ya can ever carry. Visit my ol' friend, Budd, near Zul'Aman and show him this here. Ya be tellin' him ol' Griftah sent ya and he'll let ya in on his new project.

Title: Break Their Spirits
Objective: Kill Gub and the Gurubashi Master Chef inside of Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty.
Text: A city like Zul'Gurub be similar ta one of de many towering trees you see nearby. De trunk may be thick, and de canopy vast and leafy, but without nutrients from de roots far below, de tree gonna wither and fall. Jin'do's army be fed largely by de actions of a couple a' minor Gurubashi trolls. Sever dem roots, and de city gonna fall.

Title: The Fallen Chieftain
Objective: Take your orphan to Red Rocks to visit the funeral pyre of Cairne Bloodhoof. Call for your orphan if he is not present when you arrive.
Text: Matron Battlewail says that when Cairne Bloodhoof died, the Horde lost a 'voice of wisdom'. I don't know what that means, but I always wanted to meet him. Some of the other orphans even have his hoofprint. Would you take me with you to Mulgore? Our tutor says tauren bring their dead to a place called Red Rocks to honor them. We should go there and see if we can find Cairne.

Title: Secondary Targets
Objective: Kill Kaulema the Mover, Mor'Lek the Dismantler, and Mortaxx, the Tolling Bell inside of Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty.
Text: Da Gurubashi trolls gathered dere most powerful allies ta rebuild Zul'Gurub an' re-take Stranglethorn Vale. Chief among dem be two monstrous trolls: Kaulema da Mover an' Mor'Lek da Dismantler, an' a powerful soul-stealer called Mortaxx. Dey don't be leaders of da Gurubashi, but killing dem powerful minions gonna help us prevent da rise of da Gurubashi.

Title: The Beasts Within
Objective: Kill the Florawing Hive Queen, Tor-Tun the Slumberer, and a Lost Offspring of Ghaz'Ranka inside of Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty.
Text: After de fall of Hakkar, de city of de Gurubashi fell into disrepair, and de jungle claimed most of Zul'Gurub for its own. Some powerful beasts now be livin' in da cracks an' hollows of de ancient city. We seen de powers dem Gurubashi priests wield - dey turn de very plantlife against us wit' venomous concoctions. You tink you be strong? Dispose of dese beasts, before dey become mindless agents of Jin'do.

Title: UNUSED
Objective: Kill Corla, Herald of Twilight.
Text: What is this place? It looks like they're doing something terrible to that nether dragon. The energy is being siphoned from the creature into that lady! We need to stop this ritual! Kill Corla to get past this hall!

Title: Break Their Spirits
Objective: Kill Gub and the Gurubashi Master Chef inside of Zul'Gurub.
Text: A city like Zul'Gurub is similar to one of the many towering trees you see nearby. The trunk may be thick, and the canopy vast and leafy, but without nutrients from the roots far below, the tree will wither and fall. Jin'Do's army is fed largely by the actions of two minor Gurubashi trolls. Sever these roots, and the city will fall all the easier.

Title: UNUSED
Objective: Kill Corla, Herald of Twilight.
Text: What is this place? It looks like they're doing something terrible to that nether dragon. The energy is being siphoned from the creature into that lady! We need to stop this ritual! Kill Corla to get past this hall!

Title: The Beasts Within
Objective: Kill the Florawing Hive Queen, Tor-Tun the Slumberer, and a Lost Offspring of Ghaz'Ranka inside of Zul'Gurub.
Text: After the fall of Hakkar, the city of the Gurubashi fell into disrepair, and the jungle claimed most of Zul'Gurub for its own. Several powerful beasts now reside in the cracks and hollows of the ancient city. We have seen the powers that the Gurubashi priests wield - they turn the very plantlife against us with their venomous concoctions. Please, heroes, dispose of these beasts, before they become mindless agents of Jin'Do and his minions!

Title: The Banshee Queen
Objective: Take your orphan to meet Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in the Royal Quarter of the Undercity. Call for your orphan if he is not present when you arrive.
Text: Lady Sylvanas is s'posed to be one of the best warriors in the Horde, maybe that's why she is warchief! I've always wanted to meet her. Maybe an adventurer like you could get an audience with her! Would you take me to the Royal Quarter of the Undercity to meet Lady Sylvanas? It's a long way away and I bet the guards would never let me in by myself!

Title: Secondary Targets
Objective: Kill Kaulema the Mover, Mor'Lek the Dismantler, and Mortaxx, the Tolling Bell inside of Zul'Gurub.
Text: The Gurubashi trolls have gathered their most powerful allies to rebuild Zul'Gurub and re-take Stranglethorn Vale. Chief among them are two monstrous trolls: Kaulema the Mover and Mor'Lek the Dismantler, and a powerful soul-stealer called Mortaxx. Though they are not the leaders of Zul'Gurub, defeating these powerful minions will aid us greatly preventing the rise of the Gurubashi.

Title: Rage Against the Flames
Objective: Kill any 9 invaders from the Firelands in the Regrowth or Sethria's Roost.
Text: Of all of our tasks here in Hyjal, the most pressing is simple: destroy these invaders. The very nature of fire is that it is all-consuming. Lower your defense for just a moment and it will destroy everything in sight. Kill any of the fiery invaders you find. Every enemy defeated purchases more time for Hyjal.

Title: The Call of the Pack
Objective: Use the Fang of the Wolf to summon and defeat Lylagar.
Text: The easternmost portal of flame is the domain of Lylagar. Stand before the portal, deliver a challenging howl, and then force the fiery beast to submit.

Title: Supplies for the Other Side
Objective: Obtain 7 Blueroot Vines.
Text: One of the biggest dangers that our druids face when fighting within the Firelands is simple dehydration. Our proveditors spend a significant amount of time preparing canteens for the troops on the other side. We do have other methods, however. In the greener thickets to the east, you should still find some blueroot vines which have not yet burned. These plants hold a tremendous amount of water in their roots - and also provide some energy for the weary soldier.

Title: Nature's Blessing
Objective: Use the Emerald of Aessina to summon and kill Pyrachnis.
Text: I love all creatures of the forest, even spiders, despite the fact that they are icky. But the spiders from the Firelands are worse than icky. They're burny, and don't belong here. Find the fire portal in the western Regrowth, and use the gem I gave you earlier to force it open. When a fire spider emerges, step on it! Unless it's big. Then, do something y to it. Oh, and use the gem if spider venom makes you woozy!

Title: Pyrorachnophobia
Objective: Kill 8 Cinderweb Spinners or Cinderweb Creepers.
Text: We've fought hard to secure this area, but our foothold is tenuous. Our scouts report that the area around us is teeming with vicious fire spiders. They are the spawn of the vicious brood widow, Beth'tilac. Help us hold our line by clearing the area of Cinderweb Spinners or Cinderweb Creepers. It will drive her mad to see her children slain.

Title: Perfecting Your Howl
Objective: Use the Fang of the Wolf atop the corpses of 10 Firelands invaders within the Regrowth.
Text: The wolf ancient, Lo'gosh - or, if you prefer, Goldrinn - has many weapons available to him, but always the most underestimated is his howl. Today, we will use this weapon to summon and defeat Lylagar, one of the lieutenants of flame that lurk within the Firelands. Defeat any of the creatures of flame within the Regrowth, and then use the Fang of the Wolf while standing atop their corpse. Soon, your howl will echo across all of Kalimdor.

Title: The Zandalar Representative
Objective: Meet Bwemba at Stormwind Harbor.
Text: ! Heed my call. Stranglethorn Vale has need of your assistance! Long ago you helped da Zandalar out before. We not be forgetting your deeds. It be because of your past help dat we come to you for help. Come to me at the harbor.

Title: Those Bears Up There
Objective: Climb up trees in the Whistling Grove, grab stranded Hyjal Bear Cubs, and then hurl them at the Soft Target from the top of the tree. This is perfectly safe.
Text: Oh, raspberries! Just when we had saved the last bear cub from the treetops, the fires returned and scared them again! I don't know if you know this, but baby bears are precious and soft. Go to the Whistling Grove, far to the northwest. Climb the trees, grab the bear cubs, and chuck them - gently! - to the soft target in the center of the grove.  Lil' b-b-b-baby bears! Save them!

Title: The Zandalari Menace
Objective: Speak with Bwemba in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
Text: The Zandalar trolls are on the move in Stranglethorn Vale! If you wish to help the Darkspear trolls, report to Bwemba in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.

Title: Booty Bay's Interests
Objective: Recover an artifact that might keep the Zul'Gurub trolls out of Booty Bay.
Text: I've been sent here by Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay to make sure this troll menace is halted. Or that it is at least halted at the gates of Booty Bay. I want action and I want results. I want you to get in there and kill. I want you to get in there and find me something that will help keep these trolls out of Booty Bay. You do that and we'll make sure you get paid.

Title: Egg-stinction
Objective: Collect 20 Cinderweb Eggs from the pillars in The Widow's Clutch.
Text: We have a real problem on our hands. Not only are the nearby spiders vicious and predatory, their numbers appear to be endless. We need to stop the growth of their army. Cut their heads off in the egg, not on the battlefield. The Cinderweb Spinners' eggs are laid among the stone pillars to the north. Collect 20 eggs and bring them back to me.

Title: The Troll Incursion
Objective: Speak with Commander Sharp in Stormwind Harbor.
Text: A group of trolls, claiming to represent the Darkspear tribe, have arrived at Stormwind Harbor. Our guards are keeping them at bay, for now. The Stormwind Harbor Guards are seeking seasoned adventurers for help in removing the trolls from the harbor. Report to Commander Sharp at Stormwind Harbor.

Title: Making Contact
Objective: Head to Booty Bay and find Bwemba's contact.
Text: You aren't one of the zombies... A troll? I did see one, just before the outbreak... He warned us, told us to be on our guard... But it was too late. Your troll friend headed to Booty Bay to warn them...

Title: A Shiny Reward
Objective: Get your reward from a chest in the statue at Janeiro's Point.
Text: There is a stash of loot located in the statue on Janeiro's Point just northwest of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale. Head to the statue and claim your prize.

Title: Bad Supplies
Objective: Check out the food supplies at the Explorers' League Digsite.
Text: Some of da survivors mentioned food. We better check da food supplies. I gotta a bad feelin' about dis.

Title: Rage Against the Flames
Objective: Kill any 7 invaders from the Firelands in the Regrowth or Sethria's Roost.
Text: Of all of our tasks here in Hyjal, the most pressing is simple: destroy these invaders. The very nature of fire is that it is all-consuming. Lower your defense for just a moment and it will destroy everything in sight. Kill any of the fiery invaders you find. Every enemy defeated purchases more time for Hyjal.

Title: Booty Bay's Interests
Objective: Recover an artifact that might keep the Zul'Gurub trolls out of Booty Bay.
Text: Look. You've helped out plenty so far, but that's not going to be enough. I need these crazy trolls stopped, or at least stopped from getting into Booty Bay. I'm going to send a man in to oversee the action, but I want you to go into Zul'Gurub and make something happen. At the very least, I want you to find me something that will help keep these trolls out of Booty Bay. You do that and we'll treat you right.

Title: Voodoo Zombies
Objective: Rescue 10 Digsite Survivors.
Text: Da people... Dey all zombies, voodoo zombies! Dis ain't gonna be pretty. You gotta kill dem. But once dey killed, dere is a moment where I can save dem. Change dem back into da person dey were before. We gotta act fast. Da zombies don' rest.

Title: Wings Aflame
Objective: Use the Quill of the Bird-Queen to summon and defeat Millagazor.
Text: Millagazor is a creature of flame, but in many ways, he is not unlike the birds of this land. As such, Aviana's artifacts may still have the power to summon him. The fiery portal to the west is where you will find him. Use the quill near the portal's entrance, then prepare for a fierce battle.

Title: Call the Flock
Objective: Use your Call the Flock ability to gather 12 Alpine Songbirds, 5 Forest Owls, and 2 Goldwing Hawks.
Text: Today, we have an opportunity to make another assault against one of Ragnaros' greater minions: Millagazor. However, we first need to get some assistance.  Use this artifact to invoke the power of Aviana. Once you have done so, travel northwest and gather some of her flock by calling out to them. Once you have done so, we may proceed against Millagazor.

Title: Ridin' the Rocketway
Objective: Head to the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara and board the Redhound Two-Seater prototype at the top of the tower.
Text: I heard that the goblins, built a crazy road in Azshara and it's just for rockets! Can you imagine? Ever since I heard about it, I've wanted to pay a visit. I asked Matron Battlewail about it and she said it's called the Rocketway! She even told me they're working on a prototype rocket with two seats. D'you wanna go there and see if we can try it out? I bet the experimental rocket is near the Secret Lab at the south end of the Rocketway...

Title: Oculeth Ex Machina
Objective: Speak with Oculeth and teleport to Azsuna.
Text: I have a plan to feed Shal'Aran. Now that I am no longer starving for mana I have had time to study ley lines in new regions. I detected an eddy of mana in the ley lines of Azsuna. I have plenty of magic at my disposal, but we must visit the ley line in person in order to properly redirect the energy to Shal'Aran. Oculeth has graciously offered to teleport us there, but I could use an assistant. Care to join me?

Title: Attack on the Roost
Objective: Kill 15 Legion invaders.
Text: Skylord Shadegrove has been leading the defense of the shrine, but I think he's starting to lose hope. Clearly he needs some more firepower behind him! Let's take out these demons and fend off the attack. They'll never see it coming!

Title: Unbeleyvable
Objective: Assist Arcanist Valtrois with placing ley line taps.
Text: Back to the task at hand! Take these ley line taps. We can use the resonant energies to properly redirect the flow, but they must be placed in precise locations. I will show you where. Your friend has agreed to... "supervise" us. Let us hope she just stays out of the way while the professionals take care of this.

Title: A Dance With Dragons
Objective: Speak with Stellagosa to ride back to Shal'Aran.
Text: I must say I am impressed. You and your friend were able to fix a ley line, and you are not even dragons! You both seem exhausted by this ordeal. Allow me to help you get back home.

Title: The Art of Flow
Objective: Protect Arcanist Valtrois while she completes the ritual.
Text: All done! We have but one more step and Shal'Aran will have all the mana it needs. Now that I have better access to the ley line below I can break the pool so that it will flow through properly. Given the chaotic state of this ley line it will require all of my concentration to redirect the energy. I must warn you that we will attract attention while I am doing this. You will need to protect me while I complete the process. Speak to me when you are ready.

Title: Mouths to Feed
Objective: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois in Shal'Aran.
Text: We have rescued many refugees, as you can see. Unfortunately this has revealed a new problem. The arcan'dor fruit is our salvation, but it does not bear enough fruit right now to cure everyone. We must rely on mana a little longer to tide the refugees over. Valtrois thinks that she may have a solution. Please go speak with her and see what she plans to do.

Title: Trial of Valor: Odyn's Judgment
Objective: Defeat Helya within the Trial of Valor Raid.
Text: You've proven worthy to challenge Helya. Now with my blessing, the power to defeat her is yours.

Title: Talon Terror
Objective: Use the portal in the Dreamway to meet Thisalee at the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.
Text: I just received word that the Shrine of Aviana is under attack by the Burning Legion! While the Druids of the Talon here are taking their time planning and strategizing their defense, our brothers and sisters are being slaughtered where they stand. I cannot stand idly by while my home shrine is in danger. Please, come with me to save my people.

Title: Butler to the Great
Objective: Lay the table, and summon Moroes.
Text: A ghostly dinner party awaits, ready for the spread and its dinner guests.

Title: Arming the Rebels
Objective: Speak with Victoire in Meredil.
Text: The Nightfallen rebellion is growing in number, but they have not fought a real war in ages. Victoire and Silgryn are doing their best to train the new arrivals and could use an experienced hand. Go to them and show them some of the skills in battle you have picked up in your travels. We need those Nightfallen ready for battle when the time comes.

Title: Clearing the Air
Objective: Recover a Cardinal Sky Core, a Cardinal Storm Core, and a Cardinal Wind Core for Lunelli. Bring them back to her in Shattrath when you have all three.
Text: Ancient weapons require ancient offerings to regain the knowledge on how to construct them. If you wish to learn how weapons forged from air are crafted, then you must first battle with beings born from it. Bring me their cores and I will gift you the knowledge you seek.

Title: Arming the Rebels
Objective: Speak with Victoire in Meredil.
Text: The Nightfallen rebellion is growing in number, but they have not fought a real war in ages. Victoire and Silgryn are doing their best to train the new arrivals, but could use an experienced hand. Go to them and show them some of the skills in battle you have picked up in your travels. I want those Nightfallen ready for battle when the time comes.

Title: Trolling Them
Objective: Remove insulting items from the elven war camps.
Text: My army is disciplined, and they will follow my order not to engage the Sin'dorei in combat unless I give the command. However, it is with some level of shame that I must admit both armies have been attempting to harass the other with pranks, littering our respective camps with insults. Please, we need someone both armies respect to collect these items before fighting breaks out.

Title: Liadrin's Command
Objective: Speak with Lady Liadrin in Meredil.
Text: Shal'Aran is bursting at the seams with refugees and rebels. We practically have an army now but not enough weapons or mana to keep everyone armed and un-withered. And in all of this, Lady Liadrin has a battery of requests I simply do not have the time to deal with. Will you go to her? Her growing army is hard to miss in Meredil.

Title: Trolling Them
Objective: Remove insulting items from the elven war camps.
Text: My army is disciplined, and they will follow my order not to engage the kaldorei in combat unless I give the command. However, it is with some level of shame that I must admit both armies have been attempting to harass the other with pranks, littering our respective camps with insults. Please, we need someone both armies respect to collect these items before fighting breaks out.

Title: Recruitment Drive
Objective: Ask Aerylia to escort you to Helheim.
Text: Helya's kvaldir have been raiding Azeroth's coasts for centuries, and many worthy vrykul who were destined to become my Valarjar were stolen.Now that their cursed queen is defeated, the souls held captive in Helheim can finally be freed to join us!Go to Helheim with Aerylia. I assure you she will bring you back safely.

Title: Arming the Army
Objective: Search stolen crates for 10 stolen blades and 10 stolen shields.
Text: The recent battles have greatly depleted our supplies, and we will need arms for our new Valarjar.The kvaldir have an abundance of weapons, armor, and other spoils from their raiding stockpiled in stolen crates.Confiscate whatever you can!

Title: Opening the Door
Objective: Report to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem at Nordune Ridge in Mount Hyjal.
Text: You're a bit late. Hamuul, Malfurion, and some of our esteemed guests have already traveled to the invasion point, atop that cliff. Our gate to the Firelands is not yet completed, but it will be shortly. The sooner we can break through, the better. Go on! Hamuul will be expecting you.

Title: The Harder They Fall
Objective: Kill 3 Molten Behemoths.
Text: Molten Behemoths have joined the elementals upon the battlefield. They are crushing our front lines. I need you to halt their momentum. You'll find the beasts slow and clumsy. They can easily be outmaneuvered, but they will pack a devastating punch if they hit you. Be nimble.

Title: Traitors Return
Objective: Kill 3 Druids of the Flame.
Text: The Druids of the Flame assault our front line. These vile creatures have turned their backs on Elune's teachings and worship instead the Fire Lord, Ragnaros. Twisted by his insane power, they desire nothing more than to bury us in ash. We must counter their attack immediately!

Title: Wisp Away
Objective: Lead a Hyjal Wisp to one of the fire portals in the Ashen Fields, and protect the wisp until it closes the portal. If you lose your wisp, return to Rayne Feathersong at Malfurion's Breach.
