Title: Growing Strong
Objective: Reach Revered with The Nightfallen.
Text: Magic has long been a vice of the elves. It shaped us, and lifted us out of the darkness - but without balance, it also threatens to unmake us. The shal'dorei are too proud to admit it, but they are the product of indulgence. They live without harmony. But I sense potential among the Nightfallen. Losing everything has humbled them. It has made them stronger. Stay the course. Help the Nightfallen rise up.

Title: Seed of Hope
Objective: Reach Honored with The Nightfallen.
Text: Thalyssra was wise to send you in search of the arcan'dor, though she underestimates its power. She will learn - as will the others. But it will take time. And with hunger gnawing at their very souls, the Nightfallen will need your help to survive.

Title: Redemption for the Fallen
Objective: Reach Exalted with The Nightfallen.
Text: Soon the change of seasons will be upon us, and the Nightfallen will take command of their fate. You have given them hope, and set them on the path to redemption. They need you now more than ever. We all do.

Title: Follow the Recipe
Objective: Collect the other parts of the Crown Chemical Company's recipe, then return to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Stormwind.
Text: This seems to be part of a recipe for whatever concoction the Crown Chemical Company is cooking up. The other parts must be nearby.

Title: Follow the Recipe
Objective: Collect the other parts of the Crown Chemical Company's recipe, then return to Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Orgrimmar.
Text: This seems to be part of a recipe for whatever concoction the Crown Chemical Company is cooking up. The other parts must be nearby.

Title: Finite Numbers
Objective: Close 4 Portals and slay 20 Demons in Deadwind Pass.
Text: It seems not all the protections I put in place have been defeated. The Legion isn't able to open portals inside or near the tower... at least, not yet. They appear to be bringing reinforcements in through the catacombs running beneath Deadwind Pass. Disable them and you just might buy us the time we need to drive them out of Karazhan.

Title: Return to Karazhan
Objective: Meet Khadgar outside Karazhan.
Text: Karazhan is now in the hands of the Legion. The fault is mine. In my haste to retrieve Alodi's book on the Pillars of Creation, the defenses I put in place to protect the tower were ramshackle at best. The Legion was quick to find a weakness. Thanks to the time Sargeras spent controlling Medivh, he knows the tower's secrets as well as I do. Whatever the Dark Titan's plan is, we must do everything in our power to stop it. Come at once! I'll meet you outside Karazhan.

Title: Crushing the Crown
Objective: Kill 12 Crown Chemical Co. Employees and use Snagglebolt's Khorium Bomb to destroy a chemical wagon south of Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest, then return to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Stormwind.
Text: This ledger is full of locations, and I need you to investigate and take action, pal. This has gone on long enough. Here's an entry I want you to check out: it's just south of Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. That can't be good. Get out there and rough 'em up. Oh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.

Title: Khadgar's Discovery
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
Text: Champion! Please come to the Violet Citadel immediately. I have made a discovery that I would like to share with you before the Council of Six.

Title: Called to Acherus
Objective: Speak with Siouxsie the Banshee
Text: Deathlord, your presence has been requested on Acherus.The war against the Burning Legion rages on and the Knights of the Ebon Blade await further orders.Please return to Acherus at your soonest convenience. Siouxsie the Banshee is awaiting your return.

Title: Master of the Isles
Objective: Review your remaining assault point on the Broken Isles at the Command Map in your Order Hall.

Title: Sauranok Will Point the Way
Objective: Speak with Sauranok the Mystic at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
Text: I see you haven't yet spoken to the Warchiefs... other... advisor, Sauranok the Mystic. He has been at their side since our campaign together in Northrend. To assault the Twilight Highlands, we're going to need a map of the shoreline. I have tasked Sauranok with digging up this information. See if he can use your assistance!

Title: Mysteries of the Twilight Hive
Objective: Search Hive'Ashi for evidence of the Twilight Hammer's plot, and kill 10 Twilight's Hammer cultists.
Text: It's as we suspected... this hive is a hidden base of operations for the Twilight's Hammer cult. They have kept their increased activity a secret this way. We must find what they are plotting. Search the hive for any clues to their plans, and make sure you leave enough of the lunatics dead to keep them from further scheming.

Title: Riding in Plain Sight
Objective: Use the Primed Silithid Mucous near the Hive'Ashi Egg pile to infiltrate the hive.
Text: We are prepared. Take this box. Upon opening it, you will be engulfed in silithid mucus and encased within a temporary egg. Use it near other eggs on the surface of Hive'Ashi, and the drones should carry you within the hive, unknown to their twilight guardians. The egg should break before you run out of air.

Title: Prisoners of Madness
Objective: Rescue 5 Hive'Ashi Prisoners.
Text: You! Come here! Yes, to the egg! I can just barely see you. It looks like Baristolth improved his disguise before you tried it... I'm still stuck in this thing. I'm the scout he sent ahead here. No, no, there's no time to assist me! You have to help the others! They've got prisoners all throughout this hive... Find them and rescue them. I'll get out of this thing myself... how hard could it be?

Title: Secretion and Subterfuge
Objective: Collect 8 Hive'Ashi Secretion Glands from any Silithid in Hive'Ashi.
Text: I've seen no cultists wandering the surface of Hive'Ashi to the north. With any luck, we can make our preparations without being noticed. One of the organs of the silithid is used to secrete a thick sludge that hardens in the air. This is used to build hives, and by some to lay eggs. Bring me enough of these organs to cover someone twice your height, and do not venture far into the hives just yet.

Title: Baristolth's Plan
Objective: Speak with Baristolth of the Shifting Sands in Cenarion Hold.
Text: The guards here mentioned they've seen the Twilight's Hammer cultists moving closer to Hive'Ashi recently. Could they be amassing forces inside the hive, in secret? We've got to get to the bottom of this before they have a chance to put whatever foul plot they're brewing into motion. Baristolth, the hunter just across the way in front of me, has hunted through the hives of Silithus since before you or I were born. He may have a way for you to get inside Hive'Ashi unnoticed...

Title: Recalling
Objective: Use the Glyphs of Calling at the Bones of Grakkarond to summon the new master of the silithid.
Text: The glyphs illustrate an emissary of the Qiraji meeting with three silithid at the bones of a large dragon, and above them is a code... I know this code. I deciphered it when the gates of Ahn'Qiraj reopened. But the Qiraji are long defeated... who is controlling the silithid with this? Take the Glyphs of Calling to the Bones of Grakkarond, south of Cenarion Hold. Use them there and see who shows up. They likely won't be friendly... be careful.

Title: Uncovering Past Secrets
Objective: Speak with Rabine Saturna at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Text: Anyway, you should check back with me relatively soon... that is if you want to know what was in here. As soon as I find out what it is, and if it's indeed a book, I'd be happy to share that information with you. In the meantime, I'd check in with our dear "den mother" Rabine. No doubt he'll want to know what crazy antics you've been up to. Never leave the den mother waiting... that is, unless you want to be doused in honey. It's happened, trust me.

Title: Hive in the Tower
Objective: Recover the Encrusted Silithid Object.
Text: The hive needs to be addressed in Southwind Village, and I think I know a way to get at them. It's been my experience that the silithid hives are very sensitive to their environment; this explains their attacks when hearing the death wails of the spirits. The silithid are strongest in the tower - the one with the mass of wasps circling it. Scale the tower and jostle the hive into activity. Report back what you learn, but be careful! If you uncover anything that might help, bring it to me.

Title: Umber, Archivist
Objective: Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber.
Text: Analyzing this is key. If it's a journal inside this sticky chitin, then the Circle would finally have a window into the past! Give this to my friend over there. His name is Umber, and the man's brilliant. Touched, sure, but brilliant nonetheless! Umber's salvaged tomes in far worse shape than this. If it can be saved, he can do it.

Title: Wasteland
Objective: Deliver Rabine's Letter to Laylo Starstrike near Southwind Village.
Text: This is Silithus... a harsh and brutal wasteland. Few know that an ancient war was waged here between the night elves and a malign, alien power. The evil was sealed, but now we suspect that forces work to stir this... unspeakable horror. Seek out Layo Starstrike, one of my agents. I have sent him to the southeast to investigate the ruins of Southwind Village. Give him this letter, and he will give you his trust accordingly.

Title: The Spirits of Southwind
Objective: Free the spirits of 8 Tortured Druids and 8 Tortured Sentinels in Southwind Village.
Text: To our southwest lies a tragic site - the ruins of Southwind Village. This is where our work should begin. From what we've learned, this village was once a night elf base of operations for Silithus. It's long since overrun by the silithid hives that infest the wastes. I can only imagine the horror of the village's initial sundering... The tortured spirits of fallen druids and sentinels wander the ruins aimlessly. Explore this locale, freeing the souls of these wretched beings as needed.

Title: Befoulers of the Wind
Objective: Destroy 10 Desert Rumblers.
Text: You are foolish to even have come to a place such as this. But I might have use for even a fool. I stand vigil here over my master's prison, keeping watch across the years. Nothing may interrupt me. Not even the disgusting minions of the earth that roam here, intruders upon the territory of wind... I despise them! I destroy those that venture close, but I cannot allow myself to waste time on such pests. If you were to do so, however, I could reward you for it...

Title: Call of the Earthen Ring
Objective: Speak with Advisor Sevel.
Text: At last, I've found you!I have a message from Advisor Sevel.The Earthen Ring has need of you, Farseer. Please return to the Heart of Azeroth at your soonest convenience. Advisor Sevel is eagerly awaiting your return.

Title: Pressing the Assault
Objective: Select your next assault point on the Broken Isles at the Command Map in your Order Hall.

Title: The Battle for Broken Shore
Objective: Take the wind rider to the Broken Shore.
Text: This wind rider will take you to Broken Shore. May your weapon bring you many kills today.The Warchief has already made landfall, I will wager you will simply need to follow the trail of demon blood.

Title: Scouring What Remains
Objective: Select your next assault point on the Broken Isles at the Command Map in your Order Hall.

Title: Isle Hopping
Objective: Select your next assault point on the Broken Isles at the Command Map in your Order Hall.

Title: Crushing the Crown
Objective: Kill 12 Crown Chemical Co. Employees and use Snagglebolt's Khorium Bomb to destroy a chemical wagon south of Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest, then return to Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Orgrimmar.
Text: This ledger is full of locations, and I need you to investigate and take action, pal. This has gone on long enough. Here's an entry I want you to check out: it's just south of Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. That can't be good. Get out there and rough 'em up. Oh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.

Title: Author! Author!
Objective: Tell Khadgar to begin the ritual to summon the spirit of Alodi, the first Guardian.
Text: We've reviewed the tome recovered from Karazhan. Though we found references to the Pillars of Creation, one piece of crucial information was omitted from the book... where to find the artifacts. Fortunately, we have access to an expert on the subject. The author, Alodi, was the first Guardian of Tirisfal. His spirit is forever bound to the Forge of the Guardian, which has been hidden in our safekeeping. I think the time has come to call him forth.

Title: Leyline Proficiency
Objective: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois.
Text: Our leyline feed grows stronger.The more powerful our feed becomes, the more I learn about ancient mana itself.Of course, as my apprentice, you may reap the benefits of my discoveries. Listen well, and I will teach you how to extract power from your enemies more reliably.

Title: Destiny Unfulfilled
Objective: Witness True Betrayal in Shadowmoon Valley on the fringes of Outland.
Text: Hardly recognizable from the golden eyed child of prophecy, and living as an outcast on the fringes of a shattered world, his motivation remained unchanged. His assaults on the Legion and his attempts to end their march were his only focus. Yet, in a strange twist of fate, it was not the Burning Legion who came for him in the end. We must travel to Outland to experience Illidan's last memory.

Title: Lyana Darksorrow
Objective: Destroy the Soul Harvester.

Title: Leyline Master
Objective: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois.
Text: You surprise me, outlander. During our first lesson about the ancient leylines, I half-expected you to be lost in daydreams of adventure, or treasure or... some such nonsense.But you have proven an apt student.Our leyline feed has grown extremely powerful. Watching it grow has taught me a great deal about the arcane, and the nature of mana.I have one final lesson that will help you find even more ancient mana.

Title: Leyline Apprentice
Objective: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois.
Text: Good work finding those additional leyline feeds.You seem rather competent - for an outlander.Allow me to share with you a few secrets about the power of the leylines. This should help you in scavenging more ancient mana from the creatures around Suramar. A grisly task, I know - which is why I leave it to you!

Title: Grimwing the Devourer
Objective: Slay Grimwing the Devourer.
Text: You have my thanks for rescuing me from captivity. However, Azoran is no mere demon. He is a powerful eredar who commands great rank within the Burning Legion. Before we can get to him, there is another that must be destroyed. Grimwing the Devourer is the strongest of the felbats. Place the basilisk flesh upon the altar to the north and slay Grimwing when she appears. Then, return to me with her head. My thirst for vengeance must be quenched.

Title: Mr. Goldmine's Wild Ride
Objective: Ride the mine cart with Initiate Goldmine to the end of the line.
Text: Okay, we need to get to the earth portal at the back of the cave. I've "procured" a ride for us. Why walk when we can ride in style? I hope you don't mind mine carts. Let me know when you're ready.

Title: Cursed Tome
Objective: Bring the Fel-Ravaged Tome to Robert Newhearth in Dalaran.
Text: Much of the elven writing in the tome has been singed by fel fire. The head of the curators in Dalaran is renowned for his restoration skills. Perhaps he can treat the tome to bring it back to legibility.

Title: Back To The Orphanage
Objective: Return your ward to the Dalaran orphanage by handing in the Wolvar Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.
Text: Know what? You not so bad after all. You take Kekek a lot of fun places. Kekek meet a lot of new friends and do things no other pup get to do. You, and Hemet Nesingwary, and Snowfall Glade pups all new best friends. Maybe sometime you bring Kekek that green hills book? Kekek promise to write sometimes, too, tell you how things go. Maybe even be nice to big-tongue kids sometimes. Kekek gotta go back to orphan-lady Aria now, back in purple human city.

Title: Destiny Unfulfilled
Objective: Witness True Betrayal in Shadowmoon Valley on the fringes of Outland.
Text: Hardly recognizable from the golden eyed child of prophecy, and living as an outcast on the fringes of a shattered world, his motivation remained unchanged. His assaults on the Legion and his attempts to end their march were his only focus. Yet, in a strange twist of fate, it was not the Burning Legion who came for him in the end. We must travel to Outland to experience Illidan's last memory.

Title: Victory in Tol Barad
Objective: Win a Tol Barad battle and return to Colonel Karzag at Hellscream's Grasp in Tol Barad Peninsula.
Text: Maintaining control of Tol Barad is the key to our strategic plans here in the Eastern Kingdoms. We must do whatever it takes to keep the Alliance off this island and that means we need your help. Fight with everything you have to win control of Tol Barad and bring me word of victory.

Title: Prospector Gunstan
Objective: Report to Prospector Gunstan at Southmoon Ruins in Tanaris.
Text: Say... you haven't been to Southmoon Ruins yet, have you? Oh you simply MUST. They have all sorts of fascinating titan artifacts. Head west, and look for the Explorers' League tents.

Title: Victory in Tol Barad
Objective: Win a Tol Barad battle and return to Major Marsden at Baradin Base Camp in Tol Barad Peninsula.
Text: We fought hard to get a foothold on this ugly rock and there is no way we are going to let the Horde get in the way of our plans. Keeping control of Tol Barad is our first priority and we need your help. Fight your way to victory in Tol Barad and return to me word of your triumph.

Title: Back To The Orphanage
Objective: Return your ward to the Dalaran orphanage by handing in the Oracle Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.
Text: We had the best time with you. We wish you could be our  now, but you have to take us back to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran. Maybe you could come visit us again sometime? We loved meeting Winterfin hatchlings and getting to see the dragon queen. No one will believe us when we say we met a Great One! We going to miss you. We promise to write letter sometime, oki?

Title: To the Mor'shan Rampart
Objective: Report to Kadrak at the Mor'shan Rampart on the border between the Northern Barrens and Ashenvale.
Text: Kadrak at the Mor'shan Rampart to the north is calling for aid. The rampart rests on the border between the Northern Barrens and Ashenvale. It is the front line in the fight against the Alliance. We're driving the night elves out of the forest. We'll claim its resources for the Horde! To get there, take the Gold Road north out of the Crossroads. Destiny calls!

Title: They Call Him Swiftdagger. He Kills Harpies.
Objective: Locate Darsok Swiftdagger in Northern Barrens.
Text: There's an orc who lives in the west. At the frayed edge of the cataclysm's swath of destruction. They call him Swiftdagger. They call him that because ... his ... actually I think that's just his name.  Anyway, he's a harpy-killing machine. He kills harpies. Loves it. It's a living. Go and see him! See how it's done. Live the dream. You might make a career out of it.

Title: Bring Down the High Shaman
Objective: Slay High Shaman MacKilligan.
Text: Our scouts in the field report that High Shaman MacKilligan has moved out of Thundermar and is fighting amidst the Thundermar Ruins northwest of here, across the river. He's a dangerous one, responsible for the deaths of many a Dragonmaw. He WILL be destroyed, that is not the question. The question is: will you be the one to earn the glory of the kill?

Title: Total War
Objective: Smash 10 Thundermar Ale Kegs within the Thundermar Ruins.
Text: Some of the Wildhammer still cling to the hope of reclaiming the Thundermar Ruins to the north, across the river. Burn them out! Smash open kegs of Thundermar ale. That wicked brew is potent enough to explode when set aflame. Don't ask me why. And don't ask me how they drink the stuff.

Title: Return to the Lost City
Objective: Speak to Captain Hadan inside the Lost City of the Tol'vir.
Text: We might've taken Neferset City, but the Neferset have a new seat of power. Thanks to Siamat, the powerful djinn of the south wind, the Neferset have become considerably more dangerous. We just learned that some of Nadun's ambushed reconnaissance party managed to secure the entrance to the Lost City. Go find Captain Hadan and get whatever information you need to bring down Siamat and the Neferset scum.

Title: Pebble
Objective: Speak to Pebble in the Shuddering Spires. If you stay on the ground long enough, he should come out of hiding to find you.
Text: If you hadn't noticed, there's a very small elemental that has taken a liking to you. If you stay on the ground for even a few moments, I'm sure you'll spot him. You seem to be quite adept at making friends down here. A good talent to have.

Title: Crushing the Wildhammer
Objective: Kill Wildhammer Warbrands to collect 8 Wildhammer Insignias. Named characters within the Thundermar Ruins will also carry insignias.
Text: The Wildhammer grow bold with their new Alliance allies. They dare press across the river. Drive them back! Seek out and crush the Wildhammer warbrands who fight in the riverbed and within the Thundermar Ruins along the north bank. The best among them carry insignias - gather them for me to prove your allegiance to the Dragonmaw cause.

Title: Call of the Warmatron
Objective: Report to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold in Blasted Lands.
Text: Our venerable warmatron, Okrilla, has sent me to the far reaches of the world in search of suitable heroes that would join our cause. Are you interested in strengthening the Horde's grasp over the Eastern Kingdoms? Then take this portal to the Blasted Lands and report to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold!

Title: Another Maw to Feed
Objective: Gather 10 Wildhammer Food Stores from the Thundermar Ruins.
Text: Still hungry. It's like ... every day, I'm hungry. I hear there's more food stashed up in the Thundermar Ruins across the river to the north, where all the fighting is. Bring some to my mouth.

Title: The View from Down Here
Objective: Use the Viewpoint Equalizer on 5 Frostmane Builders in Frostmane Retreat.
Text: We need to halt the construction on this Frostmane village. If we let them get too entrenched, it will be more difficult to keep them from settling here permanently. It's time to give those brutes a gnome's-eye view of the world! Take this gnomish viewpoint equalizer and use it on the Frostmane builders to bring them down to our level. They won't be able to lift their tools and construction will come to a standstill.

Title: Hook 'em High
Objective: Use the Barbed Fleshhook to dismount and kill 4 Thundermar Gryphon Riders.
Text: The Wildhammer can train war gryphons faster than we can subvert and control drakes. We can't let them continue to outnumber us! Hunt gryphon riders flying over the river north of Bloodgulch. Take this hook and fling it at them as they fly by. Their momentum will hurl them from their mount, right to your feet. Kill the dismounted gryphon riders!

Title: Nethergarde Needs You!
Objective: Speak to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep in Blasted Lands.
Text: Nethergarde needs you! I have been sent here by Quartermaster Lungertz to head off Okrilla's nefarious lackeys and to recruit able-bodied heroes of the Alliance! Help us fight off the Horde! If you are willing, take this portal in front of me to the Blasted Lands and speak with the quartermaster.

Title: Into the Stonecore
Objective: Speak to Earthwarden Yrsa inside the Stonecore.
Text: You say that this Millhouse Manastorm and High Priestess Azil were to meet inside the Stonecore? Sounds big. We'd best get on their trail. We don't want the Twilight's Hammer pulling off something big right under our noses. Speak to Earthwarden Yrsa inside the Stonecore. She's been stationed there to make sure the Twilight's Hammer doesn't try to retake the Temple of Earth.

Title: Beer Run
Objective: Speak with Hammelhand on the road southeast of Thunderstrike Mountain and escort a supply caravan to Kirthaven.
Text: After my sister's wedding, I developed a taste for that Thunderbrew Lager that Kurdran had imported from Dun Morogh. More is on the way, but our caravan keeps getting jumped by the Dragonmaw! Head on up to the southeast side of Thunderstrike Mountain and catch up with the caravan. Look for a fellow named Hammelhand at the side of the road, and help him get the booze through the pass. Just get it as far as Kirthaven, and we'll take it from there.

Title: The Dunes of Silithus
Objective: Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Text: Cenarion Hold, in Silithus, is one of the biggest druid settlements in Kalimdor. Almost as big as Moonglade, mon. Someday, maybe Zen'Aliri be headin' on over to Cenarion Hold... fightin' some Twilight's Hammer, healin' the land where the silithid tear it... but Zen'Aliri's master tells him to wait. So Zen'Aliri waits. The easiest way to get there is that path up Un'Goro Crater's northwestern cliffs. If you got no master... there's nothing keepin' you from movin' on.

Title: Never Leave a Dinner Behind
Objective: Gather 10 Wildhammer Food Stores from the Thundermar Ruins.
Text: Refugees are still pouring into Thundermar from the fighting, and I'm hungry! I mean them. The refugees, they're hungry. Get me some food from the Thundermar Ruins! Scour the ruins to the south, east, and southwest for any stores that still remain. Especially them big hocks of ham. I love those! Er, the refugees do. And see if you can find some of them little cocktail weenies.

Title: Fight Like a Wildhammer
Objective: Collect 10 Kegs of Thundermar Ale from the Thundermar Ruins. Carfeul - it's got some kick!
Text: I'm all outta ale! Head out into the Thundermar Ruins and see if there's any left, before those grungy Dragonmaw get their mouths on it. Feel free to have a few sips, yerself. A mug of ol' Thundermar's finest will fortify yer fightin' skills.

Title: Keeping the Dragonmaw at Bay
Objective: Kill Dragonmaw Marauders and collect 8 Dragonmaw Insignias. Named characters within the Thundermar Ruins will also carry insignias.
Text: With your help we've thumped the Dragonmaw pretty hard, but still their daily attacks in the Thundermar outskirts persist. We need to keep up the pressure! Wade back into the battle that's raging in the Thundermar ruins to the south and southwest. Kill Dragonmaw marauders and collect the insignias that their greatest warriors wear.

Title: The Sands of Silithus
Objective: Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Text: Let's see... oh, here's a good one! Silithus! So, apparently the Cenarion Circle needs assistance with an insect infestation of some sort.  Ugh! No thanks, not for me. I'm perfectly happy freezing to death here in Everlook if the alternative is bugs. Hmm... it says here that visitors should speak with Windcaller Proudhorn, and the easiest way to get there is via the path up Un'Goro Crater's northwestern cliffs. You interested?

Title: Blasted Lands: The Other Side of the World
Objective: Report to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold in the Blasted Lands.
Text: Now here's an interesting one. It says that members of the Horde should talk to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold. Hmph! I didn't even know that the Horde held Dreadmaul Hold! I guess this Okrilla requires help fighting some ogres and the Alliance. You'd think she'd already have her hands full with all the demons down there! The best way to Dreadmaul Hold is to cross the Great Sea, then to take the road south from the Swamp of Sorrows. You interested?

Title: Blasted Lands: The Other Side of the World
Objective: Report to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep.
Text: Now here's an interesting one. It says to report to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep, in the Blasted Lands. That's just about as far as you can get from here! It says they're having trouble with Horde attacks. Hmph! I didn't know the Horde even had an outpost in the Blasted Lands! They tend to worry more about demons and less about rivalries down there, as I understand it. You'll have to cross the Great Sea, then travel south from the Swamp of Sorrows. You interested?

Title: Warlord Halthar is Back
Objective: Slay Warlord Halthar.
Text: He's at it again. Warlord Halthar... terror of the shire. He and his drake were spotted causing trouble to the south, among the Thundermar Ruins. Kill Halthar! We'll send in some warbrands to help out once you engage.

Title: Closing a Dark Chapter
Objective: Slay Erudax, the Duke of Below.
Text: This terrible place was Alexstrasza's nightmare. During what mortals call the second war, she was chained in the depths below, her tormented offspring forced to serve the demon-corrupted Horde. Alexstrasza may be free, but the beast known as Erudax still corrupts her offspring below.  Destroy him. Crush him that we may end these horrors once and for all!

Title: Kill the Courier
Objective: Kill Drahga Shadowburner and grab his Missive to Cho'gall.
Text: Thank you, for braving the horrors of this dark and terrible place. The bowels of Grim Batol are the heart of Cho'gall's war machine. If we are to stop his machinations throughout the Highlands, we must learn all we can from these depths. Seek out Drahga Shadowburner within. He is Cho'gall's runner, the link between here and the Bastion of Twilight. We must learn the secrets he carries.

Title: Waterlogged Tome
Objective: Bring the Waterlogged Tome to Robert Newhearth in Dalaran.
Text: In spite of its magical nature, the book has been damaged by water. The head of the curators in Dalaran is renowned for his abilities. Perhaps he can restore it.

Title: The Prison Rooftop
Objective: Speak to Darius Crowley upstairs in the Stoneward Prison in Gilneas City.
Text: I don't understand why the king wants to waste time saving his hide, but if you want to risk your life, then be my guest. Crowley and his men are holed up upstairs, probably plotting against the king as we speak!

Title: Twilight Skies
Objective: Check in with Friz Groundspin at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.
Text: I just got word from Orgrimmar that the Warchief wants us to move out. We wouldn't have been ready if it wasn't for your help! The plan is for the air fleet to take off immediately, and for the navy to follow close behind. Hellscream will be accompanying the air fleet and specifically requested that you come along with us. No time to delay! Go to the Southern Rocketway Terminus here in Azshara, and check in with Friz Groundspin. I'll bring the zeppelin around to pick you up.

Title: Sullah's Sideshow
Objective: Speak to Sullah at Sullah's Sideshow.
Text: Welcome, my friend! The fruits of our labor have paid off abundantly! The time has come for us to give a dress rehearsal. Oh, before we begin, I have a favor to ask. There was a small snafu with a stubborn pygmy, so I have to ask that you take his place for the performance. I'm sure you'll be able to pick it right up. You're a natural! Break a leg, my friend!

Title: Trailing the Spiritspeaker
Objective: Report to Nymn at Everlook in Winterspring.
Text: I have heard tales of Umbranse, though I have not ever met him in person. Rumor has it that he's been collecting magical artifacts, though for what purpose, I couldn't say. Best pass this information on to a trusted ally. Nymn, the high elf, can be found within Everlook, the large goblin town to the northeast. Tell him all that we learned today.

Title: Soften them Up
Objective: Free a Red Drake within Grim Batol and use it to destroy 30 Troggs and 15 Twilight's Hammer minions.
Text: At last, reinforcements! I'm so glad you're here. We never imagined just how entrenched the Twilight's Hammer forces are. And there are so many! Several of our drakes have been captured just inside the main hall. Please, break their bonds and free them. Once free, together we can scourge these halls clean with flame. Just climb aboard a red drake and call out your targets. You will definitely want to cut down the enemy numbers before delving deeper into the ruins.

Title: Fel-Ravaged Tome
Objective: Bring the Fel-Ravaged Tome to Robert Newhearth in Dalaran.
Text: Much of the elven writing in the tome has been singed by fel fire. The head of the curators in Dalaran is renowned for his restoration skills. Perhaps he can treat the tome to bring it back to legibility.

Title: In My Father's House
Objective: Witness Illidan's Sacrifice in Azshara on the continent of Kalimdor.
Text: Most mortals cannot comprehend the truth of the Legion. Those that recognize it, often refuse to accept its meaning. Such knowledge carries a weight that the mortal frame cannot bear. To sacrifice that much of ones self changes the soul. Among your greatest heroes, a rare few understood that type of sacrifice. Let us witness it through Illidan's eyes. We must go to Azshara, on the continent of Kalimdor.

Title: Ravencrest's Legacy
Objective: Experience Ravencrest's Legacy at Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah.
Text: Years later, as the War of the Ancients raged on and the Burning Legion's grip upon this world took hold, Illidan would meet a military leader known as Kur'talos Ravencrest. He too would see the potential within Illidan, eventually promoting him to captain of the Moon Guard: a powerful group of night elf sorcerers. We must experience this memory in Black Rook Hold, located on the western shores of Val'sharah.

Title: Destiny Unfulfilled
Objective: Witness True Betrayal in Shadowmoon Valley on the fringes of Outland.
Text: Hardly recognizable from the golden eyed child of prophecy, and living as an outcast on the fringes of a shattered world, his motivation remained unchanged. His assaults on the Legion and his attempts to end their march were his only focus. Yet, in a strange twist of fate, it was not the Burning Legion who came for him in the end. We must travel to Outland to experience Illidan's last memory.

Title: Second Sight
Objective: Use your Spectral Sight.
Text: Though young King Anduin is a noble soul, he may lack the conviction of his father. The Alliance needs a leader who will do what needs to be done. The Legion will strike at the first hint of weakness. Even now, I sense something amiss. I fear that not all is as it seems. Quickly, use your Spectral Sight. We must know if there are foes among us!

Title: A Weapon of the Alliance
Objective: Meet with the Illidari in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
Text: At first I was unsure whether it was wise to allow the Illidari inside the city. But you may have just saved all our lives. You may establish a camp in the Mage Quarter. The Alliance will have need of your skills if we are to face the Legion. Make no mistake though. Should your kind give in to the fel energies you toy with, we will treat you like the demons you are becoming.

Title: Recruiting Earthcallers
Objective: Speak to Felinda Frye.
Text: Felinda Frye has recently joined us at the Heart of Azeroth. She oversees the recruitment and training of our Earthcallers. I recommend that you speak with her at your soonest convenience, Farseer . The Earthcallers are powerful shaman and will greatly bolster our ranks.

Title: Demons Among Them
Objective: Protect the King.
Text: It is just as we suspected! The demons thought they could take us by surprise. Quickly, to arms! Warn the King!

Title: An Unclear Path
Objective: Witness Illidan's Resilience at the Dreamgrove in Val'sharah.
Text: Much of Illidan's formative years were spent in Val'sharah, alongside his twin brother, Malfurion. As young night elves, the twins vied for the affection of the young priestess, Tyrande, as they underwent the trials of the demi-god, Cenarius. We must travel to the Dreamgrove now, where Illidan's true path would be forged.

Title: Awakenings
Objective: Witness the Awakening of Illidan Stormrage in Val'sharah.
Text: Light's Heart is to serve as the vessel for Illidan Stormrage's rebirth: my last act of service to the Light. But Illidan is dead and his soul is lost in the Nether. Before we may attempt to recover his soul, we must prepare the vessel for his return. Across two worlds exist echoes of Illidan's past. You must venture out and find the echoes. Start where all life begins: birth. Find Illidan's birthplace in Val'sharah. Awaken the memory.

Title: Brotherly Love
Objective: Find Maiev Shadowsong in Black Rook Prison.
Text: Maiev will be somewhere in the prison. I found her discarded armor on my way here.I know the two of you have a history. I trust that will not be a problem.Let's split up to search the cells more quickly. We must find her.

Title: The Pursuit of Umbranse
Objective: Report to Haleh at Beryl Egress in Winterspring.
Text: We have isolated Umbranse's position here in Winterspring. It is as I suspected. Umbranse is at Mazthoril, the cavern that once belonged to the blue dragonflight, in the southwest. My mother, Haleh, will greet you there. She is stationed outside of the cave in a small camp with a few other survivors. Look for her campfire.

Title: Sins of the Sea Witch
Objective: Legionnaire Nazgrim wants you to slay Lady Naz'jar.
Text: Naz'jar! She's the one responsible for this mess. She's in here somewhere. She must be exhausted after that fight with Neptulon. Now is the time to strike! We won't have another opportunity like this. I'll handle anything that tries to aid her from this direction. Find her, and run her through!

Title: Hyena Harvest
Objective: Use Sullah's Hyena Trap to capture 5 Bloodsnarl Hyenas.
Text: Look! I have taken your bait and fashioned traps that will be most useful in your next task. Far to the southeast of here run a dangerous pack of Bloodsnarl Hyenas. I am confident that they can be tamed and used to great effect in our performance. Lay one of these next to them and they won't be able to resist it. Then, once they're trapped, you just have to collect them and bring them back. It works almost every time!

Title: The Vortex Pinnacle
Objective: Find Itesh inside the Vortex Pinnacle.
Text: One of our civilian leaders was taken prisoner by the air elementals. They are probably torturing him for information as we speak. Go to the Vortex Pinnacle, where these foul creatures came from, and look for Itesh. You will find the entrance to the Vortex Pinnacle hovering off of the southeastern coast of Uldum.

Title: Umbranse's Deliverance
Objective: Slay Umbranse the Spiritspeaker.
Text: Umbranse lurks in the back of Mazthoril. His time has come. Unfortunately, I am unable to join you on this quest. While I'd love to get my hands on that snake, Mazthoril's magic would rip me apart in its current state. No, I need you to finish this for me. When the deed is done, use this charm. It will return you safely to the egress.

Title: The Arcane Storm Within
Objective: Use the Empowered Dreamcatcher to close 5 Arcane Tesseracts within Mazthoril.
Text: Mazthoril's innate magic can wreak unimaginable havoc if mishandled. Umbranse's wanton casting within the cavern has opened up a number of tesseracts - in other words, portals - connecting to other worlds. If I am to return to Mazthoril, these tesseracts must be closed. The dreamcatcher will close the portals, buying you safe entrance into Umbranse's lair. First defeat whatever comes out of the tesseracts, then use the dreamcatcher to quickly close them, before anything else spills into this world.

Title: Winterwater
Objective: Obtain 7 Winterwater from Ice Avatars in Frostwhisper Gorge.
Text: I don't want our gambit to fail. Such a failure would only draw attention to our efforts, giving Umbranse an opportunity to hone his defenses. No, we have to do this right the first time. The Frostwhisper Gorge, to the south, provides us access to powerful ice elementals. The water within these elementals' hulls should amplify the power of your dreamcatcher, ensuring our efforts. Obtain this water. Then return to our small camp.

Title: The Owlbeasts' Defense
Objective: Obtain an Owlbeast Dreamcatcher from Dun Mandarr.
Text: What a shame. Whatever Umbranse has done, he has prevented me from undoing his magic. He is wiser than I had anticipated. I do have a backup plan, however. I have seen owlbeasts enter and leave Mazthoril, even after Umbranse took control. Their ancient druidic magic must be capable of disabling Umbranse's. Luckily, I happen to be somewhat of an expert in their methods. Travel south, to Dun Mandarr. You will find a chest with a dreamcatcher in it. That will be your first step.

Title: Magic Prehistoric
Objective: Obtain the Essence of the Claw-Totem, the Essence of the Life-Totem, and the Essence of the Moon-Totem.
Text: The owlbeasts' sacred caves are located to the east. Within several of these caves, you should find totems. I want you to approach these totems and gather whatever essence you can from them. The dreamcatcher should absorb this essence for use within Mazthoril.

Title: Altered Beasts
Objective: Obtain 5 Mana-Addled Brains from Altered Beasts.
Text: We, the blue dragons, have been forced out of our home, Mazthoril. An impostor by the name of Umbranse has taken advantage of us in our weakest hour, and now occupies the cave. Mazthoril is a place of extremely potent magic, and he does not know how to wield it. Even the wildlife suffers. The beasts nearby have been altered. Please, I must ask you a favor. Gather their brains, so I can see if I can undo this Umbranse's wild magic.

Title: Sins of the Sea Witch
Objective: Slay Lady Naz'jar in the Throne of Tides.
Text: That vile worm has earned a thousand deaths! It won't be easy. She and her minions are firmly entrenched in this place, but she's bound to be exhausted from her fight with Neptulon. Now is the time to strike! We won't have another opportunity like this. Run her through!

Title: Necessary Refreshment (Backup Groundspawn Quest)
Objective: Obtain 6 Cactus Apples.
Text: It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials.  If only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat. I'll tell you what. If you bring me 6 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.

Title: Rescue the Earthspeaker!
Objective: Rescue Erunak Stonespeaker.
Text: Good! You've brought allies. You must hurry if we are to rescue Erunak. Go now. Fight your way through Neptulon's halls. Find the shaman and free him from these worms... if he still lives. Don't worry about them coming up from behind you. I'll see that nothing makes it past me!

Title: You Gotta Have Eggs
Objective: Obtain 40 Chillwind Eggs.
Text: I don't have a very discerning palate, but even I can't stand the taste of those chimaeras that you'll find around here. Their eggs, however, are a different story. Chimaera eggs are the richest, most buttery eggs you'll find this side of Orgrimmar. Way better than boring owl eggs, and not as sulfurous as those weird wildkin eggs. I'll take as many of them as you can gather. Head northeast, and look for their nests in the snow.

Title: Rescue the Earthspeaker!
Objective: Rescue Erunak Stonespeaker.
Text: Good! You've brought allies. You must hurry if we are to rescue Erunak. Fight your way through Neptulon's halls. Find the shaman and free him from these worms... if he still lives. Don't worry about them coming up from behind you. Nothing's making it past me!

Title: Twilight Shores
Objective: Speak with Lieutenant Fawkes at Highbank in Twilight Highlands.
Text: Right then, just hop in the seaplane behind me and I'll fly yeh to the Highlands. We're to report to a feller named "Lieutenant Fawkes." I've promised the King we'd get there lickety-fast, so I took the liberty of ditchin' any excess weight. Like seatbelts. Parachutes. Maps. Stabilizers. Landing gear. I never actually "land" these things anyways.

Title: To the Depths
Objective: Speak with Recruiter Burns at Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City.
Text: The Earthen Ring has identified the watery realm of Vashj'ir as a source of the adversary's destructive energies. It is still uncertain what dangers might be faced there, so any information you could gather would be of great value. The Alliance is sending warships to the region as we speak. To gain passage, travel northwest of Stormwind and speak to Recruiter Burns at Stormwind Harbor. May the spirits guide you.

Title: Razor Beak and Antlers Pointy
Objective: Slay 12 Owlbeasts in Owl Wing Thicket.
Text: What happened to me, you ask? Listen, and listen well, for my tale is one of tragedy... I was sent here to Owl Wing Thicket to find some relics. I only made it this far before I was overwhelmed by a flurry of wings and talons. How they roared and pecked! I now lay here, a broken orc, with nothing but vengeance on my mind. Please, if you have any sense of honor, you will go into Owl Wing Thicket and help me regain mine.

Title: Damn You, Frostilicus
Objective: Slay Frostilicus.
Text: The Frostmaul giants wouldn't have been a problem if it weren't for that damned Frostilicus. When the ground shook and the bridge broke, he and his fellow water elementals seeped out of the earth and took over the bottom of Frostwhisper Gorge, forcing the giants out. Damn you, Frostilicus! You would do me a great honor if you would send him back into the ground. You will find him to the south, at the bottom of the gorge.

Title: Chips off the Old Block
Objective: Slay 8 Frostmaul Tumblers.
Text: My mysterious benefactors gave me more than one task. The second task took me farther south, to the Frostwhisper Gorge. I was surprised to learn that the gorge's bridge had been broken in two, preventing land travel from one side to the other. In addition, the juvenile Frostmaul tumblers were separated from their stronger adult parents. I thought that I could defeat them in battle. I was incorrect. I was forced to run away in shame. Teach these tumblers a lesson. Fight them, and win.

Title: The Rear is Clear
Objective: Report to Marshal McBride in front of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
Text: Excellent work! The rear is now officially clear. We'll take care of the stragglers. I want you to go back to Marshal McBride, standing in front of Northshire Abbey, south of here, and let him know that the goblin situation is under control. Farewell.

Title: A Personal Summons
Objective: Speak to Naraat the Earthspeaker in Stormwind.
Text: Hear my words. Our world finds itself in the grip of a terrible crisis. I call upon you to lend your aid in this desperate hour. I am Naraat. Seek me out at once, and your calling shall be revealed. I await you at the Eastern Earthshrine in Stormwind City.

Title: The Rear is Clear
Objective: Report to Marshal McBride in front of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
Text: Excellent work! The rear is now officially clear. We'll take care of the stragglers. I want you to go back to Marshal McBride, standing in front of Northshire Abbey, south of here, and let him know that the goblin situation is under control. Farewell.

Title: The Eye of the Storm
Objective: Naraat the Earthspeaker wants you to look into the Waters of Farseeing.
Text: Greetings, hero of Azeroth. We of the Earthen Ring know you by name. Your exploits and accomplishments are many. Azeroth already stands in your debt, and yet again she is in need of her heroes. I am but a messenger. A powerful presence seeks audience with you. Peer into the Waters of Farseeing and behold the dilemma of our world.

Title: The Rear is Clear
Objective: Report to Marshal McBride in front of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
Text: Excellent work! The rear is now officially clear. We'll take care of the stragglers. I want you to go back to Marshal McBride, standing in front of Northshire Abbey, south of here, and let him know that the goblin situation is under control. Farewell.

Title: Wayward Child
Objective: Slay Ozruk.
Text: One of my children is not with me. He stayed behind with the Twilight's Hammer at the Stonecore deep within the Temple of Earth. I sent my other children to free him from the dark magic that was surely keeping him from returning here, but... no such magic was placed upon him. Go into the Stonecore and destroy Ozruk. He must be reclaimed by the earth.

Title: Advanced Quenching
Objective: Craft a pair of Hard Leystone Armguards for Alard.
Text: Now that we have a frost mage at our disposal, testing this method out should be a cinch. Here are the plans for what I'd like you to make. Get to work and give me the armguards when you're finished.

Title: The Rear is Clear
Objective: Report to Marshal McBride in front of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
Text: Excellent work! The rear is now officially clear. We'll take care of the stragglers. I want you to go back to Marshal McBride, standing in front of Northshire Abbey, south of here, and let him know that the goblin situation is under control. Farewell.

Title: In the House of Light and Shadow
Objective: Take the Tears of Elune to Light's Heart in your Order Hall.
Text: The Tears of Elune are ready for you. I am uncertain what to do from here. Take the relic back to your order hall and try to use it on Light's Heart. Maybe make them touch? Honestly your guess is as good as mine. Let's hope this works!

Title: Weapons of the Ancients
Objective: Choose a fourth artifact to pursue.
Text: You've proven yourself to be a druid without equal, but if we are to succeed in our battles against the Burning Legion you need you to take advantage of every opportunity to stay ahead of our foes. You should consider obtaining one final weapon of the Ancients. Its powers will maximize your ability to adapt to whatever the Legion can throw our way. Let me know how you'd like to proceed.

Title: More Weapons of Old
Objective: Choose a third artifact to pursue.
Text: You've had great success against our foes, but you should be ready for any challenge they send your way. You would be wise to consider obtaining yet another of the weapons of old to aid in our conflict. Let me know how you'd like to proceed.

Title: Anomalous Anomalies
Objective: Use Khadgar's crystal to neutralize anomalies in Dalaran.
Text: Dalaran's move to this location was intended to be a temporary measure, but we may need to depart sooner than expected. Blinking a city across the world is no mean feat. The magnitude of energies involved can lead to... unexpected side effects. Arcane anomalies are causing mischief throughout the city. Their presence could destabilize any attempt to blink again. We don't have time to let them dissipate on their own. I have a device that will help speed things along.

Title: Three Paths, Three Weapons
Objective: Choose a third artifact to pursue.
Text: We've searched and found a lead upon another artifact that you might find helpful.Here, let me show you what I've found. If it interests you then simply let me know.

Title: One More Legend
Objective: Speak with Odyn to pursue another artifact.
Text: Two is good, but three would be better. You should pursue another artifact to add to your armory.What say you?

Title: Hunter of Night
Objective: Defeat Malvingeroth
Text: A glorious battle indeed!If I am correct, we can expect something a bit more deadly at any moment.The Legion often uses fodder such as these to prepare the way for a more worthy foe.My axe is sharp and ready.

Title: Enemies Everywhere
Objective: Defeat the hidden infiltrators in Dalaran.
Text: Hold a moment. While I look into this orb of yours, why don't you look into something for me? I have long suspected an infiltration of Dalaran but after an embarrassing encounter with a local florist I've withheld my accusations until I'm absolutely certain. Have you noticed citizens among us that seem just too mundane? Almost inhumanly so? Spies, serving dark masters, watch and wait until our backs are turned. Root them out, but try and keep it quiet.

Title: The Red Axe
Objective: Close the Unstable Portals and make your way to Broxigar the Red.
Text: Broxigar the Red is cornered on the bridge. I am not sure he would ever admit that he needs our help, but I feel it only proper to lend him our aid.If you wish to assist our ally, I would be humbled to accompany you in this endeavor.

Title: Strange Humming Crystal
Objective: Take the Strange Humming Crystal to Khadgar in Dalaran.

Title: Felspawns of Lothros
Objective: Defeat Lothros.
Text: These Felspawns are endless! I can't cut them down quickly enough to get to the dreadlord within the mausoleum.Master Illidan, will you come with me so we can take down Lothros together?

Title: Fear No Evil
Objective: Revive 4 Injured Stormwind Soldiers.
Text: Have you embraced the Holy Light yet? It is through the Holy Light that we are saved! It is through the Holy Light that I am able to heal these overly demanding soldiers! And it is through the Holy Light that you will be able to venture out into the field to the north and rescue our fallen brothers! Take this prayer book with you into the field and cast the Light's healing touch on the injured.

Title: Twilight Documents
Objective: Obtain the Twilight Documents.
Text: We've tailed one of the Twilight's Hammer operatives here. He goes by the name of Millhouse Manastorm. We have reason to believe he's carrying important documents. This is as far as we can safely go, however, without neglecting our duty to defend the Temple of Earth's inner perimeter. Track down Manastorm and retrieve the documents from him.

Title: Followers and Leaders
Objective: Slay High Priestess Azil and 101 Devout Followers.
Text: The documents detail the arrival of High Priestess Azil to the depths of the Stonecore. Azil is described as a high-ranking member of the Twilight Council. Additionally, her entourage of over a hundred devout followers is preparing for an unholy ritual of unforeseen darkness. Sounds like an event you need to put a stop to.

Title: Fear No Evil
Objective: Revive 4 Injured Stormwind Soldiers.
Text: Have you embraced the Holy Light yet? It is through the Holy Light that we are saved! It is through the Holy Light that I am able to heal these overly demanding soldiers! And it is through the Holy Light that you will be able to venture out into the field to the north and rescue our fallen brothers! Take this prayer book with you into the field and cast the Light's healing touch on the injured.

Title: Expert Opinion
Objective: Bring the Suspicious Badges to Mathias Shaw at SI:7 Headquarters in Stormwind.
Text: The medallion we found on the farm is identical to the one in Samuelson's notes! It can't be a coincidence. I think Samuelson is up to something, but we need a smoking gun before we can accuse one of my father's most trusted guards. There's only one person I trust to sort this all out: Mathias Shaw, the director of SI:7. Show him these badges and see what he thinks. Meanwhile, I'll go back to the keep and watch Samuelson like a hawk!

Title: The Eye of the Storm
Objective: Farseer Krogar wants you to look into the Waters of Farseeing.
Text: Greetings. Yes, you are known to the Earthen Ring by name. Your exploits and accomplishments are many. Azeroth already stands in your debt, and yet again she is in need of her heroes. I am but a messenger. A familiar presence seeks audience with you. Peer into the Waters of Farseeing and behold the fate of our world.

Title: They Sent Assassins
Objective: Kill 8 Goblin Assassins.
Text: Have you ever seen a goblin? They're wretched little green-skinned monsters that love only two things: gold and themselves. The Blackrock orcs have enlisted the aid of goblin assassins to kill our soldiers. If you look to the field in the north you can barely make out their silhouettes, sneaking about in the grass. I need you to head out there and kill every goblin that you see. They need to learn that nobody messes with the Alliance!

Text: Hear my words. Our world finds itself in the grip of a terrible crisis. I call upon you to lend your aid in this desperate hour. I am Krogar. Seek me out at once, and your destiny shall be revealed. You can find me north of the Drag in Orgrimmar.

Title: Join the Battle!
Objective: Report to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
Text: I received an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them! Find Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!

Title: Join the Battle!
Objective: Report to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
Text: I received an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them! Find Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!

Title: The Third Legend
Objective: Speak with Alonsus Faol to pursue a third artifact.
Text: You have not one but TWO powerful artifacts to use against the Legion. But can you imagine a world where you have three? Think of what you could do in such a world!Shall we look at the possibilities?

Title: Aggra's Guidance
Objective: Seek out Aggra at the Storm's Eye Overlook within the Heart of Azeroth.
Text: t, have you met the shaman Aggra? Born of a shattered world, she learned the ways of the elements among the Mag'har orcs of Outland. On the eve of the Cataclysm she took it upon herself to complete Thrall's shamanistic training. Our younger initiates are fortunate to have her among us to guide them. If you wish to seek out a second artifact, Aggra can assist you. She is training new recruits above us on the Storm's Eye Overlook.

Title: A Weapon For Every Occasion
Objective: Let Duke Lankral know if you'd like to pursue another artifact.
Text: Our ally, the Lich King, has offered to provide you with a lead on a final weapon should you desire to maximize our offensive options.Let me know how you would like to proceed.

Title: Assault on Violet Hold: Purple Pain
Objective: Repel the Assault on Violet Hold.
Text: Again! It happened again!Sure, it's the Legion that staged the prison breakout this time, but I *told* them it was a bad idea to keep some of the most dangerous beings on Azeroth in a prison inside our city!We can talk about relocating later, I suppose. Right now, we've got some... pacification to tend to.Can you help?

Title: In Pursuit of Power
Objective: Let Kayn know if you'd like to pursue another artifact.
Text: There is still one other pair of blades that could be of great use to you in the battles to come. I can brief you on what we know if you would like to pursue them.

Title: The Final Blade
Objective: Let Jorach know if you'd like to pursue another artifact.
Text: As I'm sure you recall, we have retained our final set of plans to obtain a weapon of immense power. No pressure, of course, but if you wish to pursue it just let me know.

Title: In Pursuit of Power
Objective: Let Altruis know if you'd like to pursue another artifact.
Text: There is one more pair of blades still within reach that would aid you against the Legion. If you wish to pursue them, just let me know.

Title: Join the Battle!
Objective: Report to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
Text: I received an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them! Find Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!

Title: Completing Your Arsenal
Objective: Let Tyrosus know if you'd like to pursue another artifact.
Text: Highlord, there is still one last weapon out there that would aid you against the Legion. If you would like, I would be happy to go over our latest information on its whereabouts.

Title: Join the Battle!
Objective: Report to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
Text: I received an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them! Find Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!

Title: The Source of Their Power
Objective: Slay Siamat.
Text: We managed to do extensive scouting before our crew was ambushed. We discovered that Deathwing's envoy, Siamat, is giving the Neferset their newfound power. They claim it has restored them to the greatness of old, but something else has happened. Their very souls have been corrupted. As one of the four winds, Siamat is incredibly powerful. But that power has been drained considerably by this process. Strike now, while it is possible for you to slay him and bring an end to this madness.

Title: A Bird of Legend
Objective: Slay Hell-Hoot.
Text: Local legend tells of a mighty owl that circles the mountaintops like death on wings. They named her Deathwing. Soon afterwards, they were told that that name was already taken. So they settled on a moniker that evoked a similar sense of horror and dread: Hell-Hoot. Hell-Hoot can be found atop the mountain to the southwest of our smoking pit. Silence the infernal nocturnal... so we can eat her!

Title: A Long Way from Home
Objective: Obtain Grand Vizier Ertan's Heart.
Text: I've a feeling I was able to escape my captors because, frankly, there is nowhere to go. Stranded on these platforms, they are bound to find me sooner or later. Unless... It is said that the heart of an elemental noble can grant whoever holds it the characteristics of that element. Which, in the case of air, would be most useful during a downward trip. Bring me Grand Vizier Ertan's heart so I can use its magic to land safely on the shoreline of Uldum.

Title: Broken Owl Figurine
Objective: Repair the broken figurine using your skill and materials.
Text: This badly broken figurine was discarded by its last owner. However, with the right materials and your skill in jewelcrafting, it could be completely restored.

Title: Targets of Opportunity
Objective: Slay General Husam and 2 Oathsworn Captains.
Text: We were part of a clandestine operation put together by Prince Nadun of Ramkahen. We lost most of our unit during an ambush and we're now unable to finish our mission. Should you be up for it, I can arrange for a sizable reward for you. We were instructed to take out any targets of opportunity that would damage the enemy's military infrastructure. We've spotted General Husam and two of his captains up ahead. Slaying them for us will be a great favor for Ramkahen.

Title: Lions for Lambs
Objective: Kill 8 Blackrock Spies.
Text: The invading orcs aren't fools. They are sizing us up, making sure that when they attack it will be to their advantage. In the forest, to the northwest, are Blackrock spies. They peer at us through spyglasses, watching our every move - waiting. I want you take the fight to them! Kill the Blackrock spies! We must show them that we know they are watching us and that we are prepared!

Title: Join the Battle!
Objective: Report to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
Text: I received an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them! Find Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!

Title: Winterspring!
Objective: Report to Donova Snowden at Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring.
Text: Donova Snowden, dwarf woman, is friend of the Timbermaw. We trade firewater. She is at Frostfire Hotsprings, to the east, through our cave. She needs help to beat up the Winterfall furbolg. Maybe you will help her.

Title: Lions for Lambs
Objective: Kill 8 Blackrock Spies.
Text: The invading orcs aren't fools. They are sizing us up, making sure that when they attack it will be to their advantage. In the forest, to the northwest, are Blackrock spies. They peer at us through spyglasses, watching our every move - waiting. I want you take the fight to them! Kill the Blackrock spies! We must show them that we know they are watching us and that we are prepared!

Title: Beating Them Back!
Objective: Kill 6 Blackrock Worgs.
Text: So you're the new recruit from Stormwind, eh? I'm Marshal McBride, commander of this garrison. Glad to have you on board...  . It is , right? You've arrived just in time. The Blackrock orcs have managed to sneak into Northshire through a break in the mountain. My soldiers are doing the best that they can to push them back, but I fear they will be overwhelmed soon. Head northwest into the forest and kill the attacking Blackrock worgs! Help my soldiers!

Title: Beating Them Back!
