Objective: Place a work order for Champion armaments and equipment.
Text: If we gonna win dis war, we need to get these Champions of ours better equipment.It won't be cheap, or easy, but I can get dem for you.

Title: Fate and Time
Objective: Place a work order for a Seal of Broken Fate.
Text: For years we wondered, we conjectured, that it was possible to control the twisting, slipping, streaming threads of fate and destiny. These books tell of powerful mages who embraced the manipulation of time. No no, not like Time Warp, they would laugh at us, think us silly amateurs. No, they were true Chronomancers.The only spell we've been able to determine is a conjuration. It calls forth what they termed a "Seal of Fate". This allowed them to repeat their actions. Let us try it out shall we?

Title: Unseen Fate
Objective: Place a work order for a Seal of Broken Fate.
Text: Our path is a winding, twisting road full of peril. Yet did you know it can be walked many times? There is an item of great power available to us. It allows us another opportunity, a second chance.Do you wish to acquire one?

Title: The Might of Dalaran pt2
Objective: Collect the Focusing Crystal and use it to complete a world quest.
Text: Yes, now once the crystal has been empowered, collect it here, and use it to unleash the power of our mages on a world quest.

Title: Portal Full of Shiny Things
Objective: Place a work order for Champion armaments and equipment.
Text: When I heard the Hall of the Guardian was open again, I said to myself "Minuette, this is your chance!" I rushed over here thinking I'd be hurled into the front lines. Imagine it, me, little old me, assaulting Demons with missiles, blinking away from Fel Meteors. That would be brilliant!Instead, they send me over here and say "Hey, open up some portals so we can throw things through, would you?" At least I get to charge something for it.

Title: The Might of Dalaran
Objective: Channel the power of Dalaran into the focusing crystal, then unleash it to complete a World Quest.
Text: In times of great need, the mages of Dalaran can focus their power into one pure, destructive form. This is such a time.On request, these mages will channel that power into a focusing crystal, which we will impart to you. Use it to unleash that power, completing a quest of great value.

Title: Workorders for Armaments
Objective: Place a workorder for a shipment of Champion Armaments and Equipment.
Text: I can get you the best deals on some slightly... used... equipment.

Title: The Ascended
Objective: Place a request to recruit Ascendants.
Text: These shaman have spent their lives dedicated to the path of Air, Water or Fire. On your request, we will beseech the elements to Ascend them, becoming a powerful, if short lived, force to deploy in this war against the Legion.The ritual of ascension is not to be requested lightly.

Title: Seal their Fates
Objective: Place a work order for a Seal of Broken Fate.
Text: Ever feel like luck just isn't on your side? Well maybe I can help you with that.There are some interesting items I've come across in my travels which can be used to swing the dice in your favor, or at least give you another shot at it. It takes some time, and supplies are hard to come by, but I can get you one of them... for a price?

Title: Shape Your Fate
Objective: Place a work order for a Seal of Broken Fate.
Text: The whims of the spirits can be guided, I have seen it.There were whispers of an item, a way to change the path of destiny. I heard dem, and I went looking. For many years I listened to those whispers on the wind until one day they showed me the way. This is what I offer you. It will take some time, and some valuable resources, but I can perform the ritual to allow you to control this power.Well? Are you ready?

Title: In the Blink of an Eye
Objective: Witness the teleportation of Dalaran to the Broken Isles.
Text: The Broken Isles is our destination. The spell that will blink Dalaran to its new location is not a simple one. It will take this Council's full energy and attention. As Jaina is... absent, Kalecgos of the blue dragonflight has offered us his aid. The Legion will make every attempt to stop us, but we will not falter. It is time to begin!

Title: A Particularly Potent Potion
Objective: Steal Love Potion #6 from Gallywix's personal safe.
Text: I've got a proposition for ya! Word has it that Trade Prince Gallywix recently acquired a priceless, one-of-a-kind love potion. There's only one goblin who can replicate it and you're looking at him! Get me that potion and I can make us both richer than kings! The pleasure palace is located in Azshara and it has been on high alert since the war started. Gallywix isn't letting anybody in except his personal staff, but I know a girl on the inside! Find her and she'll get you to the safe!

Title: City Under Siege
Objective: Meet Khadgar at the Chamber of the Guardian in Dalaran.
Text: Obtaining information on the Pillars of Creation before the Legion could stop us was a considerable victory. It won't bring back those we lost on the Broken Shore, but I believe it will help us avenge them. Dalaran has become a focal point of the Legion's assault. Your presence here is crucial. If the demons are putting this much effort into attacking the city, it means Dalaran will play a pivotal role in the struggle to save Azeroth.

Title: Treasure
Objective: Speak with Valtrois.
Text: There is a strange energy in the air.I feel as if a force is growing, pressing down on us. It is worrisome.Valtrois works most closely with the sources of power in this room.Speak to her. Ask if there is anything to be concerned with.

Title: The Perfect Horns
Objective: Obtain Icewhomp's Pristine Horns.
Text: I can't make a yeti without horns! I've been looking for what seems like forever for the perfect set of horns... and no horn I find is good enough! But just the other day I saw the biggest yeti in Winterspring. I named him Icewhomp. His horns are the ones I've been looking for! He lurks all the way in the back of the cave along the eastern ridge of Ice Thistle Hills. Bring me his horns... but be sure to check on Echo Three along the way!

Title: Seril's Boast
Objective: Speak with Deez Rocksnitch.
Text: Brutes and amateurs. It doesn't matter how sharp or heavy your weapon is if all it's good for is hacking like an ogre. I could go on and on about finesse and speed and balance and control... but it's easier to one-up these fools. Tell Deez we've got one more order for him. I need a block of ice.

Title: Echo Three
Objective: Find Echo Three.
Text: A lot of goblins have been going missing out there in Ice Thistle Hills. I was almost one of them! I had the idea to set up a sensor to tell us when the yeti were getting close to Everlook. Of course, it's not working either. There's yeti all over the hills and I haven't heard a peep from it. Would you mind checking on it for me? It might still be fixable. Echo Three's set up to the southeast on the edge of Ice Thistle Hills. Don't ask what happened to Echo One and Two.

Title: The Push Westward
Objective: Report to King Phaoris at the Neferset City Outskirts in Uldum.
Text: Our work is done here. Against all odds, we stopped the Neferset advance on Nahom. Let us join the forces pushing west, lest they take all the glory for themselves. They must've reached the outskirts of Neferset City by now.

Title: Ice Delivery
Objective: Deliver the Instant Ice Block to Seril Scourgebane in Everlook.
Text: Alright, one high-quality, pure grade Instant Ice Block! I tried selling these to people for protection for a while. Y'know, like that trick you see mages pull? Couldn't figure out the whole "breathing" thing, though.

Title: Tree Delivery
Objective: Deliver the Super-Gro Insta-Tree to Kilram at the inn in Everlook.
Text: Here you go, one instant Super-Gro Insta-Tree made with 80% natural ingredients! No roots, no muss, no fuss. Just give it to Kilram and make sure he stands the heck back when he uses it.

Title: Are We There, Yeti?
Objective: Collect 10 Thick Yeti Furs from Ice Thistle Yeti.
Text: My friends are always coming up with great ideas. I've never felt like I could match them... until today! I just drew up the plans for something great! If you promise not to tell, I'll let you in on the secret... I'm going to make a mechanical yeti! Not only are my friends sure to be freaked out when they see it, but when they get over that, I know they'll be impressed! I need thick yeti fur from the Ice Thistle yeti. There's plenty of them in the Ice Thistle Hills to the southeast.

Title: Chop Chop
Objective: Collect 10 pieces of Fresh-Cut Frostwood from Frostleaf Treants.
Text: I deal in small timber plenty, but full trees? That's a novelty item. Kinda like those boulders. Maybe you can do me another favor. Just west of town there's a grove of trees overlooking Lake Kel'theril. I don't know if it's the spooks there, or all that elf magic junk strewn around the place, but we've been getting treants and lashers wandering around there recently. They're making it a real pain to chop wood over there, so why don't you chop some of them? Bring the wood from the treants back here.

Title: Warchief's Command: Arathi Highlands!
Objective: Report to Dark Ranger Alina at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.
Text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Dark Ranger Alina at Galen's Fall. The Dark Lady's forces need your help to expand the dominions of the Horde and drive back the Alliance interlopers. To reach the Arathi Highlands, travel east from Hillsbrad Foothills and follow the road past Thoradin's Wall. Destiny calls!

Title: Kilram's Boast
Objective: Speak with Deez Rocksnitch.
Text: Pah! Crude and clumsy is all I see! You need more than just strength. My axes are just as strong as Lilith's maces, but so sharp, I can cut through a tree in one chop! You heard me, one chop! I'll prove it, too, here in front of everyone. Go ask Deez if he can get a tree in here!

Title: Put That Baby in the Cradle!
Objective: Speak to Harrison Jones at the Temple of Uldum.
Text: Och! You an' junior took yer sweet time gettin' 'ere, din't ya!? , takin' in the sights, I'll wager. Don't go breakin' yer arm pattin' yerself on the back now, the real work's just beginnin'! There be more ta this ancient artifact than ye know, but in order ta reveal its secrets, we need ta get it to the Cradle of the Ancients! Now howdya spose we do that? Maybe junior over there has some bright ideas, eh?

Title: Eastpoint Tower
Objective: Speak to Nils Beerot at Eastpoint Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Text: Our outpost in the southeast is having some problems. I don't have any details other than... well, let me just read from the latest letter: "The orcs have grown petulant. Send help or I will have them beaten with reeds." That's it. It was sent from our chief psylosopher, Nils Beerot. Yea, I have no idea what that means either. Could you please head to Eastpoint Tower and find out what he needs? I can't take any more of these cryptic letters! Just head south and then follow the road east.

Title: Turning the Earth
Objective: Use Tanrir's Overcharged Totem to overload 4 Winterfall Earth Totems.
Text: Despite their corruption and madness, the Winterfall barely cling to their shamanic powers. It disturbs me to see the power of the elements used by them to harm my tribe and other innocents. We will turn their totems against them! Take my own totem with you into Winterfall Village. Use its powers on the Winterfall's totems from afar, and the fury of the earth will be unleashed on all nearby! Needless to say... keep a safe distance!

Title: Boulder Delivery
Objective: Deliver the Boulder-in-a-Box to Lilith the Lithe in Everlook.
Text: Here you go, as promised! One Boulder-in-a-Box. Lilith was asking for this, wasn't she? She's my only customer!

Title: Bearzerker
Objective: Slay Grolnar the Berserk.
Text: High Chieftain Winterfall's absence has done little to quell the rage of the Winterfall. In his absence, their greatest warrior has rose to a position of terrible power. Grolnar the Berserk lurks in the cave at the top of Winterfall Village, gorged on enough corrupt firewater to kill ten lesser furbolgs. He has become a bloated and horrible beast! Our warriors have been unable to face him... do you have the strength to defeat him?

Title: Flower Power
Objective: Survive a Massive Wave of Zombies.
Text: You know how to use the spitters, but did you know that if you use a sunflower you can grow things faster? We'll grow some sunflowers and then we'll plant some spitters to push back Warden Stillwater's crazed monstrosities. Let's go!

Title: Three if by Air
Objective: Use the Signal Flares at the Temple of Uldum.
Text: I had planned on bringing the coffer back to my lab for study, but it seems Brann here has different ideas. He thinks he knows how to put a stop to Deathwing's plans here in Uldum. My buddy, Jock, is standing by with the transport, just waiting for our signal. Take these flares and plant them around the perimeter to let him know that we're ready.

Title: Stormpike Apocalypse
Objective: Witness the Stormpike Apocalypse.
Text: Before we continue, let us have a moment of silence for our fallen brother, Orkus, for without him, we would have been destroyed by the Stormpike onslaught. This is for you, brother!  Now, do not think that I forgot your part in all of this! That is why you get the honors of detonating the goblin pocket-nukes. Are you ready? FOR THE HORDE!

Title: Hammer Time
Objective: Speak with Deez Rocksnitch.
Text: The three of us have been arguing for weeks over whose weapons are superior. I won't let anyone tell me my maces are second best. Kilram's axes and Seril's swords could never match the pure strength of my craft. I'm tired of arguing. It's time to show those two I'm right with a demonstration. If you would, dear, head outside and tell Deez Rocksnitch that I need the biggest boulder he can find!

Title: Rubble Trouble
Objective: Collect 6 Prime Rubble Chunks from Frostshard Rumblers.
Text: If you want to get a boulder in there, you can use my own patented Boulder-in-a-Box! Normally I'd just sell you one up front, but I'm fresh out of materials. Earth elementals have been popping up on the peak directly south of town. They're a good source of rubble. If you bring me back a good amount, I'll pay you for the restock, and I'll throw in a Boulder-in-a-Box absolutely free!

Title: Harrison Jones and the Temple of Uldum
Objective: Recover the Coffer of Promise.
Text: After all we've been through, it looks like everything's actually coming together! We're just steps away from the coffer... I've researched the codes to reveal it... Schnottz thinks we're dead.... You know, we might just pull this off after all!

Title: See You on the Other Side!
Objective: Speak to Harrison Jones at the top of Maker's Ascent in Uldum.
Text: Alright. We've bought ourselves a little breathing room, but there's no time to lose. Follow me!

Title: The Shadow Grave
Objective: Obtain the Thick Embalming Fluid and the Corpse-Stitching Twine from the Shadow Grave in Deathknell.
Text: I'm pleased to see that you're up and walking around. You've held up nicely, especially after being dead for so long! Others weren't as lucky. If you wouldn't mind, I need you to fetch my embalming fluid and some twine to stitch up these bodies. You'll find both in the Shadow Grave, the building just behind me. Here, Darnell will join you. He knows the way.

Title: Domination
Objective: Kill 10 Stormpike Engineers.
Text: The last task will be an assault against the siege technicians of Gavin's Naze, located west of the Headland. Venture to the final finger and lay waste to the dwarf and gnome engineers that build and fortify the Stormpike machines of war. Be sure to plant Cromush's final pocket-nuke as well.

Title: The Defilers' Ritual
Objective: Stop the Neferset Ritual at the Murkdeep Cavern.
Text: Ah, I can already see more clearly. We are right to be wary of the evil Neferset. I can already sense that they're behind the forces that corrupt the river. Go underwater once more and find the Murkdeep Cavern. You will find the Neferset are performing a foul ritual of corruption. Stop them so the river is cleansed once again.

Title: Matters of Loyalty
Objective: Speak to Drek'Thar.
Text: I have no authority over such matters. You must speak to our leader, Drek'Thar. I have already sent word of your arrival to Frostwolf Keep. Drek'Thar will be out to speak with you personally.

Title: Deception and Trickery
Objective: Use the Barrel of Water to Poison 30 Stormpike Trainees.
Text: As long as I am by your side the enemy will think of you as one of their own. Your newfound humanity, however, will not allow you to be reckless. If you draw attention to yourself the dwarves will grow suspicious and likely attack! With that said, I have a plan. Take this barrel of poisoned water and use it to sate the thirst of the tired Stormpike trainees. Once they drink from it they will become deathly ill, eventually succumbing to the poison.

Title: Infiltration
Objective: Kill Instructor Rufus, Drill Sergeant Magnus and Captain Crudbeard.
Text: For your next mission I want you to travel west to the Headland and infiltrate the Stormpike training grounds. Though there are hundreds of Stormpike trainees there, one of my banshees will disguise you to look like one of the humans captured earlier, allowing you to walk freely among the enemy. Enter the Headland and find the Stormpike instructors. Once found, coerce them into attacking you! When they attack, kill them. With their instructors dead, they will be unable to train more soldiers!

Title: Kurdran's Waitin'
Objective: Speak to Kurdran Wildhammer inside of the Highbank Keep in Twilight Highlands.
Text: It looks like the attack stopped. Which is a shame, 'cuz we never got to use the -rocket. Anyways, Kurdran Wildhammer is up in the top of the keep an' I'm sure he'll be wantin' to gives ya a hero's welcome. Yeh earned it! Go talk to 'im! I'll move on ahead and scout out the beach.

Title: The Conveniences of Home
Objective: Take the Traveler's Banking Chest to Shal'aran.
Text: This chest could prove very useful to our efforts. Take the chest back to Shal'aran.

Title: A Call to Battle
Objective: Win 4 Battleground matches.
Text: The favorite star of warlords and generals dominates the sky, offering good fortune to tacticians everywhere. Some say that the battle star hones the instincts of commanders to the point of near-prophecy. If ever you were going to test yourself on the field of battle, now is the time.

Title: Dark Secrets and Shady Deals
Objective: Speak with Lord Ravenholdt.
Text: Whatever Amber Kearnen knew, Mathias Shaw didn't want it gettin' out... Aye, this be dirty business indeed, hiring th' Red Blade at such a price... just to hunt down and kill one of their own! Ye best get back to th' Hall 'o Shadows, and let Lord Ravenholdt know what we found here in Citrine Bay. Whatever SI:7 be up to, it be goin' deeper than we first imagined...

Title: Be Prepared
Objective: Collect 6 Rope Pieces.
Text: Every adventurer worth their salt knows never to step foot in a cave, dungeon, crypt or tomb without an ample supply of rope... right? Well, mine was in that wagon full of explosives that you set off. How about searching around here and seeing if you can't find some.

Title: The World Awaits
Objective: Complete 20 World Quests in the Broken Isles.
Text: When the sign of the emissary shines in the night sky, the stars strengthen existing bonds and forge new ones. Friendship is still not cheaply won, and deeds will prove loyalty, but trust comes more readily during these days. Venture across the Broken Isles, and give aid where you may, to prove your worth.

Title: Emissary of War
Objective: Complete 4 dungeons on Mythic difficulty.
Text: When the sign of the warrior shines in the night sky, fortune favors the daring. Powerful foes may yield even greater rewards. Venture deep into caverns and strongholds to prove your worth.

Title: Aiming High
Objective: Wait for Fargo Flintlocke to get you onto the zeppelin and then set his explosives in its lower chamber.
Text: Lookie here. I found the biggest gun in Highbank! We're gonna try a technique handed down ta me by my pappy, from his pappy, from his pappy, shortly before he got blowed up. It's called the "-shot." You take a  , and load  inta a gigantic cannon, and then ya - oh relax. This usually works. Take these explosives, then wait here next ta me. As soon as that blimpy comes around I'll blast you onto tha deck. Plant the explosives in 'er belly and, oh I dunno, make it up as you go.

Title: The Very Best
Objective: Defeat 5 players through Find Battle with a team of level 25 pets.
Text: This alignment of the stars is truly a strange one, causing the tiniest of creatures to gain unnatural aptitude. None of our sages can explain the phenomenon, but cunning tamers have much to gain, especially by testing their skills against those of their peers.

Title: A Burning Path Through Time
Objective: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
Text: The blazing star shines upon the land, searing the earth and parching the landscape. This star is relentless, malevolent almost. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

Title: The Arena Calls
Objective: Win 10 Arena Skirmish battles.
Text: This alignment of the stars is a dire sign, stirring bloodlust and calling warriors to battle to the death in close quarters. Arena masters turn a tidy profit during these days, likely not understanding why their stands are overflowing. Amidst the excitement, great rewards do await those brave, or foolhardy, enough to venture into the arena....

Title: A Frozen Path Through Time
Objective: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
Text: The chill star shines upon the land with its cold light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, sapping warmth and life. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

Title: A Shattered Path Through Time
Objective: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
Text: The Destroyer's star shines upon the land with its piercing light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, laying bare the weaknesses of even the boldest heroes. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

Title: Another Arcan'dor Closes...
Objective: Return to Shal'aran.
Text: I hope you have a better understanding of what is at stake.Come. There is no more for us to do here.Meet me in Shal'aran and we will discuss what steps we may take next.

Title: A Ticket for Marin
Objective: Deliver the Vault Ticket to Marin Noggenfogger.
Text: This Vault Ticket should be delivered to Marin Noggenfogger.

Title: Things Gaardoun Needs
Objective: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Things Gaardoun Needs".
Text: Battlelord Gaardoun has offered to recruit more broken warriors for the cause. He just needs a few things first. He said something about the right tool for the job, or something like that.Time to put your new champions to the test. I'm sure it will be a grueling mission.

Title: Light's Charge
Objective: Place Light's Heart in your Order Hall.
Text: "You did not ask for this burden, but it is what fate has deemed." Turalyon's haunting last words still echo in my mind. I worry about the fate of the draenei... about the fate of my friend, Velen; but we must remain vigilant! For now, Light's Heart remains under your watchful eye. There is one place on Azeroth that I would trust with the safekeeping of the object: your order hall. Take it there. I will remain in Dalaran and continue looking for answers. There must be another way!

Title: A Growing Crisis
Objective: Meet Valewalker Farodin at the Temple of Fala'dora. You can travel there using the Portal to Falanaar in Shal'aran.
Text: The Arcan'dor is failing.This energy was once bound in its boughs and fueled its growth. There was balance, between life and arcane.Now that energy is breaking free. When the heart can no longer hold it, this tree will kill every living thing in this hall.I have seen this happen before and I must find a way to stop it from happening again.We must go to the tree that came before. Its bones can guide us.Meet me at the temple of Fal'adora. We will descend together.

Title: The Rite of the Executioner
Objective: Interact with the Pile of Skulls and complete the Rite of the Executioner in the crypt near Morgan's Plot in Deadwind Pass.
Text: The skulls have been gathered and the ritual area is prepared.All that is left is to perform the incantation, and Ulthalesh will become imbued with the essence of the Executioner.

Title: Searching For Clues
Objective: Find proof of SI:7 working with The Red Blade.
Text: It be no coincidence that we be in Citrine Bay investigatin' a murder, and we find th' band 'o pirates known as th' Red Blade here as well! Aye, this be no coincidence at all... but we be needin' proof! Ye go on ahead and look fer clues and I'll find some scallywags to interrogate. Aye , we'll get t' 'th bottom o' this t' be sure! Thar be no doubt!

Title: Burnin' at Both Ends
Objective: Collect 10 bags full of Cannon Powder.
Text: Har! We get to jump right inta the action. Looks like Highbank has whatcha call a zeppelin problem: that airship is poundin' the crap outta the walls. Listen, I've got me an idear so stupid it's genius. I just need some cannon powder. Collect as much as you can find around Highbank an' meet me by the trade area!

Title: Krazz Works!
Objective: Speak to Newt to secure a ride back to Krazzworks, then give the Induction Samophlange to Captain Krazz.
Text: That's it. We're all wrapped up. Let's ship out. Newt's got some gyrocopters tethered at the top of the tower. Go meet up with her for a quick trip back to Krazzworks. We'll mop up here.

Title: Welcome to Highbank!
Objective: Kill 10 Horde attackers within Highbank.
Text: Welcome to the highlands, soldier. You're here just in time. Horde troops just launched an assault from the air. Step up and do something about it. Clear them out!

Title: Highbank, Crybank
Objective: Kill 10 Highbank defenders.
Text: Get down there and make a mess of those Alliance rabble. Any of'm will do. I just want'm scattered while you're in there after the real target. Find us near the eastern tower when you're done.

Title: Of Utmost Importance
Objective: Recover the Induction Samophlange.
Text: When Garrosh's zeppelin went down, so did the induction samophlange that you recovered for us in Azshara. The Alliance have it somewhere in that keep, and Krazz wants it back. The basement of the keep would be my best guess, so start there. When you get your hands on it, bring it back to me near the eastern tower.

Title: Parting Packages
Objective: Set bombs on the boat, in the keep entrance, and in one of the northern towers.
Text: I'm sure Patch has some grand scheme in mind, but this wouldn't be an assault if we didn't leave some explosive presents behind. Get down there and plant some of these explosives on the boat, in the keep entrance, and in one of those northern towers. That should be enough to leave them reeling. We're heading down to the ground as well. Meet us at the eastern tower when you're through.

Title: Reprisal
Objective: Speak to Patch aboard the Skyshredder circling Highbank.
Text: I happen to know some Alliance scum that have somethin' coming to them. And they have something that belongs to us. I've authorized an all out assault on Highbank. Board the Skyshredder and join the assault. Patch will fill you in on the details as you arrive.

Title: Off The Wall
Objective: Kill 80 Highbank Marksman, 12 Highbank Cannoneers, and 4 Highbank Cannons with a Skyshredder Turret.
Text: You look like a  who likes some action. Get on one of those turrets and lay waste to their defenses on the wall. Be quick about it, will you? Before we go up in a big ball of fire preferably.

Title: Wildhammer Infestation
Objective: Slay 10 Wildhammer Raiders.
Text: While these two idiots argue about who royally messed up here, we've got a full-scale invasion of the Krazzworks taking place! Those no-good Wildhammer are all over the place. Get out there and clear the Krazzworks of those smelly ale-guzzling pests.

Title: Quality Construction
Objective: Use the Blast Tape to seal 10 Faulty Valves.
Text: Look here, chief, if it weren't for this bumbly idiot across from me, the Krazzworks would be holding up just fine. Unfortunately for everyone involved, "Fancypants" Rothman here decided to deploy the place on top of a mountain! I mean really, who does that? So, we got leaks all over the place due to faulty valves. Think you could take this blast tape and seal 'em up for me?

Title: Aid of the Frostwolf
Objective: Speak to Voggah Deathgrip at Alterac Mountains in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Text: I will study the Stormpike battle plans and prepare for an assault. I need you to go to Alterac Valley and enlist the aid of the Frostwolf Clan: the very clan of our former warchief, Thrall. They will help us battle the Stormpike dwarves! Together, we will crush the invaders and see them driven out of Lordaeron for good! Go now. Alterac Valley is northeast of Tarren Mill. Find Voggah Deathgrip and tell him that the Horde requires the aid of the Frostwolf! LOK'TAR!

Title: Pool Pony Rescue
Objective: Use the Pool Ponies to rescue 10 Krazzworks Laborers that have fallen into the water.
Text: This jerk across from me is getting all of our people killed! Brett "the Bummer" unpacked the Krazzworks in the wrong place and now it's highly unstable. The explosions from the instability are throwing our laborers off of the platforms and into the water below. You don't mind flying down there and rescuing them with some pool ponies?

Title: Warchief's Command: Searing Gorge!
Objective: Report to Jack Rockleg at Thorium Advance in the Searing Gorge.
Text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Jack Rockleg at Thorium Advance. The Shattered Hand reports that the Dark Iron dwarves of the Searing Gorge seem to be preparing for something. Your duty is to learn all you can about their scheming and put a halt to it. You can reach the Searing Gorge by following the road west from the Badlands. Destiny calls!

Title: Everything But the Kitchen Sink
Objective: Slay 15 Wildhammer Stormtalons.
Text: You gotta do something about them Wildhammer Stormtalons. They're tearing us up! Problem is, we're out of ammo, so we had to improvise. We loaded up my Krazz Cannons with all kinds of stuff: pool ponies, Kaja'Cola cans, food containers, fuelcells, tires... you get the picture. Basically, everything but the kitchen sink. Think you're in the mood for some target practice?

Title: Hero's Call: Searing Gorge!
Objective: Report to Jack Rockleg at Thorium Advance in the Searing Gorge.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Jack Rockleg at Thorium Advance. SI:7 reports that the Dark Iron dwarves of the Searing Gorge seem to be preparing to attack. Your duty is to learn all you can about their scheming and put a halt to it. You can reach the Searing Gorge by following the road west from the Badlands. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Hero's Call: Badlands!
Objective: Report to Gek Nozzlerocket at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Gek Nozzlerocket at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. Your help is needed to survey the damage done by Deathwing, and the disposition of Horde forces in the Badlands. Gek has agreed to provide transportation to the Badlands via rocket, in exchange for your help. Look for him at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Krazzworks
Objective: Take the Patent Application to Captain Krazz at the Krazzworks in Twilight Highlands.
Text: This new shredder design is tops. Tops! Next step is to protect my intellectual property. There are patents to file, traders to mark, ceases to desist. Oh, and the bribes! Here, take this patent application to Captain Krazz at the Krazzworks. He survived the destruction of his zeppelin, so he's probably hungry for new business opportunities. The Krazzworks is due north of here, atop a perfectly safe mountain peak. Go ahead, kid. Chop chop!

Title: Warchief's Command: Eastern Plaguelands!
Objective: Report to Fiona on the east bank of the Thondroril River in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Fiona on the east bank of the Thondroril River. The Argent Crusade has reinforced its presence in the Plaguelands and it needs your help to consolidate its victories. Cross the Thondroril River at the eastern border of the Western Plaguelands and look for Fiona on the far bank. Destiny calls!

Title: Warchief's Command: Badlands!
Objective: Report to Gek Nozzlerocket at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Gek Nozzlerocket at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. The Alliance is desperate to gain a foothold in the Badlands. Your duty will be to keep them at bay and learn about the destruction wrought by Deathwing. Gek has agreed to provide transportation to the Badlands by rocket. Meet with him at Light's Hope Chapel. Destiny calls!

Title: Hero's Call: Eastern Plaguelands!
Objective: Report to Fiona on the eastern bank of the Thondroril River in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Fiona on the east bank of the Thondroril River. The Argent Crusade needs your help to win back the Eastern Plaguelands from the grasp of the Scourge. To reach the Eastern Plaguelands, cross the Thondroril River from the Western Plaguelands and look for Fiona on the eastern bank. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: The Bogpaddle Bullet
Objective: Speak with Sharon Boomgetter in the southeastern corner of Burning Steppes to ride the Bogpaddle Bullet to the Swamp of Sorrows. Then speak with Trade Baron Silversnap in Bogpaddle.
Text: You're quite the , aren't you? Look at you... you're all grown up already. And we only just met! I know how it'll go... soon you'll run out of things to do here at Flame Crest. You'll promise to come back. But you never will. Kibler's seen it all before. When you do leave, talk to Sharon Boomgetter in the southeastern corner of the Steppes. She'll give you a ride on the bullet. What? Oh, it's just a rocket. Perfectly safe.

Title: Hero's Call: Western Plaguelands!
Objective: Report to Thassarian at Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Thassarian at Andorhal. On the heels of our early victories in Andorhal, the Forsaken have decided to launch a counterattack. Your help is needed to beat back the Scourge and Horde and reclaim lost Andorhal. To reach Andorhal, travel north through the Hillsbrad Foothills and follow the road beyond Chillwind Camp. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Warchief's Command: The Hinterlands!
Objective: Report to Elder Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.
Text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Elder Torntusk at Revantusk Village. Now that the Wildhammer dwarves have officially thrown in their lot with the Alliance, they have made themselves our enemies. They must be defeated! To reach Revanktusk Village, cross into the Hinterlands from the mountain pass in eastern Hillsbrad Foothills and make your way to the eastern coast. Destiny calls!

Title: Hero's Call: Arathi Highlands!
Objective: Report to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe. Ancient Stromgarde's honor must be redeemed! Too long have ogres and criminals sullied its streets. Travel north from the Wetlands and cross the Thandol Span to reach Arathi. Follow the road to Refuge Pointe and present yourself to the captain. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Warchief's Command: Arathi Highlands!
Objective: Report to Dark Ranger Alina at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.
Text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Dark Ranger Alina at Galen's Fall. The Dark Lady's forces need your help to expand the dominions of the Horde and drive back the Alliance interlopers. To reach the Arathi Highlands, travel east from Hillsbrad Foothills and follow the road past Thoradin's Wall. Destiny calls!

Title: Warchief's Command: Western Plaguelands!
Objective: Report to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands.
Text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal. The Alliance forces are advancing into the ruined city of Andorhal, seeking to claim it for themselves. We must counter them before they can gain a foothold there! Cross the Bulwark at the eastern end of Tirisfal Glades and follow the roads southeast to Andorhal and meet up with our forces there. Destiny calls!

Title: The Bogpaddle Bullet
Objective: Speak with Sharon Boomgetter in the southeastern corner of Burning Steppes to ride the Bogpaddle Bullet to the Swamp of Sorrows. Then speak with Trade Baron Silversnap in Bogpaddle.
Text: I've heard stories about a road to the Swamp of Sorrows. Mysterious tales of a meandering mountain pathway that completely bypasses Redridge and poops you right out into Bogpaddle! If you run out of things to do, I suppose you'll have to leave. And we'll all be sad. When you do leave, talk to Sharon Boomgetter in the southeastern corner of the Steppes. She'll give you a ride.  Winky? WINKY! NO!

Title: Warchief's Command: Hillsbrad Foothills!
Objective: Report to High Executor Darthalia at Southpoint Gate in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to High Executor Darthalia at Southpoint Gate in Hillsbrad Foothills. The Forsaken war machine marches ever onward, securing Lordaeron for the Horde! To reach Southpoint Gate you must follow the road south through Silverpine Forest and take the east fork leading into Hillsbrad Foothills. Onward! Destiny calls!

Title: Hero's Call: Loch Modan!
Objective: Report to Pilot Hammerfoot at South Gate Outpost in Loch Modan.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Pilot Hammerfoot at South Gate Outpost. The destruction of the Stonewrought Dam and the resurgence of the kobolds and troggs has the mountaineers stretched thin. Reinforcements are desperately needed! Travel east through South Gate Pass from eastern Dun Morogh to reach South Gate Outpost. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Warchief's Command: Silverpine Forest!
Objective: Report to Grand Executor Mortuus at Forsaken High Command in Silverpine Forest.
Text: All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Grand Executor Mortuus at Forsaken High Command in Silverpine Forest. Now, more than ever, your help is needed in routing the enemy infestation of the region and conquering the port of Gilneas! To reach Forsaken High Command you must travel south through Tirisfal Glades and enter Silverpine Forest. From there, follow the road south until you reach Forsaken High Command. Destiny calls!

Title: Hero's Call: Wetlands!
Objective: Report to Mountaineer Rharen at Dun Algaz.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Mountaineer Rharen at Dun Algaz. In the wake of the cataclysm's destruction, Wetlands has become overrun with wild beasts, orcish raiders, and savage gnolls! To reach the Wetlands, you must travel north from Loch Modan through the dwarven hold of Dun Algaz. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Decimation
Objective: Kill Captain Iceheart and 12 Stormpike Soldiers.
Text: The Stormpike forward camp sits atop Corrahn's Dagger, west of Sofera's Naze. You must enter the camp and slaughter every dwarf that you see. They must be taught what it means to fear and there is no finer lesson than absolute decimation. No survivors. Even their captain - especially their captain - must die. I will be in contact.

Title: Into the Fray
Objective: Speak with the lead demon hunter at Illidari Stand.
Text: The Burning Legion has beaten us here, but so too have the Illidari. It looks like the demon hunters are holding their own, but just barely.Come, let's put that weapon of yours to use. I'll figure out our next move while you crush the Legion.

Title: From Within
Objective: Find Kor'vas Bloodthorn on Faronaar at Vanquish Point.
Text: Our demon hunters, Kor'vas Bloodthorn and Cyana Nightglaive took a small force of the Illidari across to Faronaar. Their mission was to weaken the Legion from within.I haven't heard from them in a while.It would be best if you could find and lead them to success. Agreed?

Title: Illidari Allies
Objective: Meet with the Illidari representative in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
Text: At first I was unsure whether it was wise to allow the Illidari inside the city. But they may have just saved all our lives. I gave the demon hunters leave to establish a temporary camp in the Mage Quarter. I'd like you to be my personal envoy to them. Thank the Illidari for their assistance and see how they can aid our cause. Just... keep your eyes open. They have harnessed a terrible power, and we must be ready should they be consumed by the darkness within.

Title: Welcome to Legion!
Objective: Welcome to World of Warcraft: Legion! We hope you enjoy all of the new experiences that await you in the Broken Isles, and want to make sure you're well-armed to take on the Burning Legion.
Text: Welcome to World of Warcraft: Legion! We hope you enjoy all of the new experiences that await you in the Broken Isles, and want to make sure you're well-armed to take on the Burning Legion.

Title: Mystery at Citrine Bay
Objective: Speak with Fleet Admiral Tethys at Citrine Bay in Stormheim.
Text: The Burning Legion invades Azeroth, and SI:7 is wasting valuable resources hunting down and assassinating one of their top agents? Something isn't adding up... We need to find out how deep this goes. Why was Amber Kearnen being hunted by her own organization? The encrypted letter she was carrying may hold the clues... but we need more information. The SI:7 assassins you tailed in Dalaran mentioned Citrine Bay... search Citrine Bay for clues and we'll see about getting this letter decrypted.

Title: Time Flies When Yer Havin' Rum!
Objective: Collect 10 bottles of Red Blade Rum.
Text: Thar be few pirates ye want to cross swords wit' less than th' Red Blade! They be salty dogs, indeed! That being said... they does have a way wit' rum! I'll level wit' ye... thar be few rums as jolly as that 'o th' Red Blade. Seein' as ye be headin' off in search 'o clues, ye might as well brin' back a few bottles while ye be at it! Brin' me back as many bottles as ye can find, and I'll reward ye handsomely! Pirates honor!

Title: Hero's Call: Duskwood!
Objective: Report to Commander Althea Ebonlocke at Darkshire in Duskwood.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire. The commander's watchmen are stretched thin defending against marauding wolves and bands of wild worgen. They cannot hold out for long without your help. You can reach Darkshire in Duskwood by following the road south at the border between Elwynn Forest and the Redridge Mountains. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Hero's Call: Redridge Mountains!
Objective: Report to Watch Captain Parker at Tower Watch in Redridge Mountains.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report Watch Captain Parker at Tower Watch in the Redridge Mountains. Captain Parker's forces have come under attack from marauding gnolls and orcs. The people of Lakewood are in peril and your aid is needed to safeguard them. Travel east from the border of Elwynn Forest and into the Three Corners area of Redridge to reach Tower Watch. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Nahom Must Hold
Objective: Report to the regiment at Nahom in Uldum.
Text: As soon as we make our move west in order to attack Neferset City, the enemy will strike us from the east, where we'll be weak. Nahom will be the first to fall, and if it does, Ramkahen will soon follow. A small detachment is there already. Get a briefing from them. I want you to make sure that they hold Nahom until I can send more troops there.

Title: Hero's Call: Westfall!
Objective: Report to Lieutenant Horatio Laine at the Jansen Stead in Westfall.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Lieutenant Horatio Laine at the Jansen Stead. Westfall has been overrun by beggars and transients, leading to a massive increase in criminal activity. Your help is needed to restore order to the populace. You can reach the Jansen Stead in Westfall by traveling west from Elwynn Forest. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Breaking the Hand
Objective: Plant a Goblin Pocket-Nuke at Sofera's Naze, Corrahn's Dagger, the Headland and Gavin's Naze.
Text: We must break the fingers of the Stormpike if we are to stop their incursion.  Within this package are four high-yield goblin explosives. You are to infiltrate each of the four fingers - Sofera's Naze, Corrahn's Dagger, the Headland and Gavin's Naze - and plant a goblin pocket-nuke at each. Once you have done that - as well as all that Melisara asks of you - return to me.

Title: Hero's Call: Uldum!
Objective: Speak with Adarrah at Thistleshrub Valley in Tanaris.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Adarrah at Thistleshrub Valley in Tanaris. Be one of the first to enter glorious Uldum and claim its treasures in honor of the Alliance! You can reach Adarrah's caravan by traveling to the western reaches of Tanaris. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Hero's Call: Bloodmyst Isle!
Objective: Report to Vorkhan the Elekk Herder at Kessel's Crossing on Bloodmyst Isle.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Vorkhan the Elekk Herder at Kessel's Crossing. The people of Bloodmyst need your help to deal with treacherous blood elves and dangerous creatures loose on the island. You can reach Kessel's Crossing on Bloodmyst Isle by taking the bridge north from Azuremyst Isle. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Warchief's Command: Uldum!
Objective: Speak with Adarrah in Thistleshrub Valley in western Tanaris.
Text: All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Adarrah at the Thistleshrub Valley in Tanaris. Ancient texts tell us that Uldum is home to untold riches and treasures beyond compare. Go forth and claim these in the name of the Horde! You can reach Adarrah's caravan by traveling to the southwestern part of Tanaris and looking for her in Thistleshrub Valley. Destiny calls!

Title: Hero's Call: Dustwallow Marsh!
Objective: Report to Calia Hastings at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Calia Hastings at Theramore Isle. You must aid SI:7's Calia Hastings in uncovering the threats to Theramore, both within the city and beyond its walls. You can reach Theramore Isle by taking the boat from Menethil or traveling across the marsh from the Southern Barrens. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Okrilla and the Blasted Lands
Objective: Report to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold in the Blasted Lands.
Text: I have one final dispatch to deliver to you. It comes from Dreadmaul Hold, to the south, in the Blasted Lands. Warmatron Okrilla is waging battle against the Alliance forces of Nethergarde Keep, and she needs the assistance of a stout . You immediately sprung to mind. Travel south into the Blasted Lands, then head west. Good luck.

Title: Warchief's Command: Dustwallow Marsh!
Objective: Report to Krog at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh. Optionally, grab a flight there from Doras in Orgrimmar.
Text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Krog at Brackenwall Village. The marsh is overrun with enemies of many kinds and the Alliance forces there are dangerously strong. You can travel to Dustwallow Marsh by following the path from the eastern part of the Southern Barrens toward Brackenwall Village. Or, you can get a flight there from Doras in Orgrimmar. Destiny calls!

Title: Hero's Call: Southern Barrens!
Objective: Report to Commander Walpole at Stonetalon Pass in northwestern Southern Barrens.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Commander Walpole at Stonetalon Pass in the Southern Barrens. Our brave soldiers have made tremendous gains in the Barrens, but they have paid a heavy price! Your efforts are needed to consolidate our gains. You can reach the Southern Barrens from the Stonetalon Mountains by traveling southeast through Greatwood Vale. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Warchief's Command: Ghostlands!
Objective: Report to Arcanist Vandril at Tranquillien in the Ghostlands.
Text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Arcanist Vandril at Tranquillien in the Ghostlands. Your help is needed to turn back the numberless Scourge invaders and secure the help of the Forsaken in fighting our common enemy. To reach Tranquillien, follow the road south from Fairbreeze Square and into the Ghostlands. Destiny calls!

Title: Warchief's Command: Desolace!
Objective: Report to Furien at Tethris Aran in Desolace.
Text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Furien at Tethris Aran in Desolace. The brave Horde warriors of Desolace need your help to beat back the armies of the Alliance and ancient demons. To reach Tethris Aran, travel south from the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains. Destiny calls!

Title: Winterfall E'ko
Objective: Collect 3 Winterfall E'ko from any Winterfall furbolg in Winterspring.
Text: In Winterspring, you will fight misguided creatures known as da Winterfall furbolg. Dese bear-people be so angry an' ferocious, dey live in a constant frenzy. Bring me de E'ko of de Winterfall, an' I give you a frenzy so intense, ya legs will let you run like de wind!

Title: Hero's Call: Winterspring!
Objective: Report to Donova Snowden at Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Donova Snowden at Frostfire Hotsprings. She requires your help to overcome the threat of the Winterfall furbolg. To reach Winterspring, you must travel east from northern Felwood and traverse Timbermaw Hold. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Winterfall E'ko
Objective: Collect 5 Winterfall E'ko from any Winterfall furbolg in Winterspring.
Text: In Winterspring, you will fight misguided creatures known as de Winterfall furbolg. These bear-people be so angry an' ferocious, dey live in a constant frenzy. Bring me de E'ko of de Winterfall, an' I give you a frenzy so intense, ya legs will let you run like de wind!

Title: Hero's Call: Southern Barrens!
Objective: Report to Dockmaster Lewis at the docks outside Northwatch Hold in the Southern Barrens.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Dockmaster Lewis near Northwatch Hold. Our brave soldiers have made tremendous gains in the Barrens, but they have paid a heavy price! Your efforts are needed to consolidate our gains. You can reach the docks outside Northwatch Hold by taking a boat from Booty Bay to Ratchet and traveling south along the coast. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Warchief's Command: Winterspring!
Objective: Report to Donova Snowden at Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring.
Text: All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Donova Snowden at Frostfire Hot Springs. Her discoveries about the Winterfall furbolg may be the key to dealing with this threat once and for all. To reach the Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring, you must travel east from northern Felwood and traverse Timbermaw Hold. Destiny calls!

Title: Warchief's Command: Southern Barrens!
Objective: Report to Nura Pathfinder at the High Road in the Southern Barrens. Optionally, grab a flight there from Doras in Orgrimmar.
Text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Nura Pathfinder at the High Road in the Southern Barrens. With the recent Alliance victories in the Barrens, our enemies are threatening to cut our supply lines and leave our warriors stranded. We must act! To reach the High Road, travel east from Stonetalon Mountains. If necessary, you can get a flight there from Doras in Orgrimmar. Destiny calls!

Title: Hero's Call: Felwood!
Objective: Report to Tenell Leafrunner at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Tenell Leafrunner at the Emerald Sanctuary. His order requires your help to redeem Felwood from the demonic influences that rule the forest. Head north from Ashenvale and follow the road into Felwood until you reach the Emerald Sanctuary. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Warchief's Command: Felwood!
Objective: Report to Tenell Leafrunner at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood.
Text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Tenell Leafrunner at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood. The Cenarion Circle requires your help to wrest Felwood from the control of demons and other corrupt creatures! To reach the Emerald Sanctuary, travel north from Ashenvale and follow the road until you reach the sanctuary. Destiny calls!

Title: Cache of Mau'ari
Objective: Watch Witch Doctor Mau'ari pull the E'ko from Rimepelt's body.
Text: It be hard to describe de E'ko, but all creatures in dese lands have it... beasts, furbolg, even de frost giants. You got to open your mind and know where to look... Watch me now, an' I show you how to pull out de E'ko.

Title: Descendants of the High Elves
Objective: Speak with the Sin'dorei Spirit.
Text: Long after my death, my people would suffer an even greater mistake. The High Elves relied on the Sunwell and its glory. Never imagining a world without it, we would never make preparations to deal with such a fate. Later, when the Sunwell fell to the forces of the undead, what was left of my descendants would be lost and helpless... and the path they would take in response would change them forever. The Sin'dorei, still striving for redemption, would return here as well...

Title: Hero's Call: Stonetalon Mountains!
Objective: Report to Huntress Jalin at Stardust Spire at the border between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Huntress Jalin at Stardust Spire in Ashenvale. The Horde's forces are poised to push into Stonetalon and they must be opposed! You can reach Stardust Spire by traveling to the southern part of Ashenvale Forest, near the border with Stonetalon. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: The Curse of Zin-Malor
Objective: Return to Kelek Skykeeper at Lake Kel'theril in Winterspring.
Text: You have seen enough. Know that the Crystal of Zin-Malor brings only ruin to all around it. Leave this place, if you do not wish to join us.

Title: In Pursuit of Shades
Objective: Pursue and slay the Shade of the Spiritspeaker and obtain any evidence of its master.
Text: You say it spoke of a master? Of one who holds Zin-Malor? This is grave news. You must act! I saw the shade fly off to the south. Take the path to the upper ruins, and you may be able to climb the frozen waterfall after it! And do not let your guard down... it may be waiting for you.

Title: Descendants of the Highborne
Objective: Speak with the Quel'dorei Spirit.
Text: Not long after my death, the greed of my people would lead to their exile. A continent away, they would become Quel'dorei, the High Elves. In Quel'thalas they would bathe in the power of their Sunwell, and forget their legacy of desire and greed. These distant descendants returned here, drawn by the hand of fate, doomed to repeat history. Hear their tale now, as I have...

Title: Archdruid of Lore
Objective: Seek out Elothir in Thas'talah.
Text: Elothir resides in the ancient grove Thas'talah, where he communes with nature and instructs his acolytes in the ways of healing and the preservation of lore. Seek him out and tell him that he is desperately needed here.

Title: Cry of the Banshee
Objective: Use the Banshee Mirror to capture 10 SI:7 Agents.
Text: So you are to be our savior? Very well then, I will bond myself with you. Through this bond I will be able to see through your eyes and communicate with you in the field. According to the plans you brought to us, the Stormpike have enlisted the aid of SI:7 at Sofera's Naze, to the north. SI:7 are comprised solely of humans - humans that we are able to use to our benefit. Take my mirror and travel north. Engage in combat with the SI:7 and bring them near death. Once they are injured, use the mirror.

Title: Warchief's Command: Stonetalon Mountains!
Objective: Report to Blood Guard Aldo Rockrain at Silverwind Refuge in Ashenvale.
Text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Blood Guard Aldo Rockrain at Silverwind Refuge in Ashenvale. The Horde forces in Stonetalon need your help to drive back the Alliance invaders and protect our people. The blood guard will direct you to the border of Stonetalon. To reach Silverwind Refuge, travel into the heart of Ashenvale and join our forces by the lake. Destiny calls!

Title: The High Council's Decision
Objective: Speak to King Phaoris at Ramkahen in Uldum.
Text: The High Council is ready to decide on the war with the Neferset tribe.

Title: Trading for Dreams
Objective: Use the Nightborne Flask to craft an Ysera's Dream Draught.
Text: From the look of you, I take it you're an alchemist, yes? I'd be willing to trade my services with you for a price that I deem is fair. I have been away from Suramar for some time now. I long for an Ysera's Dream Draught. To concoct it, you'll need some dreamleaf as well as the leaves of a Dreamer's Tear. One grows not to far from here in the clearing of some ruins. Take my flask, make this drink for me, and I'll do as you ask.

Title: Doin' De E'ko Magic
Objective: Obtain Rimepelt's Heart.
Text: Mau'ari been makin' charms from da spirits of de wilds here for years now. Mau'ari just PLUCK de E'ko right outta de animals, and make charms for de kids, and de adventurers. Ovah to de east, dere be a tall hill surrounded by de shardtooth bears. Up on de hill be Rimepelt, de oldest bear in de woods. Mau'ari need dat bear for her magic. You bring me de bear's big ol' heart.

Title: A Mutual Friend
Objective: Return to Calydus within Dreadscar Rift.
Text: It's good to see you are well.I've been sent by our mutual friend, Calydus. He is eager to speak with you.Please return to Dreadscar Rift at your earliest convenience.

Title: Proper Introductions
Objective: Return to Alonsus Faol within Netherlight Temple.
Text: I'm glad I found you.I have a message from Alonsus Faol.He says introductions are in order, and requests your presence within Netherlight Temple at your earliest convenience.

Title: Recruiting Apprentices
Objective: Speak to Grand Conjuror Mimic.
Text: Grand Conjuror Mimic has arrived to aid us in bolstering our numbers. She seeks out the most promising apprentices and trains them very quickly. Her former students are some of the most powerful conjurors in the land! Speak to her and recruit some of her apprentices to add to our roster.

Title: Needs of the Many
Objective: Seek out the Kirin Tor mages in Orgrimmar and travel to Dalaran.
Text: You've seen that the Legion is everywhere. Even with the Illidari as your allies, we are at a great disadvantage. We need an edge against the Legion... something to send them back to the Nether. We have heard that Dalaran will be the focal point of our campaign. I suggest you go there. You must do anything necessary to become stronger. ANYTHING. I have seen Kirin Tor mages near Grommash Hold. They can send you to Dalaran. Go. Take revenge upon the Legion!

Title: Supply Dropped
Objective: Challenge and defeat the Grimtotem Champion who is raiding your supplies.
Text: These supplies for the Earthen Ring have not been processed yet. It looks like someone has been rummaging through them and looting whatever can be carried. You have reasons to suspect the Grimtotem tribe, on account of the fact that one of their champions is nearby, visibly pilfering your stuff. Challenge the Grimtotem to secure your resources!

Title: Pledge of Loyalty
Objective: Return to Altar Keeper Biehn in Trueshot Lodge.
Text: The eagle appears to have a message for you: |cFF660000To: |r I hope this message finds you well. Word of Ohn'ahra's omen has traveled fast. There are many who wish to pledge their loyalty to the Unseen Path's new leader. Return to me at Trueshot Lodge, and we can discuss this further. |cFF660000 |r-Altar Keeper Biehn

Title: Protect the Home Front
Objective: Open your map to find an active Legion invasion in Kalimdor or Eastern Kingdoms. Go to the invasion site and stop the demons!
Text: The Legion hasn't just invaded this city. Their evil is spreading across Azeroth, threatening the far corners of our world. We must seek them out and stop them, everywhere their darkness touches. We've dispatched scouts around the world to watch for Legion activity. As invasions arise, we'll mark the locations on your map. Make them suffer!

Title: Return to the Fel Hammer
Objective: Speak with Battlelord Gaardoun on the Fel Hammer.
Text: , Battlelord Gaardoun asked me to retrieve you. He says there is a very important matter that he needs your help with.He requests your presence back on the Fel Hammer as soon as possible.

Title: A Greater Arsenal
Objective: Speak with Calydus to choose to pursue your final artifact.
Text: The tome speaks of one more weapon that friend can use against our foes.Do you wish to seek it?

Title: The Grimoire of the First Necrolyte
Objective: Collect 13 Skulls of the Executed from powerful humanoid champions throughout Broken Isles, and bring them to the Executioner's Altar in the crypt near Morgan's Plot in Deadwind Pass.
Text: This ancient tome appears to be the spellbook of Sataiel, the first necrolyte.Within its pages of curses and cantrips, you discover instructions for a ritual that Sataiel was concocting to empower Ulthalesh, the Deadwind Harvester. She calls this ritual, "The Rite of the Executioner."The site was chosen and prepared, but Sataiel met her unfortunate end before she could proceed. Perhaps you can pick up where she left off?First, you'll need some skulls.

Title: Knights of the Ebon Blade
Objective: Speak to Korgaz Deadaxe.
Text: Korgaz Deadaxe has arrived at Acherus to aid us in recruiting additional death knights. He has an eye for potential. I cannot emphasize enough that it is of the utmost importance that we replenish our numbers during the battle with the Burning Legion. The demon armies are nearly endless and we are few. Speak with Korgaz when you are ready to recruit additional death knights.

Title: Vengeance for Margaux
Objective: Slay 8 Vineyard Enforcers or Wardens.
Text: How could they? Margaux did everything they asked of her and more! The arcwine never stopped flowing despite everything they did to us! To her!Such injustice cannot stand. We must take vengeance for Margaux.

Title: Eye of Azshara: Essence of Balance
Objective: Collect 1 Essence of Balance from the Wrath of Azshara.
Text: Within the Eye of Azshara in Azsuna, a powerful being known as the Wrath of Azshara grows in strength. It is a blasphemy of nature - an infusion of stolen arcane power, and cannot be allowed to exist. Slay it. In its aftermath, you may find the essence of balance that you seek.

Title: Halls of Valor: Essence of Ferocity
Objective: Collect 1 Essence of Ferocity from Fenryr in the Halls of Valor, then prove your worth to Odyn.
Text: To find the essence of ferocity, you must seek a creature who has slain thousands, and is revered by even the gods. I speak of none other than the wolf, Fenryr, whom you can find hunting in the eternal forests of the Halls of Valor.

Title: Darkheart Thicket: Essence of Regrowth
Objective: Collect 1 Essence of Regrowth from Oakheart in Darkheart Thicket, then defeat the Shade of Xavius.
Text: My child, I can think of only one place to capture the essence of regrowth. Deep within Darkheart Thicket is Oakheart, a loyal ancient defender of the grove. He has recently fallen to the Nightmare's corruption, but deep within his heart, he still fights. Gather the essence of this great tree, so that his everliving soul may be used to fuel new life.

Title: Hero's Call: Desolace!
Objective: Report to Officer Jankie at Tethris Aran in Desolace.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Officer Jankie on the road into Desolace at Tethris Aran. The brave soldiers of Nijel's Point are beset by demons and the armies of the Horde, and they need your help. To reach Desolace, travel south on the road from the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Warchief's Command: Un'Goro Crater!
Objective: Report to Williden Marshal at Marshal's Stand in Un'Goro Crater. Optionally, grab a flight there from Doras in Orgrimmar.
Text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report Williden Marshal at Marshal's Stand. You are to provide aid to the Marshal Expeditions' personnel as they uncover the secrets of Un'Goro Crater. The Horde may be able to find a use for the unique beasts and crystals populating the crater. You can reach Un'Goro Crater by taking the road from western Tanaris down into the crater and toward Marshal's Stand. Or, you can get a flight there from Doras in Orgrimmar. Destiny calls!

Title: Scalding Signs
Objective: Collect 7 pieces of Suspicious Green Sludge from Scalding Springsurges or Boiling Springbubbles.
Text: The cauldron looked like it contained concentrated material. If the Winterfall are diluting this stuff directly in the springs, contamination could build up over time... and then the dilution would be less and less effective. The spring to the northeast has boiled over with elementals. I thought it was because of the cataclysm, but their appearance could be a reaction to this. Could you check them for corruption? Hunt a few and bring me any bits of green foreign material they leave behind.

Title: Writings of the Void
Objective: Bring the Writings of the Dark Herald to Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea at Lor'danel.
Text: The scrolls are vague and appear to be a piece of a much larger puzzle, but if you are not mistaken, they seem to reveal some of the steps on the path to becoming a demon hunter. The dark oaths and rituals necessary for becoming a demon hunter are frowned on by most of the night elves, so this is likely something they would be very interested in keeping quiet. Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea will know what to do with these scrolls.

Title: Hero's Call: Silithus!
Objective: Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold. Our Cenarion Circle allies require your assistance to fight back against the Twilight's Hammer onslaught. You can reach Silithus by taking the northwestern road out of the Un'Goro Crater. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Warchief's Command: Silithus!
Objective: Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. Optionally, grab a flight there from Doras in Orgrimmar.
Text: All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold. You are to aid our Cenarion allies in their battle to turn back Twilight's Hammer. Cho'Gall's minions must not be allowed to dominate Silithus! You can reach Silithus by taking the northwestern road out of Un'Goro Crater. Or, you can get a flight there from Doras in Orgrimmar. Destiny calls!

Title: Hero's Call: Un'Goro Crater!
Objective: Report to Williden Marshal at Marshal's Stand in Un'Goro Crater.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Williden Marshal at Marshal's Stand. The Alliance needs you to provide support to the Marshal Expeditions as they uncover the secrets of Un'Goro Crater's ancient beasts, unique flora, and powerful crystals. You can reach the crater by departing western Tanaris and following the road all the way to Marshal's Stand. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Delivery for Donova
Objective: Deliver Salfa's Basket to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
Text: Donova Snowden is a kind dwarf who frequents the nearby hot springs. She claims to be studying their magical properties. She is a kind person and has good relations with our tribe. As the Winterfall have become more and more aggressive, she has begun researching the cause of their corruption. I must keep my post here, but I have made a basket of refreshments for her. Please take it to her for me and tell her we await her next visit.

Title: The Fall of Neferset City
Objective: Slay Dark Pharaoh Tekahn at Neferset City in Uldum.
Text: We are ready to strike now. If we take down Dark Pharaoh Tekahn, the immortal colossi will fall and our armies will be able to march into Neferset City. Seek him out and engage him without fear. I will make sure you're not alone when it's time to bring him down.

Title: Centuries of Suffering
Objective: Speak with the Kaldorei Spirit at the center of Lake Kel'theril.
Text: I only agreed to even consider cooperating with night elves and the alliance on rumors that the Crystal of Zin-Malor was found here. The crystal is a powerful and ancient artifact, whose destruction cursed this land, and whose reassembly has caused little relief. But I cannot face the hauntings that dwell here. Mock me if you must, but if you do, try your own hand. Perhaps the placid spirits that sit at the center of the lake will speak with you...

Title: Speak to Salfa
Objective: Travel through Timbermaw Hold and exit into Winterspring. Speak with Salfa, who stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
Text: The threat of corruption comes not only from the Deadwood furbolgs to the south, but also from the east and the Winterfall furbolgs of Winterspring. If you wish to further aid us, speak with Salfa on the other side of the Hold, by the Winterspring entrance. Follow the path to the left to reach it.

Title: Mouton Flamestar
Objective: Report to Mouton Flamestar at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.
Text: I get precious little time away from Searing Gorge these days. I've been meaning to visit a friend in Burning Steppes for the last several months, but haven't had the chance. His name is Mouton Flamestar. While he's not a member of the Brotherhood, he's a trusted friend, and definitely trustworthy. Will you send him my regards? You'll have to travel south, through the base of Blackrock Mountain. Just keep heading south... you'll find him. Thank you.

Title: Legacy of the High Elves
Objective: Obtain the Memory of Zin-Malor from the spirit of Archmage Maenius.
Text: One hundred years ago... I and a small group of other High Elves traveled here from our homeland, Quel'thalas. We sought the ancient mysteries of Kel'thoril... to find why it was destroyed. We found fragments in the ice, shards of the crystal. The Archmage we accompanied did not take long to fall under their sway. In our foolishness, we noticed too late. His spirit wanders in the southeast, among those he drove to madness, still clutching the memory of the precious shard...

Title: The Howling Oak
Objective: Speak to Genn Greymane at the Howling Oak in Darnassus.
Text: So this is it... our new home. I'm not sure if I'll ever feel like I truly have a home again. We mustn't be unappreciative of what the night elves have offered us though. Their race is not one to throw out idle welcomes to just anyone. It is a true testament to faith and generosity that they've taken us in. Gwen and Greymane are in the city proper, at the Howling Oak. You should stop by. Take the portal beneath the tree north of us, then seek out the Howling Oak in the northern portion of the city.

Title: Winterfall Activity
Objective: Collect 10 Spirit Beads from Winterfall furbolg.
Text: The Timbermaw tend to stay to themselves. While we do allow safe passage to those we trust, we try to avoid other furbolg tribes if at all possible. The Winterfall tribe has become increasingly hostile towards us. They seem to be in a state of rage, completely engulfed by their own fear and hatred of anything they do not understand. The Winterfall carry spirit beads, which have clearly failed to protect them against corruption. Bring me 10 of these beads to show you have thinned their ranks.

Title: Pain of the Blood Elves
Objective: Slay 7 Wretched Spirits or Wretched Spectres at Lake Kel'theril.
Text: One year ago... The legend of the Crystal of Zin-Malor reached Silvermoon, and I led a group of the finest warriors and scholars available to this land. We brought ample mana crystals, so none of us would be tempted to taste the crystal itself. The crystal did not need our hunger to ruin us. Once in our possession, it warped all but me into wretched beasts. The wretched souls still wander, seeking more lives to chain to this lake. Will you give them mercy... or flee to die on safer ground someday?

Title: Pride of the Highborne
Objective: Slay 8 Anguished or Suffering Highborne.
Text: Ten thousand years ago... The Highborne lived here in prosperity. We considered ourselves above the common ranks of the other night elves. With our every need met by magic and wealth, we led lives of indulgence and amusement. And greed... The spirits you see here are overwhelmed with remorse and regret. Their anguish chains them here. If you wish to learn more of Kel'theril and Zin'malor, free them from their agony.

Title: The Battle for Andorhal
Objective: Speak with Kellen Kuhn to fly to Andorhal in Western Plaguelands. Then report to Koltira Deathweaver within Andorhal.
Text: I just received the most curious missive. Curious indeed... The city of Andorhal is in the middle of a three-way war between the Forsaken, the Alliance, and the Scourge. It sounds like Sylvanas has made her move, and to make matters interesting, she's put Koltira Deathweaver, the death knight, in command. They've asked for you by name. Speak with Kellen Kuhn, the bat handler. He'll put you on the first bat out to Andorhal.

Title: Warchief's Command: Tanaris!
Objective: Report to Megs Dreadshredder at Gadgetzan in Tanaris. Optionally, grab a flight there from Doras in Orgrimmar.
Text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Megs Dreadshredder in Gadgetzan. Help the Horde and the Bilgewater Cartel establish a presence in Tanaris before the Alliance does! You can reach Gadgetzan in Tanaris by traveling south to the shore from Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge in southeastern Thousand Needles. Or, you can get a flight there from Doras in Orgrimmar. Destiny calls!

Title: Hero's Call: Tanaris!
Objective: Report to Kelsey Steelspark at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Kelsey Steelspark in Gadgetzan. The Alliance needs your help to win concessions from the local baron and access to the area's priceless resources. You can reach Gadgetzan by traveling south from the Shimmering Deep in Thousand Needles. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Mouton Flamestar
Objective: Report to Mouton Flamestar at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.
Text: I get precious little time away from Searing Gorge these days. I've been meaning to visit a friend in Burning Steppes for the last several months, but haven't had the chance. His name is Mouton Flamestar. While he's not a member of the Brotherhood, he's a trusted friend, and definitely trustworthy. Will you send him my regards? You'll have to travel south, through the base of Blackrock Mountain. Just keep heading south... you'll find him. Thank you.

Title: To the Aid of the Thorium Brotherhood
Objective: Speak with Jack Rockleg at Thorium Advance in Searing Gorge.
Text: Dark Iron dwarves may be scheming and mischievous... but they're not all enemies. I've spoken several times with the dwarves of the Thorium Brotherhood, and they've never been anything but helpful. An acquaintance of mine, Jack Rockleg, came to town not long ago, asking if I could join him on an expedition of some sort. It sounded important. I'm a little busy, but maybe you wouldn't mind going? Just travel west, on the road to Searing Gorge. You'll see him soon after leaving the Badlands.

Title: March of the Stormpike
Objective: See the March of the Stormpike.
Text: These plans you recovered weave an interesting tale. The Stormpike have been moving their armies from Alterac Valley into the "four fingers" of Hillsbrad for over a month. Somehow they have managed to secretly get their installations set up without our forces knowing. Had we not received these plans they would have marched on us in a week's time, annihilating everything in their path. With these plans, though, we can turn the tables. This is what we must do...

Title: Hero's Call: Feralas!
Objective: Report to Telaron Windflight at Dreamer's Rest in Feralas.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Telaron Windflight at Dreamer's Rest in Feralas. The Alliance needs your help to overcome our enemies, the Horde and the Grimtotems. You can reach Dreamer's Rest by traveling south from Desolace into Feralas. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: The Battle for Andorhal
Objective: Speak with Guthrum Thunderfist to fly to Andorhal in Western Plaguelands. Then report to Thassarian within Andorhal.
