While many in Azeroth would pay dearly for such an artifact, something tells you that it belongs in a museum for all to see and remember. Harrison Jones is likely to have the proper connections. Sullah would certainly be happy to deliver it to him.

Title: A Second Legend
Objective: Choose a second artifact to pursue.
Text: Perhaps it's time to consider improving your flexibility when it comes to powerful artifacts. There are still others that I think are worth pursuing if you are interested.Let me show you what your options are and you can choose one.

Title: A New Path
Objective: Speak to Delas Moonfang.
Text: Highlord , if I could have a moment of your time? Long have I followed the path of the Light, and for many years I studied under the Priestesses of the Moon. Yet, I have always felt my education incomplete, and a yearning to know more. When I walked into these halls, I finally felt a spark of what was missing. I believe that a new path lies before me. I wish to become a paladin of the Silver Hand. Will you allow me to join you?

Title: My Sister, Fanny
Objective: Talk to Fanny Thundermar at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.
Text: Before you go, be sure to stop by the inn behind me. My sister Fanny is inside. Refugees are pouring into Thundermar from all of the torched Wildhammer settlements around us, and I put Fanny in charge of 'em. She's tough as talons, that one. But she might need your help.

Title: Focusing Our Efforts
Objective: Complete the "Nightfall" and "Moon Guard Stronghold" storylines in Suramar, then meet Archmage Kalec in Shal'Aran.
Text: The Nightfallen in Suramar were once a part of the Nightborne, but have been exiled by their former brethren and cut off from the Nightwell. I believe they could be valuable allies in our quest if you can turn them to our side. I know only that they have gone into hiding somewhere in Suramar. Afterward, seek out the Moon Guard in the northern reaches of Suramar. They, too, could be valuable allies in our cause... if they still oppose the Legion as they once did many years ago.

Title: Aggregates of Anguish
Objective: Complete 5 "Unholy Attainment" missions.
Text: Our preparations for conjuring the Steeds of the Damned are nearly complete. Salanar the Horseman has given us a list of the remaining components. The ritual of conjuring requires five unholy essences known as the Aggregates of Anguish. I have taken it upon myself to organize the necessary missions to obtain these components. Use the mission table to assign your chosen champions to the task.

Title: Seeking Refuge
Objective: Complete the "Nightfall" storyline in Suramar, then meet Archmage Kalec in Shal'Aran.
Text: The Nightfallen in Suramar were once a part of the Nightborne, but have been exiled by their former brethren and cut off from the Nightwell. I believe they could be valuable allies in our quest if you can turn them to our side. I know only that they have gone into hiding somewhere in Suramar. If you can convince the Nightfallen to aid us, they may be able to offer the Moon Guard and us both refuge right under the Legion's nose.

Title: Fire in the Hole!
Objective: Slay Grolvitar the Everburning.
Text: Land's sakes, pardner! You done shut off those valves but good. Unfortunately we've had a critical blowout in our gosh-darned central burnoff regulator! Missus Darla's done sent as many workers as she can rustle to go shut it off, but those flames have a mind of their own! Literally! They're hoppin' up and grabbin' anyone who comes near! So Darla says if you can muster up out of that cave you're in and beat that elemental, she's got a mighty fine prize in store for ya!

Title: The Legion Returns
Objective: Check in with Holgar Stormaxe at the Dranosh'ar Blockade.
Text: Warriors of da Horde! Break out ya axes and sharpen ya spears. Da Burning Legion has returned ta our world!We be shipping outta Bladefist Bay right away. With da full fury of da Horde, we gonna smash der line so hard dat Sargeras is gonna feel it in da Nether!Get to da ships. We got demons ta slay!

Title: The Nighthold: Elisande
Objective: Kill Elisande in The Nighthold.
Text: Long ago, Grand Magistrix Elisande opposed the Legion and defied Queen Azshara herself. Passing millennia have changed Elisande's mind, and turned her into an ally of the demons. The time has come to face her.

Title: The Nighthold: Gul'dan
Objective: Kill Gul'dan in The Nighthold.
Text: Gul'dan believed that the Legion was the destiny of the orcs, and has not paused in his brutal pursuit. Now, at last, the time has come to end his demonic crusade, and dispense justice for all.

Title: The Nighthold: Elisande
Objective: Kill Elisande in The Nighthold.
Text: Long ago, Grand Magistrix Elisande opposed the Legion and defied Queen Azshara herself. Passing millennia have changed Elisande's mind, and turned her into an ally of the demons. The time has come to face her.

Title: The Nighthold: High Botanist Tel'arn
Objective: Kill High Botanist Tel'arn in The Nighthold.
Text: The Nightborne are adept in more than one kind of magic, and we will likely face formidable foes inside the walls of the Nighthold. Their strongest mages and warriors must fall before we can hope to face Gul'dan.

Title: The Emerald Nightmare: Xavius
Objective: Defeat Xavius in the Emerald Nightmare.
Text: The time has come to tackle the source of the Nightmare, and restore balance to the Emerald Dream. Battle into the heart of the Nightmare, and face the Nightmare Lord Xavius.

Title: The Emerald Nightmare: Fall of Cenarius
Objective: Defeat Cenarius in the Emerald Nightmare.
Text: While we know that the Nightmare bends the boundary between reality and dream, there is no doubt of the threat upon us. Our own allies have fallen into darkness.

Title: The Emerald Nightmare: Xavius
Objective: Defeat Xavius in the Emerald Nightmare.
Text: The time has come to tackle the source of the Nightmare, and restore balance to the Emerald Dream. Battle into the heart of the Nightmare, and face the Nightmare Lord Xavius.

Title: Disarming Bears
Objective: Collect 7 Deadwood Weapons from Felpaw Village.
Text: I would prefer to do as much as we can to protect my people from the Deadwood tribe without slaughtering every last one of them. We've taken steps towards this before, and if you wish to prove yourself to the Timbermaw tribe, I would ask you do this as well. Look for the piles of weapons kept in Felpaw Village to the southwest. Take as many as you find. If we disarm the Deadwood tribe, we may be able to stop some bloodshed later.

Title: The Chieftain's Key
Objective: Retrieve Drizle's Key from Chieftain Bloodmaw.
Text: Sniff... I'm sorry! I didn't mean to get caught! They grabbed me and put this chain on me and left me here! I can't move and my leg fell asleep and I'm hungry! The chief has the key... Chieftain Bloodmaw, the other ones said. He's in the north end of the camp. But hurry! Please! Don't leave me alone here!

Title: Stirred the Hornet's Nest
Objective: Speak to Sullah at Sullah's Sideshow.
Text: Wow! It sounds like you really got their attention. We're never getting in there with them on alert like this. There must be a way... It's just a matter of time before Schnottz's men activate the obelisk and I need to research the scrolls you found. I need you to figure this one out without me. Sullah has connections in these parts. Maybe he has a solution for getting us inside.

Title: Running Their Course
Objective: Slay 8 Felrot Coursers.
Text: I'd love so much to save every creature in the forest, but as you probably have seen, some are just too far gone. When we first founded Whisperwind Grove, the woods just to the south were full of beautiful coursers, majestic and gentle creatures. The corruption here hasn't made them violent, but they've wasted away to nearly nothing. Even if they were cleansed, they would know only pain and suffering. Please, help put them down for me.

Title: Stupid Drizle!
Objective: Find Drizle in Felpaw Village.
Text: Stupid, stupid Drizle! I told him not to go! Drizle wanted to steal more honey from Felpaw Village... you know, just west of here? You can see it from the cliff... Anyway... I told him it was a dumb idea but he went anyway, and then the Deadwood tribe got him, and... and... Sniff... I don't know what they're gonna do! Please find him,  ! Even if he is a dummy! I don't want Drizle to get eaten!

Title: Squirrely Clean
Objective: Scrub 6 Tainted Squirrels.
Text: The larger animals are often too far corrupted to save, but you'd be surprised how hardy the little ones are. Take the squirrels, for example. After washing in corrupted water, they can spread illness far from the original source, but it's slow to affect the squirrels themselves. In fact, a simple washing will result in a clean squirrel and a safer forest! Here, take this bottle of cleaning mixture. Grab and scrub any squirrel you see in the woods to the south... they'll be thankful for it!

Title: Shroud of the Makers
Objective: Sabotage 7 Schnottz Powder Kegs.
Text: It is good to have friends! While kindness is its own reward, there can be tangible benefits too! Some friends of mine recently intercepted a shipment of Schnottz's plunder and found something that should serve your needs nicely. It's a piece of titan technology that renders the user nearly invisible. If you use it in the enemy camp, you might be able to rewire their explosives and make a mess of their operation. Each charge has a limited duration, so don't stray too far from safety!

Title: Take it to the Tree
Objective: Slay 8 Talonbranch Defenders.
Text: Those mangy curs think they can just snoop around my site and get away with it? I'll show them... And what I mean by that is, of course, that YOU will show them. You and the small army of axe-wielding goblin hires I've sent to Talonbranch Glade. The place will be swarming with worgen by now. Just where we want them. Head to the southeast, join up with the rest of our forces, and let some fur fly.

Title: The Core of Kroshius
Objective: Obtain Kroshius' Infernal Core.
Text: The most fearsome demon in Shatter Scar Vale is known as Kroshius. Though many have hunted him over the years, destruction has only made him stronger. Time after time, warlocks have come to this forest and reanimated Kroshius. He now lurks in the southeast, surrounded by demonic fire, awaiting any who come to try and claim his power. I will not have this corrupt cycle continue! Kill Kroshius, and bring his infernal core to me.

Title: Hunting the Damned
Objective: Slay 6 Infernal Sentries.
Text: The first demons to set foot in this forest were infernals. Long ago, these powerful beings of stone and demonic fire fell from the sky to take this land for the Burning Legion. The charred craters of Shatter Scar Vale to the south are where these infernals landed, and many still wander there. They are fierce foes, and killing them is both a worthy challenge and a noble cause. I offer reward for those who join the hunt. Return here afterwards.

Title: Preemptive Strike
Objective: Kill any 15 Naga at the Eastern Strand.
Text: These plans document what appears to be an imminent attack on Southshore. The naga of the Eastern Strand are planning to take over the town now that the Alliance has been pushed out. Not if you can help it! Kill all of the naga on the Eastern Strand and report to Helcular at the Ruins of Southshore with the Daggerspine attack plan.

Title: Jonesy Sent For You
Objective: Speak with Harrison Jones in the Oasis of Vir'sar.
Text: Listen, you may want to make your way back to Jonesy when you get a moment. Chances are, whatever he's got to talk to you about is more pressing than anything I have for you to do.

Title: Terrible Little Creatures
Objective: Kill any 10 Gnolls at the Nethander Stead.
Text: Gnolls! These terrible little creatures are a blight upon any land - which is saying a lot when you consider that Hillsbrad is Forsaken territory. Kill as many of the gnolls at the Nethander Stead as you can. For the good of the world!

Title: Kasha Will Fly Again
Objective: Gather 8 Mudsnout Blossoms.
Text: Kasha will fly again. She must if we are to claim vengeance! Sadly, Orkus must stay here with Kasha. You must help us. I beg of you! Listen carefully, quest giver. When I first arrived here I flew around for days to learn the lay of the land. There is a farm east of here that has long since been abandoned and is now overrun by gnolls. On this farm grows a special type of mushroom known as the mudsnout. Go to the stead and gather mudsnout for Kasha. Return here when your pack is full.

Title: Camel Tow
Objective: Use Sullah's Harness to tame 3 Camels.
Text: Greetings, friend! You are always most welcome in my humble tent. Looking for something to do? Sullah has just the thing! Camels are good to have in hand regardless, but when putting together a performance the likes of my sideshow, they are an absolute must! Take this harness and use it to subdue a wandering camel. You may have to, uhh, humble it a bit first... if you know what I mean. You'll find a desert full of wild camels to the south.

Title: Unlimited Potential
Objective: Use the Reinforced Cage to capture 5 Cavorting Pygmies.
Text: Some see the little sand pygmy as nothing more than a pest, a vermin, or worse yet, a vile little demon. I say they are simply misunderstood! With the proper care and guidance, these little fellows may just turn out to be a glorious gift of nature. I would like you to take these cages and use them to capture a few of them for me to work with. You will need to give them a sound beating before boxing them up, but in the end it will be for their own good. You'll see! Go south for pygmies!

Title: *Gurgle* HELP! *Gurgle*
Objective: Help Kingslayer Orkus get out of the water.
Text: *GURGLE* HELP!*GASP* ORKUS IS DROWNING! HELP ME, QUEST GIVER ! *GLUB* Dwarf threw Orkus into the water! Must not die! *GURGLE* The shame would be too great.

Title: Stormpike Rendezvous
Objective: Learn about the Stormpike Rendezvous from Orkus.
Text: I tracked down the decrepit necromancer, Helcular, in hopes of getting a lead on Alliance movement within Hillsbrad. Helcular tasked me with finding and killing worgen. Ordinarily this would not be a problem for Orkus, but I had just eaten several helpings of Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok chops, causing my bowels to cry out in anguish. That's when the trouble began and how I ended up in the water. Hear Orkus out.

Title: Megs in Marketing
Objective: Speak with Megs Dreadshredder at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.
Text: Boss, while you were down at the mines, Megs Dreadshredder in marketing was asking for you. Something about your new ride? She's right outside the building to the left.

Title: The Bachelor
Objective: Discuss marriage prospects with Keegan Firebeard at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.
Text: We need to make this work. The answer is in the blood! Family bonds have kept these Wildhammer clans apart from one another. It'll take family bonds to glue 'em back together. It's a long shot, but we're going to have to play matchmaker! I'll track down Colin Thundermar and talk with him. You're a smooth one - you should talk to Keegan Firebeard inside. He's sharp enough to understand a political marriage. Go find out if he fancies anyone!

Title: Master Trapper
Objective: Sullah wants you to collect 5 Meat Scraps from the wildlife in Uldum.
Text: One thing about me that you might not know... I come from a long line of trappers. My father taught me, as his taught him, to master the art of trapping creatures in a most merciful manner. As any master trapper will tell you, the most important ingredient in an effective trap is the bait. So let's start there. Fill this bucket with the meat scraps from almost any wild creature in Uldum.

Title: Can You Smell What the Lok'tar is Cooking?
Objective: Find Kingslayer Orkus at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Text: Shortly before you arrived an orc flew in upon a frost wyrm and demanded that I direct him to where the 'newbies were hanging out.' Uncertain as to the vernacular, I told him to fulfill his duty as a member of the Horde and deal with the worgen threat of the area. He grumbled something about 'what the lok'tar was cooking' and headed south to the docks. Ordinarily I wouldn't care about whether or not an orc went missing, but I am genuinely curious about what the lok'tar might be cooking. Find out.

Title: The Breath of Cenarius
Objective: Recover the Breath of Cenarius from Pyromancer Loregrain in Blackrock Depths and use the artifact to close 3 Elemental Gates.
Text: , we have learned that a missing Cenarion artifact has surfaced in the hands of a Twilight's Hammer pyromancer. Pyromancer Loregrain has taken this artifact, the Breath of Cenarius, into Blackrock Depths and uses its power to open elemental gates. We must act to keep Loregrain from summoning elementals to bolster the ranks of his Dark Iron allies. Recover the artifact from him and use its power to close the gates that Loregrain has been using.

Title: A Bomb Deal
Objective: Collect 8 Irontree Explosives from Irontree Cavern.
Text: All my workers got driven straight out of the cavern here by those big swamp-lookin' things! Darla's sent me here to pick up the pieces, but have you seen it in there? I ain't goin' in! There's a ton of explosives left behind that we can't just leave layin' around. I'll make you a deal: You run in there and get those explosives gathered up, and I will stay here and not get killed by swamp-things, and if you don't either, I'll pay ya! How's that sound?

Title: Is Your Oil Running?
Objective: Collect 10 Crude Tarballs from Oily Sludges.
Text: Last time we had an oil leak this bad, the oil itself tried to get away! I don't know what does it, maybe all the demon goop floating around here, but when we get a big enough crude leak half of it globs together and tries to run away. That's profit trying to escape! Go run after those oil sludges and bring back their sweet, precious oil!

Title: The Shredders of Irontree
Objective: Kill 9 Irontree Shredders.
Text: Disgusting, isn't it? Look at them. Pathetic little things that can't even toil with their own bodies. They stomp around in their massive metal shredders, carving the forest to splinters. I bet they think they're safe in there, all warm and cozy. Prove them wrong. Blaze north through the camp and destroy as many shredders as you can. Once you've spilled some blood, we're going to take this place apart for good.

Title: Deadwood of the North
Objective: Kill 15 Deadwood Furbolg of any kind in Felpaw Village.
Text: There is a camp of Deadwood furbolgs directly to our southwest. Corruption permeates the camp, and I wish to put an end to it before they become a problem. The Deadwood tribe is evil, but it is the effects of the fel that pollutes their minds. Their hostility is not truly an innate quality, yet they cannot be helped. It saddens me that we must fight our own brethren. Please,  - I ask you to do what must be done. Simply spare me the details; such troublesome images upset me far too much.

Title: Collecting Corruption
Objective: Collect 8 Entropic Essences from Entropic Horrors in Shatter Scar Vale.
Text: Though we druids shun the demonic powers infesting this land, it must still be confronted. Shatter Scar Vale to the south seethes with corruption. The energies there are so chaotic that they manifest as violent entities, pure fel magic given form to lash out at all life. I have been keeping a close eye on these chaotic beasts, and studying their strength. I need to make sure they are still weakening with time. Bring me the essences they drop, so I may ensure they are diminishing.

Title: It's Time to Oil Up
Objective: Use Darla's Grapple to collect Irontree Oil Cans and use them to oil 7 Irontree Shredders.
Text: Three things come out of Irontree Clearing: lumber, oil, and exhausted workers. The first two are pretty much the cause of the third, but I like to be efficient about things where I can. I've got our shredders working triple unpaid overtime, and there's really nowhere in the schedule for them to get maintenance. Use this grappling hook to nab some of the extra oil cans floating around camp and use them to oil up the shredders, would you?

Title: The Emerald Nightmare: Fall of Cenarius
Objective: Defeat Cenarius in the Emerald Nightmare.
Text: While we know that the Nightmare bends the boundary between reality and dream, there is no doubt of the threat upon us. Our own allies have fallen into darkness.

Title: Slap and Cap
Objective: Slap 7 Panicked Workers to make them cap the oil gushers.
Text: Oh for... not again! If you heard the deputy yelling out there, that means we've got a fullblown oil leak on our hands! It's those filthy worgen again! Listen, it's going to be total chaos out there. Sleep-deprived goblins running around screaming and not knowing what to do. I need you to snap the workers back to their senses. A good, swift backhand across the face should do it! Once they shake themselves off, they'll get to work capping those gushers!

Title: Steeds of the Damned
Objective: Complete 5 "Fallen Steeds" missions.
Text: Salanar the Horseman has arrived at Ebon Hold from the Realm of Shadows. He alone has the knowledge and power to conjure the steeds of the Four Horsemen. Salanar has given us the first list of necessary components to create the steeds. I have organized a number of missions to obtain these items. Use the mission table to assign your chosen champions to the task.

Title: Turn It Off! Turn It Off!
Objective: Shut off the Master Control Pump at the bottom of Irontree Cavern.
Text: It was those darn worgen! They blew right past me into the cavern. They must've messed with the Master Control Pump! If that thing is left on too long, every pipe runnin' under our feet is gonna blow. You think the leaks now are bad? Just wait! Listen, if you can reach the Master Control Pump all the way in the back of the cavern, you can shut it off and save us all!

Title: Fel To Pieces
Objective: Collect 9 pieces of Infernal Debris from Shatter Scar Vale.
Text: The infernals that lurk in Shatter Scar Vale are formidable, but not invincible. Much progress has been made in thinning their numbers. Destroying them is only part of the solution, however. I've found that the stone that infernals are made of still contains large amounts of fel magic even after the infernal's death. The rubble of slain infernals now litters Shatter Scar Vale, leeching its corruption back into the ground. If you could collect it and bring it to me, I would be grateful.

Title: A Flare Fight
Objective: Use Darla's Box of Megaflares to reveal 8 Talonbranch Prowlers and slay them.
Text: This operation's stayed pretty discreet so far, but the worgen over in Talonbranch Glade have it out for us. They've been trying everything they can to get us shut down. Some of the workers have told me they've seen glimpses of worgen lurking around the clearing. Take these oversized megaflares. They're bright enough to show anything that gets anywhere near them. Use the flares to look for prowling worgen, and make sure they don't leave here alive!

Title: Preparing to Move
Objective: Meet Archmage Kalec in Shal'Aran.
Text: Thanks to your tireless efforts the Heart of Zin-Azshari is ready to withstand the full power of the Legion. The final destination in our journey has stood defiantly in front of us from the moment we began - the Nighthold, now home to none other than Gul'dan himself. Before we move on the hold, we should reunite with the Moon Guard in Shal'Aran - we still have need of their skills, and I would wager that they have unfinished business with their former brothers and sisters.

Title: The Nighthold: Vaults
Objective: Kill Trilliax in The Nighthold.
Text: The Nighthold will be a challenge to infiltrate and conquer. Even the catacombs and vaults are likely to be heavily guarded, but we must make our way in by any route possible.

Title: The Nighthold: Vaults
Objective: Kill Trilliax in The Nighthold.
Text: The Nighthold will be a challenge to infiltrate and conquer. Even the catacombs and vaults are likely to be heavily guarded, but we must make our way in by any route possible.

Title: The Nighthold: Vaults
Objective: Kill Trilliax in The Nighthold.
Text: The Nighthold will be a challenge to infiltrate and conquer. Even the catacombs and vaults are likely to be heavily guarded, but we must make our way in by any route possible.

Title: Speaking to the Wind
Objective: Start a Research Work Order.
Text: You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. We know stories of it, but little about its origins.If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. The winds can help us with this, but we need to know what to ask.It will take more shaman than just myself to learn everything there is to know about this artifact of yours. We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

Title: Hitting the Books
Objective: Start a Research Work Order.
Text: You wield ancient steel, strengthened by magics we barely understand.If you truly want to unlock the potential of your weapons, you need to know more of how they were forged, and of the battles they've fought in. I can help with this.Any resources that you can prioritize towards this research will be well worth it.

Title: Hitting the Books
Objective: Start a Research Work Order.
Text: Your weapons are undeniably powerful, but we know near nothing about'm.If we want to unlock all of their potential, we need to dig up some dirt on how they work, what they've done... get to know them, ya know? That's where I come in. I dig up dirt all the time. I mean, not literally, but... you know what I mean.It will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this. We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

Title: The Nighthold: Vaults
Objective: Kill Trilliax in The Nighthold.
Text: The Nighthold will be a challenge to infiltrate and conquer. Even the catacombs and vaults are likely to be heavily guarded, but we must make our way in by any route possible.

Title: Hitting the Books
Objective: Start a Research Work Order.
Text: You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. I can do this for you.Still, it will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

Title: Hitting the Books
Objective: Start a Research Work Order.
Text: You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. That is a thing that I can do for you.Still, it will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

Title: Hitting the Books
Objective: Start a Research Work Order.
Text: You have a mighty weapon with a long history, one we barely understand. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. I can get workin' on that for ya.Still, it'll take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

Title: Hitting the Books
Objective: Start a Research Work Order.
Text: You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. I am quite good at such things.Still, it will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

Title: Hitting the Books
Objective: Start a Research Work Order.
Text: You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. That's where I come in. It's my specialty.Still, it will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. I promise you it will be worth every minute.

Title: Hitting the Books
Objective: Start a Research Work Order.
Text: A demon hunter is nothing without blades with which to cut flesh. Yet those you wield are older than even you... and have power we don't understand yet.If you truly want to unlock all of their potential, we need to learn more about them. It will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. I promise you it will be worth every minute.

Title: Hitting the Books
Objective: Start a Research Work Order.
Text: You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. I can help with that.Still, it will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

Title: Trail of Filth
Objective: Kill Chet the Slime-Breeder.
Text: The trail of filth and anger leads into the ruined town hall. Surely there is a slime breeding pool inside the structure. Fight your way inside and deal with whatever angry slime-breeder that you encounter! Should you succeed Serge Hinott at the Ruins of Southshore will surely want to hear about it.

Title: Angry Scrubbing Bubbles
Objective: Kill 5 Angry Blight Slimes.
Text: These blight slimes seem to be really angry. They've even got a faint outline of an angry humanoid face in their ectoplasm. You don't think Hinott would be too happy about having non-compliant slimes working the slime pools. Kill any angry blight slimes that you see and try to get a lock on a breeding pool.

Title: Hitting the Books
Objective: Start a Research Work Order.
Text: Any death knight worth their salt knows the weapon they wield as if they were born with it. But you now carry a weapon older than any in this hall.If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. It will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. I promise you it will be worth every minute.

Title: Twilight Scheming
Objective: Use the Glowing Torch to destroy 8 copies of The Twilight Creed in the Domicile of Blackrock Depths.
Text: The influence of Twilight's Hammer reaches far and wide. They search ceaselessly for allies in their battle against us and they are recruiting the Dark Iron dwarves of Blackrock Depths to their cause. Moira's grip on the Dark Irons is tenuous at best and more of her people fall away from her rule with each day. We must sabotage their recruitment efforts. I want you to go into Domicile portion of Blackrock Depths and use this torch to burn the books that the Twilight's Hammer is distributing there.

Title: Locked and Loaded
Objective: Report to Colonel Troteman at Morgan's Vigil in Burning Steppes.
Text: , come in. Can you read me? The battle is about to start. I hope you've delivered all of those packages. I need you here in Morgan's Vigil, NOW.

Title: Helcular's Rod Giveth...
Objective: Use Helcular's Rod to Empower 8 Dark Rangers.
Text: To think, I, a master of necromancy, trained by Kel'Thuzad himself, was reduced to nothing more than a corpse in a grave. Thankfully, my astute apprentice, Thaivand, managed to find a group of heroes to recover this:  It is through the power of the rod that I was reborn. The rod giveth and the rod taketh away! Take it now and use it to empower our dark rangers battling the worgen in the field north of us. Renew their vigor with my rod.

Title: Meet with Brother Silverhallow
Objective: Speak with Brother Silverhallow at the Orgrimmar Embassy.
Text: Brother Silverhallow sent word that he wishes to speak with you. Next time you're in Orgrimmar, visit him at the embassy. It sounded like he had something important on his mind.

Title: Placing the Pawns
Objective: Return to Colonel Troteman at Morgan's Vigil in Burning Steppes.
Text: . It sounds like you and Keeshan have finished with your tasks. I've also finished mine. Return to Morgan's Vigil. I've prepared a few packages to deliver to the Big Three: Thorg'izog, Neeralak, and Xi'lun. You've already met General Thorg'izog. This will be your chance to meet the other two. That is, before we kill them.

Title: Glory Amidst Chaos
Objective: Kill General Thorg'izog, Dragon-Lord Neeralak, and High Warlock Xi'lun.
Text: You and Keeshan are going back to that mountain. There's three orcs who survived the attack, and we won't rest until they're dead. That's right, I'm talking about the Big Three. General Thorg'izog crawled back into the Firegut Furnace, and Dragon-Lord Neeralak is cowering in the cave on the mountain's peak. Xi'lun is in the back of the Skull Warren, plotting with his fellow warlocks. Leave your mark. Hunt down those sniveling Blackrocks, and teach them the might of Redridge!

Title: Studies in Lethality
Objective: Recover 250 Blight Samples.
Text: We used a fairly potent strain of blight against the humans of Southshore. As you can see, it worked. The trouble with blight use, though, is that blight tends to stick around after it's served its purpose. What I need from you is to take this testing kit and get out into the field to get a lethality count from the blight slimes that we've released into the area. Use the lethality analyzer on the blight slimes sweeping the slime pools. Come back to me when you have some solid data.

Title: The Spoils of War
Objective: Inspect the Box of Left Over Supplies at Morgan's Vigil in Burning Steppes.
Text: We've toppled a giant today. While the Blackrock orcs still swarm in their spire, I doubt their plans will take them anywhere near Redridge anytime soon. You and Keeshan saw to that. I'd say we were fairly resourceful here in Burning Steppes - those warlock supplies we collected certainly came in handy, as did the obsidian ash that we used to conceal our dragon. There were, however, some collected items left over. Please, take your pick before you move on, beyond the steppes.

Title: Green Living
Objective: Recover 8 Used Blight Canisters.
Text: Recycling! It's all the craze these days. The Banshee Queen has decreed that we must conserve if we are to prosper as a people. Everyone must do their part, right? With that said, you will be doing our part for us. There are likely thousands of blight canister bits and pieces all over Southshore. We can reuse those canisters for more blight bombing goodness. Just head into the ruins here and pick up whatever you can find.

Title: A Deal With a Dragon
Objective: Deliver the Rescued Whelplings to Acride at Slither Rock in Burning Steppes.
Text: While we are circling around Dreadmaul Rock, there's one more stop that we need to make. You remember the hatchlings that you freed from the Whelping Downs? Troteman's been hanging onto them, and we're going to deliver them to someone who will take care of them better than we can. He's staying in Slither Rock, to the northeast of Dreadmaul Rock. His name is Acride, and he might be the key to victory in the upcoming battle.

Title: Draconic Vanguard
Objective: Slay Minyoth, Whelptamer Akumi, Terromath the Seared, and Tugnar Goremaw.
Text: The Blackrock orcs don't come alone. You've already seen that they've got the Firegut ogres and Smolderthorn trolls on their side. Unfortunately for us, they're also teamed up with the black dragonflight. The orcs and the dragons have already sent some of their champions to stand guard at rally points, which are marked by a dragon skull on a pike. You and I are going to find these rally points and take out this vanguard before the battle starts. Ready?

Title: Assault on Dreadmaul Rock
Objective: Slay 200 Blackrock Invaders. If you should lose your vehicle, use the Horn of the Callers to summon it again.
Text: This is it. This is where it hits the fan. Where all the pieces come together. Strap in, and come with me. We're going to go talk to Acride and call in that favor that he owes us. Then we'll stop this invasion of Redridge before it even starts.

Title: A Delivery for Thorg'izog
Objective: Using your Blackrock Disguise, bring the Slider Cider-Marinated Cutlets to General Thorg'izog at Firegut Furnace in Burning Steppes. Speak with Colonel Troteman if you need a new Blackrock Disguise.
Text: General Thorg'izog is staying among the ogres in the Firegut Furnace, a cave on the western edge of Dreadmaul Rock. I'd like you to deliver this to him and the ogres. Inside this package, you will find the worg cutlets you obtained, marinated in the fel slider cider that we took from the Altar of Storms. I would avoid eating it if I were you. Bring it to General Thorg'izog. He will make sure that his troops are fed and, with any luck, he will eat some himself.

Title: A Delivery for Neeralak
Objective: Using your Blackrock Disguise, sneak into the Skull Warren and convince Dragon-Lord Neeralak to take your Crate of Sleeping Flamekin. Speak with Colonel Troteman if you need a new Blackrock Disguise.
Text: The warlocks of the Blackrock Clan often practice their magic in the Skull Warren, a cave on the eastern side of Dreadmaul Rock. Their leader, Xi'lun, is busy elsewhere, so the cave is currently being held by another of the big three: Dragon-Lord Neeralak. And Neeralak's expertise is in dragons, not in necromancy. I've used the slumber sand on those flamekin you captured. Try to convince Neeralak that they're warlock imps, and not flamekin. When they wake up, they won't be happy.

Title: A Delivery for Xi'lun
Objective: While using the Blackrock Disguise, deliver the Clear Glass Orb to High Warlock Xi'lun atop Dreadmaul Rock in Burning Steppes.
Text: Intel tells us that High Warlock Xi'lun - the final member of the Big Three - is within the cave atop Dreadmaul Peak, preparing for his big moment. He is waiting for a delivery: an Orb of Domination, with which he can perform a powerful summoning ritual. I want you to give him this:  This is the clear glass orb that you freed from the Altar of Storms. It is powerless. Give it to Xi'lun, and cross your fingers that he doesn't notice.

Title: Blood Tour
Objective: Kill 25 Black Dragonspawn or Black Wyrmkin.
Text: My legs are getting a little restless again. You interested in taking a little tour? We're going to take a trip around Dreadmaul Rock. I'd like to investigate some of the Blackrock army before we make our move, and I figure we might as well kill some of them while we're on the way.

Title: Latent Demons of the Land
Objective: Obtain 18 Fallen Flamekin.
Text: The lava beds nearby - to the west - play host to flamekin, a brand of fire demon that has long roamed the steppes. Situations are such in the Blackrock army that, if we are careful, we may be able to sneak some of these flamekin behind enemy lines to cause some havoc. Bring me the bodies of several flamekin. As demons, they are easily resurrected, and then we can use them for our own purposes.

Title: Morgan's Vigil
Objective: Report to Oralius at Morgan's Vigil in Burning Steppes.
Text: Our work here in Chiselgrip is done, mostly thanks to you. We'll now be moving on to the east, to Morgan's Vigil. Our intel indicates that Morgan's Vigil has been vacated, as most of its inhabitants have moved into Blackrock Mountain to fight their own battle against the Blackrocks. It should serve as a sufficient base of operations for the final stages of our plan. Of course, Keeshan will be joining you on the road. As will I.

Title: Meet with Shadow-Walker Zuru
Objective: Speak with Shadow-Walker Zuru in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
Text: Shadow-Walker Zuru, a revered priest trainer, has asked to meet with you in Orgrimmar. You can find him in the Valley of Spirits with the other Darkspear trainers. It must be an important matter for him to send for you so directly.

Title: The Fate of Bloodvenom Post
Objective: Speak with Kelnir Leafsong at Bloodvenom Post.
Text: While we dealt with Jaedenar, I sent a friend of mine north to Bloodvenom Post. We used to have infrequent visits from the tauren there, but they have stopped coming as of late. My friend, Kelnir Leafsong, has yet to return. Would you travel north to check on her and the situation at Bloodvenom? Should you find her, do be aware... dryads like her tend to strike other races as a bit odd.

Title: Meet with Tyelis
Objective: Speak with Tyelis at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
Text: Tyelis, a member of the Silvermoon delegation to Orgrimmar, has requested to meet with you next time you're in the city. You can find him inside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. It must be an important matter for him to send for you so directly.

Title: Whisperwind Grove
Objective: Speak with Tender Puregrove at Whisperwind Grove.
Text: You've been such a big help here! I'm gonna stay here a while and look after poor Mr. Tauren until he stops throwing up so much. Why don't you head north to Whisperwind Grove? It's really pretty there, and all the druids are so friendly! You should tell Miss Puregrove I'm okay, she'll worry if I'm gone too long. She might ask you to help with her flowers, too! So fun!

Title: A Heap of Delicious Worg
Objective: Use the Worgsaw on the bodies of slain Giant Ember Worgs to obtain 40 Worg Cutlets.
Text: We're going to need fresh meat, which means you're going to be hunting worg. The worg on this side of the steppes should be your target.  Hunt the giant ember worgs. Once you've killed them, use this saw to remove the choicest bits of meat from their bodies. You will find these worgs all over the steppes, but the closest pack rules the land just to our northeast.

Title: Blackened Ashes
Objective: Obtain 9 piles of Obsidian Ash.
Text: I need you to do some more gathering before we can go take out the remainder of the Blackrock army. If we're going to do this, we're going to do it right, and that means being prepared. I need ash. Not just any ash... ash from the greater obsidian elementals that roam the plains to the northwest. The stuff is deep, deep black, which is what we need for our next disguise. Don't worry, you've already got a disguise. This one is for someone... well, someTHING... else.

Title: Meet with Seer Liwatha
Objective: Speak with Seer Liwatha in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
Text: Seer Liwatha sends her greetings from the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar. She asked me to convey an invitation to visit her next time you're in the city. It sounded like she has something of importance to discuss with you.

Title: Recruiting More Troops
Objective: Speak to Vicar Eliza.
Text: Word of your leadership has spread rather fast. Priests of all sorts have traveled to the temple to lend their aid.We're lucky enough to have caught the eye of Vicar Eliza. She's quite the leader in her own right, commanding countless devotees that do her bidding without question.Speak to her now.

Title: Fancy Lads and Buccaneers
Objective: Speak with your Pirate recruiter, Yancey Grillsen.
Text: Aye, it warms me heart t' know that Yancey's now part o' th' crew.Why don't you be a good  and see if he can sponge us up some bilge rats.

Title: Convincin' Old Yancey
Objective: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Convincin' Old Yancey".
Text: Avast ye! Th' time be long overdue that we get some more pirate blood into our ranks.And I know just th' man t' do it.I'm talkin' about good old Yancey Grillsen, o' course. He's an old salt down Stranglethorn way.Send some o' your land lovin' scallywags off t' round him up.

Title: Meet with Sunwalker Atohmo
Objective: Speak with Sunwalker Atohmo in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
Text: You should make your way to Orgrimmar as soon as you can. Sunwalker Atohmo has sent word that he wishes to speak with you about a matter of importance to the Horde. Look for him the Valley of Wisdom.

Title: Meet with Dark Cleric Cecille
Objective: Speak with Dark Cleric Cecille at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
Text: Dark Cleric Cecille, a member of the Banshee Queen's delegation to Orgrimmar, has requested to meet with you next time you're in the city. You can find her inside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. It must be an important matter for her to send for you so directly.

Title: Meet with Master Pyreanor
Objective: Speak with Master Pyreanor in Orgrimmar's Grommash Hold.
Text: Master Pyreanor sent an urgent message for you. He asks you to join him at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength the next time you're in the city. It sounds as though he must have an important assignment for you.

Title: Meet with Terga Earthbreaker
Objective: Speak with Terga Earthbreaker in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
Text: An urgent message just arrived for you. It's from Terga Earthbreaker, one of the shaman trainers in Orgrimmar. She requests your presence as soon as possible.

Title: That's No Pyramid!
Objective: Speak with Belloc Brightblade at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
Text: That pyramid at the Maker's Terrace in Uldum is nothing of the sort. It's a giant machine that can be reconfigured for any number of uses. Deathwing was going to have the Twilight's Hammer turn it into a massive weapon! , you have to take the portal to get this information to Belloc Brightblade at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. He'll know what to do.

Title: Meet with Ormak Grimshot
Objective: Speak with Ormak Grimshot in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.
Text: I received a scroll for you from Ormak Grimshot in Orgrimmar. He wants you to make your way to the Valley of Honor and speak with him as soon as you can. It sounded urgent.

Title: Meet with Kranosh
Objective: Speak with Kranosh in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow.
Text: I have just received word from Kranosh, Orgrimmar's foremost warlock trainer. He wishes you to travel to Orgrimmar and speak with him in the cleft of shadow. It sounds like he has an important mission for you.

Title: Meetup with the Caravan
Objective: Speak with Adarrah at Thistleshrub Valley in Tanaris.
Text: The pyramid inside of the Maker's Terrace in Uldum can be used as some kind of super weapon that will end all life on Azeroth.  You must continue the good research that you've begun. Head south to the desert of Tanaris. There's a caravan there that's about to leave for Uldum. Perhaps you can tag along.

Title: The Kirthaven Summit
Objective: Speak with Lachlan MacGraff at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.
Text: After the licking we just gave 'em, the Dragonmaw assaults on Thundermar ought to stop. Maybe the Wildhammer do have a place in your Alliance - we Thundermars certainly owe you a debt. Up in Kirthaven, our Grand Shaman Lachlan MacGraff has been trying to arrange a summit between the surviving Wildhammer family leaders. It's a tall order to get us all to work together, but I'm at least willing to give it a go. Fly up to Kirthaven in the North and talk to Lachlan MacGraff. I'll meet you there!

Title: Meet with Ureda
Objective: Speak with Ureda in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow.
Text: I just received a scroll for you from Orgrimmar. It's from Ureda, one of the mage trainers there. She wants you to meet with her in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow next time you're in the city.

Title: Meetup with the Caravan
Objective: Speak with Adarrah at Thistleshrub Valley in Tanaris.
Text: The pyramid inside of the Maker's Terrace in Uldum can be used as some kind of super weapon that will end all life on Azeroth.  You need to continue the research you've begun. Head to the southern end of Kalimdor, to the desert of Tanaris. There's a caravan there that's about to leave for Uldum. Perhaps you can tag along.

Title: Meet with Gordul
Objective: Speak with Gordul in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow.
Text: Gordul, leader of the rogues of the Shattered Hand in Orgrimmar, wishes to meet with you. Make your way to Orgrimmar quickly,  and seek him in the Cleft of Shadow. He must have an important mission for you.

Title: That's No Pyramid!
Objective: Speak with Harrison Jones at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
Text: That pyramid at the Maker's Terrace in Uldum is nothing of the sort. It's a giant machine that can be reconfigured for any number of uses. Deathwing was going to have the Twilight's Hammer turn it into a massive weapon! , you have to take the portal to get this information to Harrison Jones in Stormwind. He'll know what to do.

Title: Return to Camp
Objective: Return to High Commander Kamses at the Ramkahen Legion post.
Text: What do you think? Maybe the High Commander will give me a few men to command. Maybe we can marshal a regiment together. What do you think?

Title: Enough Damage For One Day
Objective: Return to Colonel Troteman at Chiselgrip.
Text: We do not have any further strategic need for Thorg'izog or the Blackrock ground troops. We must continue to the next phase of the plan. When you are finished at the stronghold, return to us here in Chiselgrip.

Title: Moonglade Calls
Objective: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Loganaar in Nighthaven.
Text: I have received word that our brothers in Moonglade have requested your help. You should travel there and speak with Loganaar in Nighthaven. He will tell you all you need to know.

Title: Meet with Grezz Ragefist
Objective: Speak with Grezz Ragefist in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.
Text: Grezz Ragefist sent an urgent message for you. He wants you to join him immediately in Orgrimmar's Valley of Heroes. He must have a mission of importance for you.

Title: Meet with High Priestess Laurena
Objective: Speak with High Priestess Laurena at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind's Cathedral District.
Text: I just received a scroll from the Cathedral of Light. High Priestess Laurena sends word that she wishes to speak with you. You should meet with her as soon as you can.

Title: Meet with Farseer Umbrua
Objective: Speak with Farseer Umbrua at the Golden Keg in Stormwind's Dwarven District.
Text: Farseer Umbrua's messenger just reached me. She has an important matter she wishes to discuss with you and sends word that you should meet her at the Golden Keg in the Dwarven District of Stormwind as soon as you can make it there.

Title: What's that Rattle?
Objective: Inspect the Rattle of Bones on Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.
Text: Did you see that glowing rattle on the ground outside of Isha's hut?

Title: Open Their Eyes
Objective: Use Delaris's Prism to terrify 20 Jadefire Imps.
Text: Before you go... I've taken advantage of my "alone time" with Impsy here to learn some interesting facts about imps. Specifically, he ended up telling me the one thing that all imps fear most. Something they're absolutely terrified of. I thought that sounded useful as well as interesting, so I've done some basic conjuring. This prism will project an image of... well, of what Impsy described. Shadowlurk Ridge is still swarming with imps. Why don't you go test their reaction for me?

Title: What's that Rattle?
Objective: Inspect the Rattle of Bones on Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.
Text: Did you see that glowing rattle on the ground outside of Isha's hut?

Title: Tear Them From the Sky!
Objective: Use the Shoulder-Mounted Drake-Dropper to slay 8 Dragonmaw Black Drakes.
Text: Egah! They're here. They're here! I had hoped to equip a whole army with my shoulder-mounted drake-droppers, but all I have is a single, extremely expensive and wholly untested prototype. Here, take it! Shoot the Dragonmaw black drakes that are circling Thundermar, and drop them from the sky!

Title: Last Stand at Thundermar
Objective: Kill 8 Dragonmaw Skyclaws on foot.
Text: I'll hand it to you and your Alliance friends. You've really worked the Dragonmaw over! Many of their riders are dismounted but they're still coming at us, and my defenders will be overrun without help. Kill Dragonmaw Skyclaws on foot and Thundermar will forever be in your debt!

Title: Salhet's Secret
Objective: Find Salhet at the Southern End of the Sunwatcher's Ridge in Uldum.
Text: Listen. Before you give up on me, there's something I'd like to show you. You see, I'm not much of a fighter. I'm not very coordinated. I'm more of a tactical mind. Meet me at the southern end of the ridge and I'll show you.

Title: Narkrall, The Drake-Tamer
Objective: Slay Narkrall Rakeclaw. Speak with Colin Thundermar when you're ready.
Text: There's one Dragonmaw among this lot, the one they call "Narkrall: The Drake-Tamer." I don't know where he gets his power over those beasts, but the black terror he rides is as nasty a brute as ever took the skies over the Highlands. , Narkrall is the fiend who took my father's life and left Thundermar in my hands. I can't take him on alone, but I've seen what you're capable of. Maybe together we can end this. Let me know when you're ready, and we'll fight Narkrall together!

Title: Abuse of Power
Objective: Kill 5 Blackrock Sergeants using the Blackrock Cudgel of Discipline. Defeat them quickly, before they have a chance to unmask you.
Text: ? Troteman here. It sounds like you have earned Thorg'izog's trust, and he's assigned you to discipline duty. This is fortunate. We need you to take out his sergeants. You'll find them on wolfback, outside of the Blackrock Stronghold in the Fields of Honor. Use that cudgel on them, several times, until they die. You'll have to act fast, because if they realize you're not one of them, they can unmask you. Strike quickly and ferociously. Troteman out.

Title: I Am the Law and I Am the Lash
Objective: Use the Blackrock Cudgel of Discipline on 20 troops in the Fields of Honor. If one of the troops discovers your disguise, cudgel him to death before he can unmask you.
Text: I've been looking for a good, strong soldier like you. I need someone to keep my troops in line. Outside the stronghold, you will find orcs, ogres, and trolls preparing for the assault on Redridge. My sergeants keep them in line, but I'd like you to assist them. Take this cudgel and discipline a few of my soldiers. I don't care if they're misbehaving or standing perfectly in line, I want them beaten. I want them focused, battle-hardened, and obedient. Now go.

Title: Salhet the Tactician
Objective: Speak to Salhet and slay 30 Bloodsnarl Scavengers.
Text: Ever since I was a cub, I've always wanted to be a general. I was eager to join the army. But as you've seen, my combat skills are not all quite there. This is not the first time I've been sent to kill hyenas. As a matter of fact, I get sent here so often, that I've befriended these lions and trained them to do my bidding. They are my soldiers and at my command they will slay legions of hyenas. Watch!

Title: Bombs Away!
Objective: Destroy 10 Ghastly Supply Boats.
Text: The Wellson Shipyard is constantly receiving supplies from offshore and we need to put a stop to it. They have setup cannons along the docks for defense but if you can make it to them, we can use them to destroy their supply ships. Head over there and see what you can do. Report back to me on your progress.

Title: Two Tents
Objective: Accompany Sullah to Sullah's Sideshow.
Text: Look at you, my friend. This grand adventure of yours has you in knots! You need to relax and unwind. You're too tense, and that's just going to tire you out. Trust me, I know about relaxing! Speaking of tents, I see Jonesy brought me the ones I asked for. Come, friend. Ride with me!

Title: Elixirs of Aid
Objective: Collect elixir crafting ingredients for Alonsus Faol.
Text: We can never be too prepared for battle. The Legion will strike at any moment, and we must be ready to deal with a multitude of injuries and afflictions. Zabra and Yalia have provided me a list of their most potent potions and battle elixirs than can do everything from restore health to blind the enemy. We have an exhaustive list of ingredients that we'll need in order to craft a respectable supply.

Title: Hidden History
Objective: Use Mile's notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes he needs to begin research on your artifact.
Text: Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

Title: Spy vs. Spy
Objective: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Spy vs. Spy".
Text: SI:7 is the espionage and intel branch of the Alliance. They are based out of Stormwind City and headed up by Master Mathias Shaw. As of late, they have been acting, shall we say, peculiar.I would like for you to send some of our people out to assess the situation. It might be nothing, but I am not fond of situations that I do not fully understand.If we are going to win this war against the Burning Legion, the last thing we need is for something wholly unexpected to occur.

Title: Hidden History
Objective: Use the scouting notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes Fjornson needs to begin research on your artifact.
Text: To truly unlock the power of your steel, I will need more books.Your races use books to store their histories, and I will need some of these to piece together the legend of your steel. I asked one of your followers to look into their locations for me. Here are her notes.

Title: Hidden History
Objective: Use Gorma's notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes she needs to begin research on your artifact.
Text: I know of a few books that will give me the right place to start. They may be hard to get your hands on, but they'll be worth it. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

Title: Hidden History
Objective: Use Fillius' notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes he needs to begin research on your artifact.
Text: I think I can help you, I mean all of us, out.Before I can get started though, I need some books. Some important ones. They may be hard to pinch. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

Title: Hidden History
Objective: Use the scouting notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes Holt needs to begin research on your artifact.
Text: I believe further research is possible with some help.Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes. They may be hard to procure. I asked one of the scouts to seek them out, here are her notes.

Title: Hidden History
Objective: Use Juvess' notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes she needs to begin research on your artifact.
Text: More research? Absolutely!Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

Title: Hidden History
Objective: Use Sister Elda's notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes she needs to begin research on your artifact.
Text: I have some ideas on how we can improve our research methods.Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I put one of the researchers on digging up where they might be. Here are her notes.

Title: Hidden History
Objective: Use Illiana Dreadmoore's notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes she needs to begin research on your artifact.
Text: I will need more research material if I'm to keep improving on our current records.If I am to get started, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

Title: Hidden History
Objective: Use the scouting notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes Lorewalker Cho needs to begin research on your artifact.
Text: We definitely have plans to improve our research methods.Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I had one of the initiates attempt to find them. Here are her notes.

Title: Hidden History
Objective: Use Celadine's notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes she needs to begin research on your artifact.
Text: I will need to increase our overall knowledge levels before I can research the artifact further.Before I can get started, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

Title: Hidden History
Objective: Use Vehu's notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes he needs to begin research on your artifact.
Text: It may sound strange, but in order to do more research I will need, uh, more research material.If I am to get started, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

Title: Down to Business
Objective: Enter the Grand Promenade and slay 15 defenders.
Text: Time to get to business. We cannot afford to tarry. While we are not setting up for a prolonged engagement, we must still have a war camp of some sorts. I do not expect the Nightborne to stay patiently in their city while we plant stakes. They are starting to build their defenses. Go in there and see what we are up against. You will strike them from within while we finalize our preparations.

Title: Sanctum of Order Teleporter Online!
Objective: Infuse the Telemancy Beacon with Ancient Mana.

Title: Moon Guard Teleporter Online!
Objective: Infuse the Telemancy Beacon with Ancient Mana.

Title: Tel'anor'eporter Online!
Objective: Infuse the Telemancy Beacon with Ancient Mana.

Title: Lunastre Estate Teleporter Online!
Objective: Infuse the Telemancy Beacon with Ancient Mana.

Title: Down to Business
Objective: Enter the Grand Promenade and slay 15 defenders.
Text: First things first: we must set up our camp. We do not have the time or resources for a prolonged siege. It is not like we can starve them out. No, we must be swift and sure as an arrow, piercing their heart in one strike. They are drawing up their battle lines within the city, but could attack us while we are setting up our defenses. Venture forth and show them what the kaldorei have learned from thousands of years of war. Discover their weaknesses so that we may exploit them.

Title: Missing Pieces
Objective: Collect 7 Ancient Copper Scrolls.
Text: There are just a few specific pieces of information that I'm missing. Once those blanks are filled, we'll be ready to activate the final obelisk. Then, it'll be a race to discover the Coffer of Promise before Schnottz and his cronies can. Those fools are excavating this site as fast as they can. They're ruining more than they're looting! Go to the obelisk and rummage through their booty. See if you can find our missing pieces.

Title: Friend of a Friend
Objective: Harrison wants you to speak to Sullah at Oasis of Vir'sar.
Text: I need to unpack and look around the area a bit. In the meantime, I have an old friend I'd like you to meet. Sullah and I go way back. He's a man who can be trusted, and that's pretty rare these days. Why don't you go on over and introduce yourself.

Title: The Battle for Broken Shore
Objective: Rendezvous with the third fleet.
Text: The third fleet has shipped out ahead of us. This gryphon will bring you to them.Good luck out there. It's clear the Legion isn't going to make this easy, but let's hope King Varian has matters well in hand.

Title: Meet with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
Objective: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind's Cathedral District.
Text: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker from the Cathedral of the Light in Stormwind has sent a message for you. He wants to speak with you the next time you're in the city. You should be able to find him in the Cathedral District.

Title: Riding Shotgun!
Objective: Accompany Harrison to the Oasis of Vir'sar.
Text: Alright, I'm very close to learning how to activate the final obelisk. Only a few pieces of information are missing and with any luck, we should be able to find them at the site. The supplies are all packed up. Let me know when you're ready to go.

Title: Reduced Productivity
Objective: Kill 15 Schnottz Excavators or Schnottz Overseers.
Text: Alright, here's what I've learned. There's a titan device deep in a place called the Halls of Origination. It's meant to be an emergency reset switch for all life on Azeroth. If activated, it will destroy every living thing in the world! Now, it's only meant to be used under certain extreme conditions, but if Deathwing is able to corrupt the titan watchers, he could use the contents of the coffer to trigger the device. Go to the Obelisk of the Moon. Slow them down!

Title: Trial by Magma
Objective: Speak with Wyrtle Spreelthonket and ask him to release Magma Lord Kolob. Then defeat Magma Lord Kolob in battle.
Text: I suppose I'll make the most of this situation. These goblin mercenaries brought this enormous fire elemental to my stronghold as a "thank you" for hiring them. What am I going to do with an elemental here in the steppes? That's like bringing sand to the beach. If you're looking for work, then prove yourself. Talk to this goblin here, and challenge his elemental to a fight. The victor earns my respect, and my time.

Title: Meet Me In Vir'sar
Objective: Speak to Harrison Jones at the Oasis of Vir'sar.
Text: So, listen to this. I knew that these obelisks were linked to the Coffer of Promise, but there's more to it. There appears to be something very important about the coffer - something pertaining to a place the Makers called the Halls of Origination. Now that we know this Schnottz fellow and his crew are in league with Deathwing, it's all the more urgent that we get to it first. I'll wait for you north of here, at the Oasis of Vir'sar Hurry! They have a head start on us!

Title: General Thorg'izog
Objective: Speak with General Thorg'izog.
Text: Kaoshin turned out to be more helpful than I expected, but we're done with him. It's time you spoke with the General. I think you're ready. General Thorg'izog is one of the "big three" that run the ground forces here in Burning Steppes. He does so from the Blackrock Stronghold to the northwest. Put on your disguise and go speak with him. See if you can earn his trust. Troteman will be in touch, should we need anything further.

Title: Meet with Wulf Hansreim
Objective: Speak with Wulf Hansreim in the Command Center to the south of Stormwind's Old Town.
Text: Wulf Hansreim sends word from Stormwind -- he wants to meet with you right away. He'll be in the Command Center just to the south of Stormwind's Old Town.

Title: Meet with Maginor Dumas
Objective: Speak with Maginor Dumas at the Wizard Sanctum in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.
Text: I just received a message from Maginor Dumas, the senior mage trainer in Stormwind. He's asking you to join him in the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind as soon as you can travel there.

Title: Meet with Lord Tony Romano
Objective: Speak with Ander Germaine at the Command Center south of Stormwind's Old Town.
Text: Lord Tony Romano, one of the senior rogue trainers in Stormwind's SI:7, has sent word that he wants to speak with you. Head to Stormwind as soon as you can and look for him in the SI:7 building just south of Old Town.

Title: Navarax's Gambit
Objective: Slay the demon impersonating Arch Druid Navarax.
Text: I have been preying on these demonic impostors for some time now, and I have finally gleaned the location of their leader. It is none other than Arch Druid Navarax, the leader of the Emerald Circle. The demon shields himself with innocents. If I entered Whisperwind Grove to hunt him, I would be set upon by ignorant protectors... but you! You can catch him unaware. Return to Whisperwind Grove. Climb the druid tower and you'll find Navarax at the top, in his room amidst the boughs.

Title: Meet with Ander Germaine
Objective: Speak with Ander Germaine at the Command Center south of Stormwind's Old Town.
Text: Ander Germaine sent a message for you. He wants you to join him at his headquarters in the Command Center in Stormwind's Old Town as quickly as you can. It sounded important.

Title: Meet with Demisette Cloyce
Objective: Speak with Demisette Cloyce in the basement of the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage District.
Text: I just received a scroll from Demisette Cloyce in Stormwind. She wants you to pay a visit to the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind. She doesn't mention specifics, but I got the impression that it was a matter of some importance.

Title: Deceivers In Our Midst
Objective: Slay 12 Jadefire Shifters in Jadefire Run.
Text: Now that you've had a lesson in keeping an open mind, perhaps you'd like to learn WHY I killed those druids. The answer is simple: They are not druids at all. Demons still roam the ruins, now hiding in plain sight in the guise of friendly caretakers. See for yourself...this blindfold is soaked in demon blood. Take it north up the hills to Jadefire Run and place it on your eyes. It will show even the most oblivious fool the true nature of any demon.

Title: Firing Squad
Objective: Speak to Commander Schnottz.
Text: Come out back vizh me. Zhere is somezhink I vould like you to see.

Title: The Skull of Gul'dan
Objective: Relive Illidan's battle for the Skull of Gul'dan.
Text: Illidan set out to find the Skull of Gul'dan. He fought through armies of demons to reach it, slaying them with the power that made him a hated outcast. See him in battle. Witness the one that fought the fiercest against the corruptors of Felwood, and struck at its source.

Title: Vhat's Next?
Objective: Commander Schnottz just wants a hug...
Text: Vhich vay vill zhings turn out? Hmm? Vill I turn on my dark master, whoever zhat might be? Vill I learn to become a more sensitif and compassionate leader? Vill I go so far as to drop my adorable dialect? Or vill I embrace my aspirations and press forvard at all costs, never satisfied until all of Azerozh is mine? And vhat zhen, hmm? Maybe it vill all come togezher next veek... ...or maybe zhe veek after zhat...

Title: A Needle in a Hellhole
Objective: Speak with Thelaron Direneedle at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.
Text: You and I can't take on an army. They'll overwhelm us. That's why we've got to stick to Troteman's plan. The next part of the plan is going to require a bit of subtlety... something that I'm not terribly good at. That's where you come in. Speak with Thelaron Direneedle, the tailor here in town. I've already given him the hides and mud that we've collected. He's going to need to size you. That's right: you're going undercover.

Title: The Fall of Tichondrius
Objective: Relive Illidan's battle with Tichondrius.
Text: Yes, Illidan took the power of the Skull of Gul'dan for himself. But did he flee with it into the night? Did he use it for his own glory? No... his very first action was to use his new power to assault the dreadlord Tichondrius! Witness his triumph. Witness how Illidan reclaimed Felwood from the demons... and the thanks he was given.

Title: Trouble at Southshore
Objective: Speak to Serge Hinott at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Text: Before my capture and imprisonment, I was stationed at Southshore. My primary job at the ruins was to take slime samples and make sure that the blight that we released was safely dissipating. Simple and easy if not for the worgen that would continuously harass us. I need you to head to Southshore and find my apprentice, Serge Hinott. Make sure that he's ok and inform him that I will return once my work here has concluded. You'll find the Ruins of Southshore to the southeast, near the coast.

Title: Taking the Horn For Ourselves
Objective: Bring the Horn of the Callers back to Colonel Troteman at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.
Text: , it's Troteman. I want you to hold onto that horn. I'm sure we can improvise and find a way to work it into the plan. I'm more than a little concerned about what Kaoshin said about attacking Redridge. We knew another attack was imminent, but our timetables were off by several days. Return to me, with the horn. We will talk again here, in Chiselgrip. And try not to ruin that disguise. You're not done with your undercover work yet.

Title: The Kodocaller's Horn
Objective: Use the Horn of the Callers to call 7 Blackrock War Kodos back to camp. If a kodo turns hostile, fight it until it submits.
Text: Alright, I've got some actual, legitimate, important work for you. We've got to call the kodos in from the grazing lands to the south. General Thorg'izog says we'll be moving out into Redridge soon, and I won't be caught with my kodos down. Use this horn near a kodo. It will return to the camp when it hears the call. You'll want to watch out. Sometimes the kodos get a little feisty, so you need to knock them around a bit before they listen to you.

Title: Crushblow
Objective: Speak to Warlord Zaela at Crushblow.
Text: You've more than proved your intent and your abilities. With Grim Batol cut off and the black dragons routed, the Twilight's Hammer are cornered in their Citadel. Go to your leaders. You should find them west, at Crushblow. Let them know that when the attack on the Twilight Citadel begins, the red flight shall fill the skies above. You may not be able to atone for all of the sins your allies have committed, but in this one battle, we shall be by your side. The Twilight's Hammer will fall.

Title: Victors' Point
Objective: Speak to Kurdran Wildhammer at Victor's Point.
Text: You've more than proved your intent and your abilities. With Grim Batol cut off and the black dragons routed, the Twilight's Hammer are cornered in their Citadel. Go to your leaders. You should find them northwest, at Victors' Point. Let them know that when the attack on the Twilight Citadel begins, the red flight shall fill the skies above. You may not be able to atone for all of the sins your allies have committed, but in this one battle, we shall be by your side. The Twilight's Hammer will fall.

Title: Thieving Little Pluckers
Objective: Smash 30 Sand Pygmies with the Tahret Dynasty Mallet.
Text: I don't have the most glamorous job in the world. I do not concern myself with matters of war or the deep mysteries of the halls of Uldum or what have you. I am in charge of these grounds... and these grounds grow dates. Now, these little date-plucking mongrels have gotten gutsy enough to stand on each other's shoulders to try and steal my precious fruit. I will not stand for this. Take this mallet, crafted by the titans, blessed by the sun-kings and who-knows-what-else and smash the runts!

Title: The Eyes Have It
Objective: Take the Eye of Twilight to Low Shaman Blundy at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.
Text: Very well then. You have purchased my services in blood. Take me back to the "Low Shaman" of Thundermar. Oh yes, I already know where you're taking me. Blundy's meager, ale-soaked abilities are trivial. But you - you fascinate me. With my sight and your abilities, imagine the havoc we could unleash into this pathetic world together...

Title: We All Must Sacrifice
Objective: Slay 10 Shaman of the Black.
Text: You seek my sight? My powers come at a price. These disciples of the Twilight have been honoring me with the blood of Wildhammer dwarves from the nearby ruins, but still I thirst. Perhaps you can do better. Slay my old masters, and my vision is yours. Honor me with the slaughter of the Shaman of the Black. Blood is blood, after all.

Title: Eye Spy
Objective: Peer into the Eye of Twilight for Low Shaman Blundy.
Text: I'll be honest. That thing gives me the willy-willies. But seein' as you went to all the trouble of bringin' it here, I s'pose we ought to put it to use. You first. Peer into the eye and ask it to show you inside Cho'gall's Bastion of Twilight. We'll find out what that fat two-headed bugger is up to, and use it against him.

Title: Strategic Cuts
Objective: Use the Razor-Sharp Scorpid Barb on Voodooist Timan atop the Pillar of Ash, Worgmistress Othana in the worg pens, and Gorlop when he is near the lava pools.
Text: ... , can you hear me? It's Troteman. Listen, we've just received the final bit of intel for your next mission. There are three marks that we'd like you to take down. The first is Voodooist Timan, whom you'll find atop the Pillar of Ash. Worgmistress Othana is in the central worg pens. Finally, Gorlop is near the lava pools to the south. You will find the scorpid barbs you harvested packed along with your belongings. Use the barbs on the marks when the time is right.

Title: Aiding the Conclave
Objective: Return to Alonsus Faol within Netherlight Temple.
Text: The priests of the Conclave are formidable allies. With our combined strength, we may just have a chance to slay the dreadlord, forever.Let Alonsus Faol know that we will be by your side and ready to fight when you need us.

Title: Grunt Work
Objective: Vigorously polish 7 pairs of Blackrock Boots.
Text: Bah! You're lucky I'm short-handed today. Otherwise I'd make you my personal whipping  for the week. The officers and high-ranking soldiers need their boots polished. They've left them out in front of their huts. I want to see my reflection in those boots, grunt! Get to work!

Title: Last of Her Kind
Objective: Kill Obsidia.
Text: Obsidia is one of the last mature dragons that can continue the black dragonflight bloodline. She must be killed. If you succeed in killing her, you should inform Lirastrasza immediately of your victory. She's been fighting a long time to see this done. Thank you for being our fang in these battles. You've proven a powerful ally.

Title: Tapped Out
Objective: Harrison Jones wants you to talk to him again in a week or two.
Text: Listen. You know I live to entertain you, and that I strive to keep you pleasantly occupied and whatnot. But it just so happens that I've completely run out of ideas. That was it! Ususally as I'm questing with you I can think of a few things to have you do next, which buys me time to cook up some grand objective, but no more. I'm tapped out. Completely uninspired. Couldn't muster up another idea to save my life. Oh, wait!I know what we can do! Talk to me in a week or two...

Title: Burnside Must Fall
Objective: Kill Magistrate Burnside.
Text: Magistrate Burnside was once the mayor of this region. In life he was a formidable adversary in the battle over Hillsbrad. In undeath he will surely test us. Burnside channels great arcane magic in the northwest section of the Sludge Fields. Lead us there and together we shall put an end to his rule, once and for all.

Title: Twilight Shores
Objective: Speak with Fargo Flintlocke at Stormwind Harbor.
Text: The time has come. With Stormwind secure, we will take this fight to the enemy. To the Highlands! The bulk of our navy has already shipped out, thanks to your work earlier. But Fargo Flintlocke has prepared a seaplane that can make the journey in double-time. Speak with Flintlocke down at the harbor and tell him that you are to accompany him to the Highlands. He will be by the water's edge. Safe journeys.
