Title: Adventurers Wanted: Stratholme Main Gate
Objective: Speak with Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Stratholme's main gate, due north from Plaguewood, immediately! The Dreadlord Balnazzar has slain the Scarlet Crusade and resurrected them as the Risen! If you so choose, head to the main gate and speak with Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer, leader of the Argent Crusade effort to retake Stratholme for its true owners.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Scholomance
Objective: Enter Scholomance.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Scholomance, east of Andorhal, immediately! Recent necromantic activity in the area points to Darkmaster Gandling, and a renewed effort to train powerful sorcerers for the scourge. If you so choose, travel to Scholomance to cleanse this bastion of evil from the Plaguelands.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Stratholme Service Gate
Objective: Speak with Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Stratholme's service gate, just northwest of the Northpass Tower, immediately! Lord Aurius Rivendare, former paladin of the Silver Hand and recently resurrected son of none other than Baron Rivendare himself, now leads the remaining scourge forces there! If you so choose, head to the service gate and speak with Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer, leader of the Argent Crusade effort to retake Stratholme for its true owners.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Stratholme Main Gate
Objective: Speak with Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Stratholme's main gate, due north from Plaguewood, immediately! The Dreadlord Balnazzar has slain the Scarlet Crusade and resurrected them as the Risen! If you so choose, head to the main gate and speak with Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer, leader of the Argent Crusade effort to retake Stratholme for its true owners.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Northern Dire Maul
Objective: Speak with the Stonemaul Ogre.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Northern Dire Maul, west of Camp Mojache, immediately! King Gordok and his growing army of Gordok ogres pose the largest and most powerful threat in the area to us! If you so choose, head to Northern Dire Maul and speak with the Stonemaul Ogre already sent there as a forward scout.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Dire Maul Warpwood Quarter
Objective: Speak with Furgus Warpwood.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Dire Maul's Warpwood Quarter, west of Camp Mojache, immediately! Alzzin the Wildshaper has corrupted the area and could take over the entire Maul! If you so choose, head to the Warpwood Quarter and speak with Furgus Warpwood, one of the few uncorrupt beings left inside alive.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Dire Maul Capital Gardens
Objective: Speak with Estulan.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Dire Maul's Capital Gardens, west of Camp Mojache, immediately! The fallen Highborne Prince Tortheldrin is using the massive demon Immol'thar to control the area! If you so choose, head to the Capital Gardens and speak with Estulan, a recently discovered pure Highborne seeking to reclaim the fallen city for his people.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Northern Dire Maul
Objective: Speak with the Druid of the Talon.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Northern Dire Maul, east of Feathermoon Stronghold, immediately! King Gordok and his growing army of Gordok ogres pose the largest and most powerful threat in the area to us! If you so choose, head to Northern Dire Maul and speak with the Druid of the Talon already sent there as a forward scout.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Blackrock Spire
Objective: Speak with Acride.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Blackrock Spire, northwest of Morgan's Vigil, immediately! Nefarian's armies and Rend Blackhand's followers threaten the entirety of His Majesty's kingdom! If you so choose, head to Blackrock Spire and speak with Acride, our only contact within that may be able to help us stop the impending invasion.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Dire Maul Warpwood Quarter
Objective: Speak with Furgus Warpwood.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Dire Maul's Warpwood Quarter, east of Feathermoon Stronghold, immediately! Alzzin the Wildshaper has corrupted the area and could take over the entire Maul! If you so choose, head to the Warpwood Quarter and speak with Furgus Warpwood, one of the few uncorrupt beings left inside alive.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Dire Maul Capital Gardens
Objective: Speak with Estulan.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Dire Maul's Capital Gardens, east of Feathermoon Stronghold, immediately! The fallen Highborne Prince Tortheldrin is using the massive demon Immol'thar to control the area! If you so choose, head to the Capital Gardens and speak with Estulan, a recently discovered pure Highborne seeking to reclaim the fallen city for his people.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Blackrock Spire
Objective: Speak with Acride.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Blackrock Spire, west of Flame Crest, immediately! Nefarian's armies and Rend Blackhand's followers threaten the very existence of the Horde! If you so choose, head to Blackrock Spire and speak with Acride, our only contact within that may be able to help us stop the impending invasion.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Blackrock Depths
Objective: Speak with High Executioner Nuzrak.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Blackrock Depths, west of Flame Crest, immediately! The Dark Iron dwarves have already attacked Alliance-held Redridge, and if left unchecked, may soon threaten our few Horde footholds in southern Azeroth. If you so choose, head to Blackrock Depths and speak with High Executioner Nuzrak, who is reforming the Kargath Expeditionary Force to finish off the Dark Irons once and for all.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: The Sunken Temple
Objective: Speak with Lord Itharius.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to the Sunken Temple, not far from Stonard, immediately! The Atal'ai trolls within are attempting to summon forth Hakkar the Soulflayer! If you so choose, head to the Sunken Temple and speak with the green dragon Lord Itharius, who is prepared to put an end to these dangerous trolls.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Blackrock Depths
Objective: Speak with Morgan.
Text: King Anduin Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Blackrock Depths, northwest of Morgan's Vigil, immediately! The Dark Iron dwarves pose a serious threat to the citizens of Redridge! If you so choose, head to Blackrock Depths and speak with Morgan, who has returned from her extended absence and wishes to enact her vengeance on the Dark Iron nation.

Title: Walk A Mile In Their Shoes
Objective: Escort a Farson Hold Prisoner to safety. The hold is located on the northwestern tip of the island.
Text: We have sent at least 3 different recon groups to investigate Farson Hold in the last few weeks. Sadly, not one of them has returned back with any info. At this point, all we can hope is that they are being held alive as prisoners. I need you to infiltrate the keep and help get our soldiers back. This won't be easy , but if anyone can help us, it's you.

Title: Leave No Weapon Behind
Objective: Retrieve 12 Rusty Rifles from Farson Hold on the north side of Tol Barad Peninsula.
Text: Battle supplies are hard to come by on this rock. Every time we hold off another horde attack, it feels like we are fighting with sticks and stones. Reports have come in that Keep Lord Farson on the north side of the island has a large stockpile of rifles that we could use. Can you head down there and check it out? Be careful , Farson's followers will do anything to protect him.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: The Sunken Temple
Objective: Speak with Lord Itharius.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to the Sunken Temple, not far from Marshtide Watch, immediately! The Atal'ai trolls within are attempting to summon forth Hakkar the Soulflayer! If you so choose, head to the Sunken Temple and speak with the green dragon Lord Itharius, who is prepared to put an end to these dangerous trolls.

Title: Minions of Calcinder
Objective: Slay 6 Searing Flamewraiths.
Text: There is such a thing as digging too deep. While you'll find the richest mineral veins deep below the surface, you'll also find the most evil creatures. Like fire elementals. Calcinder's minions roam the cavern ahead. Every one of them holds a piece of Calcinder's evil within it. Slay as many as you can, and show no remorse.

Title: Welcome to the Brotherhood
Objective: Report to Overseer Oilfist at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.
Text: You should return to Thorium Point. Overseer Oilfist and the rest of the Thorium Brotherhood will be wondering how you fared in the fight against Calcinder.

Title: From Whence He Came
Objective: Weaken Archduke Calcinder, then use the Sanctified Tripetricine to banish him.
Text: Archduke Calcinder squirms in the back of this very cavern. We are close to killing him... but that is not what we are going to do. Slaying Calcinder here means nothing. His acolytes can easily revive him. Instead, we are going to banish him. I asked you to gather a precious stone from the Twilight's Hammer earlier. You will now use it against Calcinder. Engage him, weaken him, then use this device on him. He will be banished from this realm. Good luck, brave .

Title: Look at the Size of It!
Objective: Take Chambermaid Pillaclencher's Pillow to Evonice Sootsmoker in the Searing Gorge.
Text: Well, well, well... Isn't this a surprise. The Chambermaid had a gigantic ornate pillow and now it's yours. Evonice Sootsmoker will definitely want to get her grubby little hands all over this item. Take it to her and see if she'll offer you any goodies for your trouble.

Title: Claiming The Keep
Objective: You have been asked to kill Keep Lord Farson at the Farson Hold. Farson Hold can be found on the north side of the island.
Text: Have you seen the keep on the north side of the island? That is where Keep Lord Farson runs his operation from. Farson has a small group of dedicated followers and they have been giving us trouble since we got here. We sent a small group to investigate and they reported back on his exact position within the keep. Can you finish him off for us?

Title: Twisted Twilight Ties
Objective: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands and help him assault Overseer Maltorius and Twilight-Lord Arkkus.
Text: Hansel and I came here on a secret mission: kill Overseer Maltorius. While our main goal still remains the same - defeating Archduke Calcinder - it can't hurt to take out the infamous overseer of the Slag Pit while we're here. Problem is, Hansel was only prepared to fight one dwarf, but it looks like Maltorius has a visitor... an emissary from the Twilight's Hammer! Speak with Hansel and help him out. Then proceed down this corridor and along the balcony outside to find Overseer Oilfist.

Title: Kill 'em With Sleep Deprivation
Objective: Obtain 16 Dark Iron Pillows.
Text: It's a little known fact that dwarves, particularly of the Dark Iron variety, need rest! Lots of rest! Now I ask you; How can they sleep without pillows? Exactly, they can't. This is why you must steal their pillows. Once you've finished your cushion-thievery, talk with Taskmaster Scrange. He's a bit deeper in the cave, working on a covert project with Hansel.

Title: Slavery is Bad
Objective: Slay 10 Dark Iron Taskmasters or Dark Iron Slavers.
Text: Much like Overseer Maltorius, I'm a rich dwarf. However, I earned my riches through hard work and wise decisions, not through slavery. OK fine, very little slavery. Hardly any. Anyhow, the first thing that I see inside these caverns are slavedrivers and taskmasters. I won't stand for this! As you progress through the cavern, kill as many as you can. Report your results to Evonice Sootsmoker, deeper within the Slag Pit.

Title: Sweet, Horrible Freedom
Objective: Free 12 Slave Workers. If they resist, kill them.
Text: Of course, we'll want to free as many slaves as we can while we're here. Most of them will likely join forces with us, anxious to fight against their captors. However, sometimes you will find that slaves are resistant to being freed. It's a strange phenomenon, often called "Durnholde Syndrome". Either way, you should try to free them. If they resist, treat them as enemies. Report your results to Evonice Sootsmoker, deeper within the Slag Pit.

Title: Rise, Obsidion
Objective: Use the Altar of Suntara, then slay Lathoric the Black and Obsidion.
Text: Overseer Maltorius is in charge here, but he's not the only dwarf of power within the Slag Pit. Lathoric the Black and his horrifying golem, Obsidion, loom just down this corridor. Interfering with Lathoric's altar should summon both of them. Find it, then summon Lathoric and kill him. Report to Evonice Sootsmoker when you're finished.

Title: That Smart One's Gotta Go
Objective: Slay the Hive Controller.
Text: There's some kind of smart brain bug in the back of the cave. It's in charge of all of the silithid down there. My ice cream is melting! How am I supposed to launch my ice cream empire, and save my inventory, if that thing's in there?!

Title: Operation: Stir the Cauldron
Objective: Speak to the Thorium Point flight master, then use the Brotherhood Flying Machine's guns to kill Cauldron Defenders until the area is safe for entry.
Text: I'm putting you on a flying machine. You'll be responsible for softening our landing into the slag pit. Speak with your flight master here in Thorium Point, then fly down to the gorge. Once you near your landing point, there will undoubtedly be hordes of Dark Iron dwarves waiting for you. Use our flying machine's guns to take out as many of them as you can, then land at the cavern's entrance. Rendan should be waiting for you by the time you arrive.

Title: Shark Tank
Objective: You have been tasked to kill Tank, a large shark cruising the waters of the Cape of Lost Hope. The cape can be found north of here, along the northern coastline.
Text: I hate sharks. All of my troops hate sharks too. This is where you come in. I need you to head up to the Cape of Lost Hope and take out a huge shark named Tank. Tank is not to be trifled with so I would bring a few friends if I were you.

Title: We All Scream for Ice Cream... and then Die!
Objective: Attach the tug's tow hook to 10 Dead Employees.
Text: Don't get me wrong... I'm cheerful on the outside, but inside I'm just terribly torn to pieces. All of my friends and employees are dead. Could you do me a favor? Would you swim down there and attach the tug's tow hook to my dead employees? I'll reel them in.

Title: See the Invisible
Objective: Collect 8 batches of Cursed Ooze from the Ruins of Constellas.
Text: Yeah, yeah, your stuck-up mage friend there hit it on the nose. The imps over at Shadowlurk Ridge are hiding the key to the satyr's barrier in the nether. It's right there, but you can't see it or touch it unless you're shifted. I guess you're out of luck though, because only imps can phase shift! So you should just close your eyes, turn around, and let me go... It was just a joke! Don't hurt me! I'll need slime from the cursed oozes around these ruins. Bring me enough to cover you from head to toe!

Title: Shalassic Park
Objective: Ride Su'esh and defeat 50 adversaries.
Text: We have a Devilsaur. I think she sees you as the pack leader now. She should obey your commands. She looks hungry. Why don't you let her off the leash a little bit?

Title: The Wisdom of Patience
Objective: Await the opening of the Emerald Nightmare, then report back to Senegos in Azsuna.
Text: The horrors you braved in the thicket are only the beginning. Within the Emerald Nightmare you will face the very heart of the corruption that threatens the stability of all life on Azeroth. But not just yet. We have not yet managed to permeate the magic protecting Xavius' sinister realm. Once we have, however, you should return here; there is still much to be done.

Title: Maw of Souls: Maul of the Dead
Objective: Retrieve the Maul of the Dead from Helheim.
Text: All of the necessary components have been gathered together. Soon, the unholy steeds of the damned will trample the armies of the Burning Legion. However, our work is not quite done. One item yet remains beyond our grasp... Lurking within the depths of Helheim, the fallen queen Helya rules over the dead. In her possession is a maul, infused with the souls of countless fallen warriors. Bring to me the Maul of the Dead and with it, I will forge barding so impenetrable... no demon shall break it!

Title: Regroup at the Refuge
Objective: Return to Starsong Refuge.
Text: I cannot think clearly in this place.Even though the moonwell is still pure, the corrupting influence of the Nightmare remains.Come, we will return to the refuge and gather our wits. Then we will continue the hunt for my husband.

Title: Advancing the War Effort
Objective: Complete 10 World Quests.
Text: The quest for the Four Horsemen is of the utmost importance, however we must turn our attention to the warfront. Our continued success on the field of battle has shaken the Burning Legion and as a result, they have increased the frequency and intensity of their assaults. We must meet the increased aggression with continued resistance! Only then will we be able to turn our attention back to the Four Horsemen.

Title: Capturing the Gateway
Objective: Complete the missions: Investigate Felsoul Hold, Preparing Our Arrival and Capturing the Gateway.
Text: The time has come to make our move against the Legion. The Legion has multiple portals across the Broken Isles. Should your armies succeed in securing one while it's still active, Hymdall can use the runestones you gathered to direct it to whatever hellish world Hodir is trapped in.

Title: Arluin's Request
Objective: Locate Arluelle and give her a piece of the Arcan'dor Fruit.
Text: I never thought I would need to read this...Arluin made... plans... in the event he fell. It is not much, but I would like to honor his last request.Go to the location marked on this map. Take this Arcan'dor Fruit and give it to a woman named Arluelle. Arluin was very specific that all rewards for his work be directed to her.I think he may have known what his sacrifice meant. I was wrong about him.

Title: Darkheart Thicket: The Nightmare Lash
Objective: Retrieve the Nightmare Lash from Darkheart Thicket.
Text: The dark steeds of the apocalypse are indomitable creatures of anguish and cruelty. They can never be tamed... only subjugated. The next component of power we require is one born of hatred, fashioned within the Emerald Nightmare. It is known as the Nightmare Lash. The Nightmare Lash has the power to suffocate all hope... all light... from within a living soul. The Shade of Xavius himself carries the lash. Defeat him and bring the lash to me! I will use it to dominate the steeds of the damned!

Title: All In
Objective: Complete the "All In" scenario.
Text: It is time to put our plan into action.Oculeth will send you, Arluin and myself into the Arcway, where we shall trigger a manastorm in the Nightflow Conduit.Valtrois will stay here and prepare Shal'Aran for a massive jolt of arcane power - hopefully enough to satisfy the arcan'dor.$p... We have a saying... "To lead is to stand alone." It means only those who bear the weight of leadership can truly appreciate it.Thank you for standing beside me. In truth, I do not feel alone.

Title: Flow Control
Objective: Seal off the Arcway Outlets in Lunastre Lane, The Parade Grounds, and the Midnight Court.
Text: If all goes as planned, the manastorm will cause the leyline to flare up, sending a great surge of energy through the arcway.In order for the surge to reach Shal'Aran, we must seal off any outlets along the way. If we miss even one, the mission fails - and hundreds of people will be vaporized by the energy blow off.Thalyssra had better be sure about this tree.

Title: Arcan'dor, Gift of the Ancient Magi
Objective: Pick the Fruit of the Arcan'dor and share it with Chief Telemancer Oculeth, Arcanist Valtrois, and First Arcanist Thalyssra.
Text: Thousands of years ago, as the Quel'dorei were just beginning to unravel the mysteries of the arcane, a small enclave of druids met with the first of the elven magi.In the pale moonlight, they formed an order that would seek to bring the arcane into balance - using nature itself as a vessel. Thus the arcan'dor were created.My masters who belonged to this order have long since faded away. Yet their legacy remains.Their gift will mend the spirit of the shal'dorei. Let them eat, and be made whole.

Title: Bring Home the Beacon
Objective: Use the Advanced Telemancy Beacon to survey Evermoon Commons, Evermoon Bazaar, and Siren's Vigil in Suramar City.
Text: The conduit we need is in the Arcway, and security in the Arcway has doubled since your last visit.Our only reasonable option is to teleport your strike team directly in.This is a long-range teleport to a non-anchored destination. In other words, it will be hard.Take this beacon and survey the commons in Suramar City, then return the beacon to me so I can analyze the results.This will help me teleport you as close as possible to the conduit!

Title: Ephemeral Manastorm Projector
Objective: Collect 4 Warp-Resistant Plating from Chronarch Defenders.
Text: Oculeth's theory is sound. Reckless, but sound.A small warp-field could trap and excite ambient mana in the conduit, thus creating a manastorm similar to when the arcan'dor fell out of balance.I can build a device to generate the warp-field, but I need materials.Specifically, warp-resistant alloys - such as the armor plating of high-end security constructs in the noble district.Those constructs are deadly. If anyone owes you a favor, now is the time to call it in.

Title: Neltharion's Lair: Braid of the Underking
Objective: Retrieve the Braid of the Underking from Neltharion's Lair.
Text: Greetings, Deathlord. Years have passed since we first met, but for me it has been mere days. The unholy bond between Horseman and steed must not be taken lightly. Power begets power, Deathlord. Never forget this fact! I can forge an inseparable bond between rider and steed, but components of great power are required. The first item I require is the Braid of the Underking, a dark shamanic adornment passed down for generations. Currently, it is possessed by Dargrul the Underking.

Title: I Believe I Can Fly!
Objective: Collect 6 Molted Feathers for Snicarus Dungleflight.
Text: Let's not bother explaining how this happened, just know that I have the plan of all plans to escape this... this...  This place stinks! But you can help! These feathers here will help craft my escape plan. If you wouldn't mind, I'm sure there's enough for the both of us!

Title: Giving It All We've Got
Objective: Activate all of the leyline feeds in Suramar, then speak with Valtrois.
Text: The arcan'dor is drawing incredible amounts of energy.Even with the leyline feed at full capacity, we may not have the power.Let us first ensure that all potential leyline conduits connecting to Shal'Aran are active.Then I can attempt to amplify the output and hopefully satisfy this insufferable plant.

Title: Audience with the Windlord
Objective: Witness Thunderaan.
Text: I have kept my promise. Thunderaan the Windlord awaits.Know that if betrayal is in your heart, the Windlord will not be deceived. Be silent, and perhaps your audience shall be a fortunate one.

Objective: Satisfy Thrymjaris' demands.
Text: You bring the cursed bindings of Ragnaros to this place. Speak your intent.

Title: Assault on Violet Hold: Into the Violet Hold
Objective: Defeat the leader of the Assault on Violet Hold.
Text: The Violet Hold contains some of the Lich King's most powerful servants, and is at risk of being overrun by Legion agents. We must go there and thwart the demons before any of the prisoners can be set free.

Title: Eye of Azshara: Into the Eye of Azshara
Objective: Defeat the Wrath of Azshara in Eye of Azshara.
Text: Our investigation found that the naga, under the orders of Queen Azshara herself, are preparing to summon a powerful entity to unleash Azshara's power across the Broken Isles.Travel to the Eye of Azshara, and put a stop to the ritual.

Title: Vault of the Wardens: Into the Vault of the Wardens
Objective: Defeat Cordana Felsong in Vault of the Wardens.
Text: It's worse than we thought within the Vault of the Wardens. The prisoners have become the jailers, and have completely taken over the vault. However, our intelligence reports that Cordana Felsong herself may be there.Enter the Vault of the Wardens and cleanse the place of evil.

Title: Bindings of the Windlord
Objective: Retrieve both Bindings of the Windlord and 10 Infernal Brimstone.
Text: With Thunderaan risen again as the lord of Skywall, there may indeed be an arrangement you can make in exchange for those wretched implements. But one binding is of no use on its own.Return to me with both bindings, and with powerful enough ore to bind them, and I will arrange your audience with Thunderaan the Windlord.

Title: Maw of Souls: Into the Maw of Souls
Objective: Defeat Helya in Maw of Souls.
Text: Our scouts report that the vrykul damned are forced to sail aboard the Naglfar, a ship built of death.Travel to the Maw of Souls and confront Helya, before she collects any more poor, unfortunate souls.

Title: The Arcway: Into the Arcway
Objective: Defeat Advisor Vandros in The Arcway.
Text: The Arcway is even more vast than we thought, and holds many dangers. If we have any hope of taking the city, we must first see to the underground.Enter The Arcway and clear out any, and all enemies.

Title: Neltharion's Lair: Into Neltharion's Lair
Objective: Defeat Dargrul in Neltharion's Lair.
Text: Our scouts found that not only have the drogbar obtained a Titan relic, but also they've amassed an army large enough to threaten the overworld.Delve underground and stop the Underking before he can unleash the might of his drogbar army.

Title: Court of Stars: Into the Court of Stars
Objective: Defeat Advisor Melandrus in Court of Stars.
Text: The weather is perfect for a party, isn't it?Travel to the Court of Stars, where the Grand Magistrix herself may appear among her nobles to reassure them of the need for all the Legion patrols.

Title: Special Delivery for Brivelthwerp
Objective: Deliver the I-Scream Cryocannon to Brivelthwerp at the Sunken Dig Site in Thousand Needles.
Text: I recently came into possession of something that needs to be delivered to a gnome that goes by the name, Brivelthwerp. It's more like Briveltwerp if you ask me. I want you to take it to him in the southwest, down at the Sunken Dig Site. He's up to something and there's moolah involved... I can smell it! Keep an eye on what he's doing, and see if you can't get a cut of his profits. A big cut!

Title: Darkheart Thicket: Into Darkheart Thicket
Objective: Defeat the Shade of Xavius in Darkheart Thicket.
Text: Beneath the boughs of Shaladrassil, Xavius extends his power to twist and torment the once-pure druid grove.Not only this, but Xavius has taken a prize from among the druids, and his revenge will be slow and painful. We should go to Darkheart Thicket and stop his wicked plans.

Title: The Greatest Flavor in the World!
Objective: Collect 8 Scoops of Silithid Goo.
Text: Below us is a cave. It's huge! The perfect location for our new refrigerated vault. It's big enough to hold all of our inventory with room to grow. Unfortunately, when we were almost done equipping all of the pipes, bugs burrowed up out of nowhere and killed all of my employees! How was I supposed to know? But it gave me a great idea: silithid-flavored ice cream. We'll make a killing! All I need now are the ingredients.

Title: Finish The Job
Objective: Kill 5 Restless Infantry at the Restless Front. You can find the front on the west side of the island, just before Forgotten Hill.
Text: We have been trying to collect useful scraps from the front all week. Every time we gather a batch to bring back to camp, we get assaulted by the restless infantry in the area. Can you head over there and clear them out?

Title: Freezing the Pipes
Objective: Use the I-Scream Cryocannon to freeze the four pipes inside the cave.
Text: It's time to break out the I-Scream Cryocannon! We lifted the tech from the frost cannons on the river boats. If it's one thing that we gnomes are good at, it's miniaturization by way of making everything else that much bigger! I need you to take the cannon down there into the cave and freeze the pipes we setup in the walls. That'll jumpstart them.

Title: Bait and Throttle
Objective: Get a Fresh Gryphon Carcass.
Text: You can hold your own on the ground. I'll give you that. But we Dragonmaw dominate the skies as well as land. Until you can prove to me you can handle a drake as well as a Dragonmaw, your Horde is nothing to me. Let's see if you can wrangle one back to Bloodgulch. First you'll need bait. Go out and kill one of the gryphons that wander the woods west or northeast of here. Make sure it's untamed! Drakes hate the stink of dwarf on their food. Get the gryphon carcass and you'll know what to do.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Maraudon
Objective: Speak with Zaetar's Spirit.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Maraudon, in western Desolace, immediately! Healing Maraudon from its current corruption would great help the entirety of Desolace! If you so choose, head to Maraudon and speak with Zaetar's Spirit, he will guide you.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Maraudon
Objective: Speak with Zaetar's Spirit.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Maraudon, in western Desolace, immediately! Healing Maraudon from its current corruption would great help the entirety of Desolace! If you so choose, head to Maraudon and speak with Zaetar's Spirit, he will guide you.

Title: Touch the Untouchable
Objective: Use the Phaseblood Potion at the Sigil of Tichondrius to shift into the nether, and search for the Claw of Tichondrius.
Text: I've added a drop of my very own essence to the ooze. Look for a glowing sigil to the west, at the edge of Shadowlurk Ridge. Stand on it, concentrate, and pour this stuff all over yourself. It should be enough to shift you into the nether and let you see what's REALLY there. You won't be alone... the satyr's treasure is being guarded by the biggest voidstalker they could summon. Defeat him, and the treasure is yours. And come back in one piece, or this crazy broad's gonna fry me!

Title: How to Maim Your Dragon
Objective: Lure in a Baited Black Drake, attack it until it is weak, and then ride it back to Bloodgulch.

Title: The Mountain-Lord's Support
Objective: Report your success to Overseer Oilfist at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.
Text: Alright, alright! If I knew ye could dance like that, I wouldn't'a asked ye to do all that stuff earlier. Tell Overseer Oilfist that I'll be joinin' ye. I'll meet ye in the slag pit! With the combined forces of Thorium Point and Iron Summit, those gorge-dwarves won't know what hit 'em!

Title: Blood in the Highlands
Objective: Talk to Wodin the Troll-Servant at the Crucible of Carnage in Twilight Highlands.
Text: You've got some fight in you. You might do well in the crucible. What!? You haven't heard of the Crucible of Carnage? That smarmy goblin Gurgthock and his troll sidekick have been plastering us with leaflets ever since he set up shop here in the Highlands. Champions from all over Azeroth fight to the death in there. You should gather up some friends and see how you fare. The Crucible is just to the southwest. Look for Wodin the Troll-Servant somewhere in the middle of a ring of bones.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Zul'farrak
Objective: Speak with Tran'rek.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Zul'farrak, just west of Gadgetzan, immediately! Gadgetzan is being threatened by the Sandfury trolls and their growing army! If you so choose, head to Zul'farrak and speak with Tran'rek to help the goblins out.

Title: Deceit
Objective: Find a way to convince Mountain-Lord Rendan to join the Thorium Brotherhood.
Text: What? Why're you still here? Oh, did I promise that I'd help you and the Thorium Brotherhood in yer fight? I lied. I just can't spare the men right now. I know I said I'd help, but there's absolutely no way you can convince me to leave Iron Summit right now. Absolutely no way.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Zul'farrak
Objective: Speak with Tran'rek.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Zul'farrak, just west of Gadgetzan, immediately! Gadgetzan is being threatened by the Sandfury trolls and their growing army! If you so choose, head to Zul'farrak and speak with Tran'rek to help the goblins out.

Title: Lunk's Adventure: Rendan's Weakness
Objective: Speak with three Iron Summit Guards and ask them to join your dance.
Text: Lunk not smart, but Lunk notice things. Today, Lunk notice that Mountain-Dwarf likes to watch people dance. Lunk like to dance!  like to dance! Probably! Maybe we find some more dwarfs that like to dance. Then we go talk to Mountain-Dwarf, and he will listen to .

Title: Special Delivery for Brivelthwerp
Objective: Deliver the I-Scream Cryocannon to Brivelthwerp at the Sunken Dig Site in Thousand Needles.
Text: I have a new business partner, my best buddy, Brivelthwerp. Even as we speak, he's building up the infrastructure for our new ice cream empire! He took our coolant tug, inventory, and employees southwest to the Sunken Dig Site. Unfortunately, I don't currently have a way to deliver something to him... something extremely important: our super-secret I-Scream Cryocannon! You don't mind taking it to him, do you?

Title: The Mysteries of the Fire-Gizzard
Objective: Obtain 6 Fire-Gizzards.
Text: There's so much we don't know about the incendosaurs. Where did they come from? How do they survive out here on the flats? And why do they taste so bad? The key to understanding these prehistoric beasts, I believe, starts with the fire-gizzard. Every incendosaur has one. I'd like a few of them to study. You'll find incendosaurs circling the foot of Iron Summit, mostly to the west.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Uldaman
Objective: Speak with Lead Prospector Durdin.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Uldaman, in the Badlands, immediately! The Explorers' League, under Lead Prospector Durdin, requires assistance in braving great danger in pursuit of knowledge! If you so choose, head to Uldaman and speak with Lead Prospector Durdin to help them out.

Title: Set Them Ablaze!
Objective: Use the Torch of Retribution on the four towers surrounding the Cauldron.
Text: I'm not sure if ye've noticed, but my tower's much taller than any o' the other towers here around the Gorge. Some dwarves pride themselves at how deep they can dig, but not me. Sometimes I think I shoulda been born a Wildhammer. I still don't like the sight o' those other towers, though. Reachin' up like that, ticklin' my tower's feet. Here, take this torch, an' use it on the braziers atop those other towers. They'll be sorry they ever built 'em to begin with.

Title: They Build a Better Bullet
Objective: Obtain 200 Dark Iron Bullets.
Text: Those gorge-digging dwarves do at least one thing right: they make very high-quality bullets. I've been unable to reproduce their results, so I've taken to stealing whatever bullets of theirs that I can find. Ye want my help? Get me a couple hundred bullets from those marksmen below. I'm sure they'll be happy to give ye their bullets one at a time, but you might find it faster just to look for the crates filled with them.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Uldaman
Objective: Speak with High Examiner Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Uldaman, near New Kargath, immediately! The Reliquary and its leader, High Examine Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher, requires assistance in obtaining powerful relics within! If you so choose, head to Uldaman and speak with the High Examiner to aid their cause.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Razorfen Downs
Objective: Speak with Koristrasza.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Razorfen Downs, in Thousand Needles, immediately! The mysterious Koristrasza needs help to stop the Scourge-Quilboar alliance! If you so choose, head to Razorfen Downs and speak with Koristrasza to lend her your skills.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Razorfen Downs
Objective: Speak with Koristrasza.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Razorfen Downs, in Thousand Needles, immediately! The mysterious Koristrasza needs help to stop the Scourge-Quilboar alliance! If you so choose, head to Razorfen Downs and speak with Koristrasza to lend her your skills.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Scarlet Monastery
Objective: Enter the Scarlet Monastery.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested able-bodied adventurers to assault the Scarlet Monastery, northeast of the Undercity, immediately! Repeated efforts to negotiate with the Scarlet Crusade have failed. Their zealotry is wreaking havoc across the reclaimed plaguelands and elsewhere. Report to the Scarlet Monastery to dish out the King's justice. Use of deadly force is encouraged!

Title: Siege!
Objective: Slay 9 Dark Iron Marksmen.
Text: That Overseer Oilfist couldn't'a picked a worse time to ask me to join a fight. My summit's already under siege! It's nothin' my guards can't handle, but still, it won't be easy for me to just pick up and send some dwarves into that infernal gorge. Tell ya what: you take out their marksmen that're holding our fortress under siege, and I'll consider your offer. Ye'll find 'em slinkin' around the flats to the east.

Title: The Emerald Nightmare: Il'gynoth
Objective: Defeat Il'gynoth in the Emerald Nightmare.
Text: Our Champions have discovered the source of the corruption. The Emerald Dream has been infested by the Legion and if we don't put our efforts towards stopping them, this will be only the beginning of the corruption. It must be stopped here.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Scarlet Halls
Objective: Enter the Scarlet Halls.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to the Scarlet Halls, northeast of the Undercity, immediately! Crusader activity has picked up throughout the plaguelands and elsewhere. His majesty fears a revival is underway. Scarlet zealotry will not be tolerated near the King's lands! Enter the Scarlet Halls and assault the armory and library before they can mobilize.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Scarlet Monastery Armory
Objective: Speak with Joseph the Crazed.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to the Scarlet Monastery Armory, northeast of the Undercity, immediately! Joseph the Crazed has requested help to kill Herod, the Scarlet Champion! If you so choose, head to the Scarlet Monastery Armory and speak with Joseph the Crazed to help him out.

Title: The Emerald Nightmare: Il'gynoth
Objective: Defeat Il'gynoth in the Emerald Nightmare.
Text: Our Champions have discovered the source of the corruption. The Emerald Dream has been infested by the Legion and if we don't put our efforts towards stopping them, this will be only the beginning of the corruption. It must be stopped here.

Title: The Emerald Nightmare: Il'gynoth
Objective: Defeat Il'gynoth in the Emerald Nightmare.
Text: Our Champions have discovered the source of the corruption. The Emerald Dream has been infested by the Legion and if we don't put our efforts towards stopping them, this will be only the beginning of the corruption. It must be stopped here.

Title: United As One
Objective: Speak to Delas Moonfang and hear the council of war.
Text: I am glad you returned safely, Highlord. Delas Moonfang has also arrived with representatives of the Conclave. The priests have come to discuss Netherlight Temple, their seat of power, hidden deep within the Twisting Nether. As you have both discovered, the Legion has been searching for them for quite some time, and now... they have found them. The Silver Hand has agreed to hear their words. Would you join them now, Highlord?

Title: The Mind of the Enemy
Objective: Find the Legion Intelligence, the Star Map, the Image of Velen, then slay Brood Queen Aramis.
Text: The demon jailors spoke of an upcoming invasion. Their army is gathering for something big, and it worries me greatly. Let us find whatever information we can about their plans.

Title: Translation: Danger!
Objective: Speak to Aponi Brightmane at the Sanctum of Light.
Text: My goodness... these are detailed records of the Legion invasion force at Felblaze Ingress. They are planning to open a portal directly to their demon world of Niskara! This is quite serious - we need to alert your allies at once. If you are going back to Light's Hope Chapel, could I accompany you? I would like to offer my services.

Title: Salanar the Horseman
Objective: Complete the "Salanar the Horsemen" mission.
Text: The Four Horsemen will need perfect steeds. This is no simple task. For the next step of our campaign, I have organized a mission to the Realm of Shadows. The goal of the mission is to find Salanar the Horseman, leader of the Dark Riders, and summon him to Acherus. The mission is currently waiting your assignment.

Title: The Emerald Nightmare: Il'gynoth
Objective: Defeat Il'gynoth in the Emerald Nightmare.
Text: Our Champions have discovered the source of the corruption. The Emerald Dream has been infested by the Legion and if we don't put our efforts towards stopping them, this will be only the beginning of the corruption. It must be stopped here.

Title: Black Rook Hold: The Lord of Black Rook Hold
Objective: Defeat Lord Kur'talos Ravencrest in Black Rook Hold.
Text: While investigating the remains of Black Rook Hold, our Champions were ambushed! The Lord of the Rook appears to have allied himself with the Legion.We need your assistance to defeat his growing army, and bring him down.

Title: The Nighthold: Darkness Calls
Objective: Bring one of Gul'dan's eyes to Archmage Kalec on Normal difficulty or higher.
Text: Before we perform the ritual there is one last thing I must ask of you. You must finally bring Gul'dan to justice. No more of his lies, his deceits, or his trickery. None of it can save him now. Take one of his conjured eyes when you're done. Using his power for good will be a fitting end.

Title: Blood of Sargeras
Objective: Collect 5 Blood of Sargeras.
Text: We will require a powerful reagent to bind the magic in our weapons and armor. A rare material that will do just the trick is Blood of Sargeras. We will need a plentiful quantity. Bring me whatever you can muster.

Title: Saving the Guard
Objective: Complete the "Moon Guard Stronghold" storyline in Suramar, then meet Archmage Kalec in Shal'Aran.
Text: The Moon Guard were once among the most powerful sorcerers on Azeroth. Most assumed their ranks demolished after the War of the Ancients, but it seems they have managed to survive in their ancient stronghold in Suramar! I believe they could be valuable allies in our quest if they still oppose the Legion. , if you can save what remains of the Guard, I will work to convince the Council of Six to lend us additional aid.

Title: Planning the Assault
Objective: Await the opening of the Nighthold, then meet Archmage Kalec in Shal'Aran.
Text: Thanks to your tireless efforts the Heart of Zin-Azshari is ready to withstand the full power of the Legion. The final destination in our journey has stood defiantly in front of us from the moment we began - the Nighthold, now home to none other than Gul'dan himself. We just need a way inside. I am working fervently with the rest of the Council of Six to secure an entrance. Once we have, we should reunite with the Moon Guard in Shal'Aran - we still have need of their skills.

Title: A True Test
Objective: Absorb the power from the Twisted Runebindings using the Heart of Zin-Azshari.
Text: Vizuul's runebindings are more potent than I had anticipated. Not a bad thing - more power is certainly welcome - but there's certainly more potential for catastrophe if the spell matrix somehow becomes unstable. We should be able to safely contain the fel energy within the containment field using the eon winder you recovered... but keep an eye open just in case.

Title: Balance of Power
Objective: Absorb the combined power of the Nightshards and the Eye of Gul'dan using the Heart of Zin-Azshari at the Lunar Crucible.
Text: At long last, it is time to reap the fruits of your labors. Lothrius tells of a place deep in the former Moonguard Stronghold used to infuse new Guards with immense power. It will be the perfect place to tap into and augment the power of the Nightshards you gathered. Gather your effects and meet me there when you are ready, and we will use the Heart to finally reveal the great power within your artifact.

Title: The Nighthold: Into the Nighthold
Objective: Collect 20 Nightshards from the Nighthold on Normal difficulty or higher.
Text: Our work is very nearly complete. Now that the Heart can safely absorb power from fel magic, we need the strongest sources of it that we can get our hands on. Gul'dan has called the nightborne's elite back to the Nighthold to aid him. The storm of fel energy above the palace has seeped into the very fabric of their being, even making its way into the crystallized pieces of the Nightwell that many carry with them. Those shards are exactly what we need. Save as many as you can in your assault.

Title: Essential Consumption
Objective: Absorb the combined power of the Corrupted Essences using the Heart of Zin-Azshari.
Text: As before, once you are ready raise your artifact and channel its energy upon the Heart of Zin-Azshari and we will unleash the power of the essence you gathered. Do not worry - we still have enough of the blood you gathered to ensure the ritual remains stable.

Title: The Nighthold: Delusions of Grandeur
Objective: Collect the core of Trilliax and Grand Magistrix Elisande's Millennia Tome in the Nighthold on Normal difficulty or higher.
Text: Grand Magistrix Elisande and her cohorts have lost their minds - they truly believe that allying themselves with the Legion will end in anything but their own demise! They are too far gone to save, I'm afraid, but they still have powerful items that we can use to help us infuse the Heart of Zin-Azshari with their power. In your assault on the Nighthold, ensure you recover the mad construct Trilliax's power core, as well as the spellbook of the Grand Magistrix herself. Good luck.

Title: Repaid Debt
Objective: Meet Archmage Kalec in the Shal'Aran in Suramar.
Text: The Moon Guard fought against the Legion many years ago, during the War of the Ancients. Their intimate knowledge of our enemies would be invaluable to our cause. They have remained in Shal'Aran since you saved Thalrenus and his kin. Shall we pay them a visit and see what they can do?

Title: Vault of the Wardens: Borrowing Without Asking
Objective: Recover a Containment Crystal from the Vault of the Wardens on Mythic difficulty.
Text: The elusive Wardens run an immense secret prison facility deep underneath the mountains of Azsuna housing all manner of terrible creatures. Perhaps... 'used to run' is more accurate. This presents us with a unique opportunity. The wardens used powerful containment crystals to encase each prisoner in their cell. If any of them still remain intact, we could use one to safely contain the Heart's power. They certainly won't be needing them.

Title: Lucid Strength
Objective: Absorb the power from the Corrupted Essence using the Heart of Zin-Azshari.
Text: We have everything we need. Once you are ready, raise your artifact and channel its energy upon the Heart of Zin-Azshari to safely absorb the power stored within the nightmare essence. I will use the blood you provided to make sure the ritual stays safely contained.

Title: Court of Stars: Literary Perfection
Objective: Find Lothrius' first edition copy of "Wards, Sigils, and the Nightborne Way" in the Court of Stars on Mythic difficulty.
Text: Out of all the books, why that one?! Oh, Mother Moon, I am but a trusting fool. I apologize, you have no idea what I'm going on about. I lent my first edition copy of "Wards, Sigils, and the Nightborne Way" to a dear friend - well, former friend, I should say - just before the betrayal. As fate would have it, there is an incantation in that book that I will need for my part of the ritual. Please retrieve it if you can, but be careful - it is quite valuable!

Title: The Emerald Nightmare: Essence of Power
Objective: Collect 30 Corrupted Essence from the Emerald Nightmare on Normal difficulty or higher.
Text: Now that we have a better understanding on the Heart's capabilities, it is time we tap into its true potential. In the Emerald Nightmare you will find creatures that should not be; monsters that defy all that the Dream stands for. All that the green flight itself stands for. Each of these fiends carry within them corrupted essence, as Oakheart did, but far more potent. Gather all that you can, and we will turn their corruption against them.

Title: Tempering Darkness
Objective: Obtain 30 Blood of Sargeras.
Text: I do not doubt Senegos' plan, but I do have some concerns about the Heart's volatility, especially when combined with nightmare energy. Despite its name, Blood of Sargeras is often used as a tempering agent by master craftsmen. I believe it would work for our ritual as well. You should keep an eye out for it during your travels - we'll need a substantial amount to ensure that everything goes smoothly.

Title: A Vainglorious Past
Objective: Obtain a Vainglorious Draught from Veridis Fallon.
Text: The Heart's magic is attuned to Azshara's elite through powerful warding spells. If we tried to tap into its power now we would be met only with our own demise. However, there may be a way we can bypass the wards. Prince Farondis and his court were once a part of Azshara's empire, and still hold on to keepsakes of their sordid past. Among these is sure to be a Vainglorious Draught, said to further bind the queen's followers to her will. See if you can convince the court to part with a bottle.

Title: The Emerald Nightmare: In Nightmares
Objective: Obtain a Deathglare Iris and the Horn of the Nightmare Lord from the Emerald Nightmare on Normal difficulty or higher.
Text: We must do what we can to ensure that the Nightmare never again festers within the Emerald Dream. The aberration known as Il'gynoth lies at the heart of the corruption - a living, writhing manifestation of the horrors you will encounter at every turn of your journey. I ask that you ensure its destruction, along with the Nightmare Lord himself... Xavius. Once the deeds have been done, bring a small piece of each to me. We can study them to figure out just how the Nightmare grew so quickly.

Title: Darkheart Thicket: Fallen Power
Objective: Recover a Corrupted Essence from Oakheart and defeat the Shade of Xavius in Darkheart Thicket on Mythic difficulty.
Text: Once we have the proper implements we can use the Heart to infuse great power into your artifact. We need only a source. Deep within the Darkheart Thicket lies the ancient Oakheart, once a great and mighty protector of Shaladrassil. He has regrettably fallen to the nightmare like so many of his kin. As the darkness within him has taken root, an essence of the corruption has manifested. I ask that you recover the essence so that we may draw from its power, and put noble Oakheart to rest.

Title: Halls of Valor: Odyn's Challenge
Objective: Defeat Odyn in the Halls of Valor.
Text: Odyn himself sends a message. He and his warriors await worthy contenders within the Halls of Valor.Defeat the champions of the Halls of Valor, and claim glory.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Scarlet Monastery Armory
Objective: Speak with Dark Ranger Velonara.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to the Scarlet Monastery Armory, northeast of the Undercity, immediately! Dark Ranger Velonara has requested more soldiers to help her take out their offensive capabilities! If you so choose, head to the Scarlet Monastery Armory and speak with Dark Ranger Velonara to do your part.

Title: The Captive Spymaster
Objective: Follow Taoshi into the Halls of the Eclipse to where Mathias Shaw is being held captive.
Text: We must move swiftly while the distraction is working. Mathias Shaw is being held in the lower levels of the Halls of the Eclipse directly to the south.Quickly, we must go!

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Scarlet Monastery Graveyard
Objective: Speak with Joseph the Awakened.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to the Scarlet Monastery Graveyard, northeast of the Undercity, immediately! Joseph the Awakened, a former crusader, has requested aid to help him take out the leaders there and reform the crusade! If you so choose, head to the Scarlet Monastery Graveyard and speak with Joseph the Awakened to do your part.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Scarlet Monastery
Objective: Enter the Scarlet Monastery.
Text: The Warchief demands that able-bodied adventurers assault the Scarlet Monastery, northeast of the Undercity, immediately! The Scarlet Crusade has continually threatened Forsaken strongholds throughout the plaguelands. They MUST be destroyed. Report to the Scarlet Monastery to execute the Warchief's orders and crush the crusade once and for all.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Scarlet Halls
Objective: Enter the Scarlet Halls.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to the Scarlet Halls, northeast of the Undercity, immediately! Crusader activity has picked up throughout the plaguelands and elsewhere. The Warchief believes a revival is underway, and this will NOT be tolerated. Enter the Scarlet Halls to crush their armory and lay waste to their library before they can mobilize.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Razorfen Kraul
Objective: Speak with Auld Stonespire.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Razorfen Kraul, in the southernmost part of the Southern Barrens, immediately! Auld Stonespire needs assistance in stopping the quilboar before they begin to spread further! If you so choose, head to Razorfen Kraul and speak with Auld Stonespire, a wise and respected shaman, to help stop the menace.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Razorfen Kraul
Objective: Speak with Auld Stonespire.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Razorfen Kraul, in the southernmost part of the Southern Barrens, immediately! Auld Stonespire needs assistance in stopping the quilboar before they begin to spread further! If you so choose, head to Razorfen Kraul and speak with Auld Stonespire, a wise and respected shaman, to help stop the menace.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Scarlet Monastery Graveyard
Objective: Speak with Dark Ranger Velonara.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to the Scarlet Monastery Graveyard, northeast of the Undercity, immediately! Dark Ranger Velonara has requested more soldiers to help her begin her assault! If you so choose, head to the Scarlet Monastery Graveyard and speak with Dark Ranger Velonara, a clever fighter indeed, to do your part.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Blackfathom Deeps
Objective: Speak with Sentinel Aluwyn.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Blackfathom Deeps, west of Astranaar, immediately! The Twilight's Hammer threatens the world with its actions there! If you so choose, head to Blackfathom Deeps and speak with Sentinel Aluwyn, head of the night elf effort there, to help stop the Twilight threat.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Gnomeregan
Objective: Speak with Murd Doc.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Gnomeregan,west of Ironforge, immediately! The Gnomes need help reclaiming their city! If you so choose, head to Gnomeregan and speak with Murd Doc, recruiter for the G-Team, to help in the mission.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Stormwind Stockade
Objective: Speak with Rifle Commander Coe.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to the Stormwind Stockade, inside his highness' own city, immediately! A mass riot has begun within! If you so choose, head to the Stockade and speak with Rifle Commander Coe, head rifleman of the Stockade guard, to help quell the uprising.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Blackfathom Deeps
Objective: Speak with Je'neu Sancrea.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Blackfathom Deeps, north of Zoram'gar Outpost, immediately! The Twilight's Hammer threatens the world with its actions there! If you so choose, head to Blackfathom Deeps and speak with Je'neu Sancrea, a member of the Earthen Ring, to help stop the Twilight threat.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Shadowfang Keep
Objective: Speak with Packleader Ivar Bloodfang.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Shadowfang Keep, in southern Silverpine Forest, immediately! The traitor, Lord Godfrey, must pay for what he did to our new allies! If you so choose, head to Shadowfang Keep and speak with Packleader Ivar Bloodfang, leader of the war effort there, to help enact proper revenge.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Shadowfang Keep
Objective: Speak with Deathstalker Commander Belmont.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Shadowfang Keep, in southern Silverpine Forest, immediately! The traitor, Lord Godfrey, must pay for what he did to Sylvanas! If you so choose, head to Shadowfang Keep and speak with Deathstalker Commander Belmont, leader of the war effort there, to help enact proper revenge.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Wailing Caverns
Objective: Speak with Nalpak.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to the Wailing Caverns, just west of the Crossroads, immediately! Naralex must be awakened to save the Barrens! If you so choose, head to the Wailing Caverns and speak with Nalpak, one of Naralex's disciples, to help in healing the injured land.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Wailing Caverns
Objective: Speak with Nalpak.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to the Wailing Caverns, just west of the Crossroads, immediately! Naralex must be awakened to save the Barrens! If you so choose, head to the Wailing Caverns and speak with Nalpak, one of Naralex's disciples, to help in healing the injured land.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: The Deadmines
Objective: Speak with Kagtha.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to the Deadmines, in the distant land of Westfall, immediately! Assistance is required in the initiative to take the Defias Juggernaut for the Horde to use against the Alliance! If you so choose, head to the Deadmines and speak with Kagtha, a rogue of the Shattered Hand, to aid in the ongoing war against the Alliance.

Title: Adventurers Wanted: Ragefire Chasm
Objective: Speak with Stone Guard Kurjack.
Text: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Ragefire Chasm, just beneath the great city of Orgrimmar, immediately! The Searing Blade is poised to launch an attack at any moment and the city guards cannot hold for much longer! If you so choose, head to Ragefire Chasm and speak with Stone Guard Kurjack, head of the defense initiative, to end the threat to Orgrimmar once and for all.

Title: Sweet, Merciless Revenge
Objective: Kill Lord Godfrey.
Text: If all goes well you'll just be able to walk right into Godfrey's personal domain and take a reward fitting for such an eager young . Godfrey is a cunning foe, though, so it may be wise to head up there quickly just in case you're needed. He will pay for what he did to the Dark Lady!

Title: Adventurers Wanted: The Deadmines
Objective: Speak with Lieutenant Horatio Laine.
Text: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to the Deadmines, in southern Westfall, immediately! Assistance is required in stopping the reborn Defias Brotherhood from terrorizing the area! If you so choose, head to the Deadmines and speak with Lieutenant Horatio Laine, lead investigator on the case, to aid in stopping the Defias once and for all.

Title: Crisis Management
Objective: Belloc Brightblade wants you to reassure the guests at Schnottz's Landing.
Text: There is a delicate situation that calls for the... objective discretion of an outsider. You see, an unfortunate incident has upset some of our guests. Rest assured, our top men are sorting out the details. In the meantime, it would be wonderful if you could calm our more squeamish visitors. Handle this well, and the furrier is sure to hear of it!

Title: The Corruption of the Jadefire
Objective: Slay 12 Jadefire Satyr or Jadefire Felsworn in Jadefire Glen.
Text: The cleansing of this forest has been a grueling process. For every success we have achieved, a new challenge has arisen. The Jadefire satyr have been a constant nuisance. They seek to corrupt the forest just as we seek to cleanse it. Now, we have taken steps to begin eradicating them from Felwood entirely. Travel to Jadefire Glen to the west and rid the forest of their presence. You'll find the entrance just north of the walls of Deadwood Village; look for their vile banners.

Title: The Fate of the Doyles
Objective: Return the news of Clan Doyle to Iain Firebeard at the Firebeard Cemetery.
Text: It seems the Doyles already joined their last fight. Iain will want to know of their fate.

Title: Ruumbo Demands Justice
Objective: Slay 15 Deadwood Furbolg of any type.
Text: You! Wanderer! Bow before the might of Ruumbo, great god of the Timbermaw tribe! Hear my will! The evil Deadwood tribe lives in the village behind me! They are big jerks! I mean, they... they sully my name with their wicked misdeeds! They persecute my cherished Timbermaw tribe and hurt them! I demand you inflict my justice! Defeat the Deadwood and I will give you my... my favor! Yes! The favor of RUUMBO!

Title: A Coward's Due
Objective: Speak to Colin Thundermar in Thundermar.
Text: We may be safe here, but there are a lot of Wildhammer who could still use support. Our wing can offer that, but we need to keep bolsterin' our forces if we're going to clear the Twilight completely. I'm going to have words with Colin Thundermar. Only a coward turns down the callin' of his people, especially in a time this dire. Go to Thundermar, find Colin and get a real explanation out of'm. I won't be putting up with cowardice in a Wildhammer leader.

Title: Do the Imp-Possible
Objective: Weaken Impsy and use the Enchanted Imp Sack to capture him.
Text: The satyr hide their corrupted moonwell behind an impenetrable barrier of demonic fire. Their forces must have some way of getting through it. Interrogating the satyr will be useless, but the imps they consort with will be easily swayed. I have a specific one in mind, as well... In the foothills to the east, a lone imp has been seen wandering, far from the other demons. He should prove easy pickings. Weaken him with combat, and then use this enchanted sack to capture him. Then I'll do the talking...

Title: Orders Are For the Living
Objective: Kill Lord Walden.
Text: Unsurprisingly, we aren't going to listen to Cromush about the plague. However, his brute strength will come in handy for muscling my men through the many foes ahead on the path to Godfrey, the most powerful being his right hand man, Lord Walden. I'll meet you in Walden's chamber after you finish him off. Then, at long last, we can completely take Shadowfang Keep for the Forsaken!

Title: Take it to 'Em!
Objective: Mack wants you to investigate Khartut's Tomb.
Text: We was lucky to escape. I'm not sure I'd feel right if we didn't take care of them ambushers. Hows about you git back up to Khartut's tomb and give them little buggers what fer! It's off to the northeast, just inside the entrance to Uldum if'n I recollect correctly. What're you looking at? I sure ain't in no condition to do it!

Title: Dance for Ruumbo!
Objective: Do a silly dance for Ruumbo.
Text: You have done well! Ruumbo is pleased by your bravery, and the delicious honey you have given Ruumbo. Now, you must... you must dance! Yes! Dance for Ruumbo! Dance!

Title: Taking the Overlook Back
Objective: Sergeant Gray has asked you to kill Commander Largo at Largo's Overlook. The overlook is just northeast of the base camp.
Text: There is only one way for us to take Largo's Overlook back. I think you know what we need to do . Largo is pretty paranoid these days so you should be able to find him on top of the tower, looking for his imaginary navy to finally arrive.

Title: Magnets, How Do They Work?
Objective: You have been tasked with recovering 7 pieces of Siege Engine Scrap. Use the Magnetized Scrap Collector in The Restless Front to find the scraps. The Restless Front is due west, just past the second bridge.
Text: Getting useful machine parts out here on the island has been difficult. We have been trying to repair the broken siege engines here in camp but we keep running out of useful parts. Our second regiment reported some wrecked out siege engines in a old battlefield to the west. Maybe we could find some parts over there? You are going to have trouble finding anything in that old battlefield so take this magnetized scrap collector and put it to some good use.

Title: Battlezone
Objective: Commander Schnottz wants you to man one of the siege tank turrets and use it to defeat 7 Decrepit Watchers, then report back to him.
Text: It vould appear zhat anozher opportunity has arisen for you to redeem yourself. Zhis little emergency has set me back a few tank gunnahs. You zhink you have vhat it takes to fill in for vone of zhem? My tanks are just vest of zhe camp. Get out zhere and put an end to zhis silliness!

Title: Plague...Plague Everywhere!
Objective: Kill Baron Silverlaine and Commander Springvale.
Text: The best part about this plague is that even when it visually fades away, the remaining residue is still quite potent! However, we still have an enormous area to cover before we're done, with plenty of Godfrey's defenses in the way. It appears that the spirits that served Baron Silverlaine and Commander Springvale in life now guard them in death, and Godfrey is using them to deter us. Show them all the iron will of the Forsaken!

Title: Ruumbo Demands Honey
Objective: Collect 10 Deadwood Honey Globs from the hives in Deadwood Village using Ruumbo's Honey Stick.
Text: Ruumbo hungers! The Deadwood jerks have stolen all their honey from the Timbermaw tribe! We saw...er, Ruumbo saw them do it! Now Ruumbo must have that honey! Take this... this stick! Yes, this stick. Take this stick and use it to steal the honey from their beehives in Deadwood Village. Ruumbo must have as much honey as possible. This is vital.

Title: The Power Within
Objective: Complete the "Defending Azurewing Repose" storyline in Azsuna, then meet Archmage Kalec at Azurewing Repose.
Text: Do you have a moment, Conjurer? The power within your weapon has grown exponentially as you have fought the Legion, but I cannot help but wonder if there is something... more... hidden away within. Perhaps even a new form entirely! The very thought demands we find out for sure. The ancient blue dragon in Azsuna known as Senegos lays dying and is key to our journey. You must aid him - I will meet you in his domain as soon as I am able.

Title: Cannonball!
Objective: You need to recover 4 Stacks of Cannonballs from Largo's Overlook for Sergeant Gray. You can find Largo's Overlook just northeast of the base camp.
Text: Largo and his minions have been stealing our supplies ever since we setup camp here. It's frustrating to say the least. We have heard reports that he is stockpiling cannonballs in the towers overlooking the water up on his overlook. Can you head up there and try to recover some of them for us? , don't forget to keep a watch out for horde too.

Title: A Change of Seasons
Objective: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois.
Text: It is time.The arcan'dor is preparing to mature. With a final burst of growth, this gift will be fully realized.We must make ready the leyline feed.

Title: Black Rook Hold: Greater Power
Objective: Defeat Lord Kur'talos Ravencrest and retrieve a Greater Demonic Runestone from Dantalionax in the Black Rook Hold Dungeon.
Text: The raw power of the runestones will allow Hymdall to temporarily open a tear into demonic worlds, but it's not enough. The Legion hides its presence in far away worlds with dark magic. Bring a greater runestone so that Hymdall can hone in on our enemies across the cosmos.

Title: The Power Within
Objective: Complete the "Defending Azurewing Repose" storyline in Azsuna, then meet Archmage Kalec at Azurewing Repose.
Text: My apologies for the unannounced intrusion. Do you have a moment? The power within your weapon has grown exponentially as you have fought the Legion, but I cannot help but wonder if there is something... more... hidden away within. Perhaps even a new form entirely! The very thought demands we find out for sure. The ancient blue dragon in Azsuna known as Senegos lays dying and is key to our journey. You must aid him - I will meet you in his domain as soon as I am able.

Title: The Power Within
Objective: Meet Archmage Kalec at Azurewing Repose in Azsuna.
Text: Do you have a moment, Conjurer? The power within your weapon has grown exponentially as you have fought the Legion, but I cannot help but wonder if there is something... more... hidden away deep within. Perhaps even a new form entirely! The very thought demands we find out for sure. You are familiar with the ancient blue dragon Senegos in Azsuna, yes? Meet me at his repose once you are able and we will discuss more.

Title: Silver Hand Knights
Objective: Speak to Commander Born.
Text: Good news, Highlord! We have recruited a paladin trainer named Commander Born. He is a hard teacher, but has trained some of the greatest paladin knights in recent times. We are lucky to have his services. Go speak to him, and train a squad of Silver Hand Knights.

Title: Black Rook Hold: Lord Ravencrest
Objective: Defeat Lord Kur'talos Ravencrest in Black Rook Hold.
Text: Highlord, news has reached us of a Legion presence at Black Rook Hold. It is rumored that the night elf commander, Kur'talos Ravencrest, amasses an enormous army behind the fortress walls. Take a group of your most powerful allies, Highlord, and investigate these stories. Lord Ravencrest was a formidable general during Azshara's reign, and if the reports are true, then we must know more.

Title: Allies of the Light
Objective: Save 15 Silver Hand Knights or Conclave Priests, and rescue Arator the Redeemer and Delas Moonfang.
Text: Both Arator and Delas are still somewhere on this forsaken rock, as well as many of our other allies. We cannot leave them.

Title: Blood of Our Enemy
Objective: Send your champions on "Blood of Our Enemy" missions against the Burning Legion and collect 5 Flasks of Demon Blood.
Text: I have seen demonic artifacts before. Legion sigils will only reveal themselves in the presence of demon blood. I sense that time is of the essence. Bring me a large quantity of demon blood, so that I may translate the book as soon as you retrieve it.

Title: Aponi's Trail
Objective: Find 8 pages of Aponi's journal, then use them to track her down.

Title: The Power Within
Objective: Meet Archmage Kalec at Azurewing Repose in Azsuna.
Text: My apologies for the unannounced intrusion. Do you have a moment? The power within your weapon has grown exponentially as you have fought the Legion, but I cannot help but wonder if there is something... more... hidden away within. Perhaps even a new form entirely! The very thought demands we find out for sure. You are familiar with the ancient blue dragon Senegos in Azsuna, yes? Meet me at his repose once you are able and we will discuss more.

Title: To Felblaze Ingress
Objective: Find Aponi Brightmane at Felblaze Ingress in Azsuna.
Text: I have sobering news, Highlord. We have had no word from Chieftain Aponi Brightmane, young Arator, or priestess Delas Moonfang since they departed for Felblaze Ingress. We need to know what happened to them. We fear the worst.

Title: Cracking the Codex
Objective: Speak to Delas Moonfang in Dalaran.
Text: I have been studying the Codex of Command that you recovered from Faronaar. It is important to Balnazzar, but WHY? What does it say? I'm sure we could gain valuable knowledge if we could just crack this code. I have a friend who might be able to help us: a priestess named Delas Moonfang. She has been studying Eredun, the language of the demons. Take the sigil to her in Dalaran. Tell her I sent you.

Title: Assault on Violet Hold: The Fel Lexicon
Objective: Collect a Fel Lexicon from a powerful prisoner inside Violet Hold.
Text: I have been studying the language of the demons, but it has been difficult to get my hands on written material. I have heard rumor of a book called the Fel Lexicon, written by an ancient scholar who spoke both eredun and draenei. If I could just get my hands on that book, I could learn so much! I heard that this book might be in the hands of a powerful prisoner inside the Violet Hold. Bring me this book, and my work here will go much faster.

Title: A Burning Distraction
Objective: Place the Noggenfogger Boom Bombs on your way through Felsoul Hold and then trigger the Detonator to set them off.
Text: We're going to need a distraction if we are to rescue Mathias Shaw from where he's being held captive in Felsoul Hold.A big one.Explosives placed in a few key locations should do nicely. Noggenfogger is playing nice and has donated some bombs to the cause. He might be trying to smooth over relations due to his earlier extortion.I can have someone go ahead and mark the best locations. You want to do the honors?

Title: Lunthistle's Tale
Objective: Hear Zamael tell his tale.
Text: Will you assist me, mortal? Hear my tale.

Title: The World is Not Enough
Objective: Complete any 1 "Rare Elite" World Quest designated by a blue exclamation mark surrounded by a gold dragon on the area maps.
Text: Now that we have pruned the garden, it is time to dig up the rotting tree stump in the middle.Put another way, we need to make sure to keep the forces of chaos from overwhelming the Broken Isles. Certainly others are helping in this endeavor.However, I am sure the target you select to eliminate will be the wisest from the standpoint of the Uncrowned.

Title: Prayer to Elune
Objective: Find and read the Prayer to Elune.
Text: Will you assist me, mortal? Will you find the prayer to Elune? As I stated, the prayer was etched onto a golden tablet. I believe they hold it within one of their vile chests, near the entrance to their cave at the bottom of the ridge. If you do recover my prayer, don't bring it back to me. Instead, take the time to read through it. Absolution may be asking too much, based on the sins I've committed. But that won't stop me from holding out hope.

Title: The Spiders Have to Go
Objective: Slay 9 Lava Spiders within Searing Gorge.
Text: Normal-size spiders, I can handle. Giant glassweb spiders make me uncomfortable, but they're far enough away that I don't worry too much. But lava spiders?  Lava spiders are SCARY. They're enormous spiders. That live in LAVA. I just got paid for my last week of work, and I'll pay you well to kill those things. You'll find 'em all over Searing Gorge.

Title: Twilight Collars
Objective: Obtain 20 Twilight Collars.
Text: Have ye seen the ridiculous necklaces those Twilight's Hammer cultists all wear? The gems on those things are bigger than Hansel's fist! A few hamburger-sized jewels like that, and Burninate over there could really push his blacksmithing business to the next level. Fetch those collars, and he'll make it worth your while.

Title: Curse These Fat Fingers
Objective: Kill 12 Heavy War Golems.
Text: Unfortunately, I can't dish out the beats like I used to, due to this here fat finger problem. Ye see, the climate out here combined with the lack o' air pressure makes me fingers expand. They're like gigantic Thelsamar Blood Sausages, they are... Ye're gonna have to carry out me orders of business and what have ye. First on me agenda: Poundin' the livin' daylights out o' the heavy war golems o' the Gorge. Get crackin'.

Title: Heat That Just Don't Quit
Objective: Obtain 10 Filled Furnace Flasks. You must use the Furnace Flasks on living elementals within Searing Gorge.
Text: We smith, we smelt, we roast up whatever spider meat we can get. Bush chicken if we're lucky. Point is, all o' this work means we need lots and lots of fire. Good thing we're smack dab in the middle of firetown. O' course, the best fire comes from the elementals. You'll find 'em all over Searing Gorge, but always near lava. Here, take these flasks and use 'em on the elementals. Oh, did I mention the elementals gotta be alive when you gather your sample?

Title: Dark Ministry
Objective: Obtain Kiyuubi's Spherule, Letherio's Spherule, and Finister's Spherule, then combine them into a Twilight Tripetricine.
Text: I got one more assignment for ye. This one comes straight down from the Overseer himself. Seems he was pretty shook up once he heard about that "Archduke" ye discovered. He's asked for us to hunt down three Twilight ministers that work over in Firewatch Ridge, to the west. Kiyuubi, Letherio, and Finister are their names, and they each carry some sort o' special rock. Combine all three and bring 'em back here. Listen, when the Overseer gives orders, ye don't ask questions. Ye just do it.

Title: Ghostbuster
Objective: Kill 14 ghosts of any type at Largo's Overlook, just northeast of base camp.
Text: See that hill just beyond our base camp? That's Largo's Overlook and it's not a fun place to setup camp next to. We have been dealing with those spirits and spectres ever since we setup base camp. Can you head up there and let them know we don't plan on leaving anytime soon? A few good kills on their ranks should put them in line. Thanks for your help on this.

Title: Recon Essentials
Objective: Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass.
Text: We used to have more stuff around here. I think there was a spyglass somewhere nearby, along with a smithing tuyere. I'm pretty certain that they've been stolen by Dark Iron dwarves. Yes, I know that I'm a Dark Iron dwarf! I'm talking about the bad ones that live down in that gorge. You'd best check the steamsmiths that work just south of here. They'd be most likely to use tools like these.

Title: Lunk's Adventure: Cranky Little Dwarfs
Objective: Weaken 7 Dark Iron Steamsmiths so Lunk can help them fall asleep.
