Text: What you doing? Why you kill? You need to get things from dwarfs? Ah, Lunk understand. Lunk have a better way. Listen: you go fight dwarf, but do not kill! Just fight until dwarf get tired. Then Lunk will help dwarf fall asleep. Dwarfs probably just cranky because they don't get sleep. Come on! Trust Lunk.

Title: WANTED: Foreman Wellson
Objective: Kill Foreman Wellson at the Wellson Shipyard. The shipyard can be found northwest of here, on the western coast.
Text: Foreman Wellson has been a pain in our side since we got here. His shipyard holds a large amount of supplies that would be extremely useful to us... if we could get to them. He keeps a close watch over his minions and makes it very difficult for us to get a foothold on the shipyard. I need you to take out Wellson for good this time. Be careful , we have been receiving reports of filthy Horde all around the area.

Title: Boosting Morale
Objective: You have been asked to recover 6 Barrels of Southsea Rum from the shipwrecks on the Cape of Lost Hope. The cape can be found north of here, along the coast.
Text: Morale is low these days. We make every effort we can to keep the troops in high spirits but we are running low on our main supply of morale booster... rum. I have been getting reports from our infantry to the south that the shipwrecks on the Cape of Lost Hope still have a good supply of southsea rum in their wrecked hulls. Can you head up there and investigate? Bring back any rum you can find.

Title: This Land is Our Land
Objective: Kill Baron Ashbury.
Text: Did you think that a handful of worgen vermin could stop me? Hah! Shadowfang Keep was part of the Lordaeron kingdom in life, so it is quite fitting that it should belong to the Forsaken in death. Godfrey and his accomplices are minor obstacles at best, and of course we're all happy to take them out for their treachery against the Dark Lady. Ashbury has positioned himself near the front of the keep, leaving him wide open to attack. Start us out on the right foot, would you?

Title: First Lieutenant Connor
Objective: Find and kill First Lieutenant Connor at Forgotten Hill. You will find Forgotten Hill on the far west side of the island.
Text: The first time I heard about Lt. Connor, I was just a young recruit in the Stormwind stockades. None of us could believe he ended up here on Tol Barad. Sadly, he still roams these wretched islands, wreaking havoc on our troops morale. I need you to put an end to his misery... and ours.

Title: Rattling Their Cages
Objective: Camp Coordinator Brack has asked you to kill 8 Shipwrecked Sailors at the Cape of Lost Hope. The cape is located due northwest of here, on the beach.
Text: We have been having issues with the undead down at the Cape of Lost Hope for a while now. Every time a new ship wrecks, they end up getting more undead to join their ranks. Can you do us a favor and thin out the ranks up there? I know you won't be able to kill them all, but anything you can do will help at this point. Keep an eye out for horde, we have been getting reports of them ambushing the beach lately.

Title: Make Yourself Useful
Objective: Commander Schnottz wants you to persuade 6 Slacking Laborers to get to work.
Text: Gobbles vill be sorely missed, but zhe mission must not suffer. Perhaps zhere is somezhink you can do to redeem yourself. Take vone of zhe uniforms you recovered. Vhile vearink it, my vorkers vill not behave so... aggressively. Lately, zheir morale has been a bit lackink. Some of zhe vorkers are refusing to perform zheir labors. Auch, zhe audacity! Find zhese lazy imbeciles and convince zhem zhat zhey must get to vork... or else!

Title: Captain P. Harris
Objective: You have been tasked with killing Captain P. Harris at the Cape of Lost Hope. The Cape of Lost Hope can be found northwest of here, along the coast. Just look for the shipwrecks.
Text: The Cape of Lost Hope has been a sore in our side for weeks here on Tol Barad. Half of our supply ships end up on the rocks down there. To make matters worse, it's been overrun by a gang of undead sailors. We have tried thinning the ranks, but they just seem to keep coming back. Our last resort is to try and take out the captain that they report to. You should be able to find him on a ship, just off the shoreline. Oh, and I hope you are not too scared of sharks.

Title: Watch Out For Splinters!
Objective: Sergeant Gray has asked you to recover 15 pieces of Shipyard Lumber from the Wellson Shipyard. The lumber can be recovered from the ghosts in the shipyard or found lying around the premises. The shipyard can be found northwest of here, on the coast.
Text: Have you been over to the Wellson Shipyard yet? Best to stay away from there unless you have a good reason to venture in. Unfortunately, that is exactly what I need you to do. You see, we have been short on supplies ever since we recaptured the island. That ghost ridden shipyard is overflowing with lumber but every time we send an escort to recover the lumber, they never make it back. Can you help us out?

Title: Fury of the Pack
Objective: Kill Lord Godfrey.
Text: Ah, the sweet scent of victory! My men should be tearing Godfrey to pieces even as we speak. Go up to his domain and collect your share of the spoils - you've earned it! You'd think that he would have been more difficult to defeat...

Title: Salvaging the Remains
Objective: You need to recover 9 Cursed Femur bones from the ghouls that inhabit Forgotten Hill. Forgotten Hill is on the west side of the island, just past The Forgotten Front.
Text: Forgotten Hill has been overrun with zombies and ghouls ever since we reclaimed this wretched isle. We have tried to clear them out many times but they always seem to come back. One of our lieutenants recommended taking the ghouls' bones when we kill them in hopes that they can't reincarnate overnight. Think you can help us out with this one?

Title: Thorium Point: The Seat of the Brotherhood
Objective: Report to Overseer Oilfist at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.
Text: Did... did you see that? This is the missing piece we've been looking for! We have to take this information back to someone at Thorium Point. The Dark Irons have been known to consort with the firelord in the past, but never before have they brought their kind this far out into Searing Gorge. Thorium Point is west and north of here. You will find it nestled in the cliffs that overlook Pyrox Flats. Take this information straight to Overseer Oilfist.

Title: A New Master... But Who?
Objective: Obtain the Dark Iron Memo from Gravius Grimesilt at Grimesilt Worksite.
Text: You've arrived just in time. Here's the skinny: the Dark Iron dwarves in the gorge have been acting strangely, and the Thorium Brotherhood intends to find out why. Overseer Oilfist doesn't like surprises. We suspect that they're following orders from some new leader. I have reason to believe that Gravius Grimesilt, just south of here, knows who it is. Even here in Searing Gorge, we've begun to hear tales of your exploits. You should have no problem with Grimesilt.

Title: A Proper Antivenom
Objective: Obtain 14 samples of Glassweb Venom.
Text: Shame that Lunk left. I was beginning to enjoy his company. Oh well, back to work! I'm the closest thing that this expedition has to a medical officer, and I'm running low on antivenom. We tend to need a lot of antivenom. The key to a proper antivenom is ALWAYS to start with the poison itself. The glassweb spiders nearby should be a good place to start. If you kill them, you can probably extract some venom from the sacs within their jaws.

Title: Dig-Boss Dinwhisker
Objective: Kill Dark Iron Excavators and Dark Iron Footmen within the Cauldron until Dig-Boss Dinwhisker appears. Then slay Dig-Boss Dinwhisker and obtain his Dark Ember.
Text: Grimesilt wasn't as high up on the chain as I thought. We'll have to take out his superior and find out what he knows. Dig-Boss Dinwhisker's his name, and he runs the Dark Iron digging operations within the Cauldron, just northwest of here. His excavators and footmen patrol the eastern side of the Cauldron, digging downward, day and night. He's not known to show his face out in the field very often, but if you slay enough of his men, he'll be forced to come out and deal with you.

Title: A Lumbering Relic
Objective: Obtain Margol's Gigantic Horn.
Text: Margol the Rager's an old thunder lizard seen round these parts. Legend has it that he's been here in the gorge since before it was even a gorge. Legend also has it that he ate my brother Barnabas. I don't care how old he is or what kind of magic he shoots out of his nose. I just want him dead. For Barnabas' sake. You'll find him wandering the cliffs to the south of here.

Title: The Fewer, the Better
Objective: Slay 10 Dark Iron Geologists or Dark Iron Watchmen.
Text: I'm not much of a fighter... I'm more of a mining dwarf. Same goes for Jack and Pris. And Lunk... well, you'd think he'd be a big fighter, but he's the biggest wimp of all of us. What I'm saying is, it's good that you came here when you did. It seems likely that we in the Thorium Brotherhood are going to be fighting the other Dark Iron dwarves soon. I'm thinking we should pick off some of their finest before the war starts in earnest. Start with the geologists and watchmen to the south.

Title: Out of Place
Objective: Obtain 8 Ash Chickens.
Text: The gorge is an unforgiving place. We don't get a whole lot of fuzzy wildlife wandering around here. We tried bringing in some wild game, but they haven't fared well at all. There's just no food for them to eat. Now the nearby spiders - which were already dangerous - are getting big and fat on chicken meat. We'll never get rid of all the spiders, but we can salvage what few chickens remain. Not only will you be feeding the Brotherhood, you'll be saving them a painful death by spider bite.

Title: Lunk's Adventure: Spider Rider
Objective: Weaken 7 Glassweb Spiders so Lunk can ride them.
Text: Lunk sees you like to kill things. Let Lunk teach you another way. Lunk always wanted to ride on spider's back. Looks like fun. Spiders move too fast, though. Always slip away. We work together. You fight spider until it gets weak and tired. Then Lunk jump on spider's back and ride around. Maybe Lunk even gather some venom for you! No have to kill!

Title: Lunk's Task
Objective: Obtain 15 Tempered Flywheels from Tempered War Golems.
Text: Lunk came from the Badlands. Other ogres try to make Lunk fight. Lunk hate fighting. Lunk want to learn. Lunk sees machines to the south. Machines made of gears. Maybe if you ask nicely, machines will give you some gears? Then maybe Lunk can have a gear, and learn about machines too.

Title: The Historians
Objective: Meet with Historian Ju'Pa in the Valley of Spirits of Orgrimmar.
Text: , each year I visit Orgrimmar to help adventurers like you reflect on our shared history. While our eyes must always be trained on the future, we must be mindful of our past. Come visit me in the Valley of Spirits and we can speak more.

Title: Eye Spy
Objective: Peer into the Eye of Twilight for Garona.
Text: This terrible thing makes my hair stand on end. Cho'gall uses these to control his minions - now it's time to use it against him. Let me see... hmm, it's all cloudy. All I can see is you. Why is it showing me you?  Look into the eye and tell me what you see. Peer into Cho'gall's lair! What is he doing? Is he heavily guarded? Tell me!

Title: Pruning the Garden
Objective: Complete 10 World Quests.
Text: In a very real sense, the Uncrowned are gardeners. We snip and trim here and there. One clipping of a single branch may seem nonsensical until you step back and look at the garden as a whole.On the greater theater of the Broken Isles, we must act decisively. The forces that arrayed against Azeroth are moving quickly. We need to prune some very ugly flowers to make our garden beautiful again, wouldn't you agree?

Title: The Historians
Objective: Meet with Historian Llore in the Royal Library of Stormwind.
Text: , each year I visit Stormwind to help adventurers like you reflect on our shared history. While our eyes must always be trained on the future, we must be mindful of our past. Come visit me in the Stormwind Royal Library and we can speak more.

Title: Where In the World is Mathias?
Objective: Use the Scouting Map and complete the "Where In the World is Mathias Shaw?" missions.
Text: Master Mathias Shaw is the leader of the Alliance intelligence organization known as SI:7. And apparently, he is now a dreadlord.Or rather, a very clever dreadlord has taken his place while he is being held captive somewhere.It is imperative that we reveal this imposter to the new king of Stormwind. If we fail to do so, then the Alliance will surely be eaten alive from within and the Burning Legion will win this war for a certainty.

Title: Blood for the Wolfe
Objective: Collect 50 Fel Blood.
Text: We have a request in from Winstone Wolfe. He says that he needs a rather large amount of demon blood. He was not specific what for, and I did not ask.I am inclined to do this for him with all expediency. The Wolf rarely asks for anything, so when he does, we jump. He gets results, one-hundred percent of the time and then some.We should show him the same professional courtesy.

Title: Hidden History
Objective: Use Old Filmaff's notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes for Edirah's research.
Text: Filmaff believes with a little assistance we can give you more.There are a few tomes I could point out - not easy to get, mind you - that would... ... that would push forward our research a bit.Here, I'll give you a list.

Title: Mother Ozram
Objective: Kill Mother Ozram.
Text: The fiendish imps in this region are an incessant pain on our allies defending the camps below. They are the spawn of a wicked imp-mother named Mother Ozram, who has been seen on a hill to the south. Destroy her, and we will end her brood as well.

Title: A Time to Reflect
Objective: Correctly answer one of Ju'Pa's questions about the history of Azeroth.
Text: It is time to reflect on the events that have brought us to this moment. A celebration of our great history and the events that shape it.

Title: A Second Weapon
Objective: Choose a second artifact to pursue.
Text: We have strong leads on other ancient weapons that you might choose to pursue, if having one renowned, powerful piece of history in your hands is somehow insufficient.I'll lay out the options for you. Let me know how you'd like to proceed.

Title: We All Must Sacrifice
Objective: Slay 10 Shaman of the Black.
Text: You seek my sight? My powers come at a price. These disciples of the Twilight have been honoring me with the blood of Wildhammer dwarves from the nearby ruins, but still I thirst. Perhaps you can do better. Slay my old masters, and my vision is yours. Honor me with the slaughter of the Shaman of the Black. Blood is blood, after all.

Title: The Eyes Have It
Objective: Take the Eye of Twilight to Garona Halforcen at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.
Text: Very well then. You have purchased my services in blood. Take me back to Garona Halforcen. Oh yes, I already know where you're taking me. Garona's relentless quest for vengeance is no secret. It will be a delight to watch it unfold.

Title: The Explorers
Objective: Speak with Explorer Mowi at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.
Text: We have a contingent of the Explorers' League in the chamber just to the northwest inside the temple. They've been making increasing noises about something that the Twilight's Hammer is up to. , would you be a dear and see what they need?

Title: A Sticky Task
Objective: Collect 4 Sticky Silk Glands from Darkwood Broodmother spiders in The Darkwood. The Darkwood forest is just west of here, across the bridge on the central island.
Text: Finding supplies on the island has been difficult, to say the least. Fortunately, we have found a good supply of silk in The Darkwood, just west of here. The bad part of this story is that the silk comes from the glands on Broodmother spiders. I need you to gather 4 of these for me. That should be just enough to finish up this last set of shirts.

Title: Gobbles!
Objective: Schnottz wants you to speak with him when you are prepared to witness the ritual.
Text: At last! Zhe time has come to set my Gobbles free of zhat nasty curse! Pay attention now, and stay on guard. Zhere can be no interruptions vhile I perform zhe ritual. Let me know vhen you haf secured zhe perimeter! Now, move it!

Title: The Forgotten
Objective: Release the spirits of 6 tortured souls at Forgotten Hill. Souls can be channeled by touching your hands directly to the gravestones. Forgotten Hill is due west of here, past The Darkwood and The Restless Front.
Text: Many soldiers died on this island . It is only fair that we pay our respects to them in any way that we can. I need you to travel to Forgotten Hill, due west of here and release our brothers in arms' tortured souls away from this place. Do be careful over there, reports of undead have been ongoing in the area.

Title: Paint it Black
Objective: Acquire a Black Diamond Heart.
Text: The ground bleeds. They tear it open, as one would gouge flesh. These cultists relish their secrecy but the very elementals they use for their misdeeds can betray them. Seek out Obsidian Stoneslaves northeast of here, among the ruined earth we have named the Black Breach. Shatter their bodies and find for me a perfect heart of black diamond. I will look into this heart. And I will bare its soul.

Title: The Reliquary
Objective: Speak with Examiner Rowe at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.
Text: We have a contingent of the Reliquary in the chamber just to the northeast inside the temple. They've been making increasing noises about something that the Twilight's Hammer is up to. , would you be a dear and see what they need?

Title: A Vision of Twilight
Objective: Locate an Eye of Twilight within the Black Breach.
Text: Cho'gall keeps track of his minions through powerful magical orbs: "The Eyes of Twilight." In Mount Hyjal, the Guardians of Hyjal managed to find and manipulate one to their own ends. We must do the same. I want one of those orbs, and I want to use it to peer into the very heart of Cho'gall's lair. Search the Black Breach, across the river to the northeast, and find an Eye of Twilight. Do whatever you need to bring it back to me!

Title: Thinning the Brood
Objective: Kill 12 Darkwood Lurkers in The Darkwood. The Darkwood forest is just west of here, across the bridge on the central island.
Text: We have been trying to get a foothold in The Darkwood for weeks now but that forest is infested with spiders. Do me a favor and see if you can thin them out enough for us to set up an attack. Careful out there, I have heard reports of Horde troops nearby earlier in the week.

Title: Angered Spirits
Objective: Commander Schnottz wants you to use the L.P.A.C. to collect 5 Furious Spectral Essences.
Text: Doctor Venkman vas vone of my greatest researchers, until he had to be put out of my misery. He did leave me vizh vone of his greatest accomplishments, zhough. Against zhe properly attuned supernatural adversary, zhis veapon vill siphon zhe target's essence. It is of key importance in zhe ritual I vill be attemptink. Vhere do you come in, you ask? Simple. You have zhe priviledge of collecting zhe material. Zhe veapon is calibrated to vork on zhe Furious Specters in zhe temple to zhe east.

Title: Fashionism
Objective: Belloc Brightblade wants you to collect 10 Trooper Uniforms.
Text: We have a strict policy among our ranks, one that we take most seriously. Our troops are to dress in official uniform at all times. This helps with organization, friendly fire incidents are reduced, and it keeps the troops looking wonderful! We call it, Fashionism. We've been running low on uniforms lately. I must ask that you recover them from the troopers that have fallen in the line of duty. You should find plenty of the poor fellows east of here, at the Ruins of Ammon.

Title: Idolatry
Objective: Commander Schnottz wants you to collect 8 Well-preserved Idols.
Text: Zhere is somezhink I need handled. My most trusted advisor has run afoul of an ancient curse. A hex zhat has transformed zhe man into a turkey, of all zhings! I haff studied for days to discover a remedy for his condition, and finally I am ready to conduct zhe ritual. I vill reqvire several idols from zhe nearby ruins. You are to brink zhem to me at vonce! Dismissed!

Title: Dirty Birds
Objective: You are to slay 8 Diseased Vultures.
Text: The sky above the Shriveled Oasis is littered with these nasty vultures. Like infectious rodents with wings, these creatures serve no great purpose and inflict untold misery. Rid the skies of this nuisance and leave the region better than you found it.

Title: Bring Down the Avalanche
Objective: Slay Avalanchion.
Text: You have to go back and slay Avalanchion to keep Therazane's forces from attacking Stonehearth!

Title: The Hero Returns
Objective: Present yourself to Stonefather Oremantle at Stonehearth in Deepholm.
Text: The Stonefather is waiting for you back south at Stonehearth. Make yourself presentable. You've earned a hero's welcome!

Title: The Desert Fox
Objective: Schnottz wants you to bring him the Desert Fox.
Text: Zhere is much to be done in zhis region. Ve bozh haf a burning passion for zhe ancient technologies here, do ve not? Perhaps zhere is a vay for us to vork togezher? Let us put zhe misunderstandinks of zhe past behind us zhen, hmm? Now, zhere is an elusive animal in zhe region to zhe east zhat I have been huntink. Brink me zhis creature as a token of your sincerity, hmm? Zhen maybe I let you in on my operation...

Title: The Middle Fragment
Objective: Recover the Middle Fragment of the World Pillar.
Text: I present you with the key to Stonehearth. With it you may unlock the vault to my home and recover the middle fragment of the World Pillar. Keep the fragment safe. Make certain to get it to the Temple of Earth in the middle of Deepholm as quickly as possible! Know that you are always welcome here.

Title: Elemental Ore
Objective: Collect 6 Elemental Ore.
Text: You're going to have to deal with the leader of Therazane's forces here. However, to get you to him quickly and safely, I'm going to need to perform a ritual. Go out into the field and collect elemental ore from the ragers. With enough of it, I should be able to make you one with the ground to get you where you need to go.

Title: Bring Down the Avalanche
Objective: Slay Avalanchion.
Text: Avalanchion stands before you. Slay him to keep Therazane's forces from attacking Stonehearth.

Title: The Quaking Fields
Objective: Speak with Slate Quicksand at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.
Text: Before you can help us here, you're going have to deal with Therazane, the Stone Mother's, forces to the south. The elementals and giants upon the Quaking Fields are being mustered. They too are after the middle fragment of the World Pillar. They'll attack us amidst our war with the stone troggs and we'll be unable to repel them. I've sent the arch geomancer ahead. Get to Slate Quicksand and do as he asks.

Title: The Axe of Earthly Sundering
Objective: Slay 5 Sundered Emerald Colossi.
Text: The emerald colossi are the greatest of the Stone Mother's creatures. They must be the first to be removed from the field. I brought Stonefather Oremantle's axe for just this task. Use it to sunder the giants. That should bring them down to a more manageable size for you to finish off.

Title: Devastation
Objective: Search for Rheastrasza.
Text: The coast is clear. If Rheastrasza or the egg were able to miraculously evade Deathwing's flames, they would probably need your assistance as soon as possible.

Title: Drag 'em Down
Objective: Use the Barbed Fleshhook to dismount and kill 4 Thundermar Gryphon Riders.
Text: A single Dragonmaw drake is worth a dozen Wildhammer gryphon-riders. Take them off of their lice-ridden birds and they're nothing. Even you can slay them easily, Horde-. Hunt gryphon riders flying over the river north of Bloodgulch. Take this hook and fling it at them as they fly by. Their momentum will hurl them from their mount, right to your feet. Finish them! Kill a few Thundermar gryphon riders and I'll believe your Horde is as mighty as you say.

Title: One With the Ground
Objective: Complete the One With the Ground ritual.
Text: The leader of the Stone Mother's forces here is the great earth elemental lord, Avalanchion. Luckily for us, the Twilight's Hammer cultists have decided to invade his lair. They're seeking to bind his elementals to their will. We will take advantage of the chaos. The earth ritual that I invoke will make you one with the ground. It will take you near to Avalanchion without alerting him to your presence. It's up to you to finish him.

Title: A Favor for the Furrier
Objective: Collect 5 Desert Coyote Pelts.
Text: The commander can be most generous to those who demonstrate their loyalty, and I know of something that you can do to curry favor with him. Before building up his... ehh... workforce, he dealt in the furs of animals. He is quite skilled in the art of leatherworking. The furrier can do wonders with even the most tattered pelts. The dried oasis to the east is said to be home to a rare breed of coyote. Their furs would make a very thoughtful gift.

Title: Budd's Plan
Objective: Obtain 6 pieces of Neferset Armor.
Text: I've an idea! Trust me, it's a good one this time! Get some of those shiny armor pieces the cat-people wear. This plan cannot fail. Trust me.

Title: Down to the Scar
Objective: Find Theldurin the Lost at the Scar of the Worldbreaker in the Badlands.
Text: The Badlands are home to some unusual people, many of whom have been here for quite a long time. For example, there were three gentlemen who were staying here in town. I forget their names... the dwarf was Theldurin, I think? Anyhow, they headed south with a pack full of ale a couple of days ago, and haven't been heard from since. I think they were headed to that big scar. Would you mind checking in on them? I'd like to make sure that they're alright.

Title: Efficient Excavations
Objective: Bring 'Efficient Excavations' to Belloc Brightblade in Schnottz's Landing.
Text: This manual describes outlandish theories on how to efficiently manage large groups of workers as they engage in the manual labor of various types of excavation. It becomes clear to you that the author of the book is the figure in charge of the over-aggressive pillagers here. Perhaps an introduction is in order.

Title: Traitors!
Objective: Hide behind the Neferset Frond and Uncover the Neferset Secret.
Text: Please, stranger. You must help me. I came here to investigate the arrival of a powerful ally to the Neferset, only to be betrayed by my closest allies and given up to the enemy. Go to the terrace above us to the east and find the information I failed to uncover. You'll need to hide from the Neferset. Perhaps you can hide behind one of the large plants on the platform to conceal your presence. Do this for me and I will help your friends find their way to safety.

Title: Eastern Hospitality
Objective: Belloc Brightblade wants you to mingle with the guests at Schnottz's Landing.
Text: The commander is quite busy now, I'm afraid. The demands of an operation such as this require much of his attention these days. While you wait to speak with him, why don't you mingle with some of our guests? We have invited a variety of Azeroth's most illustrious figures to be present when we unlock the secrets of this region. I am confident that you will find them most captivating.

Title: Smoke in Their Eyes
Objective: Burn Stacks of Hay inside the Lost City of the Tol'vir in Uldum.
Text: I'm not sure what knuckle-headed plan your friend is concocting, but we're going to need a distraction if we're to stand a chance of escaping. Take the torch from that brazier and go start some fires. Perhaps if we divert the Neferset scum's attention away for a few minutes, we'll have the opportunity we need.

Title: Armored to the Teeth
Objective: Kill Baron Silverlaine and Commander Springvale.
Text: We've hit an unexpected snag in our assault on the keep. It seems the servants that tended to Baron Silverlaine and Commander Springvale in life do so now in death as well, and Godfrey has placed them directly between us and him. Not to worry, we won't let them be anything more than a minor inconvenience. Eliminate Silverlaine and Springvale both and not only will their guards no longer have masters to direct them, it will place us that much closer to our final goal.

Title: Fighting Tooth and Claw
Objective: Kill Lord Walden.
Text: It appears that Lord Walden has finally taken notice to our presence and has heightened his defenses. It's worthless really... nothing will deter our pack. The path ahead to him is rife with powerful Scourge minions, but I trust that you will be able to clear the path for the rest of us to follow in. Once we kill Walden, it should be a straight shot to his cowardly leader.

Title: Onward to the Blasted Lands
Objective: Journey to the Blasted Lands and speak with Enohar Thunderbrew in Nethergarde Keep.
Text: We appreciate your assistance here in this swamp. I would like to inform you that I have received correspondence from Nethergarde Keep. Enohar Thunderbrew has requested help in investigating the shipwrecks of the Red Reaches, but we have had none willing to make the journey, and I could not leave the Harborage. Nethergarde Keep sits in the Blasted Lands, south of the Swamp of Sorrows. Do not journey too close to Stonard on your way.

Title: The Harborage
Objective: Deliver the Draenethyst Crystals to Anchorite Avuun.
Text: Anchorite Avuun is one of our uncorrupted brethren, what other races know as Draenei. He came to The Harborage to heal us, and try to find a cure. It is he who sent me here to collect these crystals. He watches over a very sick friend now... and despite sending word to the Exodar itself, he has not found any aid so far. Could you bring these crystals to him? You may be the only one able to assist him.

Title: A Hero's Weapon
Objective: Meet with Odyn at his forge and raise your weapon at the indicated location.
Text: I've been watching you. Time and again you've led the Valarjar to war with your weapon held high! Time and again the halls of Valhalas have thundered with the cheers of your victory! Now that the enhancements to the forge have been completed, it is time that your weapon's true potential be unleashed! Meet with me at the forge, hero.

Title: A Hero's Weapon
Objective: Approach the indicated location before the Altar of Ancient Kings and raise your weapon.
Text: t, you've brought together the Silver Hand like no t has done before. You've shown us that with determination and faith in the holy light we can overcome any challenge. Following in your example our workmen have toiled hard to improve the Altar of Ancient Kings, allowing it to unlock the true potential of your weapon. Their work is now complete! Step forward when you are ready and we shall begin.

Title: A Hero's Weapon
Objective: Approach the indicated location before the Crucible of the Uncrowned and raise your weapon.
Text: I'm pleased to say that the improvements to the crucible are complete! When you are prepared, we shall use it to unlock the true potential of your weapons!

Title: A Hero's Weapon
Objective: Approach the indicated location before the Altar of the Eternal Hunt and raise your weapon.
Text: I'm pleased to say that the improvements to the Altar of the Eternal Hunt are complete! When you are ready, we shall use it to unlock the full potential of your weapon!

Title: A Hero's Weapon
Objective: Approach the indicated location before the Altar of Light and Shadow and raise your weapon.
Text: t, in our short time together you have done much to aid the Conclave. Now, with the work upon the Altar of Light and Shadow complete, it is time that we aid you. We have discovered a method to awaken the full power of your weapon! Please, step before the altar and raise your weapon high.

Title: A Hero's Weapon
Objective: Approach the indicated location before the Ancient Elemental Altar and raise your weapon.
Text: Farseer, since you have joined us you have done much to aid the Earthen Ring. Your efforts have not gone unnoticed. The spirits have watched all that you have done and are pleased. They also have shown me a technique that will unleash the true power of your weapon! The ritual is ready. When you are prepared we can begin.

Title: A Hero's Weapon
Objective: Approach the indicated location before the Felblood Altar and raise your weapon.
Text: t, our research into the Felblood Altar has proven useful. We've developed a ritual that should unleash the full powers of your artifact weapon! Say the word, and we shall begin the ritual at once!

Title: A Hero's Weapon
Objective: Approach the indicated location before the Forge of the Guardian and raise your weapon.
Text: t, in our short time together you have done much for our order. Through your words and deeds we've been inspired to redouble our efforts and I'm proud to report that we've discovered a new technique that may be of use to you. If you have a moment, t, I would be pleased to show you the fruit of our research.

Title: Sniffing Them Out
Objective: Kill Baron Ashbury.
Text: I could smell Godfrey and his companions a mile away from here. They did an exceedingly poor job covering their tracks in flight. It will be the mistake that puts the final nail in their coffins. One of them is very close, and though the scent has changed slightly in undeath, I'm fairly certain it's Ashbury's. Go inside and tear him to pieces, we'll ensure the Forsaken do not intervene with our task.

Title: A Hero's Weapon
Objective: Approach the indicated location before the Cursed Forge of the Nathrezim and raise your weapon.
Text: I'm pleased to report that the improvements to the Forge are complete! When you are ready, we shall use it to unlock the true potential of your weapon!

Title: A Hero's Weapon
Objective: Approach the indicated location before the Seed of Ages and raise your weapon.
Text: t, in our short time together you have done much to aid the Circle. We are inspired by your determination and have developed a new technique that will bind the power of your weapon with the Emerald Dream itself! Everything is prepared. When you are ready we shall begin.

Title: The Heart of the Temple
Objective: Speak with Lord Itharius again inside the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
Text: I must confess I have a more personal involvement in this affair. One of the first of the green dragons corrupted here was my brother, Eranikus. I thought Eranikus gone, lost forever to the darkest rifts of nightmare, but I have heard that his shade has emerged within the temple. I know not whether it is truly him, or an empty, mournful echo. If you wish to help me further, return to the Hall of Masks and journey through the archway into the true sanctum of the temple. I will find you there.

Title: Ruag's Report
Objective: Deliver the Splinterspear Report to Dispatch Commander Ruag in Stonard.
Text: Here is Ruag's report. Let him know his scout is still here. Do not speak of Helgrum. I will not distract others with news of tragedy. I have to be strong. We all have to be strong.

Title: The Titans' Trove
Objective: Investigate the Trove of the Watchers.
Text: As the second defender falls to the ground, a chest appears in the back of the chamber. Could this be what they were protecting?

Title: The Titans' Trove
Objective: Investigate the Trove of the Watchers.
Text: As the second defender falls to the ground, a chest appears in the back of the chamber. Could this be what they were protecting?

Title: With Dying Breath
Objective: Witness Helgrum's last moments.
Text: He stirs... Do not leave. Please, honor Helgrum with me. You have done so much for him.

Title: Blessing of the Green Dragonflight
Objective: Speak with Lord Itharius atop the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
Text: You have done well. Jammal'an may have escaped our grasp, but his retreat paves the way for me to enter the temple as I desire. Stay where you are and do not move. I will hasten your return by pulling your spirit to me through the Emerald Dream. This may cause slight drowsiness.

Title: Secrets of the Mire
Objective: Collect 10 samples of Invigorated Silt from Shifting Mireglobs.
Text: Helgrum's wounds fester in the swamp air. They swell and ooze, filling his final moments with suffering. I must have something to coat them with. The spirits move through this mire. They inhabit the mud itself, pushing it along in clumps of fine soil that take on lives of their own The spirits of the cool, pure mud will offer him some comfort. Please, gather it for me, for I cannot abandon his side.

Title: Last Regrets
Objective: Collect Duskfang's Hide.
Text: If I am reduced to groveling, I may as well ask everything I can. There is one last favor I would ask of you, one more task a shamed orc pleads for. Helgrum had a prized prey. Duskfang, eater of ogres, the great panther of Misty Valley. He would never allow himself the leisure of stalking it. Though he wanted badly to hunt, our scouting duties were too important. If he cannot hunt Duskfang in this world, he can hunt the beast in the next. Take up the hunt for him; bring Duskfang's pelt to me.

Title: Neeka Bloodscar
Objective: Speak with Neeka Bloodscar at Splinterspear Junction.
Text: There is much work to do in recovering from the assault and bracing ourselves for the next one. I will need coordination from all of our scouts. Neeka Bloodscar is our finest tracker, trained in the harsh Badlands. She has been sent west to Splinterspear Junction to watch for Alliance activity. Go to Neeka. Tell her of what has occured in Stonard. Assist her in any way she requires.

Title: The Purespring
Objective: Collect 8 Purespring Motes from Purespring Elementals.
Text: Helgrum's breathing slows. His time is near. I need water. Elementals roam the ponds of Purespring Cavern. The water that flows from them is the purest in this swamp. Even if I could risk leaving Helgrum's side, my axe would shudder in my hand. I must beg you once again to pity me, for his comfort. Bring me the motes of the elementals, that his final drink may be pure and refreshing.

Title: Prayerblossom
Objective: Collect 10 sprigs of Prayerblossom from the Shifting Mire.
Text: I have been ruined. I placed my strength in Helgrum, and now it bleeds from his gaping wounds. Wounds too deep to heal, flesh that refuses to knit. He murmurs in fear, consumed by fever and pain. I cannot leave his side. Not now. Please, I ask you in shame to gather herbs for me. The prayerblossom that grows in the swamp is an old remedy for soothing. With enough of it, his pain might be stilled.

Title: The Purespring
Objective: Collect 6 Purespring Motes from Purespring Elementals.
Text: Magtoor has told me of the shamanism that the Broken practice. The great Nobundo once said that the path of the elements may, in a way, be another way to the Light. I can only hope there is some truth in this. The elementals that gather near Purespring Cavern to the south are a source of truly pristine water. They can be chaotic and violent, but the pure water harvested from them will be the perfect conduit for the blessing of the Light. Please, bring me this water.

Title: Breath of Mist
Objective: Collect 5 Smoky Crystals from Misty Grell.
Text: The Grell are forest spirits that wander the Misty Valley to the east. Though they resemble imps, I have found no demonic traces among the ones I've studied. They are, as far as I can tell, uncorrupted. Those that dwell in the valley move as one with the wind, summoning gusts of breeze at their whim. This pure air may be incorporated into my remedy for poor Magtoor. Please, gather the smoky crystals found within the grells' bodies for me. I must exhaust every potential cure.

Title: Tailgunner!
Objective: Use the tailgun to defend the Schnottz Bomber.
Text: Okay, I've softened this guy up, how about you help me finish him off? I've got a plan for our escape, but it'll require a lot of guts and a little luck. You up for it? Just follow my lead...

Title: They Don't Know What They've Got Here
Objective: Create the Titan Activation Device.
Text: Listen. I don't have a lot of time to talk here. These guys are excavating relics from this site and taking pieces of ancient technology that we need! I need you to check their crates for pieces of an ancient activation device. The officers should have the codes you'll need to open them. Hurry! We can't let them load this stuff into their planes!

Title: That Gleam in his Eye
Objective: Speak to Harrison Jones at the Obelisk of the Sun.
Text: If you're looking for Harrison, you just missed him. He was going on and on about his latest discovery, and how everything was beginning to make sense. Whatever... he certainly wasn't making sense to me. I tried to convince him to stay here and just enjoy a few desert sunsets with me, but there's no talking to him when he gets that gleam in his eye. Perhaps you'd be willing to check in on him? He was headed to that big monolith, south of here.

Title: I've Got This Guy
Objective: Kill 10 Schnottz Air Troopers.
Text: Good timing. Seems I'm not the only one interested in these obelisks, and these fellas aren't inclined to compare notes... I think I can handle this guy. Maybe you could take care of a few of his friends before they make their way over here?

Title: Ignition
Objective: Recover the Lens of the Sun.
Text: This guy just won't go down! You're doin' great, kid. Only one thing left to do. According to my research, there should be a titan statue down below. Use the device to activate it, then break it down. If my theory is correct, that statue holds the key to reactivating this obelisk.

Title: The Hidden Clutch
Objective: Speak with Rhea at The Hidden Clutch in the Badlands.
Text: With the major black dragons out of the Badlands, it is now safe to move the egg again. You will find me on a small plateau, north of New Kargath. Come and find me.

Title: Gargal, the Behemoth
Objective: Use Gargal's Shield Wall and Gargal's Mighty Shout.
Text: You may not have noticed, but I'm pretty big, as far as orcs go. I make sure that my two pals here don't get into too much trouble. They're small, and they don't have a big shield like me. I'm big, and I can handle a few monsters hitting me! Plus, if I'm careful, I can usually get them to hit my shield instead! I can protect you, too. Come on, let's go practice for a bit. I'll make sure the enemies attack me, and not you.

Title: Rheastrasza's Gift
Objective: Wait as Rhea retrieves the egg from the Hidden Clutch.
Text: Wait here. I will retrieve the egg.

Title: Their Hunt Continues
Objective: Defeat General Jirakka, Moldarr, and 6 Blackflight dragonspawn.
Text: The black dragonflight means business. As you've probably already noticed, they've taken over a large portion of New Kargath. These troops are under the command of General Jirakka and his champion, Moldarr. They must be stopped.

Title: The Wrath of a Dragonflight
Objective: Slay Kalaran the Annihilator and 4 Darkflight Soldiers.
Text: Hello. It looks like you four have had time to become well-acquainted. I have my first assignment for you. Kalaran, an ancient black dragon of considerable power, has joined in the hunt for the egg we are protecting. We need to stop him before he gets too close. You will find him and his minions at the Dustbowl, east of New Kargath. Hunt him down and defeat him. You will likely need the help of your new mercenary allies.

Title: The Sorrow and the Fury
Objective: Slay Nyxondra and 12 of Nyxondra's Broodlings.
Text: My greatest regret is the treatment that we - no, I - gave to Nyxondra. I forced her to lay eggs, then I performed experiments on them. Over, and over, and over again. Even as a mother myself, I can only imagine her sorrow. No... I mustn't be weak. Our work is, after all, for the benefit of future generations of black dragons. Her sacrifice was necessary. She circles the Ruins of Kargath, northwest of New Kargath, insane with fury. Please, heroes... put her out of her misery.

Title: The Bad Dogs
Objective: Speak with Amakkar at New Kargath in the Badlands.
Text: In my haste to escape from Lethlor Ravine, I forgot to tie up one loose end: Nyxondra. She's free, and she's sounded the alarm among the black dragonflight. Half the flight is here in the western Badlands, combing for this egg. I'll take care of hiding the egg. You're going to take care of some of the more troublesome dragons. And you'll have help. I've paid off a couple of mercenaries to help you. You'll find them inside this inn.

Title: Amakkar, Jack of All Trades
Objective: Use Amakkar's Kidney Shot and Amakkar's Pocket Potion.
Text: Before we get too crazy with the dragon-killing, let me tell you a little bit about how I fight. I'm not terribly strong or stalwart like these other two, but I've got a few tricks. At your command I'll stun your enemies to keep 'em held still. I also make sure to keep a few potions around for tight spots. Why don't we practice fighting together? Head out into the field, and you can see what it's like to fight with a real orc.

Title: Jurrix the Striker
Objective: Use Jurrix's Fiery Blast and Jurrix's Time Warp.
Text: Oh, you want to talk? Fine. I'm Jurrix, the only merc here with half a brain. The only one with any bite to my attacks, too. The only reason I keep these meat shields around is to keep myself from getting killed. Listen, you're the boss of this operation. You give the word, and I'll send a fireball right through your target's heart. If things start getting hectic, I can even warp time a bit so you can fit in a few extra attacks. Why don't we go try fighting together?

Title: Return to Blam
Objective: Bring the Eye of the Watchers to Dr. Hieronymus Blam at Agmond's End in the Badlands.
Text: Inside the chest, you find a small, circular device, resting upon a cushion. If there are any titan artifacts to be found here in the tomb, this is it. You resolve to bring it back to Dr. Blam.

Title: The Sentinel's Game
Objective: Complete the Sentinel's Game by connecting the two red statues.
Text: As you place the statue in its place, several other stone statues appear in the room. One more ruby-colored statue also appears, in a small enclosure on the far end of the room. You hear a voice: "The Sentinel watches. The Sentinel protects. The Sentinel's vision never falters." That red statue on the other side of the room looks important. Perhaps you should try to connect the two red statues?

Title: New Kargath
Objective: Bring the Purified Black Dragon Egg to Rhea at New Kargath in the Badlands.
Text: D... did you see that? Incredible! My titan thing idea worked! With your help, of course. We'll want to get these back to Rhea. She's not at Lethlor Ravine anymore; it sounds like she blew her cover when she transformed into her true form in front of all those whelps. She's now in the west, staying at a large Horde establishment dubbed "New Kargath". She'll be waiting for you. And for that egg.

Title: Ancient Protectors
Objective: Investigate The Warden and The Sentinel.
Text: You heard a good amount of rumbling happen in the tomb's central chamber. Those two large statues did look awfully suspicious.

Title: The Sentinel's Pawn
Objective: Find a use for the Sentinel's Pawn within the Tomb of the Watchers in the Badlands.
Text: We found this small red statue on the corpse of one of those Explorers' League archaeologists. Sadly, it wasn't us who killed him. The local wildlife had already taken care of that. The statue is well-crafted, but apparently bereft of magical power. You may use it for whatever means you deem necessary.

Title: The Warden's Pawn
Objective: Find a use for the Warden's Pawn within the Tomb of the Watchers in the Badlands.
Text: One of the few items of worth that we managed to loot from these ruins is this small jade statue. We believe it to be a key of some sort, but we're unable to determine what it opens. As such, it is useless to me. Perhaps you'll have some better luck with it.

Title: Survival of the Fattest
Objective: Obtain 6 pieces of Dustbelcher Meat and 10 sheets of Dustbelcher Silk.
Text: We're hard-up for supplies, stranger. With the black dragons raining destruction on our hunting grounds, we have no way to get food. The ogres to our south, however, have exactly what we need. Within their grotto you should find plenty of meat and crafting supplies. They may put up a fight. Be on your guard.

Title: Bloodwatcher Point
Objective: Speak with High Examiner Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher at Bloodwatcher Point in the Badlands.
Text: I've got an idea, but it's a bit of a long shot. Thankfully, long shots happen to be a specialty of mine. North of here, the Reliquary has uncovered a new set of titan ruins beneath the sands. If there's anything older and wiser than dragons, it's titans. Heck, I've heard rumors that the titans CREATED the dragons. Talk to High Examiner Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher at their camp to the northeast. He'll have more information than I do about these titans. What did I tell you? It's a long shot.

Title: A Hero's Weapon
Objective: Approach the indicated location before the Soul Forge and raise your weapon.
Text: I'm pleased to report that the improvements to the Soul Forge are complete! When you are ready, we shall use it to unlock the true potential of your weapon!

Title: Half-Ton Holdouts
Objective: Slay 12 Dustbelcher Combatants. You may kill Dustbelcher Maulers or Dustbelcher Shaman.
Text: My grunts have got this dragon problem under control. Besides, I can't have an upstart  like you barging in and ruining our battle plans. You want work? Fine, I'll give you work. Investigate the ogre camp to our southwest. From what I've heard, a small army of combatants seems to have appeared outside of their hovel. We can't sit and wait for them to flank us, soldier... especially while we're already embroiled with black dragons. Thin their ranks before they thin ours.

Title: It's Not About History, It's About Power
Objective: Obtain a Broken Chalice, a Dusty Vase, an Earthen Hieroglyph, and a Trogg Tool.
Text: The Explorers' League may have a yeoman's knowledge of the actual act of digging. What they lack, however, is the good sense to USE the artifacts that they dig up. They stow their treasures in stagnant museums instead of using these items of power for their true purpose. The dwarves are fools. Fortunately, they die easily. You'll find them digging into canyon walls north of here. Take whatever you can out of their stubby-fingered hands, then return it to me.

Title: The Warden's Game
Objective: Complete the Warden's Game by teleporting the Warden's Pawns into inward-facing positions.
Text: You see the statue split into two, then four, then eight identical statues in a square formation. You hear a voice, not through your ears, but in the back of your mind: "A true warden does not face OUTWARD, searching for signs of danger. A true warden keeps his gaze INWARD, always focused on protecting his quarry." Perhaps this is a riddle of some sort?

Title: Defending the Isles
Objective: Complete 10 World Quests.
Text: As druids, our charge is to defend nature... and in turn, our home, Azeroth. Conflict breaks out all across the Broken Isles. The Burning Legion pushes forward, and numerous allies call out for our aid. We must focus our efforts on defense, before we can mount an offense against the Nightmare. Help our allies across the Broken Isles, then return to me when the situation is under control.

Title: A Gathering for the Grand Master
Objective: Report to Iron-Body Ponshu in the Temple of Five Dawns.
Text: , err... t, Your presence is requested for a matter of the greatest importance at the Temple of Five Dawns. Master Ponshu and the rest of the Broken Temple are waiting for you!

Title: Lumenstone
Objective: Collect 50 Lumenstone by sending champions on "Lumenstone" missions.
Text: To prepare for the battle, we will need the best armor and weapons we can get. Lumenstone is an enchanted material that can withstand great amounts of fel magic. It is found in rare quantities all over the Broken Isles, and many of the native races use it in their own metalcrafting. We should send our champions to target enemies around the Broken Isles - there should be plenty of lumenstone to be found in their stockpiles.

Title: United As One
Objective: Make your way to the Sanctum of Light to speak with Lady Liadrin, and hear the council of war.
Text: You and Delas have had dealings with the paladins before, maybe it's possible they will grant you an audience with their war council.Head to the Sanctum of Light and ask the paladins to help us defend Netherlight Temple from Balnazzar's attack.

Title: Fortifying the Temple
Objective: Complete 10 World Quests.
Text: We've all worked so hard turning this temple into something all priests can be proud of, it would be a shame to see it fall to the Burning Legion. We must strengthen our defenses in preparation for the attack. With the right resources, we can make the temple a nearly impenetrable fortress.

Title: A Light in the Darkness
Objective: United with the paladins, defend Netherlight Temple and slay Lord Balnazzar.
Text: The Burning Legion has begun their attack! I will remain here and prepare the temple's defenses. You must meet our allies in Dalaran and let them know that the battle has begun! Make haste. I do not know how long we will be able to keep Balnazzar at bay.

Title: Allies of the Light
Objective: Save Silver Hand Knights or Conclave Priests, and rescue Arator the Redeemer and Delas Moonfang.
Text: Both Arator and Delas are still somewhere on this forsaken rock, as well as many of our other allies. We cannot leave them.

Title: High Priest of Netherlight
Objective: Listen as you are honored by the Conclave of priests.
Text: You have fulfilled the prophecy, but more than that, you have united the priests of Azeroth.We should take a moment to recognize all that you have accomplished.

Title: The Mind of the Enemy
Objective: Find the Legion Intelligence, Star Map, and Image of Velen, then slay Brood Queen Aramis.
Text: The demon jailors spoke of an upcoming invasion. Their army is gathering for something big, and it worries me greatly. Let us find whatever information we can about their plans.

Title: Crossing Legion Lines
Objective: Use the demon portal at Felblaze Ingress to enter Niskara and find Aponi Brightmane.
Text: I've received word from the Highlord that a group of paladins and priests were captured after a battle broke out at Felblaze Ingress. Your priestess, Delas Moonfang, was among those captured. They've been taken through the demon portal and into the Legion stronghold of Niskara. We will need the assistance of the Conclave if we have any hope of recovering them.

Title: Into the Void
Objective: Read Natalie's Journal at the catacomb's shadow altar to enter the void and recover her spirit.
Text: This is without a doubt Natalie's writing. The entry was scrawled in haste, but the message is clear: The spell within this journal will lead us to Natalie's spirit, but it needs to be incanted at a shadow altar within the catacombs. Odessa and I have a duty to watch over Natalie's body, but with your considerable power, you should be able to perform the spell with ease.

Title: Secrets of the Void
Objective: Recover Natalie's Journal from Twilight Lord Urgrok.
Text: Our leader was murdered for her beliefs, or so most would believe.Natalie Seline knew her fate, and took steps to protect herself from an inevitable death.The night her attackers came, Natalie sent her spirit to the Void, its location known only to Natalie herself.She penned a spell to retrieve it in one of her many journals, but the tome has since fallen into the hands of those who wished her dead in the first place.Without her journal, we will never be able to recover her spirit.

Title: Forgotten Shadows
Objective: Head to Duskwood and meet with a member of the Cult of Forgotten Shadows.
Text: The Light walks among us, as does one of our enemies. You have done well to bring the prophecy to life, but it is not yet complete.The shadows must rise, and to do so, the Cult of Forgotten Shadows must be restored.You will find the few remaining followers at the cemetery in Duskwood. They linger there near the grave of their fallen leader.

Title: Unexpected Guests
Objective: Return to Alonsus Faol in Netherlight Temple.
Text: You helped me escape my fate by freeing me from the gallows, but allowing me to fight the Scarlet Onslaught by your side has truly freed my heart and mind from the guilt I have felt for so long.I want to be a part of something greater than myself, a noble cause that won't distort the meaning of the Light.Let me travel to your temple and beg forgiveness of the Prophet. I may not be a welcome guest, but it's a journey I must make to complete my redemption.

Title: Scarlet Redemption
Objective: Help Mariella the Heretic redeem herself by killing members of the Scarlet Onslaught in New Hearthglen.
Text: The Light shines upon me! For the first time in my life, I feel it!I was without hope, ready to die for the things I had done in the name of the Scarlet Crusade, but then you appeared! You are my chance at redemption.Please, let me prove to you that I am worthy of a second chance. Let me slay those I used to be loyal to!

Title: Rising Shadows
Objective: Return to Alonsus Faol at Netherlight Temple.
Text: News of my return will spread fast among those who share my beliefs. Soon Azeroth will see the rise of Shadows, but I imagine this is not news to you.Whatever your plan may be, I hope it continues to see the Cult of Forgotten Shadows as allies.

Title: Onslaught Envoy
Objective: Find a new ally among old enemies in New Hearthglen.
Text: A few defectors have been discovered among the Scarlet Onslaught in Northrend. I know it's difficult to think that any within their ranks could be useful to our cause, but we must make an attempt. The prophecy says an old enemy will become an ally, so it's worth it to investigate and see if these defectors can be brought to the Light.

Title: Apostate Liberation
Objective: Rescue Onslaught Apostates within New Hearthglen.
Text: There are others like me, you know. Others that have removed the veil that the Scarlet Crusade has kept over our eyes for so long.They've been placed in cages, treated like animals, simply because their beliefs no longer line up with what the Onslaught deems is right and holy.They wish to redeem themselves. We should try to free them, if you think their lives are worth saving.

Title: Infiltrating Our Enemies
Objective: Interact with the Command Map and complete the mission, "Infiltrating Our Enemies".
Text: With the Light at our side, we should focus our efforts on figuring out who among our enemies could be a potential ally.Any of your champions should be capable of infiltrating enemy ranks, giving us a better understanding of how to approach this.Even so, it is a delicate task. Proceed with caution.

Title: Awakening the Light
Objective: Collect Pure Holy Light by completing Class Hall missions.
Text: This spark will only know its full potential once it's been filled with pure Light, gleaned from the holiest places in our world. Nurture this spark, and it may grow to walk among you.

Title: Velen's Vision
Objective: Use the Lens of the Tides to witness Prophet Velen's vision.
Text: I have everything I need to bring forth a vision, but the question remains: are you ready to witness it? Even the smallest glimpse into the future can weigh heavy on your soul. Once I ingest the elixir, the vision will come quickly. Gazing into the Lens of the Tides will allow you to see what I see. Let me know when you are ready to begin.

Title: Demonic Runes
Objective: Collect Demonic Runestones from demons throughout the Broken Isles.
Text: I cannot stand by idly and allow the Legion to destroy our home.I've been studying their language for some time, deciphering any runes I can get my hands on, but my supply is severely limited.If I had more runes to study, it's possible that I may discover something that will help us in locating Balnazzar.

Title: The Morons' League
Objective: Obtain 15 Dark Iron Heads.
Text: I need your help in a little project I'm working on. It falls into a realm I like to call "defensive archaeology". I like to bury non-magical items in conspicuous places to fool those Alliance idiots into thinking they've found something valuable. Hmm... Dark Iron dwarves wander Hammertoe's Digsite and Angor Fortress, to the north. Bring their heads back to me. Yes, that's right, their heads. Once the flesh is stripped, we can use those skulls to interfere with the dwarves' work.

Title: Forcible Acquisition
Objective: Search for treasure in the bottom floor of Angor Fortress.
Text: I've got a little proposition for you, if you're interested. The Dark Iron dwarves were here long before we arrived. That means that, once these titan ruins opened up, the Dark Irons were the first ones in there, looting all the choice items. I'll bet they've still got those treasures locked up inside Angor Fortress, northwest of here. I want you to find such a treasure... then steal it.

Title: Secrets of the Mire
Objective: Collect 10 samples of Invigorated Silt from Shifting Mireglobs.
Text: The Shifting Mire takes its name from a unique phenomenon. By some force, the extremely fine silt will collect, and move on its own accord, travelling as if alive. I originally worried this was some corruptive force, but my studies have shown the opposite; whatever energy invigorates this soil is positive in nature. Perhaps such vibrant life can be imparted onto the Broken to reawaken what they once were. The silt may not take kindly to being collected. But please, help gather it.

Title: Halls of Valor: The Light Within
Objective: Recover a Spark of Light from Hyrja within the Halls of Valor dungeon.
Text: We cannot ignore the Prophet's vision. To do so would mean that everything we know and hold dear will be lost to the Legion. We must focus on what we know, and that is that the Light must walk among us. Within the Halls of Valor you will find an ascending val'kyr by the name of Hyrja. Recover a spark of her Light and release it within our temple.

Title: Eye of Azshara: Looking Through the Lens
Objective: Recover the Lens of the Tide from Lady Hatecoil within the Eye of Azshara dungeon.
Text: We have what we need to create Velen's elixir, but in order for others to be able to witness his vision, we'll need to find something that can be used to project images from the mind. A lens from the nearby naga should work well, but I don't think they're going to be too eager to give it up.

Title: Prayerblossom
Objective: Collect 10 sprigs of Prayerblossom from the Shifting Mire.
Text: I have worked for years to try to cure the affliction of the Broken. The foul energies that corrupted them did more than twist their bodies; it took the comfort of the Light from them. They cannot feel its warmth. I cannot let Magtoor pass on in darkness. Before he worsened, I was studying prayerblossom, a flower that grows in the shifting mire. It grows hardy in even the darkest shade. I beg of you, gather these flowers for me, for Magtoor's sake.

Title: Aviana's Legacy
Objective: Locate Choluna at the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.
Text: Your expertise is needed elsewhere. Just southwest of the World Tree you will find the Shrine of Aviana, home to the Druids of the Talon. Aviana, the matron of all winged creatures, gave her life for this world ten thousand years ago. I sense her shrine is being threatened, as are the druids who guard it. Seek out Choluna, one of the wisest of the winged druids, deep within the shrine.

Title: To Marshtide Watch
Objective: Speak with Joanna Blueheart at Marshtide Watch.
Text: Regardless of whether you assist me within the temple, your people must be told of what is brewing here. North of the temple, humans of your mortal Alliance have built what they call Marshtide Watch. They war with the Horde across the swamp, a raging conflict that I forsee only worsening. It is not my role to interfere in mortal affairs. I simply ask you bring warning to your people of what lurks within the temple.

Title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Earl of Evisceration!
Objective: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Lord Geoffery Tulvan!
Text: You're going to have your hands full with this one, pal. We've got a seasoned gentleman warrior here! He hails from Gilneas, and he's out to prove that he's the best warrior this side of Azeroth. You better pull up those boots and zip up those pants, because it's going to get downright feral up in here. Give me the word when you're down for some punishment.

Title: The Dragon and the Temple
Objective: Speak with Lord Itharius atop the outer steps of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
Text: These serpents must be from the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. I already had a hint... Not a few days ago, I had a visitor stop by and ask me to keep an eye out for such things. An elf by the name of Itharius. I'm sure he didn't think I could see through his form... he was a green dragon in disguise, come here to help his fallen brothers no doubt. He may very well be on to something. Itharius left for the temple itself. Perhaps you'd better go look for him there. Dark things are afoot.

Title: To Stonard
Objective: Speak with Dispatch Commander Ruag at Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.
Text: Regardless of whether you assist me within the temple, your people must be told of what is brewing here. Southwest of the temple is the Horde town of Stonard. The orcs there wage war with the new human arrivals to the swamp, a raging conflict that I forsee only worsening. It is not my role to interfere in mortal affairs. I simply ask you bring warning to your people of what lurks within the temple.

Title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Wayward Wildhammer!
Objective: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Sully Kneecapper!
Text: You're going to love this one! The Wildhammer heard you were entering the arena and they're determined to make sure you don't leave it. Time for some good ol'  on dwarf action! Let me know when you're ready to do this!

Title: The Crucible of Carnage: Calder's Creation!
Objective: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat the Cadaver Collage!
Text: Grim and gory, this next match is sure to have the crowd groanin' one way or another. Calder Gray has been gathering the bodyparts of defeated challengers and building the perfect champion. This thing is the ultimate cobbled collaboration of corpsified combatants. A magnificent mashup of mangled monstrosities. Are you ready to get messy?! Cause I am! Let me know when you're ready so we can get this thing started!

Title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Twilight Terror!
Objective: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Emberscar the Devourer!
Text: We've got someone you'll really love to hate this time around. I wasn't sure at first if I should let him into the pit, but a fight's a fight! And who am I to turn down some guaranteed cash?! This guy hails from the Twilight Citadel itself, and comes toting a toasty punch. Better move fast and watch your back! Just give me the word when you're ready for some action.

Title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Deadly Dragonmaw!
Objective: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Torg Drakeflayer!
Text: You're going to love this one! The Dragonmaw heard you were entering the arena and they're determined to make sure you don't leave it. Time for some good ol'  on orc action! Let me know when you're ready to do this!

Title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Bloodeye Bruiser!
Objective: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Hurp'derp!
Text: Well well, if it isn't the once champion of anguish! I'm seeing good money in the future now that you're here! We're gonna be rollin in the dough, buddy! Filthy RICH! Anyway, this is some old Dragonmaw fighting pit. Didn't take much modification to tune it up to our uses. I put out a few feelers, and got some heavy hitters from all around Azeroth to join in the carnage. Bout time to make some gold! You know the drill. When you're ready, let me know and we'll get this show on the road!

Title: The Lost Ones
Objective: Slay 12 Lost Ones in the Fallow Sanctuary.
Text: When the Dark Portal closed many years ago, regret and fear seized many of us who had come to these lands. In their despair, they cursed the name of the Light, and sank into violence and hatred. These fallen souls are now the Lost Ones, little more than mindless monsters, attacking all who approach. They grow more corrupt by the day, and as they die off, they have begun to kidnap from the Harborage.. They are beyond help. Their suffering must end. Will you put them from their misery?

Title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Bloodeye Bruiser!
Objective: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Hurp'derp!
Text: I'll tell you what, buddy, this place is a far cry from the rolling plains of Nagrand or the bloodbowl in Zul'Drak, but hey, I go where the gold's at! So welcome to Twi-Hi, pal. You're new to this pit, so let me set you straight. I'm the fight promoter and this feisty troll next to me is Wodin, my bodyguard. You're the entertainment. When you wanna fight, let me know and I'll set up the match. If you're ready and got a group of friends with you, we can start! What do you say?

Title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Bloodeye Bruiser!
Objective: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Hurp'derp!
Text: I was wondering when you'd show up! Having a past champion of the Ring of Blood here will be a huge draw! We're gonna be rich, buddy! RICH! Anyway, this is some old Dragonmaw fighting pit. Didn't take much modification to tune it up to our uses. I put out a few feelers, and got some heavy hitters from all around Azeroth to join in the carnage. Bout time to make some gold! You know the drill. When you're ready, let me know and we'll get this show on the road!

Title: Tides of Darkness
Objective: Slay 6 Marshtide Knights.
Text: We have suffered many losses. Dreadmaul Hold has sent ogres from the Blasted Lands as reinforcements, but they can only send so many; the Alliance attacks them as well, even as we speak. The Alliance has countered our ogres with mounted knights, a strategy that served them well in the Second War. We will need our strongest warriors to turn the tide of battle! Return to the Bloodmire, and bring down those knights!

Title: Marking the Fallen
Objective: Use the Banner of the Fallen to mark 7 Fallen Stonard Warriors.
Text: Many warriors have met death to bring us victory. The fate of a true orc. I have seen the way the Alliance loots the bodies of our fallen, clutching at our goods like packrats. They will not defile our fallen heroes on this field. Take these wards with you to the Bloodmire. Place them on the bodies of our fallen warriors. I will be watching, to see how many have fallen, and to honor their sacrifice. Let us hope the spirits give us aid for our respect.

Title: Reinforcements Denied
Objective: Slay 3 Marshtide Mages.
Text: The Alliance has brought in their mages to summon more reinforcements directly to the battlefield from beyond their fortress. This must be stopped! Their numbers are few, but a single portal can turn the tide of battle. Attack their mages and shut off those portals!

Title: Rheastrasza's Gift
Objective: Wait as Rhea retrieves the egg from the Hidden Clutch.
Text: Wait here. I will retrieve the egg.

Title: Relieving the Front Lines
Objective: Interact with the Command Map and complete the mission, "Relieving the Front Lines".
Text: Many within our order have been on the front lines of battle for too long, aiding those who are attempting to thwart the Legion's invasion. It is time we send in some relief, allowing our allies some much needed rest.

Title: Problem Salver
Objective: Use the salve on diseased demon hunters at Faronaar Front in Azsuna.
Text: Forcing a vision isn't easy by any means. Finding the ingredients for the elixir alone will take a considerable amount of time, time we don't have. Too many are suffering on the front lines as we speak, in need of the salve we were meant to deliver. I suppose if we all work together, we can make this work. Zabra and I will find the items needed for Velen's elixir, if you take the salve to Faronaar and cure the demon hunters. Does that sound fair?

Title: An Ample Supply
Objective: Recover Felbat Toxin Salve from supply crates scattered around El'dranil Shallows.
Text: Durin' our attempt to flee da murlocs, Yalia and I dropped da supplies we planned to deliver to da demon hunters in Faronaar. Inside each a those crates were vials a salve dat took us countless days and resources to craft. If we don' get those supplies back, I fear our allies on da front lines will suffer.

Title: We're Under Attack!
Objective: Slay 12 Marshtide Invaders.
Text: The Alliance are at our walls! Your actions delayed them and weakened their forces, but in the end we are outnumbered. This is our last stand. Victory or death... Fight with honor. They are within the walls as we speak. Drive the human dogs from Stonard, for the Horde!

Title: Whispers in the Void
Objective: Speak to Gilner Greymoss in the Sanctuary of the Void.
Text: Our priests are resting and recuperating, but one not as well as the others. Gilner Greymoss lingers within the Sanctuary of the Void, laughing to himself. He refuses to leave, but his presence is making the other priests uneasy. Perhaps you should speak to him and see what is wrong?

Title: The Best and Brightest
Objective: Find Zabra Hexx in Azsuna.
Text: If we wish to see the truth in Gilner's ramblings, I will need to induce a vision. It is not the sort of thing that is typically forced, but we have within our ranks the best and brightest alchemists who can craft an extract that will grant me the sight I need. Seek them out in Azsuna where they are currently aiding those on the front lines.

Title: A New Invention
Objective: I should be able to create an item that allows you to change the appearance of Hati, but the components for such an item are rare. The Squallhunters from Stormheim have a Stormy Gland, and the Stoneblood Harpies near Thas'talah in Val'sharah have Pristine Harpy Feathers that I need. The Hatecoil Naga near the Ruins of Nar'thalas in Azsuna are said to have Reflective Scales, and finally I need an Essence of Pure Spirit from the Seabound Mystics in the Blind Marshlands of Highmountain.
Text: I have been experimenting with technology that allows you to alter the structure of beasts, specifically with how they look.

Title: Murloc Mind Control
Objective: Rescue Yalia Sagewhisper from the murlocs within El'dranil Shallows.
Text: Yalia and I were deliverin' antidotes to da front lines a Faronaar when we were attacked by a herd a murlocs. We dropped our supplies and made a run for it, but Yalia never made it out a da camp. Obviously I didn't fair much better, ma bones still ache from bein' turned to stone. It's possible Yalia's still alive and bein' held captive. Please, ya have to find her!

Title: Pixie Dust
Objective: Bring 50 Arkhana to Brightwing. Arkhana is obtained through the enchanting profession.
Text: Friend, you have done so much for Brightwing, but there is still so much more to do. I've been working so hard to restore the grove, but my magic is drained.  Without magic, my work cannot continue. The enchanters of your people use a magical dust that can revitalize me quickly. If you bring me some, I can work much faster!

Title: The Cycle Continues
Objective: Plant 100 Dream Seeds on corpses.
Text: Yay! The grove is regenerating nicely. Our flower friends thank you for helping them. We were able to save most of the grove, but sadly, many living souls were lost as well. Brightwing is so sad! But you can help! Take this bag of Dream Seeds. Plant them onto fresh corpses, and in time, new flowers will grow! Death is beautiful, and from death comes rebirth. This is the cycle that must continue!

Title: The Stuff of Dreams
Objective: Collect Purified Life Essence from the Emerald Dreamway.
Text: This arcan'dor is one of an ancient species. They were not bred, but created. In them the arcane and primitive druidic magics merged into something greater than both.The arcane will soon devour it whole.We can restore balance, but it will require wild magic. Magic trapped in another realm.You must enter the Emerald Dreamway and bring back the essence of life itself.Only then can the arcan'dor find stability and begin to thrive once more.

Title: A Hero's Weapon
Objective: Approach the indicated location before the Forge of the Roaring Mountain and raise your weapon.
Text: Grand Master, you have saved our order from the brink of destruction. Your deeds have shown us that with effort and determination we can overcome any challenge. In light of your example, we have doubled our efforts and developed a technique that will awaken your weapon to its true potential. Please, stand before the Forge of the Roaring Mountain and raise your weapon high.

Title: The Shardmaidens
Objective: Slay 6 Shardmaidens in the Shattered Locus.
Text: Long have I walked this land and I have seen many forms of corruption.The creatures that wander this hall are twisted by the magics unleashed by the failed arcan'dor. These dryads have lost their way, and cannot be saved.You must destroy them. End their suffering.

Title: Fragments of Disaster
Objective: Collect 5 Crystallized Bark.
Text: In the hall beyond rests the bones of the failed arcan'dor.I will take fragments of the crystallized tree and attempt to read them. We must discover the root cause of this destruction.Only then do we have any hope of preventing this disaster from repeating itself.

Title: Asset Security
Objective: Defend Arluin's stash from the city guards.
Text: With the demons and guards so agitated, I'm running out of safe places to store contraband. The guards have caught on to one of my favorite havens and will be making off with my goods any minute now.Head to my stash and discourage their curiosity. You will need to use a grappling hook to access it- just look for something to latch onto along the ledge.I will make sure there is something in it for you when you are done.

Title: The Aegis of Aggramar
Objective: Secure the Aegis of Aggramar in the Chamber of the Guardian in Dalaran.
Text: Now that it's out of the hands of the Legion, the Aegis should be brought back to Dalaran for safekeeping while the hunt continues for the rest of the Pillars of Creation.It should be safe in the central portal chamber until the time comes when it is needed.

Title: The Defias Kingpin
Objective: Kill the Defias Kingpin.
Text: The Shattered Hand has laid mostly quiet for years now. No more! You will be the instrument of our rebirth. Slay the Defias Kingpin and commandeer her ship for the Horde! We will outfit it as a proper orc warship and use it to finally lay waste to Stormwind Any survivors will spread word of our unstoppable power across all of Azeroth, and all will tremble before our might! Go now, VanCleef's death will be your greatest triumph yet hero.

Title: Cutting Supply
Objective: Seize 5 crates of Stonard Supplies.
