Text: With the scrolls in hand, now you must set to the task of finding the staff.When Aegwynn relinquished it many years ago, it was entrusted to Kirin Tor, who, fearing its unbridled power, handed it to the blue dragonflight to secure away from the hands of men. Only they would know exactly where it was taken, or how to retrieve it.The dragon Kalec may be our best chance. He now resides upon the Council of Six in Dalaran. Seek him, and your answers, there.

Title: A New Threat
Objective: Search the Azure Dragonshrine for clues regarding the current state of the Nexus.
Text: If you seek the Nexus, be wary. There are strange happenings in Coldarra, and it would be best to understand them before proceeding.During my last visit to Dragonblight, I sensed unusual energies from the Azure Dragonshrine. Since this place was integral to Malygos' plans during the Nexus War, whatever is there may explain the current state of the Nexus.Here, take this image crystal. I must remain in Dalaran on Kirin Tor business, so we will speak through it. Good luck.

Title: Seeker of Truth
Objective: Speak with Orik Trueheart in Dalaran.
Text: You may be familiar with Orik Trueheart. He has devoted his time after the Northrend campaign to learning more about Tyr. Orik has evidence of a powerful shield crafted by Tyr long ago. With the help of the Sunwalkers, we may finally be able to seek it out. Please speak to him immediately.

Title: The End of the Saga
Objective: Get the end of the story from the spirit of the saga hero.
Text: Ye should read the saga yerself, it's right here.We're here to speak to the spirit of that vrykul I spoke of. Tahu Sagewind is a powerful Seer and he should be able to bring his spirit back. It will be up to us to convince him to speak.You should speak with Tahu so we can get started.

Title: To Northrend
Objective: Meet Orik Trueheart on Shield Hill in Howling Fjord.
Text: Naturally I've done some legwork already. I believe this Gorvold is buried at Shield Hill in the Howling Fjord. Tahu can help locate the grave, and with a short ritual we should have our answers! Meet us at Shield Hill in the Howling Fjord and we'll move on to the next step.

Title: Aluneth, Greatstaff of the Magna
Objective: Meet Kalec at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
Text: Aluneth... a powerful and dangerous weapon. If tales are to be believed, Aluneth is actually the name of a very old and very powerful arcane entity, somehow bound to a staff through ancient magic.When Aegwynn relinquished Aluneth many years ago, it was entrusted to Kirin Tor, who, fearing its unbridled power, handed it to the blue dragonflight to secure away in secret. Only they would know exactly where it was taken.The dragon Kalec may be our best chance. He now resides on the Council of Six.

Title: Salvation From On High
Objective: Something unexpected has interrupted your discussion, deal with it!
Text: I was serving aboard the airship that crashed on the way to the Broken Shore. I must have blacked out as the next thing I remember was being jolted awake. I was on a broken land and above me stood a man'ari carrying a staff of darkened crystal. There is no mistaking it, that staff was T'uure! All my life I've heard stories about how T'uure flowed with the healing power of the light. Somehow the crystal has been darkened by Man'ari. We must get it back and restore it to its pure form!

Title: Blood of My Blood
Objective: Defeat Anarys Lunastre and deliver  to Ly'leth Lunastre.
Text: As my darling  has demonstrated, Elisande's decision to bring down the shield has sown unrest among the nightborne. Loyalists and demons march together in the streets. Fear and distrust grip our hearts. Family turns against family. I will help Thalyssra stir a new rebellion, but first we must deal with Anarys. I do not wish to spill the blood of my blood - only to help  see reason. Anarys is likely brooding over our father's memorial. Bring  to me alive.

Title: Fevered Request
Objective: Bring 3 Field Packs to the location marked on your map. Treat the Fevered Explorer when you arrive.
Text: I must be hallucinating because I swear I can see a giant statue talking to me right now. It's a good thing I'm writing this down. And this. And that. Help?

Title: Out of the Darkness
Objective: Travel to Darkstone Isle near the Broken Shore and search for Alora.
Text: Alora and I were were able to escape through one of the Legion's portals back to Azeroth but that's about as far as our luck got us. The portal put us on a small isle somewhere to the west of the Broken Shore. They saw us quickly and we made a run for the protection of the water. As I attempted to leap to safety, I was wounded. But Alora... she tripped and I watched them drag her back. Rescue her, please! I'll mark where the camp is on your map, just don't let her go through that ordeal again.

Title: The Value of Trust
Objective: The troubles of this world seem to never fade. They shift, change, and reform, but they are ever-present.
Text: The troubles of this world seem to never fade. They shift, change, and reform, but they are ever-present. The wind brought us whispers of a traitor in our midst. We sent one of our best sentinels to investigate, and now she has turned up dead. I did her disservice in assuming that the traitor would not be aware of our movements... I was brash, and she paid for my folly. I need a new face to pick up the trail. Someone the people of the city won't know. This is a dangerous request. Will you help me?

Title: Juice Delivery
Objective: Bring the Zombie Juice to Abercrombie at Beggar's Haunt.
Text: Here's your Zombie Juice... ...and be careful with this stuff. It's strong enough to raise the dead!

Title: Mistmantle's Revenge
Objective: Use the Mistmantle Family Ring at Manor Mistmantle, north of town.
Text: I'm afraid I cannot give Tobias the answers he seeks. But I can help you find the only person who can... Stalvan Mistmantle. Take the ring into the woods to the north, to Manor Mistmantle, where Stalvan's body was buried. Enter, and hold the ring before you. Let the waning moon pour its light through the ring, and the spirits will answer your call. Take heed. The questions of the living can offer more comfort than the answers of the dead.

Title: REUSE - BREADCRUMB
Objective: Bring the Mistmantle Family Ring to Madame Eva.
Text: This can't be. My brother was strong-willed, but such vileness... such sickness and violent, bloody evil... I must have answers. I need to know how I got that letter. I need to know if Stalvan really did this. I need to know why... Take my ring. Bring it to Madame Eva. That woman is a follower of old arts and makes no secret of it... call it madness, but I'll try anything at this point.

Title: Clawing at the Truth
Objective: Bring the Mistmantle Family Ring to Madame Eva.
Text: This can't be. My brother was strong-willed, but such vileness... such sickness and violent, bloody evil...  I must have answers. I need to know how I got that letter. I need to know if Stalvan really did this. I need to know why... Take my ring. Bring it to Madame Eva. That woman is a follower of old arts and makes no secret of it... call it madness, but I'll try anything at this point.

Title: House Call
Objective: Treat the wounds of Defender Barrem.
Text: I thought Barrem was lost to us after the tragedy at Broken Shore, Light knows we lost far too many good soldiers just like him there. I was shocked to see he was still alive when one of our patrols arrived carrying him. They found him floating in the sea with wounds that would kill any lesser draenei. There is something about those wounds that resists everything we've done to treat them. Please, as a brother in the Light I ask you to do all that you can to help him to recover.

Title: Detonation
Objective: Blow up Render's Valley.
Text: Those explosives you planted were high yield. When I push this button on the Bravo Company field kit, that whole valley is gonna be consumed by a massive fireball of death. You know, I think you should do the honors. You did all the hard work, after all. Ready?

Title: Roland's Doom
Objective: Search Roland's Doom for the remaining pages of Stalvan's Journal.
Text: This isn't all of it... You should let it go. The only place left to look is Roland's Doom. That's the mine south of town, and the largest lair of worgen in Duskwood. Nobody in Darkshire has ever made it back from that place alive. In fact, some of the records I have here imply that's where the monsters first came from... who knows what evil's lurking in there? Please, just give it up. Let's just forget about this whole thing, and never speak of it again.

Title: The Fate of Stalvan Mistmantle
Objective: Take The Legend of Stalvan back to Tobias Mistmantle.
Text: You've recovered everything. Everything except the last page... ...which I've got right here. Don't look at me like that. You'll understand when you read it. Some even say it's cursed, you know. In fact, I was relieved when the worgen broke in and made off with these! Take it. Take all of it, in fact. I thank you for recovering my archives, but I don't want anything to do with this ever again. Please, just leave me be.

Title: In A Dark Corner
Objective: Search the Rotting Orchard for the Torn Journal Page.
Text: If you're that serious about this, I'll help you. I know where the other documents must be. I'm just too terrified to do anything about it. There's only a few places that those horrible Nightbane beasts gather when they're not prowling the forest. One of them's the Rotting Orchard to the south. They use the buildings there as their dens, so if they haven't just eaten the other documents, you might find one there... but you'll have to search their lairs thoroughly, I wager.

Title: Call of Booty
Objective: Report to Baron Revilgaz at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Text: You feel like you've done just about enough damage, and you know the Bloodsail's battle plans. You've done everything that Baron Revilgaz has asked of you. It's time to hang up the pirate hat and return to Booty Bay. The battle looms near.

Title: The Stolen Letters
Objective: Collect the Bundle of Shredded Letters from Brightwood Grove.
Text: You want to know about Stalvan... You're not the first, you know. We get outsiders coming through asking about him every so often. Always outsiders. Everyone who lives here knows better. You're out of luck, anyway. I'm missing half the archives. Feral worgen broke into the town hall not a few nights ago and tore the place to shreds. The documents you'll want are probably strewn all across Brightwood Grove by now, deep in the woods to the west. Not worth it if you ask me.

Title: The Legend of Stalvan
Objective: Seek out Clerk Daltry in the Darkshire Town Hall.
Text: I'm here because I received a letter from my brother Stalvan, who I haven't seen in years. On arriving here, I was told he was dead... The entire town refuses to offer any further explanation. Any mention of his name is met with terror and suspicion. As if I didn't have enough of that myself! I'm afraid of what will happen if my frustration and anger grows any further. I beg you, help me get to the bottom of this. Implore Clerk Daltry for any information he may have on my brother.

Title: Making Mutiny
Objective: Accuse 9 Bloodsail Corsairs of mutiny, then kill them.
Text: Before returning to Booty Bay, you should do everything you can to weaken the Bloodsail Buccaneers. Unfortunately, even as captain, you're prohibited from killing other buccaneers in cold blood. Only a Fleet Master can do that. You can, however, put mutineers to the sword... and mutiny can be awfully hard to disprove. Speaking of which, those Bloodsail corsairs that hang out on the lowest level of the ships have been acting awfully suspicious...

Title: Sinking From Within
Objective: Sabotage the Barrel of Grog, the Barrel of Gunpowder, and the Crate of Cannonballs.
Text: The attack on Booty Bay is looming. You'll have to return to Booty Bay quickly and inform the Baron. First, however, it might be a good idea to sabotage some of the pirates' supplies while you're still in their favor. The pirates keep most of their supplies belowdecks, spread out across the entire fleet.

Title: The Brashtide Crew
Objective: Speak with Long John Copper on the Damsel's Luck, Enormous Shawn Stooker on the Crimson Veil, and Wailing Mary Smitts on the Riptide.
Text: The charts mention a group called the Brashtide Crew. This name is new to you, though you've heard about a few other newcomers to the Buccaneers. Maybe it's time you paid them a visit and found out what they know.

Title: Zombie Juice
Objective: Speak with Tavernkeep Smitts.
Text: I need a bottle of a certain liquor - Zombie Juice. Tavernkeep Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire should have some. And please hurry. These nights get cold, and I need that drink to put fire in my veins again!

Title: Fragile Values
Objective: Retrieve a Stonework Mallet.
Text: It is now time to draw the Broodmother's attention. To do so, we will need a mallet that the troggs use when making offerings to her. Seek out the Stone Trogg Beast Tamers that are attempting to tame basilisks in the southern portions of the Pale Roost. You will find a mallet on one of their corpses.

Title: Gather Rot Blossoms
Objective: Gather 5 Rot Blossoms from Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.
Text: If you bring me some rot blossoms then I can brew you up a batch of zombie juice. Rot blossoms grow in strange places. They tend to flourish on dead things, and Duskwood has its fair share of those! I've seen a few of them growing at Tranquil Gardens Cemetery lately. Check near the graves... but mind the dead that are walking about near there.

Title: Hard Falls
Objective: Kill 6 Stone Drakes.
Text: Stone Dragons bow only to strength. When we have punished them enough, they will bend back to our will. I have sent many of my strongest giants onto the fields in the west. They will bring the drakes to the ground. You will see to it that they do not take wing again after they fall.

Title: Resonating Blow
Objective: Defeat Aeosera.
Text: On the western edge of the Pale Roost, you will find a resonating crystal. Strike it with the mallet and the broodmother will come. Be ready for battle. I will be there to aid you, but she will not be easily overcome.

Title: Drive-By Piracy
Objective: Speak with the Bloodsail Oarsman outside the Crimson Veil, then use the cannon to kill 75 Venture Co. Oil Workers.
Text: Now that you know how to handle our cannons, it's time to hit some real targets! The Venture Company has found gold to the north of here... a rare type they call "Black Gold". More like a Black Spot if you ask me. We're going to take that gold, but first, we need to get rid of those Venture Company goons. I've got an oarsman who will take you out there. Head off the ship down the gangplank and speak with him on the islet's northern shore.

Title: Don't. Stop. Moving.
Objective: Rush at least 5 Opalescent Guardians east by ground, out of the Pale Roost, to the stone circle near Therazane's Throne.
Text: When Deathwing came, the Stone Dragons flocked to him. In his absence, they are again without purpose. They swarm and feed upon our kin. I have bound dozens of Opalescent Guardians, but am unable to lead them from the safety of cover. I need someone more swift, as I suspect you might be. Lead them by ground towards Therazane's Throne to the east. Surely, some will not make it, but as long as you keep moving, you should be able to bring several to join our forces there.

Title: Return the Comb
Objective: Return the Ghost Hair Comb to Madame Eva in Darkshire.
Text: NO!!!!! Take it, take this comb away from me! I'm a monster, and no one will ever think me lovely again!

Title: Supplies from Darkshire
Objective: Speak with Madame Eva in Darkshire.
Text: Oh, what is a poor old man to do? I need some supplies from Darkshire, but the village is so far away and I am so old and feeble...I would never make the trip. Can you go to Darkshire and bring me back some ghost hair thread? You can get it from Madame Eva at her home on the Darkshire square.

Title: Deliver the Thread
Objective: Bring the Ghost Hair Thread to Abercrombie in his tower at Beggar's Haunt.
Text: Here is your thread. It has a thousand uses, from binding evil spirits to sewing life into inanimate objects.

Title: Ghost Hair Thread
Objective: Bring the Spectral Comb to Blind Mary.
Text: There is a poor, sad spirit, Blind Mary, who haunts an old farm house in the hills south of Darkshire. Here, take this Spectral Comb and ask Blind Mary to comb her hair. Then bring back the comb and I will glean from it the Ghost Hair I'll need for the thread. And take care, for dark things now lurk near that house...

Title: The Damsel's Luck
Objective: Report to your Captain's Chambers within the Damsel's Luck in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Text: I know ye just arrived here on the Crimson Veil, but I need to send ye off on another task. The Damsel's Luck is the third ship in me fleet, moored over to the east. Her skipper - Captain Stillwater - is no longer with us. Damn those masked hoodlums! Anyhow, Ironpatch told me about yer heroics at sea, and I be runnin' low on quality brigands. I think yer more than capable for this new duty. Congratulations, matey. Ye be the new captain of the Damsel's Luck.

Title: Ol' Blasty
Objective: Practice using the cannon by hitting Smilin' Timmy Sticks 5 times with cannonballs from Ol' Blasty.
Text: We've got some work to do. How much experience have you got with cannons? Hmm... really? Well, how about with ancient, fallin'-apart pirate cannons? We've got a few cannons updecks that work the old-fashioned way: you load one cannonball in at a time, aim, lock it into place, and fire. Works well if you're tryin' to hit the side of a three-sailer... not so well for rowboats and the like. Why don't you head upstairs and lob a few shots at Smilin' Timmy Sticks?

Title: To Win a War, You Gotta Become War
Objective: Use the Bravo Company Field Kit to plant a Seaforium Charge at the Blackrock Tower and Blackrock Munitions Hut.
Text: Do you understand yet? Do you now see what we gotta do to win a war against these monsters? YOU GOTTA BECOME WAR! NO MERCY! With the P.O.W.s freed you're clear to plant the seaforium. Carefully make your way into each of the structures out there and plant a charge. Plant a seaforium charge at the Blackrock munitions hut and the Blackrock tower. Once you're done meet up with me and the rest of Bravo Company at Shalewind Canyon, east of Render's Valley.

Title: Black Rook Holdings
Objective: Take the Warden's Signet to Jarod Shadowsong.
Text: Inside the chest, hidden amongst various knickknacks, is a signet engraved with a unique crest. The band, made from a silvery, unbreakable metal, has been worn down by time, as if absently twisted and rubbed against its owner's finger.

Title: Prisoners of War
Objective: Free the Prisoners of War locked up in the prison at Render's Valley.
Text: The Bravo Company field kit is ready. I'm gonna equip you with it and you're gonna enter Render's Valley, southeast of here, and free our P.O.W.s. I'm sending Jorgensen with you to watch your back. Now the prisoners are being held on the northeast side of the valley in a large cage, but the key to the cage is in a cave on the south side of the valley. You'll have to steal the key, create a distraction, and free the citizens. Good luck! I'll be in touch through the field kit.

Title: Our Mortal Enemies
Objective: Kill 15 Ninjas on Jaguero Isle.
Text: Hey, new , take a look at this.  I don't wear this patch because of any lost eye. I wear it because this OTHER eye is so strong, the normal one was just weighin' it down. This eye's good for seein' all kinds of things, like those masked hooligans that follow us around. Fleet Master says that they've been spotted over on Jaguero Isle. Once you get there, fire this flare gun, and I'll help you spot 'em.

Title: The Vindicator's Plea
Objective: Meet with Vindicator Boros in front of First to Your Aid in Dalaran.
Text: I've obtained a request from Vindicator Boros in Dalaran asking for our help. He has recovered a soldier who escaped from the Legion! He was injured and his wounds are resisting every healing treatment available to them. Normally this would fall to an acolyte to handle, but the soldier mentioned T'uure in his delirium! I thought the holy gem was lost! You are strong with the Light, perhaps you can succeed where they can't? If you need it, Brother Larry can provide you with a flight to Dalaran.

Title: Cry More Thunder!
Objective: Fly with Vethir and kill 150 of the God-King's allies in Hrydshal.
Text: You have proven yourself an ally of the Thorignir and we will lend you our strength. I would ask one last favor of our new champion, though.The dragon who guided you to me awaits his vengeance against the vrykul. Together I wish for you to show these Drekirjar what it means to cross the Thorignir. Their toll must be paid in blood.Speak to Vethir when you are ready.

Title: Building Our Troops
Objective: Speak to Recruiter Tianji and train an Ox Initiate.
Text: Our champions acquired the talents of Recruiter Tianji, a famed monk skilled in the school of the ox. She is known for her brewmaster techniques, and is a valuable addition to the temple. She is already beginning to train a new batch of pupils. Speak to her now and train an initiate of the ox.

Title: Tianji of the Ox
Objective: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Tianji Needs Help".
Text: Greetings, Grandmaster. Beside me is the Scouting Map. From it, you can direct our allies to carry out vital assignments across the Broken Isles. The first task is critical. Tianji, a renowned trainer in the ox school style of martial combat, was on her way to the Broken Isles when she was attacked. I suggest we send Chen Stormstout to help her. He will be uniquely suited to this task.

Title: The Brand of Damnation
Objective: Retrieve Emberscar, Brand of Damnation.
Text: I require a symbol of my dominion as Firelord. A weapon that will strike fear into the hearts of all who dare to oppose my rule! Deep within the den of the Cinderweb, there is an ancient spear born from within the heart of the Firelands. Emberscar is a living weapon whose wicked power is beyond mortal comprehension. Prove your strength and claim Emberscar in my name! If you survive, perhaps I will aid the feeble races of humanity against the Burning Legion.

Title: Attracting Attention
Objective: Report to Fleet Master Firallon within the Crimson Veil in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Text: Swabbie ! This is a sad day fer ol' Cap'n Keelhaul. Today I lose m'best swabbie. A letter's come in from Fleet Master Firallon. Apparently he's heard about the excellent swabbin' y'been doin', and he wants t'take ye aboard the Crimson Veil as his Jack o' Swords and third mate. She's moored just next t'the Riptide. Piracy career-wise, this's a big step fer ye, Swabbie . I recommend y'take his offer. Dismissed!

Title: Fangs of the Devourer
Objective: Obtain the Fangs of the Devourer from Akaari Shadowgore.
Text: If you spare me I can use the rune of portals you provided to open a gateway to Akaari's citadel in the Twisting Nether. Of course, killing the Legion's master assassin in her own domain will be no simple feat, but surely the Fangs of the Devourer are worth the risk, no?  I will guide you through the citadel once you arrive, but you will have to defeat Akaari on your own.

Title: The Night Watch
Objective: Kill 8 Rotting Horrors near Blind Mary's Haunt, southeast of Darkshire.
Text: I'm afraid you're all I've got to help here. Stormwind's forces are so taxed by greater evils that they can't spare a single footman to protect Darkshire. It's up to me and the rest of the Night Watch to keep our homes safe. There's more threats here than just wolves, unfortunately. Rotting horrors roam near Blind Mary's Haunt, on the southeast outskirts. If they're not kept in check, they'll be visiting our homes in the night. Deal with the undead and report back to me for your bounty.

Title: Closing In
Objective: Confront Akaari Shadowgore in the Legerdemain Lounge.
Text: The Legerdemain Lounge isn't far from here. We have agents nearby who can secure the area. Come prepared for a fight. Akaari won't go down easily.

Title: Starvation Diet
Objective: Destroy 6 Cocooned Victims at the Creeping Ruins.
Text: The Creeping Ruin to the east is crawling with fully-grown Shadraspawn spiders. They're large enough to drag off an entire dwarf in the night, and you'll see evidence enough of that when you get there... bodies are cocooned all through the ruins. They don't keep them alive for long, but they feed off the bodies for days. It's too late to save the victims, but we can't let those spiders grow fat and thrive. Make sure you get rid of those cocoons.

Title: Preserving the Barrens
Objective: Report to Kargal Battlescar at Far Watch Post in Northern Barrens.
Text: For years, the Barrens have been the heart of the Horde presence on Kalimdor, a vital link between the orcs of Durotar and the tauren settlements in Mulgore. In the chaos of the cataclysm, floods, earthquakes, and even a quilboar invasion threaten to separate us from this vital grassland. You look ready for a challenge. Report to Kargal Battlescar at Far Watch Post and ensure the route to the Barrens remains clear! Head west from nearby Razor Hill and cross the Southfury River to find him.

Title: Point of Contact: Brubaker
Objective: Find Brubaker.
Text: Before we do a damned thing we need to get a field kit together. You'll help with that. There's also a matter of scouting. Thankfully for that we got some help from Stormwind. An old war buddy of mine, Brubaker, was sent here by SI:7 to scout around for us. You're to meet him in the field, just south of here. Meet up with Brubaker and find out what he knows.

Title: Can't Make An Omelette Without...
Objective: Collect 5 Shadraspawn Eggs from Agol'watha.
Text: The Vilebranch broodguards to the northeast tend the eggs of Shadra's brood. Even if we kill the Vilebranch, those eggs will still sit there, waiting to hatch and release those horrible creatures further into the wilds. We need to take care of this properly. Tear any eggs you see out of the egg sacks and bring them to me. Don't try to destroy them on your own; you might let the little ones out. When you get them back here, I'll see that they're properly disposed of!

Title: Unspeakable Atrocities
Objective: Deliver Brubaker's Report to John J. Keeshan at Camp Everstill in Redridge.
Text: Keeshan, if you're reading this note, I'm dead. Likely that my position was compromised. Orcs are committing unspeakable atrocities against their prisoners. Yes, prisoners, Keeshan. They've got cages full of P.O.W's. If you're gonna blow up this valley, you'll need to free the prisoners first. Tell my wife I love her and to take out the damned trash. -Brubaker PS - They've got black dragons. Take Brubaker's report back to Keeshan.

Title: Traitor!
Objective: Join Valeera Sanguinar in the Underbelly Descent.
Text: That lying demon SCUM! I should have known. Let's show Val'zuun what happens to people who dare cross the Uncrowned.

Title: Bravo Company Field Kit: Camouflage
Objective: Gather 5 Piles of Leaves and 5 pieces of Fox Poop.
Text: We're gonna need some supplies before we take out the Blackrock army and save Redridge. That's where you come in, rookie. Keeshan put me in charge of getting camouflage together for the Bravo Company field kit. What I need you to do is head south and do a little "gardening." There are two parts to this little adventure that you should know about: (1) Leaves and (2) Fox poop. We need 'em both. What did you think camo was made of? Head south and gather what I asked for.

Title: Close Escort
Objective: Escort the Earthen Catapult safely to Needlerock Slag.
Text: Alright, I think I've got it working again. You've got to get the catapult to the stone trogg town, Needlerock Slag, just to the north of the front. The driver will go with you. I'll head back and let Gravel know. There's no doubt that the stone troggs will try to stop you. You just keep them off of the catapult. It packs a big punch. Let me know when you're ready.

Title: Bravo Company Field Kit: Chloroform
Objective: Collect 8 Muckdweller Glands.
Text: The first part of this mission is all covert ops. To that end, we need to be able to incapacitate the enemy without making any sounds. To do that we're going to need chloroform. The muckdwellers at the bottom of Lake Everstill hold chloroform in their glands. I'm going to need you to go underwater and recover muckdweller glands. Think you can handle it? Come back to me once you've recovered enough glands. Where's the lake you ask? Open your eyes, dummy. Directly west.

Title: Hunting the Hunters
Objective: Kill 8 Blackrock Hunters.
Text: Just south of here on the Lakeridge Highway are a group of Blackrock orcs that stalk the forests under cover of darkness and ambush the uninitiated. That group is the first line of defense for the Blackrock army. They're scouts, reporting everything they see back to their central command. They need to be taken OUT or our mission here could be compromised. Head south and kill every Blackrock hunter that you see.

Title: Cannonball Swim
Objective: Obtain 6 Bloodsail Cannonballs from the water beneath the Riptide.
Text: Help out a fellow swabbie? Keelhaul asked me to gather up some cannonballs at the bottom of the ocean. Let me tell you why this doesn't work for me. - One: I have tiny arms. Look at them! Do you really think I can pick up a cannonball, even underwater? - Two: I have a weak respiratory system. I start to white out after holding my breath for more than ten seconds. - Three: There are sharks. You gotta help me! I've been demoted as far as I can... I don't want to see what comes next!

Title: The Bane of Many A Pirate
Objective: Obtain 5 Bushels of Limes.
Text: Gum disease. It's a real problem. I know you're new and all, and probably haven't ever needed your gums cut, but the rest of us pirates have to deal with a little thing called SCURVY. It's why we keep so many limes around here. Well... we used to keep limes around here. Someone made off with our last shipment, but they can't have gone far - maybe to the nearby islands? Bring them back, and maybe I'll see what I can do to get you promoted from swabbie.

Title: The Hermit
Objective: Find the denizen of the tower at Beggar's Haunt.
Text: I've been told there's signs of activity at Beggar's Haunt. People have reported seeing lights in the tower to the east of town. Few would be bold enough to stay that close to Deadwind Pass. You're the first to report since I've learned about this; go check it out and make sure whatever's in there is human.

Title: Your First Day as a Pirate
Objective: Bring Yer Papers to Captain Keelhaul.
Text: Ye may be a slayer of Fleet Masters, but rules is rules and orders is orders. And MY orders say that all new pirates start out as swabbies. It's the rule. You're to be working for Captain Keelhaul, the commander of the Riptide. It's the westernmost ship in the fleet, which is parked south of the tip o' the cape. Find him in his captain's chambers, and bring yer papers.

Title: Troggzor the Earthinator
Objective: Obtain the Earthinator's Cudgel.
Text: You have to put an end to this now! Go back northwest onto the front and kill their battle leader, Troggzor the Earthinator. Bring me his cudgel as proof.

Title: Looks Like a Tauren Pirate to Me
Objective: Obtain a Cow Head and an Oversized Pirate Hat, then bring them back to Fleet Master Seahorn.
Text: Firallon wants MY head? Now that's interesting. But it's nothing we can't work around. This Yancey character probably doesn't know my face too well. Most non-tauren find us tauren indistinguishable from one another. In fact... most non-tauren find us indistinguishable from... a certain four-legged farm creature. Rikqiz the leatherworker keeps one of these creatures here in Booty Bay, and Narkk is my chief supplier for pirate hats. Get a replacement head and a hat, then return with both.

Title: Seeing Where Your Loyalties Lie
Objective: Obtain the Head of Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay.
Text: Thar be just one thing... Yancey hears things. A few o' me hearties were pretty deep in their cups when they told me about some   that came a-rollin' through the Southern Command lookin' for charts and orders. Even ran a couple o' good pirates through,  did. Like I said, they were up to their eyeballs in grog, but still... a buccaneer's gotta trust his ears. So I've just got one small task for ye, one sent down from Firallon hisself... Bring me the head of Fleet Master Seahorn.

Title: Death From Below
Objective: Protect Shakes O'Breen during the attack.
Text: This is bad. It seems the Daggerspines are amassing for an attack. Naga are known for their ruthlessness in battle. They will keep attacking until I am dead. I don't value my own life above that of my crew members, but you must help to defend me. The crew will not be able to make it back to Booty Bay without my knowledge of the seas. The naga will be coming from the sea. I need you to remain up here with me to fend off the attack. Man the cannon and drive them back. Are you ready?

Title: Dusky Crab Cakes
Objective: Gather 6 Dusky Lumps from Venom Web Spiders.
Text: I'll let you in on a little secret - Dusky "Crab" Cakes are really made from spider meat! I know it's a bit disgusting, but the cakes have a nice, tangy flavor and make great snacks! If you want to try some still, I'm afraid I'm out of meat. I need some lump meat to whip up a few more cakes. Venom Web Spiders are a good source - they nest to the north, between the foothills and the river.

Title: We Have a Situation
Objective: Speak with Clay Mudaxle on the Fractured Front in Deepholm.
Text: One of Clay's catapult teams is broken down on the front. I need you to get some parts from him and get that catapult back in the fight.

Title: Swabbing Duty
Objective: Pick up a Swabbie's Mop on the deck of the Riptide, then keep the deck clean for 2 minutes.
Text: I want the surface of the Riptide t'shine like a star ruby, Swabbie . I keep a tight ship around here, and it's swabbies like you that make it happen! Well, what're y'waitin' for, y'cockle-brained bilgerat? Head updecks and start swabbin'!

Title: Getting In With the Bloodsail
Objective: Report to Yancey Grillsen at the waterfall north of Booty Bay.
Text: These plans are... interesting. Firallon, you're smarter than this! Look, he has all three ships devoted to cannon fire, and only a few men coming in through the tunnel. He can never take Booty Bay with three ships and a dozen footmen. And he knows that. No, they've got something else planned... and you're going to find out what it is. Speak to Yancey Grillsen, the Bloodsail Recruiter, just to the north of town. That's right. You'd better hope that they don't recognize your face.

Title: Death to Mor'ghor
Objective: Slay Warchief Mor'ghor in Dragonmaw Port. You can still recruit Dragonmaw Merchants and Workers to help you.
Text: The time has come. Mor'ghor dies today. Be warned. Demon blood courses through his wretched veins, and he channels unnatural power. He will be destroyed, yes. But it will not be an easy fight. You remember where Mor'ghor resides, at the top of the camp. I will meet you there. Finish him! Be sure to recruit 3 Dragonmaw followers if you are short - you will need our help.

Title: An Old Sea Dog
Objective: Bring the Weather-Beaten Coin to Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay.
Text: This old, weathered coin was found on the body of the pirate "Good-Boy" Bruce. Its front side bears the image of a large, unfamiliar pirate ship; on its back side, the term "Brashtide Crew". Someone who has been in the piracy business for some time might know what this coin is, or what it means.

Title: Insurrection
Objective: Arm 3 Dragonmaw Workers or Merchants, then slay 10 Dragonmaw Enforcers and 4 Dragonmaw Warlocks.
Text: The weapons the Horde has supplied us with will be more than enough. The four of us should split up and arm as many Dragonmaw workers and merchants as we can. Don't underestimate us. You'll find even our tradesmen are ferocious in battle. Let's do as much damage as possible. Arm a squad of Dragonmaw and lay waste to the fel enforcers and warlocks that have intimidated my people for so long. Then meet back here to launch our final strike!

Title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs
Objective: Gather 5 Wolf Skirt Steaks from Dire Wolves.
Text: Seasoned wolf kabobs are a house favorite! Sure, I can make you some. But first I'll need the supplies. Bring me five wolf skirt steaks. The dire wolves near the river north of town are good to hunt; I wouldn't stray too far into the woods if I were you.

Title: You Say You Want a Revolution
Objective: Slip through the front lines at Dragonmaw Port and speak with Zaela.
Text: If what you say is true, then we have friends within the Dragonmaw Clan. We can support an insurgency from within their ranks and avoid a lot of bloodshed on both sides. I can help, but the most dangerous part is up to you. My Axebite Warriors will launch an offensive on the shores. During the confusion, I need you to slip behind the lines and speak with your revolutionary contact, Zaela. We'll arm the Dragonmaw and overthrow their fel masters!

Title: It's Never Over
Objective: Take Keeshan's Riverboat to Camp Everstill in Redridge.
Text: Those Blackrock orcs are gonna need an army to handle the Bravo Company and you. When you're ready to go, meet us at the dock facing Lake Everstill and we'll set off on my riverboat for Camp Everstill on the other side of the lake. See you there.

Title: Wolves at Our Heels
Objective: Kill 12 Dire Wolves.
Text: The dire wolves are the most common threat to the townsfolk here. They lurk in the forests on all sides of us, though most are along the north bank of the river. These aren't the runt dogs you see in Elwynn, or wherever you come from. They're big as a man and twice as vicious. If you wish to assist the people of Darkshire, hunt the dire wolves so our streets can be safer.

Title: Up to Snuff
Objective: Deeg in Booty Bay wants you to bring him 15 tiny heaps of Snuff.
Text: Ah, the sea life. I ain't gonna say it's the good life, but it's my life. When I get into port I like to find me a good bottle of grog and some high quality snuff. Nasty habits but what's a pirate without his vices, right? So you can imagine how heartbroken I was to find out the herbalist here in town has gone and sold out of the stuff. Says his shipment got hijacked by those damned Bloodsail Raiders. I bet a fearless  like you could convince 'em to share the goods, eh?

Title: Keep An Eye Out
Objective: Retrieve Dizzy's Eye from the Bloodsail Buccaneers.
Text: Avast! Who goes there? Argh, I am but useless without me special enchanted eye. Bad enough to have lost me eyes in battle in the first place! But by some stroke o' luck we docked in Menethil and a traveling wizard enchanted a special glass eye that let me see again. Last night I ended up gettin' jumped by some Bloodsail Buccaneers on me way out. Took me eye, they did! Seems those blokes have found their way to Booty Bay. Help an old sea dog out by gettin' me eye back?

Title: Bloodsail Treachery
Objective: Report your findings to First Mate Crazz in Booty Bay.
Text: The map shows Booty Bay with a red "X" drawn precisely at the spot at which you are standing. The scribbled text reads: "Set up your command post here, and bide your time. The Fleet Master will send out word when it's time to make your move." "I'm placing Lieutenant Bruce in charge here. This time will be different. This time we take Booty Bay once and for all." The map is held in place with a dagger, placed right through the location of Booty Bay.

Title: The Baron Must Be Told
Objective: Report the planned Bloodsail attack to Baron Revilgaz.
Text: Shiver me timbers! So the Bloodsail Buccaneers are planning some sort of attack on Booty Bay? Why, the nerve of those scoundrels. Booty Bay will always be run by the Blackwater Raiders! This is bigger than I thought. Report what you have learned to Baron Revilgaz at once! You'll find him here in Booty Bay.

Title: A Matter of Finesse
Objective: Borrow a Rune of Portals from Archmage Celindra.
Text: A rune of portals?! Who does Val'zuun think he is?  It's worth the price, but those runes aren't exactly easy to come by. Unless... Archmage Celindra, the Kirin Tor's portal master, has a study in the center of town. We rogues aren't particularly welcome there, nor would she simply hand a rune over even if we were...  But who said anything about asking?

Title: The Master's Legacy
Objective: Investigate the Gemcutter's Tomb.
Text: You work for a murderer and a thief. That design he wants? It is called the magistrix cut, and it was perfected by my husband. He was killed by Lespin for his secret. I had him entombed in a small cave north of the city, for we could not make the trip to Tel'anor. Buried with him is a tome that contains the secrets of the design. Retrieve the design and keep it out of his hands!

Title: The Dreamer Returns
Objective: Return to Arch Druid Greathoof in the Dreamgrove.
Text: Arch Druid Greathoof will be expecting word on the success of our mission, but I'm afraid I must ask you to return alone. I can't rest knowing that Xavius has Lord Ursoc in his clutches. Just the thought of it makes me shake with rage! I'll find where he has been taken if I have to search every corner of Azeroth! Our paths will cross again. Be sure of it.

Title: The Shadows Reveal
Objective: Speak to your contacts in Dalaran to acquire intel on Akaari Shadowgore's whereabouts.
Text: The Fangs of the Devourer are wielded by Akaari Shadowgore, one of Kil'Jaeden's personal assassins. Every attempt on her life ends the same... she's gone before we even arrive.  But not this time. We've been working with these contacts to find Akaari so we can finally take the Fangs for our own purposes. Go to each contact and tell them "The shadows reveal." See what they know.

Title: A Better Future
Objective: Rescue 8 Shal'dorei Insurgents in the Grand Promenade.
Text: We must move quickly. I must save as many of my people as I can before the attack begins. Word has gotten out in the city that there is a safe haven with us and some no longer fear exile. Venture into the Grand Promenade, champion. Find those willing to join us and let them know it is time they made their escape.

Title: Freya's Spring
Objective: Use the Scouting Map and complete five "Freya's Spring" missions.
Text: First, we need water from Freya's Spring. Once a year, on the first day of solstice, the sun hits the white-capped summit of the highest peak in Highmountain. The melting snow runs through a ravine and collects in a crystalline pool. Some say these waters grant eternal youth. Silly stories if you ask me, but we will need this rare, purified water for our brew. I suggest sending our champions to collect us a sample, for your skills will be needed elsewhere.

Title: Amaranthine Hops
Objective: Speak to Fleuris Asterleaf in Val'sharah and trade 20 Stonehide Leather for 1 bag of Amaranthine Hops.
Text: The hops for our brew must be a very specific, and they will also be hard to acquire. Amaranthine Hops only grow in the realm known as the Emerald Dream, meaning we can only acquire this ingredient from a druid. There is one such supplier from whom I receive this item, but she may ask for something in exchange.

Title: Details of the Attack
Objective: Kill 8 Bloodsail Sea Dogs and 8 Bloodsail Elder Magi, and bring back the Bloodsail Charts and the Bloodsail Orders.
Text: I want to know details. Our supremacy over the Bloodsail is due largely in part to our stronghold here in Booty Bay, but intelligence also plays a critical role. The Bloodsail maintain a few meager camps to the south which they call their "Southern Command." Well, you're going to raid their excuse for a southern command, find their plans, and slaughter their men. Return with whatever information you can find.

Title: Oath of the Windlord
Objective: Speak with Advisor Sevel.
Text: You have my thanks, mortal for bringing about my rebirth. However, thanks alone would not be honorable. I know that the Earthen Ring seeks to save Azeroth from the Burning Legion. I will pledge my sword, and the armies of Skywall to the aid of Azeroth. When the time for battle arrives, and the Earthen Ring stands upon the battlefield against the Burning Legion, the Windlord shall stand with you.

Title: Appropriations
Objective: Speak to Lao Shu in The Laughing Crane inn.
Text: I have come to lend my help to the Order of the Broken Temple. My job is to create a solid base of operations around here. Right now, we have wounded to tend and bellies to feed. After this, we can worry about building our defenses. Lao Shu is in charge of our supply inventory. Go and speak with him now in the inn.

Title: Report from Tian Monastery
Objective: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Investigate Tian Monastery."
Text: We have heard from all our temples on Pandaria, except for one. We dispatched a message by bird to Tian Monastery, but no answer has yet arrived. This silence is quite unusual. Grandmaster, I recommend that we send our champion, Chen Stormstout, to scout the situation at once.

Title: Tracking the Tideskorn
Objective: Use the Scouting Map and complete the "Tracking the Tideskorn" missions.
Text: We have sent scouts to search for our kidnapped allies, and our efforts may have finally paid off. They've tracked them to the vrykul homeland of Stormheim, but the unfamiliar territory has slowed our progress and we're in danger of losing the trail. I suggest that we send our champions immediately to assist with the tracking effort.

Title: Gathering the Pieces
Objective: Interact with the Mission Table and complete five Order Hall missions.
Text: Grand Master, the Mission Table is now at your disposal. There are several strategic areas where we can focus our Order's efforts. First, we should check on the status of the other monk temples. It seems the Legion has a special focus on destroying us. Second, we need to scour the seas near the Broken Shore. There are still many missing from the battle. Finally, there is the continued appearance of demonic forces at numerous points across the Broken Isles. They must be kept at bay.

Title: A Promise of Earth
Objective: Speak with Advisor Sevel in the Heart of Azeroth.
Text: Deepholm thanks you, shaman. The Twilight's Hammer has always sought dominion over my kingdom, but this latest threat was far greater than their previous efforts. For your service to the elements of earth, I will pledge my armies to the Earthen Ring in the defense of Azeroth. I have no love for the mortal races, but this world is not the Burning Legion's to destroy. Tell your Earthen Ring that Therazane the Stonemother stands with them!

Title: Held Captive!
Objective: Rescue 10 Twilight Slaves from the Twilight Depths.
Text: There are prisoners here, Farseer , that are enslaved by the Twilight's Hammer. The cultists work them to death in the depths of the mine. I cannot abide such cruel mistreatment! Let us clear a path through the mine and rescue any Twilight's Hammer prisoners we find, so that they may return to their homes and families. The Twilight's Hammer will pay for their crimes!

Title: The Master's Plan
Objective: Collect the excerpts from The Master's Journal.
Text: The purpose of the Twilight's Hammer has always been the same. They seek to bring about the end of the world. Their schemes may change, but their wicked purpose remains constant. Defeating the Twilight's Hammer is not simply a matter of defeating them in battle. If we are to be successful, we will need to uncover their scheme and put an end to whatever terrible plans they have created. Let us start by searching the encampment for clues as to their true purpose here.

Title: Unleashing the Elements
Objective: Release the Servants of Therazane from Twilight Depths.
Text: According to The Master's journal, the Twilight's Hammer has discovered a method of harnessing the void to subjugate even the most powerful of elementals. The journal specifically mentioned the children of Therazane as test subjects. Whether The Master was speaking literally or figuratively in this regard, I do not know. Regardless, we need to free these elementals and stop these dark rituals from continuing. It appears that our journey here is going to take us deeper into the depths of darkness...

Title: Tainted Growth
Objective: Collect 5 Corrupted Seedlings and return them to Tyrande.
Text: The blood red petals of the Nightmare Flower seethe with chaotic energy. The plant twitches every now and then, releasing puffs of pollen into the air.The nearby satyrs and keepers can be seen harvesting similar plants for little crimson seeds.These seeds must be destroyed.

Title: Given to Corruption
Objective: Slay Keeper Varethos.
Text: A final favor for an old friend, perhaps? My age-old companion, Varethos, has fallen to the nightmare's torment. We once worked in unison to protect this land. His close ties to the land brought him low in this dark hour. As with all who suffer this fate, there is no restoring him. Please, bring him peace.

Title: Allegiance of Flame
Objective: Speak with Farseer Nobundo in The Heart of Azeroth.
Text: My rivals lay dead and there are none within the Firelands who dare oppose my rule! As promised, I will unite with the other Elemental Lords in the defense of Azeroth. The armies of the Firelands will scorch the battlefield with the corpses of our enemies! Go now, mortal. Tell your Earthen Ring that the Firelord himself stands with you!

Title: Dark Side of the Moon
Objective: Protect Tyrande while she holds her vigil at the Ancient Moonwell.
Text: Xavius has been this way, but his destination is unclear. The Nightmare smothers my mind!These refugees tell of an ancient Moonwell hidden in the ruins ahead.If it is uncorrupted, it will give me the focus I need. By Elune's light, we will find my husband yet.Meet me at the Moonwell at once.

Title: The Bloodsail Buccaneers
Objective: First Mate Crazz wants you to check the cove north of Booty Bay.
Text: You sure seem eager to work, matey. Not sure why some land-loving   is offering help to the Blackwater Raiders, but I'm not going to turn you away. We've made Booty Bay our happy home away from the high seas, but word has it that the Bloodsail have some new plan cooked up. All me boys are too busy hitting the grog and looking for ladies! What I need is a scout. Check the cove just north of Booty Bay along the Savage Coast and see what you find.

Title: Dazed of the Past
Objective: Construct a Stonehide Leather Barding.
Text: Let's begin crafting this mount armor, shall we?

Title: Negotiations Terminated
Objective: Return to Admiral Stonefist off the shore of Dragonmaw Hold in Twilight Highlands.
Text: Go now, go back to your fleet. Tell them what kind of a monster claims authority over the Dragonmaw. Our "Warchief" is a traitor to his blood. Since his return from Outland he reeks of demon and leads what remains of our clan to ruin. Help rid the Dragonmaw of Mor'ghor, and those of us with pure blood will be your allies forever. This I can promise.

Title: Protecting Her Royal Highness Poobah
Objective: Slay 5 Jaguero Stalkers.
Text: These vicious jungle cats have been circling me for some time now. I watch them as closely as I can, but they seem to just... disappear into the grass. How they snarl and hiss! Don't get me wrong... I still want you to rescue me, but first, clear out some of these cats. I won't need to be rescued if I end up someone's dinner.

Title: Mukla's Demise
Objective: Slay King Mukla obtain the Shackle Key.
Text: , I now put my faith in you to help free me. The great Skymane King Mukla is my captor. He commands the beasts of this island, and they keep me here against my will with the aid of this chain. If you can slay him and find the key to this shackle, I shall be indebted to you greatly. I often hear him to the southeast side of the island, but please be careful: he is not to be trifled with.

Title: Message in a Bottle
Objective: Find the author of the message at Jaguero Isle in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Text: Inside the bottle you find a note which reads, in fairly good handwriting:

Title: Grubby Little Paws
Objective: Obtain Poobah's Tiara, Poobah's Scepter, Poobah's Slippers, and Poobah's Diary from the apes on Jaguero Isle.
Text: I understand that you're anxious to rescue me, but the time is not yet right. First I'm going to need some of my things. The gorillas and the monkeys on the other side of the island have taken most of my possessions. I'll need my tiara, my scepter, my slippers, and my diary before I'm ready to leave. What? Stop looking at me like I'm some sort of insane person. You don't know what it's like being a princess.

Title: They Drew First Blood
Objective: Deliver Keeshan's Possessions to John J. Keeshan at the Lakeshire Inn in Redridge.
Text: Take this bundle of Keeshan's possessions and head back to the Lakeshire inn basement. Bravo Company is already there, talking to Keeshan. Remind him of who drew first blood. Lakeshire needs Keeshan. The Alliance needs Keeshan. Dismissed, soldier!

Title: A Dish Best Served Huge
Objective: Bring the Giant Crate of Giant Food to Captain Smotts' lifeboat, then use it to summon and kill Negolash.
Text: Take this food, and put it in our old lifeboat, southeast of here along the coast. When Negolash smells all that food, he'll come running! And when he does, there will be a stouthearted  ready to knock his corpse back into the briny deep.

Title: Mok'rash the Cleaver
Objective: Kill Mok'rash the Cleaver at Janeiro's Point.
Text: Mok'rash the Cleaver is the last of the lot. And the largest, by my memory. Taller than a wave in a windstorm, with a beard like a kelp forest and a hammer like an oak tree. He taunts me from Janeiro's Point, the island right off the end of this very pier. It's because of him that I'm still trapped here, living this lamentable landlubber's life. If you can swim, then head out to Janeiro's Point and slay Mok'rash. Take care. Mok'rash will not lay down as easily as his brothers.

Title: The Call of Kalimdor
Objective: Ride the ship from Booty Bay to Ratchet, then speak with Gazlowe.
Text: I've been sent by the good people of Theramore to find loyal members of the Alliance who are willing to help Lady Jaina with some problems in Dustwallow. You weren't really here working for the goblins, were you? The path back to Dustwallow will take you through Ratchet. Wait on the end of this pier for the next boat. Once you get to Ratchet, speak with Gazlowe. He'll point you in the right direction from there. Ugh, I think I stepped on a fish! And it flopped!

Title: Return to MacKinley
Objective: Bring Shaky's Payment to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley.
Text: Here, take this pouch and give it to Sea Wolf. And tell him I meant to pay him back! I swear!! I just got a little drunk and lost my way, and...you know how things are. He'll understand - you don't have to get rough!

Title: The Captain's Chest
Objective: Obtain Smotts' Chest from Gorlash in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Text: I used to sail a ship from here all the way to Ratchet, in Kalimdor. I was a successful captain with a sterling reputation. Until... Those cursed sea giants ruined me! They smashed my ship, killed my crew, and set me on a lifeboat to Booty Bay. I will not rest until their corpses pepper the ocean floor! One of the giants, Gorlash, stole my captain's chest. I hear Gorlash wanders the coast east of here. Find him and get back my chest! Do that, and you'll have earned a captain's gratitude.

Title: A Giant's Feast
Objective: Purchase a Crate of Grade-E Meat from Kelsey Yance and a Crate of Pupellyverbos Port from Whiskey Slim.
Text: The next giant on my list is called Negolash. I remember vividly how he leapt from the seafoam and plucked poor Poop-Deck Paul from the crow's nest. Swallowed him in one gulp, he did. And snapped my mizzenmast in two on the way down. No man on my crew deserves such a heinous death. So we're going to use Negolash's appetite against him. Kelsey Yance should be able to sell you some meat, and Whiskey Slim has enough booze to knock out... well, a sea giant. You'll find both of them in town.

Title: Kill-Collect
Objective: Obtain Maury's Clubbed Foot, Fitztittle's Ratcheting Torque Wrench, and Ephram's Jeweled Mirror.
Text: There's three phases to debt collecting: asking nicely, asking forcefully, and something I like to call "Phase Three". Unfortunately, collecting during Phase Three is something that this old dog can't do any more. That's why I employ so many cronies, stooges, mooks, goons, and noble adventurers like yourself! Juntz Fitztittle, Ephram Moonfall, and Maury Wilkins are hiding out on the eastern coast. You should have no problem visiting them all in one trip... and bringing back their valuables.

Title: Stranglethorn Fever
Objective: Seek out Witch Doctor Unbagwa and have him summon Mokk the Savage. Bring the Heart of Mokk to Fin Fizracket.
Text: Sick...so...very s-s-sick... have contracted Stranglethorn Fever.... ...technically... CAPE of Stranglethorn Fever.... ...deadly v-v-virus.... ...only cure... is... is... to eat the heart of M-m-m-m-mokk the Savage... elusive white beast.... ...Witch Doctor Unbagwa... only one who can s-s-summon.... ...seek Unbagwa in hidden cave on southern cape.... ...hurry... dying... dying....

Title: A Furious Catch
Objective: Catch a Giant Furious Pike in the Southfury River. The Southfury River can be found just outside Orgrimmar's western gate. Return to Razgar in the Valley of Honor once you are done.
Text: Are you up for a challenge? Good, I was hoping you would be. The Southfury River flows just west of Orgrimmar and your challenge can be found within its mighty flow. We are looking for a giant furious pike. This esteemed fish used to be prevalent in these areas but ever since the floods hit, the big ones have been much harder to find. Head out to the river and let's see just how good of an angler you really are.

Title: Scaring Shaky
Objective: Obtain 5 Mistvale Giblets from Elder Mistvale Gorillas.
Text: If there's one thing I can't stand, it's people who don't pay their gambling debts! And there are a lot of people who owe me. Think you can help me collect? First, there's "Shaky" Phillipe down by the docks. He owes me plenty after last week's game and I want my due! But to get it, we'll have to scare him. Go out of town and hunt elder mistvale gorillas. Find a nice selection of giblets, then take them to Shaky. Don't let on that they're from an animal; let him think the worst.

Title: The Wilds of Feralas
Objective: Travel to Feralas and speak with Konu Runetotem at Camp Ataya.
Text: You are truly brave to help us protect these lands, hero. If you wish to do more for the wilds, there are others in need of your aid. The verdant forests of Feralas lie to the south. There, in the shade of the mighty Twin Colossals, you must seek out Konu Runetotem. He has found signs of a disturbing illness. Follow the road west around the Twin Colossals to find Camp Ataya. Go in peace, and walk with the Earth Mother.

Title: Diffractory Chromascope
Objective: Obtain a Bloodsail Ruby and a Bloodsail Sapphire.
Text: To properly identify this artifact, I will need tools for analysis. A diffractory chromascope should suffice, I think. I already have the mithril casing, which surprisingly, is the hardest part to find. We simply need two other pieces: a ruby and a sapphire. There's pirates nearby, just to our south, and a bit farther to the east. Pirates love treasure... why don't you see if you can find some gems for me?

Title: The Holy Water of Clarity
Objective: Obtain The Holy Water of Clarity from the Nek'mani Wellspring in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Text: Hey, listen. You don't look like any old tourist, and I'm in a bit of a pickle. My cousin up north sent me this weird artifact, and I need your help to... ah... identify it. To start out, I'm going to need you to obtain The Holy Water of Clarity. Rumor has it that whoever drinks from this spring is given a vision of clarity. Sounds pretty promising, doesn't it? Obtain it from the Nek'mani Wellspring at the peak of the naga camp. Good luck!

Title: In Search of Bravo Company
Objective: Search Alther's Mill for a member of the Bravo Company.
Text: If you and Keeshan are going to defend Lakeshire, we're going to need to find his old battalion. Last I heard all of 'em - Messner, Jorgensen, Krakauer and Danforth - were captured by the Blackrock orcs. Now I don't know where they could possibly be or if they're even alive, but I'd be a damned fool if I didn't ask you to try and find 'em. Search Alther's Mill, east of here, for any clues.

Title: Battlefront Triage
Objective: Patch up 10 Injured Earthen.
Text: You seem quick on your feet. I need someone to go out into the chaos of the front and patch up our injured. Take my kit. It's simple enough to use. Heal them before the stone troggs finish them off for good.

Title: Breaking Out is Hard to Do
Objective: Retrieve Messner's Cage Key.
Text: The key to this cage is stored in a pouch over at the worg den, just north of our location. The problem is that the pouch is resting safely atop a tree stump amidst a sea of bloodthirsty man-killing worgs. You've got one shot to get that key without waking up any of those sleeping worgs. Head to the worg den and find a way into the center. Tread carefully and watch out for the Blackrock worg captain. Get the key and return to me. If you got a pet, I'd recommend telling it to stay back!

Title: Shaken and Stirred
Objective: Kill 8 Verlok Pillartumblers in the lower section of Verlok Stand.
Text: I have sent my brothers to assault the Verlok village from below. The Verlok will gather on their rocky ledges, as they always do to avoid our ire. When they do, we shall make the earth itself shake them until they fall at our feet below. That is where you prove your use. When they fall to the ground amongst my brothers, make sure that they do not rise again.

Title: Gone Soft
Objective: Kill 8 Fungal Behemoths.
Text: The fungal behemoths that surround us have succumbed to a weakness very similar to that that affects your kind. Their skin has grown soft. They no longer belong with the stone. Kill them. We do not wish to see this infection spread.

Title: Corruption Destruction
Objective: Retrieve 8 bags of Verlok Miracle-Grow.
Text: If this disgusting growth is truly brought on by the Verlok, then their supplies will be in their village to the north. Bring them to me so that I can verify your claims.

Title: Wrath of the Fungalmancer
Objective: Speak to Earthmender Norsala, then kill Fungalmancer Glop.
Text: Their leader hides within his hole ahead. He is the one that has brought the plague upon the crimson expanse. He must be killed. One of your Earthen Ring companions is already inside. You should speak with her.

Title: Unnatural Causes
Objective: Speak to Gorsik the Tumultuous in the Crimson Expanse.
Text: This is most definitely magic in origin. Not even druidic. I suspect one among the stone troggs to the north. Go to Gorsik and point him in their direction. Hopefully this will help earn his favor.

Title: A Head Full of Wind
Objective: Bring Lorvarius' wind-devil to the clouds of red mist in the Crimson Expanse, near the water, and then return with a sample.
Text: I'm no druid, but some of these mushrooms do not look to be naturally occurring. I know that our Stone Lord friend over there is eager to blame this on exposure to Azeroth, but I suspect more domestic causes. I saw some clouds of red mist to the northeast, near the water's edge. They seemed to be spurring new growth in their wake. Take one of my wind-devils with you and get me a sample from those clouds. You may have to stay close to the ground to spot them.

Title: Familiar Intruders
Objective: Speak to the "fleshling" intruders in the Crimson Expanse.
Text: Fleshling. Some of your kind skitter among the rocks. Too cowardly to approach, too swift to be crushed. If you wish my favor, deal with them. I tire of these games.

Title: Whispers of the Darkness
Objective: Free 6 Highmountain Protectors.
Text: Before our arrival, many of our own came to neutralize the threat here. They did not know what they were walking into.Our people are now suffering from the whispers. The Old Gods seek to corrupt them and turn them against their own.Wake them from their stupor. Free them from the whispers any way you can.

Title: Dark Tales
Objective: Meet Spiritwalker Graysky in Riverbend.
Text: Spiritwalker Ebonhorn is stable... for now.He once told me of the wards he maintains against the Old Gods. He placed them at key locations around this mountain, but kept them hidden from mortal eyes--even my own.Incapacitated like this, his wards cannot hold back the evil ones. No doubt this is the reason for their attack.To find the wards, we must enter the echoes of Ebonhorn's past and commune with the spirits we find there.Meet me in Riverbend. It is there our search begins.

Title: Rocky Upheaval
Objective: Speak to Gorsik the Tumultuous upon the Crimson Expanse.
Text: To the east, on the Crimson Expanse, you will find Gorsik. He embodies the more unstable and violent nature of our kind. He is neither friendly, nor trusting, but his word carries weight. Proving yourself to Gorsik will go a long way towards proving yourself to the Stonemother.

Title: Steady Hand
Objective: Speak to Terrath the Steady at the Pale Roost.
Text: Nearby to the north, you will find Terrath the Steady. He has taken upon the task of pulling the stone dragons back into the fold. We find ourselves repeating this trial every few hundred years... the stone dragons are fickle, and bend only to strength. Terrath is balanced and reasonable, but his goals may not be easily accomplished. Go to him. Appeal to the more balanced side of the Stonemother.

Title: The Gondolier
Objective: Make contact with the Gondolier.
Text: I need your help.The wine you so graciously distributed to the needy was the last of my reserves. Without more, these people here will risk succumbing to their thirst, and eventually becoming withered.I am dedicated to preventing this for as long as possible.There is a woman by the name of Deline who owns and operates a small delivery service out of her gondola.Find her, identify yourself as my messenger, and offer your aid in acquiring the next shipment.

Title: Doomshrooms
Objective: Destroy 10 Doomshrooms.
Text: The rift to your world has poisoned our home. Corrupted it. Polluted it. This expanse festers and grows. It becomes difficult to even see the purity of the rock beneath this filth. If you are here to lend your aid, then go about cleansing this overgrowth. Look for the brightly glowing mushrooms that are growing faster than the others. They are the worst of the offenders.

Title: Den of Shadows
Objective: Make contact with Arluin Shadowblade.
Text: Placeholder: Thalyssra sends you to find Arluin Shadowblade, a deft assassin once in her employ/social circle. (whichever fits) Indicate that he would be an invaluable asset to making progress in the City with covert operations.

Title: Lady Lunastre
Objective: Seek out Ly'leth at the Grand Promenade.
Text: Our friend Ly'leth contacted me. She requested that you meet her atop the Grand Promenade as it overlooks the city.Have your disguise ready just in case.

Title: The Mead Master
Objective: Speak to Apprentice Meldir in Stormheim.
Text: The vyrkul meadery overlooks the coast in northern Stormheim. Meet me there when you are ready.

Title: Vengeance Will Be Ours
Objective: Take the Aldrachi Warblades from Caria Felsoul.
Text: Caria lies in the very heart of Legion territory - they'll see our forces immediately if we try to launch an all-out attack. Failure is not an option. However, if you go alone you might be able to slip by unnoticed long enough to avoid the brunt of the Legion army. Remember,  - this is not a rescue mission. The power of the Aldrachi Warblades could tip the scales of this war in our favor; Allari and her men are expendable if need be.

Title: Zero to Hiro
Objective: Steal a Storm Brew, then save Hiro.
Text: I have a favor to ask of you. My good friend Hiro is still somewhere inside the main camp. Only problem is, the Gates of Valor are swarming with the biggest, baddest, nastiest Legion creatures I've ever seen. If we walk in there, we'll just get slaughtered. But I've seen these vrykul chugging some kind of special brew called Storm Brew. It's some kind of combat tonic that makes them bigger and stronger. Let's steal some of that drink, then storm in to save Hiro!

Title: The Iron Fist
Objective: Speak to Angus Ironfist at Tideskorn Warcamp in Stormheim.
Text: It's time to send a rescue operation to the Gates of Valor. I will prepare our troops and send them at once. We will need a sizable army to take on the massive Legion force in Stormheim. Grandmaster, go ahead whenever you are ready. I will send our forces to meet you in the field.

Title: No Monk Left Behind
Objective: Free 6 Tortured Prisoners.
Text: Most of the prisoners are being held in the main camp at the Gates of Valor. Our people have been beaten and tortured, and worse still awaits for them if we don't save them. Find the cages within the main camp and free as many monks as you can find. I'll be right beside you, knocking heads and taking names!

Title: Brick By Brick
Objective: Return to Iron-Body Ponshu on the Wandering Isle.
Text: Da monks be free, and we put a thorn in dat eredar lady's side. I'm back wit my friends, and lookin' forward to sleepin' in a bed tonight. Let's go back ta da Wanderin' Isle. I've never been so excited ta see a turtle in my life.

Title: Quelling the Tide
Objective: Kill 16 Legion defenders at the Gate of Valor.
Text: Our friends are in danger. We will save them. Kill any Legion in the way.

Title: The Master of Swords
Objective: Collect Dravax's Key from Dravax, then free Sylara Shadowheart.
Text: I got bad news fer ya - we don't have time to wait for reinforcements. They're sacrificin' prisoners now! Every minute we wait here jabberin' is another life on the line! First things first, my friend Sylara is being held captive in the camp just across the road. We need ta free her - she'll be a valuable ally. We've got ta move move move!

Title: Adella's Covert Camp
Objective: Report to Adella at Shadebough in Feralas.
Text: Lady Shandris has already asked for you to assist us further. Adella has struck out to the east, among the woodpaw gnolls, and established a foothold south of Camp Mojache. You are to report to her if you wish to assist Lady Shandris and the Alliance further. Don't stray too close to Camp Mojache... the Horde will not hesitate to attack. Keep to the south and look for our banners.

Title: Rock Bottom
Objective: Kill Gorgonite.
Text: I've one more favor to ask, fleshling. There is a basilisk, much larger and much older than the rest. Though we normally fear nothing from their kind, this one has become so potent as to petrify some of my sons. This shall not be abided. Find Gorgonite to the east and slay him. He has lived much longer than necessary.

Title: This Ain't My War
Objective: Return to Colonel Troteman.
Text: They asked me to fight in those wars. I didn't ask them! I did what I had to do to win. So I end up getting captured by those filthy, crap-swilling, maggot orcs and for five long years they used me as a toilet. Finally I break out and head back to my hometown and what do I get? People spitting on me, protesting me, calling me a baby orc killer and all kinds of vile crap! No, I don't think I'll be helping you. You go back to Troteman and you tell him that this ain't my war.

Title: His Heart Must Be In It
Objective: Recover Keeshan's Red Headband and Keeshan's Jade Amulet.
Text: His gear alone won't be enough. His heart must also be in this battle. To capture that, we need items of sentimental value. The Blackrock orcs of Render's Camp, located in the north, hold two such items that belong to Keeshan. Get up there and search their coffers for Keeshan's headband and a jade amulet left to him by his wife - who was brutally killed during a Blackrock orc invasion. Bring them back to me should you succeed.

Title: A Golden Opportunity
Objective: Use Razgar's Fillet Knife to cut off a Drowned Thunder lizard Tail in Thunder Ridge, south of Orgrimmar. Once you have the tail, use it near a Golden Stonefish to kill it. Return to Razgar in the Valley of Honor once you are done.
Text: You heard of the golden stonefish? The thing with these fish is that they can't be caught by normal means. They have jaws so strong that they snap right through any hooks or lures you try to use on 'em. You can find a number of them in Thunder Ridge, south of Orgrimmar. That ridge used to be full of thunder lizards, but they all drowned in the flood. Take my knife, swim down there and cut off their tails. You should be able to use the tail to zap any stonefish you find.

Title: Render's Army
Objective: Kill any 25 Blackrock Orcs in Alther's Mill or Render's Camp.
Text: Heading up north, eh? How about you wage your own little war against those Blackrock monsters? What do you say? Kill any Blackrock orc that you see at Alther's Mill or Render's Camp. Kill until your skin turns red from their blood splatter and then come back to me and I'll pay you handsomely. It might not stop the Blackrock invasion, but it'll be sure to put a kink in their plans.

Title: Weapons of War
Objective: Recover Keeshan's Bow and Keeshan's Survival Knife.
Text: What I'm about to ask of you isn't going to be easy to accomplish. Keeshan left everything back there in that orc prison, and I'm not just talking about his soul or his will to live. If we're going to get Johnny ready for war, we need to recover his prized possessions. The orcs now hold Keeshan's bow and his survival knife. Head to Alther's Mill, east of here and look for two orc lieutenants, Murdunk and Homurk. They've got Keeshan's gear. Get it back. I'll be in touch via gnomecorder.

Title: A Triumph of Gnomish Ingenuity
Objective: Speak with Engineer Grindspark in New Tinkertown.
Text: We will need all the weapons, inventions, and soldiers we can get in order to defeat Razlo Crushcog and his followers. Over to the northeast, you'll find Engineer Grindspark, one of a new generation of brilliant gnomish minds. Why, he hasn't had an explosion in over three prototypes! But enough bragging. Engineer Grindspark is working on a bot that he says will help clean up the toxic airfield. You should introduce yourself to him and see if he needs any help testing it.

Title: Surveying Equipment
Objective: Recover 5 Blackrock Spyglasses.
Text: Ah, my savior! I've heard that you're on a mission to save Lakeshire... and my bridge. Yep, worked too damned long on that thing to let it get destroyed by an army of marauding orc monsters! Listen, if you're headed up north towards Render's Camp, would you do me a solid and get me some spyglasses from the Blackrock trackers up there? I could sure use 'em for my new surveying gear.

Title: Jorgensen
Objective: Retrieve Jorgensen's Cage Key.
Text: I don't know where Krakauer or Danforth are, but Jorgensen was being held at Render's Camp, northwest of here. I was in the same crap filled cage with him before they relocated me to Alther's Mill. If we're gonna get him out we'll need the key. A stone cold witch from hell known as Utroka the Keymistress holds on tight to that thing. We'll have to kill her if we're going to get Jorgensen's cage key. She's up north in the valley leading to the Burning Steppes. Let's go, kid.

Title: John J. Keeshan
Objective: Enlist the help of John J. Keeshan at the Lakeshire Inn in Lakeshire.
Text: You ever heard of John Keeshan? I was his commanding officer throughout all three great wars. Let me tell you, that man has killed more orcs than any man alive. If anyone can stop the Blackrock orc invasion, it's JOHN J. KEESHAN. We need to get him to help us or Lakeshire will be nothing more than a mound of rubble and ash after that massive Blackrock army marches through to Elwynn. I heard he was fighting in the underground fight club at the Lakeshire inn. Find him and tell him everything you know.

Title: Return of the Bravo Company
Objective: Report to Colonel Troteman at Lakeshire in Redridge.
Text: I don't know who you are, but you've earned the respect and admiration of the Bravo Company. You've managed to save all our hides and kill a boatload of orcs in the process. Now we return the favor. Get back to Lakeshire and report to Colonel Troteman. We'll find Johnny and deliver the good news in person. With the Bravo Company back in action, these orcs don't stand a chance.

Title: A Furious Catch (REMOVED)
Objective: Catch a Furious Pike in the Southfury River. The Southfury River can be found just outside Orgrimmar's western gate. Return to Razgar in the Valley of Honor once you are done.
Text: Are you up for a challenge? Good, I was hoping you would be. The southfury river flows just west of Orgrimmar and your challenge can be found within it's mighty flow. We are looking for a furious pike. This mighty fish used to be prevalent in these areas but ever since the floods hit, they have been much harder to find. Head out to the river and let's see just how good of an angler you really are.

Title: Fixer Upper
Objective: Collect 6 Catapult Parts.
Text: They've smashed all of our catapults. I've been trying to get this one working, but no luck so far. Maybe you'd like to make yourself useful. Head out onto the front and grab me any spare parts you come across. You think you can handle that, flesh bag?

Title: Krakauer
Objective: Kill Ritualist Tarak.
Text: Krakauer is up on the chopping block as we speak! The orcs brought in a Gurubashi witch doctor to perform a dark ritual on him. We need to kill that troll to free Krakauer! Let's go! He's just inside the cave here. Hang a right at the first fork.

Title: And Last But Not Least... Danforth
Objective: Kill Overlord Barbarius and recover the Blackrock Lever Key. Use the Blackrock Lever Key to free Danforth.
Text: Danforth's being tortured on the other side of the cave. There's no telling what state he's in by now! We need to get over there and save him! Overlord Barbarius has the key to the lever holding Danforth up. We work together as a team and we can kill that bastard, Barbarius. Once Barbarius is dead, we use his key to get Danforth down and get out of here! Ready?

Title: Summoning Shadra
Objective: Use the Idol of Shadra at the Northwestern, Southwestern, and Eastern Temples in Shadra'Alor.
Text: The idol is prepared. I trust that you are as well? You will go southwest to Shadra'Alor ahead of us with the idol. You'll need to use the idol at each of the three temples. When you do that, Shadra will be summoned to this realm. The Deathstalkers and I will be along shortly to subdue and harvest her body. Speak with the lookout I've sent ahead once you've performed the ritual, and await my arrival.

Title: Eliminate the Outcast
Objective: Travel to the Ruins of Aboraz in the Cape of Stranglethorn and deal with Zanzil the Outcast.
