Objective: Bring the Immaculate Stormscale to Kondal Huntsworn in Dalaran.
Text: You have been skinning for a long time now, but never have you seen a scale specimen as fine as this. Your trainer in Dalaran would be VERY interested in seeing this.

Title: Mother's Prized Knife
Objective: Obtain Agnes' Skinning Knife.
Text: The other day, Mother and I were up at the top of the nearby mountain, and she threw her skinning knife at me because the view wasn't good enough. Her knife is still up there, somewhere. I'd feel horrible just leaving it.

Title: Unfinished Treatise on the Properties of Stormscale
Objective: Bring the Unfinished Treatise on the Properties of Stormscale to Kondal Huntsworn in Dalaran.
Text: Tucked between the folds of this animal's hide, you find a scrap of paper. It appears to be a handwritten guide to harvesting stormscales, but too much of the manuscript has been lost to be of use. Perhaps your skinning trainer in Dalaran could help you find its owner.

Title: Seymour and Agnes
Objective: Find Seymour in Stormheim.
Text: The other skinner - pair of skinners, to be honest - that comes to mind when you show me this scroll is a student of mine, named Seymour, and his mother Agnes. Last I heard, they were in Stormheim, hunting the storm drakes.

Title: Drakol'nir Must Die
Objective: Obtain the Scale of Drakol'nir.
Text: The dragon that took Mother's life was named Drakol'nir. Mother always wanted to wear his scale as a pendant, but we never got a chance to skin him because I couldn't kill him alone, and she didn't care much for killing. Only skinning. You... you wouldn't mind bringing it for her, would you?

Title: Red-Eyed Revenge
Objective: Slay 15 Adult Squallhunters.
Text: It came out of nowhere. I was waiting for mother to finish skinning her half of the drake when the biggest storm dragon I'd ever seen came and... and...  I want you to kill as many of them as you can. Skin them, don't skin them, I don't care. Just get revenge for mother!

Title: Under Down
Objective: Obtain 20 Hippogryph Scales.
Text: I can train you, though. Everyone knows about the bright stormscales on the hippogryph's hindquarters, but did you know that they also have a few scales beneath their feathers? You just need to know where to look.  Now go see if you can get some on your own.

Title: Seaside Salvage
Objective: Collect 7 Steamwheedle Supplies.
Text: If we want to convince Mister Noggenfogger to let us move more gnomes here, we've got to show him just how nice we are! I know just the thing. Gadgetzan's under blockade by pirates, but plenty of the goods that get blown off the ships survive intact... they just wash away. Most of them wash up in the shallows just south of town. If you could go collect those supplies for them, it'd help us make friends! And it'll keep that mean goblin girl over there from taking them and selling them.

Title: The Core of the Stormscale
Objective: Obtain 20 Stormscale Sparks by skinning scaled creatures in the Broken Isles.
Text: Ahh, yes. The elusive stormscale. I have seen similar scales in Northrend, and some in Skywall, but it would appear that such a scale is common here. My colleagues that specialize in mail armor will be happy to learn this. To more efficiently harvest this type of scale, you must first understand its power. Look for broken, unusable scales on your quarry, and remove the sparks within them. Once you have seen the sparks, you will better understand the stormscale.

Title: Diplomacy By Another Means
Objective: Take the Horn of Challenge to the Bristleback Challenge Ring in Southern Barrens. Blow the horn to challenge Sabersnout and kill him.
Text: I have not forgotten my brush with death at the hands of the quilboar in that filthy jungle. The General here has ordered some tactical strikes, but he stops short of genocide. I have no such qualms. Take this horn that I 'borrowed' during my negotiations. Blow the horn within the Bristleback challenge ring west of our position - you can't miss it. I want you to challenge the champion of the Bristleback, Sabersnout, to single combat. His death in front of his followers will leave them in utter chaos.

Title: Glielle
Objective: Find Glielle in Azsuna.
Text: One skinner makes the wilds of Azsuna her home. Her name is Glielle, and she is a night elf - or at least, she was, in life. Perhaps the scroll was hers.

Title: A Line in the Dirt
Objective: Capture a neutral hill in the Fields of Blood and defend it against a Horde counter-attack.
Text: Strategically, control of a region requires constant observation. See here on this map - I've identified a number of strategic hills, similar to this one, that the Alliance must acquire if we are to keep the enemy under our thumb. My scouts have already marked their location on the field. What I need is someone to spearhead their capture, and you're the  for the job. Seek out neutral grey flags on hills to the north, east, and south of the Taurajo Ruins. Capture one and defend it!

Title: Broken Panther Figurine
Objective: Repair the broken figurine using your skill and materials.
Text: This badly broken figurine was discarded by its last owner. However, with the right materials and your skill in jewelcrafting, it could be completely restored.

Title: A Daughter's Embrace
Objective: Bring Lilian Voss to her father in the tower at Crusader's Run.
Text: The whisper continues:

Title: Marching On Our Stomachs
Objective: Collect 4 Fresh Stormsnout Steaks by killing Stormsnouts in Southern Barrens.
Text: It's true what they say: An army marches on its stomach. And we've been marching a long way. I'm thinking if we barbecue up a few of those giant lumbering stormsnouts, we'll have enough meat to feed us for weeks. Stormsnouts are big and slow, so they should be easy to kill. Except... Hey you're not carrying any metal on you are you?

Title: Lion's Pride
Objective: Kill any combination of 5 Plains Prowlers or Plains Pridemanes.
Text: Respect the lion! A ferocious killer. You gotta admire the elegance of the beast... Muscle and claws... Running down its food... So primal... I'm sorry, my mind wandered. As I was saying, I respect these lions, but they're just murder on our patrols. I mean that literally. The men are afraid to go to the bathroom alone at night. Can you help make our camp a little safer? Barrens lions like to linger under trees.

Title: Gordo's Task
Objective: Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in Brill.
Text: Master want weeds. Us gots big hands and not good at picking. You help us and we not hurt you. Us need gloom weed. Many weeds around here and near road. When you have gloom weed you take to Master Holland in Brill.

Title: Fields of Blood
Objective: Kill 10 Desolation Grunts at the Fields of Blood in Southern Barrens.
Text: The Horde has taken to calling this region the "Fields of Blood." It's an apt name: these reeds run red with the blood of some of my best men. I've sent out recon patrols to crush the quilboar and report on the Horde troop movements, but not all of them return. They could use your support out there. Patrol the fields and seek out the Desolation Grunts that are causing us so much grief. Do not expect them to surrender; their Warchief has instructed them to fight to the death.

Title: Crab Fishin'
Objective: Kill Pygmy Surf Crawlers and collect 5 Fresh Crawler Meat.
Text: Perhaps me agin' body is just growin' too picky after all dese years, but boar meat just ain't goin' down easy no more. More for da new recruits I be thinkin'. We just set out some crab traps, but if ya be willin' ta help an impatient old troll, I'd love ta have some fresh crawler meat right now. Dey're all around da island, but da best spot ta be huntin' them is off da eastern coast.

Title: To the Front!
Objective: Locate Ambassador Gaines at Forward Command in Southern Barrens.
Text: I'd love to keep you here behind the lines, but it looks like you've been summoned to the front. Ambassador Gaines - remember him? - has relocated to Forward Command and in his latest missive he's requested you, personally, to assist him. You'll find our Forward Command operation south of here, in what's become known as the "Fields of Blood." Be careful. The Horde has taken to ambushing some of our officers en route.

Title: Have You Seen Anything Weird Out There?
Objective: Speak with Executor Zygand about your encounter with the worgen.
Text: ! Listen up, I got somethin'... odd to discuss. I was out fishin' by Brightwater Lake when I saw the darnedest thing... some sorta wolf-man, running around Tirisfal. Ya don't suppose that could be a... worgen, do ya? Anyway, I keep tellin' myself I should tell Executor Zygand about it, but I just get so scared when I talk to that guy. Maybe you could talk with him?

Title: Teegan's Troubles
Objective: Report to Corporal Teegan at Teegan's Expedition in Southern Barrens.
Text: The Admiral will be pleased that Northwatch is almost secured, but if we're to keep a grip on this continent we're going to need to maintain the supply lines to the interior. Just before the assault I received the strangest of reports from Corporal Teegan, who's in charge of maintaining our contact with Forward Command. Says he's having trouble with the "jungle?" There's no jungle in the Barrens! Follow the upper road out of Northwatch and see if you can render any assistance to our wayward Corporal.

Title: Head for the Mills
Objective: Report to Coleman Farthing at Agamand Mills in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: The Agamand Mills, to the west, have been lost to the Scourge. The Agamand family has been slain, and the entire residence has been claimed by the Scourge. This is probably the largest Scourge outpost in Tirisfal. If you think you're enough of a , head up there and speak with Coleman Farthing. He's been doing his best to take the land back, and he'll need help. Just follow this road, it'll take you right to him.

Title: The Red Messenger
Objective: Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, and obtain any information you can find.
Text: Reports from my superiors in Brill indicate that an agent of the Scarlet Crusade was dispatched from the Scarlet Monastery and sent here to Deathknell. According to the reports, the messenger possesses important information on his person. I do not have further details, but whatever it is, we must have it! You're the most qualified person I have to send. Find that messenger and bring me whatever information you can find.

Title: Trouble From the Ground Up
Objective: Gather 10 Unusual Flower Buds from Budding Flowers in the overgrowth.
Text: Teegan's a fool to think the quilboar caused this sudden overgrowth. Look around you. I've been watching these plants bloom and sprout daily - each generation is more mutated than the last. This isn't tribal magic - it's something primal. And dangerous. The day before last a great druid passed through our camp. Seek out Naralex, somewhere in the midst of this jungle. He'll know what to do. And bring him some plant samples from around the overgrowth to help his studies.

Title: The Haunted Mills
Objective: Bring Dargol's Skull to Coleman Farthing at the Agamand Mills.
Text: You sense a malign presence coming from within the skull of the beast. Coleman Farthing may be interested in seeing this.

Title: Deaths in the Family
Objective: Obtain Gregor's Remains, Nissa's Remains, Thurman's Remains, and Devlin's Remains.
Text: The Agamand family was the most prosperous family in Tirisfal Glades. I used to work their mills...before the plague. When the Scourge first came, the Agamands fortified their home and convinced those in their employ to remain and help them defend. We were fools, but at least we were loyal fools. The Agamands, in their pride, doomed us to undeath. And now they are minions of the Scourge! Serve the Forsaken by defeating the Agamands who fell to the plague. Serve me by bringing me their remains.

Title: Secrets in the Oasis
Objective: Search for Jang'thraze the Protector.
Text: Yes, I see the other half now, mon...to the south... We be close now, mon. It's in an oasis, buried in de muck beneath de water. Don't delay!

Title: You Flicked a Fine Vine to Leaf Me
Objective: Use the Bramblestaff on Three-Tooth and kill her 2 Deviate Crones in the Overgrowth.
Text: According to Gaines, "Three-Tooth" is what the quilboar call their matriarch. She's been twisting the thorns of this crazy jungle to her own ends, and it was her orders that Gaines be "torn apart and fed to the overgrowth." Nice lady. Let's give her a taste of her own. Take the Bramblestaff you recovered, and use it on Three-Tooth to take her out of the picture. Then kill the crones she's been training, to ensure nobody else can take her place.

Title: Breaking the Line
Objective: Speak to Jornun to secure a ride to Spitescale Cove and then seek out Morakki.
Text: Vol'jin be callin' for an all out attack on da naga that have taken over our northern isle. Many of our men were already engaged with their forces near da bridge, but several of us are breakin' through their lines ta assault their isle itself. Speak to Jornun right 'ere to secure a ride to da isle. Once there, seek out Morakki, da Captain of da Watch. He will be tellin' ya how ya can aid in da battle.

Title: Repel the Paratroopers
Objective: Slay 10 Alliance Paratroopers.
Text: The Alliance have caught back up with us at just the wrong moment, my friend. We took care of their ships, but they still have planes that are dropping their vaunted 127th Paratroopers onto the coast below. It's all that the battlesworn and scouts can do to hold the two ramps against their overwhelming numbers. I'm certain that if you were to aid them, the tide would quickly be turned.

Title: Darkest Mojo
Objective: Collect 6 Darkest Mojo from Sandfury Zombies.
Text: Jang'thraze eludes me, mon... de blood is not enough. We gonna need somethin' stronger to find it. When you need every troll you got to help out to scrape by, one o' them dyin' on ya is a big problem, mon, an' dat's why de Sandfury learned to raise our dead wit' da voodoo. You fall over, you just get back up again and keep workin'... forever! De zombies we make be imbued wit' darkest mojo. You go on to de west an' find a whole mess o' dem, an' get me dat mojo, yah?

Title: A Failure to Communicate
Objective: Rescue Ambassador Gaines from the quilboar in the Overgrowth.
Text: I told him he was a fool, but Ambassador Gaines insisted he could negotiate an alliance with the quilboar against the Horde. Even if he succeeded, I for one wouldn't want to fight with those ... pig-men at my side. Well, Gaines hasn't returned, and General Hawthorne will hold me accountable if I lose one of our best negotiators to these squealing savages. Locate the Ambassador in this steaming mess of a jungle and rescue him if he's still alive.

Title: Sang'thraze the Deflector
Objective: Defeat Zakkaru and collect the Sealed Sang'Thraze.
Text: The blood speaks. I can feel its flow through the sand...drenched in death, a desert of suffering...  There! The blood flows to the south, in a valley of bones. Zakkaru! Zakkaru, spawn of Makkari, the dark one who demands sacrifice... his father forced from Zul'Farrak, his ascension interrupted... he will taste blood once more...  Go. Zakkaru has Sang'thraze. Ya not be wanting him to keep it, trust me.

Title: Old Friends
Objective: Speak with Thrall at the Warchief's Lookout on the Lost Isles.
Text: Alright then, grab onto the ladder. We gotta get outa here! We'll make a flyby of the town, and then I'm gonna get you to some old friends!

Title: Laying Claim
Objective: Kill 10 Dwarven Archeologists.
Text: We are not the only ones who have discovered the value of the Southmoon Ruins. The dwarves of the Explorers' League have swarmed there, taking artifacts and inscriptions for the Alliance. I don't think I have to explain much further. We will not allow the discoveries here to fall into the hands of the Alliance. Slay as many dwarves as you can, and drive them from the ruins!

Title: Fragments of Language
Objective: Collect 5 Ancient Hieroglyphs.
Text: At the Southmoon ruins, just east of here, we've made some finds. My colleagues have found stone shards, engraved with ancient writings, newly exposed by the shifting sands. The writings are in no known tongue, though they bear resemblance to markings we've seen on other ruins of the titans. Deciphering them could reveal many more secrets. Unfortunately, my colleagues are also busy defending the tablets from the Alliance. I need you to go to the Southmoon ruins and retrieve the tablets yourself.

Title: Blood to Thrive
Objective: Collect 6 Fistfuls of Blood from Sandfury Trolls.
Text: To survive in de harsh desert, de Sandfury had to learn all de secrets of blood magic. You drink de blood, you get de power...darkest voodoo, yah? But dere be no room for holdin' back out here. If we gonna find de sword, we need blood. Lucky for ya, Mazoga be a traitor, yah? And dere be plenty of Sandfury trolls wanderin' over de hills dere. Go an' get Mazoga blood...plenty of blood...and we make de ritual to find Jang'thraze.

Title: Stormscale Sample
Objective: Bring the Stormscale Sample to Kondal Huntsworn in Dalaran.
Text: This scale shimmers with electrical energy. Your skinning trainer in Dalaran would be interested in seeing this.

Title: Ancient Obstacles
Objective: Destroy 6 Sandstone Golems.
Text: For years, this valley has been sealed behind impenetrable gates. Now that the cataclysm has torn them down, the secrets within are ours to discover. There are yet some obstacles in the way. From within the gates, the bygone creations of the titans have awoken. They wander aimlessly across the sand, attacking any who approach. Someone needs to destroy the golems patrolling the valley; are you up to it?

Title: Ske'rit's Leather Handbook
Objective: Bring Ske'rit's Leather Handbook to Kondal Huntsworn in Dalaran.
Text: An' wit dat, my research be done.  Dis is what I been workin' on here in Suramar. Bring it to Kondal, so dat he can teach it to all you other skinnahs. Since you been helpin' so much, I put your name on it. Hope you don't mind.

Title: The Freedom to Roam
Objective: Obtain 5 Musken Hides, 5 Lion Seal Hides, 5 Boar Hides, and 5 Wolf Hides.
Text: I remember bein' young. D'ye remember it? So much less responsibility... I could just run around as I pleased. Now, I'm pretty much stuck with my hunting crew, here in Highmountain. There're so many interestin' creatures in the other regions o'the Broken Isles, though. I'll mark yer map, you get out there and do some skinnin'!

Title: Trial of the Crusader: Hides of Legend
Objective: Obtain the Hide of Icehowl from the Trial of the Crusader.
Text: Ya, I can train you. Ting is, I'm still workin' on my techniques 'ere in Suramar. In fact, you can probably help. I need ta look at a few special skins, for comparison. I need a strong white yeti pelt, a really big demon skin, and da thickest direhorn skin you can find. Do that, and I'll share my results with you and' ol' Kondal up in de city.

Title: Halls of Valor: The Hide of Fenryr
Objective: Obtain the Hide of Fenryr by skinning Fenryr in Valhallas.
Text: While you be here, I got a favor t'ask you. I been hearin' whispers about one big, nasty wolf dat's been causin' all kinds of trouble up in de vrykul lands. His name be Fenryr. I want his hide.

Title: Highmountain Hides
Objective: Obtain 5 Bear Hides, 5 Elderhorn Hides, and 5 Saber Hides by skinning the creatures of Highmountain.
Text: So, ye're a skinner too, aye? That's great news! I don't think I ever knew we shared that in common. Ye've GOT ta see some o'the hides we've got here in Highmountain. Why, I'd give me spare monacle just t'get me hands on some o'those fine, silky hides...

Title: Immaculate Stonehide Leather
Objective: Bring the Immaculate Stonehide Leather to Kondal Huntsworn in Dalaran.
Text: You have been skinning for a long time now, but never have you seen a leather specimen as fine as this. Durable, pliable, beautifully colored... Your trainer in Dalaran would be VERY interested in seeing this.

Title: Repairing the Source
Objective: You have found a damaged power core for an arcane construct. It seems like you could repair the device.

Title: Stonehide Leather Sample
Objective: Bring the Stonehide Leather Sample, along with 10 additional pieces of Stonehide Leather, to Kondal Huntsworn in Dalaran.
Text: The quality of this leather scrap appears representative of the beast hides found in the Broken Isles. Your skinning trainer in Dalaran would be interested in seeing this.

Title: Scrap of Pants
Objective: Bring the Scrap of Pants to Hemet Nesingwary in Highmountain.
Text: The mouth of this particular beast contained a piece of handsewn cloth. The fabric bears the word "singwa". While the term "singwa" is unfamiliar, it DOES happen to be the middle of the last name of a fairly notable Azerothian skinner.

Title: Leather for Ske'rit
Objective: Report to Ske'rit in Suramar.
Text: This hide certifies that you have learned everything about leather that I can teach you. My skills have dulled since I set up shop here in town. I have a former protege who skins the creatures of Suramar. His name is Ske'rit. His skills remain as sharp as his blade, and if there is anyone out there who can teach you, it is him.

Title: In One Piece
Objective: Obtain 20 Undivided Hides by skinning the beasts of the Broken Isles.
Text: This hide is usable, but it is mournably small. You disrespect the beast by chopping it up like this. You make light of the gift that it gave to you. Go out into the wilds again. Skin the leathery beasts below us, and this time, bring me hides in one piece.

Title: Andoren Will Know
Objective: Deliver the artifact to Andoren Dawnrise at the Valley of the Watchers.
Text: Listen carefully. I don't know how those ogres got ahold of it, but that thing's a titan artifact. I'm no expert, but just that fact alone makes it probably older than the sand we're standing on. I also know that things like this are nothing but trouble. I don't want anything to do with it. Take it south, to the Valley of the Watchers, and give it to a blood elf named Andoren Dawnrise there. And don't ask any questions, babe, please.

Title: Washed Clean
Objective: Meet the Fallen Priestess at the Nor'Danil Wellspring. Watch as the priestess attempts the purification ritual.
Text: Mighty though the Legion is, theirs is not the strongest power in Azeroth. There is a place where Enchantress Ilanya and I spent many blissful hours together. The love that infuses such a place is more potent than fel magic. Go to the Nor'Danil Wellspring. Its waters can purify the fel dust you have collected... and perhaps purify me as well. I will meet you there.

Title: Branch of the Arcan'dor
Objective: Speak with Thalyssra.
Text: You have used the spellstone of Kel'danath to soothe countless withered. Yet it contains merely a shade of the arcan'dor's power, drawn from its slumbering seed.This fell from the tree. Though it is severed, it is not dead - invisible threads of magic bind all pieces of the arcan'dor together.I have enchanted this branch with a new iteration of Kel'danath's charm spell. With it, you can mend the arcane essence of even more withered. Use it well.

Title: A Murky Fate
Objective: Use the Smoldering Torch to burn 8 Decaying Corpses in Morheim.
Text: You may not know, but you stand upon the grounds of Morheim, home to the greatest warriors of the land. Our deeds were great, our valor legendary. It pains me that we see such an end.The creatures set upon us at nightfall. Our men fought bravely, but were vastly outnumbered. Now their corpses lie rotting in the sun, with no burial and no rites.This is not an end befitting to the glorious warriors of Morheim. Make it right, and you will have our thanks.

Title: Cenarius, Keeper of the Grove
Objective: Speak to Malfurion Stormrage at Lorlathil in Val'sharah.
Text: Ahh, Val'sharah. It has been an age since I have set foot in these sacred woods. Too long... Our work here is simple. We must call upon my mentor, Cenarius, and learn where he safeguards the Tears of Elune. With them, you will be one step closer to sealing Sargeras' Tomb and thwarting the Legion. You have many treacherous tasks in front of you. Consider your visit here a brief respite. Come, this will not take long.

Title: The Nightborne Pact
Objective: Bandage Thalyssra.
Text: Ngh... I can ignore this wound no longer.Help me patch this up. I will explain everything.

Title: Huln's War - Malorne's Favored
Objective: Rescue Eche'ro.
Text: Shan'do ask for you. Sent Eche'ro beast with message on rack.Unng Ak hear Eche'ro sound fighting. You find beast? Give help, maybe feathered night elf be relieve.

Title: Make 'em Squeal
Objective: Kill any combination of 8 Bristleback Bladewardens or Deviate Thornweavers, and collect a Bramblestaff from one of the Thornweavers.
Text: One of the native species in Kalimdor is the 'quilboar.' Prickly little buggers. Reason enough to hate this continent. The raids started shortly after we established our forward camps. Worse, those spiny fiends seem to thrive in this thorny hell of a jungle. I need you to help beat them back so we can re-establish contact with Forward Command. While you're out there, acquire one of those twisted branches their casters seem to be using to manipulate the jungle growth...

Title: Sandscraper's Treasure
Objective: Talk to Megs Dreadshredder.
Text: Inside this weathered stone chest at the back of Stonescraper's lair, you find a curious artifact. Shaped like a beetle, its surface is a smooth, brilliant blue, lined with gold. It looks mechanical, but unlike anything you've seen crafted by mortal hands, and very old. Megs will probably be interested in this.

Title: A Little Oomph
Objective: Obtain 4 samples of Vicious Night Web Spider Venom.
Text: Hmm... this isn't quite there. It needs something to give it a little more zing. I've got it! The spiders to the north have a potent venom that'll do the trick. See if you can extract some for me?

Title: Filthy Animals
Objective: Kill 6 Hecklefang Scavengers.
Text: You probably caught wind of some of them Hecklefang scavengers on the way in - they reek worse than ol' Durty Pete here. Worthless animals! They steal our kills, rummage through our supplies, and worse... they ain't good for eatin'. Go kill some. Then kill some more, if you want to.

Title: To Bigger and Better Things
Objective: Speak with Timothy Cunningham at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: There isn't much more glory for you here on the Bulwark. You've done enough already. There may, however, be further adventures waiting in Silverpine Forest. Speak with my bat man, Timothy Cunningham. He'll give you a ride to Brill, free of charge.

Title: Take to the Skies
Objective: Speak with Executor Zygand at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: If you're headed back to Brill, you'll want to stop by Executor Zygand on your way out. I hear there's some excitement going on in Silverpine Forest, to the south. He'll know more than I do. Speak with me again when you're ready to head out.

Title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
Objective: Slay 3 Scarlet Zealots and 4 Scarlet Friars.
Text: Though the strength of the Scarlet Crusade wanes, we are still at war. The report Executor Arren sent me indicates Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in southeastern Tirisfal near the Balnir Farmstead under the command of Captain Vachon. Kill 3 of his zealots and 4 of his friars. It should prove to be a devastating blow to the Crusade!

Title: The Grasp Weakens
Objective: Speak with Shadow Priestess Malia in Brill and participate in the extraction of Devlin Agamand.
Text: While the Frozen Throne lies dormant, the grasp that the Lich King once held over the Scourge grows ever-weaker. His grip on a weakling like Devlin Agamand should be weak enough that we can remove it entirely. Speak with Shadow Priestess Malia in the manor on the east side of town. She will assist you in the procedure.

Title: A Deadly New Ally
Objective: Look for your new ally at the Scarlet Encampment in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: Shortly before you arrived at the Bulwark, I was approached by the most unusual young undead woman. She swore enmity against the Scarlet Crusade, so I sent her to work on our enemies to the north. You say you saw some dead crusaders earlier? Those were probably her work. Go check up on her, and see if she can use any assistance in her vendetta against the Crusade... though I wouldn't be surprised if she's already killed them all.

Title: East... Always to the East
Objective: Report to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: You've done much for us here, but  of your caliber are needed elsewhere. To the east lies the Bulwark: a fortified barricade against the ravages of the Plaguelands. The Bulwark protects us from Scourge invasions, and has allowed us enough sanctity to build up our forces here in Tirisfal Glades. Go, speak with High Executor Derrington. He is an ally, and will doubtless appreciate whatever aid you can give him.

Title: Speak with Sevren
Objective: Speak with Magistrate Sevren at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: I have destroyed the remains you've given me. That is, all remains except for these... Devlin Agamand was weak and sharp-tongued in life, and was among the first to succumb to the plague. He existed as a slave of the Scourge for a long time, longer than most. As such, he may possess knowledge that would be of value to us. Bring his remains to Magistrate Sevren, and tell him what I've told you. He'll know what to do.

Title: The Family Crypt
Objective: Kill 5 Wailing Ancestors and 5 Rotting Ancestors.
Text: The strongest point in the mills is the Agamand Family Crypt. With necromancy, Captain Dargol has raised the ancestors of the Agamands and plans to use them against us. This cannot pass, and you must stop it. Travel to the Agamand Family Crypt and defeat the raised Agamand ancestors.

Title: Teegan's People
Objective: Kill Terrortooth Runners and Terrortooth Scytheclaws to collect 8 Terrortooth Hides.
Text: Hey! Are you headed to support Corporal Teegan? He's in charge of keeping the supply routes open. He's got two of the most ornery dwarves I've ever met in charge of sundries. If you want to make an impression on those two crotchety hunters, you're going to need to show that you can hold your own against the predators around here. The raptors west of the hold here are especially vicious. Bring Goucho some fresh hides and you'll make an impression while supplying the troops in one swoop.

Title: Sandscraper
Objective: Kill Sandscraper.
Text: My other assistants are making sure our proud new comrades are put into comfy cages and shipped to where they're needed most. For the Horde. Meanwhile, we've got one last item on our agenda. Sandscraper, the chief of the Dunemaul Clan, is probably too dumb to even be aware of what we're doing here. But I absolutely loathe unfinished business, babe. He's lurking in the den just over there to the west. Knuckle down, take him out, and we'll be good to sign off on this, 'kay?

Title: The Mills Overrun
Objective: Gather 5 Notched Ribs and 3 Blackened Skulls.
Text: The Scourge are trying to form a base here at the Agamand Mills. If they do, then they can stage further attacks within Tirisfal. The orders have been given. The Scourge in the Mills must be destroyed. Collect Notched Ribs from Rattlecage and Cracked Skull Soldiers, and Blackened Skulls from Darkeye Bonecasters.

Title: Scavenged
Objective: Retrieve 10 Northwatch Supply Crates from the Raptor Den.

Title: Doom Weed
Objective: Collect 10 Doom Weed.
Text: My envoy just delivered me a bushel of gloom weed. Gloom weed! I don't need gloom weed, I need doom weed! You can see the predicament that I'm in. I'll make it worth your while to gather what I need. Bring back to me enough doom weed and I'll give you a suitable reward. It is my understanding that they like to plague the flora near the mass gravesite, to the north of the Brill graveyard. Hurry and be mindful of the gnolls in the area.

Title: Maggot Eye
Objective: Kill Maggot Eye and obtain his paw.
Text: Maggot Eye is a foul beast, even by gnoll standards. He leads a band of renegade gnolls through the land, tearing up the glades and stealing whatever corpses he can find along the way. Those are our corpses! We had plans for those! Maggot Eye resides just up the path from us. Show him no mercy. Mercy is for the weak.

Title: Planting the Seed of Fear
Objective: Chase 12 Vile Fin Tadpoles until they pass out in fear.
Text: It seems that Jerrod has you hunting the murlocs to the north. That's good... we can use their parts for our poisons. I get a little worried sometimes, though... The Vile Fin spawning grounds are not far off Tirisfal's northern coast, so you'll probably notice several tadpoles among the adults on the shore. If these impressionable young murlocs were to seek revenge against us... that could ruin us. Go chase them, and show them that the Forsaken and the Horde are not to be trifled with.

Title: Holland's Experiment
Objective: Bring Holland's Special Drink to the Captured Mountaineer.
Text: I am to understand that another one of those foolish Dwarven Mountaineers has just been captured. The deathguard has him stored here in this building, and they've assigned one of their own to persuade him not to escape. Why don't you go see how the Captured Mountaineer enjoys this special drink I made for him? It contains a subtle hint of what The Dark Lady has planned for the rest of Azeroth.

Title: Off the Scales
Objective: Obtain 5 Vile Fin Scales.
Text: While you were collecting samples for me, my experiments led me to realize that more reagents will be required for this new disease to spread properly. Poisoning some hapless victim is child's play. Plaguing an entire world proves to be a bit more complicated. I will need several scales from murlocs in the vicinity. You will find the creatures ambling brainlessly along the coast to the north.

Title: Garren's Haunt
Objective: Report to Apothecary Jerrod at Garren's Haunt in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: As you're probably already realizing, the Royal Apothecary Society is a widespread organization. We take our plague-alchemy seriously. It is our belief that the more agents we have performing experiments, the sooner we will realize our objective. One of our agents performs his work at a small encampment to the north of here. His name is Jerrod, and he could use an apprentice of your... stature.

Title: Graverobbers
Objective: Kill Rot Hide Graverobbers and Rot Hide Mongrels, and obtain 6 flasks of Embalming Ichor.
Text: The mass graves within the forest to the west of us were made to accommodate the... impressive... number of deaths Tirisfal suffered when the plague first came. The bodies in these graves have so far been spared an undeath, but the Scourge now send Rot Hide gnolls to gather the corpses and use them to bolster their armies. This cannot be allowed! Your task is twofold: slay the Rot Hides at the mass grave and Garren's Haunt, and gather from them the embalming ichor that gives them life.

Title: Darkhound Pounding
Objective: Collect 5 Vials of Darkhound Blood.
Text: Lady Sylvanas has called upon the Royal Apothecary Society. She has challenged us to concoct a new plague, a plague deadlier than any ailment on Azeroth. This new disease will bring our enemies - living and dead - to ruin. My studies show that the blood of beasts might prove to be the key. Here, fill these vials with darkhound blood so I can test my theory.

Title: Annihilate the Worgen
Objective: Find and kill 5 Worgen Infiltrators within Brill.
Text: These worgen must be dealt with, and quickly. Our first priority is to eliminate any which may have infiltrated Brill. I want you to be on the lookout for any suspicious activity here in Brill. We know that these worgen can hide in the shadows, so look for any signs you can find... footsteps, kicked-up rocks... anything.

Title: Proving Allegiance
Objective: Obtain a Candle of Beckoning.
Text: Fine. I will continue with this charade, but only because I sense in you a spark of... excellence. But before I believe you I must have proof that you are enemy to the Scourge. There is an old, bloody altar just off the southern coast of this island. It is used by a powerful Scourge agent, Lillith Nefara. Take a Candle of Beckoning from this crate here. Light it on the altar and Lillith will awake. Destroy Lillith, and I will believe you are an ally.

Title: Return to the Magistrate
Objective: Return to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
Text: You should return to Magistrate Sevren with the information I gave you. He'll want it as soon as possible, so be swift.

Title: The Prodigal Lich Returns
Objective: Bring the Nether Gem to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
Text: Take this Nether Gem to my old comrade Bethor, who resides in the Undercity. It will let us communicate ... and I have much to tell him.

Title: Escaped From Gilneas
Objective: Report the worgen's presence to Executor Zygand at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: As far as you know, a worgen rogue roaming in Tirisfal is a new development. This is something that Executor Zygand would certainly be interested in.

Title: The Prodigal Lich
Objective: Report to Gunther Arcanus at Gunther's Retreat in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: Long ago, the mage Gunther Arcanus, along with Bethor Iceshard and the now-Scourge Necromancer Thule Ravenclaw, were friends and students within the Kirin Tor - a society of mages in Dalaran. Gunther fell to the Plague, but we thought he either remained dead, or was raised into the ranks of the Lich King. We now know he is free. We must have him. If you travel east, you will find him on an island in Brightwater Lake. Convince him to join our ranks.

Title: Dark Lady, Watch Over Us
Objective: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.
Text: In fact, why don't you speak with Lady Sylvanas herself? The presence of another Kirin Tor-trained mage among our ranks is an occasion worthy of an audience.

Title: The Chill of Death
Objective: Obtain five Duskbat Pelts.
Text: It's so cold, now. The Plague of Undeath crawls through my veins like an icy serpent. The mindless state will be upon me soon. But no doomed destiny will prevent me from serving our Dark Lady. When the call arose I sewed body bags for the fallen soldiers of Sylvanas's mighty army. Now my hands shake from the chill. If you would bring me five duskbat pelts, I could sew myself a blanket. Help me, so that I can continue to serve the cause.

Title: A Thorn in our Side
Objective: Kill 3 Scarlet Zealots and 3 Scarlet Missionaries, and obtain the Scarlet Epistle.
Text: Information we've received from Executor Arren in Deathknell contain all the details we need to wipe the human infestation from the lands. According to the information, The Scarlet Crusade has assigned Captain Perrine and a brigade to the ruined tower southwest of Brill. Kill 3 of his zealots and 3 of his missionaries. And while you're there, see if you can dig up any other information about what they're up to.

Title: Forsaken Duties
Objective: Speak with Deathguard Linnea at Death's Watch Waystation in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: I need a fresh report from our Deathguard waystation to the east. I must know if more Scourge forces have slipped past The Bulwark and into Tirisfal. Our vigilance on the border to the Plaguelands must be maintained - we can't let the Scourge get a stronger foothold here! Travel south along the road, then east at the fork to the waystation. Speak with Deathguard Linnea. She has the information I need.

Title: The New Forsaken
Objective: Report to Magistrate Sevren at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: Speaking frankly, the Forsaken of yesteryear were a sniveling, pathetic group. We huddled together in decrepit old human buildings, hiding from the Scourge, cowering from the Alliance, and groveling at the foot of the Horde. Look before you now, and see the product of the new Forsaken. We have made our mark here on Azeroth, and that mark will grow. Our dominion will soon blanket the world! You want my advice? Speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill, down this road. He runs that town.

Title: The Scarlet Palisade
Objective: Kill 10 Scarlet Warriors.
Text: We need someone with "initiative" like yourself to drive the Scarlet Crusade to the grave. Prove to me you are capable of serving The Dark Lady by travelling west to the tower past the Solliden Farmstead and slaying 10 warriors of the Scarlet Crusade.

Title: Murlocs: The Next Generation
Objective: Mindmeld with Murky and slay 10 Cavemoss Clackers.
Text: The time has come! Murky and his followers need a place to hide out and train--away from the mature murlocs--so that they can prepare to take over in the future.There's a nice cave not too far away... only problem is that it's filled with makrura.This would be a good base for the tadpoles. Murky must go show them what for!Mindmeld with Murky in his egg and show him how it's done!

Title: A Heavy Burden
Objective: Take the fish from Havi's Fish Barrel and skewer it on the spear above the fire.
Text: With Ashildir's judgment, your final trial is complete.But even Valhallas can wait, for now we must eat! Being dead works up quite an appetite.Come now, bring some of that fish to roast over the fire. It is far too heavy for me to carry.

Title: Halls of Valor: Securing the Aegis
Objective: Defeat God-King Skovald in the Halls of Valor and claim the Aegis of Aggramar.
Text: The Felskorn may be broken, but the head of the beast yet lives. The God-King will still vie for the Aegis if left unchecked.You, who have completed trials upon trials, must not let this come to pass. You must claim the Aegis over Skovald's broken bones!The Halls of Valor await!

Title: The Invasion Begins
Objective: Slay 15 demons and change the Legion banner to take control of Despair Ridge.
Text: Our advance force of demon hunters is here and has engaged the Legion.Make our presence known. Let's send a shiver down every demon spine. Raise our colors with pride.

Title: Eagle Egg Recovery
Objective: Head into Rockcrawler Chasm and recover eagle eggs.
Text: Eagles are revered by the Skyhorn tribe, but their numbers are dwindling.The drogbar feed their fledgling worms eagle eggs so they'll grow strong enough to ride into battle.If the drogbar continue to pilfer these eggs, the eagles may become extinct.Head deeper into the cave and recover any eagle eggs you can find.

Title: Tamer Takedown
Objective: Kill Tamer Korgrul within Rockcrawler Chasm.
Text: The drogbar will continue to breed vicious worms as long as their tamer lives.Korgrul is responsible for turning fledgling rockcrawlers into the monstrous siege worms that are ridden into battle.Head deep into the chasm and end his life, so that we may also see the end of these unnatural creatures.

Title: Fledgling Worm Guts
Objective: Collect Worm Guts from Fledgling Rockcrawlers within Rockcrawler Chasm.
Text: The drogbar use these caves as a place to train fledgling worms.The rockcrawlers are young and fairly weak, for now, but in time they will grow in size and strength. Without our intervention, the worms will morph into the monstrosities that the drogbar ride into battle.Their guts are also known to be quite useful, and I have need of them. Two worms, one stone.

Title: Fields of Grief
Objective: Steal 10 pumpkins from the Solliden Farmstead in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: What have we here? You look like a fledgling . If you hope to prove yourself to the Dark Lady, you need to learn the ways of the Forsaken. To the west you'll find a farm. Humans infest the land like mold on a rotting corpse. And worse yet, the Scarlet Crusade patrols nearby from their tower. Teach those scum a lesson and steal 10 of their precious pumpkins. Once you have 10, bring them back to me.

Title: Johaan's Experiment
Objective: Take the Laced Pumpkin to the Captured Scarlet Zealot at the gazebo at Calston Estate.
Text: Harmless pumpkins, right? Or so it would seem. If we are to defeat the Scourge advances from the North and the human infestation from the South we need to start realizing the full potential of our gift of undeath. With a little ingenuity a simple pumpkin becomes an agent for our Dark Lady. This pumpkin, laced with my latest formula, will prove to be quite a treat. Yet another Scarlet Zealot has been captured and is being kept outside, by the gazebo. Take this pumpkin to the fool.

Title: A Scarlet Letter
Objective: Find the prisoner in Scarlet Palisade.
Text: Lieutenant Gebler: How curious that you would decide to take a prisoner... an undead one at that. What were you thinking? Do you think that, just because of the prisoner's former status, that she would be above the edicts of the Scarlet Crusade? This is most troubling, Gebler. I would remind you that there are penalties for such behavior. I command you to execute the prisoner at once. She is no longer one of us.

Title: Night Web's Hollow
Objective: Kill 8 Young Night Web Spiders and 5 Night Web Spiders.
Text: One of our greatest struggles is obtaining the natural resources we need to survive. Gold was scarce in Lordaeron, even in the height of the Alliance's power so many years ago. There is a gold mine to the west that has been overrun with spiders. We need gold from the mine, but we can't very well get it while the spiders are crawling around in there. I've not much manpower to commit to the task, so we'll just have to do it little by little. Get up there and see what you can do for us.

Title: Ever So Lonely
Objective: Use the Murloc Leash on a Vile Fin murloc at the Whispering Shore, then return it to Sedrick Calston at Calston Estate.
Text: You work hard your whole life, and what do you get? Killed by a plague. Then you work even harder in undeath, and what do you get? Money, yes, and a small estate with a few pesky hangers-on, but happiness? Not so much. I'm lonely in my old age. I need a companion. Use this leash on one of the murlocs at the Whispering Shore to the northwest. You'll have to weaken it first before it can be leashed. Then bring it back to me.

Title: Variety is the Spice of Death
Objective: Obtain 4 Marrowpetals, 4 Xavren's Thorns, and 8 Briny Sea Cucumbers.
Text: These pumpkins have a purpose. They'll be the delivery mechanism for my latest batch of plague, which should be a particularly painful and virulent concoction. However, the plague requires a few rare ingredients. We'll need Marrowpetals, which grow at the bottom of Stillwater Pond, just to the east of here. We'll also need Xavren's thorn, which grows on rocky cliffs to the northwest. Finally, we need some briny sea cucumbers, found in the surf off of Whispering Shore.

Title: No Better Than the Zombies
Objective: Report to Darnell at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: While you were inside that cave, your big friend Darnell came by with some alarming news. Since the val'kyr arrived, we've seen more and more undead that chose not to join our forces under the banner of the Dark Lady. They've been gathering at a small camp here in the valley, and now they've organized forces. They plan to attack Deathknell. Darnell is just down the road, to the east. Be careful. While those undead aren't completely brainless, they're still not quite right in the head.

Title: Reaping the Reapers
Objective: Kill 10 Tirisfal Farmers or Tirisfal Farmhands.
Text: Humans are notoriously fickle creatures. The farmers to the west are no exception. Sure, they may be plowing their fields peacefully now, but tomorrow, they may be raising their scythes against us. The Alliance looms close by in Gilneas, and the power of Stormwind looms to the south... any of these could recruit these tillers and use them as a wedge against us. I want them dead. See to it that it's done.

Title: Vital Intelligence
Objective: Deliver the Scarlet Crusade Documents to Deathguard Simmer at Calston Estate in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: These will need to be taken to my field agent, Deathguard Simmer. This information contains the whereabouts of the last few holdouts from the Scarlet Crusade. We will destroy these crusaders, once and for all. And I have a feeling you'll be instrumental in that effort. Take the road north out of Deathknell. Soon after entering Tirisfal proper, you'll see a large manse. Simmer's inside.

Title: Assault on the Rotbrain Encampment
Objective: Kill Marshal Redpath and 8 Rotbrain undead.
Text: While you were taking care of matters for Executor Arren, I went off on an assignment of my own. Shadow Priest Sarvis asked me to peek in on the Rotbrain camp. There's a reason why they're called Rotbrains. Their leader goes by the name of Marshal Redpath, and he's an absolute beast. Look... the attack is starting. You're better in combat than I am. Get in there and help out! When you're done, meet up with Shadow Priest Sarvis in the chapel. Good luck.

Title: Stab!
Objective: Reach level 3 to learn Eviscerate, then practice using Eviscerate 3 times on a Training Dummy.
Text: Quiet down! I don't want these novices around us to hear what we're about to discuss. Listen up... , is it? Soon, you'll learn something that'll change the way you operate as a rogue. You'll be able to follow up on your attacks with a deadly finishing move. Maybe even slide a dagger between their vertebrae.To learn it, you just gotta get some more experience. Don't worry, you'll figure it out.

Title: Dark Deeds
Objective: Reach level 3 to learn Corruption, then practice casting Corruption 5 times on a Training Dummy.
Text: As you continue your career as a warlock, you'll begin to hear the voices of fel power... they will reveal their secrets, teaching you new spells.I want to see you learn a new spell and try it out on one of the dummies here.

Title: Charging into Battle
Objective: Reach level 3 to learn Charge, then practice using Charge on a Training Dummy.
Text: If you want to become a stronger warrior, you'll need to work on your weapons. You'll find stronger swords and larger shields out on your adventures, that I have no doubt about. But it isn't just your physical armory that will get stronger - you'll also begin to discover new techniques. Go, get some experience, learn something new, then come back and show me.

Title: Of Light and Shadows
Objective: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain. Then, practice casting it 5 times on training dummies.
Text: A Forsaken priest is a curious beast,  path an unusual course. $G His: Her; shadowy rites cannot come from the Light, so  seeks a more sinister source. Not only has the world forsaken us... it seems the Light has left us as well. As the poem hints, however... we are not without power.Go, get more experience, grow your power. Return to me, and demonstrate what you have learned.

Title: Maul 'Em With Kindness
Objective: Use the Bilgewater Cartel Promotional Delicacy Morsels on 8 Dunemaul Ogres after weakening them.
Text: Okay, babe, listen up. There's two ways to get people to do what you want. You can provide goods, services, and things people want...or you can beat the living daylights out of them. I've often found it's useful to do both at the same time, and you're pretty familiar with both methods by now. Take these little silithid treats, go and beat some ogres dizzy, and then give them the treat before you knock them completely dead, 'kay?

Title: The Thrill of the Hunt
Objective: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot, then practice using Steady Shot 5 times on a Training Dummy.
Text: I've been told that I'm supposed to train you how to be a hunter. That's all well and good, but in my opinion, you'll get more training out in the field than you will talking about theories with me. Go out, get some more experience, and see if you learn any new tricks. Then you can come back and show me.

Title: Magic Training
Objective: Reach Level 3 to learn Frost Nova, then practice using it 2 times against a Training Dummy.
Text: Let's get some work done, shall we?As you grow in power, your connection to the arcane will deepen, granting you access to new spells.You'll see. Go, get some more experience, then come back and demonstrate what you've learned.

Title: Fresh out of the Grave
Objective: Report to Undertaker Mordo at the Deathknell Graves in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: ! Rise! Welcome back to the realm of the living. With the blessing and power of the Dark Lady, I have freed you from death's grip. You are no slave. You are free to follow whatever path you choose from here. If you choose to serve the Dark Lady Sylvanas, I recommend you speak with Undertaker Mordo. You will find him behind me, in the graveyard.

Title: Trail-Worn Scroll
Objective: Read the Trail-Worn Scroll and speak to Xavier the Huntsman in Deathknell.
Text: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the hunter trainer Xavier. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.

Title: The Wakening
Objective: Speak with Marshal Redpath, Lilian Voss, and Valdred Moray.
Text: King, peasant, or ... I don't care WHAT you were before. I just need somebody with a working tongue. Being raised from the dead is strenuous. Not everyone copes with it as well as you did. In particular, there are three newly-raised undead who are having trouble coping right now. I want you to find them and talk to them. It might be that they just need someone that they can relate with. You'll find them here in the graveyard.

Title: The Truth of the Grave
Objective: Find Lilian Voss inside the large inn in Deathknell. Then speak with her to show her Elreth's Hand Mirror.
Text: Earlier on, I saw a young Forsaken woman running towards the old inn. She was screaming for her life, pleading to be taken back home. Not all of us are as resolute as others. Even so, we must accept our fate as undead if we are to rise up against those that would put us down. Take my hand mirror and show it to the young woman. She needs to see what she really is, and join us in our cause. Besides... we can use all the bodies that we can get.

Title: Get The Centipaarty Started
Objective: Collect 20 Centipaarts from Centipaar Silithid.
Text: Okay, babe. Like I said, the ogres are too dumb to know what signing that charter meant. Now we have to actually get them to come along with us, so we'll be procuring what is apparently beloved local flavor. Beloved local flavor for drooling idiots, I mean. Just pop on over to the Noxious Lair to the west, it's that big horrible pit full of dangerous silithid. Kill a bunch of the Centipaar silithid and bring back the pieces so we can hand 'em out, okay? Ciao.

Title: Rocket Boot Boost
Objective: Use the Rockin' Powder Infused Rocket Boots and deliver them to Hobart Grapplehammer.
Text: You need to get those boots down into the caldera to Hobart Grapplehammer. Now that they're infused with the leftover rockin' powder, they should have enough thrust to get you all the way there on one shot. When you're ready, activate the boots. Don't worry, they're automatically set to land you safely. I think.

Title: Silencing Rageroar
Objective: Slay 4 Rageroar Lieutenants and acquire Rageroar's Helm by killing Karga Rageroar.
Text: I have encountered the Rageroar clan before. They are led not by an orc, but by a monster - a war-gorged fiend without a shred of decency or compassion. He and his lieutenants must be killed, not just to save Northwatch, but for the good of all of Azeroth. Karga Rageroar wears a helm. Execute him, and bring the helm to me. It is of ... particular importance. Rageroar has made his camp across the chasm, east of here.

Title: Children of a Turtle God
Objective: Collect 5 Fire Glands.
Text: Volcanoth is the turtle god in the cave that these primitives worship. It's not really a god.  But it is tough enough that I'm going to have to devise a new weapon for you from the one functioning boot we have left. I think that the age-old motto of "fight fire with fire" applies here. Plus, I like fire! Let's get some fire glands from Volcanoth's children. That should give me time to modify the rocket boot into something more fitting.

Title: Volcanoth!
Objective: Use the Bootzooka to slay Volcanoth.
Text: It took a lot of blood, sweat, and tears, but the Bootzooka, patent-pending, is ready for use! These no-good pygmies have been feeding our people to their "god", Volcanoth, and they're about to unleash it on our town! You have to get into the cave and kill that thing before it's too late!

Title: Un-Chartered
Objective: Obtain 10 Charter Signatures from Dunemaul Ogres.
Text: As I may have mentioned, I'm trying to get these Dunemaul ogres to join the Horde..and work for the Bilgewater Cartel as cheap local labor. To pull this off, we've gotta pay lip service to the actual initiation process and all that, or I'm going to catch flak later on. So I've gotten this charter drawn up, and slapped the initiation rites onto our own limited time offer labor stipulation contract. I've got a disguise for you here, so suit up and get all these signatures filled out.

Title: Captain Dreadbeard
Objective: Kill Captain Dreadbeard.
Text: Alright, babe, I've got something bigger for you to take on here. We spotted the captain of the Southsea over on one of his boats to the south; that's to the south, and NOT the one we've been suicidally bum-rushing for the better part of several hours. He's sitting up there, smug and stoic, watching us war down here. I'll spare you the "hostile takeover" jokes. Get on his ship and beat the tar out of him, and we're done here!

Title: A Great Idea
Objective: Use the Bootlegger Bug Bait to capture a Hazzali Swarmer.
Text: Now that we've got a good pile of fresh chunks, we just tie it to this rope...and now you're ready to go catch me a silithid. What? Don't give me that look, it's perfectly safe. Well, mostly safe. Okay, you might die painfully. But it'll be easy! Just throw this meat out there, wait for a bug to pounce on it, and then drag 'em back here by the rope! Go after one of the swarmers. I haven't seen the other ones go for hyenas before, and you should find plenty of swarmers around the edge of the pit.

Title: Just Trying to Kill Some Bugs
Objective: Talk to Narain Soothfancy to pilot the Mind-Controlled Swarmer into the Gaping Chasm hive.
Text: Now it's time for my plan to go into full effect. We've got the captured bug strapped up with as many explosives as it can carry, and with Soothfancy's mostly amazing mental powers, we're gonna drive that sucker straight down into the center of the underground hive. And then...BOOM! No more bugs! You get the personal honor of directin' the ugly thing. Go talk to Narain and get set up with your bug-pal.

Title: Lifting the Siege
Objective: Use Paxton's Torch to burn 3 Rageroar Catapults and 1 Rageroar Blade Thrower.
Text: We'll never be able to re-secure the fortress walls so long as Rageroar and his goons have access to artillery. I need you to fight your way across that chasm and take out his big guns. Orcs season their heavy machinery with coal tar, which makes them flammable. Take my torch and burn any catapults you see north of Northwatch. Then, torch those big blade-throwers in Rageroar's base camp! Those things have killed enough of our men.

Title: Fjarnsk
Objective: Bring the Fjarnsk to Professor Pallin in Dalaran.

Title: Booty Duty
Objective: Collect 10 pieces of Pirate Booty.
Text: Let's not be wasteful here, babe. These pirates have tons of valuable nonsense just sitting around, waiting to be fenced. Can you believe they just sit on this stuff? I mean, why do they even bother taking it if it's just going to sit around? Stolen goods should be sold off and used to buy shiny new things. Anyway, be a dear and go grab as much of their loot as you can carry while you're out busting heads. Ciao!

Title: Woody Seed Cluster
Objective: Bring the Woody Seed Cluster to Professor Pallin in Dalaran.

Title: Containing the Demon Within
Objective: Assist Baric in completing the ritual.
Text: Now that we have all the essential pieces, let's begin the ritual. I'll instruct you on how to help me throughout it. It is pivotal that you follow my instructions when I give them, or the ritual will fail.

Title: Control is Key
Objective: Destroy the crystal providing protecting Overseer Felorax, then slay him.
Text: I trust you remember why you removed your eyes? Even though we can see more clearly now, the demons have found ways to mask even their fel energies from us. A demon commander walks amongst the troops below, commanding them from the shadows. His cloak is powered by an energetic crystal. Find and destroy that crystal, then kill the commander.

Title: To Know Your Enemy
Objective: Find Zaria Shadowheart near the Felblaze Ingress.
Text: As we fight the demons, we've also been studying them. Great understanding can come from gathering intel. I have a demon hunter near the Felblaze Ingress now gathering intel on the demons there. Go to her and see what she has learned from the demons invading that region.

Title: Ancient Vrykul Mastered
Objective: Return the tablets and codex to Professor Pallin.
Text: Here are those tablets back, along with their deciphered writing. You can take this codex back to Pallin, too. I'll start getting my things ready for when he calls me back to Dalaran.  Learn from my example. If I were you, I'd break free from Pallin's "requests" as soon as you can.

Title: Opposites Repel
Objective: Collect ley dust from the nightfallen in Zarkhenar.
Text: The ruins nearby have had an eruption of ley energies. Twisted night elves deemed "Nightfallen" are scavenging the area as we speak. Collect ley dust for me from the nightfallen in the ruins up ahead. The dust is infused with arcane energy that I'll need to complete my ritual.

Title: The Price of Power
Objective: Slay 15 demons to help lessen the invasion.
Text: I see, you wish to augment your powers through script. I believe we can kill two birds with one stone then. I need help here reducing the demon threat. Perhaps some more engagement with our enemy will inspire you.

Title: Fel Secrets
Objective: Read the Tome of Fel Secrets to choose between the Havoc and Vengeance specializations.
Text: The demons made a grave error inscribing their secrets into this book. The fel energy emanating from it is potent.But there's only enough to enact one of the rituals. After that, the book will be consumed.It's up to you to choose which secrets we want to use against the Burning Legion.

Title: Bulging Nightmare Pod
Objective: Bring the Bulging Nightmare Pod to Professor Pallin in Dalaran.

Title: Defense Symbology
Objective: Find Baric Stormrunner near the Ley-Ruins of Zarkhenar.
Text: As you know, we demon hunters must keep our darkness at bay, lest we succumb to it and become demons ourselves. Up to the north, a demon hunter by the name of Baric Stormrunner is preparing to strengthen his markings. He could use your assistance with his ritual.

Title: Our New Allies
Objective: Report to Allari the Souleater in Azsuna.
Text: Student! Your fellow demon hunters in Azsuna have sent for you. I can certainly appreciate your time being spent fending off the Legion, but it doesn't excuse you from your studies. While you're down there, I'd like you to come up with some new glyphs for your abilities. Surely my genius has worn off on you and you'll be able to create your own recipes based on what you learn.

Title: Strings of the Puppet Masters
Objective: Acquire a Rune of Dominance from the demons at Legion Camp: Chaos.
Text: I understand you were just here to deliver the vellums, but we could use your skills as a . Our forces can only hold back the demon invasion, disallowing us to send anyone further into the enemy's camp. The stronger of their forces stay in the back, commanding from a distance. They carry enchanted runes to keep control over the frontline demons. I would very much like to study one of these runes. Please retrieve one for me, so we may learn from it and use it against the Legion.

Title: Slime Time
Objective: Feed Murky 6 Bunches of Slimeweed by swimming through them.
Text: Murky's a growing boy, he needs to eat! What better than slimeweed for a young murloc?There's plenty of it around in the water amongst the murlocs; swim through it and feed Murky!

Title: Shadows in the Mists
Objective: Defeat Captain Sten, Sigrid, Kjell and Halvir in Helmouth Shallows.
Text: Many of the Kvaldir here in the bay are former denizens of this harbor, cursed by the sea-witch Helya to do her bidding for all time.The ones you read about, they still walk the stagnant waters. They could be given respite, should a kind soul bring it to them at the tip of a blade.So tell me, how kind is your soul?

Title: I'll Huff, I'll Puff...
Objective: Collect 5 Pufferfish Eggs.
Text: Murky is my favorite little fella. However, in order to lead a change in the murloc population here, he needs some awesome abilities.There are a lot of pufferfish around in the water, and I think that they could be a good resource for him.Kill a few and collect their eggs for Murky.

Title: The Emerald Nightmare: Felwort Mastery
Objective: Travel to the Emerald Nightmare and cleanse Cenarius of his affliction. Bring back anything you discover to Kuhuine in Dalaran.
Text: I have a theory on how we can better harvest this felwort. You see, sometimes in order to understand how something comes into being, you have to work backwards. I've recently heard of the corruption of one of our greatest gods, Cenarius. I have no doubt the same corruption that lives in these herbs also resides within him now. If you were able to cleanse that corruption, find a way to understand how it works and remove it, I think we can apply that to how we harvest these herbs.

Title: The Hunter of Heroes
Objective: Deal with Vigfus Bladewind's warband and claim his blades.
Text: Helya has made a mockery of my order by creating her own "helarjar", powerful undead tasked with hunting down heroic warriors and taking their souls before my val'kyr can claim them. Among them is her personal champion, Vigfus Bladewind, who wields stolen blades I forged myself long ago.He has returned to Tideskorn Harbor with a full cargo of stolen souls to take to Helheim. Go there, kill him and his helarjar, and make the swords yours.

Title: Nature vs. Nurture
Objective: Talk to 10 Swamprock Tadpoles.
Text: I appreciate murloc-kind far too much to tell you to go kill all the adults.What we should be doing is setting up the next generation to be more peaceful; Murky is the best representative for this.Bring him to talk to the murloc tadpoles. He'll get them on our side.

Title: Felwort Sample
Objective: Bring the Felwort Sample to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
Text: This herb bubbles and seethes with a foul energy. It is smooth, dry, and cool, yet somehow quite painful to touch. Your herbalism trainer in Dalaran will want to see this.

Title: Scavenging the Shallows
Objective: Search the Shipwreck Debris in Helmouth Shallows for Havi's clue.
Text: The kvaldir exist to spite Odyn, and it is here their spiteful work is done. They rob the souls of the living - the souls not yet judged - thus robbing Odyn of his champions.They bring them here to transport to Helya, though the mists obscure any indications of how.You seem to fare the mists well. Perhaps if you search the wreckage in the bay, the answer may present itself. You outsiders seem to have a knack for uncovering the most hidden of secrets.

Title: Insane Ramblings
Objective: Bring the Scribbled Ramblings to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
Text: Scribbled, angry phrases on a dirty scrap of vellum. One part catches your eye: "thinks  knows how to gather herbs   steal my blade slit  THROAT when I just need a bit more mana maybe aethril, yes..." Your herbalism trainer may be interested in seeing this.

Title: Felwort Analysis
Objective: Collect Ryno Bloomfield's Analysis, Dani Earthtouch's Analysis, and Lohor's Analysis.
Text: I sent felwort samples to some of my fellow herbalists, but haven't heard back from them yet. Could you please follow up with them and collect their analyses. Ryno Bloomfield is currently working in Un'goro Crater. Dani Earthtouch is researching Freya's influence in Sholazar Basin. Finally, Lohor has been working in the overgrown portion of Gorgrond.

Title: The Spade's Blade
Objective: Find the Broken Herbalist's Blade.
Text: Did you notice the script along the base of the handle? It says "Herbalist Tharillon," in the writing of the nightborne. The handle does little for us, but perhaps the blade of this spade will give us some information on how to harvest the starlight rose without failing quite so often. I would start my search for it in Suramar.

Title: Tharillon's Fall
Objective: Bring 20 piles of Starlight Rosedust to Azsuna, use them to taunt Herbalist Tharillon out of hiding, then search him for information about herbalism.
Text: He mentions your name... his blade... aethril... I'd say that this is absolutely from Herbalist Tharillon, and by the look of it, he may have succumbed to the plight of the nightfallen. Furthermore, if he's looking for aethril, he's probably in Azsuna somewhere. Tharillon is currently our only hope for learning more about starlight roses. Seek him out, but you may want to bring friends... he likely won't go without a fight.

Title: The Gentlest Touch
Objective: Attempt to harvest 15 more Starlight Roses.
Text: Sadly, I don't have any special techniques that can help you here. You'll simply need to practice your methods. Get back out there, and focus on a gentle touch when dealing with starlight roses.

Title: Jeweled Spade Handle
Objective: Bring the Jeweled Spade Handle to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
Text: An immaculately carved spade handle lies beside the rose. Apparently the spade was more beautiful than it was durable, as the blade has completely fallen off. Your herbalism trainer may be interested in seeing this.

Title: Fjarnskaggl
Objective: Bring 20 Fjarnskaggl to the Wind-Worn Cairn in Stormheim, then earn the Blessing of Fjarnskaggl.
Text: There! It seems that there was a vrykul herbalist, Torgus, who brought a gift of fjarnskaggl to a seaside cairn - presumably in Stormheim - and by doing so received a blessing from his ancestors.  It's worth a shot, though without knowing what you're getting into, you may want to bring friends with you.

Title: Starlight Rosedust
Objective: Bring the Starlight Rosedust to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
Text: Despite all your training, the rose disintegrated in your hand. Your herbalism trainer in Dalaran will want to see this.

Title: Up the Volcano
Objective: Speak with Coach Crosscheck at the Lost Peak on the Lost Isles.
Text: A whole bunch of our people headed up to the top of the volcano to mount a counter-offensive. There's something horrible brewing up there on the Lost Peak. They're waiting for you before they make any moves against the pygmies. Those evil little things turned a lot of us into zombies! , save us!

Title: Rockin' Powder
Objective: Collect 5 scoops of Rockin' Powder.
Text: I'll give these pygmies one thing... they sure know how to party! But they're not so clever. I think I've discovered the source of their rockin' powers: Rockin' Powder! It turns out that this stuff, which turns them into world-class rockers, is also highly explosive. We must have it! So, while you're in there at Oostan to the east, make sure that you pickup a whole bunch of the stuff. Trust me, you're going to need it for what's coming up!

Title: Momentum
Objective: Meet Megs Dreadshredder at Lost Rigger Cove.
Text: We can't just rest on our laurels here, babe. We've got to keep this momentum going! People are talking about us. Unfortunately, they're also talking about this air-headed gnome, Kelsey, who's apparently been running jobs right alongside us. If we're going to drive her out of what's rightfully a goblin town, we need to seal the deal here. We're going to take care of Gadgetzan's pirate problem for them, for good. Head south to Lost Rigger Cove, I'll meet you there.

Title: Three Little Pygmies
Objective: Slay Gaahl, Malmo, and Teloch.
Text: Look, I think it's great that we're destroying all of these zombies, even though they're our friends and family. But don't you think we should be taking care of the pygmies that are creating them as well? At the three Oostan villages, Nord, Sor, and Ost, there are witch doctors: Gaahl, Malmo, and Teloch. Maybe you could take care of them? I don't want to be turned into a zombie!

Title: Langridge Shot
Objective: Gather 15 pieces of Langridge Shot.
Text: ! Thank the Light - they've practically driven us back to the docks. The courtyard is overrun! We're out of canister shot and the orcs are getting ready for an assault up the hill. We need to improvise some scatter-shot, and fast. Hurry, run into the broken tower here and grab whatever sharp, pointy bits of scrap metal you can lay your hands on. Knives, forks, nails - anything! Load the cannon when you've got an armful!

Title: Re-Take the Courtyard
Objective: Kill 10 Rageroar Grunts.
Text: That's one way to clear a hill. Those corpses are impaled with knives and forks! The Rageroar clan has breached the walls, but we can still turn this fight around. Go down the hill and help our men hold on to the courtyard below...

Title: Zombies vs. Super Booster Rocket Boots
Objective: Use the Super Booster Rocket Boots to slay 50 Goblin Zombies.
Text: Those zombies that got past us are nothing compared to the numbers waiting just through the pass. If we don't deal with them soon, the pygmy witch doctors are going to send all of them against the town, and even the cannons down there won't be able to handle that many! I brought a couple of shredder boots along. Greely modded them and now they're Super Booster Rocket Boots! Use the boots to incinerate the zombies in the Oostan villages to the east.

Title: The Guns of Northwatch
Objective: Speak with Cannoneer Smythe.
Text: Captain Fisher signaled us from below. The Horde fleet is landing shore parties? We can't let them flank us from the beach. I've already sent two of my best gunners down there to defend the beach head. Talk to Cannoneer Smythe down on the shore. You'll have to fight your way through the courtyard to get there. See if you can help the others secure the hold on your way down!

Title: Run Out the Guns
Objective: Use a Northwatch Shore Battery to destroy 10 Rageroar Rowboats.
Text: We've got the hardware but not the manpower. Man one of the carronades on the shore here and take out those incoming boats!

Title: Body And Soul
Objective: Destroy Yngwie's Soul.
Text: There are powerful and evil magics at work in this village. Yngwie, was tough. In fact, he was probably too tough. If you were to drag his body down to the big blue bonfire and toss it in, you'd release his soul. Destroying it would deal with the Oomlot chieftain for good, and ensure that the attacks upon the Town-In-A-Box come to an end.

Title: Body And Soul
Objective: Destroy Yngwie's Soul.
Text: There are powerful and evil magics at work in this village. Yngwie, was tough. In fact, he was probably too tough. If you were to drag his body over to the big blue bonfire and toss it in, you'd release his soul. Destroying it would deal with the Oomlot chieftain for good, and ensure that the attacks upon the Town-In-A-Box come to an end.

Title: Oomlot Dealt With
Objective: Speak with Sassy Hardwrench at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.
Text: , you have to get back to the Town-In-A-Box and warn them about the goblin zombies up in the volcano's caldera!

Title: Gazer Tag
Objective: Collect 5 Ocular Crystals from Glasshide Gazers.
Text: You're going out to hunt hyenas, eh? If you don't mind, I've got an offer myself. I'm in need of eyes from the Glasshide Gazers that lurk to the north. Their eyes contain wonderful crystals, valuable to...collectors. Now, you may have heard that some sad individuals use these to enhance paramental abilities, but I assure you, my interests are purely academic! Bring me a good portion of them and I'll pay you well for them. Better than these copper-pinching goblins will, at least!

Title: Chicken of the Desert
Objective: Collect 6 pieces of Hyena Meat.
Text: I've got an idea, but we're going to need bait. The other day I saw a rabid blisterpaw hyena wander too close to the edge of the chasm, and one of the silithid comes diving out of nowhere. Nearly swallowed it whole! Horrible sight. So we're gonna need hyena meat, obviously. Go gather some, make sure it's fresh, and bring it back here. There should be plenty just north of the camp.

Title: Cutting Losses
Objective: Kill 15 Hazzali Silithid of any kind in the Gaping Chasm.
Text: I've spent the last week starin' at this ugly pit trying to think of how to exploit a bunch of dangerous, violent arthropods for profit. Now I'm out of ideas, and starving. These things are a wash, and I say it's time to start clearing them out. Head down into that pit and start killin' bugs.

Title: To The Ground!
Objective: Set fire to the Northwest Shack, the Southeast Shack, and the Northeast Shack.
Text: I've conducted a thorough appraisal of the real estate here and, unfortunately, its market value is just far too low to be of any use. We're going to have to renovate. Luckily for you, I've learned a few things about arson. Hopefully you have too! You're going to be throwing these perfectly safe bottles of flaming rum at those filthy ramshackle huts over there. Try not to stand downwind.

Title: Repel Boarders!
Objective: Speak to Admiral Aubrey to fly to the Blackpool and kill 6 Rageroar Sea Dogs.
Text: , the sea is our only lifeline, and right now most of my fleet is either steaming back to Theramore for repairs or rusting at the bottom of this bay. Only the Blackpool remains afloat to defend our harbor. But she's just signaled that she's being boarded! Speak to me when you're ready, I'll have one of our naval gryphons deposit you right on the deck. Slaughter the rageroar sea dogs who dare assault my precious ship and report to Captain Fisher for further orders.

Title: Dead Man's Chest
Objective: Kill 15 Southsea Freebooters of any kind.
Text: Look, babe, you should be able to see what's happening here pretty easily. There's pirates, there's goblins, the goblins are fighting the pirates. There's some sad little gnomes trying to fight the pirates too. I'll make it nice and simple for you: we need to kill a lot of pirates. Go do that, 'kay? We don't want the gnomes killing more than us, after all.

Title: Free the Captives
Objective: Free 5 Goblin Captives.
Text: They've got a bunch of our people in there. I know that they're doing strange rituals to them. It looks like they're sucking the life force right out of them! You have to go into the village and free the captives before it's too late!

Title: While You're At It
Objective: Kill 5 Bloodfang Worgen.
Text: Fine by me if King Greymane wants you to risk your life to rescue a known traitor. Do me a favor and do something useful while you're out there and kill these cursed fleabags.

Title: Serving A-Me 01
Objective: Bring A-Me's Thumb Drive back to Karna Remtravel at Mossy Pile in Un'Goro Crater.
