Text: Greetings. I unit A-Me 01. You... ? A-Me's mission to study the local gorillas was success. A-Me has gathered data that Karna needs. A-Me 01 not returning, though. A-Me has new family now. Here, with the gorillas, A-Me stay.  You bring data back to Karna. You tell her what happen.

Title: Send a Message
Objective: Slay Yngwie.
Text: The Oomlot leader, Yngwie, is too powerful to be left alive. He's barking nonsense from the raised west side of the village, across the rope bridge. Go up there and get him before he sends the rest of the village against us. Piece of cake!

Title: Back in the Fight
Objective: Use the Herb-Soaked Bandages on 6 Wounded Defenders.
Text: This fight isn't over. Not by a long shot. Some of the soldiers in the courtyard still have breath in their lungs. We can save them! I've soaked these rags in an herbal remedy we used to rely on back in Gilneas. The smell is awful but this poultice can practically raise the dead. Use these bandages on wounded defenders down in the courtyard and we'll see if we can't get them back in the fight.

Title: Oomlot Village
Objective: Speak with Izzy at Oomlot Village on the Lost Isles.
Text: The pygmies took most of our people back to their village. Who knows what evil they're up to? , you have to go up there and free all of the captives before the pygmies work their voodoo on them! Izzy's already up near Oomlot Village to the southeast. She'll give you the heads-up on what's going down. Your pygmy helmet looks like it's in bad shape, but it should last long enough for you to get there. I hope.

Title: Slowing the Inevitable
Objective: Use the Captured Riding Bat to destroy 6 Forsaken Catapults and 40 Invading Forsaken.
Text: As much as I want to exact swift and brutal revenge... I must honor my son's memory first. He cared for his people first and foremost. The Undertaker's Pass goes underground below Northgate River. You must prevent the plague from being deployed while we evacuate our men, women and children to Aderic's Repose. We captured one of the Forsaken's dreaded bombing bats. I want you to fly the infernal beast as best you can and unleash hell upon those who seek to bring the Plague to our people. Hurry!

Title: Report to Aubrey
Objective: Report to Admiral Aubrey in Northwatch Hold.
Text: You there! Fresh off the boat? Welcome to Kalimdor, a land hellbent to kill you or die tryin'. There's trouble at the hold - as I'm sure you noticed on your way in. Admiral Aubrey needs all hands on deck if we're to make it through this. Consider yourself drafted! Follow the road up the hill and you'll find Aubrey in the tower, topside.

Title: Tropical Paradise Beckons
Objective: Report to Williden Marshal at Marshal's Stand in Un'Goro Crater.
Text: Hey, you look like a discriminating adventurer. Are you looking for something different? Something exotic? Something... profitable? Well shake the sand out of your boots, because I've got a proposition for you. Williden Marshal is looking for competent sellswords such as yourself. He's set up camp at Marshal's Stand, just southeast of the volcano in the center of lush Un'Goro Crater. Then again, paradise isn't for everyone. It's up to you. Your tropical oasis awaits.

Title: Personal Property
Objective: Bring the Sealed Chest to Highlord Darion Mograine in Icecrown Citadel.
Text: You can detect no hinges or openings on this box. Were it not for the shifting of items inside, it could easily be mistaken for solid metal. If anyone could know the method of its opening, it would be Highlord Mograine.

Title: Ram's-Horn Trowel
Objective: Bring the Ram's-Horn Trowel to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
Text: The rune markings along the tool's grip suggest that it was left behind by a vrykul herbalist. Apparently, the vrykul are also gathering this fjarnskaggl. Your trainer, Kuhuine, mentioned that she had read about this herb in the past. Perhaps she might be interested in seeing the tools that the vrykul use to harvest it.

Title: Vrykul Herblore
Objective: Find three vrykul Herbology books in Stormheim.
Text: This is a standard digging tool. There is not much to be learned here, except... ...this DOES suggest that the vrykul are still actively gathering this herb. The vrykul likely know much more about this herb than we do. All we need to do is find out where their knowledge is stored.

Title: Remember the Light
Objective: Help Anchorite Avuun say farewell to Magtoor.
Text: Magtoor grows weaker by the second. My remedy is prepared... it must work. It must! You have done so much for the both of us. I would be honored if you stayed for what may be Magtoor's final moments.

Title: The Missing Page
Objective: Bring the Runed Journal Page to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
Text: "...the Cairn of the Sea, a place long-known to be beloved by the gods. He placed his offering of fjarnskaggl at the foot of the cairn, mouthed the words 'Herbs beget herbs', and received the blessing he desired." This may be related to the books you brought back to your herbalism trainer.

Title: The Pied Picker
Objective: Bring the Foxflower Scent Gland to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
Text: As you finish gathering the foxflower, a particular part of the bloom catches your eye. One of the leaves has a small protuberance, right where it meets the stem. Further investigation suggests that this is where the foxflower's unusual smell comes from. Your herbalism trainer would be interested in seeing this.

Title: Chase the Culprit
Objective: Find out what creature has been eating Foxflower, then chase it and catch 12 Chewed Foxflower Bits.
Text: This is a powerful herb. Creatures will occasionally snack on some simpler herbs, but usually they avoid plants of such potency. I'm intrigued. What kind of animal would eat foxflower? A moose? You should investigate further. Find out what creature has been snacking on foxflower, and then see if you can wrestle some of the flowers from its mouth, before it escapes.

Title: Fjarnskaggl Sample
Objective: Bring 20 Fjarnskaggl to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
Text: To one not trained in herbalism, this brambly bush might appear to be entirely useless. Your training, however, reveals this to be a very special plant indeed. Your herbalism trainer in Dalaran will want to see some more samples of this.

Title: Foxflower Sample
Objective: Obtain 20 samples of Foxflower, then bring them to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
Text: Something about this herb catches your eye... and your nose. Your herbalism trainer in Dalaran would certainly be interested in studying some samples of this piquant new flower.

Title: Dreamleaf Sample
Objective: Bring the Dreamleaf Sample to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
Text: The herb is brilliantly green, paper-thin, and somewhat sticky. Your herbalism trainer in Dalaran will want to see this.

Title: Teeny Bite Marks
Objective: Bring the Nibbled Foxflower Stem to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
Text: This herb has been chewed by some of the local wildlife. What kind of animal would eat foxflower? A bear? Perhaps your trainer in Dalaran will know.

Title: One Dead Plant is One Too Many
Objective: Slay 20 satyrs within Val'sharah.
Text: We must exact VENGEANCE for this. While I understand the importance of the balance between the Emerald Dream and the Nightmare, this time it's corruption has gone TOO FAR! Satyrs. I blame the satyrs for this. Make them pay! Make them pay, and Elune will reward you with her bounty!

Title: Twisted to Death
Objective: Find someone in Lorlathil to teach you about the blight's effects on herbs.
Text: The corruption has completely taken this herb. This blight is a mysterious force whose complexities transcend the teachings of simple herbalism. An expert in such infestation will need to tell you what's really going on here.

Title: The Last Straw
Objective: Use Tur'xoran's Summoning Stone to summon and slay Tur'xoran.
Text: We cannot falter in our crusade against this corruption. It is our duty as heroes. As herbalists. As hero-balists. Slaying simple satyrs will not do. We must attack their leaders. Bring this fallen herb to Shala'nir, in the northeast. Find Tur'xoran's summoning stone, and place this herb in front of it. Then... rip off his head. Do it for the plants.

Title: Choked by Nightmare
Objective: Bring the Blight-Choked Herb to Wildcrafter Osme in Val'sharah.
Text: Another plant, killed by the blight. This one coiled so hard that it starved itself of sunlight. You should bring it to Wildcrafter Osme in Lorlathil. He won't be happy.

Title: A Slip of the Hand
Objective: Speak with Kuhuine Tenderstride about the quick-reproducing property of aethril.
Text: As you harvest the aethril, your hand brushes the flower's pollinating organs against one another, creating a reaction. You may have discovered a new herbalism technique. Your trainer in Dalaran would be a good person to discuss this with.

Title: Ragged Strips of Silk
Objective: Speak with Kuhuine Tenderstride about aethril and the withered.
Text: Finely made strips of clothing, torn, tattered, and dirty: telltale signs of the withered. The feral, degenerate outcasts of nightborne society must also be harvesting the aethril... but why?

Title: An Empathetic Herb
Objective: Obtain 15 Healthy Dreamleaf and 5 Blight-Infested Dreamleaf.
Text: Something is different about this dreamleaf, though. It is less than pure. I have a theory. The wilds of Val'sharah have been blighted by a nightmarish curse. Sensitive herbs like this may be susceptible to such a blight. I need more information before I can draw any conclusions. Find me some healthy samples and some blight-infested samples, and we can continue.

Title: Aethril Sample
Objective: Bring the Aethril Sample to Kuhuine Tenderstride in Dalaran.
Text: This herb has clearly been absorbing magical energy from the land. Filaments of ley energy course from root to leaf. Your herbalism trainer in Dalaran will want to see this.

Title: Desperation Breeds Ingenuity
Objective: Obtain 6 Chewed Aethril Stems from Withered in Azsuna.
Text: I believe we may be able to use this clue to our advantage. The withered are notoriously thirsty for mana, and will stop at nothing to get it. Perhaps we can study how they use the aethril and use the results to improve our own harvesting methods.

Title: Tapping the Leylines
Objective: Explore Anora Hollow and find the Ley Station there.
Text: The arcways were built to tap into the magical leylines beneath Suramar. As we learned to subsist on the Nightwell, the old facilities fell out of use. This chamber is clearly receiving power from elsewhere. There is only a trickle now, but if you can direct more leyline energy here it will help to sustain us. The closest source is to the north, near Anora Hollow.

Title: An Old Ally
Objective: Find Arcanist Kel'danath's hideout in Ambervale.
Text: I was on my way to Ambervale in hopes of finding an old colleague.Arcanist Kel'danath was fascinated by the withered. He studied them for years hoping to calm their feral nature or even cure them.When one of his subjects escaped and ran amok in the royal gardens, Kel'danath was ordered to cease his research and kill all withered in his possession. He refused, and was exiled.If Kel'danath lives, he is near withered. And withered are drawn to old settlements like Ambervale.

Title: Spayed by the Spade
Objective: Obtain a Pristine Pistil and a Stainless Stamen.
Text: The stem, leaves, and petals are dazzling, to be certain... but look at the pollination filaments, here, and the reproductive organs in the center of the bloom. They contain more energy than the rest of the plant put together. I suspect that we can more responsibly and efficiently harvest aethril by focusing on these parts. Still, it looks like this bloom has been damaged. I need undamaged parts if I'm to be sure.

Title: Oculeth's Workshop
Objective: Give the First Arcanist's Token to Chief Telemancer Oculeth.
Text: We need to make contact with Chief Telemancer Oculeth, the man who developed Suramar's teleportation network.Oculeth had a workshop in old Suramar, from the age before the Sundering. He may be taking refuge there.If you find him, show him this. Hopefully you see him before he sees you...

Title: The Only Way Out is Through
Objective: Escort Thalyssra to safety.
Text: I have much to tell you, but it is not safe to speak here. I cannot hold this barrier forever.If we push through, we may find shelter up ahead.

Title: Arcane Thirst
Objective: Enter Shal'Aran and find something to sate Thalyssra's thirst.
Text: My people have subsisted on the Nightwell for millennia. Ancient mana is our lifeblood - without it, we become... well, you saw them out there.I'm afraid I have been rather reckless today.Already, my senses are dulling. Without magic to feed upon, I will turn.Please... find me something to feed upon... anything...

Title: Break the Spine
Objective: Defeat Garzareth, Karuas, Muorg and Ravathes in Gates of Valor.
Text: To lead his tainted forces, the God-King has enlisted demons of great power to act as his lieutenants. If we wish to end his assault, we will need to take their leaders.These demons are too powerful for most mortals to face, but with the power of Stormheim at your disposal, they will prove no match for you.Take them down, and shatter the spine of Skovald's offensive!

Title: A Familiar Fate
Objective: Collect the Jailer's Shard from Dravax and free Vethir from his prison.
Text: We had come to defend the Halls of Valor... I was taken from the sky...I cannot break free of my bindings. Find the jailer who made this cell...Set me free, friend...

Title: Stem the Tide
Objective: Use the Stormforged Horn to destroy the three Felbound Portals in Gates of Valor.
Text: Skovald has profaned the Gates of Valor with his demonic allies. Among his forces his twisted mystics have conjured portals to ferry his fel allies from their blighted worlds.If we wish to stem this tide, these portals must be destroyed.I will gather my allies. Take this horn and signal when you have found a portal, and we will strike from the skies!

Title: Knocking on Valor's Door
Objective: Find Vethir in the Felskorn Camp.
Text: The Halls of Valor is your destiny to claim, but it is already in the claiming. The God-King befouls its steps with demons and wickedness.Your dragon allies have come to Halls' defense, but they need your aid. The vrykul have taken the leader of the storm dragons, the one you call Vethir.Free your dragon friend, champion, and wash the Felskorn from the Gates of Valor!

Title: Stormheim's Salvation
Objective: Defeat God-King Skovald in the Gates of Valor.
Text: It would seem that the portals we destroyed down here were not the only ones. Demons still pour in from the top of the Gates of Valor's edifice, summoned by the God-King himself!I cannot face Skovald alone. Come, champion, let us take the battle to him and end this threat!For Stormheim!

Title: Build the Fort Placeholder
Objective: Contact Foreman Franklin.
Text: Nice work! For our next placeholder, talk to that dude. Uh, Foreman Franklin. Special stuff will happen.

Title: Vengeance or Survival
Objective: Speak to King Genn Greymane at Greymane Court in Gilneas City.
Text: Tell Greymane that we have trackers on Sylvanas and tell him about the Plague. The decision will be his. Launch an all out attack against the leader of the Forsaken or try to evacuate our survivors.

Title: Seaside Salvage
Objective: Collect 7 Steamwheedle Supplies.
Text: We've got to get goods moving in this market ASAP if we want to be competitive. I've got an angle for us. Gadgetzan's under blockade by pirates, but plenty of the goods that get blown off the ships survive intact... they just wash away. Most of them wash up in the shallows just south of town. Head down there and start salvaging; there's crates full of pure profit just floating around down there.

Title: Puddle Stomping
Objective: Kill 8 Tidal Striders.
Text: Here's the situation. If we want to establish the Bilgewater Cartel's market presence in Gadgetzan, we'll need to start providing services to the community. The new coast has been great for business here, but the sea also brought sea giants with it. They're large, foul, and drive real estate values down. Head to the shallows just south of town and kill as many as you can, and I'll cut you in on some of the deals I'm brokering here.

Title: Returning a Favor
Objective: Find Megs Dreadshredder at the Dunemaul Camp.
Text: You know, while you were out doin' your thing, Megs stopped by here. I hadn't seen her in months, but she barely gave me the time of day, just wanted me to tell you she had more business lined up. She said she was headed over to the Dunemaul Compound to set up shop, something about ogres. Since you're done here, might as well head over...I wouldn't keep a goblin like her waiting.

Title: Protect the Pass Placeholder
Objective: Use the guns.
Text: This here placeholder will be like a shootin' gallery. On Steroids.

Title: Town-In-A-Box: Under Attack
Objective: Use a B.C. Eliminator to defeat 30 Oomlot Warriors.
Text: , you have to defend us! I had the eggheads deploy the town's cannon defenses, but it seems like there's an unlimited supply of these Oomlot warriors! Get your behind into one of those B.C. Eliminators and eliminate the pygmy threat to the town!

Title: Rocket Rescue
Objective: Deliver Life-Rockets to 5 Steamwheedle Survivors and use bombs to kill 40 Southshore Blockaders.
Text: Alright. We've done enough small jobs around here; it's time to seal the deal. The ruins of Steamwheedle Port are still full of hapless Steamwheedle goblins, waiting to be rescued. Every single one of them is a potential future customer. They're firing on every boat that leaves port...so I say we take to the skies! There's a hot air balloon just outside of town near the docks, we can use that. Go ahead and hop in, I'll catch up with you.

Title: Blueleaf Tubers
Objective: In Razorfen Kraul, use the Crate with Holes to summon a Snufflenose Gopher, and use the Command Stick on the gopher to make it search for Tubers.
Text: Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world! But they're rare, very rare. The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul. And even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look! That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me. They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away. It won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.

Title: Going, Going, Guano!
Objective: Bring 1 pile of Kraul Guano to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
Text: As you can see, we're up to some very.... interesting experiments at the Royal Apothecary Society. As the Master here, it is my job to oversee the most ambitious of our alchemical attempts. So much work and so little time! You look well traveled for a . Perhaps you can aid me. I'm in need of a rare substance. It's foul material; it comes from a rare species of bats only found in the muck-hole known as Razorfen Kraul. Bring to me the guano from the Kraul Bats so we can begin our work...

Title: Going, Going, Guano!
Objective: Bring 1 pile of Kraul Guano to Zan'do at Firestone Point.
Text: There be more in the Razorfen than just pigs. There be bats as well...and if you're goin in there and rilin' up the quilboar anyway, I want ya to bring me back some guano. Yah, guano. The droppin's. Don't give me that look. It be foul, but powerful, primal stuff for rituals...rituals to keep the earth 'round here strong enough to keep from rippin' apart under all the damn fools warrin' round here. Just bring Zan'do one pile of guano, yah?

Title: Get Back to Town
Objective: Speak with Sassy Hardwrench at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.
Text: We were wrong. It wasn't the naga that were preparing to attack... it was the nearby Oomlot tribe. , you need to get back to the Town-In-A-Box. The pygmies are already attacking! Here, take this. We bought it off of a pygmy who said it used to belong to some great leader of theirs. Someone whose name translates as Dark Tan Helmet. It should fool them so that they don't attack you.

Title: The Battle for Gilneas City
Objective: Achieve victory in the Battle for Gilneas City.
Text: The time has come. We've rallied and armed every available Gilnean. It is time to meet the enemy head on. Time to settle the score with Sylvanas and her Forsaken dogs once and for all. Liam is heading the assault from this gate. King Greymane and my father are leading the assault on the other districts. You have a crucial role to play in this as well. Take this rapier. Use it to inspire our men and women in combat. Speak to Krennan Aranas to take part in the battle for Gilneas City.

Title: Respite for a Tormented Soul
Objective: Use the Life Crystals to preserve Sindragosa's Essence.
Text: Take this Life Crystal, and have your companions take one as well. It contains potent energies from the verdant Dragonshrine in Dragonblight, and it was my own secret to resisting the dark magics of this place for so long. When you face Sindragosa, battle her until she is weakened, and then have your companions use these Crystals to coax out the essence that is dormant within her. If you then defeat her, you should be able to recover it and return it to Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

Title: Blood Quickening
Objective: Rescue Infiltrator Minchar before he is executed.
Text: These Scourge bloodsuckers -- San'layn they call themselves -- give me the creeps. We've had one of our best men keeping an eye on them. But this morning he got sloppy and got himself taken prisoner. He's being interrogated by the Queen herself right now, and his cries echo through the Crimson Halls. Please, save him before it's too late!

Title: Residue Rendezvous
Objective: Return to Alchemist Adrianna while infected with Orange and Green Blight.
Text: Professor Putricide has been holed up in his foul laboratory, experimenting and refining increasingly lethal strains of blight to be used against us. If only we could obtain pure samples of the toxins, our researchers could concoct an antidote that would save countless lives. If you happen to come across live specimens, please return here immediately so that we can harvest them for study.

Title: A True Hunter
Objective: Prove you're a worthy hunter by hunting Bonebeak Hawks in Sunfrost Glade.
Text: I don't know why Hemet hunts with Razik. His contraptions are unreliable at best!A true hunter doesn't need gadgets to hunt. They rely on instinct, skill, and agility.So tell me, do you have the skills of a true hunter? Better yet, prove it.Take down some of the Bonebeak Hawks that circle the nearby meadow.

Title: Securing the Ramparts
Objective: Slay the Rotting Frost Giant.
Text: As if this place weren't enough of a madhouse to begin with, we're fighting a war on two fronts up here, with the Scourge on one side and those blasted Alliance dogs on our other flank! We are here to clear a safe landing for our vessels, but a behemoth of a giant on the other side of the Ramparts is hurling debris at anything that comes close and keeping our smaller ships at bay. I'll be honest -- he's a bit much for us to handle, but you and your companions look up to the task.

Title: Huln's War - The Nathrezim
Objective: Defeat Tichondrius.
Text: I am fully occupied here organizing my troops and planning for the battle to come.While I would like to slay the Dreadlord Tichondrius myself, I will allow that honor to be yours, Huln Highmountain.

Title: Huln's War - Stormrage
Objective: Meet Malfurion.

Title: Khadgar's Discovery
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
Text: Champion! Please come to the Violet Citadel immediately. I have made a discovery that I would like to share with you before the Council of Six.

Title: Magic Message
Objective: Examine the Arcane Anomaly in Dalaran.
Text: For the last 10,000 years, the elven city of Suramar has been sealed in an arcane barrier, much like Dalaran once was. That barrier has come down. Since then, waves of magical energy have been emanating from the city like ripples in a pond. It was in these waves that I sensed a pattern. A spell, encrypted among the chaos. I have recreated the spell here. It's not dangerous, but beyond that... I have no idea what it does!

Title: Blessing of Cenarius
Objective: Meet with Cenarius.
Text: Cenarius himself has risked much in coming here, if only briefly, to bestow a blessing upon you. He has seen what you are capable of, and has chosen you as champion in this battle.Speak with him in the grove to the south.

Title: Keepers of the Hammer
Objective: Meet the High-Chieftain at Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
Text: High Chieftain Ulan has requested your presence. We have learned that the Burning Legion has returned and know that if you are true in your purpose in facing this evil, you will need our aid. Our people have in our possession a great titan relic: the Hammer of Khaz'goroth. We intend to lend it to you for this task. When you are ready, join me at our stronghold of Thunder Totem in Highmountain.

Title: Huln's War - Reinforcements
Objective: Defend Malfurion.
Text: Cenarius himself has risked much in coming here, if only briefly, to bestow a blessing upon you. He has seen what you are capable of, and has chosen you as champion in this battle. I would speak with you on this later. It is a rare gift indeed.But now, I ask for your help, Huln Highmountain. I must finish my incantations to allow dryads from beyond the veil to enter this place and lend us their aid.

Title: Huln's War - The Arrival
Objective: Defeat 25 Legion.
Text: Huln Highmountain is the origin of our strength as a tribe. He bested the Legion when last they threatened our survival and unified many disparate tribes.Live his story, and you will know why his name imbues courage in the cowardly and sows fear in the fearless.

Title: Trail of Echoes
Objective: Use Khadgar's Wand to find Arcane Echoes and track down First Arcanist Thalyssra.
Text: The Nightborne could prove powerful allies against the Legion. We must aid this Thalyssra if we can.We should be able to find her by tracking her magical echoes, the same way I found her distress call.I can teleport you near the location where she recorded that message. From there, you must search for ripples in the very fabric of the arcane itself.My wand should do the trick. Follow the sparks it creates--they should lead you to places where Thalyssra used her magic.

Title: Meet the Recruits
Objective: Use the Guiding Light spell to return to Light's Hope Chapel.
Text: Highlord, my mission in Dalaran was successful. I have recruited paladins truly worthy to carry your banner. They await your return at the Sanctum of Light.

Title: Remnants of the Past
Objective: Locate clues to discover the fate of Tideskorn Harbor.
Text: I do not know what has become of my village. Ever since the mists engulfed the harbor, my kinsfolk have changed. Some have grown violent and savage, while others have fallen into madness. Many have ventured into the mists and have yet to return. In these times, we can usually turn to our leader, Jarl Tarben. Alas, the mists have taken him as well. I do not know what will become of me. For now, I can only stay at my post and remain vigilant.

Title: Kill Azshara
Objective: xxxxx
Text: xxxxx

Title: Deprogramming
Objective: Defeat Lady Deathwhisper while ensuring that Darnavan survives.
Text: We had hoped to place a man on the inside of the Cult of the Damned, to give us an inside angle on the Lich King's machinations, but we... underestimated the persuasive powers of Arthas and his dark minister, Lady Deathwhisper. Our man, Darnavan, is one of them now. If you plan on fighting your way through the Oratory ahead, please keep your eyes peeled for Darnavan. If you can bring him back to us alive, we can attempt to reverse the Cult's brainwashing.

Title: Securing the Ramparts
Objective: Slay the Rotting Frost Giant.
Text: As if this place weren't enough of a madhouse to begin with, we're fighting a war on two fronts up here, with the Scourge on one side and those blasted Horde dogs on our other flank! We are here to clear a safe landing for our vessels, but a behemoth of a giant on the other side of the Ramparts is hurling debris at anything that comes close and keeping our smaller ships at bay. I'll be honest -- he's a bit much for us to handle, but you and your companions look up to the task.

If only we could obtain pure samples of the toxins, our researchers could concoct an antidote that would save countless lives. But there's a catch -- a proper sample will need to mix two active strains within a living host. Should you have the... misfortune... of becoming such a host, please return here immediately so that we can harvest you for study.

If you then defeat her, you should be able to recover it and return it to Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

We are here to clear a safe landing for our vessels, but a behemoth of a giant on the other side of the Ramparts is hurling debris at anything that comes close and keeping our smaller ships at bay. I'll be honest -- he's a bit much for us to handle, but you and your companions look up to the task.

Title: Is This Stuff Still Good?
Objective: Return the Crate of Foodstuffs to Williden Marshal at Marshal's Stand.
Text: You find what appears to be a crate of food, left behind when this camp was abandoned. On the outside of the crate, you can make out a stamp that says "PROPERTY OF MARSHAL EXPEDITIONS". Perhaps you might find someone who could use this?

Title: Deprogramming
Objective: Defeat Lady Deathwhisper while ensuring that Darnavan survives.
Text: We had hoped to place a man on the inside of the Cult of the Damned, to give us an inside angle on the Lich King's machinations, but we... underestimated the persuasive powers of Arthas and his dark minister, Lady Deathwhisper. Our man, Darnavan, is one of them now. If you plan on fighting your way through the Oratory ahead, please keep your eyes peeled for Darnavan. If you can bring him back to us alive, we can attempt to reverse the Cult's brainwashing.
