The curved ceremonial blades they use have a power all their own. Gather some of these for me. We will deprive them of these weapons and learn something about our enemy at the same time.

Title: Rumble in the Jungle
Objective: Defeat the three arena champions of Fangri'la.
Text: Dem fancy cat-men gotta be shown who is da boss 'round dese parts. Kill all their champions, and ya will earn da respect of all creatures in da jungle.Y'gonna need dese totems to draw dem out.

Title: Tooth and Claw
Objective: Collect 100 Tanaan Jungle Teeth from the various wildlife within Tanaan Jungle.
Text: Beyond the meager shelter of these fortress walls, the jungle closes in. Can you feel it? That is the untamed wilderness, calling forth our primal instincts. There is no better way to feel alive than to court death. Join me in the hunt! Collect teeth from the wild beasts. The ravagers in Thornmire, the raptors in Zorammarsh - even the sea creatures along the strand and the little podling plants themselves all have teeth. Bring them to me!

Title: The Forgening
Objective: Speak with Master Smith Helgar in the Forge in Valhallas.
Text: Your new weapon is very powerful, but my smiths have mastered crafting over thousands of years. Speak to Master Smith Helgar and see what improvements can be made.

Title: Bringing Down the Iron Horde
Objective: Slay 25 Iron Horde orcs in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: Ever since the fall of Blackrock Foundry, Gul'dan has been turning the Iron Horde into... something worse. The orcs who once flocked to Grommash's banner, through either fear or thirst for revenge, are now embracing the fel. Wade into the battlefields of Tanaan and lay waste to Gul'dan's forces. Orc or fel orc makes no difference. Gut what remains of the Iron Horde!

Title: Slay Them All!
Objective: Slay 200 enemy players.
Text: The Horde encroachment cannot be tolerated. Dwindle their numbers to the ground!

Title: Pressing the Attack
Objective: Complete 2 bonus objective areas within Tanaan Jungle.
Text: We got Gul'dan's minions on the run, commander! If you be feelin' it, we should put some pressure on some of his other strongholds as well.

Title: Slay Them All!
Objective: Slay 200 enemy players.
Text: Find them, hunt them, kill them. Teach our enemies a lesson they'll never forget.

Title: Continue the Domination
Objective: Defeat the Alliance at the event locations in Ashran and kill Grand Marshal Tremblade.
Text: The Alliance refuse to back down in Ashran. Teach them that the Horde will not stand aside while they plunder the power of the ancient ogre empire to use for their own schemes.

Title: Continue the Domination
Objective: Defeat the Horde at all event locations in Ashran and kill High Warlord Volrath.
Text: As we feared the Horde are trying to consolidate their position here on the island by looting it, just like we feared. Get out there and show them the Alliance won't put up with their aggression.

Title: Ashran Dominance
Objective: Defeat the Horde at the event locations in Ashran and kill High Warlord Volrath.
Text: As we feared the Horde are trying to consolidate their position here on the island by looting it, just like we feared. Get out there and show them the Alliance won't put up with their aggression.

Title: Ashran Dominance
Objective: Defeat the Alliance at the event locations in Ashran and kill Grand Marshal Tremblade.
Text: The Alliance refuse to back down in Ashran. Teach them that the Horde will not stand aside while they plunder the power of the ancient ogre empire to use for their own schemes.

Title: Harnessing Their Power
Objective: Collect a Wargronn Harness from an Iron Wargronn at the Iron Front in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: Ol' Grommash Hellscream found a way to weaponize the gronn. Vol'jin wants to know how. Travel to the Iron Front and kill one of them big beasties, then bring back its war harness. You might be needin' help.

Title: Vengeance Will Be Mine!
Objective: Teach the Vengeance specialization to your assembled demon hunters.
Text: This is why the Legion fears us. We have the ability to turn their secrets against them and in so doing become stronger than they ever can be.Quickly, teach us what you have learned.

Title: Blood of Fallen Brothers
Objective: Collect 20 Vials of Fel Blood from fel orcs throughout Tanaan Jungle.
Text: Orcs that drink Gul'dan's poison turn into fel beasts. Soulless savages. Lady Liadrin an' the Blood Knights think maybe there be a way back. They be wantin' samples of blood from freshly turned orcs. Get their blood! You be findin' fel orcs all over Tanaan, but the Iron Front, the Fel Forge, and the Throne of Kil'jaeden is where you find the most.

Title: Secrets of the Shadow Council
Objective: Collect 20 Shadow Council Missives from shadow council representatives in the Ruins of Kra'nak or the Throne of Kil'jaeden.
Text: Gul'dan be growin' his Shadow Council like a spider spin a web. But some of this new blood, they not so smart. They write down the secrets but don't burn 'em. Catch his minions out in the open and bring their secrets back to me! You find them workin' with the arakkoa in da Ruins of Kra'nak or atop the Throne of Kil'jaeden.

Title: Cry Havoc and Let Slip the Illidari!
Objective: Teach the Havoc specialization to your assembled demon hunters.
Text: This is why the Legion fears us. We have the ability to turn their secrets against them and in so doing become stronger than they ever can be.

Title: Demonslayer of Tanaan
Objective: Slay 20 demons in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: Look to the north. The sky is turning a sickly green. Gul'dan's summoning portals are not yet at full strength, but already the stench of demon is on the wind. Slay them. Destroy as many beasts as you can before they find a way to Azeroth. The Temple of Sha'naar is infested, as is the Throne of Kil'jaeden, although you may find others wandering about the jungle.

Title: Bloodied Blades of Zeth'Gol
Objective: Collect 25 Bleeding Hollow Ritual Blades from Bleeding Hollow orcs in Zeth'Gol.
Text: Them Bleeding Hollow orcs do blood magic - like voodoo but it hurt more. They cut their own flesh. Most of 'em carry curved ritual blades for carvin' themselves up. Bring me them blades, commander. We can turn their power against 'em.

Title: A Little Wetwork
Objective: Collect 15 Iron Horde Naval Manifests from forces in Ironhold Harbor.
Text: What be left of the Iron Horde is comin' to Tanaan through Ironhold Harbor. If we knew who was comin' and when, we could use our shipyard to cause some chaos. Go to Ironhold Harbor and fish up some intelligence!

Title: The Fel Spire
Objective: Collect 4 Fel Essences from Mannoroth in Hellfire Citadel on Mythic difficulty.
Text: This would all be so much simpler if we could just teleport directly to the top of the Citadel, where Gul'dan works his dark magic, wouldn't it? But while demonic power fills the halls, my magic cannot penetrate to such heights. If only I had powerful Fel Essences to work with, I could attune my magic to their defenses and bypass them. But the only place you might find such concentrated fel energy would be atop the Citadel itself. What a conundrum....

Title: Disarming Sha'naar
Objective: Collect 8 Unrefined Draenic Crystals from the mines located within the Temple of Sha'naar in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: Draenei at the Temple of Sha'naar would mine these mountains for perfect crystals used to channel their magics. Now demons be lootin' the place. We gotta keep those crystals out of demonic hands, commander! Attack the mines behind the temple and grab them crystals.

Title: The Fel Spire
Objective: Collect 4 Fel Essences from Mannoroth in Hellfire Citadel on Heroic difficulty.
Text: This would all be so much simpler if we could just teleport directly to the top of the Citadel, where Gul'dan works his dark magic, wouldn't it? But while demonic power fills the halls, my magic cannot penetrate to such heights. If only I had powerful Fel Essences to work with, I could attune my magic to their defenses and bypass them. But the only place you might find such concentrated fel energy would be atop the Citadel itself. What a conundrum....

Title: The Fel Spire
Objective: Collect 4 Fel Essences from Mannoroth in Hellfire Citadel on Normal difficulty.
Text: This would all be so much simpler if we could just teleport directly to the top of the Citadel, where Gul'dan works his dark magic, wouldn't it? But while demonic power fills the halls, my magic cannot penetrate to such heights. If only I had powerful Fel Essences to work with, I could attune my magic to their defenses and bypass them. But the only place you might find such concentrated fel energy would be atop the Citadel itself. What a conundrum....

Title: Well of Souls
Objective: Collect 4 Soul Remnants from Gorefiend in Hellfire Citadel on Normal difficulty.
Text: As you defeat Gul'dan's minions, his hold over this fel citadel weakens, allowing me to teleport you and your allies deeper into the dark halls. If I only I had some Soul Remnants - four of them, let's say - none of this would be necessary, and I could harness that power to send you directly into the upper reaches of the Citadel.

Title: Well of Souls
Objective: Collect 4 Soul Remnants from Gorefiend in Hellfire Citadel on Mythic difficulty.
Text: As you defeat Gul'dan's minions, his hold over this fel citadel weakens, allowing me to teleport you and your allies deeper into the dark halls. If I only I had some Soul Remnants - four of them, let's say - none of this would be necessary, and I could harness that power to send you directly into the upper reaches of the Citadel.

Title: Well of Souls
Objective: Collect 4 Soul Remnants from Gorefiend in Hellfire Citadel on Heroic difficulty.
Text: As you defeat Gul'dan's minions, his hold over this fel citadel weakens, allowing me to teleport you and your allies deeper into the dark halls. If I only I had some Soul Remnants - four of them, let's say - none of this would be necessary, and I could harness that power to send you directly into the upper reaches of the Citadel.

Title: Hidden No More
Objective: Kill Fel Lord Caza and take his fel power.
Text: Now that you've uncovered the demons, I can sense them, too. Specifically, I sense a very powerful fel lord deeper in the cave. You need to grab his power while you still can.If you can deal with their leader, we will take care of the rest of his forces in that cave.

Title: High Water
Objective: Speak with Jale Rivermane at Riverbend.
Text: Riverbend! Is that what the Underking said? That is my home and the place where we store our winter supplies. We must make it there at all speed and warn them. Meet me there.

Title: The Flow of the River
Objective: Meet with Angler Creel in Whitewater Wash.
Text: We can leave Farmer Maya in charge of the farmland now that the greatest threat has been reduced.But we aren't out of hot water just yet. The fisheries are just as important as our fields, and they are in even greater danger than the farm if what Angler Creel says is true.

Title: Ormgul the Pestilent
Objective: Slay Ormgul the Pestilent and acquire his Bug Sprayer.
Text: We've lived at peace with the drogbar for years--our tribe even more than the others. But we were betrayed in our last trade with them at Riverbend.They usually supply us with potent alchemy to prevent insects from infesting our fields. This time, led by Ormgul, they have attacked the crops that sustain us all.Ormgul the Pestilent is the one who brought the infection to our farmland. Destroy him, and bring me whatever he uses to attract the bugs to our land.

Title: Invading Spelunkers
Objective: Slay 7 Drogbar Manathirsters or Violent Crageaters.
Text: The drogbar and their earthen furies have overrun the cavern. They're perverting the magic within and destroying the elementals that have forever dwelled in this place.Let's work together to remove them from this sacred cave.

Title: Infestation
Objective: Slay 10 Diseased Grubs and 3 Overgrown Larva at Earthmother's Bounty.
Text: Those bugs are destroying our crops and attack any of us who get near them.Would you exterminate some of those vile creatures?

Title: Balance of Elements
Objective: Recover 10 Empowered Crystals.
Text: The drogbar place their foul crystals in our cave to absorb the magic within, and then they collect them when they are saturated with power.We must recover the crystals so the magic might dissipate and be suffused back into the waters, or else the drogbar will find ways to corrupt the magic to their own purposes.

Title: Crystal Fury
Objective: Slay Gelmogg.
Text: A drogbar stonecaster known as Gelmogg entered our sacred water caverns and aims to draw its power into himself.We must destroy him before he gets too powerful.He is in the upper caverns.

Title: Cut Out the Heart
Objective: Kill Apothecary Curseheart in the Dread-Rider Incursion.
Text: This map points out the strategic locations of the Forsaken forces around Greywatch. A marker to the east indicates an apothecary camp where Dread-Riders are being supplied from.If you were to take out the apothecary in charge of creating this plague, it could stem the invasion and prevent the Dread-Riders from spreading the plague any further.

Title: Vale POI Event TRACKING
Objective: Defeat Botanist Darkgrove
Text: (PH)Darkgrove has run out of places to hide. Now it is time to finish him off. If we stop him now, there may be hope for this valley yet.

Title: Assault on the Throne of Kil'jaeden
Objective: Assault the Shadow Council forces at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Shadow Council are summoning their demonic masters upon a mountain they are calling the Throne of Kil'jaeden. Remember the first war, we know the destruction the legion can cause if they are unchecked.Head to the Throne of Kil'jaeden and let's put an end to this invasion before it can begin.

Title: Unexpected Allies
Objective: Speak with Mayla Highmountain at Thunder Totem.
Text: You have gained my trust. Not all drogbar are as violent as the savages led by Dargrul the Underking, nor are all tauren as bloodthirsty as the Bloodtotem.You may tell Mayla Highmountain that she has our support. The cavern we call home is yours to explore freely as well.

Title: Cave of the Blood Trial
Objective: Place the Witch of the Wood's carcass on the altar and defeat a Warmonger in single combat.
Text: All Bloodtotem and distinguished guests must go through a trial of blood in the cavern beneath this outpost.I hope it's a good sign that they wish you to participate in this rite of passage. You will need to show proof of your deeds, defeat a Warmonger in single combat, then perform sacrifice at an altar deep in the cavern.

Title: Assault on the Throne of Kil'jaeden
Objective: Assault the Shadow Council forces at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Shadow Council are summoning their demonic masters upon a mountain they are calling the Throne of Kil'jaeden. We know the destruction the legion can cause if they are left unchecked.Head to the Throne of Kil'jaeden and let's put an end to this invasion before it can begin.

Title: Assault on the Fel Forge
Objective: Assault the Iron Horde reinforcements at Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

Title: Assault on the Fel Forge
Objective: Assault the Iron Horde reinforcements at Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

Title: Stonedark Relics
Objective: Recover the Chain of Resistance, Wheel of Fortitude, and Rod of Bearing.
Text: The murlocs managed to steal some of our sacred relics and carry them down into the lower cavern.While we warm up, do you think you could go find them?

Title: You Lift, Brul?
Objective: Carry the weights to the statue of Liftbrul and return to Damrul the Stronk.
Text: Do you even lift? If you can carry these weights to the statue of Liftbrul and back, maybe we can talk.

Title: Deep in the Cavern
Objective: Slay 8 murlocs in Stonedark Cavern.
Text: We're getting tired of those murlocs. They skitter around the cavern like they own it. They stole some of our most precious relics and got their fishy fins all over them.Kill a few of them so they know they don't run things around here.

Title: Unknowable Power
Objective: Collect a Fel-Corrupted Apexis Fragment from any Treasure or from any Rare or Rare Elite creature in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The one they call Gul'dan has ruined his own people, and now seeks to ruin what remains of mine as well. The fallen outcasts at Kra'nak have already pledged themselves to Gul'dan in a false promise of a return to the skies. He has given the most powerful of his minions the power of the Apexis, but twisted in a way that I cannot explain. Bring one of these fragments to me.

Title: Guhruhlruhlruh
Objective: Defeat Guhruhlruhlruh.
Text: The murlocs are usually pretty scared of us, but some bigger one led them into our cavern and they're getting too brave.Kill their leader. I think its name is something like "Guhruhlruhlruh."

Title: Assaulting the Haglands
Objective: Slay 8 Crawliac Harpies and 6 Skywhisker Loyalists in the Haglands.
Text: Proceed on foot into the Haglands and slay any harpies you find. Quell their numbers! We will provide air support and force your prey to the ground where you can deal with them. Show these witches the fury of your... well... your "you."

Title: Unseen Influence
Objective: Collect 10 Fel-Corrupted Apexis Fragments from any Treasure or from any Rare or Rare Elite creature in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The corruption in the Apexis has begun to affect many of my people. We are so accustomed to the power it grants us that more succumb to the whispers every day. You must bring me more samples so I can free my people from yet another curse.

Title: Mending the Filter
Objective: Try to find the whereabouts of a tailor in Val'sharah who can help you mend the silk.
Text: Bringing back the cloth in such a manner would not be beneficial to Deucus. Perhaps there's a tailor here in Val'sharah who'd be willing to mend it for you. The priestess who helped you earlier may know of such a person.

Title: Flasking for a Favor
Objective: Seek out Barm Stonebreaker at the Ironhorn Enclave in Highmountain.
Text: You know, this mixing flask didn't suffer terrible damage. I'm positive it can just be repaired. I'm no expert in glass repair, but I've heard of someone who is--a tauren by the name of Barm Stonebreaker. He's a smith by trade, but those who know him say he was born to work glass. Those tauren don't work for free, so you may be in for some work yourself.

Title: Blood Debt
Objective: Defeat Torok Bloodtotem at Torok's Bluff.
Text: You have proven a much greater ally than the Bloodtotem ever were. With my focus crystal, my wounds are healed. I fear Frag was too far gone to revive.Torok and his Bloodtotem will suffer for what they have done to us. Let's pay them a visit before they can mount an attack against the cave of my people.

Title: Satyr Line TRACKING
Objective: Defeat Botanist Darkgrove
Text: (PH)Darkgrove has run out of places to hide. Now it is time to finish him off. If we stop him now, there may be hope for this valley yet.

Title: The Eagle Spirit's Blessing
Objective: Receive the Eagle Spirit's blessing at Spiritwatch Point in Highmountain.
Text: The spear is linked to a spirit called Ohn'ahra. It has been tradition for us to speak with her and receive her blessing before going after the spear. She may also impart some knowledge.If you would accompany me to Spiritwatch Point, I will summon the Eagle Spirit and ask for its blessing in the coming fight.

Title: Shipyard Report
Objective: Return to your shipyard in Frostwall.
Text: Commander! We have received reports from the shipyard that things are getting serious. Can you head back to Frostwall and check in with Rolosh? Every ship we build gives us another advantage over Gul'dan's new Horde.

Title: Shipyard Report
Objective: Return to your shipyard in Lunarfall.
Text: Commander! We have received reports from the shipyard that things are getting serious. Can you head back to Lunarfall and check in with Merreck? Every ship we build gives us another advantage over Gul'dan's new Horde.

Title: Xavius Event TRACKING
Objective: Defeat Botanist Darkgrove
Text: (PH)Darkgrove has run out of places to hide. Now it is time to finish him off. If we stop him now, there may be hope for this valley yet.

Title: Hex-a-Gone
Objective: Slay Hexweaver Akara.
Text: The harpies are relentless in their pursuit to control the basin. They are able to craft bags of foul magic as quickly as we can destroy them.The Skyhorn cannot gain the upper hand as long as their hexweaver lives. She must be stopped.

Title: Stonedark Crystal
Objective: Find Navarrogg's Stonedark Focus.
Text: Without my crystalline focus, my powers are weak. Those who captured me took it, and I know not where it is now.I'm sure one of the Feltotem has it. If you find it, please return it to me.

Title: Rating Razik
Objective: Find Hemet Nesingwary at his Highmountain retreat.
Text: Hemet is expecting an update on how my munitions research and development is going.I'm sure you'll be happy to tell my boss that my latest creation worked flawlessly!You can find him at his camp near the hunters' lodge.

Title: Stories of Battle
Objective: Collect 8 verses of Ashilvara from Priestesses of Eyir in Skold-Ashil.
Text: The writings carried by the priestess appear to be the first part of an epic poem describing the history of Ashildir, the ancient queen of the Valkyra.If Ashildir has a connection to the shieldmaidens here, you may be able to use that to your advantage.The answer to her involvement likely lies within the remaining text.

Title: NOT USED
Objective: Get Oronok and your ally to destroy the barrier, then stop Gul'dan.
Text: Your ally and I will remove this barrier now, though it will take a greater part of our strength. What lies beyond will not be easy.Gul'dan will have empowered an elemental lord with the Cipher, driving it insane. He will use it to destroy the link between the elements and Draenor. If you destroy that elemental, we could recover the Cipher.

Title: Destroying the Competition
Objective: Construct a Destroyer in your Shipyard and send it on a naval mission.
Text: One battle does not win the war, Commander.That Transport isn't gonna hold up long against this Iron Horde navy. We are going to need another ship. Lucky for us, a local smuggler has supplied us with the plans we need to build Destroyers. We should construct one of these ships immediately!

Title: Destroying the Competition
Objective: Construct a Destroyer in your Shipyard and send it on a naval mission.
Text: One battle does not win the war, Commander.That Transport isn't gonna hold up long against this Iron Horde navy. We are going to need another ship. Lucky for us, a local smuggler has supplied us with the plans we need to build Destroyers. We should construct one of these ships immediately!

Title: It Hungers for Blood
Objective: Let the Bloodstone feed on the blood of demons.
Text: Bloodstones contain a great deal of power that can only be awakened once they are fed.Yet this stone does not feast on fish and cakes. It hungers for blood; the more powerful, the better.There's an infestation of demons just east of here. I need you to nourish my stone with their blood, so that I may unlock its power.

Title: Moonclaw's Wisdom
Objective: Meet Thaon Moonclaw in his den.
Text: Our quick action today has stopped this aggression and saved my valley. As you requested, I will join Malfurion in the Grove of Cenarius. Still, there is much about these satyrs that I wish to tell you. This information would be most valuable to you. Please meet me in my den before departing.

Title: The Cipher of Damnation
Objective: Get Oronok and your ally to destroy the barrier, then stop Gul'dan.
Text: Your ally and I will remove this barrier now, though it will take a greater part of our strength. What lies beyond will not be easy.Gul'dan will have empowered an elemental lord with the Cipher, driving it insane. He will use it to destroy the link between the elements and Draenor. If you destroy that elemental, we could recover the Cipher.

Title: A Mysterious Text
Objective: Bring the Runewritten Tome to Deucus Valdera in Dalaran.
Text: You found a water-logged tome near the bones of a massive creature. Written in an unfamiliar language, the book is adorned with runes and alchemical symbols. Perhaps another alchemist would be able to tell you more.

Title: Bear Huntin'
Objective: Collect 4 Bristlefur Pelts within the Fields of An'she.
Text: They say a single hair from the back of a bristlefur bear is sharp enough to cut a dwarf's beard. But if the fur doesn't kill ya, the maul will.Some lesser hunters have been a meal for those bears.Show me you're more than a snack and bring me back a few of those bristlefur pelts.

Title: Pet Rocks
Objective: Find Navarrogg's pets.
Text: I raise creatures born of the earth to help defend myself and my people. When I was captured, I ordered them to stay behind at our home, but they are often disobedient and likely tried to follow me.If they did, I fear the Bloodtotem may have captured them, or worse. In my current state, I can't muster the strength to find them. If you find them, it would be much appreciated.

Title: The Skies of Highmountain
Objective: Speak with Lasan Skyhorn at the base of Thunder Totem.
Text: When you are ready, join me at the base of Thunder Totem. I would be honored to have you at my side as my tribe once again swears its allegiance to the young Mayla. Together, we are Highmountain!

Title: Procuring a Prototype
Objective: Find Razik Gazbolt at Icepine Point.
Text: If Addie's going to be a more permanent member of the huntin' party, then she'll need some specialty gear for someone her size.My munitions expert should have some ideas about what kind of weapon would best suit a gnome.Stop by his camp and let him know that I'll be needin' a prototype soon.

Title: Rock Troll in a Hard Place
Objective: Speak with Navarrogg to meet him at a safe location.
Text: We should leave this place while we have a chance. The Bloodtotem are amassing at their village to the north, and I believe they intend to kill my people.Let me know when you are ready to go, and I can take us to a safe place quickly.

Title: Dishonored
Objective: Slay Xandris the Dishonored.
Text: Xandris the Dishonored was among the first to betray his brethren and accept the curse of Xavius. During the great war, it was he who led the slaughter of many of my dearest friends. The last time I met him on the battlefield he fled. Help me to finally dispense justice on this foul being.

Title: A Gift for Greymane
Objective: Plant 3 Gilnean Heavy Explosives onto the hull of Greymane's ship and detonate them at a safe distance.
Text: It looks like the Gilnean infiltrators brought some heavy ordnance to the fight. It's likely they intend to use them on the walls of Dreadwake's Landing.If these could be rigged to Greymane's ship, it could make for a decisive end to his assault on the outpost.

Title: Perrexx the Corruptor
Objective: Kill Perrexx the Corruptor in the Moonclaw Vale.
Text: Look around you. Corruption has befouled my valley. If Malfurion requires my presence to summon Ysera the Awakened, then I will surely aid him, but not until I have purged these demons from my lands. Perrexx the Corruptor is just ahead. Help me slay this fiend. Stand by my side, and together we can rout these satyrs and their brethren.

Title: The Corruptor
Objective: Slay Kagraxxis the Corruptor.
Text: Xandris has been slain, but there are others that must be dealt with if my grove is to be saved. During the great war, Kagraxxis took great pleasure in corrupting the lands he once called home. Were it not for the foolish mercy of my fellow druids, I would have slain him myself. Find the demon and bring justice upon him. I must entrust this task to you alone, for I sense an even darker presence here... one that requires my personal attention.

Title: Witch of the Wood
Objective: Defeat the Witch of the Wood.
Text: You saved me at Riverbend not long ago. It is the reason I vouched for you as emissary to this tribe, and the only reason you're alive here now. I consider my debt to you paid.You must prove yourself to the Bloodtotem chieftain before he will speak with you.Within the forest is the Witch of the Wood, a harpy mother who recently descended into this territory. If you are able to defeat her and show her carcass to the Bloodtotem, they might allow you an audience with Torok.

Title: Equipment Blueprint: Automated Sky Scanner
Objective: Return the blueprints to a Naval Equipment Specialist at your garrison shipyard.
Text: This appears to be a blueprint for some sort of naval equipment. We should take it back to our Shipyard and see if someone can decipher it.

Title: An Audience with Torok
Objective: Speak with Torok Bloodtotem.
Text: I should warn you that Torok is easily displeased and is hateful of outsiders. Be on your guard.We will seek an audience with him at his tent at the Cliff's Edge. As the Rivermane Emissary here, I am afforded some protection against aggression, but they have made no such promises about you.

Title: Hags of a Feather
Objective: Collect 50 Hag Feathers from Witchwood Hags in the Witchwood.
Text: The drogbar you freed me from were unusually aggressive. The tribe in the nearby caves seems to be apart from the rest of them, but that didn't stop the Bloodtotem from going on the offensive just in case, capturing some of their number.That move left the woods exposed to the harpies, however. Your help dealing with these witches would not go unnoticed by Torok. Bring back their feathers as proof of death.

Title: Equipment Blueprint: Ammo Reserves
Objective: Return the blueprints to a Naval Equipment Specialist at your garrison shipyard.
Text: This appears to be a blueprint for some sort of naval equipment. We should take it back to our Shipyard and see if someone can decipher it.

Objective: Return the blueprints to a Naval Equipment Specialist at your garrison shipyard.

Title: Equipment Blueprint: Tuskarr Fishing Net
Objective: Return the blueprints to a Naval Equipment Specialist at your garrison shipyard.
Text: This appears to be a blueprint for some sort of naval equipment. We should take it back to our Shipyard and see if someone can decipher it.

Title: Wisp in the Willows
Objective: Guide the Wisp through the Hidden Pools to grow 8 trees.
Text: Wisps are the spirits of our night elven brethren who have become one with the forest. But their minds and the way they perceive things are very different than in life. You should bond with this little one. See through its eyes as it travels to the hidden pools and grows some trees.

Title: Extinguishing the Sentinels
Objective: Extinguish the three Sentinels.
Text: You've made it. See that camp there? They've got some Legion Sentinels hiding in there, set to notify Sargeras any time his pet pooch gets hungry or craves attention. Shut them down.

Title: Maw of Souls: A Hope in Helheim
Objective: Retrieve a crate of Dragur Dust from Heroic: Maw of Souls, craft a Flask of the Seventh Demon and return both items to Alard in Dalaran.
Text: For this last ingredient, well...  Yes, that's the only way. For this last one, you'll need to go to the land of the damned, Helheim. Well, not there exactly, but aboard the boat that ferries the dead across the Maw of Souls. Upon that boat may be the final ingredient we need. It's called Dragur Dust. Keep an eye out for it. Also, one needs to be quick when adding this ingredient. I'll need something to heighten my reflexes.

Title: Equipment Blueprint: High Intensity Fog Lights
Objective: Return the blueprints to a Naval Equipment Specialist at your garrison shipyard.
Text: This appears to be a blueprint for some sort of naval equipment. We should take it back to our Shipyard and see if someone can decipher it.

Title: Equipment Blueprint: Trained Shark Tank
Objective: Return the blueprints to a Naval Equipment Specialist at your garrison shipyard.
Text: This appears to be a blueprint for some sort of naval equipment. We should take it back to our Shipyard and see if someone can decipher it.

Title: Testing the Calibration
Objective: Test the Malloric Burettes' calibration by crafting a variety of potions.
Text: Now that you have the burettes calibrated, it's time to test them out! The only way to be sure is by crafting a sufficient quantity of a variety of potions. Glamorous work? No, but the most important reagent in alchemy is a bit of elbow grease!

Title: The Emerald Nightmare: Rage Fire
Objective: Travel to the Emerald Nightmare and acquire Nythendra's Heart. Bring it to Alard in Dalaran.
Text: Now that we have all the ingredients assembled, we need one last thing. The fire of my forges burn hot, but not hot enough to work these ingredients into glass. For that, we need more heat. The heat of a dragon, to be exact. I'm aware of one that has emerged from the Emerald Dream in a corrupted state. Corrupted or not, a dragon's heart burns with enough heat to melt the strongest of materials. Bring me its heart and you'll have your conduit.

Title: Black Rook Hold: Heavy, But Helpful
Objective: Retrieve some Sabelite Sulfate from Heroic: Black Rook Hold, craft a Flask of the Countless Armies and return both items to Alard in Dalaran.
Text: The next ingredient on the list will supposedly add strength to the mix, according to Deucus. I've heard of it before, but haven't really used it. It's called Sabelite Sulfate, and it's said the elves of Black Rook Hold use it in their blacksmithing. Something like that won't just be lying around. You may have to delve deep into the hold to find it. And due to its weight, I may need a concoction of yours to compensate, something to give me a bit more strength.

Title: Halls of Valor: The Prime Ingredient
Objective: Retrieve the Eternity Sand from Heroic: Halls of Valor, craft a Flask of Ten Thousand Scars and return both items to Alard in Dalaran.
Text: This first ingredient can only be obtained by visiting the next realm. Fortunately for us, there's a gate in Stormheim that can take you there. In the Halls of Valor, there is a sand that's used for polishing their architecture. Eternity Sand, it's called. I'll need an ample amount of it as the base for the new glass. This ingredient won't be easy to work with either. I'll need something to keep me going, you know, keep my stamina up.

Title: Channeling Our Efforts
Objective: Talk to Alard Schmied about the list of things you need done.
Text: While it's no secret my time is more valuable than... well, anyone's, I fear I must step in and help to replace my decoction conduit. You will also play a crucial part in this, as my liaison with the blacksmiths. The thought of getting soot on my robes curls my toes. Here's a list of what we'll need done. Meanwhile I'll be out gathering the rest of what's needed.

Title: Calibration Experts
Objective: Take the Uncalibrated Malloric Burettes to skilled alchemists for calibration.
Text: It will take the cooperation of several highly skilled sorts to calibrate these burettes for a variety of substances. Chemist Emmara is an old friend from the Undercity who has helped me with similar endeavors. Thunder Bluff smells like a barn to me, but Jana Winterhoof is an alchemist with exacting standards. And while I'd never travel to Booty Bay without a lock on my wallet, Tryks Pourtrue has proven reliable and fair.

Title: Going Underground
Objective: See Ms. Xiulan about acquiring some new burettes for Deucus.
Text: We're so close to replacing all my equipment. In order to make flasks again, we need to be able to precisely measure each ingredient. For that, we need to replace my burette assembly. Unfortunately, burettes aren't easy to come by. We may be able to procure some though through other means by...  Going underground, so to say. As in, the Black Market. Go see Ms. Xiulan. Mum's the word.

Title: Vault of the Wardens: Bendy Glass Tubes
Objective: Bring the Bendy Glass Tubes to Deucus Valdera in Dalaran.
Text: You find tubing formed from a bendable sort of glass. It appears as though Grimoira was using it to suck out the insides of her victims. Its magical properties, however, would seem ideal for use on an advanced alchemy table.

Title: The Price of the Black Market
Objective: Collect a Silver Hair of Khadgar, a Blood of Sargeras, 5 Kaldorei Ginger Wine and 5 Moist Azsunian Feta.
Text: I may have what you're looking for, burettes you say? Not a very common item. For that, I require a moderate favor. Nothing too big, just a few things really. A silver hair from a high-ranking archmage... the blood of a titan, and, oh... some wine and cheese. What?! I have appetites that need satiating.

Title: Lining the Crucible
Objective: Gather 1 Blood of Sargeras, 1 Felhide, 2 Felwort, and 100 Yseralline Seeds.
Text: The first step in making this crucible useful is to restore the lining of its interior. That's going to require supplies you'll either gather yourself or obtain through trade with fellow adventurers. Felwort and yseralline seeds are familiar to herbalists. Felhide is obtained through skinning. Blood of Sargeras can be found all over the Broken Isles.

Title: Forlorn Filter
Objective: Speak with a Temple Priestess at the Temple of Elune to see if you can acquire some Shaldorei Silk.
Text: Next on the list of things to replace are my filters. Now I'm sure you've concluded that an alchemist of my caliber uses only the finest of tools when mixing my potions. The elves at the Temple of Elune in Val'sharah use Shaldorei silk to craft their robes. Perhaps they'd be willing to part with some for my filters.

Title: Vault of the Wardens: Demon's Bile
Objective: Craft a Skaggldrynk, then go to the Vault of the Wardens and bathe the crucible in the bile of Grimoira.
Text: The key to a crucible like this is that it must be bathed in the foulest of fel energy. I hate to say it, but the most efficient method of accomplishing such a feat is to subject it to the bile of a demon. Yes, I said the bile of a demon. Ready to get to work? In the Vault of the Wardens, such a demon exists. An imp mother by the name of Grimoira. The door to her room is sealed by an invisible lock. I'd suggest bringing some Skaggldrynk with you. Use it when you get to her door.

Title: A Fragile Crucible
Objective: Bring the Fragile Demonsbreath Crucible to Deucus Valdera in Dalaran.
Text: I have customers asking for alchemist stones, but I'm unable to make any until I replace my crucible. In order to create a new one, we'll need a few things, but first we'll need a proper container. Something that can be augmented to withstand a demon's breath. There's a place in Suramar which the Legion has occupied. There surely must be a device there we can take that will be suitable for our needs.

Title: Return the Filter
Objective: Return the Mended Shaldorei Silk to Deucus Valdera in Dalaran.
Text: What was torn has now been mended. I hope you put this Shaldorei silk to good use. Now, run along.

Title: We Need More Powder!
Objective: Obtain Katterin's Alchemy Kit from Katterin the Blistered in Stormheim.
Text: The substance you brought me appears to be precipitating powder, a highly volatile reagent used by the vrykul in their recipes. There are rumors that a vrykul elder named Katterin has built up quite a store of this powder. A substance this dangerous needs to be in our hands, not hers!

Title: Thanks for Flasking
Objective: Take the repaired Dual-Chambered Mixing Flask to Deucus Valdera in Dalaran.
Text: Here is your flask, good as new. A fair trade for those potions. Be a little more careful with your breakables next time!

Title: A Dormant Burner
Objective: Purchase a Depleted Leyflame Burner from Hobart Grapplehammer and bring it to Deucus Valdera in Dalaran.
Text: I've heard that someone over in the engineering shop is selling a burner that might be usable. You could likely negotiate a fairer price than I could! The shop is just across the street. I'll make a note on your map for you.

Title: Neltharion's Lair: Potent Powder
Objective: Acquire Precipitating Powder in Neltharion's Lair and bring it to Deucus Valdera in Dalaran.
Text: I've heard rumors that the ancient drogbar collected powder from the residue of dragon's breath. If it's true that Neltharion's Lair lies somewhere below us, it seems a likely source. Go there and try to find a replacement for my powder.

Title: Get Your Mix On
Objective: Deucus Valdera in Dalaran wants you to craft some new potions. Merchant Patricia Egan in the alchemy shop can help you learn how.
Text: Let's see... potion stains on your tabard, crushed herbs on your boots... I know a fellow alchemist when I see one! We will do good work together, the two of us. I trust you're not averse to learning new tricks. Be sure to use my state-of-the-art alchemy table. I built her myself!

Title: An Imprecise Burette
Objective: Bring the Uncalibrated Malloric Burettes to Deucus in Dalaran.
Text: Here are your burettes. Should you ever be in the need of anything else, don't hesitate to ask.

Title: Ley Hunting
Objective: Travel to key locations in Azsuna and use the Depleted Leyflame Burner to collect ley energy.
Text: The leyflame burner you brought me is useless! This is why I never trust an engineer... The burner needs to be charged in areas that resonate with ley energy before it can be used to craft our newfound alchemy recipes. Lucky for us, Azsuna is rich with such power.

Title: Missing Shipments
Objective: Alchemist Deucus Valdera in Dalaran wants you to locate supplies lost near the water in Azsuna.
Text: Now that we've gotten to know each other, perhaps you can lend me a hand. My weekly supply shipment was lost when my longtime courier--you know, old whatsername--was shot out of the sky over the shores of Azsuna. Surely a hardy sort like you could retrieve my lost goods.

Title: Through the Portal
Objective: Use the Demonic Gateway to enter the Hound's Portal World.
Text: Here's the good news: you're halfway there. Sorry you had to do that, but necessity is the mother of invention. See that portal down there? That's where the Hound lives. Get through it and find out what's going on in there.

Title: There's a Scribe for That
Objective: Bring the Runewritten Tome to Professor Pallin in Dalaran.
Text: Fine! I admit, even my considerable intellect can't translate the strange tome you discovered. No doubt the water smears made it illegible. Say, one of those dimwitted scribes down the block owes me a favor. This sort of busywork is just his cup of tea.

Title: Moozy's Sojourn
Objective: Find Moozy downriver in Whitewater Wash.
Text: My son! They took him! My wife and I split up to look for him. She went upriver and I went downriver.Leave me, please, and find Moozy... I might be okay... If you find Moozy, please bring him to my wife upriver.

Title: Ancient Knowledge
Objective: Observe Deucus Valdera as he attempts one of the vrykul recipes.
Text: The tome contains a wealth of ancient vrykul recipes! Why, I could be the first alchemist in untold ages to craft one! How fortunate for you, friend , that you are here to bear witness to my greatness! Awful kind of that Svena person to die and leave her book for us, eh? Silly vrykul...

Title: The Three
Objective: Slay Ragi the Hexxer, Agara Deathsong, and Ugla the Hag.
Text: When High Crawliac seized control of the harpies she placed 3 powerful and deadly witches in charge of the covens under her command. These witches must die. Feel up for the challenge? Head into the Haglands behind me and find these three evil creatures. We will cover you from the air and give your prey no sky to retreat. Look for us higher up the mountain, should you survive.

Title: The Witchqueen
Objective: Slay High Crawliac, the Witchqueen.
Text: The time has come to assault High Crawliac, the Witchqueen. You should know that one does not become queen of the harpies through kindness. This creature has killed, betrayed, and tormented countless tauren, harpies, kobolds, and anything else she had to in order to secure her position as queen. Come, friend, let us finish this.

Title: Nursing the Wounds
Objective: Find Windmaster Julan and help extinguish the fires on Skyhorn.
Text: I know why Mayla sent you. But as you have seen, the drogbar are not the only threat to Highmountain. I will not send forces to support until we deal with the minions of High Crawliac. If you want to help, find my shaman. He was supposed to be dispersing these fires that are ravaging my village. He was last seen heading for his spirit lodge to the south just before these Cinderwitches descended on us.

Title: Trapped Tauren
Objective: Free the captured Rivermane tauren.
Text: The drogbar just rounded up those of us that they could and led them to a cave near here.If you act quickly, I think they can still be saved. I know not what purpose they have for capturing our people.I shudder to think of it... in the deep places, the darkness rules.

Title: Bring the Reinforcements
Objective: Talk to Fraggs and choose which reinforcements to bring to Tanaan.
Text: Hey there, Commander. You know, with all of the fighting concentrated here in Tanaan, we've got plenty of extra supplies just sitting around in our nearby outposts. You just give me the order and I'll make sure some of them get sent our way!

Title: Bring the Reinforcements
Objective: Talk to Angar Steelbellow and choose which reinforcements to bring to Tanaan.
Text: Greetings, Commander! With all of the fighting concentrated here in Tanaan, we've got the breathing room to divert some of our resources from nearby outposts to help make headway. Just let me know which reinforcements to call, and I'll get them here on the double!

Title: Empty Nest
Objective: Place the eagle eggs in the empty nest above the eastern entrance to Rockcrawler Chasm.
Text: I've taken an inventory of the eggs you recovered. Some among the bunch may still have a chance to hatch.They will need to be returned to an empty nest, and with any luck, an eagle will claim the eggs as her own and watch over them once again.There is a nest just outside the entrance, on a rocky ledge above the cave.Be careful. The eggs are very delicate.

Title: Black Marketeering
Objective: Speak with Zhang Yeoh in your garrison.
Text: Ya did us a real solid today. Boss Goya says you're big stuff in dese parts and we should keep an eye on --- uh, I mean we should be good buds. She's sent a repre... repre... del-e-g... um, a Black Market person to your garrison. Go say hi and stuff, and make sure to speak loudly when you plan what you're gonna do next.

Title: Ashran Dominance
Objective: Defeat the Alliance at all event locations in Ashran and kill Grand Marshal Tremblade.
Text: The Alliance refuse to back down in Ashran. Teach them that the Horde will not stand aside while they plunder the power of the ancient ogre empire to use for their own schemes.

Title: A Gruesome Task
Objective: Retrieve 5 Severed Heads from the Broken Shore.
Text: So here's the scoop. One of our agents has found an entrance to the portal world where Sargeras is keeping his personal felhound. We can't strike at him directly, but he's imbued a lot of power into this creature. That's the good news. The bad news, however, is outright gruesome. He's been feeding this monster on the brains of our allies, and that's all it will eat. As horrifying as it is, there's a fresh supply of corpses at the Broken Shore. Head down and get them.

Title: Ashran Dominance
Objective: Defeat the Horde at all event locations in Ashran and kill High Warlord Volrath.
Text: As we feared the Horde are trying to consolidate their position here on the island by looting it, just like we feared. Get out there and show them the Alliance won't put up with their aggression.

Title: Strange Tools
Objective: Speak with Yanas Seastrike at the dry docks.
Text: We are well on our way to building our first ship, but unfortunately, I am not the orc for the job. I have no idea how to work with these human tools. Your shipwright, Yanas Seastrike, is going to take over from here on out. I will be here at the dry docks if you need anything from me.

Title: The Missing Manifest
Objective: Find Mr. Knuckles' missing shipment.
Text: The water-proofed manifest contains some form of code for the most part, hiding the contents of the actual manifest. In the corner is a hastily scrawled note for a Mr. Knuckles. "Shipment attacked, got away but boat is sinking. Get here before they do." There are coordinates after that which lead to the sunken boat. Mr. Knuckles is definitely the kind of person you want owing you a favor, not the other way around.

Title: Poisoned Crops
Objective: Destroy the drogbar Poison Idols.
Text: After driving us from the farmland and infesting our crops with insects, the drogbar placed wicked totems that further poison our harvest.I can only hope that if you destroy them, we'll be able to heal the land using Jale's water magic.Thank you for coming to help us. We are but simple farmers and fishermen, and have little prowess in combat.

Title: Spray and Prey
Objective: Use the Bug Sprayer on drogbar in Whitewater Wash.
Text: The Bug Sprayer you recovered from Ormgul the Pestilent seems like it could give us an advantage against the drogbar and their insects.Spray the Drogbar with their own alchemy and watch their insects turn against them.

Title: Call of the Illidari
Objective: Speak to Kayn Sunfury at Krasus' Landing.
Text: , Kayn requests that you meet him at Krasus' Landing at once.  You must hurry. The Legion has eyes everywhere.

Title: The Black Gate
Objective: Defeat Archimonde in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: We've heard rumors that one o' the strongest eredar might enter this world through the Black Gate soon.If these rumors are to be believed, it could even be Archimonde the Defiler. If he arrives unchallenged, Draenor itself is likely to fall.

Title: The Felborne Breach
Objective: Defeat Xhul'horac in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: Summoned by Gul'dan from the depths o' the Twisting Nether, Xhul'horac is one o' the most powerful o' the Void Revenants--a race of parasitic void-beings that tear holes through the planes o' reality, consuming and absorbing the energies and beings within.Gul'dan has twisted Xhul'horac, feeding him overwhelming fel energy, and using his powers to tear open the portals through which he plans to rally the forces o' the Burning Legion.

Title: Maw of Souls
Objective: Defeat Gorefiend in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: Falling into the heart o' the mausoleum in Auchindoun, Teron'gor gorged upon hundreds o' draenei souls, becoming a bloated abomination in the process.No longer recognizable as an orc, Teron'gor gave up his old name and has taken on the mantle of Gorefiend.

Title: Grommash's Torment
Objective: Defeat Fel Lord Zakuun in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: We believe Grommash has not yet accepted Gul'dan's offer, and may even have avoided drinking the blood offered him.But Gul'dan has set Fel Lord Zakuun on Grommash. This demon is Gul'dans best-known torturer.I fear for Grommash. If he is turned, I fear for us all.

Title: Give Me Sight Beyond Sight
Objective: Speak with Jace Darkweaver and then use your Spectral Sight ability to scan the cave for hidden demons.
Text: Jace Darkweaver swears that for a split second he sensed a demonic presence up and behind us. He took some of our forces up to the cave just to the southeast to investigate.They found nothing in the cave, but he is certain that something is amiss.Would you lend him your guidance, and more importantly, your spectral sight?

Title: Destructor's Rise
Objective: Defeat Mannoroth in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: We believed we were done with Mannoroth, at least for a time. But Gul'dan is more powerful than we thought.Mannoroth is nearly back in this world. His bones have been seen within the citadel, and he must be destroyed before he can reach his full power.

Title: Amphitheater of the Eternal
Objective: Defeat the Soulbound Construct in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: The Exarch betrayer, Socrethar, was defeated with the assistance of Lady Liadrin and Exarch Maladaar.But, he has returned. His vile spirit is now within the Soulbound Construct in Hellfire Citadel, and must be destroyed once again.

Title: Temple of Tyranny
Objective: Defeat Tyrant Velhari in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: Tyrant Velhari was once a promising vindicator, but has turned to Shadow for reasons known only to her.Purge this Eredar of darkness.

Title: Iskar's Clutch
Objective: Defeat Shadow-Lord Iskar in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: I'm afraid I have bad news about someone ye once trusted. The arakkoa Iskar has gone too far in his desire to regain flight, and has joined with Gul'dan to regain his highborn body.With it came the price of fel corruption and being doomed to fall at yer hands.

Title: Naval Domination
Objective: Collect 2500 garrison resources, 2500 gold and complete 25 naval treasure missions.
Text: Our naval domination continues! However, we are going to need even more experience and resources to take this shipyard to the next level. Once we reach our goals, we can upgrade the capacity of the shipyard to hold even more ships!

Title: Pits of Mannoroth
Objective: Defeat Kormrok in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: In the Hellfire Citadel, they're corruptin' a magnaron with fel energy in the Pits o' Mannoroth.If ye delve into the fel pools of that place, be on yer guard.

Title: Hellfire Assault
Objective: Defeat the Hellfire Assault in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: If ye want to breach the walls o' the citadel, ye must first face siege equipment and forces led by Siegemaster Mar'tak.Good luck gainin' entry to Hellfire Citadel with yer limbs intact.

Title: The Iron Bulwark
Objective: Defeat the Iron Reaver in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: The Siegemaster in Hellfire Citadel has been working on a special machine she calls the Iron Reaver.With any luck, she hasn't yet completed its construction, but ye know what happens when we rely on luck...

Title: The Hunt
Objective: Obtain the Twinblades of the Deceiver from Varedis Felsoul in Suramar.
Text: This hunt is yours to lead,  - a select few Illidari will join you to make sure Varedis meets his end. The rest of us must stay behind; a small team will have the best chance of making it to his hold undetected. We will meet you at Krasus' Landing to see you off when you are ready.

Title: Deadeye's Vision
Objective: Defeat Kilrogg Deadeye in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: Kilrogg Deadeye has led his clan down a dark path that he cannot return from.Demon blood coursing through his veins, he awaits the moment of his death at yer hands in Hellfire Citadel.

Title: Naval Commander
Objective: Find Rolash Wavechaser at your shipyard and complete a Naval Mission.
Text: You're a natural at this. You've got the salt in your veins. Now it's time to run our first naval mission and control the seas of Draenor! You will want a high vantage point to plan out these seafaring missions. I know a good spot just up the path behind us. Meet me near the shipyard entrance and we can get started on our first mission.

Title: Upgrading The Fleet
Objective: Collect 1000 garrison resources, 1000 gold and combat 15 naval missions.
Text: You have been doing a great job out there commander. However, we are going to need more experience and resources to upgrade this shipyard. Once we reach our goals, we can upgrade the capacity of the shipyard to hold more ships!

Title: Ship Shape
Objective: Speak with Solog to begin construction on a transport ship. Once complete, add it to your collection of ships.
Text: You want to take the fight to Gul'dan? You need a transport! Speak to me when you are ready to begin construction.

Title: Don't Hate, Excavate!
Objective: Belloc Brightblade in Ashran wants you to investigate the deepest part of the Ashran Excavation, The Breach.
Text: At last , you've arrived and not a moment too soon. Quick, go down into the mine and take a look at what we've discovered. You may run into some Alliance down there. It is a minor inconvenience that is easily remedied.

Title: Let's Get To Work
Objective: Meet Solog at the dry docks.
Text: Now that the shipyard is complete, we need to get busy making ships! Solog ran off to the dry docks, why don't you meet him down there? He said he had a plan.

Title: Shipbuilding
Objective: Learn the blueprints and destroy the evidence.
Text: The first thing we need to start building ships is a blueprint. With your help, I grabbed some of the best ones from the Iron Docks before we broke out of there. Let's make sure these don't fall back into the hands of the Iron Horde. Memorize these blueprints, and then destroy the evidence. Let me know when you are done.

Title: Peak Urgency
Objective: Speak to Mathias Shaw in the sewers beneath Dalaran.
Text: BYou've been summoned by Master Mathias Shaw of SI:7. He's waiting for you in the depths beneath Dalaran. Be wary - there have been reports of disappearances in those sewers.

Title: Destructor's Rise
Objective: Defeat Mannoroth in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: We believed we were done with Mannoroth, at least for a time. But Gul'dan is more powerful than we had predicted.Mannoroth is nearly back in this world. His bones have been seen within the citadel, and he must be destroyed before he can reach his full power.

Title: The Black Gate
Objective: Defeat Archimonde in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: We have heard rumors that one of the strongest of the eredar could soon enter this world through the Black Gate.If these rumors are to be believed, it could even be Archimonde the Defiler. Should he arrive uncontested, Draenor itself is likely to fall.

Title: The Felborne Breach
Objective: Defeat Xhul'horac in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: Summoned by Gul'dan from the depths of the Twisting Nether, Xhul'horac is one of most powerful of the Void Revenants--a race of parasitic void-beings that tear holes through the planes of reality, consuming and absorbing the energies and beings within.Gul'dan has twisted Xhul'horac, feeding him overwhelming fel energy, and using his powers to tear open the portals through which he plans to rally the forces of the Burning Legion.

Title: Grommash's Torment
Objective: Defeat Fel Lord Zakuun in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: We believe Grommash has not yet accepted Gul'dan's offer, and may even have avoided drinking the blood offered to him.But Gul'dan has set Fel Lord Zakuun on Grommash. This demon is Gul'dan's best-known torturer.I fear for Grommash. If he is turned, I fear for us all.

Title: Temple of Tyranny
Objective: Defeat Tyrant Velhari in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: Tyrant Velhari was once a promising vindicator, but has turned to Shadow for reasons known only to her.Purge this Eredar of darkness.

Title: Maw of Souls
Objective: Defeat Gorefiend in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: Falling into the heart of the mausoleum in Auchindoun, Teron'gor gorged upon hundreds of draenei souls, becoming a bloated abomination in the process.No longer recognizable as an orc, Teron'gor gave up his old name and has taken on the mantle of Gorefiend.

Title: Amphitheater of the Eternal
Objective: Defeat the Soulbound Construct in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: The Exarch betrayer, Socrethar, was defeated with the assistance of Lady Liadrin and Exarch Maladaar.But, he has returned. His vile spirit is now within the Soulbound Construct in Hellfire Citadel, and must be destroyed once again.

Title: Iskar's Clutch
Objective: Defeat Shadow-Lord Iskar in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: I'm afraid I have bad news about someone we once trusted. The arakkoa known as Iskar has gone too far in his desire to regain flight, and has joined with Gul'dan to regain his highborn body.With it came the price of fel corruption and being doomed to fall at your hands.

Title: Pits of Mannoroth
Objective: Defeat Kormrok in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: In the Hellfire Citadel, they work to corrupt a magnaron with fel energy within the Pits of Mannoroth.If you delve into the fel pools of that place, be on your guard.

Title: Deadeye's Vision
Objective: Defeat Kilrogg Deadeye in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: Kilrogg Deadeye has led his clan down a dark path that he cannot return from.Demon blood coursing through his veins, he awaits the moment of his death--or yours--in Hellfire Citadel.

Title: Don't Hate, Excavate!
Objective: Harrison Jones in Ashran wants you to investigate the deepest part of the Ashran Excavation, The Breach.
Text: Well , the good news is that our excavation team breached a chamber below right outside some sort of vault. The bad news is that the Horde were there too. Go down there and take a look.

Title: The Iron Bulwark
Objective: Defeat the Iron Reaver in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: The Siegemaster within Hellfire Citadel has been working on a special machine she calls the Iron Reaver.With any luck, she has not yet completed its construction, but you know what happens when we rely on luck...

Title: Court of Blood
Objective: Defeat the Hellfire High Council in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: A council of orc clans has assembled and must be adjourned... permanently.Gurtogg Bloodboil of the Bleeding Hollow, Jubei'thos of the Burning Blade, and Dia Darkwhisper of the Shadowmoon clan can all be found within the accursed walls of Hellfire Citadel.

Title: The Eye of Odyn
Objective: Go to the Eye of Odyn.
Text: It is time to begin the war in Azeroth. We have prepared a tool for you to direct your warriors and your own operations from here. It is called the Eye of Odyn.If you will follow me, I will take you to it, and someone that will help you use it.

Title: Sholazar Basin
Objective: Talk to Archmage Pentarus when you're ready to leave for Sholazar Basin. When you arrive, speak with Monte Muzzleshot in the Wildgrowth Mangal of Sholazar Basin.
Text: Hemet Nesingwary was last heard from leading an expedition into the jungle depths of Sholazar Basin. His expedition has not been heard from since. Monte Muzzleshot is a pilot who was dispatched to provide them supplies, but he hasn't returned, either. Archmage Pentarus in Dalaran is standing by with a flying machine to take you to the last known location of Monte Muzzleshot.

Title: The Magical Kingdom of Dalaran
Objective: Report to Archmage Celindra at The Violet Gate in Dalaran.
Text: The Kirin Tor have moved their city here to Northrend. No longer does Dalaran sit under its protective dome on the shores of Lordamere Lake. Now the city magically floats above the Crystalsong Forest. They believe you to be ready for your journey to the city. Look for the teleportation crystal in Crystal Song Forest. When you arrive, seek out Archmage Celindra.

Title: Zul'Drak
Objective: Report to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.
Text: Our death knight allies in Zul'Drak are in need of heroes to aid them in securing the troll lands from the Scourge. Those willing to aid should travel to the southwestern camp of Ebon Watch and speak with Stefan Vadu there.

Title: Sholazar Basin
Objective: Speak with Monte Muzzleshot in the Wildgrowth Mangal of Sholazar Basin.
Text: Hemet Nesingwary was last heard from leading an expedition into the jungle depths of Sholazar Basin. His expedition has not been heard from since. Monte Muzzleshot is a pilot who was dispatched to provide them supplies, but he hasn't returned, either. Volunteers are needed to mount an expedition to find the missing expedition. Monte's flying machine was last seen in the Wildgrowth Mangal south of the Suntouched Pillar in Sholazar Basin.

Title: Warchief's Command: Netherstorm!
Objective: Report to Rocket-Chief Fuselage at Area 52.
Text: The goblins of Area 52 in Netherstorm have called for assistance from any able bodied champions willing to provide them the support they need in their endevours. The Warchief feels their position and aid in the region will provide a tactical advantage against the nearby forces of Kael'thas. Area 52 can be reached by following the northeastern road of Blade's Edge Mountains until you see the world crumbling away into the Twisting Nether.

Title: Hero's Call: Grizzly Hills!
Objective: Report to Lieutenant Dumont at Amberpine Lodge in western Grizzly Hills.
Text: While we focus to hold our ground at Wintergarde and deal with the unfolding events of the Wrathgate, battalions from as far away as Westfall battle their way through the dense foliage and inhospitable denizens of Grizzly Hills. All in hopes of finding an alternate route into Icecrown. Lieutenant Dumont, stationed at Amberpine Lodge, has enlisted the aid of able bodied citizens willing to risk life and limb in the uncharted wilds. Will you rise to meet this challenge?

Title: Warchief's Command: Grizzly Hills!
Objective: Present yourself to Conqueror Krenna at Conquest Hold in the Grizzly Hills.
Text: We've received a request for help from our base in the Grizzly Hills. Go to see Conqueror Krenna. She's attempting to secure all of the natural resources. Just watch your back around her. The word is that she's aggressive even for an orc. You can reach her by traveling east from Dragonblight.

Title: Hero's Call: Dragonblight!
Objective: Speak with the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest.
Text: Volunteers are needed to aid the Silver Covenant forces in the Dragonblight as they attempt to counter the chaotic arcane energies that threaten to rip the land apart. Those skilled in fighting dragons and undead are greatly welcome. Those willing to answer the call should report to Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

Title: Hero's Call: Netherstorm!
Objective: Report to Rocket-Chief Fuselage at Area 52.
Text: The goblins of Area 52 in Netherstorm have called for assistance from any able bodied champions willing to provide them the support they need in their endevours. The King feels their position and aid in the region will provide a tactical advantage against the nearby forces of Kael'thas. Area 52 can be reached by following the northeastern road of Blade's Edge Mountains until you see the world crumbling away into the Twisting Nether.

Title: Warchief's Command: Dragonblight!
Objective: Speak with the Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer.
Text: The Warchief wishes to reinforce the Horde's presence at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight. The fortress is a vital staging point for our assault on Icecrown and pivotal to containing the chaotic magic energies being released throughout the land. Report to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver.

Title: Hero's Call: Nagrand!
Objective: Speak with Warden Moi'bff Jill at Telaar in Nagrand on Outland.
Text: The King has requested you represent him with the Kurenai settlement of Telaar in Nagrand. Seek out Warden Moi'bff Jill upon arrival.

Title: Lynore's Fury
Objective: Speak with Lynore.
Text: It appears Eira has a present for you, your first valarjar! You lead 'em, I'll make sure their weapons and armor are ready for war!

Title: Warchief's Command: Blade's Edge Mountains!
Objective: Travel to Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains and speak with Gor'drek.
Text: The Warchief is calling for champions to put an end to the ogre threat in Blade's Edge Mountains. Make your way north into the mountains, to the orcish stronghold of Thunderlord Stronghold and let Gor'drek know of our plight. Any help he can spare would be most welcome.

Title: Hero's Call: Blade's Edge Mountains!
Objective: Speak with Rina Moonspring at Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Text: The Alliance forces of Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains require reinforcements. The King has asked for any able bodied members of the Alliance to journey to the mountains along the northern border of Zangarmarsh.

Title: Gems of the Apexis
Objective: Find Sun-Sage Chakkis in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: Commander! I've noticed you have been keeping up with your jewelcrafting, despite all of this war going on. I find that to be most admirable. I overheard some of the arakkoa discussing a gemcutting device that they believe is located within Tanaan Jungle. They got their information from one named "Chakkis." Just thought you might be interested.

Title: Warchief's Command: Nagrand!
Objective: Speak with Captain Kroghan at Garadar in Nagrand.
Text: The Warchief has asked for any able bodied champions of the Horde to ride to the aid of Garadar. The home of the Mag'har, lies to the south, in Nagrand. Take the southern road out of the marsh, then turn east at the first fork and look for a large settlement on the lake. Report to Captain Kroghan there and offer him what assistance you can. Garadar must not fall!

Title: Hellfire Assault
Objective: Defeat the Hellfire Assault in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: If you are to breach the walls of the citadel, you must first face siege equipment and forces led by Siegemaster Mar'tak.I wish you luck in gaining entry to Hellfire Citadel with your limbs intact.

Title: Warchief's Command: Nagrand!
Objective: Speak with one of the druids at the Cenarion Thicket in Terokkar Forest.
Text: We have lost contact with the druids of the Cenarion Thicket The Warchief has commanded any able bodies of the Horde to venture into Terokkar Forest and discover what has happened. The thicket can be found by heading northwest through Terokkar Forest from Zangarmarsh.

Title: Hero's Call: Terokkar Forest!
Objective: Speak with one of the druids at the Cenarion Thicket in Terokkar Forest.
Text: We have lost contact with the druids of the Cenarion Thicket The King has commanded any able bodies of the Alliance to venture into Terokkar Forest and discover what has happened. The thicket can be found by heading northwest through Terokkar Forest from Zangarmarsh.

Title: The Forge of Odyn
Objective: Use the Forge of Odyn.
Text: This Forge has been working for longer than your race has existed; we might know a few things. Your weapon is powerful, it will take my personal forge in order to work it.We can work the artifact to provide various improvements, provided you have enough experience with it. Let's give it a try shall we?

Title: Legacy of the Icebreaker
Objective: Deal with Magnar Icebreaker.
Text: The greatest warrior should wield the greatest weapons. Long ago a great king, Magnar Icebreaker, wielded weapons crafted from a scale of the mightiest dragon in the land. He should be here, but he is not. Instead he languishes in his tomb.His son, Hruthnir, is here. He will lead you to the tomb. If Magnar can be saved, do so. Either way, return with his weapons.

Title: Warchief's Command: Terokkar Forest!
Objective: Speak with one of the druids at the Cenarion Thicket in Terokkar Forest.
Text: We have lost contact with the druids of the Cenarion Thicket The Warchief has commanded any able bodies of the Horde to venture into Terokkar Forest and discover what has happened. The thicket can be found by heading northwest through Terokkar Forest from Zangarmarsh.

Title: Warchief's Command: Zangarmarsh!
Objective: Speak to Ysiel Windsinger at the Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.
Text: The Cenarion Circle's main expeditionary force in Outland is known as the Cenarion Expedition. Though it began as a small venture controlled directly by the Cenarion Circle, it's become a large and fairly autonomous body. The expedition's leader, Ysiel Windsinger, has asked us to direct volunteers to her outpost. Report to her at the Cenarion Refuge in eastern Zangarmarsh. Take the main path to the west and it will lead you directly there.

Title: Hero's Call: Zangarmarsh!
Objective: Speak to Ysiel Windsinger at the Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.
Text: The Cenarion Circle's main expeditionary force in Outland is known as the Cenarion Expedition. Though it began as a small venture controlled directly by the Cenarion Circle, it's become a large and fairly autonomous body. The expedition's leader, Ysiel Windsinger, has asked us to direct volunteers to her outpost. Report to her at the Cenarion Refuge in eastern Zangarmarsh. Take the main path to the west and it will lead you directly there.

Title: Mastery Of Taladite
Objective: Find the Apexis Gemcutting Construct.
Text: You - you are a gemcutter, no? You have the look of it in the twitch of your knuckles, in the focus of your eyes. I've been looking for something specific out here in Tanaan. We did not find it in our excavations in Arak... but the Apexis did not only dwell in Arak. What I am looking for is a storied Apexis construct that specialized in cutting gems. Be on the lookout, jewelcrafter. Such a marvel could benefit the both of us.

Title: Ruined Construct
Objective: Repair the Apexis Gemcutter Construct by inserting 1000 Apexis Crystals.

Title: Moose on the Loose
Objective: Collect the antlers of the cursed ancient spirit, Morashu.
Text: There's been chatter around the hunters' lodge about a crazed moose that is terrorizing the basin.I've never laid eyes on the beast myself, but they say its antlers are illuminated with magic.Where other lesser hunters have tried and failed, you will prevail, and collect me a one-of-a-kind trophy!

Title: Bloodstone Bandit
Objective: Recover Kira's Bloodstone from Narashi Spitescale.
Text: Something of personal value has been taken from me, and my work here cannot continue until I get it back.To most it would appear to be an ordinary stone, but it is so much more than a simple rock - it lives and breathes!The nearby naga have been snatching anything with any sort of magical significance, my stone included. Fortunately, they do not know how to access its power.Return my stone to me, and I will consider your request for help.

Title: Gems of the Apexis
Objective: Find Sun-Sage Chakkis in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: Listen, boss. I know you're a jewelcrafter. It's OK, I totally understand - I like money, too! I heard some of them bird fellas talking about some new gem-cuttin' device they got up in Tanaan. I'd be interested in checkin' it out myself, but I've got this whole shipyard mess to deal with right now.

Title: Forging the Artifact
Objective: Use Valgar's anvil to imbue your artifact with a new power.
Text: We've certainly got our work cut out for us, but not to worry. There's nae weapon in existence that ye can't improve, legendary ones included! This anvil's only powerful enough to imbue your artifact once before we'll need something better, but that'll have to do fer now.

Title: To Skold-Ashil
Objective: Meet with the dark rangers in Ranger's Foothold, outside of Skold-Ashil.
Text: Thanks to your initiative, the situation at Dreadwake's Landing is under control. We have no time to rest on our laurels, however - Sylvanas's mission must still be carried out.The dark rangers are heading up operations in Skold-Ashil from the tower overlooking the river junction. Seek them out there, and see if you can aid in completing this task.

Title: Becoming the Ascendant
Objective: Seek the blessings at the four shrines in the temple at Skold-Ashil, then commune with the statue.
Text: It would seem that the engravings depict a rite of ascension, which allows the shieldmaidens to enter the vault. I believe we can use this to our advantage.You must become the next ascendant.Go to the temple and perform the rites. Should you need to wade through the corpses of the shieldmaidens to do so, then so be it.Find me when you have completed this task, and we will take the vault for the Horde!

Title: Dreadwake's Dilemma
Objective: Kill 10 Greywatch Saboteurs or Infiltrators in Greymane's Offensive.
Text: The situation has taken a dire turn. We were unprepared for Greymane's sudden assault, with only a token force left behind at Dreadwake's Landing, and we are paying the toll.The beach is now swarming with worgen infiltrators, and if the cannons breach our defenses, they will likely swarm in on us. We're spread too thin here to take the fight to them, but you could change that.Wipe them out.

Title: A Village in Peril
Objective: Speak to Mayor Heathrow at Bradensbrook.
Text: Another outsider? Some bloke named Jarod just went off to our village down the road claiming he might be able to help us with our problem. If you're here to help as well, then you best speak to the Mayor. Just know this is a bad time, and he's got an itchy trigger finger.

Title: Testing a Theory
Objective: Use the Bloodstone on an Imprisoned Imp.
Text: Now that the Bloodstone has fed, I hope to use its power to bend the will of demons that would otherwise not be so easily controlled.Of course, this is all theory. I have never witnessed the direct effect of the Bloodstone's power on a demon. This is where you come in.I have procured a few imps that should make suitable test subjects. Use the Bloodstone on them and report back to me with your findings.

Title: A Sundered Tribe
Objective: Speak with the Rivermane, Bloodtotem, and Skyhorn chieftains.
Text: Dargrul didn't just take the Hammer of Khaz'goroth. He slew the High Chieftain -- my father -- to get it. There are some who claim our tribe died with my father, and they have gone their separate ways. But you... you look like someone they might listen to. You might convince them to return or at least send reinforcements. Can you speak with the representatives of the three tribes?

Title: March Forth and Conquer
Objective: Use the Command Map to send your followers on three missions to Azsuna.
Text: You should make sure that we do not lose momentum, Highlord. There is still much to be done in Azsuna. We have a map of the island set up near the front of the sanctum. Meet me there and you can delegate your forces to handle important tasks in the area.

Title: Unused
Objective: Defeat Kiranys Duskwhisper at the haunted manor in Bradensbrook.
Text: You've charged up the gun. Now it's time to use it. Go and confront the ghostly wizard Kiranys Duskwhisper, and drive him out of Bradensbrook.

Title: No Time to Talk
Objective: Destroy 8 Enraged Ambershard.
Text: Dargrul has sent his pets to do battle with us. We need to crush these elementals before their rage swarms into Thunder Totem.

Title: Beyond the Wall
Objective: Speak with Taran Zhu at the Longying Outpost in Townlong Steppes.
Text: We received word the Shado-Pan have begun a counter attack in to Townlong Steppes. It sounds like they are going after the root of the yaungol invasion. The pandaren have not traveled in force in to Townlong for thousands of years. The Shado-Pan are strong and brave, but they are also proud and few. They will need help from heroes like yourself. Can you travel through the Gate of Winter's Blossom in the northwest? Find the Shado-Pan leaders and lend your help and experience?

Title: Ill Tempered
Objective: Take the Shark Brainwashing Plans to your garrison shipwright.

Title: Possessions of Power
Objective: Seek those who may offer insight into the origins of the shard.
Text: Echoes of a thousand worlds swirl in the palm of your hand. Its true value lies in the eye of the beholder.

Title: Wrathshard
Objective: Slay Wrathshard.
