Text: The Underking has used the Hammer of Khaz'goroth to render the mountainside into a weapon against us. The hammer is a tool for creation, not a weapon for his amusement! Even now, his crystal servant, Wrathshard, is driving these elementals out of the mountain down upon my people. We must hold the bridge against this onslaught. Enter the cave, find Wrathshard, and send him back to his master in pieces.

Title: The New Chieftain
Objective: Find Mayla Highmountain.
Text: So you are the one of whom Ebonhorn foretold. I thought you would be taller. Our High Chieftain Ulan has been slain by the drogbar when they seized the hammer. His daughter, Mayla Highmountain, has now taken on the burden of High Chieftain. You can find her on the northern bluff with what few forces we have left to defend this place. She will have need of you.

Title: Moose Shootin'
Objective: Hunt Pinerock Elderhorn in Pinerock Basin.
Text: Highmountain is home to wildlife that can't be hunted anywhere else in the world. Tell me, have you ever laid eyes on a moose before?The roaming Elderhorn may look like gentle giants, but only a fool would underestimate their strength.They should prove to be a good challenge, even for someone as experienced as you.

Title: Demon Destroyer
Objective: Slay Doomcaller, Sneermaw, and Grinchain
Text: The demons spreading this corruption must be dealt with. Kill their generals and their plans will unravel.I have a gift for you. This horn was given to me by Odyn himself, use it to strike down all that stand in your way.The gods will surely smile upon you if you thwart the advances of Legion.

Title: Lion Stalkin'
Objective: Hunt Pinerock Stalkers and Prowlers in Pinerock Basin.
Text: The hills are crawlin' with lions that stalk their prey from afar. These big cats will pounce at anything that catches their eye, including |5.While most would fall to such a formidable predator, anyone in my huntin' party would be able to best those beasts.Prove you've got what it takes by taking down a few of those stalkers.

Title: Cleansing the Fountain
Objective: Cleanse the demon blood from the fountain.
Text: The blood from an impaled dreadlord is flowing into a fountain at the base of Valhallas. Following orders given by their "God-King" the vrykul are drinking from the fountain.The demon blood is driving the vrykul mad and it's giving them greater power than they deserve.Take this acorn. Throw it into the fountain. My ravens will take care of the rest.

Title: Ending the New Beginning
Objective: Confront Sylvanas in the Vault of Eyir.
Text: The Banshee Queen is here! I'd recognize those tainted arrows anywhere.This is the moment we have been fighting for. Sylvanas will answer for her crimes against Varian Wrynn and the Alliance!To arms!

Title: Shriek No More
Objective: Find Rotbeak along the Bradensbrook, and collect the beast's head.
Text: Papa loved this village. He'd never hear of leaving, even in these dread times. Before he died, he told me what attacked him: a monstrous falcon we call Rotbeak. You're fighting these undead, aren't you? Will you avenge my father? If so, you can find the beast northwest of here, patrolling our western route to the sea.

Title: An Even Bigga Score
Objective: Obtain Dingy Iron Coins for Griftah.
Text: So these mooks in Tanaan, they be carryin' all manner of valuable treasures. It still be complicated, but I can give ya a lot more now!

Title: Slay Them All!
Objective: Slay 200 enemy players.
Text: The Horde encroachment cannot be tolerated. Dwindle their numbers to the ground!

Title: Becoming the Ascendant
Objective: Seek the blessings at the four shrines in the temple at Skold-Ashil, then commune with the statue.
Text: Our course is now clear. We must enter the vault and prevent Sylvanas from obtaining the power to create more Val'kyr.The entrance is barred, which is likely what has kept her out so far, but you may have already uncovered the key to this barrier.You must become the next ascendant.Complete the rites as depicted on the shields and take down the barrier to the vault. I will send word to Greymane of our findings - he will wish to confront Sylvanas himself.

Title: Slay Them All!
Objective: Slay 200 enemy players.
Text: Find them, hunt them, kill them. Teach our enemies a lesson they'll never forget.

Title: Let's Get To Work
Objective: Meet Solog at the dry docks.
Text: Now that the shipyard is complete, we need to get busy making ships! Solog ran off to the dry docks, why don't you meet him down there? He said he had a plan.

Title: Naval Domination
Objective: Collect 2500 garrison resources, 2500 gold and complete 25 naval treasure missions.
Text: Our naval domination continues! However, we are going to need even more experience and resources to take this shipyard to the next level. Once we reach our goals, we can upgrade the capacity of the shipyard to hold even more ships!

Title: Whispers from the Dark
Objective: Collect the Forsaken Scouting Orders from Dread-Rider Stalkers and Dread-Rider Plaguebringers near Greywatch.
Text: We still have little knowledge of the Horde's activities in the region, but I'm hoping you can help change that.Lately the woods have been crawling with Sylvanas' agents. The few we have taken out carried orders from her Dark Rangers, who are no doubt in command of her forces here.While you're on the hunt, keep an eye out for any scouting orders. They may help us pinpoint Sylvanas' objective in the area.

Title: Upgrading The Fleet
Objective: Collect 1000 garrison resources, 1000 gold and complete 15 naval missions.
Text: You have been doing a great job out there commander. However, we are going to need more experience and resources to upgrade this shipyard. Once we reach our goals, we can upgrade the capacity of the shipyard to hold more ships!

Title: Shielded Secrets
Objective: Examine 6 Engraved Vrykul Shields in Skold-Ashil.
Text: It's obvious at this point that the Horde wants something in Skold-Ashil. Unfortunately we still don't know what they're after.We think the secret lies with the shieldmaidens here, so we need to find out more about them. Some early scouting revealed that they have a method of carving their shields to tell their stories.Go into the city and find as many of these shields as you can. With luck, we will find what Sylvanas seeks.

Title: To Skold-Ashil
Objective: Meet with Commander Lorna Crowley in Crowley's Overlook.
Text: We have her now! According to these reports, Sylvanas' forces are after something in Skold-Ashil - a vrykul town not far from here. We must make our way there and track her down.I had previously dispatched Commander Lorna Crowley and a detachment of Gilneas Brigade to scout the position. Meet up with her there and find out what Sylvanas is after.Meanwhile, I will muster the fleet to assault their outpost. We will have justice if I have to reduce their camp to rubble!

Title: Critters of Draenor
Objective: Defeat Erris the Collector in a pet battle.
Text: I love collecting pets, and I've picked up a few unusual pets here in Draenor. What would you say to a battle? If you can defeat my humble team, I think we'll both learn a few new tricks.

Title: Combustible Contagion
Objective: Burn the Forsaken Blight Caches near Greywatch.
Text: It is true that we may have a lead on Sylvanas. Though I want nothing more than to get my hands on the Banshee Queen, the situation here at Greywatch requires immediate attention.Yesterday, a regiment of guards returned with word of Forsaken forces in the woods. Several of them bore signs of a blight, similar to the one we endured in Gilneas. It would appear these Forsaken seek to unleash this blight upon Greywatch.Seek out their caches and destroy them, before the blight overtakes us!

Title: To Catch a Banshee
Objective: Meet with Genn Greymane in Greywatch.
Text: The strange-talking vrykul said I might be able to meet you here. I have orders from Greymane. It seems he may have a lead on Sylvanas' location.He's set up a camp near the base of the mountain. We've run into some troubles, though. It looks like the Horde may have homed in on our position.We could use your help. You can take my gryphon. Just speak to me when you're ready to leave.

Title: Command of the Seas
Objective: Upgrade to a Level 2 shipyard.
Text: Gul'dan wasted no time integrating his Shadow Council minions into every rank of the Iron Horde. The naval fleet that once owed loyalty only to Grommash is now his to command. If we want to fight back, we're going to need more than just a couple of transport ships. We must build an arsenal. We need your expertise, commander. Upgrade your dockyards and create a fleet capable of dominating the seas!

Title: Naval Commander
Objective: Find Merreck Vonder in your Shipyard and complete a Naval Mission.
Text: We have come a long way in a short time on this shipyard. Now it's time to run our first naval mission and control the seas of Draenor! I will need to setup shop from a high vantage point to plan out these seafaring missions. Meet me near the shipyard entrance and we can get started.

Title: Shipbuilding
Objective: Learn the blueprints and destroy the evidence.
Text: The first thing we need to start building ships is a blueprint. With your help, I grabbed some of the best ones from the Iron Docks before we broke out of there. Let's make sure these don't fall back into the hands of the Iron Horde. Memorize these blueprints, and then destroy the evidence. Let me know when you are done.

Title: Ship Shape
Objective: Speak with Yanas to begin construction on a transport ship. Once complete, add it to your collection of ships.
Text: Now that we have the blueprints, let's get started on our first ship, a transport! Speak to me when you are ready to begin construction.

Title: Blueprints Are Important
Objective: Take the blueprints to Crowler at your Garrison. He should be able to decode them.
Text: The first thing we need to start building ships is a blueprint. Lucky for you, I snatched some of the best ones from the Iron Docks before we broke out of there. There is a one problem though...These blueprints can get me in big trouble if the Iron Horde finds out. I need you to memorize them and then destroy the evidence. Let me know when you are done.

Title: By Any Means
Objective: Gain entrance to the Violet Hold and interrogate Taldath the Destroyer to find out the location of the traitor Varedis.
Text: We need to figure out what rock Varedis is hiding under - the only way we're going to do that is by getting inside this prison. Do what you must.

Title: Eye On the Prize
Objective: Kill Inquisitor Baleful and take his power.
Text: This demon has proved less than useful. I have been using the Scythe of Souls on it, but so far, it has resisted my inquiries. We will see how long that lasts.I have a different idea...There is a fresh inquisitor demon ahead. They are horrific fel casters who see through their floating eyes and specialize in dark pacts. If you steal its power, Jace Darkweaver could use some of it in his ritual to spy on the Legion.Better yet, you will gain its power by ripping it from its smoking corpse.

Title: Call of the Illidari
Objective: Speak to Altruis the Sufferer at Krasus' Landing.
Text: , Altruis requests that you meet him at Krasus' Landing at once.  You must hurry. The Legion has eyes everywhere.

Title: Meeting With the Queen
Objective: Complete the ritual to spy upon the Legion leaders.
Text: We can use some of that essence to complete my ritual. You'll be able to spy upon the Legion leaders and see what they're planning.Use the nether crucible and complete the ritual.

Title: Bitestone Enclave
Objective: Slay drogbar in the Bitestone Enclave.
Text: This is an old drogbar enclave that we used to trade with. Now it is a base of operations for their raids. I need more time to gather what is left of our warbraves. Go, enter the enclave, and slay any you find in there. Buy us the time we need to gather our strength.

Title: Emissary of War
Objective: Complete 4 dungeons on Mythic difficulty.
Text: When the sign of the emissary shines in the night sky, the stars strengthen existing bonds and forge new ones. Friendship is still not cheaply won, and deeds will prove loyalty, but trust comes more readily during these days. Venture deep into caverns and strongholds to prove your worth.

Title: The Arena Calls
Objective: Win 10 Arena Skirmish battles.
Text: This alignment of the stars is a dire sign, stirring bloodlust and calling warriors to battle to the death in close quarters. Arena masters turn a tidy profit during these days, likely not understanding why their stands are overflowing. Amidst the excitement, great rewards do await those brave, or foolhardy, enough to venture into the arena....

Title: A Call to Battle
Objective: Win 4 Battleground matches.
Text: The favorite star of warlords and generals dominates the sky, offering good fortune to tacticians everywhere. Some say that the battle star hones the instincts of commanders to the point of near-prophecy. If ever you were going to test yourself on the field of battle, now is the time.

Title: A Summons from Saylanna
Objective: Seek out Saylanna Riverbreeze in the Lunarwing Shallows.
Text: Sprites have always been mischievous creatures, but lately their mischief has turned to violence. One of the druids I call friend, Saylanna Riverbreeze, reports that they are assaulting the faerie dragon nesting grounds. The Lunarwing Shallows lie to the south. You will find Saylanna there.

Title: The Very Best
Objective: Defeat 5 players through Find Battle with a team of level 25 pets.
Text: This alignment of the stars is truly a strange one, causing the tiniest of creatures to gain unnatural aptitude. None of our sages can explain the phenomenon, but cunning tamers have much to gain, especially by testing their skills against those of their peers.

Title: Dargrul and the Hammer
Objective: Confront Dargrul the Underking.
Text: We are about to follow a drogbar into a cave, something we warn our children never to do. Even so, several of our warbraves have already followed Dargrul inside. Come, join us in battle and let us reclaim the Hammer of Khaz'goroth.

Title: The Time to Strike
Objective: Complete 5 Objectives in Apexis-yielding areas.
Text: This configuration of the stars causes an unusual vibration in the crystals strewn across Draenor, relics of the ancient Apexis. Some swear that the crystals will multiply when left unattended beneath the night sky, but none have seen the phenomenon firsthand. Regardless of the true cause, these crystals should be far more plentiful should you seek them out.

Title: REUSE ME
Objective: asdf
Text: asdf

Title: Grasp of the Underking
Objective: Rescue Jale Rivermane, Warbrave Oro, and Oakin Ironbull.
Text: If we have one good fortune in this it is that Dargrul has no knowledge of how to use the hammer. He keeps thinking of the hammer as a weapon instead of a tool of creation. Even so, he has imprisoned our tribesman in fists of stone summoned from the earth. Our weapons have proven useless against this magic. You might have power enough to break these fists. Can you help?

Title: The Drogbar
Objective: Slay 8 Drogbar in Riverbend.
Text: It wasn't enough for Dargrul to just destroy this village. He has also sent his Stoneraiders to take what is left. Please champion, prove to my people that you are the hero I foresaw. Slay enough of these Stoneraiders that it breaks their resolve.

Title: Call of the Archmage
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.
Text: Archmage Khadgar has devised the next course of action against the Shadow Council. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp. This will not take long.

Title: Call of the Archmage
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.
Text: Archmage Khadgar has devised the next course of action against the Shadow Council. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp. This will not take long.

Title: Call of the Archmage
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.
Text: Archmage Khadgar has devised the next course of action against the Shadow Council. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.

Title: Call of the Archmage
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.
Text: Archmage Khadgar has a very urgent favor to ask. He is gravely concerned about additional threats this world may hold for Azeroth, and he will need your assistance pursuing them. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.

Title: A Burning Path Through Time
Objective: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
Text: The blazing star shines upon the land, searing the earth and parching the landscape. This star is relentless, malevolent almost. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

Title: Call of the Archmage
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.
Text: Archmage Khadgar has devised the next course of action against the Shadow Council. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.

Title: Unused - The Fish Must Flow
Objective: Collect 6 Stolen Fish from the Black Rook Assassins and Black Rook Lieutenants in Bradensbrook.
Text: Our village is running low on food, and undead spies from Black Rook Hold have started targeting our fishers. It's a surgical move, hitting our people and our food supply all at once. Help us out and send those ghosts a message. Pare down their forces and bring back the food they've stolen.

Title: A Frozen Path Through Time
Objective: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
Text: The chill star shines upon the land with its cold light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, sapping warmth and life. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

Title: Rise to the Occasion
Objective: Speak with Highlord Darion Mograine within Acherus.
Text: The Lich King made a wise choice in giving you that weapon. You've proven your strength and cunning on countless occasions and it is time that you have a position fitting for your accomplishments.

Title: Black Rook Invasion
Objective: Kill 7 Black Rook Assassins in Bradensbrook.
Text: Once, this area was peaceful and prosperous. Then we saw the first bad omens: strange ailments, spoiled crops, and the like. Now ghosts attack us from that castle across the river, and undead assassins slay our fishers so as to cut off the village's food supply. We're the last family living this close to the castle, but we daren't retreat: this river is the best route for fishers to bring their hauls in to town. Please, will you take the fight to these undead?

Title: To Farahlon!
Objective: Use your shipyard to complete the "To Farahlon!" Naval Mission and retrieve the Pearl of Farahlon.
Text: , have you ever heard of Farahlon? Archmage Vargoth would never stop talking about it - beautiful fields and forests dotted with natural crystalline formations that make it the magical nexus of Draenor. It's nearly impossible to get to. The magical storms in the seas around it are frequent and unpredictable. For your ring, we'll need a magical artifact from Farahlon. You will need an absolutely top-notch crew to sail safely to the region and get back alive. Choose carefully and get me that artifact!

Title: Darkness Incarnate
Objective: Hunt down and engage Gul'dan within the Hellfire Citadel.
Text: We have one final task before us. We must defeat Gul'dan and unravel his plans for this world. I have no reward to offer you - I have given you everything I can. Come. When you and your allies are ready, we march on Hellfire Citadel... and end this.

Title: Ogres of the Deep
Objective: Use your shipyard to complete the "Ogres of the Deep" Naval Mission and retrieve the Soaked Ogre Decoder.
Text: It might surprise you to know that at its peak the Gorian ogre empire had a small but powerful navy. It probably wouldn't surprise you to learn that many of its largest warships sunk. They were built out of stone. I've found an old chart indicating the last-known position of "The Emperor's Foot," lost at sea with a valuable artifact I need. An ogre decoder. Right! To salvage it you'll need a submarine and a crack crew. This is an extremely dangerous mission which is why I'm giving it to you.

Title: Cooking the Books
Objective: Deliver Gul'dan's Library of Chaos to Cordana at Zangarra and ensure they are destroyed.
Text: , we've got to destroy these tomes. Many of them have actual tortured souls bound into the pages, so we can't just burn them. Cordana will know what to do. Take these books to my tower in Zangarra and give them to Cordana. Let me know when the deed is done.

Title: We Don't Need No Library Card
Objective: Collect 33 Tomes of Chaos from bosses in Hellfire Citadel.
Text: If history is any indication, Gul'dan is training a whole generation of warlocks to marshal against us. If we act fast, we can stem the tide and make things easier on ourselves. As you and your fellow heroes venture into the depths of the Hellfire Citadel, seek out Tomes of Chaos from Gul'dan's lieutenants. They're dangerous, so don't read any of them. Not even the pictures.  ESPECIALLY the pictures.

Title: Your Orders, General?
Objective: Speak with Yrel at Lion's Stand in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: Exarch Yrel has sent word from Lion's Watch in Tanaan Jungle that your forces stand ready for their new orders. For the Alliance!

Title: TRACKING Encounter Botanist
Objective: Defeat Botanist Darkgrove
Text: (PH)Darkgrove has run out of places to hide. Now it is time to finish him off. If we stop him now, there may be hope for this valley yet.

Title: The Call of Icecrown
Objective: Use your Death Gate ability to travel to Icecrown and obtain the Blades of the Fallen Prince.
Text: I have ordered your brethren to Icecrown to prepare for the coming conflict, but I have a more important fate in mind for you. You, will be the hand of our vengeance! Use the Death Gate to return to Acherus and I shall reveal your role in this.

Title: Your Orders, General?
Objective: Go to the Tanaan Planning Map in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: General, your forces in Tanaan Jungle await your orders. Travel to the Planning Map there to issue your commands. For the Horde!

Title: Proof of Loyalty
Objective: Slay 25 withered within Suramar.
Text: I see. You sound almost... sympathetic to the wretch. The nightfallen are liars and thieves. ALL of them. Lyndras included. I will not tolerate a student that has any respect or sympathy for those... things. And have you witnessed what they turn into at the depths of their depravity? If you want to get on my good side, do not return until you are covered in the blood of the withered.

Title: The Nightborne Connection
Objective: Speak with Leyweaver Tytallo in Suramar.
Text: Now that you're able to disguise yourself, you should go to Suramar City and try to find this guild of tailors. Good luck, and try not to get caught.

Title: Inspire Me!
Objective: Craft a Brown Linen Robe, a White Woolen Dress, a Simple Black Dress, a Frostwoven Robe, and a Spiritmend Robe while standing near Leyweaver Mithrogane.
Text: I am, and always will be, a student of robemaking and dressmaking. You can keep your gloves, belts, and cloaks. Nothing beats a good robe. I'll share my pattern for an imbued silkweave robe with you if you can teach me some of the robe and dress patterns you've learned along your tailoring journey.

Title: Master of Silkweave
Objective: Purchase a Shal'dorei Mannequin from Leyweaver Mithrogane, then craft an entire set of silkweave armor and place them on the mannequin.
Text: While Tytallo is busy exacting withered genocide, it falls on me to take care of the more mundane aspects of training. We're going to need to see how talented you are. Craft an entire set of silkweave armor for me. Leyweaver Mithrogane can provide you with a proper mannequin for displaying it.

Title: The Queen's Grace Loom
Objective: Use the Teleportation Crystal in the Leyweavers' Hall, then speak with Leyweaver Azayna.
Text: Great power comes only with sacrifice. Even the most masterful tailor can only do so much with silkweave. To improve your patterns any further, bargains must be made. You are prepared, to learn about working with Imbued Silkweave. Use the teleportation crystal behind me, and speak with Azayna, the leader of our order.

Title: Exotic Textiles
Objective: Obtain the Fel Inscribed Shroud.
Text: I'm risking my life and career to be here, tailor. I've been curious about demonic cloth, and my attempts to obtain some through approved means have been met with resistance. I simply must see this cloth for myself. I don't wish to disrupt Azayna's pact with the demons, but you - you can attack the demons without drawing attention to our guild. I'm particularly interested in a particular demon's set of robes. Bring me a scrap, and I'll teach you what I know.

Title: Halls of Valor: The Right Question
Objective: Defeat Hymdall in the Halls of Valor and recover his loincloth.
Text: One might ask what a leyweaver is doing standing over a dead vrykul's body. But such questions only stir up trouble. Instead let us ask what can be learned from those who have passed on. A question like that promotes progress. I assume you're here to learn from me, the pattern for Imbued Silkweave pants, yes? If that's true, then I'll need something from one who has passed on. In the Halls of Valor the great guardian, Hymdall resides. Bring me his loincloth and I will teach you my pattern.

Title: The Path to Suramar City
Objective: Assist the nightfallen of Suramar until you discover a way to move safely amongst the elves of Suramar City.
Text: I recall Lyndras mentioning a guild of tailors within Suramar City. Perhaps they could further our understanding of how to utilize this new cloth. Unfortunately from what I've heard, they've sided with the demons and anyone opposed to them is to be killed on sight. You must find a way to move safely within the confines of their city if we're to continue our research.

Title: Secret Silkweaving Methods
Objective: Craft some Masterwork Silkweave Bracers.
Text: Okay, done mourning! Let's look through his stuff.  Our friend has been keeping secrets from us. Look at this! Every single one of the recipes he's taught us can be improved. Let's start simple, with some bracers. I can supply most of the materials, but you'll have to talk to Alard Schmied in the blacksmithing shop to get this powdered brimstone.

Title: Where's Lyndras Now?
Objective: Go the alchemy shop across the street.
Text: Lyndras couldn't have gone very far. I mean, we're floating a thousand feet over the sea. I heard some commotion across the way this morning near the alchemy shop. I pray that wasn't Lyndras. Could you please go over there and make sure?

Title: Assault on Violet Hold: Into the Hold
Objective: Go into Violet Hold and find out what happened to Lyndras.
Text: With Lyndras being locked up in Violet Hold, you feel responsible for him and must discover the truth behind his actions. Perhaps if you were able to speak with him, you could find a way to have him released from the hold and put back into your custody. Go into Violet Hold and find out what happened to Lyndras.

Title: The Final Lesson?
Objective: Create a Handcrafted Silkweave Hood on Tanithria's Finishing Bench. You will need to gather the materials in her shop.
Text: Now that we have everything we need, let's work on the hood. After we're finished, we'll move onto the gloves.

Title: The Right Color
Objective: Obtain 10 Helsquid Ink.
Text: Your assistance, if you have a moment. I've been attempting to reproduce a pattern for footwear that I spotted a while back, but I'm having trouble getting the right color for my dye. Our black dye is too dark, our blue dye is too bright, and mixing the two doesn't look right. The color I'm looking for is more of a squid-ink blue. If, in your travels, you come across any dyes of this color, would you do me the favor of bringing some to me?

Title: Where's Lyndras?
Objective: Find Lyndras.
Text: That's strange. Lyndras was here one moment, and then he ran off the next. He had such a strange look on his face. Perhaps we should track him down.

Title: Lining Them Up
Objective: Gather 15 Bear Furs.
Text: Since you're heading to Azsuna, you may as well gather some lining for our projects. The bears of Azsuna are known for how soft, yet durable their fur is. Hunt them in the woods around Llothien and bring their fur back with you.

Title: Eye of Azshara: The Depraved Nightfallen
Objective: Go to the Eye of Azshara, defeat the Wrath of Azshara and recover the Heart of the Storm.
Text: In order to craft the gloves, we'll require a special item. This will be no easy task to recover it. The naga of Azsuna are said to be hard at work trying to summon a terrible creature into this world. The creature's heart holds immense energy that we can use to channel into the gloves, making them incredibly powerful. I need... I mean, we need that heart if we are to produce a suitable pair of gloves for someone of your presence.

Title: Left Behind
Objective: Gather Lyndras' Pinking Shears, his Box of Measuring Tools and his Threading Needles from where you first met him in Azsuna.
Text: I do truly want to help you work on your tailoring, but without my patterns or my supplies, there isn't much more I can do save for teaching you what little I remember. If my memory still serves true, you're just missing a good pattern for some gloves and a hood. The first thing I need you to do is grab a few things from where you first met me. Here's what I need...

Title: Where's Lyndras Again?
Objective: Find Lyndras in Dalaran.
Text: Oh dear. He had just promised you that he wouldn't wander off, and then he did it again! I'm starting to think that this Lyndras character might be a bit too impetuous for my tastes. Please, go find him, before he gets into any more trouble.

Title: Sew Far, Sew Good
Objective: Craft a Silkweave Bag. You will need to gather materials inside the Dalaran tailoring shop.
Text: Your tailoring skill really is impressive and, although I don't have my patterns with me, I do have some patterns memorized. One of those patterns is for a simple bag. Follow my lead.

Title: The Wayward Tailor
Objective: Speak to Lalla Brightweave in Dalaran, and ask her to summon Lyndras.
Text: Might I ask a favor? As I am recently without a home, shop, family, or friends, I was wondering if you might show me your floating city? I must admit, I am VERY curious about the place. I've also heard good things about their tailoring shop. I have no way of getting there myself, but certainly such a magical city has SOMEONE who can summon me.

Title: Taking Inspiration
Objective: Obtain 6 Runed Breeches.
Text: I wish I had more patterns to share, but my notebook was lost along with my shop. We'll need to come up with some patterns on our own. I've been thinking about the leather breeches that the Stormheim vrykul wear. They're certainly much thicker and heavier than anything we could sew, but their embellishing runework is quite impressive. If I had a few pairs, perhaps I could re-imagine this runework on a more... refined garment.

Title: So You Think You Can Sew
Objective: Craft a Rune-Threaded Silkweave Robe and a set of Rune-Threaded Silkweave Bracers at Lyndras' Finishing Table. You can find the patterns in your tailoring pattern list.
Text: Very good, I think we're ready to begin.  Let's prepare our materials and make the robe and bracers that you so rightfully deserve!

Title: Meticulous Precision
Objective: Bring the Spritethorns to Tiffany Cartier in Dalaran.
Text: The needles are sharp, but look at them closely. Some have a curve to them, others have a spur hanging off the side. Look at this one... it's got a ninety-degree crook in it! I have no desire to sew around a corner. Tiffany Cartier in the jewelcrafting shop has a good eye for this sort of thing. Bring these needles to her, and she'll straighten them out.

Title: A Needle Need
Objective: Obtain 150 Spritethorns.
Text: This shop has almost everything we need. Unfortunately, the quality of your sewing needles is lacking. I do know where you can get better needles. The sprites of Val'sharah are covered with spines which, fortuitously, are perfect for the type of sewing we need. I hate to be such a prickler stickler, but these needles really will make a difference.

Title: Advanced Needlework
Objective: Make an Embroidered Silkweave Robe on Tanithria's Finishing Bench. You will need to gather the materials in her shop.
Text: You've already learned the patterns for bracers, belts, epaulets, and of course, robes. Unfortunately, your technique was wasteful... you need a better method. That's where our needles come in. Here, I'll show you how to improve the process of these patterns.

Title: Hard Times
Objective: Obtain a Stained Silken Robe and a set of Hatecoil Wristwraps.
Text: When I worked at the tailoring guild in Suramar, I would usually work off of a pattern. Something that inspired me. Unfortunately, I've run into streak of bad luck, and I'm ashamed to say that I no longer have my patterns. The naga sorceresses in the lagoon to the west, however, have expertly-sewn wristwraps. And the nightfallen to the north wear robes that we can use... if you can pry one from their greedy clutches.

Title: Consult the Locals
Objective: Find a tailor in Azsuna.
Text: Whoever wove this fabric CAN'T have intended it only for belts and shoulderpads. There must be some way to sew thread into this material. Head on down to Azsuna and try to find a tailor. We need to sew if we're going to do any real tailoring.

Title: Runic Catgut
Objective: Obtain 3 pieces of Runic Catgut.
Text: Let me guess... thread troubles? Mm-hm. I suspected as much. My people weave sumptuous silks, but those silks can be fickle about the types of thread they'll accept. Shal'dorei silk has a bit of ley energy woven right into it. You need something that's learned to coexist with the ley energies of this land. I'm talking about owlcats, my good friend! They have what you need. You'll find them amongst the ruins of Llothien.

Title: This Should Be Simple... Right?
Objective: Craft a Handcrafted Silkweave Robe on Tanithria's Finishing Bench. You can find the pattern in your tailoring pattern list. You can find the materials for the pattern in her shop.
Text: I have plenty of silk patterns that we can put this cloth to work on. Help me to prepare the materials. We're going to put this cloth to good use and make you a new robe.

Title: Unbearable
Objective: Investigate the Shivering Ashmaw Cub in southern Val'sharah.
Text: Not far away, a bear cub looks to be in some distress. Perhaps you should investigate?

Title: Sew It Begins
Objective: Obtain 10 Shal'dorei Silk. You can find Shal'dorei Silk on humanoids within the Broken Isles, obtain some from a fellow adventurer, or you may visit the Auction House and buy some.
Text: Every time Dalaran takes us to a new shore, I get anxious over what types of fabric and cloth we might find below. Threads imbued with magic? Something demonically-tinged? Ugh, I hope it's not FURS again. You're an adventurer... and tailor to boot. Head on down there and see what you can scrounge up!

Title: His Name Was... Stormstout
Objective: Speak with Chen Stormstout at the Thunderfoot Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: The land is ripe with rumors of an unusual pandaren monk whose power was matched only for his appetite for brew. He was traveling with his young niece who's mouth seems to get them into a lot of trouble. The locals say these two were headed to the Valley of the Four Winds. You should meet him! Just... watch out for that right hook.

Title: The Road to Kun-Lai
Objective: Travel through the Veiled Stair to Binan Village.
Text: Lorewalker Cho has sent word that several of your companions survived the conflict in the Jade Forest and have been moved to Kun-Lai Summit to seek healing. They need your help if they are to survive! To reach Kun-Lai Summit, travel to the Valley of the Four Winds and look for the Highroad Grummle that can be found at the base of the Veiled Stair along the northeastern border. They can guide you the rest of the way.

Title: Logistical Matters
Objective: Speak to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker.
Text: I think we are ready to... reintroduce ourselves to the Legion on the Broken Isles. Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker has volunteered to help coordinate our forces on the ground. You should speak with him immediately, Highlord.

Title: Battle Hardened
Objective: Win 3 Rated Battleground matches.
Text: Defeat your opponents on the battlefield and you will be rewarded.

Title: Equipment Blueprint: Bilge Pump
Objective: Return the blueprints to a Naval Equipment Specialist at your garrison shipyard.
Text: This appears to be a blueprint for some sort of naval equipment. We should take it back to our Shipyard and see if someone can decipher it.

Title: Hero's Call: The Hinterlands!
Objective: Travel to Aerie Peak in The Hinterlands and speak with Gryphon Master Talonaxe.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Gryphon Master Talonaxe at the aviary in Aerie Peak. Our new brothers in the Alliance need your help to fend off the aggressive Horde offensive in their beloved homeland. Travel north from the Arathi Highlands, through the dwarven mountain pass and follow the road northwest to Aerie Peak. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Continue the Domination
Objective: Defeat the Horde at all event locations in Ashran and kill High Warlord Volrath.
Text: As we feared the Horde are trying to consolidate their position here on the island by looting it, just like we feared. Get out there and show them the Alliance won't put up with their aggression.

Title: Continue the Domination
Objective: Defeat the Alliance at the event locations in Ashran and kill Grand Marshal Tremblade.
Text: The Alliance refuse to back down in Ashran. Teach them that the Horde will not stand aside while they plunder the power of the ancient ogre empire to use for their own schemes.

Title: Unused - Wraith Zapper
Objective: Zap 7 Wraiths near the haunted manor on the hill in western Bradensbrook.
Text: I came here to exorcise the manor. Unfortunately it's haunted by a wizard, and he's summoned quite a few wraiths to bolster his power. I'm no match for them, but perhaps you are. My gun can harvest the wraiths' ectoplasmic energy. Then we can turn it against him. By my estimates, you'll need to zap 7 wraiths before the gun is fully charged. Here, take it.

Title: Battle Hardened
Objective: Win 3 Rated Battleground matches.
Text: Defeat your opponents on the battlefield and you will be rewarded.

Title: Silas' Secret Stash
Objective: Find Silas' Secret Stash.
Text: A great Darkmoon prize do you now seek, but be ye warned, it is not for the meek.Your very first clue to send you on this caper, you will find printed on the back of this paper.

Title: Littlefur
Objective: Speak to Littlefur at Smolderhide Thicket.
Text: Stranger, I beseech you! My once peaceful brethren are now cursed with insatiable wrath. My nephew and I tried to leave against the Chieftain's wishes. The clan wrested him from me, and would have torn me apart if I did not flee. He is trapped in the village, and I fear the worst. Great , please save him. I am too old and too weak to do it myself.

Title: Secrets of Highmountain
Objective: Speak with Spiritwalker Ebonhorn in Thunder totem.
Text: Now that you are familiar with our greatest hero, perhaps you are willing to assist me on a very dangerous endeavor. To this end I have sent word for one of your allies to join us. When you are ready, join us in my spirit lodge. It is up the elevators and across the southwestern most bridge.

Title: Ashran Dominance
Objective: Defeat the enemy faction at the event locations in Ashran and slay their leader within their base.
Text: As we feared the Horde are trying to consolidate their position here on the island by looting it, just like we feared. Get out there and show them the Alliance won't put up with their aggression.

Title: Battle of Snowblind Mesa
Objective: Journey to Snowblind Mesa.
Text: Your timing is fortunate. Our forces at Snowblind Mesa report seeing the Underking above ground. What is more, he is lightly guarded, and has the hammer with him. Thanks to your efforts, we can meet them in battle. Meet us at Snowblind Mesa and let us take the fight to Dargrul together.

Title: Ashran Dominance
Objective: Defeat the enemy faction at the event locations in Ashran and slay their leader within their base.
Text: The Alliance refuse to back down in Ashran. Teach them that the Horde will not stand aside while they plunder the power of the ancient ogre empire to use for their own schemes.

Title: Secrets of Highmountain
Objective: Meet Spiritwalker Ebonhorn at the southern bluff of Thunder Totem.
Text: Mayla's father, Ulan, was our last high chieftain. He was slain trying to stop the Underking from seizing the Hammer of Khaz'goroth. I have watched Mayla all her life and can tell you she has both the courage and the strength to wear the mantle of High Chieftain. She needs only our help to realize it herself. Will you meet us at the city entrance along the southern bluff? There is a ritual that might help, but we will need your aid to survive it.

Title: The Skyhorn Tribe
Objective: Meet Lasan Skyhorn at Skyhorn.
Text: The Skyhorn people are some of the greatest pathfinders and hunters this world has ever known. They are a proud people, but should be willing to listen to reason. If the roads feel unsafe, you may ask any flight master in Highmountain to fly you there. Please, go to their leader Lasan and remind him that only together, we are Highmountain.

Title: The Bloodtotem Tribe
Objective: Meet Oakin Ironbull at Cliff's Edge.
Text: The Bloodtotem are led by Torok, a volatile but useful tauren chieftain. He is wary of outsiders, but I believe you have already met an emissary to their tribe--Oakin Ironbull--whom you rescued at Riverbend.Use that small thread and you may be able to bring the Bloodtotem back into the fold. Highmountain needs them if we are to defeat the drogbar and reclaim the Hammer of Khaz'goroth. Be on your guard.

Title: Return to the Broken Shore
Objective: Take Saurfang's spare mount to the Broken Shore and fight alongside him to restore your honor.
Text: Fear not. I'm angry, but I don't chase my own death. We will fly in and scout the ideal point of attack. The demons are still drunk on their victory, but we will put a swift end to their revelry! Take my spare mount and we will fly to the Broken Shore. There we will bring honor to our dead.

Title: The Rivermane Tribe
Objective: Meet Jale Rivermane at Earthmother's Bounty.
Text: What has happened here requires more time than I have to explain. In short, our tribes have scattered in the wake of the attack that left the Hammer of Khaz'goroth in the hands of the barbaric drogbar.Even now the drogbar are raiding the Rivermane tribe, and I have too few braves left to send to their aid.We need a hero. Please, go to Earthmother's Bounty and lend what aid you can.

Title: To the Rescue
Objective: Assist the warriors in killing the demon captains in the Fel Ingress.
Text: Saurfang, Wyrmsbane, and Anselm could not wait for reinforcements, they have ventured into that mess to cut off the heads of demon captains. I'm sure they do not require help but time is of the essence. If you could go and assist them in killing the demon captains, we can get on with killing the portal guardian.

Title: Rocs vs Eagles
Objective: Save 7 Captive Great Eagles.
Text: High Crawliac has taught her witches how to curse our beloved eagles into the vile rocs you see assaulting the valley. There is no way to break this curse once it has taken hold. We will take to the skies and do battle with the rocs, but we need your help on the ground. Head north through Darkfeather Valley and release any eagles that you find. Every eagle you save is one less roc we must kill later.

Title: Keepers of the Hammer
Objective: Meet Mayla Highmountain at Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
Text: The Highmountain Tribes had intended to pledge our allegiance to your forces. We know war has come with the Burning Legion. However, we have been betrayed from within and must now ask for your aid. A great relic, the Hammer of Khaz'goroth, was stolen from our people by the vile drogbar. We need your help in recovering it.

Title: The Felsmiths
Objective: Report to Felsmith Nal'ryssa in Suramar.
Text: Ye have a knack with this felslate. Best ship ye off to someone who knows the stuff better than I. The Illidari have a knack with all things demonic, really, and I've heard about a few miners who've set up shop out near the demons in Suramar. Pay 'em a visit. See what they have to teach ye.

Title: Get to High Ground
Objective: Bring Jale Rivermane to Thunder Totem.
Text: It is no accident that Dargrul attacked the Rivermane in force. It is their farms and their pastures that supply food for the region. Please, get Jale to Thunder Totem. With luck, Mayla will have reinforcements to send to the area. We will rally the survivors here and follow as quickly as we can.

Title: Scouting Report
Objective: Find Goblin Intel from any Steamwheedle Scout in Tanaris.
Text: We were supposed to meet back here, and then sneak back to Gatgetzan. That was hours ago! The others fanned out across all of Tanaris to gather intel.Anything you can find will help in the defense of Gadgetzan. Keep your eyes open!

Title: Not Dead Yet!
Objective: Use the Nitro-Electric Jumpstarter to resurrect 5 Gadgetzan Bruisers.
Text: They're not dead yet! A little nitro here, a jolt of electricity there... we can bring 'em back! And then, they can pay me! Whaddya say? Wanna go into business with me?

Title: Tearing down the Legion
Objective: Kill 15 Legion Invaders while piloting a vehicle during a Tanaris invasion.
Text: A piece of paper is tacked to the controls. On it is a tally of demons slain by the previous pilot.Your ego demands satisfaciton.

Title: The Highmountain Tauren
Objective: Report to Ronos Ironhorn in Highmountain.
Text: Ye've brought me a bit of interesting rocks to look at. I've got a special assignment for ye, if ye're up for it. I hear stories about these tauren, up in Highmountain, who claim mastery over minin'. I don't know if they're as talented as you or me, but they've been minin' leystone longer. Pay 'em a visit. See what they have to say.

Title: Shielded Secrets
Objective: Examine 6 Engraved Vrykul Shields in Skold-Ashil.
Text: Our goal lies within that vault. I don't have time to explain in detail - just know that it is vital to the Forsaken that we succeed.The shieldmaidens have proven tenacious in their defense, but I believe there may be another way in. A chosen few of their order are allowed entrance, and I need you to find out how.In the town I have seen intricately engraved shields which I believe are passed down from these champions. The scenes they depict may be the key to passing into the vault.

Title: Assault on the Fel Forge
Objective: Assault the Iron Horde reinforcements at Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

Title: A New Life for Undeath
Objective: Follow Sylvanas into the Vault of Eyir.
Text: It seems that you are full of surprises. With the blessing of the Valkyra queen, you have opened a path that will shape the destiny of Azeroth.I invite you to bear witness, for today a new day dawns on the Forsaken!

Title: Assault on the Fel Forge
Objective: Assault the Iron Horde reinforcements at Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

Title: Clear the Deck!
Objective: Fire 4 Forsaken Catapults in Greymane's Offensive.
Text: Our mission in Skold-Ashil will have to wait,  - for now, we have more pressing matters to attend to.I had just recently arrived with reinforcements for our assault when Greymane's ship sailed in and began barraging our walls. We deployed our siege weapons, but their ground forces quickly overwhelmed us.If you can get to those catapults and take out the dogs manning the cannons, it may give us the window we need to push the attack!

Title: The Dark Lady's Bidding
Objective: Meet with Nathanos Blightcaller in Dreadwake's Landing.
Text: Uh, are these guys friendlies? I guess it's a good sign they haven't tried to eat Duchess... yet.Anyway, I have orders. Nathanos caught up with the dark rangers, who were sent forward aboard the Oblivion on a secret mission from Lady Sylvanas herself! Unfortunately the Alliance caught wind of our plan, and now Greymane is attacking the outpost!We could really use you over there. Duchess can take you there, just give me the word.

Title: Inspiration Strikes
Objective: Obtain 3 vials of Leyblood, then bring them to Cedonu in Azurewing Repose.
Text: The blood of this creature glows with magical energy. It doesn't SEEM to be poisonous. Your training in the culinary arts has presented you with some strange ingredients before, but this one is particularly inspiring. Perhaps someone within the Azurewing Repose can suggest a preparation for Leyblood.

Title: Thieving Thistleleaf
Objective: Collect 5 Stolen Lunarwing Eggs in the Lunarwing Shallows.
Text: Why the Thistleleaf are collecting the Lunarwing eggs is anyone's guess, but you can be sure it's not to give them a loving home. Saylanna Riverbreeze will know what to do with these.

Title: A Favor for Mr. Shackle
Objective: Free Cleave Thunderhill, Gentle Rosh, and Grace the Green.
Text: Throm'ka. My name is Seska. I represent a... trading company. As you can see, I've fallen victim to these giants and their naga allies.Three of my associates were also captured while surveying this cove. I'm certain that my employer, Mr. Shackle, would be most grateful if you could procure their release.

Title: Fighting on the Front
Objective: Complete the Iron Front Daily.
Text: While you are here, maybe you could help out a little? Normally you'd get this at the objective map in Lion's Watch. Please help out here.

Title: Holy Retribution
Objective: Strike down Az'jtal at Tyr's Fall in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: I fell in what you now call Tirisfal Glades at the claws of two of Yogg'Saron's most powerful lieutenants... the C'Thraxi. I was able to slay one in my death throes - Az'jtal. Now, the dark forces deep beneath Azeroth have begun to usher Az'jtal once again into this world. You must go to Tyr's Fall and strike Az'jtal down again before it can fully manifest. Only once this deed is done may you receive my blessing upon the Ashbringer.

Title: Unused
Objective: Oronok Torn-heart at Oronok's Farm in Shadowmoon Valley wants you to listen to his story. Speak to Oronok to begin hearing his story.
Text: I had to be sure. And to be sure, I had to test you. Please excuse the little masquerade. I am as much a farmer as you are . Which is to say, not at all. If you are to recover the Cipher of Damnation, you will need to listen to what I have to tell you. When you are ready, let me know and I will tell you the story.

Title: Die, Fish-People
Objective: Bring 3 Intact Murktide Tails to Makra Knifewhisper on the southern cliffs of Val'sharah.
Text: Makrura are massing down by the shore, and far too many of them seem to practice water magic. I think they're planning to summon a massive wave. Also, I've come a long way, and I'm out of supplies. I'm so hungry, I could eat almost anything. Even the makrura you kill. Just cut the heads off first.

Title: Fishy Business
Objective: Kill 3 Murktide Wavecallers on the southern coast of Val'sharah.
Text: Makrura are massing down by the shore, and far too many of them seem to practice water magic. I think once they've got enough spellcasters, they're planning to summon a massive wave.

Title: Done with Waiting
Objective: Travel to the southern cliffs of Val'sharah and speak to Makra Knifewhisper.
Text: Mom got a message and said blood called for blood. She told me to wait here while she went out, but it's been two weeks since then. I'm tired of waiting. I'll stay home if you go find her. She said she was going to the cliffs far to the south.

Title: Into the Fray
Objective: Speak with the lead demon hunter at Illidari Stand.
Text: The Burning Legion has beaten us here, but so too have the Illidari. It looks like the demon hunters are holding their own, but just barely.Come, let's put that weapon of yours to use. I'll figure out our next move while you crush the Legion.

Title: The Art of Demonsteel
Objective: Work with Muirn Ironhorn to craft a Demonsteel Bar.
Text: The Firmament Stone is one of the few anvils beneath the sky that can tolerate the hammer strikes necessary to craft demonsteel. Here, I will show you. Two parts leystone, one part felslate. No heat, no tempering, just pure strength and finesse. Try it. I will coach you.

Title: The Runes that Bind
Objective: Destroy the Ritual Stones to stop the rituals binding Ashildir's spirit in Haustvald.
Text: The stone tablet here describes a ritual where a powerful spirit can be broken into weaker pieces by binding them to special runestones. It looks like the Bonespeakers may be using this very ritual to weaken the spirit of Ashildir.It may be impossible to summon her with her spirit so weakened. The rituals must be stopped.

Title: Your Will Be Done
Objective: Speak to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker.
Text: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker has drawn a rough map of what we know of the Broken Isles. You should speak with him at once - he can best advise you on where we should first strike against the Legion.

Title: Their Numbers Are Legion
Objective: Wage war upon the Brood Queen's Court and the Burning Legion within the greater Inferno Peak area.
Text: Yes, those devastators must be silenced, but there's also a great deal more to be done.Despite the odds, we're counting on you. The Brood Queen's primary leaders are in control of the volcano. They must be killed. We must smash the Legion and do anything else necessary to achieve absolute victory.

Title: Regal Remains
Objective: Collect 8 Ashildir's Bones in Haustvald.
Text: So you seek the judgment of the queen of the Valkyra? This must be your fault!The Bonespeakers of Haustvald have committed an atrocity and stolen Ashildir's bones. They must have done this to keep an outsider from completing the trials. You must not let this stand!Enter Haustvald and retrieve her remains. I hope, for your sake, that Ashildir is in a forgiving mood.

Title: The Final Judgment
Objective: Defeat Runeseer Faljar in Haustvald.
Text: In my fragmented state, I captured glimpses of a hero meting out justice to the corrupted mystics of Haustvald. I see now, this hero was you.I know you seek my judgment, but my spirit is still fragmented. As we speak, Runeseer Faljar is calling upon dark, forbidden magics in an attempt to banish my spirit to Helheim. If he succeeds, your trial will be lost.My connection here is fading. Go, there is little time!

Title: Orders for Your Captains
Objective: Brief your Illidari captains on where to attack the Burning Legion within the volcano.
Text: All that is left is to deliver your orders to our Illidari captains. The mightiest of the Legion's forces have arrayed themselves within the volcano. But, they will not remain on the defensive for long.We must strike first and we must strike hard.Once we destroy them, we can fly up to the command ship, defeat Brood Queen Tyranna, and take the keystone for our own. Lord Illidan will be pleased.

Title: Waking the Shieldmaiden
Objective: Use the Rune of Reformation to return Ashildir's spirit to her bones.
Text: With the rituals disrupted and her bones returned, we may be able to wrest Ashildir from the grasp of these Bonespeakers.Deeper within Haustvald, the mystics possess a special altar that can reunite the body and spirit of a fallen warrior. With this, we may be able to return Ashildir's spirit into her bones, and out of the grasp of these foul mystics.Go outsider, I will rally her guard.

Title: Breaking the Bonespeakers
Objective: Defeat 15 Bonespeaker vrykul or their allies in Haustvald.
Text: The crimes of these ritualists must not go unpunished, but we cannot be their executioners. The rune magic they practice grants them untold power over the dead.You, however, are not dead, and I can sense great power from you. Take the fight to these heretics, and show Ashildir that you are truly worthy of her judgment!

Title: Judgment Day
Objective: Receive judgment from the ancient vrykul rulers.
Text: You have proven resourceful thus far, stranger. As promised, I will instruct you on the ritual of wakening.First, you must place the offering directly atop the grave of the ruler you wish to awaken. Burn the incense so that its aroma wafts over the grave. If your offering is adequate, the ruler will rise, and you may ask your judgment.Take care, outsider. The dead vrykul kings will not enjoy being awakened from their slumber.

Title: Bjornharta
Objective: Collect 4 Engorged Bear Hearts from Voracious Bears in the Runewood.
Text: The afterlife leaves the dead hungry for the delicacies of their former lives. For the vrykul kings, none such offering is prized more than Bjornharta - a celebratory feast of an engorged bear heart.The bears of the Runewood eat well, and have long been prized for their tender meat. Hunt them and find a suitable heart of offer to the ancient rulers. They will not be able to resist such an offering.

Title: Ondri
Objective: Summon and defeat Ondri.
Text: You are nothing compared to me. You think yourself hardened, experienced... heroic, even. Hah! You have no idea what I've been through. The tortures I've endured, the sacrifices I've made. All for the sake of my trade! Yes, I'm a miner, just like you. Want to learn what I have to teach? Come to the Crimson Thicket in Suramar, and speak my name: Ondri.

Title: The Dreaming Fungus
Objective: Collect 8 Soulcaps in the Runewood.
Text: So an outsider would seek to be judged by the ancient rulers of the vrykul? Curious, this. Know that they will not take to your presence kindly, stranger.If you are so hasty to meet judgment, you can call them forth with a ritual of wakening. To complete this ritual, you will require an aromatic to burn and an offering to present.A plant grows in the Runewood that will make a suitable incense. Gather it, and I will instruct you further.

Title: Infernal Brimstone Analysis
Objective: Collect the reports from Mama Diggs' apprentices in Icecrown, Deepholm and Twilight Highlands.
Text: In order to mine Infernal Brimstone, we first need to understand the way in which ore comes into being. I currently have three of my apprentices doing research on different ores around the world. Find Forinn Stoneheart in Deepholm, Rhol Landers in Twilight Highlands and Krul Rockhorn in Icecrown and collect any information they've gathered on the ore at those locations.

Title: Lyrelle
Objective: Summon and defeat Lyrelle.
Text: Look at you, miner. Still held back by the limitations of your fragile, decaying flesh. To truly become one with the demon-tinged rocks of these lands, you must shed your skin and submit to a darker power. Join us, miner. Bring your feeble body to Felsoul Hold, and speak my name: Lyrelle.

Title: Infernal Brimstone Sample
Objective: Bring the Infernal Brimstone Sample to Mama Diggs in Dalaran.
Text: This ore. Smells. Horrible. It combines the odor of sulfur with all the worst parts of a rotting corpse. Someone will probably want it for something. Maybe your mining trainer in Dalaran will take it off of your hands.

Title: Rin'thissa's Eye
Objective: Bring the Ore-Bound Eye to Felsmith Nal'ryssa in Suramar.
Text: Oddly enveloped within the felslate deposit is a humanoid eye. It quivers with life. You get the sense that it would blink at you if it had an eyelid. A mining expert should take a look at this.

Title: Ondri's Still-Beating Heart
Objective: Bring the Ore-Choked Heart to Felsmith Nal'ryssa in Suramar.
Text: What at first looked like another chunk of felslate is, in fact, a humanoid heart, encrusted in rock and filled not with blood but a vile, demonic substance. It does not appear to belong to the beast you carved it out of... it seems that the infernal was holding it like a keepsake. Luckily your mining pick didn't hit it straight on. Felsmith Nal'ryssa will want to see this.

Title: Rin'thissa
Objective: Summon and defeat Rin'thissa.
Text: My sister Nal'ryssa has her claws in you, doesn't she? That weakling doesn't know the first thing about mining. She was always too afraid to take the leap. True knowledge comes only from the Great One, the God of Fel and Flame. You want to truly learn how to mine? Come to Suramar's northwestern corner, and speak my name: Rin'thissa.

Title: A Shred of Your Humanity
Objective: Allow Felsmith Nal'ryssa to place three shards of felslate in your body.
Text: To mine for felslate is to seek the very blood of demons. To improve at it, you must become part demon yourself. Why the dirty look? You said it yourself: you're willing to make sacrifices. Luckily for you, I'm an expert in this area. I won't put you in any danger, as long as you trust me. Are you ready?

Title: Darkheart Thicket: Nal'ryssa's Sisters
Objective: Go to the Darkheart Thicket and find Lyrelle's Signet Ring.
Text: I was not the only miner in my family. I was the youngest of four sisters. I say "was" because the other three are gone. Two of them went too far. They overloaded their bodies with felslate and succumbed to the will of Sargeras. They are more demon than elf, now. The third, I have not heard from in quite some time. The last I heard, she was investigating the Darkheart Thicket. I fear she may have fallen, too - one way or the other.

Title: Lyrelle's Right Arm
Objective: Bring the Severed Arm to Felsmith Nal'ryssa in Suramar.
Text: You blink and rub your eyes, but they do not deceive you. This is a woman's arm, completely enveloped within a felslate seam. The arm is bloodless, but still twitches. Fel-colored streaks remain where veins once were. Felsmith Nal'ryssa will certainly want to see this.

Title: Living Felslate Sample
Objective: Bring the Living Felslate Sample to Mama Diggs in Dalaran.
Text: Your miner's instinct is kicking in. Chunks of the infernal's corpse appear to be usable. Still, there must be a way to extract more ore from the demon's body. Perhaps your mining trainer in Dalaran will know how.

Title: Rethu's Horn
Objective: Bring the Chunk of Horn to Ronos Ironhorn in Highmountain.
Text: The corpse of the rocky beast yielded an unusual treasure: a battered chunk of tauren's horn. It is clearly very, very old, but something about its color and curve reminds you of Ronos Ironhorn at the Ironhorn Enclave.

Title: Felslate Seam Sample
Objective: Bring the Felslate Seam Sample to Mama Diggs in Dalaran.
Text: This ore is remarkably heavy. More disturbingly, it seems to darken and hiss at your touch. Perhaps your mining trainer in Dalaran has some insights.

Title: Felslate Deposit Sample
Objective: Bring the Felslate Deposit Sample to Mama Diggs in Dalaran.
Text: This is one nasty-looking stone. Your trainer in Dalaran should see this.

Title: Rethu's Sacrifice
Objective: Report your encounter to Ronos Ironhorn in Highmountain.
Text: Miner... speak with me a moment. I haven't much time in this place. I see you fight for your ore. I believe that is the most noble way to obtain your stone. It gives the land a fighting chance. Still, one mustn't be callous with their own life. Dig too deep, and the land will overcome you. No stone is worth the price I paid. But that is a tale for another day...

Title: Rethu's Experience
Objective: Report your encounter to Ronos Ironhorn in Highmountain.
Text: Miner... you... you know who I am? I see. That is good. My tribe continues to honor its roots. If you return to the land of the Ironhorn tribe... let them know that they are looked upon with pride.

Title: Rethu's Lesson
Objective: Report your encounter to Ronos Ironhorn in Highmountain.
Text: You... miner... let me see your pick a moment.  You remind me of myself, when I once walked this land. Savor these moments, miner. They cannot last forever.

Title: Rethu's Pick
Objective: Bring the Battered Mining Pick to Ronos Ironhorn in Highmountain.
Text: This seam has been mined before - it bears the telltale diagonal ruts of a miner's pick. Looking down, that pick now lays on the ground - handle broken, pick-point dulled with use and years. Carved into the haft is a familiar name: "Rethu"

Title: Where Respect is Due
Objective: Mine for leystone 35 times while using Ronos's Glass Pick.
Text: Leystone is a sensitive ore. Our smiths can coax great power out of it, but as miners, we must treat it with respect, or else its power will retreat inward.  The next time you mine some leystone ore, use this pick. It will break if you strike too hard. THIS is the respect that leystone requires.

Title: Rethu's Journal
Objective: Bring the Torn Journal Page to Ronos Ironhorn in Highmountain.
Text: Tucked in between a few pieces of rubble, a scrap of paper catches your eye. Mining carefully, you uncover the tattered remains of an old scroll. The tauren handwriting is archaic, but one word catches your eye: "Rethu".

Title: The Legend of Rethu Ironhorn
Objective: Speak with Ronos Ironhorn to learn the tale of Rethu Ironhorn.
Text: A long, long time ago, a tauren by the name of Rethu entered this land. His exploits paved the road that all miners walk. If you wish to learn more about mining, you must first learn about Rethu.

Title: Living Leystone Sample
Objective: Bring the Living Leystone Sample to Mama Diggs in Dalaran.
Text: This is no normal leystone. It is much livelier, shimmering in complex, enthralling patterns. It is easy to stare at. Your trainer in Dalaran would certainly like to have a look at this.

Title: Leystone Seam Sample
Objective: Bring the Leystone Seam Sample to Mama Diggs in Dalaran.
Text: This ore has clearly absorbed some of the latent ley energies within the Broken Isles. It is cool to the touch, and reflects light in odd, playful angles. Your trainer in Dalaran should analyze this.

Title: Leystone Deposit Sample
Objective: Bring the Leystone Deposit Sample to Mama Diggs in Dalaran.
Text: This ore looks like nothing you've seen before. A mystical sheen moves through the metal in complex, unpredictable patterns. Your trainer in Dalaran would certainly like to see this.

Title: Turn the Keys
Objective: Activate the Runestones within the Runewood.
Text: My roots wither... my branches die...The Bonespeakers, they seek to silence the Runewood. The runestones are the key...Turn the stones... release my bonds...

Title: Before We're Overrun
Objective: Slay Doom Commander Beliash and take his power for your own.
Text: The doomguard commander and his queen must be dealt with. His eredar are summoning in a huge number of reinforcements.We need to put an end to him before the Legion overruns our new foothold up in the volcano!As an added benefit, you can steal his demonic power.

Title: Enter the Illidari: Shivarra
Objective: Feed a powerful soul into the Legion Gateway Activator and then use it to summon in your Shivarra forces.
Text: Our Shivarra demonesses are waiting at the Black Temple. It's a gamble bringing them here... they used to be part of the Burning Legion after all. But, they are some of the most powerful in Lord Illidan's arsenal.I have a feeling that the ultimate sacrifice is going to have to be made in order to summon them in.

Title: Set Them Free
Objective: Several of your demon hunters are in trouble. Get the Soulwrought Key to set them free.
Text: Cyana went down to the Molten Shore. She was going to help some of the demon hunters who came in through the gateway ahead of us. Instead, she got herself into trouble.This inquisitor revealed they're being held prisoner by some new type of demon called a 'jailer'. The thing sucks the souls out of its victims. I doubt they can hold out much longer.

Title: The Demon's Trail
Objective: Find Malfurion Stormrage.
Text: Malfurion is nearby. I can sense him.. Search the summit of Andu'talah while I continue to scour the forest. Be swift. Time is of the essence!

Title: Hard Lessons
Objective: Burn 5 Harpy Nests and Break 5 Harpy Eggs in the Wretched Grove.
Text: Please understand, stranger, that I am a being of peace. I have discarded any vengeful nature long, long ago. In my youth, however, many hard lessons were learned through discipline. When applied wisely and properly, discipline can be a great teacher and shaper of character. It is in the spirit of wisdom and guidance that I would have you teach these harpies a memorable lesson.

Title: An End To War
Objective: Defeat Ironbranch.
Text: It appears that the great Ancient of War, Ironbranch, has fallen to the Nightmare. It pains me greatly to ask this of you, but Ironbranch must be put to rest. In life, he once stood vigil in Shala'nir as a protector of the world tree. In death, my dear friend is no more than a destructive weapon that will be used to cause even more violence. He must be slain before he does more harm to Val'sharah. In my heart, I know that he would thank you for this mercy...

Title: The Fate of Val'sharah
Objective: Defend the Temple of Elune.
Text: Malfurion, my love.... My heart breaks for him, but I cannot follow where he goes. I have sworn myself to Elune, my goddess, to defend her temples and lands with all that I am. I cannot stand by while my order is in danger. May she keep you in her graces, Malfurion.

Title: Return to the Black Temple
Objective: Use the Sargerite Keystone to activate the Fel Portal and return to the Black Temple.
Text: Quickly, use the Sargerite Keystone.We must get back to the Black Temple before it is too late!

Title: Stop the Bombardment
Objective: Destroy the Legion Devastators.
Text: Jace's wards are not going to hold out much longer. We need someone to go out there and make sure those Legion devastators are destroyed.

Title: Brotherly Love
Objective: Find Maiev Shadowsong in Black Rook Prison.
Text: Maiev will be somewhere in the prison. I found her discarded armor on my way here.Let's split up to search the cells more quickly. We must find her.

Title: The Keystone
Objective: Kill Brood Queen Tyranna and take the Sargerite Keystone. Then, join the others down-below in the portal chamber.
Text: , Brood Queen Tyranna is just ahead in the command chamber. The others already charged in. She has the Sargerite Keystone in her possession.Finally, the object of all our sacrifice is at hand.

Title: No Reason to Stay
Objective: Evacuate survivors in the Waning Crescent and Siren's Vigil.
Text: Elisande's purge of the Waning Crescent came so swiftly that few could react. Many of my people are dead or taken. Some may have endured this atrocity. We need to make sure they are not left behind. I need you to search the houses nearby for any survivors. See that they flee before they are discovered. Reassure them that there is no reason to stay. Not here, not while Elisande's insanity reigns.

Title: Into the Foul Creche
Objective: Meet up with Kor'vas Bloodthorn at the Foul Creche.
Text: One of the demons that I interrogated revealed a particularly juicy bit of information. Apparently, there's an imp mother in the volcano that scribes Legion secrets.Kor'vas has gone out to find that demon and bring those secrets back for us.

Title: Black Rook Prison
Objective: Kill Araxxas and collect the Prison Keys.
Text: I did not come this far to lose her in the final moments. Maiev must be in the cells beneath Black Rook Hold. I scouted above, and the entrance to the prison is guarded by a fearsome jailor. I will sneak past and take out the guards inside. Defeat Araxxas, take the keys, and then meet me within.

Title: Illidari Freedom
Objective: Free Sirius Ebonwing, Cassiel Nightthorn, and Asha Ravensong.
Text: Within the prison are three of my... ... comrades. We were taken by surprise while scouting the area. I am not long for this world, but please, save them.

Title: Lieutenant of the Tower
Objective: Kill Desdel Stareye.
Text: All of your instincts were correct. Gul'dan raised Lord Ravencrest, and his ghostly army, from beyond the grave. Now, they serve the Legion, protecting secrets within the tower. Although Ravencrest commands from above, Lieutenant Desdel Stareye operates the prisons. He tormented me these past few moons, but I did not yield.  His life must be ended.

Title: Stop Gul'dan!
Objective: Enter the Vault of the Betrayer, kill Crusher and Sledge, and take their fel power.
Text: After his defeat at the Black Temple, we brought Illidan's lifeless body here, to be interred forever within the Vault of the Wardens.Gul'dan has found his way through our defenses and is trying to steal the Betrayer's corpse.Even in death, Illidan's body can be used by the Burning Legion. Gul'dan CANNOT succeed.

Title: Black Rook Hold
Objective: Take the Warden's Signet to Jarod Shadowsong.
Text: Inside the chest, hidden amongst various knickknacks, is a signet engraved with a unique crest. The band, made from a silvery, unbreakable metal, has been worn down by time, as if absently twisted and rubbed against its owner's finger.

Title: Kur'talos Ravencrest
Objective: Examine Ravencrest's Sigil.
Text: Lord Ravencrest was a fearless leader, a seasoned commander, a man of integrity and honor, a teacher, and a protector of his people. Malfurion, Illidan, Tyrande, and I... we were still young when he helped shape our destinies. The sigil of his house was legendary. Observe, for a moment, the sigil over his former resting place and I shall tell you more of his legacy.

Title: The Rook's Guard
Objective: Kill Kester Farseeker, Trelan Shieldbreaker, and Starlys Strongbow.
Text: Black Rook Hold is not the same place I knew. Its walls have crumbled, a ghostly echo of its former glory. If Lord Ravencrest has returned, then surely he will have his former officers at his side. Kester Farseeker, captain of the guard. Trelan Shieldbreaker, peerless master of maces. Starlys Strongbow, who could split arrows while blindfolded. If we stand any chance of entering the tower itself, they must be eliminated.

Title: The Crusade Calls
Objective: Speak to Lord Maxwell Tyrosus at Krasus' Landing.
Text: ((You have just finished the introduction sequence in Dalaran.)) Lord Maxwell Tyrosus of the Argent Crusade sent for you. He mentioned knowing of a weapon we could use against the Legion. As much as I loathe their ilk, you should go to Krasus' Landing and speak with him. We need every advantage we can muster.

Title: Maiev's Trail
Objective: Search the forge, the saber pens, and the guard tower.
Text: The fortress grounds are just up ahead. There is a large area to search, but if we split up, I believe we can cover a lot of ground. Search the prison cages, the forge, and the guard tower for any signs of Maiev. I will check the upper ramparts and meet you on the other side of the keep.

Title: The Warden's Signet
Objective: Take the Warden's Signet to Jarod Shadowsong.
Text: The night elf was carrying a signet engraved with the crest of the Wardens. The band, made from a silvery, unbreakable metal, has been worn down by time, as if absently twisted and rubbed against its owner's finger.

Title: An Urgent Gathering
Objective: Gather Travard and Orik Trueheart, then meet Lord Maxwell Tyrosus at Krasus' Landing.
Text: A critical decision must be made. The Legion devastated our forces at the Broken Shore. The mightiest army this world has ever known was reduced to cinders in moments. We must gather those with the conviction to save our home. Travard of Tyr's Guard and Orik Trueheart have each made plans to do just that, but we must not let them walk alone. I ask that you seek them out and guide them to Krasus' Landing so that we may make this decision together.

Title: The Sword of Truth
Objective: Place Fal'shathil on the ground, then defeat Black Rook night elves within its holy light.
Text: Lord Ravencrest's army rises from the dead, but I believe they are controlled by Gul'dan's will. Take this - Lord Ravencrest's blade, Fal'shathil. It was known for a unique, magical quality. Those who gazed upon its mirrored blade found themselves unable to deny the truth. Take the blade and plant it in the ground. Attack the night elven ghosts near its light. Once they are weakened in its presence, perhaps they will regain their senses.

Title: Crackdown
Objective: Investigate the events of the Waning Crescent.
Text: Thalyssra is right to be concerned! The network has not responded to my attempts to re-establish connection with the Waning Crescent. I do not know what happened, but given the circumstances I believe it prudent to investigate in person. , would you do the honors? I will send you as close to the Waning Crescent as I can.

Title: Kill Feral Dogs
Objective: Return to Anna Thornton at Barreltown.
Text: You've done more than enough. My people and I can clean things up here. You should return to town and report on our victory.

Title: Fel Infusion
Objective: Infuse yourself with 100 energy from fallen demons.
Text: So many years of imprisonment has left us weak.The Vault is overrun with demons. Kill them and gather their souls to regain your strength.

Title: Regroup
Objective: Escape Siren's Vigil.
Text: These people may be able to hold out here, but I know for certain that we cannot. Every moment we spend here places them in danger of Elisande's forces retaliating against us. We need to move. We need to find a place to regroup and recover. Follow me. I think I know how we can get out of here.

Title: Competitive Exorcise
Objective: Kill 15 Burning Legion invaders in 10 minutes or less.
Text: Think you're good at sending demons back to the hell from whence they came? Show me!I once bagged 15 in under 10 minutes. Do better than that and there'll be brew money waitin' for ya.

Title: Answering Aggression
Objective: Kill 12 of Elisande's Forces in the Waning Crescent, Starcaller Retreat, and Siren's Vigil.
Text: I weep for the Nightborne this day.  Elisande demonstrates the ultimate disdain for her people. So many lives... wasted! All to relay a message: This is what happens to those who defy her. , my friend, we must answer her. We must show her that she cannot slay her people without retribution. Fight back.

Title: Jarod's Mission
Objective: Speak to Jarod Shadowsong at Ravencrest Mausoleum.
