Text: Since Maiev chased after Gul'dan at the Vault of the Wardens, her sisters among the Wardens have been searching far and wide for her whereabouts. With so few Wardens remaining, I volunteered to join the search. I hope I will find sign of her within Black Rook Hold. The fortress will be well guarded, and I will need help to break through. Help me find her, and I will reward you handsomely.

Title: Hope Remains
Objective: Take the Tear of Elune to Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
Text: The Tear of Elune floats effortlessly, glistening in an ethereal pillar of moonlight.

Title: Close Enough to Touch
Objective: Search for Malfurion within Shala'nir.
Text: He is near, I can feel it. We must scour this place in search of my husband. I fear if we do not find him soon it will be too late. You have been courageous throughout our search. I know you will not fail me now. Thank you, and please hurry.

Title: Rise of the Illidari
Objective: Free 8 Illidari Prisoners.
Text: Look down there. We are vastly outnumbered.We will need more allies on our side if we are to escape from here intact. Free the other Illidari imprisoned within the cells of this chamber.We will need everyone to escape this place alive.

Title: Reading the Leaves
Objective: Collect 5 Corrupted Petals.
Text: , my friend. You must succeed where I have failed. You must find our dear Malfurion. As the Nightmare consumes my thoughts, I hear the voices of these twisted trees. I must cling to sanity long enough to aid you. Venture into Ash'theran and bring me Corrupted Petals from the fallen denizens there. With them, I might find your Archdruid while my mind is still my own.

Title: Malfurion's Cure
Objective: Deliver the Cleansed Mooncaps to Mender Onelle.
Text: The cleansed Mooncaps glow radiantly in your hands as you lift them from the waters of the ancient moonwell. Mender Onelle will need the Mooncaps in order to make a healing poultice for Malfurion's wounds.

Title: Heart of the Nightmare
Objective: Track Malfurion's path through the Nightmare.
Text: I know only that my husband is somewhere deeper in this twisted forest. He is still alive, but it remains to be seen if he is whole.  Elune herself cannot protect Xavius if he is not.

Title: Our Last Hope
Objective: Speak with Maiev Shadowsong in the Illidari Cellblock.
Text: Your jailor, Maiev Shadowsong, stands outside the open door to your cell. The leader of the Wardens has just finished removing your bonds.In the distance, you can hear sounds of battle. The unmistakable stench of the Burning Legion wafts through the air.

Title: The Wormtalon Crone
Objective: Slay Grelda the Crone.
Text: A wicked coven of harpies have overtaken our village. It was the twisting of the forest that forced us out of our village, but now that the harpies have moved in I fear that we may never be able to return. The Wormtalon coven are led by a witch called Grelda the Crone. She has made her nest in a cave near our village. If their leader is defeated, the remaining harpies will surely flee. Slay Grelda the Crone and we will be forever in your debt.

Title: Breaking Out
Objective: Free both Altruis the Sufferer and Kayn Sunfury.
Text: We cannot fight our way out of the Vault alone.Two of your allies, Kayn Sunfury and Altruis the Sufferer, are imprisoned within this room.Free them with haste. Their strength will be of great use to us.

Title: Lost in Retreat
Objective: Retrieve 5 Shadowfen Heirlooms in Shadowfen.
Text: Is this the end? Our beloved Malfurion. I saw him in the Dreamer's clutches, but Ysera was... changed. Twisted. Shaladrassil, our mighty world tree, is corrupted beyond recognition. We were forced to flee our home without our belongings. Some were heirlooms, sacred to us. Return them to me if you can, I beg you.

Title: The Demon's Trail
Objective: Travel with Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage.
Text: Xavius! How many times must I end that wretched satyr before he stays dead... We must get to Shaladrassil and find Xavius before it is too late! My wounds are grave, but they will heal... do not concern yourself with my safety. There is little time... we may already be too late...

Title: Our Last Hope
Objective: Retrieve your new warglaives.
Text: The Vault has fallen to the Burning Legion.It pains me to say it, but all is lost, but for one glimmer of hope... YOU. Believe me when I say, I did NOT want to have to do this. However, it would seem I have no choice.Help me, demon hunter, and I will grant you your freedom.

Title: Mark of the Demon
Objective: Return the Demonic Emblem to Isoraen Nightstar at the Temple of Elune.
Text: The demonic rune glows in your hand, emanating dark power. A single word, inscribed in demon tongue, glows coldly... ...GRAVAX...

Title: Tears for Fears
Objective: Retrieve the Tears of Elune.
Text: The Tears of Elune are a sacred artifact, protected by my order for thousands of years. I tell you this so that you may understand the gravity of your request. That said, Ysera is noble and wise and I trust in her guidance. You will find the tears in a vault at the eastern edge of the temple grounds. Proceed with caution though, as that area has been overrun by demons.

Title: Cleansing the Corruption
Objective: Destroy 6 Nightmare Totems on the Battlefield.
Text: All along the battlefield, the satyrs have erected dark totems that spread the corruption of the Emerald Nightmare upon the land. As long as the Nightmare totems remain, we will not be able to hold back the corruption! If you truly wish to aid us in the fight, destroy the totems that you encounter upon the battlefield. Our survival depends on it!

Title: Root Cause
Objective: Collect 30 Corrupted Root Samples.
Text: The massive roots of Shaladrassil are spreading a horrible corruption throughout the forest. If we are to save Val'sharah, we will need to find a way to stop the encroachment of the world tree. If you bring me enough corrupted root samples, I may be able to discover their secrets.

Title: Black Rook Orders
Objective: Return to Commander Jarod Shadowsong at Bradensbrook.
Text: The letter is written in midnight ink: "A demon invasion is imminent, but as long as the fires of Black Rook Hold blaze, we shall protect kaldorei lands. Kill any intruders who stand in our way." - K.R." Perhaps Jarod Shadowsong will want to see this.

Title: Silence in the City
Objective: Speak to Chief Telemancer Oculeth.
Text: There is a troubling silence from Suramar City this day. Oculeth just informed me that the teleporter to the Waning Crescent has gone dark. He is not able to reach Vanthir, nor am I. While I am hesitant to believe something dire has happened, I do feel this warrants investigation. Speak with Oculeth and see if he can transport you to the Waning Crescent. We need to find out what happened.

Title: A Sight For Sore Eyes
Objective: Use Granny's Flare Gun to mark 6 Black Rook Falcons.
Text: Do you see those ravenous birds flying above my farm? Vicious creatures are spreading their filth an' eatin' my crops. I'd get rid of them with my trusty gun, but my eyesight's gone downhill. Take this flare gun and mark them for me. Once I get my sights on them, I'll make 'em scatter.

Title: Children of the Night
Objective: Kill 12 Risen Assassins, Black Rook Falcons, or Risen Hounds.
Text: I am no enemy to these people, but there is no convincing them of that. Their village has come under attack by some very old friends of mine. Friends who are no longer... living. There's no telling who or what controls them, but in life these noble soldiers would never engage in such acts. That's a mystery for another time. For now, help me earn the trust of these villagers. Strike down the Black Rook enemies who are terrorizing their citizens.

Title: A Village in Peril
Objective: Speak to Mayor Heathrow at Bradensbrook.
Text: The corpse of Darcy Heathrow lies before you pierced by several arrows and knife wounds. In one hand she clutches a note, written with a feeble hand, that reads: "The dead march on Bradensbrook. Help us, please!"

Title: For the Corn!
Objective: Collect 5 Barrels of Corn.
Text: I've got a full summer's corn harvest just sittin' out in the field. I need some muscle to bring it in before the night elf raiders can destroy it. Get out there and bring me those crops, and I'll reward you handsomely. The folks back in town need this food, and I sure as heck ain't eating rats for another winter.

Title: The Farmsteads
Objective: Check on the Heathrow house, Granny Marl's farm, and the Radcliffes' fishing dock.
Text: Forgive us, stranger. Mayor Heathrow has been under a lot of stress recently. I can't blame him: his own daughter, Penelope, has been missing for two days. In fact, we could use information on several farmsteads to the south: Mayor Heathrow's house, Granny Marl's farm, and the Radcliffes' dock. Can you go check on the situation out there? Help us, and perhaps the mayor's heart will soften.

Title: The Temple of Elune
Objective: Speak with Lyanis Moonfall at the Temple of Elune.
Text: Cenarius is in danger. If his condition is not reversed soon, he will be lost to the Nightmare that threatens the Emerald Dream. To spare him that fate, we must have the Tears of Elune - the same relic you were sent here to retrieve. Elune's temple is not far. Go there. Find Lyanis. Show her my seal and instruct her to release the tears into your custody. Hurry. Time is short.

Title: Burning Importance
Objective: Save yourself by completing a Timewalking Dungeon.
Text: Champion, you would not believe the horrors I have seen. The timeline is twisting and your fate is dire. Causality bends at its very knees, and in this dire future you kneel to the Betrayer himself, Illidan Stormrage. Venture into the past and save yourself, but beware - your powers are as they were then.

Title: Another Way
Objective: Defeat the Drekirjar Champion in Hrydshal, then climb to the top of the tower.
Text: Wait, do you still have that grapple launcher? I think you can still get to the path if you can launch from the top of that tower. The gap doesn't seem too bad there.Of course, we'll have to take out the big guy out front first. He looks tough, but I think we have a chance if we can flank him.

Title: Cry Thunder!
Objective: Fly with Vethir and kill 150 of the God-King's allies in Hrydshal.
Text: You have proven yourself an ally of the Thorignir and we will lend you our strength. I would ask one last favor of our new champion, though.The dragon who guided you to me awaits his vengeance against the vrykul. Together I wish for you to show these Drekirjar what it means to cross the Thorignir. Be they Felskorn or not, their malice has caused suffering to my brood. Their toll must be paid in blood.Speak to Vethir when you are ready.

Title: No Wings Required
Objective: Use the Stormforged Grapple Launcher to launch over the wall at Hrydshal.
Text: That thing looks like it's got the range to get us over the wall. There's a good spot to hook onto right past us - you should be able to spot it from here.Once you're inside, do me a favor and see if you can distract the guards so I can slip through. I'll see what else I can find out about these vrykul.

Title: Above the Winter Moonlight
Objective: Grapple across from the tower and climb to the top of the mountain path.
Text: There, it looks like there's a good spot to launch to right across from here. This path should take you all the way to the top.According to my intel, your dragons should be up there. Let's just hope that they're still in a state to help you.

Title: Built to Scale
Objective: Collect Storm Drake Scales from the Stormwing drakes in Hrydhsal.
Text: The vrykul around here seem to use scales from these drakes to fashion their armor. If you were able to gather enough material from the local drakes, you may be able to make something useful out of it.

Title: Impalement Insurance
Objective: Grapple on top of the walls and dismantle 7 Tideskorn Harpoon Launchers atop in Hrydshal.
Text: It looks like the elements aren't the only thing you'll need to worry about going up that path. Those harpoon launchers on the wall look pretty nasty, and unless we take them out first, they're likely to make short work of anyone trying to scale that path.They're up on top of the walls, so you'll need to use that grapple launcher to get to them. Just try not to end up drake food!

Title: Will of the Thorignir
Objective: Meet with Dread-Rider Cullen outside of Hrydshal to begin the trial of the Thorignir.
Text: In the summit of storms the dragons await. Born of the gods, they will test your will.They roost above Hrydshal, where their children serve the Drekirjar. But they are no allies to man or vrykul, and so you must earn their blessing as they see fit.A friend of yours awaits in Hrydshal, no doubt searching for the answers you now possess. Go to her, and together, you will test your might against the storm!

Title: To Weather the Storm
Objective: Collect Climbing Treads, an Oiled Cloak, and an Enchanted Lodestone from Hrydshal.
Text: When I was scouting this place out, I noticed the vrykul here are no strangers to the treacherous mountain path we're trying to get to. They've got some specialized equipment they're using, and if I were you I'd try to get my hands on some.You'll want to find some climbing treads to keep your grip and an oiled cloak to keep you dry. They've also got these stones they carry to keep the lightning at bay, so you'll want to pick one of those up as well.

Title: A Grapple a Day
Objective: Pick up a Stormforged Grapple Launcher and meet Dread-Rider Cullen outside the wall of Hrydshal.
Text: So some old magic vrykul is helping us out? I guess that's good, but this trial of yours might be tricky. You see, the only way up that mountain, is through those big walls.You know, the ones with the mean-looking drakes on them.I scouted a bit, but couldn't get too far without those drakes trying to make lunch out of poor Duchess. The vrykul have them trained, which can't be good.I say we sneak in. I managed to snag a few grapple launchers earlier. Grab one and meet me outside the city walls.

Title: Gates of Valhallas
Objective: Speak with Vedhir.
Text: Escaping the grasp of Helya is no small feat. You may prove to be a worthy warrior after all.Skovald has entered Valhallas; you are running out of time. Legion has corrupted the minds of the Skovald's men. A battalion of unworthy vrykul is attempting to enter the portal to Valhallas.The giants that protect the gates are fighting a losing battle. There is no end to Legion's onslaught.Speak with the dragon, Vehdir, inside the gates near the portal. He will aid you on your next task.

Title: Infrastructure Improvements
Objective: Place 5 G-X3 Telemetry Beacons.
Text: , we built a vehicle to take ya up to the Throne of Kil'jaeden but whenever we try a test flight the navigation system goes crazy! In my expert opinion it's 'cause of that crazy demon magic the Iron Horde is playing around with up there.If you could travel up there and place these telemetry beacons we can program the vehicle and give you a stable flight all the way up.Just be sure to have some friends with you, the demons up there look especially vicious!

Title: Setting the Signal
Objective: Place 5 Pentangulate-o-tron 2000s.
Text: , we built a vehicle to bypass the Horde camp and take you to the Throne of Kil'jaeden! There's one problem, the concentrated fel energy up there is causing the navigation system to go haywire!I'll need you to place some sensors along the edge of the summit. With them in place we can stabilize the flight controls.Just be sure to have some friends with you, the demons up there look especially vicious!

Title: TRACKING Nightmare 02
Objective: Defeat Botanist Darkgrove
Text: (PH)Darkgrove has run out of places to hide. Now it is time to finish him off. If we stop him now, there may be hope for this valley yet.

Title: Malfurion's Fury
Objective: Speak with Ysera to search for Malfurion.
Text: The loss of Cenarius to the nightmare is a devastating blow to us all. Though Malfurion's rage is justified, his hatred of Xavius has burned for centuries and I fear that his blind rage will be used as a weapon against him. May Elune guide us in our search for him, lest we have yet another friend to mourn today.

Title: Assault on the Throne of Kil'jaeden
Objective: Defeat the Shadow Council at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Shadow Council are summoning their demonic masters upon a mountain they are calling the Throne of Kil'jaeden. Make no mistake; This is the most dangerous region in Tanaan.Gather together a war party and assault the Throne of Kil'jaeden before the Legion gains a foothold here!

Title: Assault on the Throne of Kil'jaeden
Objective: Assault the Shadow Council forces at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Shadow Council are summoning their demonic masters upon a mountain they are calling the Throne of Kil'jaeden. Remember the first war, we know the destruction the legion can cause if they are unchecked.Head to the Throne of Kil'jaeden and let's put an end to this invasion before it can begin.

Title: Assault on the Throne of Kil'jaeden
Objective: Defeat the Shadow Council at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Shadow Council are summoning their demonic masters upon a mountain they are calling the Throne of Kil'jaeden. Make no mistake; This is the most dangerous region in Tanaan.Gather together a war party and assault the Throne of Kil'jaeden before the Legion gains a foothold here!

Title: Assault on the Throne of Kil'jaeden
Objective: Assault the Shadow Council forces at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Shadow Council are summoning their demonic masters upon a mountain they are calling the Throne of Kil'jaeden. We know the destruction the legion can cause if they are left unchecked.Head to the Throne of Kil'jaeden and let's put an end to this invasion before it can begin.

Title: The Battle for the West
Objective: Go to the Iron Front and speak with Exarch Maladaar.
Text: Our base is barely built and already the Iron Horde sets up defenses against us. Still the plan worked and we fight on two fronts. I have received word that Exarch Maladaar has finally breached the western gates as well, but is bogged down in a pitched battle. You should go see the situation for yourself.

Title: A Message of Terrible Import
Objective: Go to the Vault of the Earth and speak with Lagar the Wise.
Text: Your scout... he got me out of that hellish place. Fel orcs surprised us out in the jungle and dragged us up the mountain. They tortured us... killed all but me. I fear one of us may have given up our secret before the end. I must ask you to go to the home of our order. Speak with Lagar, my leader, tell him... tell him Gul'dan knows.

Title: To Old Friends
Objective: Kill 50 Corrupted Creatures in Moonrest.
Text: I sense a powerful dark presence here, but it is not of Xavius. This feels too familiar. I sense a druid's touch here, a druid twisted by the shadow of the Nightmare. We must deal with this threat if we are to find Xavius. I will take to the skies and lend you my aid. Find this corrupted druid and cut down his tainted and twisted plants.

Title: The Battle for the West
Objective: Go to the Iron Front and speak with Durotan.
Text: Our base is barely built and already the Iron Horde sets up defenses against us. Still the plan worked and we fight on two fronts. I have received word that Durotan has finally breached the western gates as well, but is bogged down in a pitched battle. You should go see the situation for yourself.

Title: We Meet at Light's Hope
Objective: Join the other paladins at Light's Hope Sanctum beneath Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
Text: With you on our side, I know the Legion will fall! But before we march on the Broken Isles, we must put Highlord Tirion to rest. There is but one place suitable for a paladin of his caliber... Light's Hope Sanctum, a secret bastion of the Light hidden beneath our chapel. Paladins the world over are on their way to the ceremony. I know Tirion would want you there most of all.

Title: Nothing Remains
Objective: Report back to Vol'jin at your garrison.
Text: Nothing is left for me here. My old clanmates have turned into foes, and Gul'dan is desecrating what remains of my people. You and your Frostwolf allies still have some fight left. If you pledge to depose Gul'dan, I will stand by your side. I will go to this garrison of yours and together we will build a shipyard that will rule the red seas of Draenor! Let your people know I am coming.

Title: The Train Gang
Objective: Use the detonator to blow open the prison train, and convince Roark to join your cause.
Text: My warriors will surround and cover the train car. Hit the detonator to blow open the doors. I will speak to Roark and convince him to defect to our cause. He built all of this - he's our best hope for building a shipyard of our own. If this doesn't work, execute him on the spot. The last thing we need is someone rebuilding the Iron Fleet.

Title: Garrison Campaign: War Council
Objective: Speak with Warchief Vol'jin inside the Town Hall of your garrison.
Text: Your garrison is in an uproar. Warchief Vol'jin himself is visiting your fortress to discuss your invasion plan for Tanaan Jungle. The Warchief is ready for you inside your Town Hall. It would be wise not to keep him waiting...

Title: Clearing the Docks
Objective: Kill 1 Iron Horde orcs and 50 ogron.
Text: We need to get control of this situation. We thought these docks would be all but abandoned. Instead, Gul'dan has ordered the Iron Horde to retreat to Tanaan, and many are using this harbor to make their getaway. We need to clear a path for your salvage team. Lay waste to them! Every foe we slay here is one less convert for Gul'dan's wretched demon-worshipping army.

Title: Derailment
Objective: Collect Explosive Charges and a Detonator.
Text: Some orcs have spoken out against Gul'dan, and they've been taken prisoner. One of them is what you'd call an engineering prodigy: Solog Roark, "The Iron Shipwright." This guy's good. Designed all these docks, as well as the big dreadnaughts you fought around Shattrath. If my scouts are right, he's in a prison train as we speak... And I betcha he'd be willing to defect! Gather up some explosives and meet Durotan next to the train to the south.

Title: Hook, Line, and... Sink Him!
Objective: Use a Blackrock Grapple to reach Knar's bunker. Slay him to obtain Roark's Shipyard Blueprints.
Text: I can build you a shipyard. And not some wasteful piece of over-engineering like this place. But I'm going to need my blueprints. My work was confiscated when Gul'dan turned this harbor over to Admiral Knar.  Gul'dan's green poison courses through Knar's veins. He's calling the shots from on high. We'll need to grapple up there to take him out.

Title: All Hands on Deck
Objective: Construct a Level 1 Shipyard for your garrison.
Text: Let's put dis "Iron Shipwright" ta work, commander. If we ta take Tanaan from both land an' sea, we gonna need a shipyard. Work wit' Roark an' make it happen! He be surveyin' tha land along tha road west of Frostwall.

Title: We Need a Shipwright
Objective: Travel to the Iron Docks and speak with Sammy Fivefingers. Your Garrison Flight Master can provide transport.
Text: Whatever be left of da Iron Horde be fallin' back ta Tanaan Jungle, where Gul'dan is turnin' them into sumthun' even worse. A frontal assault be suicide. But da seas be open. If we attack by both land an' sea, Gul'dan got ta fall back somewhere. , it be time ta build a shipyard! We need local resources. Go to da Iron Docks. Gazlowe's boys are already there. Gather any equipment ya find, and see if ya can recruit us a proper Horde Shipwright!

Title: Garrison Campaign: The Bane of the Bleeding Hollow
Objective: Collect tracking maps to find the location of the killer.
Text: Commander, now that we've had time to get scouts all over the jungle we have heard some news near Zeth'Gol.It appears that somebody else has a vendetta against the Bleeding Hollow and has been... hunting... them. Their hunters are closing in on the assassin.You know what they say about "the enemy of my enemy..." We should collect their tracking maps and try to find the killer first!

Title: A United Force
Objective: Establish the Order of the Silver Hand using the Libram of Ancient Kings.
Text: The paladins of Azeroth must stand united behind a single leader. With Tirion's passing, you are the one most worthy to wear the mantle of Highlord. If you agree to accept this duty, inscribe your name into the Libram of Ancient Kings and I will address the masses on your behalf. The Order of the Silver Hand is reborn, with you as its champion!

Title: The Sargerei Menace
Objective: Slay 12 Sargerei.
Text: This attack surprised our defenders. Forces are marshalling to push them out, but it will take some time for them to arrive.Any Sargerei you can slay will make retaking this area much easier commander.

Title: Flower-Pickers and Potion-Quaffers
Objective: Speak with Linzy Blackbolt and Kuhuine Tenderstride to secure a work order for Foxflower Flux.
Text: Now that we know the foxflower flux is safe to use, we can start stocking it. That being said, I don't particularly feel like picking flowers. Do you feel like picking flowers? Didn't think so. Go talk to the alchemists and herbalists across the way. I'm sure we can set up some sort of work order arrangement.

Title: Garrison Campaign: The Warlock
Objective: Speak with the warlock at Lion's Watch in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: Commander, you have a visitor. One of Gul'dan's warlocks just walked up to the base and surrendered. He says he has information of a terrible event that is about to occur.I suggest you speak with him immediately.

Title: A Sweet Bargain
Objective: Find a frost mage in Dalaran to chill your quenching trough.
Text: Reading over this research, I found an interesting method that I'd like you to try. The method would require us to chill the metal to sub-freezing temperatures during the pre-tempering phase. Simple water quenching won't do. Good thing you can't walk two steps in this city without bumping into a frost mage! See if you can recruit one for the shop.

Title: Worthy of the Stone
Objective: Speak with Muirn Ironhorn.
Text: You have nothing more to prove to me. Your training is complete. Only a very small herd of smiths have earned the right to the Firmament Stone. You should speak with Muirn Ironhorn, who maintains vigil over our sacred stone. He will tell you what to do next.

Title: Lord Hal'shara's Tomb
Objective: Raid the tomb.
Text: The tomb, I've found it.

Title: See Ya Later, Oscillator
Objective: Collect the Crystal Oscillator.
Text: Those jawless mooks are actually trying to salvage parts from our ship! They can't possibly appreciate superior gnomish technology... Perhaps its shiny nature is appealing to their simple inclinations. In any case, I need a crystal oscillator for our new transponder. It's the shiniest part of the whole system, they're bound to have it set aside somewhere!

Title: Secrets of the Sargerei
Objective: Locate and stop the source of corruption underneath Auchindoun.
Text: The Auchenai have been reporting for some time that something was... wrong... with Auchindoun since Teron'gor's original assault. Now suddenly the Sargerei attacked and blew open a hole into one of the underhalls.Corruption leaks from that breach. We must investigate!

Title: Maw of Souls: Hammered By The Storm
Objective: Go to the Maw of Souls and recover an Ancient Vrykul Hammer.
Text: Your hammer looks weak, and would probably break upon striking the Firmament Stone. The vrykul master blacksmiths of old were known for the strength of their hammers. The only way to get our hands on such a hammer would be to go where vrykul go when they die. To the Maw of Souls. The goddess that resides over that realm is named Helya. She hoards the trinkets they bring for her own desires. Defeat her and you may be able to acquire such a hammer.

Title: Tribal Knowledge
Objective: Report back to Felsmith Nal'ryssa in Suramar.
Text: First, however, you'll need proper patterns for demonsteel armor. While access to the stone is earned through hard work and perseverance, access to our recipes is limited to the trusted members of our tribe. Perhaps you should seek another smith if you wish to discuss demonsteel patterns.

Title: Leystone Mastery
Objective: Speak with Thala Steeltotem to purchase a Leystone Armor Stand, then hang all eight pieces of Leystone Armor on it.
Text: Smiths that seek access to the Firmament Stone must first prove complete mastery over leystone. Craft an entire set of Leystone Armor, then submit it to me for inspection. Thala can provide you with an armor stand.

Title: Felsmith Nal'ryssa
Objective: Report to Felsmith Nal'ryssa in Suramar.
Text: Word has been circulating in smithing circles about a pair of Illidari blacksmiths that have been doing exciting work out on the demon-infested front lines of Suramar. I'd follow up myself, but anything described as "demon-infested" is a little too exotic for my tastes. I just make the armor. I prefer not to wear it. You, though... you could follow up on this tip. Be on the lookout for Nal'ryssa. From what I hear, she's a hell of a smith.

Title: The Firmament Stone
Objective: Speak with Barm Stonebreaker in Highmountain.
Text: When working with felslate and demonsteel, one must use special equipment. Specifically, an anvil hard enough to withstand the energy given off when felslate is hammered. Urael and I no longer possess such an anvil. But your friends, the Highmountain tauren, do. Gain access to the Firmament Stone, their sacred anvil, and we can start working with demonsteel again.

Title: Nal'ryssa's Technique
Objective: Obtain 60 Leystone Ore and 60 Felslate.
Text: Listen. We need smiths like you to carry on the traditions of the Illidari, should we fail in our crusade against the Legion. You are ready to learn. Bring me materials. Lots of them. When you return, we will have much to discuss.

Title: Leystone's Potential
Objective: Use Felsmith Nal'ryssa's technique to craft a set of Masterwork Leystone Armguards.
Text: As I'm sure you've deduced, all of the leystone recipes you know can be improved. By learning to harness leystone's true potential, you can reduce the amount of material you use and still yield an equivalent result. Here, I'll show you. We'll start, as one does, with the humble bracer. This particular piece of armor benefits from the addition of brimstone runes. See for yourself.

Title: Smith Under Fire
Objective: Follow Felsmith Nal'ryssa's instructions to craft Leystone Boots.
Text: You lack recipes for boots? What, were you trained by a tauren or something? Hurry up, then. We probably have a few minutes before the demons attack again. Here's a pattern - show me your work.

Title: Part of the Team
Objective: Slay 40 demons within Felsoul Hold.
Text: You're a blacksmith?  Still working in leystone, are you? I might be able to help you out. Alliances out here are hard-won. You've got a pretty face, but that's no guarantee that you aren't working for the demons. I can't afford to trust you yet. Don't come back until you're caked in demon's blood. Then we'll talk smithing.

Title: Not Just Weapons and Armor
Objective: Craft 4 Hard Leystone Bars and 24 Hard Leystone Nails.
Text: You know, we aren't just limited to armorsmithing and weaponsmithing. I regularly make chisels for the scribes, crucibles for the alchemists, and even thimbles for the tailors. They should sew in full plate gauntlets if they're really all that worried about their poor little thumbs. Anyhow, I have a recipe I think an adventurer like you might be interested in. Let's try it out.

Title: Leystone Hoofplates
Objective: Approach Mei Francis in Dalaran while mounted to have your Leystone Hoofplates fitted.
Text: Here, bring these hoofplates to Mei Francis, down at the mounts and pets store, to get your mount properly shod. I'll share the pattern when you return.

Title: Grayheft
Objective: Obtain Grayheft, Ancient Hammer of the Highmountain Tauren from Kubrul within the Deep Roads cavern.
Text: Our tribe regularly crafts legplates out of leystone. I will share our pattern with you... if you do me a favor. My father fell to the drogbar several years ago, and they took his hammer as a trophy. That hammer was in my family for countless generations. Now, it languishes in the hands of the vile drogbar, Kubrul. I would very much like to have it back.

Title: From One Master to Another
Objective: Go back to Alard in Dalaran and share what you've learned from the Tauren.
Text: Now young one, go back to your master in Dalaran and continue to practice your swing. We'll always be here if you wish to come back and learn more.

Title: You Are Not Worthy
Objective: Use your blacksmithing skill to craft a pair of Leystone Gauntlets for Barm.
Text: You wish me to teach you how to strengthen your crafts? We do not simply share the secrets of our trade with outsiders who ask for them. We do, however, respect craftsmanship and discipline. Let's see your hammerwork. Our greenhorn trainees use those small anvils over there. Craft your best pair of gauntlets so I may judge your work.

Title: The Highmountain Smiths
Objective: Speak with Barm Stonebreaker in Highmountain.
Text: I think we've gone as far as we can go with what I know. The tauren of Highmountain must have some smiths among their ranks. See if you can find out how to further progress our leysmithing abilities from them.

Title: Nature Provides
Objective: Obtain 10 Foxflower.
Text: This is interesting, it says that leystone reacts violently with anything it views as a contaminant. Our foreign-mined flux was enough to cause the small explosion. Local ingredients, however, have learned to coexist with leystone. Up in Highmountain, an herb called foxflower grows that can be turned into a suitable flux. Go and gather some foxflower that we can turn into a usable flux.

Title: Secrets of Leysmithing
Objective: Bring the Leysmithing Guide to Alard Schmied in Dalaran.
Text: I could spend hours poring over the details of this fascinating manuscript! ...is what I would say if this weren't the simplest of tasks for someone of my skill level. It's about something called "Leysmithing". Here.  There it is, word-for-word. Bring me something interesting next time.

Title: Chicken Scratch
Objective: Bring the Ancient Highborne Data Printout to Professor Pallin in Dalaran.
Text: I think I have just the thing to extract the information from this core for you.  You may wish to avert your eyes, blacksmith.

Title: Hatecoil Hammerwork
Objective: Obtain a Masterwork Hatecoil Breastplate and a pair of Masterwork Hatecoil Pauldrons.
Text: There may be a way to jump-start our research into leystone. I've heard reports of naga camps down in Azsuna. If they've been in Azsuna for long enough, their smiths have certainly started experimenting with leystone themselves. Be on the lookout for some leystone armor on the naga... ideally something more elaborate than a bracer.

Title: The Methods of the Nightfallen
Objective: Obtain an Ancient Sentry Construct Memory Core.
Text: I have a theory. Have you encountered the nightfallen elves of Azsuna? They descend from the Highborne, and the accomplishments of Highborne smiths are legendary. These fallen elves do a bit of arcane tinkering, crafting sentries to patrol their camps. Bring me a memory core from one of their constructs. Who knows what manner of smithlore might lie within!

Title: Leysmithing Mastery
Objective: Follow Alard Schmied's recipes in your Blacksmithing recipe list to build some Handcrafted Leystone Gauntlets.
Text: Well, now that we have the flux we can put it to work and see how it goes. Why don't you take a crack at it this time and make some gauntlets for me. I'll observe your work... from a distance.

Title: Engineers: Not COMPLETELY Useless
Objective: Bring the Ancient Sentry Construct Memory Core to Timofey Oshenko in Dalaran.
Text: Unfortunately, I have no idea how to access any information within this core. But I know someone who does. Head over to "Like Clockwork", the engineering shop three doors down from here. Timofey Oshenko owes me a favor. He should be able to extract the memory out of the core.

Title: Strange New Ores
Objective: Obtain 10 Leystone Ore.
Text: You smell that, smith? Ahhhh... that there's the smell of opportunity. Dalaran's taken us to some strange new shores, filled with mysterious metals. I'm tethered to my shop here, but you... you've got the freedom to explore and mine at will. Bring me something interesting, and we'll see what we can make with it.

Title: Will of the Thorignir
Objective: Meet with Lorna Crowley outside of Hrydshal to begin the trial of the Thorignir.
Text: In the summit of storms the dragons await. Born of the gods, they will test your will.They roost above Hrydshal, where their children serve the Drekirjar. But they are no allies to man or vrykul, and so you must earn their blessing as they see fit.A friend of yours awaits in Hrydshal, no doubt searching for the answers you now possess. Go to her, and together, you will test your might against the storm!

Title: Frenzied Furbolgs
Objective: Kill 8 Smolderhide furbolgs.
Text: I would help you seek audience with the Archdruid, but we have a difficult situation on our hands. The nearby furbolgs have gone into a frenzied rage. For days, it has been all we can do to protect our grove from their aggression. They have cut off our access to the barrow dens, where the Archdruid and our clan sleep in the Emerald Dream. In order to awaken them, we must first get past the furbolg.

Title: The Cipher of Damnation
Objective: Get Oronok and your ally to destroy the barrier, then stop Gul'dan.
Text: Your ally and I will remove this barrier now, though it will take a greater part of our strength. What lies beyond will not be easy.Gul'dan will have empowered an elemental lord with the Cipher, driving it insane. He will use it to destroy the link between the elements and Draenor. If you destroy that elemental, we could recover the Cipher.

Title: The Ancient Trials
Objective: Find Havi near Aggramar's Vault.
Text: I know who you are, champion, and I know what you seek.Come to me, if you think yourself truly worthy.

Title: Breaching the Barrier
Objective: Collect the Black Candle, the Tome of Protection, and the Shadowblade at the Fel Forge and bring them to Oronok.
Text: The ritual site is already prepared, and it is protected by a barrier... one that I created. I can destroy the barrier, but I will need three items currently in use at Forge Camp Vengeance.If you can get those ritual items, I will meet you at the Corrupted Refuge and remove the barrier. Even if it kills me.

Title: Let's Make A Deal
Objective: Sign Daglop's contract.
Text: Hey there! You seem like a gullib- er... um... "intelligent" type. I propose a deal. I need a minion to be my muscle to help me acquire a few special... "ingredients" for a ritual. In exchange, I'll give you my former master to do with whatever you demon-slaying types do with demons. If you are interested, just sign here. In blood, please.

Title: Garrison Campaign: The Warlock
Objective: Speak with the warlock at Vol'mar in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: Commander, you have a visitor. One of Gul'dan's warlocks just walked up to the base and surrendered. He says he has information of a terrible event that is about to occur.I suggest you speak with him immediately.

Title: Unfortunate Circumstances
Objective: Free Lady Liadrin.
Text: The Illidari ask us to trust them, but all I see is failure. Look around... this entire city has been lost! I tracked down the pit lord Malinoth here and brought what few of my men I had with me to put an end to this depravity. They were not enough. The brute threw us in this cage and was 'saving us for later.' We need your help.

Title: Garrison Campaign: The Bane of the Bleeding Hollow
Objective: Collect tracking maps to find the location of the killer.
Text: Commander, now that we've had time to get scouts all over the jungle we have heard some news near Zeth'Gol.It appears that somebody else has a vendetta against the Bleeding Hollow and has been... hunting... them. Their hunters are closing in on the assassin.You know what they say about "the enemy of my enemy..." We should collect their tracking maps and try to find the killer first!

Title: Assault on the Temple of Sha'naar
Objective: Assault the Sargerei forces at the Temple of Sha'naar in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: Up in the hills of Tanaan Jungle, the Sargerei have converted a once-sacred temple into a den of demonic summoning.We must attack them now, before their rituals complete. The longer we delay, the stronger our enemy grows.

Title: Commander in the Field!
Objective: Get reports from various scouts in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: This battle will be won, but it will be hard fought. Our rangari did manage to get a few scouts out to the rest of the jungle though. Perhaps it is best you collect this intelligence yourself and see what this jungle holds for us all.

Title: Journey to the Repose
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at the Azurewing Repose.
Text: For now, the Illidari can hold the line against the Legion. We will return later to help them drive the Legion from the upper reaches of Faronaar. You and I must concentrate on the Pillars of Creation if the Tomb of Sargeras is to be resealed.Your saving of Stellagosa is fortuitous. Surely if anyone knows where a Pillar of Creation is, it will be her grandfather, Senegos.The Azurewing Repose is to the northeast. I will meet you there.

Title: Assault on The Fel Forge
Objective: Assault the Iron Horde forces at the Fel Forge in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Iron Horde is growing stronger each day as their war machines are empowered with fel magic. We have even obtained word that they are constructing a Fel Reaver!Head to the Fel Forge and destroy their forces before we are overwhelmed.

Title: Obstacle Course
Objective: Find any information on the forces deployed in the area and meet with the scouts afterwards.
Text: Our landing was unopposed. Why are these docks all but abandoned? The rangari scouts up ahead report trouble. Bleeding Hollow scavengers are looting some abandoned buildings to the northwest, and an encampment of warlock cultists lurk near the Dark Portal. Let's find out what we can and meet up with our scouts.

Title: Assault on the Fel Forge
Objective: Assault the Iron Horde reinforcements at Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

Title: The Assault Base
Objective: Establish your assault base in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: While you were playing with fel fire, I've located the perfect position for an assault outpost.Follow me and we can get this base started!

Title: In, Through, and Beyond!
Objective: Destroy the Fel Defense Cannon covering the gate.
Text: Gul'dan seems to have concentrated his defenses on this chokepoint. The guns up ahead are unlike anything we've seen before - they're empowered with fel energy. Our enemies think this pass is impregnable. Let's prove them wrong, commander! If we can break through, the terrain ahead will make an excellent stronghold. Destroy that cannon!

Title: The Ashbringer
Objective: Retrieve the Ashbringer from the Lost Temple at the Broken Shore.
Text: The blade fell... during the battle... Broken Shore...  My time... is short. You must go ahead... into the temple ruins... You must... retrieve... ...the Ashbringer.

Title: The Invasion of Tanaan
Objective: Meet with Khadgar at your shipyard and then speak to Yrel to begin the invasion.
Text: It is done! By your command we have built our first ship and can run our naval operations from here. Now that we have our transport, we can let Yrel and Archmage Khadgar know that we are ready to kick off an invasion of Tanaan. Speak with them at the docks to embark.

Title: New Goods
Objective: Talk with Sergeant Grimjaw.
Text: New items are available from Sergeant Grimjaw. I suggest you stop by and take a look at his new goods as soon as you can!

Title: Garrison Campaign: Onslaught at Auchindoun
Objective: Meet Yrel at Auchindoun in Talador.
Text: The Auchenai have sent me an urgent missive - Auchindoun is in jeopardy again! The Sargerei have renewed their assault and breached the underhalls. I sense the hand of Gul'dan is behind this. Gather your things and meet me in the Court of Souls West of Auchindoun at once!

Title: Secrets of the Sargerei
Objective: Locate and stop the source of corruption underneath Auchindoun.
Text: The Auchenai have been reporting for some time that something was... wrong... with Auchindoun. They were never able to find a reason. Suddenly the Sargerei attacked and blew open a hole into a subchamber.Corruption leaks from that hole, we need to stop it.

Title: The Sargerei Menace
Objective: Slay 12 Sargerei.
Text: An attack such as this was unexpected. They have deployed heavily and it will take me some time to marshal enough forces to root them out.Any Sargerei you can slay will make retaking this area much easier commander.

Title: Garrison Campaign: Onslaught at Auchindoun
Objective: Meet Liadrin at Auchindoun in Talador.
Text: Your ally, Liadrin, has sent a missive requesting aid near Auchindoun. The Sargerei have made a new assault there and breached something important. It is no coincidence this happened after Gul'dan's ascendancy. We will watch the front here, commander.

Title: New Goods
Objective: Talk with Sergeant Crowler.
Text: New items are available from Sergeant Crowler. I suggest you stop by and take a look at his new goods as soon as you can!

Title: Above the Winter Moonlight
Objective: Grapple across from the tower and climb to the top of the mountain path.
Text: You should have a good vantage from this tower to grapple over to the mountain path. I can't help you once you're across, but you should be able to take it all the way up to the top.I hope you're able to find what you need from the dragons up there. Who knows what the God-King has done to them.

Title: Wings of Liberty
Objective: Free Aleifir, Hrafsir, Erilar and Hridmogir in Thorim's Peak.
Text: When the Felskorn assaulted the nest, the Thorignir fought bravely to save our brood. But their demonic allies proved too much, and many of us were captured.Even now they work to corrupt my brothers and sisters to turn them to their side.Please, outsider, free them from this fate!

Title: Impalement Insurance
Objective: Grapple on top of the walls in Hrydshal and dismantle 7 Tideskorn Harpoon Launchers.
Text: I've got bad news. Those harpoon launchers up on the walls might cause us some problems.They can't get at us down here, but once you start climbing that path, they're likely going to try to skewer you.If you use that grapple launcher, you should be able to get on top of the walls and dismantle them. Watch out for the drakes, though!

Title: Heart of a Dragon
Objective: Find and rescue the mother of the Thorignir brood.
Text: Through brute force and corruption, the God-King has taken the power you seek, but there may be hope for you and the Thorignir.With the aid of fel powers such as I've never seen, the Felskorn are corrupting our young and seeking to enslave the Thorignir. Their leader, a demon of great power, has captured our mother and seeks to bend her to the God-King's will.Find her and free her from the demon's grasp - only then might the Thorignir regain our power and grant you aid.

Title: Bottled Up
Objective: Take Okuna's Message to Lady Irisse.

Title: The Same, But Different
Objective: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
Text: A most intriguing theory has been put forth by an associate of mine that may explain what's wrong with these coins. We believe they might be demonic in origin. See? This one's got three eyes. And this one always comes up tails. And THIS one whispers to me at night - on now, don't be jealous sweetheart. You're still my favorite. ...Provided you bring me more coins so I can confirm our theory. Run along!

Title: To Weather the Storm
Objective: Collect Climbing Treads, an Oiled Cloak, and an Enchanted Lodestone from Hrydshal.
Text: I've been doing some nosing around, and it looks like these vrykul are making regular trips up the mountain themselves. They've got some specialized gear for it, so while we're here we should take some.I'd recommend finding some climbing treads to keep your grip on the slopes, as well as an oiled cloak to keep the rain out. Also, it looks like they carry enchanted lodestones, which seem to keep the lightning at bay. You should probably grab one of those, too.

Title: The Same, But Different
Objective: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
Text: I'm beginning to suspect these here coins are demonic. See? This one's got three eyes! This one always comes up tails. And over here - the ones you brought me earlier? They dissolved in holy water. I need to make absolutely sure this isn't a fluke - bring me a huge pile of coins to sort through so nobody can refute m'theory.

Title: A Curious Oddity
Objective: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
Text: Well sweet pea, I have good news and bad news for you. The good news is that you brought me enough coins to complete this new misprint set! The bad news is that not a single one of them has matched the original partial set. See here - this coin has two heads. And the face on the reverse is grinning at me, where he was looking so dour only an hour ago. This one squints when I shine a light on it. Such a mystery! I must have more!

Title: A Curious Oddity
Objective: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
Text: I've been looking at some of the other coins in circulation plus the ones you've brought back. Some o' these are misprints... others are just plain wrong. Look 'ere. This one's got two heads. And the second one is smiling at me, where it wasn't before. There's a bigger mystery in play here and these misprints are the key to figuring it out. I'm gonna need even more.

Title: Completionism
Objective: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
Text: This is intolerable! The coins you brought me do not match the rest of the coins I already have! You aren't counterfeiting these are you? No? Hrumph. In that case I'm sorry we fought, dearie.There's only one thing to do, buttercup: we need to complete the new set you've discovered. Bring me more misprinted coins!

Title: Completionism
Objective: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
Text: Interesting - the coins you've brought back from your Garrison are slightly different than the ones Nolan collected in Outland. Y'see here, the markings along the edge? Very interesting stuff! This requires some more study an' that means more coins! Bring them to me and I'll see if I can scrounge up something for your trouble.

Title: Nature's Call
Objective: Speak to Aranelle in Lorlathil.
Text: What vile power is this?! A curse with the strength to paralyze a demigod? Unimaginable! Quickly, you must gather the archdruids of the forest. With their help, we can summon Ysera. She will surely know what horror has overtaken my mentor. I will remain here and lend Cenarius what aid I can. Return to Lorlathil and speak with Aranelle. She will know the archdruids' whereabouts. And please, friend, make haste...

Title: Archdruid of the Vale
Objective: Speak with Thaon Moonclaw.
Text: Deep within our forest lies Moonclaw Vale. There you will find a reclusive group of feral druids charged with the protection of Val'sharah from any that would seek to disrupt the balance of nature. These druids are led by Thaon Moonclaw, the most fierce of the Archdruids. Seek him out. Let him know that Cenarius is in need of his aid.

Title: Archdruid of Lore
Objective: Seek out Elothir in Thas'talah.
Text: Elothir resides in the ancient grove Thas'talah, where he communes with nature and instructs his acolytes in the ways of healing and the preservation of lore. Seek him out and tell him that he is desperately needed here.

Title: The Emerald Queen
Objective: Speak to Malfurion when ready.
Text: , you have returned. Good. I have counseled with the other archdruids and concluded that Cenarius' condition is merely a symptom of a much greater problem. Your experiences in Moonclaw Vale make that clear. We need help. There is one who can bring understanding to these events. With Thaon gone, we must ask that you aid us in reaching out to the Lady of Dreams.

Title: The Search for the Highlord
Objective: Recover Tirion Fordring and the Ashbringer from the Broken Shore.
Text: Tirion is fading away on that infernal shore... and the Ashbringer with him! We must not waste another moment. Give the word and we'll set off. We're ready when you are.

Title: Wrath of the Blightcaller
Objective: Slay 15 7th Legion Paratroopers or Skyfire Gryphon-Riders.
Text: The Alliance dogs have bitten off more than they can chew. They have attacked the Banshee Queen, and invoked the wrath of her champion! Like my bow, my axes, and my hounds, you will be an agent of vengeance. Pile the bodies high, and know that I am doing the same. When next we meet, I expect to see blood upon your hands.

Title: A Grim Trophy
Objective: Take the Head of Thane Wildsky.
Text: It would seem Sylvanas does not wish to be followed - by us or anyone else. Her will is her own, it is not my place to question. Only to obey. In the hills nearby, a gryphon master is preparing to take flight, no doubt to pursue our queen from the sky. My rangers are lying in wait - we need only to close our jaws around him. I will have his head when this is over.

Title: The Windrunner's Fate
Objective: Search the wreckage of the Windrunner and the nearby coastline for signs of Sylvanas.
Text: Finding Sylvanas is our only priority! We will cover more ground if we split up. I will lead a team into the hills above the enemy's camp while you search the wreckage itself for any signs of the crew. Once we've cleared the high ground, I will meet you at the far end of the beach.

Title: Side Effects May Include Mild Undeath
Objective: Slay 10 Volatile Bears or Volatile Sailors.
Text: Exposure to this particular "byproduct" is quite nasty. Rapid cell degeneration quickly reduces the subject to a shambling husk incapable of any reason or thought beyond a violent, throbbing hatred for the warmth of life. As you might imagine, the local fauna have been affected by the spill. Oh, and most of the crew as well... Anyway, good luck!

Title: Portable Portals
Objective: Speak with Apprentice Var'nath outside the Mage Tower.
Text: My assistants have figured out how to convert ogre waystones into useful items for our garrison. Speak with Apprentice Var'nath outside to start your first work order.

Title: Bringing the Bass
Objective: Collect a Bass Blaster, Laz-Tron Disc Reader, Phonic Amplifier, S.P.R.K. Capacitor, and a Cord of Ancient Wood.
Text: It's a bit quiet around here, in between the invasions and all.You're in luck though, Commander! I can fix that, and boost morale among your troops all at the same time.All you need to do is bring me a few items from around Draenor, and I'll fill your garrison with music. I'll even throw in a few music rolls from my own collection to get you started!What do you say?

Title: Pump it Up
Objective: Fill the Containment Unit with Volatile Waste.
Text: The Black Rose was a seafaring laboratory for the Royal Apothecary Society. Naturally, we had some volatile... "byproducts" onboard. Regrettably, one such substance was released during our skirmish with the Alliance gunship. As you can see, it is taking quite a toll on the coast. The R.A.S. must remedy this situation before we press further inland. Please take a containment unit and fill it with waste - for us to dispose of properly at a later time, of course.

Title: Numismatics
Objective: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
Text: I told him this was a fool's errand. Of course he would get himself killed over a handful of coins! Oh well, there are always new lovers to find.You'll have to do in the mean time. And you are quite easy on the eyes, aren't you? Be a dear and find me more coins that look like this one? I need them for... research.

Title: Rescued From Darkness
Objective: Save 7 Prowler Cubs in The Midnight Vale.
Text: Midnight Vale is home to a unique breed of Nightsaber known as the Vale Prowler. For centuries, our clan has lived in harmony with these great feline hunters. However, even as we speak satyrs are twisting and corrupting the vale into a place of death and nightmare. Even the forest itself lashes out in torment against the living, causing many of the forest creatures to flee the vale. I fear for the safety of the youngest nightsabers, who may yet be caught in the twisting chaos, unable to escape.

Title: Portable Portals
Objective: Speak with Varsha outside the Spirit Lodge.
Text: My assistants have figured out how to convert ogre waystones into useful items for our garrison. Speak with Varsha outside to start your first work order.

Title: Stealth by Seaweed
Objective: Use the Kvaldir Disguise to sneak by Guarm.
Text: There! The disguise be complete!Don't mind the smell, there. It's probably better that we smell like the kvaldir, as well. Though I have a feeling I'll be needin a priest to get this stench out once we're gone.

Title: Mystery Notebook
Objective: Return the notebook to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge.
Text: This book has seen better days. Not much can be made out between the waterlogging and the apparent animal bites, but you can make out some sort of Ironforge-based drinking game scoring system involving a dwarf named Krom Stoutarm.

Title: Numismatics
Objective: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
Text: I hate to be too cynical, but I don't think we're gonna find Nolan in one piece. Or in a lot of pieces.Nolan was a nut for finding rare coins. He's been from one end of the world to the other finding them, and now he's gone and gotten himself killed looking for more mint condition Draenei coins. Tell you what - let me show you what these coins look like, you bring me a few more of them and I'll set up an exhibit in his honor.

Title: Halting the Nightmare
Objective: Destroy 3 Nightmare Totems in the Moonclaw Vale.
Text: The corruption of the vale is the work of satyrs. The new power they wield is unlike any I've seen... it is dark, seething and terrible. Nefarious demon totems help spread their taint upon the land. The Nghtmare totems must be destroyed if we are to hold back the tide of corruption.

Title: Another Way
Objective: Defeat Gunnlaug Scaleheart in Hrydshal, then climb to the top of the tower.
Text: Well, the bridge option is out. You still got that grapple launcher handy?It looks like we can get across from the top of that tower over there. First thing's first, though, we'll need to deal with the big ugly sitting out front.You take point.

Title: Built to Scale
Objective: Collect Storm Drake Scales from the Stormwing drakes in Hrydhsal.
Text: The vrykul around here seem to use scales from these drakes to fashion their armor. If you were able to gather enough material from the local drakes, you may be able to make something useful out of it.

Title: A Little Kelp From My Foes
Objective: Collect 20 pieces of seaweed from Kvaldir Mistcallers and Soulflayers in Helheim.
Text: I'm not sure what yer doin' here, but ye have my thanks. If ye want to get any further, though, ye'll need to get past that foul dog, Guarm.I've tried meself a few times, and I think I have a plan. If we can get some of the seaweed these kvaldir wear, we might be able to trick the mutt. Guarm's mean, ye see, but not too smart.What do ye say? Think ye can take on a few kvaldir?

Title: The Ranger Lord
Objective: Report to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: Good to see you survived the wreck. Nathanos made it as well, though his face is now even uglier than before. He took a group of rangers north to look for Sylvanas - nobody has seen her since the battle. He asked me to send you his way if you ever woke up.

Title: Havi's Test
Objective: Toss ingredients from the Basket of Root Vegetables, Barrel of Crabs, and Hearty Vrykul Grains into Havi's Stewpot.
Text: I could sense your power the moment you arrived in this land. You carry great purpose and a heavy task.Know that the Aegis of Agrammar rests in the high halls of the All-Father. Only if you prove your valor, can you claim it against your foe.Many trials must you face for this, but first I must know your strength. My stew is incomplete, and my old bones couldn't carry the ingredients up the hill.You look like you have a good arm. Will you help an old man finish his stew?

Title: Return to the Grove
Objective: Return to Malfurion Stormrage at the Grove of Cenarius in Val'sharah.
Text: Forgive me. Archdruid Moonclaw's fall is a terrible blow... Malfurion must be informed of what has transpired here. Inform him of Thaon's fate and of the return of Xavius. Make haste, friend. I fear this may be the greatest threat Val'sharah has ever faced.

Title: Masters of Disguise
Objective: Slay Spymaster Illandris and Spymaster Shwayder.
Text: "My chute caught a piece of shrapnel. Made a rough landing in a ravenbear nest. Luckily, a bunch of eggs broke my fall. Lost sight of Illandris and Shwayder. Both are masters of disguise, and I am confident they can remain undetected. Will continue to monitor the enemy's activity. Just need to clean all the yolk off my cloaking device. Hope the mother's not around...

Title: Accessories of the Cursed
Objective: Collect 8 Cursed Bones in Helheim.
Text: Wait! Before ye go rushin' off, we might want to be gettin more than just seaweed.Ye see, these vrykul also be carrying bones with them - worn all over like jewelry. If ye can get yer hands on some of the bones they got lyin around, it'll add to the disguise.So what ye waitin for?

Title: Return to the Grove
Objective: Return to Malfurion Stormrage at the Grove of Cenarius in Val'sharah.
Text: Now that my grove is safe, I can turn my attention to the threat you speak of. To hear of Cenarius' plight is disturbing indeed. Tell Malfurion that I shall meet him at the Grove.

Title: No Wings Required
Objective: Go to the top of the ridge and use the Stormforged Grapple Launcher to launch over the wall at Hrydshal.
Text: Now that you've got the launcher, we should be able to infiltrate the city. It looks like there's a good spot to grapple onto on the wall just past us. There's a vantage point on top of this ridge.Once we're in, I'll try to slip past the guards and get a look at the mountain path. I'd appreciate if you could make some distractions for me. If all goes well, I'll meet up with you in the upper city.Good luck!

Title: A Grapple a Day
Objective: Pick up a Stormforged Grapple Launcher and meet Lorna Crowley outside the wall of Hrydshal.
Text: So these trials are what will get us the Aegis, and the next one is on the top of that mountain? That may prove problematic.The only way I see up the mountain is through that vrykul city, and the gates are shut tight. We should be able to grapple over, though. If you don't have a launcher, I managed to wrangle a spare from one of these vrykul.I'll scout ahead and see if I can find a good spot to get in.

Title: Eyes in the Overlook
Objective: Recover the SI:7 Intel from Spymaster Knockwhistle in Blackbeak Overlook.
Text: Alliance personnel from the Skyfire were spotted parachuting into Blackbeak Overlook. I was unable to confirm numbers or positions during my flyover, but I did see parachutes tangled in treetops and a LOT of ravenbears on the ground. If anyone is up there, they must be laying low and keeping an eye on us. I have posted a rider at the top of the overlook to keep watch while I press forward into Stormheim. - Liza Cullen, Dread-Rider - 1st Wing

Title: The Warchief Beckons
Objective: Read the Royal Summons and follow Nathanos Blightcaller through the portal to Durotar.
Text: Greetings. I am here on behalf of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. I should hope you recognize the name.  Read it and follow me. You can read, can't you?

Title: Mystery Notebook
Objective: Return the notebook to Estelle Gendry in the Undercity.
Text: This book has seen better days. Not much can be made out between the waterlogging and the apparent animal bites, but a few poor attempts at poetry center around the "radiant glow" of the Undercity and someone named Estelle Gendry.

Title: Cenarius, Keeper of the Grove
Objective: Speak to Malfurion Stormrage at Lorlathil in Val'Sharah.
Text: Greetings, hero. Welcome to Val'sharah. It has been an age since I have set foot in these precious woods. Too long... Our work here is simple. We must call upon my mentor, Cenarius, and learn where he safeguards the Tears of Elune. With them, you will be one step closer to sealing Sargeras' Tomb and thwarting the Legion. You have many treacherous tasks in front of you. Consider your visit here a brief respite. Come, this will not take long.

Title: Critters of Draenor
Objective: Defeat Kura Thunderhoof in a pet battle.
Text: I love collecting pets, and I've picked up a few unusual pets here in Draenor. What would you say to a battle? If you can defeat my humble team, I think we'll both learn a few new tricks.

Title: Seeds of Remedy
Objective: Collect 50 Seeds of Remedy.
Text: Several of my fellow druids have been gravely wounded. Although my restorative abilities will keep them stabilized, there is still more we can do to aid them.  These are efflorescent seeds imbued with the blessing of nature. If I had more of them, I could create a potion that would greatly aid in the recovery of the wounded. Harvest the efflorescent saplings that grow near the fountain of Delyra and I will prepare the potion.

Title: Critters of Draenor
Objective: Defeat Erris the Collector in a pet battle.
Text: I love collecting pets, and I've picked up a few unusual pets here in Draenor. What would you say to a battle? If you can defeat my humble team, I think we'll both learn a few new tricks.

Title: Eye of Azshara: Wrath of Azshara
Objective: Enter the Eye of Azshara, then defeat Warlord Parjesh and the Wrath of Azshara. The Eye of Azshara is a dungeon so be certain to gather some friends to undertake this perilous journey.
Text: , Warlord Parjesh ran into the magical vortex just ahead. He has returned to an island off the shore to the southeast where Queen Azshara is staging more of her forces.The queen is beyond angry because we opposed her. Even now, she is summoning up a monstrosity known as her Wrath to exact revenge for our defiance and drown the Broken Isles.You must defeat the Wrath of Azshara before the queen lets it loose to destroy us all!

Title: Menacing Sprites
Objective: Slay 10 sprites in Thas'talah.
Text: The local sprites are running amok and causing all sorts of problems! Val'sharah is home to a variety of forest and pond sprites will take any opportunity to spread mischief and chaos. It seems as though an especially wicked group of sprites have descended upon Thas'talah in the wake of the harpy invasion. They are attacking the local wildlife and bullying the nearby faerie dragons. If you aid the local woodland creatures by taking care of the sprite menace, you will have our thanks.

Title: Spirits of the Bleeding Hollow
Objective: Slay 6 Enraged Blood Spirits.
Text: It is clear the cave is protected by powerful ghosts, ancestors of the Bleeding Hollow.Whatever is down there, it will be easier to deal with if many of the spirits were dealt with first.

Title: The Bleeding Hollow
Objective: Reach the bottom of the Bleeding Hollow.
Text: The cave pulls me. It keeps angry spirits near. Kilrogg has done magic here. You help me understand...

Title: Following the Bloody Path
Objective: Follow Ariok to the cave.
Text: The ones I kill... they speak of a cave. Sacred to the Bleeding Hollow. Kilrogg could be there - I am going.

Title: The Eye of Kilrogg
Objective: Find the Eye of Kilrogg and perform the scrying ritual.
Text: If you wish to know what Kilrogg and his new master intend, you will need his eye. After the ritual all chieftains place their eye under the protection of the ghosts of the Bleeding Hollow in the next chamber.Go and locate the Eye of Kilrogg in the vault. The other chieftains will not stand with us, and will fight you for it.Then place it on the ritual mark nearby to get your answers.

Title: Finding the Killer
Objective: Locate the slayer of Bleeding Hollow near Zeth'Gol.
Text: With this map, you have pinpointed the origin of the attacks. It is time to see who or what is behind the attacks, and if they are a possible ally.

Title: Friends Above
Objective: Meet with Reshad at Atkar's Post.
Text: Iskar disappeared and now the Shadow Council is at our throats. These can't be unrelated events. We need to go to the last place he was seen, the ruins of Kra'nak. I've asked a friend to set up a camp nearby. I say we head there to continue our search.

Title: Friends Above
Objective: Meet with Reshad at Atkar's Post.
Text: Iskar disappeared and now the Shadow Council is at our throats. These can't be unrelated events. We need to go to the last place he was seen, the ruins of Kra'nak. I've asked a friend to set up a camp nearby. I say we head there to continue our search.

Title: We Need a Shipwright
Objective: Travel to the Iron Docks and speak with Exarch Naielle. Your Garrison Flight Master can provide transport.
Text: The Iron Horde - or whatever Gul'dan is turning them into - has fallen back and fortified the entrance to Tanaan. A direct assault will take a heavy toll. However, the sea lanes are open. If we attack by both land and sea, Gul'dan's Horde will have no quarter. , it's time to build a shipyard! We'll need to source local resources. Travel to the Iron Docks, where a small Alliance reclamation force is already waiting. Gather what equipment you can, and find us a shipwright capable of building a fleet!

Title: The Train Gang
Objective: Use the detonator to blow open the prison train, and convince Roark to join your cause.
Text: These rangari will surround and cover the train car. Hit the detonator to blow open the doors. I will try to talk Roark into joining our cause. He's a genius around a drydock and our best hope for building a shipyard. If it doesn't work, we must be prepared to kill him. The last thing we need is someone rebuilding another Iron Fleet...

Title: All Hands on Deck
Objective: Gather materials and construct a Level 1 Shipyard for your garrison.
Text: Let's put this "Iron Shipwright" of yours to work, commander. If we're to pull off your plan to assault Tanaan from both land and sea, we'll need to get some docks operational as soon as possible. Work with Roark and build the Alliance a shipyard! Last I saw, Roark was northwest of the garrison, near Eventide Landing.

Title: Assault on the Ruins of Kra'nak
Objective: Assault the Shadow Council forces at the Ruins of Kra'nak in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Shadow Council have recruited the Sethekk and other power hungry Arakkoa to their service. Our allies in the Order of the Awakened have tracked them to a ruin in the west of Tanaan where the Shadow Council is instructing them in the use of fel magic.We must strike at them before they can master their diabolic powers.

Title: Nothing Remains
Objective: Report back to King Wrynn at the Town Hall in your garrison.
Text: Nothing is left for me here. My old clanmates have turned into foes, and Gul'dan is desecrating what remains of my people. You and your allies from Shattrath still have some fight left. If you pledge to depose Gul'dan, I will stand by your side. I will go to this garrison of yours and together we will build a shipyard that will rule the red seas of Draenor! Let your people know I am coming.

Title: Hook, Line, and... Sink Him!
Objective: Use a Blackrock Grapple to reach Knar's bunker. Slay him to obtain Roark's Shipyard Blueprints.
Text: I can build you a shipyard. And not some wasteful piece of over-engineering like this place. But I'm going to need my blueprints. My work was confiscated when Gul'dan turned this harbor over to Admiral Knar.  Gul'dan's green poison courses through Knar's veins. He's calling the shots from on high. We'll need to grapple up there to take him out.

Title: Assault on the Ruins of Kra'nak
Objective: Assault the Shadow Council forces at the Ruins of Kra'nak in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Shadow Council have recruited the Sethekk and other power hungry Arakkoa to their service. Our allies in the Order of the Awakened have tracked them to a ruin in the west of Tanaan where the Shadow Council is instructing them in the use of fel magic.We must strike at them before they can master their diabolic powers.

Title: Derailment
Objective: Collect Explosive Charges and a Detonator.
Text: Several orcs have spoken out since Gul'dan assumed control. Some were taken prisoner. Among them is an engineering prodigy: Solog Roark, "The Iron Shipwright." He designed these docks as well as the great dreadnaughts of the orcish fleet. If my scouts are right, he's in that prison train as we speak... And he may be ready to defect! Gather explosives and meet with Yrel at the train to the southeast!

Title: Garrison Campaign: War Council
Objective: Speak with King Varian Wrynn inside the Town Hall of your garrison.
Text: Your garrison is in an uproar. King Varian Wrynn himself is visiting your fortress to discuss your invasion plan for Tanaan Jungle. The King is ready for you inside your town hall along with his full retinue. It would be wise not to keep him waiting...

Title: Totemic Call
Objective: Destroy the Nightmare Totem.
Text: I heard the others talking earlier. I may know the cause of their fear. They say the Chieftain has a mysterious totem. It gives him power, and fearful visions. If you destroy the totem, the madness will end.

Title: Unearthed Magic
Objective: Find the Strange Stone near your garrison mine.
Text: Commander, I've heard reports of a strange stone found in the garrison mine. The miners aren't sure what to make of it, but I have a feeling it could be useful. When you next find yourself at the mine, it may be worth investigating. And if you don't mind, I would love to see the stone for myself.

Title: Unearthed Magic
Objective: Find the Strange Stone near your garrison mine.
Text: Commander, da miners be findin' somethin' in our mine with strong mojo. They don' be knowin' what ta do with it, so maybe you gonna go overe dere and check it out? If you find it, bring it here so I can look closer at da magic.

Title: This IS In My Contract.
Objective: Help Daglop complete his ritual.
Text: To perform my ritual I need to use a special cave I have prepared at Gloombound Barrow. Meet me there and I will "give" you your reward. Hee hee.

Title: Solid as a Rock
Objective: Rescue Marnor Lorleaf, Erwind Mistfen and Del'thanar Sagewood.
Text: Cenarius requires me? I shall depart as soon as I am able, but I mustn't leave while my druids are in danger. A vile harpy coven has emerged and seeks to claim my grove as their own. These vermin inflict a petrifying disease which, given time, will destroy the infected. While I wish for all of my followers to be cured, it is crucial that my elder disciples survive to protect the grove in my absence. If you would assist us, find my disciples and rouse them from this terrible state.

Title: REUSE
Objective: PH: Search the Ruins of Kra'nak
Text: PH: Search the Ruins of Kra'nak for clues.

Title: A True Leader Inspires Others
Objective: Use the Command Table to send the Westfall Militia on a mission
Text: , for all of your mastery over the Light you cannot possibly be everywhere at once. As newly ordained Knights of the Silver Hand it is our duty to carry out your will and defend our world from the darkness. There is an ancient tome within this sanctum by the armory that can serve as the means to disperse your will - direct our blades and we will carry out your command.

Title: Death to the Witchmother
Objective: Slay Magula.
Text: The numberless years of my life have been dedicated to learning and perfecting the arts of healing and restoration. Nothing in this world pains me more than taking a life, traveler. It is with a heavy heart that I must commission the death of Magula, the leader of the harpies that threaten this grove. May her death save the lives of more noble beings.

Title: Minion! Kill Them!
Objective: Fulfill your part of the deal with Daglop.
Text: Per your contract you will help me gather supplies for a perfectly harmless ritual. I need feathers, and horns. Lots of horns. See those shadowrunners, prowlers and heron over there in the Olivian Veil? They should have lots of both. Oh! And I need olives. Lots of olives. One for each finger. Minion! Let's ride!

Title: REUSE
Objective: PH: Search the Ruins of Kra'nak
Text: PH: Search the Ruins of Kra'nak for clues.

Title: Dark Ascension
Objective: Speak to Reshad in the Ruins of Kra'nak.
Text: You skim through the pages of the tome, most of them filled with notes on the nature of shadow and illusion. On the last pages you discover a journal: I continue to search for a cure to the curse of Sethe. If Terokk was restored I would not be in this situation. Damn Reshad! I was contacted by an orc that identified himself as Gul'dan. He has a cure for the curse! I must travel to Tanaan to search for the location of this "cipher" of his. Take this information to Reshad.

Title: Defending The Grove
Objective: Slay 12 Harpies involved in the attack on Thas'talah.
Text: The harpies have had a presence in Val'Sharah for hundreds of years. They have never been much more than an occasional nuisance; thus we have tolerated their presence here within these woods. However, something has emboldened them... it feels as though the forest is weakening... they must sense it as well. The opportunistic harpies have broken the peace and attacked us in a time of weakness. Help us defend Thas'talah by slaying the invaders.

Title: REUSE
Objective: PH: Search the Ruins of Kra'nak
Text: PH: Search the Ruins of Kra'nak for clues.

Title: Preserving The Lore
Objective: Collect 12 Stones of Remembrance.

Title: Get a Clue
