Text: Quest Text.

Title: Gossip Test Case 1
Objective: Objective Text.
Text: Quest Text.

Title: Signal Boost
Objective: Use the Skyfire Propeller to broadcast a distress signal, then hold out until help arrives.
Text: The Skyfire's starboard propeller came to rest on the cliffs overlooking our camp - we're gonna use it like a big antenna and push our distress signal so far that even Mekkatorque's alarm clock could pick it up! Unfortunately, it might attract some unwanted attention. We're braced for enemy contact down here at the camp - fire up that signal and be ready to defend the antenna!

Title: Pins and Needles
Objective: Release 6 7th Legion Dragoons from static fields.
Text: Hngghh! Nope, can't stand yet. It's all pins and needles. Small fries like this are usually no problem for the 7th, but we weren't prepared for their electrical attacks. Before I knew it, I was trapped in some kind of static field. Couldn't move a muscle until you came along. My comrades were carried deeper into the cave. Get 'em out before they become whelp chow!

Title: Assault and Battery
Objective: Recover the Transponder Battery from Dread-Rider Malwick.
Text: We need to report our position to the Alliance navy ASAP! I am building a new transponder to send a distress signal, but I need a battery from the Skyfire's communications console. You'll find the console at the top of the ship - I just hope those undead haven't put their creepy, bony fingers on it yet!

Title: Lightning Rod
Objective: Charge the Transponder by absorbing Storm Drake lightning attacks.
Text: Put this on. Just up the hill you'll find the front half of the Skyfire - and the big nest of storm drakes it crashed into! We can use the energy from those drakes to charge the transponder. You'll have to incite them, of course, but the device should draw most of the power. The probability of you being electrocuted is well within acceptable parameters!

Title: The Lost Legion
Objective: Locate the missing 7th Legion Dragoons.
Text: The heroic men and women of the 7th Legion stayed at the front of the ship to fight off storm drakes while the crew evacuated. None of them have returned. Please find them!

Title: Battle At The Iron Front
Objective: Aid the Alliance and Horde assault at The Iron Front in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: General, our troops are currently engaged in a conjoined assault at the Iron Front. The fight has been raging for some time now, and casualties are high. Report to the Iron Front and lend your strength to the war effort. I have no doubt that your presence on the battlefield will inspire the soldiers to victory!

Title: Boarded!
Objective: Slay 8 Forsaken Bat-Riders or Forsaken Deathstalkers.
Text: Glad to see you survived the crash. Unfortunately, so did most of the enemy's boarding party. Just the thought of those monsters setting foot on my ship makes me sick. Wipe them out. For my crew... For King Wrynn... For the Alliance!

Title: Battle At The Iron Front
Objective: Aid the Alliance and Horde assault at The Iron Front in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The war against the Iron horde rages on. Not far from here at The Iron Front, our warriors are engaged in mortal combat with the enemy. They fight tenaciously and with great fury, but the losses have been severe. Go to The Iron Front and show the enemy that we will not falter in this war. Show them that we fight as wolves!

Title: Bleeding the Bleeding Hollow
Objective: Assault the Bleeding Hollow at Zeth'Gol in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Bleeding Hollow provide significant reinforcement to the Iron Horde in Tanaan. From their home in Zeth'Gol they relentlessly pursue our scouts, disrupt our operations, and gather more power for Gul'dan's magic.We should consider a direct raid on Zeth'Gol to make them pull back their forces across the valley. This should give us some breathing room... for a time.

Title: Bleeding the Bleeding Hollow
Objective: Assault the Bleeding Hollow at Zeth'Gol in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Bleeding Hollow provide significant reinforcement to the Iron Horde in Tanaan. From their home in Zeth'Gol they relentlessly pursue our scouts, disrupt our operations, and gather more power for Gul'dan's magic.We should consider a direct raid on Zeth'Gol to make them pull back their forces across the valley. This should give us some breathing room... for a time.

Title: A Royal Summons
Objective: Use the Royal Summons and follow Sky Admiral Rogers through the portal to Stormwind Harbor.
Text: Well met. I have come on behalf of King Anduin Wrynn. My crew is preparing for a special mission, and the king would like you to join us. Please review this official summons and, if you are satisfied, return with me to Stormwind Harbor.

Title: Supplies From the Skies
Objective: Gather 5 Skyfire First Aid Kits.
Text: Are you feeling alright? Say 'ah.'  Sorry... we are in desperate need of medical supplies here. The infirmary on the Skyfire was well-stocked, but it's all scattered to the winds now. Anything you can salvage from the wreck will save lives!

Title: Assault on the Temple of Sha'naar
Objective: Assault the Sargerei forces at the Temple of Sha'naar in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Sargerei council continues to work in secret with the warlock, Gul'dan. Up in the hills of Tanaan Jungle, they have converted a once-sacred temple into a den of demonic summoning.We must attack them now, before their rituals complete. The longer we delay, the stronger their forces become.

Title: Feasting on the Dragon
Objective: Slay 15 withered in Azurewing Repose.
Text: You killed their leader, so they came here? Understandable. These creatures crave only one thing - magic - and they can sniff it out from leagues away. Without a leader, they will soon wither and die. Our only recourse in the meantime is to put as many as possible down before they take these dragons with them!

Title: On the Brink
Objective: Use the Radiant Ley Crystal or your healing spells and abilities to resuscitate wounded dragons.
Text: This many withered threaten to wipe our brood out completely! Quickly! Crack off a ley crystal and heal any wounded drakes you can find out on the battlefield. I will do what I can to keep these whelplings safe and healthy.

Title: The Road of Glory
Objective: Chris Clarkie in Stormshield wants you to kill 5 members of the Horde within the Road of Glory.
Text: The Horde intends to force us out of Ashran. We can't let them succeed. March into the Road of Glory and thin their ranks by at least five.

Title: Dream of Argus: The Crystal Reborn
Objective: Locate the crystal reconstruction device and use it to restore the Dream of Argus.
Text: With the shards recovered, it is now possible to restore the Dream of Argus. You must seek out the device that Maatun mentions in his journal, which is said to be in a cave overlooking Anguish Fortress.

Title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The Apexis Device
Objective: Activate the Apexis device and claim the Amulet of Rukhmar.
Text: Now that the keys have been activated, the Apexis device that leads to the amulet should be accessible.The Arakkoa research states that it is likely located in Lost Veil Anzu, within the "shrine to the raven god."

Title: Commander in the Field!
Objective: Get reports from various scouts in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: We have been stopped by these new fel orcs, but we will ultimately prevail. Draka and I did manage to get a full scouting group out into the jungle to gather what else we will have to deal with. You should seek them out, gain a full understanding of what we face here.

Title: Gronnsbane: The Blessing of Beasts
Objective: Defeat the ancient black rylak and douse Gronnsbane in its blood.
Text: Gronnsbane now pulses with energies of fire and frost. All that remains to restore the full power of the weapon is to receive the Blessing of the Beast. Argoram believed this could be accomplished by bloodying the weapon against one of the ancient black rylaks of Stonefury Cliffs. His journal reads:"High in the Stonefury Cliffs, I have seen an altar where the ogres have left offerings to these ancient beasts. Perhaps I could use it to lure one of them"

Title: Agapanthus
Objective: Investigate and assist the visitors in Azurewing Repose.

Title: Gutrek's Cleaver: The Spirit Forge
Objective: Locate the Spirit Forge in Earthshaker Gorge and reforge Gutrek's Cleaver.
Text: With the pieces recovered, all that is left is to reforge Gutrek's Cleaver. Goldspade's journal seems to indicate that the only place to do this is the location where it was initially dismantled.The journal mentions a "Spirit Forge" used to dismantle the blade, and that it may be located somewhere in the nearby gorge. Find the forge and use it to combine the pieces you've gathered.

Title: Dark Grimoire: Breaching the Barrier
Objective: Destroy the ancient barrier below Socrethar's Rise and claim the Grimoire of the Nameless Void.
Text: The components have been gathered and the "Arcane Bunker Buster" is assembled. Hopefully, this should pack enough punch to take out the barrier.There's only one way to find out...

Title: The World Famous Ring of Blood!
Objective: Become Lord of the Ring at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand.
Text: Dear Unadulterated Badass, If you're reading this, you're exactly the sort of tough-as-nails champ in the making we need down at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand. You and two friends are cordially invited to fight for your lives against the toughest creatures this side of Gorgrond. It's positively brutal - and the crowd loves it! Come talk to me to start your first fight - beat four of the fiercest creatures I've got and you'll get a shot at the champ himself! -Gurgthock

Title: Dream of Argus: The First Fragment
Objective: Follow the clue from the journal to find Lor Stonefist. Defeat her and claim the Rough Crystal Shard.
Text: In his quest to restore the Dream of Argus, Maatun enlisted the help of three orcs. These same orcs betrayed him and took the crystal shards before they could be combined. If you find these orcs, they may still have them.The first target shouldn't be far. The journal reads:"I was told she spent most of her time in the crystal cave to the north of the encampment. There she studied the native crystals for ways to improve their potential abilities."

Title: The Silent Skull: Taking from the Taker
Objective: Use the Laughing Skull elixir to find Skulltaker and claim the Silent Skull.
Text: With the reagents found, you should seek out Grinning Tolg's camp in the nearby cave to brew the elixir.Once the elixir is consumed, you should be able to communicate with the ravagers there. With any luck, they should be able to bring you to Skulltaker.His mask should bring a hefty reward.

Title: Dream of Argus: The Crystal Reborn
Objective: Locate the crystal reconstruction device and use it to restore the Dream of Argus.
Text: With the shards recovered, it is now possible to restore the Dream of Argus. You must seek out the device that Maatun mentions in his journal, which is said to be in a cave overlooking Anguish Fortress.

Title: Dream of Argus: The Second Fragment
Objective: Follow the clue in the journal to find Vok Blacktongue. Defeat him and claim the Cracked Crystal Shard.
Text: The second orc that Matuun mentioned was a master runecarver and sorcerer. He should be located somewhere in the main camp. The journal reads:"She mentioned that the orc could normally found in one of the runemaster's huts in the southern part of the camp. They could be identified by the standing stones surrounding the structure, as well as the floating runestones above."

Title: Assault on the Fel Forge
Objective: Assault the Iron Horde reinforcements at Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

Title: Dream of Argus: The Final Fragment
Objective: Follow the clue in the journal to find Koros Soulsplinter. Defeat him and claim the Smooth Crystal Shard.
Text: The last orc to be found was a hermit who kept away from the bulk of the Shadowmoon orcs at the Pillars of Fate camp, but was often seen in the high hills above. The journal reads:"It is said, however, that he can often be seen among the graves upon the high hill, overlooking the camp below. There he would commune with the dead ancestors, whom it is said he preferred over his living brethren."

Title: Treasure Contract: The Artificer
Objective: Search near the entrance of the Pillars of Fate for evidence of Artificer Maatun's crystal.
Text: I have heard of a draenei artificer by the name of Maatun that was seeking to restore an old draenei crystal, possibly of naaru origin. He called the crystal the Dream of Argus.The draenei went missing after seeking out help from the Shadowmoon orcs back before they allied themselves with the Iron Horde. One of your scouts recently spotted a draenei matching the description of Maatun near the entrance of the Pillars of Fate. Go there and see what you can dig up.

Title: Assault on the Temple of Sha'naar
Objective: Assault the Sargerei forces at the Temple of Sha'naar in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: Up in the hills of Tanaan Jungle, the Sargerei have converted a once-sacred temple into a den of demonic summoning.We must attack them now, before their rituals complete. The longer we delay, the stronger our enemy grows.

Title: To Gul'dan!
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar outside of Bladefury's Command in Northern Talador.
Text: We must act quickly - Garona here tells me that Gul'dan is on the move. He is headed to the Path of Glory to meet with Grommash Hellscream. We have to act while our intelligence is fresh! Hurry and meet us outside of Bladefury's Command in northern Talador. We won't be able to engage Gul'dan and the whole Iron Horde army on our own, but we may just learn something to use against them...

Title: Leyline Abuse
Objective: Slay Iskhaneth and Tyndrissen.
Text: These monsters are pulling mana directly out of the ground. This explains why not even my mana pools can dull my pain. I worry about my brood. Without the power of the ley lines, we are nothing. At this rate, I may not even be able to help you with your Tidestone. Look for their mana siphons, and punish the cowardly nightfallen elves that are using them.

Title: The Hunger Returns
Objective: Obtain 4 Charged Mana Jewels.
Text: I can help you, and I very much want to help you, but I'm a bit distracted. Look at all that raw, unfiltered, mouthwatering mana...  No! NO! You must stay in control! I simply need to clear my head. Yes, that's it. A few of my depraved brethren carry small mana jewels around with them in case they need a quick burst of energy. Find a few for me? Then I will show you how to get your ley line back.

Title: Bringing the Bass
Objective: Collect a Bass Blaster, Laz-Tron Disc Reader, Phonic Amplifier, S.P.R.K. Capacitor, and a Cord of Ancient Wood.
Text: You know what would boost morale around here?Bass. Beats. Music!Everyone loves a party! You go out and get me some hardware, and I'll make a system that will shatter Draenor itself.

Title: Runas the Shamed
Objective: Slay Runas the Shamed.
Text: I fell so quickly. I am not as strong as I once was. We truly do need your help. One of these disgusting creatures ran off with several of the whelplings. I heard him called by name: Runas. I will survive. Home is not far. You still have strength, though. Slay this Runas before he does any more damage to our brood.

Title: Death to Nullifier Darkoor!
Objective: Speak to Gurgthock at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand and win the special exhibition match.
Text: Da goblin Gurgthock stopped by and be sayin' that Mogor wants his Blood Champion to fight in an exhibition match against something terrible he's dug up. Dat be you, boss. If you be ready, whisper to Gurgthock "I seek da seeker." He take care of da rest.

Title: Death to Nullifier Darkoor!
Objective: Speak to Gurgthock at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand and win the special exhibition match.
Text: Gurgthock stopped by from the Ring of Blood and said that Mogor wants his Blood Champion to participate in a special exhibition match. That's you, commander! Just whisper "I seek the seeker." into Gurgthock's ear and he'll get things going for ya!

Title: The Silent Skull: The First Reagent
Objective: Follow the clue from the journal to find the Shadethisle Leaves.
Text: Grinning Tolg was in the process of brewing an elixir that would allow him to communicate with the ravagers, whom the Skulltaker relies on to remain hidden.The first ingredient, the leaves of the Shadethistle plant, can be found nearby. The journal reads:"It rests in the shadows of the harsh Gorgrond sun. I saw some under standing stones near the black iron walls."

Title: Assault on Ironhold Harbor
Objective: Assault the Iron Horde reinforcements at Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Iron Horde continues to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

Title: The Silent Skull: The Third Reagent
Objective: Follow the clue from the journal to find the Steamcap Mushrooms.
Text: The final component of the elixir is a handful of Steamcap mushrooms. The journal reads:"The Crowfeeder said that they grow among the steam vents in the higher parts of the Everbloom. I have seen one such place above the northern hydra pools."

Title: The Silent Skull: Taking from the Taker
Objective: Use the Laughing Skull elixir to find Skulltaker and claim the Silent Skull.
Text: With the reagents found, you should seek out Grinning Tolg's camp in the nearby cave to brew the elixir.Once the elixir is consumed, you should be able to communicate with the ravagers there. With any luck, they should be able to bring you to Skulltaker.His mask should bring a hefty reward.

Title: The Silent Skull: The Second Reagent
Objective: Follow the clue from the journal to find the Bonethorn Vine.
Text: The second ingredient to the elixir is a vine from the Bonethorn plant. The journal reads:"I must find a vine of bonethorn, which grows in the bones of the ancient dead. I remember seeing the bones of a long-dead beast in the dry beds of the northern wilds. Its sun-parched skull would make a pleasant home for such a plant."

Title: Treasure Contract: The Infected Orc
Objective: Find Grinning Tolg's journal among the mutated orcs in Everbloom Wilds.
Text: In Gorgrond, the Laughing Skull clan has a legend of one called Skulltaker. His mask, known only as the Silent Skull, is legendary among the clan, and could help us learn more about them.Until recently, he was thought to have vanished. Now it appears he has shown his face, so to speak, in Everbloom Wilds. The last orc to have seen him fell to the botani there, but may still have some clues on how you can find Skulltaker and recover the mask.If the botani have him, he may not be cooperative.

Title: The Assault Base
Objective: Establish your assault base in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: Nearby be a good place. Not too close to da enemy, but close enough for us to take some pressure off da boys in the west. Follow me.

Title: Uncovering the Artifact Fragments
Objective: Harrison Jones in Stormshield Stronghold wants you to go kill creatures in the outskirts of Ashran outside of the main road and bring back 5 Artifact Fragments to Ecilam.
Text: The Artifact Fragments seem to come from any creature we've found in the outskirts of Ashran. Go out and kill any you find and bring at least five to Ecilam the Mage near the campfire in Stormshield Stronghold.

Title: In, Through, and Beyond!
Objective: Destroy the Fel Defense Cannon covering the gate.
Text: A few of us snuck through before we was spotted, den de cannons started up. De small ones are no trouble, but de big one... we gonna need to take it out if we wanna get anyting through.

Title: We Meet at Light's Hope
Objective: Enter the portal to Light's Hope Chapel and speak to Tirion Fordring.
Text: Thank the Light I found you! Highlord Fordring has called all paladins to Light's Hope Chapel to discuss our next course of action following the Broken Shore. He sent me to personally make sure you were in attendance. I will ask Khadgar to direct this portal to Light's Hope for you. We must make haste.

Title: Maritime Salvage
Objective: Mark 7 supply caches with flags.
Text: It would go a bit faster if you could mark any bigger piles of resources you see while you are clearing those guys out. Just drop this flag down and someone will be along directly!

Title: Clearing the Docks
Objective: Kill 1 Iron Horde orcs and 50 ogron.
Text: Our salvage team thought these here docks would be abandoned, but they're crawlin' wit' remnants of the Iron Horde. Gul'dan's cronies are convertin' anyone they can and evacuatin' everyone to Tanaan Jungle. Commander, if yeh can clear this place out, my team can salvage some of this equipment. Plus, ev'ry orc yeh kill here is one less ta worry about in Tanaan!

Title: Gronnsbane: The Blessing of Beasts
Objective: Defeat the ancient black rylak and douse Gronnsbane in its blood.
Text: Gronnsbane now pulses with energies of fire and frost. All that remains to restore the full power of the weapon is to receive the Blessing of the Beast. Argoram believed this could be accomplished by bloodying the weapon against one of the ancient black rylaks of Stonefury Cliffs. His journal reads:"High in the Stonefury Cliffs, I have seen an altar where the ogres have left offerings to these ancient beasts. Perhaps I could use it to lure one of them"

Title: Gronnsbane: The Broken Spear
Objective: Search throughout Magnarok for Gronnsbane's blade, haft, and weight.
Text: Looking through Argoram's journal, it becomes apparent that claiming this relic will be far more complicated than simply finding the pieces of the spear.However, that would be the best place to start...

Title: Gronnsbane: The Blessing of Frost
Objective: Follow the clue to find the Frozen Shamanstone and receive the Blessing of Frost.
Text: The weapon has been imbued with the Blessing of Fire, drawing power from the Molten Shamanstone. The Frozen Shamanstone should impart the next blessing. Argoram mentions its location in his journal:"As I was maneuvering away from the great boulders hurled at me by the ogron brutes, I glanced what looked like another monolith atop the tallest of the snow-capped towers in Bloodmaul. Perhaps this is the Frozen Shamanstone, which is thought to grant the Blessing of Frost"

Title: Gronnsbane: The Blessing of Fire
Objective: Follow the clue to find the Molten Shamanstone and receive the Blessing of Fire.
Text: The weapon has been assembled, but it lacks the power that made it a legend. In order to restore it, you must receive three blessings: one of fire, one of frost, and one of beasts.The first blessing mentioned in the journal is that of fire. The journal reads:"He describes an ancient monolith, perched upon the edge of a precipice extending from the cliff where the searing magma falls into the sea. I believe the location he speaks of is just overlooking Tor'goroth's Tooth."

Title: The Real Race
Objective: Run through the Start Banner, hit the Blue Post, then the Green Post, then the Red Post, then return to the Start Banner.
Text: Ok, Darkmoon Racer, let's see what you got!The real race has four legs: get to the blue post, then green, then red, then back here.Your time matters, so do it fast!

Title: Treasure Contract: The Thunderlord Sage
Objective: Locate the Thunderlord sage Argoram in Magnarok.
Text: In Frostfire Ridge, a Thunderlord sage by the name of Argoram seems to have uncovered the whereabouts of a storied weapon, known to the orcs as Gronnsbane.He was last spotted headed into Magnarok. Find him and see if he can lead you to this relic.

Title: Obstacle Course
Objective: Find any information on the forces deployed in the area and meet with the scouts afterwards.
Text: It is strange that these docks were abandoned by the Iron Horde, but up ahead our scouts report trouble. A set of Bleeding Hollow scavengers is busy looting the abandoned buildings to the northwest. Further down the road orc cultists are doing... something... near the Dark Portal. We should try to recover any orders or information as to what is going on here, then meet with our scouts further in...

Title: The Real Big Race
Objective: Run through the Start Banner, hit the Purple Post, then the Green Post, then the Red Post, then the return to the Start Banner.
Text: Here's the big one! Good luck out there!This race has four legs: get to the purple post, then green, then red, then back here.Your time matters, so do it fast!

Title: Assault on Ironhold Harbor
Objective: Assault the Iron Horde reinforcements at Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
Text: The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

Title: The Invasion of Tanaan
Objective: Meet with Khadgar and then speak to Draka to start the invasion.
Text: It is done! By your command we have built our first ship and can run our naval operations from here. Now that we have our transport, we can let Durotan and that Archmage of yours know that we are ready to kick off an invasion of Tanaan. Speak with them at the docks to embark.

Title: Dark Grimoire: The Second Ingredient
Objective: Follow the clue from Megacharge's Cookbook to find the high voltage detonator.
Text: With the blasting powder acquired, you now must find a suitable detonator. A note attached to the entry in the cookbook hints to where one might be found:"Reminder: Order more high-voltage detonators. The last shipment was lost off of the Shadowmoon coast near the demon-inhabited cliffs. Maybe we should send a diving team to salvage."

Title: Dark Grimoire: The First Ingredient
Objective: Follow the clue from Megacharge's Cookbook to locate some precision blasting powder.
Text: You will need three ingredients to make Megacharge's special "Arcane Bunker Buster," which should be able to take down the barrier. The first ingredient, some precision blasting powder, should be available nearby. The book reads:"To make one, you'll first need to acquire some high grade, precision blasting powder. Here in Blackfuse Company, it's pretty easy to come by, since they use it for all of the cannons."

Title: Treasure Contract: Explosive Discoveries
Objective: Defeat Demolitionist Megacharge in Darktide Roost and take his explosives cookbook.
Text: In Shadowmoon Valley there is a cave said to possess an ancient tome that may contain secrets that can help our cause against the Iron Horde. The cave, however, is protected by an ancient barrier composed of arcane energy.There is a goblin in Darktide Roost, said to know how to take down any barrier. Persuade him to give up his secrets and bring back the book.

Title: More Big Racing!
Objective: Run through the Start Banner, hit the Purple Post, then the Green Post, then the Red Post, then the return to the Start Banner.
Text: You like this big race, do you? Me too!It has four legs: get to the purple post, then green, then red, then back here.Your time matters, so do it fast!

Title: Dark Grimoire: Breaching the Barrier
Objective: Destroy the ancient barrier below Socrethar's Rise and claim the Grimoire of the Nameless Void.
Text: The components have been gathered and the "Arcane Bunker Buster" is assembled. Hopefully, this should pack enough punch to take out the barrier.There's only one way to find out...

Title: Dark Grimoire: The Final Ingredient
Objective: Collect blood from demons in Socrethar's Rise.
Text: The final ingredient to create Megacharge's bomb is a sizable quantity of demon's blood.Unfortunately, that's not something they're likely to give up easily...

Title: The Nightborne Prince
Objective: Slay Ael'Yith.
Text: I sense it now. In the ruined building, to the east. One of these cretins must have tapped deep into the ley line. I suspect he will be heavily defended. Once again, the well-being of my brood is in your hands.

Title: The Consumed
Objective: Find a Dim Ley Crystal, then revive 10 Mana-Drained Whelplings.

Title: Still Alive
Objective: Speak with Stellagosa to take a ride back to Azurewing Repose.
Text: Wait, what was it that I heard? Was it... "feast on the dragons"? We must check on grandfather, right away! Let me know when you're ready to depart.

Title: You Scratch My Back...
Objective: Release the whelplings on each of the Mana Collector Pylons in Zarkhenar.
Text: Much better. I knew I could count on you, my friend. Allow me to return the favor. I know how you can destroy the large mana collector pylons. We shall save your dragon yet! The pylons only work against ground targets, yet they're defenseless from above. Send your whelplings at them, my friend. The whelplings can fly where we cannot. Trust me.

Title: Stellagosa
Objective: Find Stellagosa.
Text: Something is wrong. I sent Stellagosa to assist you, but I can no longer sense her. Please, go out there and find out what's happened to my granddaughter.

Title: Runas Knows the Way
Objective: Allow Runas to escort you.
Text: I wish to make it up to you for whatever I did that made you want to kill me. Hmm... your dragon complains about being weak. I know why. Runas can fix it, my friend. One of my kind, Ael'Yith, pulls ley energy from the very ground of Azsuna. I can take you to the location of his mana siphons. It's not too late to undo the harm the others have done. You've done well to trust me.

Title: The Death of the Eldest
Objective: Slay Leyworms to obtain 6 Crackling Leyworm Cores, then drop them into Senegos's pool.
Text: I will do what I can to stabilize him, but I will need your help. The small amount of energy he has left is coming from the mana pool he rests in. Follow the whelplings' lead. Dropping ley crystals into the pool gives him a bit of energy - buying him a few more breaths. They seem to be getting the crystals from inside that cave to the north.

Title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The Apexis Device
Objective: Activate the Apexis device and claim the Amulet of Rukhmar.
Text: Now that the keys have been activated, the Apexis device that leads to the amulet should be accessible.The Arakkoa research states that it is likely located in Lost Veil Anzu, within the "shrine to the raven god."

Title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The Final Key
Objective: Find and activate the final key to the Apexis device.
Text: One last key is required to access the Apexis device. The writings pertaining to its location read:"The final key has been housed deep within the fungal caves where the river makes its final drop. Though the pale orcs that dwell there may be vile, they should prove a worthy deterrent."

Title: The Last of the Last
Objective: Investigate the Azurewing Whelplands.
Text: We need help. Since the fall of Deathwing, we dragons have lost nearly all of our power. To make matters worse, we can no longer bear eggs. My whelplings are the last of the last. I need you, champion. Help defend my whelplands, and I swear to you, the blues will be at your side when you need them.

Title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The Second Key
Objective: Find and activate the second key to the Apexis device.
Text: The first point has been activated and two more remain. The second location is hinted at in the old outcast writing:"Beneath the third fall of the great Skettis river lay the second key. May the ever-rushing waters sweep away those that might seek it."

Title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The First Key
Objective: Find and activate the first key to the Apexis device.
Text: The Arakkoa research points to three "keys" that need to be activated in order to use the Apexis device. The first is located in Skettis. The text mentioning it reads:"The first key is kept in the high reaches of upper Skettis. It lay where the dead can protect it from the talons of the unwanted."

Title: Mana Bark
Objective: Collect 8 Mana Bark.
Text: We need bark from the trees if we are going to fix the wood. Being a mortal, you can walk right in and pick up the mana bark without any trouble, as long as you don't get eaten by something. Can you get us some mana bark?

Title: The Withered
Objective: Slay 12 withered in the Azurewing Whelplands.
Text: The withered are the worst kind of pest. They capture our whelplings, knock them unconscious, and then drink whatever mana they can from the helpless babes. Normally our drakes and keepers would fend them off. Today, it looks like we may need your help.

Title: Treasure Contract: Amulet of Rukhmar
Objective: Search the ruins of upper Skettis for the Arakkoa research involving the Amulet of Rukhmar.
Text: It seems the Adherents of Rukhmar have stumbled upon some information leading to an ancient amulet, said to possess the power of their god and bestow it upon the wearer. We should make sure they don't find it.Head to Skettis and find what they have learned. Hopefully we can find it before they get to it.

Title: Essence of the Unbound
Objective: Collect 20 Unbound Essences.
Text: I need your help, mortal. Something has warded the Mana Wood against our kind That same something is changing the song of the wood. We can hear it. Enter the wood and gather essence from some of the local wildlife and maybe we can track this thing down. I will project an image of myself in the wood for when you are done.

Title: Draenor's Blessing
Objective: Speak with Drek'Thar at the Throne of the Elements in Nagrand.
Text: You've done everything I've asked. I believe we can apply one final enchantment to your ring. But... we must be cautious. Last time I augmented your ring I killed you. (Sorry.) It will take an act of ancient magic to empower you further. Fortunately, you've made some powerful allies during your time here. Seek out Farseer Drek'Thar at the Throne of Elements in Nagrand. There you can receive the blessing of the elements and safely unlock your ring's final form. Go, hero! Claim your reward!

Title: The Final Assault
Objective: Speak with your faction leader in your garrison and complete the quests to build a shipyard. Khadgar will meet you there when it's built.
Text: Our campaign in Draenor has taken an unexpected turn. With Gul'dan assuming power over the Iron Horde, history is poised to repeat itself - our world is in more peril than ever. It's time to bring the full might of your garrison to bear against Tanaan Jungle. Build a shipyard for your garrison! I will meet you at your new shipyard and we will discuss our next move from there.

Title: Rift Rippers
Objective: Seal 3 Unbound Rifts.
Text: Something is opening rifts to the twisting nether using the ley line energy. That is never a good thing. Our kind may not be able to enter the forest, but you can. Take this gem and look for these unbound rifts. The gem will let you seal these breaches. I will project an image of myself into the forest when you are done.

Title: Light Be With You
Objective: Meet Yrel at the Coliseum of Light near the Temple of Karabor.
Text: You've done everything I've asked. I believe we can apply one final enchantment to your ring. But... we must be cautious. Last time I augmented your ring I killed you. (Sorry.) It will take a divine act to empower you further. Fortunately, you've made some powerful allies during your time here. Travel to the Temple of Karabor, where Yrel is waiting for you. With the blessing of a Naaru your ring will become as powerful and unique as - well, as you yourself. Go to Karabor. You've earned it.

Title: The Shadow War
Objective: Slay 15 Shadow Council members in the Den of Secrets.
Text: The Shadow Council are more entrenched than you expected. A large contingent seems focused on infiltrating the draenei Exarch Council in the town above. Khadgar certainly wouldn't complain if you did a little... "housecleaning."

Title: Breaking Badness
Objective: Speak with Khadgar and assist him as he frees Garona from Gul'dan's mind control.
Text: It is time to liberate Garona. I know what to do... I think. I'd like you to stay close in case anything goes wrong. Speak with me when you are ready to begin.

Title: An Inside Job
Objective: Infiltrate Bladefury's Command with Garona's help. Use her talents to eliminate guards without being seen. Locate Iron Horde intelligence and then spy on Gul'dan.
Text: If Garona's intelligence is correct, Gul'dan will be inside this Iron Horde compound. With Garona's help, slip inside, gather any info you find, and learn what Gul'dan intends to do. The guards are on high alert. Garona can "liquidate" individual guards for you, but she must not be seen! You will have to choose your targets carefully and pick your way through the bastion undetected. Don't let anyone sound the alarm. If things get too hot, I'll teleport you to safety. At least... I'll try.

Title: Orb of Dominion
Objective: Retrieve an Orb of Dominion from the Den of Secrets in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: Gul'dan and his Shadow Council have their hooks embedded deep into Garona's soul. We've tried traditional magical methods and they haven't helped her. It's time to get unorthodox.  I've just learned of a Shadow Council holdout hidden beneath the Draenei city of Elodor. They are using an Orb of Dominion to brainwash spies. Quickly! Assault the cave and recover the orb for me. We will turn this dark magic to our advantage.

Title: Death to Tremor!
Objective: Kill Tremor west of Gorgorek's Fall in Gorgrond and obtain the Pile of Partially Digested Lobstrok Meat.
Text: Da Gorgrond outpost be havin' troubles with saberon, and we can't afford ta throw troops at the problem any longer. Don't worry, I be havin' an idea. There be an enormous worm beast on the west coast of Gorgrond called Tremor, da devourer of lobstroks. If you killed da beast and brought da pile of lobstrok meat back here, we can cook it 'ere, send it to da outpost, and use it to calm da saberon for good!

Title: Death to Hivelord Ik'rix!
Objective: Retrieve the Iceshatter Carapace from Hiveord Ik'rix at Southwind Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.
Text: We been tryin' out a new way to temper weapons with ice ravager carapaces. Der icy hides are perfect for da process. Hivelord Ik'rix in da Southwind Cliffs nearby is rumored to be da largest ravager we ever seen - if you could bring its carapace back, we'd be able to make all sorts of things!

Title: UNUSED: Test Race: 1 Marker
Objective: Run through the arch, hit the blue marker, then return to the Ironelf games camp.
Text: Run through the arch... Get to the blue marker... then return Good luck!

Title: Death to Undertow!
Objective: Kill Undertow in the Tanaan Channel north of Umbrafen in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: We be havin' a problem, commander. We been sendin' some small boats into the Tanaan Channel north of da Umbrafen in Shadowmoon ta spy on da Alliance base der as well as da Iron Horde in Tanaan Jungle. Da problem is dat every boat we send out come back in pieces, if it come back at all. We think a water elemental called Undertow is da culprit. I know you be busy, but destroyin' that creature would be very helpful to our efforts.

Title: Death to Nullifier Darkoor!
Objective: Speak to Gurgthock at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand and win the special exhibition match.
Text: Da goblin Gurgthock be requestin' your presence at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand, boss-mon. It seems that Mogor, da lord of da ring, be holdin' an exhibition match der and he want you to fight his newest acquisition. I think it be safe, commander. I heard of dis goblin's work before. If you be ready, whisper to him "I seek da seeker."

Title: Death to Gor'thul!
Objective: Slay Gor'thul at Bloodmane Pridelands in Spires of Arak.
Text: We been hearin' 'bout some real, real bad voodoo in Spires of Arak, commander. Da Shattered Hand shaman Gor'thul be seen sneakin' about da spires the same time we be hearin' of saberon spirits attackin' our supply caravans and our arakkoa allies. I think it best if we take no chances. You should deal with da shaman personally before dis matter gets out of hand.

Title: Gutrek's Cleaver: The Spirit Forge
Objective: Locate the Spirit Forge in Earthshaker Gorge and reforge Gutrek's Cleaver.
Text: With the pieces recovered, all that is left is to reforge Gutrek's Cleaver. Goldspade's journal seems to indicate that the only place to do this is the location where it was initially dismantled.The journal mentions a "Spirit Forge" used to dismantle the blade, and that it may be located somewhere in the nearby gorge. Find the forge and use it to combine the pieces you've gathered.

Title: Death to Amethon!
Objective: Retrieve a Humming Draenite Spike from Amethon above Kuuro's Claim in Talador.
Text: Foreman Grobash in da Talador outpost figures he knows why der's been so much seismic activity recently. Der be an earth fury called Amethon that be covered in powerful crystals in a cave up above Kuuro's Claim. Da crystals' hummin' be drivin' da fury crazy! We want a sample to see if we can figure out why da crystals are so powerful. I wouldn't be askin' ya if I thought anybody else could do it, commander.

Title: Welcome to the Darkmoon Races
Objective: Run through the Darkmoon Races Start Banner, hit the Blue Post, then return to the Darkmoon Races Start Banner.
Text: So this is your first race, eh? Don't worry - it's easier than it looks. Let me break it down for you...Run through that big banner there. That starts everything. Then, follow the smaller banners until you see a big, blue Post. Hit that, then return here.You're scored on your time, so finish as fast as you can! And watch out for those electrified tripwires. They'll slow you down if you run through them. Good luck!

Title: Gutrek's Cleaver: The Second Piece
Objective: Follow the clue from the journal to find Gutrek's hilt.
Text: The search for Gutrek's Cleaver continues. The journal reads:"The hilt was to be buried in the marshlands, among the serpents whose poison claimed Gutrek's life. There's something here about covering it with a spiral stone, which is supposed to keep Gutrek's spirit at bay somehow."

Title: Gutrek's Cleaver: The Final Piece
Objective: Follow the clue from the journal to find Gutrek's blade.
Text: Only one piece remains. The journal reads:"The final piece, Gutrek's blade, was to be displayed in a place of honor for all time overlooking the Ring of Blood. I don't think I've seen it there myself, but it says it's supposed to be somewhere where it has a clear view of every battle."

Title: Auchindoun
Objective: Defeat Teron'gor in Auchindoun.
Text: Commander, Gul'dan's favored agent Teron'gor has infiltrated Auchindoun in Talador and has already taken to devourin' the countless souls within. We mustn't let this nefarious warlock gain any further strength. Enter the holy mausoleum o' Auchindoun and rout Teron'gor and the rest o' the Shadow Council before more damage is done.

Title: Gutrek's Cleaver: The First Piece
Objective: Follow the clue from the journal to find Gutrek's pommel.
Text: The journal points to the location of the pieces of Gutrek's Cleaver. It reads:"The pommel was brought to the Broken Precipice, where it was to be housed in the skull of Gutrek's first kill. It looks like it was some manner of large beast that he fought in the big bone pit."

Title: Grimrail Depot
Objective: Defeat Skylord Tovra in Grimrail Depot.
Text: We must move quickly, commander. As we speak the Grimrail is preparing to depart Grimrail Depot to deliver a massive battalion o' troops to Shattrath. Rumor has it that they have outfitted the train with a weapon strong enough to shatter the shield protectin' the inner city. Skylord Tovra has taken to guardin' the train on its journey to Talador. You must stop Tovra and the Grimrail before it reaches Shattrath!

Title: Bloodmaul Slag Mines
Objective: Defeat Gug'rokk in the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
Text: The Bloodmaul ogres are brutal slavers, commander. Innocents from across Draenor are dragged deep into the volcanic slag mines in Frostfire Ridge to dredge up cart after cart o' gems and ore, never to return. We suspect that they have turned their focus to unearthin' an ancient relic o' immense power for their sorcerer-king. The ogre Gug'rokk rules over the slag mines with an iron fist. Take him down and the mines will fall as well.

Title: Skyreach
Objective: Defeat High Sage Viryx in Skyreach.
Text: High Sage Viryx has finished a devastatin' crystal superweapon atop the highest point in Skyreach in Spires of Arak. She intends to eradicate the 'lesser races' in the name of their god Rukhmar. The arakkoa outcasts were nearly wiped out in mere seconds by the weapon. You must stop Viryx before she turns her sights to your garrison!

Title: Shadowmoon Burial Grounds
Objective: Defeat Ner'zhul in the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
Text: Ner'zhul wasn't always evil - once he was the wise chieftain and elder shaman o' the Shadowmoon clan. In his desperate bid to join the Iron Horde he's forsaken all he once stood for and twisted his ancestors' spirits to tap into dark, forbidden power... all to please Hellscream. Enter their ancestral burial grounds and put an end to Ner'zhul's madness before he pulls all o' Draenor into the engulfing maw o' the void.

Title: Iron Docks
Objective: Defeat Skulloc in the Iron Docks.
Text: The Iron Docks is one o' the Iron Horde's greatest assets in this war. Our scouts have reported that the docks are alight with activity, indicatin' imminent attack. Skulloc, son o' Gruul, was seen leavin' the Blackrock Foundry, armed to the teeth with powerful cannons, and has been loaded onto their mightiest warship. It doesn't matter where they intend to strike, commander - you must sack the Iron Docks and defeat Skulloc before they ever leave!

Title: The Everbloom
Objective: Defeat Yalnu in the Everbloom.
Text: The Kirin Tor created an outpost in Gorgrond with a portal to Stormwind to facilitate quick reinforcements in the assault on the Blackrock Foundry. Unfortunately they built it in the heart o' the Everbloom, home to the botani and the mightiest o' the genesaur - Yalnu. The outpost has already been overrun and it is only a matter o' time before the overgrowth spreads to Stormwind... and with it the whole of Azeroth.

Title: Skyreach
Objective: Defeat High Sage Viryx in Skyreach.
Text: High Sage Viryx has finished a devastating crystal superweapon atop the highest point in Skyreach in Spires of Arak. She intends to eradicate the 'lesser races' in the name of their god Rukhmar. The arakkoa outcasts were nearly wiped out in mere seconds by the weapon. You must stop Viryx before she turns her sights to your garrison, commander.

Title: Upper Blackrock Spire
Objective: Defeat Warlord Zaela in Upper Blackrock Spire.
Text: Hellscream's Ironmarch vanguard managed to reach Blackrock Mountain and has allied with Warlord Zaela o' the Dragonmaw clan. Even now the Iron Horde readies to invade Azeroth while Zaela prepares a doomsday weapon in the heart o' the mountain to ensure nothing stands in their way. You must put a stop to Zaela once and for all, commander. She's been a thorn in our side for too long.

Title: The Everbloom
Objective: Defeat Yalnu in the Everbloom.
Text: The Kirin Tor created an outpost in Gorgrond with a portal to Stormwind to facilitate quick reinforcements in the assault on the Blackrock Foundry. In their infinite wisdom they built it in the heart of the Everbloom, home to the botani and the mightiest of the genesaur - Yalnu. The outpost has already been overrun and it is only a matter of time before the overgrowth spreads to Stormwind... and with it the whole of Azeroth.

Title: Upper Blackrock Spire
Objective: Defeat Warlord Zaela in Upper Blackrock Spire.
Text: Hellscream's Ironmarch vanguard managed to reach Blackrock Mountain and has allied with Warlord Zaela of the Dragonmaw clan. Even now the Iron Horde readies to invade Azeroth while Zaela prepares a doomsday weapon in the heart of the mountain to ensure nothing stands in their way. You must put a stop to Zaela once and for all, commander. She has been a thorn in our side for too long.

Title: Shadowmoon Burial Grounds
Objective: Defeat Ner'zhul in the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
Text: Ner'zhul was once a noble orc - he was the wise chieftain and elder shaman of the Shadowmoon clan. In his desperate bid to join the Iron Horde he has spat on all he once stood for and twisted his ancestors' spirits to tap into dark, forbidden power... all to please Hellscream. The Shadowmoon has fallen, commander. Enter their ancestral burial grounds and put an end to Ner'zhul's madness before he pulls all of Draenor into the engulfing maw of the void.

Title: Iron Docks
Objective: Defeat Skulloc in the Iron Docks.
Text: The Iron Docks is one of the Iron Horde's greatest assets in this war. Our scouts have reported that the docks are alight with activity, indicating imminent attack. Skulloc, son of Gruul, was seen leaving the Blackrock Foundry, armed to the teeth with powerful cannons, and has been loaded onto their mightiest warship. It does not matter where they intend to strike, commander - you must sack the Iron Docks and defeat Skulloc before they ever leave.

Title: Grimrail Depot
Objective: Defeat Skylord Tovra in Grimrail Depot.
Text: We must move quickly, commander. As we speak the Grimrail is preparing to depart Grimrail Depot to deliver a massive battalion of troops to Shattrath. Rumor has it that they have outfitted the train with a weapon strong enough to shatter the shield protecting the inner city. Skylord Tovra has taken to guarding the train on its journey to Talador. You must stop Tovra and the Grimrail before it reaches Shattrath!

Title: Auchindoun
Objective: Defeat Teron'gor in Auchindoun.
Text: Commander, Gul'dan's favored agent Teron'gor has infiltrated Auchindoun in Talador and has already taken to devouring the countless souls within. We must not let this nefarious warlock gain any further strength. Enter the holy mausoleum of Auchindoun and rout Teron'gor and the rest of the Shadow Council before more damage is done.

Title: Treasure Contract: Gutrek's Cleaver
Objective: Search the ogres in the Broken Precipice for clues regarding Goldspade's discovery.
Text: In Nagrand, the ogres tell of an ancient weapon called Gutrek's cleaver. I would very much like to study it.A goblin treasure hunter by the name of Val Goldspade discovered the whereabouts of the weapon. Unfortunately, this goblin has gone missing somewhere in the Broken Precipice - probably after a run-in with the locals.

Title: Bloodmaul Slag Mines
Objective: Defeat Gug'rokk in the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
Text: The Bloodmaul ogres are brutal slavers, commander. Innocents from across Draenor are dragged deep into the volcanic slag mines in Frostfire Ridge to dredge up cart after cart of gems and ore, never to return. We suspect that they have turned their focus to unearthing an ancient relic of immense power for their sorcerer-king. The ogre Gug'rokk rules over the slag mines with an iron fist. Take him down and the mines will fall as well.

Title: Death to Nullifier Darkoor!
Objective: Speak to Gurgthock at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand and win the special exhibition match.
Text: You ever heard of the Ring of Blood, commander? It's pretty simple. Big ogre named Mogor loves watching people fight for their lives against savage beasts. Ambitious goblin called Gurgthock arranges the fights and rakes in the profits. Anwyays, Gurgthock and I are long time buddies and he's arranged a special exhibition match just for you! Pretty sweet, right? Just whisper into his ear "I seek the seeker."

Title: Death to Tremor!
Objective: Kill Tremor west of Gorgorek's Fall in Gorgrond and obtain the Pile of Partially Digested Lobstrok Meat.
Text: Your outpost in Gorgrond has a serious saberon problem, commander, and we can't really afford to keep sending more troops to help 'em out. So I have an idea. There's an enormous worm beast on the west coast of Gorgrond called Tremor, better known as the devourer of lobstroks. If you took that thing down and brought the, well, pile of partially digested lobstrok meat back here, we can cook it here, ship it back there, use it to calm the saberon for a good long time!

Title: Death to Hivelord Ik'rix!
Objective: Retrieve the Iceshatter Carapace from Hivelord Ik'rix at Southwind Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.
Text: We've got a radical new idea to try using ice ravager carapaces in our tempering process for armor and weapons. It's the sort of trailblazing work we strive for, commander! Only problem is, ravagers apparently aren't keen on our guys and gals taking their carapaces off of them. There's this particular ravager at the Southwind Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge called Hivelord Ik'rix - if you could take him down we wouldn't need more for weeks!

Title: Death to Amethon!
Objective: Retrieve a Humming Draenite Spike from Amethon above Kuuro's Claim in Talador.
Text: Foreman Eksos down in your Talador outpost figures he has the answer for why there's been so much seismic activity recently. See, there's this giant, ah... earth fury, I think they're called, and it's covered in these powerful crystals in a cave up above Kuuro's Claim. The crystals hum real loud and we think it's driving the fury crazy! Problem is, nobody's got the firepower to take the thing down so we can examine a sample. Think you could lend us a hand, commander?

Title: Death to Undertow!
Objective: Kill Undertow in the Tanaan Channel north of Umbrafen in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: Good day to ya, commander! I have bad news. We've been contracting out some spy work to the local fisherman - we pay 'em some coin, they take their boats out north of Umbrafen and see what the Iron Horde's up to. Win-win, right? Well, it turns out... no. Every boat that goes out never comes back. Apparently this giant water elemental, Undertow I think it was, is murdering the snot out of everyone that passes through. Any chance you could clear it out for us, commander?

Title: Blackhand's Crucible: Blackhand
Objective: Defeat Blackhand in the Blackrock Foundry.
Text: Ol' Grommash cannot rule the Iron Horde without his Warlords keeping the clans in line. Let's deal 'em a blow that they can't recover from! Blackhand, Warlord of the Blackrock clan, is a dauntless warrior and ruthless tyrant. He's second only to Grommash within the Iron Horde and oversees operations in the Foundry from atop its Crucible. Travel to the Blackrock Foundry and defeat Blackhand.

Title: The Black Forge: Kromog
Objective: Defeat Kromog in Blackrock Foundry.
Text: Yer garrison scouts report that blackrock miners dug up a magnaron, and that the filthy beast has begun helpin' those brutes churn out their infernal machines. They call it "Kromog."Travel to Blackrock Foundry and slay that fiend!

Title: Slagworks: Heart of the Mountain
Objective: Defeat the Heart of the Mountain at the Blast Furnace in Blackrock Foundry.
Text: Blackrock warriors use weapons forged in cursed fire by the breath of a creature o' pure flame: The Heart o' the Mountain. Let's disarm 'em! Destroy that infernal creature, and the Blackrock won't have enough heat to fuel their Blast Furnace. Travel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat the Heart o' the Mountain.

Title: Imperator's Rise: Imperator Mar'gok
Objective: Defeat Imperator Mar'gok in Highmaul.
Text: I never thought much of them ogres, not until I saw a Highmaul legion on the march. Like a wall o' armored muscle, backed by the magics o' the emperor's best sorcerers. Never underestimate an ogre. Imperator Mar'gok is the grand Imperator of Highmaul. Aye, he's a cunning one - allied himself with the Iron Horde, he did. If we're to break up the party, we'd best start at the top. Travel to Highmaul and defeat Imperator Mar'gok!

Title: Death to Gor'thul!
Objective: Slay Gor'thul at Bloodmane Pridelands in Spires of Arak.
Text: Saberon spirit army. I ain't pullin' your leg, commander, that's what we've got coming for us if we don't act fast. The Shattered Hand shaman Gor'thul was spotted down in Spires of Arak in the Bloodmane Pridelands right about the same time we started hearing reports of saberon spirits raiding our supply caravans. I don't want to take any chances, commander. I think you should personally head down there and put a stop to this before it starts.

Title: Iron Assembly: Admiral Gar'an
Objective: Defeat Admiral Gar'an in Blackrock Foundry.
Text: "If ye want to topple a wall, start with the foundation." It's an old Dwarf saying. If we take out the Iron Horde's leadership, the whole thing tumbles. Gar'an is the Admiral o' the Iron Horde fleet and first of the so-called "Iron Maidens." She, along with her lieutenants, Marak, and Sorka, have dominated the seas of Draenor. No more. Travel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat Admiral Gar'an.

Title: Arcane Sanctum: Ko'ragh
Objective: Defeat Ko'ragh in Highmaul.
Text: Ye know the name "Ko'ragh?" One of them Highmaul ogres. They dug up a relic some time ago that killed everyone it touched but for Ko'ragh... givin' him a near-complete immunity to all magic. Ogres ain't meant to have that kind of power! Travel to Highmaul and defeat Ko'ragh, before they learn to use him against us.

Title: Blackhand's Crucible: Blackhand
Objective: Defeat Blackhand in the Blackrock Foundry.
Text: Grommash Hellscream relied on the strength of his Warlords to keep the Iron Horde under his control. It is time to strike a decisive blow. Blackhand, Warlord of the Blackrock clan, is a dauntless warrior and ruthless tyrant. He is second only to Grommash within the Iron Horde and oversees operations in the Foundry from atop its Crucible. Travel to the Blackrock Foundry and defeat Blackhand.

Title: Imperator's Rise: Imperator Mar'gok
Objective: Defeat Imperator Mar'gok in Highmaul.
Text: The conditions are ripe for a decisive attack against the Highmaul, commander. Will you engage? Descended from a long line of sorcerers, Imperator Mar'gok is the grand Imperator of Highmaul. He is both cunning and brutal, and allied himself with the Iron Horde when he recognized what it would be to oppose them. Travel to Highmaul and defeat Imperator Mar'gok. Without their leader, the Ogre Empire will descend into chaos for many years.

Title: Walled City: Brackenspore
Objective: Defeat Brackenspore in Highmaul.
Text: If it ain't one threat, it's another - I swear this light-forsaken world would try to eat us alive even without no Horde to fight. Brackenspore, ancient walker of the deep, was drawn from the waters near Highmaul by the presence of the Iron Horde. That thing is already spreading like a disease. Ye got to put it down! Travel to Highmaul and defeat Brackenspore before he gets too powerful to stop.

Title: Iron Assembly: Admiral Gar'an
Objective: Defeat Admiral Gar'an in Blackrock Foundry.
Text: Our forces are making progress on land, but victory at sea still eludes us. We must take out the Iron Horde leadership while they are in harbor. Gar'an, Admiral of the Iron Horde fleet and first of the so-called Iron Maidens, is tactically brilliant. She, along with her lieutenants, Marak, and Sorka, have crushed all who have been sent to oppose them. Travel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat Admiral Gar'an.

Title: Arcane Sanctum: Ko'ragh
Objective: Defeat Ko'ragh in Highmaul.
Text: Forget all you know of the ogres on Azeroth. On Draenor they commanded a once-mighty civilization. Even now they threaten to reclaim their former glory. Highmaul excavations in Nagrand unearthed a mysterious relic. The only ogre to survive direct exposure to this relic was Ko'ragh; he was left with a near-complete immunity to all magic. Ko'ragh must be killed before the ogres learn to replicate his unique powers. Travel to Highmaul and defeat Ko'ragh!

Title: The Black Forge: Kromog
Objective: Defeat Kromog in Blackrock Foundry.
Text: Commander. Frostwolf scouts report that blackrock miners dug up a magnaron, and they've coerced the beast into helping them to create their infernal machines. They call it "Kromog." We must destroy it. Travel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat Kromog.

Title: Slagworks: Heart of the Mountain
Objective: Defeat the Heart of the Mountain at the Blast Furnace in Blackrock Foundry.
Text: Blackrock orcs fight like no other clan. They rely on arms and armor forged in the heart of their unnatural crucibles. Deep within the Foundry of the Blackrock clan is a furnace powered by a primal force known as the Heart of the Mountain. Destroy it, and deprive our foe of the arms they rely on. Travel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat the Heart of the Mountain.

Title: Walled City: Brackenspore
Objective: Defeat Brackenspore in Highmaul.
Text: The Iron Horde is just one of the threats we must deal with on Draenor. We must also clean up the chaos they are leaving in their wake. Brackenspore, ancient walker of the deep, was drawn from the waters near Highmaul by the presence of the Iron Horde. He spreads his fungal growth in his wake and will eradicate all of us if left unchecked. Travel to Highmaul and defeat Brackenspore.

Title: The Headmistress' Keys
Objective: Obtain the Tidestone Vault Key from Elya Azuremoon, the Academy Headmistress.
Text: I have a suspicion you are avoiding your studies - but I can see you're anxious to see the Headmistress. Very well! Headmistress Azuremoon can be found up ahead, though I doubt she will enjoy being interrupted.

Title: Trials of Khadgar: Iron Maidens
Objective: Defeat the Iron Maidens encounter, with the following conditions.
Text: Defeat your enemies with greater skill to earn the favor of Khadgar - and with it, greater rewards!

Title: Presentation is Everything
Objective: Collect the Six Eyes of Gangamesh.
Text: The eggs will provide the 'oomph' to my drink's character. But there's another element, and this must not be underestimated!Presentation.Now, you could go with your standard olive skewered on a toothpick. Maybe a carrot stalk stuck slapdash out of a glass.But then, you wouldn't be me.No, my friend. What MY drink needs to sell it visually comes from a one-of-a-kind creature. I'm only going to serve it once and so my drink deserves something unique.The eyes of Gangamesh are what I need.

Title: Dressing With Class
Objective: Obtain a Nar'thalas Academy Hat, Robes, Wand, and Spellbook.
Text: Now stop right there. Look at you! You look like you just walked in off of the street. Where are your robes and hat? And don't tell me you've entered the academy without your wand and spellbook. Freshmen. Put yourself together, and maybe then I will consider letting you enter the academy.

Title: Prince Farondis
Objective: Meet up with Nightwatcher Idri at the Crumbled Palace.
Text: I'm glad to see that my doubts in you were unfounded. You seek Prince Farondis? Follow me. I will show you to the prince's hall.

Title: Pop Quiz: Advanced Rune Drawing
Objective: Trace an arcane rune, a fire rune, and a frost rune.
Text: Still aching to get into the headmistress' study, eh? I suppose I can let you in... as long as you prove that you've been studying. Proper rune formation is essential when it comes to spellcasting. If you can draw a rune, you can cast a spell. I will provide outlines for you. You can simply use your feet to trace the runes.

Title: The Ancient One
Objective: Approach Senegos.
Text: This place is now the home of what is left of the Blue Dragonflight. Its eldest dragon, Senegos, lies ahead within a pool of ley energy. If any are wise enough to help us find the Pillar of Creation that we seek on Azsuna, it will be him.Stellagosa went ahead to join her grandfather. She assured me that we are welcome to enter the repose.Come, we must hurry. Even from here, I can sense his life force waning. Let us approach him together.

Title: The Magister of Mixology
Objective: Collect 6 Arcane-Infused Eggs.
Text: As you must know, I'm a connoisseur of drinks... specifically, arcane-infused spirits. Cocktail mixing is alchemy, and as everyone knows, alchemy is magic.My latest drink must be more exotic than anything I've conjured before. I already have most of what I need. But there are a couple of items left on the list.Notice the herons down in the lagoon? As with many of the creatures on Azsuna, the magic coursing through the island permeates them.Their eggs will do nicely.

Title: Those Who Remember
Objective: Locate Nightwatcher Idri in the Drowned Gardens.
Text: The ghostly elves, to the south, once had the Pillar of Creation known as the Tidestone of Golganneth. Their great city of Nar'thalas was destroyed an eon ago. The city's ruler, Prince Farondis, fell with the city. You small ones die so easily. If anyone knows where the fragments rest, it will be the ghost of the prince. Seek out his people.

Title: The Imposter
Objective: Grapple up the Lion's Rest cliffs, sneak through Stormwind City to the SI:7 courtyard, and then kill Detheroc.
Text: Detheroc has SI:7's finest snipers on all of the rooftops. We can't mount up and we can't fly. There are grapple points above so that we can move up the cliff.We've also setup hay bales to hide in along the likely routes to SI:7. We just need to stealth in and kill Detheroc.Once we get up there, we'll separate to increase the chances of at least one of us making it through the city.Good luck.

Title: Garrison Campaign: In the Shadows
Objective: Kill 3 Council Nightblades within Vol'mar.
Text: I need your help. Iskar has gone missing. I have reason to believe he has followed the remnants of the Sethekk who have been gathering here in Tanaan. I've been investigating and... what was that?  There is movement in the shadows, we are being watched! Take these vials, they form a gas with a terrible smell when the liquid comes in contact with the air. Smells terrible, they won't be able to resist it. Use them to drive our watchers out of hiding.

Title: Garrison Campaign: In the Shadows
Objective: Kill 3 Council Nightblades within Lion's Watch.
Text: I need your help. Iskar has gone missing. I have reason to believe he has followed the remnants of the Sethekk who have been gathering here in Tanaan. I've been investigating and... what was that?  There is movement in the shadows, we are being watched! Take these vials, they form a gas with a terrible smell when the liquid comes in contact with the air. Smells terrible, they won't be able to resist it. Use them to drive our watchers out of hiding.

Title: Hit the Books
Objective: Destroy 3 Ancient Tomes.
Text: One problem with maintaining such a large arcane library is that the books often pick up an errant enchantment and start darting about on their own. These overmagicked books need to be destroyed before they cause any further damage. If you encounter any of these exasperating essays, please put them down. Quietly.

Title: Building for Professions
Objective: Build any profession building.
Text: I see that you have acquired the blueprints for a profession building! Use the Architect Table to build in a small plot.

Title: Maritime Law
Objective: Find Looper Allen near the ship that's run aground on the east side of Mak'rana.
Text: Good , a moment of your time. My fellow salvors and I could not help but notice yon ship that ran aground in the storm last night.A pity about its crew.Still, the law's the law. The maritime code is quite clear on the matter. If you find yourself out that way, would you mind terribly checking in on my acquisitions scout, Looper? I would have expected him back for tea some time ago.

Title: Building for Professions
Objective: Build any profession building.
Text: I see that you have acquired the blueprints for a profession building! Use the Architect Table to build in a small plot.

Title: The Captain's Foot Locker
Objective: Locate the Captain's Chest below decks on the Queen's Reprisal.
Text: I don't care what you do, mate. But, if you get caught, you didn't see me.I wasn't here.

Title: Picking a Fight
Objective: Kill demons until Vaultwarden Umbral appears and kill him. Then, set Mathias Shaw free.
Text: They're coming!I will get to work unlocking these fel-magic chains from the cage.You keep the Legion at bay.

Title: Reignite the Wards
Objective: Reignite the 3 demon wards.
Text: The demons are weakening my defenses. They must be far more powerful than what we've faced before.Will you help me to reignite the wards to keep the Legion from overrunning our position here?

Title: Fel Machinations
Objective: Free 6 Demon Hunters from Soul Harvesters.
Text: My force wiped out the demons' forward base here. But, an imp mother and her brood took the rest of my demon hunters hostage, including Cyana Nightglaive.We need to free the Illidari and destroy the Burning Legion.

Title: The Scythe of Souls
Objective: Work with Allari the Souleater to compel information from the demon souls.
Text: Let's head to the other side of the stand. We will release the demon souls one by one and get the answers that we seek concerning Lord Illidan.The Scythe of Souls will ensure that we do.

Title: Making the World Safe for Profit
Objective: Kill 12 gilblin and/or makrura at Mak'rana and slay their leader, Queen Kraklaa.
Text: Might I ask a small favor, my friend? These creatures in the tide pools to the east are starting to frighten me. Our efforts to trade with them have been rebuffed at every turn with aggression. This is not good; neither for running a business, nor for profit.Sadly, I must admit the time for talk has come to an end.Might you be willing to serve as my representative in dealing with the denizens of Mak'rura and their "queen"?I can assure you that your efforts will be rewarded commensurately.

Title: Demon Souls
Objective: Trap 8 demon souls on the Faronaar Front.
Text: I need to extract information about the Burning Legion from these foul creatures. But living, the demons are almost impossible to break.However, like you, I wield a powerful artifact -- the Scythe of Souls.Take one of my soul gems. If you place it next to a demon's corpse, it will rip the 'soul' out. Then, we will see if the scythe can get them to talk.

Title: Assault on Darktide Roost
Objective: Disrupt the Iron Horde and gather intelligence on them.
Text: The Iron Horde has Goblins now? Take them out!

Title: Mastering the Menagerie
Objective: Defeat the pets in the battle area.
Text: You know the drill. Defeat the pets in the garrison, and I might have something for you.

Title: Mastering the Menagerie
Objective: Defeat the pets in the battle area.
Text: You know the drill. Defeat the pets in the garrison, and I might have something for you.

Title: Assault on Darktide Roost
Objective: Disrupt the Iron Horde and gather intelligence on them.
Text: The Iron Horde has Goblins now? Take them out!

Title: Your Second Inscription Work Order
Objective: Place a work order, then collect it once it completes. It will take a day.
Text: It normally takes us a day to complete one work order. Place another work order with my assistant. Once it is complete, we will leave it out here for you to collect.

Title: Your First Jewelcrafting Work Order
Objective: Start and collect your first Jewelcrafting work order at the Gem Boutique.
Text: Now that the gem boutique is complete, we can start producing taladite crystals for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

Title: Your Second Alchemy Work Order
Objective: Place a work order, then collect it once it completes.
Text: Place another work order with my assistant. Once it is complete, we will leave it out here for you to collect.

Title: Your First Tailoring Work Order
Objective: Start and collect your first Tailoring work order at the Tailoring Emporium.
Text: Now that the tailoring emporium is complete, we can start producing hexweave cloth for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

Title: Your First Leatherworking Work Order
Objective: Start and collect your first Leatherworking work order at the Tannery.
Text: Now that the tannery is complete, we can start producing burnished leather for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

Title: Your First Engineering Work Order
Objective: Start and collect your first Engineering work order at the Engineering Works.
Text: Now that the engineering works is complete, we can start producing gearspring parts for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

Title: Your First Enchanting Work Order
Objective: Start and collect your first Enchanting work order at the Enchanter's Study.
Text: Now that the enchanter's study is complete, we can start producing draenic dust for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

Title: The Prince is Going Down
Objective: Free Okuna Longtusk and kill Prince Oceanus.
Text: ! I knew you'd come.Quick, let me out of here and we'll take this giant down.

Title: Your First Inscription Work Order
Objective: Start and collect your first Inscription work order at the Scribe's Quarters.
Text: Now that the scribe's quarters are complete, we can start producing war paints for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

Title: Your First Blacksmithing Work Order

Text: Now that the forge is complete, we can start producing truesteel ingots for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

Title: Your First Alchemy Work Order
Objective: Start and collect your first Alchemy work order at the Alchemy Lab.
Text: Now that the alchemy lab is complete, we can start producing alchemical catalysts for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

Text: Redeem your Essence of the Iron Vanquisher with Exarch Maladaar to select an armament of your choice.

Objective: Arm 25 Shipwrecked Captives.

Text: Redeem your Essence of the Iron Conqueror with Exarch Maladaar to select an armament of your choice.

Title: The Frostwolves Stand Ready
Objective: Choose a follower (either Greatmother Geyah, Kal'gor the Honorable, or Lokra) and then speak with Makar Stonebinder.
Text: Though we have lost much this day, the Frostwolves stand ready to uphold our pact with your people. To honor this agreement, some of my clan have asked to join your ranks and fight alongside your forces. Our numbers are strained so I ask that you chose only one. Speak with me when you have made your decision.

Title: Essence of the Iron Protector
Objective: Obtain an Essence of the Iron Protector.
Text: Redeem your Essence of the Iron Protector with Exarch Maladaar to select an armament of your choice.

Text: Redeem your Essence of the Iron Conqueror with Exarch Maladaar to select an armament of your choice.

Text: Redeem your Essence of the Iron Vanquisher with Lady Liadrin to select a Vanquisher armament of your choice.

Objective: Collect an Essence of the Iron Conqueror.
Text: Redeem your Essence of the Iron Conqueror with Lady Liadrin to select an armament of your choice.

Text: Redeem your Essence of the Iron Protector with Lady Liadrin to select an armament of your choice.

Text: Redeem your Essence of the Iron Protector with Lady Liadrin to select an armament of your choice.
