Text: Redeem your Essence of the Iron Vanquisher with Lady Liadrin to select a Vanquisher armament of your choice.

Title: Essence of the Iron Protector
Objective: Obtain an Essence of the Iron Protector.
Text: Redeem your Essence of the Iron Protector with Lady Liadrin to select an armament of your choice.

Title: No Time for Tryouts
Objective: Deliver a beatdown to Ooker Dooker.
Text: We don't have time for you to go through a lengthy set of tryouts. But, fighting in the arena is our best chance at getting you in good with the giants.That kind-hearted giant over there that's losing against Bilgerudder is Sternfathom. If you were to defeat his hozen champion, you'd make yourself a spot on his team.Looks like Ooker Dooker's taking a rest between bouts. Now's the time to deliver a good ol' monkey beatdown.

Title: Essence of the Iron Conqueror
Objective: Collect an Essence of the Iron Conqueror.
Text: Redeem your Essence of the Iron Conqueror with Lady Liadrin to select an armament of your choice.

Title: Round 1, Fight!
Objective: Have Sternfathom throw you into the arena, defeat Boss Whalebelly, and then find Okuna Longtusk inside Oceanus Cove.
Text: All of my gladiators are out of commission!It's down to you. Bilgerudder's going to pit his three champions against you.

Title: Essence of the Iron Vanquisher
Objective: Obtain an Essence of the Iron Vanquisher.
Text: Redeem your Essence of the Iron Vanquisher with Lady Liadrin to select an armament of your choice.

Title: Morale Booster
Objective: Get the Fighter Chow from Ooka Dooker
Text: Things may look good from where you're standing, but, we're losing. However, do not fret, my little  friend. You can help.Listen closely. Ooka Dooker, Ooker's sister, is back over yonder in the champions' cave making her world famous Fighter Chow. It'll do the trick and boost our team's morale.All you have to do is to convince her to hand it over.

Title: Rolling With the Tidestone
Objective: Bring the Tidestone Shards to Senegos.
Text: Before I forget: the Tidestone shards. They are yours to protect now. Bring them back to your dragon. The people of Azsuna stand behind you.

Title: Let Sleeping Giants Lie
Objective: Collect the Giants' Stash of Weapons.
Text: We're going to need a diversion to get close to Prince Oceanus. Are you thinking what I'm thinking?See Sleepy Dhow over there? He's guarding all of the weapons the giants take from our shipwrecks. We can use those weapons to arm the rest of the pit fighters that are held in the caves.All you have to do is get past that giant without waking him.

Title: Save Yourself
Objective: Speak with Farondis and hear his account of how he saved you.
Text: Of course I couldn't sit back and let them just cart you away. I will explain everything.

Title: Assault on the Gorian Proving Grounds
Objective: Assault the ogre forces at the Gorian Proving Grounds in Nagrand.
Text: The ogres at the Gorian Proving Grounds be rousin' champions to turn against our forces in Nagrand.A decisive assault on their training grounds should prevent dem from musterin' the forces dey be needin' to stand against us, and will help remind them that we are not an enemy they want to be makin'.

Title: News for Nixxie
Objective: Speak with Nixxie.
Text: Nixxie is probably worried sick about the potential loss of profits from this surveying operation. If you see her can you let her know we will be back soonish?

Title: The Iron Horde Approaches... BETA
Objective: Speak with Sergeant Crowler.
Text: There's smoke on the horizon... The Iron Horde is coming.

Title: The Haunted Halls
Objective: Enter the academy's west wing.
Text: Now, what was it you wanted? You're here to see the Tidestone of Golganneth? Hah! Ho ho ha ha haa! Hooo my. No, only the academy's headmistress has the keys to that chamber, and she hasn't opened the door in... oh, I'd say about ten thousand years. You'd best be off to class, now. Go on, then! Into the west wing with you!

Title: News for Nixxie
Objective: Speak with Nixxie.
Text: Nixxie is probably worried sick about the potential loss of profits from this surveying operation. If you see her can you let her know we will be back soonish?

Title: Assault on the Gorian Proving Grounds
Objective: Assault the ogre forces at the Gorian Proving Grounds in Nagrand.
Text: The ogres at the Gorian Proving Grounds are rousing champions to turn against our forces in Nagrand.A decisive assault on their training grounds should prevent them from mustering the forces they need to stand against us, and will help remind them that we are not an enemy they want to make.

Title: Dizzy Sparkshift
Objective: Find Dizzy Sparkshift.
Text: I'm in a pretty good spot as far as artifacts go. We have a couple other society members out in the field. I'd go look for them, but it seems like a bad idea from a health perspective. You don't seem to have a problem with pain, think you could find Dizzy?

Title: Breakers Invasion!! BETA
Objective: Repel the Goren and Gronnling invasion of your garrison.
Text: The earth quakes beneath us, Commander. Our scouts are not returning. I can feel an attack creeping up on us, but from where?

Title: Primals Invasion! BETA
Objective: Repel the Primals invasion of your garrison.
Text: The plants seem different today. Grass blades bend against the wind and catch on my boots. Twice this morning a tree branch struck my helmet as it fell.

Title: Ogres Invasion! BETA
Objective: Repel the Ogres invasion of your garrison.
Text: Commander, our scouts say that Ogre bands march through the snow. If they want more battle after the beating we already delivered, then I'm eager to oblige them.

Title: Sternfathom's Champion
Objective: Report to Sternfathom as his new pitfighter.
Text: Since you defeated Ooker Dooker, there's a pit fighter spot open on Sternfathom's team. You should go establish yourself as his champion. That way, the giants won't think twice about why a stranger is suddenly coming and going as  pleases.Meanwhile, I'll start to sow some chaos so that we can strike at Prince Oceanus.

Title: Boss Whalebelly's in Charge
Objective: Speak with Boss Whalebelly.
Text: Great, let's get started! If we're going to break everyone out of here, you need to pose as a pit fighter like the rest of us. They won't just let you run around anywhere you want in here.First thing you need to do is present yourself to Boss Whalebelly. The giants may run this place, but as far as posing as one of us, Whalebelly's in charge.He's speaking with his goons just to the south.

Title: Infiltrating Shipwreck Arena
Objective: Infiltrate Shipwreck Arena and find Okuna Longtusk.
Text: The giants at Shipwreck Arena are very fond of smashing ships that sail too close to shore. They take the sailors prisoner and use them for their own amusement.I suppose it will be easy for you to infiltrate the place. It's breaking out that will be the difficult part.

Title: A Rather Long Walk
Objective: Find Elder Aldryth.
Text: I'm concerned for Elder Aldryth. He went out for a walk about ten thousand years ago, and he has not returned. With these naga attacking, I fear he may be in danger! If you dare venture out into the fray, do look out for our court elder.

Title: Trailing the Tidestone
Objective: Escort Prince Farondis to the Ruins of Nar'thalas.
Text: Your quest for the Tidestone... it intrigues me. More than that, it suits my needs quite well. I have been in need of a champion for a very, very long time. It is decided, then. I shall join you. We will have to head east, through Nar'thalas. Shall we depart?

Title: Under Cover of Darkness
Objective: Speak with Taoshi when you're ready for Fleet Admiral Tethys to arrange your transport to Stormwind City.
Text: We are off to Stormwind. Tethys will sneak us by water beneath the old barracks under cover of darkness tonight.The rest will be up to you, Mathias, and myself. We will have to stealth through Stormwind and confront Detheroc at SI:7.Are you ready to do this?

Title: Nar'thalas Still Suffers
Objective: Defeat Athissa.
Text: They have not forgiven me. I cannot blame them. Past crimes aside, I am still their prince. Even in death, I will do what I can to protect my people. . Act as my champion. Find and defeat the creature that leads this naga attack against the people of Nar'thalas. After all these years, you - |5 , of all things - may be the instrument of my redemption.

Title: Basics First
Objective: Speak with Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind City.
Text: Great spirit, but you have to learn the basics of pet battles first. Visit Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind City, and she'll get you started.

Title: The Head of the Snake
Objective: Defeat Athissa.
Text: Those naga have the Tidestone shards. They will soon be dragging them into their watery holes, away from our reach. It would be wise to take out their leaders before that happens.

Title: Into the Academy
Objective: Enter the halls of the Nar'thalas Academy.
Text: The sunken structure on the other side of this bridge was once called Nar'thalas Academy: the center of magical studies in all of Azeroth. You should have seen her in her full splendor. The Tidestone should be locked up within. I dare not enter, but you - my champion - you go with my blessing.

Title: The Tidestone: Shattered
Objective: Collect the 5 Tidestone Shards.
Text: I suppose you can go in, then. The shattered pieces of the Tidestone of Golganneth are contained within the academy's eastern wing. Even as curator, I cannot attest to their condition, as I have not been in to inspect them in many millennia. Oh, young ? Please do not touch anything.

Title: The Walk of Shame
Objective: Escort Prince Farondis around the edge of Nar'thalas.
Text: The echoes of Nar'thalas still haunt me, and I cannot bear the pain of this accursed town any longer. I may still be able to get you closer to the Tidestone, however.  We will need to skirt around the edge of town. Follow me.

Title: A Simple Plan
Objective: Hear Mathias Shaw's plan and then cast your vote.
Text: Like many dreadlords, Detheroc cannot help but gloat. He was careless and I overheard many of his plans while I was held captive.With your leave, I would like to underscore the gravity of the situation in Stormwind. The fate of Azeroth hangs in the balance.But for all of that, I have a simple plan: get 'em.

Title: Dark Revelations
Objective: Kill Nightglaive the Traitor.
Text: I'm not going to let Cordana Felsong get away with this. There is no way in hell I am going to let that warden witch turn my people.As for Nightglaive... I will NOT suffer a traitor to live!Are you with me?

Title: Saving Stellagosa
Objective: Obtain Lykill's Key and free Stellagosa.
Text: During the fighting, of all things, I saw a blue drake swoop in and attack the demons. I couldn't believe my eyes. I'd heard that the Blue Dragonflight had gone extinct.The Legion managed to bring the drake down, but not until after she'd killed a score of them. She was magnificent. Last I saw, they were dragging her in the direction of the southern camp.We should see if she's still alive. A dragon could prove a powerful ally.

Title: Solanian's Belongings
Objective: Collect Well Watcher Solanian's Scrying Orb, his Scroll of Scourge Magic, and his Journal. They are found on Sunstrider Isle by the pond, the fountain, and one of the Burning Crystals. Return them to the Well Watcher at the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle when you've collected them all.
Text: With all the chaos happening here at the Sunspire, I haven't had a chance to collect my belongings I've left outside at various places on the isle. I must maintain my vigil over the Sunwell here, so I'll ask you to collect them in my stead. I need my scrying orb, my scroll of Scourge magic, and my journal. Use this satchel for some extra space, as my things are rather bulky. Return them to me and I'll give you a little something - you know, for the effort; you can keep the satchel as well!

Title: Solanian's Belongings
Objective: Collect Well Watcher Solanian's Scrying Orb, his Scroll of Scourge Magic, and his Journal. They are found on Sunstrider Isle by the pond, the fountain, and one of the Burning Crystals. Return them to the Well Watcher at the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle when you've collected them all.
Text: With all the chaos happening here at the Sunspire, I haven't had a chance to collect my belongings I've left outside at various places on the isle. I must maintain my vigil over the Sunwell here, so I'll ask you to collect them in my stead. I need my scrying orb, my scroll of Scourge magic, and my journal. Use this satchel for some extra space, as my things are rather bulky. Return them to me and I'll give you a little something - you know, for the effort; you can keep the satchel as well!

Title: Lazy Peons
Objective: Use the Foreman's Blackjack on 4 Lazy Peons when they're sleeping.
Text: Cursed peons! They work hard gathering lumber from the trees of the valley, but they're always taking naps! I need someone to help keep the peons in line. You look like the right  for my task. Here, you take this blackjack and use it on any lazy peons you find sleeping on the job. A good smack will get them right back to work! Return the blackjack when you're done. Look for them underneath the trees in the valley. Lousy slacking peons...

Title: The Shrine of Dath'Remar
Objective: Read the plaque on the Shrine of Dath'Remar and then return to Well Watcher Solanian at the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.
Text: Day after day I stand here, watching, waiting. I've been accused of dwelling too much on our past, while my eyes look to the horizon. But it is my firm belief that each visitor to this island should honor those who have sacrificed all so that they may continue to do so. Dath'Remar Sunstrider was our first king. He led us here from Kalimdor through the Maelstrom. Seek out his shrine to the west and do not return to me until you have read the plaque upon it in his honor.

Title: Inoculation
Objective: Use the Inoculating Crystal on 6 Nestlewood Owlkin. Then return to Vindicator Aldar at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
Text: Zhanaa needs our help to salvage parts from the Exodar. Taerix prepared an inoculum that can be given to the Nestlewood owlkin that live in the area of a lot of the salvage. Just get close to the unaffected ones and use the crystal on them. Unfortunately, you'll have to kill the others. You'll find the owlkin at Nestlewood Thicket and Nestlewood Hills to the southeast.

Title: Spare Parts
Objective: Collect 4 Emitter Spare Parts and then return to Technician Zhanaa at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
Text: We managed to recover a damaged holographic emitter from the crash. If we repair it, we'll have a chance to find other survivors outside of Ammen Vale. There were devices from the ship that could be salvaged for spare parts in the area, but the local owlkin carried them off before we could get to them. , you must go south to Nestlewood Thicket and Hills to find the spare parts.

Title: The Blood of Demons
Objective: Collect 100 Fel Blood from any demon on the Broken Isles.
Text: The time has come to make contact with the Master's soul. It is somewhere in the endless expanse of the Twisting Nether. Luckily, so is Mardum.Such a thing is not unheard of, but it will be exceedingly difficult, even here. In addition to what the matron mother had us gather, we need a great deal of demon blood.Like, a lot of it!

Title: A Fistful of Slivers
Objective: Collect 6 Arcane Slivers from any creature on the isle that uses mana, and then return to Arcanist Ithanas on Sunstrider Isle.
Text: It's a shame that we've lost control of many of the creatures here on the island. This was once a tranquil place of study and research. Now it's all we can do to keep from being attacked by our own creations! I'm going to offer you a chance to receive a magical boon in exchange for some collecting work on your part. Bring me a stack of arcane slivers that are found on the mana-using creatures of Sunstrider Isle, and I will cast a spell on you that should aid your adventures on the isle.

Title: Proving Grounds
Objective: Speak with Warmaster Zog in your garrison to enter the Proving Grounds, and then complete a Bronze trial.
Text: Hail commander. Word of your exploits has made its way back to Trial Master Rotun, and he has requested to see your prowess in person. Fighting in his proving grounds would be an excellent way to spread your reputation to the farthest reaches of the Horde, and beyond. If you're interested in proving yourself, talk to me to enter Trial Master Rotun's Proving Grounds.

Title: Thirst Unending
Objective: Use your Arcane Torrent racial ability on a Mana Wyrm, then return to Arcanist Helion.
Text: If there is only one lesson you deign to remember from your time on Sunstrider Isle, let it be this - control your thirst for magic. It is a thirst unending,  - what you absorb must be controlled and released via Arcane Torrent. Failure is to become one of the Wretched... hopelessly addicted and insane. Seek out a mana wyrm and unleash your Arcane Torrent upon it. Learn to master your power. When you have sufficiently released an Arcane Torrent, return to me.

Title: Proving Grounds
Objective: Speak with Lieutenant Thorn to enter the Proving Grounds, and then complete a Bronze trial.
Text: Greetings commander. Word of your exploits has made its way back to Trial Master Rotun, and he has humbly requested to see your prowess in person. Fighting in his proving grounds would be an excellent way to spread your reputation to the farthest reaches of the Alliance, and beyond. If you're interested in proving yourself, talk to me to enter Trial Master Rotun's Proving Grounds.

Title: Fully Armed and Operational
Objective: Place a Work Order at your Garrison's Workshop.
Text: Commander! Great news! Now that the workshop is fully armed and operational, we can start cranking out siege weapons just as soon as we have the resources. The Overcharged Siege Engine is the pinnacle of gnomish engineering, if I do say so myself. It's more powerful than your average siege engine and you can use it almost anywhere! The only limit is the amount of fuel we're able to pack into the chasis. As soon as you're ready to begin production, just bring us some resources and place a work order!

Title: Feast of the Spires
Objective: Eat a Feast of the Spires at Axefall.
Text: Boss-mon, I prepared a great feast for you right over dere. You should be havin' a bite or two before you be goin' out for da day. Trust me, you will feel much betta if you do!

Title: Fully Armed and Operational
Objective: Place a Work Order at your Garrison's Workshop.
Text: Commander! Great news! Now that the workshop is fully armed and operational, we can start cranking out siege weapons just as soon as we have the resources. The Overcharged Demolisher is the pinnacle of goblin engineering, if I do say so myself. It's more powerful than your average demolisher, and you can use it almost anywhere! The only limit is the amount of fuel we're able to pack into the chasis. As soon as you're ready to begin production, just bring us some resources and place a work order!

Title: Feast of the Spires
Objective: Eat a Feast of the Spires at Southport.
Text: Commander, I prepared a great feast for ye right over there. You should be have a bite o' two before you be go out fer the day. Trust me, it's good fer ya!

Title: Fungal Bundle
Objective: Take the Curious Growth to Rangari Sheera at the Rangari Enclave in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: The umbraspore giant you killed seemed immune to the volatile spores in the area. Perhaps the odd growths you found all over its body contribute to its immunity. You grab a big, disgusting fungal lump in order to give it to the rangari for study.

Title: Befriending the Locals
Objective: Speak to Dusk-Seer Irizzar near Veil Terokk.
Text: We need allies desperately if we want a chance at surviving until tomorrow. We've made contact with one of the outcast arakkoa, but he refused to discuss alliances without speaking to you first. He called himself Dusk-Seer Irrizar. You should speak with him, commander. You can find him just southwest of Veil Terokk.

Title: Not Here, Not Now
Objective: Speak to Lieutenant Willem at Southport.
Text: I will travel to your people to make arrangements soon. For now, begone. Leave me in peace.

Title: Not Here, Not Now
Objective: Speak to Taskmaster Gornek at Axefall.
Text: I will travel to your people to make arrangements soon. For now, begone. Leave me in peace.

Title: Not Here, Not Now
Objective: Speak to Taskmaster Gornek at Axefall.
Text: I will travel to your people to make arrangements soon. For now, begone. Leave me in peace.

Title: Not Here, Not Now
Objective: Speak to Lieutenant Willem at Southport.
Text: I will travel to your people to make arrangements soon. For now, begone. Leave me in peace.

Title: Befriending the Locals
Objective: Speak to Dusk-Seer Irizzar near Veil Terokk.
Text: Commander, I believe it best for the safety of this outpost if we secure an ally. We've made contact with one of the outcast arakkoa, but he refused to make any promises of alliance without speaking to you first. He called himself Dusk-Seer Irrizar. Could you go speak with him, commander? You can find him just southwest of Veil Terokk.

Title: Out of Stock: True Iron Ore
Objective: Obtain twenty True Iron Ore.
Text: It seems our little boutique is gaining a reputation. We use true iron in all our designs, and guess what: we're out!

Title: Out of Stock: Blackrock Ore
Objective: Obtain twenty Blackrock Ore.
Text: Our latest bracelet design is selling like mad, but we are completely out of the blackrock to make them.

Title: Jewelcrafting Special Order: Blue the Shade of Sky and Sea
Objective: Craft two Haste Taladite.
Text: The client wants a pair of silver earrings, set with blue crystals to match her eyes. The metal work is simple enough, but I don't know how to create such a shade of taladite.

Title: Jewelcrafting Special Order: A Yellow Brighter Than Gold
Objective: Craft a Critical Strike Taladite.
Text: We've been commissioned to make a gold bracelet, set with a taladite crystal "even brighter than gold". I can handle the metal work, but the crystal isn't something I can do.

Title: The Prophet's Final Message
Objective: Deliver the Prophet's Arcanum to Prophet Velen's Memorial beneath the Coliseum of Light in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: This unassuming iridescent crystal contains some of the final thoughts of Great Prophet Velen, created sometime in the hours before he confronted Ner'zhul. Deliver the crystal to Prophet Velen's Memorial beneath the Coliseum of Light near Karabor to hear his final message.

Title: Jewelcrafting Special Order: A Fine Choker
Objective: Craft a Whispering Iron Choker. The secondary stats do not matter.
Text: We have a request for a fine necklace. The client wants to give it to an old enemy, to end the conflict. She didn't specify a design, but I think I heard her mumbling under her breath about a choker.Oh, and she asks that the chain be "extra sturdy".

Title: The Dead Do Not Forget...
Objective: Place 10 Ancient Snarlpaw Skulls in the Boneseer's Cauldron.
Text: Many years ago my family and I were slain in this very spot. The saberon you see around you are descended from the tribe that murdered my village. Long have I waited, here in this forgotten place, to see justice brought to the saberon for their crimes. The Snarlpaw chief is a boneseer, a saberon who divines the future using the remains of the dead. Collect the ancient skulls of the Snarlpaw ancestors and place them in the boneseer's cauldron. Let their own bones fill their cauldron for once!

Title: Jewelcrafting Special Order: Wedding Bands
Objective: Craft two Glowing Blackrock Bands. The secondary stats do not matter.
Text: We've been asked to craft a pair of wedding bands. The clients requested that they be made by you.

Title: Not In Your Army
Objective: Deal with Rorka at Axefall.
Text: Your men caught one of da new recruits, talking with da alliance behind your back. She be a traitor, boss-mon! She be a danger to everything you've worked so hard for. We have a wyvern ready to be takin' her to your garrison for proper punishment. I thought you would be wantin' to deal with da scoundrel personally. I last be seein' her on the back road out of Axefall.

Title: Upgrades in Ashran
Objective: Speak with Torgg Flexington at Warspear in Ashran.
Text: You got some construction guides or assembly notes on ya? Oh man that's good news! I know this guy in Ashran, goes by Torgg Flexington. He's got finished blueprints we need! Go talk to this guy and bring back some good stuff for us to build, ok?

Title: A Lack of Wasps
Objective: Kill 8 Widow Wasps.
Text: The stings! These cursed wasps drone day and night and their constant aggression taxes me so. I shall do nothing about your offer until these nuisances are dealt with.

Title: Cleaning House
Objective: Deal with Jacob Anders at Southport.
Text: Not long ago, a new recruit showed up by the name o' Jacob Anders. He's been trouble since he got here, always drinkin' and pickin' fights, but he crossed the line this time. One o' our patrols spotted him tradin' intel with the Horde - he's a traitor, commander! I thought ye would want tae deal with him personally. He was out drinkin' by the water last time I saw him, and I'd bet me pappy's beard he's still there.

Title: Clearing the Mist
Objective: Kill 8 Cerulean Crawlers and collect the Overgrown Heart.
Text: I know you owe me nouting, but if you be willin' ta help me, I have a favor to ask. Ta da north, dere be da creature dat is da cause a' dis poisonous mist. Only da heart a' dis beast has da power ta neutralize da toxins in my body. Ya may have ta kill some a dose crawlers while you're at it. If ya feel weak from da poison, eat some a dose glowing mushrooms ta counter da effects.

Title: Resources in Ashran
Objective: Speak with Kinkade Jacobs at Stormshield in Ashran.
Text: Bodrick has mentioned to me that you have acquired some interesting construction notes in your forays out there. A construction guide or assembly notes perhaps? You should speak with Kinkade Jacobs in Stormshield. She is willing to exchange finished blueprints for such things.

Title: Thunderlord Invasion!
Objective: Repel the Thunderlord invasion.
Text: Your timing could not have been better. Your scouts have reported the approach of a large Thunderlord army. My clan can ride out and assist in severing their reinforcements, but you will need to see to the defense of your fort against the bulk of their forces. Sergeant Grimjaw awaits your command.

Title: Shadowmoon Invasion!
Objective: Repel the Shadowmoon clan invasion of your garrison.
Text: Your arrival couldn't be more timely, commander. Shadowmoon raiders have been spotted closing in on the garrison. You repelled their advances at Teluuna Observatory, and created chaos at Shaz'gul. Now, they surely seek retribution. They will throw everything they have at us. I have the entire garrison on high alert. Are you ready to face them?

Title: The Bloodshed Never Ends
Objective: Kill 100 Gladiators at the Coliseum in Highmaul.
Text: You are insatiable, gladiator! Let none doubt your voracious appetite for destruction and death! Imperator Mar'gok will be very pleased to see you battling upon the arena floor of the Coliseum once more! As before, I will accept nothing less than 100 lives! Kill or be killed, gladiator!

Title: Da Big Score
Objective: Obtain Dingy Iron Coins for Griftah.
Text: I know, I know. I be givin' ya these for ya treasures, but now I be wantin' dem back. It be complicated, mon. Do ya want da gold or not?

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Yalnu
Objective: Complete The Everbloom Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a resolute group of adventures and journey in to The Everbloom. Activate the Challenger's Orb, penetrate the depths of The Everbloom and put a stop to Yalnu and his ambitions. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: If You're Sure
Objective: Give surplus Dingy Iron Coins to Griftah.
Text: You sure be collectin' a lot of treasures. Dey will be worth more next week, but I can take 'em off your hands.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Warlord Zaela
Objective: Complete the Upper Blackrock Spire Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a group of stalwart adventures and journey back to Azeroth and Upper Blackrock Spire. Activate the Challenger's Orb, enter the old home of the Blackrock clan and defeat the Ironmarch Vanguard and their new ally, Warlord Zaela. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: High Sage Viryx
Objective: Complete the Skyreach Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a determined group of adventures and venture into Skyreach. Activate the Challenger's Orb, reach the summit and put an end to High Sage Viryx and her super weapon. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Skylord Tovra
Objective: Complete the Grimrail Depot Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble an elite group to infiltrate the Grimrail Depot. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and make your way to the Grimrail and put an end to it and Skylord Tovra's air support. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Ner'zhul
Objective: Complete the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a resolute group of warriors and venture into the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and put a stop to Ner'zhul's communion with the void before he takes all of Draenor with him. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Skullok, Son of Gruul
Objective: Complete the Iron Docks Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a hardy group to breach the Iron Docks. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and put a stop to the Iron Horde's training facility and their subjugation of Draenor's mightiest, including Skullok, Son of Gruul. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Gug'rokk
Objective: Complete the Bloodmaul Slag Mines Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a formidable group and head into the depths of the Bloodmaul Slag Mines. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and free the miners of Gug'rokk's tyrannical rule. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: Shadowmoon Invasion! BETA
Objective: Repel the Shadowmoon invasion of your garrison.
Text: Scouts say the Shadowmoon Clan looms close, ready with their necromancy. If I die and rise again, Commander, finish me quickly. I don't want to be a ghoul.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Teron'gor
Objective: Complete the Auchindoun Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a fearless group and lead them into the depths of Auchindoun. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and cleanse Auchindoun of Teon'gor's evil presence. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: High Sage Viryx
Objective: Complete the Skyreach Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a determined group of adventures and venture into Skyreach. Activate the Challenger's Orb, reach the summit and put an end to High Sage Viryx and her super weapon. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Ner'zhul
Objective: Complete the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a resolute group of warriors and venture into the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and put a stop to Ner'zhul's communion with the void before he takes all of Draenor with him. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: Shadowmoon Invasion! BETA
Objective: Repel the Shadowmoon Clan invasion of your garrison.
Text: Scouts report that the Shadowmoon Clan is buzzing like a kicked hornets' nest. Time again to earn our pay, Commander?

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Yalnu
Objective: Complete The Everbloom Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a resolute group of adventures and journey in to The Everbloom. Activate the Challenger's Orb, penetrate the depths of The Everbloom and put a stop to Yalnu and his ambitions. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Objective: Complete the Upper Blackrock Spire Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a group of stalwart adventures and journey back to Azeroth and Upper Blackrock Spire. Activate the Challenger's Orb, enter the old home of the Blackrock clan and defeat the Ironmarch Vanguard and their new ally, Warlord Zaela. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Skullok, Son of Gruul
Objective: Complete the Iron Docks Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a hardy group to breach the Iron Docks. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and put a stop to the Iron Horde's training facility and their subjugation of Draenor's mightiest, including Skullok, Son of Gruul. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Skylord Tovra
Objective: Complete the Grimrail Depot Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble an elite group to infiltrate the Grimrail Depot. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and make your way to the Grimrail and put an end to it and Skylord Tovra's air support. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: Our Very Bones
Objective: Obtain 55 Pilfered Night Elf Bones.
Text: You seek the Tidestone of Golganneth? Yes, I know where it lies. It is in a place to which I prefer not to return. You may be of use to me. In the midst of this naga attack, those horrid fish-men flopped their way onto my lands and raided our graveyards. They steal the bones of our ancestors, and indeed, the very bones of my people. Help me bring some solace to my people. Then I shall tell you more about the Tidestone.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Teron'gor
Objective: Complete the Auchindoun Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a fearless group and lead them into the depths of Auchindoun. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and cleanse Auchindoun of Teon'gor's evil presence. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: A Worthy Challenge: Gug'rokk
Objective: Complete the Bloodmaul Slag Mines Challenge Mode.
Text: , I need you to assemble a formidable group and head into the depths of the Bloodmaul Slag Mines. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and free the miners of Gug'rokk's tyrannical rule. Return to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title: They Came From the Sea
Objective: Obtain the Head of Fathom-Commander Zarrin, and slay 8 of his naga troops.
Text: You're looking for Prince Farondis?  I can take you to Farondis... but first things first. These naga attacked suddenly. They take orders from one called Zarrin, in the low hills to the west. Help me take Zarrin's head, and you'll have my ear.

Title: Mastering the Menagerie
Objective: Defeat the Draenor battle pet trainers.
Text: I'd like you to do some training. Head out and test your skill against the trainers in Draenor.

Title: Whispers in the Darkness
Objective: Find a Void-Gate Key in the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
Text: If you don't mind, I'm trying VERY hard to prevent all of our worlds from collapsing into the void, AGAIN. Oh, right, you helped me last time, didn't you? Well, you've got great timing. I'm in need of another Gate-Key. Well? Go on! The infinite horrors of the abyss aren't just going to wait until you've had a nap! Having that many tentacles makes them really antsy.

Title: An Axe to Grind
Objective: Find an Iron Limbcleaver in Grimrail Depot.
Text: I, Gamon, have cleaved many orc skulls. Yet many of the iron horde remain, full of limbs and blood. I will relieve them of these things! Or I would, if I had an axe. The last one broke in half in the middle of an orc's ribcage.  Bring me another, so that I may continue cleaving my way through this land!

Title: Fate of the Fallen
Objective: Collect a Silver-Lined Arrow from the Shadowmoon Burial Ground.
Text: I feel that I can trust you, perhaps. You have, at least, not spoken of my secret to anyone, and for that I thank you. I have need of your aid again, and in return, I will share some of my own information. I am here, you see, to find an elf by the name of Alleria. She was lost years ago, on Draenor. It is my faint hope that the twisting nether brought her here. I do not know if such a thing is even possible, but do keep an eye out for any signs of high elves as you travel.

Title: Lessons of the Past
Objective: Collect an Overgrown Artifact from The Everbloom.
Text: I have returned! You must have known that a world so rich in history could not keep me away for long!  I have perhaps been taking part in too many celebratory feasts, now that the Vale has been cleansed. There is so much to celebrate in Pandaria! Should you find any future evidence of titanic influence on the native species, I will be here, heartily enjoying the roast clefthoof.

Title: The Leaf-Reader
Objective: Collect a Strangely-Glowing Frond from Everbloom.
Text: Good ta see you again, mon! De Cenarion Circle sent Zen'kiki out here ta find some more of dem plants. We not likin' what we be seein' here. If ya find any more of dem leaves, bring one on back. Dey can see right through Zen'kiki's tree disguise, even when he plant himself in da ground! And dat make it harder to run!

Title: Learning Is Painful
Objective: Collect a Huge Crate of Weapons in Grimrail Depot.
Text: The academy is up and running, in a secret location of course. Maybe it doesn't exist at all? By the by, I appear to be running quite dry on sharp, pointy instruments of education.

Title: Flamefly Trap
Objective: Collect a Spire Flamefly in Upper Blackrock Spire.
Text: Ol' Winky still hasn't come back! Now I'm gettin' worried. Do me a favor and get another one of those flameflies from Upper Blackrock Spire. If we get enough of em,' Winky's sure to see the glimmer and come heading on back. An then we'll have him right where we want him!

Title: Secrets of Soulbinding
Objective: Collect a Dark Parchment from the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
Text: We have reviewed Ner'zhul's notes, which you brought to us previously. Though we are closer to understanding how these warlocks have learned to bind souls and control the undead, the picture is incomplete. We will need more pages if we are to see the whole picture. I do not want to experiment with partial information and create an abomination. There are enough of those in Northrend as it is.

Title: The Dark Within
Objective: Collect a Sun Crystal in Skyreach.
Text: The light... has gone out. I know not why. I am more troubled now than before. I can find little comfort in the everyday. Each day seems darker than the last. Please, bring me another one of the Sun Crystals. Its light is so warm, so comforting.

Title: A Hero's Quest is Never Complete
Objective: Collect a Shed Proto-Dragon Claw.
Text: What ho, squire ! Since last we spoke, I have heroically approached the gates of Blackrock Spire and nobly intended to end the toothy reign of its dragons. Yet, as I neared the place, my mind drifted to thoughts of my Doloria's fair face, and to my own painfully unsatisfied desires. My sword arm fell limp at my side. I charge THEE then, squire, to go in my stead and search Upper Blackrock Spire. I must know if the dragons still squirm within its corridors.

Title: Like Father, Like Son
Objective: Find Finkle's Improved Skinner in Blackrock Spire.
Text: He's done it again! My son took my knife and yelled something about a 'chromatic hide,' then ran off for the Spire! What would he even do with something like that, wear it around like a cape? If it's not too much to ask, would you keep an eye out for the knife? You know, next time you're around Upper Blackrock Spire. Which, hopefully, is soon. VERY soon.

Title: Vessel of Virtue
Objective: Collect a Soulweave Vessel from Auchindoun.
Text: Hello, again, commander. This plague yet vexes me, but I shall remain resolute, with the light as my guide. The Soulweave Vessel has aided our investigations into the world beyond and the transition from life to death. With more vessels, we may be able to discover the truth behind the bridge between worlds. Perhaps there is a reason why the scourged do not fully make this transition. Any additional help would be greatly appreciated by the Argent Dawn.

Title: The Search Continues
Objective: Find the Brass Compass at the Iron Docks.
Text: An old deckhand inspected that device you brought us, and thinks it was quite the forgery. This Iron Horde is trying to copy the mechanism, but they don't quite have the technology. When you get right down to it, we're not sure how these primitive beasts got a hold of this kind of tool. Wouldn't be half as good of a sea tale if we knew, ha! We've still got a pile of treasure with your name on it, if you can find us the real compass.

Title: A Plea to the Sky
Objective: Collect some Pristine Plumage in Skyreach.
Text: We have, so far, been unsuccessful in our attempts to contact the arakkoa. Each attempt strips the plumage, and we are left with a feather that is tattered and broken. Aviana implores you, commander, to find another plume for her. We do not wish to see our brethren become victim of their own violent nature. All beings of the sky have a place with us, in life or beyond.

Title: Like A Dwarf In A Mine
Objective: Collect Olaf's Shield from the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
Text: Baelog and Eric swear there's got to be treasure at the bottom of the mine. Why? Because it's a mine! An' we sure do love rocks that sparkle. On our last trip, we were beaten back by huge ogres. Baelog held up the rear, swingin' his sword, while Eric rushed on ahead to try and find a quick exit. Wouldn't you know, in all that excitement, I done lost my shield AGAIN?

Title: Soulcarver Voss
Objective: Collect a Soulsever Blade from Auchindoun.
Text: You! You're the one that found me the blade, correct? I have need of your services again. The blade worked wonderfully, allowing me to sever the tormented undead from this world. Their screams were such beautiful music. However, the Soulsever Blade cannot be repaired, as it is partially woven with spirit energy that is drawn upon each time a soul is released. I need another, as there are still dark forces at work in this place, raising spirits and turning them.

Title: Put a Bird on It
Objective: Find a Tiny Peachick Hatchling in The Everbloom.
Text: ! Have you met the peachick you saved the other day?  Did you hear that? More peachicks are still trapped in the Everbloom! If you don't save them... well, you heard what will happen!

Title: Bloody Expensive
Objective: Collect a barrel of Horribly Acidic Solution from the Iron Docks.
Text: Welcome back, commander. The commander is obviously in a great hurry, and certainly the thought of removing their coat or boots or not dripping all over the floor are much too far beyond consideration. The commander remembers the acidic solution, yes? Quite effective it was, though one barrel was not enough to remove ALL of the blood stains from the portraits, or the tapestries, or the ceiling. Surely this must have been the most heroic and viscous battle in recent history.

Title: A Fruitful Proposition
Objective: Collect a Giant Ogre Head from the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
Text: The head of just ONE ogre won't be enough to stop the fruit vendor. No, the fruit vendor is wise, they would not put all of their fruit into one basket. Bring me the head of ANOTHER ogre! Ha! Then what will the fruit vendor do? Cry onto their bananas as they rot and fall to the ground. DESPAIR, FRUIT VENDOR. SO DELICIOUS!

Title: Gargra
Objective: Defeat Gargra in a pet battle.
Text: Do you wish to offer challenge? My wolves must train to become strong.

Title: Cold Steel Part II
Objective: Find an Iron Autocannon in Grimrail Depot.
Text: Hey, you. I wanted to thank you for what you did for me. The feel of that cannon in my hands is all the therapy I'll ever need. But now... ...I'm all out of bullets. Guess I'll just sit here and wait to die.

Title: Taralune
Objective: Defeat Taralune in a pet battle.
Text: I strive to teach through non-lethal pet battle. Are you willing to learn?

Title: Vesharr
Objective: Defeat Vesharr in a pet battle.
Text: I had a vision with one who had mastered pets came to challenge me. Has the vision finally come to pass?

Title: Tarr the Terrible
Objective: Defeat Tarr the Terrible in a pet battle.
Text: Tarr is the true warlord! Bring your army to fight and I show you.

Title: Ashlei
Objective: Defeat Ashlei in a pet battle.
Text: I don't really like when my pets fight, but I love making them feel better when they're done.

Title: Rekindling an Old Flame
Objective: Deliver the Essence of Flame to Firaga in Magnarok.
Text: I am dying. My flame, it smolders... soon my light will flicker and fade into nothing. You mustn't allow this. Retrieve for me the Essence of Flame. Allow me to live another day and I will burn every breaker to ash, I swear it. I will take vengeance for my brothers and sisters.

Title: Cymre Brightblade
Objective: Defeat Cymre Brightblade in a pet battle.
Text: I found some interesting artifacts on a recent dig, and I'd love to put them through their paces to see how they would have performed in their native cultures. Don't suppose you have anything small and furry that can put up a fight?

Title: Sanketsu, The Burning Blade
Objective: Bring Sanketsu, the Burning Blade, to Lieutenant Thorn at your garrison.
Text: The blade is searing hot to the touch. The jewel on its hilt stares at you, as if daring you to claim it. Perhaps someone at your garrison would be interested in seeing this weapon.

Title: Sanketsu, The Burning Blade
Objective: Bring Sanketsu, the Burning Blade, to Warmaster Zog at your garrison.
Text: The blade is searing hot to the touch. The jewel on its hilt stares at you, as if daring you to claim it. Perhaps someone at your garrison would be interested in seeing this weapon.

Title: The Critical Path
Objective: Speak to Dungar Longdrink to secure a flight to Talador.
Text: The auburn forests of Talador sit at a critical crossroads of this continent, commander. The Iron Horde's fleet is already en route from Gorgrond to Shattrath on the west coast. Talador will fall if we don't reinforce them. I took the liberty of dispatching Foreman Eksos, who has already begun construction on an outpost for your forces not far from the Iron Horde landing point. He awaits your orders sir.

Title: Taking the Fight to Nagrand
Objective: Speak with Lieutenant Balfor at the caravan in Nagrand.
Text: Commander, good to see you. With the fall of the rangari base at Telaar, Vindicator Yrel, recommended that we establish a new foothold in Nagrand. I've taken the liberty of dispatching some of our men and supplies. Rangari D'kaan's already reporting that the outpost is nearly complete. He asked me to let you know they are ready for you. A gryphon is waiting to catch you up with the latest caravan shipment whenever you're ready.

Title: Call of the Talon King
Objective: Speak with the Shade of Terokk in Veil Terokk.
Text: $p, you have done much for my people. I wish to thank you on their behalf.Please visit Veil Terokk when you can.

Title: An Ogre Without His Sword...
Objective: Retrieve Tormmok's Favorite Sword from Vizier Dar'gud at Broken Precipice in Nagrand.
Text: Before I was shipped off to Gorgrond, I was stationed at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand, maintaining order over the unruly dredges. Vizier Dar'gud refused to let me take my favorite sword; he told me "I wouldn't need it where I was going." I want it back, commander, and we are powerful enough together to take it from Dar'gud's bloody corpse. It would mean a great deal to me. An ogre without his sword isn't an ogre at all.

Title: Scrying Hard or Hardly Scrying
Objective: Retrieve Urna's Fathomstaff from Urna Darkfathom at Shadowmoon Enclave in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: There are others that harness the shadows to do their bidding. You know of them, commander... the Shadowmoon orcs. They have begun to master their craft... they call to the shadows beyond this realm... I desire their power. They have one who possesses a staff of particular interest... we should claim it as our own.

Title: Leorajh's Prayer Beads
Objective: Retrieve Leorajh's Prayer Beads from Kirox the Wind Dancer in Skettis.
Text: When Leorajh became shaman, pridelord gave prayer beads. Beads help Leorajh hear elements. One day bird-men attacked and took prayer beads. Took them to Skettis. Master, you help Leorajh get prayer beads back?

Title: Craig's Test Quest Again!
Objective: Get Omar some cloth
Text: An honorable person gives me cloth

Title: For The Children!
Objective: Collect a Miniature Iron Star from Upper Blackrock Spire.
Text: Wait, wait! Don't attack me! I've changed! Really, I've turned over a new leaf, I promise. I haven't said "DOOOOOOM!" in months! All I care about now is saving the poor little orphans of Azeroth, whose parents have been taken by this tragic war. That's why I'm here! Why, with just a single Miniature Iron Star, I could provide clean water and power for all of the orphans of Azeroth! And no one could stop me! So, what do you think, sweetcheeks? Want to help ol' Milhouse save the orphans?

Title: The Huntresses
Objective: Collect a Silver-Lined Arrow from the Shadowmoon Burial Ground.
Text: I do not wish to come out of the shadows, but I mean you no harm. My purpose here is my own secret to keep, I simply needed a warm place to bed down for the night. I can see that you are not the type to be easily swayed into leaving. Very well, perhaps you can aid me in my search. I am looking for someone, it is not important who. All you need to know is that I will reward you for any sign of high elven weaponry that you should come across.

Title: Titanic Evolution
Objective: Collect an Overgrown Artifact from The Everbloom.
Text: Ah, hello! Do not look so surprised! Did I not also brave the dangers of the Mogu'shan Vaults? I am more sturdy than I look! I have learned many things of this wonderful place in history already. Did you know that, just like on our world, the titans once came to this place? At least, that is what I believe! Surely there are signs of the titans' presence here, even now. Should you find one, I would very much like to see it!

Title: And No Maces!
Objective: Collect a Huge Crate of Weapons in Grimrail Depot.
Text: There are far too many bright-eyed young rogues being sent through this portal and off to war. If I'm going to start up my academy again, some of them have got to survive this little excursion. While I'm here, I figured I might as well use the opportunity to gather some supplies for my grand opening. You can't start a business without plenty of daggers, after all. Grab me a crate of weaponry from the Grimrail Depot, there should be plenty lying around. I'll have something nice for you.

Title: Family Traditions
Objective: Find Finkle's Improved Skinner in Blackrock Spire.
Text: He ran off with it! Oh what am I going to do, what am I going to DO? My son, and my knife, they ran off to Blackrock Spire! Well, the knife didn't run, I suppose. That doesn't matter! You've got to get it back! Yes, the knife! You've got to get me back my knife! Go! Now! Stop talking!

Title: Shadowy Secrets
Objective: Collect a Dark Parchment from the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
Text: Though the Lich King has been defeated, we are no closer to unlocking the secrets of the Frozen Throne than we were when jousting pointlessly at the Argent Tournament. Bolvar remains resigned to his fate. Perhaps there is something here, though, that can aid us. Ner'zhul was not always the Lich King, you know. Once, he was a mere orc dabbling in dark powers beyond his comprehension. Find whatever you can of his early studies, and we may have our answers.

Title: Cenarion Concerns
Objective: Collect a Strangely-Glowing Frond from Everbloom.
Text: Ey mon! De Cenarion Circle sent Zen'kiki out here ta check out dem primals. I woulda been here sooner, but I had a little bit o' trouble gettin' my flight form ta work, mon. De plants in dis place... I can hear dem talk. Dey be yellin' all the time. Angry an' violent yellin'. Would ya bring Zen'kiki back a leaf from dis Everbloom place dey be talkin' about? Maybe I can figure out what dey want.

Title: Damsels and Dragons
Objective: Collect a Shed Proto-Dragon Claw.
Text: What ho, squire ! Forgive my lips, as they bear gravest news. Dragons have taken up stinking residence within the hallowed halls of Blackrock Spire! These great wyrms hold a distressed damsel in their scaly graspers. Her name is Zaela, they say. Such a beautiful name! As my squire, it is your Light-given duty to adventure yourself into this spire and procure evidence of these dragons, lest I waste my heroism on a dragonless quest.

Title: The Cure For Death
Objective: Collect a Soulweave Vessel from Auchindoun.
Text: Greetings, and my thanks for the warmth of this inn and your hospitality. As you can see, this malady of death continues to plague me. My studies on Azeroth and in Northrend met with little luck, and all of my leads ran dry. I have come to Draenor in the hope of finding something, anything, to go on. My first pilgrimage will be to Auchindoun, a house where souls are put at ease. If you should head there yourself, do let me know if you should happen upon anything of interest.

Title: Cleaving Time
Objective: Find an Iron Limbcleaver in Grimrail Depot.
Text: I, Gamon, have come through the dark portal to cleave many orc skulls. Yet my weapon has not kept pace with my rage, and is nicked and dull. Find me a new weapon - one that is good for removing Hellscream limbs.

Title: Time-Lost Vikings
Objective: Collect Olaf's Shield from the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
Text: Oi, barely made it out of that place! We came through the portal to help, and the next thing you know, we're prisoners in the Bloodmaul Slag Mine. It was brutal! We were shackled for days, and covered in filth. And they took my SHIELD!

Title: Feeling A Bit Morose
Objective: Collect a barrel of Horribly Acidic Solution from the Iron Docks.
Text: So many years of waking up as a spirit, reanimated by some unseen force time and again, has left one with certain desires - the comforting, velvet blackness of death being chief amongst them. One will, however, settle for the lesser prize of a solution capable of removing the scuff marks that the commander's wonderful compatriots left behind in the dining hall in their woefully short stay in Karazhan, whereupon they barely had enough time to irreparably damage the priceless furniture.

Title: Gloriously Incandescent
Objective: Collect a Sun Crystal in Skyreach.
Text: I did not come here to fight, I have seen too many die already. I have killed so many with my own hands. I have come to seek the light, and redemption. The arakkoa of this land worship the sun as I do. But they are a violent, isolationist, and decadent race, who seem to derive a different message than my own people. This troubles me. Bring me one of their Sun Crystals. I wish to see this light.

Title: Aviana's Request
Objective: Collect some Pristine Plumage in Skyreach.
Text: The arakkoa are creatures of the sky, and are thus within the domain of the great Aviana. I have been sent to procure a feather, that we may parley with them through the language of the winds. We will extend an invitation of peace, and a place on the Great Bough. Would you aid us in this quest? The feather must come from an arakkoan of nobility. You will find them in the place known as Skyreach.

Title: The Soulcutter
Objective: Collect a Soulsever Blade from Auchindoun.
Text: Don't look at me! Who do you think you are? You and I are on the same side, you know. The necromancers here, we have to kill them. All of them. Don't you agree? Of course you do, and you can help me accomplish this goal. Find a Soulsever Blade in that hovel where the necromancers have holed up like rats. It has... special properties... that will aid us against the undead.

Title: The Brass Compass
Objective: Find the Brass Compass at the Iron Docks.
Text: Greetings, commander. I have come on a mission directly from the captain. Aboard any vessel on Azeroth that's manned by at least one orc, you'll hear sea shanties sung about a device capable of navigating the broad, rough ocean of Draenor. The orcs used it to keep their heading true in the choppiest of storms. Perhaps it's just an old sea tale, but this one chance to find that kind of prize has the captain willing to part with some fine treasure.

Title: Cold Steel
Objective: Find an Iron Autocannon in Grimrail Depot.
Text: Do you know what I want? What everyone who came through that portal wants. Every soldier running from a world that didn't understand us, didn't need us. I want that world to love us as much as we love it. But we don't really belong there, not anymore. War is part of us, and we can't go back. To everyone back there, we're expendable. The only thing that makes me feel better now is the feel of a cold iron cannon in my hands, pointed at the enemy.

Title: Oralius' Adventure
Objective: Collect a Spire Flamefly in Upper Blackrock Spire.
Text: Me n' Winky, off on adventures again! This is the life, I tell ye. No burning air to breathe, an' plenty of ogres to kill!  We did leave a bit of a mess back there in the Blackrock Spire, though. A whole mess of these iron-plated orcs and some proto-dragons marched right on up from the south and took it over. Ol' Winky, he couldn't take the guilt. Went on back by himself he did, to stop them! Or... to JOIN them! Winky, ye two-timing son of an orc. Ye've got to stop him!

Title: Cro's Revenge
Objective: Collect a Giant Ogre Head from the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
Text: HA! The fruit vendor was so cunning, but I, Cro Threadstrong, am even MORE cunning. I have come back into the past to defeat the ogre army before that fruit vendor can turn them against me! Bring me the head of a big, strong ogre from the old slag mines, and I will have crushed the fruit vendor before a single apple has even grown! CAN YOU HEAR ME, FRUIT VENDOR? I WILL HAVE MY VICTORY!

Title: The Void-Gate
Objective: Find a Void-Gate Key in the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
Text: My 'master' is an idiot, but you look like you've got some smarts in that oddly-shaped head. Listen up, the Twisting Nether is a chaotic abyss, and things work differently there. I've felt some disturbances, and they don't bode well for any of us. Yes, there are things happening here, in Draenor, that are causing ripples in the nether. No, don't try to wrap your head around how that works, you'll only hurt yourself. It's simple: bring me a Void-Gate Key, and maybe I can stop the bad things.

Title: Sky Dancers
Objective: Collect a Bottled Windstorm from Skyreach.
Text: Greetings, and I thank you for your hospitality. The Shado-pan have sent several warriors to aid against the Iron Horde, however we can. We are few, though, and they are many. The arakkoa in the south are both beautiful and deadly. They appear lighter than air, their attacks a deadly dance that flits from opponent to opponent. The winds are on their side, as the four winds lighten the steps of my own allies. Bring me a sample of their winds, if you are able. It will surely aid us.

Title: Ogre Ancestry
Objective: Collect an Ogre Family Tree from the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
Text: Lunk no like fight, want to learn. You help Lunk learn? Find Lunk ancestors. Lunk have many question. Where Lunk come from? Why Lunk Lunk? Lunk stay here. Small ogres mean, big ogres meaner.

Title: Go Fetch
Objective: Collect a Nightmare Bell from Auchindoun.
Text: Now THIS is a savage land worthy of my level of heroism! Oh, hello, I did not see you standing there, staring at me. Perhaps you have noticed that every piece of my armor is an ancient relic, forgotten by time. As you have properly surmised, an adventurer of my stature does not have time to complete the menial requests I am given daily. I must remain here, yelling aloud to the trade district so that others may witness my heroicness and be inspired. Today I require a Nightmare Bell, do find one.

Title: Budd's Gambit
Objective: Collect a Very Shiny Thing from the Iron Docks.
Text: Listen, I don't know how I got here, but I have it on good authority that there is an entire island made of shiny things and it's just off of the coast a ways. All we have to do is hop in the water and swim out there, then we can load up our pockets and swim back! I'm just going to rest up and do some stretching before heading out. Don't try and stop me!

Title: For the Birds
Objective: Find a Tiny Peachick Hatchling in The Everbloom.
Text: Hi! Have you ever held a peachick hatchling?  Isn't it so small and light and downy? Like you're holding a beaky peepy lil' CLOUD! It's so adorable you can't help but hug it and cuddle it and stuff regurgitated food in its teeny-tiny mouth. , the plantfolk in the Everbloom are turning peachicks into monsters before they can grow into beautiful swans. Or whatever they grow into. Please help them!

Title: Leorajh's Prayer Beads
Objective: Retrieve Leorajh's Prayer Beads from Kirox the Wind Dancer in Skettis.
Text: When Leorajh became shaman, pridelord gave prayer beads. Beads help Leorajh hear elements. One day bird-men attacked and took prayer beads. Took them to Skettis. Master, you help Leorajh get prayer beads back?

Title: Scrying Hard or Hardly Scrying
Objective: Retrieve Urna's Fathomstaff from Urna Darkfathom at Shadowmoon Enclave in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: There are others that harness the shadows to do their bidding. You know of them, commander... the Shadowmoon orcs. They have begun to master their craft... they call to the shadows beyond this realm... I desire their power. They have one who possesses a staff of particular interest... we should claim it as our own.

Title: The Dark Lady's Concern
Objective: Retrieve Infested Orc Remains from Acanthus at Everbloom Wilds in Gorgrond.
Text: The botani in the Everbloom Wilds kill anything foolish enough to wander too close to their blooms and are raising their corpses as mindless soldiers. This is all too reminiscent of the Scourge... and the Dark Lady has taken notice. She has a special mission for us, commander. There is a particularly large infested creature that was recently raised. We are to destroy it and retrieve its remains.

Title: Unwelcome Memories
Objective: Retrieve Infested Orc Remains from Acanthus at Everbloom Wilds in Gorgrond.
Text: The botani in the Everbloom Wilds are doin' some sorta foul magic to create these plant... well... zombies, basically. I've seen what happens with armies o' mindless slaves. The Lich King...  No matter. We cannae let this escalate any further. I heard o' a particularly nasty one they've just made... let's kill it and see what makes it tick.

Title: Settling Grievances
Objective: Retrieve the Light of Exodus from Ambassador Hellmaw at Beacon of Sha'tar in Shattrath City in Talador.
Text: Our scouts have found a powerful draenei crystal being corrupted by Ambassador Hellmaw at the Beacon of Sha'tar in Shattrath. The draenei call it the Light of Exodus. Commander, I'd like to accompany you on this mission. Hellmaw slew my brother in Outland... this is personal.

Title: The Light of Exodus
Objective: Retrieve the Light of Exodus from Ambassador Hellmaw at Beacon of Sha'tar in Shattrath City in Talador.
Text: My grandfather always told me stories of a powerful crystal made of the Light that would grant power to those who intended to use it for good. He called it the Light of Exodus. I never believed him... until now. Your scouts have found a crystal that sounds just like it. It has been taken by a terrible demon and is being corrupted at the Beacon of Sha'tar in Shattrath. We have to hurry!

Title: Teeth of a Predator
Objective: Ask Sage Paluna about the Garn-Tooth Necklace.
Text: This necklace dropped off of one of the orc hunters we found while out taming beasts. I've never seen the animals react so strongly to anything.

Title: Teeth of a Predator
Objective: Ask Fanny Firebeard about the Garn-Tooth Necklace.
Text: This necklace dropped off of one of the orc hunters we found while out taming beasts. I've never seen the animals react so strongly to anything!

Title: The Black Claw
Objective: Ask Sage Paluna about the Black Claw of Sethe.
Text: You've probably seen this enormous, black claw in our pile of supplies. We found it while we were out hunting new beasts to tame. The animals seem to be quite afraid of it, perhaps the beast it belonged to used to hunt them.

Title: An Ogre Without His Sword...
Objective: Retrieve Tormmok's Favorite Sword from Vizier Dar'gud at Broken Precipice in Nagrand.
Text: Before I was shipped off to Gorgrond, I was stationed at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand, maintaining order over the unruly dredges. Vizier Dar'gud refused to let me take my favorite sword; he told me "I wouldn't need it where I was going." I want it back, commander, and we are powerful enough together to take it from Dar'gud's bloody corpse. It would mean a great deal to me. An ogre without his sword isn't an ogre at all.

Title: The Black Claw
Objective: Ask Fanny Firebeard about the Black Claw of Sethe.
Text: Behind me, as ye can probably see, is a giant black claw. We found it while we were out hunting new beasts to tame. The animals seem to be quite afraid of it, perhaps the beast it belonged to used to hunt them.

Title: The Headhunter's Harvest
Objective: Recruit a follower from Lysa Serion in the Lunarfall Inn.
Text: The inn provides a perfect place for adventurers to take a rest between their travels. It's also a great place to talk them into joining our cause over a few rounds of drinks.Go through my selection and let's see if we can obtain a new recruit. I'll give you a little something as a finder's fee for your efforts.

Title: Wolf Training: Ironbore
Objective: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Snarler-In-Training.
Text: You have defeated foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. Next, you face beasts beneath your very feet. The rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your mount on out to the sandy shores test it against the elder worm Ironbore.

Title: Wolf Training: The Garn
Objective: Defeat Maimclaw while riding your Snarler-In-Training.
Text: The last test for your mount will pit it against one of the great terrors of this land. The garn. Wolves as black as night, and twice the size of a normal wolf, they can tear an orc apart in mere moments. The beasts here wisely fear them. There is a lone garn that calls Nagrand its home. Take your wolf, mount up, and bring it down. If the two of you survive, your wolf will truly be ready.

Title: Rest and Relaxation
Objective: Speak with Innkeeper Farley at the Lion's Pride Inn.
Text: Every adventurer should rest when exhaustion sets in - and there is no finer place to get rest and relaxation than at the Lion's Pride Inn! My best friend, Innkeeper Farley, runs the Lion's Pride. If you tell him I sent you, he may give you the special discounted rates on food and drink. To find the Lion's Pride Inn, travel south along the road from here -- you can't miss it!

Title: Wolf Training: Thundercall
Objective: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Snarler-In-Training.
Text: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Even the mightiest wolf will often cower at the sound of thunder in the distance. In Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your beast and face off against Thundercall, and we will see how your mount fares.

Title: Wolf Training: Moth of Wrath
Objective: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Snarler-In-Training.
Text: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust. If the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it will probably be a pretty good test for your wolf. See if you can keep it focused and defeat the moth.

Title: Wolf Training: Darkwing Roc
Objective: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Snarler-In-Training.
Text: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both. Travel to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. It will be a good test for your mount.

Title: Wolf Training: Orc Hunters
Objective: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Snarler-In-Training.
Text: The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the finest hunters the world of Draenor has ever known. Their beast-killers will aid us in putting this mount to the test. Out in Nagrand, you will find an orc by the name of Karak, the Great Hunter. He has slain more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Face him astride your mount, and avenge the slain.

Title: Talbuk Training: Orc Hunters
Objective: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
Text: The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the finest hunters the world of Draenor has ever known. Their beast-killers will aid us in putting this mount to the test. Out in Nagrand, you will find an orc by the name of Karak, the Great Hunter. He has slain more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Face him astride your mount, and avenge the slain.

Title: Talbuk Training: Ironbore
Objective: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
Text: You have defeated foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. Next, you face beasts beneath your very feet. The rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your mount on out to the sandy shores test it against the elder worm Ironbore.

Title: Wolf Training: Cruel Ogres
Objective: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Snarler-In-Training.
Text: The wolves of this land are the most savage beasts I have seen, and surely do not fear orc nor ogre. Bring him to bear against once of the ogres that you are familiar with. The Gorian Beast-Lasher, the one that smells of blood and fear, see how the wolf reacts to him.

Title: Talbuk Training: The Garn
Objective: Defeat Maimclaw while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
Text: The last test for your mount will pit it against one of the great terrors of this land. The garn. Wolves as black as night, and twice the size of a normal wolf, they can tear an orc apart in mere moments. The beasts here wisely fear them. There is a lone garn that calls Nagrand its home. Take your talbuk, mount up, and bring it down. If the two of you survive, your talbuk will truly be ready for war.

Title: Talbuk Training: Moth of Wrath
Objective: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
Text: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust. If the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it will probably be a pretty good test for your talbuk. See if you can keep it focused and defeat the moth.

Title: Talbuk Training: Rakkiri
Objective: Defeat Rakkiri while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
Text: We shall start training the talbuk here, on the icy plains of Frostfire Ridge. We must train it rigorously, or else it may become afraid at the sight of combat, and run. Find the great blood-sucker, Rakkiri, out on the frozen plains, and bring him down astride your talbuk. That will give it a taste for combat.

Title: Talbuk Training: Darkwing Roc
Objective: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
Text: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both. Travel to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. It will be a good test for your mount.

Title: Talbuk Training: Thundercall
Objective: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
Text: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Even the mightiest wolf will often cower at the sound of thunder in the distance. In Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your beast and face off against Thundercall, and we will see how your mount fares.

Title: Talbuk Training: Gezz'ran
Objective: Defeat Gezz'ran while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
Text: Many of the creatures of Draenor have grown and thrived in a most hostile environment. One of the most cunning is the stalker. Stalkers can blend into their environments, allowing them to sneak in and steal the eggs of nearby prey. See if you and your beast can overcome this natural defense mechanism. You will find a proper predator in Talador.

Title: Talbuk Training: Cruel Ogres
Objective: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
Text: Nagrand is home to the mightiest beasts in Draenor, and the ogres of the region have learned to tame them using brutal techniques. There is one ogre in particular, the Gorian Beast-Lasher, that smells of blood and fear. Go on and see how your beast reacts to that.

Title: Talbuk Training: Bulbapore
Objective: Defeat Bulbapore while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
Text: In the far south, in the Spires of Arak, the land is being swallowed by the mushrooms that grow underwater, and strange fungal creatures grow uninhibited. Taking on a strange creature, like the fungal giant Bulbapore, will grant you a chance to expose your mount to unfamiliar predators.

Title: Talbuk Training: Riplash
Objective: Defeat Riplash while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
Text: Many beasts will cower in fear at the sight of a mighty predator. In the desolate cliffs of Gorgrond lives one of the most fierce. It will prove your next challenge. Take your beast to the nest of the great Riplash, and see if you cannot emerge victorious.

Title: Salvaging the Situation
Objective: Use the Small Sack of Salavaged Goods near the incinerator at your Salvage Yard.
Text: Here at the Salvage Yard we inspect any extra material your followers bring back from the field, preserving anything that may be useful.I have an extra pack of material our people brought in that I've yet to go through. Why don't you take it over to the incinerator and see if it contains anything useful?

Title: Talbuk Training: Great-Tusk
Objective: Defeat Great-Tusk while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
Text: The talbuk is ready for more training, and for this, we will return to its home in Shadowmoon Valley. One of the great beasts of this land, Great-Tusk, has taken the valley for his own. Pit your beast against him in combat, and if you should survive, it will have greater confidence in its own abilities.

Title: Unconventional Inventions
Objective: Acquire an invention from the workbench at the Gnomish Gearworks.
Text: The workshop is bustling with the whir of minds and motors. We're coming up with new inventions all the time.Try out today's glorious invention on the workbench behind me.

Title: Lost in Transition
Objective: Gather 5 Crate of Surplus Materials.
Text: , the storehouse is fully operational and I've seen to it that your supplies are safely stored away and accounted for.Unfortunately, during the rest of my audit I found that we are missing a few crates of surplus material - probably misplaced by one of the porters.If you happen to come across any of the surplus crates while making your rounds, please bring them to me and I'll update our ledger.

Title: Tricks of the Trade
Objective: Find and rouse the missing Trader.
Text: To pass the time, traders have been known to consume beverages of an inspired nature, if you know what I mean.Sometimes, they drink a bit too much. Your trader might have stumbled beyond the gates and passed out under a tree. It's been known to happen from time to time.Luckily, I have a brew that I use to rouse groggy traders. One splash and I find they're more willing to work.

Title: Scraps of Iron
Objective: Collect 5 Iron Horde Scraps from Iron Horde on Draenor.
Text: At the Dwarven Bunker, we can take scraps of Iron Horde armor that you collect and turn them into new gear. It's not the strongest stuff in the world, but it looks good.Get some Iron Horde scraps and come back my way. I'll set you up with a nice tabard for your troubles.

Title: Fight, Kill, Salute!
Objective: Kill 100 Gladiators at the Coliseum in Highmaul.
Text: The greatest gladiators on Draenor have fought for glory and honor inside the Coliseum. Will you become a legend like Kargath Bladefist or will you be nothing more than bone dust beneath the boots of a more savage gladiator? There is only one way to find out. You must enter the competition and fight! The price of victory is 100 lives! I will admit you without cost once per day, but if you fail and wish to fight again you must pay the price of admission in blood and bone!

Title: Call of the Gladiator
Objective: Take the Sigil of Highmaul to Kharg outside the Highmaul Coliseum in Nagrand.
Text: Your merciless rampage has not gone unnoticed, gladiator. So many of your enemies have fallen before your might. It is because of your unrelenting savagery that Imperator Mar'gok himself has requested your presence at the grand Highmaul Coliseum. It is at Highmaul that a battle of epic proportions awaits. Should you heed the call of the gladiator, present this sigil to my brother, Kharg. He is the arena master residing outside of the Coliseum in Nagrand.

Title: Riverbeast Training: Thundercall
Objective: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.
Text: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Even the mightiest wolf will often cower at the sound of thunder in the distance. In Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your beast and face off against Thundercall, and we will see how your mount fares.

Title: Riverbeast Training: Darkwing Roc

Text: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both. Travel to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. It will be a good test for your mount.

Title: Riverbeast Training: Gezz'ran
Objective: Defeat Gezz'ran while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.
Text: This bulbous beast has spent a number of years in the wilds of Talador. We will begin the training there. It is already docile, as well, so I do not think it will take as long to train as the others. As you know, stalkers can blend into their environments, allowing them to sneak in and steal the eggs of nearby prey. See if you and your riverbeast can't overcome this natural defense mechanism.
