Objective: Defeat Bulbapore while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.

Title: Elekk Training: Orc Hunters
Objective: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Meadowstomper-In-Training.

Text: You have defeated foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. Next, you face beasts beneath your very feet. The rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Title: Elekk Training: Cruel Ogres
Objective: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Meadowstomper-In-Training.
Text: This beast is surely at home in Nagrand, and after the years of domestication by Draenei it will be quite easy to train. We shall face it against the ogres of the region that you are familiar with. The Gorian Beast-Lasher, the one that smells of blood and fear, see how this elekk reacts to him.

Title: Elekk Training: Thundercall
Objective: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Meadowstomper-In-Training.
Text: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Even the mightiest wolf will often cower at the sound of thunder in the distance. In Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your beast and face off against Thundercall, and we will see how your mount fares.

Title: Lost in Transition
Objective: Gather 5 Crate of Surplus Materials.
Text: , the storehouse is fully operational and I've seen to it that your supplies are safely stored away and accounted for.Unfortunately, during the rest of my audit I found that we are missing a few crates of surplus material - probably misplaced by one of the porters.If you happen to come across any of the surplus crates while making your rounds, please bring them to me and I'll update our ledger.

Title: Elekk Training: Moth of Wrath
Objective: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Meadowstomper-In-Training.
Text: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust. If the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it will probably be a pretty good test for your elekk. See if you can keep it focused and defeat the moth.

Title: Clefthoof Training: Orc Hunters
Objective: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
Text: The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the finest hunters the world of Draenor has ever known. Their beast-killers will aid us in putting this mount to the test. Out in Nagrand, you will find an orc by the name of Karak, the Great Hunter. He has slain more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Face him astride your mount, and avenge the slain.

Title: Tricks of the Trade
Objective: Find and rouse the missing Trader.
Text: To pass the time, traders have been known to consume beverages of an inspired nature, if you know what I mean.Sometimes, they drink a bit too much. Your trader might have stumbled beyond the gates and passed out under a tree. It's been known to happen from time to time.Luckily, I have a brew that I use to rouse groggy traders. One splash and I find they're more willing to work.

Title: Elekk Training: Darkwing Roc
Objective: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Meadowstomper-In-Training.
Text: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both. Travel to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. It will be a good test for your mount.

Title: Clefthoof Training: The Garn
Objective: Defeat Maimclaw while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
Text: The last test for your mount will pit it against one of the great terrors of this land. The garn. Wolves as black as night, and twice the size of a normal wolf, they can tear an orc apart in mere moments. The beasts here wisely fear them. There is a lone garn that calls Nagrand its home. Take your clefthoof, mount up, and bring it down. If the two of you survive, your clefthoof will truly be ready.

Title: Clefthoof Training: Cruel Ogres
Objective: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
Text: Nagrand is home to the mightiest beasts in Draenor, and the ogres of the region have learned to tame them using brutal techniques. There is one ogre in particular, the Gorian Beast-Lasher, that smells of blood and fear. Go on and see how your beast reacts to that.

Title: Clefthoof Training: Ironbore
Objective: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
Text: You have defeated foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. Next, you face beasts beneath your very feet. The rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your mount on out to the sandy shores and test it against the elder worm Ironbore.

Title: Clefthoof Training: Riplash
Objective: Defeat Riplash while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
Text: Many beasts will cower in fear at the sight of a mighty predator. In the desolate cliffs of Gorgrond lives one of the most fierce. It will prove your next challenge. Take your beast to the nest of the great Riplash, and see if you cannot emerge victorious.

Title: Clefthoof Training: Darkwing Roc
Objective: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
Text: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both. Travel to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. It will be a good test for your mount.

Title: Clefthoof Training: Bulbapore
Objective: Defeat Bulbapore while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
Text: In the far south, in the Spires of Arak, the land is being swallowed by the mushrooms that grow underwater, and strange fungal creatures grow uninhibited. Taking on a strange creature, like the fungal giant Bulbapore, will grant you a chance to expose your mount to unfamiliar predators.

Title: Clefthoof Training: Moth of Wrath

Text: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust. If the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it will probably be a pretty good test for your clefthoof. See if you can keep it focused and defeat the moth.

Title: Clefthoof Training: Gezz'ran
Objective: Defeat Gezz'ran while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
Text: Many of the creatures of Draenor have grown and thrived in a most hostile environment. One of the most cunning on is the stalker. Stalkers can blend into their environments, allowing them to sneak in and steal the eggs of nearby prey. See if you and your beast can overcome this natural defense mechanism. You will find a proper predator in Talador.

Title: Clefthoof Training: Rakkiri
Objective: Defeat Rakkiri while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
Text: Your clefthoof is most at home here in Frostfire Ridge, and that is where we will begin the training. Out on the icy plains, you will find a hunter of blood and death. The winged terror Rakkiri is feared by beasts across this region, and will prove a good first test for your future mount.

Title: Clefthoof Training: Great-Tusk
Objective: Defeat Great-Tusk while riding your Clefthoof -In-Training.
Text: The next step in training your mount for war will be getting it used to the sights and sounds of combat. If it is not trained properly, it might become afraid at a very inopportune time. Though small, take your clefthoof to the plains of Shadowmoon Valley and find the greatest beast you can. It will grow quickly against such a foe.

Title: Unconventional Inventions
Objective: Acquire an invention from the workbench at your Goblin Workshop.
Text: We've got a lot goin' on here at the workshop. We're buildin' new inventions all the time, and you can find 'em behind me on the workbench.Go ahead and grab today's glorious invention. Use it at your own risk.

Title: Boar Training: The Garn
Objective: Defeat Maimclaw while riding your Boar-In-Training.
Text: The last test for your mount will pit it against one of the great terrors of this land. The garn. Wolves as black as night, and twice the size of a normal wolf, they can tear an orc apart in mere moments. The beasts here wisely fear them. There is a lone garn that calls Nagrand its home. Take your boar, mount up, and bring it down. If the two of you survive, your boar will truly be ready.

Title: The Headhunter's Harvest
Objective: Recruit a follower from Akanja in the Frostwall Tavern.
Text: Hey der mon, I be ya new headhunter.The tavern be a perfect place for adventurers to rest after a long journey. It also be a great place to talk them into joining our cause.I be havin' a few recruits for ya to look at, if ya find one we can hire then I'll give ya a little somethin' as a finder fee for ya time.

Title: Scraps of Iron
Objective: Collect 5 Iron Horde Scraps from Iron Horde on Draenor.
Text: At the armory, we can take scraps of Iron Horde armor that you collect and turn them into new gear. It's not the strongest stuff in the world, but it looks good.Get some Iron Horde scraps and come back my way. I'll set you up with a nice tabard for your troubles.

Title: Boar Training: Ironbore
Objective: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Boar-In-Training.
Text: You have defeated foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. Next, you face beasts beneath your very feet. The rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your mount on out to the sandy shores test it against the elder worm Ironbore.

Title: Salvaging the Situation
Objective: Use the Small Sack of Salavaged Goods near the incinerator at your Salvage Yard.
Text: Here at the Salvage Yard we inspect any extra material your followers bring back from the field, preserving anything that may be useful.I have an extra pack of material our people brought in that I've yet to go through. Why don't you take it over to the incinerator and see if it contains anything useful?

Title: Boar Training: Bulbapore
Objective: Defeat Bulbapore while riding your Boar-In-Training.
Text: In the far south, in the Spires of Arak, the land is being swallowed by the mushrooms that grow underwater, and strange fungal creatures grow uninhibited. Taking on a strange creature, like the fungal giant Bulbapore, will grant you a chance to expose your mount to unfamiliar predators.

Title: Sigil of the Black Hand (Mythic)
Objective: Collect 4 Embers of the Mountain, 4 Hearts of Stone, and 4 Shards of Iron from the final bosses of each wing of the Blackrock Foundry on Mythic difficulty.
Text: Once I walked these halls with pride, holding my head high as an orc of the Blackrock clan. But this is a wrong path. Our hammers were meant to craft axes, swords... not these machines from the stranger's whispers. The Warlord will not be swayed, but by force. If you can retrieve essences from the Foundry's most powerful guardians, I can craft for you a sigil that will permit direct access to Blackhand's Crucible.

Title: Boar Training: Riplash
Objective: Defeat Riplash while riding your Boar-In-Training.
Text: This boar is at home in the rocky plains of Gorgrond, so it will be easier to train. As with other beasts, we will begin the training in the place it calls home. Test your boar against the great predator Riplash, a raptor known to hunt boars.

Title: Wolf Training: The Garn
Objective: Defeat Maimclaw while riding your Snarler-In-Training.
Text: I've got one last challenge for ye, commander, but if it isn't a doozy. They call them the garn. Wolves as black as night, and twice the size of a normal wolf, they can tear a man apart in seconds. Any beast in their right mind would be scared witless at the sight of such a predator. There's a lone garn that's made it from their usual home in Frostfire, all the way over to Nagrand. Take your wolf, mount up, and bring it down. If the two of you survive, your wolf will truly be ready.

Title: Wolf Training: Darkwing Roc

Text: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both of em.' Head on out to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. That'll be a good test for the both of ye.

Title: Wolf Training: Cruel Ogres
Objective: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Snarler-In-Training.
Text: The wolves of Draenor are some of the most savage beasts around, but they've also gotten used to the sights and smells of the orcs and ogres that live here. It shouldn't take us much time at all to train this little ball of fur and death. Let's set it loose against the ogres of the region that yer familiar with. That Gorian Beast-Lasher, the one that smells of blood and fear, go on and see how your wolf reacts to that.

Title: Wolf Training: Orc Hunters
Objective: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Snarler-In-Training.
Text: The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the best hunters I've ever had the misfortune of meeting. If anyone can pose a real test for your future mount, it's one of their chief beast-killers. Out in Nagrand, you'll find an orc by the name of Karak. They call him the Great Hunter, and he's taken down more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Get astride your wolf and bring him down. In the name of the poor wee beasts!

Title: Wolf Training: Ironbore
Objective: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Snarler-In-Training.
Text: Alright, we've taken on foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. What happens when the beasts are below your feet, though? We're about to find out! The rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your wolf on out to the sandy shores and see if you can't take down one of the elder rockworms: Ironbore.

Text: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both of em.' Head on out to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. That'll be a good test for the both of ye.

Title: Boar Training: Bulbapore
Objective: Defeat Bulbapore while riding your Boar-In-Training.
Text: Way down south in the Spires of Arak, the land's being overtaken by the mushrooms that grow underwater. The result? Strange fungal creatures sprouting up all over the place. Taking on a strange creature, like the fungal giant Bulbapore, gives us a great chance to expose your boar to predators it's unfamiliar with.

Title: Clefthoof Training: Thundercall
Objective: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
Text: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Ever seen a ram in a thunderstorm? They'll hide behind anything larger than themselves. I'm not sure if they think the world is ending or what, but it's not great if you're atop one at the time. In Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your clefthoof and face off against Thundercall, and we'll see if it gets spooked.

Title: Boar Training: Gezz'ran
Objective: Defeat Gezz'ran while riding your Boar-In-Training.
Text: There's plenty more beasts out in the wild that can make a snack of your favorite mount. One of the most cunning on Draenor is the stalker. Stalkers can blend into their environments, allowing them to sneak in and steal the eggs of nearby prey. See if you and your boar can't overcome this natural defense mechanism. You'll find some mean stalkers out in Talador.

Title: Boar Training: Riplash
Objective: Defeat Riplash while riding your Boar-In-Training.
Text: That boar's seen it's share of combat out in Gorgrond, so it'll be a bit easier to train. We'll start off in it's home, as you've done with yer other beasties. See if the two of you can't take down the mighty raptor known as Riplash.

Title: Clefthoof Training: Orc Hunters
Objective: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
Text: The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the best hunters I've ever had the misfortune of meeting. If anyone can pose a real test for your future mount, it's one of their chief beast-killers. Out in Nagrand, you'll find an orc by the name of Karak. They call him the Great Hunter, and he's taken down more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Get astride your clefthoof and bring him down. In the name of the poor wee beasts!

Title: Clefthoof Training: Ironbore
Objective: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
Text: Alright, we've taken on foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. What happens when the beasts are below your feet, though? We're about to find out! The rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your clefthoof on out to the sandy shores and see if you can't take down one of the elder rockworms: Ironbore.

Title: Clefthoof Training: The Garn
Objective: Defeat Maimclaw while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
Text: I've got one last challenge for ye, commander, but if it isn't a doozy. They call them the garn. Wolves as black as night, and twice the size of a normal wolf, they can tear a man apart in seconds. Any beast in their right mind would be scared witless at the sight of such a predator. There's a lone garn that's made it from their usual home in Frostfire, all the way over to Nagrand. Take your clefthoof, mount up, and bring it down. If the two of you survive, your clefthoof will truly be ready.

Title: Clefthoof Training: Cruel Ogres
Objective: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
Text: Nagrand is home to the mightiest beasts in Draenor, and the ogres of the region have learned to tame them using brutal techniques. There is one ogre in particular, the Gorian Beast-Lasher, that smells of blood and fear. Go on and see how your clefthoof reacts to that.

Title: Clefthoof Training: Moth of Wrath
Objective: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
Text: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust. If the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it'll probably be a pretty good test for your clefthoof. See if you can't keep it focused and take down that moth.

Title: Clefthoof Training: Darkwing Roc
Objective: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
Text: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both of em.' Title: Clefthoof Training: Great-Tusk
Objective: Defeat Great-Tusk while riding your Clefthoof -In-Training.
Text: The first step in training your mount for war will be getting it used to the sights and sounds of combat. If it's not trained properly, it might get spooked and run. Take this little clefthoof out to the plains of Shadowmoon Valley and take on the biggest beast you can find, together. That should raise its confidence!

Objective: Defeat Rakkiri while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
Text: Now that the clefthoof has a taste for combat, let's take it out into a harsher environment. Take your clefthoof out to the icy hills of Frostfire Ridge, and take on the great predator Rakkiri. We'll really put 'er toughness to the test.

Title: Nemesis: Becoming Death
Objective: Kill a Goblin Player in Player versus Player combat while in Draenor and retrieve their Goblin Heart.
Text: You have chosen your quarry and surely soon they will feel your merciless wrath, but first you must venture out into the wilds of Draenor and rip out the still-beating heart of a goblin in mortal combat. Return here with your prize. Through the heart of your enemy the spirits will attune your senses, granting you second sight and keenness in hearing - all to stalk your prey and claim dominance.

Objective: Kill 500 Goblin Players in Player versus Player combat across Draenor.
Text: The ritual is complete. Your nemesis is marked for death. Now your work to rid this world of the enemy truly begins. Kill all goblins that stand defiantly against the Alliance. Let their deaths serve as a warning to the rest of the Horde: they will leave Draenor or they will die. Return when you have quenched your rage with the blood of goblin. Conquer our enemy and be known as the killer of Kezan. Fail and be nothing.

Title: Nemesis: Hunter - Hunted
Objective: Burn a Nemesis Effigy at the Gladiator's Sanctum then speak to Kuros.
Text: Our enemies surround us, and with each passing day their numbers grow. It is time to make a decisive strike against their armies, champion. Around me stand effigies of our most hated adversaries. You will be their downfall. You will become nemesis and they will run in fear at the sight of you. Now select the target of your rage and burn in effigy that race which you mean to eradicate. Speak to me when you have made your selection.

Text: The ritual is complete. Your nemesis is marked for death. Now your work to rid this world of the enemy truly begins. Kill all blood elves that stand defiantly against the Alliance. Let their deaths serve as a warning to the rest of the Horde: they will leave Draenor or they will die. Return when you have quenched your rage with the blood of blood elf. Conquer our enemy and be known as slayer of Sin'dorei. Fail and be nothing.

Title: It's a Matter of Strategy
Objective: Speak to Bron Skyhorn to secure a flight to Talador.
Text: **Eyes Only -- Commander **The Iron Horde have proved themselves worthy foes. They managed to get their fleet moving to Talador from Gorgrond without my spies seeing a thing. Talador be a crossroads for the whole continent. We can't let them have it. Don't worry boss, we got a plan. Foreman Grobash be setting up an outpost for our forces as we speak. They be ready for you when you arrive, commander. --Rokhan

Title: Taking the Fight to Nagrand
Objective: Speak with Stone Guard Brox at the caravan in Nagrand.
Text: **Eyes Only -- Commander **Durotan recommended dat we be gettin' a foothold in Nagrand, so I taken the liberty of dispatchin' some of da boys.Thrall's already reportin' the new outpost be nearly complete. He been askin' me to let ya know they be ready for ya.A windrider be waitin' to catch ya up with the latest caravan shipment whenever you be ready.-- Rokhan

Title: Arakkoa Exodus
Objective: Speak with Azik in Spires of Arak.
Text: I assume you're familiar with the arakkoa, commander? Great, flying birdfolk. Extremely territorial.Some, however, have withered wings - a disease, maybe. They seem to be outcast from arakkoa society. You find them now and then, squatting in forgotten ruins or peddling trinkets on the roadside.It seems the Iron Horde has incited the arakkoa by moving into their lands, and the outcasts are fleeing in droves.We should make contact with these outcasts - they could have valuable information.

Title: Wrangling a Wolf
Objective: Use the Wolf Lasso on a Young Snarler and follow it until it is tamed.
Text: The wolves of this land have jaws of steel. It is no wonder that the orcs have taken them as their own. Yet, deep in Nagrand, there are young wolves, ripe for taming. They will present a great challenge to you, as they are more fast and agile than any beast in this land. Here is your final rope, may luck be with you.

Title: Requisition a Riverbeast
Objective: Use the Riverbeast Lasso on a Young Riverwallow and follow it until it is tamed.
Text: I have seen great beasts floating slowly along the rivers of Talador. The 'riverbeasts,' I believe they are called. Their hides are solid, like rock, and yet they float along the waters easily. I would quite like to see one of these up close, if you should head that way. Tormak has created for you another rope, if you are interested.

Title: Entangling an Elekk
Objective: Use the Elekk Lasso on a Young Meadowstomper and follow it until it is tamed.
Text: The plains of Nagrand are the most lush and fertile that I have ever seen. Should you ever see them, you will come upon the mightiest beasts that this place has to offer. Among them, the great elekk. A magnificent beast with horns that can grow larger than you or I. Here is another rope, should you wish to tangle with such a beast.

Title: Besting a Boar
Objective: Use the Boar Lasso on a Young Rocktusk and follow it until it is tamed.
Text: The great boars of Gorgrond appear to serve as both a mount and an excellent source of food. Having a few of them in the garrison would not be an unwise idea. I have created for you another rope, should you wish to ride one down. Be wary of the Iron Horde presence nearby.

Title: Blood of the Annihilan
Objective: Collect Malinoth's Blood.
Text: We must make contact with Lord Illidan's spirit. But to do that, we need something powerful enough to fuel the nether crucible. I know just the thing.A pit lord named Malinoth has taken over a nearby cave. If we acquire his blood, you can use it to power the crucible. Then, you can make contact with Illidan in the Twisting Nether.

Title: Report to the King
Objective: Speak with King Anduin Wrynn.
Text: We have slowed the Iron Horde down, but this war is far from over... I'll stay here and continue our efforts to hold back the Iron Horde. The King needs to know about what we have accomplished here today, and the threat we face in the future. It is probably best if you report to King Wrynn yourself.

Title: Phantom Potion
Objective: Bring Tyra Silverblood 10 Ghost Truffles.
Text: Every turn you take in Ashran you run into danger. But don't fret , I've developed the perfect solution. It's my very own riff on the popular Invisibility Potion. I'm just missing one of the ingredients: cave mushrooms. Luckily, a variety grows right here in Ashran.

Title: Warning Orgrimmar

Title: Nemesis: Becoming Death
Objective: Kill a Gnome Player in Player versus Player combat while in Draenor and retrieve their Gnome Heart.
Text: You have chosen your quarry and surely soon they will feel your merciless wrath, but first you must venture out into the wilds of Draenor and rip out the still-beating heart of a gnome in mortal combat. Return here with your prize. Through the heart of your enemy the spirits will attune your senses, granting you second sight and keenness in hearing - all to stalk your prey and claim dominance.

Title: Nemesis: Becoming Death
Objective: Kill a Dwarf Player in Player versus Player combat while in Draenor and retrieve their Dwarf Heart.
Text: You have chosen your quarry and surely soon they will feel your merciless wrath, but first you must venture out into the wilds of Draenor and rip out the still-beating heart of a dwarf in mortal combat. Return here with your prize. Through the heart of your enemy the spirits will attune your senses, granting you second sight and keenness in hearing - all to stalk your prey and claim dominance.

Title: Requisition a Riverbeast
Objective: Use the Riverbeast Lasso on a Young Riverwallow and follow it until it is tamed.
Text: I wasn't sure about this next beast, but it turns out that they've got a key strategic purpose. The riverbeast is quite at home in the water! You'll find the best ones around in Talador, around about Duskfall Island. Look for the huge, floating lumps out in the water. Try not to get wet!

Title: Nemesis: Manslayer
Objective: Kill 500 Human Players in Player versus Player combat across Draenor.
Text: The ritual is complete. Your nemesis is marked for death. Now your work to rid this world of the enemy truly begins. Kill all humans that stand defiantly against the Horde. Let their deaths serve as a warning to the rest of the Alliance: they will leave Draenor or they will die. Return when you have quenched your rage with the blood of man. Conquer our enemy and be known as manslayer. Fail and be nothing.

Title: From Within
Objective: Find Kor'vas Bloodthorn on Faronaar at Vanquish Point.
Text: A few of our demon hunters, Kor'vas Bloodthorn and Cyana Nightglaive, took a small force of the Illidari across to Faronaar. Their mission was to weaken the Legion from within.I haven't heard from them in a while.It would be best if you could find and lead them to success. Agreed?

Title: Capturing a Clefthoof
Objective: Use the Clefthoof Lasso on a Young Icehoof and follow it until it is tamed.
Text: Greetings, friend. I have been told that you are in need of a master of beasts. I come from the icy slopes of Northrend to finally shake this snow from my fur. This savage land holds many creatures that we may tame so that our forces may ride on formidable war mounts. The mighty clefthoof reminds me of the mammoths from my home. Take this lasso and head out to the northern reaches of Frostfire Ridge. Mount up and use it to capture one of the young beasts.

Title: Taming a Talbuk
Objective: Use the Talbuk Lasso on a Young Silverpelt and follow it until it is tamed.
Text: The next beast is one of the fastest in Draenor, but will test your skills at infiltrating into enemy territory. The young talbuk can be found on the flowery hills of Shadowmoon Valley. Take this talbuk lasso and head out. When you encounter one, mount up and throw this rope, then follow it until it is tamed. Good hunting!

Title: Besting a Boar
Objective: Use the Boar Lasso on a Young Rocktusk and follow it until it is tamed.
Text: Have you seen the boars they have here? Bigger than I am! Let's get one of them, why not? You're going to have to head to Gorgrond for that task. Way out in the desolate regions, you'll find the ones we're lookin' for.

Title: Capturing a Clefthoof
Objective: Use the Clefthoof Lasso on a Young Icehoof and follow it until it is tamed.
Text: Way up north in the frozen peaks of Frostfire Ridge, you'll find the wooly clefthoof. They're sturdy, for sure, and fierce when you corner them. Don't expect them to be tamed without a fight. Here's a lasso, see if you can't manage to tame one before it tugs the rope out of your hands.

Title: Entangling an Elekk
Objective: Use the Elekk Lasso on a Young Meadowstomper and follow it until it is tamed.
Text: Well, you're pretty good at this whole taming thing. What's next? We've done big, and we've done pointy. Let's do big AND pointy. I'm talking Elekks. Way out on the fertile plains of Nagrand, you'll find the finest specimens of beast this world has to offer. Grab one of the younger elekks, and we'll see if we can't get it trained like the Draenei used to.

Title: Wrangling a Wolf
Objective: Use the Wolf Lasso on a Young Snarler and follow it until it is tamed.
Text: This next one will test you to your very limits, commander. The wolf is the most savage beast in all of Draenor. The wolves of Nagrand, mounts of the fabled Warsong clan, can rend a man to bits in seconds. They're also faster and more agile than anything you've seen yet. Here's your lasso. Good luck, and don't get yourself killed!

Title: Taming a Talbuk
Objective: Use the Talbuk Lasso on a Young Silverpelt and follow it until it is tamed.
Text: If we're going to start sending out patrols in this wilderness, we'll need swift mounts for our troops. We can capture young beasts and bring them back here for training, eventually turning them into formidable beasts of war. The talbuk is one of Draenor's fastest creatures, and that makes them just that much more difficult to capture. Take this talbuk lasso and head out to Shadowmoon Valley. Mount up and rope one of the young talbuk, and follow it until it's tamed. Don't let it get too far from you!

Title: Nemesis: Becoming Death
Objective: Kill a Human Player in Player versus Player combat while in Draenor and retrieve their Human Heart.
Text: You have chosen your quarry and surely soon they will feel your merciless wrath, but first you must venture out into the wilds of Draenor and rip out the still-beating heart of a human in mortal combat. Return here with your prize. Through the heart of your enemy the spirits will attune your senses, granting you second sight and keenness in hearing - all to stalk your prey and claim dominance.

Title: Nemesis: Hunter - Hunted
Objective: Burn a Nemesis Effigy at the Gladiator's Sanctum then speak to Raza'kul.
Text: Our enemies surround us, and with each passing day their numbers grow. It is time to make a decisive strike against their armies, champion. Around me stand effigies of our most hated adversaries. You will be their downfall. You will become nemesis and they will run in fear at the sight of you. Now select the target of your rage and burn in effigy that race which you mean to eradicate. Speak to me when you have made your selection.

Title: The Great Angler Returns
Objective: Return to Segumi with Nat's journal page as proof that you found him.
Text: What's this species, an arcane trout you say? I have never even heard of a fish like this, much less seen one in person!I have to find more fish like this, it's what I live for! And if the fishing is as good as you say it is, there is just no way I can pass this opportunity up. Take this page from my journal as proof that you found me and I will meet you back at your Garrison.

Title: Warlord of Draenor
Objective: Kill Enemy Players in Player versus Player combat to earn 20 Broken Bones then place an offering at the Altar of Bones to Earn a Conqueror's Tribute.
Text: The Exarchs do nothing but squabble amongst themselves over petty issues while our people are slaughtered in their homes by orc filth. If they will not raise a fist of defiance against our enemies, I will. I wish to join your Alliance and rid this world of Horde. ALL HORDE - "Iron" or otherwise. This Altar of Bones that I stand upon represents glory in battle against our Horde enemy. Place an offering upon it and earn a conqueror's tribute worthy of your unrelenting bloodthirst. Kill. Them. All.

Title: Warlord of Draenor
Objective: Kill Enemy Players in Player versus Player combat to earn 20 Broken Bones then place an offering at the Altar of Bones to Earn a Conqueror's Tribute.
Text: Durotan...  He cowers behind the white flag of peace, relying upon diplomacy to win over our sworn enemies. Enemies that have taken our homes and driven us from our ancestral lands. There is only one way to deal with the draenei and their newfound alliance of cowards - blood for blood. Join me in crushing our enemies. Together we will flood this hallowed ground with the bones of the Alliance and earn tributes fit for a warchief! Return here when your bloodthirst is sated.

Title: The Dark Portal
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at the foot of the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands.
Text: , is it? I'm glad you're here. We can use every able-bodied  that we can get. I am assembling a coalition of Azeroth's strongest to step through this Dark Portal and stop the Iron Horde invasion. This may be the only way to save Azeroth. Will you join us?

Title: Luring Nat
Objective: Catch an Arcane Trout in Shadowmoon Valley and bring it back to Segumi.
Text: Now that you are experienced enough with Draenor fishing, we might have a shot at convincing Nat Pagle to join us out here.If we want Nat to actually come all the way out here, we are going to have to show him real proof of the incredible catches on Draenor. Head out to local waters here in Shadowmoon Valley and see what you can do. All that time you spend honing your skill here in Draenor should pay off now.

Title: Pinchwhistle Gearworks
Objective: Speak to Bron Skyhorn the Wingman to secure a flight to the Pinchwhistle Gearworks.
Text: Commander, a courier arrived this morning. He said he's from a goblin settlement in Spires of Arak called the Pinchwhistle Gearworks. They've asked for our assistance with some sort of ecological disaster. We're spread thin but if we can earn their trust then we might be able to gain a valuable ally. Head down there and see what sort of assistance we can provide. I've already spoken to the flight master and he's set up a special flight to get you out there.

Title: Pinchwhistle Gearworks
Objective: Speak to Dungar Longdrink to secure a flight to the Pinchwhistle Gearworks.
Text: Commander, a goblin courier arrived this morning. He mentioned that he is from a settlement in the Spires of Arak called the Pinchwhistle Gearworks. They have requested our assistance with some sort of ecological disaster. If we can earn their trust it'll be worth the effort. Head down there and see what sort of assistance we can provide. I've already spoken to the flight master and he's set up a special flight to get you out there.

Title: Your Second Leatherworking Work Order
Objective: Place a work order, then collect it once it completes.
Text: Place another work order with my assistant. Once it is complete, we will leave it out here for you to collect.

Title: Ogre Waygates
Objective: Collect 25 Ogre Waystones and use them to activate an Ogre Waygate in Draenor.
Text: Six unique gates exist in Draenor, built by ogre magi in ages past. We've discovered their potency has not diminished over the millennia. If you can collect enough ogre waystones to activate one of these ancient waygates, we can build a one-way portal from your garrison to that location.

Title: Your Second Alchemy Work Order

Title: They Came From Above
Objective: Find Crystal-Shaper Barum near Aruuna in Talador.
Text: Please, traveler, I need your help. Aruuna, my home, has been destroyed by the arakkoa. They swooped down from their spires and killed anyone who tried to escape. My family... did not make it out. My brother Barum stayed behind to find his daughter amidst the chaos. I beseech you, please, go to Aruuna and find Barum. He is the only family I have left.

Title: Your Second Enchanting Work Order
Objective: Place a work order, then collect it once it completes.
Text: Place another work order with my assistant. Once it is complete, we will leave it out here for you to collect.

Title: Shadow Council Invasion!
Objective: Repel the Shadow Council invasion of your garrison.
Text: There's a cold fire in my blood, Commander. Like a warlock has my heart in his claw. Let the Shadow Council show themselves!

Title: Shadow Council Invasion!
Objective: Repel the Shadow Council invasion of your garrison.
Text: The demons are at our heels, Commander. Cow's milk is sour. A crone gave me an evil look this morning. The sky just doesn't seem... right.

Title: Subversive Infestation
Objective: Recover Phylarch's Research, Xeri'tac's Venom Gland, and 3 Depleted Everbloom Seeds from the Everbloom and return to Phylarch the Evergreen.
Text: As lord of the Everbloom my charge was the weaponization of nature. You have likely seen the fruits of my labor in your journeys across my world. My discoveries have allowed my kind to control the invasive species of Draenor through subversive infestation. I speak of total systemic control of the invading organism - the mind and the body. Now that you are my master I offer these gifts to you, but first you must retrieve my research and tools from the Everbloom. Do this and great power is yours.

Title: The Flock's Revenge
Objective: Kill 18 Bloodmane Saberon.
Text: The Bloodmane took several of our initiates when they ambushed our ritual in Ravenskar. They must be taught that the flock will never allow such a deed to go unpunished! We will kill one of their tribe for each of the flock that has fallen! head into their accursed home of Bloodmane Valley and slaughter as many of them as you can find.

Title: The Initiate's Revenge
Objective: Kill 18 Bloodmane Saberon.
Text: I... I'm finished. My spirit will be with the Raven Mother soon. I beg of you, stranger... avenge me! Slay these filthy beasts.

Title: Phantom Potion
Objective: Bring Gimlett Ginfizz 10 Ghost Truffles.
Text: Every turn you take in Ashran you run into danger. But don't fret , I've developed the perfect solution. It's my very own riff on the popular Invisibility Potion. I'm just missing one of the ingredients: cave mushrooms. Luckily, a variety grows right here in Ashran.

Title: One Step Ahead
Objective: Speak to Vindicator Maraad at Redemption Rise.
Text: Commander, Vindicator Maraad set off with Yrel and Thaelin Darkanvil to track the Iron Horde's movements in the nearby forest. They await your arrival on a small rise to the southwest.

Title: Vintage Free Action Potion
Objective: Bring Tyra Silverblood 10 Ashmaul Pearls.
Text: The Alliance have increased their usage of snares, roots and stuns on our melee forces. Luckily I have just the potion for them. The recipe is a little old, but it'll work. A key ingredient I need can be found here in Ashran, at the beach near that Ogre Tower.

Title: Vintage Free Action Potion
Objective: Bring Gimlett Ginfizz 10 Ashmaul Pearls.
Text: I hear our heroes in the front line are becoming victim to massive amounts of snares, roots and stuns! Luckily I have just the potion for them. The recipe is a little old, but it'll work. A key ingredient I need can be found here in Ashran, at the beach near that Ogre Tower.

Title: Pristine Fang-Scarred Frostwolf Axe
Objective: Put the artifact on display.
Text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in your Garrison.

Title: Burning Beauty
Objective: Speak with Vivianne.
Text: Before you go, there is someone you should meet. She might set some of your stuff on fire, but I believe she's the best mage this side of Draenor. She belongs on the front lines with you, commander.

Title: Warspear Welcome
Objective: Speak with Lieutenant Kragil.
Text: Lieutenant Kragil said you might be showing up. I've been ordered to take you to the inn.

Title: Inspiring Ashran
Objective: Speak with Narnin Dawnglow, Beska Redtusk, and Zarjhin.
Text: I hope you will find our facilities to be up to your high standards. This inn is run by Narnin Dawnglow, in my opinion this is the best place to hearth in Draenor. We have new recruits coming through the portal daily. In fact one of out latest recruits, Zarjhin, just came through the portal today. If you are looking for weapons or armor Beska Redtusk will be happy to help.

Title: Assault on the Pit
Objective: Assault the Blackrock forces at the Pit in Gorgrond.
Text: The Blackrock forces based out of the Pit in Gorgrond make up the bulk of the Iron Horde army. If we crush them on their home soil, the rest of the Iron Horde will have little hope of standing against us.If you choose the battle, bring friends. The Blackrock won't be defeated easily.

Title: The Ring of Blood: Mogor!
Objective: Defeat Mogor in the Ring of Blood.
Text: You've really done it this time, champ. Mogor has challenged you to uphold his title as lord of the ring! I wish I could give you tips to help you make it out of there in one piece, but I've never seen Mogor fight. Nobody's ever gotten this far! Good luck.

Title: Ashran Appearance
Objective: Speak with Private Stomphoof at Warspear in Ashran.
Text: Our base on Ashran is almost complete, commander. It would be a huge show of support if you could make a trip out there and put your stamp of approval on their staging area. I can arrange a flight if you are interested.

Title: Challenge at the Ring of Blood
Objective: Do battle at the Ring of Blood.
Text: A challenge has been issued at the Ring of Blood.Bring friends and do battle to prove your right as champion.

Title: Assault on the Broken Precipice
Objective: Assault the ogron forces at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.
Text: Massive ogron have been battering our frontlines, and no matter how many we down, there seem to be more to replace them.Most of these ogron appear to be coming from the Broken Precipice, deep in western Nagrand. If we're to stand a chance in the coming battles, we need to find a way to remove these ogron from the battlefield.

Title: Assault on the Everbloom Wilds
Objective: Assault the Botani forces in the Everbloom Wilds in Gorgrond.
Text: Botani and the plant monstrosities they conjure have been slowly encroaching on our outposts in the north. For every plant we kill, new ones seem to rise in its place.Rokhan has put together a plan for striking at the heart of their lands, in Everbloom Wilds. He thinks this will draw them back into the jungles of Gorgrond, giving us more room to maneuver around them.

Title: Assault on the Heart of Shattrath
Objective: Assault the Sargerei force in Shattrath City in Talador.
Text: Sargerei forces from deep in Shattrath have grown stronger and bolder by the day. We can no longer risk ignoring the threat that they pose.Bring allies if you wish to face the Sargerei so deep within the city.

Title: Assault on Magnarok
Objective: Assault the stone monstrosities at Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge.
Text: Colossal magnaron, gronn, and other stone monstrosities have been threatening our garrison. Most seem to originate from Magnarok, just to the north.If we strike at them at their home, we should be able to force them back. It's risky, but it may be our best move. While you're there, see if you can recover any of our supplies.

Title: Assault on the Iron Siegeworks
Objective: Assault the Iron Horde forces at the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.
Text: Iron Horde war machines are being shipped onto battlefields by the dozens, and our forces are struggling to hold their ground. Most of these machines seem to be originating from the Iron Siegeworks in eastern Frostfire Ridge.A strategic attack to disrupt and dismantle the Iron Horde at the siegeworks could be just what we need to turn the tide of the war.

Title: Battle in Ashran
Objective: Join the battle in Ashran.
Text: As we do battle all across Draenor, the cowardly Alliance try to seize our territory within Ashran.Our men would be inspired to see you join the battlefield, striking terror into the hearts of the Alliance.

Title: Assault on Mok'gol Watchpost
Objective: Assault the Warsong force at Mok'gol Watchpost in Nagrand.
Text: Warsong raiders out of Mok'gol Watchpost have been terrorizing anything and everything not behind a tall wall. We've warned travelers not to stray out alone, but many don't listen.If we were to launch an assault on Mok'gol Watchpost, we would almost certainly put the Warsong back on the defensive, restricting most of their riders to Nagrand.

Title: Assault on Skettis
Objective: Assault the arakkoa forces at Skettis in Spires of Arak.
Text: We've been receiving regular reports of birdmen from the south ambushing and burning caravans along the main roads.Guards from our outposts are requesting that we launch a counter attack against the main presence of Adherents of Rukhmar at Skettis in Spires of Arak.

Title: Assault on Socrethar's Rise
Objective: Assault the Sargerei forces at Socrethar's Rise in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: Recent reports suggest a notable rise of activity by Sargerei forces at Socrethar's Rise in southern Shadowmoon Valley.Socrathar's disciples pose a threat all over Draenor. We must not allow them to gain a foothold so far from our reach.

Title: Assault on Lost Veil Anzu
Objective: Assault the hostile creatures at Lost Veil Anzu in Spires of Arak.
Text: Some of our best scouts have gone missing in the vicinity of the lost ruins of Veil Anzu.Rokhan has requested any available resources be dispatched to identify the threat and see if any of our men yet remain alive within the ruins.

Title: Assault on Darktide Roost
Objective: Assault the Iron Horde forces at Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: There's been a resurgence of rylaks on the battlefield in our skirmishes against the Iron Horde. If we don't stop them at the source, we'll quickly lose control of the roads and be pushed back into our outposts.The most likely source of these additional rylaks is in southeastern Shadowmoon Valley, at Darktide Roost. If we move quickly, we should be able to stop their operation cold.

Title: Assault on the Pit
Objective: Assault the Blackrock orcs at the Pit in Gorgrond.
Text: The Blackrock forces based out of the Pit in Gorgrond make up the bulk of the Iron Horde army. If we crush them on their home soil, the rest of the Iron Horde will have little hope of standing against us.If you choose the battle, bring friends. The Blackrock won't be defeated easily.

Title: Assault on Pillars of Fate
Objective: Assault the Shadowmoon forces at Pillars of Fate in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: Remnants of the Shadowmoon clan continue to operate out of the peaks on the eastern border of Spires of Arak.Rokhan is concerned at their proximity to key choke points leading into Shadowmoon Valley, and has put out a request that we thin their forces as soon as possible.

Title: Challenge at the Ring of Blood
Objective: Do battle at the Ring of Blood.
Text: A challenge has been issued at the Ring of Blood.Bring friends and do battle to prove your right as champion.

Title: Assault on the Heart of Shattrath
Objective: Assault the Sargerei forces deep within Shattrath City in Talador.
Text: Sargerei forces from deep in Shattrath have grown stronger and bolder by the day. We can no longer risk ignoring the threat that they pose.Bring allies if you wish to face the Sargerei so deep within the city.

Title: Assault on Skettis
Objective: Assault the Adherents of Rukhmar at Skettis in Spires of Arak.
Text: We've been receiving regular reports of birdmen from the south ambushing and burning caravans along the main roads.Guards from our outposts are requesting that we launch a counter attack against the main presence of Adherents of Rukhmar at Skettis in Spires of Arak.

Title: Assault on Pillars of Fate
Objective: Assault the Shadowmoon orcs at Pillars of Fate in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: Remnants of the Shadowmoon clan continue to operate out of the peaks on the eastern border of Spires of Arak.Bodrick Grey is concerned at their proximity to the garrison, and has put out a request that we thin their forces as soon as possible.

Title: Assault on the Broken Precipice
Objective: Assault the ogron forces at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.
Text: Massive ogron have been battering our frontlines, and no matter how many we down, there seem to be more to replace them.Most of these ogron appear to be coming from the Broken Precipice, deep in western Nagrand. If we're to stand a chance in the coming battles, we need to find a way to remove these ogron from the battlefield.

Title: Assault on Lost Veil Anzu
Objective: Assault the hostile creatures at Lost Veil Anzu in Spires of Arak.
Text: Some of our best scouts have gone missing in the vicinity of the lost ruins of Veil Anzu.Bodrick Grey has requested any available resources be dispatched to identify the threat and see if any of our men yet remain alive within the ruins.

Title: Battle in Ashran
Objective: Join the battle in Ashran.
Text: As we do battle all across Draenor, the cowardly Horde try to seize our territory within Ashran.Our men would be inspired to see you join the battlefield, striking terror into the hearts of the Horde.

Title: Assault on Mok'gol Watchpost
Objective: Assault the Warsong forces at Mok'gol Watchpost in Nagrand.
Text: Warsong raiders out of Mok'gol Watchpost have been terrorizing anything and everything not behind a tall wall. We've warned travelers not to stray out alone, but many don't listen.If we were to launch an assault on Mok'gol Watchpost, we would almost certainly put the Warsong back on the defensive, restricting most of their riders to Nagrand.

Title: Assault on Darktide Roost
Objective: Assault the Iron Horde forces at Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: There's been a resurgence of rylaks on the battlefield in our skirmishes against the Iron Horde. If we don't stop them at the source, we'll quickly lose control of the roads and be pushed back into our outposts.The most likely source of these additional rylaks is in southeastern Shadowmoon Valley, at Darktide Roost. If we move quickly, we should still have time to get ahead of the problem.

Title: Assault on Socrethar's Rise
Objective: Assault the Sargerei forces at Socrethar's Rise in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: Recent reports suggest a notable rise of activity by Sargerei forces at Socrethar's Rise in southern Shadowmoon Valley.Socrathar's disciples pose a threat to draenei and our garrison alike. We need to quell them at our soonest convenience.

Title: Assault on the Everbloom Wilds
Objective: Assault the botani forces in the Everbloom Wilds of Gorgrond.
Text: Botani and the plant monstrosities they conjure have been slowly encroaching on our outposts in the north. For every plant we kill, new ones seem to rise in its place.Bodrick Grey has put together a plan for striking at the heart of their lands, in Everbloom Wilds. He thinks this will draw them back into the wilds of Gorgrond, giving us more room to maneuver around them.

Title: The Ring of Blood: Skull Chewer!
Objective: Defeat Skull Chewer in the Ring of Blood.
Text: Welcome to Nagrand's one and only Ring of Blood, where hopefuls become gladiators and gladiators become discarded piles of meat on the arena floor! Talk to me to start a fight, hop down into the ring, and fight for your life. It's positively brutal - and the crowd loves it! You'll face off against an ogron that has a hankering for freshly severed heads. You'll be fine... and I'll be rich!

Title: Assault on the Iron Siegeworks
Objective: Assault the Iron Horde forces at the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.
Text: Iron Horde war machines are being shipped onto battlefields by the dozens, and our forces are struggling to hold their ground. Most of these machines seem to be originating from the Iron Siegeworks in eastern Frostfire Ridge.A strategic attack to disrupt and dismantle the Iron Horde at the siegeworks could be just what we need to turn the tide of the war.

Title: The Ring of Blood: Dreshax!
Objective: Defeat Dreshax in the Ring of Blood.
Text: You're going to love this one, champ. That's right, it's the largest bone worm this side of Draenor. Dreshax lovingly disposes of all of the suckers... I mean... fallen gladiators for us. Think you've got what it takes? Hop on in and wait. Dreshax's lair is just below the arena - he'll come to you.

Title: The Ring of Blood: Fracktus!
Objective: Defeat Fracktus in the Ring of Blood.
Text: Have you ever fought a living, breathing mountain that wants to murder your face? Well, today's your lucky day! Fracktus is a... well... living, breathing mountain that wants to murder your face, actually. Got that one right the first time! Just hop in the ring so we can get started, will ya?

Title: The Ring of Blood: Venoxis!
Objective: Defeat Venoxis in the Ring of Blood.
Text: Alright, alright, how about this. A living, breathing... wait for it.... tree... that wants to murder your face. Genius, right? Look, they don't pay me to come up with witty dialogue about these things, give me a break. They're ogres - they pay for blood. Hence the name.

Title: Assault on Magnarok
Objective: Assault the stone monstrosities at Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge.
Text: Colossal magnaron, gronn, and other stone monstrosities have been threatening our outposts in the west. Most seem to originate from Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge.If we strike at them at their home, we should be able to force them back. It's risky, but it may be our best move. While you're there, see if you can recover any of our supplies.

Title: Assault on Shattrath Harbor
Objective: Assault the Sargerei forces at Shattrath City in Talador.
Text: Shattrath City is in the hands of Sargerei forces under the leadership of the once Exarch, Socrethar.The Shadow Council forces in the eastern portion of the city are gaining in power through the aid of demons from the Nether, and need to be culled before they become a threat to all of our operations.

Title: Assault on Stonefury Cliffs
Objective: Assault the Bloodmaul ogres at Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.
Text: Bloodmaul ogres from Frostfire Ridge have been ambushing trade routes throughout the continent, and are putting captured soldiers to work in their slag mines.Shadow Hunter Rokhan has requested the rescue of friendly troops that have been taken prisoner in the main Bloodmaul compound at Stonefury Cliffs.

Title: Scrappin'
Objective: Defeat the pets in the battle area.
Text: Ever since we built da menagerie, a lot o' "visitors" been showin' up. I know da look, and they be lookin' for a fight. , you show 'em you da real master 'round here.

Title: Iron Horde Invasion!
Objective: Speak with Sergeant Crowler.
Text: There's smoke on the horizon... The Iron Horde is coming.

Title: Botani Invasion!
Objective: Repel the botani invasion of your garrison.
Text: There's a weight in the air. Reminds me of battles in Stranglethorn Valley. Jungle warfare is good for axe-play.

Title: Your First Jewelcrafting Work Order
Objective: Start and collect your first Jewelcrafting work order at the Gem Boutique.
Text: Now that the gem boutique is complete, we can start producing taladite crystals for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

Title: Ogre Invasion!
Objective: Repel the ogre invasion of your garrison.
Text: Scouts report that ogre packs march through Shadowmoon Valley. We've left our impression with them, eh Commander?

Title: Your First Inscription Work Order
Objective: Start and collect your first Inscription work order at the Scribe's Quarters.
Text: Now that the scribe's quarters are complete, we can start producing war paints for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

Title: Your First Engineering Work Order
Objective: Start and collect your first Engineering work order at the Engineering Works.
Text: Now that the engineering works is complete, we can start producing gearspring parts for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

Title: Assault on Shattrath Harbor
Objective: Assault the Sargerei forces at Shattrath City in Talador.
Text: Shattrath City is in the hands of Sargerei forces under the leadership of the traitor Exarch, Socrethar.Members of the Sha'tari Defense have been requesting aid against the Shadow Council forces in the eastern portions of the city.

Title: Your First Enchanting Work Order
Objective: Start and collect your first Enchanting work order at the Enchanter's Study.
Text: Now that the enchanter's study is complete, we can start producing draenic dust for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

Title: Your First Tailoring Work Order
Objective: Start and collect your first Tailoring work order at the Tailoring Emporium.
Text: Now that the tailoring emporium is complete, we can start producing hexweave cloth for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

Title: Assault on Stonefury Cliffs
Objective: Assault the Bloodmaul ogres at Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.
Text: Bloodmaul ogres from Frostfire Ridge have been ambushing trade routes throughout the continent, and are putting captured soldiers to work in their slag mines.Bodrick Grey has requested the rescue of friendly troops that have been taken prisoner in the main Bloodmaul compound at Stonefury Cliffs.

Title: Your First Leatherworking Work Order
Objective: Start and collect your first Leatherworking work order at the Tannery.
Text: Now that the tannery is complete, we can start producing burnished leather for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

Title: Your First Alchemy Work Order
Objective: Start and collect your first Alchemy work order at the Alchemy Lab.
Text: Now that the alchemy lab is complete, we can start producing alchemical catalysts for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

Title: Your First Work Order
Objective: Hand the assistant the reagents to start your first work order from a profession building.
Text: Now that you have a profession building, we can start producing work orders for you. When you have the ingredients we need, please come to me to start the first batch.

Title: The Secrets of Gorgrond
Objective: Seek Yrel at the Wildwood Wash in Gorgrond. Speak with your Garrison Gryphon Master or the Flight Master at Bastion Rise to fly there.
Text: Commander, I was dispatched to intercept you. Yrel and Maraad have landed at Wildwood Wash, the rangari base of operations for the area. Your presence is requested immediately. We keep a small feywing presence just east of here. If you speak with the flight master they should be able to provide you safe passage to the Wash.

Title: Ashran Appearance
Objective: Speak with Private Tristan at Stormshield in Ashran.
Text: Our base on Ashran is almost complete, commander. It would be a huge show of support if you could make a trip out there and put your stamp of approval on their staging area. I can arrange a flight if you are interested.

Title: Host Howell
Objective: Speak with Lieutenant Howell.
Text: Lieutenant Howell said you might be showing up. It's such an honor to meet you in person. The lieutenant is at the inn, I'll escort you over there.

Title: A Surly Dwarf
Objective: Speak with Delvar Ironfist.
Text: Before you go there is someone you might want to talk with. He's opinionated, a bit gruff, and very overbearing, but he's the best damn warrior I've met in ages. He belongs on the front lines with you, commander. And trust me, he knows it.

Title: Inspiring Ashran
Objective: Speak with Jaesia Rosecheer, Vindicator Nuurem, and Knewbie McGreen.
Text: I hope you will find our facilities to be up to your high standards. This inn is run by Jaesia Rosecheer, in my opinion this is the best place to hearth in Draenor. We have new recruits coming through the portal daily. In fact our latest recruit, Knewbie McGreen just came through the portal today. If you are looking to trade for weapons or armor, Vindicator Nuurem will be happy to help.

Title: Strategic Choices
Objective: Choose between your strategic options.
Text: Good to see you, commander.My network has been keeping eyes on enemy movements. There are a couple threats I'd like to get you up to date on.Do you have a moment to look at our options?

Title: Ogre Invasion!
Objective: Repel the ogre invasion of your garrison.
Text: Commander, our scouts say that ogre bands march through the snow. If they want more battle after the beating we already delivered, then I'm eager to oblige them.

Title: Big Frostfire Gun
Objective: Subdue 6 Clefthooves.
Text: One of my finest works! Momma would be so proud of me right now... if she was still in one piece. We gotta test this bad boy out though before I'm comfortable letting you run around with it all willy-nilly. I heard there were some clefthooves out back causing a ruckus.

Title: My Very Own Castle
Objective: Gather 2000 Garrison Resources and then use the Architect Table to select your Town Hall and upgrade your garrison to Tier 3.
Text: Commander! Some good news. I finally got that new larger draft paper in that I ordered when we first came here. And do you know what larger draft paper means?It means I can draw a bigger castle!And if I can draw it, we can certainly make it! Making it is the easy part, assuming you have a few thousand stones and logs lying around.So what do you say, sir? Shall we get building?

Title: An Angler on Our Team
Objective: Talk to Nat Pagle and ask him to join our cause.
Text: You truly are a master fisherman!I would be delighted to join you here on Draenor and help you catch as many lunkers as you can. But first, let's grab a drink.

Title: The Great Angler Returns
Objective: Return to Rak'jin with Nat's journal page as proof that you found him.
Text: What's this species, a molten catfish you say? I have never even heard of a fish like this, much less seen one in person!I have to find more fish like this, it's what I live for! And if the fishing is as good as you say it is, there is just no way I can pass this opportunity up. Take this page from my journal as proof that you found me and I will meet you back at your Garrison.

Title: Finding Nat Pagle
Objective: Travel to the Angler's Wharf in Krasarang Wilds and talk to Nat Pagle.
Text: Now that you have proof, we might just have a shot at convincing Nat Pagle to join us out here.Last I heard, he was in fishing with the local Angler's faction out in Pandaria. Somewhere off the coast of Krasarang Wilds. Head out there, show him your catch and see if you can get him to come back with you!

Title: Luring Nat
Objective: Catch a Molten Catfish in Frostfire Ridge and bring it back to Rak'jin.
Text: Now that you are experienced enough with Draenor fishing, we might have a shot at convincing Nat Pagle to join us out here.If we want Nat to actually come all the way out here, we are going to have to show him real proof of the incredible catches on Draenor. Head out to the lava lakes here in Frostfire and see what you can do. All that time you spend honing your skill here in Draenor should pay off now.

Title: My Very Own Fortress
Objective: Gather 2000 Garrison Resources and then use the Architect Table to select your Town Hall and upgrade your garrison to Tier 3.
Text: Boss! Guess what?! I finally got that new larger draft paper in that I ordered when we first came here. And ya know what larger draft paper means?It means I can draw a bigger fortress!And if I can draw it, I can certainly make it! Making's the easy part, as long as you've got a few thousand stones and logs lying around.So whada'ya say, boss? Shall we get building?

Title: News from Nagrand
Objective: Speak to Rokhan at your garrison in Frostfire Ridge.
Text: Welcome back.One of our shadow hunters delivered a message about a caravan being dispatched for Nagrand. Rokhan's awaiting your approval on a new outpost.I've been hearing whispers around camp about Nagrand. They say it's Warsong territory. They might need your help .

Title: News from Nagrand
Objective: Speak to Bodrick Grey at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: Welcome back.One of Bodrick's men delivered a message about a caravan being dispatched for Nagrand. He's awaiting your approval on a new outpost.I've been hearing whispers around camp about Nagrand. They say it's Warsong territory. They might need your help .

Title: News from Nagrand
Objective: Speak to Rokhan at your garrison in Frostfire Ridge.
Text: One of your soldiers stopped by asking for you while you were out. Something about a caravan heading out to Nagrand.Whatever it was, it can't have gone well for them. That's Warsong territory.

Title: News from Nagrand
Objective: Speak to Bodrick Grey at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: One of your soldiers stopped by asking for you while you were out. Something about a caravan heading out to Nagrand.Whatever it was, it can't have gone well for them. That's Warsong territory.

Title: "Spare" Parts
Objective: Recover 20 Black Iron Shells and 50 Siege Cannon Parts.
Text: I've never seen anything like this before! No problem though, boss man. If it can be used to blow things up, I can get it working again. We are definitely going to need some parts--some sort of ammunition wouldn't hurt either. Sounds like those Iron Horde guys over yonder are no stranger to things that go boom. Take these tools with you and let's see if we can't commandeer us some spare parts!

Title: A True Draenor Angler
Objective: Catch a Lunker in each of the Draenor zones and bring them back to Nat Pagle.
Text: If you want me to help you permanently, you have to show me a few of these big Draenor catches first. Head out into the wild and bring me back the biggest fish you can find from all the surrounding areas.I made this custom lure for you to use, please take care of it, it's never let me down!

Title: Breakers Invasion! UNUSED
Objective: Repel the Breaker invasion of your garrison.
Text: Quakes have been shaking the garrison for the last hour, and a few of our scouts aren't reporting in.

Title: Heavy Arms
Objective: Look around the garrison for help with the repairs.
Text: The burned out shell of some sort of weapon of mass destruction. It might be worth asking around your garrison to see if anyone can help get it working again.

Title: Bigger is Better
Objective: Use the Architect Table to select your Town Hall and upgrade your garrison to Tier 2.
Text: Commander, I've been working on schematics that you might be interested in.What do you think about pushing out the walls and making room to get some additional structures in here? Our forces have been growing, and things are getting a little cramped, and I'd really like us to put some of those additional blueprints to use.If you could, take a look at the plans on the table here. As soon as I have your go ahead, I'll get everyone to work immediately.

Title: He Drew Aggro...culture
Objective: Find the pilot of the Dark Iron tank.
Text: What you saw was the wake of the genesaur, Iyu. It was chasing this mechanical monstrosity and the person who drove it. I believe the pilot of this vessel is still alive and trapped within the ruins of the camp. If you wish them to be recovered, I recommend doing so now.

Title: Strike While the Iron is Hot
Objective: Speak to Rangari Rajess to fly to the Iron Approach and attack the Iron Horde.
Text: With the Will of the Genesaur, we wield a powerful weapon. Our scouts have discovered an Iron Horde base, and I believe this is the time to seize an opportunity. They amass far to the north at the Iron Approach. This will not be easy, but we must deal a blow to the Iron Horde while we possess the artifact. We are prepared to depart at your command. Speak with Rangari Rajess when you are ready.

Title: Tangleheart Return
Objective: Speak to Penny Clobberbottom outside Tangleheart.
Text: Hey there, peach. We've got the lumber mill good and ready, but we gotta find a way of choppin' wood fast out here.The Laughing Skull talked about Tangleheart, where the botani grow things quick as a quark.I'm headin' there now.

Title: Strike While the Iron is Hot
Objective: Speak to Grinslicer to fly to the Iron Approach and attack the Iron Horde.
Text: With the Heart of the Mangaron, we wield a powerful weapon against the Iron Horde. They amass far to the north at the Iron Approach. This will not be easy, but we must seize the opportunity to deal a blow to the Iron Horde while we possess the artifact. We are prepared to depart at your command. Speak with Grinslicer when you are ready.

Title: Unruly Visitors
Objective: Defeat the pets in your Garrison menagerie's battle area.
Text: Looks like we've got some visitors in the battle pen today, and they're looking for a fight. Why don't you show 'em how a master of pet battles handles ?

Title: Unruly Visitors
Objective: Defeat the pets in your Garrison menagerie's battle area.
Text: Looks like we've got some visitors in the battle pen today, and they're looking for a fight. Why don't you show 'em how a master of pet battles handles ?

Title: Strike While the Iron is Hot
Objective: Speak to Rangari Rajess to fly to the Iron Approach and attack the Iron Horde.
Text: With the Heart of the Magnaron, we wield a powerful weapon against the Iron Horde. They amass far to the north at the Iron Approach. This will not be easy, but we must seize the opportunity to deal a blow to the Iron Horde while we possess the artifact. We are prepared to depart at your command. Speak with Rangari Rajess when you are ready.

Title: Strike While the Iron is Hot
Objective: Speak to Grinslicer to fly to the Iron Approach and attack the Iron Horde.
Text: With the Will of the Genesaur, we wield a powerful weapon. Our scouts have discovered an Iron Horde base, and I believe it is time to seize an opportunity. They amass far to the north at the Iron Approach. This will not be easy, but we must deal a blow to the Iron Horde while we possess the artifact. We are prepared to depart at your command. Speak with Grinslicer when you are ready.

Title: Bigger is Better
Objective: Use the Architect Table to select your Town Hall and upgrade your garrison to Tier 2.
Text: Ya know boss, I think I know how we can take this place to the next level. Bigger walls. More buildings. Some space to stretch your arms after a long day of adventuring.Don't get me wrong, it's going to take a lot of resources, but what else are these things for?We can plot it out on the drafting table whenever you're ready. It's going to be GLORIOUS.

Title: A Green Ogron?
Objective: Kill the Infested Ogron.
Text: Them botani got themselves a green ogron. A green ogron! I mean I may not know much about plant people but that canno' be a good thing. Think ya can take it in a fight?

Title: Abyssal Gulper Eel
Objective: Ron Ashton wants you to collect 10 Abyssal Gulper Eel Eggs from Spires of Arak.
Text: We need to stock the garrison pond with local fish. I need you to search the waters in Spires of Arak for fish that we can stock up with. Once you have the fish, you will need to slice them up and look for eggs inside.

Title: Cut 'Em Out!
Objective: Obtain the materials needed to repair the cloak.
Text: After all that you've done for us, I would love to help you. Regrettably, I don't have the materials I would need to repair this perfectly. Use my knife to gather a few hides from the clefthoof that roam near the spire and find some sootweed pitch to properly cure them. Unfortunately, those miserable ogres have taken up residence in the only place that I know of sootweed to grow. You may be in for a fight . Return to me if you can obtain these and I will gladly help you repair your cloak.

Title: Blind Lake Sturgeon
Objective: Ron Ashton wants you to collect 10 Blind Lake Sturgeon Eggs from Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: We need to stock the garrison pond with local fish.  I need you to search the waters in Shadowmoon Valley for fish that we can stock up with. Once you have the fish, you will need to slice them up and look for eggs inside.

Title: Blackwater Whiptail
Objective: Ron Ashton wants you to collect 10 Blackwater Whiptail Eggs from Talador.
Text: We need to stock the garrison pond with local fish. I need you to search the waters in Talador for fish that we can stock up with. Once you have the fish, you will need to slice them up and look for eggs inside.

Title: Fat Sleeper
Objective: Ron Ashton wants you to collect 10 Fat Sleeper Eggs from Nagrand.
Text: We need to stock the garrison pond with local fish. I need you to search the waters in Nagrand for fish that we can stock up with. Once you have the fish, you will need to slice them up and look for eggs inside.

Title: Fire Ammonite
Objective: Ron Ashton wants you to collect 10 Fire Ammonite Eggs from Frostfire Ridge.
Text: We need to stock the garrison pond with local fish. I need you to search the waters in Frostfire Ridge for fish that we can stock up with. Once you have the fish, you will need to slice them up and look for eggs inside.

Title: Jawless Skulker
Objective: Ron Ashton wants you to collect 10 Jawless Skulker Eggs from Gorgrond.
Text: We need to stock the garrison pond with local fish. I need you to search the waters in Gorgrond for fish that we can stock up with. Once you have the fish, you will need to slice them up and look for eggs inside.

Title: Is This One of Yours?
Objective: Talk to Rexxar and vouch for Rangari Erdanii.
Text: I found this one skulking nearby. She claims to be an ally of yours. Is this true? Or does she cook slowly over my fire?

Title: A Warrior's Shroud
Objective: Locate a Frostwolf leatherworker in Wor'gol that can help you.
Text: Although this cloak has seen better days, the workmanship is still quite impressive. Any normal cloak would have most certainly fallen apart by now. Perhaps one of the Frostwolf orcs within Wor'gol would be willing to help you repair it.

Title: Trophy of Glory: Biolante
Objective: Take the trophy to Durotan at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
Text: Defeating Biolante has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim. Take this to Durotan at Beastwatch.

Title: Trophy of Glory: Biolante
Objective: Take the trophy to Maraad at Highpass in Gorgrond.
Text: Defeating Biolante has yielded you a trophy worthy of showing off at your outpost. Return this to Maraad to increase your glory!

Title: News from Talador
Objective: Speak to Bodrick Grey at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: Bodrick Grey sends word from your garrison that they have spotted a fleet of Iron Horde at the shores of Talador. We must not allow them to destroy Shattrath.

Title: Iron Horde Invasion
Objective: Speak with Thrall at the Shattered Landing in Blasted Lands.
Text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Thrall in Blasted Lands. Use the portal at the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar to head directly to the front line. This new threat is known only as the Iron Horde. They have taken over the Dark Portal and must be stopped Destiny calls!

Title: Iron Horde Invasion
Objective: xxxx
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Vindicator Maraad at the Shattered Beachhead in the Blasted Lands. You can reach the docks outside Northwatch Hold by taking a boat from Booty Bay to Ratchet and traveling south along the coast. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: News from Talador
Objective: Speak to Rokhan at your garrison in Frostfire Ridge.
Text: Rokhan sends word that you are needed at Frostwall. The Iron Horde have landed on the shores of Talador.

Title: The Lumber Mill
Objective: Speak to Glirin outside Tangleheart.
Text: The Rangari have been here for a tick, and they hear tell from the Laughing Skull o' a place called Tangleheart.Seems some really bad ancients come from there, and botani use a kind o' sap to grow them quickly.I think we could use that for yer outpost. Hey, wood is wood, right?I'll meet ya there.

Title: Iron Horde Invasion
Objective: Speak with Vindicator Maraad at the Shattered Beachhead in Blasted Lands.
Text: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Vindicator Maraad at the Shattered Beachhead in Blasted Lands. Use the portal at the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind to head directly to the front line. This new threat is known only as the Iron Horde. They have taken over the Dark Portal and must be stopped. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

Title: Thieving Dwarves
Objective: Find Cutter at Bastion Rise.
Text: Cutter is on the trail of the artifact the dwarves stole. He has the nose of a wolf when it comes to hunting in the jungle. Follow the canyons south until you find him. It would seem the wolf queen and I are going to do more damage here before we leave. We will follow as quickly as we can.

Title: Firebird's Challenge
Objective: Collect 15 rings while flying.
Text: You're ready to fly high and give the Firebird's challenge a shot? That's great! Simply collect 15 rings to win! Speak to me when you're ready for takeoff!

Title: A Green Ogron?
Objective: Kill the Infested Ogron.
Text: Kaz always told me green ogron are bad. The botani here have a green ogron and it is mean. It was strong enough to take out my dad's entire hunting party. Are you strong enough to kill it?
