Title: Assault on the Pit
Objective: Destroy Iron Horde weapons cache and take out as many of them as you can.
Text: The Iron Horde are stockpiling their weapons and ammunition outside of the Foundry. Their campaign throughout Draenor has left their caches vulnerable. Get in there and cause as much chaos as you can, and while you're at it use some of that ammunition against them if they're just going to leave it lying around!

Title: Battle Pet Roundup
Objective: Defeat the pets in the battle area.
Text: Looks like we've got some visitors in the battle pen today, and they're looking for a fight. Why don't you show 'em how a master of pet battles handles ?

Title: The Razorbloom
Objective: Find Draka and Kaz at the Razorbloom.
Text: The Laughing Skull shaman Kaz ran off while we were coming here. She claimed to be looking for more of her people in the jungles to the south. Draka insisted on following her to safeguard us against betrayal. Commander, if Kaz is telling the truth, then she and Draka are going to need all the help they can get. Will you join them? They could not have gotten far. This could prove to be the perfect test for your new shredder and lumber mill resources.

Title: Broken Promises
Objective: Find someone at the Darkmoon Faire that might be interested in the ring.
Text: A heavily-scratched ring, faintly stained with blood. Someone at the Darkmoon Faire might be able to provide more information about this item.

Title: A New Darkmoon Challenger!
Objective: Defeat Christoph VonFeasel in a pet battle.
Text: Look at me, now look at my horse, now look back at me, are I not the most impressive battler of pets that you have ever seen? Look now at my compatriot over there. Is he on a horse? Of course not! Is his hat made of fireworks? Not in a million years! Everything about me is more impressive, from my coat color to my last name, which I made myself. Dare you step up to the might of Christoph Willikens Dennis Ragnaros VonFeasel the First? I can see you trembling!

Title: Pets Versus Pests
Objective: Defeat the three pests in your garrison.
Text: I been tryin' ta get dis place ready for your pets, but we uncovered some rude pests while buildin' da garrison. I tried takin' care o' dem myself, but they be too tough for my little friends. Beat da angry carrot in da garden, da rat eatin' our food, and da ornery water creature harassing da fishermen. If you can do it, I be free to finish up da work on your menagerie.

Title: Stealing the Declaration
Objective: Loot the contents of Master Siegesmith Uratok's Strongbox.
Text: Commander, you and Raleigh did a great job finding me, but I'm exactly where I need to be. We've been working tirelessly since we got here, trying to crack these Draenic texts. I really thought I was gonna get the scrolls, but they nabbed me at the last possible second! Please, you've gotta help me out... up the hill to the east, you'll find the Master Siegesmith's tent. If you can grab the documents out of his chest, possibly this key too, I'll finally have enough to translate their languages.

Title: Bypassing Security
Objective: Infiltrate Grom'gar using Raleigh's Prestige Card.
Text: Oh, my goodness! This is a list of captives, it appears they may be awaiting transfer... or possibly even execution. There is one name on this list that I do recognize: my master! I have been awaiting his return, but now it appears that he may have fallen into enemy hands. This is a disaster! Please, we must rescue him. According to the notes, he has been taken to Grom'gar, located far east of here. One moment... I think I may have just the thing to help you break in undetected...

Title: Locating the Lapidarist
Objective: Search for the owner of the pendant in Wor'gol.
Text: Are you sure I can't take this off your hands? I'll give you a fair price! Alright, alright... if you insist on finding the owner, you might want to try visiting Wor'gol. Rumor has it, there is a master craftsman, skilled in manipulating precious metals and stones. But, if you change your mind, you know where to find me....

Title: Just Another Stick in the Wall
Objective: Use Penny's Plunger to blow up the Rock Wall.
Text: So, get this.As I was flyin' in, I took the opportunity to scope out what might be a defensible position.Just on the other side o' these boulders is an ideal clearing to hole up in. I even brought a set of blueprints to get us all settled in!That's not too presumptuous, is it?Anyway, whenever you're ready just hit this plunger!

Title: Reduction in Force
Objective: Collect the Head of Weldon Barov.
Text: I was a fool to trust him after the fiasco over the Barov family fortune! What I should have done is killed him the first chance I had. And now he thinks he's going to plumb this land for all that it's worth and cut me out?! No, dear brother, not this time! There can only be one CEO of Barov Industries and it will be me. My peasant friend, you must do me this service. Find my brother, Weldon, and serve him a notice of termination! You will likely find him out in the wilds, near small timber.

Title: Reduction in Force
Objective: Collect the Head of Alexi Barov.
Text: I was a fool to trust him after the fiasco over the Barov family fortune! What I should have done is killed him the first chance I had. And now he thinks he's going to plumb this land for all that it's worth and cut me out?! No, dear brother, not this time! There can only be one CEO of Barov Industries and it will be me. My peasant friend, you must do me this service. Find my brother, Alexi, and serve him a notice of termination! You will likely find him out in the wilds, near small timber.

Title: Taking the Death Bloom
Objective: Take the Death Bloom from Smokemaster Snarl in Steamscar Rise.
Text: Your work has born fruit. Inside the nearby cave a powerful saberon shaman is learning to channel the genesaur magic using the Death Bloom we seek. The solution is before us: kill the shaman, take the Death Bloom, return it to Birchus. That should improve the safety of our outpost.

Title: Spawn Tracking & Spell Visuals: Do They Work?
Objective: Use the What's It to see a Spell Visual play through the magic of Spawn Tracking tech.
Text: Here's some text.

Title: Reclaiming Property
Objective: Find 8 Herb Bundles in saberon stashes at Steamscar Rise.
Text: You are attracted by a low green glow to the container. Inside there is a glowing bundle of herbs that was most likely stolen from the overgrowth below. It would be best to collect all of these so the saberon don't continue their dabbling in plant magic and irritating the nearby magnaron.

Title: Shredder vs. Saberon
Objective: Break the vine barrier using your shredder.
Text: The saberon took their treasure up the rise and barricaded themselves in after Birchus attacked. It will be difficult to get in but I hear you have resources to handle this. One of their entrances is covered with tough vegetation. I believe you have a mechanical solution to this problem in the form of a shredder. I think you know what to do...

Title: Saberon Population Reduction
Objective: Slay 10 saberon at Steamscar Rise.
Text: We are closer to our goals but a host of sharp toothed saberon bar our way. If we are to get anywhere up here, some of the more aggressive ones will need to be put down I think.

Title: Laying Dionor to Rest
Objective: Watch Birchus's ritual.
Text: You have given me a tremendous gift with this bloom. I can finally send Dionor back to the Overgrowth for good and end this nightmare. All that remains is the ritual... stay and behold something you will never see again in your lifetime...

Title: Beatface vs. Boulder
Objective: Break the boulder barrier using Beatface the gladiator.
Text: The saberon took their treasure up the rise and barricaded themselves in after Birchus attacked. It will be difficult to get in but I hear you have resources to handle this. One of their entrances is covered with a large boulder. Too large for you or I, but perhaps an ogre with a large enough hammer could break it. I think you know who I am talking about...

Title: Penny From Heaven
Objective: Speak to Penny Clobberbottom at Beastwatch.
Text: Those from your world are not much for subtlety, are they?Go on ahead and greet our new companion. We will join you as soon as we can make ready.

Title: Ambassador to the Ancient
Objective: Talk to Birchus at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.
Text: It appears that a genesaur was killed here not long ago and this growth has sprung up. It is stirring up the local monsters and I fear for our outpost. There is a strange ancient that wallows in grief here and is not hostile. Perhaps you could "harvest" its story?

Title: Unintelligible Intelligence
Objective: Look around Wor'gol for someone who can help translate the notes.
Text: The notes are unreadable, but based on previous experience, the text appears to be very similar to standard Orcish. It is possible that the notes could contain strategic information. Perhaps it would be of great value to the Frostwolf Orcs. Someone in Wor'gol might be able to help interpret the text.

Title: Plant Pruning
Objective: Kill 12 defenders at Dionor's Demise.
Text: There may be more to this aberrant growth than it seems, but we will need to clear the way a bit before we can get to the bottom of this, yes? I suggest clearing out some of the angrier defenders to be on the safe side.

Title: Seeking the Scout
Objective: Find Altauur at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.
Text: We are still trying to locate all of our scouts out in the field. One of these, Altauur, enjoys handling the more dangerous missions. He has not checked in and I feel we should check to make sure he has not taken on more than he can handle.

Title: The Rise and Fall of Barov Industries: Alexi Barov
Objective: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.

Title: Egg Punt
Objective: Kick 10 Ravager Eggs in Camp Thornscar.

Title: Curing With Force
Objective: Cure 6 Infected Goblins.
Text: The infection is getting stronger so I made some adjustments and I'm pretty sure I have the right formula now. It should now work but it needs to have less competition with the infected blood for it to have any effect. This means you will need to weaken them before you apply the serum for it to function properly. The infection is getting more advanced and will soon be untreatable so we have this one shot to save as many as we can.

Title: Pets Versus Pests
Objective: Defeat the three pests in your garrison.
Text: I've been trying to get this place ready for your pets, but we've uncovered some rude pests while building the garrison. I tried to take care of them myself, but they are too tough for my meager team. There's an angry carrot in the garden, an enormous rat eating our food rations, and an ornery water creature harassing the fishermen. If you can take care of them, I'll be free to finish up my work on your menagerie.

Title: Dyed in the Fur
Objective: Use Trega's Flytrap Ichor to create a Swatch of Hexweave.
Text: I can't believe they tried to physically rip the magic out of the material! It seems we were never in danger of my secrets falling into the wrong hands after all. Better safe than dead... In return for your help, I will share with you my methods of fusing magic to cloth. Flytrap Ichor is very rare in this region, but I do have a bit in reserve. Take this woven fur and dip it in the ichor here. You will see for yourself what all of the fuss is about.

Title: From Their Cold Dead Hands
Objective: Collect 10 Damaged Hexweave from Bladespire Ogres.
Text: Those ogres took all of my hexweave! I kept it hidden at the bottom of my bag. How could they possibly know of its importance? If they discover even a portion of hexweave's properties, it means trouble for us all. , this is a Frostwolf problem. It requires a Frostwolf solution. Will you help me?

Title: Shadowmoon Invasion!
Objective: Repel the Shadowmoon clan invasion of your garrison.
Text: Scouts say the Shadowmoon clan looms close, ready with their necromancy. If I die and rise again, Commander, finish me quickly. I don't want to be a ghoul.

Title: Shadowmoon Invasion!
Objective: Repel the Shadowmoon clan invasion of your garrison.
Text: Scouts report that the Shadowmoon clan is buzzing like a kicked hornets' nest. Time again to earn our pay, Commander?

Title: Restoration
Objective: Retrieve the sample for Artificer Baleera.
Text: As mentioned, our larger defense crystals have been drained of power, creating gaps in our defenses. The crystal you brought me is only a reminder of the severity of this situation. It's Shadowmoon magic to blame, I'm sure of it. One of our rangari scouts spotted an orc fleeing north, past Palemoon Village, and into the valley beyond. Go, find this orc, and see if you can't retrieve whatever vessel he's storing the power inside of. If we get it back, I'm sure I can restore the crystals.

Title: The Rise and Fall of Barov Industries: Weldon Barov
Objective: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.

Title: A Power Lost
Objective: Find someone in Embaari Village well-versed in gemology and magic.
Text: The power within the fragment appears to be drained. You recall hearing travelers speak of a local in Embaari Village who specializes in imbuing gems with magic.

Title: Clearing the Garden
Objective: Kill 8 Lunarfall Raccoons.
Text: This clearing is the perfect spot to grow herbs for our Garrison, there is just one little problem. All these dang raccoons! I need you to clear them out and we can get this garden growing.

Title: Peeking into the Portal
Objective: Find Scout Pazaztick and use her telescope.
Text: I sent Scout Pazaztick to be gettin' a better look at da portal. He shoulda reported back by dis time; what be taking him so long? Dis is what happens when you hire da goblins as help.

Title: Field Trial
Objective: Venture into Pinchwhistle Point and use the Vial of Untested Serum on an Infected Bruiser or Infected Lumberjack. Return to Krixel Pinchwhistle to report the results.
Text: Look, I didn't tell Kimzee about this because I don't want to hurt her feelings, I chose not to leave Pinchwhistle Point. See, I've been working on a serum that I think should be able to cure the infected, but when I tried to test it I got surrounded and I injured my leg during the escape. I know I'm on the right track but I need to test it. Do me a favor and take this vial and go try it out on one of the infected outside.

Title: Legacy of the Ancients
Objective: Collect the Heart of Kuruk, the Trunk of Autuk, the Twig of Loruk, and the Roots of Hanuk.
Text: Opening the ancient tome you see that it's not actually a tome at all, but a container. Inside are four empty slots. Upon closer inspection each slot has next to it a carving of what appears to be a unique Draenor ancient, some glyphs and a receptacle used to hold a piece of the pictured ancient. There also appear to be directions to where these ancients may be found: medium timber -- Shadowmoon, Gorgrond, the Spires of Arak and Nagrand. These are assassination instructions. From trees to kill trees.

Title: Peeking into the Portal
Objective: Find Scout Pazerp and use her telescope.
Text: I sent Scout Pazerp to get a better look at the portal. She should have reported back by now; what could be taking her so long? She is one of my best scouts, I hope she is alright.

Title: No Pressure, No Diamonds
Objective: Acquire Lava Diamonds from the Lava Slimes that reside in Frostfire Ridge.
Text: You wish to understand the secrets of our gems? In exchange for returning my pendant, I am willing to help. I must warn you, however, that the materials will not be easy to obtain. To the north, you will find magma pools that give birth to living lava creatures. Contained within these, you may find magnificent diamonds. Please return to me with a few of these diamonds...

Title: Diamonds Are Forever
Objective: Wait for Orolak to finish crafting the pendant.
Text: Please watch closely . I shall craft this jewel into a fine pendant for you. Hopefully you will learn a bit of true jewelcrafting in the process.

Title: Assault on the Pit
Objective: Destroy Iron Horde weapons cache and take out as many of them as you can.
Text: The Iron Horde are stockpiling their weapons and ammunition outside of the Foundry. Their campaign throughout Draenor has left their caches vulnerable. Get in there and cause as much chaos as you can, and while you're at it use some of that ammunition against them if they're just going to leave it lying around!

Title: Goren Invasion!
Objective: Repel the goren invasion.
Text: Quakes have been shaking the garrison, and our scouts haven't reported in hours.

Title: Lost Lumberjack
Objective: Find Frenna within Tangleheart.
Text: All o' them mole machines got mighty unreliable here in Gorgrond. I hear tell that one of 'em might've crashed here in Tangleheart.See if you can find Frenna. She would've been on the one we tracked to this location. I'll go lookin' for the mole machine to see if it can be repaired.

Title: A Father and His Son
Objective: Return Duna and the toolset to Haephest.
Text: We must hurry before more orcs arrive! My father works just down this path! We'll be safe at his shop.

Title: Feeding An Army
Objective: Use the Improved Iron Trap to capture a Boar or Riverbeast in Gorgrond and then place a Work Order at your Barn.
Text: We've had a chance to work with these beasts for a while now, and that's allowed us to develop a brand-new trap for you to try out. It should be much sturdier than the last one. The Improved Iron Trap will let you capture some of the meatiest beasts on Draenor. You will find that a single riverbeast or boar from Gorgrond can feed many warriors. Trap one and bring it back, and we will cook you a savage meal.

Title: Bigger Trap, Better Rewards
Objective: Use the Deadly Iron Trap to capture a Ironhide Bull, Direfang Alpha, or Wetland Trampler.
Text: Ah, commander, it is good to see you again. With the materials we have gathered here in Draenor, we have been able to construct a trap strong enough to immobilize even the mightiest beast. These enormous creatures can be found on the western side of Nagrand, among the most fertile plains. A word of warning: these beasts are great and powerful. You may want to bring some friends along.

Title: Locating the Lapidarist
Objective: Search for the owner of the pendant in Wor'gol.
Text: Are you sure I can't take this off your hands? I'll give you a fair price! Alright, alright... if you insist on finding the owner, you might want to try visiting Wor'gol. Rumor has it there is a master craftsman there who's skilled in manipulating precious metals and stones. Might be your guy.

Title: Breaking into the Trap Game
Objective: Use the Iron Trap to capture a Clefthoof or Wolf in Frostfire Ridge and then place a Work Order at your Barn.
Text: When we came through the portal, we weren't able to bring any of our animals with us. For us to produce leather and furs, we'll need to trap some of the native beasts and bring them back here. Although the plains are frozen, there are many clefthooves and wolves in Frostfire. We can gather leather from the clefthooves, or furs from the wolves. Take this iron trap and use it on a wounded adult beast. Bring the trapped creature back to us, and we will begin our work.

Title: UNUSED
Objective: Use the Iron Trap to capture a Leatherhide Clefthoof, Breezestrider Talbuk, or Meadowstomper.
Text: When we came through the portal, we weren't able to bring any of our animals with us. For us to produce meat, leather, and furs, we'll need to trap some of the native beasts and bring them back here. I've heard word that the best grazing grounds are out in Nagrand. We can get a load of meat from the elekk, leather from the clefthooves, or furs from the talbuk. Take this iron trap and use it on a wounded adult beast, we'll haul it on back here and get to work.

Title: Primal Fury
Objective: Speak to Shadow Hunter Rokhan in northern Talador, then defeat Gorgorek and Warlord Azuka Bladefury.
Text: It looks like this is it, commander. We must stop the Iron Horde at all costs. I have sent stormcrows to your garrison, and called for Shadow Hunter Rokhan to deploy your troops to the Gates of Tanaan at once. By the time you get to northern Talador, he should be waiting for you... with an entire army. There is no time to delay.

Title: Primal Fury
Objective: Meet Bodrick Grey near the Gates of Tanaan in Talador, then defeat Gorgorek and Warlord Azuka Bladefury.
Text: It looks like this is it, commander. We must stop the Iron Horde at all costs. I have sent stormcrows to your garrison, and called for Bodrick Grey to deploy your troops to the Gates of Tanaan at once. By the time you get to northern Talador, he should be waiting for you... with an entire army. There is no time to delay.

Title: The Intricate Pendant
Objective: Ask around your garrison to see if anyone recognizes the pendant.
Text: The crimson gem used in this pendant is unlike any you've seen before, and the filigree wrapped around it is masterfully crafted. There's likely to be much you can learn from the person who made this. Perhaps someone at your garrison will recognize the work.

Title: Failed Apprentice
Objective: Find and release Deema from her time prison.
Text: Oru'kai was the first ogre mage to master the art of enchanting on Draenor. Upon his death, his items were scattered across Draenor. I have tracked his staff to the shore you see before us.As you can see, the staff's enchantment is making it difficult to retrieve. A would-be apprentice, Deema, took one of Oru'kai's rings in to break the enchantment, but she failed and became trapped as well.Find and free Deema, take the ring, complete her task, and I will consider a reward.

Title: Victory is Within Reach
Objective: Slay Ranjit, Araknath, Rukhran and High Sage Viryx in the Skyreach dungeon.
Text: We have dealt a crippling blow to the Adherents, but our fight is not yet finished. Gather your allies and prepare for the final siege on Skyreach! "Shadows gather when the raven swallows the day. Burning sky is extinguished as black wings fold gently about the heavens. Rest, my children, rest. For even the sun must sleep." This was Rukhmar's lullaby, sung by her to the first arakkoa. My, how we've lost our way.

Title: Oru'kai's Staff
Objective: Retrieve Oru'kai's staff and return it to Delath.
Text: If I had known being an enchanter was this dangerous, I would have stayed in Shattrath.Here, take this ring. The arakkoa told me to use the ring on the staff to nullify the enchantment.Bring the scepter back to him and maybe he will teach you what he promised to teach me.

Title: Father and Son
Objective: Find Haephest's son.
Text: Please find my boy! Before the looters came we were on the hill just northeast of here. There weren't many of them, but I'm a blacksmith, not a fighter! Have I let my only son down?

Title: Investigating the Invasion
Objective: Meet Maraad behind enemy lines.
Text: I'm going to lead a small squad behind enemy lines. Meet me by Dreadmaul. From there we can decide our next course of action.

Title: The Strength of Iron
Objective: Deliver the satchel to Haephest.
Text: A stitched patch along the side of the satchel clearly identifies its owner. You remember hearing stories of a great blacksmith just north of Embaari.

Title: The Arakkoan Enchanter
Objective: Find Delath on the Forgotten Shore to the south.
Text: The arakkoa said it was going to investigate an anomaly along the Forgotten Shore that might be related to another armor piece.

Title: Enchanted Highmaul Bracer
Objective: Take the bracer to Eileese Shadowsong in your Garrison.
Text: A powerful enchantment emanates from these ancient Highmaul bracers.Maybe Eileese Shadowsong, your garrison enchanting quartermaster, can tell you more about the bracer.

Title: Phylarch the Evergreen
Objective: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.

Title: Trega's Tailoring Kit
Objective: Find Trega in Wor'gol.
Text: The bag is filled with patterns and unfamiliar tailoring tools. You find the name "Trega" embroidered on the inside of the bag. You seem to recall seeing her in Wor'gol. With any luck, she's still there.

Title: Out of the Shadows
Objective: Speak to Bodrick Grey at your Garrison.
Text: Congratulations again, Blood Champion. You be fightin' like nobody I ever seen. While you were in da ring, one ayour bruddas came by and asked for you ta return ta your base. He called himself Bodrick Grey.

Title: Investigating the Invasion
Objective: Meet Thrall behind enemy lines.
Text: I'm going to lead a small squad behind enemy lines. Meet me by Dreadmaul. From there we can decide our next course of action.

Title: It's Gotta Work!
Objective: Visit Nubble.
Text: My apprentice Nubble was able to use your salvaged parts to put the finishing touches on the new location analyzer. Head on over to try out my newest invention!

Title: Snatch 'n' Grab
Objective: Search the beach for salvageable parts.
Text: We were able to map all of the data from the transponder you recovered! Now our location analyzer is complete! We're just missing a few final pieces, then the real testing begins. One of my pilots mentioned seeing a beached Iron Horde ship over by the shore. If you can salvage some parts we may just be able to get this thing up and running!

Title: Out of the Shadows
Objective: Speak to Rokhan in your Garrison.
Text: Congratulations, Blood Champion. You be fightin' like nobody I ever seen. While you were in da ring, one a your bruddas came by and asked for you ta return ta your base. He called himself a shadow hunter.

Title: Dirgemire
Objective: Retrieve the Fungal Brain from Dirgemire.
Text: In order to fully understand the nature and properties of the Zangarium Draenormycota, I need to examine the strain within a complex fungal structure. The fungal brain of a spore giant would do nicely. Not just any spore giant will serve though, it needs to be big... mean... primordial... the perfect specimen! In a cavern deep below the surface is an ancient spore giant the locals fearfully refer to as Dirgemire. Slay the monster, but be sure to carefully preserve the fungal brain for our research!

Title: Garrison Campaign: The Ring of Blood
Objective: Speak to Gurgthock at Gurgthock's Stash in Nagrand.
Text: Hey Champ, You were out when I stopped by. You're the talk of the arena, friend! I mean, the Ring of Trials? Stonemaul? You're killing it out there! I've got a sweet gig set up at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand. Lots of ogres looking for the next big fight. Big money. You in? I'll meet you at my stash so we can talk a bit in private before your big debut.

Title: Transponder 047-B
Objective: Return the transponder to Goggles.
Text: The back of the transponder is etched in scribbled writing.

Title: A Fascinating Fungus
Objective: Collect 12 Fungal Spores.
Text: The Zangar Shore is home to many peculiar strains of fungi, some of which are similar to those of our native Azeroth. However, one strain in particular is most fascinating! I call it "Zangarium Draenormycota," due to its prevelance in Draenor's fungal ecosystem. This unique strain of fungus is highly adaptable and can be found on many of the living organisms throughout Zangar Shore. Why does it exist? What properties does it hold? To answer these questions, I will need additional spore samples.

Title: Garrison Campaign: The Ring of Blood
Objective: Speak to Gurgthock at Gurgthock's Stash in Nagrand.
Text: Hey Champ, You were out when I stopped by. I've got a sweet gig set up at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand. Lots of ogres looking for the next big fight. Big money. You in? If you think the Stonemaul arena was a thrill, this is way, way bigger than that. It's going to be HUGE, I'm calling it now. I'll meet you at my stash so we can talk a bit in private before your big debut.

Title: Garrison Campaign: The Ring of Blood
Objective: Speak to Gurgthock at Gurgthock's Stash in Nagrand.
Text: Hey Champ, You were out when I stopped by. I've got a sweet gig set up at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand. Lots of ogres looking for the next big fight. Big money. You in? You're the one that brought a new meaning to pain at the Ring of Trials not too long ago, right? This is the next step in your climb to fame! You've gotta get down here. I'll meet you at my stash so we can talk a bit in private before your big debut.

Title: Hexcloth
Objective: Use Ameeka's Flytrap Ichor to create a Swatch of Hexweave.
Text: I shall now impart to you the finer points of creating hexcloth. The process is quite simple. It involves immersing carefully woven fur into the ichor drawn from Gorgrond Flytraps. Normally, you would need to harvest it yourself, but I actually managed to liberate some from the Shadowmoon during their last raid. You are welcome to use it.

Title: Whacking Weeds
Objective: Slay 20 Spiteleaf podlings.
Text: Something needs to be done about the podling menace in Spiteleaf Thicket! Alongside Hemet Nesingwary, I've hunted some of the largest and most terrifying beasts around. Never in my life have I encountered a creature as vile, depraved, nefarious or degenerate as a podling! The vicious little monsters spread themselves like weeds and if something isn't done, they'll spread across the entire continent! Make your way into Spiteleaf Thicket and slay as many podlings as you can find!

Title: Bigger Trap, Better Rewards
Objective: Use the Deadly Iron Trap to capture an Ironhide Bull, Direfang Alpha, or Wetland Trampler.
Text: Good news, commander! With the materials we've gathered here in Draenor, we've been able to construct a trap strong enough to immobilize even the mightiest beast! Why don't you head on out to Nagrand and give it a try? Word has it that the western plains are home to some of the most magnificent beasts this side of Crystal Lake. I'm going to warn you, though, these beasts are tough. You may want to bring some friends along.

Title: The Search For Research
Objective: Return the Research Journal, Expedition Supplies, and Anti-fungal Boots to Dr. Hadley Ricard.
Text: My research notes are missing! They must have gone missing during the podling attack on the research station. All of my work will be lost if they are not found! Come to think of it, I'm also missing my expedition supply bag, as well as my anti-fungal boots.... How can I do biological research without my equipment?! No... this will not do at all. Please, go and search the Zangar Shore for my missing belongings so that I may continue my fungal research!

Title: Feeding An Army
Objective: Use the Improved Iron Trap to capture a Boar or Riverbeast in Gorgrond and then place a Work Order at your Barn.
Text: We've had a chance to work with these beasts for a while now, and that's allowed us to develop a brand-new trap for you to try out. It should be much sturdier than the last one! Mind giving 'er a run, commander? The Improved Iron Trap will let you capture some of the meatiest wildlife, like the big boars and riverbeasts out in Gorgrond. We'll be able to turn them into some tasty steaks.

Title: Breaking into the Trap Game
Objective: Use the Iron Trap to capture an Elekk or Talbuk in Shadowmoon Valley and then place a Work Order at your Barn.
Text: When we came through the portal, we weren't able to bring any of our animals with us. For us to produce leather and furs, we'll need to trap some of the native beasts and bring them back here. We can get a load of leather from the elekk, or furs from the talbuk, right here in Shadowmoon. Take this iron trap and use it on a wounded adult talbuk or elekk, then bring the trap on back here and we'll start a work order.

Title: The Clothes on Their Backs
Objective: Collect 10 Ceremonial Shadowmoon Robes.
Text: Such kindness you have shown me, perhaps I can ask for one more? In our village, we salvage and reuse old cloth to patch clothes and light armor. Sadly, most of my supply was taken or destroyed in the recent attacks. The Shadowmoon cultists might think twice about stealing from us if you were to relieve them of their own resources. If you can collect some ceremonial Shadowmoon robes for me, I will demonstrate some of my favorite tailoring techniques for you.

Title: A Strengthened Bond
Objective: Give Axe-Shaper Kugra the Ghost-Touched Materials.
Text: This entire time... I have been so consumed with my own grief. I never once stopped to consider how much my father was suffering at the hands of our enemies. Thank you so much  for helping him to return to me. Please, allow me to repair his hammer. In exchange for everything you have done for us, I will teach you whatever you wish to know.

Title: Ameeka, Master Tailor
Objective: Speak to Ameeka in Elodor.
Text: Ameeka created this book to document and pass down our most cherished crafting techniques to our children. She must have dropped it while traveling. She will be relieved to see her book. From what I have heard from other villagers, she was last seen on the road to Elodor. Perhaps you can find her there.

Title: The Arakkoan Enchanter
Objective: Find Delath on the edge of the Cracking Plains to the north.
Text: The arakkoa said it was going to investigate an anomaly in the Cracking Plains that might be related to another armor piece.

Title: Garrison Campaign: Missing Grunt
Objective: Find Dul'zak.
Text: With the Heart of Gorgorek residing inside the garrison walls, we need to stay vigilant. The Burning Blade are known for attacking swiftly, and without warning. I have a number of grunts patrolling the keep. Dul'zak, one of our newer recruits, should have reported back by now.

Title: Failed Apprentice
Objective: Find and release Torag from his icy prison.
Text: Oru'kai was the first ogre mage to master the art of enchanting. Upon his death, his items were scattered across Draenor. I have tracked his scepter to the field you see before us.As you can see, the scepter's enchantment is making it difficult to retrieve. A would-be apprentice, Torag Stonefury, took one of Oru'kai's rings in to break the enchantment, but he failed and became trapped in ice.Free Torag, take the ring, and complete his task, and I will consider a reward.

Title: Oru'kai's Scepter
Objective: Retrieve Oru'kai's scepter and return it to Delath.
Text: If I had known being an enchanter was this dangerous, I would have stayed in Wor'gol.Here, take this ring. The bird man told me to use the ring on the scepter to nullify the enchantment.Bring the scepter back to him and maybe he will teach you what he promised to teach me.

Title: Enchanted Highmaul Bracer
Objective: Take the bracer to Yu'rina the Mystic in your Garrison.
Text: A powerful enchantment emanates from these ancient Highmaul bracers.Maybe Yu'rina the Mystic, your garrison enchanting quartermaster, can tell you more about the bracer.

Title: A Stolen Heart
Objective: Defeat Azuka Bladefury.
Text: This invasion is clearly an attempt to seize the Heart of Gorgorek. We need to fortify our guard before it's too late!

Title: The Power of Preservation
Objective: Deliver the ink to Master Ardule.
Text: The ink is very precious to our people. It has the ability to preserve ancient texts. Master Ardule can explain further. He's just inside.

Title: Where There Is Smoke...
Objective: Kill Rag'sla Thunkblade, Akatha Blazeburn, and Drek the Firecaller.
Text: You garrison is under attack by the Burning Blade! Kill the Burning Blade masters that are leading the assault and report back to Warmaster Zog.

Title: Slow and Steady
Objective: Gather the herbs and return to Sha'la.
Text: Excellent! When you've collected enough herbs from the local wildlife, return to me and I'll craft them into an ink for Master Ardule. The sporebats and giants should have what you're looking for. And remember, be careful!

Title: A Mysterious Satchel
Objective: Find the satchel's owner.
Text: An empty satchel with an old, magical aura. It appears quite dilapidated, with remnants of herbs and mushrooms along the inner lining. Perhaps exploring Umbrafen will offer a clue.

Title: Mending A Broken Heart
Objective: Meet Waruk at Stonefang Outpost.
Text: $p, thank you for avenging my death... but I have just one more favor to ask of you. If you help me see this through, I will forever be in your debt. Take these items and meet me at the forge in Stonefang Outpost. I have imbued them with a portion of my essence, but we still need the aid of another to reforge the hammer. It is time for me to reconcile with Kugra, so that we both may finally find peace....

Title: The Road of Glory
Objective: Zurge in Warspear wants you to kill 5 members of the Alliance within the Road of Glory.
Text: THE ALLIANCE!  THEY NEED TO BE REMOVED FROM ASHRAN IMMEDIATELY! MARCH INTO THE ROAD OF GLORY AND SLAY AS MANY AS YOU CAN! NOW!

Title: The Cryptic Tome of Tailoring
Objective: Speak to Aerun in your garrison.
Text: The different sections of the tome describe tailoring techniques that seem strange compared to traditional methods. The author's name does not appear anywhere in the tome. Maybe someone in your garrison knows more about the book's origins.

Title: The Champion of Blood
Objective: Speak to Gurgthock to participate in the Blood Champion fight.
Text: You have da blood stones required as proof of your worth. Hmm. Yes, you might be da champion Mogor be lookin' for. You be one of only two to complete da blood stone trial. Da two of ya be fightin' for da glory of becoming Blood Champion. Speak to Gurgthock and we be seein' if you be a champion... or just another stain on da arena floor.

Title: Into The Wilderness
Objective: Zurge in Warspear Outpost wants you to kill a member of the Alliance outside of the main road and recover a piece of their armor as proof.
Text: YOU KNOW WHAT'S BETTER THAN KILLING ALLIANCE SCUM IN THE ROAD OF GLORY? KILLING THEM EVERYWHERE ELSE.  GO INTO THE OUTSKIRTS OF ASHRAN AND SLAY ANY ALLIANCE MEMBER. BRING ME BACK SCRAPS OF THEIR DISGUSTING ARMOR AS PROOF. THE BLOODIER THE BETTER.

Title: The Restless Spirit
Objective: Slay Kurgthuk the Merciless and use Waruk's hammer to salvage equipment from the Thunderlord orcs.
Text: This hammer was once used to craft magnificent weapons for my Frostwolf brothers and sisters. When I was taken prisoner by the Thunderlords, however, I refused to wield it. How could I craft weapons to be used against my own people? It saddens me to see that it has been damaged and abused. I wished to one day pass it down to Kugra, but now, her anger prevents her from even visiting my grave. Please $p, can you help me repair my hammer and seek revenge on those that caused this? For Kugra....

Title: Survey Ashran
Objective: Farseer Mare Wildrunner in Warspear wants you to explore The Road of Glory, The Molten Quarry, Brute's Rise, The Amphitheater Of Annihilation and The Ashmaul Burial Grounds in Ashran.
Text: As a Farseer, I can peer into the far corners of Ashran while within Warspear. But you must go forth and see it for yourself.

Title: Leave Every Soldier Behind
Objective: Find Corporal Thukmar and recover his intel.
Text: The ogron possess something of value to the Iron Horde. I am sure they're unaware, likely just bored and in need of something to torture. We could simply leave them to their fate, but we should follow up on this clue. With any luck, it will help us stop the Iron Horde from turning Gorgrond's most fearsome creatures into weapons. Try to find Corporal Thukmar and his notes.

Title: Entry Fee
Objective: Gather 50 Blood Stones and bring them to Wodin the Troll Servant.
Text: You looking for da Ring of Blood? HAH! That good one. Not just anybody able to compete in da ring. You gotta pay the entry fee: fifty blood marks. How do you get them? Oh, tiny one, you killing me!  Dat one is yours. You kill others in da proving grounds to get da rest. Take dem to Wodin da troll servant by Mogor when you done. Don't talk to Mogor, though. Mogor da boss.

Title: How Tough Are You?
Objective: Kill Lug'dol and present his head to Kroggol the Wall outside the Gorian Proving Grounds.
Text: Mogor's holding a special match over at the Ring of Blood to crown the new Blood Champion and I think you have what it takes! Now, these ogres respect one thing and one thing only: badass...ness. They have a big fella at the front door making sure only the toughest gladiators enter the proving grounds. If you're in, kill the grizzled gladiator Lug'dol at the tower just up the road and present his head to Kroggol the Wall. That oughta show 'em what you're made of.

Title: Garrison Campaign: The Ring of Blood
Objective: Speak to Gurgthock at Gurgthock's Stash in Nagrand.
Text: Hey Champ, You were out when I stopped by. I've got a sweet gig set up at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand. Lots of ogres looking for the next big fight. Big money. You in? Who am I kidding, who wouldn't be interested in fame, fortune, and brawlin'? I'll meet you at my stash so we can talk a bit in private before your big debut.

Title: What's Under There?
Objective: Use the goren disguise to explore locations in Gorgrond.
Text: It is done. With this enchantment, not only can you roam amongst the goren freely, but you can move as they do. Your travels through the canyon are now made easier. You have safe access to places otherwise impossible to reach. Perhaps these tunnels will lead to more information that could be used against the Iron Horde.

Title: The Crystal Shard
Objective: Collect 25 Goren Crystals from Longtooth Gorgers.
Text: I'm glad you arrived when you did. The Laughing Skull orcs practice some strange spirit magic, but one of their traditions could be quite useful in our situation. While I make preparations, can you gather the reagents? First, we'll need crystals from the husks of goren corpses. You can find their bodies in the canyon.

Title: Hard Shell
Objective: Collect 9 Goren Shells from Boneyard Gorgers.
Text: I have already learned much from watching the Laughing Skull. Traveling through goren tunnels was thought to be impossible due to the acid they leave behind, but the orcs found a way around it. We will need some of the shells of goren within the canyon. If you see any of their tunnel craters ready to burst, approach them and goren will come pouring out. This way, you can kill many at once and find the shells more quickly.

Title: The Dragon's Tale
Objective: Follow the trail of clues up the hillside until you discover Kairozdormu in the Time-Lost Glade.
Text: Chromie thinks she's picked up the trail. We suspect that Garrosh traveled through here when he first arrived on Draenor. But what about Kairoz? He must be close. Chromie will illuminate the clues. Look for a series of temporal anomalies. Follow the trail east of here and pick your way up to the top of the mountains until we've located Kairozdormu... or his body. Good luck!

Title: The Fractured Hammer
Objective: Search Stonefang Outpost for the hammer's previous owner.
Text: It is obvious that this elaborate smithing hammer has seen better days. Now fractured and dirty, it is merely a shadow of its former self. One thing is certain, its previous owner was neither ogre nor Iron Horde. Perhaps someone at Stonefang Outpost would know who this belongs to.

Title: Waruk the Frostforger
Objective: Deliver Waruk's hammer to his grave site.
Text: Many say my father was a legendary blacksmith, Waruk the Frostforger they called him. They will tell you tales of his mighty weapons, crafted with nothing more than ice and steel. Waruk the Lieforger, I call him. He promised he wouldn't be gone long, "I must support our troops!" he said. Why did he have to go? Why did they let him get captured!? I have no more need for broken tools than I do broken promises. His grave is east of here, you can leave this with the rest of his unwanted belongings.

Title: Anglin' In Our Garrison
Objective: Return to Ron Ashton with the Eventide Fishing Journal.
Text: You have proven your worth, traveler. Now take this eventide fishing journal back to your garrison and study up. You will be catching all you can eat in no time.

Title: Moonshell Claws
Objective: Prove your worth to Madari by collecting 4 Moonshell Claws.
Text: I will help you, but you are going to need to prove to me that you are not only a worthy fisherman, but also a fearless warrior. The beach southeast of us is full of moonshell crawlers. Slaughter them and bring their claws back to me. They should work well as bait in these local waters.

Title: Proving Your Worth
Objective: Prove your worth to Madari by catching 5 Shadow Sturgeon using the supplied bait.
Text: Now that you have proven yourself as a warrior, let's see how your fishing skills hold up. I have fashioned a bait out of the moonshell claws you brought me. Use it to catch the shadow sturgeon in these coastal waters.

Title: Uncovering the Artifact Fragments
Objective: Cymre Brightblade in Warspear Outpost wants you to go kill creatures in the outskirts of Ashran outside of the main road and bring back 5 Artifact Fragments to Fura.
Text: The Artifact Fragments seem to come from any creature we've found in the outskirts of Ashran. Go out and kill any you find and bring at least five Artifact Fragments to Fura the Mage in Warspear Outpost.

Title: Reporting For Duty
Objective: Speak to Cymre Brightblade, Mare Wildrunner and Zurge.
Text: Front and center! No time to waste, go speak with these fellows and they'll fill you in.

Title: Welcome to Ashran
Objective: Speak to General Ushet Wolfbarger in Warspear.
Text: Greetings, and welcome to Ashran. Report to General Ushet Wolfbarger in Warspear for your orders.

Title: Tree-i-cide
Objective: Harvest a Timber Sample from Large Timber and return it to Justin Timberlord.
Text: Commander, your engineers have brought you a present. They call it the Wood Annihilator XXI the Third, Jr. What's it do? I reckon it annihilates trees - but more importantly it will allow for the harvesting of large timber. Do you know how much timber a large tree holds? Me neither, but I bet it's a lot! There's a large piece of timber ready to be annihilated nearby. Why don't you give the contraption a test run? Bring me back whatever it harvests and I'll put it to good use.

Title: Sharper Blades, Bigger Timber
Objective: Harvest a Timber Sample from Timber and return it to Justin Timberlord.
Text: Incredible news, Commander . Your ever-loyal servant has managed to secure us commandojacks. Now maybe you don't know what a commandojack is, so let me explain: they're like lumberjacks, only highly trained in the art of killing. Mostly they're out of work mercenaries and assassins. What this means is that we can now cut medium sized timber - but first we need to give these commandojacks a test run. There's a suitable tree nearby. Good luck!

Title: Moving On Up
Objective: Garaal has offered to further your knowledge in leatherworking.
Text: A generous decision. You have demonstrated your skills as a hunter, delivered a piece worthy of your name and proven your dedication to your craft. Please, take this as a token of my gratitude. May the light guide your hand and passion, your heart.

Title: An Act of Kindness
Objective: Use Restorative Goldcaps to revive fallen rangari.
Text: I know that you and Vindicator Yrel are here on important matters, but I must ask you a favor. A squad of rangari left on patrol just before the poisonous mist set in. If they were caught out in the swamp, they are surely in trouble. Harvest the Restorative Goldcaps growing among the reeds, and use them to restore any fallen rangari that you find. If you find yourself in trouble, eat one to combat the poison.

Title: Turning Timber into Profit
Objective: Collect 10 pieces of Timber from around Draenor and then Place a Work Order at your Garrison's Lumber Mill.
Text: Now that you know how to put lumberjacks to work harvesting timber, we're going to create a work order for your mill. But first we're going to need some timber to process! All around Draenor are juicy trees ripe for the chopping. Go out and find suitable timber for the lumber mill. Come back here when you have enough and we'll get started on a work order. And as usual, let the lumberjacks do the hard work. Just keep 'em protected. Draenor's a dangerous place!

Title: Tree-i-cide
Objective: Harvest a Timber Sample from Large Timber and return it to Lumber Lord Oktron.
Text: Commander, the goblins have brought you a present. They call it the Tree Murderer 9000. What's it do? I reckon it murders trees - but more importantly it will allow for the harvesting of large timber. Do you know how much timber a large tree holds? Me neither, but I bet it's a lot! There's a large piece of timber ready to be murdered nearby. Why don't you give the contraption a test run? Bring me back whatever it harvests and I'll put it to good use.

Title: Admiral Taylor
Objective: Find Admiral Taylor at Admiral Taylor's Farm.
Text: Admiral Taylor had figured out who was behind all this. He told us to save who we could... he wanted to handle matters himself. We never heard from him again, but we have our orders. Please... please find him. He went towards the farm.

Title: Fair Trade
Objective: Garaal awaits your delivery.
Text: Alright. Here you go. Be sure to deliver them to Garaal quickly. He has a heavy interest in detail and fine craftsmanship. He'll surely appreciate your work.

Title: Easing into Lumberjacking
Objective: Harvest a Timber Sample from Small Timber and return it to Justin Timberlord.
Text: , we're going to need a lot of lumber if we're going to build this garrison into a suitable fortress. That means we're going to have to do a little work. While I certainly wouldn't ask you to dirty your hands with manual labor, I do need you to go out and find timber for our mill. Once you mark a tree a lumberjack will come chop it down and give you the timber. Let's give our lumberjacks a test run. There's a tree nearby!

Title: Unwanted Pests
Objective: Kill 10 Spore Drifters or Fungal Hulks in Sporemist Shallows.
Text: Those creatures out in the shallows keep busting the turrets as fast as we can get them operational. I'm supposed to go clear them out but my blaster is completely busted; the damn thing barely can light a candle like this! Could you do me a favor and go kill a few of those pests while I get my blaster fixed at the shop? Just let Gazwitz know you covered for me so I can get reimbursed for the repair.

Title: Put out the Fires
Objective: xxxx
Text: (PH)I need a gift for thorn! A rose style gift.

Title: A Call for Huntsman
Objective: Deliver the Dirty Note to Fanara in Embaari Village to join the competition.
Text: "Any and all competitors are welcome to test their skills in a friendly hunting challenge."

Title: The Trial of Champions
Objective: Defeat the Exarch Council.
Text: The first three trials you have passed with flying colors. For the final trial, you shall face the Exarch Council. Speak to me when you are ready to begin.

Title: Friendly Competition
Objective: Gather 4 Shadowmoon Hides and 3 Silverwing Talons and return to Fanara before the other competitors.
Text: So you wish to join the competition? Best of luck to you. Be the first to gather a sack full of hides and talons from local wildlife and return them to me before the other competitors! Winner earns the opportunity for an apprenticeship under craftsman Garaal. Good luck!

Title: The Trial of Faith
Objective: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani outside the entrance to Auchindoun, then pass the Trial of Faith.
Text: No Exarch trial is complete without a holy pilgrimage to the sacred resting place of our fallen champions. On the way, I ask that you take Vindicator Maraad's ashes and lay them to rest within the hallowed halls of Auchindoun. There, the spirits of our fallen ancestors will test Yrel's greatest weakness. Good luck.

Title: Botani Invasion!
Objective: Repel the botani invasion of your garrison.
Text: The plants seem different today. Grass blades bend against the wind and catch on my boots. Twice this morning a tree branch struck my helmet as it fell.

Title: The Trial of Heart
Objective: Speak to Yrel at Cerulean Lagoon, then find out the cause of the poisonous mist.
Text: The Trial of Heart is a test of your willingness to persevere in the face of great adversity. Far to the west, there is a rangari outpost at Cerulean Lagoon. They have sent a request for help. Some sort of infection is making everyone in the area sick. They desperately need aid. Go and seek out the rangari stationed there. Help them find the cause of this terrible ailment.

Title: No Time to Waste
Objective: Administer the Spiresalve to Lunzul in Axefall.
Text: Commander, we're in luck. The antidote recipe is fairly simple. I was able to make a small amount with what I had on me. You should take it to Lunzul before it's too late. It should keep her alive long enough for me to make more.

Title: Garrison Campaign: The Exarch's Call
Objective: Speak to Yrel at Elodor in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: Ahhh, just the  I were hopin' ta see, my dear. Yrel stopped by the garrison earlier lookin' fer ya. Such a lovely lass, that one! Asked me all about ma family back home when I be feelin' homesick. Bless her. Anyway, what were I goin' on about ag'in? Oh! She asked if ye'd meet her at Elodor to the east. She's been invited by the draenei council ta face the Exarch trials, whatever those may be. Anyway, ye'd better scooch!

Title: The Trial of Courage
Objective: Kill Everburn.
Text: An Exarch must be a pillar of strength, and no greater strength is there than the courage to face danger. Far to the northwest, among the snowy crags of Frostfire Ridge, lives a primal fury named Everburn. Only when you face one of these creatures eye to eye, will you know the extent of your courage.

Title: A Stolen Heart
Objective: Kill Azuka Bladefury.
Text: Don't let Azuka take the heart, commander. Don't let her win.

Title: No Time to Waste
Objective: Administer the Spiresalve to Kolrigg Stoktron in Southport.
Text: We're in luck, commander. The antidote is relatively easy tae make. I've made a small amount with what I had on me. You should take it tae Kolrigg before it's too late. It'll keep him alive long enough for me tae make more.

Title: Where There Is Smoke...
Objective: Kill Rag'sla Thunkblade, Akatha Blazeburn, and Drek the Firecaller.
Text: Burning Blade assassins have infiltrated the garrison. We must not let them take the Heart of Gorgorek, commander.

Title: Garrison Campaign: Every Rose Has Its Thorn
Objective: Find Baros a rose for Thorn.
Text: These feelings are too strong. I can no longer hide my love away. I need to tell Thorn the truth. I need to tell Thorn, I love her. She mentioned her favorite flower is a rose. I've been so heads down with my work... I don't even know where I could find a rose on Draenor.

Title: Draenor's Secret Power
Objective: Gather 4986 Apexis Crystals for Archmage Khadgar. Crystals can be found amongst creatures in the most dangerous parts of the world.
Text: Since we're going to be working so closely together, I'd like to upgrade that ring of yours. Ancient magics are the key: apexis crystals, the leftover remains of an earlier arakkoa civilization! They can be found among the most dangerous creatures around the world. Collect 4986 crystals for me. Don't look at me like that. I'm a mage. I did the math. I need exactly 4986 crystals. 4985 is inadequate. 4987 is of course absurd. Four thousand, nine hundred eighty-six. Go!

Title: Spires of the Betrayer
Objective: Collect a Pure Solium Band from High Sage Viryx in Skyreach.
Text: I have much to ask of you, but before we begin I must ensure that you develop yourself to your full potential. I can help. I'd like to create a link between us, an artifact that will enhance your power and allow me to track your progress. How do you feel about amulets? No? A ring? I've got it. My contacts among the arakkoa outcasts tell of a band of pure solium. Right now it's in the talons of High Sage Viryx high atop Skyreach. Bring me that ring,  - you and I have much better uses for it.

Title: Icespine Stingers
Objective: Prove your worth to Mokugg Lagerpounder by collecting 4 Icespine Stingers.
Text: I will help you, but you are going to need to prove to me that you are not only a worthy fisherman, but also a fearless warrior. The canyon north of us is full of icespine stingers. Slaughter them and bring their stingers back to me. They should work well as bait in these local waters.

Title: Sharper Blades, Bigger Timber
Objective: Harvest a Timber Sample from Timber and return it to Lumber Lord Oktron.
Text: Incredible news, Commander . Your ever-loyal servant (that's me) has managed to secure us timber lords. Now maybe you don't know what a timber lord is, so let explain: think of a blood-crazed, mass murderer who enjoys nothing more than killing. Now take that same enthusiasm for killing and apply it to killing trees! That's a timber lord. What this means is that we can now cut medium sized timber - but first we need to give these timber lords a test run. There's a suitable tree nearby. Good luck!

Title: Garrison Campaign: Awakening
Objective: Speak to Choluna at Gorgorek's Rest in Gorgrond.
Text: We've tracked Warlord Bladefury an' da stolen artifact ta northern Gorgrond. Choluna be dere wit a scouting team. I got dey entire garrison on high alert. Go, meet wit her, and intercept da enemy if necessary.

Title: Easing into Lumberjacking
Objective: Harvest a Timber Sample from Small Timber and return it to Lumber Lord Oktron.
Text: , we're going to need a lot of lumber if we're going to build this garrison into a suitable fortress. That means we're going to have to do a little work. While I certainly wouldn't ask you to dirty your hands with manual labor, I do need you to go out and find timber for our mill. Once you mark a tree an able-bodied lazy-good-for-nothing peon will come and chop it down and give you the timber. Frostfire isn't the best place for timber, but I did see a suitable small tree nearby.

Title: Turning Timber into Profit
Objective: Collect 10 pieces of Timber from around Draenor and then Place a Work Order at your Garrison's Lumber Mill.
Text: Now that you know how to put peons to work harvesting timber, we're going to create a work order for your mill. But first we're going to need some timber to process! All around Draenor are juicy trees ripe for the chopping. Go out and find suitable timber for the lumber mill. Come back here when you have enough and we'll get started on a work order. And as usual, let the peons do the hard work. Just keep 'em protected. Draenor's a dangerous place!

Title: Rosa is bad
Objective: Retrieve Rulga's lost inscription papers.
Text: Text

Title: Reporting For Duty
Objective: Speak to Misirin Stouttoe, Farseer Kylanda and Chris Clarkie.
Text: Front and center! No time to waste, go speak with these fellows and they'll fill you in.

Title: Anglin' In Our Garrison
Objective: Return to Mak'jin with the Frostwolf Fishing Journal.
Text: You have proven your worth, traveler. Now take this frostwolf fishing journal back to your garrison and study up. You will be catching all you can eat in no time.

Title: Garrison Campaign: Awakening
Objective: Speak to Thisalee Crow at Gorgorek's Rest in Gorgrond.
Text: We've tracked Warlord Bladefury and the stolen artifact to the salt fields of western Gorgrond. Thisalee Crow will meet you there with an advance scouting team. The entire garrison is on high alert. We must be ready to intercept the enemy if necessary.

Title: Uncovering the Artifact Fragments
Objective: Misirin Stouttoe in Stormshield Stronghold wants you to go kill creatures in the outskirts of Ashran outside of the main road and bring back 5 Artifact Fragments to Ecilam.
Text: The Artifact Fragments seem to come from any creature we've found in the outskirts of Ashran. Go out and kill any you find and bring at least five to Ecilam the Mage near the campfire in Stormshield Stronghold.

Title: Proving Your Worth
Objective: Prove your worth to Mokugg Lagerpounder by catching 5 Zangar Eels using the supplied bait.
Text: Now that you have proven yourself as a warrior, let's see how your fishing skills hold up. I have fashioned a bait out of the icespine stingers you brought me. Use it to catch the Zangar eels in these coastal waters.

Title: The Road of Glory
Objective: Chris Clarkie in Stormshield wants you to kill 5 members of the Horde within the Road of Glory.
Text: The Horde intends to force us out of Ashran. We can't let them succeed. March into the Road of Glory and thin their ranks by at least five.

Title: Into The Wilderness
Objective: Chris Clarkie in Stormshield Stronghold wants you to kill a member of the Horde outside of the main road and recover a piece of their armor.
Text: The Road of Glory is not just the only field of strife in this land. We must go into the wilderness here to uncover the artifacts. Venture forth and kill a member of the Horde you find in the outskirt areas and bring me back a piece of their armor to prove your worth.

Title: Survey Ashran
Objective: Farseer Kylanda in Stormshield wants you to explore The Road of Glory, The Molten Quarry, Brute's Rise, The Amphitheater Of Annihilation and The Ashmaul Burial Grounds in Ashran.
Text: As a Farseer, I can peer into the far corners of Ashran while within Stormshield. But you must go forth and see it for yourself.

Title: Welcome to Ashran
Objective: Speak to Commander Anne Dunworthy in Stormshield.
Text: Greetings, and welcome to Ashran. Report to Commander Anne Dunworthy in Stormshield for your briefing.

Title: Azuka Bladefury
Objective: Return to Rokhan at your garrison in Frostfire Ridge.
Text: Jub'waz is dead. A fire smolders inside a large wound where her heart used to be. Flipping through a report you find on her corpse you are able to piece together some basic information. Azuka has betrayed the ogres, she has killed Ugbright and used her blade to take his power for herself. Rokhan will want to know of Jub'waz's fate.

Title: Garrison Campaign: The Broken Precipice
Objective: Find Greblin Fastfizzle.
Text: Hey there! You're the commander of this keep, right? I represent the Steamwheedle Preservation Society. We've been trying to get a very important excavation up and running in Nagrand. Unfortunately, we've had trouble with ogres in the area. In fact, one of our best preservationists recently went missing while surveying the area. He's the third society member we've lost up there this week! We aren't really equipped for a rescue mission... so whad'ya say? We could really use the help.

Title: Proof of Strength: Elemental Crystal
Objective: Take the proof to Limbflayer at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
Text: This crystal is proof of your strength at slaying elementals and your gladiator friend has born witness! Take the crystal back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!

Title: Proof of Strength: Basilisk Scale
Objective: Take the proof to Limbflayer at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
Text: This scale is proof of your strength at slaying basilisks and your gladiator friend has born witness! Take the scale back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!

Text: This scale is proof of your strength at slaying basilisks and your gladiator friend has born witness! Take the scale back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!

Text: Agent Springslip is dead. A fire smolders inside a large wound where his heart used to be. Flipping through a report you find on his corpse you are able to piece together some basic information. Azuka has betrayed the ogres, she has killed Ugbright and taken his power for herself. You should report this information to Bodrick at once.

Title: Building for Professions
Objective: Build any profession building.
Text: I see that you have acquired the blueprints for a profession building! Use the Architect Table to build in a small plot.

Text: This thorn is proof of your strength at slaying the infested and your gladiator friend has born witness! Take the thorn back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!

Title: On Ebon Wings
Objective: Slay 8 Adherents and Windkeeper Koreyx. Speak with Ka'alu for a ride to Windswept Terrace.
Text: Now we bring our fight to the Adherents. Raastok is certain his new invention will give us control of the Apexis weapons, but we must get close - very close. Ka'alu and her ravens will fly us to the Windswept Terrace. We shall gain a foothold there before pressing on to the Terrace of Dawn.

Title: Proof of Strength: Botani Bloom
Objective: Take the proof to Rangari Jonaa at Highpass in Gorgrond.
Text: This bloom is proof of your strength at slaying botani and your gladiator friend has born witness! Take the bloom back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!

Title: A Hero's Welcome
Objective: Speak with Farseer Drek'Thar at Glacier Bay in Frostfire Ridge.
Text: You have arrived in Frostfire Ridge. Farseer Drek'Thar can guide you from here.

Title: Proof of Strength: Gronnling Scale
Objective: Take the proof to Limbflayer at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
Text: This scale is proof of your strength at slaying ogron and your gladiator friend has born witness! Take the scale back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!

Objective: Take the proof to Limbflayer at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
Text: This eye is proof of your strength at slaying ogron and your gladiator friend has born witness! Take the eye back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!
