Objective: Take the proof to Rangari Jonaa at Highpass in Gorgrond.
Text: This scale is proof of your strength at slaying ogron and your gladiator friend has born witness! Take the scale back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!

Title: Ogron Boss
Objective: Locate Agent Springslip.
Text: Alright, I'm outta here. What? Oh now you want me to help you? Sheesh, alright fine. A goblin named Ganky came through here just a bit ago. She tried to help me down but she was too short, and in a massive hurry. She said something about stopping Azuki? Azukah? I'm pretty sure it was a name that started with "az". Anyway, Ganky ran toward the top of the Broken Precipice. Bad timing if you ask me. The ogres and ogron are in some kind of civil war. I'd be careful if I were you.

Title: A Worthy Vessel
Objective: Awaken the Talon King.
Text: The time has come.Awaken the Talon King from his long slumber. Call him into this world so that he may destroy our enemies!

Title: We Have Him Now
Objective: Collect Venomshiv's Secret Formula and 6 Poison Barrels.
Text: We have Gardul right where we want him, commander. You're far more equipped to face him than I am. Dispose of him, take his formula from his corpse, and grab as many barrels of poison as you can. I'll guard this ramp and make sure no reinforcements come to his aid.

Title: We Have Him Now
Objective: Collect Venomshiv's Secret Formula and 6 Poison Barrels.
Text: We have Gardul right cornered, commander. Ye have a much better chance against him than me. Take him out, grab the formula from his corpse, and grab as many barrels o' poison as ye can carry. I'll stay here and make sure nae reinforcements come to Gardul's aid.

Title: Gardul Venomshiv
Objective: Defeat Gardul Venomshiv in Shattered Rise.
Text: We need tae take out Gardul and take his poison recipe while we still have the element o' surprise on our side. We need the recipe tae figure out the antidote. This may be our only opportunity. If what ye learned is true, his camp is just south of here. Ye take him down, and I'll make sure none of his guards interfere.

Title: Gardul Venomshiv
Objective: Defeat Gardul Venomshiv in Shattered Rise.
Text: We need to take out Gardul and take his poison recipe while we still have the element of surprise on our side. We need it to craft the antidote. This may be our only opportunity. If what you learned is true, his camp is just south of here. You take him down, and I'll make sure none of his guards interfere. Let's get moving.

Title: Extrinsic Motivation
Objective: Kill 4 Shattered Sightless, 3 Shattered Harvesters, and 1 Shattered Blood-Singer.
Text: The Shattered Hand aren't strangers to pain. They each cut off their own hand as a sign of their allegiance to Kargath. If you're going to get them to talk, it might take more than my poison. Slaughter them all. We'll see how far they're willing to go for their beloved warlord.

Title: Extrinsic Motivation
Objective: Kill 4 Shattered Sightless, 3 Shattered Harvesters, and 1 Shattered Blood-Singer.
Text: The Shattered Hand are nae strangers tae pain. They each cut off their own hand as a sign o' their allegiance to Kargath. If you're going tae get the information we need, it might take more than my poison. Slaughter them all. We'll see how far they're willing tae go fer their beloved warlord.

Title: We're Not Finished...
Objective: Report to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.
Text: , I'm going to have to hit the books and do more research to figure out how to locate Gul'dan or untangle his mind control of Garona. It's not glamorous, but the life of a mage is often spent in long hours of grueling study. As for you, there's much to do. Ensure that your garrison is fully upgraded, locate the best possible equipment, and continue fighting the Iron Horde. I will summon you when the next step of our journey is ready.

Title: The Unbroken Circle
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar to upgrade your ring.
Text: Reading these tablets is like stepping back in time to the moment of Draenor's creation. There is a power here greater than any I have dealt with since I was Medivh's apprentice. I believe I can control it, but - can you handle it? If you think you are ready, prepare yourself. Hold your ring close to your heart. I will channel pure elemental energies into it. Speak with me to begin!

Title: Prisoner of the Mind
Objective: Speak with Khadgar and protect him while he casts his spell on Garona.
Text: I'd had some time to compare the Flamebinder's tome with the elemental tablets you collected. Where it gets interesting is when I cross-reference the incantations you obtained from the ogre felbreakers... I can see I'm losing you. I will get to the point: I believe I can cast a spell that will nullify Gul'dan's mind control over his assassin Garona. Mind-controlled or not, she may be dangerous, so I won't begin the spell until you're with me. Let me know when you're ready!

Title: Blackhand's Secret
Objective: Slay Warlord Blackhand and acquire his severed arm in the Blackrock Foundry.
Text: , you've given me a lot to think about. There's a section of the Flamebender's Tome that speaks about a "sacrifice," and a more recent notation referring to "the chieftain." I think it's talking about Warlord Blackhand. Did Blackhand sacrifice someone? Himself? A piece of himself? Is that why his hand is deformed? Before I risk channeling these elements into a spell, I need to know. And there's only one way to find out. Kill Warlord Blackhand. And bring me his severed arm.

Title: Reverse Piracy
Objective: Acquire the Draenic Thaumaturgical Orb from the Dread Grotto in the Blackrock Foundry.
Text: , during the attack on Karabor Iron Horde dreadnaughts looted or sank most of the draenei eastern fleet. A priceless artifact was captured: A genuine Draenic Thaumaturgical Orb. I must have it! Those orcs don't know what they've got! My sources indicate that the orb was aboard a ship that's being retrofitted down in the Dread Grotto beneath the Blackrock Foundry. Search the ship and the area nearby for the Sha'tari Vault that contained the orb. We've got to get it back!

Title: Heart of the Fury
Objective: Collect a Heart of the Fury from the elemental Fury encased within the furnace of the Blackrock Foundry.
Text: It is foolish to pursue Gul'dan with magical means alone. But thanks to you we have a prisoner: Garona. If we can break Gul'dan's mind-control over her, we will learn all his secrets. I can do it, but I'll need some powerful spell components. First on the list is the heart of an elemental fury. There's one imprisoned in the center of the Blackrock Foundry. Fight your way in, destroy the furnace, and slay the elemental within.

Title: Might of the Elemental Lords
Objective: Collect 3 Elemental Tablets. Assemble the tablets by collecting Elemental Runes from bosses in the Blackrock Foundry.
Text: Somehow, the Blackrock Clan has forged an alliance with the creatures of fire and stone. I must know how! Search the entirety of the Blackrock Foundry. We are looking for stone tablets dating back to the prehistory of Draenor. They will likely be broken apart into fragments that you'll need to assemble by hand. Look for elemental runes carried by high-ranking members of the Iron Horde. Assemble them and bring me those tablets. I will use their power to augment the powers of your ring!

Title: Flamebender's Tome
Objective: Retrieve the Flamebender's Tome from Flamebender Ka'graz in the Blackrock Foundry.
Text: The Iron Horde, and the Burning Blade clan in particular, have forged a unique relationship with Draenor's ancient elementals. They can work with iron and flame in ways that even I don't fully understand. Yet. , slay the Burning Blade's highest-ranking artisan: Flamebender Ka'graz. She is down in the very heart of the Black Forge of the Blackrock Foundry, an area known as the Burning Font. If we're lucky, her secrets are codified in a Flamebender's Tome.

Title: Power Unleashed
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra, and allow him to upgrade your ring.
Text: You've more than earned a reward, commander. I'll wrap things up here and meet you back at my tower - you can use my portal as a shortcut. Speak to me when you arrive and I will use Kairoz's power with the crystals you gathered earlier to upgrade your ring!

Title: Hunter: Hunted
Objective: Follow Garona's trail into the Zangarra lowlands. Find, defeat, and capture her.
Text: The weapon that stabbed the archmage was imbued with fel magic. He's slowly being poisoned! , we don't have any time. Khadgar will be dead in minutes. I need you to track down Garona before she gets away - find that murder weapon and maybe we can find a cure! Follow the traces of fel energy she left behind. Track her down into the Zangarra lowlands and capture her with this Violet Hold Incarceration rune. Hurry!

Title: Touch of the Kirin-Tor
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar to upgrade your ring.
Text: You saved me. Once again I underestimated Gul'dan, and it nearly cost me everything. Come, help me up. While Jaina is here, the two of us can work together to upgrade your ring. You've earned it! Let me know when you're ready.

Title: The Scrying Game
Objective: Speak with Khadgar and locate Gul'dan with his scrying spell.
Text: We've learned everything we need from the ogres. Thanks to your efforts, I believe I can pierce the veil of secrecy that's cloaking Gul'dan. I WILL find him. Once my spell is finished we should be ready to leap into action. I won't begin until you let me know you're ready.

Title: Fugitive Dragon
Objective: Meet with Khadgar north of the Ring of Trials in Nagrand.
Text: Ready to do some dragon hunting? A bronze dragon freed Garrosh Hellscream and took him to this world. His name is Kairozdormu, and he's a fugitive from Azeroth. It's time to track him down. His essence permeates this entire timeline. If I could just get a hold of him - dead or alive! - I could re-calibrate my magic to this era of Draenor. We'll need the help of a fellow bronze dragon. I'll find her and meet you in Nagrand. Let's rendezvous at the crossroads north of the Ring of Trials.

Title: Legacy of the Sorcerer Kings
Objective: Collect 125 Abrogator Stones from creatures in Highmaul. Your garrison followers may also be able to locate stones in certain missions.
Text: For over a thousand years, the ogre sorcerer kings maintained an iron grip over their empire using a variety of artifacts. Trusted lieutenants were given magical gems that allowed them to enforce the emperor's will out in the field. These "Abrogator Stones" still maintain their power even today, and can be found scattered throughout the Highmaul complex. Sometimes in clusters. Collect $1oa of these Abrogator Stones for me!

Title: Empire's Fall
Objective: Collect a Felbreaker's Tome and the Sigil of the Sorcerer King from Highmaul.
Text: The Ogre Sorcerer King, Imperator Mar'gok, has mastered magical techniques we would consider on the fringe of arcane science. His felbreakers, among others, can actively dampen or nullify magic. Even fel magic! If we're to locate Gul'dan, we need to figure out how it's done. Acquire a felbreaker's tome from his felbreaker captain and acquire the sigil of the sorcerer king himself - I must know what he knows. Yes, this means I expect you to storm Highmaul and defeat everyone inside. Get to it!

Title: Eyes of the Archmage
Objective: Speak with Khadgar and guard him as he performs his scrying spell.
Text: With the blood of Teron'gor and the crystals you collected for me, I should be able to zero in on our target. Step outside with me and I will begin my scrying spell. Speak with me to start - be ready for anything!

Title: Core of Iron
Objective: Collect a Core of Iron from the engine of the Grimrail Depot train
Text: There's no point in getting a Core of Flame without any way to focus its power. Somehow, the goblins figured out how to do it - the technology is used in the "Iron Star" engines that the Iron Horde is using extensively throughout Draenor. We're gonna need the biggest engine core that we can find. Our best bet is to derail one of their trains and crack open the engine compartment. I suggest a raid on the Grimrail Depot...

Title: Core of Life
Objective: Collect a Core of Life by slaying Yalnu in the Everbloom .
Text: Scrying for a living being is a very specific kind of magic, and if we want to search the whole of Draenor for Gul'dan, we're going to need a very powerful living reagent. The answer lies with the plant life of Draenor itself. There is a creature known as a "genesaur" who is the closest we can get to the primordial creatures who shaped all life on this world. One of our Kirin-Tor outposts has been overrun in Gorgrond, and a genesaur named "Yalnu" was spotted. Kill it, and bring its heart to me!

Title: Core of Flame
Objective: Acquire a Core of Flame from Gug'rokk in the Bloodmaul Slag Mines
Text: Compared to Azeroth, Draenor is a young world. The primal forces that shaped and bent the land are still accessible - if you know where to look. I need you to find for me a Core of Flame. The Bloodmaul Ogres have been known to use these to bend molten furies to their will, but you and I can find a much better use for one. Enter the Bloodmaul Slag Mines and acquire one from Gug'rokk. He won't need it anymore after you kill him.

Title: Tarnished Bronze
Objective: Speak to Archmage Khadgar to choose your preferred role, and defeat the Spirit of Kairozdormu.
Text: That dead dragon's essence has seeped into the very fabric of this light-forsaken world. His spirit is also restless. If you and I are to claim what remains of his power, we're going to need to finish the job that Garrosh started. I'm going to need to rely on your tactical combat expertise, commander. Would you prefer to go on the offensive, to fight defensively, or to heal us? The decision is yours. Speak to me when you are ready, and the three of us will destroy Kairoz once and for all.

Title: Tackling Teron'gor
Objective: Obtain Corrupted Blood of Teron'gor from Teron'gor in Auchindoun .
Text: I just received dark news from Exarch Maladaar that may be of use to us. Shadow Council agents have infiltrated Auchindoun! I guarantee Gul'dan's minions are behind this - likely Teron'gor, his right-hand orc. Let's pull him from the chessboard. Kill Teron'gor! Bring me a vial of his corrupt blood, and I can use it to track down other Shadow Council troublemakers... Including Gul'dan. Our prey will not be able to hide.

Title: Khadgar's Task
Objective: Speak with Khadgar within his tower in Zangarra.
Text: This world poses many dangers to our own. Chief among them is the Iron Horde - your garrison and the full might of your army is directed at this foe. But for myself I have a different target in mind. Gul'dan. Here, make yourself comfortable. Have some mana strudel. I will share my plan as I create your ring...

Title: Call of the Archmage
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.
Text: Commander ! I was sent here to summon you. Archmage Khadgar has a very urgent favor to ask. He is gravely concerned about additional threats this world may hold for Azeroth, and he will need your assistance pursuing them. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp. This will not take long.

Title: Garrison Campaign: The Broken Precipice
Objective: Find Greblin Fastfizzle.
Text: Hey there! You're the commander of this keep, right? I represent the Steamwheedle Preservation Society. We've been trying to get a very important excavation up and running in Nagrand. Unfortunately, we've had trouble with ogres in the area. In fact, one of our best preservationists recently went missing while surveying the area. He's the third society member we've lost up there this week! We aren't really equipped for a rescue mission... so whad'ya say? We could really use the help.

Title: Brokyo Beatdown
Objective: Kill Brokyo.
Text: I'm almost done here, but I can't leave in good conscience. I spotted an ogron named Brokyo that is wearing a priceless ring. Priceless as in crazy expensive. I'm sure Nixxie will give me a promotion if I bring that ring back to her.

Title: Assault on Darktide Roost
Objective: Disrupt the Iron Horde and gather intelligence on them.
Text: The Iron Horde has Goblins now? Take them out!

Title: Ogre Onslaught
Objective: Kill 3 Ogres and 3 Ogron.
Text: Those ogres are standing in the way of a full Steamwheedle Preservation excavation. They are brutal, violent, horrible smelling beasts. And if I'm being completely honest with myself, I'm pretty mad they broke my glider. Do me a favor will ya? Wipe 'em off the face of Draenor. It will make everyone's life easier, or at the very least, it will make my life easier.

Title: Preservation Capitalization
Objective: Collect a Redtooth Necklace, Purpletooth Necklace, and an Ogre Bust.
Text: I'm looking for precious artifacts. The kind of artifacts that can help solve some of the greatest mysteries of Draenor, and make the Steamwheedle Preservation Society a ton of moolah. And ladies love the moolah, know what I'm sayin? So, get me the artifacts, I'll get the ladies, and you get... wait, what are you looking for again?

Title: Assault on Darktide Roost
Objective: Disrupt the Iron Horde and gather intelligence on them.
Text: The Iron Horde has Goblins now? Take them out!

Title: The Power of Poison
Objective: Interrogate Shattered Hand orcs in the Harvesting Pits to find out the name and location of "G.V.".
Text: G.V.? We need a full name. A location! I have an idea fer how we can find those out.  This is my last vial o' wracking poison. We use it when we need tae extract information from prisoners. Coat yer weapon wi' it and head into the Shattered Hand camp just ahead. Engage them as normal and demand answers - the poison will take care o' the rest.

Title: Proof of Strength: Goren Tooth
Objective: Take the proof to Limbflayer at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
Text: This tooth is proof of your strength at slaying goren and your gladiator friend has born witness! Take the tooth back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!

Title: Peckers the Majestic
Objective: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
Text: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine. I offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces. Will you accept it?

Title: The Power of Poison
Objective: Interrogate Shattered Hand orcs in the Harvesting Pits to find out the name and location of "G.V.".
Text: G.V.? We need a name and a location. Not damned initials.  This is my last vial of wracking poison. We use it to extract information from prisoners. It is... potent. Coat your weapon with it and head into the Shattered Hand camp just ahead. Engage them as normal and demand answers - the poison will take care of the rest. I've had enough of these orcs.

Title: Greblin Fastfizzle
Objective: Help Greblin Fastfizzle down.
Text: I've been hanging here forever! I was flying around, surveying the area for Nixxie when -- blamo! One of those stupid ogres throws a rock right at me! My glider busted and here I am... and boy is this uncomfortable. Help me down will ya? I'll make it worth your while.

Title: Proof of Strength: Goren Tooth
Objective: Take the proof to Rangari Jonaa at Highpass in Gorgrond.
Text: This tooth is proof of your strength at slaying goren and your gladiator friend has born witness! Take the tooth back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!

Title: Iron Horde Invasion!
Objective: Repel the Iron Horde invasion.
Text: There's smoke on the horizon.... The Iron Horde is coming.

Title: Nisha's Vengeance
Objective: Kill 10 Grom'kar Grunts.
Text: Since I left on my last hunt, the Iron Horde have drawn nearer and reinforced their positions.  They've created a target-rich environment. I must continue nursing Nisha to health for now. You go in my stead, friend. Fill them with the fear and pain that they inflicted on her. Make their screams fill the canyon!

Title: Assassin's Mark
Objective: Search Vigilant Outcast corpses for a Craftsman's Mark.
Text: We need tae find the orc responsible fer makin' the poison tae make an antidote. Master assassins always leave their mark somewhere on one o' their kills. It's a claim tae fame o' sorts. An' trust me, this was the work of a master assassin. Let's split up and see if we can find some sign on one o' the outcast corpses that will lead us tae their killer. I'll meet ye at the bottom o' the hill, commander.

Title: Azeroth's Last Stand
Objective: Collect the Iron Horde Missive from one of the Iron Horde at the base of the Dark Portal.
Text: Countless times you have battled against impossible odds and unspeakable evil - and returned the victor. Now, once more, you have answered the call of duty, prepared to risk your life to save the world that you love - our world. You are Azeroth's last hope. While the challenges that stand before us are daunting, there is no other that I would trust to lead this mission. The enemy at the front may have the information we need to win this war. Seek and destroy! Go now! For Azeroth!

Title: Assassin's Mark
Objective: Search Vigilant Outcast corpses for a Craftsman's Mark.
Text: Their poison is more powerful than I thought. We need to find the orc responsible for making it. Master assassins always leave their mark somewhere on one of their kills. It's a calling card; a claim to fame in their circles. This was definitely the work of such an assassin. We should split up and see if we can find some sign on one of the outcast corpses that will lead us to their creator. Rendezvous at the bottom of the hill, commander.

Title: The Gronn Strategy
Objective: Show the weaponization orders to Rexxar at Breaker's Crown.
Text: Raz, Your orders are to capture four additional gronn for weaponization. Of your first group, only one survived the entire process. One attacked our soldiers relentlessly and had to be put down. Another fell victim to a misfire while being fitted. Yet another rolled onto its cannons in its sleep. We're still cleaning up that mess. Rest assured, your efforts are not in vain. - Captain Brak

Title: Bread and Circuses
Objective: Speak with Dexyl Deadblade at the Ring of Trials.
Text: Hey, this crumb-bum won't let me in. Interested in some cold, hard cash? My boss is promoting fights at the Ring of Trials. You look like you could hold your own. You should go fight.

Title: Bread and Circuses
Objective: Speak with Dexyl Deadblade at the Ring of Trials.
Text: Hey, this crumb-bum won't let me in. Interested in some cold, hard cash? My boss is promoting fights at the Ring of Trials. You look like you could hold your own. You should go fight.

Title: Internal: Default Invasion Reward
Objective: Repel the Breaker invasion of your garrison.
Text: Quakes have been shaking the garrison for the last hour, and a few of our scouts aren't reporting in.

Title: Attempted Murder
Objective: Speak to Firn Swiftbreeze to secure a flight to Shadow's Vigil.
Text: Kolrigg is dyin', commander. He's been poisoned and needs an antidote before it's too late. One o' yer scouts reported seein' a Shattered Hand orc nearby not long ago - I wager that's our best shot. There's a small arakkoa camp tae the east that sits near a known Shattered Hand encampment. We should start our search there. I've already spoken to yer flight master about flyin' us out; every second counts.

Title: Supply Drop
Objective: Speak with Baros Alexston at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.
Text: Your laborers below have finished with the harvest and are ready to cart supplies back to your garrison. Don't worry about the safety of your caravan this time; I will dispatch a rangari detail to shadow them from the woods and protect them. The Exarchs will always watch over you. Your supplies should be waiting for you when you return to your garrison. Good luck with your campaign!

Title: Attempted Murder
Objective: Speak to Hutou Featherwind to secure a flight to Shadow's Vigil.
Text: Your bartender Lunzul is dying, commander. She's been poisoned and needs an antidote immediately. One of your scouts reported seeing a Shattered Hand orc nearby recently - that's our best bet. There is a small arakkoa camp to the east that sits near a known Shattered Hand encampment. I suggest we start our search there. I've already spoken to your flight master about securing us a flight; every second counts.

Title: The Missing Piece
Objective: Place Lithic's Gift on the Effigy of Terokk.
Text: Terokk's daughter Lithic was a skilled huntress, but found her true passion in goldsmithing.She forged this bangle as a gift for her father, and he wore it for many years. Only after Lithic passed away did he remove the bangle, for her memory was too much for the old king to bear.Place the bangle upon the effigy, and I shall tell you of Terokk's fall.

Title: The Avatar of Terokk
Objective: Speak with Shade of Terokk to accept his power. Slay 25 Shattered Hand combatants, 4 Shattered Pit-Masters, and confront Kargath Bladefist.
Text: My long sleep was disturbed by dreams of the past. I cut down my old enemies again. I watched my daughter die again.You were there. I felt your presence in these dreams. And your past was revealed to me as well.Someone has woven our fates together. My people are yours to protect, and your enemies are mine to destroy.The Shattered Hand are rallied in Bladefist Hold. Left to their own, they would claim this land for the Iron Horde.Take my power, and together we shall break them.

Title: Terokk's Fall
Objective: Use the Effigy of Terokk to re-live Terokk's fall. Find Lithic, rally 5 Outcast Talon Guards, slay 20 Crazed Outcasts, and use the Eye of Anzu.
Text: Terokk was a powerful and respected king, beloved by his people.His sages, however, were not so loyal. Hungry for control of Skyreach, they conspired against him.

Title: The Fists of Vaandaam
Objective: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
Text: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine. I offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces. Will you accept it?

Title: The Interest of Bruto
Objective: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
Text: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine. I offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces. Will you accept it?

Title: The Home Stretch
Objective: Escape to the docks.
Text: If they weren't angry before, they sure are now. We won't survive a minute up on top o' this tank! Let's join up with the rest and get out of here!!

Title: Garrison Campaign: Darktide Roost
Objective: Travel to Darktide Roost.
Text: We is getting reports dat da Iron Horde warships be dockin' on a small island to da south of da Shadowmoon Valley. We be sendin' some scouts, but we haven't heard back yet. We need ta be investigating. Bron Skyhorn has a ryklak waitin' for ya when you be ready, commander.

Title: Safety Measures
Objective: Kill 15 bog denizens.
Text: The batteries I lost in the bog have really ticked off the wild creatures. It's going to be impossible to remove them without fighting through who knows what. If you're up for it, why don't you 'take care' of any critters you come across? I don't want some giant beast stalking me back to the excavation site. I'll make it worth your while.

Title: Safety Measures
Objective: Kill 15 bog denizens.
Text: As it turns out, the resonance frequency of the batteries has really upset the local wildlife. I... I think one of the boars looked at me and licked its lips just a moment ago. I'll make it worth your time if you just... get rid of anything you come across down there. Doesn't matter what it is, just kill it, okay?

Title: Rage and Wisdom
Objective: Speak to Bony Xuk at Affliction Ridge.
Text: Beasts of the western wasteland fight an endless war with the creatures of the eastern wilds. If one side were to overwhelm the other, all of Draenor would be doomed at the hand of the victor. The Laughing Skull seek revenge for their destroyed village. I have directed them to aim their vengeance at the nearby creatures, that our outpost here might be preserved. If you would, commander, oversee their efforts. I have not yet grown to trust the Laughing Skull.

Title: Basilisk Butcher
Objective: Collect 9 Basilisk Meat from Stoneshamble Basilisks or Decaying Basilisks.
Text: Basilisk is one of Nisha's favorite meals. This is where she hunts, and that's likely how those Iron Horde bastards were able to capture her. Why would they go to the trouble to subdue her this way? Perhaps together, you and I might learn the answer as we punish them for their transgressions. For now, Nisha's going to need some food. While I tend to her, will you do her hunting for her?

Title: Garrison Campaign: Darktide Roost
Objective: Travel to Darktide Roost.
Text: We are getting reports that Iron Horde warships are docking on a small island just south of Shadowmoon Valley. We sent in some scouts, but we haven't heard back from them yet. It might be worth investigating. Dungar Longdrink has a gryphon waiting for you when you are ready, commander.

Title: Putting Down the Packleader
Objective: Slay Packleader Vor'gash.
Text: Da one in charge a Mok'gol Watchpost be Packleader Vor'gash. We take him out, we shut dem down. Ya ken find 'im patrolling da compound ta da nor'east. Kill 'im.

Title: Intercepting the Orders
Objective: Collect the Frostfire Mission Orders, Shadowmoon Mission Orders, and Spires of Arak Mission Orders.
Text: Intelligence be da name a da game, commanda. Da more we know about Hellscream's plans, da easier it be ta mess dem. Da Mok'gol orcs be Hellscream's couriers, carrying mission orders from dis place ta his outposts all over Draenor. Kill dese riders, an' recover any orders dat you ken find.

Title: The Warlord's Council
Objective: Find out who is behind the written note.
Text: Upon closer inspection, you notice a piece of leather parchment looped around his neck. Scrawled upon it angrily are the words: "WITNESS THE FATE OF THOSE WHO DEFY THE IRON HORDE!"

Title: Plans of War
Objective: Find the Scale Model of Gorgorek, Miniature War Machine, and Map of Tanaan Jungle.
Text: I managed ta recover Zasta's notes. He saw dey Warsong leaders meetin' often in dey nearby buildings. Zasta tinks dere be clues about dey Iron Horde's plans nearby. Dey least we can do is follow dey lead he left us. Search dey camp for dey intelligence. I'll keep dey orcs distracted.

Title: Garrison Campaign: Deep Recon
Objective: Find Shadow Hunter Zasta at the Hidden Camp in Nagrand.
Text: Ya timin' be good, commanda. I sent one a ma shadow huntas deep inta da land 'a da enemy. He reports dat da warlords be plannin' ta meet in secret at Mok'gol Watchpost. Dis be our chance ta learn what Hellscream be up to. Go now, and meet wit Zasta. He will tell ya what to do next.

Title: Garrison Campaign: Deep Recon
Objective: Find Jeanine Amrell at the Hidden Camp in Nagrand.
Text: One of my top field operatives, Jeanine Amrell, is stationed deep in Iron Horde territory in northern Nagrand. She reports that the warlords of the orcish clans are planning to convene in secret at Mok'gol Watchpost. This may be a critical opportunity for us to gain intel on their future plans. I need you to meet up with agent Amrell immediately. This may be our chance!

Title: Putting Down the Packleader
Objective: Slay Packleader Vor'gash.
Text: Operations at Mok'gol Watchpost are entrusted to a mighty warrior named Packleader Vor'gash. If we can take out this fierce leader, we can shut down their communications temporarily. You can find Vor'gash patrolling the compound to the northeast. Slay him.

Title: Intercepting the Orders
Objective: Collect the Frostfire Mission Orders, Shadowmoon Mission Orders, and Spires of Arak Mission Orders.
Text: Intelligence is the name of the game, friend. The more we know about Hellscream's plans, the easier it will be to thwart them. The Mok'gol orcs often act as Hellscream's couriers, carrying mission orders from this place to his outposts all over Draenor. Kill these riders, and recover any orders that you can find.

Title: The Ebon Hunter
Objective: Collect an Organic Laser Apparatus from the Ebon Hunter.
Text: We're ready to set up the laser, but we're going to need more firepower to cut through this stuff. The Ebon Hunter stalks the delta just southeast from here. It has an apparatus on its face that can fire a laser way stronger than what we have hooked up. We need that. You should go get it while we set up the laser.

Title: Plans of War
Objective: Find the Scale Model of Gorgorek, Miniature War Machine, and Map of Tanaan Jungle.
Text: I managed to get my hands on Jeanine's notebook. She identified several key items in the nearby buildings to investigate, but couldn't follow up before her demise. The least we can do is follow the lead that she left us. Search the camp for the intelligence. I'll keep the orcs distracted.

Title: The Warlord's Council
Objective: Find out who is behind the written note.
Text: Upon closer inspection, you notice a piece of leather parchment looped around her neck. Scrawled upon it angrily are the words: "WITNESS THE FATE OF THOSE WHO DEFY THE IRON HORDE!"

Title: Wake of the Genesaur
Objective: Slay 9 Wild Overgrowth.
Text: One moment we see a great metal beast rolling into our camp, the next a genesaur follows it and sends a wave of pure chaotic life at us. The manifestations left behind by the genesaur must be culled so we have time to salvage what we can before leaving. If you are here to help, then start killing as many of the violent plants that are assailing us as possible.

Title: Trophy of Glory: Sodius
Objective: Take the trophy to Durotan at  in Gorgrond.
Text: Defeating Sodius has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim. Take this to Durotan at .

Title: Trophy of Glory: Sodius
Objective: Take the trophy to  at  in Gorgrond.
Text: Defeating Erosian has yielded you a trophy worthy of showing off at your gladiatorial arena. Return this to  to increase your glory!

Title: Trophy of Glory: Khargax the Devourer
Objective: Take the trophy to Durotan at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
Text: Defeating Khargax has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim. Take this to Durotan at Beastwatch.

Title: Trophy of Glory: Khargax the Devourer
Objective: Take the trophy to Maraad at Highpass in Gorgrond.
Text: Defeating Khargax has yielded you a trophy worthy of showing off at your outpost. Return this to Maraad to increase your glory!

Title: Trophy of Glory: Fungal Praetorian
Objective: Take the trophy to Durotan at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
Text: Defeating the Fungal Praetorian has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim. Take this to Durotan at Beastwatch.

Title: Trophy of Glory: Roardan the Sky Terror
Objective: Take the trophy to Durotan at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
Text: Defeating Roardan has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim. Take this to Durotan at Beastwatch.

Objective: Take the trophy to Durotan at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
Text: Defeating Charl has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim. Take this to Durotan at Beastwatch.

Text: Defeating Roardan has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim. Take this to Maraad at Highpass.

Text: Defeating Charl has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim. Take this to Maraad at Highpass.

Objective: Take the trophy to Durotan at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
Text: Defeating Crater Lord Igneous has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim. Take this to Durotan at Beastwatch.

Title: Trophy of Glory: Dessicus
Objective: Take the trophy to Durotan at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
Text: Defeating Dessicus has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim. Take this to Durotan at Beastwatch.

Objective: Take the trophy to Maraad at Highpass in Gorgrond.
Text: Defeating Erosian has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim. Take this to Maraad at Highpass.

Title: Trophy of Glory: Fungal Praetorian
Objective: Take the trophy to Maraad at Highpass in Gorgrond.
Text: Defeating the Fungal Praetorian has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim. Take this to Maraad at Highpass.

Title: Trophy of Glory: Crater Lord Igneous
Objective: Take the trophy to Maraad at Highpass in Gorgrond.
Text: Defeating Crater Lord Igneous has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim. Take this to Maraad at Highpass.

Title: Trophy of Glory: Dessicus
Objective: Take the trophy to Maraad at Highpass in Gorgrond.
Text: Defeating Dessicus has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim. Take this to Maraad at Highpass.

Title: Trophy of Glory: Erosian
Objective: Take the trophy to Durotan at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
Text: Defeating Erosian has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim. Take this to Durotan at Beastwatch.

Title: The Ebon Hunter
Objective: Collect an Organic Laser Apparatus from the Ebon Hunter.
Text: The laser should be good to go once we get it set up, there's just one more thing I need. There's a spore walker that hunts on the delta just southeast from here. It has an apparatus on its face that can fire a powerful laser - way more powerful than what we have hooked up. I want it. We'll be mining faster than you can imagine once we get that bad boy hooked up!

Title: A Balanced Diet
Objective: Collect 12 Chunks of Meat from beasts in Uldum and the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: Now that our larva is hatched, we'll need to figure out what we can feed it to keep it healthy.It would seem that the aqir are carnivores, but the only things I've seen them eat are... well... us.Of course, we can't feed our little friend people, so we'll have to find an alternative. Perhaps we could substitute animal meat?

Title: Coming Out of His Shell
Objective: Watch the Aqir Egg hatch in Ramkahen.
Text: It looks like our egg is ready to hatch! Isn't this exciting!Come, let us welcome our new little friend to this world.

Title: A Shocking Technique
Objective: Collect 8 Lightning Rod Components from the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: I have heard tales that the mogu use lightning to speed up the growth of their cloud serpents. I wonder if the same principle could be used for our aqir friend?There's only one way to find out! Go to the Vale of Eternal Blossoms and see if you can get the parts together so we can create our own lightning rods.If they work the same as they do for the cloud serpents, it should speed up the hatching process significantly.

Title: Meat Alternatives
Objective: Collect 12 pieces of Insectoid Meat from Aqir, Mantid, or other insects in Uldum or the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: In the wild it is actually fairly common for insects to eat others of their species. I wonder if this rings true for the aqir as well.Could you bring back some meat from the aqir or mantid? We'll see if that's more palatable for our friend here.

Title: Continued Incubation
Objective: Collect 10 Crystallized Void in areas under assault by N'Zoth's forces.
Text: The egg is doing well, but we're going to need more of those void crystals to keep it healthy.Could you go out and gather some?

Title: Match the Hatch
Objective: Investigate 7 Voudtouched Eggs in Uldum.
Text: Don't fret, I'm sure no ill will become of hatching this creature. After all, the aqir can't be born evil, can they?Of course, we have no idea how to take care of such an egg. I will need you to do some investigating.Head back to the aqir hives and see if you can find any other, similar eggs. If we can observe how they're being treated, we might be able to apply those learnings here.

Title: Encased in Amber
Objective: Mark an Amber Incubator for H'partho to airlift in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: You know who would probably know a lot about how to properly incubate this egg? The mantid!Of course, they're too busy trying to kill us to share their expertise, but there might be another way to benefit from their knowledge!Perhaps we could repurpose one of their incubation chambers. That could help speed up this process, I'm sure!If you could find and mark one for me, I could airlift it out of there.

Title: Void Incubation
Objective: Collect 10 Crystallized Void in areas under assault by N'Zoth's forces.
Text: Well one thing is for certain with this egg, it requires great amounts of void energy in order to strive.It is fortunate for us that an Old God is attacking Azeroth at this very moment, yes?No? Oh...In any case, there should be an abundance of void energy wherever N'Zoth's minions strike. You should head out and find some.

Title: Wrapping Up
Objective: Collect 30 pieces of Aqir Webbing from aqir casters in Uldum.
Text: One oddity I have observed about this egg is that it lacks the protective webbing commonly found throughout the aqir hives.I believe this webbing has protective qualities, and could be beneficial to our egg if we can acquire some.While you're out fighting the insects, see if you can't bring back some of their webbing so we can make a proper cocoon for our growing egg.

Title: Warmth of the Sun
Objective: Collect an Amathet Solar Collector in Uldum.
Text: The desert nights in Uldum can get awfully cold. I fear for our little egg's ability to withstand these temperatures.These Amathet to the East seem to have mastered the harnessing of the sun's energy. If we could borrow some of their expertise, we could use it to keep the egg nice and cozy.Keep your eyes open for something we can use.

Title: Heralds of the Hive
Objective: Kill 5 Aqir Dominators in Uldum.
Text: The aqir that have assaulted our camp seem to mainly consist of their shock troops. However, our scouts who dare venture behind their lines have spotted a different kind of creature -- tall and thin, wielding dangerous void magic.My instinct tells me that these creatures are the leaders behind this invasion. They should be seen as targets of opportunity, and cut down wherever they're met.Are you up to the task?

Title: Enter the Void
Objective: Without dying or leaving Void Wraith form, sacrifice 10 players to N'Zoth.
Text: My faithful servant. I will grant you but a small taste of my unimaginable power, all I ask in return is that you complete one simple task. Kill any who would oppose me, spare no one. Do not fail me...

Title: The Incredible Egg
Objective: Bring the Voidtouched Egg to H'Partho Adoros in Ramkahen.

Title: Terrors from the Deep
Objective: Defeat 3 rare Aqir enemies in Uldum.
Text: The Aqir threaten the livelihood of the Wastewanders with each passing day, but I have heard of greater terrors that have been unearthed with them.Our fighters are able, but I fear what might happen if one of these ancient terrors falls upon us.I know that you have experience putting down great foes. I would like to ask you to do the same for us.After all, we can hardly help protect the forge if we've been decimated by some long-buried monster.

Title: Things Left Behind
Objective: Collect 3 Wastewander Supplies from Infested Caches in Uldum.
Text: The invading aqir forced the Wastewanders to flee many of our settlements in Uldum. In our haste to escape, much was left behind.I understand you intend to take the fight to the beasts. While you're there, could you keep an eye out for any of the supplies we had to leave behind?You can keep anything of use to you, of course.

Title: Put Your Foot Down
Objective: Squish 8 Aqir Larvae in Uldum.
Text: You see that? Doesn't look like much, but believe it or not, those bugs grow out of these things.They're all over the places the aqir have taken over, feeding off of our dead and growing into these monstrosities.If you happen to see any of them, do the world a favor and take your boot to 'em.

Title: Getting Ahead
Objective: Collect 1 Goliath Trophy from Aqir Goliaths in Uldum.
Text: Morale's been down at the camp lately. Funny how getting chewed on by some bugs can spoil the mood of a place.I've got an idea to perk the troops back up, though. We need a trophy!See if you can get me the head of one of those big tanky-looking ones so we can put it on display to show these bugs that we mean business! Just try to make sure it's not too mangled, okay?

Title: Taking the Skies
Objective: Kill 15 flying Aqir in Uldum.
Text: I'd like to see if we can get some more of these flyers in the air to drive back the aqir, but it's nearly impossible to get back to the Obelisk of the Sun with all these bugs in the air.I think we're going to have to thin them out on the ground before we can hope to gain aerial superiority.Can I count on you to lend a hand?

Title: Taken by the Swarm
Objective: Free 6 Golden Lotus prisoners from Hardened Amber Cages in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: There's something different about this mantid swarm. Instead of just killing everything in sight like the mantid usually do, they've taken to capturing our defenders and holding them alive.I really don't want to know what they have in store for the captives.Why don't you go rescue them so we don't have to find out?

Title: Hatching Problems
Objective: Destroy 6 Aqir Egg Clusters in Uldum.
Text: The aqir are multiplying faster than we can put them down. If this pace continues, we will be outnumbered before long.The only way to slow down their assault is to attack their hives directly and destroy their eggs, but we have been unsuccessful in doing so.That's why I wish to conscript your services.Will you help?

Title: Standards of the Swarm
Objective: Burn 6 Zara'thik Banners within the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The brazen mantid think they've already won. Even now, they fly banners along the Serpent's Spine, announcing their dominance.They must learn that Pandaria belongs to the pandaren.Burn their banners down.

Title: Halting Production
Objective: Destroy 6 Amber Vessels in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The mantid use amber in nearly all aspects of their lives, from the structures they live in to the weapons they wield. Of course, I'm more interested in the latter.If we can deprive the mantid of their materials, we will deprive them of their means to create implements of war.Find where they keep their amber and make sure they are unable to use it.

Title: Siege Breaker
Objective: Sabotage 3 Vil'thik War Wagons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The Golden Lotus can hold their own against the mantid's warriors, of that I have no doubt. Their war wagons, on the other hand, have the capability of crippling an entire squad of our fighters in a single volley.If we wish to maintain the upper hand in this battle, we will need someone to infiltrate their positions and sabotage their siege engines.I would like you to volunteer.

Title: Crushed Underfoot
Objective: Squash 10 Vil'thik Larvae in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: In the past, the mantid would safeguard their hatchlings in incubation chambers until they were ready to be tested in the swarm.These Vil'thik are sloppy, however, allowing their larvae to scurry out in the open.Wouldn't it be a shame if someone crushed them?No, of course it wouldn't.

Title: Dread Menders
Objective: Kill 6 Mantid ambercasters in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The ambercasters are among the highest castes of mantid society. Through their magic, they can mend and form amber to their will, allowing hastened recovery of the mantid's forces after a battle.They are strategic targets, and we should seek them out.Care to join us?

Title: Rampaging Destroyers
Objective: Kill 4 Kunchong Destroyers in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The last mantid swarm is still very fresh in the memory of the Golden Lotus. Prior to the advancement of the swarm, the mantid would send their massive kunchong to soften up the defenders' lines.It would seem their tactics have not changed.We must stop those kunchong if the Golden Lotus hope to mount a defensive against the swarm. I'm counting on you to strike them down.

Title: The Empress' Guard
Objective: Kill 8 Zara'thik mantid in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The Zara'thik are the empress' elite guard. Empowered with plundered Azerite, they will stop at nothing short of absolute conquest of all of Pandaria.If we allow them to advance past the Serpent's spine, the Golden Lotus will be no match for them.Stop them at the wall.

Title: Blades of Amber
Objective: Collect 12 Amber Blades from Vil'thik mantid in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The mantid are frail and easily broken, but the amber blades they wield are formidable.With a bit of work, they could be reshaped into something suitable for the mogu.Bring them to me, and I can see about repurposing them to service the Rajani.

Title: Stashed Supplies
Objective: Collect 3 Golden Lotus Supplies from Ambered Caches in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The invading mantid have been making off with the Golden Lotus' supplies lately. They're probably hoping they can starve us out.Well, they may be right if we can't get some of our supplies back.While you're taking the fight to the swarm, keep an eye out for anywhere they might have stashed our supplies. You'd be doing the Golden Lotus a big favor if you could recover some.

Title: Testing the Untested
Objective: Kill 12 Vil'thik Swarmborn in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: During a swarm, the mantid send their youngest in great numbers against the enemy to test their mettle. Those who survive join the swarm as true warriors of the mantid.We should do our best to ensure that they don't make it through this test.

Title: Champions of the Swarm
Objective: Defeat 3 rare mantid enemies in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: It is clear that Shek'zara is fully committed to this invasion. Our scouts have spotted some of her greatest champions among the battlefield.Any one of these mantid could prove too much for the soldiers of the Golden Lotus to overcome. We must hunt them down and eliminate them ourselves.Are you in?

Title: Fame Waits for Gnome One
Objective: Meet with Tinkmaster Overspark in Boralus.
Text: Tinkmaster Overspark requests your assistance on an important research expedition.Working with the esteemed Tinkmaster will certainly be of benefit to your career. It's done wonders for mine!

Title: Magni's Findings
Objective: Learn Magni's findings.
Text: As if gettin' the Forge back up and runnin' wasn't good enough, I think we may have found the key tae takin' out N'Zoth once and for all in the archives of Mogu'shan Vaults!Ye might want tae be sittin' down for this one, champion.

Title: Cutting Stone
Objective: Collect 10 Mogu Armaments in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: One problem with waging war against other mogu is that weapons dull and break very quickly when used against foes of stone and metal.Being the sole blacksmith among the Rajani, it is sometimes difficult to keep up with our warriors needs.If you come across any weapons in your battles with the mogu, I'm sure I could put them to good use.

Title: Subjugated Serpents
Objective: Kill 4 Onyx Warserpents in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: Where the Zan-Tien march, the warserpents are sure to follow.I cannot stress to you enough how dangerous these beasts are. It is a shame to see them subjugated by the mogu, but we cannot afford to let them run rampant.I need you to put them down before they can wreak havoc on our lines.

Title: The Price of Peace
Objective: Witness King Wrynn's address.
Text: The king will be addressing us shortly with news from his diplomatic mission to the Horde.The other leaders of the Alliance have already arrived. I am sure they are eager to hear what King Wrynn has to say.Speak with me when you are ready, and we will greet the king together.

Title: A Gathering of Champions
Objective: Speak with Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.
Text: King Wrynn has called for an audience with the Alliance leaders in Stormwind.Your presence at the meeting has been specifically requested. The gathering will be held at the embassy.Come speak with me when you arrive in Stormwind, I'll be waiting with the others.Do hurry. It would be ill-advised to keep the king waiting...

Title: Warchief of the Horde
Objective: Witness the gathering of champions.
Text: The meeting to decide the next Warchief of the Horde is about to begin.The other leaders of the Horde have already arrived. They are waiting for you inside the embassy.Speak with me when you are ready, and we will greet the others together.

Title: A Gathering of Champions
Objective: Speak with Valeera Sanguinar in Orgrimmar.
Text: The leaders of the Horde are gathering together in Orgrimmar to nominate a new Warchief of the Horde.As a champion of the Horde, your presence at the meeting has been requested. The gathering will be held at the embassy in Orgrimmar.I will be going on ahead. Come speak with me when you arrive in Orgrimmar, I'll be waiting with the others.Make haste, champion. The future of the Horde is about to be decided...

Title: A World Worth Saving
Objective: Stop the Amathet from taking the Halls of Origination.
Text: We could not stand against them. Their warriors... wreathed in the sun's flames...They want the forge... to end all...Go... I will... endure...

Title: Chew On This!
Objective: Kill 8 Scavenging Dunerunners in Uldum.
Text: These mangy hyena will gnaw on anything they dig up, including priceless artifacts!We cannae allow the history of Uldum tae go tae the dogs, so tae speak.I'm afraid we're gonna have tae thin out their numbers.

Title: Shared Goals
Objective: Defend High Explorer Dellorah as she deciphers the Amathet Tablets within the Chamber of the Stars.
Text: The decree you found made mention of a plan to defeat the Old Gods.I know that the Amathet aren't likely to work with us toward that goal, but if they have a plan tae take out N'Zoth, it's worthwhile for us tae look at it.The decree mentions the Engine of Ascension. I think that might be what they call that solar empowering device we saw earlier. We should take a peek underneath and see if we can figure out what they're planning!

Title: Buried History
Objective: Uncover and collect 6 Amathet Artifacts in Uldum.
Text: Since the Amathet came from this region, it would only stand to reason that artifacts from their civilization would be left behind here, hidden beneath the sands.It looks like it's time for a good old-fashioned dig!The dunes near here must have covered up a large swath of the Amathet's former territory. Let's see what we can dig up there!

Title: Mutually Assured Destruction
Objective: Warn the defenders of the Halls of Origination about the Amathet's plan.
Text: The Amathet want tae re-take the Forge of Origination so they can use it tae end all life on Azeroth, Old God or otherwise!They could strike at any moment. We have tae warn the defenders of the Forge!

Title: A Crack in the Armor
Objective: Defend High Explorer Dellorah as she deciphers the Amathet Monument outside the Halls of Origination.
Text: The artifacts you helped excavate show the Amathet as a tribe who prided themselves on protecting the works of the titans.This confirms our assumptions, and indicates that something drastic must have happened to them to cause them to damage the very works they swore to protect.We should continue to track down their writings. I think I saw a more recent monument outside the Halls of Origination.

Title: Seekers of Corruption
Objective: Collect the Sun King's Decree from Suntouched Amathet in Uldum.
Text: If anyone would know more about the "corruption" the tablet spoke of, it would be the Suntouched that were put in charge of rooting it out.Of course, I doubt they'll be willing to turn over any information voluntarily.Luckily for me, you're a bit of a specialist at brute force investigation, aren't you?

Title: A Deeper Dive
Objective: Defend High Explorer Dellorah as she deciphers the Amathet Monument at Sunstone Terrace.
Text: Something just isn't adding up about these Amathet. Why would protectors of titan works attack and damage the Forge of Origination?I think we need tae take a closer look. I think I saw a monument on the terrace over there. Perhaps the writings there could tell us more about these tol'vir.

Title: Eyes on the Amathet
Objective: Scout the Amathet territories with High Explorer Dellorah in Uldum.
Text: On behalf of the Explorer's League, I'd like tae thank ye for helping establish the Uldum Accord and buying us some cooperation from Ramkahen.In the interest of better understanding our foes, Ramkahen has allowed the exploring of the Amathet tombs. Unfortunately, though, their forces are spread too thin to provide protection.I was hopin' ye could help out with that.Think ye could spare some time tae see what they're all about? We can start with an aerial look.

Title: Opening the Gateway
Objective: Speak with MOTHER to establish the Tenebrous Gateway in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: The fabric of reality is torn. But there's no need for me to tell you that. You've seen it firsthand.It's only a matter of time before these realities become one, veiled in eternal darkness. Instead of hiding, perhaps it's time we embraced the darkness.With the help of our titan friend here we may be able to thread the needle of this reality through the fabric of another, creating a bridge of sorts.After all, the key to understanding an enemy's weakness is to understand their intentions.

Title: Ny'alotha, the Waking City: The Corruptor's End
Objective: Defeat N'Zoth in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Text: Usin' the mogu's research, MOTHER and Ra-den found a way tae focus the forge's Origination Protocol through the Chamber of Heart. The only problem was findin' out where tae shoot it.That is, until now.Take these anchors and head through that portal. Ye'll need tae find some prominent landmarks tae place 'em so we can focus the weapon. Once they're set, we'll be ready tae fire.Ye'll only get one shot. Make it count!

Title: Into Dreams
Objective: Speak with MOTHER in the Chamber of Heart to track Ra-den's location.
Text: I cannae believe that Ra-den sacrificed himself to save us. We cannae give up on him!There must be a way tae find out where he went.Let's see if MOTHER can track him down!

Title: A Bit of Investigation
Objective: Collect 16 Aqir Bits.
Text: $p, this may be the discovery of a lifetime!I cannot yet say with absolute certainty, but I have a suspicion that these insects are known as the aqir.The League has few intact records, but the last mention of these creatures describes a great war waged between the C'Thraxxi, aqir, and early troll civilizations.We had assumed they were driven to extinction, but they may have simply been... rebuilding.Could you please collect some samples for me to examine?

Title: Where the Heart Is
Objective: Meet Magni Bronzebeard in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: The Speaker has requested that I send you to aid him and Wrathion in their efforts.You have proven yourself a great ally to Azeroth, and I suspect you will have a big part to play in the coming battles.Let us hope that the rest of the Horde and Alliance can put aside their squabbles to face a common enemy.

Title: Pillars of Oblivion
Objective: Destroy 6 Black Empire Obelisks in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: In ages past, the black obelisks of the Old Gods would herald the coming of their forces. The dark conjurers among the k'thir and n'raqi would utilize these monuments to establish footholds in our world and usher in more of the Old Gods' minions.Today, we see these very same obelisks littering the battlefields. So long as they stand, N'Zoth's forces will be without end.Make sure they do not.

Title: Network Diagnostics
Objective: Activate the Titan Consoles in the Chamber of Heart to check the status of the titan forges throughout Azeroth.
Text: Unfortunately, we've got no clue where N'Zoth has been lurking since his escape. We do, however have an idea where he might strike.Back when the keepers were imprisoning the Old Gods, they built defense mechanisms against their corruption into the titan forges. If N'Zoth wants tae corrupt Azeroth, he'll have tae go through them first.Fortunately, we've got ourselves hooked up tae them now, so we can monitor them from here. Go ahead an' take a look.

Title: Whispers in the Dark
Objective: Find the source of N'Zoth's whispers in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: Did ye hear that as well? That cannae be good.If N'Zoth gains access tae this chamber, we'll all be done for!We need tae figure out where he's accessing the chamber and shut it down, before he does more than just whisper at us!

Title: Return of the Black Prince
Objective: Speak with Valeera Sanguinar at the Great Seal in Dazar'alor.
Text: I have just returned from a meeting with King Wrynn in Stormwind.We have much to discuss.Meet me at the Great Seal with haste.

Title: Return of the Warrior King
Objective: Walk with Anduin and retrieve Fearbreaker in Stormwind Keep.
Text: Ye've done a great deal fer Azeroth, hero, but unfortunately I'm gonna have tae ask ye tae do more. N'Zoth is on the loose, an there's no tellin' when or where he'll strike.This battle is one ye can't face alone. When the time comes, ye'll have my hammer at yer side!But first, we'll need tae fetch it.

Title: An Unwelcome Advisor
Objective: Speak with King Anduin Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.
Text: Even with the forces of the Horde and Alliance working together, we still have found no trace of N'Zoth's forces. Ever since his release, the Old God has evaded us at every turn.The Light only knows what ill he has in store for Azeroth.Meet me in Stormwind Keep. We must put a plan together to uncover N'Zoth's schemes before it is too late!

Title: Where the Heart Is
Objective: Return to the Chamber of Heart.
Text: It's time we put Wrathion's plans in tae motion.He'll be headin' back tae the Chamber of Heart, so we should meet him there.

Title: Built to Fall
Objective: Destroy 6 Mogu Statues in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The Baruk use the forbidden arts of necromancy to trap souls of fallen mogu into the statues that fight for them.These tactics are a disgrace to our people, and cannot be allowed to continue.Break their precious statues, and give them no vessels with which to contaminate with their stolen spirits.

Title: No Stone Unbroken
Objective: Kill 10 Baruk mogu in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: When the warring clans came into the Vale, the Baruk deigned themselves worthy to lay claim to the ancient grounds of Guo-Lai.They are not.Show these usurpers their place, and you may earn a modicum of favor with the Rajani.

Title: Plunder the Plunderers
Objective: Loot 3 Mogu Plunder from the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: Our raids on Lei Shen's treasuries did much to ensure the Thunder King's downfall. I think we should employ the same strategy here.Seek out the hoarded plunder of the mogu clans and relieve them of it.We must do all we can to disrupt their advance.

Title: Corrupted Curiosities
Objective: Collect 3 Artifacts of the Black Empire from Black Empire Caches in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: I understand that the Black Empire poses a grave threat to Pandaria, but we may also use this as an opportunity!Though we've faced them several times before, very little is known about the Old Gods or N'Zoth's mysterious realm of Ny'alotha.When studying ancient civilizations, we often rely on artifacts to unlock the deepest mysteries lost to time. I wonder if some such artifacts could be found among the Old God's forces?It can't hurt to check, right?

Title: Through Blood and Dirt and Bone
Objective: Collect 100 Anima Globule from Dokani mogu and their allies in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The Dokani see themselves fit to wield the ancient magic of anima, but their golems and manifestations are but a fraction of anima's true power.Liberate them of their prized substance, so that the Rajani may put it to better use.

Title: Rituals of Blood
Objective: Destroy 6 Blood Fonts in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: Anji and I have fought in many battles, so we know how to handle a few mogu, but the blood magic used by these Dokani is just unsettling!As if it weren't bad enough for them to kill everyone in their path, but to use their corpses to fuel their unholy rituals? I just can't stomach it!Do me a favor. If you ever come across any of these rituals, put a stop to them! Even our enemies don't deserve to be defiled with their dark magic.

Title: Bringing the Thunder
Objective: Kill 12 Zan-Tien mogu in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: All of the mogu clans are formidable, to be sure, but it is the Zan-Tien that pose the most direct threat to the Golden Lotus.Even now, their numbers are amassing outside the Golden Pagoda. Many of our warriors are fresh-faced and inexperienced. They would not withstand a mogu assault for long.An experienced  like you could serve to slow them down significantly.Care to help?

Title: Lightning Crashes
Objective: Destroy 6 Lightning Rods in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The Zan-Tien like to claim mastery over the power of storms, yet they resort to machines to harness lightning from the sky.Show these pretenders that the true power of storm and thunder comes from within. Break their toys, and see how they fare without.

Title: Aggressive Notation
Objective: Use the Lorewalker's Notebook to gather notes about the faceless, k'thir, and fleshbeasts in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: Even given the Sha's origins with the Old Gods, we in Pandaria still know very little of them.I would like to take this opportunity to add whatever information I can about them to the archives of the Lorewalkers. Of course, that becomes a bit problematic when they're trying to kill us.That doesn't seem to be a problem for you, though. Could you do me a favor and jot down some notes about what you encounter out there? It could help a great deal towards understanding what we're fighting.

Title: Corruption Manifest
Objective: Kill 8 Putrid Ichors in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The corruption of the Old Gods is often so foul it manifests itself in physical form.We have seen this with the Sha. This time is no different.Cull this corruption wherever you see it spread. It must not be left to flourish.

Title: Tears in the Vale
Objective: Close 3 Void Tears within the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: As N'Zoth's influence spreads within the Vale, our very reality begins to break down.The Old God's power has created tears in the fabric our world, acting as doorways for his minions to invade from his dark realm.As long as these tears exist, we will never be free from N'Zoth's grasp. Close them, and stem the tide of his corruption!

Title: Prisoners of Mind and Body
Objective: Rescue 6 captive pandaren in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: N'Zoth's forces struck the Vale suddenly. By the time I and my Shado-Pan arrived, many of the Golden Lotus had already been taken captive by the Old God's forces.Even with our combined might, we have only been able to hold off the invaders from taking more of our people. Those already taken, however, are still within the clutches of the Old God.I know we have had our differences, but if you could aid us in their recovery, the Shado-Pan would be in your debt.

Title: Deephive Decimation
Objective: Kill 10 Deephive mantid within the Big Blossom Mine in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: A sect of the mantid swarm calling themselves the "Deephive" have taken hold of the Big Blossom mine. These mantid have fully given themselves up to the Old Gods' corruption, making them especially dangerous.We cannot allow the Deephive to run amok in the Vale. Do what must be done.

Title: A Growing Darkness
Objective: Destroy 6 Corrupted Incubators in the Big Blossom Mine in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: Shado-Pan scouts have spotted evidence of a new mantid hatchery within the Big Blossom mine. It seems these Deephive mantid are looking to create new corrupted spawn to serve N'Zoth.If these eggs were allowed to hatch, a new swarm empowered by the Old God could blacken the skies of the Vale and plunge Pandaria into darkness.We will not allow that to happen, will we?

Title: Spawns of Madness
Objective: Kill 10 fleshbeasts in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: To see the Vale of Eternal Blossoms recover from the Sha to its former beauty, only to see it tainted by the Old Gods once more, it makes the blood boil!We must root out the Old God's corruption before it can take hold of this land again. I have seen the fleshbeasts that accompany N'Zoth's forces spreading his corruption where they tread.Make sure they tread no longer.

Title: Pet Battle Challenge: Blackrock Depths
Objective: Stop the Shadowy Figures.
Text: Those Shadowy Figures are up to no good again, are you sure you want to face them? If you really want to go back in there, I'm not going to stop you.

Title: Shadows of Blackrock
Objective: Stop the Shadowy Figures.
Text: We've finally tracked those pesky Shadowy Figures down, they should all be in there. They seem highly skilled, you're going to need to bring your best teams in there if you have any chance of winning.Let me know when you are ready.

Title: Windows to the Soul
Objective: Kill 6 Eyes of the Empire in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: Were it not enough for our enemy to apply deadly force against us, their minions also strike into the very heart of our defenders.I speak, of course, of the eyes. They peer into the souls of our warriors and produce their darkest fears against them.If we have any hope to defeat this foe, they must be destroyed.

Title: Torment From Beyond
Objective: Release 6 Ancient Pandaren Spirits in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: As if it were not bad enough that N'Zoth seeks to dominate those living in the Vale, my scouts report they now seek to dominate the dead!The Shado-Pan have their hands full defending the living. Can we rely on you to put an end to this disgrace?

Title: Shadowy Showdown
Objective: Find Burt Macklyn outside of the entrance to Blackrock Depths in Blackrock Mountain.
Text: This is our time! We've found where these Shadowy Figures have been hiding, and it's time for us to take the fight to them and stop whatever their plans are. Their base of operations is in Blackrock Depths. It's all up to you.

Title: Tomes of Ancient Madness
Objective: Collect 8 Tomes of Ancient Madness from k'thir enemies in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: In times like these, it becomes necessary for all of the denizens of the Vale to pitch in and do their part. Unfortunately, I have never been much of a fighter, so my usefulness in times of war is limited.However, I may be able to do some good. You see, we know very little about the invaders we face, and knowledge can be a very powerful weapon.I think I have seen tomes carried by some of the k'thir. If you could bring some to me, I may be able to glean something useful from their writings.

Title: Marshals of Madness
Objective: Kill 6 faceless minions of N'Zoth in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The n'raqi have long served as the commanders and taskmasters of the Old Gods' forces. Their presence on the field of battle shows that this invasion is a coordinated effort rather than a random outbreak of corruption.Led by these faceless masters, the chaotic forces of the Old Gods transform into capable military.We must make it a priority to fell these creatures. Only then might we take the upper hand against N'Zoth.

Title: Shadowy Showdown
Objective: Find Burt Macklyn outside of the entrance to Blackrock Depths in Blackrock Mountain.
Text: This is our time! We've found where these Shadowy Figures have been hiding, and it's time for us to take the fight to them and stop whatever their plans are. Their base of operations is in Blackrock Depths. It's all up to you.

Title: Heritage of the Mechagnome
Objective: Meet Prince Erazmin in Mechagon City.
Text: , we could not be more pleased with your progress. You represent us well with the Alliance.Return to Mechagon City at your earliest convenience. Waren has created a gift for you.

Title: Heritage of the Vulpera
Objective: Meet Hagashi at the Vulpera Hideaway in Vol'dun.
Text: The Horde has come to truly value the Vulpera, thanks to your efforts.You are the most... vulperan vulpera that I know!Visit me in the Vulpera Hideaway in Vol'dun. Kiro had me put together a small memento in appreciation of your efforts.

Title: Mark of the Conquerors
Objective: Burn 6 Banners of the Black Empire in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The invading minions of N'Zoth lay claim to lands they are not entitled to.The Vale will not be conquered while even one of the Rajani still draws breath.Burn down their banners as a reminder of this.

Title: The Strongest Among Them
Objective: Defeat 3 rare minions of N'Zoth in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: You have shown great strength in your conquests, but new enemies assail the Vale with each day.Seek out the strongest that our foes have sent forth, and bring them down for their allies to see.

Title: A Foul Annoyance
Objective: Kill 7 Squidtail hozen in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The Hozen are opportunistic and weak. It does not surprise me that some of their kind have thrown their lot in with the Old Gods.We should take care of them before they become more than a nuisance.

Title: Ny'alotha: MOTHER's Guidance
Objective: Collect 4 Titan Cores from Ra-Den, 4 Dragon Hearts from Vexiona and 4 Prophetic Eyes from Il'gynoth within Ny'alotha, the Waking City on Mythic Difficulty.
Text: Ny'alotha does not obey the rules of space and time, and we may be able to use this to our advantage.MOTHER theorizes that if we obtain specific objects from N'Zoth's chosen, we can utilize them to bend space and expedite our passage here in the future. Though, it is doubtful they will relinquish these items willingly.

Title: Ny'alotha: MOTHER's Guidance
Objective: Collect 4 Titan Cores from Ra-Den, 4 Dragon Hearts from Vexiona and 4 Prophetic Eyes from Il'gynoth within Ny'alotha, the Waking City on Heroic Difficulty.
Text: Ny'alotha does not obey the rules of space and time, and we may be able to use this to our advantage.MOTHER theorizes that if we obtain specific objects from N'Zoth's chosen, we can utilize them to bend space and expedite our passage here in the future. Though, it is doubtful they will relinquish these items willingly.

Title: Ny'alotha: MOTHER's Guidance
Objective: Collect 4 Titan Cores from Ra-Den, 4 Dragon Hearts from Vexiona and 4 Prophetic Eyes from Il'gynoth within Ny'alotha, the Waking City on Normal Difficulty.
Text: Ny'alotha does not obey the rules of space and time, and we may be able to use this to our advantage.MOTHER theorizes that if we obtain specific objects from N'Zoth's chosen, we can utilize them to bend space and expedite our passage here in the future. Though, it is doubtful they will relinquish these items willingly.

Title: Faceless Mask of the Long Night
Objective: Return the Faceless Mask of the Long Night to the altar within a Horrific Vision.
Text: The endurance needed to make it this far is extraordinary and the feat of a long experienced adventurer. Yet, the longest night is nigh and with it our ultimate conquest. Those that fight the coming of eternal twilight know only futility, for in the Longest Night they will be on the edge of sanity forever.

Title: Uncommon Core
Objective: Collect a Titanic Core from an Ivory Watcher in Uldum.
Text: Our scouts have reported that the Amathet are constructing new titanic watchers.We had long thought this art was lost to the sands of time. It would appear we were mistaken.I needn't tell you what a boon it would be to have the aid of watcher constructs in our battles for Uldum. We must unlock the secrets of their construction!The power of a titanic watcher lies in its core. I ask that you bring one to me, so that our artificers might divine its construction.

Title: Faceless Mask of the Dark Imagination
Objective: Return the Faceless Mask of the Dark Imagination to the altar within a Horrific Vision.
Text: The magi, twisting their magic to manipulate and conquer the world. Imagining greater power they tread along the lines of the voids domain. In these pursuits this magi came to the realization that in the depths of one's imagination lies truly dark and terrible things.

Title: Faceless Mask of the Pained
Objective: Return the Faceless Mask of the Pained to the altar within a Horrific Vision.
Text: Trading in secrets, trading in lies, operating on the fringes are all the Spymaster knows. His lost passions, lost loves are all gone, crushed under his own duty and loyalty to the crown. Nothing is left, nothing but the pain. Pain is an apt tutor and tool and one in which the void knows intimately. Return my mask if you dare to feel the many forms pain can take.

Title: Faceless Mask of the Burned Bridge
Objective: Return the Faceless Mask of the Burned Bridge to the altar within a Horrific Vision.
Text: The displaced warrior is always on uneasy footing, especially one who is removed from her home world. The void makes this unsteadiness a reality where one step can lead into the abyss or drain you to your core.

Title: Faceless Mask of the Daredevil
Objective: Return the Faceless Mask of the Daredevil to the altar within a Horrific Vision.
Text: The hunter never sought to lead yet sought a challenge in life at every turn. He directed his allies with a deft hand and never shied from diving in to the melee himself. The prowess he showed made him as well as my other minions much more deadly. Return this mask to the altar of the Daredevil to challenge your own resolve in battle as your foes attacks cut even more deep.

Title: Encroaching Poachers
Objective: Collect 6 Rugged Hyena Pelts from Amathet Hunters or by skinning hyenas in Uldum.
Text: The Wastewanders used the pelts of the local hyenas to construct our armor. Unfortunately since the Amathet arrived, their hunters have overrun our normal hunting grounds.We need those pelts, and will pay handsomely for them. Either take them from the hunters or skin the hyenas yourself, if you have the skill.

Title: Champions of the Amathet
Objective: Kill 6 elite Amathet enemies in Uldum.
Text: The soldiers of Ramkahen are hearty and reliable.I would stand them up against any footman of the Amathet, but some of their higher-caste fighters are too much for even our toughest to handle.I don't think they'd be a problem for you, though. It would be a boon to our defense efforts if you could handle them while my soldiers engage the rank and file.

Title: Guarded Secrets
Objective: Loot 3 Amathet Caches in Uldum.
Text: From what we know about the Amathet, they must've been locked away in their tombs for thousands of years. Just think of what we could learn from them!Of course, that would be a lot easier if they weren't trying to kill us.If you happen upon any caches of Amathet relics in your travels, let me know. I'd love to see what sort of mysteries they contain!

Title: The Sun King's Chosen
Objective: Defeat 3 rare Amathet enemies in Uldum.
Text: On the surface the Amathet appear to be unwavering, but all soldiers have their breaking point. We need to send a message to their forces that we are not to be trifled with.Seek out the strongest of their numbers and bring them down in front of their eyes.We will show them the strength of Uldum!

Title: Blind Leading the Blind
Objective: Kill 8 Amathet priests in Uldum.
Text: The Sun Priests are an ancient order for the tol'vir who have walked among all of the tribes.Those that follow the Amathet, however, have twisted our beliefs and weaponized them to justify their crusade against Ramkahen.
