Their soldiers follow them blindly, never questioning.They must be stopped.

Title: Far From Home
Objective: Free 6 Enslaved Tol'vir in Uldum.
Text: The Amathet's conquest of eastern Uldum was sudden, and we were unable to reach some of our farthest settlements in time.Fortunately, many of the tol'vir who lived in the conquered territories were not killed, instead being put to work under the Amathet's whip.We must take any opportunity we can to free them and return them to their homes.

Title: Unearthed Artifacts
Objective: Collect 6 Titan Artifacts in Uldum.
Text: Ever since the Amathet came out of their tombs, they've been busy unearthing titan relics from the surrounding areas.I'm not sure what they intend to do with them or if they're just hoarding it so we can't have them. Sufficed to say the Explorer's League would love to study some of what they found!Of course, we can't get anywhere close to them without the Amathet trying to stick an axe in us, but that's not a problem for you, is it?Care to help?

Title: A Smashing Plan
Objective: Destroy 4 Amathet Idols and 2 Suntouched Obelisks in Uldum.
Text: Reports from my scouts mention various idols and monuments that the Amathet use to channel their solar magic.I don't know exactly what they're up to, but we should take away any possible advantage they have. So, I want you to go over there, and break anything that looks remotely magical.Just don't tell the Explorer's League. I'll never hear the end of it.

Title: Writs of the Sun King
Objective: Collect 6 Writs of the Sun King from Suntouched Amathet in Uldum.
Text: Very little is known about the Sun King that leads the Amathet. Our observations suggest that those closest to him are the "Suntouched," a unique caste of solar magic practitioners.I would like very much to learn more about this Sun King but, unlike some members of the Explorer's League, I'm not willing to risk the lives of my researchers to do so.You seem to be able to hold your own, though. If you happen upon any records about the Sun King, I'd gladly take them off your hands.

Title: Ancient Armaments
Objective: Collect 10 pieces of Amathet Armor from armored Amathet tol'vir in Uldum.
Text: Fighting a war on several fronts has taken its toll on our supplies. Our blacksmiths cannot repair and replace our soldiers' armor quickly enough, which is leaving us ill-equipped to face so many foes.Though the Amathet's armor is ancient, it is titan-forged and formidable. If we were able to salvage any, it could prove very useful to our defensive efforts.Can you help?

Title: Down From the Sky
Objective: Kill 8 Amathet Bowmen in Uldum.
Text: The archers of Ramkahen are highly skilled, but the bows of the Amathet have the advantage of range. This makes our incursions into their territory highly dangerous.You have a knack for fighting behind enemy lines. If you could thin out their ranks, it could provide us an opportunity to push their lines back for once.Will you help?

Title: Dark Deceivers
Objective: Kill 8 K'thir minions in Uldum.
Text: The Old Gods have many faceless minions at their disposal, but none so deceiving as the ones they call k'thir.Though not nearly as imposing as their brethren, the k'thir manipulate in the shadows, bending the wills of men and even reality itself.We must not allow their machinations to go unchecked.

Title: Servant of N'Zoth
Objective: Use the N'lyeth, Sliver of N'zoth to change your faction from Alliance to become devoted to N'Zoth. Then slay 10 Alliance players without dying.
Text: ...I have watched you... I have felt your bloodlust.But you serve false prophets... the Alliance is an illusion... I am a god!Prove to me you are worthy of my gift... kill those who are to betray you...Kill... the Alliance!

Title: Servant of N'Zoth
Objective: Use the N'lyeth, Sliver of N'zoth to change your faction from Horde to become devoted to N'Zoth. Then slay 10 Horde players without dying.
Text: ...I have watched you... I have felt your bloodlust.But you serve false prophets... the Horde is an illusion... I am a god!Prove to me you are worthy of my gift... kill those who are to betray you...Kill... the Horde!

Title: Symbolic Destruction
Objective: Destroy 6 Banners of the Black Empire in Uldum.
Text: The cultists that follow this dark legion befoul our lands with symbols of the tyrants they follow.Their mindless followers flock to these banners, worshipping them as unholy idols.Burn them down, and cleanse their taint from our lands.

Title: Twisted Corruptors
Objective: Kill 10 fleshbeasts in Uldum.
Text: While the fleshbeasts that accompany the invading forces appear to be no more than a nuisance, they carry within themselves a deep connection to the corrupting powers of the Old Gods.Like a pestilence, they spread the N'Zoth's corruption wherever they tread, slowly twisting the very land to their form.They must be eradicated.

Title: Lost and Tormented
Objective: Free 6 Ramkahen Citizens from Torment Cells within the Lost City of Tol'vir in Uldum.
Text: Our citizens here in Ramkahen have managed to escape the brunt of N'Zoth's assault.Our brothers in the Lost City were not so fortunate. Those not immediately slain have been held captive only to be tortured by N'Zoth's minions.I know that you will be taking the fight to N'Zoth's forces. If you can free our allies as well, Ramkahen will be in your debt.

Title: Lessons in Brigandry
Objective: Loot 3 Black Empire Caches in Uldum.
Text: The Wastewanders have spent many generations as brigands, whether on land or sea. Though we have decided to hang up that life for a chance at a more peaceful existence, we have not forgotten the lessons we've learned in those days.One such lesson I feel is particularly relevant now -- when faced with a superior opponent, it often helps to use their weapons against them.Find their hidden caches and take whatever you can carry. You may just find something that can turn the tide of this battle.

Title: Cleansing Uldum
Objective: Destroy 6 Corruption Tumors in Uldum.
Text: Every moment that N'Zoth's forces remain in Uldum, his corruption seeps further into the land itself.Even if we were to drive back his minions, the damage he has done to Uldum may be irreversible.We must seek out his corruption where it festers and eliminate it.

Title: Questionable Sourcing
Objective: Collect 8 Coalesced Corruption from slimes in Uldum.
Text: My clairvoyance provides a great strategic asset to the people of Ramkahen. However, the potency of my visions of late has proven taxing to my health.I have devised a tonic that may serve to dull the harm these visions cause, but it will require the coalesced essence of the Old Gods' corruption.If you could retrieve some samples of this for me, it could prove invaluable in our efforts.

Title: Anchors of the Black Empire
Objective: Destroy 6 Black Empire Obelisks in Uldum.
Text: This invasion struck us without warning, with structures reminiscent of the Black Empire materializing out of nothing, pouring out the forces of the Old Gods. We have no idea how they came to be or where they came from.However, whenever a new structure appears, it is preceded by malefic obelisks. We believe these obelisks act as anchors to usher in more of the Old Gods' forces.If we truly wish to stem the tide of this invasion, we must destroy the obelisks.

Title: A Rallying Cry
Objective: Kill 3 rare minions of N'Zoth in Uldum.
Text: Our lands have been infested by the minions of the Old Gods. They strike at every front, even assailing the very minds of our soldiers.Our forces cannot handle this for long. We must strike a decisive blow to try to salvage some of their morale.Find the biggest, slimiest, tentacle-faced monstrosities that you can and bring them down. My men will rally to your example.

Title: Wisdom From Madness
Objective: Collect 10 Maddened Writings from Black Empire Cultists in Uldum.
Text: In my visions I hear... voices...Their words are nonsense, but over time patterns arise. I believe there is something important behind what these voices say, but I have yet to decipher a word.We will need to learn from the source. Find any writings you can among the cultists who travel with these dark creatures. Their ramblings may be the key to understanding the message beneath this madness.

Title: Order Among Chaos
Objective: Kill 6 faceless minions of N'Zoth in Uldum.
Text: It has been a long time since the tol'vir have squared off against the forces of an Old God, so our tactical knowledge of their forces is limited.However, one tenet of combat always holds true -- striking down those that issue the orders will weaken the foe much greater than the rank and file.I have observed that the larger faceless minions act as commanders of the Old Gods' forces. Silence them, and perhaps we can sow a different kind of chaos in their ranks.

Title: Urgent Care
Objective: Find Kelsey Steelspark in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Excellent timing.Kelsey Steelspark has been sending communications to the capital cities looking for aid.Mekkatorque's condition is quite dire and time is of the essence.Hurry to Boralus Harbor, she will be watching for you.

Title: Blind the Eyes
Objective: Kill 6 Foul Observers in the Akhenet Fields in Uldum.
Text: Strange forces have been interfering with my visions of late. The ever-watching eyes pierce through the veil, shattering my clairvoyance.The eyes of our enemy peer into our very souls and pierce our minds. We must rip them out, if we truly wish to be rid of the curse on this land.

Title: A Hand in the Dark
Objective: Rescue 8 souls from the vision.
Text: Imagine being trapped in a world you didn't know existed--a reality unbeknownst to even yourself.Thoughts, fears, and dark desires cloud the mind, coupled with irresistible temptation.So many are lost to the darkness, unable to resist these temptations, but not all.Do what you can to preserve those that fight against the darkness. We mustn't allow them to fall.

Title: Vanquishing the Darkness
Objective: Repel N'Zoth's corruption within the vision.
Text: The darkness grows. The cycle continues.Do what you can to stay N'Zoth's efforts. If we do not stand against the corruption we may some day find ourselves drowning in darkness.

Title: A Dark, Glaring Reality
Objective: Defeat 6 Darkglare Watchers within the vision.
Text: Their eyes are upon us, watching every move from the shadows. It is no wonder our efforts thus far have felt... lacking.The fault is by no means your own. We should have suspected this was the case long ago.If we are to continue our efforts with meaningful expectations we must go undetected.Our old friend has offered an elixir to aide in exposing our enemy. While there may be a few... unknown side effects, the result provides the imbiber true sight in the darkness.

Title: Supplies from the Uldum Accord
Objective: Speak with Provisioner Qorra in Uldum for your reward.
Text: The Resistance appreciates all the help you've given us.Please take these supplies as a token of our gratitude, and a promise of more to come, should you continue to help us.

Title: Preventative Measures
Objective: Destroy 3 Void Portals within the vision.
Text: Waves of darkness continue their assault on the shores of our world. I am afraid the waters at our feet may soon wash over us. Perhaps it is time for a different approach.Make your way into the twisted realm and seek out their dark portals. If we are able to slow their advance it might just buy us the time needed to expose a fatal weakness.

Title: Stranger in a Strange Land
Objective: Find the Hero's Call Board in Stormwind City.
Text: Welcome to Stormwind. King Anduin Wrynn invites you to explore our fair city. Say, you look like someone who enjoys the night life. We have many popular taverns and a vibrant music scene!Ah, but that can wait. Seek out the Hero's Call Board in the city to find where adventure lies, then speak to your emissary.Have a pleasant stay. Oh, and a friendly word of advice... best to not attempt to upgrade people without their consent. Some don't take too kindly to that!

Title: For the Alliance
Objective: Meet Ambassador Moorgard at the Stormwind Embassy.
Text: As High Tinker, and leader of both Gnomes and Mechagnomes, I am proud to welcome you to the Alliance!A world of adventure awaits you beyond the walls of Mechagon City.When you are ready, step on the teleporter. Ambassador Moorgard will be awaiting your arrival at the Stormwind Embassy.There will be many potential avenues of advancement available to you.Choose wisely, improve, and remember to share your data.

Title: Stranger in a Strange Land
Objective: Find the Warchief's Command Board in Orgrimmar.
Text: Hi. I'm Ambassador Blackguard.On behalf of the warchief, I am honored to welcome you to Orgrimmar.As a lifetime of adventure unfolds before you, be assured that... uh...You know what? I've been reading this same greeting all day. Enough's enough.Examine the Warchief's Command Board and find out where you can adventure. Run along.

Title: For the Horde
Objective: Meet Ambassador Blackguard at the Orgrimmar Embassy.
Text: What an adventure!There is so much to explore... so much to discover. These are such exciting times!We'll show our allies in the Horde the value of having some clever Vulpera around.Please meet with the ambassador at the Orgrimmar embassy, then seek out the possibilities throughout all of Azeroth and beyond.Until our paths cross again!

Title: Supplies from the Rajani
Objective: Speak with Zhang Ku in Vale of Eternal Blossoms for your reward.
Text: The Resistance appreciates all the help you've given us.Please take these supplies as a token of our gratitude, and a promise of more to come, should you continue to help us.

Title: Minions of N'Zoth
Objective: Defeat 20 minions of N'Zoth within the vision.
Text: The howling winds that surround us may some day be drowned out, masked by these increasingly dark, yet familiar whispers.Something must be done.Enter the darkness, and strike down the enemy.

Title: Destroying the Source
Objective: Destroy 3 Nazeshi Powercells within Dreadpearl Shallows.
Text: Tidecaller Nezara is running the show. If we take her out, the remaining naga will break rank, but getting to her won't be easy. She's protected by a magical barrier that's drawing power from powercells nearby.If we can destroy the source, we can destroy Nezara.

Title: Obelisk of the Sun
Objective: Locate Exterminator Zahra at the Obelisk of the Sun.
Text: I have one more thing I must ask of you, my friend. Completion of this task is critical to our survival here.Our comrade, Zahra, has taken it upon herself to climb the plateau just east of us to secure one of the old bombers left up there.So far, our attempts to get word back to Arik have failed.However, if you can help her get one of those planes working, we might just have a chance.Hopefully they can send aid before we are overrun...

Title: To the Moon
Objective: Remove the Aqir threat from Obelisk of the Moon.
Text: Alright! It's time to high tail it outta here.We gotta get back to camp and tell Arik what's been going on out here as soon as possible.Head for the bomber and let's fuel 'er up.I'll letcha have the gunner seat, but I'm drivin', so let's try to blow up a few bugs on the way back!

Title: All Gassed Up
Objective: Collect 6 Fuel Canisters.
Text: So, I was checkin' all these planes... and you are never gonna believe this, but none of them have any fuel in the tanks!Saw a few canisters scattered around nearby, surely some a' them have some gas left.Was gonna collect 'em myself, but these damned bugs came outta nowhere and started swarmin' the place.Too many here now to deal with on my own, think you'd be able to lend a hand?

Title: More Bits, More Bits!
Objective: Collect 16 Aqir Bits.
Text: We need more Aqir samples. As many as you can get your hands on!I've made some fascinating discoveries already, but there's so much more to learn.With further study and a bit of good luck, perhaps we can slowly begin to uncover some of their weaknesses.

Title: Ruins of Ammon
Objective: Travel to the Ruins of Ammon.
Text: These things seem to be everywhere and all at once!Either this was an organized attack, or there are far more of them than we can even comprehend.Regardless, this is bad for us... really, really bad.$p, I need you to travel to the Ruins of Ammon and find out what the situation is like over there.If they need help, please try to lend a hand!

Title: Ruinator Xok'nixx
Objective: Kill Ruinator Xok'nixx.
Text: Ar'kali and a group of our warriors are engaged with a most behemothic creature in the heart of the ruins.She can hold her own against nearly any foe, but I fear it is only a matter of time before this monster is able to wear them down.Although the creature is occupied for now, if our warriors fall, the ruins will be lost to us.Please, make haste, with your help they can surely fell this titanic foe.

Title: Heroic Warfront: The Battle for Darkshore
Objective: Defeat the Horde at the Battle for Darkshore.
Text: We will not tolerate further Horde aggression in our territories.The night elves will not stand alone this day. Darkshore will be theirs once more.For the Alliance!

Title: Wastewander Hosts
Objective: Kill 6 Wastewander Hosts.
Text: The bugs have been laying eggs in the corpses of our soldiers, it's absolutely terrifying!Some of them are rising from the ground as putrid, bloated, hideous monstrosities.We have to stop them before they continue to bolster their ranks with our fallen.It's not a pleasant task... but I have to ask you to help me destroy them. Completely.Grab some bombs behind me, if you'd like.

Title: The Wastewandering Dead
Objective: Kill 6 Wastewander Hosts.
Text: Is there no end to these foul monsters!?I cannot abide the desecration of our dead, especially not as fodder for this disgusting insect army.Destroy as many as you can, preferably with fire!

Title: Tend the Wounded
Objective: Heal 8 Wastewander Laborers.
Text: My friend, as you can see here, we are besieged by these terrible creatures.Many of our comrades have fallen prey to the monsters, but fortunately, we have enough warriors here to keep the threat at bay... for now.If you are able to assist us, please, tend to our wounded and help clear a path for them to escape the ruins.

Title: To Ankhaten Harbor
Objective: Find Tracker Samara in Ankhaten Harbor.
Text: I fear that I don't yet have the strength to ride out into the sands and face those monsters again.Ride to the south and find Tracker Samara in the excavation camp formerly known as Schnottz's Landing.Tell her to halt any caravans that plan to pass this way, lest others are ambushed and met with the same grisly fate.We must get the word out across Uldum before our forces are further divided!

Title: Heroic Warfront: The Battle for Darkshore
Objective: Defeat the Alliance at the Battle for Darkshore.
Text: Darkshore belongs to the Horde! We must hold that ground to maintain our dominance over Kalimdor.Prepare yourselves. Battle awaits!

Title: Search for Survivors
Objective: Check 8 Wastewanders in Orsis.
Text: The bugs came from everywhere... There wasn't any time to react.Many of my friends died where they stood, while others tried to fight with our meager tools.I'm a coward. I fled in the commotion instead of trying to help.Now, here I am, out of food and water and too scared to look for survivors.Please, I beg you to help anyone you find left alive in Orsis...

Title: Burn the Bodies
Objective: Burn 10 Egg-bearing corpses.
Text: The bugs seem to be indiscriminately laying eggs all over the nearby corpses.They are using them as food to spawn more of those horrible things. Disgusting!We can mourn the dead later, but if any more bugs are allowed to hatch we may not live long enough to do so.Burn the bodies and destroy those eggs!

Title: Word from Orsis
Objective: Investigate the situation in Orsis.
Text: As you can see, we have our hands full here dealing with these disgusting bugs.Our caravans from the south have stopped arriving and we have received disturbing news from the few who've made it back recently.I've sent a patrol toward Orsis to investigate; they are past due for a report back.Can I ask you to check in on them for me?

Title: Nine Lives
Objective: Destroy 8 Neferset Denizens.
Text: Scouts have returned recently, nearly on the verge of death, with reports that I find... disconcerting.Neferset have been spotted wandering the streets of their city to the south.This would normally be no cause for alarm, except the Neferset were completely wiped out.I must ask you to investigate further... and if by some foul magic these reports turn out to be true, you must do whatever you can to contain this threat!

Title: Close to Tears
Objective: Find and close 3 Void Tears in Uldum.
Text: Our warriors have observed foul manifestations coming forth from numerous void tears within the surrounding jungle.They have been but mere weaklings, clearly intended to test our defenses before the real forces arrive.If we do not deal with this threat now, however, it will only be a matter of time until we are overrun by their fodder.Find a way to close those portals!

Title: Ramkahen Rescue
Objective: Rescue 6 Mar'at Villagers.
Text: Mar'at was overrun by those foul K'thir before we could safely evacuate our citizens.I fear the worst has happened to them.Please, if anyone is left alive within the city, tell them to come to Ramkahen.

Title: Zinfizzlex's Portable Shredder Unit
Objective: Master Engineer Zinfizzlex wants you to bring him the following:
Text: I'm as anxious as you are to try out my portable shredder unit, but before I can make the kit, I'm going to need materials - lots of materials! To be exact, I'm going to need a mountain of thorium, mithril, and iron. I will also need one steamsaw per unit. You'll have to get those at the lumber mill. When I was nosing around in here (before my capture) I noticed a pile of steamsaws at the Stormpike lumber camp.

Title: Zinfizzlex's Portable Shredder Unit
Objective: Master Engineer Zinfizzlex wants you to bring him the following:
Text: I'm as anxious as you are to try out my portable shredder unit, but before I can make the kit, I'm going to need materials - lots of materials! To be exact, I'm going to need a mountain of thorium, mithril, and iron. I will also need one steamsaw per unit. You'll have to get those at the lumber mill. When I was nosing around in here (before my capture) I noticed a pile of steamsaws at the Frostwolf lumber camp.

Title: Empty Stables
Objective: Locate an Alterac Ram in Alterac Valley. Use the Stormpike Training Collar when you are near the Alterac Ram to 'tame' the beast. Once tamed, the Alterac Ram will follow you back to the Stable Master. Speak with the Stable Master to earn credit for the capture.
Text: Just look at the stables! Empty! The Stormpike Brigade has no rams to ride - the cavalry is defunct. You must help us, soldier. Take this training collar and enter the wilds of this valley. Locate the Alterac rams that roam throughout the area and use the collar to snare one. When you have captured a ram, return it to me and I shall place it in our stable. When we have enough rams, the ram rider commander will be notified. With your help, the cavalry will be reborn!

Title: Empty Stables
Objective: Locate a Frostwolf in Alterac Valley. Use the Frostwolf Muzzle when you are near the Frostwolf to 'tame' the beast. Once tamed, the Frostwolf will follow you back to the Frostwolf Stable Master. Speak with the Frostwolf Stable Master to earn credit for the capture.
Text: The war in the valley has taken its toll on our soldiers. We must revitalize our forces! If we can fill up the stables, the Wolf Riders will once more be able to ride out into the field of battle. Take this muzzle and track down the frostwolves that inhabit the nearby forest. Once you find a wolf, use the muzzle to tame the beast. Bring the tamed beast back to me so that I may place it in the stable. When we have enough wolves stabled, the Wolf Riders will rejoin their patrol on our front lines.

Title: Assault: The Endless Swarm
Objective: Drive back the Mantid Assault in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The mantid swarm is surging! There's no way the Golden Lotus will be able to handle this many of them.We must do something to drive them back!

Title: Champions of the Mogu
Objective: Defeat 3 rare enemies while the Mogu are invading the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: These lesser clans warring with each other in the Vale need to be taught their place.Seek out their champions and eliminate them. Show them that only the Rajani have rightful claim here!

Title: Spoils of War
Objective: Collect 12 pieces of Salvaged Mogu Armor from mogu enemies in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The warring clans are relentless and our warriors are going through armor faster than I can keep it repaired.If you find yourself in battle with the other clans, see if you can salvage any undamaged armor pieces from their soldiers. We should not let good resources go to waste.

Title: Bound in Stone
Objective: Collect Stoneshaper Rods from Baruk Stoneshapers and use them to free 5 Petrified Warriors in the Ruins of Guo-Lai.
Text: Some of our warriors were camped in the small settlement near Guo-Lai when the Baruk invaded the area. Some managed to escape, but they returned with tales of their brothers and sisters in arms being petrified by the mogu stoneshapers into living statues!We can't leave our warriors behind!The stoneshapers must carry some means to reverse the spell and free them from their stone prisons. Bring our soldiers back!

Title: Unbeelievable Quality
Objective: Take the Collected Tidebloom Honey to "Nasty" Buck in Brennadam.

Title: Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye
Objective: Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson.
Text: Your war in the heart of Alterac means nothing to the Syndicate. We will do as we have always done: Wait until a clear victor rises from the ashes and rubble of this madness and then strike. That, however, is not why we are here now. The All Seeing Eye has been lost - taken by the Winterax trolls of the region. Recover the Eye and our services shall be yours - for whatever time remains for your side. Return to me once you acquire the eye so that I may examine you.

Title: Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye
Objective: Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson.
Text: Your war in the heart of Alterac means nothing to the Syndicate. We will do as we have always done: Wait until a clear victor rises from the ashes and rubble of this madness and then strike. That, however, is not why we are here now. The All Seeing Eye has been lost - taken by the Winterax trolls of the region. Recover the Eye and our services shall be yours - for whatever time remains for your side. Return to me once you acquire the eye so that I may examine you.

Title: The Legend of Korrak
Objective: According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
Text: The invading Stormpike are not the only threat in the region, soldier. The war in the Valley is waged on two fronts. The cannibal Winterax trolls also vie for power. They are lead by Korrak the Bloodrager - a cruel and cunning beast. A strike against Korrak could prove to be a crushing blow to the Winterax clan. Slay the beast and be rewarded!

Title: Disturbance Detected: Firelands
Objective: Relive the siege of the Firelands.
Text: You're early , I hadn't even sent for you yet.Another temporal distubrance has flared up, this time in the Firelands. If Ragnaros hadn't been dealt with when he was, well, you've already seen one way the end time could turn out.Some intricate time weaving is required to be sure you catch Ragnaros early, but still after whatever is causing the disturbance. Whoever is doing this isn't messing around any more.

Title: Korrak the Bloodrager
Objective: According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
Text: The indigenous Winterax trolls of the region are ruthless savages that would love nothing more than to have our bones added to their foul stew. We must show them our might! We have recovered tomes from their caves that detail their leadership hierarchy. The artifacts indicate that their leader, Korrak the Bloodrager, tends to remain hidden until given a reason to make his presence known. Death to Korrak would mean death to Winterax Clan! Slay him and return.

Title: The Eternal Traveler
Objective: Gather Echoes of Mortality from living creatures.
Text: Hail, mortal.For untold ages, my kind has traversed the myriad realms of reality. We have beheld phenomena that you cannot begin to comprehend. But there is much you must learn of what awaits you on the horizon.The power of Death is on the rise. The veil weakens between your world and the Shadowlands.When a mortal life expires, an echo of it remains behind. The most powerful mortals leave the most resonant echoes.Bring these to me, that I might study them... to both our benefits.

Title: Accessing the Archives
Objective: Speak with MOTHER to activate the Titanic Research Archive, then examine the archives.
Text: The information you've gathered has allowed us to better understand these manifestations.I believe MOTHER is waiting to share some of her findings with you.

Title: The Future of Mechagon
Objective: Travel to the High Tinkertory in Mechagon City.
Text: Now that Mechagon City has been cleared of its remaining dangers, it may once again be a place of peace and prosperity for gnomes and mechagnomes alike.It is time for me to speak with Prince Erazmin regarding the future of our peoples. It is my sincere hope that we will forge an alliance that will last for generations to come!When you are ready, please join us at the High Tinkertory for a special address.

Title: Propagate the News
Objective: Update Aysa Cloudsinger in Stormwind.
Text: We wanted to save a life and we have accomplished so much more!We really couldn't have done it without you. I am so excited about the future of all gnomekind.Head back to Stormwind and share the good news!

Title: Mental Attunement
Objective: Activate the Synchroscope when Christy tells you to fire.
Text: We now have a baseline of who Mekkatorque is, looks like there could be some room for improvement.Your assistance is needed to get him stabilized and synchronized before removing him from his pod.Please position yourself by the Synchroscope. I will make adjustments, you will need to fire the machine when I call.

Title: Ascension
Objective: Clear the remaining Mechagon defenders.
Text: After everything the mechagnomes have done for us today, it is our duty to return the favor.Let us clear out the rogue creations that remain in Mechagon.With their home returned, Prince Erazmin and his people will have a brilliant path forward.With this team, we will make short work of the remaining King Mechagon loyalists.Let me know when you are ready to roll out!

Title: Voyage to Safety
Objective: Defeat the scavenging troggs and retrieve Mekkatorque's Escape Pod.
Text: One of our defenders saw the troggs take out the homing copter carrying Mekkatorque's pod.Since we started bringing goods in from Tiragarde, they have been a real thorn in our side.Piston, a very promising young inventor, has a vehicle able to handle this task. Meet his crew down in Bondo's yard.Please hurry and retrieve the pod! I am not sure what will happen to Gelbin, if they break it open.Ahem, we would not be upset if you did a little beach clean-up while you were there...

Title: The Current Schematic
Objective: Collect 4 Heat Tolerant Ooze and 6 Acquisitioned Machine Parts.
Text: I think I can modify one of our existing devices to give us access to Gelbin Mekkatorque without disturbing his life preserving functions.There are some items I will need you to procure.From the nearby vector of the Heaps, you will find scrapbots and scraphounds. These would be a fine source of spare parts for my construction project.The Outflow is home to some particularly slimy friends. From them, you will find excellent ingredients for the heat resistant lubricant we need.

Title: A Strong Heart
Objective: Retrieve the Spark Reactor and complete Mekkatorque's procedure.
Text: We saw a flare near Junkwatt Depot.The retrieval team has made it out with the power source. We are now forever safe from King Mechagon's Annihilo-tron, its heart will serve a new purpose.This is great news!However, the flare means they have company. Your help will be needed to extricate the team and retrieve the Spark Reactor.Please move with haste, we are so close to completion.

Title: Dream Catcher
Objective: Acquire 200 Shred of Insanity. These can be looted from bosses in Ny'alotha and World Bosses, obtained by winning Battlegrounds and Arenas, or from Honorable Kills.
Text: It appears that the focus remains stable, and its containment field remains intact. I daresay we can empower it even further.Hunt down and defeat formidable enemies to acquire additional remnants of N'Zoth's influence. This time, we will infuse the focus with even greater amounts of the Old God's power. I am confident that the containment field will continue to hold.

Title: Better... Stronger... Less Dead
Objective: Collect the Neural Accelerator, Omni Electromagnetic Amplifier, and Flux Energized Servos from the erratic units.
Text: King Mechagon may have been crazy, but his minions did have exemplary robotic creation capabilities.There are a few residual creations wandering Mechagon. Refusing to accept King Mechagon's dethroning.The logical conclusion to defeat is withdrawal, if one remains operational. Some do not excel at logic.They currently bear the latest in technical advancement. I believe retrieving specific pieces from these units would greatly benefit our recovery endeavor.

Title: Him?
Objective: Gather data from gnomes and mechagnomes in Mechagon.
Text: Speak to some of the gnomes in Mechagon, enhanced or otherwise. Of my people, ask what they hope for in a leader of our kind. Of our new friends, ask what they appreciate most about their current leader.From what I have learned thus far, the High Tinker has always led his people by necessity, he never sought or desired the crown. I believe the gnomes should be united once again.I seek a solution that will be most amenable to all. Will you gather the information I need?

Title: Someone Who Can Help
Objective: Help Kelsey move Mekkatorque's Escape Pod to Mechagon.
Text: I believe there is a way to help Mekkatorque, but some may not be a hundred percent on board...The mechagnomes have advanced techniques in biomechanical repair and improvements.If there is even a chance they can help him, we have to try! There are some mechagnomes sending supplies out to the island from a dock in Hook Point. No one will notice one more piece of cargo. We need to reroute one of their homing copters.Will you please help me get Mekkatorque's Pod to Mechagon?

Title: Waning Energy
Objective: Meet Kelsey Steelspark at Proudmoore Keep.
Text: Mekkatorque's pod is powering down.We are no longer able to hear him speak.His pulse has slowed, in spite of the best efforts of Kul Tiran healers.I have an idea, but I am going to need your help.Meet me at Proudmoore Keep. We must go soon.

Title: Maintaining Focus
Objective: Acquire 20 Shred of Insanity. These can be looted from bosses in Ny'alotha and World Bosses, obtained by winning Battlegrounds and Arenas, or from Honorable Kills.
Text: At present, the focus holds but a fraction of N'Zoth's true power. If we further empower it, we could craft even more effective weapons to wield against him.N'Zoth's influence is everywhere, and is most concentrated within powerful foes. Vanquish them and claim whatever vestiges of the Old God's power remain.

Title: New Allies Among Us
Objective: Witness Baine welcome the vulpera into the Horde.
Text: Even in times of peace, the Horde is not without its problems.Although they can be overwhelming at times, our struggles should never stop us from remembering what it means to be a part of the Horde.We don't turn people away when times get tough; we band together and endure.For a moment I forgot this. Burdened by the troubles facing our new allies, I hastily dismissed the vulpera.My only hope is that they still see as much value in the Horde as I see in them.

Title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
Objective: Collect Torn Pages of "Fear and Flesh" from Corrupted or Lost Areas within Horrific Visions for Wrathion in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: Perhaps the most insidious element of the Old Gods' whispers is that they contain within them the smallest kernel of truth. There is something to be said for the joy that comes with feeling the sun on one's skin and the wind in one's hair.But you have braved N'Zoth's visions. You have seen where their designs are ultimately meant to lead. The curse of flesh has nothing to do with bringing us joy.Continue to collect the pages of this book. We have nearly finished piecing it back together.

Title: Reconstructing "The Final Truth"
Objective: Collect Torn Pages of "The Final Truth" from Lost Areas within Horrific Visions for Wrathion in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: Long have I studied the secrets of the Old Gods. I have traversed the whole of Azeroth in search of esoteric texts, lost archives, and forbidden knowledge, all in the name of preparing for the horror to come.No amount of research could have prepared me for the depths of the insanity I would find within this book. A madness so absolute that only the Shath'yar language can convey it.Find me the final pages of this accursed tome. I wish to learn what I need from it and be done with it forever.

Title: Reconstructing "The Curse of Stone"
Objective: Collect Torn Pages of "The Curse of Stone" from Horrific Visions for Wrathion in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: N'Zoth is nothing if not subtle and insidious. I can see how an impressionable mind could be turned against the Titans by reading these words. Thankfully, we are not so susceptible to such manipulation, are we?The book is nearly complete. Continue retrieving its pages from within the visions.

Title: Stepping Through the Darkness
Objective: Recover a copy of "Fear and Flesh" from the depths of a Horrific Vision for Wrathion in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: By now you've noticed the protection of your cloak wavering the deeper you delve into these visions.To further bolster your resistance to N'Zoth's influence, we will need to gain an even deeper understanding of his nefarious power.Seek out knowledge from manifestations deeper within the visions, and we shall have our answers soon enough.

Title: Reconstructing "The Final Truth"
Objective: Collect Torn Pages of "The Final Truth" from Lost Areas within Horrific Visions for Wrathion in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: I know of this book. It is a sacred tome to those who worship the Old Gods, containing the deepest secrets and most incomprehensible mysteries of the Void. Only the most devout cultists are allowed to gaze upon its pages.Even incomplete, holding it makes my skin crawl. I must take care not to read too much of it in a single sitting.That being said, we must find its missing pages in order to continue our research. Retrieve them from the darkest corners of N'Zoth's visions.

Title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
Objective: Collect Torn Pages of "Fear and Flesh" from Corrupted or Lost Areas within Horrific Visions for Wrathion in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: Adherents of the Old Gods maintain that flesh is a gift, not a curse. This tome reflects on the Old Gods' supposed benevolence in granting us such a generous blessing.Naturally, it omits any mention of what occurs when their corruption is allowed to run unfettered.Gather more of these pages for me. As wretched as these words might be, studying them will allow us to increase the efficacy of your cloak.

Title: Reconstructing "The Final Truth"
Objective: Collect Torn Pages of "The Final Truth" from Lost Areas within Horrific Visions for Wrathion in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: I dare not repeat aloud the horrors that are recorded in these pages. The words themselves seem to shift and morph as I read them, as if the book itself is attempting to induce a descent into madness.This is taxing work, but it is necessary if we are to fully prepare you for the dangers of Ny'alotha. For as disturbing as its descriptions might be, setting foot within it will prove more challenging by an order of magnitude.Keep looking for pages from the book. But... leave the reading to me.

Title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
Objective: Collect Torn Pages of "Fear and Flesh" from Corrupted or Lost Areas within Horrific Visions for Wrathion in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: Adherents of the Old Gods maintain that flesh is a gift, not a curse. This tome reflects on the Old Gods' supposed benevolence in granting us such a generous blessing.Naturally, it omits any mention of what occurs when their corruption is allowed to run unfettered.Gather more of these pages for me. As wretched as these words might be, studying them will allow us to increase the efficacy of your cloak.

Title: Walking in the Darkness
Objective: Recover a copy of "The Final Truth" from Lost Areas within Horrific Visions for Wrathion in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: The end nears. The darkest corners of these visions await.Our work has ensured you are well equipped to seek out the most horrific manifestations these visions have to offer. The final answers lie just beyond. Our preparations for Ny'alotha are nearly complete.

Title: Reconstructing "The Curse of Stone"
Objective: Collect Torn Pages of "The Curse of Stone" from Horrific Visions for Wrathion in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: Thus far, the contents of this book are unsettling to say the least. Nevertheless, I have been able to glean valuable information on the nature of N'Zoth's power, and have made alterations to your cloak accordingly.There remains much to learn, however. Continue your search for additional pages as you delve into the visions.

Title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
Objective: Collect Torn Pages of "Fear and Flesh" from Corrupted or Lost Areas within Horrific Visions for Wrathion in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: Perhaps the most insidious element of the Old Gods' whispers is that they contain within them the smallest kernel of truth. There is something to be said for the joy that comes with feeling the sun on one's skin and the wind in one's hair.But you have braved N'Zoth's visions. You have seen where their designs are ultimately meant to lead. The curse of flesh has nothing to do with bringing us joy.Continue to collect the pages of this book. We have nearly finished piecing it back together.

Title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
Objective: Collect Torn Pages of "Fear and Flesh" from Corrupted or Lost Areas within Horrific Visions for Wrathion in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: Another tome written by one lost to N'Zoth's madness. I dread to think of what vile words await us within it.But if we are to strengthen your cloak, then we must know more of that which it was meant to resist. See if you can find the remaining pages so that we can complete this tome and make use of the knowledge it holds.

Title: The Hidden Need
Objective: Meet Lilian Voss in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: Because of Sylvanas, some members of the Horde are skeptical of the Forsaken. We must regain their trust.We cannot do that without accepting ourselves. So many feel lost, alone... abandoned.I have arranged a meeting. It could be a big step... or all go horribly wrong. Either way, you should bear witness.Meet me in Tirisfal Glades, at the Calston Estate.

Title: Reconstructing "The Curse of Stone"
Objective: Collect Torn Pages of "The Curse of Stone" from Horrific Visions for Wrathion in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: I came across several references to this book in my research of Ny'alotha. Penned by a neophyte cultist, it documents the "lies of the Titans" and the "injustices" they inflicted upon the denizens of Azeroth.Mad ravings, intended to erode the reader's acceptance of reality.Still, by studying this work, we can gain a better understanding of the Old God's power, and thus tailor the cloak to offer better protection against it.Bring as many pages from this tome as you can find.

Title: Remnants of a Shattered World
Objective: Recover a copy of "The Curse of Stone" from a Horrific Vision for Wrathion in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: The knowledge gained from these visions affords us a unique opportunity to further protect one's mind from corruption. To continue our research, we must investigate the deeper mysteries of these experiences.Seek out those of power within these visions. Should you come across anything of interest do not hesitate to share your findings.In the meantime, MOTHER and I shall continue our research here in the chamber.We await your return.

Title: Into the Darkest Depths
Objective: Enter a Horrific Vision to discover what dark manifestations await in a world ruled by N'Zoth.
Text: With our connection secured, it is time for us to breach the veil and discover what lies beyond.What you find may provide us the key to unlocking our success.

Title: Descending Into Madness
Objective: Seek out a Vision of N'Zoth amidst the corruption in Vale of Eternal Blossoms or Uldum to discover what the future holds for Azeroth.
Text: As unfortunate as the spreading corruption may seem, I believe it provides us the opportunity to prepare for what lies ahead.Locate one of these incursions and see what happens when you peer beyond the dark veil.

Title: Deeper Into the Darkness
Objective: Speak with MOTHER to return to the Halls of Origination in Uldum to discover the source behind the anomaly.
Text: This recent change of events allows us to continue our journey to discover what darkness lies beyond the sands.It will not be easy. We stand on the precipice of the unknown, but now the tables have turned.You do dress the part.Let's see what insights your return to the Halls of Origination bring to light.

Title: Sail With the Tide
Objective: Meet with Calia Menethil and Derek Proudmoore.
Text: Hello.I have received word from Calia asking that we meet with her once again.She has so much to offer those who feel lost, those seeking a better way. Once she is free of doubt, she will know what must be done.Will you join me?

Title: Prototypes for Inspiration
Objective: Collect 150 Prototype Implants in Mechagon, while in War Mode.
Text: As the leader of this momentous expedition, I must stay with Prince Erazmin to ensure he's not swindled by this Horde hooligan.But I cannot stop my research, or the Horde will gain the advantage!Underlings like yourself must collect the technology samples required to fuel my legendary brainstorms.Bring me prototypes from the island, and I will turn them into groundbreaking new innovations for the Alliance!

Title: Towers and Bunkers
Objective: Capture an enemy tower or bunker, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in Frostwolf Village.
Text: Towers and bunkers are important positions, and we must capture and hold them all! So to that end, I want you to attack a bunker that is controlled by the enemy. To do that, enter one with an Alliance banner. You will see another banner inside. Pull out that banner, and a white Horde banner will appear in its place. Well done! At that point your task for me will be complete, but if you hold the place long enough, and if the Alliance doesn't take it back, then it will be destroyed!

Title: Irondeep Supplies
Objective: Bring 10 Irondeep Supplies to the Horde Quartermaster in Frostwolf Keep.
Text: The Stormpike dwarves are using the Irondeep mine as a storage depot. I want you to raid that mine and bring me its supplies. This will curtail the Stormpikes' efforts in Alterac Valley, and will provide us with needed equipment! Be wary. The Irondeep mine is deep in Alliance territory, and control of the mine is as shifting as the snows of Alterac.

Title: Capture a Mine
Objective: Capture a mine, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in Frostwolf Village.
Text: As battle rages over the landscape of Alterac Valley, so too does it rage through the Coldtooth and Irondeep mines. Both are rich sources of minerals and both are used to store supplies; it's no wonder they are so highly valued! Help our war effort! Capture one of the mines for the Horde! To capture a mine, enter one that we do not control and kill its leader. When that is done, the mine will be ours and we'll send troops to protect it!

Title: Speak with our Quartermaster
Objective: Speak with the Frostwolf Quartermaster.
Text: , the Frostwolf Quartermaster is looking for recruits, for tasks that lead into the mines of Alterac Valley. Speak with him; he will tell you more. Follow the road west into the bunker, then take the west exit and you'll find our quartermaster.

Title: Enemy Booty
Objective: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Smith Regzar in Frostwolf Village.
Text: When you fight the enemy, gather the scraps of their armor and bring them to me. I'll use those scraps to make armor for our own troops!

Title: Prototypes for Profit
Objective: Collect 150 Prototype Implants in Mechagon, while in War Mode.
Text: Lookit here. I gotta keep my nose clean here in front of the prince.But I trust you know what's gotta be done outside of town, yeah?Outside of town... where all the tech is...Tech that Alliance grubs are tryin' to get their clumsy mitts on...which we could use for the Horde...to build big weapons...and scary robots...and other lucrative products...?I don't gotta spell this out for you, right?

Title: Coldtooth Supplies
Objective: Bring 10 Coldtooth Supplies to the Alliance Quartermaster in Dun Baldar.
Text: The Coldtooth mine is a storage depot for the Horde. I can't stomach the food they give their troops, and the state of their arms and armor is atrocious! But... in times like these when supplies are so important, we can use what they have. Enter the Coldtooth mine and bring me back their supplies. That will help keep the Alliance in fighting shape, and remove much needed equipment from the Horde's warriors. Good luck. The mine is to the distant south, deep in Horde territory.

Title: Irondeep Supplies
Objective: Bring 10 Irondeep Supplies to the Alliance Quartermaster in Dun Baldar.
Text: Before the fighting started, we stored supplies for Dun Baldar in the Irondeep mine. The troggs that surfaced there weren't much of a problem when we had spare troops to guard the mine, but now that we're fighting with the Horde we can't maintain control of Irondeep. We need the supplies in Irondeep. Enter the mine and bring me a load of them.

Title: The Graveyards of Alterac
Objective: Assault a graveyard, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in Frostwolf Village.
Text: The battle lines of Alterac Valley are ever shifting. Territories swing back and forth as we meet our opponents in deadly combat. And graveyards, are where battles rage most fierce. I want you to attack an Alliance held graveyard! Find a graveyard with an Alliance banner in its midst and pull it from the ground. Do that and your task for me will be complete, but... if you hold the graveyard for a few minutes, then it will be ours and troops will come and relieve you.

Title: Towers and Bunkers
Objective: Destroy the banner at an enemy tower or bunker, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Dun Baldar.
Text: Towers and bunkers are key defensive positions, and so we must hold as many as possible! I want you to attack a tower or a bunker in Alterac Valley. To do that, enter a tower with a Horde banner atop it. You will see another enemy banner inside. Pull out that banner, and a white Alliance banner will appear in its place. Well done! At that point your mission for me will be complete, but hold the area long enough, and if the Horde doesn't take it back, then it will be destroyed!

Title: Armor Scraps
Objective: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Murgot Deepforge in Dun Baldar.
Text: Battles rage constantly in Alterac Valley, and the supplies we get from Ironforge are not enough to outfit our experienced troops. If you find armor scraps from the battlefield, aid the war effort and bring those scraps to me!

Title: Coldtooth Supplies
Objective: Bring 10 Coldtooth Supplies to the Horde Quartermaster in Frostwolf Keep.
Text: The Coldtooth mine to the north was once an ideal place to store extra supplies, but now that the fighting with the Stormpikes grows fierce, we do not always have the spare warriors to station at the mine and protect it. And so, control of the mine often falls to the Alliance, or to underground denizens... But we still need our supplies! Go to the Coldtooth mine and bring me a load of them. And be wary of enemies as you go; the tides of battle shift quickly in that place...

Title: Capture a Mine
Objective: Capture a mine that the Stormpike does not control, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.
Text: The mines in Alterac Valley hold more than just minerals. Both the Frostwolf and Stormpike have cached excess supplies in the Irondeep and Coldtooth mines... that's not a bad idea, if we could only maintain control of them! Capture a mine, then return to me. To capture a mine, enter one that we do not control and kill its leader. When you do that, the mine will be ours, and we'll send troops to protect it!

Title: The Quartermaster
Objective: Speak with the Stormpike Quartermaster.
Text: , our quartermaster charged me to direct new recruits to him. He needs supplies from caches stored in the mines of Alterac, and he'll probably send you to get them. Follow the road. You'll find our quartermaster to the west.

Title: Alterac Valley Graveyards
Objective: Assault a graveyard, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in Dun Baldar.
Text: The graveyards in Alterac Valley are prized territories. Both the Horde and the Alliance fight savagely for these sacred grounds. Are you, ready to join that fight? I want you to assault an enemy graveyard. Find a graveyard with a Horde banner in its midst, and pull it from the ground! Do that, and your task will be complete.... But if you can also hold the graveyard for a few minutes, then our troops will soon come to relieve you.

Title: Maintaining Focus
Objective: Acquire 20 Shred of Insanity. These can be looted from bosses in Ny'alotha and World Bosses, obtained by winning Battlegrounds and Arenas, or from Honorable Kills.
Text: At present, the focus holds but a fraction of N'Zoth's true power. If we further empower it, we could craft even more effective weapons to wield against him.N'Zoth's influence is everywhere, and is most concentrated within powerful foes. Vanquish them and claim whatever vestiges of the Old God's power remain.

Title: Soldier of Time
Objective: Earn 500 honor in Korrak's Revenge.
Text: Once upon a time, the land of Alterac Valley was fought over by the Horde and the Alliance.Well, actually the battle is still ongoing, but let's take a look back to when the conflict was just beginning...

Title: Something in Your Mind
Objective: Bring the Void Focus to Wrathion in the Chamber of Heart.

Title: How Things "Really" Happened...
Objective: Embark from the Caverns of Time with Chromie to defeat villains of the past.
Text: You've come a long way over the years.From humble beginnings doing odd jobs to saving Azeroth's very existence, you've done so much to ensure the safety of our world.But why should we just stand around trying to remember things? Let's just go back in time and relive all of the exciting bits again!Don't worry, in all of the millions upon millions of timeways I'm sure I'll find one where you never die.

Title: Beginning the Descent
Objective: Retrieve the Corrupt Black Dragonscale from Blackwing Descent atop Blackrock Mountain in Burning Steppes.
Text: Protecting one's mind against the old gods requires an object of pure corruption. Unbeknownst to many, one such object exists--dormant beneath the molten pits of Blackwing Descent.Until recently, one of my agents stood watch over the area, keeping detailed records of suspicious activities. Unfortunately, this agent has gone silent. It is now clear we are not the only ones with this knowledge.If we are to find answers, there is one place to look.Our journey continues. Blackrock awaits.

Title: A Timely Invitation
Objective: Bring the Invitation from the Timewalkers to Chromie within the Caverns of Time.
Text: The time has arrived to remember the past and celebrate our adventures across Azeroth and Beyond.To commemorate the occasion the Bronze Dragonflight is throwing a celebration and you are invited!Come to the Caverns of Time and present this ticket to gain entry to the party!

Title: Re-Origination
Objective: Meet Magni Bronzebeard outside the Halls of Origination in Uldum.
Text: If the Ramkahen haven't reached out tae sound any alarms then the anomaly must be contained within the Halls of Origination.We best get back tae investigate.

Title: Power Protocol Initiation
Objective: Relay power from the Chamber of Heart, Engine of Nalak'sha and Forge of Origination auxiliary systems, then speak with MOTHER to power up the Forge of Origination.
Text: We've come a long way.Once the power from the auxiliary systems are brought online MOTHER will be able tae run diagnostics.All that's left is settin' the final pieces in place.

Title: Investigating the Halls
Objective: Investigate the anomaly in the Halls of Origination.
Text: Whatever's happenin' has tae be comin' from deep within the inner chamber. If we can get tae the forge maybe we'll find some answers.Best check yer gear 'fore headin' in. Who knows what's waitin' fer us in there.

Title: Sense of Obligation
Objective: Eavesdrop on Jaina Proudmoore's meeting.
Text: Derek is free. I have to atone for much with him.There is a rumor of a meeting with Jaina and her brother.Head to Seabreeze Village in Stormsong Valley. I hope there you will be able to find out... well, let's just say I am trying to keep the bigger picture in focus.If you find out anything of interest, I would be most appreciative.For now, let's keep this between the two of us.

Title: Blinding the Eye
Objective: Speak with Brother Pike to cleanse your "gift".
Text: Ah yes, just the  I wanted to see.I can still sense his touch lingering upon you. Our victory over the god of the deep will not be complete until we remove all traces of his infection.Through my research I have learned a less painful way of removing the infection.Speak with me, and let's put an end to this nightmare.

Title: Militia
Objective: Rally the citizens of Orgrimmar.
Text: The war has proven costly and our ranks have been steadily depleted. But the Horde is nothing if not strong. Each and every citizen of Orgrimmar is worth ten Alliance weaklings on the battlefield.Rally the citizens and form a militia! Remind them of their slain brothers and sisters!

Title: Assault: The Black Empire
Objective: Drive back the N'Zoth Assault in Uldum.
Text: It is just as the visions fortold. Dark forces have come to claim the Forge of Origination.They must be stopped, or all of Azeroth will meet its end!

Title: A Line in the Sand
Objective: Speak with Nathanos.
Text: Now that we have put our house in order, it is time to purge the filth before our gates.How thoughtful of those traitors to gather themselves in one place, so that we may slay them all in one fell swoop.Let us end this pitiful rebellion.

Title: Most Loyal
Objective: Speak with Sylvanas Windrunner.
Text: The Dark Lady anticipated this as a possible outcome. She has prepared a contingency plan to deal with it accordingly.You are to rendezvous with her in the Ghostlands. Take this hearthstone. It is good for one more use.She will meet you near Windrunner Spire.

Title: Not My Warchief
Objective: Escape with Eitrigg and meet up with Saurfang in Razor Hill.
Text: There is little time. Sylvanas likely knows of my intentions and sent you to deal with me accordingly. I doubt she will be pleased with your decision.We must make our way to the wyverns and take to the skies.

Title: Traitors In Our Midst
Objective: Deal with this traitor.
Text: There is a difference between loyalty and blind obedience. I am done following the Banshee's orders!

Title: Siegebreakers
Objective: Covertly place Suspicious Crates and slay guards.
Text: The fools who follow Saurfang have grown bold enough to launch a direct assault. We cannot allow these pests to swarm before our gates.Our operatives are collapsing the pass between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar as we speak. Saurfang's treasonous forces will be cut in half.Your task is to sneak into their ranks and sabotage their siege engines. Wear this disguise, but know that it will not hold up under close examination. Slay anyone who discovers you.

Title: Propaganda Takedown
Objective: Burn Dissident Propaganda in Orgrimmar.
Text: Recently, dissidents have been posting propaganda around the city and spreading all manner of lies.This is no time to entertain delusion. An army of traitors and sworn enemies assembles at our gates. These ingrates would see us become pin cushions for the Alliance's archers.Tear down the rubbish. It can only lead to panic in the streets.And should you encounter any... resistance... you are hereby authorized to respond with force.

Title: ...And Following Seas
Objective: Visit Derek Proudmoore and Calia Menethil.
Text: My brother Derek died in the Second War, only to be raised against his will by the Banshee Queen. If not for Baine Bloodhoof's courageous act of defiance, Derek would have been turned into a weapon against my family.He's lived in torment since his awakening. I feared he would be lost to us, but he has received help from an old friend of mine who has also been recently raised--Calia Menethil. She has guided him back from the brink of despair.I am on my way to pay them a visit. Care to join me?

Title: Test Shared Quest
Objective: None
Text: None

Title: Before the Gates of Orgrimmar
Objective: Begin the battle at the gates of Orgrimmar.
Text: It is time.We have done all that we can to prepare. All that remains is the battle itself.I am not one for speeches. So I will say only this.Lok-tar ogar. Victory. Or death.

Title: Saving the Siege
Objective: Remove 8 Suspicious Crates.
Text: The Banshee's spies were able to sneak past our guards in the chaos of the rockslides. They've been planting bombs on our siege weaponry.Get rid of those bombs.

Title: Already Among Us
Objective: Slay 10 Suspicious Technicians or Loyalist Assassins.
Text: Sylvanas still commands the loyalty of many within the Horde. The war she started has blinded them with rage and hatred. She exploits that to maintain her support.They do not yet see she will lead us to ruin, that her so-called victories are all hollow.Some of her agents have been spotted lurking within our ranks. Kill them. They will show us no mercy, and will have none in return.

Title: The Price of Victory
Objective: Inform Baine Bloodhoof of what has transpired.
Text: Saurfang... I......Thrall will wish to honor Saurfang's sacrifice. And so shall the rest of us.Recall our forces. Let them know what has transpired. Tell them that the great warrior Varok Saurfang is dead and that the warchief has abandoned us.Speak to Baine when you arrive in Thunder Bluff. You will find him on the Elder Rise. I am certain he will want to pay his respects to Saurfang as well.Let us stand as a united Horde once more.

Title: Old Soldier
Objective: Honor High Overlord Saurfang.
Text: No matter what anyone says, he was an honorable orc. A legend in his own right, the ideal to which all warriors of the Horde aspired.He gave his life to heal the rift in the Horde and give us the chance to forge a new path forward. His was more than a death befitting a warrior. It was the death of a hero.We shall honor his sacrifice.

Title: Strategic Deployment
Objective: Deliver Saurfang's deployment orders.
Text: For years, I guarded the gates of Orgrimmar. The city's greatest weakness has always been its multiple entrances. We should strike at all of them to seize victory.Wrynn and I have drawn up orders for deployment. The mages will cover our flank. Greymane will close in from the west, and the elves will take the north. We will send Mayla to reinforce Thunder Bluff's defenses in case Sylvanas launches a counterattack.Bring the orders to our commanders.

Title: Beat The Crapopolis Outta Him!
Objective: Complete the Crapopolis scenario.
Text: Boy am I glad to see you! We've got a bad situation on our hands...While you were away delivering the invitations, Gallywix and his goons took over Crapopolis! They're holding Hobart Grapplehammer hostage until he hands over the X-52 Personnel Armor!You have to stop Gallywix before it's too late!

Title: Legacy of the Mad Mage
Objective: Investigate Mardivas's Laboratory.

Title: This Ain't Mine
Objective: Clear the pass of boulders, mines, and other obstructions between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar.
Text: Sylvanas's loyalists have collapsed part of the canyon path to Orgrimmar. Our forces are now cut off from each other.We need to reinforce our front line or the Banshee will pick us off at her leisure. We have come too far to be slain by a thousand cuts.Gazlowe and one of the Alliance's gnomes believe they have an answer. You'd best ensure that their plan does not backfire.

Title: The VIP List
Objective: Deliver the invitations to Grapplehammer's private auction.
Text: While you've been assisting Grapplehammer with his newest invention, I've been hard at work finding potential buyers!This is going to be a private auction, so we're only inviting the best and the brightest, the cream of the crop, the creme de la creme... got it?I've narrowed the potential buyers down to an 'A' list of only the wealthiest, classiest, most connected goblins around... minus Gallywix, of course!Head out and deliver these invitations while I finish up preparations for the auction!

Title: Buyers Wanted!
Objective: Speak with Sassy Hardwrench in Stranglethorn Vale.
Text: The X-52 Personnel Armor is finally complete and Gallywix has been sent packing with his tail between his legs!I've got you to thank for this!But we're still not done... the best part is yet to come. We're going to hold an auction and sell the X-52 Personnel Armor to the highest bidder!Sassy Hardwrench should have a list of interested buyers ready to go. Head over to Hardwrench Hideaway and let her know we're ready for the auction!

Title: Our Backs to the Gate
Objective: Ride Mobi with Chen and Li Li to the Gate of August Celestials.
Text: It is most fortuitous that you found this brew, and a yak to carry it on!But we cannot remain here. Li Li has healed me up enough to travel. We can ride the yak back to the gate and hope that the mogu do not notice our passing.Let me know when you are ready to leave.

Title: Liquid Courage
Objective: Mount Mobi and defeat the mogu armies with the power of brew.
Text: We have to do something about all these mogu. At least to thin their ranks before they invade the Vale!As much as Uncle Chen loves his brew, I think we can put it to better use. Let's hop onto that yak and give the mogu something to fear!

Title: Yak of All Trades
Objective: Find something to help you carry the brew back to Chen in Mogujia.

Title: Return to Mistfall
Objective: Return to Stormspeaker Qian in the Silent Sanctuary in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: We have done all we can here. We know how much the mogu are a clear threat.The forge is in great danger of falling into their hands if we lose our hold on the Vale.Let us return to Mistfall and report to the Rajani. They will want to know what we are up against.

Title: No Brew Left Behind
Objective: Locate the abandoned brew barrels in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: My head is... hurting. There can be only one solution.We flew over an abandoned brew caravan. You must go find it, and save that brew! That should help bring me back to full strength.Plus, it would do wonders for the morale of those fighting in the Vale, if we can recover it.

Title: Kite Surveillance
Objective: Ride Chen's Kite to scout the Mogu armies.
Text: We heard for ourselves that there were mogu attacking, but I had no idea it would be this many!There must be a way to stop them before they completely overrun the Vale. Quickly, let us fly over and scout out their numbers.We just so happen to have a kite that can carry three people. Usually it's more, but I had a big lunch.

Title: Cut Off the Heads
Objective: Slay mogu commanders.
Text: Okay. We're stuck in the middle of three mogu armies, and Uncle Chen is too hurt to move yet.It's not hopeless though. We have the chance to take out the leaders of these armies. Maybe that will slow them down or distract them long enough for us to get back to the gate!See if you can get out there and take down the biggest, baddest mogu you can find. Those will be the commanders.

Title: I've Got What You Need
Objective: Deliver the package to Hobart Grapplehammer.
Text: A deal's a deal. Here's the thermoplugs you ordered!Be sure to let that ol' grouch Grapplehammer know that I won't be giving out anymore handouts. If he needs more thermoplugs he'd better be ready to pay up.Anyway, it was a pleasure doing business with you...Now get lost!

Title: Let's Rumble!
Objective: Defeat 8 Hired Scoundrels.
Text: This is bad! Real bad!Gallywix and his goons are destroying my workshop, but he's got another thing coming if he thinks I'm gonna hand over the X-52 Personnel Armor!You've gotta get down there and clear out his goon squad before this place--AND ALL MY INVENTIONS--go up in flames!

Title: Fun With Landmines
Objective: Retrieve the refreshing coconut beverage from the minefield.
Text: The prototype X-52 Personnel Armor is ready for the final test!How are you with loud noises and sudden bursts of concussive energy?For the final test, we're going to strap you into the X-52 Personnel Armor and have you traverse a minefield!I have placed a refreshing coconut beverage in the center of the minefield. Consider the drink a fitting reward for reaching the oasis and surviving the inevitable explosions in the process!

Title: Mogu Massacre
Objective: Slay mogu in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: I think this is what my friends would call a "target rich environment." As a nicer way of saying "we're surrounded and probably doomed."You know what this means. We have to kill as many of these mogu as possible! It doesn't matter how you do it, just take them out!

Title: Mogu at the Gates
Objective: Meet Chen and Li Li Stormstout at the Gate of the August Celestials.
Text: The time has come. The other mogu clans have set their sights on the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.They will not conquer it.Some of your kind have already gone to the gate to scout out the size of their force. If you think yourself worthy for such a mission, meet them there.

Title: Blunt Force Testing
Objective: Complete Hobart Grapplehammer's experiment.
Text: Now that we have the thermoplugs we're ready for our next test of the prototype X-52 Personnel Armor!Unfortunately, my lab assistants have either quit or expired. What a pity! But their loss is your gain... now YOU get to wear the X-52 Personnel Armor!How exciting!The next test will be conducted by my new mechanized lab assistant. Head over to the main workshop and press the big red button to begin.Don't worry, I'll be giving you directions over the X-52's built in intercom!

Title: Debt Collection!
Objective: Collect 8 Unpaid Debts.
Text: You need thermoplugs? Well, you came to the right place, kid.But I ain't giving 'em to you on credit. There's way too many shlubs who haven't paid me back the money they owe. I'm in over my head here, if I don't get paid fast, I'll be out of business in no time.Look, I tell you what... If you can muscle those no-good goons into paying me my money, I'll give you the thermoplugs as payment.You won't find a better deal than that!

Title: Shopping For Parts
Objective: Speak with Crank Greasefuse.
Text: I'm going to need some additional components in order to complete the next phase of testing.Right now, what we need most are thermoplugs and thermoplug adaptors! I'll explain what they're for later...Crank Greasefuse runs a shop near the entrance of the town. Go speak with Crank and get him to fork over the necessary parts.I don't care what they cost, just tell him to bill me later! I can't be bothered to negotiate right now. I need to prepare the modifications to the X-52 Personnel Armor!

Title: A Special Delivery
Objective: Deliver the package to Hobart Grapplehammer.
Text: I'm glad you're finally here. I've got an important delivery to make and you're the goblin I trust most.Yeah, yeah. I know that's not sayin' much, but it's hard to find good help these days!This package is for Hobart Grapplehammer. He's got a workshop in Crapopolis and I need you to deliver it to him. He's been working on somethin' big lately!Deliver the package and for the love of money... DON'T DROP IT!You have no idea how long it took me to locate this thing!

Title: A Simple Experiment
Objective: Assist Hobart Grapplehammer.
Text: Now that you've delivered the necessary parts, I can begin testing my latest prototype!I call it the X-52 Personnel Armor! It will be nearly indestructible!Gallywix has always coveted my inventions and now that he knows about the X-52 I'm sure he'll be up to no good. I've gotta complete the prototype before Gallywix comes up with a way to steal it out from under me!I could really use an extra set of hands with the experiments.Can I count on you?

Title: Rumors of Mechagon
Objective: Meet Gazlowe outside the Great Seal in Dazar'alor.
Text: I knew I should've taken that gig with the Greasemonkeys...Gazlowe's crew always get paid, and no dumb risks. I heard they got somethin' big comin' up too...

Title: Fame Waits for Gnome One
Objective: Meet with Tinkmaster Overspark in Boralus.
Text: Tinkmaster Overspark requests your assistance on an important research expedition.Working with the esteemed Tinkmaster will certainly be of benefit to your career. It's done wonders for mine!

Title: Harnessing the Power
Objective: Use the Petrified Ebony Scale atop the Heart Forge to infuse its power into the Heart of Azeroth.
Text: Heart Forge online.Initiate final attunement sequence.Awaiting input from champion unit .

Title: Old Friends, New Opportunities
Objective: Speak with Sassy Hardwrench in Stranglethorn Vale.
Text: Well if it isn't ! You're just the goblin we've been lookin' for!It's been a long time since Kezan, hasn't it? We had some good times cruising around together back in the day!Now, I don't want to get all sentimental on you but Sassy Hardwrench sent me to find you! She's putting the gang back together for a big job! BIG!Look, I wish I had more time to catch up but we've gotta split. Time is money, you know?If you want in on the job, find Sassy. She'll fill you in on the details!

Title: A Worthy Ally
Objective: Use the Deepflame Campfire, choose an ally, and complete 3 ally quests.
Text: Some of our bravest ankoan have volunteered to join you on your expedition.You will find each have their own special interests and they will mark your map with different opportunities every day.Use the Deepflame Campfire when you are ready. Choose a noble ally to join you, and explore what remains of Nazjatar.Choose wisely! You may only select one friend per day.

Title: Becoming a Friend
Objective: Use the Calling Conch, choose an ally, and complete 3 ally quests.
Text: Some of our bravest kelfin have volunteered to join you on your adventures, should you ever need a friend.You will find they each have their own special interests and they will mark your map with different opportunities every day.Use the conch when you're ready, choose who you would like to join you, and explore Nazjatar!Choose wisely! You may only select one friend per day.

Title: Create Your Own Strength
Objective: Upgrade a piece of Benthic armor through Voidbinder Zorlan.
Text: For something that has been sitting on the ocean floor, there is still power to be found in this item.Take your piece of Benthic armor to Voidbinder Zorlan. He has been eyeing it with great curiosity.Go ahead and humor the ethereal and let him have a look.Maybe he has something to offer.

Title: Create Your Own Strength
Objective: Upgrade a piece of Benthic armor through Voidbinder Sturzah.
Text: That Benthic armor you carry has been lost beneath the tides for too long.There is still power within it.Voidbinder Sturzah may be able to provide insight.Take your find to our intrepid ethereal friend, and see what he can do with it.

Title: Assault: The Warring Clans
Objective: Drive back the Mogu Assault in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: The opportunistic mogu clans seek to take the Vale while its defenders are recovering from N'Zoth's attack.They are both cowardly and foolish.Show them the error of their ways.

Title: Old Soldier
Objective: Speak with Jaina in front of the gates of Orgrimmar.
Text: No matter what doubts he harbored, Saurfang was an honorable soldier.He prevented both a civil war within the Horde and the potential destruction of the Alliance. He brought an end to Sylvanas's reign and saved many lives at the cost of his own.We shall honor his sacrifice.

Title: The Price of Victory
Objective: Recall the Alliance forces and inform them of what has transpired.
Text: Saurfang... how could this have happened....The Alliance has known High Overlord Saurfang as both a sworn enemy and an invaluable ally.Anduin will want to honor his memory. Recall our forces and inform them of what has happened. Genn's soldiers were dispatched to the western gate. You should be able to find him there.

Title: Strategic Deployment
Objective: Deliver Anduin's deployment orders.
Text: Saurfang maintains that the key to taking Orgrimmar is to exploit its multiple points of entry. He led the city's defenses for years, and knows its vulnerabilities better than anyone. We are spread thin as it is, but I trust his judgment in this matter.We must also fortify Thunder Bluff in case Sylvanas plans to assault it while our forces are committed here.Deliver these deployment orders to our officers. We will assail all of Orgrimmar's gates at once while also defending Thunder Bluff.

Title: Already Among Us
Objective: Slay 10 Suspicious Technicians or Loyalist Assassins.
Text: While some of the Horde have joined forces with us, many within Orgrimmar remain loyal to Sylvanas. Her saboteurs have infiltrated our ranks and are posing as our technicians. Her assassins are lurking in the shadows.Stop any loyalists you encounter, before they can cause any harm.

Title: Before the Gates of Orgrimmar
Objective: Begin the battle at the gates of Orgrimmar.
Text: We have prepared for this battle as best we can.I pray that we all survive what is to come.

Title: Saving the Siege
Objective: Remove 8 Suspicious Crates.
Text: In the chaos of the rockslides, Sylvanas dispatched her saboteurs to sneak past our sentries and plant bombs on our siege weaponry.Several of them have already been lost. We cannot afford to lose more.

Title: Paint Bottle: Goblin Green
Objective: Deliver the item to Kram Kelada.

Title: Crown of Dark Blossoms
Objective: Gather blooms from Duskwood, Silverpine Forest, and Desolace.
Text: Such somber flowers... but they hold a beauty of their own, don't you think?
