If only they could last.Allow me to lend my aid.Every Lunar Festival, similar flowers to yours bloom around the world. They hold a special connection to Elune... one that I can empower. If you bring them to me, I can preserve them so you may enjoy them long after an ordinary flower would die.

Title: Paint Bottle: Nukular Red
Objective: Deliver the item to Kram Kelada.

Title: Paint Bottle: Electric Blue
Objective: Deliver the item to Kram Kelada.

Title: Crown of Good Fortune
Objective: Gather blooms from Winterspring, Dun Morogh, and Hillsbrad Foothills.
Text: Those flowers remind me of Elune herself! I wear similar ones year round, to remind me of her watchful grace.Perhaps you would like to as well?Your crown is made of ordinary blossoms that will one day wilt and die. It is an unfortunate fate for such delicate beauties, but my crown is made of similar flowers that I made to last year round! If you bring me specific flowers that bloom only during Lunar Festival, I can bless them so that you too can enjoy your crown all year long.

Title: Crown of Prosperity
Objective: Gather blooms from Un'goro Crater, Stranglethorn Vale, and Northern Barrens.
Text: Your crown is so colorful! Such beautiful pinks and yellows and blues... if only it could last.Although those particular flowers cannot, I know some that can!Similar flowers to those bloom every Lunar Festival. They hold a special connection to Elune that I can empower, thanks to you. Retrieve them for me, and we can fashion a crown that you can enjoy year round!

Title: Wounded Wastewanderers
Objective: Heal 6 Wastewander Laborers.
Text: Ahh, my friend, have you returned to render additional aid?As you can see, we are still locked in battle with these creatures, with no end to their numbers in sight.This is a war of attrition and we find ourselves at a clear disadvantage as injuries continue to mount.Please, assist any of our wounded that you find within the ruins.

Title: Crown of Courage
Objective: Gather blooms from Eversong Woods, the Hinterlands, and Mulgore.
Text: I see you are a fan of pink flowers. It is a shame those that make up your crown will one day come to perish.Perhaps I can help with that.Though those are ordinary blossoms, I know similar flowers that bloom only during Lunar Festival. If you retrieve them for me, I can imbue them with Elune's power so that you may enjoy them throughout the year.

Title: Leaders of the Horde
Objective: Order the Horde leaders in Orgrimmar to prepare for battle.
Text: Saurfang has shown his true colors and now enlists the aid of the Alliance.Meet with those who have remained loyal to the Horde. They are to ready themselves for the battle against our enemies.And as for Eitrigg... bring him to Nathanos. A quick death is too lenient a punishment for his treachery.Go. Let us end this.

Title: A Kelfin's Best Friend
Objective: Examine Neri's Find.
Text: There is no better weapon in our fight than knowledge.Knowing you is proof of that!I found this thing, it lets me see better than my eyes could ever do before.With the water gone, I can see far, too! I have been using it sometimes to see what is happening in Nazjatar.Let me show you!

Title: Thank You For Being A Friend
Objective: Enjoy Neri's Spot.
Text: Since the waterwall appeared, so much has changed here.There is a little spot I found, where you can feel the sea spray on your face.Sometimes I just ride over there and relax.I will show it to you, if you'd like.

Title: With A Little Help From My Friends
Objective: Visit Atolia Seapearl, in Newhome, for your gift.
Text: It has been so long since we have been able to trust anyone not in our little pack of survivors.I forgot how good it feels.Thank you for reminding me.Atolia should have the rest of your gift together by now. We should go check in with her!

Title: An Unexpected Friend
Objective: Visit Atolia Seapearl, in Newhome, for your gift.
Text: Oh, I nearly forgot!To help you with your mission here in Nazjatar, Atolia and I put together some items you may need.We should swing by and grab them when we have the time!

Title: Friendship Is Magic
Objective: Seek out Poen's Wonder.
Text: Every day with you, I feel like I am a better kelfin than I was the day before.You have no idea how much that means to me.I felt like I wanted to do more, be more... help more.Now, I'm starting to be a real contributing member of the Unshackled.It's all thanks to you.

Title: You've Got A Friend In Me
Objective: Examine Poen's Hidey Hole.
Text: There are a few spots I enjoy checking out with my friends.I actually found this amazing... well, I don't know what it is.Think you could check it out with me?

Title: Super Friends
Objective: See what's in Poen's Bag.
Text: You are a super trooper duper friend!There is a place I go to visit some of my smaller buddies. I keep some neat things I find in a bag there.Would you like to see it?What am I asking? Of course you would, let's go!

Title: Anytime You Need A Friend
Objective: Find Neri's Ruse.
Text: You're not that bad for a... what was it? ?I like when I am reminded to look past appearances. Ha!But, really, speaking of hiding things in plain sight, I put some things in a naga crate. It is close to one of their camps in the Spears of Azshara, so they will never suspect it belongs to me!Let's go see if it is still there.

Title: Real Friends Help Hide Bodies
Objective: Find Gorm's Lantern.
Text: Bodies... treasures...I've seen it all, but it was a long time before I found someone worth calling friend.I am glad I added you to that list.So, back to those friends... I have one more place I would like you to see.

Title: With Friends Like You, Who Needs Anemones?
Objective: See what is in Vim's Cache.
Text: I sometimes amuse myself with excursions into Zanj'ir Terrace, where the naga tough guys hang out.I grab things that could be useful and stash them somewhere I can pick them up later.I haven't been down there in a while.I could have something in there you may find useful.

Title: Friends Through Eternity
Objective: Visit Vim's Round.
Text: You may have noticed by now that me and the sea giants get along great.They mostly just want to be left alone. They want to laugh, and they want to tell you stories that make no sense.A simple life.We do share one interest, aside from killing naga, that is sampling interesting brews.Maedin recently brought in a lovely new keg, I hid it away. When it is ready to be opened, that round will be on me!Come, take a look!

Title: A Friend Indeed
Objective: Visit Atolia Seapearl, in Newhome, for your gift.
Text: My friend, every day with you is a new adventure.I am sorry your ships crashed, but I am so happy we met!I heard a rumor, that Atolia found some more goods!We should swing by and see what she has this time!

Title: That's What Friends Are For
Objective: Visit Atolia Seapearl in Newhome.
Text: Hmm. I am not admitting to anything, but there is a very small chance that I could have possibly, but not definitely, been mistaken about your whole... thing.On the off chance we were still tolerating each other, Atolia mentioned she had another delivery for you.We should swing through Newhome.

Title: Just A Friend
Objective: Visit Atolia Seapearl in Newhome.
Text: Look, mudfoot, I need to make sure a slight current isn't going to knock you over.I asked Atolia to see if she could pull together some things to make you a little less useless here.After what I saw in that last fight, we should probably head back sooner rather than later.

Title: We're Going To Be Friends
Objective: Visit Atolia Seapearl, in Newhome, for your gift.
Text: It is going to be fun getting to know you. You're not half bad!We kinda got a little gift for you, to welcome you to the neighborhood.I hope Atolia was able to put together something neat, she didn't have much time.

Title: Mysterious Treasure
Objective: Loot the Mysterious Cache.
Text: We have located many treasure hoards while exploring Nazjatar. I believe that I have found yet another cache for us to liberate.Some time ago, I noticed a mysterious looking chest. It is held in an extremely dangerous area, so whatever it contains must be valuable.We should embark on a mission to liberate the contents of the cache. Whatever is inside is better used in our hands than the hands of the enemy.

Title: Reclaimed Treasure
Objective: Loot the Lambent Lockbox.
Text: The naga have filled Nazjatar with the ill-gotten spoils of war. We should reclaim whatever we come across in our effort to put an end to their tyranny once and for all.I noticed a strange looking chest in a cave nearby. It appeared to be of naga make.We should claim the contents of the cache. There may be valuable items inside that will help us in our battle against the naga.

Title: Treasure To Find
Objective: Loot the Mystic Chest.
Text: The naga have stashed away treasures all over Nazjatar.Not long ago, I noticed an ornately crafted treasure chest hidden in plain view. The area is heavily fortified, but such minor inconveniences have not stopped us yet.We should head back there and liberate the contents of the cache.

Title: A Gift of Supplies
Objective: Meet with Speaker Utia.
Text: Speaker Utia has asked that I send you back to Mezzamere at your soonest convenience.The Speaker has gathered together a gift of supplies to further aid you in your fight against the naga.You should return to Mezzamere at your soonest convenience. Please accept this gift with the thanks of our clan.

Title: Helpful Provisions
Objective: Meet with Speaker Utia.
Text: Speaker Utia is awaiting your return to Mezzamere.The Speaker has bundled together some helpful provisions to aid you in your journey.Please accept this gift with the thanks of our clan.

Title: Additional Supplies
Objective: Meet with Speaker Utia.
Text: Speaker Utia has asked me to send you back to Mezzamere when you have a moment.The Speaker has some additional supplies that might aid you in your fight against the naga.Please return to Mezzamere at your soonest convenience and accept the Speaker's gift with the thanks of our entire clan.

Title: Hidden, But Dangerous
Objective: Loot the Mystic Chest.
Text: The naga have hidden many useful treasures throughout Nazjatar.I have heard tell that there is a treasure hoard not far from here. It will be dangerous, but it may be worth investigating.There may be untold valuables inside the cache that could aid us in our fight against the naga.

Title: Naga Treasure
Objective: Loot the Mysterious Cache.
Text: The naga have stashed away the spoils of their wars throughout Nazjatar.Earlier while we were adventuring, I noticed a mysterious looking cache. The chest is located deep within naga territory, so I imagine that whatever is inside is most likely extremely valuable.We should retrieve the contents of the cache. Whatever is inside is better used in our hands than the hands of the enemy.

Title: The Mystic Chest
Objective: Loot the Mystic Chest.
Text: We have uncovered many rare treasures while exploring Nazjatar. I believe that I have found yet another cache of valuable artifacts to retrieve.Some time ago, I noticed a strangely glowing object in the distance. I believe that it may have been a treasure chest.We should go and investigate the object. If it is a treasure chest, its contents may prove valuable in our quest to defeat the naga!

Title: The Speaker's Gift
Objective: Meet with Speaker Utia.
Text: Speaker Utia has requested your presence in Mezzamere.I believe that the Speaker has prepared a collection of items to aid you in your journey.You should return to Mezzamere at your soonest convenience and accept the Speaker's gift.

Title: The Lambent Lockbox
Objective: Loot the Lambent Lockbox.
Text: There are many treasures to find throughout these ancient ruins.Sometime ago, I noticed a strange looking chest in a cave not far from here.There may be valuable items inside that can help us in our fight against Queen Azshara.We should go back and investigate the chest.

Title: A Glint in the Darkness
Objective: Loot the Lambent Lockbox.
Text: There are many treasures hidden throughout Nazjatar.Recently, I spotted an object glinting from within a cave not far from here. It appeared to be some sort of lockbox.I suggest we head back and investigate. There may be valuable items inside that will help us in our battle against the naga.

Title: Treasure In The Deep
Objective: Loot the Mysterious Cache.
Text: There are many treasures to be found throughout the naga stronghold of Nazjatar.Some time ago, I noticed a mysterious looking chest. The area was heavily fortified with naga troops, so whatever it contains must be valuable.We should go back and investigate the chest. Whatever is inside is better used in our hands than the hands of the enemy.

Title: A Valorous Reward
Objective: Meet with Speaker Utia.
Text: Your deeds on the battlefield have brought honor upon your Alliance.Speaker Utia has requested your presence in Mezzamere to accept a reward on behalf of our clan.You should return to Mezzamere at your soonest convenience.It is an honor to fight at your side.

Title: A Gift From The Clan
Objective: Meet with Speaker Utia.
Text: Speaker Utia has requested that I direct you back to Mezzamere when you have a chance.Our clan has prepared a gift for you to show our appreciation for the courage and valor you have shown in battle against the naga.I am sure that you will find the gift of supplies to be a valuable addition to your arsenal as you continue your campaign against Azshara.

Title: Time-Lost Warriors
Objective: Meet with the Rajani at the Silent Sanctuary.
Text: According to the scouting report ye found, the Rajani are holed up in the Silent Sanctuary, overlooking Mistfall Village.They are described in the report as seclusive and dangerous, so we'd had best take caution when approaching them.I'll meet ye there.

Title: Brewfest Chowdown
Objective: Participate in the Brewfest Chowdown.
Text: Welcome! I hope you came with an empty stomach!What's better, or more Brewfest, than sausage and brew? The Brewfest Chowdown is our new celebration of the things that make this festival great.Take a seat and show us what you can eat. If you want more details before jumping in, just ask!

Title: My Punkin, the Action Figure
Objective: Craft the Sapphronetta Flivvers Action Figure at Pascal-K1N6.
Text: Heya.I'm workin' on a surprise for Saffy. Hopin' you can help me out.I overheard her beggin' Jepetto Joybuzz to make her into one of his fancy new action figures.That ol' jerk told her no. Can you believe it? My Punkin!Well, we don't need him. I reverse engineered a few of his toys and found out what makes them tick.I got a blueprint ready to go. We can make Saffy's action figure ourselves and surprise her with it!

Title: The Spear of Destiny
Objective: Return to Jaina Proudmoore in Mezzamere.
Text: The Javelins are some of the most powerful magical creations of Suramar, before the Sundering. This is just what we need to bring down the wards on the protector and the Tidestone.We must hurry back to Mezzamere, Lady Proudmoore needs to know of our success.This will change the entire course of our campaign here in Nazjatar.

Title: S.P.A.R.E. Crates
Objective: Craft $1oa Junkyard Tinkering items with Pascal-K1N6.
Text: I'm sure you agree that Pascal-K1N6 is the greatest invention you've ever seen!If you're not convinced yet, try to push him to his limits. I don't mind!Bring him more resources and blueprints -- he'll craft anything you need!

Title: Brewfest Chowdown
Objective: Participate in the Brewfest Chowdown.
Text: Mok-rah! I hope you came with an empty stomach!Back on Draenor, we often held eating contests at our festivals as a form of celebration. When we were put in charge of Brewfest, we could think of nothing better to add to the event!Take a seat and show us what you can eat. If you want more details before jumping in, just ask!

Title: The Power of Worship
Objective: Destroy 3 Arcane Energy Transmuters.
Text: I was once like them, stuck in a loop and waiting for Azshara to come and save me. Our spirits are locked to this place.There are naga in the other parts of these ruins. They have these magical orbs... I think they are using us to fuel their arcane experiments. They draw power from our spirits and our worship of Azshara. This keeps us weakened and unable to break free.Destroy the orbs. Breaking the connection will allow us to gain strength and move on.

Title: Our Direct Line
Objective: Craft $1oa Junkyard Tinkering items with Pascal-K1N6.
Text: I'm sure you agree that Pascal-K1N6 is the greatest invention you've ever seen!If you're not convinced yet, try to push him to his limits. I don't mind!Bring him more resources and blueprints -- he'll craft anything you need!

Title: This Ain't Mine
Objective: Clear the pass of boulders, mines, and other obstructions between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar.
Text: Your arrival is timely. Sylvanas's loyalists have collapsed part of the canyon path to Orgrimmar.We are cut off from our vanguard and I fear that they will be destroyed if we cannot reinforce them quickly. Our forces are few in number. We cannot afford to leave them stranded for long.Tinkmaster Overspark and Gazlowe believe they have a solution. Hurry and aid them however you can.

Title: Direbrew Cog
Objective: Talk to Blix Fixwidget in the Brewfest grounds.

Title: Hozen Totem
Objective: Talk to Zenda in the Brewfest grounds.

Title: Call to Arms: Nazjatar
Objective: Slay Horde within Nazjatar.
Text: Our mission in Nazjatar is being compromised by the Horde incursion.Get into Nazjatar and take out as many as you can.

Title: Call to Arms: Mechagon
Objective: Slay Alliance within Mechagon.
Text: Our objectives in Mechagon are being interrupted by the influx of Alliance scum.Clear as many of them out of the area that you find, then report back.

Title: Contained Alemental
Objective: Talk to Brewmaster Tao in the Brewfest grounds.

Title: Call to Arms: Mechagon
Objective: Slay Horde within Mechagon.
Text: Our mission in Mechagon is being compromised by the Horde incursion.Get into Mechagon and take out as many as you can.

Title: Up Against It
Objective: Move deeper into Nazjatar with Jaina and Genn.
Text: We must move quickly if we are to find safety for our people.This cave is barely defensible, and much of our army is in an even more precarious position.Let's search deeper.

Title: The Mantid Threat
Objective: Return to Stormspeaker Qian at the Silent Sanctuary.
Text: The mantid have been corrupting their kypari trees to imbue their amber with power from N'Zoth. The swarm is enough of a menace on its own. N'Zoth could transform them into something even more dire.The Shado-Pan need to hear about this. I suggest you bring this information to your other allies as well.

Title: In Deep
Objective: Meet Jaina and Genn in the cave within Spears of Azshara.
Text: By now, King Greymane and Lady Proudmoore should be in the cave at which we are to meet.Let's not keep them waiting.

Title: Heart of the Swarm
Objective: Fly with Taoshi on the Shado-Pan Kite.
Text: We need to know what we're up against. Before we return to the Serpent's Spine, we should take the opportunity to scout the swarm.I will fly us over the Heart of Fear. We should be able to survey Empress Shek'zara's forces from above. Then we can determine the extent to which N'Zoth has bolstered their ranks with his own.

Title: Fortunate Souls
Objective: Rescue 7 captive soldiers in Spears of Azshara.
Text: You and I survived the attack and have thus far evaded capture by the enemy.Not all were as fortunate.There are many of our allies now under the control of the naga. We must free them before they are killed or suffer an even worse fate.

Title: Dark Tides
Objective: Slay Tidemistress Ethendriss.
Text: A tidemistress leads some nefarious ritual above a pool.Do not look in the pool when we approach it, or you will be rewarded with a view of our drowned allies.We must put a stop to this ritual. The tidemistress is key.

Title: Disruption of Power
Objective: Destroy 5 Ley Line Accumulators in Spears of Azshara.
Text: The naga are tapping into some latent power, infusing the energy into some manner of device.I do not know what purpose they have for this power, but it is surely in our interest to destroy the objects before they can be used against us.

Title: Ashran Dominance
Objective: Defeat the Horde at all event locations in Ashran and kill High Warlord Volrath.
Text: As we feared the Horde are trying to consolidate their position here on the island by looting it, just like we feared. Get out there and show them the Alliance won't put up with their aggression.

Title: Amber Secrets
Objective: Collect 8 pieces of Corrupted Amber.
Text: The Morrowchamber houses a small section of the Zara'thik, mantid under immediate directive of the new empress. Some of them may have been given pieces of amber like the one you found.The Shado-Pan would be interested in any extra pieces we can acquire.

Title: Ashran Dominance
Objective: Defeat the Alliance at all event locations in Ashran and kill Grand Marshal Tremblade.
Text: The Alliance refuse to back down in Ashran. Teach them that the Horde will not stand aside while they plunder the power of the ancient ogre empire to use for their own schemes.

Title: Rotten at the Roots
Objective: Stop the source of the corruption within the Morrowchamber.
Text: Underneath Kypari Kor is a large chamber where the mantid tend to the tree. That must be where the source of the corruption lies.We need to get into that chamber and stop them. N'Zoth must not be allowed to empower the swarm.

Title: Old Faces, New Problems
Objective: Kill Watcher Vl'thax.
Text: One of N'Zoth's minions appears to have taken note of our presence.Shall we pay them a visit?

Title: Real Ultimate Power
Objective: Collect 15 discarded technologies from techno-animated sludge.
Text: When I say that power is life, I'm not speaking figuratively, my dear test subject.Properly harnessed, power can create life itself--or at least a close enough facsimile for our purposes.There is a massive reserve of discarded technology lurking deep in the mucky depths of the Outflow. As usual, Mechagon's trash is our treasure.I've finally perfected my device that will animate the sludge to bring that technology up to the surface for you.All you have to do is pop 'em and grab the tech!

Title: A Unified Swarm
Objective: Infiltrate Klaxxi'vess.
Text: It seemed as though the mantid had been producing the corrupted amber for some time before our... intervention. It stands to reason that they are keeping a stockpile of it somewhere.The Shado-Pan's scouts have been reporting an increased presence of the swarm's warriors in Klaxxi'vess. I would wager that they are guarding the corrupted amber.Meet me there. If we have a chance to destroy that amber, then we need to take it.

Title: Aqir Extermination
Objective: Kill 10 Aqir Impalers.
Text: There are too many of these things flyin' around for us to make a clean getaway.We're liable to get swarmed the second we start up them plane engines!These bugs are going straight back into the ground... one way or another. May as well expedite the process, know what I mean?

Title: Once More Into Kor'vess
Objective: Investigate Kor'vess.
Text: You found this on a member of the swarm? It seeps with corruption... and with power. We could be faced with a serious threat if the rest of the mantid's amber is similarly corrupted.Far to the west in the Dread Wastes lies Kor'vess, a large kypari tree that provides the swarm with most of its amber. From there, we can determine just how much of their stores have been infused with the energy of the Old Gods.I will meet you closer to the tree.

Title: Crippling the Hive
Objective: Kill 12 Kor'thik mantid in Kor'vess.
Text: The mantid here are working feverishly to harvest amber from the tree.Perhaps killing a pawful of them will slow their efforts.

Title: Hanging by a Thread
Objective: Ask Rolm about the deteriorating cragscales.

Title: Certified Pre-Owned
Objective: Collect 15 Salvaged Mechagnome Appendages.
Text: First, let me say that you will ALWAYS be our favorite test subject.But our experiments require far more sacrifice than a single test subject can offer. And, from time to time, some of those test subjects require new limbs.My dear brother and I have a nascent concept for expanding the average lifespan of mechanical appendages. But we've run out of components to experiment on.Salvage some appendages from the heap outside town so we can continue our experiments.

Title: Reflections in Amber
Objective: Bring the Ooze-Covered Amber to the Shado-Pan at the Serpent's Spine.

Title: Hanging by a Thread
Objective: Ask Instructor Ulooaka about the deteriorating cragscales.

Title: Toys Like Us
Objective: Quasi-Facet scan creatures in Mechagon
Text: I must share the wonders of this place with all of Azeroth in a way that will entertain young and old alike. I will use the technology here to create a new line of toys unlike anything seen before!My Quasi-Faceted scanner can help construct perfect replicas of things here on the island.I just need a helpful individual such as yourself to scan a few things around this area.

Title: A Curious Discovery
Objective: Bring the Enchanting Crystal to Narv in Newhome.

Title: The Problem with Shrinkage
Objective: Ask Instructor Ulooaka about the shriveled leather hide.

Title: The Problem with Shrinkage
Objective: Ask Rolm about the shriveled leather hide.

Title: A Little Side Action
Objective: Slay 5 Horde players in Mechagon.
Text: 'Ey, I could be usin' yer talents fer a little bet I got goin' on with Usha.I'm wagerin' you can beat up five 'o her pals around the island before her dog can beat up five o' ours.Ye up fer it me $ulad:lass;? 'O course ya are, ahahaha!

Title: A Curious Discovery
Objective: Bring the Enchanting Crystal to Instructor Okanu in Mezzamere.

Title: Corpse Cleanup
Objective: Burn 8 Egg-bearing corpses.
Text: Our friends continue to fall as these terrible insects pour of their nests and attack our camps.It's a terrible job to ask of anyone, but we have to dispose of the corpses as quickly as possible.We can't allow our dead to be used as fertilizer for growing their disgusting eggs.

Title: Off-the-Books Brawlin'
Objective: Brawl with Usha Eyegouge's forces on Mechagon.
Text: *buuuurrp* Arrrright, listen 'ere. We got ourselves a bit o' a predicament.Besides this dump's ale tastin' like oil, that pigheaded Usha here been sayin' some unfortunate stuff about our troops.Unfortunate FOR HER, 'cuz now *uuuuurp* gonna needya ta rough up any Horde swine ya end up runnin' into out there.Loosely speakin' we ain't supposed to be brawlin' out 'ere, so this ain't a formal order or nothin'...

Title: A Little Side Action
Objective: Slay 5 Alliance players in Mechagon.
Text: There are only two things more fun than fighting, and the first is talking trash!That boar-beard runt over there's been a thorn in my backside since Alterac... Can't seem to shake him.We got a bet going about who's the best fighter on the island.You want to help me win this wager?

Title: Finding the Rajani
Objective: Collect a Mogu Scouting Report from mogu in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: Now that we have an idea of who we're looking for, the next question is, where can we find them?With the constant infighting of the mogu, it is likely that each clan would keep tabs on the whereabouts of their competitors. If we can find such information, it may just lead us to the Rajani.Seek out the champions of the mogu. They would be the most likely to carry reports on their enemies' whereabouts.

Title: Restored Hope
Objective: Speak with Ra-den to return to the Chamber of Heart.
Text: Your persistence fills me with hope for this world.Let us return to your "Chamber of Heart." As the caretaker of the Forge of Origination, I believe I can help your efforts to restore it.Speak to me when you are ready, and I will bring us there.

Title: The Engine of Nalak'sha
Objective: Follow the secret passage within Mogu'shan Palace and re-activate the Engine of Nalak'sha.
Text: Your kind have proved me wrong in the past, so I will give you a chance to do so again.The titan structure which houses the Engine of Nalak'sha spans the entirety of Pandaria. There are more ways to reach it than just the Mogu'shan Vaults.There are many such routes, but the closest would be through Mogu'shan Palace. The chambers beneath the palace are interconnected with the vaults.Seek your fate there, champion.

Title: Clans of the Mogu
Objective: Help Lorewalker Cho discover the origin of the Mysterious Mogu Sigil at the Seat of Knowledge.
Text: You say a mogu asked for your help? This is quite uncharacteristic.I'd be happy to help you uncover the origins of this sigil. To be honest, the prospect of a mogu clan that isn't openly hostile interests me greatly. Just think of the possibilities!Let's get down to business. We'll need to consult the volumes on the various mogu clans in the vale to narrow it down.

Title: The Mysterious Sigil
Objective: Bring the Mysterious Mogu Sigil to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Title: Off-the-Books Brawlin'
Objective: Brawl with Grumbol Grimhammer's forces on Mechagon.
Text: Gazlowe hired you for protection too? I guess it's true that he only hires the best, eh? Ha!Pay's great, but the rules are dung: no fightin' in town, no exceptions. Bah!That tiny tender prince won't give us his tech unless he thinks we're good little angels... Ha!But Gazlowe didn't say nothin' about fightin' outside of town.I got my own squad on the outskirts, ready to brawl with Grumbol's guzzlers if they show their bearded faces.You want in?

Title: Proof of Tenacity
Objective: Obtain a Conqueror's Trophy from the commander of an Assault in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: If the Highkeeper is so convinced that we don't stand a chance against our enemies, perhaps a show of force would sway him.I am not sure how you would manage, but if you could bring proof of a victory against those who threaten the Vale, it may convince him that action should be taken.

Title: It's Never Easy
Objective: Meet Magni Bronzebeard outside Mogu'shan Vaults in Kun-Lai Summit.
Text: The last I heard, Mogu'shan Vaults was still abandoned.We shouldn't have too tough of a time reachin' the engine, since we've already defeated the mogu guardians in that place.Well, what are ye waitin' for? Let's get that engine turned on!

Title: Vinyl: Triumph of Gnomeregan
Objective: Install the vinyl into the Rustbolt Gramophone.

Title: Worldvein Rumors
Objective: Collect 3 Worldvein Intelligence Reports.
Text: Gather more intelligence to assist your followers in tracking down the location of the Fluctuating Worldvein.

Title: My Chickens are Not for Eating!
Objective: Collect 20 Mechanical Giblets and repair the OOX-Bomber/MG.
Text: If you've spent any time with that arrogant nitwit, Overspark, you know why I'm here.To silence his boasting and finally prove that my inventions are better!I've released countless mechanical chickens across this island to analyze the technology here, adopt it, and evolve their own circuitry. One of them will become my ultimate battle chicken!But those idiot troggs think my chickens are edible and keep bashing them.Protect them, so my techno-evolutionary experiment can run its course.

Title: Worldvein Rumors
Objective: Collect 3 Worldvein Intelligence Reports.
Text: Gather intelligence to assist SI:7 in identifying the location of the Fluctuating Worldvein.

Title: Vinyl: Depths of Ulduar
Objective: Install the vinyl into the Rustbolt Gramophone.

Title: Vinyl: Battle of Gnomeregan
Objective: Install the vinyl into the Rustbolt Gramophone.

Title: Nuke 'Em Norbit
Objective: Eliminate the 5 Reinforced Sparkweave Eggs
Text: These motospiders continue to multiply unchecked. If we don't slow them down they'll overrun Rustbolt soon.I've modified Norbit here with adequate firepower to take the spiders head on!Would you pilot Norbit and destroy the Reinforced Sparkweave Eggs?

Title: Vinyl: Gnomeregan Forever
Objective: Install the vinyl into the Rustbolt Gramophone.

Title: Vinyl: Mimiron's Brainstorm
Objective: Install the vinyl into the Rustbolt Gramophone.

Title: Waste Not
Objective: Collect 20 Useful Bits and Pieces

Title: The Eve of Battle
Objective: Speak with Mathias Shaw.
Text: . The time has come.We may have defeated Azshara, but we still have to deal with Sylvanas. Though our position is not ideal, we have mobilized our available forces and stand ready to finish this war.King Wrynn wanted me to brief you on the situation before we join him. There have been some... interesting developments.

Title: Storming the Battlefields
Objective: Win a PVP Island Expedition, Normal Battleground and Epic Battleground.
Text: We cannot afford to let up on any front, continue to press the war.

Title: Wrathion's Journal
Objective: Deliver Wrathion's incomplete journal to MOTHER.
Text: The whispers ceased as soon as I drank the potion. Thank you.Still, it is gravely concerning that N'Zoth's influence could reach me even within the Chamber of Heart. If Wrathion has found a way to resist the power of the Old Gods, then we can use it to reinforce the Chamber's defenses.Perhaps MOTHER can glean more information from Wrathion's journal.

Title: Storming the Battlefields
Objective: Win a PVP Island Expedition, Normal Battleground and Epic Battleground.
Text: We cannot afford to let up on any front, continue to press the war.

Title: The Eve of Battle
Objective: Speak with Lor'themar.
Text: , we must speak of the Horde... and the warchief.The war has proven costly, and the battle against Azshara drained what little resources we had left. The Horde is divided once more and the Alliance fares little better than we do.Sylvanas is now in a position to destroy everyone she considers an enemy. That means us, as well.I had hoped that my old friend would see reason, but now...High Overlord Saurfang is rallying those of us who remain--including some unlikely allies.

Title: Taking The Air Out
Objective: Eliminate 5 Venture Co. Transports

Title: They Move Against Us
Objective: Meet with Sylvanas in Orgrimmar.
Text: The Dark Lady requests your presence in Orgrimmar.It seems the rats have finally come out of hiding. Which will make it all the easier to exterminate them.Do not delay. We have waited for this moment long enough.

Title: A Direct Approach
Objective: Eliminate 12 Venture Co. employees
Text: Maokka has such a gentle heart. He is so good with the little ones, always playing games and telling stories.We do however really dislike these Venture Co. individuals, so I suggest a more direct approach.Try killing them all.

Title: Restless Dead
Objective: Find Sean Wilkers outside of the service entrance of Stratholme in Eastern Plaguelands.
Text: Rumors are spreading of some new evil business happening in Stratholme of all places. We need you to head to Eastern Plaguelands and put an end to any new evil threats that may have taken residence there.We have received contact from a member of the Argent Crusade who has offered their assistance to get you into Stratholme and find the source of this new evil.

Title: Tiny Terrors of Stratholme
Objective: Defeat Blackmane.
Text: Scourge activity inside of Stratholme has increased dramatically in the recent days. The air is thick with the stink of necromancy, and there are screams and shrieks coming from within these walls that will send chills down your spine for weeks to come.I haven't ventured in there yet myself, but there is definitely some new evil stirring from within. I have the keys to this entrance, and can bring you in there to see for yourself.Let me know when you are ready.

Title: Restless Dead
Objective: Find Sean Wilkers outside of the service entrance of Stratholme in Eastern Plaguelands.
Text: Rumors are spreading of some new evil business happening in Stratholme of all places. We need you to head to Eastern Plaguelands and put an end to any new evil threats that may have taken residence there.We have received contact from a member of the Argent Crusade who has offered their assistance to get you into Stratholme and find the source of this new evil.

Title: Pet Battle Challenge: Stratholme
Objective: Defeat Blackmane.
Text: The evil presence has returned to Stratholme yet again. That's the problem with necromancy and scourge, they keep reanimating themselves and coming right back!I can bring us in there again, but I suspect all of those evil forces have returned. Are you sure you want to go back in there? That place gives me the creeps. If you really want to head back in there, I will let you back in.

Title: Spiral Yeti Horn
Objective: Take the Spiral Yeti Horn to the Honeyback Hivemother for a reward.
Text: All manner of creatures are attracted to the sweet smell of fresh honey, but relatively few are willing to withstand the painful and often deadly stings of the largest of bees. This yeti, however, has been a persistent thorn in the hive's side, until now.The Hivemother will be interested in this item.

Title: Envenomed Spider Fang
Objective: Take the Envenomed Spider Fang to the Honeyback Hivemother for a reward.
Text: Even wary bees have been known to fall prey to these enormous spiders. They lie in wait near flowerbeds and ambush them while they collect their harvest. Thanks to you, they have one less spider to worry about.The Hivemother will be interested in this item.

Title: Hivekiller Stinger
Objective: Take the Hivekiller Stinger to the Honeyback Hivemother for a reward.
Text: Wasps are a bee's natural enemy, and none are more deadly than this highly specialized killer. It will terrorize the hive no longer, thanks to you.The Hivemother will be interested in this item.

Title: The Uldum Accord
Objective: Learn about the threats facing Uldum in Ramkahen.
Text: You seek assistance defending the Forge of Origination? It would seem that our goals align.The Halls of Origination are but a small portion of the forge's true scope. Any threat to Uldum would be a potential threat to the forge, and Uldum has found itself with many new enemies of late.We were about to convene the High Council when these Wastewanders arrived unannounced. Perhaps you could join us in learning about these threats?

Title: Frenzy Fang
Objective: Show the Frenzy Fang to Finder Palta in Newhome in Nazjatar.

Title: Strange Organ
Objective: Show the Strange Organ to Finder Palta in Newhome in Nazjatar.

Title: Pirates? I Hate Those Guys!
Objective: Deliver the old pirate hat to Reno Jackson.

Title: Crackling Mandible
Objective: Show the Crackling Mandible to Finder Palta in Newhome in Nazjatar.

Title: Unprofitable Ventures
Objective: Destroy Pummeller Red, Pummeller Orange, and Pummeller Grey
Text: This land is already a monumental disaster, but it could get worse!The Venture Company is here, and will exploit this land for every ounce of profit they can make. We must make their venture here unprofitable, so they will leave.Destroy the three expensive security units with them, and they may leave for more profitable ventures.

Title: Drowning the Alliance
Objective: Kill 25 Alliance players in Nazjatar while in War Mode.
Text: The Alliance continue to pursue us, they will not disrupt our plans any further. Drive their champions into a watery grave.

Title: Scorched Data Disc
Objective: Deliver the item to R33-DR.

Title: Seams to be a Problem
Objective: Ask Rolm about the Osmenite Dust.

Title: Ounces of Osmenite
Objective: Ask Rolm about the Osmenite Shards.

Title: Defensive in Death
Objective: Ask Rolm about the tentacles of the Zin'anthid.

Title: WANTED: Junkbrat and Roadtrogg
Objective: Eliminate Junkbrat and Roadtrogg.
Text: Responsible for a spree of mayhem and chaos throughout the Heaps, resulting in the theft of energy cells, spare parts, and the consumption of Improbable Mechano-Chicken Wings without payment.Special caution around Roadtrogg, who has demonstrated a violent attitude towards living things.Elimination of these two felons is of the highest priority.

Title: Up Against It
Objective: Move deeper into Nazjatar with Lor'themar and Thalyssra.
Text: I don't like the sound of that... It sounds like an army!We need to investigate.Try not to draw too much attention as we take a look. If there's an army down there, we'll need to move quickly to find refuge.

Title: Rust Covered Disc
Objective: Deliver the item to R33-DR.

Title: On Ghostly Wings
Objective: Return to Kelya Moonfall in Zin-Azshari.
Text: We will meet you back where our journey began.Corin and I have been separated for many years. We have so much to catch up on.As a token of our gratitude we will remain in the area to help you in your travels through this cursed land.

Title: Cracked Numeric Cylinder
Objective: Deliver the item to R33-DR.

Title: Large Storage Fragment
Objective: Deliver the item to R33-DR.

Title: Discs of Norgannon
Objective: Recover Corrupted Disc Fragment
Text: King Mechagon unit in possession of Norgannon disk. Data is corrupted, possession of such data is dangerous.Please aid in the recovery of Corrupted Disk Fragments that have been discarded via Mechagon waste systems.Deliver recovered Corrupted Disc Fragment to Data Analyzer R33-DR for purging.

Title: Cogfrenzy's Construction Frenzy
Objective: Help build construction projects.
Text: You Rustbolt resisters inspire me. Tinkering, building, exploring.Letting your imagination run wild and then chasing after it, wherever it leads, with reckless abandon!I miss those days. I hope, someday, my conscience will allow me to stay on the surface with you all permanently...Before I return to Mechagon, we must build something incredible.Waren and I have identified a large number of extra construction project sites for today.Build with boldness!

Title: Wastewander Coins
Objective: Collect 6 Wastewander Coins.
Text: It may be too late for some of our fallen brothers and sisters, but it is not too late to give solace to their families.Every Wastewander carries with them a unique coin, signifying their status as a member of our group.If you find any of these coins, please bring them to me and I will make sure they are properly returned to their next of kin.

Title: A Bolt from the Blue
Objective: Meet Kalecgos at the Nexus and claim the Charged Scale of the Blue Aspect.
Text: You have done much to empower the Heart of Azeroth, and I am proud that the dragonflights have lent their strength to your cause.It is now time for the blue dragonflight to do the same.When I first learned of the essences, I knew that some remnant of my dragonflight's power must be out there, coalescing where we were once strong.That is exactly what I have found. The Kirin Tor have isolated its signature at the Nexus, but only the wielder of the Heart of Azeroth can claim it.

Title: Grounded
Objective: Destroy the Aerial Patroller XZ-2
Text: One of King Mechagon's older Aerial units is having mechanical problems and is grounded nearby.They're trying to get it repaired, so we need to act fast while it's vulnerable.Destroy the Aerial Patroller XZ-2 before they can get it repaired.

Title: The Missing Crew
Objective: Find and rescue the missing crew members.
Text: I can't believe it. Almost the entire fleet.. lost!We need to have ships out there on missions supporting our efforts, but how am I supposed to do that now?If we are going to recover from this, I'm going to need my top people. I know the chances are low, but I need you to get out there and try to find them. Alive if possible.

Title: Surfacing Threats
Objective: Complete an Assault in Uldum.
Text: The tol'vir take the protection of the titans' constructs here in Uldum as a sacred duty. However, our numbers have dwindled, and we face greater threats with each day.Even with the strength of our new allies, we will only be able to hold these enemies back for so long. Should any of them surge in power, they may still be able to overwhelm us and endanger the forge. This is where your assistance is needed.Speak to High Commander Kamses to assess our current situation.

Title: A Titanic Problem
Objective: Meet Magni Bronzebeard at the Halls of Origination in Uldum.
Text: We've no time tae waste.Without the Forge of Origination, Azeroth is left vulnerable tae N'Zoth's corruption. Not tae mention it holds a weapon capable of wipin' out all life on Azeroth!We'll need tae head over tae the forge right away. MOTHER can hold down the fort here.Hurry on, I'll meet ye there.

Title: The Missing Crew
Objective: Find and rescue the missing crew members.
Text: I can't believe it. Almost the entire fleet.. lost!We need to have ships out there on missions supporting our efforts, but how am I supposed to do that now?If we are going to recover from this, I'm going to need my top people. I know the chances are low, but I need you to get out there and try to find them. Alive if possible.

Title: Forging Onward
Objective: Return to Magni Bronzebeard at the Chamber of Heart and learn about the fate of the Forge of Origination.
Text: Thanks fer helpin' me back there at the forge. It's vexin' that N'Zoth was able to infiltrate it so quickly, but at least we arrived in time tae keep it from bein' completely wrecked!Now comes the task of getting' her back tae a hundred percent. MOTHER has been workin' on a solution, and we think we've got a plan.

Title: A Gulper Ate The Rolly
Objective: Kill the Rolly Gulper and catch 3 Bubble-eyed Rolly.
Text: The Bubble-eyed Rolly used to be plentiful in the nearby pond. Last week they all started to vanish!A large water elemental has been swallowing all the fish! They are still alive, just swimming around inside the elemental now.I need you to kill that elemental, and catch three Bubbly-eyed Rolly so I can examine their condition.

Title: To Ramkahen
Objective: Meet King Phaoris in Ramkahen.
Text: It looks like we're gonna have tae wait a spell while MOTHER figures out what tae do with the forge. In the mean time we'll want tae try to make sure nobody tries tae do any more damage here.Ye should check in on the tol'vir in Ramkahen. I know ye've helped them in the past, so they might be able tae help us keep the forge out o' the wrong hands.

Title: Hozen Totem
Objective: Talk to Arcti in the Brewfest grounds.

Title: Young Twilight Scale
Objective: Show the scale to Eryna above Grim Batol in the Wetlands.

Title: Break a Few Eggs
Objective: Destroy 10 Deepcoil Eggs.
Text: The naga are using these caverns as a hatchery for their deadly deepcoil serpents.These deepcoil serpents are especially dangerous because they have been infused with dark void magic.We must put a stop to this operation before it is too late. The naga forces are already quite powerful. I do not wish to imagine what would happen if Azshara also had an army of these deepcoil serpents as well.Our only hope is to destroy the deepcoil eggs before they hatch.

Title: The Eternal Palace: Queen's Gambit
Objective: Defeat Queen Azshara in the Eternal Palace.
Text: We have opened the way to the palace. We must end this. Queen Azshara is the most powerful sorceress in existence. She mastered magics thousands of years before our archmagi were even born. Still, we must prevail. If not, she and her dark patron will remake all of Azeroth to their desires. Champion, we must defeat Azshara. Are you with us?

Title: The Eternal Palace: Queen's Gambit
Objective: Defeat Queen Azshara in the Eternal Palace.
Text: The way is clear. The palace awaits. Within the Vainglorious holds court with an old god. Defeating her will be no small feat. Make no mistake, Azshara is one of the most powerful sorceresses alive. We cannot underestimate her power or her planning, for she has had thousands of years to prepare for us. Nevertheless, she must be defeated. We are ready when you are. Shall we finally accept her invitation?

Title: Be Kind, Rewind
Objective: Deliver the Visual Holo Sphere to Izira Geasworn in Rustbolt.
Text: You exist here due to a time anomaly, but you must return to your own time and help us there.The Visual Holo Sphere from the Vaultbot nearby contains the data necessary to defeat King Mechagon before he can use the Mechoriginator.Deliver the Visual Holo Sphere to me in your reality. With luck I will be able to rewind history and prevent this existence from ever happening.

Title: Battle Tested
Objective: Eliminate 10 Upgraded, Anodized, or Corroded Sentry wherever you find them.
Text: A weapon like this could really turn the tide against King Mechagons Troops. Let's go see how their gear matches up against our new toy.Take out King Mechagon's Sentries wherever you can find them

Title: Ancient Technology
Objective: Bring the Broken Power Core to Rolm in Newhome.

Title: The Eternal Palace: We Can Make It Stronger...
Objective: Collect 20 Eternal Ornaments from the most powerful creatures of the Eternal Palace.
Text: Now that it's functioning, it occurred to me while repairing it that it has the capability to output even more energy. Of course that will require stronger materials to upgrade and the only place I can think of is in the Eternal Palace. Azshara's army and even herself carry items of extraordinary power. If you could bring some of those back, I could at the very least test my theory and see if it's viable.

Title: The Eternal Palace: Pushing the Limits
Objective: Collect 200 Eternal Ornaments from the most powerful creatures of the Eternal Palace.
Text: Now that we know how to increase the potency of this thing, I think we can push its capabilities even further. Bring me back more of those ornaments. LOTS of them. Let's see just how far we can make this go.

Title: Scouting the Palace
Objective: Speak with Lady Jaina Proudmoore to observe the scouting party.
Text: We cannot hide here forever. Azshara must be dealt with. It would be an act of folly to assault her palace without knowing what defenses she has in place. I dispatched a scouting team while you were gone, but they have not reported back. I'm getting concerned. Let me know when you're ready and I'll perform a ritual to see what has happened to our scouts.

Title: An Abyssal Opportunity
Objective: Acquire 15 Abyssal Shards from Finder Pruc.
Text: I believe, we can use this thing to make our armor stronger. By redirecting its power, we can take the strength of our crafts to a new level. But we're getting ahead of ourselves. The first thing we need to do is repair this device. It'll require some powerful materials to fix it, and those are usually carried by the stronger creatures of this region. However, Finder Pruc is great at collecting materials like the ones we need. I'd check with him to see what he's got.

Title: Ancient Technology
Objective: Bring the Broken Power Core to Instructor Ulooaka in Mezzamere.

Title: Direbrew Cog
Objective: Talk to Verra Fireblood in the Brewfest grounds.

Title: The Eternal Palace: Pushing the Limits
Objective: Collect 200 Eternal Ornaments from the most powerful creatures of the Eternal Palace.
Text: Now that we know how to increase the potency of this tool, I think we can push its capabilities even further. Bring me back more of those ornaments. LOTS of them. Let's see just how far we can make this go.

Title: The Eternal Palace: We Can Make It Stronger...
Objective: Collect 20 Eternal Ornaments from the most powerful creatures of the Eternal Palace.
Text: Now that it's functioning, it occurred to me while repairing it that it has the capability to output even more energy. Of course that'll require stronger materials to upgrade and the only place I can think of is in the Eternal Palace. Azshara's army and even herself carry items of extraordinary power. If you could bring some of those back, I could at the very least test my theory and see if it's viable.

Title: An Abyssal Opportunity
Objective: Acquire 15 Abyssal Shards from Artisan Okata.
Text: I believe, we can use this thing to make our armor stronger. By redirecting its power, we can take the strength of our crafts to a new level. But we're getting ahead of ourselves. The first thing we need to do is repair this device. It'll require some powerful materials to fix it, and those are usually carried by the stronger creatures of this region. However, Artisan Okata is great at collecting materials like the ones we need. I'd check with him to see what he's got.

Title: Uncovering the Artifact Fragments
Objective: Fura in Warspear Outpost wants you to go kill creatures in the outskirts of Ashran outside of the main road and bring back 50 Artifact Fragments.
Text: The Artifact Fragments seem to come from any creature we've found in the outskirts of Ashran. Go out and kill any you find and bring at least fifty Artifact Fragments to Fura the Mage in Warspear Outpost.

Title: Wanna Charge? Gotta Pay!
Objective: Pay Flux's access fee, then use the Charging Station to charge an Empty Energy Cell.
Text: You lookin' to charge some energy cells off of our tower of power?I ain't surprised - everyone is.And everyone PAYS. You got that or I got ta say it again?I can tell you're a first-timer. Bondo's got a special deal for you flashfoots.Small access fee, one charge only.Deal? You ain't gettin' any other offers.

Title: Tremblade Must Die
Objective: Slay Grand Marshal Tremblade found in the Alliance base Stormshield Keep within Ashran.
Text: This battle in Ashran has waged on long enough. It appears they're being led by Grand Marshal Tremblade. If she falls, the Alliance will crumble.Push forward through the center road, make your way into their keep and take down Tremblade.For the Horde!

Title: Volrath Must Die
Objective: Slay High Warlord Volrath found in the Horde base Warspear within Ashran.
Text: The Horde are getting in our way of completing our mission here in Ashran. Their leader is High Warlord Volrath. He must be put down.Push forth through the center road, enter Warspear and slay Volrath.

Title: Ravenous Rescue
Objective: Rescue 8 injured mechagnomes.
Text: A conspiracy of ravens is preying on citizens of Rustbolt! It's most unacceptable!Prince Erazmin has asked me to rescue as many citizens as I can, but I could use your help. I've tracked the ravens to this hill. We blast the ravens out of the sky, and you rescue the mechagnomes.Use my marker gun if you need help bringing the ravens down.

Title: Uncovering the Artifact Fragments
Objective: Ecilam in Stormshield Stronghold wants you to go kill creatures in the outskirts of Ashran outside of the main road and bring back 50 Artifact Fragments.
Text: The Artifact Fragments seem to come from any creature we've found in the outskirts of Ashran. Go out and kill any you find and bring at least fifty to Ecilam the Mage near the campfire in Stormshield Stronghold.

Title: Saving Corin
Objective: Defeat Shadowcaster Vixtris.
Text: My father is being tortured by that naga!, I need you to help me save him. We can't let his spirit be a slave to the naga.Hurry, if we don't act now he will end up like the rest of them!

Title: Do Not Drink
Objective: Recover 12 containers of Stolen Oil.
Text: These troggs watch everything we do.They see us pouring oil into various machines, so now they're stealing the oil and drinking it. I think they believe it's going to turn them into machines!We need that oil back, before they drink it all!

Title: Bots Gone Wild
Objective: Whirling Zap-O-Matic slain
Text: It's loose up there!I told them not to do it, but they didn't listen. Now it's gone out of control and killed everyone up there. It's an experimental Whirlbot, they never should have built it!You need to stop it before it comes down here looking for more victims!Kill the Whirling Zap-O-Matic.

Title: Your First Charge is Free!
Objective: Gain access to the Charging Station in Bondo's Yard, then use it to charge an Empty Energy Cell.
Text: Do you feel the energy rippling through the ground here, my dear test subject?Without that constant bristle of electricity, nothing of any meaning would exist.My dear sister and I have tapped into a high-voltage power line buried here, but the real juice is over in Bondo's Yard. He selfishly hoards access to the heftiest power line in Mechagon!If you want to recharge your empty energy cells, you're going to have to get access to the Charging Station from Flux.

Title: Contained Alemental
Objective: Talk to Brewmaster Tsing in the Brewfest grounds.

Title: Chopped Bots
Objective: 12 Re-animated bots delivered to Bolten Springspark.
Text: Chopping up bots is my business. Any bots you bring to my scrapper will be broken up into useful parts. It's a win for both of us!Use the Bot-Energizer to bring me dead bots, and we'll break them into spare parts.

Title: Your First Charge Ain't Free!
Objective: Pay Flux's access fee, then use the Charging Station to charge an Empty Energy Cell.
Text: You lookin' to charge some energy cells off of our tower of power?I ain't surprised - everyone is.And everyone PAYS. You got that or I got ta say it again?I can tell you're a first-timer. Bondo's got a special deal for you flashfoots.Small access fee, one charge only.Deal? You ain't gettin' any other offers.

Title: Changing Tides
Objective: Assault the naga camp and seize control of the Tidestone of Golganneth.
Text: We are out of time. We must gain control the Tidestone of Golganneth and the Javelin is our best shot at piercing the barrier surrounding it. The guardian is formidable, but must be defeated if we are to take the fight to Azshara. What forces we have will be arrayed below, just outside their encampment. I would trust you with the Javelin of Suramar. We will need your strength in the coming battle.

Title: They Made Their Choice
Objective: Aid Shandris Feathermoon.
Text: It wasn't enough for Azshara to break the world. She had to doom the rest of our people here as well!Those who didn't choose to become naga were stuck in this horrifying half death, left to haunt these drowned ruins.I am almost afraid of what we will find if we do find my friend.Wait, did you hear something?

Title: The Quickcharge Contract
Objective: Agree to the Quickcharge Contract.
Text: Wondrous news, dear test subject!My dear brother and I have restored 65% of the functionality of our research laboratory.We are hoping to resume our regular research schedule shortly, but require a fresh batch of brave test subjects to help us push the laws of nature and science to their limits!If you're interested, you'll just need to agree to our standard verbal contract first...

Title: City of Drowned Friends
Objective: Help First Arcanist Thalyssra search the Drowned Market.
Text: Champion, I have a personal favor to ask of you. This is not on behalf of the Horde or the war effort. It has been over ten thousand years since I last walked these streets. I knew many of these people, even trained some of them. Will you walk with me as I learn their fates? The road is dangerous, and I do not trust myself to maintain calm as I try to resurface old grief.

Title: They Made Their Choice
Objective: Aid First Arcanist Thalyssra.
Text: It wasn't enough for Azshara to break the world. She had to doom the rest of our people here as well!Those who didn't choose to become naga were stuck in this horrifying half death, left to haunt these drowned ruins.I am almost afraid to find Sivara.Wait, did you hear something?

Title: The Warbringer
Objective: Commune with the Memory of the Pact.
Text: We are standing in the center of some very powerful magics. An echo of something Azshara did long ago. If you are feeling brave enough to commune with this echo, I will stand guard as you do.

Title: The Warbringer
Objective: Commune with the Memory of the Pact.
Text: We are standing in the center of some very powerful magics. An echo of something Azshara did long ago. If you are feeling brave enough to commune with this echo, I will stand guard as you do.

Title: City of Drowned Friends
Objective: Help Shandris Feathermoon search the Drowned Market.
Text: Champion, I have a personal favor to ask of you that I do not feel I can ask of any of my sentinels. This... this is not on behalf of the Alliance, or the war, or even our battle against Azshara. This is a favor for me. When I was a little girl, my city was attacked by the Legion. Many of the survivors fled here only to drown or worse. I must know their fate. Will you help me search for signs?

Title: The Ever Drowning
Objective: Escort First Arcanist Thalyssra through the Drowned Market.
Text: Queen Azshara has her eye on us now. We must proceed with caution. I do not know what she may try but stay close to me. Whatever this threat is we must pass through it if we are to find Sivara. Speak with me when you are ready to proceed.

Title: The Ever Drowning
Objective: Escort Shandris Feathermoon through the Drowned Market.
Text: Stay close, Champion. I have some magical items that might help us defend briefly against magic attacks, but Azshara was the greatest mage our kind has ever known. I do not feel confident that these trinkets will hold back her power for long, or even be usable afterward. Speak with me when you are ready.

Title: Drunk Angry Murlocs
Objective: Collect 12 Ocean "Infused" Lagers.
Text: Those no-good Bloodfins ran off with all of the beer!I've been experimenting with brews that only use ingredients native to Nazjatar, but it's still a work in progress. For now, I must rely on whatever I can scrounge up from the shipwreck.My supply of beer was already limited, but now it's all gone thanks to those thieving Bloodfin murlocs! We're going to have some very angry customers here if we don't get it back.Please recover the stolen lager from Bloodfin Village before it's too late!

Title: Let's Fish!
Objective: Catch and kill the Deepwater Maw.
Text: We may need the help of some friends to land this fish!Use the Hundred-Fathom Lure when you're ready to start.

Title: The Family Jewels
Objective: Recover 75 Family Jewels
Text: Darn pirates stole my jewels... err, I mean my sister's... uh, mom's jewelry. Yeah, that's the story!Point is, they stole it, and it's all out there strewn around in the mud, and treasure chests. Maybe on a few of the robots and murlocs.My mom's not greedy, she just wants a few of the necklaces with gold and lots of diamonds. I'd pay ya for those.

Title: We've Got Crabs!
Objective: Collect 12 Crackleclaw Crabs.
Text: , you're just in time. Everything's ready for the crab hunt!Okay, okay... I know what you're thinking. A founding member of D.E.H.T.A. that condones hunting?I'm going to level with you. I've got a bar full of hungry murlocs that only eat three things: crabs, fish, and people.If that's not reason enough, crabs are overpopulated in this region and they're decimating the local grub worm population!How many innocent grub worms need to die before we do something?

Title: Whispers of N'Zoth
Objective: Speak to Kalecgos in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: We've got an emergency, champion! We need ye in the Chamber o' Heart at once.Somethin' nasty is gettin' into Ebonhorn's head. He can't shake it loose!Maybe ye can help him out!

Title: Go For The Gold
Objective: Recover the Murloc Treasure Bag.
Text: I've heard lot's of stories about dead fathers, mothers, and family treasures. Don't believe any of it. We're all here to get any pirate gold, before these mecha-fools get it first!If there's gold to be had here, it's in that fat chest the murlocs are guarding.Kill their chief, empty out the chest, and we'll split it fifty-fifty, since I'm telling ya about it.

Title: Mgglurky's Mugglrgl
Objective: Retrieve Mgglurky's Mugglrgl from Bloodfin Village.
Text: My cook, Mgglurky, lost his mugglrgl and he's refusing to work until he gets it back.I've got a bar full of hungry murlocs and nothing to feed them until Mgglurky starts cooking. If Mgglurky doesn't find his mugglrgl soon, we're going to have a riot on our hands!I don't know about you, but I definitely don't want to be the main course tonight.There were some Bloodfins lurking around earlier. Search Bloodfin Village for the mugglrgl and bring it back to me once you find it.

Title: The High Life
Objective: Accompany Kelya Moonfall into the Highborne Estates to search for the spirit of her father.
Text: You there, I require some help.Everyone where I once called home lost their lives to the flood. I still don't know what became of my father, Corin.It pains me to return to the estates, and there are vengeful spirits who haunt the once pristine grounds. Will you help me find out what happened to my father?

Title: Unlocking the Power
Objective: Return to the Chamber of Heart.
Text: There's somethin' special waitin' fer ye back in the Chamber of Heart, champion.I won't spoil it, but ye best get back there as quick as ye can.

Title: Assault: Aqir Unearthed
Objective: Drive back the Aqir Assault in Uldum.
Text: Our position is being overrun. The aqir are surging in greater numbers than I've ever seen!I'm not sure how long we'll be able to hold the line. We need you to drive them back!

Title: Unlocking the Power
Objective: Return to the Chamber of Heart.
Text: There's somethin' special waitin' fer ye back in the Chamber of Heart, champion.I won't spoil it, but ye best get back there as quick as ye can.

Title: Back to the Chamber
Objective: Return to the Chamber of Heart.
Text: The Heart o' Azeroth is gettin' stronger every day, and it's makin' a difference.Make yer way tae the Chamber o' Heart, champion. Yer talents are needed.

Title: Return to the Heart
Objective: Return to the Chamber of Heart.
Text: Greetings, Champion of Azeroth.MOTHER's been monitorin' yer progress with the Heart of Azeroth, and is mighty pleased with the work you've done tae make it stronger.At least, we think she's pleased. It's difficult tae tell at times.Regardless, come back tae the Chamber of Heart when ye've got a chance. There's more that needs doin'.

Title: Lokholar the Ice Lord
Objective: Slay Alliance and loot Stormpike Blood and return it to Primalist Thurloga within Frostwolf Village in Alterac Valley.
Text: I come from Thunder Bluff. Cairne himself has seen to it that I assist the Frostwolf Clan in these dire times. But let us not waste any more time. You must strike down our enemies and bring to me their blood. Once enough blood has been gathered, the ritual of summoning may begin. Victory will be assured when the elemental lord is loosed upon the Stormpike army.

Title: Ivus the Forest Lord
Objective: Slay Horde and loot a Storm Crystal and return it to Archdruid Renferal in Alterac Valley.
Text: The Frostwolf Clan is protected by a taint of elemental energy. Their shaman meddle in powers that will surely destroy us all if left unchecked. The damage has grown too great for the Circle to control! Ivus must be called to our aid. The Frostwolf soldiers carry elemental charms called storm crystals. We can use the charms to conjure Ivus. Venture forth and claim the crystals!

Title: The Battle for Alterac
Objective: Enter Alterac Valley and defeat the dwarven general, Vanndar Stormpike.
Text: The Stormpike dwarves and their allies have invaded Alterac Valley, and we must drive them out! To win the battle for Alterac, we must defeat their general, Vanndar Stormpike! You will find Vanndar in Dun Baldar, in the north of Alterac Valley. Destroy him, and then return to me.

Title: The Battle of Alterac
Objective: Enter Alterac Valley, defeat the Horde general Drek'thar.
Text: The Explorers' League believes there are artifacts in Alterac Valley, but the Frostwolf orcs won't let us explore. We can't allow the Horde to stop our scholarly pursuits! Defeat the Frostwolf general, Drek'Thar. With him dead, the orcs will lose their edge. Drek'Thar is in Frostwolf Keep, in the south of Alterac Valley. Vanquish him, and then return to me.

Title: I Am the Trashmaster
Objective: Give Jani the Trashmaster's Mantle.
Text: Whatcha got there, richmon?Ha! You think you be de Trashmasta? You be talkin' to de God of Garbage! De Ruler of Rubbish! Master of all things Discarded an' Unwanted!So you not be wantin' that ol' trashy cloak, eh? Jani got somethin' better.You just give dat ol' thing to me, an Jani will be takin' care o' you...

Title: I Am the Trashmaster
Objective: Give Jani the Trashmaster's Mantle.
Text: Whatcha got there, richmon?Ha! You think you be de Trashmasta? You be talkin' to de God of Garbage! De Ruler of Rubbish! Master of all things Discarded an' Unwanted!So you not be wantin' that ol' trashy cloak, eh? Jani got somethin' better.You just give dat ol' thing to me, an Jani will be takin' care o' you...

Title: Treasure Tale
Objective: Return to Finder Palta in Newhome in Nazjatar.

Title: Treasure Tale
Objective: Return to Artisan Itanu in Nazjatar.

Title: Enchanted Lock
Objective: Solve Mardivas' arcane puzzle to unlock the enchanted lock.

Title: Down But Not Out
Objective: Support your allies in Nazjatar by gaining 3000 experience combined between Vim Brineheart, Poen Gillbrack, and Neri Sharpfin.
Text: Ashvane won't trouble us for now, but our situation remains perilous.I must consider our next move. In the meantime we should continue to build upon our relationship with our new allies, the Unshackled. Test them in combat, train them while you can, we will need their aid in the battles to come.We will show them that through unity there are no obstacles that can stand in our way.

Title: Diaries of the Dead
Objective: Search Zin-Azshari in Nazjatar for additional diaries.
Text: Then he had the audacity to enter our summoning circle and demand we evict his study space at once. Who willingly steps into the chaos of a summoning ritual? He is mad. We call him that now -- Mad Mardivas.Of course, he was bitten on the leg by a lesser summon, and...

Title: Enchanted Lock
Objective: Solve Mardivas' arcane puzzle to unlock the enchanted lock.

Title: Preserved Clues
Objective: Search in Zin-Azshari for information about the strange arcane chests.
Text: We have found similar chests, as you describe. We believe they were left behind by one that came before the naga.Some are even locked by odd arcane runes, the naga seem most interested in those.I know little about them, save that we find them most often in the city ruins.If you seek to decipher their history, I would begin there.

Title: Diaries of the Dead
Objective: Search Zin-Azshari in Nazjatar for additional diaries.
Text: Then he had the audacity to enter our summoning circle and demand we evict his study space at once. Who willingly steps into the chaos of a summoning ritual? He is mad. We call him that now -- Mad Mardivas.Of course, he was bitten on the leg by a lesser summon, and...

Title: Preserved Clues
Objective: Search in Zin-Azshari for information about the strange arcane chests.
Text: If you find anything else in those chests that you don't need, you feel free to bring it on over my way.Found a few of them myself. Don't look like they belong to the naga, probably someone that lived in the city.Some are locked tight by arcane magic, seen the naga taking those back with them. Probably got the good stuff in there.I don't know much more than that. If you want a history lesson, I'd snoop around the city ruins.

Title: Down Into Nazjatar
Objective: Support your allies in Nazjatar by getting one to rank 3.
Text: We have much to do . However our troops are weary and need rest. Decisions made when tired are often the wrong ones.These "Unshackled" have offered to aid us with what forces they have. If we hope to survive down here against Azshara's forces, we will need to support our new allies.Join one of their hunters and aid them in their tasks, we will remain here and discuss our next move.

Title: Friends In Need
Objective: Support your allies in Nazjatar by gaining 3000 experience combined between Farseer Ori, Hunter Akana, and Bladesman Inowari.
Text: I doubt that will be the last we've seen of Priscilla, but at least she is no longer one of our immediate concerns.We must think carefully before making our next move. In the meantime we should continue to build upon our relationship with our new allies, the Ankoan. Work with them to secure the area and hone their skills, we're not out of the woods yet.I fear the biggest battle is still to come. Let's show them that together we can take on Azshara's forces and succeed!

Title: WANTED: Gler'thogg
Objective: Retrieve the Eye of Gler'thogg.
Text: Gler'thogg is responsible for the death and torture of many of the Unshackled.They have shared with us their pain. Bring back his eye.He dwells in the Deepcoil Tunnels. Extreme caution advised!Upon completion of the mission, report to Seacaller Unow for commendation.

Title: Strange Silver Knife
Objective: Ask the Unshackled about the knife.

Title: Strange Silver Knife
Objective: Ask the Ankoan about the knife.

Title: Arcane Cache
Objective: Locate the key to the Naga Cache.
Text: The heavily reinforced chest is of naga construction and appears to be reinforced with a magical lock of some kind.Magical reinforcement aside, the cache still requires a key to unlock.The key is most likely being held by one of the nearby naga commanders.

Title: WANTED: Inquisitor Ithriza
Objective: Retrieve the head of Inquisitor Ithriza.
Text: Wanted for attacks against the Horde!Inquisitor Ithriza is responsible for leading several raids and ambushes against our soldiers.Last seen in the vicinity of Dragon's Teeth Basin. Extreme caution advised!Upon completion of the mission, report to Seacaller Unow for commendation.

Title: Void Cache
Objective: Locate the key to the Naga Cache.
Text: The heavily reinforced chest is of naga construction and appears to be reinforced with a magical lock of some kind.Magical reinforcement aside, the cache still requires a key to unlock.The key is most likely being held by one of the nearby naga commanders.

Title: WANTED: Lady Narjiss
Objective: Retrieve the head of Lady Narjiss.
Text: Wanted for attacks against the Horde!Lady Narjiss is responsible for leading several raids and ambushes against our soldiers.Last seen on the outskirts of Zanj'ir Terrace. Extreme caution advised!Upon completion of the mission, report to Seacaller Unow for commendation.

Title: Reinforced Cache
Objective: Locate the key to the Naga Cache.
Text: The heavily reinforced chest is of naga construction and appears to be reinforced with a heavy-duty lock of some kind.Reinforcement aside, the cache still requires a key to unlock.The key is most likely being held by one of the nearby naga commanders.

Title: WANTED: Lord Ha'kass
Objective: Retrieve the head of Lord Ha'kass.
Text: Wanted for attacks against the people of Nazjatar.Lord Ha'kass has attempted to enslave many Horde survivors.He commands slavers in Zanj'ir Wash. Extreme caution advised!Upon completion of the mission, report to Seacaller Unow for commendation.

Title: Beauty in the Deeps
Objective: Accept a gift from your companion.
Text: We have slain many enemies, spilled much blood on the sand. My skills have improved tenfold fighting at your side.Yet let us not forget that once, this was a place of peace. Once, my people walked amongst the caverns and reefs undisturbed.There is beauty, here, in the depths, all around us. Take a moment, sit, and enjoy your serene surroundings. Look here, a crab with a shell of brilliant colors.You see? There is beauty here, even now.

Title: Good Girl
Objective: Accept a gift from your companion.
Text: I have learned so much by your side, I can't believe how many naga we've taken down!When you first arrived, I was skeptical that you'd make a difference. We've been down here, fighting, for so long. I had almost lost hope.But now, we see a way out of the darkness of the depths, finally!I took in a snapdragon pup when we formed Newhome, been training her ever since. I think... I think I'd like you to have her.She'll make a great mount... and loyal friend.

Title: Tome of Tears
Objective: Accept a gift from your companion.
Text: We've been fighting side by side for a while now. I didn't think an old salt like me could get any better at killing naga, but here we are.I have something to show you...Worst thing we can do is forget.So many names I've written in this book, each and every one of them an Unshackled. All of them gone, now.I will never forget their names.I want you to have it. Tell people. Tell them who they were, and what we have done here.

Title: WANTED: Lady Naz'jess
Objective: Retrieve the head of Lady Naz'jess.
Text: Wanted for attacks against the people of Nazjatar.Lady Naz'jess has been driving the weapon masters to create crueler devices.Last seen skulking about Zanj'ir Terrace. She is vicious, proceed with caution.Upon completion of the mission, report to Seacaller Unow for commendation.

Title: WANTED: Commander Sarj'eth
Objective: Retrieve the head of Commander Sarj'eth.
Text: Wanted for attacks against the people of Nazjatar.Commander Sarj'eth has attempted to enslave many Horde survivors.He commands slavers in Zanj'ir Terrace. Extreme caution advised!Upon completion of the mission, report to Seacaller Unow for commendation.

Title: Glittering Shell
Objective: Accept a gift from your companion.
Text: Hi, friend. I just wanted you to know that traveling with you has been the best ever!I never thought I could learn so much about fighting, but now I feel like I can actually hold my own.I will protect all of the wee ones that can't protect themselves!Like this little one. I found him a while back, while we were out. He looked so scared.Hey, why don't you take him?

Title: Wild Tame
Objective: Accept a gift from your companion.
Text: In our time together, I have learned much. Both about my own abilities, and about your people.You are selfless in the face of challenge, much like our own. I consider us kin.For some time, I have been training a snapdragon I found as a pup. He is a worthy mount, and I have been waiting for a worthy hunter to ride him. I believe I have found that hunter.Here, he is yours.

Title: Last Heirloom
Objective: Accept a gift from your companion.
Text: We have encountered many foes together, and emerged victorious every time. I have you to thank for our safety this day, and my prowess in combat.I will be honest with you, friend. I did not think I would live this long.My people had families, once. Traditions. We would carve symbols into our talismans and pass them down from generation to generation of deep sea hunters. Charms for luck, or prowess, each family had their own.This is mine. I have none to pass it on to. I would like you to have it

Title: Scrying Stones
Objective: Find treasures hidden away by magic within Nazjatar.
Text: I have a gift for you.It's a stone unlike anything you've seen before. To the uninformed, it may seem to be a simple rock, but it's far more precious than that.This is a scrying stone. It reveals objects that have been hidden by magic. When near an anomaly, the runes etched within will begin to glow.Use the stone to reveal treasure hidden away by ancient magic.

Title: The Halls of Origination
Objective: Defeat the Amathet forces and reactivate the forge in the Halls of Origination.
Text: It looks like the Halls of Origination have been claimed by a group o' tol'vir calling themselves the Amathet. I don't know much about them other than they're new in town and not the friendliest of types.We'll need tae get in there and re-activate the forge, or else Azeroth will be done for!

Title: Just Ptrust Me On This
Objective: Place your faith in Pa'ku and Kua'fon.
Text: Ahhh, it is good to see you.How is de defective one? Still pleased to be at your side?I have given this some thought.
