Fear may still be what holds your not-so-little one back, but your love is what enables him to thrive without his wings. Perhaps that love will be what restores him to de skies.I am asking you to trust me. I wish to try something.If I am correct then de two of you will find yourselves airborne as nature intended!

Title: Scrying Stones
Objective: Find treasures hidden away by magic within Nazjatar.
Text: I have a gift for you.This stone is unlike anything you may have seen before. To the uninformed, it appears to be a simple rock, but it is far more precious than that.This is a scrying stone. It reveals objects that have been hidden by magic. When near an anomaly, the runes etched within will begin to glow.Use the stone to reveal treasure hidden away by ancient magic.

Title: Save Ebonhorn
Objective: Return to the Chamber of Heart and treat Ebonhorn with the Potion of Mental Clarity.

Title: On the Trail of the Black Prince
Objective: Enter the Karazhan Catacombs and search for a cure for Ebonhorn.

Title: To the Catacombs!
Objective: Seek out Wrathion outside the Karazhan Catacombs.
Text: I held out as long as I could, but... the whispers were too strong.You must hurry to Karazhan. The Black Prince said he intended to study the artifacts stored within its catacombs.Please, do not allow my failure to bring about his doom!

Title: Black Winged Shadow
Objective: Seek out Wrathion outside the entrance to Blackwing Descent.
Text: Obviously, the Black Prince isn't here. Trust me when I say he's not an easy one to find.If I were you, I'd make my way to Blackrock Mountain. There's a terrace carved into its slopes, where Nefarian once made his lair.Wrathion has been monitoring that place for a long time. Even if he's not there himself, you might find someone who knows where to look.And ... it's clear you're not the only one searching for him. Watch your back.

Title: Spies to the Left and Right
Objective: Seek out Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists.
Text: Ebonhorn cannot resist the whispers for long. The dark forces that once corrupted the black dragonflight seek to overwhelm the world once again.We need a way to fight back. While I am loathe to mention him, I do know of someone who has been studying the Old Gods in order to better combat their insidious power: Wrathion.The Black Prince will be difficult to find. He has associates in Pandaria, in the Tavern of the Mists at the Veiled Stair. I suggest you begin your search there.Please hurry.

Title: Whispers of N'Zoth
Objective: Speak to Kalecgos in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: We've got an emergency, champion! We need ye in the Chamber o' Heart at once.Somethin' nasty is gettin' into Ebonhorn's head. He can't shake it loose!Maybe ye can help him out!

Title: This One's on Me
Objective: Craft $1oa Junkyard Tinkering items with Pascal-K1N6.
Text: I'm sure you agree that Pascal-K1N6 is the greatest invention you've ever seen!If you're not convinced yet, try to push him to his limits. I don't mind!Bring him more resources and blueprints -- he'll craft anything you need!

Title: Other Interests
Objective: Deliver 5 Disintegrating Sand Sculpture to Steelsage Gao.
Text: Madam Goya is interested in many unusual items other than just rare metals.Keep your eyes out for these particular items during your travels in Nazjatar.Deliver them to me and Madam Goya will consider you for special access.

Title: Pirates, Sea Monsters, Robots
Objective: Recover DeMeza's father's Sword, Clothing and Bones.
Text: I finally found it! This is the resting place of my father, after his crew mutinied and left him here to die.I've scouted the island, and found the locations of three chests that contain mementoes of my father.Do this for me and my family. Recover my father's sword, clothing, and bones from the three chests I've marked.

Title: Other Interests
Objective: Deliver 5 Curious Murloc Horn to Steelsage Gao.
Text: Madam Goya is interested in many unusual items other than just rare metals.Keep your eyes out for these particular items during your travels in Nazjatar.Deliver them to me and Madam Goya will consider you for special access.

Title: Emission Free
Objective: Collect 20 Empty Energy Cells
Text: We're going to need a few Empty Energy Cells to fill out the battery pack on the mount control assembly.See if you can find me these.

Title: Other Interests
Objective: Deliver 5 Unidentified Mass to Steelsage Gao.
Text: Madam Goya is interested in many unusual items other than just rare metals.Keep your eyes out for these particular items during your travels in Nazjatar.Deliver them to me and Madam Goya will consider you for special access.

Title: Blueprint: Extraordinary Adventurer Augment
Objective: Upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database.

Title: Factory Refurbished
Objective: Recycled Crawler Manifold obtained.
Text: I need you to get us a Recycled Crawler Manifold.You should be able to get one up at Junkwatt Depot if you recycle parts found there.

Title: Investigating the Highlands
Objective: Meet Kalecgos in the Twilight Highlands.
Text: When I first sensed these essences, I did not anticipate the importance of the role they would play. It is only a matter of time before all of the dragonflights are brought into the fold.Though I have reached out to the other Aspects, I have yet to hear from Alexstrasza. It is odd that she would be silent while these powers manifest.She was last seen in the Vermillion Redoubt in Twilight Highlands.I fear she may be in trouble. We must hurry.

Title: The Needs of the People
Objective: Speak to people in Mezzamere about things they need.
Text: There are others in the camp that may be in need of aid. Ask around and see if there are any duties that you could take up.Be sure to report what you find to Speaker Utia.

Title: Plug the Geysers
Objective: Seal 6 Unstable Geysers.
Text: There are several geysers nearby that will be erupting soon.Unfortunately, the elements in this area are not stable enough to handle the force of the eruptions.I need someone to plug the geysers while I use the elements to redirect the pressure to a safer area of Nazjatar.Take this sealant and use it to plug the geysers while I work to restore the elemental balance.

Title: Back Out to Sea
Objective: Return to Mezzamere in Nazjatar.
Text: Now that things're under control here, I'm sure they could use your help back in Nazjatar!Why don't ye head back out tae sea, err, or under the sea, tae lend a hand with the new folk there?

Title: Back Out to Sea
Objective: Return to Newhome in Nazjatar.
Text: Now that things're under control here, I'm sure they could use your help back in Nazjatar!Why don't ye head back out tae sea, err, or under the sea, tae lend a hand with the new folk there?

Title: Plug the Geysers
Objective: Seal 7 Unstable Geysers.
Text: The elements are becoming increasingly unstable due to Azshara's abuse of the Tidestone.Geysers will be erupting nearby at any moment. Each eruption threatens to destroy the delicate balance of life on the surface.Take this sealant and use it to plug the geysers while I work to restore the elemental balance and redistribute the explosive underground pressure to a safer location.

Title: A Tempered Blade
Objective: Slay 15 naga with Bladesman Inowari.
Text: These blades that I wield are newly forged. The time has come to temper them in the blood of my enemies.I have heard that you are skilled in the ways of battle. I too am proficient in the business of death and I would be honored to fight at your side.Accompany me, and together we will spill the blood of our enemies.

Title: Plug the Geysers
Objective: Seal 5 Unstable Geysers and slay the Disturbed Algan.
Text: There are several geysers nearby that will be erupting soon.Unfortunately, the elements in this area are not stable enough to handle the force of the eruptions.I need someone to plug the geysers while I use the elements to redirect the pressure to a safer area of Nazjatar.Take this sealant and use it to plug the geysers while I work to restore the elemental balance.

Title: Plug the Geysers
Objective: Seal 7 Unstable Geysers.
Text: The geysers are dangerously unstable and will be erupting any moment now.I fear that Azshara's misuse of the Tidestone is causing irreparable damage to the elements within Nazjatar.We have to do what we can to prevent any further destruction.Take this sealant and use it to stave off the next round of eruptions. In the meantime, I will do what I can to stabilize the elements.

Title: Turn the Scale
Objective: Collect 20 Hydra Scales.
Text: I am in need of your help. I have been hunting the nearby hydras for their scales, but my weapon was broken in the melee.The scales of the hydra make durable and resilient armor for our warriors. Our clan requires the scales to craft and repair our armor.If we do not resupply soon, we will be ill-equipped in our fight against the naga.

Title: Plug the Geysers
Objective: Seal 5 Unstable Geysers and slay the Disturbed Algan.
Text: The geysers are dangerously unstable and will be erupting any moment now.I fear that Azshara's misuse of the Tidestone is causing irreparable damage to the elements within Nazjatar.We have to do what we can to prevent any further destruction.Take this sealant and use it to stave off the next round of eruptions. In the meantime, I will do what I can to stabilize the elements.

Title: Where They Hide
Objective: Use the Fresh Sponge to reveal and kill 5 Zanj'ir Assassins.
Text: The naga are sending assassins to eliminate our forces.They hide nearby and murder those they cannot steal away to the slave pens.Take this special sea sponge with you. The spores will reveal the naga in all their treachery.Once revealed, slay the assassins before they can flee for reinforcements.Azshara will fall!

Title: Making Kelpberry Wine
Objective: Deliver Kelpberry Wine to Maedin in Maedin's Challenge.

Title: Poen's Favorite Dish
Objective: Collect 15 Fresh Unagi.
Text: Poen is always helping us take care of every rescue we find.Can you collect some meat from the eels south of here?I like to make his favorite dish every now and then, to repay him.It also has a great effect on the ones recovering.The power of deliciousness, I tell you!

Title: Most Delicious Clams
Objective: Collect 10 Neptulian Clams.
Text: Neptulian clams are an important part of the ankoan diet.Many forget how important proper nutrition is during a time of war. A warrior can be armed with the finest weapons and training, but if she is not healthy and well-nourished she will be ineffective in battle.Now that Mezzamere is home to your Alliance, we must work hard to gather enough food to feed our soldiers.Gather as many Neptulian clams as you can find and I will see that they make it back to camp safely.

Title: Kill the Kritch
Objective: Kill the Kritch.
Text: Mrgglrr! Mrlg rmglr grlmrrgrr, grmm mrgl grrmrrgllrr.Grrmrlgr mrg lrglgllmrrglm mlr mrlglmrgm mrl Kriiitchrglgr.Mrglrmgr lrg, mrgglmmmr! Mrlg grrrrml lrg.

Title: The Fate of Professor Elryna
Objective: Defeat the Snapdragon Matriarch, collect the Memory Core, and activate the Memory Pylon to witness the fate of Professor Elryna.
Text: From the looks of it, Elryna's story should have a very interesting end. This pylon here has been acting up, but I think I know why!These things use memory cores, little crystals found within the center of the orb. I bet there's one in that old magi tower.There's a snapdragon that's bigger than the terrormaws in there so here, keep the scroll for now. It should help in your fight. She's a big one!

Title: Old Nasha's Paw
Objective: Take Old Nasha's paw to the Honeyback Hivemother for a reward.
Text: The old bear's paw is sticky with honey. She likely ransacked a number of hives before you stopped her.The Hivemother will be interested in this item.

Title: Call to Arms: Nazjatar
Objective: Slay Alliance within Nazjatar.
Text: Our objectives in Nazjatar are being interrupted by the influx of Alliance scum.Clear as many of them out of the area that you find, then report back.

Title: Feed Them All
Objective: Collect 10 Fathom Flesh.
Text: I am grateful for the help that your Alliance has given my people, but we are desperately short on food and supplies.If we do not gather enough supplies to take care of both the Alliance and my clan, we will run out of food within the week.Thankfully, there appears to be an abundance of fathom rays in the area, but I will need help hunting them in order to gather enough food for our camp.Take this fathom hook and use it to pull down the fathom rays from above.

Title: Blueprint: Advanced Adventurer Augment
Objective: Upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database.

Title: Heroic Warfront: The Battle for Stromgarde
Objective: Defeat the Horde at the Battle for Stromgarde.
Text: If the Horde thinks it can assault Stromgarde, it is sorely mistaken! We will not let Arathi fall!Prepare yourself for battle.

Title: Heroic Warfront: The Battle for Stromgarde
Objective: Defeat the Alliance at the Battle for Stromgarde.
Text: Our enemies are relentless in their quest to seize Arathi for themselves. We will never allow it to fall into their hands! We must stop them before the keep is rebuilt!Take up arms. The Alliance is upon us.

Title: Drowning the Horde
Objective: Kill 25 Horde players in Nazjatar while in War Mode.
Text: We must strike now before the Horde have a chance to gain a secure foothold. Attack their champions and knock them on their heels.

Title: Security First
Objective: Defeat Rare enemies on the island of Mechagon.
Text: Many dangerous creatures and allies of my father still seek to destroy us.Help secure this island, seek out and and eliminate five of our most powerful enemies.

Title: Security First
Objective: Defeat Rare enemies on the island of Mechagon.
Text: Many dangerous creatures and allies of my father still seek to destroy us.Help secure this island, seek out and and eliminate five of our most powerful enemies.

Title: Seams to be a Problem
Objective: Ask Instructor Ulooaka about the Osmenite Dust.

Title: Adapt, Improve, Overcome!
Objective: 20 Pristine Hound Bolts, 4 Steel Tibia XS, and 2 Machined Heel Nut.
Text: Izira Gearsworn is still alive, she is Rustbolt's strongest fighter, but her legs are broken. If we're going to survive I need parts to repair and upgrade her.There are machines all over with parts we can salvage. With some perseverance we should be able to fix Izira's legs.Help me obtain the following parts.

Title: Recyclable Parts
Objective: Collect 1 Bundle of Recyclable Parts

Title: The Waveblade Ankoan
Objective: Complete any 4 world quests in Nazjatar.
Text: Assist the Ankoan in Nazjatar by completing 4 world quests.

Title: The Unshackled
Objective: Complete any 4 world quests in Nazjatar.
Text: Assist the Unshackled in Nazjatar by completing 4 world quests.

Title: Snap Back
Objective: Use the Scroll of Busting Power on Snapdragon Terrormaws and slay snapdragons in Nar'anan.
Text: I have a favor to ask of you, if you would be so kind.Scrollsage Nola gave me this scroll to protect me on my adventures here in Nazjatar. She is a kind soul, but her scroll-work isn't always the most...accurate.You look like a brave adventurer who's seen a thing or two. Could you test out the scroll for me? While you're there you may as well cull their numbers a tad.

Title: Defensive in Death
Objective: Ask Instructor Ulooaka about the tentacles of the Zin'anthid.

Title: Legacy of Nar'anan
Objective: Activate the Memory Pylons in Nar'anan and witness what happened.
Text: Hey there. Mind helping me out?You see, I found these pylons here and it seems they contain memories from a notable Highborne who lived here long ago.I can't get any closer to the rest of em' because of the snapdragons. Especially the terrormaws...Can you go and activate the pylons for me? We Tortollans love old things, and this is a potential goldmine!Oh, and be sure to write down what you see!

Title: Ounces of Osmenite
Objective: Ask Instructor Ulooaka about the Osmenite Shards.

Title: Leaving the Hive
Objective: Speak to Barry in the Honeyback Hatchery.
Text: Barry might know what's going on.

Title: Usurper's Scent Gland
Objective: Take the Usurper's Scent Gland to the Honeyback Hivemother for a reward.
Text: When a new queen is born and old enough to start proliferating her own hive, she will leave the nest. Her scent will attract some of the hive to fly with her to their new home. This one likely never got the chance to do so, thanks to you.The Hivemother will be interested in this item.

Title: Hivethief's Jelly Stash
Objective: Take the Hivethief's Jelly Stash to the Honeyback Hivemother for a reward.
Text: This ettin was a well known and oft dreaded face among the bees of the Honeyback hive. Their jelly stores will benefit from his demise.The Hivemother will be interested in this item.

Title: Blueprint: Experimental Adventurer Augment
Objective: Upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database.

Title: Blueprint: Holographic Digitalization Relay
Objective: Upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database.

Title: Unsafe Work Conditions
Objective: 15 attacking bots slain.
Text: Those rampaging bots ain't lettin' up!We're payin' good money for the best and brightest goblins on the planet, and I ain't gonna let some malfunctionin' machinery take 'em outta the shift schedule.This is textbook unsafe working conditions, and the Greasemonkey Union reps are givin' me an earful for it. Protect the workers!

Title: Bot Rampage
Objective: 15 attacking bots slain.
Text: Those bots have been attacking us from the moment we landed. We've got to hold this beach!My expedition guards could use your help . Lend a hand, destroy bots on the beach and in the nearby woodlands.

Title: Dark Tides
Objective: Slay Tidemistress Ethendriss.
Text: A Tidemistress leads the naga in this area.She is performing some damnable ritual outside, demanding sacrifices of our soldiers.Stop her before more of our own meet a cruel fate.

Title: Assault: The Black Empire
Objective: Drive back the N'Zoth Assault in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: I cannot believe my eyes. The Black Empire is materializing right here in the Vale!We must spring to action!

Title: Stolen Power
Objective: Collect 8 Scrolls of Shirakess.
Text: From the void these naga pull their strength.Each scroll they record, shared knowledge -- that knowledge is power.It stands to reason, if we take away their knowledge, we steal their power.My logic may be flawed, but let's do it anyway!

Title: De-Synced Vibro Blade
Objective: Give the De-Synced Vibro Blade to Ricket in Rustbolt.
Text: The wildly shaking blade reminds you of the blades the Rustbolt defenders use. No doubt someone will be able to fix it up.

Title: De-Synced Vibro Blade
Objective: Give the De-Synced Vibro Blade to Sapphronetta Flivvers in Rustbolt.
Text: The wildly shaking blade reminds you of the blades the Rustbolt defenders use. No doubt someone will be able to fix it up.

Title: The Final Act
Objective: Kill Bondo Bigblock.
Text: Those of us with enough mechanization survived, but it didn't matter. Bondo Bigblock sold us out. In exchange for full mechanization, he built giant bots and attacked Rustbolt.He will continue to act against us, till those few of us left are dead.We must remove this threat immediately.

Title: Working with Purpose
Objective: Collect 6 Iridescent Pearls from Chittershell Clams.
Text: It seems the Shirakess are never satisfied with the number of pearls we source for them. They're always demanding more.Before you came along, it was my job to crawl around the cavern, cracking open clams.So you see, you have some purpose, other than being a mindless sack of flesh.

Title: We Can't Have Dull Weapons
Objective: Find the special weaponry within Zanj'ir Terrace.
Text: For a squid head, you sure are making my life easier.I guess you get to live long enough to complete another task.Our new weapons are forged from some foreign material that I don't quite trust.You won't catch me sharpening any blades, but the work still needs to get done.Get to it!

Title: Send the Fleet
Objective: Speak to Captain Rez'okun to set sail.
Text: The Warchief has entrusted me with a mission of the highest priority.The mission will succeed, of this there is no question, but to ensure that any obstacles I encounter are dealt with swiftly I once again have need of your particular skills.The Zandalari have offered us use of their ships for this endeavor. Clear out whatever affairs you have remaining and report to Captain Rez'okun when you are ready to set sail.

Title: Deck 'Em
Objective: Recover Adalin's Hearthstone Cards.
Text: That ooze seems really hungry!He ate my backpack, compass, pickaxe and my hearthstone cards.Get my cards back!

Title: Send the Fleet
Objective: Speak to Harbormaster Cyrus Crestfall to set sail.
Text: This war has cost us dearly, but victory will soon be in our grasp.What remains of the Horde fleet has departed Zuldazar and our spies say that the Banshee Queen's hand sails at their helm.This is our chance! With one strike we can eliminate what remains of their fleet and rid Azeroth of Blightcaller's filth once and for all!The fleet is preparing to depart, report to the Harbormaster when you are ready to set sail.

Title: We Can't Have Dull Weapons
Objective: Find the special weaponry within Zanj'ir Terrace.
Text: For a squid head, you sure are making my life easier.I guess you get to live long enough to complete another task.Our new weapons are forged from some foreign material that I don't quite trust.You won't catch me sharpening any blades, but the work still needs to get done.Get to it!

Title: Stealing the Naga's Secrets
Objective: Steal the Azerite weaponry and fight your way out of Zanj'ir Terrace!

Title: Working with Purpose
Objective: Collect 6 Iridescent Pearls from Chittershell Clams.
Text: It seems the Shirakess are never satisfied with the number of pearls we source for them. They're always demanding more.Before you came along, it was my job to crawl around the cavern, cracking open clams.So you see, you have some purpose, other than being a mindless sack of flesh.

Title: Stealing the Naga's Secrets
Objective: Steal the Azerite weaponry and fight your way out of Zanj'ir Terrace!

Title: The Wolf's Offensive
Objective: Meet with Genn Greymane on the Wind's Redemption.
Text: Champion, Spymaster Shaw reports that the remains of the Horde fleet is preparing to depart.They will be easy pickings for our superior forces. Let us seize this opportunity to eliminate their threat once and for all!Preparations are underway to set sail. Come to Boralus Harbor and meet with me upon the Wind's Redemption with all haste!

Title: The Warchief's Order
Objective: Meet with Nathanos Blightcaller on The Banshee's Wail.
Text: Champion, the Dark Lady summons you. The time has come to set her plan into motion.Our warships are ready to embark. The key to victory over the Alliance is within our grasp.Meet me in Zuldazar, aboard the Banshee's Wail. What we do next... we do for the Horde.

Title: Most Delicious Clams
Objective: Collect 10 Neptulian Clams.
Text: This pool is filled with creepy fish.It is also the home of some of the most delicious clams you will ever eat. Fresh water somehow mixes into the ocean water in this one part of Nazjatar, and that gives the meat a totally new flavor.Every now and then, we come down here and collect them for our friends in Newhome.We could sure use some help with all these extra mouths to feed!

Title: Mgglurky's Mugglrgl
Objective: Retrieve Mgglurky's Mugglrgl from Bloodfin Village.
Text: My cook, Mgglurky, lost his mugglrgl and he's refusing to work until he gets it back.I've got a bar full of hungry murlocs and nothing to feed them until Mgglurky starts cooking. If Mgglurky doesn't find his mugglrgl soon, we're going to have a riot on our hands!I don't know about you, but I definitely don't want to be the main course tonight.There were some Bloodfins lurking around earlier. Search Bloodfin Village for the mugglrgl and bring it back to me once you find it.

Title: We've Got Crabs!
Objective: Collect 12 Crackleclaw Crabs.
Text: , you're just in time. Everything's ready for the crab hunt!Okay, okay... I know what you're thinking. A founding member of D.E.H.T.A. that condones hunting?I'm going to level with you. I've got a bar full of hungry murlocs that only eat three things: crabs, fish, and people.If that's not reason enough, crabs are overpopulated in this region and they're decimating the local grub worm population!How many innocent grub worms need to die before we do something?

Title: Do Not Drink
Objective: Recover 12 containers of Stolen Oil.
Text: These troggs watch everything we do.They see us pouring oil into various machines, so now they're stealing the oil and drinking it. I think they believe it's going to turn them into machines!We need that oil back, before they drink it all!

Title: Drunk Angry Murlocs
Objective: Collect 12 Ocean "Infused" Lagers.
Text: Those no-good Bloodfins ran off with all of the beer!I've been experimenting with brews that only use ingredients native to Nazjatar, but it's still a work in progress. For now, I must rely on whatever I can scrounge up from the shipwreck.My supply of beer was already limited, but now it's all gone thanks to those thieving Bloodfin murlocs! We're going to have some very angry customers here if we don't get it back.Please recover the stolen lager from Bloodfin Village before it's too late!

Title: We Can Fix It
Objective: Collect 40 Spare Parts and 1 Energy Cell from enemies in Junkwatt Depot.

Title: Extra Shiny
Objective: Collect 10 Imbued Pearls.
Text: In the pools below are some small, lovely pearls.They were tossed in during some Azsh'ari ritual.Do they mean something? I have no idea. But I would like to have some of them.Be a lovely heavyfoot and go grab some for me, please!

Title: A Little Edge
Objective: Collect 12 Chitterspine Spines.
Text: In the darkest cavern. Below the naga city. You will find them.Creepy little crabs with sharp and pointy spines.I think we can find a way to use them. Projectiles didn't work so well in water, but now...Harvest some for us!Be careful, some of them are much sneakier than they have any right to be.

Title: A Good Offense
Objective: Kill 50 naga.
Text: Korl was told to watch the naga, so watching the naga I am.They're bad, friend, you know... just... terrible, horrible, bad monsters.I don't think I can just watch any more.They say the best defense is.. something...Help me teach them being being bad gets you smashed!

Title: Break a Few Eggs
Objective: Destroy 10 Deepcoil Eggs.
Text: This chamber is lovely and terrifying.What is born here will ruin the lives of so many.We cannot hurt the pods, but we can destroy the eggs of the serpents that guard them.Take out the eggs, every little bit helps.Poor eggs...

Title: Iteration is Key
Objective: Collect an Overcharged Mecha-core from the Overcharged Mechanocrawler.
Text: You've been holding out on me!Here I was, thinking that we're friends now and yet you neglected to tell me about your magnificient wrench!Well, not too magnificient... I recognize the Ub3r-Spanner from its blueprints, but whoever built this lacks a certain level of craftsmanship.I will upgrade it for you. Bring me the Overcharged Mecha-core from a mechanocrawler.No excuses. I will fix your mistakes.

Title: Turn the Scale
Objective: Collect 20 Hydra Scales from nearby hydra.
Text: I have been trying to gather some of the scales from the young hydra nearby.Their flexibility and strength makes them incredibly versatile.With all the cranky old hydra tromping around, I don't stand much of a chance.Can you gather some up for me?

Title: A Safer Place
Objective: Escort Mrrl back to Mezzamere.

Title: Supplies From the Waveblade Ankoan
Objective: Speak with Speaker Utia in Mezzamere for your reward.
Text: The Waveblade Ankoan appreciate all the aid you've provided.Please take these supplies as a token of our gratitude, and a promise of more to come, should you continue to help us.

Title: Clearing Out the Cache
Objective: Deal with Priscilla Ashvane and her minions.

Title: Sating Snapdragons
Objective: Collect Chitterspine Roe and feed it to Savage Snapdragons.
Text: It's time for the snapdragons to feed, but it's a job best left to someone a little more expendable.The beasts will eat anything, including your arm if you don't move it away quickly enough.Luckily for you, they've developed a taste for Chitterspine Roe.

Title: Rustbolt Rebellion
Objective: Aid the Rustbolt resistance.
Text: Aid the Rustbolt resistance.

Title: Abduction Reduction
Objective: Free 6 captured Mechagnomes and catch them before they hit the ground.
Text: We got actual ABDUCTIONS happenin' here!Honest to gold, flying robots are swoopin' into town and snatchin' up people like it's closin' time at Gallywix's buffet!Lucky for the Rustbolt Resistance, Gazlowe called in me and my explosives to save the day.You wanna pitch in? Take one of my rocket launchers and blast those containment crates outta the sky.Whatever they've got trapped inside will come tumblin' down real fast, so you gotta run underneath and catch 'em.

Title: Redistribution of Power
Objective: Use the NRG-100 to charge 6 energy cells.
Text: Welcome back, dear test subject.Today's experiment is......My pet project, the NRG-100!I am quite pleased with the potential improvements I've made to efficiency, potency, and destructivity.And the only thing I had to sacrifice was stability!When you're ready to proceed, strap on the NRG-100.

Title: Rico's Rescue
Objective: Rescue Trooper Levy, Katrin, and Bybee.
Text: Some of our Roughriders are missing, I tried to find them, but got pinned down here by the bugs!I could really use your help. See if you can save my missing troopers.

Title: Plug the Geysers
Objective: Seal all of the unstable geysers.
Text: Earthquakes! Snakes! Water coming from every direction.What is going on around here?Neri said to plug some holes in the defenses - didn't think she'd mean it literally.Take some of this goo, next eruption, stick it in the hole.

Title: To Soar Like a Ray
Objective: Bring back 7 fathom ray eggs.
Text: I like to find the eggs of the fathom rays before they hatch so we can form a bond with them.At least, when we can't swim, we can fly!Bring me a few more eggs to start a new thing - we'll call them Rayriders!

Title: Plug the Geysers
Objective: Seal all of the unstable geysers.
Text: Have you heard about the geysers?All over the newly exposed areas, water trying to fill where it was pulled away.The ocean, she is angry. I don't think she likes Azshara either.We will keep filling this in until we can find a permanent fix.

Title: Plug the Geysers
Objective: Seal all of the unstable geysers.
Text: We have been keeping an eye out for these unstable geysers.Since the water went away, the ocean has been trying to find a way back in.If we let it burst up just anywhere, we could all be doomed!Help me plug these up!Be careful, though, I found out the hard way they have a bit of a kick.

Title: Plug the Geysers
Objective: Seal all of the unstable geysers.
Text: Just keep watching this spot... any second now...Once those geysers start firing, get in there and seal them up.The more they shake, the more everything breaks apart!We have to keep these things under control.

Title: Plug the Geysers
Objective: Seal all of the unstable geysers.
Text: We're getting a geyser hit any minute now.The effects of the Tidestone are far-reaching.We have to do what we can to prevent any further destruction.Use this sealant to stall off the next round of eruptions!

Title: Kill the Kritch
Objective: Kill the Kritch.
Text: Mrgglrr! Mrlg rmglr grlmrrgrr, grmm mrgl grrmrrgllrr.Grrmrlgr mrg lrglgllmrrglm mlr mrlglmrgm mrl Kriiitchrglgr.Mrglrmgr lrg, mrgglmmmr! Mrlg grrrrml lrg.

Title: Where They Hide
Objective: Use the Fresh Sponge to reveal and kill 5 Zanj'ir Assassins.
Text: Those sneaky snakes have started to send assassins.They hide nearby and kill those they cannot take away to the slave pens.Even the sponges want to be rid of them!The spores will reveal the naga treachery... and then you can go ahead and kill them.We must keep our people safe!

Title: Sea Slug Liquidation
Objective: Collect 8 Bioluminescent Ooze from Luminescent Sea Slugs within Bloodfin Village.
Text: The Azerite refinement process creates a byproduct that is invisible to the naked eye, but is easily seen with refracted bioluminescent light.The sea floor is littered with creatures that produce just what we need to track down this weapons cache.

Title: Let the Residue Lead You
Objective: Follow the residue trail to locate the Azerite Weapons Cache.
Text: I've fashioned a device that will emit bioluminescent light when toggled on, allowing you to see any Azerite residue that lingers.It should give you a clear trail to the weapons cache.Good luck.

Title: Coveted Crystals
Objective: Collect a Deepsea Crystal from Hoarder Moarrgl.
Text: Locating the weapons cache shouldn't be a problem once we have the proper tools. A little light and a lot of bioluminescent fluid is all we need!It all seems rather simple, doesn't it? But the key is in the Deepsea Crystal used to refract the light.I am told that the Bloodfin tribe covets these crystals, so it shouldn't be too much trouble to get your hands on one.

Title: Clearing Out the Cache
Objective: Deal with Priscilla Ashvane and her minions.

Title: Scouting Undercover
Objective: Scout Zanj'ir Terrace while pretending to be mind-shackled.
Text: Entering the stronghold alone would be a death wish.The Zanj'ir slaughter outsiders on sight.The only way to get in without being killed is to appear to be under the effects of a zoatroid.Even then, the mind-shackled are put to work.You must obey all commands, or they will know your mind is still your own.Once the Zanj'ir believe you are mind-shackled, it should be easier to navigate their domain and uncover their secret.

Title: Gather Friends
Objective: Collect Sandclaw Crabs and Muck Creepers for Narm.
Text: Outside is dangerous.It is safe in the Kelfin Pocket.We find the lost crabs, and slugs, and other friends.Here they get a new name and a new home.Find friends like these, and bring them home.

Title: The Price is Death
Objective: Kill 10 naga within Zanj'ir wash and the Deepsea Slave Pens.
Text: We've long believed that the ocean is big enough for all that wish to call it home.Unfortunately, the naga don't see it that way.They kill and capture our kind without remorse, and it's about time they paid the price.

Title: Deteriorating Knowledge
Objective: Rescue Fenn, Kono, and Esma from the clutches of mind-leeching Zoatroids.
Text: The kelfin are no strangers to Azshara's cruelty.She commands creatures of darkness that entrap my kind and warp their minds. They eat away at their memories until nothing's left but an empty husk.If you can get to them soon, perhaps they'll still be in a state worth saving.

Title: What We Know of the Naga
Objective: Tend to the Kelfin's wounds and hear what Fenn has to say about the naga.
Text: It feels good to be me again. I have you to thank for that.My head still hurts from the zoatroid's influence, but I think the others are worse off.Put some of this salve on their wounds, and I'll do my best to tell you what I know about the naga.

Title: Insight into Our Enemies
Objective: Speak to Neri to learn more about the naga within Nazjatar.
Text: There's no telling what awaits us within this land. We cannot press forward without first knowing exactly what we're up against.Although our new allies have suffered greatly at the hands of the naga, their hardships will not be in vain.The kelfin should have invaluable knowledge of Azshara's forces.With their help, we might be able to learn more about how our enemies operate.Speak with Neri and see what insight she can provide.

Title: Essential Empowerment
Objective: Meet Magni in the repaired Chamber of Heart in Silithus.
Text: Champion, excitin' news!I know yer busy dealin' with the naga threat right now, but we need ye to come back tae the Chamber of Heart! MOTHER's finally finished her calculations and she's got an idea of what tae do next!Hurry back tae Silithus as quick as ye can. Azeroth needs ye!

Title: Forbidden Rituals
Objective: Collect 8 Tomes of Binding.
Text: The naga use dark, forbidden rituals to subjugate the elements to their will.But such rituals threaten to destroy the elemental balance that binds this world together. The rituals must be stopped.Fortunately, the rituals the naga use are too elaborate to commit to memory. The ritual instructions are contained within ancient texts.If we destroy the ancient tomes that contain the rituals, the knowledge will be lost to the naga forever.Retrieve the tomes and I will see that they are destroyed

Title: Let the Residue Lead You
Objective: Follow the residue trail to locate the Azerite Weapons Cache.
Text: I have fashioned a device that will emit bioluminescent light when toggled on, allowing you to see any Azerite residue that lingers.It should give you a clear trail to the weapons cache.Good luck.

Title: Bounty: Dangerous Creatures
Objective: Kill 1 rare creature in Nazjatar.
Text: There are creatures in Nazjatar that are far more dangerous than their peers. I leave it to you to find them and defeat them.When you've done your part, report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

Title: Sea Slug Liquidation
Objective: Collect 8 Bioluminescent Ooze from Luminescent Sea Slugs within Bloodfin Village.
Text: My brief studies have shown that the refinement process creates a byproduct that is invisible to the naked eye, but is easily seen with refracted bioluminescent light.The sea floor is littered with creatures that produce just what we need to track down this weapons cache.

Title: Bounty: Elite Naga Forces
Objective: Kill 5 elite naga.
Text: Strike at the elite naga forces within Nazjatar. Once we remove some of their leadership, our people will be able to move about more freely.Report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

Title: Plans of Attack
Objective: Collect 8 Assault Plans.
Text: Orders from our queen:Queen Azshara has commanded that all naga forces prepare for a full assault upon the Alliance invaders in our land. Details for the attack have been distributed to your various unit commanders.The Alliance shall tremble at the might of our queen!

Title: Bounty: More Fathom Rays
Objective: Kill 15 fathom rays.
Text: The fathom ray population is eating all of the coral buds to the east. If we do not cull their numbers, we may have an environmental catastrophe on our hands.Once you have finished, report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

Title: Bounty: More Crabs
Objective: Kill 25 crabs.
Text: The crab population is expanding too quickly within Nazjatar, endangering local plant life. Cull their numbers in our conservation effort.Report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

Title: Bounty: More Makrura
Objective: Kill 15 makrura.
Text: The makrura have been a thorn in our side for too long. They are aggressive towards almost all species in Nazjatar and are very dangerous in groups. Less of them in our waters would certainly benefit our cause.Once you are done, report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

Title: Bounty: More Murlocs
Objective: Kill 25 murlocs.
Text: While murlocs are often only a nuisance, certain factions are becoming more of a danger to our people. It is time we work together to preserve our safety while moving about Nazjatar.Put an end to some of the more aggressive murlocs and the quartermaster will award you.

Title: Bounty: More Snapdragons
Objective: Kill 15 snapdragons.
Text: Snapdragons are one of the most dangerous species on Nazjatar. The naga breed them for the viciousness and their ability as trackers.If we hope to keep our positions hidden from the naga, we must take out these groups of snapdragons immediately.After you are done, report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

Title: Bounty: A Few Snapdragons
Objective: Kill 10 snapdragons.
Text: Snapdragons are one of the most dangerous species on Nazjatar. The naga breed them for the viciousness and their ability as trackers.If we hope to keep our positions hidden from the naga, we must take out these groups of snapdragons immediately.After you are done, report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

Title: Bounty: More Coral Ancients
Objective: Kill 7 coral ancients.
Text: Coral ancients are beginning to awaken from their long slumber. I warn you, these are very dangerous creatures of immense size and power. If more of them begin to awaken, our forces will be in great danger.Once you have defeated some of these ancients, report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

Title: Bounty: A Few Coral Ancients
Objective: Kill 3 Coral Ancients.
Text: Coral ancients are beginning to awaken from their long slumber. I warn you, these are very dangerous creatures of immense size and power. If more of them begin to awaken, our forces will be in great danger.Once you have defeated some of these ancients, report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

Title: Bounty: More Naga
Objective: Kill 25 naga.
Text: The naga are our true enemy. All other efforts in Nazjatar are second to disrupting the naga's operations. If you want to be an asset to our cause then destroying the enemy is a quick way to earn your way here.When you have completed your task, report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

Title: Bounty: A Few Fathom Rays
Objective: Kill 10 fathom rays.
Text: The fathom ray population is eating all of the coral buds to the east. If we do not cull their numbers, we may have an environmental catastrophe on our hands.Once you have finished, report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

Title: Bounty: A Few Makrura
Objective: Kill 10 makrura.
Text: The makrura have been a thorn in our side for too long. They are aggressive towards almost all species in Nazjatar and are very dangerous in groups. Less of them in our waters would certainly benefit our cause.Once you are done, report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

Title: Bounty: A Few Hydras
Objective: Kill 10 hydras.
Text: Our forces are desperately outmatched when it comes to the hydras. They are ferocious, tenacious, and deadly. We have retreated almost entirely out of the western region of Nazjatar.If we are going to hold the line against the naga, we need to make sure the western region is safe for our forces. Destroy as many hydras as you can manage, then report to the quartermaster.

Title: Bounty: A Few Crabs
Objective: Kill 15 crabs.
Text: The crab population is expanding too quickly within Nazjatar, endangering local plant life. Cull their numbers in our conservation effort.Report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

Title: Bounty: A Few Murlocs
Objective: Kill 15 murlocs.
Text: While murlocs are often only a nuisance, certain factions are becoming more of a danger to our people. It is time we work together to preserve our safety while moving about Nazjatar.Put an end to some of the more aggressive murlocs and the quartermaster will award you.

Title: Bounty: More Hydras
Objective: Kill 15 hydras.
Text: Our forces are desperately outmatched when it comes to the hydras. They are ferocious, tenacious, and deadly. We have retreated almost entirely out of the western region of Nazjatar.If we are going to hold the line against the naga, we need to make sure the western region is safe for our forces. Destroy as many hydras as you can manage, then report to the quartermaster.

Title: Aim High
Objective: 12 Rustwing Ravens slain.
Text: This conspiracy of ravens is preying on citizens of Rustbolt, it's unacceptable!Prince Erazmin has asked me to reduce their numbers, but I could really use your help. Can you help me kill some of them?Use my marker gun if you need it. I'll blast the ones you mark, and help bring them down.

Title: The Other Place
Objective: Scan 10 Clockwork Giants.
Text: In my travels of the many possible futures, I discovered another place much like Rustbolt, but different.In this other time and place, very little is alive, everything is machines.You must travel to this other place. You will scan the memory banks of the Clockwork Giants you find there. Then we will use that data to ensure that our Rustbolt never becomes the other place.

Title: Other Interests
Objective: Deliver 5 Particularly Dense Rock to Steelsage Gao.
Text: Madam Goya is interested in many unusual items other than just rare metals.Keep your eyes out for these particular items during your travels in Nazjatar.Deliver them to me and Madam Goya will consider you for special access.

Title: Bounty: A Few Naga
Objective: Kill 15 naga.
Text: The naga are our true enemy. All other efforts in Nazjatar are second to disrupting the naga's operations. If you want to be an asset to our cause then destroying the enemy is a quick way to earn your way here.When you have completed your task, report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

Title: The Direhorn Mother's Fury
Objective: Clear a path to the Greater Wayshrine in the Antul'Mita Plateau.
Text: This one protects de faithful who still seek de shrine.You will take your companion and show them de fury of a mother direhorn.Trust in your young friend. She has always known how to fight.Open de way. Slay de heretics that defile our loa's shrine.

Title: Wander Not Alone
Objective: Speak to Torcali.
Text: She is here. I can feel her eyes upon us.My loa is generous. She will reward you for de service you have given her.Great Wanderer guide your path.

Title: Requisition: We Need It All
Objective: Collect resources from around Nazjatar.
Text: We are dangerously low on all of our supplies. Please, you must go out and collect as much as you can.Please return with any resources you find to the quartermaster!

Title: Mountain On the Move
Objective: Speak to Torcali.
Text: I have seen such fervor only once before.In times of peril, Torcali may call upon her children to defend her and those she looks after.It is likely she called your beast away. Go to her and see how you can help.

Title: Heresy at the Crossroad
Objective: Meet Jo'nok at the Antul'Mita Plateau in Nazmir.
Text: My followers undertook a pilgrimage to a place called the Antul'Mita Plateau. It is regarded as the crossroads of Zandalar among my faithful and is the site of a Greater Wayshrine.I sense some great peril has fallen upon them.I have sent my children and my champion, Jo'nok, to their aid. Your charge is among them. Go to her and ensure that my acolytes reach the shrine safely.Let nothing stand in your way.

Title: The Tide Turns
Objective: Assault the naga camp and seize control of the Tidestone of Golganneth.
Text: The time to strike is now. We must take the Tidestone of Golganneth and the Javelin of Suramar is our best chance of piercing the barrier around it. Every minute we wait is another minute when the sea can come crashing down on us. What forces we have will be arrayed below, just outside their encampment. We will need your strength in addition to the Javelin. We do not have enough forces to take it on our own.

Title: Requisition: More Flotsam
Objective: Collect 5 Piles of Flotsam.
Text: I have seen piles of flotsam in the sands to the west. If you could go out and scrounge anything useful from the debris, it could prove useful. Beware, that area is a hydra breeding ground and they have been growing more aggressive since the water receded.Once you've gathered some supplies, return to the quartermaster for your reward.

Title: Requisition: More Cone Shells
Objective: Collect 5 Impregnable Cone Shell.
Text: If we are going to arm ourselves against the naga, we will need far more supplies and armaments. Cone Shells make most of our armor and weapons. It's light, it's strong, and it's plentiful in this region. However, our supplies are running short and our forces need support.If you find yourself carrying Impregnable Cone Shells, please leave your stores with the quartermaster.

Title: Requisition: More Deepcoral Buds
Objective: Collect 5 Deepcoral Buds.
Text: Many species feed on the deepcoral buds from the tall columns that grow in the east. Fathom rays feed on these buds especially. We use the buds as lures for fathom rays to use as mounts. But with our stores so low, we will not be able to provide the air support we need across Nazjatar.If you could gather more Deepcoral Buds and return them to the quartermaster, you will surely be rewarded.

Title: Requisition: More Seaweed
Objective: Collect 5 Sticky Seaweed.
Text: We have so many wounded and we are dangerously low on seaweed bandages. If you find Sticky Seaweed, please give it to the quartermaster.

Title: Requisition: More Carp
Objective: Return 5 Struggling Carps to water.
Text: Our local sea life is in danger! If you spot a fish out of water, please return it to the nearest lake, stream, or river. Conservation is everyone's responsibility!

Title: Requisition: More Spiral Leaf
Objective: Collect 5 Poisonous Spiral Leaf.
Text: We are dangerously low on our medicine stores. If you find any Spiral Leaf, please leave your stores with the quartermaster.I should warn you, Spiral Leaf is immensely poisonous. Make sure to handle it with care. Some symptoms of spiral leaf poisoning include bouts of rage, immense bursts of strength, and murderous impulses. If you are exposed, find some naga and use your murderous energy for good.

Title: Old Allies
Objective: Meet with allies in the Cleft of Shadows in Orgrimmar.
Text: Sylvanas Windrunner was once my ranger-general. Now she is my warchief. Through peacetime and war, I followed her orders.Until now.Baine is a noble soul. His execution would drive a blade into the very heart of the Horde.We must save him. It is the only way to preserve who we are. What we stand for.I have reached out to allies who will help you. But in siding with them, you will put your own life in peril.If you feel as I do, then meet them in the Cleft of Shadows. Good luck.

Title: Payment in Kind
Objective: Meet with Anduin Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.
Text: , King Anduin has requested our presence in Stormwind.We've sent him reports on our situation here in Nazjatar, and he understands the severity of the threat we're facing. For him to pull both of us back from the front lines, it must be a matter of grave importance.I will meet you in Stormwind Keep.

Title: Requisition: More Kelp Buds
Objective: Collect 5 Fallen Kelp Buds.
Text: We need rations for our forces. While kelp buds do not have the same delicious taste as other options, it is nutritious and plentiful near any kelp forests. This makes it our first choice for making rations.If you happen to find any around Nazjatar, please leave your stores with the quartermaster. The ones freshly fallen from kelp are best.

Title: Stay of Execution
Objective: Complete the "Stay of Execution" Scenario.
Text: Baine's time is short. We must act now.

Title: Requisition: More Starfish
Objective: Collect 5 Angel Scale Starfish.
Text: Our forward scouts have been using starfish scales as camouflage. The trouble is that the scales deteriorate too quickly. We are going to need more scales if we want to keep tabs on naga movements.If you happen upon any Angel Scale Starfish, please deliver them to the quartermaster as soon as possible.

Title: WANTED: Emorneth
Objective: Slay Emorneth.
Text: Wanted for attacks against the Alliance! Emorneth is responsible for the gruesome deaths of several of our best soldiers. Extreme caution advised! Upon completion of the mission, report to Lieutenant Hawkins for commendation.

Title: Stay of Execution
Objective: Complete the "Stay of Execution" Scenario.
Text: When I was younger, Baine Bloodhoof and I began exchanging letters. Through our unlikely friendship, I learned that there was nobility in the Horde.He proved that by defying Sylvanas when she planned to strip the free will from Derek Proudmoore. That act of nobility will cost him his life... unless we intervene.If there is to be peace in Azeroth, our hope depends upon good people doing the right thing. People like Baine. People like you.Please, go with Jaina. Save my friend and see him home.

Title: Old Allies
Objective: Meet with allies in the Cleft of Shadows.
Text: Sylvanas was my Ranger-General. I have respected her for millennia. Making this choice is something I have been wrestling with for some time. Baine's death will tear the Horde apart. The Tauren will not stand for it and if they leave, I know they will not be the last.We must save Baine. Not just for his life, but for the Horde. I can only hope once the time pressure is gone we may be able to reason with her but...I have contacted allies who will help. Meet them in the Cleft of Shadows.

Title: WANTED: Haggronar
Objective: Retrieve the head of Haggronar.
Text: Wanted for attacks against the Alliance! Haggronar is responsible for the gruesome deaths of several of our finest soldiers. Extreme caution advised! Upon completion of the mission, report to Lieutenant Hawkins for commendation.

Title: WANTED: Braxicus
Objective: Retrieve Braxicus' giant claw.
Text: Wanted for attacks against the Alliance! Braxicus is responsible for the gruesome deaths of several of our finest soldiers. Last seen near the vicinity of this command poster. Extreme caution advised! Upon completion of the mission, report to Lieutenant Hawkins for commendation.

Title: Stay of Execution
Objective: Complete the "Stay of Execution" Scenario.
Text: Come. It is time to save a friend.

Title: Visions of Danger
Objective: Speak with Spiritwalker Ussoh.
Text: , Spiritwalker Ussoh has revealed a disturbing vision to me regarding Baine Bloodhoof.He has asked that you speak with him as soon as you can.Return to me after. We will have much to discuss.

Title: WANTED: Gler'thogg
Objective: Retrieve the Eye of Gler'thogg.
Text: Wanted for attacks against the Alliance!Gler'thogg is responsible for the gruesome deaths of several of our best soldiers. Extreme caution advised!Upon completion of the mission, report to Lieutenant Hawkins for commendation.

Title: WANTED: Lady Narjiss
Objective: Retrieve the head of Lady Narjiss.
Text: Wanted for attacks against the Alliance!Lady Narjiss is responsible for leading several raids and ambushes against our soldiers. Extreme caution advised!Upon completion of the mission, report to Lieutenant Hawkins for commendation.

Title: WANTED: Inquisitor Ithriza
Objective: Retrieve the head of Inquisitor Ithriza.
Text: Wanted for attacks against the Alliance! Inquisitor Ithriza is responsible for leading several raids and ambushes against our soldiers. Last seen near the vicinity of this command poster. Extreme caution advised! Upon completion of the mission, report to Lieutenant Hawkins for commendation.

Title: Misdirection
Objective: Find Dani's Treasure.
Text: We came in friendship and those pesky murlocs jumped us and stole my treasure.They threw it in one of those big clams and ran off into the village.They keep moving them around and I have no idea where it is now!Can you please help?

Title: WANTED: Lord Ha'kass
Objective: Retrieve the head of Lord Ha'kass.
Text: Wanted for attacks against the Alliance! Lord Ha'kass is responsible for leading several raids and ambushes against our soldiers. Last seen near the vicinity of this command poster. Extreme caution advised! Upon completion of the mission, report to Lieutenant Hawkins for commendation.

Title: WANTED: Commander Sarj'eth
Objective: Retrieve the head of Commander Sarj'eth.
Text: Wanted for attacks against the Alliance! Commander Sarj'eth is responsible for leading several raids and ambushes against our soldiers. Last seen near the vicinity of this command poster. Extreme caution advised! Upon completion of the mission, report to Lieutenant Hawkins for commendation.

Title: Emergent Sea Weeds
Objective: Gather 10 vent kelp sprouts.
Text: There is a special kind of kelp that only grows near the vents.Our healers use these to help treat our friends in Newhome.My kind don't have much of a chance down there, but you do!Gather up some of the vent kelp sprouts in the Dragon's Teeth Basin and bring them to Nevin.

Title: Bugs, Lots of 'Em!
Objective: Exterminate 20 motospiders.
Text: You got a problem with mechanical bugs, so the Roughriders are here to sort this mess out!In my experience, this big of an outbreak must have some sort of queen bug behind it all. We gonna go in, kill a lot of bugs till we find the leader of 'em all.Horde or Alliance don't matter, you're with the Roughriders today. Let's kill some bugs!

Title: Knock His Bot Off
Objective: Acquire the powercore schematics from Bondo Bigblock.
Text: I need to rebuild the main powercore. It's a 500S Mekronic so I'll need the operational schematics to get the work done. Only person I know who has a copy of that is Bondo Bigblock.We're going to need Bondo's help to finish this. Maybe if you ask him, he'll lend us his schematics.

Title: We Stand United
Objective: Speak to Magni.
Text: The work ye've done tae empower the Heart o' Azeroth cannae be understated! With this power, we might just stand a chance o' savin' the world.It's been a long fight fer certain, an' there is still more tae do. But fer now, we've got a little gift fer ye!Let me know when yer ready, champion.

Title: Back to the Chamber
Objective: Return to the Chamber of Heart.
Text: The Heart o' Azeroth is gettin' stronger every day, and it's makin' a difference.Make yer way tae the Chamber o' Heart, champion. Yer talents are needed.

Title: The Heart of the Water
Objective: Collect 15 Living Droplets from water elementals in Azsh'ari Terrace.
Text: You see a lot up here.Even the water is a slave to the will of the naga.I believe we can help them reform away from here.Bring back what you can!

Title: TBD NOT USED
Objective: TBD
Text: TBD

Title: WANTED: Lady Naz'jess
Objective: Retrieve the head of Lady Naz'jess.
Text: Wanted for attacks against the Alliance!Lady Naz'jess is responsible for leading several raids and ambushes against our soldiers. Extreme caution advised!Upon completion of the mission, report to Lieutenant Hawkins for commendation.

Title: She Sells These Shells
Objective: Collect 8 seashells.
Text: Suva is so proud of her seashells.After everything she has done for our people, helping her supplies is the least we can do!Head down the hill and pick up some of the shiniest seashells you can find!You will make her day.

Title: Defending the Maelstrom
Objective: Defeat Azerite elementals and seal Azeroth's injuries at the Maelstrom.
Text: The shaman of the Earthen Ring are powerful, but this is more than even they can handle! And from the sound o' it, some o' their own are still trapped down below.Like ye did in Nordrassil, use yer Heart of Azeroth tae seal up the wounds inflicted here. An' lay any crazed elementals tae rest before they make even more o' a mess.

Title: TBD NOT USED
Objective: TBD
Text: TBD

Title: At the Azerite Time
Objective: Return to the Chamber of Heart.
Text: Ye did it! Ye stopped the damage before it could get any worse!The Maelstrom will always be a place o' great history an' pain fer Azeroth, but any little bit we do will make things better. Who knows, maybe we can even heal Silithus one day!I'll meet ye back in the Chamber o' Heart. MOTHER's sure tae be interested in what happened here.

Title: An Old Scar
Objective: Speak to MOTHER to travel to the Maelstrom.
Text: We've got a new problem, champion. Another grievous wound has opened up, this time at the Maelstrom!The shaman there are in deep trouble, an' they need our help!Speak tae MOTHER. She'll get ye tae the Maelstrom. I'll meet ye there.

Title: More Recycling
Objective: Collect 1 Bundle of Recyclable Parts

Title: Drill Rig Construction
Objective: Contribute Spare Parts and Energy Cells to the Broken Drill Rig construction project.
Text: Yes... This appears to be sufficient material to repair that drill rig.I'll do what I can with the parts that I have, but you will need to complete the repairs with yours.When you're ready, return to that broken drill rig we found and open it up.Together, we'll have it up and running in no time.

Title: Welcome to the Resistance
Objective: Tour Rustbolt with Prince Erazmin.
Text: Life in the Rustbolt Resistance is not easy.But it is yours. We will not order you around or force you to fight. Mechagon is a land of endless opportunities, and you may chase whichever opportunities you see fit.Of course, if you'd like suggestions for which improvements you most require, myself or any of the other mechagnomes in town will be happy to advise you of your current weaknesses.But, for now, I ask simply that you walk with me to my workshop.

Title: The Resistance Needs YOU!
Objective: Ride with Prince Erazmin to Junkwatt Depot.
Text: Rustbolt isn't usually in this level of malfunction.King Mechagon attacked our town last night. His mechanical armies captured many members of the Rustbolt Resistance and destroyed as much as they could before we drove them out.The prisoners are being processed at Junkwatt Depot. After that, they'll be transferred down into King Mechagon's underground city... for full mechanization.We can't let that happen. Will you help me rescue them?

Title: Rescuing the Resistance
Objective: Rescue the Rustbolt Resistance members.
Text: King Mechagon is ruthlessly efficient. He only expends resources to kidnap those he deems worthy.The rest, he... discards.We will deal with my father, King Mechagon, another day.This information is more immediately relevant in that my father's predictability means our top scientists, engineers, and tinkerers should all be trapped, alive, somewhere in this depot.We will find them, and break them out.

Title: Requisition: A Few Cone Shells
Objective: Collect 3 Impregnable Cone Shell.
Text: If we are going to arm ourselves against the naga, we will need far more supplies and armaments. Cone Shells make most of our armor and weapons. It's light, it's strong, and it's plentiful in this region. However, our supplies are running short and our forces need support.If you find yourself carrying Impregnable Cone Shells, please leave your stores with the quartermaster.

Title: Requisition: A Few Deepcoral Buds
Objective: Collect 3 Deepcoral Buds.
Text: Many species feed on the deepcoral buds from the tall columns that grow in the east. Fathom rays feed on these buds especially. We use the buds as lures for fathom rays to use as mounts. But with our stores so low, we will not be able to provide the air support we need across Nazjatar.If you could gather more Deepcoral Buds and return them to the quartermaster, you will surely be rewarded.

Title: Reinforced Cache
Objective: Locate the key to the Reinforced Cache.

Title: Requisition: A Few Flotsam
Objective: Collect 3 Piles of Flotsam.
Text: I have seen piles of flotsam in the sands to the west. If you could go out and scrounge anything useful from the debris, it could prove useful. Beware, that area is a hydra breeding ground and they have been growing more aggressive since the water receded.Once you've gathered some supplies, return to the quartermaster for your reward.

Title: My Father's Armies
Objective: Kill 12 Mechagon forces in Junkwatt Depot.
Text: My father was once a good leader. He envisioned a brighter future for his people, and did everything in his power to help us acquire it.But when his vision became misaligned with the dreams of his people, he failed to adapt. Instead, he grew rigid, forcing his will on others.In secret experiments, he began fully mechanizing the bodies of those who resisted him.It was horrible to watch... there was nothing left of the original gnomes who followed him willingly.Only robots remained. Slaves.

Title: Requisition: A Few Kelp Buds
Objective: Collect 3 Fallen Kelp Buds.
Text: We need rations for our forces. While kelp buds do not have the same delicious taste as other options, it is nutritious and plentiful near any kelp forests. This makes it our first choice for making rations.If you happen to find any around Nazjatar, please leave your stores with the quartermaster. The ones freshly fallen from kelp are best.

Title: Requisition: A Few Spiral Leaf
Objective: Collect 3 Poisonous Spiral Leaf.
Text: We are dangerously low on our medicine stores. If you find any Spiral Leaf, please leave your stores with the quartermaster.I should warn you, Spiral Leaf is immensely poisonous. Make sure to handle it with care. Some symptoms of spiral leaf poisoning include bouts of rage, immense bursts of strength, and murderous impulses. If you are exposed, find some naga and use your murderous energy for good.

Title: Requisition: A Few Seaweed
Objective: Collect 3 Sticky Seaweed.
Text: We have so many wounded and we are dangerously low on seaweed bandages. If you find Sticky Seaweed, please give it to the quartermaster.

Title: Requisition: A Few Starfish
Objective: Collect 3 Angel Scale Starfish.
Text: Our forward scouts have been using starfish scales as camouflage. The trouble is that the scales deteriorate too quickly. We are going to need more scales if we want to keep tabs on naga movements.If you happen upon any Angel Scale Starfish, please deliver them to the quartermaster as soon as possible.

Title: Requisition: A Few Carp
Objective: Return 3 Struggling Carps to water.
Text: Our local sea life is in danger! If you spot a fish out of water, please return it to the nearest lake, stream, or river. Conservation is everyone's responsibility!

Title: Feed Them All
Objective: Collect 10 Fathom Flesh.
Text: When we're doing our job right, we always have more mouths to feed!If you could help with my stock, we could care for even more.Big, strong friends are what this revolution needs!

Title: First One's Free
Objective: Punchcard Satchel recovered.
Text: The pocket-sized computational device can accept punch cards to upgrade and modify its performance.I could give you a punch card, but a particularly crafty trogg, Moch'k Eight-Thumbs, stole my satchel full of cards.Kill Moch'k Eight-Thumbs, recover my satchel, and I'll set you up with a punch card for free.

Title: Void Cache
Objective: Locate the key to the Void Cache.

Title: Upgraded
Objective: Collect 20 Microcogs.
Text: Well, look at you...Not as impressive as I had hoped.King Mechagon's armies are fully mechanized. But, you... you have a severe excess of flesh and matching machinery deficiency.Yes, we simply must make a few changes... Maybe a neural-cranial upgrade!Bring me a few microcogs from the motospiders nearby and I'll fix you up!

Title: Snapdragon Claws
Objective: Collect 10 Snapdragon Claws.
Text: Snapdragons are savage creatures that hunt in packs. Their presence in Nazjatar requires us to stay vigilant at all times.They are crafty beasts, preferring to ambush their prey when it is weak or wounded. We will need to reduce the number of snapdragons in the area.The last thing we need after a battle with the naga is to be finished off by a pack of blood-thirsty snapdragons!Hunt down any nearby snapdragons and bring me a claw from each kill so that I may keep track of their numbers.

Title: Strange Discovery
Objective: Deliver the ring to Elise Starseeker.

Title: There's Something in the Water
Objective: Kill the Eye of the Corruptor.
Text: The Ankoan must contend with threats from not only the naga, but also the horrors of N'Zoth. We learned early that if we allow his infection even the smallest purchase, he will grow and corrupt everything.There is a great evil who is lingering near the waterway that flows through this place. It must be dealt with.

Title: A Little Leg Work
Objective: Collect 4 Mechaspider Leg and 12 Toe Springs.
Text: The legs and shocks on this mount are shot! We'll need some new ones if we're going to get this mount crawling.A few weeks ago, Bondo and his gang rode into the Scrapbone Den hoping to scare the Troggs off. The Troggs tore their crawlers apart! The parts for those crawlers are still laying all around Scrapbone Den.See if you can get us some of those parts from the Troggs.

Title: Test Drive
Objective: Drive it to the check point, reach Maximum speed, and test the emergency brake.
Text: There's still a lot of work to do, but it's running! We need to give the engine, brakes and gyro-balance actuator a good test.You want to take it out for a drive and see how well they work?

Title: That New Mount Smell
Objective: Collect 8 Golden Cogpaste.
Text: Once every week, Mechagon expels a lot of excess oils through the outflow. That's why the place is a toxic mess!Today they expelled a batch of Golden Cogpaste. The stuff is amazing! I make air fresheners out of it. Makes any mount smell like it's brand new!Check all the pipes in the outflow, and see if you can collect some of this paste.

Title: Time for Heroics
Objective: Leona Mistcaller, Dunkin Crackjaw, and Adalin Halfheight rescued.
Text: That card you found was a gold rare Huolon!I think that card belonged to Adalin Halfheight, one of our junior explorer league members. If he dropped it, he and our other junior members maybe in trouble!We need to find Leona Mistcaller, Dunkin Crackjaw, and Adalin Halfheight immediately!

Title: A Growing Mystery
Objective: 10 Ancient Runestones collected.
Text: This runestone could be of Vrykul origins. Is it possible that Vrykul once visited this island?Where there's one runestone, there's usually more. The roots of lashers are drawn to the magic of runestones. If there are more buried here, the Lasher roots maybe wrapped around them!Clear these lashers and see if any have runestones tangled in their roots.

Title: Crab Marks The Spot
Objective: Locate the buried treasure.

Title: Forgotten Memories
Objective: Locate Arylina's diary.
Text: Have we met before? I'm sorry... but I don't remember your name.My name is... Arylina... I think. My memory has been so foggy since the great explosion happened that sent us underwater.Oh! But look! I can see the sun and the stars again... I wonder what happened?I used to keep a diary, but I can't find it anywhere. If I just had my diary back, I'm sure I could remember more.Will you help me find it?

Title: We Come in Peace... and Profit
Objective: Explore the nearby town with Gazlowe.
Text: King Mechagon won't be happy we're on his island.But a cruel king like that is gonna have enemies. You and I know that better than most, yeah?While Skaggit and the crew get our foothold dug in here, you and I are gonna find some potential allies to shield us from King Mechagon's wrath.Those two guards ran into that junkheap town up the hill. That place don't smell of royalty to me... Let's check there first.

Title: A Historical Mess
Objective: 12 Tortollan Relics collected.
Text: The text on this parchment appears to be Tortollan. Is it possible that Tortollans once resided on this island?We need to act quickly, before the creatures in this area destroy anymore evidence. Search the area for any signs of Tortollan relics.

Title: Encrypted Radio Receiver TBD
Objective: NYI - Will add Black Market viewing NPC in town
Text: NYI - Will add Black Market viewing NPC in town

Title: The Dark Garden
Objective: Kill naga and release the poor tortured creatures held in the Imperial Garden.
Text: Look, I know we have bigger battles ahead, but these gardens are horrific.Innocent creatures captured and imprisoned for the naga's amusement.They bring them out, torture them, change them, break them... you get the idea.Help me free those the naga have taken, and punish them for their hubris!

Title: Fighting Venomous With Venom
Objective: Use collected venom to weaken and kill a Snapdragon Terrormaw for their fangs.
Text: There are many uses for the poison of the snapdragons.Immediate use would be to create antivenin for healing, or harvesting poison for attacking the naga.Let's get to the root of the issue, literally.Use some collected venom against a Terrormaw to weaken it. Kill one and bring me their fangs.I think we can come up with something handy from there.

Title: A Blow to Morale
Objective: Disrupt all activities in the Shirakess Repository.
Text: This place is the source of all of our corruption.The kelfin are taken and broken here.Hit them where it hurts. Break their power, kill every naga you see, wreak havoc!Every little crack we make, weakens their foundation.

Title: Broken Controller
Objective: Free the slaves and destroy the Merciless Controller.
Text: It is too late for me, my friends.The Controllers work us and work us and we have no rest.We have lost so many.Please, free the others! Don't let them share my fate!

Title: Arcane Cache
Objective: Locate the key to the Arcane Cache.

Title: In the Shadow of Crimson Wings
Objective: Speak with Kalecgos to fly to the Vermillion Redoubt, locate Alexstrasza and discover the source of the threat.
Text: It is unlike Alexstrasza to remain out of contact for so long, particularly when the very essences of the dragonflights' power are being made manifest.While our allies here tend to the injured, we must seek out the Life-Binder at once.When you are ready, we shall ride to the Vermillion Redoubt together.

Title: Prospectus Bay
Objective: Jetpack into Prospectus Bay with Gazlowe and the crew.
Text: Looks like we made it in unnoticed.Skaggit's crew can set up shop on that beach, but we gotta make sure it's safe for 'em to land first.Let's do a quick flyover to scout out how we're going to crack this place wide open.That town up on the hill looks promising...

Title: Clues Abound
Objective: Discover a clue about the island's history.
Text: Before King Mechagon claimed this island, someone else lived here. Buried beneath this filth and garbage is the history of a forgotten people. With your help, we shall learn about these previous inhabitants.Sir Finley has marked a location where he's seen unusual artifacts. Meet him there and see if you can discover any clues.

Title: Relics of the Sundering
Objective: Collect 10 Highborne Relics.
Text: It's not every day that you encounter the remnants of a lost civilization beneath the ocean!I never would have imagined that I'd have the opportunity to explore the lost city of Nazjatar... and on solid ground at that!There are many secrets here to uncover. If you come across any ancient highborne artifacts, please bring them to me. These relics could provide us with valuable clues regarding the mysteries of the Great Sundering.I feel as though we are barely scratching the surface so far...

Title: To Mechagon!
Objective: Talk with Captain Krooz to travel to Mechagon.
Text: Whatever's waiting for us on the shores of Mechagon, we're going to be ready for it with this crew.I don't hold any misconceptions about how that crazy king is going to welcome us. Guns blazin', I'm sure.So we're going in quietly on this submarine. Low profile'll keep us all safe.When you're ready to go, talk to Captain Krooz.

Title: Machinations for Mechagon
Objective: Ride the Greasemonkey Skysneaker to Zuldazar Harbor.
Text: So Mechagon ain't just a fairy tale? Gotta admit I'm surprised.But, if the tech on that king is any indication of what they've got out there for us to swipe, I am very, very happy to be wrong!We can't rush into this. A good crew died today. That ain't happening again on my watch.Meet me and Skaggit back in Zuldazar Harbor, and we'll build this expedition up right.

Title: A Quick Ear Hustle
Objective: Wait for the Alliance to leave the vault.
Text: Bad news. We're late.The Alliance was already crawling all over the vault when we got here.Lucky for us, some big commotion inside sent some of 'em running for the hills.Most of 'em are still down in that vault, though, including that crazy braggart Tinkmaster Overspark.Let's give 'em a few more minutes to clear out, so we don't have to go in guns blazing.

Title: This is Our Vault Now
Objective: Lead Gazlowe's crew into the vault.
Text: Looks like the coast is clear with Overspark gone. Let's get inside that vault and see what's really going on here.Mechagon or not, there'd better be some quality hardware in there to make this trip worth our time.

Title: Only the Best Will Do
Objective: Get everything needed to launch the expedition for Mechagon.
Text: You heard Gazlowe. The boss wants this expedition to go smoothly. No cutting corners, no slush.I know you've worked with Gallywix in the past. We don't run our operations like that.We expect the best from our crews, so we pay 'em what they're worth and treat 'em well. In return, we got the best goblin crews on the planet, and they ain't goin' over to any competition.Here's a list of who and what we're gonna need to pull this off. Don't worry, Gazlowe'll cover all the costs.

Title: The Legend of Mechagon
Objective: Meet Gazlowe at the Abandoned Junkheap in Tiragarde Sound.
Text: Heya. I was just tellin' Skaggit that I was hoping I'd run into you up here!I caught wind of an Alliance operation into some old vault that opened in Tiragarde Sound.In typical gnomish fashion, Tinkmaster Overspark is overreacting like crazy, claiming it's some lost connection to the gnome fairytale land of Mechagon.I don't buy that for a second, but I am very interested in getting my hands on whatever tech's in that vault. You in?

Title: Princely Visit
Objective: Explore the nearby town with Tinkmaster Overspark.
Text: This is it! The fabled Mechagon!The greatest discovery of our age, and you're here to witness me accomplish it!I am ready to address the Mechagon people. You may accompany me.

Title: Vision of Stormwind
Objective: Complete the Vision of Stormwind.
Text: Weaken N'Zoth by delving into his mind.

Title: Making Kelpberry Wine
Objective: Deliver Kelpberry Wine to Maedin in Maedin's Challenge.

Title: A Voice on the Wind
Objective: Seek out the source of the mysterious voice in Drustvar.
Text: My enchantments are not lost...Find me...Drustvar...Fallhaven...

Title: Poor, Unfortunate Souls
Objective: Put 8 Tortured Souls to rest.
Text: Countless lives were lost in the Great Sundering when this great city was plunged into the depths of the abyss.The fortunate among us died quickly in the explosion, but some survived only to cling onto dear life as the cold, unforgiving ocean waves crashed down upon them.Those poor, unfortunate souls suffer a fate worse than death to this day. They drown endlessly, forced to relive the torture of their death.Put them to rest so that they may have peace at last.

Title: A Life's Work
Objective: Collect 6 Ancient Scrolls and 6 Arcane Tomes.
Text: I spent more than one-thousand years researching the mysteries of the arcane before the Great Sundering tore our world apart.I perished amidst the destruction and my work was lost.Search the area for my ancient writings and put my spirit to rest...

Title: You Must be This Height
Objective: Tell Gazlowe to activate the device.
Text: You and the Greasemonkeys got this machine up and running even faster than I expected.The gnome we captured is keeping her mouth shut, but that shouldn't be a problem. I can take it from here.Let me know when you're ready. I'll crank up this machine to max and we'll finally see what it can do.I hope it prints gold coins...

Title: The Sunken Chest
Objective: Locate the Brass Key at the bottom of the lagoon.

Title: Let's Get It Started
Objective: Repair the vault's machinery.
Text: Those gnomes think busting up machinery is gonna stop a goblin like me from figuring out what all the tech in this place does?I ain't never seen a hunk of junk so busted up that ol' Skaggit and I can't get running smoother than the day it was made.Tell ya what.
