You head around with Skaggit and see what you can piece back together.Meanwhile, I'll have a chat with our gnome friend here and see what she knows about all this tech.

Title: Pearls of Unimaginable Power
Objective: Collect 8 Enchanted Pearls.
Text: Thousands of years ago, when the Well of Eternity was destroyed and this land plummeted to the depths of the ocean, a great storm of magical energy was unleashed.Remnants of this magical energy still exist today.Gather the pearls from the ancient mana-infused clams. These enchanted pearls may be powerful weapons in our fight against the naga!

Title: Operation: Mechagon - The Mechoriginator
Objective: Enter Mechagon and defeat King Mechagon.
Text: My father's madness won't be contained to this island.King Mechagon is creating a massive device capable of reversing the Curse of Flesh across the entirety of Azeroth!Any races forged by the Titans will return to their original state. For us gnomes, that means fully mechanical. For dwarves and troggs, stone. Vrykul, iron.The list goes on, but most races aren't even ON the list. Anything not forged by the titans will be completely obliterated.We must stop King Mechagon before it's too late!

Title: Coveted Crystals
Objective: Collect a Deepsea Crystal from Hoarder Moarrgl.
Text: Locating the weapons cache should not be a problem once we have the proper tools. A little light and a lot of bioluminescent fluid is all that is needed.It all seems rather simple, does it not? But the key is in the Deepsea Crystal used to refract the light.The Bloodfin tribe covets these crystals, so you should have no trouble obtaining one.

Title: The Heart Forge
Objective: Speak with MOTHER to activate the Heart Forge.
Text: Rise in Heart Forge energy levels indicates presence of black dragon essence.Recommendation: Initiate Heart Forge activation sequence.

Title: Drive It Away Today
Objective: 500S-Cybergenic Powercore obtained.
Text: The mount's all polished up and looking great. We are almost done!I gave the Powercore Schematics to PASCAL-K1N6. He's ready to build us a new 500S-Cybergenic Powercore, once you get him the parts.We install that powercore and you can drive this bot away today!

Title: NOT USED
Objective: Collect 200 Spare Parts in Mechagon.
Text: TBD Collect Spare Parts from anything on the island.

Title: Shop Project
Objective: Acquire Shellsteel Plating, Multi-Leg Chaindrive, and a Mechanobot Ignition.
Text: As a reward for all your help here, I was planning to fix this old mechaspider mount to give to you.I could use some more of your help though to get this project started!I'll need parts off a few of the bots nearby, and maybe you could talk to Cork Stuttgard at Bondo's Yard and see if you can get a Mechanobot Ignition system.

Title: Scouting Undercover
Objective: Scout Zanj'ir Terrace while pretending to be mind-shackled.
Text: Entering the stronghold alone would be a death wish.The Zanj'ir slaughter outsiders on sight.The only way to get in without being killed is to appear to be under the effects of a zoatroid.Even then, the mind-shackled are put to work.You must obey all commands, or they will know your mind is still your own.Once the Zanj'ir believe you are mind-shackled, it should be easier to navigate their domain and uncover their secret.

Title: What Will It Lure?
Objective: Chum the Eel Infested Waters.

Title: Sating Snapdragons
Objective: Collect Chitterspine Roe and feed it to Savage Snapdragons.
Text: It's time for the snapdragons to feed, but it's a job best left to someone a little more expendable.The beasts will eat anything, including your arm if you don't move it away quickly enough.Luckily for you, they've developed a taste for Chitterspine Roe.

Title: What We Know of the Naga
Objective: Tend to the Ankoan's wounds and hear what Adaru has to say about the naga.
Text: I owe you a debt. That much is clear.My mind still reels from the zoatroid's influence, but I fear the others suffer more visible wounds.Apply this salve to their wounds, and I will do my best to share what I know of the naga.

Title: A Promising Beginning
Objective: Return to Seshuli in Dazar'alor and report on your discovery.

Title: Polished Up
Objective: Return to Seshuli in Dazar'alor and report on your discovery.

Title: Bound by Honor
Objective: Kill 10 naga within Zanj'ir Wash and the Deepsea Slave Pens.
Text: It is true that my clan has been battling the naga for generations, but it was only in recent times that we took the fight to Nazjatar.Our leader was slain by the vile queen, and now honor binds my clan to this deep ocean.We will avenge their death or die here trying. It is our way.Your mission aligns with our duty, so we will fight the naga together.Slay their forces and bring us one step closer to honoring our promise.

Title: Setting Things Right
Objective: Return to Seshuli in Dazar'alor and report on your discovery.

Title: Deteriorating Knowledge
Objective: Rescue Imara, Adaru, and Umai from the clutches of mind-leeching Zoatroids.
Text: My clan came to Nazjatar, eager to destroy the naga queen.We were not prepared for the darkness that she commands.Our scouts knew this land best, but their knowledge now deteriorates as their minds are controlled by Azshara's forces.Find and free our scouts, and you may still have a chance to access their knowledge.

Title: Insight into Our Enemies
Objective: Speak to Blademaster Okani to learn more about the naga within Nazjatar.
Text: There's no telling what awaits us within this land. We cannot press forward without first knowing exactly what we're up against.Our new allies have long been embattled with the naga. They would know best how to navigate these waters.Speak with Blademaster Okani and see if they can provide some insight into how our enemies operate.

Title: Setting Things Right
Objective: Return to Samuel D. Colton III in Boralus and report on your discovery.

Title: A Promising Beginning
Objective: Return to Samuel D. Colton III in Boralus and report on your discovery.

Title: Polished Up
Objective: Return to Samuel D. Colton III in Boralus and report on your discovery.

Title: Atal'Dazar: Not All That Glitters...
Objective: Travel to Atal'Dazar and find a replacement for the broken jewel.

Title: High Prospects
Objective: Investigate Gol Osigir for clues about the jewels that were used to construct the shrine.

Title: Sun-Speckled Dunes
Objective: Go to the location on your map where you believe these gems to be and recover 8 of them. Polish and shape them when you've collected enough.

Title: Out With the Old
Objective: Cut 4 Insightful Rubellites and replace the old ones with the new.

Title: Cracking the Surface
Objective: Go to the Windshorn Hills and gather 20 Shard of Golden Beryl.

Title: Purging the Defilers
Objective: Purge the naga from Elun'alor.
Text: Azshara always did need everything to be about her. Everything had to have her name on it. Everything was for her glory. She forgot our people's connection to Elune. Or perhaps she believed it did not matter?Azshara and her minions have too long defiled this place with their heresy.Let us show them Elune's vengeance.

Title: Tol Dagor: Jewel of the Tides
Objective: Speak with "Slippery" Salton and learn what you can about the missing centerpiece.

Title: One Gnome's Trash
Objective: Collect 100 rare metals using the rare metal collector.
Text: The garbage in these trash heaps is full of rare metals: Dalaranium, Suramarite, even Gnomeisium!I've not seen this much easy gold to be had, since they left the vault door open in Boralus! You help me collect some of the metal, and my friend Gao will sell it on the black market.I've got a device that can tear the metal right out of the trash!

Title: Echoes of Pain
Objective: Speak with the spirits who wander around the Highborne Estates.
Text: These spirits... they are the Highborne. They were those Azshara held close. Azshara often played favorites, but these people... they were her favorites.I do not know why their spirits are here. We should investigate further. See if you can communicate with them and find out why their spirits cling to these ruins.How could she abandon them?

Title: Help Them See the Truth
Objective: Confront the spirits about Azshara.
Text: The information you have gleaned concerns me. These spirits cling to this place because they still, even now, believe in Azshara and her reign. She sold their lives to the void and they still believe in her.I know we have concerns that outweigh this, but I cannot leave them here like this.Show them. Confront them and tell them of Azshara's betrayal.

Title: Utama's Vengeance
Objective: Kill 10 Makrura.
Text: We Ankoan are a small tribe. There are not that many of us remaining.This place was once overrun with makrura, before Utama. They tried to hide here, from the naga, but found the makrura. They fell, in battle, to the Kil'karrok.If you wish to show your dedication to the Ankoan, become a force of vengeance in Utama's memory. Destroy the makrura.

Title: Rustbolt Gramophone
Objective: Install the gramophone in the Rustbolt bar, The Tipsy Tinkerer.

Title: Secrets in the Ruins
Objective: Search for items of power.
Text: This was once a place of great power. The highborne who lived here would host lavish parties, living in splendor.Zin-Azshari was once on the shores of the Well of Eternity and drew powerful mages from all over the empire to study here. I suspect, despite the many years at the bottom of the sea, there are still treasures and powerful artifacts hidden away here.Speak with the spirits that remain and see what you can find. There must be something to help us overcome the Guardian of the Tidestone.

Title: Shoring Up Mana Reserves
Objective: Collect 10 Elemental cores.
Text: Holding back the tide walls is not an easy task, even using the Tidestone. The ebb and flow of the magical energies in the area are too inconsistent.We need to shore up our magical reserves, which requires mana batteries, if you will. The befouled elementals along the canal here are created with exactly the elemental cores we need.The goal is two fold. Clearing out the befouled elementals, before their corruption spreads, but also retrieving their cores, so we can keep the water at bay.

Title: The Javelins of Azshara
Objective: Kill the Handmaiden of Azshara.
Text: These spirits keep speaking of the Javelins of Azshara. At first, I believed it to be referring to the handmaidens, who are currently holed up in Elun'alor.But -- now I think they are referring to the Javelins of Suramar. They were powerful weapons -- long thought lost. Azshara does like to claim things as her own.We need to defeat her handmaiden in Elun'alor regardless. Seizing the Javelins would be an amazing stroke of fortune.

Title: What Remains of Zin-Azshari
Objective: Meet Shandris at the statue of Azshara.
Text: Zin-Azshari, once the capital of night elf civilization, was lost during the Sundering. Queen Azshara betrayed her people and allowed N'Zoth to corrupt them, turning them into naga.It has now fallen into ruin and chaos.We must see what it has become. Meet me by the statue of Azshara.

Title: A Bolt Hole
Objective: Meet with Shandris Feathermoon at Utama's Stand.
Text: , we must seek out a powerful weapon to combat the naga who guard the Tidal Conflux. I am certain such an object would be in the hands of one of Azshara's minions.Thanks to our new allies, we've tracked down the location of one of her handmaidens within the ruins of Zin-Azshari. The journey will be quite dangerous. Thankfully our allies have a location nearby that we can use as a staging ground.I've marked the location on your map, meet with me there as soon as you can.

Title: MOTHER Knows Best
Objective: Speak to MOTHER in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: Now that this chamber's not fallin' tae pieces anymore, we can focus on makin' the Heart stronger!MOTHER says she's finished her fancy calculations. Have a word with her, champion. See if we can further empower the amazin' gift Azeroth gave ye.

Title: The Tipsy Tinkerer
Objective: Install the Rustbolt Kegerator in Rustbolt's bar, The Tipsy Tinkerer.
Text: The massive kegerator that you built should be able to house all of the Rustbolt Resistance's beverages.Find a spot to set it up in Rustbolt, and let the town know it's ready for use!

Title: A Safer Place
Objective: Escort Mrrl back to Newhome.

Title: No Backs
Objective: Bring Mrrl a Sweet Sea Vegetable, an Unidentified Mass, a Flatulent Fish, and a Slimy Naga Eyeball.

Title: Bring Him Some...
Objective: Bring Mrrl 15 Extra-Slimy Snails, 3 Smelly Piles of Gloop, and 5 Ghost Food.

Title: What Will It Mine?
Objective: Complete the Brinestone Cove event.

Title: Bring Him Some...
Objective: Bring Mrrl 3 Ghost Food, 3 Healthy Murloc Lunches, and 3 Sea Giant Foot Dust.

Title: Bring Him Some...
Objective: Locate murloc traders and obtain the items that Mrrl requires.

Title: Return to the Heart
Objective: Return to the Chamber of Heart.
Text: Greetings, Champion of Azeroth.MOTHER's been monitorin' yer progress with the Heart of Azeroth, and is mighty pleased with the work you've done tae make it stronger.At least, we think she's pleased. It's difficult tae tell at times.Regardless, come back tae the Chamber of Heart when ye've got a chance. There's more that needs doin'.

Title: Bring Him Some...
Objective: Bring Mrrl 4 Healthy Murloc Lunches, 3 Bags of Who-Knows-What, and 6 Sea Giant Foot Dust.

Title: Playtime's Over
Objective: Eliminate 12 Troggs.
Text: The troggs have been raiding our supplies since we got here, but now that we got some fire power you're going to put a stop to that!Let's teach them troggs to stay away from our stuff!

Title: Healing Nordrassil
Objective: Defeat Azerite elementals and seal Azeroth's injuries at Nordrassil.
Text: Azerite elementals are runnin' wild, driven mad by Azeroth's pain. They're menacin' the spirits o' nature that protect the World Tree.The roots o' Nordrassil run deep, nurtured by these sacred waters. For the sake o' Azeroth's world soul, the tree must be defended.Quiet the restless elementals and use yer Heart o' Azeroth tae mend the wounds ye find. We cannae let Hyjal become another gapin' scar like Silithus!

Title: Do It the Azerite Way
Objective: Return to the Chamber of Heart.
Text: Incredible! Ye stopped the wound from spreadin' before it could get out o' control!Nordrassil should be safe again, fer now. This is a good sign that we may just be able tae reverse all the damage done tae Azeroth.Let's get back tae the Chamber o' Heart, an' see if we can put any o' that azerite ye absorbed tae good use.

Title: Slay them all!
Objective: Commander Dardosh in Wintergrasp wants you to slay 10 members of the Alliance. Quest can only be auto completed while within the Battle for Wintergrasp.
Text: Welcome to the Wintergrasp. Warlord Garrosh demands one thing: Slay them all! Return to me when ten of the strongest members of the Alliance are dead.

Title: Paint Vial: Big-ol Bronze
Objective: Deliver the item to Marvelous Martini.

Title: A Fresh Trauma
Objective: Meet Magni at Nordrassil in Mount Hyjal.
Text: Azeroth is strugglin' tae survive, but new wounds are formin' at a rapid pace.I can sense her cries o' pain risin' from the north... in a place o' ancient power...By the Forge! Somethin's gone wrong in Mount Hyjal. The World Tree, Nordrassil, is in danger!Meet me there. There's no time tae lose!

Title: Spark of Genius
Objective: Meet Mimiron at the Inventor's Library in the Storm Peaks.
Text: , I require your assistance.A recent energy signature tripped several detection relays I installed after that unfortunate incident with Sargeras.Initial diagnostics suggest that these energies emanate from Hati, a legendary creature of lightning magic. This wolf was linked to the Titanstrike artifact, a weapon that proved instrumental in defeating the Legion!Hati's spirit is still bound to Titanstrike's core, so I'll need your help. Meet me at my library in the Storm Peaks right away!

Title: Torcali's Blessing
Objective: Return the Child of Torcali to her nest in Warbeast Kraal.
Text: Your actions speak to your intentions.I can see that my child will have the care she needs to grow strong, and grow she will.In the coming days she will recover the strength that would have been hers, if nature had been allowed to take its course. Tend to her, earn her loyalty, and I will allow you to keep her at your side.This is my gift to you.You may go now. She will bring you to me when it is time.

Title: No Mercy for the Merciless
Objective: Commander Zanneth in Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to slay 10 members of the Horde. Quest can only be auto completed while within the Battle for Wintergrasp.
Text: Welcome to Wintergrasp. Your mission is simple. Defeat ten of the Horde's finest. Now, go! Bring victory to the Alliance!

Title: Victory in Wintergrasp
Objective: Win a Wintergrasp battleground match. You must have participated in the battle to be credited for the victory. Quest can only be auto completed while within the Battle for Wintergrasp.
Text: Commander Zanneth might be satisfied with a pile of Horde corpses at his feet, but controlling Wintergrasp is of the utmost importance to the Valiance Expedition. Make sure it remains in our control. However, don't think we'll just let you stand around while your allies do your dirty work for you. If you're not at least a second level recruit by the end of the battle, don't come back.

Title: Victory in Wintergrasp
Objective: Win a Wintergrasp battleground match. You must have participated in the battle to gain credit for the victory. Quest can only be auto completed while within the Battle for Wintergrasp.
Text: While Dardosh might be content with slaying our foes, it is of the utmost importance that we control Wintergrasp Fortress. Do whatever it takes to ensure Wintergrasp is ours. However, don't think we'll just let you stand around while your allies do your dirty work for you. If you're not at least a second level recruit by the end of the battle, don't come back.

Title: One Road Ends
Objective: Restore the southern wayshrine and assist any travelers you come across.
Text: There is one more wayshrine in this region that requires your attention.Follow this road until you near its end at the Port of Zandalar.It is there, at the start and end of so many journeys, that one of my most trafficked shrines was established. Restore it and see that any weary travelers have my blessing.We will speak again when you are finished.

Title: Roo'li's Memory
Objective: Take Roo'li's remains to Torcali.
Text: I was going to be a Dinomancer. Roo'li was going to grow with me as I learned.Dat future is gone now. Please, take him. Find a proper place to bury him.I... can't. De shame is too great.

Title: The Shimmering Crystal
Objective: Bring the Shimmering Timewarped Crystal to Kronnus in Warspear.
Text: Though the crystal appears familiar at first, upon contact with your finger it reveals itself as so much more. A grand, lost civilization appears in front of you. Fixtures of gold shimmer in every direction, bright feathers of purple occasionally falling from overhead. You hear the distant sounds of battle, culminating in a thunderous explosion that overwhelms all of your senses and turns your vision white.When your vision returns, you feel something within you pulling you toward Ashran.

Title: The Direhorn and the Saurid
Objective: Discover the fate of the central wayshrine.
Text: I am pleased with your efforts. He will not soon forget the kindness you have shown him, and so he will not soon forget me.Now your journey will take you south. I can no longer sense one of my wayshrines. If you can determine what has happened to it and restore it, I would be grateful.

Title: Wayshrines of Zuldazar
Objective: Restore the northern wayshrine and assist any travelers you come across.
Text: My child grows under your care. I am pleased. Now, I would have your aid.There was a time long ago when the roads of Zandalar were under my protection. Those who walked them gave praise, and in return I gave them my blessing. Fewer wander now.My shrines remain, their purpose forgotten. You will help me to restore them.Begin in the north. See to the wayshrine there. If you find any lost travelers, see that they know my blessing through you.

Title: Save A Friend
Objective: Kill the Herald of the Queen to release Mak.
Text: In the cave ahead is where they are holding Mak.They torture us. They break us.Don't let them take her, too.

Title: The Shimmering Crystal
Objective: Bring the Shimmering Timewarped Crystal to Tempra in Stormshield.
Text: Though the crystal appears familiar at first, upon contact with your finger it reveals itself as so much more. A grand, lost civilization appears in front of you. Fixtures of gold shimmer in every direction, bright feathers of purple occasionally falling from overhead. You hear the distant sounds of battle, culminating in a thunderous explosion that overwhelms all of your senses and turns your vision white.When your vision returns, you feel something within you pulling you toward Ashran.

Title: A Friendly Face
Objective: Meet with Spiritwalker Ebonhorn and Magni Bronzebeard in the Chamber of Heart.
Text: An essence of black dragonflight magic is not to be trifled with.My flight has been the pawn of dark forces in the past. I owe it to my fallen kin to see that our power is never used for evil again.I would like to journey with you and meet your allies. Perhaps my knowledge can help you use this essence to defend our world.

Title: Secrets of Telemancy
Objective: Investigate Oculeth's old workshop.
Text: The nightborne are no strangers to this place. It was once our capital too, long ago. Before the Sundering and erecting the shield over Suramar we used to travel freely to Zin-Azshari. Oculeth had a workshop in these estates. Perhaps it might contain some secrets or magic that went undisturbed by the survivors.

Title: We'll Poke Their Eye Out
Objective: Return to Lor'themar Theron in Newhome.
Text: The Javelins were some of Suramar's finest creations before the Sundering. Their magic is ancient and potent. Perhaps strong enough to defeat Azshara's wards. Hurry back to Newhome. We must tell the others of our success here. You have done well.

Title: The Handmaiden's Tale
Objective: Retrieve the Javelin of Suramar.
Text: The Javelins of Suramar! Wielded by Azshara herself, they contain immense magical power. She has always had a fondness for bestowing favors on her favorites, but I never suspected she would give one something so valuable as one of her Javelins. This foe must be formidable indeed. Nevertheless, we cannot let this opportunity pass us. Defeat the handmaiden and retrieve the relic!

Title: Speak with the Dead
Objective: Question the spirits in the Highborne Estates to discover something useful.
Text: So many souls perished beneath the waves. Too many sacrificed for her ambition. It is strange that the spirits here have not departed. I wonder if they even know they are dead? Still, their knowledge might be useful to us. If you could question the spirits, they might be able to point us in the right direction.

Title: Making the Connection
Objective: Search the ruins of Kal'methir for magical relics.
Text: A communication crystal! Have they survived this long? We used to use these to communicate. They allowed us to project images of ourselves to other nearby crystals to see and speak with those on the other end.  The magic has long since depleted from the crystal. We will need a power source, preferably something just as old as this. Check our surroundings, but be careful. It is too quiet out here....

Title: Terrors in the Deep
Objective: Defeat 10 corrupted creatures and the source of the corruption.
Text: Azshara knows we are here. Still, we must press on. Be careful, though. There is a... wrongness coming from the water. It is unlike the magic of old, but more ancient and terrible. Traverse the canals and find the source of corruption. If we are to search Zin-Azshari, we cannot let any relics fall into the hands of even darker powers.

Title: The Wanderer's Call
Objective: Speak to Torcali in the Savagelands.
Text: Greetings, small thing.De Great Wanderer asked this one to collect you. She has a task for you and de little beast to complete.Jo'nok's loa is patient, but he would not keep her waiting.

Title: We Must Go Deeper
Objective: Speak to Merithra to travel deeper into the Emerald Dream.
Text: These shards can only do so much in their current state. They are broken and scattered... not unlike my kin.We must bring them together.Let us go deeper into the Emerald Dream. I know of a place where we can reforge the shards into a dragonscale. With it, you can empower the Heart of Azeroth with the essence of my dragonflight. We must go to the ancient heart of the Dream, where my mother once rested.Speak with me when you are ready to delve deeper.

Title: Aid From Nordrassil
Objective: Kill 8 Sawblade Clearcutters and use the Living Sap of Nordrassil to regrow 8 stumps.
Text: Look at what they've done to this island.Nature is nearly extinguished, its death cry falling on the deaf ears of mechagnomes.But I have heard the teeny tiny animals of Mechagon, and bring aid from afar!It won't be easy to restore balance to a land so severely wounded. Nature's scars run deep here.Thankfully, we are not alone. I've brought living sap from Nordrassil, the World Tree of Mount Hyjal. Use it to regrow the forests and speed nature's recovery in this land.

Title: Scouting the Palace
Objective: Speak with Spiritwalker Ussoh to observe the scouting party.
Text: We cannot hide here forever. We have to deal with Azshara. We will need to assault her palace but we do not know what defenses she has in place. I dispatched a scouting team while you were gone and they have not reported back. I cannot afford to lose any more people. Speak with Spiritwalker Ussoh. His abilities will let us see where the scouts are.

Title: To Zin-Azshari
Objective: Meet First Arcanist Thalyssra in the ruins of Zin-Azshari.
Text: We need something to deal with the guardian of the Tidestone. Our new allies here say that there is a naga enclave located in the ruins of Zin-Azshari. If there is anything potent enough to counter Azshara's sorcery, it will be in the ruins of her capital city. The First Arcanist will accompany you, champion. She will be best equipped to assist you in matters both historical and magical while you search. Good luck.

Title: Paint Vial: Lemonade Steel
Objective: Deliver the item to Marvelous Martini.

Title: Paint Vial: Fel Mint Green
Objective: Deliver the item to Marvelous Martini.

Title: Paint Vial: Overload Orange
Objective: Deliver the item to Marvelous Martini.

Title: Paint Vial: Fireball Red
Objective: Deliver the item to Marvelous Martini.

Title: Paint Vial: Copper Trim
Objective: Deliver the item to Marvelous Martini.

Title: Paint Vial: Mechagon Gold
Objective: Deliver the item to Marvelous Martini.

Title: Dominating the Indomitable
Objective: Confront Ma'haat the Indomitable in the Dragon's Spine.
Text: With the wounds healed, I can clearly sense the dragon essence. Unfortunately, it seems to emanate from the earthen giant before us.I will address the creature. Let us hope it listens to reason... but be prepared for anything.When Deathwing shattered the World Pillar in Deepholm, he earned the ire of the Stonemother and her forces. I fear this being may blame me for my father's crimes.

Title: What Will It Grow?
Objective: Plant the Germinating Seed within Fertile Soil.

Title: Calming the Spine
Objective: Seal the Azerite Fissures in The Dragon's Spine.
Text: It is plain that the situation here is dire.The power of the black dragonflight echoes around us, and the earth is reeling in response.I have heard tales of ruptures like these on Kul Tiras and Zandalar. The elementals have been driven into a frenzy, and they bar our way from seeking the essence.If we are to preserve the tenuous balance of the elements here, the wounds must be mended.

Title: The Stuff Dreams Are Made Of
Objective: Toss the Emerald Shards into the lake and collect the Dreamglow Dragonscale.
Text: All that remains is to throw the emerald fragments you collected into the lake. I will use my power to bind them together.If this works, they will be reforged into a powerful dragonscale that you can use to empower the Heart of Azeroth.I believe that my mother would be pleased that some of our power will go toward saving the world. I hope she would be proud of us.

Title: Before I Wake
Objective: Destroy all Grips of Horror and the Void Horror.
Text: It is as I feared. We cannot fuse the shards together until the Void has been driven from this place.Quickly, strike down these aberrations. I suspect the source of the corruption will not sit idle in response.

Title: Take My Hand
Objective: Speak to Navarrogg to travel to the Dragon's Spine in Neltharion's Lair.
Text: Beneath us lies the former home of the dragon Neltharion. You may know him as Deathwing.If your titan watcher friend detected an essence of dragon magic coalescing nearby, it may be an echo of the power of the dragonflights. Such power will be coveted by others as well.This force is likely originating from the most potent area within the lair--the decaying bones of my kin slain in the throes of Deathwing's fury.We must go before the essence falls into the wrong hands.

Title: Enter the Dreamway
Objective: Speak with Merithra to enter the Emerald Dreamway.
Text: We have little time, so I will be brief.The Emerald Dream is under attack. The shadows of the Void are on the rise, and not even the Dream is beyond their reach. Many of my kin have already been slain, and still more are at risk.We must enter the Dreamway and save what remains of my dragonflight before it is too late.

Title: The Long Awake
Objective: Return to Merithra in the Chamber of Heart with the Dreamglow Dragonscale.
Text: There is nothing more you can do for us here, champion. You have the power you sought, and the Emerald Dream is fighting back against the Void.Bring this dragonscale back to Magni and the others. I will meet you in the Chamber of Heart to help infuse it into the Heart of Azeroth.As for my flight, our long vigil must continue... or we will be lost to the Void.

Title: Shards of Emerald
Objective: Collect Emerald Shards in the Dreamway.
Text: Kalecgos tells me that you seek the power of the dragonflights in its most essential form. There may be something here that can help you.Fragments of our latent power have coalesced here in the Dream.They are scattered about the Dreamway, where my kin have fallen. Within the Dream, you should be able to wield those fragments in their raw state.

Title: Don't Close Your Eyes
Objective: Wake Thessera, Verdisa and Karkarius from Void dreams.
Text: The Void assaults us as we sleep! Those who it ensnares may never wake again.They can only be roused by powerful magic native to our dragonflight. The shards that have formed near our fallen kin may be exactly what is needed.If we succumb to slumber in the Void, we will be lost forever. Please, aid us!

Title: Settling In
Objective: Set up the calling conch and make the rounds.
Text: Whatever Azshara is up to, this *ahem* great new landscape we have found ourself in is terribly inconvenient.Too many getting too close to our home. We have moved most of the refugees deeper into the cave.Could you ask Telur to move our calling conch inside?Grab some of Slen's Elixir and check in with Vim.Once it is set up, test it out!I'm off to do a progress check!

Title: Null the Void
Objective: Slay Void invaders in the Emerald Dreamway.
Text: The green dragonflight cannot stop this tide of Void creatures on our own. Not with our reduced strength.Please, lend us your might and drive them from the Dreamway before they can enter the waking realm.

Title: In Darkness, I Dream
Objective: Meet Merithra at the Temple of Elune in Val'sharah.
Text: The green dragonflight calls for aid. The Emerald Dream, which they have watched over for eons, has been invaded by terrible creatures of the Void.Merithra of the Dream is attempting to combat the threat, but she cannot do so alone. If you seek to empower the Heart of Azeroth with the strength of the green dragonflight, you must first help Merithra save it.Meet her at the Temple of Elune in Val'sharah, and assist her however you can.

Title: A Disturbance Beneath the Earth
Objective: Travel to Highmountain and investigate the essence.
Text: Manifestation of dragon essence detected. Location: Highmountain.Assuming successful retrieval, calculations indicate 92.7 percent probability of empowering Heart of Azeroth.Theory: By combining dragon essence with sufficient quantities of Azerite within Heart Forge, previously undiscovered abilities may manifest within Heart.As Speaker Magni would say: "Get to work, champion."

Title: Knock 'Em Out The Box
Objective: Take out those Steelarm Pillagers and get 10 Spiderspring Gears back.
Text: Steelarm Pillagers have been taking all our parts and selling them to Bondo's gang.Last night they stole all our Spiderspring Gears. The parts are in a bunch of crates they're guarding.We need you to get our gears back, and show those Steelarm Pillagers they should pick on someone else.

Title: Rescue The Farseer
Objective: Rescue Farseer Ori.
Text: My master, Farseer Ori, has been imprisoned by the forces of Queen Azshara.Farseer Ori was captured while performing a sacred ritual to call upon the elements for guidance. I managed to escape, but the ritual has been left unfinished.If we do not rescue my master soon, the elements will grow even more restless.The elemental balance must be maintained. I fear what may become of my clan and our bond with the elements if Farseer Ori is not returned to us.

Title: Elemental Fury
Objective: Pacify 8 Tide Surgers.
Text: The naga have angered the elements and disrupted the natural order. We must restore the balance before it is too late.A Farseer maintains a deep connection with the elements. When the naga forces imprisoned my master, the natural balance was disturbed.Take the Stone of Elements and use it to pacify the enraged water elementals throughout Dragon's Teeth Basin.Ultimately, our only solution is to rescue Farseer Ori and bring him back alive, but the Tidestone could buy us precious time...

Title: The Lost Shaman
Objective: Locate Apprentice Odari at Dragon's Teeth Basin.
Text: Pardon me. I am in need of your assistance.Our shaman, Farseer Ori, left the camp some days ago to investigate a nearby disturbance in the elements. He took his apprentice with him, a young initiate named Odari. Neither have returned.I am leading an expedition to find them and return them here safely. Nazjatar is full of dangers. The skills of an accomplished  like yourself could prove most useful.Will you help me return the lost shaman to safety?

Title: Supplies from the Rustbolt Resistance
Objective: Speak with Prince Erazim in Rustbolt for your reward.
Text: The Resistance appreciates all the help you've given us.Please take these supplies as a token of our gratitude, and a promise of more to come, should you continue to help us.

Title: Assault: Amathet Advance
Objective: Drive back the Amathet Assault in Uldum.
Text: The Amathet seek to claim the Forge of Origination for their own. We must not allow it to fall into their hands again!Our men are defending the entrance, but they will be overwhelmed if the entire might of the Amathet advances upon them.Do what you can to route their forces before its too late.

Title: The Dark Ranger's Pupil
Objective: Find Dark Ranger Velonara in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: I am Moorgoth, hunter of fearsome foes and hero of the Trueshot Lodge.You are a renowned champion of the Alliance, but I've been told you save those in peril. Please hear me out.I am friends with a ranger named Velonara. She serves the Horde, but I assure you she is a noble soul.She's been training an apprentice ranger who disappeared after receiving a letter from his brother. Velonara has gone to Tirisfal Glades to find him.I have a bad feeling about this. Would you check on her safety?

Title: The Dark Ranger's Pupil
Objective: Find Dark Ranger Velonara in Tirisfal Glades.
Text: Thank the abyss you're here, champion!I am Moorgoth, tracker of fearsome foes in dark places. Anyone in the Trueshot Lodge will vouch for my credentials.Dark Ranger Velonara and I are good friends, and I fear she is in peril.She's been training an apprentice dark ranger. Newly raised, she said. At any rate, her pupil ran off after receiving a letter from his brother, and now Velonara has gone to Tirisfal Glades to find him.I have a bad feeling about all this. Could you check on her safety?

Title: Tidying Up
Objective: Catch 200 Ionized Minnows.
Text: Ionized Minnows are a scourge of these waters. They strip the ocean floors of any food, making it difficult for other species to survive.These fish have little to offer other than being a food source for larger fish. I want to see these larger fish, so I have a plan to clear the waters of these minnows and lure the bigger fish out from its hiding place.Let's start by using my Minnow Vac to catch Ionized Minnows for me.

Title: Solarsprocket Barbel
Objective: Take the fish to Danielle Anglers.

Title: Tasty Steelfin
Objective: Take the fish to Danielle Anglers.

Title: Energized Lightning Cod
Objective: Take the fish to Danielle Anglers.

Title: Spitting Clownfish
Objective: Take the fish to Danielle Anglers.

Title: Sludge-fouled Carp
Objective: Take the fish to Danielle Anglers.

Title: Mechanical Blowfish
Objective: Take the fish to Danielle Anglers.

Title: Shadowy Cave Eel
Objective: Take the fish to Danielle Anglers.

Title: Pond Hopping Springfish
Objective: Take the fish to Danielle Anglers.

Title: Bolted Steelhead
Objective: Take the fish to Danielle Anglers.

Title: Fishing For Something Bigger
Objective: Find the Anodized Sentry Fish, Jarmouthed Goby and the Suction Tube.
Text: There's a huge fish lurking these waters, and it's been causing lots of problems!It eats other fish, fishermen, and a lot of expensive gear. I saw it swallow a beautiful Zigby 300 Fishing Rod along with its owner just the other day!I've got a plan, but I've lost a lot of my equipment in the waters around here. Can you help fish up some of these items for me?

Title: An Unending Sleep
Objective: Speak to Beastlord L'kala in Warbeast Kraal.

Title: Bottom Feeding Stinkfish
Objective: Take the fish to Danielle Anglers.

Title: A Loa Without a Temple
Objective: Deliver L'kala's offering to Torcali.
Text: I have given some thought about your situation.It is not your fault dat de goblin deceived us. I followed along with his scheme as well. From today, you have my forgiveness.But dat cannot help de little one. I fear we may lose it, if we do not act. We must ask de wanderer's loa, de mountain dat moves, de great bulwark, de greatmother of direhorns, to save her child.Take dis offering to her shrine and ask for her boon... and her forgiveness.

Title: Sleep, Eat, Repeat
Objective: Feed the Child of Torcali.

Title: A Show of Faith
Objective: Deliver the Blessed Offering to your direhorn hatchling in Warbeast Kraal.
Text: I have watched your efforts from afar, small thing. You have made mistakes, and one of my young has suffered for it.I do not forget, but I can forgive.As my people place faith in me, I place my faith in you. Take my blessing to my child and she will wake.

Title: A Growing Appetite
Objective: Feed the Child of Torcali.

Title: The Trust You've Earned
Objective: Retrieve the Direhorn Saddle in Warbeast Kraal.
Text: I believe my loa will agree with me when I say that you have proven yourself worthy of this one's companionship.She is large enough now that she can bear you wherever it is that you wish to go.I had de Beastlord craft a saddle for you. Go and get it and I will help you put it on your new steed's back.Congratulations.

Title: Away From the Herd
Objective: Help your direhorn cheer up.

Title: A Daughter of Torcali
Objective: Find the Child of Torcali in the Slough and rescue her from danger.
Text: It has long been remarked upon that a direhorn is de bravest beast in de jungle. That is why they are chosen as mounts for our warriors.In this case, that bravery may not be in your favor. De little one has run off and I do not think she is hungry this time.Best find her before she gets hurt.

Title: A Daughter of Torcali
Objective: Find the Child of Torcali in the Savagelands and rescue her from danger.
Text: It has long been remarked upon that a direhorn is de bravest beast in de jungle. That is why they are chosen as mounts for our warriors.In this case, that bravery may not be in your favor. De little one has run off and I do not think she is hungry this time.Best find her before she gets hurt.

Title: Even Greener Pastures
Objective: Find the Child of Torcali and lead her back to her pen.
Text: Ever since Torcali gave her boon to de little one, she has been growing like a weed. Dat makes her very hungry.She got out again to look for more things to eat. Before you ask, it is not my role to stop her from doing what she wants. Only to ensure she is safe.She is probably fine. Bring her home, and if you have trouble bringing her home, you might try a bribe.

Title: Eat Like a Direhorn
Objective: Feed the Child of Torcali.

Title: Greener Pastures
Objective: Find the Child of Torcali and lead her back to her pen.
Text: You have done an adequate job keeping de little one fed, but sometimes they just want something else.I did not see where de hatchling went, but you should start where de grass is real green. You will likely find her eating it.If you have trouble bringing her home, you might try a bribe.

Title: Away From the Herd
Objective: Play with your direhorn.

Title: The Other Ghostdancer
Objective: Speak with Mevris Ghostdancer in Val'sharah.
Text: When the Legion was attacking, my partner went to Val'sharah to fight the demons. Mevris may be cold and headstrong, but he's goal oriented, and willing to sacrifice to achieve them. That's part of why I fell in love with him. If there is anyone who would know where we could get the raw materials for something of this magnitude, it would be him. Head to Val'sharah, and look for him in the Temple of Elune. Tell him of our plan, and that we need his help securing scales.

Title: Repaying the Debt
Objective: Speak with Telonis in Stormwind.
Text: I was in Teldrassil when it was set alight. Through the panic and chaos, I knew I could not rest as long as those who did this were unpunished. I need you to go to Stormwind, find Telonis near the Lion's Rest, and ask for some of his personal collection. I managed to save him from the fires, so he owes me a great deal. I would go myself, but the loss of Teldrassil is still a fresh wound. I still need to give it time to heal. Find him, tell him I sent you, and that this will absolve his debt to me.

Title: Make Some Noise
Objective: Craft 6 Drums of Primal Might.
Text: We have everything we need to craft the drum, except Elune's blessing. The drum is but a vessel, like a cup. We need her to imbue the drum with power, filling the cup so that we may drink. With Tyrande donning the mantle of the Night Warrior, much of Elune's power is taxed. Asking for another favor is not insignificant, but I must try. While I'm doing that, I need you to craft the drum. Try to keep it small. The larger the vessel, the more power it can hold, but the harder it becomes to move.

Title: Instruments of Destruction
Objective: Place the Drums of Primal Might throughout Zandalar and Kul Tiras.
Text: There is one last thing we need to do.These drums, while powerful, are practically useless here in town.If you want to get the most benefit from them, you'll need to spread them out. I'd suggest one for each territory here and in Zandalar, to help you when you are on a quest and to keep you at your strongest when you're behind enemy lines.Look for someplace centralized in each territory to place drums.Once you return, I'll show you how to make the mallet needed to utilize the drums.

Title: Picking Bones
Objective: Collect 18 Unwaning Bones.
Text: When I was sailing in, I heard some of the sailors talking about the Horde presence here in Tiragarde Sound. Apparently they're scrounging around the remains of a massive creature that has washed ashore. Whatever it was, if the Horde wants it, we need to make sure they don't get it. Find the Horde, keep them from taking anything, and see if there are any bones from the creature we can use for our drums. Show them no mercy.

Title: Mevris' Menace
Objective: Collect Brilliant Azure Scales.
Text: There is a hydra that has been something of a nuisance for us as of late. It lives out on the Gloaming Reef, almost directly due west of here. It's been attacking ships that pass by, making it difficult to get supplies to and from Bradensbrook. I sent a team to handle it, but they haven't returned. Go out there, kill it, and take its scales to Daniss. And when you see her, tell her that I said...  Nothing.

Title: Telonis' Prized Leather
Objective: Retrieve the Rare Hides.
Text: I have a stash of extremely rare leathers, or... rather, I did. A group of thieves must have heard how valuable my collection was because they stole it! And THEN they had the audacity to leave a note offering to sell it back to me! As the "former owner", I'm able to "best appreciate the value of their new acquisition." The note states they'll be waiting in the foothills behind the castle, to the east, until they find another buyer. However you get the skins, consider them yours.

Title: The Aeonian Artisan
Objective: Meet the Night Elf Leatherworker in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Good day, friend! A Night Elf woman stopped by and asked who was the best leatherworker I knew who didn't mind getting their hands dirty. I gave her your name, and she asked me to ask you to find her in Boralus Harbor. She didn't say what she needed my best student for, but the way she acted makes me think that it is for something big. Head on down to the docks and look for her. She has white hair, purple tattoos, and a pet turtle named "Gouge". Show her what I've taught you!

Title: The Audition
Objective: Craft 3 Drums of the Maelstrom and bring them to Daniss Ghostdancer.
Text: Cassandra has spoken highly of your skills, but I need to be certain of what you can do. I mean no offense, this is as much for your benefit as it is our own, as if you are not ready the task could kill you. If you are willing, I would like provide you with a test to see how well you can work leather. Bring me three Drums of the Maelstrom that you have crafted yourself. This will prove your skill and consistency. If your work is up to par, I will inform you of my plan.

Title: Make Some Noise
Objective: Craft 6 Drums of Primal Might.
Text: We have everything we need to craft the drum, except the Earth Mother's blessing.The drum is but a vessel, like a cup. We need her to imbue the drum with power, filling the cup so that we may drink.It will not be easy to convince her to assist us in creating a weapon of war, but I will implore her to protect her children.While I'm doing that, you will need to craft the drum itself.Not too big, though. The larger the vessel, the more power it can hold, but the harder it becomes to carry.

Title: Bass Fishing
Objective: Collect Brilliant Golden Scales.
Text: Have you heard of people taking small golden carp as pets?Well, if it is kept in a pond free of predators, over time it can grow enormous, only limited by the food present.Centuries ago, one of these fish lived in the pond atop a mountain. It ate everything and began to starve, so my people dug a river that connected the pond to the ocean so the fish could be free.Now, fishermen talk of being attacked by an enormous golden fish in the Rockaway Shelf.Kill it. Take his scales back to Atikka.

Title: Rank 2 - Poen test
Objective: Collect $1oa corrupted ink sacs.
Text: Gather corrupted ink sacs from the Nazothian Brain squids.The naga use them to control us, let's see if it works the other way.

Title: Picking Bones
Objective: Collect 18 Unwaning Bones.
Text: When I was sailing in, I noticed the remains of an unbelievably large beast on the nearby peninsula.Whatever it was, it must have been strong, making it the perfect source for the bone elements of the drums.Go to the peninsula, 'Xibala' I've heard it called, and fill a bag with the bones you find.If you come across any of those damned Alliance, show them no mercy. They did this to themselves.

Title: Instruments of Destruction
Objective: Place the Drums of Primal Might throughout Zandalar and Kul Tiras.
Text: Our work is almost finished.These drums, while powerful, are practically useless here in port.If you want to get the most benefit from them, you'll need to spread them out. I'd suggest one for each territory here and in Kul Tiras, to help you when you are on a quest and to keep you at your strongest when you're behind enemy lines.Look for someplace centralized in each territory to place drums.Once you return, I'll show you how to make the mallet needed to utilize the drums.

Title: Dropping by the Base
Objective: Speak with Torv Dubstomp in Thunder Totem.
Text: When the Legion was attacking, I met with a member of the Highmountain Tauren who had a knack for making and playing drums.Torv usually keeps to himself, but he is as brilliant as he is insane.If there is anyone who would know where we could get the raw materials for something of this magnitude, it would be him.Head to Thunder Totem, and ask Torv Dubstomp if he can think of a suitable source of scales. Preferably something still living, so its power is still fresh.

Title: Sheza's Prized Leather
Objective: Retrieve the Rare Hides.
Text: I have a stash of extremely rare leathers, or... rather, I did.I don't know how, but the Venture Company must have heard how valuable my collection was because they stole it!And THEN they had the audacity to leave a note offering to sell it back to me for 1,000 gold! As the "former owner", I'm able to "best appreciate the value of their new acquisition."The note states they'll be in the bluffs to the East until someone buys them.However you get the skins, consider them yours.

Title: Repaying the Life Debt
Objective: Speak with Sheza Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
Text: When I heard that the Alliance attacked Dazar'alor, I couldn't help but think of those lost when they attacked Camp Taurajo. No longer can I sit idly while they continue to slaughter us!I need you to go to Thunder Bluff, find Sheza Wildmane on the Elder Rise, and ask for some of her personal collection.I won't go into detail, but she owes me a life debt, and seeing her would... bring back too many painful memories... for both of us.Find her, tell her I sent you, and that this absolves her debt.

Title: The Audition
Objective: Craft 3 Drums of the Maelstrom and bring them to Atikka Moonchaser.
Text: Xanjo has spoken highly of your skills, but I need to be certain of what you can do. I mean no offense, this is as much for your benefit as it is our own, as if you are not ready the task could kill you.If you are willing, I would like to provide you with a test to see how well you can work leather.Bring me three Drums of the Maelstrom that you have crafted yourself. This will prove your skill and consistency.If your work is up to par, I will inform you of my plan.

Title: Batteries Not Included
Objective: Collect 10 Damaged Energy Cells.
Text: You will not be sorry that you rescued my dear sister and me.We are the vanguard of a new technological revolution, creating opportunities for all to enhance their lives with incredible technology!But, before we can do that, we need our laboratory to be fully powered. Those ruffians from Mechagon really did a number on our equipment.Fully charged energy cells are exceptionally rare around here, but I can make do with broken ones.Check around town, in the wreckage from the last attack.

Title: Seam Stress
Objective: Follow Delormi through the Time Rift.
Text: I...I need a moment.There are gaps in my memories. Things important to me, lost now. We must stop her at all costs.

Title: Recharging Rustbolt
Objective: Use the NRG-100 to charge 6 generator energy cells.
Text: Our personal generator is worthless until we recharge its empty energy cells.As my dear brother says, energy cells are the lifeblood of innovation. Everything in Mechagon needs power, and energy cells deliver that power in a wonderfully universal format.But, once they're drained of power, most people toss the empty cells away.Most people are fools, dear test subject.We have perfected the technology to recharge small numbers of energy cells back to full power.Will you help us test it?

Title: Tearing at the Seams
Objective: Speak with Delormi when you're ready to leave and investigate the disturbance.
Text: I feel odd... weak. As though something is affecting my very existence.Would you come with me? I may need your help. At the very least, you could be a witness to whatever happens should something dire occur.

Title: Listen Up!
Objective: Protect Kelsey Steelspark in Stormsong Valley.
Text: Okay! Once we get this up and running we should be able to send messages! In the valley at least.It's gonna be a little bit tricky, but I've read the manual for these things cover to cover.I'm gonna put this thing back together. You watch out for the Horde.

Title: Collaborative Construction
Objective: Find a construction project in Mechagon and help build it.
Text: Construction projects can be found all over the island. You'll be able to build some of 'em yourself, but you're gonna need help with the bigger projects.Ask around and see what others are already working on, or just head out on your own and find a project you're interested in.Construction projects move around and even change day-to-day, so keep an eye out for new ones while you're exploring.If you're ever curious what construction projects are available on a given day, just ask me!

Title: Retaliation Coordination
Objective: Find Kelsey Steelspark in Stormsong Valley.
Text: Master Shaw deployed a number of Alliance spies near a base the Horde have made in Stormsong Valley. When our spies stopped checking in, he took Kelsey Steelspark and went to investigate.Now Master Shaw is the one who hasn't checked in.I need someone to go in and find our missing people and give them whatever help they clearly need.

Title: Reverberation
Objective: Use the Thunderspark to summon an Essence of Hati.
Text: Hati's spirit is bound to yours forevermore, hunter. But it also now carries a link to the Temple of Storms--as well as Silithus, I fear.The Thunderspark shares these same bonds. By physically linking it here, you can call upon the different aspects of Hati's spirit and bind them to yourself as well.Do not worry. Skoll and I will guard the Thunderspark with our very lives! It will be safe.

Title: Reassembly Required
Objective: Collect Spy Salvage from Horde Forces.
Text: Master Shaw wanted me to rebuild the listening posts the Horde destroyed when they started to clear the area in preparation for whatever they are planning.I managed to salvage most of the parts for one, but I'm missing a few.Fortunately for us, I've been watching the workers and they've been picking up the pieces of the destroyed machines. Go get our tech back and I can take care of the rest.

Title: Where the Road Leads
Objective: Travel to Mezzamere with Okani.
Text: My people know many secrets about this place. If you prove yourselves worthy allies, you will be privy to them.First, we must regroup in Mezzamere. There, we at least have a foothold against the tide.

Title: Tearing at the Seams
Objective: Speak with Delormi when you're ready to leave and investigate the disturbance.
Text: I feel odd... weak. As though something is affecting my very existence.Would you come with me? I may need your help. At the very least, you could be a witness to whatever happens should something dire occur.

Title: Seeking Higher Ground
Objective: Meet Kelsey Steelspark on the hill south of Warfang Hold.
Text: We've only got one shot at reestablishing our communication network, so we've got to pick the right spot and I found just the right place!While you've been busy down here, I set up some camouflage and hauled the bulk of the machinery up there.What? Did you think I was just sitting here polishing my knives while you were gone?Well, okay I did that too. Anyway, I'll meet you up the hill!

Title: Stranger in a Strange Land
Objective: Find the Hero's Call board in Stormwind City.
Text: Welcome to Stormwind. King Anduin Wrynn invites you to explore our fair city. Since you hail from Kul Tiras, might I suggest visiting our lovely docks? They are home to our majestic fleet. I would be shocked if you were not impressed!Ah, but that can wait. An emissary of Kul Tiras is standing by to tell you of adventures that await beyond the city walls.Have a pleasant stay.

Title: For the Alliance
Objective: Take the portal to Stormwind in the Sanctum of the Sages and meet with Ambassador Moorgard in the Stormwind Embassy.
Text: Thank you for meeting with me.I need representatives to go to Stormwind to represent our loyalty and commitment to our newly forged bond with the Alliance.I've had Yvia and her magi prepare a portal to the city for you in the Sanctum of the Sages. Once there, go to the Stormwind Embassy and meet with Ambassador Moorgard.You will face many challenges on the long journey ahead. Remember where you came from and make your people proud!

Title: Stranger in a Strange Land
Objective: Find the Warchief's Command Board in Orgrimmar.
Text: Hi. I'm Ambassador Blackguard.On behalf of the warchief, I am honored to welcome you to Orgrimmar.As a lifetime of adventure unfolds before you, be assured that... uh...You know what? I've been reading this same greeting all day. Enough's enough.Talk to your emissary and find out where you can adventure. Run along.

Title: Spy Versus Spy
Objective: Complete the mission "Spy on Warfang Hold"
Text: Naga attacks are on the rise, but that isn't all we have to deal with. We've received word of increased Horde activity near Warfang Hold in Stormsong Valley.Send some of our operatives to investigate what they are doing.

Title: Her Dog Days Are Over
Objective: Walk the Wicker Beast.

Title: For the Horde
Objective: Meet with Ambassador Blackguard in the Orgrimmar Embassy.
Text: Thank you for meeting me upon my throne.With our recent partnerin' with de Horde, I need worthy champions to represent the might of the Zandalari.I have chosen you to be among their ranks. Go and meet with the ambassador in Orgrimmar.We have prepared a portal just behind you. When you are ready, step through to a new world.Remember, you bow only to the throne of Zandalar. Hold your head high.

Title: Righting Wrongs
Objective: Meet with Baine Bloodhoof at Plunder Harbor in Tiragarde Sound.
Text: Champion! I come with an urgent request from Baine Bloodhoof. He asks that you meet him at Plunder Harbor to help him with a... sensitive situation.You must tell no one of this request.Ancestors watch over you.

Title: Loose Ends
Objective: Meet Kelsey Steelspark in Freehold.
Text: Our campaign against the Horde is going strong, but there are some loose threads to take care of.Lady Ashvane was broken out of Tol Dagor - by the Horde. We don't know where she's gone or what she is planning. I sent Kelsey out to track down some Ashvane Loyalists to get answers. She found them and has requested backup.She's waiting for you in Freehold.

Title: Getting a Clue
Objective: Slay Haughton Francis and recover his cipher.
Text: I'm betting that one page of jibberish is a coded message. We can send it back to Stormwind to be cracked by our codebreakers or we could break some heads and find the cipher here.I'm thinking we'll just save some time and do that.The guy in charge here probably has what we're looking for. Why don't you take him out and see if you can't find it. Even if you don't, without a leader the loyalists won't be much trouble. It's a win-win!Well, for us I guess.

Title: The Laboratory of Mardivas
Objective: Activate the Elemental Essence Amalgamator in Mardivas's Laboratory.
Text: At last, my research into the base elements has begun to bear fruit! With careful application of the right base reagents and some arcane power I've managed to combine the essence of the elements in such a way as to create life! Further investigation will be needed to determine what the various mixes of the elements will yield.

Title: Reporting In!
Objective: Report to Halford Wyrmbane in Boralus.
Text: Well it looks like Ashvane's been out of contact for some time but this 'Patron' thing could be a problem.You did excellent work today. Those Loyalists aren't going to be thinking about causing trouble for awhile, heh.I'll make my way back. You take the letter to the High Commander.

Title: Correspondence Conundrum
Objective: Discover information about Lady Ashvane's plans.
Text: I think Ashvane has been in contact with her loyalists, but I don't know what their orders are.Go into their camp and see if you can't read their mail. We might find something that leads back to where Lady Ashvane is hiding or what their next move is going to be.

Title: Junkyard Tinkering and You
Objective: Use Pascal-K1N6 to craft a Scrap Grenade.
Text: Behold, the fabled Pascal Workshop of Rustbolt -- MY workshop!Countless inventions have sprung forth into existence on this very spot, including my very finest invention, Pascal-K1N6!Pascal-K1N6 can craft anything... as long as you have the blueprints for it.And since I have you to thank for the K1N6's safe return to Rustbolt, would you like to learn how to access his blueprints database?

Title: Creature Study: Zanj'ir Naga
Objective: Use Maedin's Scroll to collect data from various creatures within Nazjatar.

Title: Ideas Can Come from Anywhere
Objective: Find people and things to inspire 1 new ideas in Mechagon.
Text: I didn't notice the tinkerer's spark in you when we first met.But look at all of the blueprints you've recovered and uploaded to Pascal-K1N6's database.I was wrong. And happily so, my budding junkyard tinkering apprentice!But this is a dangerous moment in your creative development.You must avoid complacency!Take time off to find new ideas. Speak with builders that inspire you, reverse-engineer bots on the island, and be open to new ideas - no matter where they come from!

Title: Send My Father a Message
Objective: Hack a projector to display the Rustbolt Resistance emblem and defend it.
Text: My people are once again safe... for now.King Mechagon won't stop sending his armies at us as long as he does not fear us.We must send him a message.Climb to the top of the ramparts, and hack one of my father's projectors to proudly shine the banner of the Rustbolt Resistance big enough for the whole island to see.I'm sure that'll attract the attention of my father, King Mechagon.

Title: Upheaval
Objective: Speak with Lady Jaina Proudmoore above the waterfall.
Text: So many lives lost... And the attacks from the naga are relentless!I apologize. This attitude is unbecoming of a king.We have no time to lose musing of our own plight.Let us meet with Jaina and descend from this perilous place into the unknown.

Title: Disruption of Power
Objective: Destroy 5 Ley Line Accumulators in Spears of Azshara.
Text: The naga tap into the power within nearby ley lines and have found a way to harness it.Destroy their devices before they can put that power to use against us.

Title: A Gathering of Foes
Objective: Witness the Horde gathering.
Text: Before I was distracted, I was able to find out more about this Horde gathering. Sylvanas has summoned the leaders of the Horde and its allies. For what purpose, I cannot say.We aren't in a position to strike her down--she is too well-protected. But perhaps we can learn something that will prove useful in the ongoing war.Keep your head low and take a look. I'll keep an eye out for more guards.

Title: Stay Low, Stay Fast!
Objective: Follow Neri Sharpfin.
Text: It's a straight shot home. We just need to be careful.Neri's rule of survival number six: always be prepared!Let's go!

Title: TBD NOT USED
Objective: Collect the Junkyard Blueprint Book from Scrapthief Grillin.
Text: The fabled workbench of Rustbolt - MY workbench - has fallen into disrepair!This tragedy was no doubt caused by the same ruffians and miscreants who kidnapped me and Princess Wiggles.The VERY same ruffians and miscreants, in fact, who still show their faces in this very town on the regular.Their presence here is a veritable slap to our collective faces!Dispatch the snatchers quickly and recover my binder of blueprints. We may then commence crafting what we shall need to repair this.

Title: Blueprint: Anti-Gravity Pack
Objective: Upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database.

Title: Blueprint: Encrypted Black Market Radio
Objective: Upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database.

Title: The Gathering Storm
Objective: Report to Jaina Proudmoore near Proudmoore Keep in Boralus.
Text: While I deal with the naga incursions, Lady Proudmoore is going to take on handling the Horde in Stormsong Valley and figuring out what happened to our spies there.You'll find her near Proudmoore Keep.

Title: Shaw's Shank Redemption
Objective: Find Mathias Shaw in The Screaming Pit above Warfang Hold.
Text: Hmm. Shaw said he'd check in when we got communications back but he hasn't. He's probably run into the same trouble the rest of our spies did.I'll stay here and guard the listening post. You find Shaw. He was headed for the cliff above Warfang Hold near the top of the waterfall. The peons called that area "The Screaming Pit" for some reason. I bet it's a real pleasant place.Stab whatever he's fighting for me, okay?

Title: Lost in the Field
Objective: Assist injured spies in Stormsong Valley.
Text: When Shaw and I got here we discovered most of our operatives were dead. Most, but not all.Go into the field and get any of our operatives out of there. They might have more intel on what the Horde are planning here in Warfang Hold.

Objective: Upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database.

Title: Blueprint: Canned Minnows
Objective: Upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database.

Title: Upheaval
Objective: Speak with Chief Telemancer Oculeth at the top of the waterfall.
Text: We're surrounded by the dead, dying, and other detritus.Feels like war, does it not?Oculeth and others have gone ahead to see to the soldiers.Perhaps you ought to see to them as well?

Title: A Way Home
Objective: Help Oculeth open a portal to Zuldazar.
Text: We can harness the power within this place to open a portal home.I will require your assistance. Isn't this fun? You get to be my assistant!Ah, yes. Just come with me and all you have to do is wave that Heart of Azeroth of yours around. I'll handle the rest.

Title: Build A Bigger Fish Trap
Objective: Build the Hundred-Fathom lure.
Text: With those minnows and some spare parts, you should be able to build a Hundred-Fathom Lure.Visit Pascal-K1N6 in Rustbolt and build one.Then come back here, and we'll catch a huge fish!

Title: A Display of Power
Objective: Speak to Nathanos Blightcaller to witness the meeting of leaders in Warfang Hold.
Text: It looks like all the big players are here. This thing's gonna be starting any moment now.You'll probably want to get a good seat.

Title: My Brother's Keeper
Objective: Sail with Jaina to meet Baine off the coast of Theramore.
Text: While I trust Valeera believes she is not leading us into a trap, I do not trust this isn't a Horde manipulation., I want you to come with me. I will meet with Baine, but I will not do so alone.

Title: Securing Warfang Hold
Objective: Meet with Boss Mida at Warfang Hold in Stormsong Valley.
Text: , the Dark Lady has need of your services once more.The traitor, Baine, is being brought before the leaders of the Horde at Warfang Hold. Preparations are underway as we speak to secure the area.The efforts are headed up by Gallywix's minions, who I wouldn't trust to secure a kennel. You will need to go to Warfang Hold and make sure the area is locked down.We are counting on you.

Title: Communication Breakdown
Objective: Destroy 3 SI:7 Listening Devices near Warfang Hold.
Text: It looks like the stealth generators aren't the only tech that SI:7 is bringing into the field. Our scouts have reported what look like listening devices set up at key points around Warfang.Obviously, these things have to go, but the goons haven't been able to get close to them on account of the hidden spies.While you're out there, make sure to trash 'em.

Title: Tickets, Please?
Objective: Eject 5 ticketless Visiting Spectators from Warfang Hold.
Text: There's another problem we could use your help with.Gallywix knew this meeting was going to be a big deal, so naturally he decided to sell tickets. The thing is, I've done a headcount here, and we've got a lot more people here than tickets sold, so some of these spectators are trying to pull a fast one.Most of our muscle is out in the Clearcut getting killed by spies, so we could use the help. Care to make an honest wage?

Title: Don't Shoot the Messenger
Objective: Listen to Valeera's message.
Text: While he was the gladiator known as Lo'Gosh, King Varian fought beside Valeera Sanguinar. He trusted her and that allowed SI:7 to have a... cordial relationship with her. Valeera's loyalty has carried on to King Anduin.During the fight with the Legion, I came to know her as a capable if... independent operative. She can go where even some of my agents cannot.We should listen to whatever message she brings. I imagine the source will be interesting.

Title: Spy Games
Objective: Use the Electronic Mayhem Projector to reveal and kill 10 SI:7 spies in the Clearcut.
Text: The Alliance must've got wind of this meeting and they've sent SI:7 spies to try to listen in.The problem is, they're using some kind of gnomish tech to sneak past our detectors. One of our techs was able to put together something that should be able to neutralize whatever they're using, but the range is short.I'll need you to take it out into the field and look for evidence of SI:7 activity. Just mash the button on that thing when you think they're close, and it should zap 'em back into view.

Title: The Master Shipwright
Objective: Acquire the Letter from the Lord Admiral and meet Cyrus Crestfall in Brennadam.
Text: Now I am starting to remember...Dorian Atwater was a very secretive builder. Their slips were famously warded against prying eyes until the vessel was complete. It made something of a stir any time one of their works was revealed.Last I heard, they retired in Stormsong Valley. I am not certain how reliable that information is.Hm. We should head to Brennadam. It is a crossroads of sorts. If anyone knows where to find our shipwright, they will be there.

Title: Under False Colors
Objective: Start the mission "Casting the Bait" then report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard the Banshee's Wail in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: If we wish to stay the executioner's axe, we'll need to throw Sylvanas off of our scent. You'll need to have your men take the ship to Chandlery Wharf, where they can disguise it as a pirate's bounty.Your task will be to ensure that Sylvanas' forces find the ship there.You must report to Nathanos that you spotted a stolen Forsaken vessel in that area. You have no connection to Derek Proudmoore, so it should raise no suspicions.

Title: Looking Inside
Objective: Enter the vault.
Text: This vault screams of ancient gnomish tech! I believe this could be the key that leads us to King Mechagon!I can't risk putting myself in danger though, so you will lead the way into the vault.Well, what are we waiting for? Let's see what's inside!

Title: Securing Warfang Hold
Objective: Meet with Boss Mida at Warfang Hold in Stormsong Valley.
Text: The Dark Lady has important work for you.Preparations are beginning for a meeting of the Horde's leadership at Warfang Hold. I trust I don't need to emphasize that security is of the highest import for this gathering.The goblin, Gallywix, has sent his underlings to make sure the area is swept of any... unwanted guests. I need you to make sure they succeed in their task.

Title: Fish Tales and Distant Sails
Objective: Ask for information about the shipwright in Brennadam.
Text: I have an idea where to start, but it couldn't hurt to ask the locals.I hope it goes without saying that you shouldn't believe everything you hear. My people are very fond of embellishing the truth.I will meet you in The Golden Flagon when you've had a chance to ask around.

Title: A Terrible Place
Objective: Complete a Vision of N'Zoth.
Text: You may have noticed all the disturbances happening around Azeroth. The Old God is rising, and its bad news for all of us.On occasion, one of these Pillars of Endless Truth will appear. Wonderful name don't you think? I have a knack for naming things.Where was I? Oh yes, right, these Pillars grant one access to the very mind of the Old God himself. They will show you a hint of what might yet come, what this world will look like should we fail to defeat him.Are you willing to see for yourself?

Title: Bizmo's Brawlpub Awaits!
Objective: Bring an invitation to Bizmo's Brawlpub.
Text: Tired of standing around in the boring old Trade District? Come on over to Bizmo's Brawlpub, and fight for the amusement of others!You might win, or you might get killed, but either way, you're going to have a great time.Grab an invitation and bring it to Han Heavypaw, near the front door. The Brawlpub awaits!

Title: It's Scrap Work...
Objective: Use the Coiled Current Culler on dead V-300 SENTRIES at the Abandoned Junkheap, then use it to collect the Ub3r-Spanner schematic from the Reinforced Schematic Cache.
Text: , I'm glad you stopped by.The Ub3r-Spanner, capable of crafting powerful constructs, and its schematic have been lost for years. Intel tells us that its schematic is located in a locked cache in The Abandoned Junkheap.You'll need to overcharge its electric barrier to gain access. Take my Current Culler and soak up some of the latent current from the sentries there and zap that chest open!Up for some treasure huntin'?

Title: Ashes to Ashvane
Objective: Slay Ashvane Loyalists in Freehold.
Text: This place is just crawling with Ashvane loyalists.How about we do the Kul Tirans a favor and get rid of some of them.I got a head start on the way here, but there's plenty to go around!

Title: It's Scrap Work...
Objective: Use the Coiled Current Culler on dead V-300 SENTRIES at the Abandoned Junkheap, then use it to collect the Ub3r-Spanner schematic from the Reinforced Schematic Cache.
Text: , I'm glad you stopped by.The Ub3r-Spanner, capable of crafting powerful constructs, and its schematic have been lost for years. Intel tells us that its schematic is located in a locked cache in The Abandoned Junkheap.You'll need to overcharge its electric barrier to gain access. Take my Current Culler and soak up some of the latent current from the sentries there and zap that chest open!Up for some treasure huntin'?

Title: Solving the Mystery
Objective: Bring the Mysterious Challenge Card to Bizmo's Brawlpub to confront Bizmo's captor.
Text: I grabbed this challenge card from my attackers while we were fighting each other! I'm sure that you can use it to challenge my attacker to some sort of ultimate showdown!

Title: Unchained Resistance
Objective: Free 6 Makrura Slaves.
Text: The naga have enslaved a tribe of makrura and sent them to labor as mindless thralls.The naga forces may be more in number, but the makrura have an innate advantage in both size and strength.If we break the makrura from their chains, they will surely overwhelm their naga overseers and put a dent in Queen Azshara's plans.

Title: Blueprint: Scrap Trap
Objective: Upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database.

Title: The Brawlpub Trial
Objective: Reach a verdict in the Brawlpub Trial.
Text: I've issued three warrants. Jussho, Saralara, and Anne are apprehending the suspects as we speak.It's time to go to court.You may be called on to testify. Just answer as honestly as you can, and let the wheels of justice do the rest.

Title: A Clue from Area 52
Objective: Investigate Area 52 in Netherstorm for a sign of the letter's writer.
Text: We've received a letter from Area 52, the goblin outpost in Netherstorm. The author claims to know details about what they call "the situation in the Brawlpub".They don't say more than that.I'm tied to my paperwork here. Go check out this lead and see if anything turns up.

Title: Flaunt It If You Got It
Objective: Drink a bottle of Moneybrau, purchase a round of drinks at the bar in Bizmo's Brawlpub, and hit a fighting player with an Amberseed Bun while standing in the VIP Lounge.
Text: Sigh... so dull...Oh, it's you! , was it? I've seen a few of your fights. They're slightly less tedious than the standard humdrum bloodsport this arena has been producing lately.Let's spice things up a bit. Maybe buy some expensive drinks for ourselves? Buy a round of the cheap stuff for the riffraff below? Maybe even toss a few amberseed buns at the combatants?

Title: Simply Dying of Boredom
Objective: Use the Bizmo's Brawlpub Sign in Stormwind's Trade District.
Text: Up until now, I've been dying of boredom up here. I think maybe we need some new blood here in the arena. Bizmo can be so stingy with his invitations, can't he?I've had one of my servants write up a few slightly-counterfeit invitations to hand out. Maybe you could help me get them distributed? There's always plenty of tough-looking characters hanging out in front of the auction house in the Trade District...

Title: Evidence Packet: Grant Lazarby
Objective: Bring the Evidence Packet to Commander Daalo.
Text: Good work. I never expected Lazarby to be so... self-incriminating.You may bring the packet to Commander. I'm going to go buy some expensive snacks at the VIP bar.

Title: Evidence Packet: Shadowmaster O'Flannerty
Objective: Bring the Evidence Packet to Commander Daalo.
Text: Sounds like we've found our perp. This guy's sketchy, desperate, and his shadow magic is consistent with that shadowy scroll you found earlier.Bring this packet to Daalo, and we can bring him in. Good work out there!

Title: Evidence Packet: Lord Winifred Browne
Objective: Bring the Evidence Packet to Commander Daalo.
Text: I heard everything. That guy sure does talk loudly about his crimes and debts, doesn't he?It sounds like we have enough to bring him in for questioning. I've put together a packet of evidence for Commander Daalo to review.Good job out there.

Title: The Fizzlesprang Goggle Experiment
Objective: Put on Saralara's Goggles while fighting in Bizmo's Brawlpub and look for evidence against Shadowmaster O'Flannerty.
Text: Okay, before we start, I've got a few rules:First, these goggles will only work at close range. We're looking for something INSIDE the arena, so you'll have to be inside the arena to use them.Second rule: if you feel something starting to explode, try to blink real hard.Lastly, remember, we're looking for an evil shadow monster. You don't need to kill it, we just need you to see it so we can report it as evidence.Alright, go get in that arena and try them out!

Title: The Precious 13-Tooth Gogglegear
Objective: Obtain a 13-Tooth Gogglegear from G.G. Engineering. You can purchase their challenge card from Card Trader Leila.
