Text: We're going to have to invent something. Something capable of seeing into alternate dimensions. Something explosive that you strap directly onto your eyes.That's right, I'm talking about goggles.I already have all the goggle parts except for one: a 13-tooth gear. They're nearly impossible to find, but I KNOW that the G.G. Engineering boys have one, and Card Trader Leila has their challenge card.

Title: Undercover Agent: Saralara Fizzlesprang
Objective: Speak with Saralara Fizzlesprang at Bizmo's Brawlpub.
Text: I believe you've met one of my other agents: Saralara Fizzlesprang. She's investigating our second suspect: Shadowmaster O'Flannerty.You'll find Saralara near the scene of the crime.

Title: Cause for Concern
Objective: Report to Saralara Fizzlesprang.
Text: Shadowmaster O'Flannerty's behavior was unusual.His repeated mutterings about "shadow magic" and "void apocalypses" and "ancient creatures hungering for the souls of the living" certainly warrant further investigation.You should report back to Saralara Fizzlesprang.

Title: A Favor for Your Old Chum Winifred
Objective: Lose a fight in Bizmo's Brawlpub.
Text: A moment of your time.It's about all that money you won from me. Interestingly enough, that may have been slightly more money than I actually have, and now it would appear that some very powerful people want to break my elbows and my knees.I cannot pay them! |cFF0000FFI am quite broke!|r Ha ha!All I need to get back above water is for you to lose your next fight. Flop like a fish, as they say. Please.

Title: Undercover Agent: Ann Dennyson
Objective: Report to Ann Dennyson in Bizmo's Brawlpub.
Text: Lord Winifred Browne is one of our primary suspects in this case. Browne is an infamously aggressive speculator, and has a list of debts a mile long.He may be in need of money, which is consistent with the evidence you found earlier.My associate Ann has taken point on the case. I'd like you to assist her. I think you'll work well together.

Title: Murder at the Brawlpub
Objective: Investigate the scene of the crime.
Text: The Brawlpub quartermaster lies dead in front of you. He was murdered in broad daylight!He must have been assassinated while someone was fighting in the arena. Maybe even during one of your fights.Perhaps there are some clues nearby as to who might have killed him.

Title: Put Up Your Dukes
Objective: Win any 3 fights in Bizmo's Brawlpub.
Text: You know what?I COULD use a good  on my investigations team. We've had some personnel issues lately and, frankly, I can use all the help I can get.But first: why don't you go hop into the arena for a few fights so I can get a good look at your skills?

Title: The Start of Something Bigger
Objective: Board the Expedition Gyrocopter.
Text: We have coordinates locked into the gyrocopters. You and Captain Winklespring will fly the lead. If we run into any trouble, Tinkmaster Overspark wants the most experienced pilots out front.Board whenever you are ready to go.

Title: Remembrance
Objective: Deliver the offering to your spirit guide on the cliffs overlooking Thunder Bluff.
Text: You may remember the day Thunder Bluff was attacked. It was your efforts and your guide who saved us.Now we take time to honor our ancestors and give thanks for the path they have set for us.Bring this offering to the cliffs overlooking Thunder Bluff and give thanks to your guide and all our ancestors.A simple gesture to commemorate our past. This is our way.

Title: A Savage Path Through Time
Objective: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
Text: The brutal star shines upon the land, threatening to trample underfoot all who stand in its path. This star is many things: primal, fierce, and noble. While its influence holds, new paths may open up to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

Title: Waking a Dreamer
Objective: Defend Vassandra Stormclaw as she summons Goldrinn.
Text: This should be all I need to call upon the Ancient.Some unwanted visitors may answer the call first. Protect me as I perform the ritual!

Title: Under False Colors
Objective: Start the mission "Casting the Bait" then report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard the Banshee's Wail in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: If we wish to stay the executioner's axe, we'll need to throw Sylvanas off of our scent. I will take the ship near Chandlery Wharf, which has recently been taken by Irontide pirates. There, I will leave it under the guise of a pirate raid gone wrong.Your task will be to ensure that Sylvanas' forces find this ship.You must report to Nathanos that you spotted a stolen Forsaken vessel in that area. You have no connection to Derek Proudmoore, so it should raise no suspicions.

Title: Let Sleeping Wolves Lie
Objective: Enter the Dream Portal and guide Tess.
Text: Tess's essence now wanders a section of the Emerald Dream I have twisted into her thoughts. And I have given her my gift, but she could still use a guide.Enter the Dream through the portal behind me. It will place you near where she sleeps. See if you can help show her how rage may blind a mortal.

Title: The Spirit of the Hunter
Objective: Retrieve the fangs from Mistfang wolves.
Text: The other thing I may need for this ritual are the fangs of a wolf.There is a pack that has newly settled in around Manor Mistmantle. Bring me their fangs. I will await your return at Twilight Grove.

Title: Dead in the Water
Objective: Defeat 6 crew members aboard the Swift Vengeance.
Text: Once Proudmoore is freed, we will need to commandeer this ship to transport him to Theramore, where his sister awaits us.Zelling's magic can guide the ship there, but first we'll need to take care of the crew.

Title: The New Guard
Objective: Meet Tess Greymane at Stormwind Keep.
Text: I need to speak with my parents again. I think my father and I have a bit to discuss.Meet me back at Stormwind Keep. I would like to thank you in a more formal manner.

Title: Into Duskwood
Objective: Speak with Vassandra Stormclaw in Duskwood.
Text: There is a night elf I met in Teldrassil, Vassandra Stormclaw, who may be able to teach Tess without resorting to such an extreme measure. She is the one who originally helped our people with their affliction.Vassandra is currently in Duskwood, assisting the residents of Raven Hill with their attempts to cure the feral worgen in the area. If anyone knows about the curse, it is her.As a more personal request, do not let my daughter do anything too rash. She takes after her father in that way.

Title: Cry to the Moon
Objective: Gather a bloom of Elune's Grace.
Text: Duskwood has a direct connection to the Emerald Dream. Through this connection, I may be able to call forth the Ancient Goldrinn. He will be able to give the princess a taste of the curse she so dangerously chases.A rare bloom grows on the east side of the woods, gather its bloom and meet me in Twilight Grove. It will help me with this ritual.

Title: Against Overwhelming Odds
Objective: Slay 25 Level 120+ Alliance anywhere within Kul Tiras, Zandalar or Nazjatar.
Text: It appears we've allowed the Alliance forces to fester. If these reports are correct, they're outnumbering us in nearly every bastion we hold.Arm yourself, grab a few of your most trusted allies and put them into the ground!

Title: The Shadow of Gilneas
Objective: Meet with Tess Greymane at Stormwind Keep.
Text: Champion of Gilneas!I have a letter for you from Princess Tess Greymane. She requests your presence in Stormwind Keep.

Title: Bane of the Nightbane
Objective: Subdue Bloodeyes and return with her to Raven Hill.
Text: Princess Greymane has informed me of the situation and I do have an idea of how to help.But first, a favor for a favor. The residents of Duskwood have been plagued recently by a particularly ferocious member of the Nightbane pack that they call 'Bloodeyes'. Take Master Harris's sedative and bring the worgen back to me alive. She will be a perfect subject to test cures on.

Title: A Way Home
Objective: Help Jaina open a portal to Boralus.
Text: We are only alive thanks to the ankoan and Azshara's desire to toy with us.We will learn more of Okani's people in the times ahead, I am sure.For now, we must establish a portal home. While Azshara is blocking our traditional methods of magical travel, I can sense a powerful convergence of energies nearby.I believe we can use it to open a way home.

Title: A Brief Respite
Objective: Support your allies in Nazjatar by getting one to rank 3.
Text: We have much to do. However, we are all weary and require rest. Decisions made while fatigued are almost always the wrong ones to make.The Ankoan have offered their home to us, yet they are barely holding on themselves. We should do what we can to support them while we think about our next move.See what you can do to aid their hunting parties, it may be the only way we survive in this place.

Title: Descent
Objective: Jump off the falls.
Text: We've lost the bulk of our forces already; any more and we won't have enough to make a stand.This wreckage won't keep the naga at bay, so we must find safety elsewhere.You will have to trust me here. Leap off the falls and you will descend safely.

Title: Chopped Bots
Objective: 12 Re-animated bots delivered to Bolten Springspark.
Text: Chopping up bots is my business. Any bots you bring to my scrapper will be broken up into useful parts. It's a win for both of us!Use the Bot-Energizer to bring me dead bots, and we'll break them into spare parts.

Title: Against Overwhelming Odds
Objective: Slay 25 Level 120+ Horde anywhere within Kul Tiras, Zandalar, Nazjatar, Uldum or Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Text: We've received numerous reports of the Horde overwhelming our forces within both Kul Tiras and Zandalar.Brute forcing the Alliance with sheer numbers is an age-old tactic of the Horde, but we can't allow them to get the upper hand.Venture forth throughout and thin their numbers the best you can. I recommend bringing reinforcements.

Title: A One-Way Ticket to the Heart
Objective: Evacuate MOTHER from Uldir
Text: These titan facilities never cease tae amaze me. I can only imagine how many of their secrets Brann has yet tae uncover.I just hope that one o' them holds the answer tae saving Azeroth.It's time tae bring MOTHER tae the Chamber of Heart. Be prepared for anythin', champion. Ye can never be quite sure what will happen when ye activate a titan machine.

Title: Under Lock and Keys
Objective: Collect the Captain's Key, Apothecary's Key, and Navigator's Key on the Swift Vengeance, then use them to open the Reinforced Cage.
Text: Three keys? It seems Sylvanas didn't trust any one member of this crew to have access to Proudmoore.We won't be able to rescue Derek Proudmoore if we can't get his cage open.We'll need to keep an eye out for keys while we clear the ship.

Title: Righting Wrongs
Objective: Meet with Baine Bloodhoof at Plunder Harbor in Tiragarde Sound.
Text: Champion! I come with an urgent request from Baine Bloodhoof. He asks that you meet him at Plunder Harbor to help him with a... sensitive situation.You must tell no one of this request.Ancestors watch over you.

Title: Ships in the Night
Objective: Take the boat to the Swift Vengeance and find Derek Proudmoore.
Text: Sylvanas has gone too far this time. We may be at war with the Alliance, but there are certain lines we cannot cross.I must right this situation, but I need your assistance. Derek Proudmoore is being held on the Swift Vengeance, which is moored in the harbor here for supplies.We must take him and bring him back to his family. Are you with me?

Title: A Bitter Reunion
Objective: Speak to Thomas Zelling to set sail to Theramore.
Text: We've done it! Zelling will guide the ship to Theramore, and we can put an end to this foul business once and for all.Speak to Zelling when you are ready to leave, and we will set sail.

Title: More Mouths To Feed
Objective: Collect 30 Snapshell Flesh.
Text: The naga attack us relentlessly, so there is precious little time to hunt for food and supplies.You have brought many soldiers to our camp, so we must hunt while we have the chance or we will soon run out of food.

Title: Report to Gila
Objective: Meet up with Gila Crosswires in Boralus.
Text: I was quite fortunate that King Mechagon found me worthy!I will send my assistant Gila Crosswires ahead to Boralus to gather a new team. Meet up with her and help out as you can.I will join both of you shortly.

Title: A Small Team
Objective: Gather the team members.
Text: I've determined the single attribute that is most important for a team member to survive an expedition to Mechagon.That attribute is...being a gnome!Gather these gnomes and meet Tinkmaster Overspark and myself at the departure point.

Title: Necessity is the MOTHER
Objective: Take Magni to meet MOTHER and activate Waygate Consoles
Text: I may be Azeroth's speaker, but Brann's the expert on titan archaeology. If he says that MOTHER can help us save Azeroth, then I'm more than willing tae place my faith in her.Come, champion. Let's hear what guidance she has tae offer.

Title: Scouting The Strand
Objective: Locate the Ankoan scouts at the Ashen Strand.
Text: It has been a long time since we have heard from our scouts at the outpost.They may have been cut off from us due to the naga attack. I need to check in with them and get an update on the movements of the naga forces.You should come with me, this will be a good opportunity for you to meet more of the clan and get a closer look at our operation.

Title: Let's Get It Started
Objective: Repair the device.
Text: I theorize this to be a communication relay. It is non-operational, but gnomish ingenuity and your strong back shall soon solve that problem!I need you to help get this device functional.

Title: Mechanical Liberation
Objective: Free Mecha-Golems in the Scalefang Outpost.
Text: Since you successfully interrupted my nap, my defenses are obviously lacking to say the least.That's because the sethrak, in addition to stealing my gadgets and gizmos, stole my mechs! Those morons don't even have the keys!Here, take my keys and get my mechs back.

Title: Heresy!
Objective: Slay Prelate Kaj'ra.
Text: My own prelates are among them that revolted against Talanji. This is an unspeakable heresy.I will not tolerate it!This one has wisely told me who is to blame. My second, Kaj'ra.I would have heard her, had she used any other means to make her concerns known. Now she must be disposed of.You will find her in de Terrace of de Chosen.

Title: Ready to Rumble
Objective: Acquire a Sixteen-Servo-Actuator from Bondo Bigblock.
Text: We're going to need a new Sixteen-Servo-Actuator if we're going to fix the controls on this thing.Bondo's gang at the yard probably has one, but they usually aren't too helpful.Talk to Bondo, see if you can get us one.

Title: A Brother's Help
Objective: Travel to Nazmir and meet Magni outside Uldir.
Text: Ye've done well to stem the tide of destruction that threatens Azeroth, but I fear it's not enough.I can still hear her cryin' out in pain, and we're runnin' out o' options... and time.Meet me in Nazmir, outside the Heart of Darkness. Together, we'll seek guidance from someone who may be able to help.

Title: Homeward Bound
Objective: Meet Thorim at the Temple of Storms.
Text: The reformation procedure went positively flawlessly! Most excellent results indeed--and plenty of data to analyze!I'm not sure what it is Thorim has to show you, but I suggest you get to the Temple of Storms right away. He gets a bit destructive when he's kept waiting.Take my teleporter pad directly out of Ulduar. I'm afraid the normal route to the entrance is... inoperable at the moment.

Title: The Huntsman's Creed
Objective: Absorb Hati's essence into the Thunderspark at the Temple of Storms.
Text: Through the glorious wonder of science, I have managed to keep the Thunderspark powered precisely for this purpose.All you need to do is get to the Temple of Storms and absorb Hati's essence into it. Just... kind of point it in his general direction.Oh, and do keep in mind that this is only one part of Hati. You may run into a few... technical difficulties before he's subdued enough for the absorption protocol.

Title: The Nuts and Bolts of It
Objective: Collect 1000 spare parts.
Text: I started working on the leg gearing. Most the gearing around here is built from spare parts we find in the scrap heaps.We're going to need a lot of spare parts to fix this thing. See what you can find.

Title: Bonds of Thunder
Objective: Reform Hati.
Text: While you infused Hati's essence into the Thunderspark, I have concocted a flawless plan the likes of which the scientific world has never seen!I'll spare you the technical details. Just follow my instructions and Hati will be back in one piece in no time at all!...Or we will all explode. But risks must be taken in the pursuit of knowledge and the well-being of our furry companions, wouldn't you agree?

Title: Telemetry Online
Objective: Assist Mimiron in locating Hati's essence.
Text: When Titanstrike's power was expended in Silithus, Hati's essence managed to sever itself from the Thunderspark just in time to avoid destruction.The only problem is that his essence was then scattered across Azeroth, and we don't know where.Now that we've locked onto his energy signature, we should be able to triangulate Hati's position!

Title: Spark of Genius
Objective: Meet Mimiron at the Inventor's Library in the Storm Peaks.
Text: , I have wondrous news!A recent energy signature tripped several detection relays I installed after that unfortunate incident with Sargeras.I require further data to know for certain, but initial diagnostics suggest that these energies are coming from Hati! We might still be able to save him!Hati's spirit is still bound to your own, so I'll need your help. Meet me at my library in the Storm Peaks right away!

Title: Spark of Imagination
Objective: Use the Teleportation Pad outside Ulduar to rendezvous with Mimiron in his workshop.
Text: I've diverted all non-essential power to prepare for Hati's reformation, so I cannot teleport you to Ulduar from here.Be extremely careful with the Thunderspark on your way. It is charged with highly volatile energy. One wrong bump could lead to serious complications!

Title: Paid in Blood
Objective: Absorb Hati's essence into the Thunderspark at the Wound in Silithus.
Text: If Mimiron's fancy gadgets be right, then the other half o' Hati is near the wound in Silithus.We'll have tae move quickly. Even with part o' his essence contained, I can feel him fadin' away fast!'Tis a long trip. Let's get movin'!

Title: Buzzkill
Objective: Repair 4 Buzzboxes in Darkshore.
Text: Some nefarious no-goodnik is tampering with my Buzzboxes!I've been trying to get the Buzzbox network back online since we were able to drive the Horde out of Darkshore, but I'm getting no reading from boxes 456, 627, 111, and 854! I'd be willing to bet that some stragglers from the Bilgewater Cartel are to blame!See if you can get those Buzzboxes back online, will you? We'll need their readings if we ever want to permanently fix the corruption problem here.

Title: Remaining Threats
Objective: Defeat 12 rare enemies in Darkshore.
Text: We have managed to route the Horde presence in Darkshore, but several threats remain throughout the countryside.If we wish to hold this land, they must be eliminated.

Title: Tapping the Breach
Objective: Defeat 20 Twilight elementalists in Darkshore.
Text: We had thought the Twilight's Hammer's presence in Darkshore was snuffed out with the defeat of Deathwing. Apparently, we were mistaken.Remnants of their cult have used the conflict in Darkshore as an opportunity to re-establish their presence here. Darkshore is home to several breaches of elemental power, and it looks like they aim to use these to unleash powerful elementals to devastate the land.This must not stand.

Title: We Are Coming
Objective: Inform Ralston Karn to prepare for the assault on Darkshore.
Text: We must press our advantage before the Horde can further its hold on Darkshore.The kaldorei stand ready to fight for our home, and the Gilneans stand alongside us.We will show our enemies our fury. They will learn to fear us.Rally any you can. We march at once.

Title: Buzzkill
Objective: Destroy 4 Buzzboxes in Darkshore.
Text: Some gnome's been goin about planting these strange machines in the woods here. I don't know what they do, but I'll be dead before I let gnomish machines sully goblin territory!Find these "buzzboxes" and reduce them to scrap. I'll make sure you're compensated for your troubles.

Title: Blessing of the Tides
Objective: Choose a name for the new vessel, then witness Brother Pike's blessing.
Text: Dorian certainly lives up to her reputation.This magnificent vessel is complete and now it has a crew. Two pieces remain.First, we must give the ship a name.Then it falls to Brother Pike to bless this vessel. As is tradition, a tidesage's blessing fortifies the ship against storms and encourages fair weather and smooth seas. It is as much ceremonial as it is practical.Once that is done, we will set sail for Stormwind.

Title: Tapping the Breach
Objective: Defeat 20 Twilight elementalists in Darkshore.
Text: Darkshore is home to several elemental breaches which hold massive amounts of power.The remnants of the Twilight's Hammer know this. While we were preoccupied with the Kaldorei, their elementalists have moved to exploit these locations of power, calling forth massive elementals to do their bidding.Their actions must not go unchecked.

Title: Operation: Troggageddon
Objective: Clear out Sparkspanner's army.
Text: Tinkerbow has finished installing the guns on our flying machines, so it's time to give them a trial by fire. We've got confirmation that our target is in fact within the Halls of Stone.Let's start clearing out the forces out in front. We'll take the earliest opportunity to bring the fight to Sparkspanner!

Title: Remaining Threats
Objective: Defeat 12 rare enemies in Darkshore.
Text: Though our forces maintain a steady hold on Darkshore, this land still festers with enemies at every turn.Do what you can to keep them at bay, and you will be well rewarded.

Title: UNUSED
Objective: Repel the Hordes forces assaulting Tiragarde Sound.
Text: Horde forces are attacking Tiragarde Sound. Make them regret every footstep upon our soil!

Title: Answer the Call
Objective: Stop the Malevolent Spirit.
Text: It is fortunate that Spiritwalker Ussoh passed along your spirit guide's warning. We were able to evacuate most of the citizens.This cursed spirit is full of malevolence and hatred. It must be destroyed!We attack on your command.

Title: Thank Your Guide
Objective: Deliver the offering to your spirit guide on the cliffs southwest of Thunder Bluff.
Text: The balance has been restored, and Thunder Bluff is safe. Thank you.We owe our victory to your spirit's guidance. We must honor the old ways by giving thanks to the ones who came before us.To the southwest lies a beautiful vista where my father once took me. It would be a fitting place to reflect upon all that has transpired.Please take this offering there to honor our ancestors.

Title: Crossing Over
Objective: Enter the spirit realm and make contact with your spirit guide.
Text: We are ready to begin.You will be crossing into the spirit realm. Take caution, for it can be a place of both tranquility and danger.Make contact with your spirit guide. There must be a reason it was in pain when it revealed itself to you.When you are ready, raise this vessel to enter the spirit realm.

Title: A Small Retreat
Objective: Meet with Spiritwalker Ussoh at Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains.
Text: I believe your guide was delivering a warning. The unrest within the spirit realm may be even more dire than first feared.We must cross over at once, from a place with a strong bond to the spirit realm.In ages past, tauren made pilgrimages to Sun Rock Retreat to engage in such a ritual. It is said that long ago, An'she himself kissed the mountain where the retreat now stands.Meet me there and we will begin the crossing.

Title: Storm in Bloodhoof
Objective: Travel to Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore and stop the spirit attack.
Text: This is worse than I feared.The people of Bloodhoof Village are in grave danger. Even the brave young tauren who train there are woefully unprepared for the danger that is coming.Do what you can to stop this threat. I will go to Thunder Bluff to warn the High Chieftain.

Title: The Spiritwalkers
Objective: Speak with Spiritwalker Ussoh at Fargaze Mesa in Camp Narache.
Text: As you know, the spiritwalkers commune with our ancestors and maintain balance within the spirit realm. It is a sacred duty that links our present to our past.But lately the spiritwalkers have been troubled by visions of chaos and turmoil. Of a rising darkness.They tell me that the spirits have whispered your name. We are unsure why, but Spiritwalker Ussoh means to find out.Seek Ussoh on Fargaze Mesa to the south. Good luck. I believe you may need it.

Title: For the Queen
Objective: Meet with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in Orgrimmar.

Title: Spirit Guide
Objective: Light the Spiritwalker's Incense at Fargaze Mesa in Camp Narache.
Text: The ancestors have whispered your name. Now it is time for you to reach out to them.Here in this sacred place, we spiritwalkers commune with those who came before us. Sit within the circle and light the incense.If you open your heart, a spirit guide will present itself to you. Let us hope it will lead you to the answers we seek.

Title: The Loa of Scavengers
Objective: Speak with Chronicler Ash'tari at Dazar'alor.
Text: Richmon, you bring me many shiny things. You helped some of those that no one else would. And ya dumb enough to keep comin' back to me trash piles.I like ya style.Now for da big one. Go to the steps of Dazar'alor, and find the Chronicler Ash'tari. Her chisel makes da shrines there. Tell her to build me a shrine and I will grant you my boon.Unlike the flappy Pa'ku or running Gonk, I just gonna let ya scrap your trash in my pile and I'll give ya stuff back. Anywhere my trash piles be.

Title: Garbage for the Garbage God
Objective: Bring Jani's First Offering to Jani's Trashpile in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: Richmon, you found a thing I been looking for for a long time. Bring it to me in the Port of Zandalar, and I will grant you my favor.

Title: When Spirits Whisper
Objective: Meet with Baine Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
Text: Ah! I am pleased the Earthmother guided you here. I have a message for you.Chieftain Bloodhoof asks that you join him in Thunder Bluff at once.I will leave it to our leader to explain why you are being summoned. But I will say that Baine has met with the other spiritwalkers and your name was spoken with urgency.I suggest you hurry.

Title: A Worthy Crew
Objective: Recruit a crew for the new vessel.
Text: If Dorian really can build this ship before the day is out, we need to find a crew for the new vessel.This crew should represent the best of Kul Tiran society, the highest naval prowess, and the faith of our people as we present this gift to Anduin.I have a captain in mind, but you'll want to speak to him yourself. I will let him decide who else he wants aboard.Seek out my brother, Tandred Proudmoore, in Boralus. He will help you fill out the ranks from there.

Title: Balance in All Things
Objective: Speak to Ulfar and cleanse the Filled Drust Vessel.
Text: The confluence of energies around that vessel is truly disturbing. My skin crawls with the wrongness of it.We have reached the limit of my ability to help you.Go to Ulfar, the High Thornspeaker. Arthur will carry you, if you wish it.Only he knows enough about these ancient magics to undo the corruption that taints your materials.Go quickly. You do not want to hold that vessel longer than you must.

Title: The Bleak Hills
Objective: Find Chelsea Wright at the Bleak Hills Mine in Drustvar.
Text: While you are visiting Drustvar, I need you to run another errand for me.The Wright family owned a mine up near Corlain. Years past, they supplied all the metal ore I used to build my ships.I can't imagine they're faring too well, based on what we've seen here.Find Chelsea Wright, the foreman's daughter, and see what they need to get another ore shipment together.Just tell her Dorian sent you.

Title: Gorak Tul's Influence
Objective: Fill the Drust Vessel in Gol Koval by killing enemies and destroying cairns.
Text: Long have the Thornspeakers struggled against such magics. It is a conflict as old as the Drust themselves.Gorak Tul's influence, however, has vastly shifted the balance toward that of decay and death. It corrupts what would be an ordinary curse.I believe Ulfar can correct this.Go into Gol Koval. Slay our enemies, destroy their cairns, and collect their magics into this vessel.With it, Ulfar may be able to find a way to cleanse your materials.

Title: Summons from Dorian
Objective: Return to Dorian Atwater at Port Fogtide.
Text: HHsssssss.HHHHSSSSSSsssshh.

Title: Drop It!
Objective: Retrieve Chelsea Wright's keys.
Text: You must be the person Dorian sent to collect the ore.I got a message a short while ago requesting a rather large shipment, which in itself is a feat given the state of this place. I was on my way to our storehouse when that... beast!... cornered me.It took my keys. I can't get you that shipment without them. Find out where that mongrel took them and bring them back.Let it be known I wouldn't do this for anyone else.

Title: Make it Wright
Objective: Collect Dorian's ore shipment.
Text: I don't know how this happened, or why... but I know this beast.I've unlocked our storage chest. Thank you. Thank you so much.Tell Dorian she can call upon us at any time.

Title: This Lumber is Haunted
Objective: Seek out Thornspeaker Birchgrove in Gol Koval.
Text: I don't much believe in ghosts, or hauntings for that matter.That said, there is something wrong with this lumber. I can feel it in my bones. They're achier than normal.I only know of one group that would know what to do. They're reclusive, but we share a love of nature.Seek out Thornspeaker Birchgrove in Drustvar. I trust no one else with this.

Title: Frame Work
Objective: Meet Dorian Atwater at the Algerson Lumber Yard in Tiragarde Sound.
Text: Now that I have a slip to work in, I'm going to need lumber.Lots of lumber.The only lumber mill that could handle this kind of volume at such short notice would be the Algerson Lumber Yard outside of Boralus.I know this because I've made this exact request of them before.I will meet you there. Algerson might need a little persuasion.

Title: I'm Too Old for This Ship
Objective: Saddle Hurricane and meet Dorian Atwater at Port Fogtide.
Text: If I understood this correctly, the Lord Admiral of the Kul Tiran navy wants me to come out of retirement specifically to build a ship for the king of Stormwind.Can't say I've had THAT request before.I'm getting too old for this nonsense.Go on out back and saddle Hurricane for me while I pack my things. We will meet you at Port Fogtide.We're going to need a slip.

Title: Team Carry
Objective: Collect 4 heavy lumber and take it to the drop-off point.
Text: Algerson is about as useful as a legless horse. We're going to do this ourselves.The mill is overrun with bizarre creatures. I'll handle those. You and these hearty volunteers will need to be the muscle of this operation.Don't look at me like that. It's just a little lifting.Once we have enough lumber, Sal will meet us for a pick up. Just stay close to me and focus on not dropping my wood, yes?

Title: The Deep Ones
Objective: Slay 12 drowned forces in Port Fogtide.
Text: I've spent my whole life on and around the sea.Until very recently I feel like I've always had one foot in the water. I knew there were... things... best left untouched.Now they're here. In Stormsong Valley. Occupying the slip I need to build your ship.Do I really need to tell you what to do about it?

Title: Covering Our Masts
Objective: Place 3 Fog Wards in Port Fogtide.
Text: When I was younger, I hid my ships out of vanity.I often went through a number of designs before I was satisfied. I didn't want anyone to see that. It might ruin the mystique, I reasoned.Now... I think it best to hide this ship from the likes of those tentacle-faced creeps. I don't think they intend to let us build unchallenged.Go into the port and place my wards around the main slip.You'll see what they do.

Title: Home, Home On the Range
Objective: Track down the shipwright in Stormsong Valley and deliver the Lord Admiral's Letter.
Text: Hmm... Along the road to Fort Daelin... to the north... somewhere in the Deadwash.I've marked a spot on your map that seems likely. I think that will get you close enough.I'll report back to the Lord Admiral with what we've learned. Good luck, and I hope our shipwright is willing.

Title: Made in Kul Tiras
Objective: Speak to Cyrus in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Are you curious about how the Kul Tirans joined the Alliance?It was assumed that Kul Tiras would rejoin the Alliance after everything that was done to stabilize their nation.Lady Jaina Proudmoore wanted to cement the allegiance by building King Anduin a ship worthy of the Kul Tiran navy.She wished for help in finding the best shipwright in Kul Tiras, Dorian Atwater. It wouldn't be easy, as Dorian was retired.It all began with a trip to see Cyrus in Boralus Harbor...

Title: Express Delivery
Objective: Mark locations on the Horde ships to direct Jaina's spell.
Text: The Horde appears to have misplaced some of its Azerite. It would be rude of us not to return it, don't you think?The most efficient way is for me to teleport it back.I've enchanted the harpoons in that launcher over there. Fire them onto the Horde ships in the bay. I can use them as beacons to return the Azerite to the Horde... and send its ships on their way.

Title: The Black Blade
Objective: Bring the Dagger to Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner.

Title: The Missing Blade
Objective: Inform King Anduin about the absence of Xal'atath.

Title: Throwing Blight
Objective: Speak with Zarvik Blastwix to learn what the Workshop has to offer.
Text: We need more firepower, and the goblins are oh so obliging, aren't they. Zarvik in particular has honed his craft ever since our conquest of Darkshore.Why don't you talk to him and see what he's got going at the Workshop?

Title: Echolocation
Objective: Deliver Crankshot's Note to your commander in Bashal'Aran.
Text: Glad you're here! These bats have got to get up and start giving us some more air support.I've got a draft of a flight plan here in Darkshore. It's helped by the fact that our bats can see in the dark, when most of us can't.Talk to Avery and she'll make sure you get safely back to Bashal'Aran.

Title: The Altar of Storms
Objective: Speak with Mizzyk to learn what the Altar of Storms has to offer.
Text: The Altar of Storms has been rebuilt. It is a unique kind of altar. The goblin kind.Keever is pleased. Keever wishes to wield that kind of power.Go, listen to Keever, talk to little goblin Mizzyk and find what the Altar can do.

Title: The War Chest
Objective: Collect resources from the War Chest in Bashal'Aran.
Text: Welcome to the warfront. I am glad we have you fighting on our side.First things first: We need to collect resources in order to strengthen our hold on Bashal'Aran and bolster our troops.Any resources that we collect will go to the War Chest. Open the chest and see what you can use.

Title: An Alchemist for Everything
Objective: Capture Gloomtide Strand, then speak with Professor Blightwell to learn what he has to offer.
Text: When we first conquered Darkshore, we set up an Alchemy Lab on the shore at Gloomtide Strand to tap into this area's latent power.Unfortunately, things did not go so well and the Alliance have overrun the lab.Would you see them off, and then speak with Professor Blightwell to see what he can do for you?

Title: Arms and Armor
Objective: Speak with Archibald to learn what the Armory has to offer.
Text: Keever knows troops need weapons. And armor. Armor and weapons.Keever wants Archibald to make armor and weapons for troops. You listen to Keever and talk to Archibald.

Title: Darkshore Recruits
Objective: Restore the Barracks, then speak with Signe to recruit an ally.
Text: We will not win unless we have the power of numbers on our side.First, we need the Barracks restored so Signe can do her work. Signe is one of the Dark Lady's val'kyr, and she can raise forces for us.Once the Barracks is built, talk to Signe and recruit a troop. I'm sure they could learn a lot from fighting alongside you.

Title: An Explosive Situation
Objective: Supply Goblin Extractors with explosives at Lornesta Mine.
Text: We have some iron available, but we could always use more.Get down to the mine at the Ruins of Lornesta. Seize it from any enemies, and get those goblins to do their job.Giving them something suitably destructive should do the trick.

Title: Lumbering Along
Objective: Pick up a Sturdy Axe, then gather 5 Freshly-Chopped Wood from the nearby Darkwood Timber.
Text: We will need more lumber if we're going to build up Bashal'Aran into a proper fortress.You should find an axe in the supplies we brought in for the effort. Grab it, and see what you can do with it to help us get our base rebuilt.

Title: Gnomercy!
Objective: De-shrinkify the Assault Tank and use it to slay troggs.
Text: We need to give Tinkerbow some cover while she figures out our new trajectory.It may not look like much, but this is a fully functional spider tank. You'll just need to de-shrinkify it. Use it to distract the troggs down below by thinning their numbers.

Title: G.E.A.R. Up
Objective: Return to Captain Tread Sparknozzle in New Tinkertown.
Text: That was a close one, but we managed to defeat Sparkspanner! Gnomanity and Azeroth are saved from a threat they didn't even know about.Hopefully, that's the last time we'll hear from any of Thermaplugg's old goons.We should return to Captain Sparknozzle. He will want a full report.

Title: For Gnomeregan!
Objective: Enter the Halls of Stone and defeat Telzo Sparkspanner.
Text: It's time to bring down Sparkspanner, Commander.Just give me the word, and I'll turn this machine straight towards the Halls of Stone!

Title: A Signal in Storm Peaks
Objective: Fly with your squadron to Storm Peaks.
Text: It looks like the signal is being transmitted from Storm Peaks.Time to put these flying machines to work! I'll keep tracking the signal en route in order to get a cleaner read.

Title: Paragon of the Storm's Wake
Objective: Speak with Sister Lilyana at Brennadam in Stormsong Valley.
Text: The grateful Storm's Wake forces have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your continued efforts on their behalf.

Title: Paragon of the Zandalari Empire
Objective: Speak with Natal'hakata in Dazar'Alor for your reward.
Text: The grateful leaders of the Zandalari Empire have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your exceptional aid.

Title: Mekkatorque's Battle Plans
Objective: Recover Mekkatorque's Battle Plans
Text: So we almost got everythin' we need, except for where that airship went!My insurance pals found out where they're hidin' that primo-info.Go and get me Mekkatorque's battle plans, then we can begin the REALLY fun part!

Title: Paragon of the Proudmoore Admiralty
Objective: Speak with Provisioner Fray in Boralus Harbor for your reward.
Text: The grateful leaders of the Proudmoore Admiralty have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your continued aid to their house.

Title: Paragon of the Honorbound
Objective: Speak with Ransa Greyfeather in the Port of Zandalar for your reward.
Text: Commanders of the Honorbound forces have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your exceptional efforts.

Title: Paragon of the Voldunai
Objective: Speak with Hoarder Jena at the Vulpera Hideaway for your reward.
Text: Your allies among the Voldunai have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your continued efforts on their behalf.

Title: Paragon of Talanji's Expedition
Objective: Speak with Provisioner Lija at the Zul'jan Ruins for your reward.
Text: Your allies among Talanji's Expedition have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your continued efforts on their behalf.

Title: Paragon of the Order of Embers
Objective: Speak with Quartermaster Alcorn at Arom's Strand in Drustvar.
Text: Your allies among the Order of Embers have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your continued efforts on their behalf.

Title: Wiping Out the Witherbark
Objective: Kill 12 Witherbark tribe trolls in Arathi Highlands.
Text: The Witherbark tribe has a long and bloody history in the highlands of Arathi.Show them how much bloodier it can get.

Title: Sins of the Syndicate
Objective: Kill 12 Syndicate members at Dabyrie's Farmstead.
Text: As if the Defilers were not trouble enough, Syndicate agents still slither down from the Alterac mountains to drive off honest Alliance farmers.Punish them.

Title: Boulderfist Beatdown
Objective: Kill 12 Boulderfist clan ogres in Arathi Highlands.
Text: The Boulderfist ogres have plagued Arathi since the Second War, and they still remain.You know what must be done.

Title: Executing Exorcisms
Objective: Kill 12 Vengeful Ghosts in Ar'gorok.
Text: Even in death, the Horde foolishly clings to Alliance territory.Drive their vengeful ghosts from the ruins of Ar'gorok before their foulness spreads.

Title: Twice-Exiled
Objective: Kill 12 Burning, Cresting, Rumbling, or Thundering Exiles or Guardians in Arathi Highlands.
Text: Elementals of all sorts are bursting free of their bonds across the Highlands.Return them to the primordial chaos from whence they came.

Title: Paragon of the 7th Legion
Objective: Speak with Vindicator Jaelaana at Boralus Harbor in Tiragarde Sound.
Text: Commanders of the 7th Legion forces have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your exceptional efforts.

Title: Death to The Defilers
Objective: Kill 12 Defilers at Go'Shek Farm.
Text: Even with the destruction of Undercity, the Defilers continue to combat our hold on the Arathi Highlands.The farmland at Go'Shek will belong to the Alliance once more. Go, and defeat the Forsaken.

Title: Wiping Out the Witherbark
Objective: Kill 12 Witherbark tribe trolls in Arathi Highlands.
Text: The bloodthirsty Witherbark tribe has always refused to join the Horde... and now that the Horde holds Arathi, we will succeed where the Alliance has failed.Drive the forest trolls from the Highlands.

Title: Sins of the Syndicate
Objective: Kill 12 Syndicate members at Go'Shek Farm.
Text: As if the League of Arathor was not trouble enough, Syndicate agents still slither down from the Alterac mountains to drive off honest Horde laborers.Punish them.

Title: Boulderfist Beatdown
Objective: Kill 12 Boulderfist clan ogres in Arathi Highlands.
Text: If the Boulderfist ogres will not join the Horde, there is no place for them in Arathi.You know what must be done.

Title: Paragon of the Tortollan Seekers
Objective: Speak with Collector Kojo.
Text: Your allies among the Tortollan Seekers have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your continued efforts on their behalf.

Title: Paragon of the Champions of Azeroth
Objective: Speak with Magni Bronzebeard in Silithus for your reward.
Text: A grateful Magni Bronzebeard has requested your presence. He wishes to reward you for your exceptional aid.

Title: Executing Exorcisms
Objective: Kill 12 Vengeful Ghosts in Stromgarde.
Text: Even in death, the Alliance foolishly clings to Horde territory.Drive their vengeful ghosts from the ruins of Stromgarde before their foulness spreads.

Title: The League Will Lose
Objective: Kill 12 League of Arathor at Dabyrie's Farmstead.
Text: Even with the fall of Stromgarde, the League of Arathor continues to operate in the Highlands.The northern farmland will belong to the Horde. Go, and defeat the humans.

Title: Twice-Exiled
Objective: Kill 12 Burning, Cresting, Rumbling, or Thundering Exiles or Guardians in Arathi Highlands.
Text: Elementals of all sorts are bursting free of their bonds across the Highlands.Return them to the primordial chaos from whence they came.

Title: Now With More Mechanical Fowl
Objective: Kill 10 Ironbound Brutes or Scrapthrowers.
Text: The gnomes here report that troggs came down from the north and started attacking everygnome and everything.So now it's our job to fix this situation! And luckily, I have the perfect plan for it. We need to calibrate the bomber's gun, and doing so on the ground is much less risky than up in the air.Give it a go, Commander!

Title: A Tundra Conundrum
Objective: Speak with Cog Captain Winklespring at Fizzcrank Airstrip in Borean Tundra.
Text: While you were in Gnomeregan, we received a distress signal from Fizzcrank Airstrip in Borean Tundra. This seems like the perfect opportunity to show off what G.E.A.R. can do!I've sent the rest of your squad ahead. Meet them out there.

Title: The Gnome Behind the Trogg
Objective: Help Tinkerbow get the machine working.
Text: If I just attach the core of this to the input module here... Amplify the matched frequency here...Flip the switch, Commander! Just make sure it's the right one. The left one is the self-destruct switch. Or was that reversed...

Title: Smarter Than Your Average Trogg
Objective: Kill Krugg the Smart.
Text: One of the recon pilots did a scouting run over the station. She reported that there seems to be a trogg on the top level that is larger and smarter than the others. He's somehow managed to get one of the Defendo-Tanks for the station working in his favor.Take him out!

Title: Shadowed Halls and Dusty Cogs
Objective: Find the Prototype Arcane Engine within the Engineering Labs of Gnomeregan.
Text: An elite aerial unit wouldn't be complete without the newest innovations in flying machine technology.There's just one small problem.The innovative new engine we built was left behind when we evacuated Gnomeregan. We need that prototype if we want these bombers to safely get off the ground!

Title: Gnomeregan's Finest
Objective: Speak with the three members of your G.E.A.R. team.
Text: The leaders of the Alliance have agreed to fund an elite gnomish aerial task force.And you have been chosen to lead the test team for the Gnomish Elite Aerial Rangers. I have assembled some of the finest tinkers and soldiers from Gnomeregan, who are now under your command.The three of them are already here in New Tinkertown. Introduce yourself and assemble them.

Title: Free Plumeria!
Objective: Defeat Maurizio Deaththrill and free Plumeria.
Text: My poor Plumeria has been captured by an exceptionally brutal villain. He has been overseeing the spread of pestilence along the wharf.Rosaline needs my mechanical expertise in fixing our weapons. Would you free my poor Plumeria and slay the vile knight tormenting her?

Title: Squad Goals
Objective: Find the members of Taelia's patrol squad.
Text: My patrol squad fought off the Horde so Galeheart and I could fly free. I have to stay with the Lord Admiral, so I can't look for them on my own. With any luck, they're out there fighting and waiting for reinforcements.Well, we're here to help save them. Would you find the rest of my patrol squad for me?

Title: Zero Zeppelins
Objective: Destroy Horde Zeppelins in Anglepoint Wharf.
Text: The Horde zeppelins proved to be problematic for our forces here. I tried to construct something quickly, but while the weapon had power, it didn't have the range necessary to take them out.The Lord Admiral has provided us with an expedient solution to the problem!Use this jury-rigged hand cannon on the zeppelins. A quick application of high energy and heat will cause thermal shock and critical failure!To simplify, blow them up while they're grounded!

Title: Mischief Managed
Objective: Report to High Commander Wyrmbane in Boralus.
Text: Thank you for returning this artifact to us. Now that we have the Abyssal Scepter, the fleet can advance without fear of the seas being turned against us.Please report our success to High Commander Wyrmbane.

Title: Expanding our Influence
Objective: Talk to Vindicator Jaelaana.
Text: As we expand the War Effort on the enemy continent we are finding ideal locations to establish new outposts, and even upgrade our current ones.Once secure, these outposts will allow us to utilize a new flight network to quickly and easily navigate the area.

Title: Expanding our Influence
Objective: Talk to Ransa Greyfeather.
Text: As we expand the War Effort on the enemy continent we are finding ideal locations to establish new outposts, and even upgrade our current ones.Once secure, these outposts will allow us to utilize a new flight network to quickly and easily navigate the area.

Title: Battle of Dazar'alor
Objective: Defeat King Rastakhan in the Battle of Dazar'alor raid.
Text: Our naval forces are ready to sail for Zuldazar. By the time we're there, the Horde and Zandalari forces should be in Nazmir.Keeshan and Kelsey checked on the bombs placed within Zuldazar harbor. They're primed and ready to destroy the Zandalari fleet.Gather any of your allies and prepare to set sail for Zuldazar.We will strike down the Zandalari and remove the Horde's most powerful ally from this war.

Title: Supplies from the Zandalari Empire
Objective: Speak with Natal'hakata in Dazar'Alor for your reward.
Text: De Zandalari Empire appreciates all your help.Please take dese supplies as a token of our gratitude, and a promise of more to come, should you continue to help.

Title: Supplies from the Voldunai
Objective: Speak with Hoarder Jena at the Vulpera Hideaway for your reward.
Text: Thanks for all the help around Vol'dun.Please take these supplies as a token of our gratitude, and a promise of more to come, should you continue to help.

Title: Supplies from Talanji's Expedition
Objective: Speak with Provisioner Lija at the Zul'jan Ruins for your reward.
Text: Thanks mon, de expedition appreciates all de help you've given us.Take dese supplies as a token of our thanks, and a promise of more to come, if you continue to help us.

Title: Supplies from the Proudmoore Admiralty
Objective: Speak with Provisioner Fray in Boralus Harbor for your reward.
Text: The Proudmoore Admiralty appreciates all the help you've given us.Please take these supplies as a token of our gratitude, and a promise of more to come, should you continue to help us.

Title: Supplies from Storm's Wake
Objective: Speak with Sister Lilyana at Brennadam in Stormsong Valley.
Text: We appreciate all the help you've given us, may the tides watch over you.Please take these supplies as a token of our gratitude, and a promise of more to come, should you continue to help us.

Title: He Who Walks in the Light
Objective: Return to Halford Wyrmbane within Boralus.
Text: Shaw reports that Zandalari scouts have been dispatched to alert of our "full assault".We did it. The Horde and Zandalari will throw their armies at our forces within Nazmir.We cannot let their sacrifice be in vain. We must get back to Boralus and let Halford know it's time to strike.Come, I'll create a portal for us to leave, once we say one final word to Telaamon.

Title: Supplies from the Honorbound
Objective: Speak with Ransa Greyfeather in the Port of Zandalar for your reward.
Text: , thanks to your efforts against the Alliance, our forces have been able to secure additional resources from the battlefield.The more you continue to dominate the battlefield the more resources our forces can spare.

Title: Supplies from the 7th Legion
Objective: Speak with Vindicator Jaelaana at Boralus Harbor in Tiragarde Sound.
Text: , thanks to your efforts against the Horde, our forces have been able to secure additional resources from the battlefield.The more you continue to dominate the battlefield the more resources our forces can spare.

Title: Supplies from Magni
Objective: Speak with Magni Bronzebeard in Silithus for your reward.
Text: Champion of Azeroth, I appreciate all the help you've given us.Please take these supplies as a token of my gratitude, and a promise of more to come, should you continue to help.

Title: Baubles from the Seekers
Objective: Speak with Collector Kojo.
Text: We Tortollan's appreciate all the help you've given us.Please take these supplies as a token of our gratitude, and a promise of more to come, should you continue to help us.

Title: A Shady Character
Objective: Deliver the token to the shady character.
Text: Your followers tell of a smuggler of wit and guile, who was able to charm them with stories of lands far and wide.Though it cost a fair sum to retrieve, they managed to obtain a token which when displayed to the smuggler, will allow the bearer to purchase his wares.

Title: Taking the Blood Gate
Objective: Ride the battlebeast and defeat the Zandalari army at the Blood Gates.
Text: We have our forces spread out throughout Nazmir, but we need to do something that will force Rastakhan into action.We must personally march into Zuldazar and take the Blood Gate. This will cause them to throw their full army at us.As you can see, we're the only ones left that can assault the Blood Gate.Shaw and Telaamon will stay behind to help the rest of the army move up.You and I will ride the battle beast into the Blood Gate and take it by force.

Title: Supplies from the Order of Embers
Objective: Speak with Quartermaster Alcorn at Arom's Strand in Drustvar.
Text: The Order of Embers appreciate all the help you've given us.Please take these supplies as a token of our gratitude, and a promise of more to come, should you continue to help us.

Title: Wisp'd Into Shape
Objective: Capture Cinderfall Grove and inspire the wisps to help you.
Text: We're off to a good start, but we're going to need more wood if we want to win this battle!The Horde has set up a lumber mill to the north of Bashal'Aran, past Forlorn Crossing. If we take it, we can stop them from destroying the forest while also getting the wisps to help us out.It's a two-for-one!

Title: Crucible of Storms: Relics of Shadow
Objective: Stop Uu'nat within the Crucible of Storms.
Text: Your intention to stop the naga attacks was noble. But that shadowy dagger tricked you into delivering powerful relics into the hands of a great enemy.No doubt those artifacts will be well defended. Gather your allies, and return to the Crucible of Storms.Defeat any opponents that stand in your way. Ensure the relics cannot be used against the Alliance.The naga cannot be allowed to summon their storm... or to call forth something even worse.

Title: Crucible of Storms: Relics of Shadow
Objective: Stop Uu'nat within the Crucible of Storms.
Text: Your intention to stop de naga attacks was noble. But de talking dagger tricked you into delivering powerful relics into de hands of our enemies.No doubt dese artifacts will be well defended. Gather your allies, and return to de Crucible of Storms.Defeat any opponents dat stand in your way. Ensure dese relics cannot be used against de Horde.And if any shadowy weapons ask you to do favors for dem in de future... I suggest you decline.

Title: A Shady Character
Objective: Deliver the token to the shady character under the bridge.
Text: Your followers tell of a smuggler of wit and guile, who was able to charm them with stories of lands far and wide.Though it cost a fair sum to retrieve, they managed to obtain a token which when displayed to the smuggler, will allow the bearer to purchase his wares.

Title: Orders from Azshara
Objective: Retrieve Xal'atath and find the Makeshift Altar.
Text: This medallion is inscribed with orders commanding the naga to invade our shores and seize artifacts of power.I've heard tales of a priest who used a horrifying dagger to fight the Burning Legion. It is said this blade... Xal'atath... whispers secrets of the deep. It might be our best chance of uncovering what the naga seek.I recently came upon a makeshift naga altar in Atal'Gral. If you take Xal'atath there, the dagger may reveal crucial information.

Title: Quelling the Masses
Objective: Subdue 12 rioters in the Zocalo.
Text: One of my own in de Rastari has seen fit to rile de drudges and guards in de Zocalo.They threaten de stability of our empire with this foolishness. If they are angry, we can address it. But this wanton destruction will not stand.Go down into de market of de Zocalo and bring about calm however you can. Choose de method that works for you.I care only for de result: Peace, so Talanji can finally be crowned.

Title: Taming their Beasts
Objective: Use the Re-Discombobulator to control 3 battle beasts.
Text: Our goal is to assault the Blood Gate, but to be blunt, we don't have the force necessary for this.That's why we have gnomish technology. The Zandalari have battle beasts, direhorns mounted with powerful weapons.Several of these beasts are resting within the Fallen Outpost. This device, the Re-Discombobulator, will give us control over these animals.Take this device and use it on these battle beasts. We'll assault the Blood Gates once we have them under our control.

Title: Showing Our Might
Objective: Defeat 12 Zandalari forces within the Fallen Outpost.
Text: We are within reach of the Blood Gate in Zandalar. Once we take that, the Horde and Zandalari will believe our full invasion has begun.Our forces have already engaged the Zandalari within the Fallen Outpost. We'll need your help to push them back.I'll be focusing on finishing off what remains of the Horde and Zandalari back in Zul'jan ruins.

Title: Warfront Preparations
Objective: Take the portal back to the Port of Zandalar to prepare for the Battle for Darkshore.
Text: We must make our preparations.Return to Zandalar immediately and rally our forces. Any contributions to our cause must be made.Go. We will hold for now.

Title: Dark Iron Machinations
Objective: Mark 3 areas within Zalamar for mole machines to appear.
Text: We have some additional support for our plan to deceive the Horde and assault the Blood Gates, but we need your help.The Dark Iron dwarves have several mole machines waiting to erupt and supply fresh troops.I've determined several spots within Zalamar that would be perfect for them to use.Take this device and plant it in the following areas. It will send a message to the Dark Iron dwarves to erupt from there.They will stay safely in their machines until our army arrives.

Title: The Mech of Death
Objective: Defeat the A.M.O.D.
Text: We have reports of a goblin machine causing havoc among our troops up ahead. They call it the A.M.O.D.It is a crude machine compared to what the Lightforged have aboard the Vindicaar.Together, you and I will bring down this machine. Go, I will await for you near the machine and engage it when you are ready.

Title: Zul'jan Deluge
Objective: Use Jaina's Water Elemental to clear out Zul'jan Ruins.
Text: Through the mists is Zul'jan ruins, a major Horde outpost in Nazmir. We need to take it over to help our forces push forward.The Horde needs to believe a large Alliance army is here, so we're going to throw everything we've got at taking the ruins.Our army will charge forward to attack, while you join them using my water elemental.Meet me outside of the ruins when you're done, we'll need to keep pushing forward.

Title: Lurking in the Swamp
Objective: Meet with Jaina Proudmoore outside of Zul'jan ruins.
Text: We have Zalamar, and we've got our fog. Now, we have to take the attack to the Horde.Our goal is to take as much land in Nazmir as possible to make the Horde think our main fleet is here.The first target is Zul'jan ruins, one of the Horde's main bases in Nazmir.We'll have to make our way through the swamps to our attack position. Meet us there.

Title: Shifting Gears
Objective: Meet Captain Tread Sparknozzle in New Tinkertown.
Text: ! The Alliance has made a new request for Gnomeregan's might in the coming war. It is my honor to inform you that Captain Sparknozzle wishes for your expert assistance in the matter.You are hereby requested to meet him in New Tinkertown.

Title: Darkshore Donations: Masterful Kubiline
Objective: Gather 20 Seasoned Loins for Senedras in Boralus Harbor.
Text: A nice, hearty meat provides the nourishment our allies deserve before shipping off to battle, not to mention it also makes quite a stew, something our troops seem to rather enjoy when the winds are at their best and the chill of night lingers in the air.If you bring me some freshly seasoned loins I would be more than happy to deliver it to our supply officers.

Title: Darkshore Donations: Stringy Loins
Objective: Bring 30 Coastal Mana Potions to Chelsea Strand in Boralus Harbor.
Text: One of our latest shipments of alchemical supplies was raided en route to storage. We're scrambling to get our stock back on track, but I'm worried we won't make our quota.You wouldn't happen to know where one can acquire additional mana potions, would you?

Title: Darkshore Donations: Seasoned Steak and Potatoes
Objective: Gather 40 Coastal Healing Potions for Chelsea Strand in Boralus Harbor.
Text: I've received word our allies are looking to stash away a few supplementary items for the battle to come. If you happen to stumble across a few Coastal Healing Potions I'd be more than happy to add them to our stores.

Title: Darkshore Donations: Sand Shifter
Objective: Gather 30 Monel-Hardened Stirrups for Brandal Darkbeard in Boralus Harbor.
Text: In times like this it's important ta be ready fer battle at a moments notice. Outfittin' our beasts with proper stirrups is a step in the right direction.If yer able ta bring me a few I'll be sure they're put ta good use.

Title: Darkshore Donations: Scarlet Diamond
Objective: Gather 20 Monel-Hardened Hoofplates for Brandal Darkbeard in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Battles aren't decided by which side has the best armor, or the sharpest blades, but it sure does help! Matter o' fact is it's not just ye allies needin' help, but our beasts of battle as well.If ye can provide any additional hoofplates fer our brave beasts I'll be sure ta have our farriers take good care of 'em.

Title: Darkshore Donations: Quick Golden Beryl
Objective: Gather 20 Seasoned Loins for Senedras in Boralus Harbor.
Text: A nice, hearty meat provides the nourishment our allies deserve before shipping off to battle, not to mention it also makes quite a stew, something our troops seem to rather enjoy when the winds are at their best and the chill of night lingers in the air.If you bring me some freshly seasoned loins I would be more than happy to deliver it to our supply officers.

Title: Darkshore Donations: Deep Sea Bandage
Objective: Gather 10 F.R.I.E.D. for Norber Togglesprocket in Boralus Harbor.
Text: You never know when you'll need to deliver a big bang on the battlefield, if you know what I mean. Luckily we can plan for the unexpected!We've begun to store a special stockpile of explosives for scenarios where we'll need a little something extra to get our point across. I've added one particular item to the list.If you have any to spare I'll make sure they're put to good use.

Title: Darkshore Donations: Shimmerscale Diving Suit
Objective: Gather 3 Frost-Laced Ammunition for Norber Togglesprocket in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Hey there!Transmission's come down from up top--we need more ammunition! Something with a bit more kick. Something really unexpected!From what I've heard there's a special frost-based ammunition crafted only by the most experienced engineers. If you were to bring me a few I'm sure our munitions officers would be ecstatic!Maybe they'd even let me keep one to examine!

Title: Darkshore Donations: Deep Sea Satin
Objective: Gather 30 Great Sea Catfish for Senedras in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Fish--it's what's for dinner! Or so say our supply officers. And this weeks meals are based around one delicious ingredient--catfish.If we're going to keep our allies well fed and full of fish we'll need to gather more stock and begin meal preparations soon.If you find yourself swimming in an abundance of catfish I'd be happy to send them along to our stores.

Title: Darkshore Donations: Tidespray Linen Net
Objective: Gather 5 Incendiary Ammunition for Norber Togglesprocket in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Though our ammunition stockpiles are faring well, it's my duty to find additional resources, especially those that are harder to come by.Today I'm looking for a specific type of ammunition, one with incendiary properties. I could really use your help tracking a few of these down.

Title: Darkshore Donations: Gold
Objective: Donate 1000000 Gold to Paymaster Vauldren in Boralus Harbor.
Text: We've spent a great deal of time and resources preparing for the battle to come.As we begin final preparations, we'll be setting aside additional funding to ensure further training and supplies are available at a moment's notice.Would you like to make a donation?

Title: Darkshore Donations: Contract: 7th Legion
Objective: Gather 3 Siren's Pollen for Chelsea Strand in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Greetings!With the war effort in full swing I'll be your point of contact for herbalism and alchemical donations! It's a pleasure to meet you!Now, let's see here... Ah, yes. Siren's Pollen. It appears our stockpiles reported a shortage as of late last night. It would be a great help to us all if you were able to donate to our efforts.

Title: Darkshore Donations: Ultramarine Ink
Objective: Gather 60 Grilled Catfish for Senedras in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Greetings, traveler.I was asked to ensure our food supplies are never left wanting and our fish supplies have been running low lately. Have anything you would care to donate?

Title: Darkshore Donations: Thermo-Accelerated Plague Spreader
Objective: Gather 3 Coarse Leather Barding for Charlane in Boralus Harbor.
Text: It's not just our allies we need to protect in the upcoming battle, but our equine friends as well!Can you lend a hand and ensure our allies receive the best possible armor for the battle ahead?

Title: Darkshore Donations: Crimson Ink
Objective: Gather 20 War-Scroll of Intellect for Liao in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Enlightenment guides our path to victory. In battle, we fight as one.Share your knowledge and skills with me. Generosity is never forgotten.

Title: Darkshore Donations: XA-1000 Surface Skimmer
Objective: Gather 2 Monelite Ore to Brandal Darkbeard in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Ye look like the kind o'  that ought ta be carryin' loads o' ore around with ya! If my assumption is right about ye, we could use yer help to gather a bit more ore for the war effort.Have ye any ore ta spare?

Title: Darkshore Donations: Electroshock Mount Motivator
Objective: Donate 2 Shimmerscale to Charlane in Boralus Harbor.
Text: I'll keep it simple: we need more Shimmerscale!I apologize for being so forward with you, but there's little time to waste.If you happen upon this item throughout your travels I'd be more than happy to put it to good use. Outfitting our allies is of the utmost importance in the battle to come, don't you agree?

Title: Darkshore Donations: Unstable Temporal Time Shifter
Objective: Donate 2 Coarse Leather to Charlane in Boralus Harbor.
Text: It's time we snuff out the competition, don't you agree? With your help we can ensure our allies receive the necessary goods and armor to prepare for the battle to come.Let's make sure our allies are well prepared.

Title: Darkshore Donations: Gold
Objective: Donate 1000000 Gold to Paymaster Grintooth in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: Our friends here are accepting all kinds of donations on behalf of the war effort, but if ya ask me, no battle was ever won without proper funding. That's right, bub. I'm talking about money! And lots of it.If you got it, we need it!

Title: Fog of War
Objective: Have Brother Pike use the Abyssal Scepter.
Text: Do not mind this, I am finishing off this insect. You have bigger matters to handle.Our army is moving within Zalamar as we speak. But the Horde will know our army's true size without aid.Speak with Brother Pike and have him perform the ritual with the Abyssal Scepter to cover Nazmir in a thick fog.He claims the illusion will also mimic an entire fleet off the beach. Let us hope he is right.I will join you once I finish with this stain upon Azeroth.

Title: Repurposing Their Village
Objective: Defeat 12 blood trolls within Zalamar.
Text: Myself and Shaw will provide support for Telaamon's army until our distraction is set up.First, we need to clear the blood trolls out of their nearby village, Zalamar, in order to move our army forward.That's where you come in. We need you to assault the blood trolls there to weaken their forces, then our army will arrive.Telaamon will be on site to help you, meet with him once you've weakened their forces.I will be here with Shaw ensuring our forces aren't seen.

Title: Outpost Upgrade: Arom's Stand
Objective: Talk to Cleric Loriette in Arom's Stand.
Text: The mission at Arom's Stand was a success. Well done.We now have access to a blessing from the Order of Embers.Travel to Arom's Stand and enquire about this blessing.

Title: Mission Report: Arom's Stand
Objective: Deliver the report to Halford Wyrmbane.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Arom's Stand.It details that they were successful in gaining access to a blessing from the Order of Embers.Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

Title: The March to Nazmir
Objective: Meet Jaina Proudmoore and the Alliance army in Nazmir.
Text: Greetings. I am Blademaster Telaamon, and I have volunteered to lead this mission against the Horde.Our forces will be gathering off the coast of Nazmir. Go now and we shall all meet there.If all goes according to plan, we will lure the Horde away from Zandalar and bring an end to this war.

Title: The Fall of Zuldazar
Objective: Speak with Mathias Shaw in the garden within Proudmoore Keep.
Text: It's time. We have the Abyssal Scepter, along with confirmation that the bombs placed amongst the Zandalari fleet are still active.Unfortunately, even with everything at our disposal, we would still lose a frontal assault against the Zandalari empire.For that reason, we plan to lure the forces of the Horde and the Zandalari away from the harbor.Mathias Shaw is holding a meeting nearby, and he has requested your presence.

Title: Outpost Upgrade: Castaway Point
Objective: Talk to Dynamite Jack in Castaway Point.
Text: The mission at Castaway Point was a success. Well done.We now have access to a very large cannon which promises to be a fast way to travel to Tiragarde Sound. Glad that's not how I plan to get around.Travel to Castaway Point and enquire about this upgrade.

Title: Talanji's Mercy
Objective: Evacuate 10 innocent bystanders in the Terrace of the Chosen.
Text: I know my priests. Such an uproar did not appear out of thin air.There is much I have to atone for, but I am not yet ruler. I have not had de time to do what is needed for de faithful of Zandalar. That does not mean they deserve to suffer.Go into de Terrace of de Chosen and find them that refuse to fight. See that they get out safely. I will hold none of them accountable for de actions of others.

Title: Breaking the Faith
Objective: Subdue 12 angered priests, druids, or prelates in the Terrace of the Chosen.
Text: De faithful are among de most revered in Zandalari society. They are an example for others to aspire to. This is not de example we want others to follow.We must respond in kind.Princess Talanji wishes for us to spare them that will see reason. Do so, if you can find any willing to surrender.For de rest, give them a swift death.

Title: Mission Report: Castaway Point
Objective: Deliver the report to Halford Wyrmbane.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Castaway Point.It details that they were successful in gaining access to an extremely large cannon.Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

Title: Fly Out to Meet Them
Objective: Ride back to Zuldazar with Hexlord Raal.
Text: De Alliance scum will pay for dis! Our army is moving as fast as it can to defend our city.Ride with Raal to get back to de entrance to our city. We must stop de Alliance!

Title: Trouble in Gnomeregan
Objective: Find Micro Zoox outside of Gnomeregan in Dun Morogh.
Text: Our engineers have reported surges of electric usage in Gnomeregan recently. We need you to investigate what is going in there as soon as possible.We made contact with one of the chief engineers in charge of keeping the robots in Gnomeregan under control, and he has offered to assist us in getting inside to see what's going on.

Title: Battle of Dazar'alor
Objective: Defeat Jaina Proudmoore in the Battle of Dazar'alor raid.
Text: Zandalar is already under attack! My people are fleeing and de Alliance are infesting my streets.Rakera's scouts say dat Jaina Proudmoore is leading de assault.She and her kind will pay for dis brazen assault on my people.Gather your allies and push de Alliance back. We must protect my father and destroy de Alliance!

Title: Telaamon's Purge
Objective: Defeat Telaamon.
Text: Telaamon, de Lightbringer leadin' dis assault, be in Hir'eek's cave. He must be thinkin' he can take us all by himself.When he is dead, we be sendin' dis assault force into chaos, allowin' us ta be marchin' on de Alliance along de shore.And hopefully, we can be findin' de source of de fog and destroyin' it.Da three of us be ambushin' Telaamon once ya start fightin'. He ain't gettin' outta here alive.

Title: None Shall Escape
Objective: Destroy 4 Mole Machines.
Text: De Alliance are using de Dark Iron's mole machines to transport troops in and out of Zalamar.We need dose machines destroyed. We are going to establish Zalamar as our forward base to attack de Alliance's main fleet.Take out dem machines, den find Rokhan within Zalamar. He be tracking down where de Alliance general be hidin'.

Title: Breaking Mirrors
Objective: Defeat Telaamon's mirror images within Zalamar.
Text: We have reports dat Telaamon, de Lightforged in charge of dis attack, can create mirror images of himself to strike us down.Two Zandalari, Witch Doctor Kejabu and Jo'chunga, have offered to go in and help fight his mirror images.I want you to ensure dey survive.Eliminating dese strange images should make Telaamon weaker, allowing you and Rokhan to slay him.

Title: Parting Mists
Objective: Ride with Princess Talanji and destroy the Alliance fleet.
Text: It be time ta face de main Alliance fleet. Dey be on da beachhead nearby.I can be feelin' da dark voodoo from dat fog nearby. Princess Talanji be wantin' ta destroy dat mojo as soon as we can.I can be gettin' us outta dis cave real fast, den we be ridin' with da princess and Rakera ta put an end ta all dis.

Title: Outpost Upgrade: Vulpera Hideaway
Objective: Talk with the Caravan Master at Vulpera Hideaway.
Text: The mission at Vulpera Hideaway was a success. Well done.The Caravan Master is very thankful for our assistance and ready to return the favor.Travel to Vulpera Hideaway and speak with the Caravan Master to see what he can do for you.

Title: Outpost Upgrade: Brennadam
Objective: Talk to Hank Harrison in Brennadam.
Text: The mission at Brennadam was a success. Well done.We now have access to what's rumored to be a very fast Harvester that you are able to ride. Sounds strange to me, but what do I know?Travel to Brennadam and enquire about this upgrade.

Title: Orders from Azshara
Objective: Retrieve Xal'atath and find the Makeshift Altar.
Text: This medallion is inscribed with orders commanding the naga to invade our shores and seize artifacts of power.I've heard tales of a priest who used a horrifying dagger to fight the Burning Legion. It is said this blade... Xal'atath... whispers secrets of the deep. It might be our best chance of uncovering what the naga seek.I'm told the naga have an altar on an island in Stormsong Valley. If you take Xal'atath there, the dagger may reveal crucial information.

Title: Mission Report: Brennadam
Objective: Deliver the report to Halford Wyrmbane.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Brennadam.It details that they were successful in gaining access to a Harvester mount.Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

Title: Mission Report: Vulpera Hideaway
Objective: Deliver the mission report to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at the Vulpera Hideaway.It details that the mission was a success and that a Caravan is now available for use.Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

Title: Zandalari Justice
Objective: Defeat 15 Alliance forces within Zalamar.
Text: We must wipe out whatever is left of de Alliance in Zalamar. Den we can find de source of dis fog and dere fleet.Rokhan will scout ahead to find dis Telaamon. He appears to be de general leading de forces here.I need you to go in and wipe out de Alliance forces within Zalamar so dat we can crush dem once and for all.Find Rokhan in Zalamar after dey have been weakened.

Title: We Have Them Cornered
Objective: Ride with Princess Talanji and Rokhan to Zalamar.
Text: General Rakera has already begun mobilizing our forces to our next target: Zalamar.Once we destroy de Alliance dere, we can push forward to de coast and destroy de source of dis fog.De Alliance will have nowhere to hide. We will surround their fleet and end dis war, once for all.Dey will wish dey never stepped foot in Nazmir.Come. We shall ride together to Zalamar and ensure our victory!

Title: Outpost Upgrade: Zul'jan Ruins
Objective: Choose a Loa Boon from the altars at Zul'jan Ruins.
Text: The mission at Zul'jan Ruins was a success. Well done.The Boons of the Loa are now more powerful and will be granted whenever you are in Zandalar.Travel to the Zul'jan Ruins and honor an altar of your choice.

Title: Mission Report: Zul'jan Ruins
Objective: Deliver the mission report to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Zul'jan Ruins.It details that the mission was a success and that the power of the Loa has increased, allowing for Boons to persist longer.Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

Title: Outpost Upgrade: The Great Seal
Objective: Inspect the Mission Command Table at The Great Seal.
Text: The mission at The Great Seal was a success. Well done.A Mission Command Table is now ready for use.Travel to The Great Seal and see that the troops quality of work is up to our standard.

Title: Mission Report: The Great Seal
Objective: Deliver the mission report to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at The Great Seal.It details that the mission was a success and that a Mission Command Table has been constructed.Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

Title: It's Alive!
Objective: Speak with Talanji to power up the A.F.M.O.D.
Text: We got the A.F.M.O.D. repaired and it works perfectly! Eh, except that it's got no power.Princess Talanji seems like she can help us out with this. Ask her if she can give the mech a jumpstart!Once we're set, we can use this thing to mow down the Alliance, take back Zul'jan ruins, and push forward to blow up that fleet!

Title: The Battle of Zul'jan Ruins
Objective: Pilot the A.F.M.O.D. and retake Zul'jan ruins.
