Text: General Rakera has pushed forward with de army. Raal and his forces are still grounded until we remove dis fog.You must pilot de A.F.M.O.D. and help our forces retake Zul'jan ruins. Only den can we move ahead to stop de Alliance and dis fog.Rokhan, and I will join you. De Alliance must see dat our victory is swift and decisive.I would have our enemies cower before us when dey meet dere ends. Such is de price for defiling our lands.

Title: Re-rebuilding the A.F.M.O.D.
Objective: Recover 10 A.F.M.O.D. parts from Gilnean Ambushers and Night Elf Sentinels.
Text: Alright, so, we're goin' after the Alliance through this crazy fog. We gotta retake Zo'bal ruins up ahead.We can do that real easy if we fix up our mech, A.F.M.O.D. - a flying mech of death!The Alliance wrecked it in their initial attack and took a bunch of its parts. Get those parts back and we'll have this thing fixed in no time!

Title: Putting the Gob in Gob Squad
Objective: Rescue the Gob Squad.
Text: Yo! We gotta get the rest of the Gob Squad back if we wanna fix the A.F.M.O.D.!So, our mech got trashed. It was rough. The rest of the Gob Squad are hidin' out there, waiting for word when it's safe.Take this tracker. It'll tell ya when you're getting close to one of the squad. When you get real close, you should see 'em.That'll tell any of the squad nearby that it's safe to come outta hidin' and come back here.With the right goblins and parts, we'll be killing Alliance in no time!

Title: The Sleeper Agent
Objective: Report back to Halford Wyrmbane in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Your work here is done. Morton and Megs can take it from here.Head back to Boralus and let Halford know we've secured the weapon.Don't you worry one wink about Grong. Morton and Megs will make sure he's well looked after.

Title: Minesweeper
Objective: Disarm 10 traps within the Fallen Outpost.
Text: The Alliance are stalling our efforts here with this irritating fog, as well as layering the entire area with traps.We will suffer too many casualties if we try marching our army through this trap-infested area.I've heard you're good at sneaking around. Use your talents to disarm the traps in this area.I'll deal with getting the goblin's parts back from the Alliance while you disarm those traps.

Title: Retaking the Outpost
Objective: Meet Hexlord Raal in Nazmir.
Text: We can handle de rest of de Alliance. I received a report that Hexlord Raal's forces are having issues up ahead.He claims dat dere is an even thicker fog enveloping Nazmir. De Alliance must be using some tricks to slow us down.Go to Nazmir to see what can be done to help Hexlord Raal. We must reach dat fleet and destroy de Alliance!

Title: The Embiggining
Objective: Test Grong's stats while embiggified.
Text: I'll give you the quick rundown before we get started.The Embiggifier is remotely controlled.See this big red button?This jolts the wearer with a surge of power, making them bigger.For safety reasons, you should remain here at camp.I think that's it! Are you ready to science?

Title: Bittersweet Goodbyes
Objective: Meet Grong within Grong's Grotto.
Text: You've helped me prepare my village for my departure, but now I must prepare myself.Meet me within the grotto, where I will say my farewells.

Title: Total Temple Destruction
Objective: Command Grong to defeat the Horde at Temple of the Prophet.
Text: Grong is our greatest achievement, and he's ready to be unleashed!The Horde is staging its troops at a temple to the north.Magister Umbric's portal will get you there fast. Then Grong can get to work!

Title: Freedom for the Da'kani
Objective: Free 8 Da'kani Highbrows within Gorilla Gorge.
Text: Have you seen the barbaric conditions to which the Da'kani are subjected? Corralled and caged, awaiting slaughter, or worse...I cannot leave here in good faith without first seeing that my kind are liberated.

Title: Calibrate the Core
Objective: Calibrate the Embiggifier's core by using it on dead things within Bilgewater Bonanza.
Text: The Embiggifier is nearly ready! All that's left to do is calibrate its core.The best way to do that without catastrophic results is to use it on things that are already dead.This should be a simple task!I have a hunch you excel at making things dead.

Title: Fit for Grong
Objective: Collect 12 Azerite Infused Ore.
Text: Grong is already impressively large. In fact, I don't think our Embiggifier is going to fit around his noggin without some modification.I'll require an ample supply of ore to make the necessary adjustments, but we're in luck. The goblins nearby have already done the work of mining it; we just need to take it off their hands!Secure an ample amount of Azerite-infused ore, and we'll be back in business!

Title: A Nice Nap
Objective: Use the Tranquilizer Dart on Grong.
Text: I'm not sure how much longer those chains will hold.Grong's going to have to take a little nap until he's ready to be deployed.Use this dart. It's been double-dipped in something potent enough to take down a direhorn, so it should do the trick.Grong would want you to be the one to do it.

Title: Out of Options
Objective: Kill 12 Bilgewater goblins within Gorilla Gorge.
Text: My kind are hunted like animals.We've tried to reach a resolution through civil discourse, but these poachers recoil from rational thought. They revel in brutality.I ask you: Who are the real animals?It pains me to descend to their level, but I fear I've exhausted all other options.

Title: Bring the Base
Objective: Help collect baseline stats for Grong's speed, intelligence, and strength.
Text: We'll need to collect some baseline statistics before we use the Embiggifier.Grong will be asked to perform basic tasks pertaining to speed, intelligence, and strength.This will help us measure the increase once he's been embiggified.

Title: The Needs of the Many
Objective: Accompany Grong to Xibala.
Text: Ever since the kaja'mite began bubbling around the gorge, I have been searching for meaning. Why was I burdened with intelligence? What is my purpose?I have found my answers in the Embiggifier.I was meant to help the Alliance defeat the Horde.If I can save lives by volunteering, then my choice is clear.The needs of the many outweigh the needs of one.I am ready.

Title: Real Big Power
Objective: Test the Embiggifier on a Kul Tiran Clucker.
Text: We're still building a harness for the Embiggifier, but we need to test its core first. That's where the real power is!This technology is years ahead of the Horde's, but it's so easy to use that even an orc could do it!Just point and click!

Title: A Beast with Brains
Objective: Find Grong within Gorilla Gorge.
Text: For optimal results, the Embiggifier should be used on someone with substantial intellect.Good thing our partner is as smart as they come.He and his kind have been empowered by kaja'mite, granting them exceptional intelligence!Head up to the gorge and let Grong know we're ready to begin the embiggifying!

Title: This is Huge!
Objective: Listen to Megs and Morton's plan.
Text: $p, allow me to introduce Megs and Morton, the gnomes who are going to shake things up for the Alliance in a big way!They've been perfecting a device that can take any ordinary animal and turn it into a humongous, unstoppable beast that we can then unleash on our enemies!I'll let Megs and Morton fill you in on the specifics, but I promise you, this tech is a game changer!

Title: Sensitive Intel
Objective: Meet Kelsey Steelspark in Zuldazar.
Text: I've received a report from Kelsey Steelspark. She claims to have discovered something that will aid our war effort.She's refused to go into specifics, citing a need for secrecy with such sensitive intel.It looks like you'll need to speak to her in person.She's expecting you in Xibala.

Title: Changing Course
Objective: Report to Halford Wyrmbane aboard Wind's Redemption in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Champion, the time for action is upon us.Developments are underway that will change the course of this war.Report to me aboard Wind's Redemption as soon as possible.

Title: Dead Reckoning
Objective: Attend the discussion in Unity Square.
Text: While I have some concerns, I cannot deny the bravery, heroism and sacrifices we have made. That you have made. Thank you for all the aid you have given to the Alliance.The future of our ongoing war campaign is why I have asked everyone here. I wish to look at what we've done, so we can decide on the best way forward.

Title: Pet Battle Challenge: Gnomeregan
Objective: Defeat Pulverizer Bot Mk 6001 in Gnomeregan.
Text: Gnomeregan's at Mayhem Level Maximum again. Those machines just don't give up, and keep coming back.I can teleport us in there again, but all of those crazy robots are back. You sure you want this? I don't. I mean, maybe I want to watch robots smash things for some entertainment. I'm sure you will be fine. Lets go!

Title: Gnomeregan's New Guardians
Objective: Defeat Pulverizer Bot Mk 6001 in Gnomeregan.
Text: My personally-modified Mayhem Detection Device has been giving readings off the charts for the last few days. You might be thinking that mayhem and Gnomeregan are synonymous, and to an extent they are, but these readings are beyond anything I've seen before!I'm not totally sure what's going on inside of Gnomeregan, but something is different. If you are feeling brave enough, I can teleport you deep in there and you can see for yourself.Let me know when you are ready.

Title: Trouble in Gnomeregan
Objective: Find Micro Zoox outside of Gnomeregan in Dun Morogh.
Text: Some strange spikes of electric usage have been happening in Gnomeregan recently. We need you to investigate what is going in there as soon as possible.We've received contact from one of the chief engineers in charge of keeping things in Gnomeregan under control, and he has offered to assist us in getting inside to see what's going on.

Title: Through the Front Door
Objective: Complete "Escape from Tol Dagor".
Text: We would like the least amount of risk during your retrieval of Priscilla Ashvane.You will arrive on the docks during a shift change. From there, you will prepare and enter the prison.Find me in Zuldazar when you are successful.

Title: Orders from Azshara
Objective: Take the Dagger to the Makeshift Altar.
Text: Ugh... naga.This medallion is inscribed with orders. Looks like naga have been commanded to invade our shores and seize artifacts of great power.You know, I recently came upon one such object. See that dagger over there? Nasty thing. Gives me the willies. I swear I hear it whispering to me.I found it nearby at Atal'Gral, on a makeshift altar. Maybe if you take it there, you'll get an idea of how the naga intended to use it.

Title: Catching a Ride
Objective: Find Nathanos at the dock in Plunder Harbor.
Text: Nathanos should have found a boat by now.Let us hasten to meet him in the harbor.It behooves us to take care of this business quickly.There are better ways for us to support the Horde's effort here.

Title: A Brilliant Distraction
Objective: Retrieve the Volatile Azerite.
Text: We plan to be cautious on entry to Tol Dagor.I imagine our exit will not be as... subtle.That foundry to the west... I hear they made Azerite explosives there.Stock up, we will need them.

Title: The Abyssal Scepter
Objective: Meet with Jaina Proudmoore in Xibala in Zuldazar.
Text: The Lord Admiral has proposed our next move. It's something we don't think the Horde will expect, but it's dangerous: We're going to steal back the Abyssal Scepter.Your name came up as someone who could see it through, if you're willing to take the chance.Meet Lady Jaina at our base in Xibala. She'll have more information for you there.

Title: Face Your Enemy
Objective: Send the targets chosen by Valtrois back for examination.
Text: We have decided that our best course of action would be to enter the prison disguised as Proudmoore military. Rexxar will be our prisoner.We want to keep a low profile until we break Ashvane out.I find that I work better with reference when undertaking this type of endeavor.I have chosen some humans that interest me. I would like to examine their faces.Use the Shard of Vesara on them, and they will be... encouraged to find their way to me.

Title: The Azsharan Medallion
Objective: Take the Medallion to Collector Kojo.

Title: Be More Uniform
Objective: Collect gear from Proudmoore forces in the foundry.
Text: Head into the foundry. Proudmoore's guards have taken over there. They will provide excellent accessories for our disguises.I can recreate their faces, but without the clothing, we won't make it far.Gather enough gear to cover us.We'll need the Captain's jacket as well.There will be less of a challenge at the gate if we outrank them.

Title: The Return of Derek Proudmoore
Objective: Observe Sylvanas's discussion with Princess Talanji.
Text: I'll admit, I did not think the Little Lion had it in him to kill King Rastakhan. Blood has been spilled, and vengeance must be had.Give me a moment to express my condolences, then come with me. We have more to do to win this war.

Title: Set Sail
Objective: Collect Azerite on Island Expeditions.
Text: Assist the Horde by collecting Azerite on Island Expeditions.

Title: The King's Death
Objective: Pay respects to King Rastakhan.
Text: King Rastakhan is dead, the Zandalari fleet has been decimated, and we have lost valuable soldiers.The Dark Lady is on her way from Orgrimmar to assess the situation. We must figure out our next move before the Alliance strike again.I believe protocol now would be to pay respects to the fallen king. We will determine our next move afterwards.

Title: What the Drust Knew
Objective: Carefully remove the enchantment from the Ancient Drust relic to learn about its construction.
Text: Bal'a dash.If you have a moment, I could use your assistance. I've recently received a shipment of Drust relics that were smuggled out of Kul Tiras.Most have our usual enchantments, but there is one that is unique. Just holding it makes my hair stand on end.With you being my best pupil, I was thinking that it would be enlightening if we disenchanted it together, to see how it was made.What do you say?

Title: As the Dust Settles
Objective: Meet with Anduin Wrynn in Unity Square.
Text: We have achieved a great victory, though at a cost.King Wrynn is gathering the Alliance leadership in Unity Square to discuss matters. He has requested our presence as well.Go to Unity Square. I'll meet you there shortly.

Title: The Treasury Heist
Objective: Retrieve the Abyssal Scepter from the Zandalari Treasury.
Text: The Abyssal Scepter is a powerful tidesage artifact and a serious threat to the fleet. The Horde stole it, but it is being held by the Zandalari in their treasury.The Storm's Wake has crafted a fake Scepter. Your first job is to obtain the real one without alerting suspicion.Speak to me when you are ready to go over the plan.

Title: A Path of Blood
Objective: Slay 15 Alliance soldiers within the Blood Gate.
Text: De main fleet of de Alliance and Kul Tirans are off de coast in Nazmir. But we cannot ignore de forces here.Dere seems to be a strange fog coming in from Nazmir. De Kul Tirans must be using some of their voodoo to weaken us.We must carve a path of blood through dese Alliance fools. Help our forces by weakening de Alliance.

Title: Set Sail
Objective: Collect Azerite on Island Expeditions.
Text: Assist the Alliance by collecting Azerite on Island Expeditions.

Title: No One Left Behind
Objective: Rescue Rokhan.
Text: De warriors here tell me Rokhan made a heroic stand, holding off de Alliance and their champions before being defeated.Rokhan is still here within de Blood Gate, held captive by some strange creature called a Lightforged.I must stay here and help hold de line. I need you to rescue Rokhan!

Title: Confront The Val'kyr
Objective: Escort the Spirit of Vol'jin to Eyir.
Text: Vol'jin's spirit is growing in power. I should no longer have to maintain a ritual to keep him here.Dis is fortunate, since Bwonsamdi warned me dat Eyir will likely not be pleased with my presence. Apparently she and Bwonsamdi have a past de loa was unwilling to discuss.We can proceed when you are ready.

Title: The Loa of Death
Objective: Confront Bwonsamdi.
Text: Bwonsamdi is a dangerous loa, but even I do not believe he whispered to Vol'jin on his deathbed. To appoint Sylvanas sounds, well... he is not fond of de undead. And from what I have seen of de warchief, she is no fan of death.We must be respectful when we speak to Bwonsamdi, or dere will be consequences. Come, stay close.

Title: War Is Here
Objective: Meet King Rastakhan within the Great Seal.
Text: We need to move. We've received word that the Alliance have mounted an attack through Nazmir.Make for the Great Seal. King Rastakhan and Princess Talanji are there forming a plan of attack.Make no mistake, we will crush the Alliance. They are fools to attack us through Nazmir.

Title: Strong New Allies
Objective: Take your Orcish Orphan to the Orgrimmar Embassy. If your orphan is not present when you arrive, call for him.
Text: I heard some adventurers saying that there are new members of the Horde, unlike all the rest! And the best part? They're right here in Orgrimmar!I don't know where the embassy is... but I bet you do! Can you take me? I heard there are orcs from another planet!

Title: The Azsharan Medallion
Objective: Take the Medallion to Collector Kojo.

Title: Ride of the Zandalari
Objective: Mobilize the Zandalari fleet, warriors, and flyers.
Text: It is time de Alliance see de full fury of de Zandalari. Dey are fools to try an attack in Nazmir.We must tell de fleet, our warriors, and our flyers dat dey must move out and go to Nazmir at once.I will go aid our forces at de Blood Gate. Here is a list of dose you must speak with to mobilize our forces.Move as fast as you can, we must stop de Alliance as quickly as possible.

Title: Orders from Azshara
Objective: Take the Dagger to the Makeshift Altar.
Text: Ugh... naga.This medallion is inscribed with orders. Looks like naga have been commanded to invade our shores and seize artifacts of great power.You know, I recently came upon one such object. See that dagger over there? Nasty thing. Gives me the willies. I swear I hear it whispering to me.I found it on an island in Stormsong Valley, on a makeshift altar. Maybe if you take it there, you'll get an idea of how the naga intended to use it.

Title: In Every Dark Corner
Objective: Lead the Horde assault into Drustvar.
Text: The Alliance's hold on Drustvar is weak. We will conquer it for the Horde!

Title: March on the Marsh
Objective: Lead the Alliance assault into Nazmir.
Text: The Alliance has begun a coordinated assault against the Horde in Nazmir. Defeat the enemy forces and drive them out!

Title: Ritual Rampage
Objective: Lead the Alliance assault into Zuldazar.
Text: The Alliance has launched an assault into the very heart of the Zandalari empire. Defeat the Horde on their own soil to show them our strength!

Title: Romp in the Swamp
Objective: Repel the Alliance forces assaulting Nazmir.
Text: Alliance armies are landing on the shores of Nazmir. Drive them back to the sea. Zandalar is ours!

Title: Horde of Heroes
Objective: Lead the Horde assault into Stormsong Valley.
Text: The Alliance has begun a coordinated assault against our forces in Stormsong Valley. Attack the enemy forces and drive them back!

Title: Our New Friends
Objective: Take your Human Orphan to the Stormwind Embassy. If your orphan is not present when you arrive, call for him.
Text: I heard that the Alliance is growing! More and more different kinds of people are joining all the time to fight the mean Horde.I'm not sure where the embassy is, but I heard it's somewhere here in Stormwind. Can you show me how to get there? I want to see all our new friends!

Title: Many Fine Heroes
Objective: Lead the Alliance assault into Vol'dun.
Text: The Alliance has the upper hand in Vol'dun. We strike now! You will lead our forces to victory!

Title: Twist the Knife
Objective: Meet Xal'atath at the Precipice of Oblivion.
Text: The relics are ours... as it was meant to be.There is but one more step needed for the great truths to be revealed.The naga sought to summon their storm from a place that echoes with ancient power. Though this site has had countless names over the ages, you mortals know it as the Precipice of Oblivion.I will go on ahead and begin preparations. Join me there.

Title: Necessary Precautions
Objective: Review the G.M.O.D's systems.
Text: That was freakin' awesome! We decimated Mekkatorque's puny little army.We got a location on where that little punk and his airship is. That's where he's controllin' all his FORMER mechs.Here's the plan, we're gonna fly over there, blow up that freak, then destroy his airship!Now, I ain't no idiot, I'm the smartest goblin alive. First, we gotta take what they call necessary precautions.Take this manual, I want you to make sure the G.M.O.D is ready to go!

Title: Rocket Hop
Objective: Repel the Hordes forces attacking Tiragarde Sound.
Text: Horde forces are attacking Tiragarde Sound. Make them regret every footstep upon our soil!

Title: To Orgrimmar
Objective: Take the Glaive of Vol'jin to Master Gadrin at Drannosh'ar Blockade, Durotar.
Text: A darkness in me mind be keeping me from remembering what happened da day I named Sylvanas warchief. Take me glaive and travel to da pyre where I was cremated in Orgrimmar. Master Gadrin be packin' enough juju to call me to dat place. Go, and I be seein' ya dere.

Title: Avoiding Lawsuits 101
Objective: Rescue 6 Uninsured Goblin Workers.
Text: Yo! I leave the A.M.O.D. for two seconds to deal with old Gallywix and now I'm knee-deep in Azerite goo!Listen, here's the deal. I need ya to rescue some of these goblins from these monsters.I'll be honest, I skimped on the money that covers their insurance in the event of Azerite-monster-related injuries.What? Who knew that these slimes would appear and attack these guys!Do me a solid and get these goblins outta there!

Title: It Belongs in My Mech!
Objective: Recover Azerite from Azerite slimes using the Azerite Vacuumizer.
Text: Check this out! It's my latest creation that someone else came up with and built, Gallywix's Mech of Death!I got it fueled with all that Azerite you found, but I still need more of the stuff to give it that extra kick.I was SUPPOSED to have the stuff from our operations here, but there's some sorta Azerite goop causin' a mess!My guy Patch made an Azerite vacuum device. I want you to suck the Azerite outta these slimes!

Title: Every Little Death Helps
Objective: Assist Xal'atath in recovering its strength.
Text: So weak... need... blood... souls...

Title: Every Little Death Helps
Objective: Assist Xal'atath in recovering its strength.
Text: So weak... need... blood... souls...

Title: Every Little Death Helps
Objective: Assist Xal'atath in recovering its strength.
Text: So weak... need... blood... souls...

Title: Breaking Out Ashvane
Objective: Meet Valtrois in Tiragarde Sound.
Text: The Dark Lady wishes to gain another potential ally in the fight against the Alliance.Lady Ashvane, head of the Ashvane Company, was one of the greatest enemies of Kul Tiras until her capture.We are going to release her.Meet Valtrois in Tiragarde Sound. She and Rexxar are working out a plan to break Ashvane out.

Title: Every Little Death Helps
Objective: Assist Xal'atath in recovering its strength.
Text: So weak... need... blood... souls...

Title: Queen's Favor
Objective: Take a hit from Varok Saurfang, then report to Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner in Orgrimmar.
Text: I have two things to ask of you, and I do not ask them lightly.First, I need you to retain the favor of the warchief. She will undoubtedly have questions, and seeds of distrust may begin to grow, but she cannot lose you as an ally. Not now. She would not so willingly part with one of her greatest champions.In order to do so, it will have to look like you faced me in combat, and lost. I trust you can take a hit.Second, I ask you not to follow me further. I must make this journey alone.

Title: Signs of Saurfang
Objective: Follow the trail of Varok Saurfang in Redridge.
Text: With the guards drunk at their posts, and others out of position, Saurfang would have had little trouble passing Three Corners undetected.The path splits just south of town. The back roads of Redridge are poorly patrolled, and are infested with gnolls and spiders. In other words, perfect for an orc trying not to be noticed.His most likely path is Lakeridge Highway. We should continue our investigation there.

Title: Tracking Tipoff
Objective: Drink the Humanizing Potion, then question Hunter McAlister at Redridge Pass in Redridge Mountains.
Text: Look there, down the hill. One of the Alliance hunters that roam the area.No one knows these pathways like them. If our quarry passed through here, that hunter would certainly have seen the tracks. His dogs may even have caught Saurfang's scent.Here is another dose of the potion. Let us question this one while he is alone.

Title: Grim Tidings
Objective: Meet with Zekhan in Swamp of Sorrows.
Text: Ey mon, dat dark ranger, she be lyin' to ya!Saurfang knew dey'd be comin' for him. He sent me to watch da pass, see who his assassins be. Try to warn him if I could.She not be reportin' back nothin'... she gonna kill him. Most likely got a whole buncha deathguards just waitin' for her signal.We gotta stop dem! Ya wit' me?

Title: Corner Crossing
Objective: Drink the Humanizing Potion, then question the citizens of Redridge Mountains.
Text: If Saurfang was headed in this direction, it would have been difficult for him to avoid the Three Corners watchpost.We could simply walk in there and demand information, but I have a feeling that they would not part with it willingly.So we will take another approach.I have procured this potion from our alchemists. It will turn us into--ugh--humans for a while.We can then question the guards. Perhaps someone saw something.

Title: Ever Eastward
Objective: Find Dark Ranger Lyana at Redridge Pass in Redridge Mountains.
Text: All signs point to our quarry heading farther east.To what end, I am not sure. But I have my suspicions.I am going to scout the area from the air. Let's meet up at Redridge Pass.

Title: A Warrior's Death
Objective: Defend Varok Saurfang in Swamp of Sorrows.
Text: She gonna try an' take him in, and den no one ever gonna see Varok Saurfang again.Dis was never a rescue mission. Dis be about power, an' control, an' Sylvanas think she be holdin' all da cards.But she didn't count on us!Let's go!

Title: A Way Out
Objective: Meet with Dark Ranger Lyana in Elwynn Forest.
Text: My spies report that our High Overlord did not leave the way he entered, nor any other way we know of. No signs of him were seen at any of the known exits from the Stockades or the sewers. He simply was in his cell one moment, and gone the next.Begin your investigation around the city of Stormwind. There must be another way out that we do not know of.Dark Ranger Lyana will meet you there. Her tracking skills are second to none.Do not fail me, my champion.

Title: Eastern Escape
Objective: Meet Dark Ranger Lyana at Three Corners in Redridge Mountains.
Text: It's not unusual to see SI:7 spies lurking around the city, but something about this doesn't feel right.We need to find where Saurfang's trail picks up. The last tracks were heading east, towards Redridge.The path to Redridge crosses the Three Corners, one of the Alliance's more well-defended towers.I have an idea. Meet me there.

Title: The High Overlord
Objective: Discuss Saurfang's fate with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in Orgrimmar.
Text: I have asked you here to discuss a matter of great importance to the Horde.Varok Saurfang is no longer in Stormwind.Let us discuss this turn of events.

Title: The Fall of the Sunwell
Objective: Complete the Fall of the Sunwell scenario.
Text: The flame of the lantern dims. Your final task is to rekindle it.In order to do so, you must walk one remaining path. While we are fortunate to hold the Sunwell once again, we must always remember that it was yet another part of us that Arthas took away... and that our late prince was forced to find us a new way of life.Enter the Sunwell Plateau, and witness its fall.

Title: On Track
Objective: Follow the trail of Varok Saurfang in Elwynn Forest.
Text: Keep your head down. We do not want to be seen out here.Our spies keep watch over Stormwind day and night, and saw no signs of Saurfang.Nor did we notice any oddly-oversized carts or strange ships in the night, if that was what you were thinking.How then, did he make his escape?Let's look around.

Title: The Dark Lady Calls
Objective: Meet with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in Orgrimmar.
Text: Champion, the Dark Lady has need of you.We cannot speak more of this here. Make haste to Orgrimmar at once.Best not to keep her waiting.

Title: A Goblin's Definition of Success
Objective: Meet with Nathanos on the Banshee's Wail.
Text: I'm all set here, I'm just gonna play around with the mech, I think I got a good idea how it works thanks to ya.Nathanos "prince of all that's death and destruction" Blightcaller is gonna want you back on that boat, the Banshee's Scream or whatever it is.He'll be happy to know we took care of business. Then again, I got no idea if he even feels happy anymore.

Title: The Legend of Mechagon
Objective: Meet Tinkmaster Overspark outside the mysterious vault.
Text: I came as soon as I heard! A mysterious vault has been discovered in Tiragarde.Centuries ago, the last king of the gnomes, King Mechagon, led his followers in search of a mythical land of technology. He left no clue as to where he was headed, and over time his legend faded into history. This vault could be the first step to discovering King Mechagon's true fate!I must examine it firsthand. Meet me there, Champion. I could use your assistance.

Title: You Must be This Height
Objective: Let me know when I can activate the device.
Text: The moment is here .For such a historic moment I feel a gnome, such as myself, should be the one to activate the device.Let me know when you think we should begin.

Title: Toys For Destruction
Objective: Help Rocket-Chief Fuselage build the perfect weapon.
Text: Ricket sent word that she was here in Mechagon, so I came right away to help with the uh... research.I had the peons scour the island for any technology they could find. With da stuff we got here, we gonna make some amazing weapons to fight King Mechagon. Then afterwards, we get rich selling 'em!Help me wrangle everyone's ideas into one perfect weapon!

Title: Right Bot for the Job
Objective: Bring three Repeating Wrenchbots to Recycler Kerchunk
Text: We don't waste anything around here. Every defeated bot gets a second chance!If I'm going to fix this mechaspider, I'm going to need a few extra wrenchbots working with me.Use my Bot Re-Energizer on three dead Repeating Wrenchbots and bring them to me, and I'll put them to work.

Title: Grease The Wheels
Objective: Use the Grease Trap to collect 12 Cog Grease from slimes around The Outflow.
Text: Kerchunk said you guys was working on getting that mechaspider running again. Well I'm not gonna let you have all the fun!That rusty old thing's gonna need a lot of grease to get moving again. So I jury-rigged a special Grease Trap to help you gather grease from the slimes nearby.

Title: More Power
Objective: Connect power lines from Bondo's Yard to the Quickcharge laboratory.
Text: Welcome back, dear test subject.My dear sister has kindly asked me to administer today's experiment, which falls below our typical standards of legality...You may, as always, choose not to participate and we will acquire sufficient replacement test subjects.Our new project requires more energy than our generator can manage. We must supercharge it with a jolt of power from the outside.Bondo's Yard has the best power line in Mechagon, so we shall siphon what we need from those rapscallions.

Title: The Night Warrior
Objective: Speak with the Lost Wisp to find out why the moon turned dark.
Text: It appears these night elves won't give up the information easily... but perhaps that wisp you captured will.See if you can get it to reveal what happened here. I don't care how you do it.Father Norlath will handle the wisp from there.

Title: Unintended Consequences
Objective: Find the Void Stone in Drustvar.
Text: The servants of N'Zoth prepare for their master's return. They intend to conjure a scouring storm to wash away all unbelievers.The particular ritual they will invoke requires three ancient artifacts. One of void, one of storm, and one of ocean.Even now, I hear the void relic calling to me. It is being empowered... or corrupted, I am not sure which. I see it upon a cliff, overlooking a vast sea.Come. We can find a much better use for such a prize.

Title: The Dead of Night
Objective: Protect the val'kyr as they resurrect Delaryn and Sira.
Text: This is the crux of the Dark Lady's plan for Darkshore. We will raise new champions for the Forsaken and the Horde on this very spot.Guard the val'kyr. We cannot allow anything or anyone to interrupt them.

Title: Questfall
Objective: Slay 8 Riverpaw Gnolls and defeat Barkpaw.
Text: Me apologies, matey! New to the bow! More of a sword arm, yeah?!Didn't mean ta give ya such a start! It's just that we're in a bit of a bind, me an' the crew here!Can ya give us a bit of a hand?! Some upright dogs attacked us in the dead of night! Chased us out of camp in our skivvies!Maybe ya can help?! They had some sort of big one as their boss! We've been callin' him Barkpaw on account of he was barkin' at us and had big ol' paws!

Title: Aftermath
Objective: Speak to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: We all have our reasons for accepting the val'kyr's gift. But now is not the time for those discussions.Sylvanas has been dealt a heavy blow today with the loss of Brynja. We will have no time to rest before the Alliance descends on this place.Nathanos has summoned you. There is something you must see.

Title: To Kill A Warden
Objective: Defeat Sira Moonwarden.

Title: Where Hope Dies
Objective: Find the body of Delaryn Summermoon.
Text: We must carry out the Dark Lady's orders before we are overrun by these newly-invigorated elves.There is one night elf in particular that we seek. You may remember her from our last venture into Darkshore. Lucky for you, she is already dead... so she should prove less troublesome than the living ones you've already encountered.Signal me when you find her corpse.

Title: We're Not Out of the Woods Yet
Objective: Bring the Lost Wisp to Nathanos Blightcaller in Lor'danel Landing.

Title: Trouble in Darkshore
Objective: Speak with Dread-Admiral Tattersail to travel to Darkshore and report to Nathanos.
Text: We have received some disturbing reports from Darkshore.What was once a secure stronghold for the Horde is now beset by an unnatural darkness. The moon has turned completely black.The outposts there have yet to be reinforced with our main force and we are suddenly outnumbered. Nathanos wants you to meet him in Darkshore and find out what happened.

Title: Quit Vining!
Objective: Free Goblin Harvesters from vines.
Text: This is terrible! We got harvesters that ain't harvestin'!We've been busting our rumps chopping down all these trees, but someone keeps tangling up our machines in the vines! I ain't going out there with those night elves stalkin' around.See if you can get in there and free up my equipment!

Title: Black Moon Rising
Objective: Interrogate Lieutenants Golras, Ivyth, and Maliyra.
Text: Darkshore has never been known for being bright and sunny, but something strange has happened here. A black moon hangs over everything.None of the scouts I sent into the forest have returned. The night elves are up to something. And I need to know what it is.Their rank-and-file won't have the information we seek. Hunt down their lieutenants and get them to talk by any means necessary.

Title: No Survivors
Objective: Kill 8 Veiled Deathstalkers.
Text: Do you see the encampment on the beach below?The Horde followed Tyrande here.No doubt some of them have remained here in the shadows in case she returned.Kill them.

Title: Dark Ranger Round-Up
Objective: Slay Vindictive Sentinels and Archers and command Brynja to raise them as Dark Rangers.
Text: These night elf ambushes have left us undermanned. We need reinforcements if we are to hold Darkshore.Brynja, one of the Dark Lady's val'kyr, can provide us with those reinforcements. Slay the night elves and command her to raise them into our service. Should any prove unwilling... deal with them.Did I not make myself clear? Go. The Dark Lady has plans for these dark rangers.

Title: A Particular Process
Objective: Speak to Nomi.
Text: As you might have noticed, Vintner Iltheux is very particular about his wine making process, but his ancient recipe was crafted with only the Nightborne in mind.We need something different to please the diverse palates of the Horde!Talk to Nomi and see what he has in mind to spice things up.

Title: Gaze of the Loa: Bwonsamdi
Objective: Complete Bwonsamdi's trial.
Text: Ordinarily the final trial would be given by Rezan. But the loa of kings is no more.It seems ol' Rastakhan picked a new favorite to take his place.Enjoy that. Bwonsamdi waits for you in the temple.

Title: Gaze of the Loa: Pa'ku
Objective: Complete Pa'ku's trial.
Text: Two more loa have declared their intent to test Talanji. The next is Pa'ku. She awaits you both at the top of these steps.I need not warn you about her tempestuous nature, nor her love for watching others fall from great heights.Good luck.

Title: Mekkatorque's Battle Plans
Objective: Recover Mekkatorque's Battle Plans

Title: The First Arcanist
Objective: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Nazjatar.
Text: Our situation is dire.The Horde fleet was decimated by the attack on Dazar'alor. This naga trap has claimed much of what we had left.Survivors report seeing the naga taking captives. Thalyssra has gone on ahead to see what she can do to help them.I will finish up here while you aid the First Arcanist's efforts. My rangers will provide what little aid they can.

Title: Job's Done
Objective: Return to Commander Dresh at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
Text: I'll stick around here a bit longer to ensure the peons get back to work.You should return to Orgrimmar and let Commander Dresh know that he does not need to fret about the outpost any longer.

Title: Gaze of the Loa: Gonk
Objective: Complete Gonk's trial.
Text: The Lord of the Pack has requested to be the next to speak to Talanji. He is just up the steps on the next terrace.I do not think he will require quite as much of you as I did, but I believe his words will be relevant to your purposes here.Do not think we are not aware of your intentions.

Title: Threat Contained
Objective: Return to Bladeguard Sonji at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
Text: That should keep those naga down!You can have the honor of telling Bladeguard Sonji that the threat to Zuldazar's coast has been contained.

Title: Gaze of the Loa: Krag'wa
Objective: "Witness" Krag'wa's trial.
Text: Hello again, small one.I see Talanji has chosen a worthy witness. I must test Talanji's willingness to sacrifice for her people. I will weigh her commitment to defending the weak. Many great rulers have failed this challenge and still gone on to make powerful monarchs.But the most beloved, those that find themselves surrounded by loyal followers, always understand the value of devotion to their people.You will help me with this trial. Speak to me when you are ready to begin.

Title: Mech versus Airship
Objective: Ride the G.M.O.D to blow up an Alliance airship and confront Mekkatorque.
Text: We're all set to go, thanks to them battle plans ya found. Looks like Mekko ain't gonna be at his airship right now.Here's the plan. We're gonna go seriously mess up his ship, then Mekko is gonna swing by to try to save his friends.But instead, he's gonna find you and me standin' on the deck of his burnin' ship, waitin' to take him out!Get in to the mech, we're blowin' up an airship and a gnome!

Title: Fortunate Souls
Objective: Rescue 7 captive soldiers in Spears of Azshara.
Text: $p, I am glad to see that you survived the wreck. Many were not as fortunate...I am capable of stalling the enemy here for now, but this position is not defensible long term.We need to find somewhere safe for our forces.Once we have taken measure of the wounded we will push on. In the meantime, find as many survivors as you can.Nazjatar will claim no more Horde lives today!

Title: Descent
Objective: Meet with Lor'themar Theron in Nazjatar.
Text: What has transpired! That is to say, what has transpired?! Yes, that is the appropriate response, is it not?I find our circumstances enthralling! Yet, tragic.I prattle on... Yes, Lor'themar asked me to send you to him at once. He is in need of your expertise.I'll lower you down the falls safely. Good luck!

Title: Killing on the Side
Objective: Kill 15 Alliance and Kul Tiran soldiers in Vigil Hill.
Text: Those annoying Alliance nearby are definitely takin' orders from Mekkatorque.That means they gotta die! And any of their Kul Tiran friends, too. They gotta know the Horde is number one.And that you don't kidnap someone's roadside assistance!

Title: In Deep
Objective: Meet Thalyssra and Lor'themar in Nazjatar.
Text: I can keep this barrier up here for a time after our departure, but we cannot remain here.These soldiers will not be safe for long.We must go deeper into this place to seek a more defensible position.

Title: Insurance Renewal
Objective: Rescue Gallywix's Roadside Assistance
Text: You know, all I wanna do is blow up Mekkatorque and whatever airship he's ridin' in. Of course it ain't gonna be easy!I need you to go rescue my roadside assistance so they can fix this mech! They're probably in the Alliance camp near here.Meanwhile, I'm gonna cook us up a plan. We're gonna give Mekkatorque a real nice surprise!And by real nice surprise, I mean we're gonna blow him up. Oh, and also his airship.

Title: What the Drust Knew
Objective: Carefully remove the enchantment from the Ancient Drust relic to learn about its construction.
Text: Ahoy!If you have a moment, I could use your assistance. I've recently received a large shipment of Drust relics that I've been processing.Most of them have been nothing out of the ordinary, but there is this one that is special. Just holding it makes my hair stand on end.With you being my best pupil, I was thinking that it would be fun if we disenchanted it together, to see how it was made.What do you say?

Title: A New Hope
Objective: Witness Tyrande's address to the kaldorei.
Text: Darkshore belongs to our people once more, in no small part due to your efforts. And, while I disagree with her methods, we would not have succeeded without Tyrande as well.Differences aside, she is our leader--and an incarnation of the Night Warrior herself.She is about to begin. You may stand here beside me.

Title: The Beat Goes On
Objective: Create a runic power core and charge it from the corpses of Awoken Guardians and Vengeful Bones.
Text: We have most of the materials we need, but we require one final item. A heart.Don't worry. I don't mean one of flesh, but of stone; to bind the materials of the body into a single form.Find a smooth stone, and enchant it to hold a life force. It will require some reagents, but I would expect a powerful enchanter such as yourself to have some on hand or know where to find them.Once that's done, it will need to be powered. The souls animating the elementals and undead here should do the trick.

Title: Insurance Policy
Objective: Activate the roadside assistance button on the G.M.O.D.
Text: Mekkatorque called us idiots, can you believe that? Well, if I'm an idiot, then why did I buy an insurance policy on my mech, huh?I bet that radioactive dimwit doesn't have an insurance policy on HIS mech!We're gonna be outta here in no time. I just gotta give a quick call for roadside assistance to come out and fix this thing up.I need you to go hit the button for roadside assistance on my mech.Just, uh, don't hit the wrong one.

Title: Putting It All Together
Objective: Assemble the golem for Sef Iwen.
Text: Hmm... Everything seems untouched.We can begin construction of my new body over here. Afterwards, I'll teach you how to make my enchanting rod.

Title: Test Case #1; Mech vs. Mekkatorque
Objective: Ride the G.M.O.D with Gallywix to face Mekkatorque.
Text: Alright, we got PLENTY of Azerite in this baby to blow up Mekkatorque and his airship.That radioactive freak is gonna pay for sendin' his toys to attack one of MY, er, OUR bases!Hop in. We got a gnome to blow up.

Title: The Sixth Sense
Objective: Escort Sef Iwen to her grave.
Text: For my plan to work, we need to break the spell on my body that is anchoring my spirit to this place.However, my mortal remains are buried deep within this forest. There are wards within it that are designed to trap spirits who are still attached to the material world. Once my remains are cleansed, I will be able to move freely through the woods.Until then, I'll need you to disenchant the wards we come across.Speak to me when you are ready, and I will lead you to my grave.

Title: We're Going In
Objective: Activate the teleportation runes to enter Sef's Retreat.
Text: This used to be a Drust shrine. There is a series of sigils that, once invoked, will allow us to teleport to my old sanctum.It has been centuries since I've been here, I'm having a bit of trouble remembering the order in which the sigils need to be activated to open the portal.I hope you're feeling adventurous. Oh, and be cautious. I enchanted the runes to keep would be intruders out by force.

Title: The Threads That Bind
Objective: Collect 55 Durable Spider Silk.
Text: Our destination is near Gol Koval, but there is something else you could pick up along the way.I don't want to ask because I hate them, but you cannot dispute the resilience of that horrible webbing that they manage to get everywhere.There are spiders to the southeast. As a guardian of nature, I don't want to say kill them, but if you could... 'obtain' some fresh silk from their bodies, we could use it to bind the limbs of the golem together.

Title: Hope
Objective: Search for signs of Tyrande.
Text: No... it is not possible. She would not have died like this!Search for signs of her departure along the strand. Personal effects. Weapons. Anything!Tyrande is still out there. We must not lose hope.

Title: Pick Up Sticks
Objective: Collect 9 Bundles of Hard Wood
Text: In order for my enchantment to work, we'll need wood from these forests.When I was alive, I would wander these woods and tend to the trees. While those trees are long gone, perhaps their grandseeds have heard their stories and would be willing to help me.But don't cut down any of the trees! Please! There are loggers that cut and hew without care for the wilds. Take their hard work so that they will think twice before felling another tree.Bring me as much wood as you can muster.

Title: The Tauren Tanner
Objective: Meet the Tauren Leatherworker in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: Hey, rich mon.One of ya Tauren stopped by and asked who was de best leatherworker I knew who doesn't mind gettin' their hands dirty.I give 'im ya name, and he asked for an introduction. Said dat he would be in de Bazaar, by de docks.He did not say what he needed ma best student for, but de way he was actin' makes me think it is somedin' big.Head on down to de docks and find dis Tauren. Show 'im what I taught ya.And focus! Needn't be havin' ya make me look bad!

Title: Exhumed
Objective: Cleanse Sef Iwen's remains.
Text: As I've said, I'm unable to interact with the material world.I am able to dominate a creature to control its body, but I find it deplorable. In essence, it is enslaving the poor creature.What I want is a body of my own. If you build and animate a golem, it would be devoid of intelligence. A shell. One that I could inhabit without issue.Doing so will require that my soul is not anchored to anything else in this world, so I need you to remove the spell binding my spirit to my physical remains.

Title: In Darkest Night
Objective: Find Tyrande in Darkshore and lend her aid.
Text: , I will not mince words. Tyrande foolishly risks her life with the ritual she intends to perform. If she falls, our entire war effort will fall with her.We must set off for Darkshore and come to her aid. Only then can we march forward and reclaim our homeland.We have lost Teldrassil. Fool or not, our people cannot afford to lose Tyrande as well.

Title: A Voice on the Wind
Objective: Seek out the source of the mysterious voice in Drustvar.
Text: My enchantments are not lost...Find me...Drustvar...Fallhaven...

Title: Warfront: The Battle for Darkshore
Objective: Defeat the Horde at the Battle for Darkshore.
Text: We will not tolerate further Horde aggression in our territories.The night elves will not stand alone this day. Darkshore will be theirs once more.For the Alliance!

Title: Supplies From The Unshackled
Objective: Speak with Atolia Seapearl in Newhome for your reward.
Text: Your aid has given us hope. Your courage has given us strength.You have given us an entirely new vision of our future.For that we will be forever grateful.I hope we can continue to repay you for all you have done!

Title: Shores of Fate
Objective: Take the Stormwind portal to Darnassus and meet Maiev Shadowsong at the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale.
Text: So be it. You are more trustworthy an ally than any army Wrynn would have sent.We will reclaim Darkshore together, but first we must find Tyrande. Without her at the front, our forces will crumble against the Horde.She left for the Zoram Strand with a small force not long ago. If we move now, we may be able to find her before the Horde does.

Title: The Day is Won
Objective: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller on the Banshee's Wail.
Text: The majority of our warriors survived and we have the Alliance's Azerite and weapons.Be proud of yourself. You fought with honor today.Go and inform Nathanos of our victory here. The Azerite should reach them shortly.

Title: The Calm Before
Objective: Take the SI:7 report to Lady Jaina
Text: A word.There was a raid on the Norwington Estate, where we were testing some new designs of Azerite systems. Lady Jaina asked SI:7 to look into the matter. I have the report here.I know the Proudmoore family wants a moment together before they're pulled apart again, but the war is still ongoing.You have been a friend to her family. Take the report to Jaina. I believe they went to pay respects at the family memorial.

Title: Gunpowder Plots
Objective: Collect 6 Kegs of Gunpowder.
Text: Since the Lord Admiral iced all of their zeppelins, the Horde are rowing in through the seagate.The nice, narrow seagate entrance that makes for a great choke point.I'll have my people haul over a cannon and some ammunition. If you collect some gunpowder, we'll set up behind the gate where they won't expect the attack.We'll blast the Horde to the bottom of the harbor!

Title: Iron in Hand
Objective: Gather Iron from a nearby Ore Crate.
Text: This won't work at all! We need to gather iron if we want to make any kind of headway against the Horde.Go down to the ruins at Lornesta and grab that iron. We need it!

Title: The War Chest
Objective: Collect resources from the War Chest in Bashal'Aran.
Text: Welcome to the warfront! We finally get to see some action.Any resources we've collected will go to the War Chest. Once enough has been gathered there, you can grab it!Why don't you pay it a visit and see what you get?

Title: Druids of Gloomtide
Objective: Capture Gloomtide Strand, then speak with Edgard to learn what he has to offer.
Text: The latent power at Gloomtide Strand presents us with an opportunity to harness great power. One of our allies, Edgard, has great knowledge into what this might mean for our efforts.Seek him out and discover the power of nature.

Title: Flying at Night
Objective: Deliver Evenshade's Note to your commander in Bashal'Aran.
Text: Now that we control Ashwood Depot, it will be much more convenient to travel about the battlefield.I've drafted plans for a flight network. It's a rather brilliant plan, if I do say so myself. You don't seem busy. Take my notes and deliver them to our commander at once.Speak to Fidelio and he will provide you with a hippogryph.

Title: Ride Out to Meet Them
Objective: Ride the Goblin Gyrocopter and fend off the Alliance army.
Text: We must defend our warriors from the Alliance army while we recover this Azerite.Take the Azerite weapons you stole and load them onto one of these gyrocopters.Misha and I will ride out and fight the reinforcements from the ground, while you provide air support.We need to hold them off until our warriors can retreat with the Azerite.

Title: Return to the Hall of Castes
Objective: Take Azala back to the Hall of Castes in Zuldazar. Make sure to call for her if she is not present when you get there.
Text: I can't believe I got to visit so many places. I've never even left Zuldazar before!I may be casteless, but now dat I've met so many loa, maybe I can follow one and have a future off of de streets.But for now, we should go back to de Hall of Castes. De caretakers must be waiting for me.

Title: The Frogmarsh
Objective: Take Azala to Krag'wa's Burrow in the Frogmarsh in Nazmir. Make sure to call for her if she is not present when you get there.
Text: De caretakers are always telling us stories in de Hall of Castes. Sometimes dey warn us about danger, sometimes dey're about de loa... dere's usually a point to dem.One time, dey told us about Krag'wa, and how blood trolls killed his followers, and how he hasn't been seen since.But I heard dat he's back! He's in Nazmir again, and he's plotting his revenge against de blood trolls.Can we go see him?

Title: The Sethrak Queen
Objective: Take Azala to the Terrace of the Devoted in Vol'dun. Make sure to call for her if she is not present when you get there.
Text: De caretakers are always talking about how de sethrak attack caravans... but dey say dat de sethrak and de Zandalari used to be friends!I heard dat dere are some sethrak who still want to be friends, and dat dey have a loa who wants peace more dan anything!Can you take me to meet de sethrak and deir loa? I want to meet dem for myself!

Title: Hunting for Gold
Objective: Take Azala to The Golden Isle in Vol'dun. Make sure to call for her if she is not present when you get there.
Text: I know dis trip is supposed to focus on de loa...But I want to see de island of gold!I heard stories of undead pirates and an island covered in gold coins and treasure! Can we go see it?!Pleeeease?

Title: The Shifting Pack
Objective: Take Azala to the Lair of Gonk at the Garden of the Loa in Zuldazar. Make sure to call for her if she is not present when you get there.
Text: Dere's one loa I'm extra interested in seeing: Gonk! I've heard de priests say dat he's de most welcoming of de loa. He even lets his followers worship other loa as well!But de best thing about him is dat he and his followers can change into many forms. I want to do dat!Will you take me to meet him?

Title: Children's Week
Objective: Use the Zandalari Orphan Whistle to call for the ward that you will be looking after during Children's Week.
Text: Thank you for offering your help with Children's Week. We have a little girl who is excited to explore Zandalar!Take dis whistle. With it, you will be able to call de child you have agreed to take care of dis week. It will serve no use after Children's Week ends.When you are ready, use de whistle and meet your new ward! She is a feisty one.

Title: Loa of Winds
Objective: Take Azala to Pterror Rise in Zuldazar. Make sure to call for her if she is not present when you get there.
Text: I heard dat Pa'ku lives somewhere in Zuldazar. Her priests tell stories about her when dey come to de Hall of Castes.She's a pretty popular loa. I mean, she's in charge of de sky AND de sea! Dat's a lot of blue, and blue is my favorite color!Maybe I could be one of her followers?

Title: Glaiveworks For Me
Objective: Speak with Erion to learn what the Glaiveworks has to offer.
Text: We've all been on edge since Teldrassil, but Erion took it hard. He jumped at the chance to help out.Why don't you talk to him and see what he's got going at the Glaiveworks?

Title: The Altar of Elders
Objective: Speak with Moon Priestess Lasara to learn what the Altar of Elders has to offer.
Text: Now that contributions are in full swing, the Altar of Elders has been rebuilt.Go, speak with Moon Priestess Lasara to see what the Altar has to offer.

Title: Darkshore Recruits
Objective: Restore the Ancient of War, then speak with Jarod Shadowsong to recruit an ally.
Text: We've got a few recruits that can help us take back Darkshore!But first, we need our Ancient of War to be back up to good health. To help him, contribute resources to him and he'll perk right up!Once the Ancient of War is restored, talk to Jarod Shadowsong and recruit a troop. I'm sure they could learn a lot from fighting alongside you.

Title: Cut from the Same Cloth
Objective: Ask Timeweaver Delormi to return you to your time.
Text: My Infinite self was right--I can no longer mend time.Too many of my threads have been purged. I can feel no others.I'm alone now. And my thread is gone. But not you.Take this recipe. You've proven yourself a talented tailor in your own time, and a savior in so many more.The fabric of time needs your hands to mend it. I trust you with that responsibility.Talk to me when you're ready. I'll take you back to when this all began.

Title: Armor for Armies
Objective: Speak with Cordressa Briarbow to learn what the Hunter's Hall has to offer.
Text: We need to make sure our soldiers have the best equipment possible in the battle against the Horde.Once the Hunter's Hall is constructed, speak with Cordressa Briarbow about how to improve the weapons and armor of our troops.

Title: Brawl'gar Awaits!
Objective: Bring an invitation to the Brawl'gar Arena.
Text: Tired of standing around in the boring old Valley of Strength? Come on over to the Brawl'gar Arena, and fight for the amusement of others!You might win, or you might get killed, but either way, you're going to have a great time.Grab an invitation and bring it to Skuglor, near the front door. Brawl'gar awaits!

Title: Warfront: The Battle for Darkshore
Objective: Defeat the Alliance at the Battle for Darkshore.
Text: Darkshore belongs to the Horde! We must hold that ground to maintain our dominance over Kalimdor.Prepare yourselves. Battle awaits!

Title: Simply Dying of Boredom
Objective: Use the Brawl'gar Arena Sign in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
Text: Up until now, I've been dying of boredom up here. I think maybe we need some new blood here in the arena. Boss Bazzelflange can be so stingy with her invitations, can't she?I've had one of my servants write up a few slightly-counterfeit invitations to hand out. Maybe you could help me get them distributed? There's always plenty of tough-looking characters hanging out in front of the auction house near Grommash Hold...

Title: The Right Mech for the Job
Objective: Fly in the G.M.O.D to Drustvar and defend Krazzlefrazz Outpost.
Text: Okay, we're good to go. The G.M.O.D has plenty of Azerite to cause some trouble!We gotta head to my, er, OUR base in Drustvar. Mekkatorque, that freakin' king of the gnomes, is attacking our Azerite supply!After we take care of the base, we're gonna take care of him! You get what I'm sayin'?

Title: Vengeful Venture
Objective: Locate the Venture Co. camp, then retrieve Gryzix's Decoder and the Encrypted Ub3r-Spanner Schematic.

Title: The Ub3r-Spanner
Objective: Wait for Layla Evenkeel to decode the schematic.
Text: It's a shame that Gryzix had to die. Those Venture Co. make all of us enterprising types look bad!At least we can still decode the Ub3r-Spanner schematic. Here, hand me that recipe and his decoder and I'll get this whipped up in just a second.

Title: Modular Construction
Objective: Kill mechanical constructs in the Abandoned Junkheap and salvage 8 Mecha-Cores with an Arclight Spanner.
Text: The Abandoned Junkheap is home to some seriously deadly gnomish constructs. These constructs contain Mecha-Cores which could come in handy for crafting the Ub3r-Spanner. Legend has it that it could forge creations unlike anything we've ever seen!You look like the adventurous type. Can you go scrap up some mechs?Don't forget your Arclight Spanner!

Title: In the Dunes
Objective: Find Dataguru Gryzix at The Forgotten Marsh in Vol'dun.
Text: This schematic you found is encrypted. My tools are no good on it, not without risking the integrity of the data.However, I do know a guy who can definitely crack this cookie: Mr. Dataguru Gryzix.If I remember correctly, he's been vacationing on a beach in Vol'dun since the war broke out. Something about not getting the recognition he deserves.Anyways, I am sure you can convince him to help you.

Title: A Stitch in Time
Objective: Assist Delormi in repairing the Tears in Time.
Text: Hm...I don't know that I've ever been to this time, before.I suppose I should explain myself. My name is Delormi, and I'm the last remaining member of the Synchronous Tailors.We make sure the fabric of time stays, well, mended. But I've found a number of new tears cropping up.In fact, I believe that's why I've arrived here in this time. Perhaps you could assist me in tracking them down and repairing them?

Title: Breaching Boralus
Objective: Lead the Horde assault into Tiragarde Sound.
Text: Finally! There's no place on Kul Tiras with a stronger Alliance presence. We must be bold and unrelenting if we're going to drive them out here.Lok-tar ogar!

Title: The Ub3r-Spanner
Objective: Wait for Shuga Blastcaps to decode the schematic.
Text: It's a shame that Gryzix had to die. Those Venture Co. make all of us enterprising types look bad!At least we can still decode the Ub3r-Spanner schematic. Here, hand me that schematic and his decoder and I'll get this whipped up in just a second.

Title: A Mech for a Goblin
Objective: Meet Gallywix at Bilgewater Bonanza.
Text: Gallywix has a plan to deal with the Alliance and has requested your help. It involves the Azerite you reclaimed.Speak with him down at Bilgewater Bonanza, and do whatever you can to help him... when it comes to the interest of the Horde.Oh, and make sure Gallywix stays alive. The Alliance already tried to kill him.

Title: A Friend in Needle
Objective: Collect 5 Tidespray Linen and 5 Deep Sea Satin.
Text: You can see me?Oh, thank goodness! I thought I was lost in the folds of time...again!But for one to see through the folds of time's fabric... you must be a very talented tailor, indeed.Would you bring me some cloth, then, tailor? I believe I'll be able to place just when I am with your help and right myself.

Title: A Clue from Area 52
Objective: Investigate Area 52 in Netherstorm for a sign of the letter's writer.
Text: We've received a letter from Area 52, the goblin outpost in Netherstorm. The author claims to know details about what they call "the situation in Brawl'gar".They don't say more than that.I'm tied to my paperwork here. Go check out this lead and see if anything turns up.

Title: Stopping the Sappers
Objective: Kill Nebbik Megafuel, collect Azerite bombs, and bring them to Jaina on top of the seagate.
Text: The ice should keep the Horde out while we handle the sapper teams gathered on the beach.I'm going to keep those Horde galleons busy. I need you to handle whoever is in charge and bring all the Azerite bombs you find back to me.Then we'll handle disposing of their weapons.

Title: Solving the Mystery
Objective: Bring the Mysterious Challenge Card to Brawl'gar Arena to confront Boss Bazzelflange's captor.
Text: I grabbed this challenge card from my attackers while we were fighting each other! I'm sure that you can use it to challenge my attacker to some sort of ultimate showdown!

Title: The Brawl'gar Trial
Objective: Reach a verdict in the Brawl'gar Trial.
Text: I've issued three warrants. Nugg, Mollivox, and Sharisanda are apprehending the suspects as we speak.It's time to go to court.You may be called on to testify. Just answer as honestly as you can, and let the wheels of justice do the rest.

Title: Evidence Packet: Libbiara Blightrunner
Objective: Bring the Evidence Packet to Commander Arlu Ravenhide.
Text: Nugg got what Nugg need. Give stupid blood elf one drink and she start getting all self-incriminatey.You bring packet to Commander. Nugg gonna buy some expensive snacks.

Title: The Mollivox Goggle Experiment
Objective: Put on Mollivox's Goggles while fighting in the Brawl'gar Arena and look for evidence against Shadowmaster Skrizzik.
Text: Okay, before we start, I've got a few rules:First, these goggles will only work at close range. We're looking for something INSIDE the arena, so you'll have to be inside the arena to use them.Second rule: if you feel something starting to explode, try to blink real hard.Lastly, remember, we're looking for an evil shadow monster. You don't need to kill it, we just need you to see it so we can report it as evidence.Alright, go get in that arena and try them out!

Title: Evidence Packet: Shadowmaster Skrizzik
Objective: Bring the Evidence Packet to Commander Arlu Ravenhide.
Text: Sounds like we've found our perp. This guy's sketchy, desperate, and his shadow magic is consistent with that shadowy scroll you found earlier.Bring this packet to Arlu, and we can bring him in. Good work out there!

Title: The Precious 13-Tooth Gogglegear
Objective: Obtain a 13-Tooth Gogglegear from G.G. Engineering. You can purchase their challenge card from Card Trader Ami.
Text: We're going to have to invent something. Something capable of seeing into alternate dimensions. Something explosive that you strap directly onto your eyes.That's right, I'm talking about goggles.I already have all the goggle parts except for one: a 13-tooth gear. They're nearly impossible to find, but I KNOW that the G.G. Engineering boys have one, and Card Trader Ami has their challenge card.

Title: Flaunt It If You Got It
Objective: Drink a bottle of Moneybrau, purchase a round of drinks at the bar in Brawl'gar Arena, and hit a fighting player with an Amberseed Bun while standing on the deck of the Skybag.
Text: Sigh... so dull...Oh, it's you! , was it? I've seen a few of your fights. They're slightly less tedious than the standard humdrum bloodsport this arena has been producing lately.Let's spice things up a bit. Maybe buy some expensive drinks for ourselves? Buy a round of the cheap stuff for the riffraff below? Maybe even toss a few amberseed buns off the boat?

Title: Cause for Concern
Objective: Report to Stone Guard Mollivox.
Text: Shadowmaster Skrizzik's behavior was unusual.His repeated mutterings about "shadow magic" and "void apocalypses" and "ancient creatures hungering for the souls of the living" certainly warrant further investigation.You should report back to Stone Guard Mollivox.

Title: A Favor for Your Ol' Pal Buxdoggle
Objective: Lose a fight in Brawl'gar Arena.
Text: Hey, listen, I was thinkin' about somethin'...You know how you won all that money from me? Well, funny story, that may have been slightly more money than I actually have, and now some very powerful people want to break my elbows and my knees.I can't pay 'em! |cFF0000FFI'm broke!|r Heh heh!All I need to get out of this hole is for you to lose your next fight. Flop like a fish. Please.

Title: Evidence Packet: Pit Boss Buxdoggle
Objective: Bring the Evidence Packet to Commander Arlu Ravenhide.
Text: I heard everything. That goblin sure does talk loudly about his crimes and debts, doesn't he?It sounds like we have enough to bring him in for questioning. I've put together a packet of evidence for Commander Ravenhide to review.Good job out dere.

Title: Undercover Agent: Stone Guard Mollivox
Objective: Speak with Stone Guard Mollivox at the Brawl'gar Arena.
Text: I believe you've met one of my other agents: Stone Guard Mollivox. She's investigating our second suspect: Shadowmaster Skrizzik.You'll find Mollivox near the arena's entrance.

Title: Outrigger Outfitters
Objective: Recover 10 Outrigger Weapons.
Text: My people met the Horde head on when they arrived, but we've been scattered over the wharf. The Horde has been relentless. We haven't been able to form a solid resistance force using just our fists as weapons.But now the Lord Admiral is here with the champion of the Alliance. That's just the spark we need to rise up and kick these sorry mongrels out of our lands. If you can get my men some weapons, they'll join the fight!Find those weapons and meet me back here. I'm working on a plan.

Title: Murder at the Brawl'gar Arena
Objective: Investigate the scene of the crime.
Text: The Brawl'gar quartermaster lies dead in front of you. He was murdered in broad daylight!He must have been assassinated while someone was fighting in the arena. Maybe even during one of your fights.Perhaps there are some clues nearby as to who might have killed him.

Title: Shots Fired
Objective: Destroy Horde Motorboats.
Text: Horde invaders keep sailing in through the seagate, but we have a nasty surprise for them!The Outriggers are good at fighting monsters of any sort, the Horde included. We'll keep them off you while you take out their boats.Send 'em to the bottom of the harbor!For Kul Tiras! For the Lord Admiral!

Title: Undercover Agent: Sharisanda
Objective: Report to Sharisanda in the Brawl'gar Arena.
Text: Pit Boss Buxdoggle is one of our primary suspects in this case. Buxdoggle is an infamously aggressive speculator, and has a list of debts a mile long.He may be in need of money, which is consistent with the evidence you found earlier.Sharisanda has taken point on the case. I'd like you to assist her. I think you'll work well together.

Title: With Honor
Objective: Defeat Lieutenant Cole.
Text: The Alliance and Kul Tiran forces are in disarray. I can hear the Azerite tank powering up.Lieutenant Cole intends to fight us... now that his forces are destroyed.Let me know when you are ready to fight. The three of us shall destroy this tank while our warriors watch on!

Title: Repel the Horde!
Objective: Defeat Horde Axe Throwers or Berserkers on the north shore of Anglepoint Wharf.
Text: The Horde has overrun Anglepoint, killing my people and destroying their livelihoods. Its raiders have come to Kul Tiras with killing on their minds. I cannot allow that to happen.Slay any Horde Axe Throwers or Berserkers you see on the north shore. I will do the same on the south. Together we will stop this invasion.

Title: Put Up Your Dukes
Objective: Win any 3 fights in the Brawl'gar Arena.
Text: You know what?I COULD use a good  on my investigations team. We've had some personnel issues lately and, frankly, I can use all the help I can get.But first: why don't you go hop into the arena for a few fights so I can get a good look at your skills?

Title: Sip and Savor
Objective: Deliver a sample of Nomi's Wine to Vintner Iltheux and gain his approval.
Text: I think we're making wine!Let's see if the vintner approves of our vintage.Take a sample to Iltheux and see what he thinks.

Title: The Hunt Never Ends
Objective: Travel to the Norwington manor.
Text: We have our victory, but we must move quickly to take the remaining Azerite from the estate.Our forces should already be moving the Azerite from the manor into our gyrocopter support.Let us move and ensure we get every ounce of Azerite away from the Alliance.

Title: Besieged Allies
Objective: Find Rosaline Madison.
Text: Seawalls can be rebuilt, but lives are lost for good. We need to secure the rest of the people here first.The Outriggers have been known as some of the fiercest hunters in these waters. Find their leader, Rosaline Madison, and enlist her aid in liberating Anglepoint. Together, clear the north shore of the Horde, save anyone in danger, and rally the dock workers.You handle the north shore. I will handle the south. We'll meet in the middle and crush the Horde between us.

Title: Awaiting Our Arrival
Objective: Return to Grommash Hold within Orgrimmar.
Text: Let's head back to Orgrimmar.I'm sure Kiro's expecting us.We really shouldn't make him wait.

Title: Playing to Their Strengths
Objective: Assign new roles to Micah Broadhoof, Boss Mida, and Nomi.
Text: Iltheux isn't properly utilizing the help he's been given.Let's fix that.Assign new roles to the workers, ones more suited to their strengths.If you need suggestions, I'm happy to help.

Title: Fermented for the Horde
Objective: Collect the needed ingredients to create a wine worthy of the Horde.
Text: Vintner Iltheux's recipe doesn't need much improvement.Some unique ingredients and slight modifications to the winemaking process is all that's needed.I'm thinking adding fermented firebloom should do the trick. Then, filter it though a special cloth made from silkwing fibers.There are plenty of silkwings roaming the vineyard, and I have no doubt that Boss Mida can acquire the flowers, for a price.

Title: Meet with Meerah
Objective: Find Meerah within Suramar's Twilight Vineyards.
Text: It appears we're making good progress.Would you meet up with Meerah?I want to be sure she's found her way to the vintner in Suramar.

Title: Taking Out the Tidecaller
Objective: Kill Tidecaller Nezara.
Text: Nezara's shield might be down, but that doesn't mean she's defenseless.There's a brute by her side that may cause trouble. I'll take a stab at him so you can take down the Tidecaller.

Title: The Vintner's Assistants
Objective: Speak to Micah Broadhoof, Boss Mida, and Nomi.
Text: Vintner Iltheux oversees all arcwine production for the Horde.He's used to making wine himself, but the Horde sent in help to speed up the process.It's had the opposite effect.We need to get to the bottom of this.How about you tour the vineyards and see how things are running? I have a few more questions for the vintner.

Title: Explosions Always Work
Objective: Place Volatile Explosives on naga Harpoon Launchers, and then detonate them to create a distraction.
Text: The area surrounding Tidecaller Nezara is heavily guarded, so I'll need you to create a distraction.Take these explosives. Plant them on the naga's harpoon launchers. Once they've been detonated, the blast should be more than enough to send the guards running!

Title: On the Outskirts
Objective: Find Nisha on the southern coast of Zuldazar.
Text: If things are settled for the Commander, you should check in on Nisha.I'm sure she could use your help.

Title: A Party in Your Honor
Objective: Inform Foreman Magrok that the Horde is throwing a party for the peons.
Text: I think I have everything needed to make tonight a success.We just need to make sure the peons show up.Tell their leader that the Horde is throwing a party in their honor.I'm sure they won't decline a night of free food and drink.

Title: We'll Use Their Weapons
Objective: Collect 10 Nazeshi Weaponry from forces within Dreadpearl Shallows.
Text: We're going to need special weapons to take down Tidecaller Nezara. Good thing it looks like the naga have plenty.We'll use their weapons against them. You and I know a thing or two about that.Grab an assortment. We'll need more than one.

Title: Strength and Honor
Objective: Battle Foreman Magrok, showing both strength and honor.
Text: Those peons certainly look happy, don't they? I have no doubt they'll return to work in the morning.However, if their leader goes unchallenged, there will always be risk of revolt.You need to face him to battle.Show him the true strength of the Horde, but also the honor that comes with showing mercy.

Title: Peon Promotions!
Objective: Give promotions to a few of the Crushblow Peons at Peon Hideout.
Text: I agree with the plight of the peons. They should be rewarded for the work they do.It's unlikely that the Horde will agree to increase their wages, but there's no reason they can't be given a promotion.Any title other than peon would help build some confidence.

Title: Stand Fast
Objective: Protect Jaina Proudmoore.
Text: The Horde will pay for what it has done, but first I have to attend to the people here., I need to hold a portal open so the injured can evacuate to Boralus.Keep the Horde's forces off me while the wounded get to safety. We can deal with them once the civilians are safe.

Title: Worthwhile Repairs
Objective: Collect 15 Twilight Ore so Kiro can repair the peon's tools.
Text: The peons are right. These tools are inexcusable.How can they be expected to complete a job without the proper tools for their trade?I can make the needed repairs, but I'll need some ore first.

Title: Where Are the Workers?
Objective: Find out where the Crushblow Peons went.
Text: Look at this axe. There's still sweat on the hilt. The workers were here not too long ago.Let's see if Sasha can track their scent.

Title: A Little Goodwill
Objective: Collect 100 Saber Flanks, 100 Worg Meat, and 100 Clucker Tidbits.
Text: It sounds like the peons are feeling undervalued. They do important work for the Horde, but their diligence is often overlooked. A little goodwill would go a long way.Let's plan a feast in their honor. We'll need quite a bit of meat to sate their enormous appetites, luckily, I have a totem that can help with that.You acquire the ingredients, and I will make a meal guaranteed to boost morale.

Title: No Problem Too Small
Objective: Meet Kiro in Twilight Highlands.
Text: These problems might seem small, but they will eat away at the Horde overtime if they remain unaddressed.We must offer our help.The vulpera are skilled at solving problems, no matter their size.I will investigate the outpost. Nisha and Meerah will see to the others.Meet me in the Twilight Highlands when you're ready.

Title: New Allies, New Problems
Objective: Find out what troubles Commander Dresh, Bladeguard Sonji, and First Arcanist Thalyssra.
Text: Baine certainly has his hands full. Taking on new allies means taking on new problems.Let us find out what troubles those within the Horde and see what we can do to help.Perhaps when Baine isn't so overwhelmed, he'll be able see our true value.

Title: A Declaration of Intent
Objective: Witness Kiro's declaration to join the Horde.
Text: Our caravan is ready to explore the world beyond the sands, but Nisha's blade can't be our only defense against the dangers we know await us.This is why we've come.To declare our intent to join the Horde.

Title: Shores of Zuldazar
Objective: Repel the Alliance forces assaulting Zuldazar.
Text: Alliance forces are attacking Zuldazar. Make them regret every step taken on our soil!

Title: Isolated Victory
Objective: Repel the Alliance forces assaulting Vol'dun.
Text: Alliance forces are pushing deeper into Vol'dun. We can not allow this aggression to go unchecked!

Title: War Marches On
Objective: Return to Halford Wyrmbane on the Wind's Redemption.
Text: I hope the Horde will think twice about attacking Kul Tiras in the future, but given the actions of its leadership, it is a faint hope at best. Still, what matters most is my people are safe now.The fleet and marines should be here soon to help the Outriggers clear out what remains of the Horde forces. Please return to High Commander Wyrmbane and let him know I will join everyone as soon as I am able.Thank you for your swift actions today.

Title: Writing on the Wall
Objective: Light the first memorial's flame.
