Text: Long has the southern wall separated Quel'Thalas from the once great kingdom of Lordaeron. We did not believe that anyone could breach it. That overconfidence was our undoing.When the Scourge arrived, the gate was not conquered by force. It was willingly opened by a traitor.Though caught unaware, every Farstrider, soldier, and magister in the area rushed to the defense of our homeland. Very few of them returned home. The gates now stand as a memorial in their name.

Title: To Anglepoint
Objective: Accompany Jaina Proudmoore to Anglepoint Wharf and assist her there.
Text: An attack on Anglepoint Wharf can only mean one thing: the Horde seeks to destroy the seagate there.This is my home. These are my people. I cannot turn my attention to our operations in Zandalar until we've routed the Horde.The military will take a little time to mobilize, but in the meantime you and I can face these monsters. If we can't stop them, we can slow them down.War has come to my shores once more. I will not stand aside.

Title: Cut from the Same Cloth
Objective: Ask Timeweaver Delormi to return you to your time.
Text: My Infinite self was right. I can no longer mend time.Too many of my threads have been purged. I can feel no others.I'm alone now. And my thread is gone. But not you.Take this recipe. You've proven yourself a talented tailor in your own time, and a savior in so many more.The fabric of time needs your hands to mend it. I trust you with that responsibility.Talk to me when you're ready. I'll take you back to when this all began.

Title: Machines of War and Azerite
Objective: Recover 4 Azerite bombs and 3 Azerite rifles.
Text: The Norwington Estate... I remember taking walks here with my wife and children.Sorry, this isn't the time for remembering an old life.The Alliance have Azerite bombs and rifles scattered throughout the estate. I believe our goal is to recover them.If only the Alliance hadn't chosen to use the estate as a testing ground... this was meant to be a place of peace.

Title: Cleaning Out the Estate
Objective: Weaken the Norwington Estate defenders.
Text: We must keep moving forward. Our goal is to weaken the Alliance, destroy their weapons, and steal their Azerite.The three of us will carve a path of destruction through our enemies. Let us go!

Title: Killing Time
Objective: Kill the Infinite Shade of Delormi.
Text: Now, stand with me.I am weak. So many threads have been severed.I'll use what power I have left to mend the rift.Please...make sure the fabric of time is safe from her.

Title: Return to the Orphanage
Objective: Bring Liam back to the orphanage in Boralus. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
Text: This has been the best Children's Week ever!I was scared to grow up, but now I'm really excited! There are so many cool things I can be!But how can I choose?I think it's time for you to take me back to the orphanage. I'll think about what I want to be when I grow up on the way.

Title: Guests at Grommash Hold
Objective: Meet your guests within Grommash Hold.
Text: $p, I've received word that a vulpera caravan has arrived at Grommash Hold. They wish to address the Horde and have requested your presence.I'm afraid it is not the best time for guests, so please see them as soon as you are able.

Title: Saving Nine
Objective: Enter the Time Rift.
Text: I saw her in there, destroying another part of my timeline.With every thread she severs, I lose myself more and more...Perhaps I will perish, but I won't let her ruin the fabric of time.I need you to join me one last time.I can only end this with your support.

Title: Bird Friends
Objective: Take Liam to see the statue of Arom Waycrest at Arom's Stand in Drustvar. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
Text: My best friend at the orphanage is named Billy. He's just a kid like me, though. I heard that some people in Drustvar have FALCONS as their best friend.How cool is that?!Can we go meet a falconer? Pretty please? I want to have a bird friend too.I hear there's a big statue in Arom's Stand of some dead guy who was friends with birds. Maybe we can find a falconer there!

Title: If The Shoe Fits...
Objective: Stop the Shade of Delormi from killing Magistrix Delormi.
Text: That thing is killing her...it's killing *me*!We need to stop it!Please, I need your help to save my self!

Title: Shapeshifters!
Objective: Take Liam to meet a druid at Ulfar's Den in Drustvar. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
Text: Being a human is alright and all, but what if I could be a BEAR?Druids can be bears. And cats! And who knows what else!I've heard rumors of druids in the mountains of Drustvar. It would be so cool to meet one. I wanna see them turn into animals! Maybe they can teach me, too!

Title: The Mountain Folk
Objective: Take Liam to meet the Roughnecks at the Roughneck Camp in Tiragarde Sound. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
Text: All Kul Tirans are really tough, but the Roughnecks are the roughest and toughest of them all!They can wrestle gryphons with their bare hands! They can knock down a yeti with a single punch!I wanna meet a Roughneck and prove that I can be really strong like them! Can you take me to their camp? I've heard it's up in the mountains by Anglepoint.

Title: Yo Ho, Yo Ho!
Objective: Take Liam to meet a pirate outside of Freehold in Tiragarde Sound. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
Text: The orphan matron is always telling us what to do! Study your books, practice your words, behave in public...What if I want to be a pirate when I grow up? A scourge of the high seas! Finding buried treasure, dueling my enemies on the mast, wearing cool hats!Pirates never come into Boralus, so I've only ever heard stories. I wanna meet a real one! Can you take me to Freehold? I'll practice my pirate voice on the way.YARRRRR!

Title: The Squid Shrine
Objective: Take Liam to see Shrine of the Storms from the beach near Mariner's Strand in Stormsong Valley. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
Text: Sometimes tidesages come to the orphanage and tell us about the sea and how they can talk to it.I wanna talk to water!We've gone on field trips to their monastery here in Boralus, but I heard their home in Stormsong is much more impressive. Can you take me to go see it? I heard there's a great view from the Brineworks!

Title: Step Into Her Shoes
Objective: Enter the Time Rift with Timeweaver Delormi.
Text: Another one of those rifts. Normally I'd repair it, but given the circumstances I wish to see where it leads.It isn't often I commune with versions of myself from other threads of time. But one particular self has been a dear friend for some time.I feel myself growing weaker. If she perishes...We don't have much time. We need to enter this rift now.

Title: Azerite Denied
Objective: Meet Rexxar in Tiragarde Sound.
Text: The Kul Tirans and Alliance are amassing a vast amount of their Azerite and Azerite weapons within Tiragarde Sound.They have a new supply of the resource, thanks to the Kul Tirans' conquest over Lady Ashvane and her company.We must strike at their supplies of Azerite and destroy these weapons, or else we will be behind in this war.You and Zelling will travel to Tiragarde Sound and meet with Rexxar. Lead the assault on their Azerite supply.And do not return until you are victorious.

Title: The Setting Sun
Objective: Witness the fall of Anasterian.
Text: Remember the Sunwell.We ride into battle with those words for a reason. We lost so much that day...I lost so much that day.Shine the lantern on the southern side of the island, where the Dead Scar meets the sea. There you will see how the fall of the Sunwell began. And with it, the last act of the High Elves.

Title: The Fury of the Horde
Objective: Command the Horde army to attack Norwington Manor.
Text: The Norwington Estate has a large cache of Azerite, along with the Alliance's latest Azerite weapons.We need to steal these weapons and all of their Azerite. Every weapon stolen is a Horde life saved.When you are ready to strike, let me know. I shall signal our warriors to begin the assault.The Alliance and Kul Tirans will see the true might of the Horde!

Title: Our War Continues
Objective: Speak with Sylvanas Windrunner aboard the Banshee's Wail.
Text: The work to stop the Alliance is far from over.King Rastakhan now possesses the Abyssal Scepter that you recovered from the Kul Tirans. He has placed it... in his treasury.The Dark Lady wishes to speak with you regarding the corpse you found at the bottom of the ocean. Derek Proudmoore.

Title: Our War Continues
Objective: Speak with Sylvanas Windrunner aboard the Banshee's Wail in Zuldazar.
Text: The work to stop the Alliance is far from over. But thanks to you, we have the methods necessary to break them.The Abyssal Scepter has been delivered to King Rastakhan, earning us more of his favor.There is a matter of greater importance that I would speak to you about... but not here.Meet me aboard the Banshee's Wail within Zuldazar.

Title: Tooling Around Vol'dun
Objective: Put on the Goblin "Mind Enhancer," then retrieve Gryzix's toolbox.
Text: Okay. We got almost everything we need. Almost.You see, I lost my toolbox. I must have dropped it while running from the sethrak a couple days ago. Can ya fetch it for me? I'm not a very good engineer without my tools!And take a mech with ya. I've spied some mysterious dwarven and troll figures lurking around... better not be the Venture Co. One whiff of the schematic being here and we got trouble.You'll need the mind enhancer for it to follow you. Just put it on and you'll be good to go!

Title: Waning Hope
Objective: View Tyrande's audience with Anduin Wrynn.
Text: The kaldorei have been steadfast members of the Alliance since the end of the Third War. We have fought on distant shores and even on different worlds without protest.It is curious that in our moment of need, their resources are stretched too thin to lend so much as a single blade.Wrynn has already denied Tyrande aid. Witness it for yourself.

Title: On Whispered Winds
Objective: Meet Maiev Shadowsong and Shandris Feathermoon in Stormwind Keep.
Text: ,I have need of you.Maiev and Shandris are en route to Stormwind to petition King Wrynn for aid in retaking Darkshore.You have proven a loyal ally to my people in times past. I ask that you join their audience with the king and lend your voice to our cause.I suspect we shall meet again soon.-Tyrande

Title: Forging the Armor
Objective: Forge the Bulwark of the Mountain King.
Text: It's time to begin. Bouldercrag, Ignis, and I are here to assist you.You'll be the first dwarf to forge the Bulwark of the Mountain King in generations. This ol' blacksmith is honored to be able to witness this.Are ye ready?

Title: Recruiting the Furnace Master
Objective: Recruit Ignis the Furnace Master to help smelt the metal.
Text: Grumnus says we're going to need some help smelting this metal. I just happen to know someone who's perfect for the job.We're heading to Ulduar!Years ago, we fought against a construct named Ignis the Furnace Master. I've heard tell that the titan keepers brought him back, and Ulduar's furnace is alive once more.

Title: Legacy of the Bronzebeard
Objective: Present the Bulwark of the Mountain King to Muradin Bronzebeard in the High Seat.
Text: You must present this armor to Muradin at once! This is an historic day for the dwarven people.This isn't just a suit of armor, it's a symbol of our heritage.

Title: The Ub3rlode
Objective: Complete The MOTHERLODE!! on Heroic Difficulty and obtain the recipe from Mogul Razdunk.
Text: Looks like Gryzix's suspicions were correct. Not only is it the Venture Co, but it's Mogul Razdunk himself!We now owe it to not only ourselves as engineers, but the Horde proper to secure the recipe before he can craft it!Go to Kezan. Stop Mogul!

Title: Earthen Blessing
Objective: Find the Remnant of the Earthen Ritual in Old Ironforge.
Text: Ignis will help with smelting the metal, but the heat from the forge will cook you in yer boots!Our ancestors, the dwarves who forged Aegrim's armor, could sustain their stoneform for far longer than we can today. That's how they could forge the bulwark in the first place.Luckily, my friend Bouldercrag can help us with that. He'll need some materials for the ritual.

Title: Aegrim's Study
Objective: Search Aegrim's study for the Bulwark of the Mountain King.
Text: This leads to Aegrim's study. I still have some scrolls to sort, so I will leave you to search the study at your leisure.I'm sure Brann would be most interested in any of your findings.

Title: Interest Yah In A Pint?
Objective: Find Grumnus Steelshaper in Loch Modan.
Text: The armor may be shattered, but there's still hope. With the fragments you found, we might be able to forge it anew.This is far outside my area of expertise, but there may be someone who can help. We should speak with Grumnus Steelshaper. He retired to Thelsamar in Loch Modan.Go on ahead, I'll meet you there.

Title: Ancient Armor, Ancient Mystery
Objective: Speak to Advisor Belgrum in Old Ironforge.
Text: By my beard! Do you know what this is?! It's an ancient tablet that describes how to forge the Bulwark of the Mountain King!The last one to wear that armor was Aegrim Bronzebeard, my ancestor and thane of the Bronzebeard clan.Talk to Advisor Belgrum. He'll know more about Aegrim's past, and might be able to shine some light on the legends of his armor.

Title: Shards of the Past
Objective: Collect the shattered pieces of armor.

Title: Watch Yer Back
Objective: Kill 8 Trogg Invaders and Roc'maw the Burrower in Old Ironforge.
Text: Aegrim, you say? Bulwark of the Mountain King? Well, if we are going to start anywhere, it has to be Aegrim's study. The entrance lies below us in the depths of Old Ironforge.The only trouble is the troggs in our way. How about you take the lead?

Title: Something Valuable, Perhaps?
Objective: Bring the tablet to Brann Bronzebeard in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge.

Title: Keep Yer Feet On The Ground
Objective: Search Gol'Bolar Quarry for the missing excavation crew.
Text: ! The Explorers League is setting up a new exhibit in the Hall of Explorers, so we sent a team in search of new artifacts to display in it.They headed off to Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh, but haven't returned. Would ye mind checking on 'em?

Title: A Royal Occasion
Objective: Meet the Zandalari emissary at The Great Seal in Dazar'alor.
Text: You wish to hear how the Zandalari joined the Horde? My people have had a... difficult history with the Zandalari.However, I believe we dealt with the Zandalari of the past. The now Queen Talanji is much different from her father.I'm rambling, my apologies. Our tale begins after the Alliance sacked the city of Zuldazar and killed King Rastakhan.The Horde had been invited by the then Princess Talanji to witness her coronation in Zuldazar...

Title: Vengeful Venture
Objective: Locate the Venture Co. camp, then retrieve Gryzix's Decoder and the Encrypted Ub3r-Spanner schematic.

Title: Queen of the Zandalari
Objective: Witness Talanji's ascension to Queen of the Zandalari.
Text: De loa have seen fit to grant me de crown. My council accepts me. My priests have given their blessing. My people have expressed their displeasure, but I am determined to right those wrongs.It is time to accept de responsibility of leadership. I will address them and speak on our future. I would be honored if you would take a place at my side while I do so.

Title: The New Zanchuli Council
Objective: Greet the Zanchuli Council.
Text: These are sobering developments .I wish to speak to my priests about what has transpired. I would like you to continue into de depths of Zanchul and up de steps into de Council Chambers. There you will find de new council I have assembled.Greet them, and make note of my choices. I hope you will find them adequate.

Title: Gaze of the Loa
Objective: Follow Talanji.
Text: My council has given their blessing and we have dealt with an enemy. All that remains is to face de judgment of my loa.I do not know what this part will be like. My father never spoke of it, at least not to me.Walk with me. I will explain what is expected of you through this final trial.

Title: The Instigator Among Us
Objective: Confront Enforcer Malzon in the Zocalo.
Text: This situation can be swiftly dealt with if we take out de one that incited this violence.I heard reports of an enforcer rousing de vagrants and drudges against de shopkeepers and guards in de Zocalo.One of my own would not do this without cause. See if you can determine de reason for this sudden change.I am told her name is Malzon. I hope for her sake that she surrenders.

Title: The Rite of Kings and Queens
Objective: Ride in procession with Princess Talanji.
Text: Now that you are here, we can begin this sacred rite.Take your place beside Talanji. She has chosen you for an important task. I will explain while we make our way to Zanchul.

Title: The Council Has Spoken
Objective: Receive the Zanchuli Council's blessing.
Text: Now that you see who I have chosen for my council, it is time to receive their blessing.It is a symbolic demonstration of support, but I believe there is power in words as well as deeds. When they declare themselves to me, de eyes of de loa are also upon them.I hope they like what they see. I know I do.

Title: A Queen's Entourage
Objective: Meet Princess Talanji at the Zocalo.
Text: Princess Talanji was very clear in her orders.You, are to join her at de steps of Zanchul. She wishes to have you at her side while she undergoes de rite of queens and kings. I hope you can comprehend what an honor that is.De queen-to-be will explain what it is you are to do.Now go, and Pa'ku's winds make you swift.

Title: He's Dead, Jastor
Objective: Return to Gazlowe in Zandalar Harbor.
Text: Hey, uh, so I got a good thing goin' on here, and I really don't want Gallywix to know I'm alive.I'll make you a deal. You spin some story about how you only found tiny pieces of me spread across Tanaris and that I am totally dead, and... And you can keep the bird.Deal?

Title: She's in a Happier Place
Objective: Return to Kelsey Steelspark in Boralus.
Text: Aww, Kelsey...she's been such a good friend. I meant to let her know I was alive eventually, but I got distracted.Azerite, the war, the near-death experience... We've been really busy. Being presumed dead has some advantages, though. We've done a lot of research and we just need a better lab-Okay. New plan. Tell Kelsey we'll be in touch, but only Kelsey. Tell everyone else I'm dead - for now. If you keep quiet about Grizzek, you- you can have Feathers.Do we have a deal?

Title: Some Reassembly Required
Objective: Collect Mechanical Parts from Venture Co. personnel.

Title: Re-parrot
Objective: Debug Feathers' recall program.

Title: Whatever Happened to Grizzek Fizzwrench?
Objective: Search for signs of Grizzek Fizzwrench in Tanaris.
Text: When this whole Azerite mess began I had a goblin named Grizzek Fizzwrench do some research for me. He was bad for business and had to be removed from the picture. I thought it was a done deal, only now I'm hearing maybe he's not so dead.I need you to hunt this guy down and see what happened. If he's alive, eliminate him and I'll add the standard mercenary fee to your reward.

Title: Return to the Nest
Objective: Activate the recall subroutine.

Title: The Severed Thread
Objective: Investigate the corpses in the Caverns of Time.
Text: Do you see that? There's a corpse just ahead.To think the caverns have been so badly overrun...We should look at the bodies. Maybe there will be something of use to us.

Title: Rolling Up the Sleeves
Objective: Kill 12 Chronal Anomalies.
Text: The Caverns of Time? Strange... I spent many timelines in this very place.What's special about here-- now?We'll have to discern as much later on. It looks like we aren't the only ones who've been affected by these rifts...Let's do the Bronze Dragonflight a favor and clear out these anomalies.

Title: Whatever Happened to Saffy Flivvers?
Objective: Search for signs of Sapphronetta Flivvers in Tanaris
Text: When Azerite was discovered, my friend Saffy was sent to investigate what it could do. There was an attack and we all thought she'd died. Then it turns out she was forced to work in some kind of goblin think tank in Tanaris! But before we could get her out, the whole place exploded.Now, my bosses have written her off as dead. But she wasn't dead the first time so I'm not sure she is now. I've been told not to go looking for her, but you could take a look.Find Saffy, or what's left of her?

Title: Children's Week
Objective: Use the Kul Tiran Orphan Whistle to call for the ward that you will be looking after during Children's Week.
Text: Thank you for coming by to celebrate Children's Week. You are going to make one little boy very happy!Take this whistle. With it, you will be able to call for the child you have agreed to take care of this week. It will serve no use after Children's Week ends, as is custom.When you are ready, use the whistle and meet your new ward! I know he is ecstatic to meet you.

Title: A Stitch in Time
Objective: Assist Delormi in repairing the Tears in Time.
Text: Hm...I don't know that I've ever been to this time, before.I suppose I should explain myself. My name is Delormi, and I'm the last remaining member of the Synchronous Tailors.We make sure the fabric of time stays, well, mended. But I've found a number of new tears cropping up.In fact, I believe that's why I've arrived here in this time. Perhaps you could assist me in tracking them down and repairing them?

Title: Heavy is the Head
Objective: Collect the Goblin "Mind Enhancer" from Warlord Surgios in the Scalefang Outpost.
Text: Okay, I am going to need one more thing from you.The sethrak leader, Warlord Surgios, has been a real pain for me.He stole my mind enhancer. I can't do my work without it. It will make me be able to think much more clearly, and make less...deadly mistakes.

Title: Sethrak Persuasion
Objective: Collect Faithless Lightning Rods in the Scalefang Outpost.
Text: Let me see the schematic...Yeah, yeah, alright. I can help you.I am going to need a few things to power my decoder.I need a way to channel electricity from the air around us. What better than to steal...I mean borrow some lightning rods from the sethrak that have been trying to steal my tech for weeks now!I'm sure you'll have to do some "convincing", but you seem like a pretty convincing .

Title: A Friend in Needle
Objective: Collect 5 Tidespray Linen and 5 Deep Sea Satin.
Text: You can see me?Oh, thank goodness! I thought I was lost in the folds of time...again!But for one to see through the folds of time's fabric... you must be a very talented tailor, indeed.Would you bring me some cloth, then, tailor? I believe I'll be able to place just when I am with your help and right myself.

Title: In the Dunes
Objective: Find Dataguru Gryzix at The Forgotten Marsh in Vol'dun.
Text: This schematic you found is encrypted. My tools are no good on it, not without risking the integrity of the data.However, I do know a guy who can definitely crack this cookie: Mr. Dataguru Gryzix.If I remember correctly, he's been vacationing on a beach in Vol'dun since the war broke out. Something about not getting the recognition he deserves.Anyways, I am sure you can convince him to help you.

Title: Modular Construction
Objective: Kill mechanical constructs in the Abandoned Junkheap and salvage 8 Mecha-Cores with an Arclight Spanner.
Text: The Abandoned Junkheap is home to some seriously deadly gnomish constructs. These constructs contain Mecha-Cores which could come in handy for crafting the Ub3r-Spanner. Legend has it that it could forge creations unlike anything we've ever seen!You look like the adventurous type. Can you go scrap up some mechs?Don't forget your Arclight Spanner!

Title: The Pride of the Sin'dorei
Objective: Speak with Lor'themar in Silvermoon City.
Text: Champion, I am here on behalf of Lor'themar Theron and the city of Silvermoon.The Regent Lord asks for your assistance with a ceremony of great importance to our people. He requests your presence at your earliest convenience.

Title: Eyir
Objective: Meet Talanji at Skold-Ashil in Stormheim.
Text: Not many got da stones or da mojo to take what be mine. Ol' Bwonsamdi always be gettin' his share.Da way Talanji be tellin' it, Vol'jin's spirit may be gettin' help from some other power. And dere be few who love to mess with souls like Eyir. A meddlin' one she be, with her wings and her valor.Ya best be seein' her in person. She be found in her vault at Skold-Ashil. And ya best not mention me name, or she might be sendin' ya back to me faster dan any death gate.

Title: Mysteries of Death
Objective: Speak with the Spirit of Vol'jin.
Text: Hmph. Well, da Lich King and dat bossy val'kyr not be me only rivals. But dey were da ones most likely ta be behind all dis. Someone be playin' with very ancient mojo.Tell Vol'jin's spirit dat da answers he be lookin' for not be found in da world of da living. He gonna need to go beyond da veil ta learn what needs knowin'.Dere be some places on dat side only he can go.

Title: Where He Fell
Objective: Search the Screaming Cliffs with the Spirit of Vol'jin.
Text: Dis be da spot, mon. Dis be where da Legion led our forces into a trap and drove a blade into me belly.Sylvanas pulled me from da ruin of da battlefield. She saved da Horde dat day. Come, let us walk around dis place and see what we can learn from da echoes of da past.

Title: To the Broken Shore
Objective: Take the Glaive of Vol'jin to Spiritwalker Ebonhorn at the Broken Shore.
Text: Da Broken Shore be where I fell in battle. We were overrun, demons everywhere. Sylvanas was doing what she could, but Thrall was down and I had fallen. It was horror.And now I need ya to take me back dere. Take me glaive to da battlefield, call to me, and I will come. Perhaps if I be in da spot where me blood was spilled, we might shine some light on dis mystery.

Title: The Lies of a Loa
Objective: Meet Talanji at the Necropolis in Nazmir.
Text: Hidden memories, spirits attackin' us for investigating, and a long road of bodies in da wake of me makin' Sylvanas warchief.I be thinkin' it time ya speak with Ol' Bwonsamdi. Odd as it sounds, dis don't seem like his style. Dat don't mean he not be behind it.Ya best work with Talanji. From what little I been seein', da death loa got a soft spot for her highness. You can confront Bwonsamdi at his necropolis in Nazmir. Just... be respectful.

Title: Where He Died
Objective: Walk the shadows with Vol'jin.
Text: Dis time, I need to bring ya to my side. We gonna walk da shadows between life and death, see if we can't uncover some clues. Be careful, and be armed. Not everything on dis side wants us to find answers. Prepare yourself, den speak with me when ya be ready.

Title: Jailor of the Damned
Objective: Confront the Lich King.
Text: I be havin' many rivals when it comes to claimin' souls. But it takes some serious mojo to do to Vol'jin what ya describe. Dat kind of power smells of old magic.Icecrown. It be more dan a pretty throne. It be an anchor dat holds dis world to da next, ya might say.I gonna open a death gate, and ya can go through and ask da Lich King if he be treadin' on Ol' Bwonsamdi's ground.

Title: Shades of Disruption
Objective: Assist in the ritual to summon Vol'jin's spirit.
Text: Vol'jin's spirit is a slippery one. I have asked Master Gadrin and Spiritwalker Ebonhorn to aid us in calling him forth. Dis ritual will not be easy, and I ask you to be on your guard should anything other than Vol'jin appear.

Title: Wisdom of the Warchief
Objective: Meet Princess Talanji in the Hall of High Priests at Zanchul.
Text: Champion. For a brief moment after the battle with G'huun, the spirit of our old warchief, Vol'jin, appeared in view of all in Zuldazar. I had a hundred questions to ask my old friend, but his spirit faded before I could muster my voice. I have asked Talanji to perform her seance once more, so that I might speak with the spirit of Vol'jin. Will you collect the Glaive of Vol'jin from its resting place at the base of the pyramid and then join us at Zanchul?

Title: His Eye Upon You
Objective: Meet Brother Pike near the Crucible of Storms to cleanse your "gift".
Text: Something dark has taken root within you. The tendrils of N'Zoth are burrowing into your mind and soul, eager to consume everything you are.I can perform a rite of cleansing, but only in a place that resonates with the very power that grips you.Meet me near the Crucible of Storms. The ritual will be perilous and painful, but it is your only chance to be free.The Old God has eyes everywhere. I do not wish you to become one of them.

Title: His Eye Upon You
Objective: Seek out Nailok at the Altar of Akunda in the Terrace of the Chosen.
Text: Dark mojo has fallen upon you. I can sense de tendrils of N'Zoth delving deep into your mind.Dis evil must be purged... before it claims your very soul!Go to de Altar of Akunda in de Terrace of de Chosen. Seek out Nailok, one of de priests of Akunda. He is your best chance to be cleansed of de wicked curse dat grips you.

Title: The Pirate's Treasure
Objective: Find the second relic.
Text: I sense another relic. A trident thought lost to the depths. It calls to me. Do you hear it too?Its song takes form. I see a harbor to the east. An ambitious pirate, greedy and proud. Completely unaware of the power hidden within her hoard of gold.The would-be-captain's hubris will not permit her to simply hand over her prize. I fear she must be taught a rather harsh lesson.But that is your specialty, is it not?

Title: Unintended Consequences
Objective: Find the Void Stone in Drustvar.
Text: The servants of N'Zoth prepare for their master's return. They intend to conjure a scouring storm to wash away all unbelievers.The particular ritual they will invoke requires three ancient artifacts. One of void, one of storm, and one of ocean.Even now, I hear the void relic calling to me. It is being empowered... or corrupted, I am not sure which. I see it upon a cliff, overlooking a vast sea.Come. We can find a much better use for such a prize.

Title: Twist the Knife
Objective: Meet Xal'atath at the Precipice of Oblivion.
Text: The relics are ours... as it was meant to be.There is but one more step needed for the great truths to be revealed.The naga sought to summon their storm from a place that echoes with ancient power. Though this site has had countless names over the ages, you mortals know it as the Precipice of Oblivion.I will go on ahead and begin preparations. Join me there.

Title: The First to Fall
Objective: Witness the fall of the first defenders.
Text: Arthas cut through the land itself to get to the Sunwell. The Dead Scar is a constant reminder of that desecration. Where it starts is where our first line of defense attempted to hold the Scourge at bay. It is where the first blood was spilled.It was a slaughter.Take the lantern to the base of the Dead Scar, and use its light to reveal the memories of what happened there.

Title: The Tempest Crown
Objective: Retrieve the third relic.
Text: My strength grows. I can see it clearly now... the third relic we seek. The crown known as Tempest Caller.How fitting that after the fall of Atal'Gral, the gluttonous Toatana would be the one to find the artifact. He was always scuttling about the depths, seeking treasures for his collection.Toatana's greed has left him trapped within a cave he can never leave. The crown awaits us there.

Title: Walk Among Ghosts
Objective: Meet Lor'themar in Tranquillien.
Text: Every year, we ask a champion of our people to perform an act of remembrance in honor of those who fell to the Scourge. Lady Liadrin has performed this ritual, as have I, among others. This year, I am honored to give the task to you.This lantern carries a flame born of the Sunwell. I would ask that you bring it to locations that were significant to the fall of the Sunwell and of Quel'Thalas, and to light the memories we cannot forget.

Title: Defense of Quel'Danas
Objective: Meet with Lady Liadrin in Quel'Danas.
Text: With our best defenders defeated and the line broken, Arthas made quick work of Silvermoon's remaining forces and tore through the city.This is where we part ways. I must return to Silvermoon before Halduron starts sending rangers to search for me.The dragonhawk master in Fairbreeze Village has orders to fly you to Quel'Danas. Someone much more familiar with the events on the island will meet you there.

Title: The Day Hope Died
Objective: Witness the fall of the Ranger-General.
Text: The Ranger-General fell just east of Fairbreeze Village, where she was holding the line to protect the civilians as they retreated to Silvermoon. If it wasn't for her, our people would number even less than we do now.Shine the lantern upon the battlefield, and witness how her forces ultimately broke under Arthas's personal assault.

Title: Lament of the Highborne
Objective: Light the second memorial flame.
Text: The next memory...Forgive me. For many of our people, it was when we realized death was coming for us.A memorial to a particular defender lies to the west, in the place of her home. The light there has no doubt attracted some of the area's lingering souls. Clear them out, and then relight the flame.

Title: A People Shattered
Objective: Light the final flame.
Text: While the monument here was intended to honor the fallen members of the Shattered Sun, it quickly took on a second meaning for the sin'dorei.It was not far from here that we lost one of our greatest heroes: Anasterian Sunstrider, the last king of Quel'Thalas. He led our final effort against the Scourge and personally crossed blades with Arthas himself. As we remember the sacrifices it took to reclaim this land, we also remember the sacrifices made in its defense.

Title: Heritage of the Kul Tiran
Objective: Meet Katherine Proudmoore in Boralus.
Text: Gossip in Boralus has oft reached my ears of your exceptional conduct.Meet me before the keep. I wish to commend your efforts on behalf of Kul Tiras.

Title: Heritage of the Zandalari
Objective: Meet Queen Talanji at the Golden Throne in Zuldazar City.
Text: You have faced many challenges in your time among de Horde. You carried de pride of de Zandalari on your shoulders and triumphed!Return to me. I wish to recognize de example you have set for us all.

Title: Allegiance of Kul Tiras
Objective: Sail to Stormwind Harbor and present Anduin with his gift.
Text: It is time for her maiden voyage.This aptly named vessel will carry us and her crew across the vast sea to Stormwind Harbor. There we will meet Anduin and I will seal the pact we made so many moons ago.Kul Tiras will stand with the Alliance so long as I am Lord Admiral.Thank you for your assistance in this endeavor.

Title: Allegiance of the Zandalari
Objective: Bring the Zandalari into the Horde.
Text: It is decided.De Zandalari will join de Horde.Our path together has been a long and difficult one. We have lost much together. De Horde has sacrificed for de Zandalari, and vice versa. I can do nothing to honor that commitment except pledge our loyalty.Collect your Warchief and send them to my throne. I will extend de offer myself.

Title: A Sound Defense
Objective: Repel the Hordes forces assaulting Tiragarde Sound.
Text: Horde forces are attacking Tiragarde Sound. Make them regret every footstep upon our soil!

Title: A Drust Cause
Objective: Repel the Horde forces assaulting Drustvar.
Text: Horde armies are pushing into the heart of Drustvar. Hold the line and drive them back to the holes they crawled out of. Kul Tiras is ours!

Title: Establishing a Connection
Objective: Deliver Grayson's Note to your commander in Stromgarde Keep.
Text: Now that we control High Perch the skies are ours!I've drafted plans for a flight network that provides our allies safe passage. Please, take these notes and deliver them to our commander at once.I'm happy to provide you with a gryphon that will deliver you to the base when you are ready.

Title: Beasts of Newstead
Objective: Speak with Vindicator Banra to learn about the beasts he's been training.
Text: Control of Newstead has allowed our forces to advance. It's also provided Vindicator Banra ample room to continue training his elekk for battle.I suggest you speak with him to learn more about what these magnificent beasts are capable of.

Title: Welcome to the Workshop
Objective: Speak with Grumble to learn what the Workshop has to offer.
Text: Welcome to the workshop!I told Grumble I thought it best for me ta protect him from unnecessary distractions, but I think it may benefit all of us if ye get a peek at what we're doin' 'round here.Why don't ye head on over and see what we have ta offer.

Title: Ready for Battle
Objective: Speak with Ralston Karn to recruit an ally from the Barracks.
Text: Welcome to the warfront.Our recruits are eager to join you on the battlefield.A good place to start would be Ralston. I'm sure he's got a few who could learn much fighting by your side.

Title: The Circle's Power
Objective: Speak with Justine Frost to learn what she has to offer.
Text: The Circle of Elements presents us with an opportunity to harness great power. One of our allies, Justine, has great knowledge into what this might mean for our efforts.Seek her out. It's time you discovered the power of the elements.

Title: The Circle's Power
Objective: Speak with Kraga Tidefury to learn what she has to offer.
Text: With the Circle of Elements under our control there are opportunities to harness the powers of the elements.Kraga understands these powers quite well. I suggest speaking with her.

Title: The Altar's Power
Objective: Speak with Altarite Jesse Taylor to learn what the Altar of Kings has to offer.
Text: With contributions in full swing it's no surprise the Altar of Kings was built with such haste.I suggest wandering over that way. You might be surprised to see what the Altar has to offer.

Title: Armor Up!
Objective: Speak with Jonathan Flynn to learn what the Armory has to offer.
Text: What've we got 'ere? A fresh, young  lookin' ta help better prepare our allies fer battle? Well then, Jonathan's always lookin' for a bit o' help ta keep our armory orders in full swing.I'd offer ta walk ya over, but I've got me hands full here. Ye can find him just over yonder.

Title: Welcome to the Workshop
Objective: Speak with Pixy Hackwrench to learn what the Workshop has to offer.
Text: You must be the new  around here. Name's Margie. And that over there, that's Pixy.We run a tight crew here at the workshop. So, if you ever need anything, you know where to find us.Now, I suggest you head on over and check in with Pixy. She can show you what we have to offer.

Title: The Altar's Power
Objective: Speak with Meredith the Crone to learn what the Altar of Storms has to offer.
Text: Looks like construction on the Altar of Storms is complete.I'm sure Meredith would be more than happy to show you what mysterious powers lie within.

Title: Beasts of Newstead
Objective: Speak with Kodo Rider Tanauk to learn about the beasts he's been training.
Text: Nothing penetrates an enemy's front line like a fierce rider and a well-trained beast. Now that we control Newstead, one of our riders in particular has focused his efforts on training us a few kodos.Go, check in with Tanauk and find out what these beasts are capable of.

Title: Flightgineer's Network
Objective: Deliver Flightgineer Krazzle's Note to your commander in Ar'gorok.
Text: Now that we control High Perch the skies are ours!I've laid out a few plans for expanding our routes in this here note. If you'd be so kind as to deliver it to our commander, I'm sure they'll be pleased with our progress.Let me know when you're ready and l'll send ya on your way.

Title: Ready for Battle
Objective: Speak with Throk to recruit an ally from the Barracks.
Text: Greetings.Our recruits are eager to join you on the battlefield.

Title: Armor Up!
Objective: Speak with Fennick to learn what the Armory has to offer.
Text: Ah. Word spreads quickly around here.Unfortunately, with all these orders coming in I can't afford to talk right now.If you're interested in learning more about the armory Fennick can help you with that. He's just outside.

Title: No Horde Allowed
Objective: Kill 10 Horde soldiers in Nazj'vel.
Text: The Horde forces in this area are trying to collect as much Azerite as possible. No doubt they intend to weaponize it.Slay any Horde forces you can find. They must not be allowed to get their hands on this Azerite!

Title: Defending Lor'danel
Objective: Take out Horde forces in Lor'danel.
Text: The Horde have invaded from the North! You must protect Lor'danel.Help our forces push back this attack!I will try to intercept the Warchief. This is our final chance to stop her. Report to Commander Summermoon in my absence.

Title: A Gift of Azerite
Objective: Deliver Azerite to Zarvik Blastwix in Blackwood Den.
Text: I think we got a handle on things here. You gotta bring all this Azerite back to Zarvik Blastwix at the main camp!He's gonna know just how to use this stuff to really take down the Alliance.

Title: Mercy for the Mad
Objective: Slay 10 frenzied Blackwood furbolgs.
Text: The ruin wrought by the Horde is driving the children of the forest mad.Chief among them are Blackwood furbolgs. They have given into the madness and are a threat to everyone. If left to their madness they could strike us from behind while our forces engage the Horde.It pains me to ask this, but please, when you are in the Twilight Vale, put these creatures out of their misery before they endanger anyone else.

Title: Azerite Denial
Objective: Collect Azerite from 6 Azerite Deposits.
Text: This substance, Azerite, is hurting Onu... and the Horde seem eager to collect it for themselves.We must not let that happen. Collect as much Azerite as you can find. Ensure the Horde do not retrieve it.

Title: A Very Clear Message
Objective: Kill 10 night elf forces.
Text: The Alliance got to the Azerite here before us, the place is crawling with night elves!Kill as many of them as you can see, we gotta make sure none of them deliver even an ounce of Azerite to the Alliance!

Title: Driving Them Out
Objective: Slay 15 Lor'danel defenders.
Text: This is it.Lor'danel is all that stands in our way before we capture Darnassus and reclaim Kalimdor.Rout the defenders. We cannot risk allowing a single enemy to escape until we have secured control over the World Tree.I want this place in order by the time the Warchief arrives.

Title: Knives of the Forsaken
Objective: Slay 8 Forsaken Assassins in Astranaar.
Text: Tread carefully. All is not as it seems. The butchers who did this still skulk within Astranaar.If you find them, give them what they deserve.

Title: Clearing Them Out
Objective: Slay Night Elf forces in The Master's Glaive.
Text: They have amassed an army before us. But it is no matter. The Horde war machine will not be stopped.Go into The Master's Glaive and dispatch their warriors. Their sentinels. Any who would raise a blade against my soldiers.Clear out the petty rabble that seeks to delay the inevitable.

Title: Aggressive Inspiration
Objective: Plant 3 Horde Banners in Blackwood Den.
Text: Nothing rallies the Horde more than their banner standing in the ruin of an enemy stronghold. Go to Blackwood Den, take the territory there, raise the Horde banners and let none question our dominance over this land.

Title: A Glaive Misunderstanding
Objective: Destroy glaive throwers in The Master's Glaive.
Text: The kaldorei have brought their siege weaponry to the field. They are currently using it to oppose mine.We need these demolishers to reach Teldrassil if we hope to stand any chance of capturing it. Go and destroy their glaive throwers as swiftly as you are able.They think they will stop my advance here. They are mistaken. Show them the gravity of their error.

Title: Adapting Our Tactics
Objective: Talk to Eitrigg to start researching an upgrade.
Text: This war will not be won with strength and might alone. Take in your surroundings while you fight and turn it into an advantage against the enemy.I have a list of modifications for you to choose from. Any one of these might feel small on its own, but together they might just be all the advantage we need.Let me know what you would like us to pursue.

Title: Dark Iron Dwarves
Objective: Speak with Aysa Cloudsinger at the Stormwind Embassy to hear the end of this tale.
Text: I can't thank ye enough. Without yer help, Ironfoe would be lost tae us and the Black Anvil could've ne'er been made whole.But even more than that, ye've proven to every Dark Iron in the mountain what it means tae be part o' somethin' bigger. Tae be part o' the Alliance.The time has come tae let King Anduin know that my people stand with him.

Title: Fueling the Horde War Machine
Objective: Collect Azerite from 6 Azerite Deposits.
Text: You heard the warchief! We got Azerite shooting outta those ruins over there and night elves tryin' to snag it.Get to those ruins and collect some of the stuff. This whole attack is done for if the night elves get their hands on that Azerite!

Title: Adapting Our Tactics
Objective: Talk to Alleria Windrunner to start researching an upgrade.
Text: For our best chance to win this war, we must continue to learn and adapt new strategies. There are opportunities for advancement all around us, but they require dedication and perseverance.I've collected a list of potential research opportunities for you to review. Any one of these might feel small on its own, but together they might just be all the advantage we need.Let me know which ones you would like us to pursue.

Title: A Change in Leadership
Objective: Defeat Elder Brolg, Gren Tornfur and Elder Brownpaw.
Text: In my experience people do not like to be driven from their homes. While normally we would crush them with the might of the Horde, we do not have time to carry out a lengthy campaign against these creatures. They will look to their leaders for hope, inspiration, and guidance. They will find none. You are the instrument of my will. Make them submit to it.

Title: Elves in the Machine
Objective: Sabotage 5 Horde Demolishers in Blackwood Den.
Text: The Horde have already set up camp here. But we can still strike back. Their war machines are terrible to behold, but they are still machines. And machines do not work well when you go in and hack up a bunch of their inner workings. If we can sabotage but a few of them, that could mean dozens of lives saved. Let us make the most of this opportunity.

Title: Stranger in a Strange Land
Objective: Find the Hero's Call board in Stormwind City.
Text: Welcome to Stormwind. King Anduin Wrynn invites you to explore our fair city. Say, you look like someone who enjoys caves and such! We have many dark corners in Stormwind to explore.Ah, but that can wait. An emissary of yours is standing by to tell you of adventures that await beyond the city walls.Have a pleasant stay. Oh, and a friendly word of advice... not all dwarves are too fond of the Dark Iron.

Title: Stranger in a Strange Land
Objective: Find the Warchief's Command board in Orgrimmar.
Text: Hi. I'm Ambassador Blackguard.On behalf of the warchief, I am honored to welcome you to Orgrimmar.As a lifetime of adventure unfolds before you, be assured that... uh...You know what? I've been reading this same greeting all day. Enough's enough.Talk to your emissary and find out where you can adventure. Run along.

Title: Caverns of Time
Objective: Meet with Anachronos in the Caverns of Time.
Text: Were the shard of the Vision of Time not depleted, I could use it to send you on your way. But my specialty is teleportation, not chronomancy.Time magic was the province of our former leader, Grand Magistrix Elisande. Much of her knowledge died with her.It is said Elisande had mastered incantations known only to the bronze dragons. Perhaps they would be willing to aid your cause.

Title: The Great Sea Scrolls
Objective: Collect a set of scrolls depicting the tortollan pilgrimage.

Title: Tea Party
Objective: Find Abby Lewis.

Title: Vision of Time
Objective: Meet with Chief Telemancer Oculeth in Zuldazar.
Text: You wish to hear how the Mag'har orcs joined the Horde? It may be one of the strangest ways we gained an ally!It all began with a plan from Eitrigg. He had a fragment of the Vision of Time that Garrosh Hellscream used to travel to Draenor.Chief Telemancer Oculeth believed there would be a way to go back to Draenor and get the Mag'har orcs to join the Horde.This tale begins with a visit to Oculeth in Zuldazar...

Title: The Village of Glenbrook
Objective: Discover the fate of the Glenbrook villagers.

Title: WANTED: Sister Lilias
Objective: Collect Sister Lilias' head from Sister Lilias in Corlain.
Text: The Krazzlefrazz Peacekeepers are looking for an able-bodied warrior to eliminate a threat in nearby Corlain.A witch by the name of Sister Lilias is wanted for the torture and killing of many of our people. Her end would prove a boon to the Horde.Present her head to claim your just reward.

Title: Precious Metals
Objective: Collect 10 Silver Nuggets from the Bleak Hills Mine.
Text: Hey you! I got a business proposition for ya.The locals here seem to have a thing for silver, and we hit the jackpot with a mine just west of here.Unfortunately, it's got a bit of a spider problem...Now, the miners we sent down there are probably goners by now, but there's still some silver left down there. If you can go and fetch it for me, we'll mark it up and make a fortune!What do you say?

Title: All Wrapped Up
Objective: Destroy Writhing Cocoons to rescue 8 Bleak Hills Miners in the Bleak Hills Mine.
Text: I'm not the only one trapped here in this mine. Grimelock left all of the other miners to the spiders, too.There might be some of them still alive out there. Could you help? I'd appreciate it if not all of my friends died.

Title: An Eight-Legged Curse
Objective: Kill 20 Bilefang spiders in the Bleak Hills Mine.
Text: That jerk Grimelock sent us down here to the mines, only to pack up and leave us behind when these spiders showed up! Now I'm stuck here with about a million legs and eyes in all directions.You look like the tough sort. Can you clear a path for me? I'll make it worth your while.

Title: WANTED: The Rime Huntress
Objective: Defeat The Rime Huntress near Highroad Pass.
Text: Attention Interested Parties! A Moneymaking Opportunity Awaits!!!!!There's a big wolf hunting people in the pass. She's taken a liking to the taste of goblin. Nobody got time for being eaten by a wolf, so take out the Rime Huntress and I'll pay you for your trouble.- Suzie Boltwrench

Title: WANTED: Quartermaster Ssylis
Objective: Kill Quartermaster Ssylis in Krakenbane Cove.
Text: Some pirates took off with a supply crate that landed further away from this site then intended.I don't think there was anything valuable in there, but now the pirates know we're here.The leader was one of those big lizard men. The worker that kills him will get double pay for the week!

Title: WANTED: The Crimson Cutthroats
Objective: Slay the Crimson Cutthroats near Falconhurst.
Text: For numerous and sinister crimes against the Lord Admiral: smuggling, forgery, sailing under false colors, looting, poaching, brigandage, sacking, pillaging, vandalism, impersonating Kul Tiran Naval officers, arson, kidnapping, torture, piracy, perjury, theft and ransacking multiple mead shipments.A reward is placed on the heads of The Crimson Cutthroats to be paid in full upon proof of their demise.

Title: Gorilla Warfare
Objective: Rescue 6 Pacifist Gorillas.
Text: Your timing is most fortuitous, stranger. I thank you for your assistance.Things are not peaceful in Gorilla Gorge. The kaja'mite has given us great intelligence and wit. With intelligence has come war.My brethren are those who do not wish to fight. But for our passivity we have been persecuted.Please free my comrades. They will be in cages all throughout the gorge and under guard. Make haste!

Title: King Da'ka
Objective: Slay King Da'ka.
Text: King Da'ka? More like King Dooker.My king sent me to talk to this new king. This new king took my things and tried to take my wings.Negotiations are ooked. Go, sticket to that angry wikket.

Title: To Stomp or Not To Stomp
Objective: Collapse Kaja'mite Steam Vents in Gorilla Gorge.
Text: Like grandpapaook always say: if a wikket gonna huff the swoof from a dookerhole then plug the dookerhole.These Da'kani wikkets huffing the green smoke from their dookerholes in the ground. Makes 'em smart and mean. Smart not so bad, mean is bad.Go into Gorilla Gorge and plug those dookerholes!

Title: WANTED: Raging Earthguard
Objective: Kill the Raging Earthguard west of Norwington Estate.
Text: I have been receiving formal complaints about some big earth elemental in the middle of our scouting path.Normally I'd elect to ignore these, but the sooner we get done here, the better. Nobody wants to be stuck in this frozen hill any longer than we need to.Payment goes to the person who brings it down!

Title: WANTED: Rindlewoe
Objective: Defeat Rindlewoe outside of Fallhaven.
Text: A monstrous beast of wood and flesh has been terrorizing the nearby river territories. Knowing more about how the creature fights may yield interesting data!Please report any and all findings to Suzie Boltwrench in Krazzlefrazz.

Title: Apes of Wrath
Objective: Travel to Gorilla Gorge.
Text: Alliance, just what I need. Down for performing a deed?Zandalari are afraid, of new gorillas that raid.These gorillas are mocking, these gorillas are talking.Gorillas are dookering, I hear they follow bad king.It is important to lead, but this guy fails to succeed.I shall send Flap-Flap ahead. Make ookin' wikket King dead.

Title: Local Flavor
Objective: Gather 5 Juicy Lurker Tails.
Text: I'm STARVING.Not actually starving, like when I first got here, but you know... Emotionally starving.Haven't had any luck with the oysters lately, and seaweed soup really upsets my guts. If I eat any more of that stuff, I think the other castaways might actually feed me to the sharks.How about them tidelurkers? They look pretty juicy. Bet you could steam those up real nice.Can you get me some? I'm not much of a hunter. But I'll share it with you!

Title: Silencing the Sisters
Objective: Slay Patheope and Nolpe.
Text: The sirens in this tideway have drawn countless ships to their doom. Wiping them out would be a boon to all seafaring folk.But you can't very well kill all of them. Only a fool would try that.The real dangerous ones are the elders. The "sisters" as they're known. Bigger, smarter, and stronger than the younger ones. Their voices carry far out to sea and bring in all the big "catches."I managed to track two of them to a den at the northern end of the tideway, but I can't take them alone.

Title: My Favorite Things
Objective: Ask Friendly Pete, Hungry Sam and Handy Bill about their missing keepsakes, then collect those items from the Wailing Tideway.
Text: It's tough out here.Pirates. Deadly monsters.Hungry Sam's seemingly endless battle with indigestion.Nothing sets the nerves at ease like an old keepsake. Somethin' to remind you of home. Somethin' to keep you going.Ask around the camp. Find out what folks might have lost out there in the tideways. If you can bring any of it back, it'd be a mighty kind gesture.Me? Oh... I had a locket...Never mind, it's too small, you'd never find it. It's nothing. Don't worry about it.

Title: The Castaways
Objective: Speak with Stabby Jane at Castaway Point.
Text: You don't look like you're from around here. You're lucky the sirens haven't stripped your bones yet.If you need to trade supplies or just warm yourself by the fire, there's a camp up the hill behind me.Everyone there washed up in the tides. Figure we've got folks from at least four or five shipwrecks now. All banded together, just tryin' to survive.Talk to Stabby Jane. Don't worry about her nickname, she's actually real nice.

Title: Blood in the Tides
Objective: Slay 8 Wailing Sirens.
Text: We do not have sirens in Zandalar, but our sailors know of dem. In Zandalari, we call dem bwon'tulak - de death singers.My ship was run aground and my fellow sailors all murdered by de death singers.Jane saved my life, so now I help to protect dese people.Sirens are a plague on da seas, no matter who ya serve. Run the tides red wit dere blood!

Title: Azerite for the Alliance
Objective: Collect Azerite on Island Expeditions.
Text: Assist the Alliance by collecting Azerite on Island Expeditions.

Title: Glimmering Locket
Objective: Return the Glimmering Locket to Stabby Jane.

Title: The Vanishing Lord
Objective: Meet with Cyril White in Fallhaven in Drustvar.
Text: Whoa there! What business do you have in Drustvar?Lookin' for someone from House Waycrest? Best of luck to ye. Even us in their guard haven't heard a word from them of late. Why, if it weren't for Marshal Reade takin' command, I doubt there'd even be a Waycrest Guard anymore.I think ye'd be better off on yer way, but if yer bent on stayin' I'd head over to Fallhaven. The mayor there is probably the only welcomin' soul left around here.Watch yer back, mainlander. There's dark workings about.

Title: WANTED: Wyvern Poachers
Objective: Kill Lindel the Snatcher and Silent Boris.
Text: Soldiers of the Horde!A few nights ago some foolish human soundrels snuck off with one of our strongest wyverns.If anybody can track down and stop these thieves, a reward awaits!

Title: The MOTHERLODE!!: Raw Deal
Objective: Send a permanent--fatal--message to Mogul Razdunk in The MOTHERLODE!!
Text: Nobody, and I mean NOBODY double-crosses me and gets away with it!The Venture Co. betrayed us in a deal for Azerite refining techniques. We need pay 'em what we owe 'em.If you're not pickin' up what I'm puttin' down, I mean we need to kill that backstabbin' upstart Mogul Razdunk.You take care of him; I'll take care of gettin' what we're owed.I s'pose we oughta tell Blightcaller about this, huh? When he tells us what to do, just smile and nod. We'll handle it our way.

Title: WANTED: The Hornet
Objective: Kill The Hornet.
Text: That's it, I'm putting a bounty on that blasted hornet.Somebody take that bug down!

Title: Warfront: The Battle for Stromgarde
Objective: Defeat the Alliance at the Battle for Stromgarde.
Text: Our enemies are relentless in their quest to seize Arathi for themselves. We will never allow it to fall into their hands! We must stop them before the keep is rebuilt!Take up arms. The Alliance is upon us.

Title: Unlocking the Heart's Potential
Objective: Speak to Magni Bronzebeard and empower the Heart of Azeroth.
Text: I sense the Heart of Azeroth gettin' stronger. Perhaps we can unlock even more of the amulet's potential.Yer gonna need every bit o' its might. As if there weren't already forces fightin' over Azerite, lately it seems the servants o' the Old Gods have begun tae seek it out as well!Come. We can use the Azerite ye've gathered tae strengthen the Heart.

Title: The Chamber of Heart
Objective: Empower the Heart of Azeroth within the Chamber of Heart.
Text: That amulet ye wear keeps gettin' stronger. But tae unlock further potential, we need tae go somewhere closer tae Azeroth's world soul.The Chamber of Heart!I know the last time ye saw it, things were lookin' bleak. But meet me there, and I think ye'll agree that we're makin' progress on healin' our world's wounds!

Title: Warfront: The Battle for Stromgarde
Objective: Defeat the Horde at the Battle for Stromgarde.
Text: If the Horde thinks it can assault Stromgarde, it is sorely mistaken! We will not let Arathi fall!Prepare yourself for battle.

Title: Azerite for the Horde
Objective: Collect Azerite on Island Expeditions.
Text: Assist the Horde by collecting Azerite on Island Expeditions.

Title: Hour of Reckoning
Objective: Speak to High Overlord Saurfang inside Grommash Hold.
Text: Champions of the Horde, the time has come.The Alliance seek to overthrow the Undercity and are laying siege to Lordaeron Keep. You are to report High Overlord Saurfang at once.Make haste, Brill has already fallen and there is no time to spare.

Title: Hour of Reckoning
Objective: Meet Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind Harbor.
Text: Champions of the Alliance,At last the time has come for us to reclaim what is rightfully ours! Our final push to retake Lordaeron Keep shall commence at dawn.The Horde and their Warchief must answer for their crimes!

Title: Let's Bee Friends
Objective: Collect 8 Vials of Honey Slime and mix them with Raimond's Secret Ingredient to make Mildenhall's Growth Formula, then feed it to Bumbles.
Text: We just need to collect some slime from the animated honey creatures that are still roaming around the farm.If you can bring back a few vials of that, we can put all our ingredients together and give the mixture to Bumbles.We should only feed him once a day, or he might get sick like some of the other bees.We're gonna have him all healed up in no time!

Title: Make Loh Go
Objective: Learn how to guide Loh.
Text: Hello! We tortollans grow up hearing the stories of Loh, a tortollan who had many adventures. These stories help to challenge a young tortollan's mind as they try to figure out how Loh would make his way through any given adventure.Care to give it a try?

Title: Test of Hyphen Tech
Objective: This is--a test of--our new hyphen--breaking technology which--we are getting--to help sentences--read better. If you--are datamining this--then I am--sorry, but--you are sure--to be disappointed. Okay--FINE--Jaina really is--a dreadlord--oh and so--are Sylvanas--Anduin--and Khadgar--I mean--who ISN'T a--dreadlord, really?
Text: This is--a test of--our new hyphen--breaking technology which--we are getting--to help sentences--read better. If you--are datamining this--then I am--sorry, but--you are sure--to be disappointed. Okay--FINE--Jaina really is--a dreadlord--oh and so--are Sylvanas--Anduin--and Khadgar--I mean--who ISN'T a--dreadlord, really?

Title: Arathi Donations: Meaty Haunch
Objective: Gather 2 Seasoned Loins for Senedras in Boralus Harbor.
Text: A nice, hearty meat provides the nourishment our allies deserve before shipping off to battle, not to mention it also makes quite a stew, something our troops seem to rather enjoy when the winds are at their best and the chill of night lingers in the air.If you bring me some freshly seasoned loins I would be more than happy to deliver it to our supply officers.

Title: Bumbles the Bee
Objective: Locate Raimond's Secret Ingredient.
Text: Hey $p, thanks for delivering Mom's letter. I was really starting to worry about her!Dad and I have been having a few problems running the farm after she left on her trip. If you didn't show up when you did, we'd still be in real trouble!I was hoping you would be willing to help Bumbles out too. He was hurt when his hive was destoyed.If we feed him some of Dad's special formula, hopefully he will heal up faster. First we need to find the secret ingredient, try looking around at his other lab.

Title: Firelands
Objective: Speak with Moira at the Stormwind Embassy to travel to the Firelands and empower the Fragment of the Molten Core.
Text: Alright, the hard part should be behind us.Now, we just need tae take that Molten Core fragment ye recovered into Firelands an' charge it up by Ragnaros' old swimmin' pool.Dinna worry! I'm sendin' Anvil-Thane Thurgaden with ye.Just give me a nudge when ye're ready.

Title: Echo of Gul'dan
Objective: Defeat the Echo of Gul'dan at the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands.
Text: To attune this shard to the place you wish to go, we must follow some of its history.The first location we will visit is the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.It was there that Gul'dan used a piece of the Vision of Time to travel between realities.Join me there when you are ready.

Title: Echo of Garrosh Hellscream
Objective: Meet Anachronos outside the gates of Orgrimmar, then defeat the Echo of Garrosh within the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Text: Our final destination will take us to the depths beneath your city of Orgrimmar.The way there is barred, but I can get us inside.Meet me outside the gates of Orgrimmar and we will descend together.

Title: WANTED: Thundersnout
Objective: Deliver Thundersnout's Snout to Centurion Kaga Warmstone.
Text: Thundersnout is the largest of the boars in the valley. She poses a serious threat to our troop movements in the south. As such, Centurion Kaga Warmstone has issued a bounty for proof of her demise. Thundersnout's location is near the Briarback kraul, so beware the local quilboar!

Title: The MOTHERLODE!!: Ironfoe
Objective: Recover Ironfoe from Mogul Razdunk.
Text: Mogul Razdunk has always been a jealous sort, wishin' he was Gallywix or better.But he's the worst sort o' greedy. He won't stop at anythin' tae achieve his ends, nae matter the cost.It was a bold move even fer him tae strike at us in Blackrock Depths.He should've knaewn he was goin' too far. Kill that covetous wretch an' bring the hammer back where it belongs.You'll find him in Kezan. Somewhere he calls "The Motherlode," likely with too many exclamation points.

Title: Echo of Warlord Zaela
Objective: Defeat the Echo of Warlord Zaela at the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun Lai Summit.
Text: Warlord Zaela... another name that stains the tongue just to speak it...She was instrumental in freeing Garrosh during his trial when she and her Dragonmaw clan attacked the Temple of the White Tiger.I am ashamed to say that the dragon Kairozdormu was also involved. We will speak of this no more.The temple in Kun Lai Summit is our next destination.

Title: Prove your Worth
Objective: Enable War Mode and slay 1 Alliance Player within the world.
Text: See many Alliance out there? We're getting reports of more and more Alliance showing up here on Zandalar.Don't forget that this is a W-A-R. Prove your worth, and get out there and slay as many of them as you can.For the Horde!

Title: Molten Core
Objective: Speak with Moira at the Stormwind Embassy to travel to Molten Core and retrieve a Fragment of the Molten Core.
Text: We'll need a fragment o' the core tae repair the Black Anvil an' who knows how much dark iron tae achieve the necessary purity. Thaelin can figure that part out.In fact, I think he oughta go with ye tae get yerself a Fragment o' the Molten Core.It's too dangerous tae go deep via mole machine, but he's got a hardy tank that can get ye the rest o' the way from the top.Talk tae me when yer ready.

Title: WANTED: Prime Thumpknuckle
Objective: Slay a Prime Thumpknuckle
Text: To any and all brave enough to seek the challenge: Find and defeat a Prime Thumpknuckle, the largest and most dangerous of all the wild gorillas. They can be found up and down the road from the Village in the Vines. A reward for any that succeed!

Title: WANTED: Sabertusk Empress
Objective: Slay a Sabertusk Empress
Text: To any and all brave enough to seek the challenge: Find and defeat a ferocious Sabertusk Empress, the strongest and most vicious of all sabertusks in Zuldazar. They can be found up and down the road from the Village in the Vines. A reward for any that succeed!

Title: Time for War
Objective: Report to Nathanos Blightcaller in Zuldazar.
Text: You should return to Nathanos Blightcaller to begin working with The Honorbound.

Title: Time for War
Objective: Report to Halford Wyrmbane in Boralus.
Text: You should return to Commander Wyrmbane to begin working with the 7th Legion.

Title: WANTED: Razorclaw Alpha
Objective: Obtain a Razorclaw Alpha Pelt.
Text: The Horde requires your contributions!We are in need of materials to craft and repair our arms and armor.There are bountiful resources in this land and they are but ours for the taking.Seek out the largest wolf you can find, slay it, and secure it's pelt so that we may craft a cloak befitting Rexxar!- Centurion Kaga Warmstone

Title: Our Sacred Forest
Objective: Defeat the Azerite Fury.
Text: An elemental... of pure Azerite. Slay it, champion, but do not destroy it. Gather as much of its resin as you can!

Title: Ours For the Taking
Objective: Defeat the Azerite Fury.
Text: An elemental... of pure Azerite. Slay it, champion, but do not destroy it. Gather as much of its resin as you can!

Title: From the Ashes...
Objective: Use the Portal to Stormwind.
Text: We must return to Stormwind, quickly!

Title: Jungle Escort
Objective: Speak with Neva.
Text: There are now healers stationed at Mistvine Ledge.The mission to escort the reinforcements through the jungle was a success thanks to your leadership.Make your way to Mistvine Ledge in Zuldazar and meet with the outpost commander there to ensure she has everything she needs.

Title: Mission Report: Jungle Escort
Objective: Deliver the mission report to Halford Wyrmbane.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the escort mission to Mistvine Ledge.It details that the mission was a success and the reinforcements arrived safely at their destination.Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

Title: Do Your Part
Objective: Enable War Mode and slay 1 Horde Player within the world.
Text: The b-b-barber shop? I'm sorry, what? You want to know where the barber shop is?I'm sorry , do you know there is a W-A-R going on right now?Speaking of which, what have you done for the Alliance lately? Get out there and slay some Horde, or I'll shave your head myself.

Title: Spare Parts
Objective: Speak with Gilblin Clockspark.
Text: An engineer has been assigned to Mugamba Overlook to build a scrapping machine.The mission to salvage materials for the machine was a success thanks to your leadership.Make your way to Mugamba Overlook in Zuldazar and meet with Gilblin Clockspark. He has been overseeing the upgrades for the outpost.

Title: Mission Report: Spare Parts
Objective: Deliver the mission report to Halford Wyrmbane.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission to collect salvage for Mugamba Overlook.It details that the mission was a success and the necessary materials have been collected.Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

Title: Dino Research
Objective: Speak with Argrim Stonedeep.
Text: The mission to gather research specimens was a success. Well done.You should check in with the outpost commander and inspect the specimens yourself.Make your way to Verdant Hollow in Zuldazar and speak with Argrim Stonedeep.

Title: Mission Report: Dino Research
Objective: Deliver the mission report to Halford Wyrmbane.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Verdant Hollow.It details that the mission was a success and a variety of dinasaur specimens have been recovered.Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

Title: Arathi Donations: Gold
Objective: Donate 1000000 Gold to Paymaster Vauldren in Boralus Harbor.
Text: We've spent a great deal of time and resources preparing for the battle to come.As we begin final preparations, we'll be setting aside additional funding to ensure further training and supplies are available at a moment's notice.Would you like to make a donation?

Title: Arathi Donations: Incendiary Ammunition
Objective: Gather 2 Incendiary Ammunition for Norber Togglesprocket in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Though our ammunition stockpiles are faring well, it's my duty to find additional resources, especially those that are harder to come by.Today I'm looking for a specific type of ammunition, one with incendiary properties. I could really use your help tracking a few of these down.

Title: Arathi Donations: F.R.I.E.D.
Objective: Gather 3 F.R.I.E.D. for Norber Togglesprocket in Boralus Harbor.
Text: You never know when you'll need to deliver a big bang on the battlefield, if you know what I mean. Luckily we can plan for the unexpected!We've begun to store a special stockpile of explosives for scenarios where we'll need a little something extra to get our point across. I've added one particular item to the list.If you have any to spare I'll make sure they're put to good use.

Title: Arathi Donations: Frost-Laced Ammunition
Objective: Gather 2 Frost-Laced Ammunition for Norber Togglesprocket in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Hey there!Transmission's come down from up top--we need more ammunition! Something with a bit more kick. Something really unexpected!From what I've heard there's a special frost-based ammunition crafted only by the most experienced engineers. If you were to bring me a few I'm sure our munitions officers would be ecstatic!Maybe they'd even let me keep one to examine!

Title: Arathi Donations: War-Scroll of Intellect
Objective: Gather 3 War-Scroll of Intellect for Liao in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Enlightenment guides our path to victory. In battle, we fight as one.Share your knowledge and skills with me. Generosity is never forgotten.

Title: Arathi Donations: Great Sea Catfish
Objective: Gather 40 Great Sea Catfish for Senedras in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Fish--it's what's for dinner! Or so say our supply officers. And this weeks meals are based around one delicious ingredient--catfish.If we're going to keep our allies well fed and full of fish we'll need to gather more stock and begin meal preparations soon.If you find yourself swimming in an abundance of catfish I'd be happy to send them along to our stores.

Title: Arathi Donations: Grilled Catfish
Objective: Gather 5 Grilled Catfish for Senedras in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Greetings, traveler.I was asked to ensure our food supplies are never left wanting and our fish supplies have been running low lately. Have anything you would care to donate?

Title: Mission Report: Missing Supplies
Objective: Deliver the mission report to Halford Wyrmbane.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Vulture's Nest.It details that the mission was a success and the lost supply shipment has been recovered.Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

Title: Arathi Donations: Seasoned Loins
Objective: Gather 20 Seasoned Loins for Senedras in Boralus Harbor.
Text: A nice, hearty meat provides the nourishment our allies deserve before shipping off to battle, not to mention it also makes quite a stew, something our troops seem to rather enjoy when the winds are at their best and the chill of night lingers in the air.If you bring me some freshly seasoned loins I would be more than happy to deliver it to our supply officers.

Title: Arathi Donations: Monel-Hardened Stirrups
Objective: Gather 2 Monel-Hardened Stirrups for Brandal Darkbeard in Boralus Harbor.
Text: In times like this it's important ta be ready fer battle at a moments notice. Outfittin' our beasts with proper stirrups is a step in the right direction.If yer able ta bring me a few I'll be sure they're put ta good use.

Title: Necessary Supplies
Objective: Speak with Buzz Crankchug.
Text: The mission to recover the supplies was a success. Well done.The supply shipment in question was ordered by Buzz Crankchug at Vulture's Nest. You should check in with the outpost in Vol'dun and ensure that all of the missing supplies have been accounted for.Make your way to Vulture's Nest in Vol'dun and speak with Buzz Crankchug.

Title: Arathi Donations: Monel-Hardened Hoofplates
Objective: Gather 2 Monel-Hardened Hoofplates for Brandal Darkbeard in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Battles aren't decided by which side has the best armor, or the sharpest blades, but it sure does help! Matter o' fact is it's not just ye allies needin' help, but our beasts of battle as well.If ye can provide any additional hoofplates fer our brave beasts I'll be sure ta have our farriers take good care of 'em.

Title: Arathi Donations: Coarse Leather Barding
Objective: Gather 5 Coarse Leather Barding for Charlane in Boralus Harbor.
Text: It's not just our allies we need to protect in the upcoming battle, but our equine friends as well!Can you lend a hand and ensure our allies receive the best possible armor for the battle ahead?

Title: Touring the Front
Objective: Report to Foreman Drogg, Graul, and Flightgineer Krazzle.
Text: The Alliance haven't attacked for a while now. Neither have we, actually. It should be safe to head on out and do some scouting.Check in with our foremen at the mine and the lumber mill. It'd be good to know that they haven't gone and gotten themselves killed, and the trip should give you a bit of a lay of the land.Speaking of which, you might also talk to Flightgineer Krazzle. He can give you a quick look at Stromgarde, so you can see what we're up against.

Title: The Warfront Looms
Objective: Report to Throk in Zuldazar.
Text: Our focus must expand beyond Kul Tiras. The Alliance still presses against our forces in other parts of the globe.We are most interested in the Arathi Highlands, near Stromgarde. We've set up an encampment in the area, with the intent of capturing Stromgarde.Speak with Throk, the recruitment officer for the division in charge of this particular warfront. He could use a good  like you.

Title: Arathi Donations: Coastal Mana Potion
Objective: Bring 10 Coastal Mana Potions to Chelsea Strand in Boralus Harbor.
Text: One of our latest shipments of alchemical supplies was raided en route to storage. We're scrambling to get our stock back on track, but I'm worried we won't make our quota.You wouldn't happen to know where one can acquire additional mana potions, would you?

Title: To the Front
Objective: Speak with Druza Netherfang to teleport to Ar'gorok, then report to Wistel Silversnitch.
Text: We're at war in the Arathi Highlands. The battle has died down for now, but when it flares up again, we'll need you on the front.Druza Netherfang maintains a portal directly to Ar'gorok. She can help you.

Title: Arathi Donations: Shimmerscale
Objective: Donate 100 Shimmerscale to Charlane in Boralus Harbor.
Text: I'll keep it simple: we need more Shimmerscale!I apologize for being so forward with you, but there's little time to waste.If you happen upon this item throughout your travels I'd be more than happy to put it to good use. Outfitting our allies is of the utmost importance in the battle to come, don't you agree?

Title: Back to Boralus
Objective: Speak with Yvera Dawnwing to return to Boralus.
Text: That should just about do it for now, then. We'll be in touch if the fighting heats back up again. No doubt it'll be any day now.

Title: Arathi Donations: Monelite Ore
Objective: Gather 20 Monelite Ore to Brandal Darkbeard in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Ye look like the kind o'  that ought ta be carryin' loads o' ore around with ya! If my assumption is right about ye, we could use yer help to gather a bit more ore for the war effort.Have ye any ore ta spare?

Title: Arathi Donations: Coastal Healing Potion
Objective: Gather 10 Coastal Healing Potions for Chelsea Strand in Boralus Harbor.
Text: I've received word our allies are looking to stash away a few supplementary items for the battle to come. If you happen to stumble across a few Coastal Healing Potions I'd be more than happy to add them to our stores.

Title: Warfront Contribution
Objective: Make a donation to the war effort. You can donate gold, War Resources, or crafted equipment. Only some NPCs will accept donations each day.
Text: A well-trained army will only get us so far. We also need money, food, and supplies to keep our army funded, fed, and ready to fight.Show some pride and give what you can. For the Horde!

Title: Back to Zuldazar
