Objective: Speak with Druza Netherfang to return to Zuldazar.
Text: That should just about do it for now, then. We'll be in touch if the fighting heats back up again. Should be any day now, honestly.

Title: Touring the Front
Objective: Report to Foreman Tully, Lumbering Leo, and Grayson Bell.
Text: The Horde haven't attacked for a while now. Neither have we, honestly. It should be safe to head on out and do some scouting.Check in with our foremen at the mine and the lumber mill. It'd be good to know that they haven't off and gotten themselves killed, and the trip should give you a bit of a lay of the land.Speaking of which, you might also talk to Grayson Bell, the flight master, who can give you a quick look at our enemy's base. "Ar'gorok," or some other such orcish nonsense.

Title: Executing Exorcisms
Objective: Kill 20 Vengeful Ghosts in Stromgarde.
Text: Even in death, the Alliance foolishly clings to Horde territory.Drive their vengeful ghosts from the ruins of Stromgarde before their foulness spreads.

Title: Twice-Exiled
Objective: Kill 20 Burning, Cresting, Rumbling, or Thundering Exiles or Guardians in Arathi Highlands.
Text: Elementals of all sorts are bursting free of their bonds across the Highlands.Return them to the primordial chaos from whence they came.

Title: To the Front
Objective: Speak with Yvera Dawnwing to teleport to Stromgarde, then report to Captain Roderick Brewston.
Text: I need you to see the Arathi Highlands. The battle has died down for now, but when it flares up again, we'll need you on the front.Yvera Dawnwing maintains a portal directly to Stromgarde. She can help you.

Title: Twice-Exiled
Objective: Kill 20 Burning, Cresting, Rumbling, or Thundering Exiles or Guardians in Arathi Highlands.
Text: Elementals of all sorts are bursting free of their bonds across the Highlands.Return them to the primordial chaos from whence they came.

Title: Arathi Donations: Akunda's Bite
Objective: Gather 20 Siren's Pollen for Chelsea Strand in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Greetings!With the war effort in full swing I'll be your point of contact for herbalism and alchemical donations! It's a pleasure to meet you!Now, let's see here... Ah, yes. Siren's Pollen. It appears our stockpiles reported a shortage as of late last night. It would be a great help to us all if you were able to donate to our efforts.

Title: An Unexpected Guest
Objective: Speak with Noella Davenport.
Text: The mission to defend Grimwatt's Crash was a success. Well done.In addition to successfully holding the outpost, the troops at Grimwatt's Crash have captured a blood crawg. Noella Davenport is handling the beast's training.Make your way to Grimwatt's Crash in Nazmir and check-in with Noella on the crawg training.

Title: Strangling Root
Objective: Take the root to Keeper Remulos in Moonglade.

Title: Druidic Fur
Objective: Bring the fur to Loganaar in Moonglade.

Title: Mission Report: Ambush at Grimwatt's Crash
Objective: Deliver the mission report to Halford Wyrmbane.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Grimwatt''s Crash.It details that the mission was a success and the attacking blood trolls were defeated.Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

Title: Warfront Contribution
Objective: Make a donation to the war effort. You can donate gold, War Resources, or crafted equipment. Only some NPCs will accept donations each day.
Text: A well-trained army will only get us so far. We also need money, food, and supplies to keep our army funded, fed, and ready to fight.Alliance coffers fund most of the war effort, but the rest is paid for by the hard work of citizens like you and me. Loosen up those purse strings and do what you can. For the Alliance!

Title: Weathered Pamphlet
Objective: Find the pamphlet's originator.

Title: Executing Exorcisms
Objective: Kill 20 Vengeful Ghosts in Ar'gorok.
Text: Even in death, the Horde foolishly clings to Alliance territory.Drive their vengeful ghosts from the ruins of Ar'gorok before their foulness spreads.

Title: Wriggling Mass
Objective: Locate someone who can explain the visions.
Text: <The tendril writhes and pulsates in your hand as your mind is assailed by all manner of vicious thoughts.One vision in particular surfaces in your mind again and again.In your mind's eye, you picture a many-eyed goat laying in a pool of black water. As you approach, its eyes burst open, and in an instant you find yourself looking upward at the goat from deep within the puddle.As you sink into the icy darkness, everything goes black.You pocket the mass and shake the thoughts from your head.

Title: Broken Compass
Objective: Find the owner of the compass.

Title: Vorus'arak's Carapace
Objective: Bring the carapace to Kilix the Unraveler in Dragonblight.

Title: Razorfin Hunting Spear
Objective: Take the spear to Tired Shushen in Krasarang Wilds.

Title: The Warfront Looms
Objective: Report to Ralston Karn in Boralus Harbor.
Text: We cannot myopically focus all our efforts on Zandalar. Horde treachery simmers all across the globe.One particular hot spot lies in the Arathi Highlands, near the storied citadel of Stromgarde. The Horde has set up an encampment nearby, and intends to capture our territory.Speak with Ralston Karn, the recruitment officer for the division in charge of this particular warfront. He could use a good  like you.

Title: Sins of the Syndicate
Objective: Kill 20 Syndicate members at Go'Shek Farm.
Text: As if the League of Arathor was not trouble enough, Syndicate agents still slither down from the Alterac mountains to drive off honest Horde laborers.Punish them.

Title: Glittering Scarab
Objective: Bring the scarab to High Commander Kamses in Uldum.

Title: Venture Co. Business Plan
Objective: Confront Lizzarik in Ratchet.

Title: Battered Twilight Scale
Objective: Solve the riddle.

Title: Murloc Eye
Objective: Solve the riddle.

Title: Magical Spyglass
Objective: Return the spyglass.

Title: Icetusk Fur Cloak
Objective: Show the fur to Tua'kea in Dragonblight.

Title: Unscarred Black Scale
Objective: Attempt to find Wrathion in Blackrock Mountain.

Title: Elemental Core
Objective: Bring the core to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

Title: Bloodwake Drinking Horn
Objective: Bring the horn to the wise Vydhar.

Title: Sonic Stone
Objective: Show the stone to Sentinel Commander Qipan in Townlong Steppes.

Title: Arathi Donations: Coarse Leather
Objective: Donate 60 Coarse Leather to Charlane in Boralus Harbor.
Text: It's time we snuff out the competition, don't you agree? With your help we can ensure our allies receive the necessary goods and armor to prepare for the battle to come.Let's make sure our allies are well prepared.

Title: Sins of the Syndicate
Objective: Kill 20 Syndicate members at Dabyrie's Farmstead.
Text: As if the Defilers were not trouble enough, Syndicate agents still slither down from the Alterac mountains to drive off honest Alliance farmers.Punish them.

Title: Ancient Crypt Key
Objective: Bring the key to Lorewalker Cho in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Title: Ring of the Reefs
Objective: Solve the riddle.

Title: Notched Coin
Objective: Bring the Notched Coin to Mili Wanderbrew in Jade Forest.

Title: The League Will Lose
Objective: Kill 20 League of Arathor at Dabyrie's Farmstead.
Text: Even with the fall of Stromgarde, the League of Arathor continues to operate in the Highlands.The northern farmland will belong to the Horde. Go, and defeat the humans.

Title: Mission Report: Wolves For The Den
Objective: Deliver the mission report to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Wolf's Den.It details that the mission was a success and that a pack of direwolves now guard the outpost.Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

Title: Death to The Defilers
Objective: Kill 20 Defilers at Go'Shek Farm.
Text: Even with the destruction of Undercity, the Defilers continue to combat our hold on the Arathi Highlands.The farmland at Go'Shek will belong to the Alliance once more. Go, and defeat the Forsaken.

Title: Wolves for the Den
Objective: Speak with Mukkral Blackvein.
Text: The mission at Wolf's Den in Tiragarde Sound was a success. Well done.A pack of direwolves now patrols the area surrounding the outpost.Travel to Wolf's Den and see that the training of the wolves is up to our standard.

Title: Wiping Out the Witherbark
Objective: Kill 20 Witherbark tribe trolls in Arathi Highlands.
Text: The bloodthirsty Witherbark tribe has always refused to join the Horde... and now that the Horde holds Arathi, we will succeed where the Alliance has failed.Drive the forest trolls from the Highlands.

Title: Wiping Out the Witherbark
Objective: Kill 20 Witherbark tribe trolls in Arathi Highlands.
Text: The Witherbark tribe has a long and bloody history in the highlands of Arathi.Show them how much bloodier it can get.

Title: Boulderfist Beatdown
Objective: Kill 20 Boulderfist clan ogres in Arathi Highlands.
Text: If the Boulderfist ogres will not join the Horde, there is no place for them in Arathi.You know what must be done.

Title: Bloodied Sentinel's Glaive
Objective: Take the Bloodied Sentinel's Glaive to Kayla Mills in Stormwind City.
Text: The glaive rests inches from the sentinel's outstretched fingertips. Her eyes stare, sightless, at the ashen husk of Teldrassil on the horizon.Perhaps someone in Stormwind can tell you what happened here.

Title: The Lord Admiral's Lament
Objective: Take the Illegible Correspondence to someone in Orgrimmar.
Text: The footlocker contains a number of Lord Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's personal effects. Among them is a rolled letter, sealed with sea-green wax and stamped with the Proudmoore crest. The parchment tears easily and requires careful handling and it appears that the ink has been largely washed away by tide and time.Perhaps someone can restore the letter and reveal its contents.

Title: Boulderfist Beatdown
Objective: Kill 20 Boulderfist clan ogres in Arathi Highlands.
Text: The Boulderfist ogres have plagued Arathi since the Second War, and they still remain.You know what must be done.

Title: Mission Report: Into The Wicker
Objective: Deliver the victory report to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Mudfisher Cove.It details that the mission was a success and the druids there have upgraded their druidic knowledge as a result.Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

Title: The Wicker Totem
Objective: Speak with Garn Blackwolf.
Text: The defense of Mudfisher Cove was successful. Well done.A mysterious totem was found in the aftermath of the battle that may prove useful to you during your adventures in Drustvar.Travel to Mudfisher Cove in Drustvar and see what power this totem contains.

Title: The Lord Admiral's Lament
Objective: Take the Illegible Correspondence to Kayla Mills in Stormwind City.
Text: The footlocker contains a number of Lord Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's personal effects. Among them is a rolled letter, sealed with sea-green wax and stamped with the Proudmoore crest. The parchment tears easily and requires careful handling and it appears that the ink has been largely washed away by tide and time.Perhaps someone can restore the letter and reveal its contents.

Title: Bloodied Sentinel's Glaive
Objective: Take the Bloodied Sentinel's Glaive to Isabella in Orgrimmar.
Text: The glaive rests inches from the sentinel's outstretched fingertips. Her eyes stare, sightless, at the ashen husk of Teldrassil on the horizon.Perhaps someone in Orgrimmar can tell you what happened here.

Title: A Season for Celebration
Objective: Speak with Darkcaller Yanka in the Ruins of Lordaeron just outside the entrance to Undercity.
Text: Well met. Hallow's End is a time for celebration and reflection, though some have no idea why. The burning of the Wickerman in particular is a mystery to many outside the Forsaken. Travel to the Ruins of Lordaeron above Undercity and speak to Darkcaller Yanka. She can tell you more about the Wickerman ceremony.

Title: The High Thornspeaker
Objective: Take the Runic Power Cores to Ulfar.
Text: My teacher, Ulfar, the High Thornspeaker, must be informed of what's been going on here.I can't leave just yet. There are too many wounded and we'll need to handle the last few remaining constructs.You have proven trustworthy, friend. Take a few of these runic cores to Ulfar for me.Arthur will meet you at the head of the path to Ulfar's den.

Title: House Waycrest
Objective: Return to Taelia in the Harbormaster's Office in Boralus.
Text: You have done much for my home and the people of Drustvar,Tell your allies that House Waycrest will return to Boralus shortly.

Title: Misplaced Faith
Objective: Use the Cleansing Thurible to purge 13 sources of corruption.
Text: The air is foul with corruption. It must be dealt with. The tidesages were fools, and I a fool to trust them. Belief in their god to perform miracles and deliver us from our folly. Nevertheless, their methods did serve to drive back the foul presence from these cliffs. A simple censer, loaded with select powders and oils. The vapors produce an effect that expels the miasma, if only for a time. Perhaps their ineffectual gesticulation will finally serve a purpose.

Title: Wicker Magic
Objective: Speak with Toska Eaglehorn.
Text: It seems that the druids at Swiftwind Post have learned much from the ancient Drust rituals you recovered.The druids are now able to offer improved services at the outpost.Make your way to Swiftwind Post in Drustvar and see what they have to offer.

Title: Mission Report: Nature Calls
Objective: Deliver the victory report to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Swiftwind Post.It details that the mission was a success and the druids there have upgraded their druidic knowledge as a result.Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

Title: Nettin' Ettin
Objective: Speak with Wyna Breezehorn.
Text: An ettin has been captured by our troops at Stonetusk Watch.Apparently, the creature is being trained to work for the Horde as a beast of burden.Make your way to Stonetusk Watch in Stormsong Valley and meet with Wyna Breezehorn. She has been training the ettin to do her bidding.

Title: Mission Report: Giant Slaying
Objective: Deliver the victory report to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission at Stonetusk Watch.It details that the mission was a success and that one of the ettins is being held captive.Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

Title: A Mote of Cosmic Truth
Objective: Defeat the Ascendant Nightmare.
Text: We stand on the brink, you and I. The final act looms over us, casting a terrible shadow. Deep we plumbed, seeking knowledge of the world. Deeper still we delved, until our fate was inevitable. Minds were shattered, my comrades ran screaming into the night. We are all lost, to that terrible Thing... Now, the malformed syzygy beckons. Complete the ritual and bring about the end.

Title: Despondent Ablutions
Objective: Investigate the Purifying Effigy.
Text: You return. A surprise. Perhaps there is still hope. In victory or defeat, you bear the weight of this place. It hangs on you like a mantle. I see your struggle to bear it. There is, perhaps, a way to shrug off this burden. An altar, to the northwest. Built by the tidesages, seeking to wash away the corruption. Offer yourself to the idol. It will exact a price, as do all things. But in communion you may claw back from the brink.

Title: A Flicker of Hope
Objective: Evacuate the Citizens of Darnassus.
Text: Champion, I need your help!We must evacuate Darnassus before it burns to ash! Many of the city's structures have already caught fire. Douse the flames and rescue the trapped civilians within!Please, do all that you can... we must save as many lives as possible.

Title: Spare Parts
Objective: Speak with Grizvek Gearsnap.
Text: An engineer has been assigned to Stonefist Watch to build a scrapping machine.The mission to salvage materials for the machine was a success thanks to your leadership.Make your way to Stonefist Watch in Tiragarde Sound and meet with Grizvek Gearsnap. He has been overseeing the upgrades for the outpost.

Title: Mission Report: Spare Parts
Objective: Deliver the victory report to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission to collect salvage for Stonefist Watch.It details that the mission was a success and the necessary materials have been collected.Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

Title: Reinforcements
Objective: Speak with Garona Halforcen to issue a recruitment order.
Text: The resources you gather can be used to recruit new troops for the war effort.Return to me periodically to issue new recruitment orders for your missions.If you have available resources, you should use them now to issue your first recruitment order.The war effort rages on even as we speak. We have need of fresh recruits.

Title: Dueler's Guild
Objective: Speak with a nearby bouncer.
Text: I figured a war-torn  such as your self would benefit from training in the Dueler's Guild. Speak with a nearby bouncer to participate in the carnage.

Title: Operation: Heartstrike
Objective: Meet with Halford Wyrmbane on the Wind's Redemption in Boralus Harbor.
Text: We've taken out quite a number of high priority targets. All thanks to your help.It is time to strike directly at the heart of the Zandalari empire.Report to the Wind's Redemption as soon as you are able. We will get started from there.

Title: Reinforcements
Objective: Speak with Mathias Shaw to issue a recruitment order.
Text: The resources you gather can be used to recruit new troops for the war effort.Return to me periodically to issue new recruitment orders for your missions.If you have available resources, you should use them now to issue your first recruitment order.The war effort rages on even as we speak. We have need of fresh recruits.

Title: Hook Point Investigation
Objective: Speak with Grand Marshal Tremblade at Hook Point.
Text: I'm sure you've heard the constant sound of battle coming from Hook Point. We sent scouts over to find out why the fighting never seems to end, and discovered an unexpected training ground. Daniel Poole at Hook Point is running some sort of fight circuit near the Tradewind Market. Seek out Grand Marshal Tremblade at our War Headquarters and find out what they've learned.

Title: Operation: Cutpurse
Objective: Meet with Halford Wyrmbane on the Wind's Redemption in Boralus Harbor.
Text: It is time to reconvene for our next mission, though Shandris and I disagree on what exactly that should entail.Meet us on the Wind's Redemption.

Title: Operation: Gryphon's Claw
Objective: Meet with Halford Wyrmbane on the Wind's Redemption in Boralus Harbor.
Text: SI:7 has procured some interesting intel.I request your presence on the Wind's Redemption immediately to help decide our next course of action.

Title: Operation: Grave Digger
Objective: Meet with Nathanos Blightcaller on the Banshee's Wail in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: Sylvanas has issued us a mission in Drustvar, where we will find our next target.Report to the Banshee's Wail immediately.

Title: Operation: Water Wise
Objective: Meet with Nathanos Blightcaller on the Banshee's Wail in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: Rexxar has reported back with news of a new... ally.Report to the Banshee's Wail for your briefing.

Title: A Mission of Unity
Objective: Meet with Nathanos Blightcaller on the Banshee's Wail in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: You have undertaken great journeys during your time here in Zandalar.It is time for your next mission. Report to the Banshee's Wail.

Title: Operation: Bottom Feeder
Objective: Meet with Nathanos Blightcaller on the Banshee's Wail in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: It is time for Zelling to prove his worth to the Horde.Return to the Banshee's Wail. Today, we sail out to open waters.

Title: A Mission of Unity
Objective: Meet with Halford Wyrmbane on the Wind's Redemption in Boralus Harbor.
Text: You have done much for the Alliance during your time here in Kul Tiras.Today we must ask more of you. Return to the Wind's Redemption when you have the chance so that we can discuss.

Title: Operation: Blood Arrow
Objective: Meet with Halford Wyrmbane on the Wind's Redemption in Boralus Harbor.
Text: We have uncovered the location of a high priority target in Nazmir.Return to the Wind's Redemption for your briefing.

Title: Operation: Hook and Line
Objective: Meet with Nathanos Blightcaller on the Banshee's Wail in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: Thanks to the help of our new allies, we have devised a plan to extract a powerful tidesage artifact from Boralus.I have already sent Valentine to get us started.Report to the Banshee's Wail posthaste.

Title: The Azerite Advantage
Objective: Meet with Halford Wyrmbane on the Wind's Redemption in Boralus Harbor.
Text: , we have received intelligence pointing us toward a reliable source of Azerite.We must acquire this precious resource before our enemies in the Horde.Report to the Wind's Redemption as soon as possible to aid in extraction.

Title: Deeper Into Zandalar
Objective: Meet with Halford Wyrmbane on the Wind's Redemption in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Our advisors have decided that now is the correct time to further our hold on Zandalar.Return to the Wind's Redemption posthaste. We shall leave for new lands immediately.

Title: The Azerite Advantage
Objective: Meet with Nathanos Blightcaller on the Banshee's Wail in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: We have received intelligence pointing us toward a reliable source of Azerite.We must move quickly to acquire these resources for the Horde.Report to the Banshee's Wail to aid in this urgent mission.

Title: Dueler's Guild
Objective: Speak with a nearby Rastari Guard.
Text: I figured a war-torn  such as your self would find benefit in this Dueler's Guild. Speak with a nearby Rastari Guard to participate in the carnage.

Title: Pushing Our Influence
Objective: Meet with Halford Wyrmbane on the Wind's Redemption in Boralus Harbor.
Text: Our scouts have identified a location for a final major foothold in Zandalar.Return to the Wind's Redemption so we can ship out.

Title: To The Mugambala!
Objective: Speak with High Warlord Volrath at The Mugambala.
Text: The Rastari have proven to be formidable allies in combat, and reports are coming in that help explain how they've honed their battle prowess. Je'stry the Untamed has a fighting ring setup at the base of Mount Mugambala that could prove useful for getting ready for war. We've dispatched our troops to take advantage of these training grounds, go and see what High Warlord Volrath has uncovered.

Title: Deeper Into Kul Tiras
Objective: Meet with Nathanos Blightcaller on the Banshee's Wail in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: It is time for us to further our hold on Kul Tiras.Return to the Banshee's Wail. From there we shall plan our next course of action.

Title: Surveying the Wharf
Objective: Speak to Coxswain Hook in Thresher's Wharf.
Text: Thresher's Wharf is a bustling fishing hub just across the delta from Fort Daelin.It was also in the direct war path of the naga -- who knows what remains now.If you could stop in and check in on its leader, Coxswain Hook, you'd have my gratitude. I must focus on tending to the wounded here and preparing for the naga's next assault.

Title: The Very Best
Objective: Defeat 5 players through Find Battle with a team of level 25 pets.
Text: This alignment of the stars is truly a strange one, causing the tiniest of creatures to gain unnatural aptitude. None of our sages can explain the phenomenon, but cunning tamers have much to gain, especially by testing their skills against those of their peers.

Title: Mission Report: Vulture's Nest
Objective: Deliver the victory report to Halford Wyrmbane.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the mission to capture Vulture's Nest in Vol'dun.It details that the mission was a success and that the troops holding the outpost have requested reinforcements.Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

Title: Pushing Our Influence
Objective: Meet with Nathanos Blightcaller on the Banshee's Wail in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: We have identified a location for a final major foothold in Kul Tiras.Return to the Banshee's Wail to discuss our new mission.

Title: The Arena Calls
Objective: Win 10 Arena Skirmish battles.
Text: This alignment of the stars is a dire sign, stirring bloodlust and calling warriors to battle to the death in close quarters. Arena masters turn a tidy profit during these days, likely not understanding why their stands are overflowing. Amidst the excitement, great rewards do await those brave, or foolhardy, enough to venture into the arena....

Title: Vulture's Nest
Objective: Claim Vulture's Nest for the Alliance.
Text: The mission to take Vulture's Nest in Vol'dun was successful. Well done.The outpost is ready to be claimed.Make your way to Vulture's Nest and establish fortifications there.It will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Horde.For the Alliance!

Title: Sampling the Goods
Objective: Collect the Chemist's Notes and a Raw Azerite Sample.
Text: Bridgeport is a major trade hub for this area. Naturally, Ashvane has offices and workshops here.Check around town and see if you can learn anything about this new material and how they're using it.If you can lift a sample for us to send back to Boralus, even better.I gotta stay here and keep an eye on someone.

Title: A Call to Battle
Objective: Win 4 Battleground matches.
Text: The favorite star of warlords and generals dominates the sky, offering good fortune to tacticians everywhere. Some say that the battle star hones the instincts of commanders to the point of near-prophecy. If ever you were going to test yourself on the field of battle, now is the time.

Title: A Shattered Path Through Time
Objective: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
Text: The Destroyer's star shines upon the land with its piercing light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, laying bare the weaknesses of even the boldest heroes. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

Title: Emissary of War
Objective: Complete 4 dungeons on Mythic difficulty.
Text: When the sign of the warrior shines in the night sky, fortune favors the daring. Powerful foes may yield even greater rewards. Venture deep into caverns and strongholds to prove your worth.

Title: A Shrouded Path Through Time
Objective: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
Text: The shrouded star flickers upon the land with its intermittent light ushering in an eerie mist upon the land. This star and the mists bring deep shadows to the land hiding its secrets and dangers. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

Title: A Dying World
Objective: Meet Magni Bronzebeard in Silithus.
Text: While the armies of the Horde and Alliance squabble over a ruined city, our world is dying.Magni Bronzebeard, the Speaker of Azeroth, needs you at his encampment in Silithus.You must hurry. The area is being overrun by elementals driven mad by Azerite!

Title: A Burning Path Through Time
Objective: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
Text: The blazing star shines upon the land, searing the earth and parching the landscape. This star is relentless, malevolent almost. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

Title: A Frozen Path Through Time
Objective: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
Text: The chill star shines upon the land with its cold light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, sapping warmth and life. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

Title: The World Awaits
Objective: Complete 20 World Quests in Kul Tiras, Zandalar, Arathi Highlands, Darkshore, or Nazjatar.
Text: When the sign of the emissary shines in the night sky, the stars strengthen existing bonds and forge new ones. Friendship is still not cheaply won, and deeds will prove loyalty, but trust comes more readily during these days. Venture across these lands, and give aid where you may, to prove your worth.

Title: The Speaker's Imperative
Objective: Speak with Nathanos Blightcaller in Orgrimmar.
Text: The world's soul is secure... fer now. I can hear Azeroth again, though her voice is still weak.The elementals on the surface above have calmed down. Even using just a fraction of its power, the Heart of Azeroth brought stability tae this place.Ye need tae return tae Orgrimmar and inform yer allies what transpired here. Remind them that no matter what happens in their war, our world must be saved.We'll speak again soon. The battle fer Azeroth has only just begun.

Title: Grimwatt's Crash
Objective: Claim Grimwatt's Crash for the Alliance.
Text: The rescue that you planned for Grimwatt's Crash in Nazmir was successful. Well done.I believe we should fortify the crash site and turn it into an outpost.Make your way to Grimwatt's Crash and establish fortifications there.Grimwatt's Crash will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Horde.For the Alliance!

Title: A Dying World
Objective: Meet Magni Bronzebeard in Silithus, located within Kalimdor.
Text: Champion, Azeroth be dyin' while the armies of the Horde and Alliance be fightin' over a ruined city.She needs yer help. Make yer way to me camp in Silithus. Azeroth's got somethin' tae give ye.

Title: A Cycle of Hatred
Objective: Report to Sylvanas Windrunner in Orgrimmar.
Text: We have raised new champions for the Horde, established footholds on Kul Tiran soil, and stolen one of their precious artifacts.We hold greater power and sway over our enemies than we have before.Sylvanas has great plans for our Horde. I will allow you the pleasure of reporting our victories to her personally.

Title: Hang On In There
Objective: Defeat the Azerite Fury.
Text: An elemental... of pure Azerite. Slay it, champion, but do not destroy it. Gather as much of its resin as you can!

Title: Mission Report: Grimwatt's Crash
Objective: Deliver the victory report to Halford Wyrmbane.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the rescue mission to Grimwatt's Crash.It details that the supplies were recovered and the enemies surrounding the crash site have been slain.Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

Title: No Turning Back
Objective: Defeat the Azerite Fury.
Text: An elemental... of pure Azerite. Slay it, champion, but do not destroy it. Gather as much of its resin as you can!

Title: Return to the Harbor
Objective: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller in Plunder Harbor.
Text: With the scepter in hand, let us return to the portal.I believe Stone would agree with me when I say that it is best for us to get away from Kul Tiras for a while.

Title: I Want It All
Objective: Defeat the Azerite Fury.
Text: An elemental... of pure Azerite. Slay it, champion, but do not destroy it. Gather as much of its resin as you can!

Title: Action This Day
Objective: Eliminate Gormok Axefall, and Ragash Bloodwish.
Text: Two of the Horde's strongest warriors have led a charge to try and capture our fleet. We cannot allow this.If they take our ships, they will use them to sail to Darnassus!Slay the two warriors leading the attack, and the rest of them will give up the fight.

Title: Killer Queen
Objective: Scour the forest of Darkshore to find the Warchief.
Text: Lor'danel is now secure, but something is amiss... there has been no sign of Stormrage.Malfurion would have never let Lor'danel fall without a fight. He must have gone after her.My army has approached from the North, and our reinforcements have arrived from the South -- which means that they are not along any of the roads.Search the forest with me. We will find them and be done with this once and for all.

Title: With Prince in Tow
Objective: Speak with Dread-Admiral Tattersail to return to Zuldazar.
Text: Let's set sail for Zandalar. In case you hadn't noticed, we've been dealing with a bit of Alliance interference while you were gone.

Title: The Guidance of Our Shan'do
Objective: Find Malfurion Stormrage in Darkshore.
Text: Lor'danel is overrun. The Horde... they -- they just don't relent.There is nothing we can do. We must find our Shan'do and ask for his guidance.He is the only one who can save us.

Title: I Want It All
Objective: Defeat the Azerite Fury.
Text: An elemental born of pure Azerite! I do not know what kind of threat this poses, champion... but please, do take care.

Title: Rescue Effort
Objective: Rescue 8 Lor'danel citizens.
Text: The suddenness of the Horde's attack gave citizens here little time to flee. Many are hiding in Lor'danel, waiting for help.Locate these civilians and send them to safety. We're counting on you.

Title: A Threat from the North
Objective: Find Malfurion Stormrage in Lor'danel.
Text: The Horde must have scaled the mountains of Felwood in the North.The wisp wall is failing, it is only a matter of time before the Horde breaks through. They will attack us from both sides.We must weather this attack together.

Title: Seaside Rendezvous
Objective: Kill Caranne Briarbow and Ariel Stagguard
Text: Lor'danel has mustered significant reinforcements on its shore. Enough to drive us back.One swift strike and we can end this threat!You will break through their lines and slay the two commanders. Without leadership this force will crumble.

Title: No Small Mercy
Objective: Capture 8 Lor'danel citizens.
Text: I will not slay innocents. If they do not raise arms against us, we shall spare them.Enter Lor'danel and capture any civilians you find there. They shall be questioned and then released.

Title: Saurfang Returns
Objective: Find Saurfang in Lor'danel.
Text: Saurfang! It's about time.Look around you, hero! What a lovely sight -- the wisps are scattering. One by one, the walls come crashing down.Now is the time. The World Tree is ours for the taking! Find Saurfang. We shall finish this once and for all.

Title: Mission Report: Mistvine Ledge
Objective: Deliver the victory report to Halford Wyrmbane.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Mistvine Ledge.It details that victory was hard-fought, but the enemies surrounding the outpost have been slain.Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

Title: Call to Arms: Drustvar
Objective: Slay Alliance within Drustvar.
Text: Its time to hit the Alliance at the source. Travel to Drustvar and slay every Alliance you find. It shouldn't be hard to find them in their own territory.

Title: Call to Arms: Stormsong Valley
Objective: Slay Alliance within Stormsong Valley.
Text: Its time to hit the Alliance at the source. Travel to Stormsong Valley and slay every Alliance you find. It shouldn't be hard to find them in their own territory.

Title: Mistvine Ledge
Objective: Claim Mistvine Ledge for the Alliance.
Text: The raid you planned for Mistvine Ledge in Zuldazar was successful. Well done.The outpost is ready to be claimed.Make your way to Mistvine Ledge in Zuldazar and establish fortifications there.Mistvine Ledge will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Horde.For the Alliance!

Title: Tyranny of the Light
Objective: Assist Geya'rah against the Tyranny of the Light.
Text: If it is not an uprising of ogres or the promise of starvation, it's the constant threat of the Lightbound.Should the reports prove true, this is the closest they have dared approach our stronghold in quite some time.Come or stay, but make your decision quickly.

Title: Call to Arms: Vol'dun
Objective: Slay Alliance within Vol'dun.
Text: We're getting reports of increased Alliance activity within Vol'dun. Head over there and clear them out.

Title: Call to Arms: Nazmir
Objective: Slay Alliance within Nazmir.
Text: We're getting reports of increased Alliance activity within Nazmir. Head over there and clear them out.

Title: Call to Arms: Tiragarde Sound
Objective: Slay Alliance within Tiragarde Sound.
Text: Its time to hit the Alliance at the source. Travel to Tiragarde Sound and slay every Alliance you find. It shouldn't be hard to find them in their own territory.

Title: Call to Arms: Vol'dun
Objective: Slay Horde within Vol'dun.
Text: It's time to press the attack within Horde territory! Travel to Vol'dun and slay as many Horde as you find.

Title: Call to Arms: Nazmir
Objective: Slay Horde within Nazmir.
Text: It's time to press the attack within Horde territory! Travel to Nazmir and slay as many Horde as you find.

Title: Call to Arms: Zuldazar
Objective: Slay Alliance within Zuldazar.
Text: We're getting reports of increased Alliance activity within Zuldazar. Head over there and clear them out.

Title: Call to Arms: Zuldazar
Objective: Slay Horde within Zuldazar.
Text: It's time to press the attack within Horde territory! Travel to Zuldazar and slay as many Horde as you find.

Title: Call to Arms: Tiragarde Sound
Objective: Slay Horde within Tiragarde Sound.
Text: We've discovered a spike of Horde activity within Tiragarde Sound. We cannot allow them to get the upper hand.

Title: Bonds Forged Through Battle
Objective: Assist Geya'rah in putting down the ogre uprising.
Text: Geya'rah has a fiery spirit... like her mother. Perhaps facing a common foe will ease her wariness.We subdued the ogre clans long ago. But every so often, one of their bravest--and stupidest--stirs the embers of rebellion. Today is such a day.You and Eitrigg will join Geya'rah in putting down the ogre uprising. Prove yourself in battle and you may earn her respect.

Title: Call to Arms: Drustvar
Objective: Slay Horde within Drustvar.
Text: We've discovered a spike of Horde activity within Drustvar. We cannot allow them to get the upper hand.

Title: A Dying World
Objective: Meet Magni Bronzebeard in Silithus, located within Kalimdor.
Text: Champion, Azeroth be dyin' while the armies of the Horde and Alliance be fightin' over a ruined city.She needs yer help. Make yer way to me camp in Silithus. Azeroth's got somethin' tae give ye.

Title: Calling Out the Clans
Objective: Pay homage to the orc clan symbols.
Text: This Overlord Geya'rah has a fire inside her. I may come to like her... if she doesn't kill us.We have but one chance. You pay homage to the symbol of each clan, and I will speak of it.Show respect--or they will show us the executioner's blade.

Title: Restoring Old Bonds
Objective: Speak with Oculeth to travel to Draenor and meet with the Mag'har.
Text: We must speak to Grommash Hellscream and remind him of his debt to us. Everything rests on this mission.I hope your skills in diplomacy are greater than mine.Be on your guard; we do not know what to expect on the other side.

Title: Arathi Donations: Gold
Objective: Donate 1000000 Gold to Paymaster Grintooth in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: Our friends here are accepting all kinds of donations on behalf of the war effort, but if ya ask me, no battle was ever won without proper funding. That's right, bub. I'm talking about money! And lots of it.If you got it, we need it!

Title: Mission Report: Verdant Hollow
Objective: Deliver the victory report to Halford Wyrmbane.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Verdant Hollow.It details that victory was hard-fought, but the enemies guarding the outpost have been slain.Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

Title: Verdant Hollow
Objective: Claim Verdant Hollow for the Alliance.
Text: The raid you planned for Verdant Hollow in Zuldazar was successful. Well done.The outpost is ready to be claimed.Make your way to Verdant Hollow in Zuldazar and establish fortifications there.Verdant Hollow will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Horde.For the Alliance!

Title: WANTED: War Gore
Objective: Find and kill War Gore
Text: By the decree of the Storm's Wake.Scouts have reported that forsaken scientists have created a monster, sewn together from the bodies of our own fallen soldiers.This monstrosity is called, War Gore.The individual that destroys this abomination will earn a fitting reward.

Title: Held For Observation
Objective: Administer the remedy to your direhorn.
Text: That should do it. Go on and get this down your direhorn's gullet.Don't worry, nothing could possibly go wrong with a concoction made under any kind of duress. Also, do I seem like the kind of goblin who would give you something dangerous?On purpose?... Don't answer that. Hurry, before they stab me.

Title: Alchemy is an Inexact Science
Objective: Gather 1 Crown of Torcali and 8 Glowfly Incandescence for Trader Alexxi in Warbeast Kraal.
Text: Hey, look.It worked, right? Mostly. I mean, it DID get bigger. Don't look at me like that! So there are some... weird side effects going on. When has that ever gotten in the way of science before?Okay, okay, okay!I have an idea. Go and get me everything on this list. And be quick about it! I think these Zandalari might do something to me if you-- if WE-- don't fix this.Do me a solid, eh?

Title: Mission Report: Mugamba Overlook
Objective: Deliver the victory report to Halford Wyrmbane.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Mugamba Overlook.It details that victory was hard-fought, but the enemies guarding the outpost have been slain.Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

Title: Mugamba Overlook
Objective: Claim Mugamba Overlook for the Alliance.
Text: The raid you planned for Mugamba Overlook in Zuldazar was successful. Well done.The outpost is ready to be claimed.Make your way to Mugamba Overlook in Zuldazar and establish fortifications there.Mugamba Overlook will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Horde.For the Alliance!

Title: Veiled Grotto
Objective: Claim Veiled Grotto for the Alliance.
Text: The raid you planned for Veiled Grotto in Zuldazar was successful. Well done.The outpost is ready to be claimed.Make your way to Veiled Grotto in Zuldazar and establish fortifications there.Veiled Grotto will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Horde.For the Alliance!

Title: Mission Report: Veiled Grotto
Objective: Deliver the victory report to Halford Wyrmbane.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Veiled Grotto.It details that victory was hard-fought, but the enemies guarding the outpost have been slain.Deliver the report to High Commander Wyrmbane aboard the Wind's Redemption.

Title: A Looming Threat
Objective: Regroup with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Blackwood Den.
Text: This stalemate is unwise to pursue. Let's regroup at the Blackwood Den.

Title: Tol Dagor: The Ashvane Overseer
Objective: Retrieve the Tol Dagor Master Key from Overseer Korgus.
Text: Tol Dagor stands as a well fortified thorn in this nation's side.As you are no doubt aware, Ashvane has taken every opportunity she could to throw any opposition into those cells. Among those in the jail are members of the Alliance that arrived alongside you and Jaina.We now have permission and the needed muscle to free them. Meet up with Taelia on the eastern shore of the island, find the overseer, and take his key. With it, we will have access to the weapon vault and cells.

Title: Circle the Wagons
Objective: Find Darion, Lorraine and Mallory.
Text: Darion and the girls should have been back by now.Maybe they had trouble on the road, that old wagon is always breaking down. I need to be sure they are safe!Can you check on them for me?

Title: An End to the Killing
Objective: Meet Shandris Feathermoon on the deck of Gral's Call.
Text: Let's return to the upper decks and see what our current status is. Shandris should be there by now.I know Shandris and Falstad well enough that they will be there with the captain of this ship, dead or alive.

Title: A Saur Point
Objective: Slay Sourtooth
Text: That saurolisk has been a folktale in these hills for years. "Sourtooth, you can smell his breath from miles away".Today that folktale attacked my family, almost killed my father and sister. It's time for it to die.

Title: Sometimes Less Is More
Objective: Eliminate 8 Saurolisk.
Text: I don't really hate saurolisk, but there seem to be a lot more around lately.Stormsong's military used to thin out the population, but they didn't show up this year.Maybe you could do the job they didn't!

Title: The Alliance Slayer
Objective: With a bounty on your head, slay 10 Alliance without dying.
Text: Yes! Keep going, keep slaying those Alliance dogs!Slay a bit more Alliance and you may set a new record.But it won't be easy, the Alliance have put a bounty on your head, so watch it!For the Horde!

Title: The Horde Slayer
Objective: While being hunted by the Horde, slay 10 Horde without dying.
Text: Wow! Keep it up, soldier!Slay a bit more Horde and you will go down in the record books among the Alliance.But it won't be easy, the Horde have put a bounty on your head, so watch it!For the Alliance!

Title: Silencing the Advisor
Objective: Kill Advisor Ko'jan.
Text: The ship's captain is nowhere to be found. Shandris and Falstad will handle locating him.We must go after the ship's advisor. Kelsey's logs indicate her name is Ko'jan.She may have methods to reach out to the mainland. We have to move before she tries to use any of them.

Title: Numbing the Pain
Objective: Gather 5 Evermoss Clumps.
Text: The medics here are doing their best, but they've suffered heavy casualties and are strapped for healing supplies.With a few clumps of evermoss I could mix a painkilling tincture to ease the suffering of the injured. Can you forage some from the nearby trees?I'll help get Flynn stabilized. The last thing these people need is another wounded man howling in pain.

Title: Leave None Alive
Objective: Kill 10 Zandalari soldiers on board the Gral's Call.
Text: Our initial assault was a success. The Dark Iron dwarves are holding the line. Now it's our turn.You and I must cleave a path through these Zandalari and eliminate them. Our forces will handle any that remain.Our goal is to weaken their forces and find two important targets: the ship's captain and its advisor.Let's go. If we fail here, all of our efforts will be thwarted.

Title: Call to Arms: Stormsong Valley
Objective: Slay Horde within Stormsong Valley.
Text: We've discovered a spike of Horde activity within Stormsong Valley. We cannot allow them to get the upper hand.

Title: Stonetusk Watch
Objective: Claim Stonetusk Watch for the Horde.
Text: The raid you planned for Stonetusk Watch in Stormsong Valley was successful. Well done.The outpost is ready to be claimed.Make your way to Stonetusk Watch in Stormsong Valley and establish fortifications there.The outpost will be essential in our campaign against the Alliance.Go with honor!

Title: Mission Report: Stonetusk Watch
Objective: Deliver the victory report to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Stonetusk Watch.It details that victory was hard-fought, but the outpost has been secured.Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

Title: The Undersea Ledge
Objective: Find Marshal Valentine's shipwreck on the undersea ledge nearby.
Text: So, now that we can hear each other again, lemme tell you what's been goin' on up here.Apparently we were off by like, a league. Somethin' about undersea currents, somethin' about the tides of time, yadda yadda. I think Zelling is getting rusty.Point is, you're not far off now. We're SURE that Marshal Valentine is right to the east of ya, in a shipwreck up on a ledge. Zelling says there's something else big up there too, but he can't tell what it is.

Title: Seafloor Shipwreck
Objective: Look for a shipwreck somewhere to the east, apparently.
Text: ... look for shipwreck ...... east ...

Title: Water-Breathing Dragon
Objective: Slay Daenistrasz.
Text: Huh. A dragon, you say? I suppose that makes sense. I mean, the Horde did utilize red dragons as part of their army during the second war, but... well, we don't talk about that very much anymore.Still, Valentine is on that ship. You're gonna have to get past that dragon one way or another.

Title: Grab and Go
Objective: Grab Marshal M. Valentine's body, as well as the body of the other sailor aboard his ship.
Text: Nothin' left to do but grab that Marshal and bring him back up to the surface, then.Though I guess you might as well search the shipwreck for anything else of value. You spent all that time gettin' down there, and time is money.

Title: Biolumi-Nuisance
Objective: Kill 10 bioluminescent creatures to fix your communications issues with Hobart.
Text: ... having trouble hearing you ...... electrical interference ... bioluminescent creatures ...... getting annoying ...

Title: Checking Dog Tags
Objective: Find and identify the captain of the shipwreck.
Text: You are no longer able to hear Hobart's voice over the static.You can make out the outlines of several floating bodies nearby. They have significantly decomposed, but their dog tags should still be intact.Hopefully the dog tags can help identify Marshal Valentine.

Title: Captain By Captain
Objective: Identify the captains of the three nearby ships.
Text: Seems like you're on your own.More shipwrecks lie along the bottom of the sea. This must have been the location of a major battle.Time to start checking dog tags to find Marshal Valentine.

Title: The Sunken Graveyard
Objective: Look for more shipwrecks to the northeast of your current location.
Text: ...wait ... more shipwrecks ...... lots of 'em ... northeast ...

Title: Deep Dive
Objective: Speak with Hobart Grapplehammer to dive to the ocean floor, then test your headlamp.
Text: We need you to retrieve Marshal M. Valentine's body at the ocean floor below.I should warn you: this part of the ocean is going to be very deep, and very dark, and very cold.Speak with Hobart at the starboard side of the ship. He's brought all the machinery you'll need to get to the ocean floor.

Title: Journey to the Middle of Nowhere
Objective: Speak with Dread-Admiral Tattersail to sail to the Great Sea.
Text: Our tidesage, Thomas Zelling, claims to have found the wreckage of Marshal Valentine's ship.Took him long enough.Marshal Valentine's body is the final piece of our plan, and it lies within that shipwreck. When you're ready, let us depart for his resting place.

Title: A Local Guide
Objective: Find Flynn Fairwind at the Harbormaster's office in Boralus.
Text: I've spent a lot of time as a guest of the Harbormaster and I've come to understand a few things about Flynn Fairwind. If anyone can quickly help you to sort out any clues in Freehold, it will be him.Flynn's been doing work for Cyrus and can be found in the Harbormaster's office. Show him the contract and recruit him to our cause. Hurry.

Title: Eyes on the Skies
Objective: Tend to Kua'fon until he is fully grown.
Text: You have made a great deal of progress with Kua'fon. He may not yet possess de power of flight, but he is healthy and growing.Take de success you have made and build upon it. Do not let Pa'ku's lesson dishearten you.Continue to do as you have been. Nurture Kua'fon, build his confidence in his wings. Show him de way forward and he will reward you with a bond stronger than any you have ever known.When his wings are large enough to shade you, we will try again.

Title: Farmers Who Fight
Objective: Recruit 6 Vigil Hill Farmers into the militia.
Text: I was hoping for a squad of Proudmoore Academy's finest, but I guess you'll have to do.What we lack in manpower we make up for in courage! Even the farmers here won't give up their land without a fight.Send the bravest of them to me. They will fight better alongside our marines than by themselves out in the fields!

Title: The War Campaign
Objective: Report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard the Banshee's Wail in Zuldazar.
Text: , a moment of your time.Before you leave the city, speak with me out on the Banshee's Wail, on the docks. I have information to discuss with you about the war against the Alliance.

Title: The War Cache
Objective: Gather 100 War Resources. War Resources can be obtained from many sources, including quests and treasure chests.
Text: First things first. Remember... this is a war.We accomplish nothing by simply adding the Zandalari to our ranks. We eventually need to crush the Alliance.You and I will be leading operations in Kul Tiras. But first, we need resources.

Title: The War Campaign
Objective: Report to Halford Wyrmbane on the Wind's Redemption.
Text: , a moment of your time.Before you leave Boralus, speak with Halford Wyrmbane, High Commander of the 7th Legion. He specifically requested you by name.You can find him aboard the Wind's Redemption, which should be parked in the first slip right outside.

Title: Lost in Darkness
Objective: Return to Katherine Proudmoore in Boralus.
Text: If people are being pulled somewhere else, it would explain why no one has ever returned. I also choose to believe it means Lady Jaina might be able to be saved as well.Go back to Lady Katherine with all speed! She will want to know of this development.

Title: The War Cache
Objective: Gather 100 War Resources. War Resources can be obtained from many sources, including quests and treasure chests.
Text: . Let's talk.This war won't be won simply by adding the Kul Tirans to our ranks. We eventually need to crush the Horde.You and I will be leading an expedition to... disrupt the Horde operations in Zandalar. But first, we need resources.

Title: Fate's End
Objective: Travel to Fate's End and search for signs of Jaina.
Text: Fate's End is a place in turmoil. The seas froth, the air cracks with thunder. We tried to settle there once, but each settlement disappeared into the mists, every soul never to be seen again. The island did not want inhabitants.Now we send our most vile exiles there. They never return and no one knows why.Should we find and recover Jaina, she will be the first. I hope we are not too late.

Title: The Strength of the Storm
Objective: Collected motes of Stormsurge from defeated elementals.
Text: The ritual I must conduct is written on a scroll. To gain access to it, you'll have to break through the dark energies the fallen tidesages have placed around it, with the power of the storm.This relic can be used to pull purified power from the enslaved elementals. Not only will you be gaining the means to our end, you will ultimately be freeing these spirits from corruption.Defeat the enslaved elementals and then call their power into the relic.

Title: Shrine of the Storm: The Missing Ritual
Objective: Go into the Shrine of the Storms, recover the Ritual of Safe Passage and defeat Vol'zith the Whisperer.
Text: The ritual which allows safe passage to Fate's End is a closely guarded secret to keep the curious from venturing there and suffering the same fate as the condemned. I have never conducted it before, but there is a scroll with instructions.It is held in the Shrine of the Storms. To access the scroll, use the staff you have empowered to break the dark energy surrounding it.Collect the Ritual of Safe Passage and bring it to me.

Title: Opening the Way
Objective: Complete the ritual.
Text: Hmm. This ritual is a bit... tricky. No matter, together we will be able to complete it.I shall begin to channel. You will need to activate the runes in the proper order. I shall leave the scroll here so you may consult it.

Title: Ritual Effects
Objective: Collected a Ritual Knife, Ritual Lantern and Ritual Robes from the Fallen Hullwardens and Abyssal Prophets in Tempest's Edge.
Text: I will need some assistance in conducting the ritual to allow us to gain passage to Fate's End. To help me with that, you will require the proper items and attire.Normally I have free access to these things, but the recent upheaval has blocked myself and many of my brothers and sisters from obtaining them easily. However, the fallen tidesages across the span have all you will need.Collect a ritual knife, lantern and robes from the fallen and these so-called prophets.

Title: Raiding the Boulderfist
Objective: Obtain 200 pieces of Unprocessed Iron Ore.
Text: The Boulderfist have been rather active ever since the battle began. One of our scouts reported their recent raid on Galson's Lode proved rather lucrative.Scout the cave to the northeast, find the iron ore they stole and steal it back.We can't afford to let anyone else control our resources.

Title: A Clean Escape
Objective: Return to Boralus and report to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane.
Text: Our victory here will echo through the Horde like a warning shot.Grunts will whisper around the campfire that nowhere is safe from $p and the Alliance.Soldiers will doubt, even for a moment, the strength of their commanders.Sylvanas herself will hear the story of what we did here today, and it will infuriate her. The thought of her outraged roar when she hears the news will keep me warm tonight.Let's return to Boralus and inform the High Commander of the good news.

Title: Ending the San'layn Threat
Objective: Kill Blood Prince Dreven.
Text: Blood Prince Dreven has barricaded himself in the lowest deck of this ship. He's trapped down there.Don't think that makes this easy for us. A cornered beast is more dangerous than a free one. But, if we have the will and wisdom, he can be slain.Follow me. I will break the barrier blocking his lair and we will face him together.

Title: Foul Crystals for Foul People
Objective: Destroy 5 San'layn Crystals.
Text: Blood Prince Dreven and his followers are siphoning power from blood-infused crystals to bolster their unholy abilities.Destroying those crystals will weaken Dreven before we fight him. Take out as many as you can find.

Title: An Unnatural Crew
Objective: Kill 12 Horde crew aboard the Crimson Squall.
Text: Blood Prince Dreven is here, and the situation's even worse than we thought.That monster's training other san'layn. Every neophyte you see on this ship is another future Blood Prince Dreven.His vile practices cannot be allowed to spread within the Horde. We're going to tear the san'layn out, right now, root and all.

Title: Behind Enemy Boats
Objective: Search the Banshee's Wail for signs of Blood Prince Dreven.
Text: This is where our information ends.Blood Prince Dreven is lurking in one of those Forsaken boats, but we don't know which boat or which section of that boat he's in.We'll split up and hit the boats simultaneously, so the Horde has less time to react.If Dreven isn't on the boat you scout, abandon it and join me on the other one. If he's not on my boat, I'll do the same.We'll take down Dreven together.Don't get distracted. Our resources are limited. Dreven is our only target today.

Title: Runic Resistance
Objective: Solve the runic puzzle to activate the Drust Effigy in Gol Inath.
Text: Whatever is going on with this effigy, I don't think it's going to open the gateway without our help.These runes must be the key. There must be some way we can use them to activate the effigy.

Title: Waycrest Manor: Draining the Heartsbane
Objective: Empower Korvash's Skull in the depths of Waycrest Manor.
Text: The skull you have taken from Korvash needs to be steeped in Gorak Tul's magic to grant the power needed to bridge the gap to Thros. You must take it to a font of his power, and let it absorb his magic.You will find one such font in Waycrest Manor - the epicenter of the coven's power. Here, their leader has tapped so freely into Tul's power that it emanates from the very walls.Bring Korvash's skull to the heart of the manor and let it feast. Then, the effigy will be complete.

Title: Broadside Bedlam
Objective: Collect gunpowder, cannonballs, and a torch, then fire the cannons.

Title: Hunting Blood Prince Dreven
Objective: Ride Swiftwing to accompany Falstad and Shandris to the Great Sea.
Text: Between the information I gathered from my scouting mission and Mathias Shaw's intel, we know exactly where Blood Prince Dreven is going to be.We will have our revenge. For ourselves, for my sisters, for the Alliance.We won't underestimate the san'layn this time. We will keep the Horde off-balance and distracted with swift, targeted, ruthless attacks.Thankfully, the Wildhammer are masters of those combat tactics. I'm glad they'll be joining us.Are you ready to leave?

Title: Into Darkness
Objective: Speak with Ensign Josey to send a message to Katherine, then meet her at Gol Inath in the Crimson Forest.
Text: I didn't think you would find a way. Though at this point, I guess I shouldn't be surprised when you accomplish what seems impossible.I guess all that is left is to brave the Crimson Forest and see if this thing works.First, however, Katherine has ordered me to send word when you have found a way to Jaina. You can use one of our falcons to take a message to her.

Title: The Wildhammer Specialty
Objective: Join Falstad and Swiftwing on a bombing run over the Horde ships.
Text: Well, if ye didn't find Blood Prince Dreven on yer ship, he must be hiding on the other one.I can take ye down to it, but the Horde knows we're here now. What do ye say we create some distractions to hold their attention while we hunt down Dreven?Me Wildhammers are itchin' tae let the hammers fly. Ye want to join us for the first round?

Title: WANTED: Ayame
Objective: Hunt down Ayame and obtain its head.
Text: Well equipped exterminator wanted.Huge snake seen lurking north of Fort Victory.Reward offered for anyone who brings in the head of the pest.-Garrick Blacksteel

Title: Hatred's Focus
Objective: Collect Korvash's Skull from Korvash in Gol Osigr.
Text: An effigy requires a central focus. The coven are fond of using animal skulls for this purpose, but for your task you will need something much more potent.Korvash was a trusted lieutenant to Gorak Tul, as well as a powerful sorcerer, until he was defeated at the battle of Arom's Stand. His bones remain at the site of his demise, now buried by the years.Find them, and take his skull.

Title: The Old Bear
Objective: Speak with Ulfar in Ulfar's Den.
Text: I cannot change your mind, can I? Very well, I may know where you can find your answers.High in the mountains, there is a hidden alcove of impossibly verdant growth. It is there that the druids of Kul Tiras train in the old ways of the Drust - from before the time of Gorak Tul.Their leader is a great bear named Ulfar. I know little about him, but few are more qualified to parse the magic of the Drust.You will find a path to his den along Highroad Pass. Good luck, Inquisitor.

Title: Nightmare Catcher
Objective: Collect 4 Intact Drust Bones and 9 Ancient Sinew from Drust skeletons in Gol Osigr.
Text: The effigies crafted by the followers of Gorak Tul were made not of wood, but of the bones and sinew of their enemies. This will be your first task.Travel to Gol Osigr where the ancient Drust have awoken from their slumber. The bones here belong to Gorak Tul's greatest soldiers who stood with him at the final battle against the first Lord Waycrest.Their bones seethe with hatred and anger. This will serve your needs well.

Title: Buried Power
Objective: Use the Dowsing Stone to find and Collect 6 Drust Runestones in Gol Osigr.
Text: Since time immemorial, the Drust have used runes to shape their magics. This remains true of the spells woven by Gorak Tul and his ilk. You will need some of these runes for your effigy to be effective.It is likely that some still exist at the site of his final battle, buried under years of soot and snow.Take this stone. It is empowered with the magic of the Thornspeakers and will react to Tul's spells. With it, you should be able to locate the runes, no matter how deep the ages have buried them.

Title: Hillcrest Pasture
Objective: Claim Hillcrest Pasture for the Horde.
Text: The raid you planned for Hillcrest Pasture in Stormsong Valley was successful. Well done.The outpost is ready to be claimed.Make your way to Hillcrest Pasture in Stormsong Valley and establish fortifications there.Hillcrest Pasture will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Alliance.Go with honor!

Title: Mission Report: Hillcrest Pasture
Objective: Deliver the victory report to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Hillcrest Pasture.It details that victory was hard-fought, but the Stormsong defenders have been slain.Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

Title: Of Myth and Fable
Objective: Meet with Lucille Waycrest at Arom's Stand in Drustvar.
Text: If Jaina is truly trapped in the Blighted Lands, that could mean we're not too late! We just need to find a way inside...We will need to enlist the help of Lucille Waycrest. The legends of that place are deeply rooted in Drustvar's culture. If anyone would know more about it, it would be she.I will send a raven ahead for her to prepare what knowledge she can gather. Make haste to Arom's Stand!

Title: WANTED: Ayame
Objective: Hunt down Ayame and obtain its head.
Text: Wanted: For the death of twelve pilgrims and their escort to Torga's Rest. A reward is offered to anyone who brings in the head of the great serpent, Ayame.-Korkush

Title: Bringing Down the Fleet
Objective: Speak with Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth to sail to Zuldazar.
Text: This is it. We've weakened the Horde enough to make a daring strike on Zuldazar itself.Our forces in Zuldazar still remain hidden, thanks to the help of the Dark Iron dwarves. That gives us our chance to strike.Set sail to Zuldazar. We will be gathering our forces there for a coordinated strike to weaken their harbor defenses.

Title: Make Loh Go
Objective: Learn how to guide Loh.
Text: Hello! We tortollans grow up hearing the stories of Loh, a tortollan who had many adventures. These stories help to challenge a young tortollan's mind as they try to figure out how Loh would make his way through any given adventure.Care to give it a try?

Title: Raiding Their Stores
Objective: Obtain a Roast Boar, a Colossal Cheese Wheel, a Basket of Eggs, and a Keg of Applebrew.
Text: Our rations are low. We need to keep our forces fed if we're to continue our efforts.Before it was overrun, Newstead had plenty of food in their stores. I only hope there's something left.

Title: Battlefield Scavenging
Objective: Gather supplies from Newstead, High Perch and the Circle of Elements.
Text: Our efforts to reclaim the keep have left our supplies a bit lighter than we anticipated. If our forces are to continue, we'll need to restock.Check the enemy camps for anything of value. We'll make use of what you find.

Title: A Load of Scrap
Objective: Use the Scrap-O-Matic 1000 on the pair of Tattered Pants.
Text: Hello, friend. Would you like the scoop on the latest invention of the century? It's called the Scrap-O-Matic 1000 and this device can triple, no QUADRUPLE your production capacity as a crafter of armor, weapons or other gizmos you adventurers wander around with. Here, take these pants and use the Scrap-O-Matic on 'em. You'll get the hang of it.

Title: A Forlorn Hope
Objective: Go to Stormsong and speak with Brother Pike at Kraken's Reach.
Text: I refuse to believe I am too late.No one has ever come back from Fate's End, but if anyone could survive I have to believe it would be my Jaina.Go to Stormsong Valley and secure transit to Fate's End from the tidesages. Brother Pike is a good place to start.Hurry.

Title: The Mysterious Island
Objective: Report to Katherine Proudmoore in Boralus.
Text: Fate's End is just that. It's where the very worst criminals are sent. No one ever comes back.I'm sorry Lady Katherine will have to hear this, but I'm glad it isn't my job to tell her.I'm certain she'll want an update, even if the news is as bad as this.

Title: Resource Recruitment
Objective: Recruit 3 Highlands Peasants to work.
Text: If we're to maintain our iron supply we'll need a bit of help.See if you can wrangle us up a few fresh recruits for the mine.

Title: Iron Stores
Objective: Use the Heavy Iron Key to access the Iron Stores.
Text: While the mine is under Alliance banners our workers ensure the iron supply never runs dry.This key will provide access to the stores. Take what you need.

Title: The Final Foothold
Objective: Use the Kul Tiras Campaign Map to review the final foothold.
Text: We have established two critical footholds in Kul Tiras. The time has come to establish the third.Let's review the battle plan when you're ready.

Title: Room To Grow
Objective: Tend to Kua'fon until he is ready to attempt another flight.
Text: Ah, I would not worry too much about de little one.Some beasts take longer than others to find their way, and Kua'fon is no exception.For now, continue to help him grow. Keep him fed, keep him out of danger, and strengthen your bond. He will let you know when he is ready to try again.

Title: The Final Foothold
Objective: Use the Zandalar Campaign Map to review the final foothold.
Text: We have established two critical footholds in Zandalar. The time has come to establish the third.Let's review the battle plan when you're ready.

Title: Tol Dagor: The Fourth Key
Objective: Enter the Tol Dagor dungeon, recover the Ashvane Skeleton Key and kill Overseer Korgus, then return to Flynn Fairwind in the Harbormaster's Office in Boralus.
Text: Hey, wait a second. I know the type of key our fourth lock needs. This is the same sort of lock the Ashvane company uses. Resists lockpicks like nothing else, but they have a standard skeleton key. There was a set hanging on the wall in the Tol Dagor Armory. Given the state we left it in, it'd be easy to grab it.Taelia and I will take the chest back to the Harbormaster's office for safe keeping.You go in to Tol Dagor and get that last key!

Title: The Blackwood Den
Objective: Drive the furbolgs out of the Blackwood Den.
Text: We have not moved all of our troops into Darkshore yet, but I think we have enough to justify establishing a foothold somewhere. I know just the place.Just south of here is the Blackwood Den. Its inhabitants, the Furbolgs, have been driven in to a hysteria. With our enemies pouring from the North, the Furbolg threat is a nuisance we cannot afford.I will lead another squad past the wall while you... negotiate with the Furbolgs.

Title: No-Landing Zone
Objective: Slay Burnsy the Blade, Wiley Jaki, and Skullcrusher Cotner.
Text: These pirates are ruthless - they're bringing in landing boats to cut off our escape!The guards are down at the riverside holding them off, but I'm afraid they'll be overrun before my family and I can get away!

Title: A Wild Ride
Objective: Join the battle at Wildbend River.
Text: Let me tell ya, kid... this may be some of the best work I've ever done!Now that the upgrades are in place, there's no time to waste.The battle is raging over at Wildbend River. Take the modified hellion into battle and give 'em hell!

Title: Infusing the Heart
Objective: Absorb Azerite to empower the Heart of Azeroth.
Text: Azeroth's voice is growin' fainter and fainter. If the seal on this chamber shatters, her soul will be lost!We've got one chance tae save us all.Absorb the Azerite around the chamber into the Heart of Azeroth. Then unleash the amulet's power tae seal that crack in the center of the seal.Azerite can be a destructive force, but if it's channeled through yer amulet, it can heal the world!

Title: The Start of Something Good
Objective: Follow Sylvanas to Nazj'vel.
Text: While the rest of our army sets up camp -- you should follow me. I spotted something... interesting... on my way back from Zoram'gar.I'll admit, not even I could have predicted such fortuitous happenstance.Come with me. And bring a pickaxe.

Title: Mission Report: Windfall Cavern
Objective: Deliver the victory report to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Windfall Cavern.It details that victory was hard-fought, but Gravemaul has been slain.Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

Title: Windfall Cavern
Objective: Claim Windfall Cavern for the Horde.
Text: The raid you planned for Windfall Cavern in Stormsong Valley was successful. Well done.The outpost is ready to be claimed.Make your way to Windfall Cavern in Stormsong Valley and establish fortifications there.Windfall Cavern will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Alliance.Go with honor!

Title: Mission Report: Mudfisher Cove
Objective: Deliver the victory report to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Mudfisher Cove.It details that victory was hard-fought, but all of the guards previously defending the outpost have been slain.Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

Title: Mudfisher Cove
Objective: Claim Mudfisher Coast for the Horde.
Text: The raid you planned for Mudfisher Cove in Drustvar was successful. Well done.The outpost is ready to be claimed.Make your way to Mudfisher Cove in Drustvar and establish fortifications there.The cove will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Alliance.Move quickly!

Title: No Ptake, Only Throw
Objective: Throw Kua'fon's favorite skull.
Text: Skree!

Title: Nature Versus Nurture
Objective: Tend to Kua'fon until he is ready to fly.
Text: Greetings. I am Wingminder Goja.I overheard the ordeal that Pa'ku has laid at your feet. I can help you.I oversee this roost at my loa's pleasure. I have seen many eggs become glorious beasts of war. It will be a long road ahead, with many trials to overcome, but de companionship of a pterrordax be a worthy reward.For now, de little one is young. Simply tend to his needs while he stays in de nest. When he is ready to take on de world he will let you know.Good luck.

Title: Sweete's Strongbox
Objective: Open Harlan Sweete's Strongbox.
Text: You've got the keys, and Taelia's still watching our backs. So let's head up to Sweete's, ah, "office" and liberate the documents in that strongbox.Come on, it's across the bridge with the rest of his treasure.

Title: Intercepted Orders
Objective: Discuss the plan with Alliance leadership.
Text: Good to see you again.Mathias and I are discussing what to do with new intel that his SI:7 agents procured for us.The intercepted letter contains orders from Warchief Sylvanas for an operation the Horde is undertaking at sea.This could be a rare opportunity, or a distraction. The letter is purposefully light on details, and it's unclear if we should make this a top priority or focus on our other missions.Do you have a moment to talk through this with Mathias and me?

Title: Fallen Idols
Objective: Collect Stolen Idols of Krag'wa from the blood troll camp in the Frogmarsh.
Text: Little creature, please... listen to me.I am Krag'wa.Once, my worshipers were many and my powers great. Now, my followers are all but gone. What little power I have left was placed within several idols, but the idols have been stolen by the heretical blood trolls.I ask you, please recover my idols so that I can become whole once more!

Title: Victory is Assured
Objective: Meet Halford Wyrmbane at Xibala in Zuldazar.
Text: Our task is finished. You've planted the bombs on two of the Zandalari's major flagships, and Keeshan has helped with the remainder.Let's return to Halford, the sooner we're done here, the better. It's far too risky for us to be at the Zandalari's doorstep.

Title: My Enemy's Enemy is My Disguise
Objective: Speak with Magister Umbric to be disguised as a blood troll.
Text: We need you to kill several targets within Warport Rastari, but we also cannot reveal that the Alliance is here.Umbric has uncovered a ritual from Nazmir that will grant you a blood troll disguise. It is grim, but it must be done.You will go through with the ritual, then use my invisibility flask to sneak into the Warport.If discovered, the Zandalari and Horde will think it's a bold attack from the blood trolls... and not from the Alliance.

Title: Intelligence Denial
Objective: Kill Spymaster Stormhorn, Spymaster Bloodsnarl, and Spymaster Bilespreader.
Text: There are three Horde spymasters stationed within Warport Rastari. They are giving the Zandalari information on the Alliance fleet.We need these targets killed. We cannot allow the Zandalari to get any advantageous information on our fleet.Luckily for us, your blood troll disguise means any witnesses will believe this to be a bold attack by the blood trolls.

Title: Sabotaging the Pa'ku
Objective: Plant 4 Remote-Detonation Deathbombs beneath the Breath of Pa'ku.
Text: Our first job is to plant some bombs along these ships. I'll take care of the smaller ships, you deal with the Breath of Pa'ku.Whatever that means.Kelsey says these bombs are the latest in gnome technology. We plant 'em and she can detonate them at any time.Let's get moving, and remember, this whole plan works as long as they don't see us plantin' these bombs.

Title: Right Beneath Their Nose
Objective: Plant 3 Remote-Detonation Deathbombs within the main warship in Warport Rastari.
Text: We must continue with our primary goal, plant bombs on major Zandalari ships. There is one docked within the Warport.You know what to do. Get beneath the boat, plant the bombs, and ensure no one sees... a blood troll using bombs.My invisibility flask will give you the stealth you need, and Umbric believes the ritual will give you some other power to tap into.

Title: Ship Logs
Objective: Recover 6 Naval Records from Zandalari and Mogu.
Text: We've got mogu and Zandalari working together on the Breath of Pa'ku. They've got records on the Zandalari fleet's ships.We've been making educated guesses regarding the Zandalari fleet. It's time to upgrade our intel.Go in there and get the naval records from anyone on board that ship.Oh, and take these jet boots. You'll need them to reach the boat if you're planting bombs on the hull.

Title: Under the Cover of Swiftwing
Objective: Ride Swiftwing to the Isle of Fangs.
Text: Aye! So we be the first in this crazy operation. We'll be hitchin' a ride on Swiftwing to tha Isle of Fangs.The Zandalari got one of their main ships there, called the Breath of Pa'ku, whatever that is.Hop on ta Swiftwing when yer ready te go. It's gonna get real cozy on there with all of ye comin' aboard.

Title: Void Vacation
Objective: Use the Portal Orb on 6 Horde Emissaries.
Text: The Horde have sent emissaries to help with their potential alliance with the Zandalari.These emissaries are also sharing secrets that the Horde have regarding the Alliance. We need to put a stop to this.Take this orb. It will create a void portal above the target and pull them... somewhere else.

Title: The Enlarged Miniaturized Submarine
Objective: Ride Kelsey's Enlarged Miniaturized Submarine to Warport Rastari.
Text: Our next target is a ship docked in a place across from here, the Warport Rastari.Lucky for you, I can get us all there in my enlarged miniaturized submarine.Shandris Feathermoon and Magister Umbric should be waiting for you on the coast of Warport Rastari.Let's get going!
