Title: How to Sink a Zandalari Battleship
Objective: Go over the plan to weaken the Zandalari naval fleet with Halford.
Text: Let's go over our plan of attack, but remember above all things, the Zandalari cannot know our full forces are here.If they were to discover an Alliance base within the shadow of their empire... we would be wiped out in an instant.

Title: Swiftwind Post
Objective: Claim Swiftwind Post for the Horde.
Text: The raid you planned for Swiftwind Post in Drustvar was successful. Well done.The outpost is ready to be claimed.Make your way to Swiftwind Post in Drustvar and establish fortifications there.Swiftwind Post will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Alliance.Go with honor!

Title: Mission Report: Swiftwind Post
Objective: Deliver the victory report to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Swiftwind Post.It details that victory was hard-fought, but all of the wicker beasts previously infesting the outpost have been slain.Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

Title: A Looming Threat
Objective: Rally the kaldorei forces in Darnassus.
Text: If we hope to push the Horde out of our lands, we must call upon all the strength our people have to offer.Go, seek out the druids, the priestesses, our sentinels! Make the call to arms, and watch as the kaldorei rise to action. Only together can we hope to end the stalemate at the Wildbend River.When you are finished, report to Malfurion Stormrage. He awaits our fleet in Rut'theran Village.

Title: Gallywix Got Away
Objective: Return to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane on the Wind's Redemption in Boralus.
Text: I must confess my disappointment that we were not able to bring an end to Gallywix's greedy reign today.But I blame no one but myself, and will report the same to the High Commander. Your performance was exemplary, just as I expected.I hope the Alliance will not lose faith in the void elves because of this. We have much to offer.When you're ready, I will open a final Void portal to take us back to Boralus.

Title: We Have Him Cornered
Objective: Kill Trade Prince Gallywix.
Text: Did you hear Gallywix barking orders to his servants and thugs? Still concerned with frivolities as we edge ever closer.He feels safe in his petulant palace of profits. He should not.Even here, we will strike down Trade Prince Gallywix. For the Alliance!

Title: The Keys to Success in Freehold
Objective: Collect the keys from Irontide Lieutenants.
Text: I've been known to be a betting man, and I'd place good odds on the information we need being in Harlan Sweete's Strongbox. This would be far too valuable to put anywhere else. I bet they haven't even moved the chest. The problem is the security features.See, the chest is locked by three keys and he gave each one to a different lieutenant. We'll need to get those.But between your skills, my finesse and Taelia's air support this will be easy.

Title: She Sells Seashells
Objective: Gather shells for Jenny.
Text: Papa wanted to go fishing, and mum is working, so he brought me along.But I'm bored! I'm trying to sell some of the shells I found washed up on the beach, but nobody seems to be stopping. I don't think my shells are pretty enough...You don't seem like you're afraid of those big snakes on the beach. Can you bring me back some prettier shells? Only the shiniest please!

Title: Malfurion Returns
Objective: Find Malfurion at the Wildbend River.
Text: Do you hear his voice?Malfurion seeks our aid! Keep your head high. The ancients stand with you this day.

Title: I Take No Pleasure In This
Objective: Crash Gallywix's party.
Text: I knew that Gallywix was selfish and wasteful, but this... this is too much.His bloated pride has blacked out the sun of good leadership. He hoards the wealth of his people to satiate his gluttony, greed, and lust while his people toil under his calloused heel.And, maybe worse, opportunistic socialites from all across the Horde revel in the depravity.All people of Azeroth deserve better than this. We must teach these spoiled cowards a lesson.

Title: "Rock" The World
Objective: Join the Ancients to slay Horde enemies.
Text: We do not fight alone.This day, the ancients will bear you in their branches. Hold back nothing in your defense of our forests!

Title: An Explosive Entrance
Objective: Collect 100 Large Azerite Grenades from the Ashvane Foundry.
Text: A hat and some smooth talking won't get us in to Freehold this time, so I'm thinking explosives. And I'm thinking we steal them from Ashvane. Fair's fair, right? She takes something from Lady Katherine, we take some Azerite empowered grenades from Ashvane.Okay, so it's not really the same, but you get where I'm going with this.Head over to Ashvane's Foundry. Grab the biggest Azerite Grenades you can get your hands on.While you do that I'm going to get us some air support.

Title: Chasing Gallywix
Objective: Find and chase Trade Prince Gallywix.
Text: Look at this... The goblins are looting ancient ornamentation like they're hoarding food at a buffet. What a disgrace.But we do not have time to get bogged down in everything happening here. Gallywix will soon know that we have arrived.We should not hesitate in ascending these stairs and locating Gallywix. I am certain that he will be wherever the thieves are carrying their treasure.Oh, and please do take care. The Zandalari do not typically leave places like this unguarded.

Title: Lost Shipment
Objective: Search the Ashvane Offices for information on where Jaina was taken.
Text: I let grief cloud my judgment and Jaina may have already paid the ultimate price for my mistake. Yet, I hold out hope she lives.I do not know where Jaina was taken after Ashvane's people took her from the Keep. The records in their offices here in Boralus will surely tell you where they took her., you helped my people when I thought I did not need it. I ask for your help again now. Save my daughter's life!

Title: The Wake of Something New
Objective: Find the source of Onu's pain.
Text: The disturbance has become more severe. I am sensing a powerful force in our midst. It is unlike anything I have felt before. It comes from the earth itself.You and Delaryn Summermoon must seek it out. Go to the water's edge, to the place you call Nazj'vel.

Title: A Greedy Goblin's Paradise
Objective: Use the Magister Umbric's Void Portal to join him in Atal'Dazar.
Text: The Zandalari have many powerful and ancient artifacts tucked away on this island, hidden from view.But some of their treasures are more... conspicuous.It is no surprise that Trade Prince Gallywix was unable to resist the allure of Atal'Dazar, a massive city made entirely of gold.Come with me and we will hunt him down together.

Title: Garden Grove
Objective: Defeat the Monstrous Shredder.
Text: Curse those goblins and their infernal machines!They are using a shredder to desecrate our sacred grove.We need that monstrosity taken down!

Title: Enraged Furbolgs
Objective: Find those who cry for help within the Blackwood Den.
Text: The ancients of the forest are all connected to one another. We can sense a disturbance from deep within our roots.I can feel it now... the rumble of their footsteps in the distance, the thundering clamor of war. With every branch they break, they awaken the ancients.Soon my brethren will answer in kind, for nothing shall disrupt the balance of nature.A disturbance is near. Our kindred spirits cry for help. Seek it out and restore balance.

Title: Atal'Dazar: An Unbreakable Bone Needle
Objective: Travel to Atal'Dazar and collect Rezan's Bone Fragment.
Text: Hey, lookin' for work? I've heard through Alliance Intelligence that the trolls have a dead god or something similar. 'Rezan' I think was the name, over in Atal'Dazar. After the last time I broke a bone needle, I can't help but think that one made from the bone of a god has got to be indestructible, right? I want you to retrieve one of his bones. Or at least something big enough that I can carve an eye in and use. In return, I'll show you everything that I know about harvesting bones.

Title: Hidden Amongst the Leaves
Objective: Find 8 hidden Druids of the Claw.
Text: When the Horde invaded, I did my best to thwart them but it is unknown how many forces have made passage already. This wall will slow them down, but it will not halt their attack entirely.Do you hear that, hero? The Ancients call to us!We must protect them at all costs! They see what our eyes cannot see, and hear what our ears cannot perceive.I have druids in the Twilight Vale. Find them. Send them to the Grove of the Ancients. I will reinforce the wall.

Title: Bone Needle
Objective: Collect an Immaculate Quill.
Text: Hey, can you do me a favor? I was sewing shut a battle wound in this skin, when my last bone needle broke, and now I need to get a new one. I've seen quilrats on the coast of Drustvar, one of their spines should do the trick. Bring me one in perfect condition, and I'll teach you how to harvest more bones when skinning.  Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to go see a healer before this gets infected.

Title: Brinepinch
Objective: Kill Brinepinch, and bring its "head" to Camilla Darksky.
Text: You! ! I have a business proposition for you. There is a monstrous crab nesting in some of my favorite hunting grounds. I've already been forced out of some areas because of the sirens, I'm not about to lose more to a CRAB! Bring me the head of Brinepinch! In return I'll teach you how to get more leather when skinning.  Sorry, most creatures that wrong me have heads. Just bring me some part of it as proof of its death.

Title: Turtle Soup
Objective: Loot 5 Sulphur Speckled Skins from Enriched Rockshells.
Text: I cannot believe that I'm constantly stuck in this city! You'd help me out, right? You see, I've heard about these turtles that have been living in hot springs. What makes it interesting is that some of the sulphur from the water has soaked into their scales to give them interesting patterns. I'm too busy to go check myself, but if you could go get me some of their skins, I'd be more than willing to teach you everything else I know about skinning anything with scales in exchange.

Title: In Pursuit of Fashion
Objective: Loot 3 Pristine Saurolisk Skins from Shallows Saurolisks in Drustvar.
Text: Despite me REPEATEDLY stating that I'm not a leatherworker, one of the fat nobles of this city has commissioned me to make him a belt of 'the finest saurolisk' hide. So... I'm just going to get the materials together, give them and some of the gold to Cassandra to make the actual belt, and pocket the difference. That said, I need you to bring me saurolisk leather, enough to circle a very wide lord. For your efforts, I'll look at the skins and see if I can give you pointers on how to harvest more.

Title: Stonefist Watch
Objective: Claim Stonefist Watch for the Horde.
Text: The raid you planned for Stonefist Watch in Tiragarde Sound was successful. Well done.The outpost is ready to be claimed.Make your way to Stonefist Watch in Tiragarde Sound and establish fortifications there.Stonefist Watch will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Alliance.Go with honor!

Title: Ivory Handled Dagger
Objective: Return the Ivory Handled Dagger to Camilla Darksky.
Text: While skinning the beast, you feel a lump within the beast's stomach. Investigating further, you find what appears to be a dagger with a beautifully etched ivory handle. Carefully extracting it, you wonder if Camilla Darksky might know something about this.

Title: Mission Report: Stonefist Watch
Objective: Deliver the victory report to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Stonefist Watch.It details that victory was hard-fought, but all of the bandits previously living in the outpost have been slain.Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.

Title: Target: Blood Prince Dreven
Objective: Meet Keeshan within the Collapsed Tunnels in Nazmir.
Text: We must kill Blood Prince Dreven and his followers. I know of the place where they intend to go. Here is the plan.You and Keeshan will make your way to the tunnels and act as bait, lure Dreven into a false sense of security.Myself and the sentinels will seal the entrance to trap him and his allies shortly thereafter.Then we kill them all. I'll send word to the others to get moving.Let's go.

Title: Hexoskeleton
Objective: Collect an Unbroken Makrura Carapace.
Text: I have a bet going with Xanjo over what leather is de best for armor in regards to resisting piercing and slashing attacks. He says scales are the best, but I have something better in mind. I feel de makrura's exoskeleton could be treated to act as a natural plate armor. Bring me de carapace of a bittertide makrura, and I will teach you how to harvest bones more effectively from creatures you're skinning.

Title: A Thicker Thread
Objective: Loot 5 Strands of Thick Webbing from Jungleweb Crawlers in Vol'Dun.
Text: ! I was hoping you would show up! Xanjo is nearly finished with de suit of ceremonial armor he has been working on, but dere is a problem. He says dat de thread he used is too thin, and dat de weight of de leather is ripping out de stitching. He asked me to get something dat will hold, and de best thing I can think of is de thick webbing of jungleweb crawlers. You can find dem in northern Vol'dun. Bring me back some strands of their thick webbing, and my knowledge of scales is yours.

Title: Loa Fit For A King
Objective: Collect Rezan's Bone Fragment.
Text: Hey! Come here. Shh. Closer.  I have something I want you to do for me. It may be just a touch sacreligous, but... well... Rezan was once de loa of kings, but he has been taken to Atal'Dazar, and it grieves me what has happened to him. I want you to go dere, and bring me back a bone of his. Not even a whole bone. A splinter. I don't care how small. Please do dis for me, and I will teach you everything I know about gathering bones while skinning.

Title: Ceremonial Vestments
Objective: Collect 3 Pristine Skins from Primal Snapjaws in Nazmir.
Text: Xanjo asked dat I gather de materials for him to make some ceremonial armor. He requested several pieces of crocolisk hide, but all de hides I have are flawed or scarred. I need you to bring me a handful of fresh crocolisk hides dat are pristine. De best source dat I know of are de primal snapjaws in Nazmir, as their hide is usually thick enough to avoid getting scarred when dey fight. If you do dat for me, I will show you how to better harvest scales from, well... scaly creatures.

Title: Ancient Skinning Knife
Objective: Return the Ancient Skinning Knife to Rana the Cutta.
Text: Within the scarred flesh of the beast, you find a notched golden blade embedded under its skin. Carefully extracting the blade, you can't help but feel like this is an old Zandalari skinning knife. You should show this to Rana the Cutta.

Title: Sending Out An SOS
Objective: Speak to the Captain.
Text: I noticed an exodus from the fleet, far out in the harbor.Flyers were sent out, they seek something, or someone.Those ships made a great journey, and they have much work ahead.Please check in with Captain Grez'ko. I am sure he could use a hand!

Title: Meeting of the Minds
Objective: Meet Shandris Feathermoon outside of Zo'bal Ruins.
Text: We're in luck. The missive details a meeting in Zo'bal Ruins between Talanji, Rokhan, Areiel, and Blood Prince Dreven.This is our chance to gain more intel on Dreven and his next move. He killed our soldiers in Vol'dun, it's time for him to pay.Meet me outside of Zo'bal Ruins. We're going to sneak into the ruins, listen to their plans, and decide what to do next.

Title: Bilgewater Bonanza Go Boom
Objective: Kill 12 Bilgewater goblins and open Void Tears to summon void elf allies.
Text: I have met very few goblins that I respect, but I must give them universal credit for one thing: they are persistent.The Bilgewater Cartel, Trade Prince Gallywix's gang, has already sent a full set of replacement miners to extract Azerite from the beach site nearby.I am certain the Alliance will be pleased if you interrupt their mining operations again.My regiment is available to aid you, but our combat tactics are unconventional. When you wish our help, call into the Void and we will answer.

Title: The Void Solution
Objective: Use Magister Umbric's Void Shard to destroy 4 Bilgewater Frackers.
Text: The Bilgewater Cartel are serious about protecting their investment at the mining site. My trackers have reported a heavy presence of large mech suits used for breaking rocks and suppressing attackers.I am certain that you could deal with the mechs yourself, but you need not waste your time doing so.Take this void shard and use it to cast the large mechs into the Void, where they won't be able to bother anyone again.

Title: Find the Paper Trail
Objective: Collect Orders From Gallywix.
Text: The High Commander's intelligence was confident that Trade Prince Gallywix is currently in Zuldazar, but my trackers could not locate him within the Bilgewater camp. He's most likely somewhere nearby.Goblins do not work for free. Someone is bound to be bossing around the rest of those miners. Locate whoever is in charge, eliminate them, and search for anything that might tell us where Gallywix is.

Title: Life Held Hostage
Objective: Help Nathanos Blightcaller with the last of Proudmoore's forces.
Text: As Lilian has pointed out, it seems we have a final visitor.Shall we go pay him a visit?

Title: What You May Regret
Objective: Meet with Genn Greymane at the memorial by Proudmoore Keep.
Text: , Genn Greymane left this letter for you. He indicated it was urgent. I was just about to send for you.",You have helped to unite the Kul Tirans and gained their support for the Alliance. Perhaps now you might be able to help reunite a mother with her daughter.Meet me at the family memorial by Proudmoore Keep. With luck we can convince Lord Admiral Proudmoore to grant her daughter a stay of execution.- Genn Greymane "

Title: Long Away
Objective: Regroup with Malfurion and Delaryn at Darnassus.
Text: For every foe we slay, two more take their place.We are too few in number to stand toe to toe. We must fall back. Strategy can yet overcome numbers.We will regroup at Darnassus. I will send for Delaryn.

Title: The Aid of the Tides
Objective: Talk to Nathanos Blightcaller and return to Zuldazar.
Text: With Derek's body and the Abyssal Scepter in stow, our undertaking here today is complete. Let us escape under their noses.When you are ready, let us return to Zuldazar. Sylvanas will want to hear of our victories.

Title: Forfeit Souls
Objective: Kill 8 Tidesage Archvists or Tidesage Summoners in Stormsong Monastery.
Text: The tidesages here have given in to dark magics. They have submitted themselves to powers they do not understand, and my people have suffered for it.I knew them once, my brothers and sisters in the tides. But now they are lost.I guess I am too.Redeem the name of the tidesages! Kill these betrayers!

Title: Tidesage Teachings
Objective: Collect 5 Tomes of Tidesage Research in Stormsong Monastery.
Text: These people are not tidesages anymore. They do not deserve to bear our title, our prestige, or our knowledge.So many of our teachings lay scattered around this monastery, potentially lost to those of us that remain.We must reclaim these writings. Better in my hands than theirs.

Title: A Well Placed Portal
Objective: Use the Portal to Boralus and meet with Thomas Zelling in Stormsong Monastery.
Text: We have the front here under control. I am sending you and Zelling into Boralus to acquire the Abyssal Scepter.Oculeth has managed to pinpoint a safe location for a portal. Get moving.

Title: Relics of Ritual
Objective: Collect the Compass of Clarity, the Curio of the Depths, and the Key of the Sea in Stormsong Monastery.
Text: There is a reason why I am accompanying you on this mission, and it's more than familiarity. The Abyssal Scepter is locked behind a ritual, the components for which are held by three separate lieutenants spread across the compound.You get the relics, I perform the ritual, we grab the Scepter and we get out.

Title: When a Plan Comes Together
Objective: Listen to Nathanos' plan, then travel to Plunder Harbor.
Text: Having Derek Proudmoore's body in our possession is a greater boon than we had planned for.Valentine is risen, but I think it best to allow Derek to lay dead for a bit longer.It's time to use our new allies to our advantage.

Title: They Can't Stay Here
Objective: Kill 12 Horde soldiers within the Necropolis.
Text: Can't believe the Horde already have a foothold in the Necropolis. We have to stop them.This one's simple. Kill as many Horde as you find in that cursed place, but keep your eye out for a fella named Bwonsamdi.Seems like he's some sort of death god. He's way beyond anything we can handle, but why not send a few of his followers his way?Better they rot in his necropolis than bother the living.

Title: Gaining the Upper Hand
Objective: Aid Zelling in retrieving the Abyssal Scepter from Stormsong Monastery.
Text: We need to retrieve the Abyssal Scepter and get out of here before the Kul Tirans break our line in Plunder Harbor.I did some research while you were gone. I believe I uncovered the location where the ritual must take place.When you are ready to go, we can make our way over.

Title: One Option: Fire
Objective: Burn Bwonsamdi Offerings, Armory Supplies, Food Cache, and Medicinal Supplies in the Necropolis.
Text: Here I thought things couldn't get worse, but now we have the Horde making camp around the home of some death god.I've got a good idea of what they've brought, thanks to my time in the first three wars. Medicine, armor, food...And probably offerings for this Bwonsamdi fella. Destroy all of these supplies to let the Horde know we won't let them stay here.

Title: The Void Elves Stand Ready
Objective: Speak with Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth and travel to Xibala.
Text: Bal'a dash. Alleria and the others have informed me of your many accomplishments here in Kul Tiras.I'm honored to join you on this mission. As a representative for the void elves, I am eager to prove to King Anduin that his trust in us was well-placed.Forgive me, do not allow me to delay you.Alleria and the others can brief me on the mission as we travel. You may tell the Grand Admiral that we are ready to set sail whenever you like.

Title: Ending Areiel
Objective: Recover the Horde Missive from Captain Areiel.
Text: The tortollans have given us Captain Areiel's location, as well as new information. She carries a missive from the Horde.Any missive the Horde would send to Areiel must be extremely important. We must recover it and deliver the information to Halford.Areiel and I once fought side by side. She's incredibly powerful, Keeshan and I will be there to help you bring her down.Good luck.

Title: The Savage Hunt
Objective: Kill 15 blood trolls and their allies within Torga's Rest.
Text: The blood trolls in Nazmir are monsters, pure and simple. No culture, no empathy, they only exist to destroy.Let's kill 'em and let whatever dark god they worship sort them out.

Title: Tortollans in Distress
Objective: Rescue 6 Tortollan Captives from the blood trolls.
Text: Our first task is to rescue the tortollans captured by the blood trolls.Keeshan's report indicates the tortollans are familiar with all things Nazmir. They should know about the Horde's operations here.The tortollans tend to stay neutral in most matters. They'll give us details on the Horde's plans if we make a fair trade.We'll meet afterwards at our other outpost, Redfield's Watch, north of Torga's Rest.

Title: How to Kill a Dark Ranger
Objective: Listen to Shandris Feathermoon's plan.
Text: Let's go over the plan. We don't get many chances to kill a captain of Sylvanas's dark rangers.

Title: Everburning
Objective: Assist in the ceremony by the statue in Arom's Stand.
Text: My people have suffered loss and pain, struggling in the darkness that covered Drustvar. But now we have some light back. We have the means and the will to reclaim our lands from the lingering evils. Your help has brought much of that about.I will miss my parents. Though their end was dark, they were family. But my duty as the head of House Waycrest is clear. The dead can handle themselves. I must attend to the living and lead.There is a short ceremony I need to conduct. Would you assist me?

Title: Our Next Target
Objective: Listen to the Alliance leadership debate the plan.
Text: Welcome back.We're ready to set sail on our next mission.... Now we just need to reach an agreement on where we're headed.General Feathermoon and I disagree on which Horde target we should prioritize next. But if you'll give me just a moment, I'm confident I can convince her the value of my strategy and we'll be swiftly on our way.I've considered every reasonable alternative. This is the best course of action.

Title: A Nation United
Objective: Attend the council meeting at Unity Square.
Text: You've done a fine job here.With the city secure and Jaina in command of the fleet, the time has come for Kul Tiras to formally join the Alliance.King Anduin has already departed for Unity Square to meet with Jaina, Katherine and the heads of the major Kul Tiran houses.They are waiting for you.

Title: Crippling the Horde
Objective: Speak with Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth to sail to Nazmir.
Text: Our scouts report that one of Sylvanas's dark ranger captains is in Nazmir.The dark rangers are Sylvanas's deadliest fighters and scouts. Killing one of their leaders will cripple Horde operations.Shandris Feathermoon will be leading the operation in Nazmir. Head there now and strike before we lose this chance.

Title: Siege of Boralus: Lady Ashvane's Return
Objective: Complete the Siege of Boralus dungeon.
Text: If Ashvane thinks we will sit idly by as she attempts a coup, she is sorely mistaken. The citizens of Boralus will fight her to a man.I'll need you on the front lines to aid them. Go with Taelia to the docks and engage the enemy.With a little luck, we may just make it out of this alive.

Title: Freehold: A Pirate's End
Objective: Slay Harlan Sweete in the Freehold dungeon.
Text: Hey, uh, I don't usually ask for help with personal business, but I know when I'm outmatched.Someone's gotta take down Harlan.He's a maniac. The things I saw him do back in the day... that's why I left Freehold in the first place.H-hey don't think of it as a favor for me--even though it would be a HUGE favor--think of it as making the seas safer for everyone, or something noble like that.Plus there's a big fat bounty on his head!

Title: The Proof of Piracy
Objective: Destroy 6 pirate Rum Stashes.
Text: One thing pirates love more than gold is rum. So we're going to find their rum stashes and blow them up. With the rum all gone, a lot of the pirates should move on.Use my special barrel busting bombs to destroy the pirates' hidden rum stashes.

Title: Blood on the Sand
Objective: Wait for Guzbert Gizmoflank and Kelsey Steelspark to return.
Text: And with that, our mission is done.Let's verify that Guzbert and Kelsey return safely from their demo sites, and then we can head back to friendlier shores.

Title: To Matters at Hand
Objective: Speak with Princess Talanji within the Great Seal.
Text: Princess Talanji should be ready to speak with you regarding how to save our empire.I would go speak with her now. She has a planning area set up nearby.

Title: Power Problems
Objective: Check in with Rozzy.
Text: Rozzy, part of the extraction crew, headed out with some gear to work on a plan to keep these reconfigulators all charged up.Go see see if she could use some help!

Title: Deadliest Cache: Carpe Diem
Objective: Listen to Coxswain Hook's tale.
Text: Bah, don't listen to these landlubbers. They haven't fished an honest day in their lives!Before they met me they were as dry as the sands o' the shoreline at low tide.I'll spin ye the tale o' the day we met. 'Twas also the day I saved the wharf from the biggest, meanest, largest monster o' the briny deep ye could imagine!

Title: Ferry Pass
Objective: Speak with Cyrus Crestfall and receive the Ferry Pass.
Text: Here, this will give you access to the ferry system.

Title: We Need Each Other
Objective: Listen to Princess Talanji.
Text: My father believes he is indulging me. He has ruled for two hundred years, many lifetimes of trolls. In his mind, de threats dat face our kingdom are minor. I have seen too much to believe dat. So since my father and his advisors would not help, I turned to someone who would. Your warchief needs our fleet, and I need her champions. So here is what we need to do.

Title: To Be Forsaken
Objective: Go with Lilian Voss to find Thomas Zelling.
Text: Let's move. Zelling is probably with his family now.Either they're happily reunited and he helps us find Valentine... or he just helps us find Valentine.Let's go.

Title: The Wolf's Den
Objective: Claim Wolf's Den for the Horde.
Text: The raid you planned on Wolf's Den in Tiragarde Sound was successful. Well done.The outpost is ready to be claimed.Make your way to Wolf's Den in Tiragarde Sound and establish fortifications there.Wolf's Den will be an essential outpost in our campaign against the Alliance.Go with honor!

Title: Honoring a True Leader
Objective: Meet Master Gadrin at the Golden Road in Zuldazar.
Text: Vol'jin. I have often felt our old chieftain's spirit whisperin' to me. His strength was da lifeblood of da Darkspear tribe. Some would even say he was da spirit of da true Horde. Princess Talanji's offer is a great one. I shall travel with Vol'jin's ashes to Atal'Dazar. If ya be wishin' to join us for dis procession, meet us upon da famed Golden Road.

Title: Deliverance
Objective: Bring supplies to Ranger Encampment in Gol Koval.
Text: Mainlander! Stop a moment, I could really use a hand!My team and I were hunting in the ruins of Gol Koval when the stones began to attack us! I've never seen anything like that before. Ranger Wons sent Duke and I to get some medical supplies for our injured.Duke didn't get hit by those possessed stone monsters but he wasn't as fortunate with the spiders nearby. He'll be okay if he rests here for awhile, but my team needs these medical supplies!Please take these to Ranger Wons!

Title: Cutting Out the Competition
Objective: Pick up a Sturdy Axe, then gather 5 Freshly-Chopped Wood from the nearby Sapling.
Text: I've never cared much for battle, but I'll be damned if those fiends think they're gettin' this mill.Best if we clear the area quickly. Grab an axe and show me what you got.

Title: A Soft Glow
Objective: Find Malfurion in Ashenvale.
Text: The wisps... they sing with sorrow, but also with purpose. The forest stirs, aglow with their light.That sound... in the distance. Could it be our Shan'do?Quickly! Malfurion beckons!

Title: Boned
Objective: Defeat 8 Vengeful Bones.
Text: If the living rocks weren't bad enough, it seems the undead are hauling themselves out of the ground, too!This used to be a Drust settlement, so those are probably Drust bones. They hated us and the feeling is definitely mutual right now.I don't know what has them stirred up, but they're a danger to us and everyone else. Take them out and I'll reward you for the work.

Title: Vol'jin, Son of Sen'jin
Objective: Escort Vol'jin's Ashes to Atal'Dazar.
Text: Even in da Echo Isles we have heard of da traditions of da Golden Road. We must walk in da presence of royalty and hail da accomplishments of Vol'jin so dat his spirit be welcome here amongst da ancient kings. I shall carry da ashes, if you light da fires. Know that any member of any other tribe may contest us. As our champion, we will need you to fend them off if they do.

Title: More Fodder
Objective: Speak to Leo Shealds at Deadwash.
Text: Leo Shealds at Deadwash is a crook, but he recognizes the threat the naga pose. He'll send men to help us if we ask, even if most are just fodder.Travel to Deadwash and ask for help.

Title: Bauer Backup
Objective: Speak to Lieutenant Bauer at Seabreeze Village.
Text: We've not heard anything from the coast since the Horde attack started. I need you to check in on Lieutenant Bauer at Seabreeze Village and see that they're safe.

Title: Helping Out, Somewhere Else
Objective: Speak to Lieutenant Bauer at Seabreeze Village.
Text: You've been a big help and now we've got a lot of gold to divvy up!You should go west to Seabreeze Village. Treat it like a vacation, keep your mind off the gold. We'll be fine here. When you come back later, we'll have your share all ready for you.You'd just be getting in the way here.

Title: The Light of Elune
Objective: Honor the bodies of the fallen soldiers in Astranaar.
Text: My sisters lie slain on the soft earth of Ashenvale.We are trained to expect losses. Soldiers die in battle. But this... this was a despicable attack, even for the Horde.We have little time to grieve, but we are not savages like our enemy.Please. Help me say a prayer to Elune in honor of the fallen. Their wisps deserve the light of her blessing.

Title: Survivors
Objective: Speak to Patrick Eckhart at the Eckhart Lodge.
Text: Patrick and Daryl Eckhart have a place north of town. If I know them, they'll be taking in survivors from Brennadam.Check in with Patrick and see if they need any help.

Title: Worse Than It Looks
Objective: Speak to Felicia Gladstone at Beacon Hill
Text: As bad as things are here we're managing to hold on.Things are actually a lot worse at Beacon Hill. They're closer to the main attack, and will need all the help they can get.Head there and see if you can help.

Title: The Horde Uprising
Objective: Report to Master Mathias Shaw for further instruction.
Text: Given the potential of Azerite to change the face of warfare, it comes as no surprise that the Warchief seeks to lay claim to it. Reports indicate that she is mobilizing an army to march on Silithus--the site of the great wound.Heroes of the Horde and the Alliance fought side-by-side during the Argus campaign. To think that Sylvanas is ready to cast that unity aside...Speak with Mathias Shaw. I want you to oversee our presence in Silithus.

Title: Petitioning Krag'wa
Objective: Summon Krag'wa to ask for his help.
Text: Nothing! I cannot believe de weapon had no effect!Damn Ateena and her dark magic! We must get up there somehow, kill her for good, and remove dat barrier!But how can we get to de top of dat building... ah, of course! Krag'wa!De loa of frogs hates de blood trolls. I am sure he will lend us his aid. Then, finally, we will be able to put an end to Ateena's madness.

Title: A Disturbance in Ashenvale
Objective: Report to Captain Delaryn Summermoon in Astranaar.
Text: The damned Horde! Clever bastards, I'll give them that. They diverted at the north fork of the Barrens and are now marching on Ashenvale.The kaldorei forces already set sail for Silithus--must be halfway there by now. The only defenders still in the area are the Darnassian City Guard. They are en route to Astranaar, but they won't last long against an army. Their commander goes by the name of Delaryn Summermoon.Find her, and buy us time. We will get our fleet there as soon as we can.

Title: A Short-Lived Peace
Objective: Report to King Anduin Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.
Text: ,As the Legion's presence wanes from our world, a new threat has risen. It is with a heavy heart that I must ask you to put your life on the line for the Alliance once more.I have received a disturbing message from our operatives stationed in Orgrimmar.I await your arrival at Stormwind Keep to discuss matters further.

Title: The Platinum Map
Objective: Find the Platinum Map's maker in Vol'dun.
Text: Nestled within the fissures of the deposit, you find a small disc of pure platinum. Dusting it off, you see etchings in its surface and recognize it as a map of Vol'dun. You also notice what appears to be a small cave in the south west that has been circled. Whoever left this apparently has a wealth of knowledge of the metal and wants to be found.

Title: An Ore for an Eye
Objective: Collect 20 Platinum Nuggets.
Text: I have one last request before I can go. I wish to see de sunset one last time. I have an enchantment in mind, and I have all the materials I need except de metal. I need you to bring me twenty platinum nuggets. I have asked de spirits to bring me de ore, but dey do not listen to me anymore. Dat is why I hid de map where only someone who could be of help would find it. If you help me out, I will teach you what I can about mining platinum.

Title: An Exceptional Platinum Shard
Objective: Bring the Exceptional Platinum Shard to Secott the Goldsmith.
Text: Out of dumb luck, you've managed to extract an exceptionally large shard of platinum, instead of several smaller chunks. You wonder to yourself if Secott could teach you to harvest this much every time.

Title: X Marks the Plat!
Objective: Find the Tattered Map's maker in Drustvar.
Text: You find a folded piece of aged paper next to the deposit Opening it up, you find a map of Drustvar with an X along the western coast. Several crude poems adorn the paper, with one in particular drawing your attention. "Once I were a pirate, livin' for rum and pleasure. Since the mutiny, I've retired, an' now I mine for treasure." Whoever left this appears to have spent a significant time mining in these lands. They may have some insights you could benefit from.

Title: A More Challenging Career
Objective: Collect 20 Platinum Nuggets.
Text: As ye can imagine, piratin' be in me blood. Spent many of the best years of me life lootin' and plunderin'. Me favorite part was when takin' a chest filled ta the brim with gold and jewels, and buryin' it where only ye know. Alas, that life be too chaotic for me nowadays. Swashbucklin' makes me tired, and grog makes me sick. But... I can still bury me treasure. Bring me some booty worth buryin', and I'll teach ya everythin' I've learned about minin' over the years. So, wanna be me scallywag?

Title: An Exceptional Platinum Shard
Objective: Bring the Exceptional Platinum Shard to Myra Cabot.
Text: Out of dumb luck, you've managed to extract an exceptionally large shard of platinum, instead of several smaller chunks. You wonder to yourself if Myra could teach you to harvest this much every time.

Title: The Big Boom
Objective: Speak with Explosioneer Zoidfuse to initiate the Vol'dun Explosion Protocol.
Text: Still, we've placed all those explosives, and there's nothing stopping us from detonating them and laying waste to the Horde's excavations.Speak with Zoidfuse when you're ready, and we'll get this explosive gnome tech going!

Title: The Wrath of Grapes
Objective: Bring a Jar of Pickle Juice, a Mountain of Bacon, a Pile of Sausages, and a Hillock of Eggs to Biru The Drunk.
Text: You look familiar. Do you owe me money? Wait... no, that's not it. If you are here to learn, I could show you my secret mining technique, bu- Ugh... I am currently busy trying to see straight right now, amongst other things. Ugh... it feels like someone is swinging a pick at my skull. De best cure for a hangover is pickle juice and a big greasy breakfast. Tell you what, get me those things, preferably quickly and quietly, and I will teach you whatever want.

Title: Report to Wyrmbane
Objective: Report to Halford Wyrmbane in Vol'dun.
Text: Our work here is done. Halford and Zoidfuse should be further down the coast, to the east.If you don't mind, I'll meet you there.

Title: Delayed Deathification
Objective: Bury 8 Remote-Detonation Deathbombs.
Text: While we can handle the assassination portion on our own, I suppose there's no harm in distributing these gnomish bombs around the enemy's digsite.They're designed to be detonated remotely, so try to bury them in the sand where they won't be noticed.

Title: Full of Arrows
Objective: Slay Arlethal Sunwatcher with Shandris.
Text: There's no need for Halford's overly-complicated desert explosion operation. We can take care of Arlethal Sunwatcher right here and now.He's right over there. We can just... kill him.You engage him. I'll join in when he least expects it. You ready?

Title: Splitting Up
Objective: Continue traveling southwest across the desert.
Text: The final Reliquary digsite is southwest of here., you and Shandris are responsible for laying the explosives at the digsite. I'll work with Zoidfuse to establish a safe position to detonate from.

Title: They Have Alpacas Here
Objective: Use the Ultra-Safe Electrified Alpaca Lasso to obtain a Lost Alpaca, then bring it back to Explosioneer Zoidfuse.
Text: Did you see? Did you see them? The floofy alpacas?!I'VE ALWAYS WANTED A... I mean, ahh, ahem! I would like to acquire an alpaca. To study. For scientific reasons. Nothing to do with floofiness at all.Here, this should help you wrangle one back here.

Title: Never Stop Combing
Objective: Continue searching for signs of the Horde.
Text: Onward to the south, then.

Title: A Message to the Zandalari
Objective: Slay 12 Zandalari Exiles.
Text: I know we're here to hunt the Horde, but this is an opportunity.Exiles or not, these are Zandalari trolls, and the Zandalari have all but put in their lot with the Horde.Let's show them what we do to friends of the Horde.

Title: WANTED: The Rime Huntress
Objective: Defeat The Rime Huntress near Highroad Pass.
Text: The Waycrest Guard is offering a reward for any hunter who can track down and eliminate the Rime Huntress from the vicinity of Highroad Pass.Track her with caution. She is a ferocious beast, and has been known to ambush even seasoned hunters.

Title: Comb the Desert
Objective: Search Vol'dun for Horde activity.
Text: It's time to mobilize, then.I'll stick with you. Keep an eye out for Horde activity.

Title: Dirty Work
Objective: Slay Nazlara and find out what she knows.
Text: That surveyor is wearing a Reliquary tabard. Sunwatcher must be hiring goblins to do his dirty work while he lounges somewhere in the shade.Let's find out what she knows.

Title: Keep Combing
Objective: Search for more signs of the Horde.
Text: Guzbert will be busy planting explosives for a while. We should continue south, looking for more signs of the Horde.

Title: Classic Reliquary
Objective: Help Shandris assassinate Elisa Veilsong and Daxx Bombhand, then find out what they know.
Text: Another goblin surveyor, and this one's reporting to a blood elf overseer of some sort. We're closing in on them.You know the drill.

Title: Informing the Horde
Objective: Speak with Baine Bloodhoof.
Text: General Jakra'zet has been defeated, but his plan to summon Mythrax succeeded despite our best efforts.Were it not for the mercy of Sethraliss, I doubt we would have made it out of Atul'Aman alive.We must inform our allies of what has transpired in Vol'dun.I'll speak with princess Talanji myself. You should go and speak with the Horde. We need all the help we can get now.I'm sure our paths will cross again. It was an honor fighting with you.

Title: Overseas Assassination
Objective: Speak with Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth to sail to Vol'dun.
Text: Ready to go to war?Mathias Shaw has assembled a list of priority Horde targets, and the first is an influential blood elf by the name of Arlethal Sunwatcher. Intelligence shows that he's the highest ranking member of the Reliquary, an elite blood elf excavation force.He's just standing out in the middle of the desert in Vol'dun, practically begging to be assassinated. Shall we?

Title: The Vol'dun Plan
Objective: Discuss strategy with Halford Wyrmbane and Shandris Feathermoon.
Text: Our target: Arlethal Sunwatcher, High Examiner of the Reliquary.Before we charge off blindly into the dunes, however, I'd like to hold a quick strategy meeting with you and the others.

Title: Informing the Horde
Objective: Speak with Baine Bloodhoof.
Text: General Jakra'zet has been defeated, but his plan to summon Mythrax succeeded despite our best efforts.Were it not for the mercy of Sethraliss, I doubt we would have made it out of Atul'Aman alive.We must inform our allies of what has transpired in Vol'dun.I'll speak with princess Talanji myself. You should go and speak with the Horde. We need all the help we can get now.I'm sure our paths will cross again. It was an honor fighting with you.

Title: Back to Biru
Objective: Speak with Biru The Drunk.
Text: Oh, you are still here? Well, I wish I could help you but being de only goldsmith in de city of gold, I am unsurprisingly busy. I heard you had built a rapport with Biru. I'm sure he remembers more, if you're still looking for more information. Ask him if he can show you anything else. Tell him if he keeps you from bothering me for the rest of de day, I will stop sending fool hardy miners to him.

Title: Improvised Survival
Objective: Gather 15 Zandalari Water Jugs and 15 Zandalari Rations.
Text: The entirety of our copter's hold was reserved for bombs. There's actually still a lot of bombs left inside. Unfortunately, that meant that we weren't able to pack sufficient water and rations for our survival.Desert natives hoard supplies efficiently. I'm certain the Zandalari trolls up ahead wouldn't miss a few lost supplies.

Title: Three Sheets to the Wind
Objective: Bring Biru The Drunk a drink he likes to learn his mining secrets.
Text: You want to know more about storm silver? Fine, if you are mining from a seam and make a mistake, you can make a deadly cloud of powderized metal. Now go.  I am very busy, but if you insist on not dying, you should talk to my former apprentice, Biru. He is a drunk at Spirits Be With You, but he has some knowledge. Talk to Ximo, de Innkeeper, and buy him a drink. If he likes it, he'll talk, if not... well, I hope you have enough coin for more drinks.

Title: Wolves For The Den
Objective: Complete the mission, "Wolves For The Den."
Text: Our scouts have spotted a large pack of dire wolves not far from here. This is a good omen!We should send a beast master to capture the wolf pack and bring them to the outpost to be tamed.The dire wolves will make fine hunting companions and sniff out any Alliance spies that come poking around!

Title: Brined Justice
Objective: Collect 100 Stolen Storm Silver Bars.
Text: , I just got word dat one of our ships was attacked and a large amount of storm silver stolen! De sacred materials can not be replaced. Once it is blessed by de wavesinger, it is buried underwater for a year. While I do not care for such nonsense, others do, and will not sail on dat ship. From what I heard, a group of naga followed de ship to see where the metal was buried on de sea floor before killing de crew and taking her cargo. Kill de naga, and get me dat metal!

Title: Ritualistic Preparations
Objective: Mine Unsanctified Storm Silver Ore, smelt it into Unsanctified Storm Silver Bars, and get them blessed by Wavesinger De'zan.
Text: I have received a request for a shipment of storm silver. It is a fine metal, lightweight and resistant to corrosion. We use it althroughout our ships. It is so strong even de naga use it in some of their weapons! However, any parts that go into de ship have to be blessed by a wavesinger. I can not be bothered with dat nonsense. I do not believe it needs these extra blessings, but what do I know? Harvest a bucketful of ore and get it blessed for me, and I will teach you how to mine it easier.

Title: DGH: Now With Real Direhorn
Objective: Collect 8 Partially-Digested Direhorn Flesh.
Text: ...Listen. I need one more thing to finish making this supplement of mine.Direhorn Growth Hormone can't exactly be made without, you know, actual direhorn. But I floated the idea of harvesting a few of their beasts and all of a sudden I got a bunch of spears pointed at me.So I came up with another plan.Those flying beasts eat direhorns, right? The big green flappy ones. I'm sure if you kill a few of them you'll find all the direhorn bits I need.

Title: Mission Report: The Wolf's Den
Objective: Deliver the victory report to Nathanos Blightcaller.

Title: Charging the Batteries
Objective: Fill that ranishu's belly.
Text: These little fellas are ravenous whirlwinds of devouring destruction. When they get going, they consume anything in their path, without even stopping! When sated, they discharge power from them little 'lectric zingers on their heads!Then they nap.Lucky for us, we found just the right frequency to control their tiny bug brains. Hit that device, and you can take your own little zapper out for a spin... literally!Make sure ya bring it back full, so we can keep our rigs charged!

Title: Wings for the Kraal
Objective: Collect 8 Nearly-hatchling Pterrordax Eggs.
Text: It seems your little one needs a moment to rest after dat adventure. I will look after it.If you want to make yourself useful while you wait, I heard de pterrordaxes to de north have been laying lots of eggs recently. Go collect de ones dat are wiggling and making noises. Dey are about to hatch.Our beasts breed well, but we always need more wings for de kraal.

Title: WANTED: Jabra'kan
Objective: Slay Jabra'kan the Poacher.
Text: To any hunters worthy of the challenge:Find and defeat the troll known as Jabra'kan. His poaching ways have robbed Warbeast Kraal of valuable eggs, hides, and beasts for their pens.Seek out Wingrider Nivek for your reward.

Title: Return to Zuldazar
Objective: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller on the Banshee's Wail. Muka Stormbreaker can give you a ride.
Text: Warfang Hold is our most secured of the footholds we hold in Kul Tiras.Kaga and her forces will be able to keep fortifications running, thanks to you. The Alliance will never see us coming!Tell Nathanos that we have succeeded in our mission. I will help here until I am needed.

Title: Return to Zuldazar
Objective: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller on the Banshee's Wail. Swellthrasher in Anyport can give you a ride.
Text: You know kid, I think I've got it all covered here. My guys will find all the Azerite they can here and make me rich!I mean, you know, make the Horde rich. With power!Anyway, you can go tell Nathanos we're done here. This base is the best place to launch any attacks against the Kul Tirans here in Drustvar -- that's a Gallywix guarantee!

Title: Return to Zuldazar
Objective: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller on the Banshee's Wail. Erul Dawnbrook can give you a ride.
Text: Look at dis place, boss-mon! We got da pirates, a location close to da Kul Tiran capital...I tink we should be bein' pretty proud of dis one.We should get goin' back and tell Nathanos about our success. Maybe we can even get him to crack a smile.

Title: The Ongoing Campaign
Objective: Use the Kul Tiras Campaign Map to choose a foothold.
Text: The Warchief wishes for us to continue spreading our influence throughout Kul Tiras.With our grip on Zandalar on the rise, now is the time to move forward with this objective in the lands of the enemy.Which location shall we secure next?

Title: Storm's Rage
Objective: Repel the Horde forces assaulting Stormsong Valley.
Text: Horde forces are pushing deeper into Stormsong Valley. We can not allow this aggression to go unchecked!

Title: Return to Boralus
Objective: Return to Halford Wyrmbane on the Wind's Redemption. Daria Smithson can give you a ride.
Text: You know, a lot has happened since you arrived in Zuldazar! I'm sure Mr. Wyrmbane would appreciate a report.Oh, not from me. Maybe somebody a bit more serious... like you!I bet Daria over here could get you back pretty quick!

Title: Return to Boralus
Objective: Return to Halford Wyrmbane on the Wind's Redemption in Boralus Harbor. Desha Stormwallow can give you a ride.
Text: I think that's enough excitement for today!Why don't ya get back ta Wyrmbane and tell the man we've got this place all under control.I'll make sure the blood trolls don't get any more of our folk! Ha!

Title: Return to Boralus
Objective: Return to Halford Wyrmbane on the Wind's Redemption in Boralus.
Text: Shatterstone Harbor is an expansive foothold, and one that we will use to great advantage against the Horde.I will leave Umbric and the others in charge here. Let's get back to the Wind's Redemption and return to Boralus.

Title: An Exquisite Brooch
Objective: Bring the Exquisitely Crafted Brooch to Secott.
Text: You find a bloody brooch that features impeccable craftsmanship. The design and quality of work reminds you of rings you previously recovered for Secott. Perhaps this is another item he lost and would like to see returned.

Title: Lending a Hand
Objective: Retrieve Secott's Rings.
Text: If you are looking for some work, I have something you can do. I went mining recently and a diemetradon managed to bite off my hand before I could get away from it. I do not care about the hand, I have already regenerated dat, but I did lose a couple rings dat I made. If you go get them back, I will show you how to harvest more monelite from a seam. Or not. I do not care, but if you were looking for a chance to finally impress me, dis could be it.

Title: Insufferable Bloodsuckers
Objective: Kill 8 Bloodbelly Flyers and 8 Blood Trolls.
Text: ! I have some actual work that you could do for me. Since your mining skills are still not what Zandalari consider "decent", in exchange, I will show you how to mine monelite better. De blood trolls of Nazmir have dese enormous ticks that they keep as pets and I have heard dat dey have managed to get within de borders of Zuldazar to de north. Dis does not sit well with me. Thin their numbers for me, so I can happily die by being eaten by a pterrordax or something else respectable instead.

Title: Lumbering Away
Objective: Collect 9 Pieces of Dry Firewood.
Text: The hardwoods in dis jungle are dense enough dat dey rival coal in terms of how much heat a skilled miner can get out of dem. The biggest problem using local timbers, however, is dat de jungle is always wet. If de wood is not stored properly, it takes weeks to dry out entirely. I bring dis up because my forge is starting to run low on fuel. Bring me some dry firewood to keep it going, and in exchange I will teach you a trick for mining monelite.

Title: Pristine Disembowling Sickle
Objective: Put the artifact on display.
Text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in your new ally's capital city.

Title: The Ongoing Campaign
Objective: Use the Zandalar Campaign Map to choose a foothold.
Text: We have made excellent progress on Zandalar, but we must continue to expand our influence.It is time for us to cross the sea once again to exert pressure on enemy lands, lest they fall fully into Horde hands.Which location shall we secure next?

Title: Pristine Ritual Fetish
Objective: Put the artifact on display.
Text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in your new ally's capital city.

Title: Pristine Jagged Blade of the Drust
Objective: Put the artifact on display.
Text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in your new ally's capital city.

Title: Uniting Kul Tiras
Objective: Earn at least Friendly reputation with the factions of Kul Tiras.
Text: The people of Kul Tiras are diverse and capable. If we can bring them all together under the banner of the Alliance, the Horde has no chance of stopping us.

Title: Uniting Zandalar
Objective: Earn at least Friendly reputation with the factions of Zandalar.
Text: The people of Zandalar are diverse and capable. If we can bring them all together under the banner of the Horde, the Alliance has no chance of stopping us.

Title: Island Expedition
Objective: Speak with Flynn Fairwind to start the expedition, then explore the Uncharted Island.
Text: Alright! Let's snap to it! We've got to get to that island before the Horde does, don't we?You ready?

Title: Island Expedition
Objective: Report to Flynn Fairwind in Boralus.
Text: Our spies have intercepted a Horde message describing an outcropping of Azerite out in the Great Sea.The Wind's Redemption isn't quick enough to get us there before they do. Lucky for us, I've arranged to have a Kul Tiran ship rigged and ready to go for opportunities like this.Go speak with Captain Flynn Fairwind. He's been briefed, and should be waiting for you.

Title: Island Expedition
Objective: Speak with Captain Rez'okun to start the expedition, then explore the Uncharted Island.
Text: We better be quick if we're gonna get to de island before de Alliance.You ready?

Title: The Mine Sweeper
Objective: Deliver the Cracked Mine Sweeper to Felecia Gladstone just outside the Saltstone Mine.

Title: The Wrath of Grapes
Objective: Bring a Jar of Pickle Juice, a Mountain of Bacon, a Pile of Sausages, and a Hillock of Eggs to Franklin The Drunk.
Text: You look familiar. Do you owe me money? Wait... no, that's not it. If you are here to learn, I could show you my secret mining technique, bu- Ugh... I'm a little busy trying to see straight right now. Ugh... it feels like someone is swinging a pick at my skull. The best cure for a hangover is pickle juice, a big greasy breakfast, and whatever I did not finish last night. Tell you what, get me those things, preferably quickly and quietly, and I will teach you whatever ya want.

Title: Island Expedition
Objective: Report to Captain Rez'okun at the Port of Zandalar.
Text: Our spies have intercepted an Alliance message describing an outcropping of Azerite out in the Great Sea.The Banshee's Wail isn't quick enough to get us there before they do. Lucky for us, I've arranged to have a Zandalari ship rigged and ready to go for opportunities like this.Go speak with Captain Rez'okun on the western side of the docks. He's been briefed, and should be waiting for you.

Title: Storm's End
Objective: Confront Lord Stormsong.
Text: I've no doubt he can feel our presence, but so long as Lord Stormsong maintains his spell the first move is ours.We have him surrounded, cornered like the rat he is. We must end this together.

Title: Whatever Will Be
Objective: Get Zelling to locate Marshal Valentine.
Text: Well, here we are. Zelling seems like he'll be a powerful asset, as long as we ensure his family is taken care of.He doesn't have much time left. Let's see if he can locate Marshal Valentine for us before he passes.

Title: Zelling's Potential
Objective: Fill Zelling's Void Font by slaying enemies in Port Fogtide and unleash his devastating wind magic.
Text: My body won't last much longer, but Miss Voss insists I display what my powers truly are.I can instill within you a   magical font that will absorb void essence from slain creatures.When the font is full, you can unleash devastating wind magic.Go to  Port Fogtide. There you will find those tainted by the Void.Slay them, fill the font, and you will  see my magic at work.

Title: Ranah's Wrench
Objective: Deliver the wrench to Ranah in the Withering Gulch.

Title: Commander and Captain
Objective: Kill Captain Malia and recover the Book of Forbidden Magics from Commander Augustine.
Text: This brings me no joy, but I will do what I must to make sure my family is happy and safe.I would prefer we avoid violence, but if we must... there are two targets. Their leaders. Captain Malia and Commander Augustine.Their loss should force the two groups to retreat from the area.Also, Augustine confiscated a book of mine. Recover it and my powers are yours, for however long I have left.

Title: Scattering Our Enemies
Objective: Kill 10 Alliance and Kul Tiran soldiers within Sagehold.
Text: We've been scouting the area of Sagehold for some time now. It was recently retaken by a large force of Alliance and Kul Tirans.We have been waiting for an opportunity to strike when their defenses were weakened. Now is that time.Go down to Sagehold and show the forces that remain what happens to those who take up arms against the Horde.

Title: Captain Hartford
Objective: Slay Captain Hartford.
Text: I'm almost ready to leave Vol'dun once and for all. There's just one thing left to be done...We need to murder the captain of the ship.If Captain Hartford finds out I've deserted, I won't be safe in Boralus or anywhere else. He'll hunt me to the Eastern Kingdoms and back if he has to!This will be dangerous. So you'll want to disguise yourself before boarding The Siren's Call.This will be our last job together. Do it and I'll give you the code to the captain's lockbox. A pirate's bounty!

Title: Blackrock Depths
Objective: Speak with Moira at the Stormwind Embassy to travel to Blackrock Depths.
Text: Have you heard how the Dark Iron dwarves joined the Alliance? It was a most unusual turn of events.Brave heroes of the Alliance had been fighting the Dark Iron dwarves for years until a schism happened in their ranks.Moira Thaurissian, estranged daughter of the former dwarven king Magni Bronzebeard, was leading a faction of the Dark Iron dwarves.Moira wished to aid the Alliance. This began with an offer to help research Azerite and its potential uses within Blackrock Depths...

Title: Foothold: Tiragarde Sound
Objective: Assist Shadow-Hunter Ty'jin in Tiragarde Sound.
Text: Tiragarde Sound has lotsa pirates on da coastline.I made contact wit' a first mate of a crew, and she tinks we can take on da captain and get a nice outpost in de process.- Shadow Hunter Ty'jin

Title: They Will Know Fear
Objective: Terrorize 20 Kul Tiran Builders or Tidesage Recruits with the Val'kyr Horn.
Text: Finally, a chance to strike at the Alliance AND Kul Tirans!Sagehold is crawling with initiate tidesages studying magic and Kul Tirans trying to fortify the place against the Horde.Let's strike some fear into them. Make them rethink trying to help the Alliance fight the Horde.Take this horn. In my hands, it calls a val'kyr. In yours, it will sow terror amongst our enemies.I trust you above all others with this horn. Do not let me down.

Title: Foothold: Stormsong Valley
Objective: Assist Rexxar in Stormsong Valley.
Text: We established and fortified an outpost in Stormsong Valley called Warfang Hold.The Kul Tiran forces have it surrounded and an attack is imminent. We need reinforcements. Do not delay.- Rexxar

Title: The Kul Tiras Campaign
Objective: Use the Kul Tiras Campaign Map to choose a foothold.
Text: Our enemy spreads its influence throughout Kul Tiras, recruiting new allies to fight against the Horde.We must establish footholds in these enemy lands if we are to win this war.The Warchief requires your assistance in securing outposts in Stormsong Valley, Drustvar, and Tiragarde Sound.Which location shall we secure first?

Title: Foothold: Drustvar
Objective: Assist Gallywix and Eitrigg in Drustvar.
Text: It seems Drustvar has a big seam of Azerite underground.Do you like profit? I LOVE profit. This seems like a golden opportunity, if ya catch my meanin'. Time is money!- Trade Prince Gallywix

Title: The Battle for Lordaeron
Objective: Complete the Battle for Lordaeron.
Text: The Alliance has called its banners and marches on the Undercity.Now the war has truly begun.Our mage will send you on your way. Go.See to our defenses, and get the civilians to safety. I will join you soon.Lok-tar ogar.

Title: No Price Too High
Objective: Help Rexxar track down a tidesage.
Text: I have tracked a tidesage to a camp nearby. He has been staying there with his family.Be warned, tidesages are powerful foes. They have mastery over all the elements, and some even manipulate the Void.If this man is with his family, it means he may not give up so easily.Let us hope he's smart enough to keep them out of this.Come.

Title: The Battle for Lordaeron
Objective: Complete the Battle for Lordaeron.
Text: King Wrynn has mustered our forces. We mean to launch a full-scale assault on Lordaeron.We'll drive the Horde from the keep and reclaim it for the Alliance. It's been far too long since our flag flew in Tirisfal.Ready to ship out? Captain Angelica here will see to your transport.

Title: Tracking Tidesages
Objective: Meet Rexxar within Warfang Hold in Stormsong.
Text: Rexxar has been tracking a powerful tidesage to help us find the body of Marshal Valentine. He has sent word of a breakthrough.Travel to Stormsong. Help the half-ogre and Lilian find this tidesage, and bend him to the will of the Horde.Do not come back without a way to find Marshal Valentine.

Title: What Remains of Marshal M. Valentine
Objective: Assist Nathanos Blightcaller in retrieving Valentine's body.
Text: We have the key. We found the crypt.Next, Valentine's body shall be ours.No need to wait for Lilian and Stone. Let's finish this now.

Title: Examining the Epitaphs
Objective: Examine 4 Grave Plaques in Barrowknoll Cemetery.
Text: Without Stone's knowledge, this mission shall require some extra legwork.Read the plaques in the cemetery. Find the corpse of the most import.The rest should be quite simple.

Title: The Crypt Keeper
Objective: Collect Valentine's Key from Brutus Thornton.
Text: I've been keeping my sights on the cemetery.There is one ghost that walks with a purpose, unlike the others.He is the crypt keeper, the keeper of the keys.If we want to get to Valentine's body, we will need to go through the ghost first.

Title: Our Lot in Life
Objective: Collect 10 Gravebloom.
Text: It seems that Amalia isn't taking to undeath well.I know an herb that may help.This cemetery is crawling with gravebloom. For the living, it grants the ability to see spirits.As for the undead...This may tie her back to reality just enough to be... sane.

Title: State of Unrest
Objective: Kill 8 Enraged Spirits.
Text: There is one thing you should know about ghosts.They are a mockery of the dead. Spirits, holding on although they have no hope. In that form, they shall never truly live again. Not as long as they keep haunting our world.But if they return to their bodies, perhaps they will become of specific use to us someday down the line.Put those spirits down.

Title: Camp Lastwind
Objective: Speak with Norah.
Text: A vulpera caravan recently set up camp not far from here.Dis could be a good opportunity to establish new trade partners with de tribe.De desert is a dangerous place. Go see if dey need any assistance. I'm sure dey could use experienced hands like yours.In exchange, perhaps dey'd be willing to offer de tribe a discount on goods and services.

Title: The Tortaka Tribe
Objective: Meet with Torka.
Text: Have you ever met a tortollan before? Dey have all kinds of useful scrolls and artifacts for sale.We used to trade often with de Tortaka tribe, but we haven't seen or heard from dem in weeks.De tribe has a village in Darkwood Shoal. We need someone to make contact with dem and reestablish our trading partnership.

Title: The Ashvane Threat
Objective: Meet with Randall Redmond.
Text: De Ashvane Trading Company has a mining operation in Redrock Harbor.Don't let de fancy name fool you, dey are as dangerous a band of pirates as I've ever seen.Recently, one of their crew members has been trying to make contact with us. I need someone to meet with him and see what he wants.It might be a trap, but whatever information he has on de Ashvane Trading Company could prove useful to our survival.

Title: War of Shadows
Objective: Send Arcanist Valtrois on a mission.
Text: I have begun to assemble heroes for our cause. Perhaps you already know Arcanist Valtrois? We will need to recruit more in the future, but this is a promising beginning.Our missions will be those of subterfuge, reconnaissance, assassination, and other focused strikes against our enemies.Let us test the mettle of this nightborne, shall we?

Title: Mission from the Warchief
Objective: Walk with Garona Halforcen belowdecks on the Banshee's Wail.
Text: Lady Sylvanas issued orders for Garona Halforcen to take on a task of great import.She will orchestrate missions from the Banshee's Wail, and is to assemble a strong force to execute on our plans.This effort will be vital to our war against the Alliance, and your assistance will certainly be necessary.

Title: Grizzled
Objective: Kill Chief Engineer Grizz.
Text: I saw a particularly ugly and quite agitated goblin barking orders at the rest of the miners.I'm willing to bet he's crucial to their entire operation. If you can get into the mine and eliminate him, hopefully it will throw things into disarray.

Title: Operation Royalty
Objective: Kill General Blackstone.
Text: I think we've got a real shot at crippling their invasion force, here and now!While you were out there terrorizing those poor peons, I managed to sneak around and get a peek inside their camp.I spotted an armor clad undead in the great hall, he was poring over detailed battle plans.I'm willing to bet the very shirt off my back that he's their general. Think you're up for the challenge $p!?

Title: Burn It All Down
Objective: Burn 6 Lumber Piles and 2 Siege Towers.
Text: Alright, the flamethrower is all patched up. Now we're going to get a little payback for Brennadam!If it's flammable, it's a target. If not, well, it probably still needs to die anyway. And let's bring down those siege towers while we're at it.Burn it all to the ground!

Title: Saw Dusted
Objective: Kill 10 Warfang Lumberjacks.
Text: If we want to keep them from expanding into Stormsong, we need to cripple their lumber production!They've only got so many lumberjacks running around. If we can cut some of them down, they'll be forced to reconsider their plans.

Title: Get Out of Here
Objective: Free 6 Captured Miners.
Text: I can't believe you're here, please, we need help!They've been forcing us to mine non-stop, the weakest among us have been steadily dropping. At this rate, we'll all be dead soon.The chains are weak, you may be able to pry the lock apart.I'll keep a lookout until the others are free, don't worry about me!

Title: Get Shredded
Objective: Find an Energized Power Core and install it in the Prototype Shredder MK-03.
Text: I was scouting ahead while you were wreaking havoc in the mine.Spotted a hulking, armored shredder in their lumber yard. Bet we could do some real damage with that thing!I tried to start it up, but looks like it might be out of juice. Maybe they forgot to charge it?See if you can grab a fresh power core from one of the other shredders nearby.

Title: Harvesting "Honey"
Objective: Collect 12 Bilewing Stingers.
Text: I don't know what Rhan'ka's doing down in that oasis with all of the honey he's bought from me. Frankly, I suspect I don't even want to know.But whatever his reasons, Rhan'ka is my best customer.So even though my supply's getting low, because Rhan'ka sent you, I'll give you a special deal.The wasps here keep all their honey stored in their stingers. Bring some to me, so I can drain them for honey and I'll give you a big batch of the sticky stuff to take back to Rhan'ka.

Title: War of Shadows
Objective: Send Falstad on a mission.
Text: Every war is fought on multiple fronts.King Wrynn has tasked Halford Wyrmbane and his 7th Legion with securing our position in Kul Tiras as well as Zandalar.But they cannot succeed without us. We are the unseen hand. The shadows in the darkness.I have been charged with establishing an elite strike force, and I need you to act as liaison between Wyrmbane's efforts and my own.You will help direct our missions going forward. Let us begin.

Title: Eye for an Eye
Objective: Use the Prototype Shredder to burn 8 Warfang Buildings and kill General Blackstone and 30 Horde Soldiers.
Text: This is it $p, now is the time to strike.Take this shredder and destroy their stronghold. Burn everything to the ground!Show no mercy. They certainly didn't offer any to all of the innocent civilians they slaughtered in Brennadam!

Title: The Best Honey In Vol'dun
Objective: Meet Rikati at The Four Stingers.
Text: If you can handle rescuin' de others by yourself, Zulsan and I will head back to de inn and start cleanin' up de place.Don't worry, I still be cookin' up a special batch of my famous scorpid blood drinks for you.In fact, you gonna be runnin' right past my friend Rikati. He sells de best honey in all of Vol'dun!Bring back a few bottles of it for me and let's add some sweetness to de drinks!

Title: Having a Blast
Objective: Acquire a Bundle of Dynamite and use it to kill 16 Warfang Miners and 4 Mine Technicians.
Text: We're going to really hit 'em where it hurts.They're carting tons of black powder right out of that mine. This could end very badly for all of us if we don't do something.The mines are relatively undefended, I bet you can get in and wipe out their workers before they realize what's happening.Keep an eye out for some explosives, if we can use their own tools against them, even better!

Title: Mission from the King
Objective: Meet Spymaster Mathias Shaw on the Wind's Redemption.
Text: Och, good ta see ya! Feels great ta stretch me gryphon's wings above the seas.I'm here ta assist with the war effort. Happy to help!Let's go meet with Master Shaw, matey.Ha! Always wanted to say somethin' piratey. Did ya know they named a ship after me once? It was wild!

Title: Almost Worth Saving
Objective: Rescue 6 Frightened Peons from Warfang Hold.
Text: We tried to evacuate as many of our people from the hold as we could, but some of the peons weren't so lucky.They're worthless as fighters, but we'll need their labor in the times ahead.Please, save them if you can.

Title: Mending Body and Soul
Objective: Follow Jol's directions to assist in healing King Rastakhan.
Text: Good. You have brought me the last ingredients I will need to concoct a solution to close the king's wounds.You are not a moment too soon. He is fading.I am not comfortable working at an elevated pace, but the situation requires it. You must be my hands, for I am very slow.Bring me what I need, and let Jamil and I worry about the rest.Speak to me when you are ready to begin.

Title: In Bwonsamdi's Shadow
Objective: Speak to Jol the Ancient and Jamil Abul'housin.
Text: Something is wrong.My king is blessed by de loa in ways your kind cannot imagine. He has been given long life, swift healing, and strength beyond most trolls. But still, he lingers on death's door. I can practically hear Bwonsamdi laughing.Two of his most trusted menders are with him. Go and find out what is taking so long.I will make sure dey are not interrupted.

Title: A Strange Port of Call
Objective: Search Rastakhan's Might for clues.
Text: I know Rastakhan is furious dat dey claimed his ship, of all de vessels in our navy.But dere is a better question to ask. Why did dey bring it here?Zeb'ahari is a small fishing village. Dere are no warriors here, no powerful supporters of de king. Dere must be another reason.Board de ship and have a good look around. See if you can find out why dey brought dat beast of a boat way out here.

Title: Rastakhan's Might
Objective: Collect Windcaller Ula'jan's skull aboard the flagship Rastakhan's Might.
Text: Do you see de ship out in de bay?Dat is my flagship, Rastakhan's Might. It is not here under my orders.We will deal with de Prophet Zul in good time. For now, those who took my vessel must pay.You are to bring me de head of Windcaller Ula'jan. De ship does not move without him, and it will not be moving again once he is dead!

Title: Douse the Flames
Objective: Obtain a Fading Umbral Wand and use it to put out 4 flames around Warfang Hold.
Text: Do you smell it? Smoke! They're burning down Warfang Hold!There is little point to our battle if our base burns to the ground!Their tidesages use wands to control their constructs of water. In our hands they may give us a chance to save the Hold!Get those wands and put out the fires before the camp burns to ash!

Title: Hunt Them Down
Objective: Slay Captain Ara and 8 Storm's Wake Footmen.
Text: These Kul Tirans, they don't seem normal. Humans can be a cruel bunch from what I've heard, but these ones seem to take pleasure in slaying the fallen.The worst of them was a woman wearing a peculiar mask. She seemed to be shouting orders to the others, so I guess she's their leader.Honor the fallen and ensure they and their leader don't survive.

Title: Mojambo
Objective: Slay Mojambo.
Text: Mojambo and his gang are attacking!We must defend de arena. Mojambo must be defeated! De outcasts will take care of his gang. Mojambo is all yours...Bring Tongo's head with you and use it to challenge Mojambo to a duel. His pride is too great to resist such a challenge!

Title: Preparing for the Fall
Objective: Destroy 8 Jambani stockpiles.

Title: A Wall of Iron
Objective: Man a cannon and slay 40 Kul Tiran forces.
Text: The enemy has pushed our men to the shore and sunk their ships. They have nowhere to run and nowhere to hide; it's up to us to save them!Get below deck, man a cannon, and start laying down some covering fire. They're depending on us!

Title: Death Trap
Objective: Place 8 Gunpowder Crates in a hidden location southwest of Bridgeport.
Text: We started this mission with a goal, but not much of a plan. I think I can see the pieces coming together, though.Place these explosives over on the southwest edge of town. Somewhere inconspicuous.We'll meet again over there. In the meantime... I need to find a horse.

Title: Bandit Blades
Objective: Retrieve 8 Sandworn Blades.
Text: We only have enough weapons to arm half of de tribe against Mojambo's gang.We're going to need more weapons if we are going to survive de approaching battle.Tongo's crew is sure to have a ready supply of weapons at their hideout.Search de hideout for any weapons you can find and bring dem back to de arena.

Title: A Bit of Chaos
Objective: Slay 15 workers at the Ashvane Foundry.
Text: This place seems fairly well-defended for a manufacturing facility, doesn't it?I suppose we'll have to kill them, then.

Title: Explosivity
Objective: Use Lilian's Torch on the Pile of Ashvane Crates near the Ashvane Foundry.
Text: I don't want to waste your time. Let's make absolutely sure that these are what we're looking for.Here, take this torch and toss it over onto those crates. If they explode, then we'll know what to do next.

Title: Ammunition Acquisition
Objective: Obtain 8 crates of Ashvane Explosives.
Text: First: we get as much of that gunpowder as we possibly can. Imagine the terror in the Kul Tirans' eyes when they realize the Horde has turned their own weapons against them.Imagine it.

Title: Explosives in the Foundry
Objective: Meet Lilian Voss at the Ashvane Foundry.
Text: I'm most interested in those explosives, though.Meet me in the foundry, east of here. You probably passed through it on your way from Plunder Harbor.

Title: Making Ourselves at Home
Objective: Obtain 7 Lengths of Chain and 7 bolts of Sail Canvas from the outskirts of Bridgeport.
Text: Log cabins will do in a pinch, but... if we're going to be spending any time here, we might as well make ourselves comfortable.The roughnecks left us no shortage of lumber and food supplies, but we'll need canvas and chains to set up some proper Forsaken tents and banners. Bridgeport sounds rather lootable, doesn't it?

Title: Gunpowder Research
Objective: Obtain the Ashvane Explosives Formula and the Gunpowder Manufacturing Guide.
Text: I suppose that, before we steal all the Kul Tirans' violently explosive gunpowder and use it against them, we should learn how they make the stuff.

Title: Into the Heart of Tiragarde
Objective: Rendezvous with Nathanos and Lilian in central Tiragarde Sound.
Text: Step one is to establish a more suitable base of operations. A pirate's den will do in a pinch, but I believe the warchief expects better of us.Let's split up and push farther inland, to the west. Be on the lookout for something defensible and inconspicuous.

Title: Our Mountain Now
Objective: Slay 10 Roughnecks in Timberfell Outpost.
