Text: , go take care of those "roughnecks." They might fashion themselves as tough, but a bit of your unique brand of Horde savagery should have them running in no time.Lilian, scout the area. We need to know about any nearby threats.Rangers, secure the perimeter. We'll reconvene in the roughneck camp once 's work is done.

Title: Bridgeport Investigation
Objective: Spy on the denizens of Bridgeport.
Text: While you're in Bridgeport, you might keep an ear out for any information that will be of aid to us.You'd be surprised what you can learn by staying quiet and listening to people who think they're alone...

Title: Onward!
Objective: Accompany Rexxar.
Text: I'm glad you came. With your help, we will show these Kul Tiran dogs what happens when you face a cornered beast!Warfang Hold is just up the path from here. Come, I'll fill you in on the details.

Title: Breaking Kul Tiran Will
Objective: Sail to Tiragarde Sound.
Text: Our partnership with the Zandalari will soon be secured. Took a little longer than I expected... but such is the way of things.Unfortunately, the Alliance seems intent on securing a naval force of their own. That can't be allowed to happen.We set sail for Tiragarde Sound when you're ready.

Title: Make it Mildenhall
Objective: Speak with Ancel Mildenhall at the Mildenhall Meadery.
Text: You've no doubt enjoyed a mug or three of world-famous Mildenhall Mead in your local tavern. Today is your day to become a part of the official meadery of Stormsong Valley!Ideal applicants have a hunger for craft mead, honey, and boundless innovation. Military experience recommended, but not required.Must not be allergic to bees.Mildenhall Mead - Make it Mildenhall.

Title: Freshly Squeezed
Objective: Collect 8 Pricklevine Juice.
Text: Is this troll a friend of yours? I'm so glad Kiro let me keep her.He's a bit wary of outsiders, but he's a great healer.She'll wake up, I promise. And when she does, she'll be thirsty.The sands are short on water, but you're in luck. The grove that surrounds this camp is filled with pricklevines.You wouldn't want to eat the flesh, but the liquid inside can quench any thirst.Just give them a good squeeze to collect their juice.

Title: I've Got Your Back
Objective: Guard Razgaji while he meets with Mojambo.
Text: It's good to see a new face around here. I've got a problem and you look like you can handle a fight.Dat group of murderous thugs over dere are looking for trouble and I need someone to back me up.De truth is dat I used to be one of dem myself, but I left for a second chance at an honest life.I need to convince Mojambo and his henchmons to leave before dey start causing trouble for de rest of de outcasts here.

Title: Foothold: Vol'dun
Objective: Assist Alliance forces in Vol'dun.
Text: The desert of Vol'dun has a promising harbor for our fleet.An indigenous snake people known as the sethrak occupy the area. They are aggressive and cannot be negotiated with. We have little choice but to eliminate them.- Magister Umbric

Title: Foothold: Nazmir
Objective: Assist Brann Bronzebeard in Nazmir.
Text: The swamp of Nazmir is home to the notorious blood trolls.Captain Conrad has been dispatched to determine how we can use their hatred toward the Zandalari to our advantage. Reports from the jungle have proven disconcerting at best.- Mathias Shaw

Title: Lost But Not Forgotten
Objective: Kill Bonescreamer and bring the 'Ancient Artifact' to Rana the Cutta.
Text: Hey, would you be interested in getting back a personal possession? Dere is a raptor in Xibala dat took an ancient and valuable artifact from my people. My attempts to negotiate with de beast have not gone well, resulting mostly in mutual screaming and biting. Find de raptor Bonescreamer, kill it, and bring me de lost artifact. In return, I will show you how to skin dese beasts of de land more effectively.

Title: Foothold: Zuldazar
Objective: Assist Kelsey Steelspark in Zuldazar.
Text: Zuldazar is the seat o' power fer the Zandalar empire.I've deployed some o' me mole machines in a place called Xibala. There's a nearby Azerite deposit that'll be o' great interest to the King. My lads say they're under attack.- Moira Thaurissan

Title: Ritualistic Preparations
Objective: Mine Unsanctified Storm Silver Ore, use a forge to smelt Unsanctified Storm Silver Ingots, then get them blessed by a tidesage.
Text: Hey! I just got a request for a shipment of storm silver. Wanna help? As you know, storm silver is lightweight and resists corrosion. What you may not know is that we use it throughout our ships. It's so light our marines and pirates use it for armor because they can swim in it! However, any parts that go onto a ship have to be blessed by a tidesage, or it'll be cursed to a watery doom! Harvest a bucketful of ore, smelt it, and get it blessed for me, and I will teach you how to mine it easier.

Title: The Zandalar Campaign
Objective: Use the Zandalar Campaign Map to choose a foothold.
Text: It is time that we begin to think of our enemy. The Horde spreads its influence throughout Zandalar unchecked.King Anduin has charged us with establishing footholds in the areas of Zuldazar, Nazmir, and Vol'dun.I have taken the liberty of deploying some of our forces in key locations, but each will need a firm hand--your hand--to direct our efforts.Which location shall we secure first?

Title: Irontide Warning
Objective: Speak to Leo Shealds at Deadwash.
Text: Horde's taking this town! I'm not gonna stick around to watch!You could help me out though. Go see Leo Shealds in Deadwash.Tell him, Irontide is still coming and we're taking the gold!

Title: Myself Again
Objective: Speak to Patrick Eckhart at Dire Hills Lodge.
Text: I joined the tidesages because I wanted to show my brother I wasn't a weakling.I loved the magic and power, but I started to do unspeakable things. I even tried to hurt my own family.Please get word to my brother at Dire Hills Lodge. Tell him I have come to my senses. I am myself again.

Title: Reloading
Objective: Deliver the note to Leo Shealds.
Text: Daryl's making every shot count, but there's just too many Horde. We're going to need more ammo soon!I need you to take this note to my uncle Leo at Deadwash, he'll be able to help.

Title: Keep Them On Task
Objective: Speak with Dennis Grimtale at Talanji's Rebuke.
Text: Princess Talanji's actions have thrown off our pursuers. Her loa is powerful indeed.We need to be certain if there were survivors, they do not gain a foothold on Zandalar. I am concerned that our Forsaken compatriots might get... overzealous. Please keep an eye on them, and remind them of what is honorable.

Title: The Days Are Just Packed
Objective: Find Sergeant Calvin in Brennadam Square.
Text: Hello there! Would you mind checking on someone for me? Sergeant Calvin was supposed to meet me here. We were going to go out looking for new alchemical reagents, but he hasn't shown up yet. I know the militia has been really busy lately so I guess he's busy, but he should still be in Brennadam Square. Would you mind checking in on him?

Title: Disarming the Cannons
Objective: Disable the cannons on the Horde ship.
Text: With your arrival, our salvation may have arrived. Your rowboats will serve as a way for us to evacuate the most critically injured.Unfortunately, the Horde have brought in a ship, and there's no way we can get our boats past their blockade.While the rest of us load our injured on the boats, we need you to infiltrate their ship and disable those cannons.

Title: WANTED: Rindlewoe
Objective: Defeat Rindlewoe outside of Fallhaven.
Text: A monstrous beast of wood and flesh has been terrorizing the nearby river territories.If any adventurers are brave enough to vanquish this beast, the town of Fallhaven would gratefully proffer a reward.Please report to Mayor White if you wish to help.

Title: Saplings in the Snow
Objective: Collect 6 Mountain Saplings.
Text: Be wary mainlander, dangers lurk nearby.One such creature, Greenstalker, used to be an ally. In his corrupted, mindless rage he nearly killed my brother and I while we were trying to help someone in the wilds. There is something which might help but I must tend to my brother's wounds and cannot obtain the remaining item on my own.Please go onto the mountainside and pull some saplings out of the earth for me. The plants here are healthy and their roots run deep so they won't come easily.

Title: Breaker Bad
Objective: Destroy the Reef Breaker.
Text: The combined fire power of all the bombs you have collected should be able to destroy the Venture Companies Reef Breaker.It's time to act and protect the reef and this sacred cave.

Title: Explosive Situation
Objective: Collect 5 Bot Buster Bombs.

Title: Inform the Horde!
Objective: Warn Baine of the betrayal.
Text: This was all perpetrated by someone on the Zanchuli Council.They sacrificed their own people, Gral's followers, for Azshara. That is unconscionable!They weaken the foundation, so the kingdom will fall.One of your people must have direct access to the king. Anyone else could be the traitor.

Title: Word from the Deep
Objective: Share Gral's warning with the Seekers.
Text: A dark soul has infiltrated the Zanchuli Council, seeking an accord with Queen Azshara.Some followed, through greed or fear. Others were too trusting and believed his lies.We fall, one by one. They will soon clear the path of resistance.Azshara's motives are hidden behind a vast darkness. She reaches into a place from where she cannot return.I would pity her, but she killed my followers...When the time comes, I will rip her apart.

Title: On the Hunt
Objective: Search Seawatch Point for survivors.
Text: Looks like the magic the Kul Tirans used on our ships is beginning to dissipate, but I'm sure what happened to our ships here is only just the beginning.Get to the shore. We need to contact the survivors and find out just what we're up against.

Title: A Veteran's Summons
Objective: Meet Eitrigg at the Orgrimmar Embassy.
Text: , we received word from Orgrimmar. Eitrigg has requested a meeting. Says it's important. He left a letter for you.I wouldn't keep him waiting or he might expire of old age before you find out what he wants.

Title: The Glaive of Vol'jin
Objective: Obtain the Glaive of Vol'jin.
Text: When fighting someone who has escaped the grasp of Bwonsamdi, as Zalazane has, it is best to bring weapons that can hurt him. In Darkspear Hold you will find the Glaive of Vol'jin. It should have enough bond with Vol'jin's spirit to aid us in this fight.

Title: Storming In
Objective: Speak with Dread-Admiral Tattersail.
Text: Front and center!As of last night, we received word that Rexxar's force at Warfang Hold in Stormsong was surrounded by a Kul Tiran army and an attack is imminent.As soon as you have your things packed, go speak with Dread-Admiral Tattersail and we'll get underway. There's no time to waste!

Title: The Warlord's Call
Objective: Report to High Warlord Cromush in Zuldazar.
Text: Warfang Hold is our best position on Kul Tiras. We can not allow it to fall!The Warchief has placed High Warlord Cromush in charge of our reinforcement efforts, you are ordered to report to him as soon as possible.

Title: Spirit Call
Objective: Observe Talanji's ritual.
Text: We gonna be reachin' far into de Shadowlands for this. If Vol'jin has gone beyond Bwonsamdi's vision than either he be lost somewhere or hiding. Either way, I am hoping the bond he shares with de gathered Darkspear here can help bring him to us. Stay close and don't interrupt de ritual once it has begun.

Title: The Lost Spirit
Objective: Speak with Princess Talanji in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: It high time you an' I had a talk about ol' Vol'jin's missin' spirit.Dis goes beyond simple bargains and rights of passage. Spirits don' just go missin'.You gotta few friends dat are gonna help ya track Vol'jin's spirit down. Dem who was friends to him in life should have da strength to find him in death. And if not, Talanji gonna help ya.Go to Talanji's ship in da Port of Zandalar. It be dat banged up ship ya came in on. You gonna do a little seance.

Title: Justice for the Fallen
Objective: Bloody the Glaive of Vol'jin in G'huun's corpse.
Text: Justice for da sons and daughters of lost loa. Justice for da heart of Zandalar. G'huun must be slain, and a symbol of his death displayed to those who need see it most. Take me glaive, drive it into da corpse of dat beast, and let Talanji show it to her people. Let peace be started in da hearts of da Zandalari.

Title: The True Leader of Zandalar
Objective: Present the Glaive of Vol'jin with Talanji to the people of Zandalar.
Text: Now, take me glaive and walk with Talanji. Let her present your victory to her people. Let da trolls know justice, and the strength of a leader.

Title: You Owe Me a Spirit
Objective: Bring the Urn of Vol'jin to Bwonsamdi in Nazmir.
Text: Ya not leaving that here. Ol' Vol'jin not be dancin' in my house. I not be seein' his spirit for a long time. Its absence has broken de bonds dat held Zalazane in my control. So... I want you to lift dat heavy urn, and bring it to my necropolis. Vol'jin and I gonna have a face to face on my ground.

Title: Atal'Dazar: Ashes of a Warchief
Objective: Bring Vol'jin's ashes to Atal'Dazar.
Text: I have learned much of de Darkspear lately. Truth is, I have quietly admired dem since I was a little girl, hearin' of Vol'jin's defiance of Zul's reckless call to action. Vol'jin was Warchief of the Horde, chieftain of de Darkspear, and more troll den most can claim to be. His ashes should be honored in a place of kings and queens. Take de ashes to Atal'Dazar with my blessing and honor your former Warchief as he deserves.

Title: Vengeance for Vol'jin
Objective: Destroy Zalazane.
Text: If we mean to destroy Zalazane then we gonna need something that can damage that spirit. Da Glaive of Vol'jin might be what we need to do this. Zalazane be hovering near where he fell so many years ago. Rokhan and Talanji have already gone to face him. Go, slay Zalazane, and then plunge da glaive into the spirit before it can escape. Let us hope de bargain Vol'jin made be powerful enough to destroy this enemy.

Title: Zalazane Returns
Objective: Reach Master Gadrin in the Echo Isles.
Text: , I have never needed your help as much as I do this day. My home be under attack.I only just heard myself. Master Gadrin be callin' for aid. Zalazane, an old enemy of da Darkspear, has returned to da Echo Isles and has brought with him an army of da dead.Zalazane be a traitor who has slain many Darkspear and defiled their souls. Will you come with me to defeat him? We can take da ship dat departs da Port of Zandalar.

Title: Broken Bargain
Objective: Destroy 20 Mindless Trolls on Darkspear Isle.
Text: These mindless undead just keep coming. They be far stronger than they were the last time Zalazane walked this world. Please, help us drive these undead back.

Title: Gathering Mementos
Objective: Search through patches of sea weed to find a memento of the lost sailor.
Text: I have a task dat I can not really trust to anyone else, and I feel you could handle it with de reverence it deserves. An old friend came to me today, bringing a wilted sea stalk flower with her. Her husband was on a ship off the coast of Nazmir. I am unsure if de ship went down because of de naga, de Alliance, or a squall, but she said she did not want revenge. Only closure. If you could go get her something to remember him by, I will tell you everything I know about sea stalks.

Title: Cookie Delivery
Objective: Deliver Box of Cookies to Charles Davenport in the Sprucewood.
Text: Before you head out dear, I have one more favor to ask of you.Please take these cookies with you to Charles.What sort of grandmother would I be if I didn't bake some for him too!?A terrible one, that's what, and I've no wish to be accused of that!

Title: Border Issues
Objective: Convince the House Stormsong militia to clear the blockade.
Text: They've closed off the entire valley! No wonder so many people have been complaining about trading with the Brennadam market.We have to do something about this. These people need to make a living!You're going to have to be an honorary cadet for me here. Tell these ruffians to clear the road!

Title: Cultural Significance
Objective: Learn the importance of sea stalks from people in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: I have noticed dat your skill with harvesting plants has improved, but I have also noticed dat you just treat each flower and leaf as a commodity. De flora of dese islands have a rich history, with a deep cultural significance to us. Go down to the Port of Zandalar, and ask some of the men and women what a sea stalk means to them. Learn from us, and l will make it worth your while.

Title: Fer the Alliance
Objective: Meet Ambassador Moorgard at the Stormwind Embassy.
Text: The mountain will always be home, but there's a whole world o' adventure up there on the surface. Ye look like just the sort o'  to find it.Fer a long time, the Dark Irons stood apart from the other kingdoms. The time has come tae show 'em that we fight fer Azeroth, too.There's an ambassador in Stormwind waitin' tae speak tae ye. He can help guide ye along on yer journey.The Alliance needs our strength. Get out there and show 'em the might o' the mountain!

Title: Time to Leave
Objective: Travel on Galeheart to Stormsong Valley.
Text: I knew it! I knew the fleet wasn't just lost!We may be a little in over our heads here. Let's leave before things get out of hand.Galeheart can take us to Stormsong Valley from here. No point in following tradition at this point, right?

Title: Searching for Answers
Objective: Question Sister Adrianna, Brother Darrel, and Sister Cecilia for information about the missing fleet.
Text: There's a saying Cyrus always said when I was a kid: "The best face is a friendly one." It's really helped me get to know the visitors from all over the world that come through Boralus.Let's ask some of the people in charge around here and see if they know anything about the fleet. Maybe it's just a matter of asking nicely!

Title: Archived Knowledge
Objective: Question Brother Alen for information about the missing fleet.
Text: It seems like this Brother Alen we keep hearing about might have some answers.At least, I sure hope so. Everyone here seems a bit... evasive.I think I saw some archivists heading into the southern cloister. If we follow them, I bet we'll find Alen too.

Title: Gunpowder Plot
Objective: Collect 100 Gunpowder from Volatile Rats.
Text: Granny has everyone out running errands trying to put our hamlet back in order.I don't know what to do. The rats have gotten into our stores, they're eating everything in sight.I tried prodding one of them to get it to move along, it started foaming at the mouth, then it exploded!Think I know where all the gunpowder went...If you recover any, can you please take it back to Marie?

Title: Seeking More Knowledge
Objective: Retrieve the Treatise on Anchor Weed from within Waycrest Manor.
Text: One of de most sacred plants on dis island is anchor weed. Legend says dat it was a gift from de Loa and it can do anything from regrow limbs to granting immortality. If you are looking for facts as to what it can do or how to harvest it, you will need to go elsewhere. The spirits tell me dat dere is a book, dat contains de information you seek. Look for it deep within the Waycrest Manor. Dey ask dat in exchange for dis knowledge, you kill whatever is causing a rift in de spirit world.

Title: For the Horde
Objective: Meet Ambassador Blackguard at the Orgrimmar Embassy.
Text: The Mag'har face a new future.Draenor has fallen. We cannot know if we will ever set eyes upon our homeland again. But this is not the time to wallow in past sorrows.Destiny is ours to decide. Orgrimmar is our home now, and we must make our mark upon this land!Show our allies in the Horde what it means to be Mag'har. Meet with the ambassador at the warchief's embassy, then go forth and claim victories across Azeroth.Strength and honor!

Title: Heritage of the Mag'har
Objective: Meet Overlord Geya'rah in Orgrimmar.
Text: You have fought countless battles across the face of Azeroth. You have shown both our allies and enemies what it means to be Mag'har!Return to Orgrimmar that I may recognize your dedication to our people.

Title: Heritage o' the Dark Iron
Objective: Meet Moira Thaurissan at Shadowforge City.
Text: Ye've done us proud. I've heard tales o' yer bravery during yer journeys across the surface o' Azeroth.Return tae the mountain. We've got somethin' special fer ye.

Title: More Anchor Pods
Objective: Collect 9 Mature Anchor Pods from anchor weed.
Text: I need you to bring me a handful of mature anchor pods. You see, dis seed pod is massive, but it is still just a seed pod. If we dissect it and take careful notes, we can learn about de normal, smaller seed pods and easily see how de anatomy works. I need you to bring me more of dese mature anchor pods. If my theory is correct, den we could actually have a factual record for de future.

Title: Enormous Anchor Pod
Objective: Bring the Enormous Anchor Pod to Jahden Fla.
Text: In all the gathering you've done, you have never come across an anchor pod of this size. Whatever the reason that it has gotten so large, there is much that can be learned from it. Your mind wanders back to Jahden, and if there is anything about it in the book you picked up earlier.

Title: The Uncorrupted
Objective: Return to Ji Firepaw in Orgrimmar to hear the end of this tale.
Text: This world is... not what I expected.It is time for us to meet your warchief.There is no need to delay any further.We can lick our wounds once we have a roof over our heads.

Title: Forged in Fire an' Flame
Objective: Speak with Moira at the Stormwind Embassy to travel to Blackrock Depths and repair the Black Anvil.
Text: Ye've done more than I had any right tae ask. Recovered Ironfoe from our enemy, retrieved a fragment o' the Molten Core, an' exposed the enemy within our ranks at the Firelands.If ye'd do me the honor, would ye come with us tae Blackrock Depths one last time while we repair our most sacred anvil?

Title: Ghost Busting
Objective: Put the Angry Spirit to rest.
Text: I have spoken with de spirits. Most of dem were willing to bare their souls, calling for help from de living as dey are under attack from de blood trolls evil magic. Dere was one, however, who seemed more angry dan most. It was furious dat we had not acted yet, dat we allowed things to get dis bad. Go to de Spirits Be With You inn at de port north of here and put dis spirit down, and in return I will teach you everything else I know about gathering star moss.

Title: Life Preserver
Objective: Protect Zallestrasza while she conducts the ritual.
Text: The Thornspeakers were assisting me but they have troubles of their own.I came in search of a powerful dragon who fell in battle many centuries ago. Melting snows have revealed Vadekius's final resting place.My Queen has tasked me with ensuring his body cannot be reanimated and enslaved. The ritual will require my full attention and my druid friends aren't fit for combat.Watch my back while I ensure my cousin's soul flies amid the branches of G'Hanir, safe from undeath.

Title: A Load of Scrap
Objective: Use the Shred-Master Mk1 on the pair of Tattered Pants.
Text: Hey there stranger, you want the scoop on the latest invention of the century? It's called the Shred-Master Mk1 and this baby can triple, no QUADRUPLE your production capacity as a crafter of armor, weapons or other doohickeys you adventurers wander around with. Here, take these pants and use the Shred-Master on 'em. You'll get the gist of it.

Title: Here In Spirit
Objective: Collect 10 Fresh Star Moss.
Text: If you are up to de challenge, I have a task dat I believe is up your alley. De spirits of dis land are screaming out in anguish. However, dey are either unwilling or unable to talk to me in their current state. I need you to get some fresh star moss, which will help anchor and calm their spirits. Once dey are calm, we will be able to give dem de help dey need. Do dis, and I will teach you how to harvest star moss more effectively.

Title: Pollen Punching
Objective: Collect 12 Heaping Handfuls of Damp Pollen.
Text: It looks like some beast managed to lap up all de pollen with it's tongue. It is curious as to what creature could have done dis, I doubt it matters. You should be able to do dis yourself without needing any sort of rare or dangerous reagents. Next time you find a siren's sting, wet your glove so the pollen will stick to it. Water, wine, blood... It should not matter.

Title: Meet Sweetflower
Objective: Find Xun Xun Sweetflower in Drustvar.
Text: You have seen and learned much from these islands, but Zandalar is not de only place where you can learn. I have heard of a flower dat cannot grow on dese islands. If you want to know more about it, you will need to find someone more knowledgeable dan myself. Fortunately for you, I know of someone who may be able to help you. Her name's Xun Xun Sweetflower, and last I heard she set up shop on the outskirts of Anyport over on de human island of Drustvar.

Title: Learn From the Best
Objective: Drink Jahden's potion and allow wasps to harvest your pollen.
Text: You want to learn how these wasps are so good at harvesting pollen, but dey will defend their territory once you set foot inside it. Dis would be a problem, but I think I have a solution. Take dis potion and go to Vol'dun, to de Prickly Grove, and drink it to turn into a plant. Here's the deal: you go out and drink the potion, you'll see firsthand how the wasps do what they do. After the potion wears off, you tell me what happened.

Title: Disgustingly Damp Flower
Objective: Take the Disgustingly Damp Flower to Jahden Fla.
Text: Rummaging for pollen as usual, you use the harvesting technique you learned from the wasps. However, when you pull your hand away from the flower, you find that there is no pollen to be seen. Looking inside the swirl of petals, despite it being a mature flower, you see that there is no pollen at all. Upon closer inspection you see that the flower is filled with a viscous liquid. Could the flower have done this? While unpleasant to touch, you carefully pluck the flower to show Jahden.

Title: Aromatic Pollenator
Objective: Bring the Dead Pollen-Covered Wasp to Jahden Fla.
Text: While gathering the pollen, you found a dead wasp absolutely covered in pollen. You know that this little creature is the secret to harvesting pollen easier, but the answer seems just out grasp. Maybe if you ask Jahden about it, he might have an idea.

Title: I'm the Captain Now
Objective: Kill Captain Rhenik.
Text: Alright ... It's time to take the mutiny to the captain.Rhenik sits in his cave, readying himself to sell our souls to the Ashvanes!Defeat him, and I will allow you to use my port as though it were your own.

Title: Thros, the Blighted Lands
Objective: Find Jaina in Thros, the Blighted Lands.
Text: The Blighted Lands...If the legends are true then inside we will witness suffering and torment the likes of which we have never known. .....but if that is what I must endure to right what I have wronged, then I will cross that threshold gladly.Will you join me?

Title: Mission Statement
Objective: Receive your mission from Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner.
Text: Come. The Warchief has summoned us to undertake a mission of the utmost secrecy.The very future of the Horde is at stake.I suggest we do not keep her waiting.

Title: Thar She Blows!
Objective: Use the Goblin-Engineered Hand Cannon to sink 3 Fogsail Rowboats.
Text: Our goblin engineers been workin' on modifyin' some cannons for our uses.Da cannonballs you been collectin' be perfect ammo for dem.Dere are rowboats in da harbor dat be readyin' ta bring loot to Owings's enemies. Take dis cannon and sink 'em before dey can get away!

Title: Parleyin' Wit Pirates
Objective: Follow Shadow Hunter Ty'jin and meet First Mate Owings.
Text: Some a dese pirates be unhappy wit' da leadership.I been hearin' dey're da last truly free pirates. Da rest be sellin' out ta some lady named Ashvane.I don' really care 'bout dat, but da captain of dese Fogsail Freebootas is tinkin' 'bout sellin' out too.We gonna help stop it, and in return build a foothold here.

Title: Cannonball Collection
Objective: Collect 3 Fogsail Cannonballs from Fogsail Cannoneers.
Text: Walkin' through da harbor gave me some ideas, boss-mon.Ya see dem big guys wit' da cannonballs?Collect some a dat ammo and bring it ta me. I tink I be havin' a use for it.

Title: A Change in Direction
Objective: Deliver the forged orders to Boatswain Taryn, Quartermaster Killian, and Navigator Swink.
Text: Whispers of dissent have been spreading through the harbor.You can hear the grumblings of pirates who do not want to give up their freedom!Rumor holds that some of the other authority figures have goals that align with mine.I forged some letters in the captain's hand. Deliver them... see who bites.Or who gets in our way.

Title: Spike the Punch
Objective: Spike 6 Kegs of Grog.
Text: Step one in causing a mutiny? Make it seem like leadership is incompetent.If the captain wants to sell our souls to the Ashvanes, we're going to need to get dirty.I hate to say it... but we've got to muck up the booze.That'll make the crew angry at the captain before you can even blink.

Title: Marking Our Territory
Objective: Plant the Horde Banner in Plunder Harbor.
Text: Dis could turn out ta be quite da foothold, boss-mon!I will help wit' da settlin', turnin' da place into a good base.I tink we need some spikes.Let's be makin' tings official.

Title: An Unusual Mentor
Objective: Find Patu in Vol'dun.
Text: You have done well so far, but dere is still much more for you to learn. I think it is time for you to meet an old 'friend'. Dere is no better person I know of to teach you about akunda's bite, as his knowledge and respect for de plant is unrivaled. Head North beyond the desert of Vol'dun. Dere you will find a tortollan who will teach you more about de desert flower.

Title: Swashbuckling in Style
Objective: Put on a pirate disguise from the chest of Pirate Garb.
Text: First ting's first, boss-mon. Ya can't parley with pirates unless ya got da appropriate clothes.I ain't big on fashion, mon, but what ya be wearin' won't work.Luckily I collected dis box of pirate clothes. No need ta ask how. Just need ta get piratey.

Title: Reverse Tinkering
Objective: Gather 4 V-300 serial plates.
Text: The sentry bots here are definitely of gnomish make. If the creator had any sort of proper education, each machine should have some sort of serial code on it.And if they've been properly documented, I might be able to use those codes to track that gnome down.Do you think you could bring a few of them back to me?

Title: Inspection Gadget
Objective: Survey the Rusted Vault.
Text: Some time ago, a good friend of mine who had a tinker shop in Boralus just stopped all correspondence. With the state of foreign affairs, I wasn't able look for him myself until recently.It's not just him, it seems that all of the gnomes that were living in the city just up and vanished.I've decided to start my search with these ruins, but the machines here have gone haywire. Could you go get a good magnetic reading on the place?

Title: I Like Turtles
Objective: Present the offering to Ai'twen.
Text: Excellent work $p.Present the offering to Ai'twen.He will accept it and come to our aid.

Title: Shiver Me Timbers
Objective: Accompany Shadow Hunter Ty'jin to Tiragarde Sound.
Text: It seems our resident shadow hunter has managed to seize a small pirate sloop.We have sent him to Tiragarde Sound in a search for a foothold, and it seems that he has concocted a plan.Ty'jin has requested your help, personally. Do not keep him waiting.

Title: Xibala
Objective: Use the rowboat in Talanji's Rebuke to travel to Xibala.
Text: ! How's things going over here?Oh. Wow. There's Horde soldiers everywhere. And Zandalari trolls. And hardly any machines at all.We should DEFINITELY head back to Xibala, with the dark iron dwarves. It's perfect for our foothold!

Title: There's No Place Like Home
Objective: Talk to Captain Roderick Brewston
Text: So, the Arathi Highlands. Quite a sprawl, isn't it?At some point, you may wish to return to this fair Stromgarde with haste.Might I offer a suggestion as to how...?

Title: Find Their Words
Objective: Deliver the Orders from Nazjatar to Akru at Seekers' Outpost.
Text: This portal will get you quickly back to the outpost.When there, present the orders to Akru.Her knowledge is vast, she will be able to discern the truth within.

Title: Carry On
Objective: Meet Taelia in Brennadam.
Text: Let's get to Brennadam right away. We need to find Brother Pike and get to the bottom of all of this before things get any worse.This road should take us right into town. Brennadam's the busiest market this side of Boralus, so there should be plenty of people there who can help us find Pike.Ready when you are!

Title: Giving Back to Nature
Objective: Plant the Akunda's Bite Sapling and defend it until it builds a static charge.
Text: Perform one additional task, and I will give you the knowledge you seek. The seeds you have are strong, but they need time until they are ready to grow. However, one must always be prepared in the desert. This sapling is mature enough to live on its own, but it is frail. It needs the dry desert winds to build static so it may bite, but until it does, it is as helpless as grass. Plant it in the desert sands, near the fallen beast south of the Brine Basin, and protect it until it can defend itself.

Title: What Happens Next
Objective: Harvest 10 Akunda's Bite without being shocked.
Text: After feeling the bite of Akunda so many times, static electricity causes your hair to stand on end as you hold in your hands an intact lightning pod. You noticed that by wrapping the lightning pod in it's own leaves, you were able to remove it without discharging it. If you manage to develop this technique, harvesting this plant would become significantly less hazardous and provide additional material in pristine condition.

Title: Reporting In
Objective: Report to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane.
Text: I can't believe what we got ourselves in the middle of here. Keystones, C'Thraxxi, there's even a snake-man civil war going on!All I know is Wyrmbane is going to want a full report and if there's anything I hate more than inept privates getting themselves captured it's paperwork.Let's get going.

Title: The Speaker's Imperative
Objective: Return to Stormwind City.
Text: The world's soul is secure... fer now. I can hear Azeroth again, although her voice is still weak.The elementals on the surface above have calmed down. Even using just a fraction of its power, the Heart of Azeroth brought stability tae this place.Ye need tae return tae Stormwind and inform your allies of what transpired here. Remind them that no matter what happens with the Horde, our world must be saved.We'll speak again soon. The battle fer Azeroth has only just begun.

Title: Foul Harvest
Objective: Collect 12 Digested Akunda's Bite Seeds.
Text: You have traveled far to find knowledge, but you have found me instead. I am curious though, how much further you would travel for it. I will teach you, if you do something for me first. Iron sharpens iron, as they say, so too does adversity strengthen the seed. Go out and find seeds, ones that have been consumed by the wild beasts and have returned to the earth unscathed. Only those seeds will be strong enough to survive the desert sands of Vol'dun.

Title: An Unusual Mentor
Objective: Find Patu in Vol'dun.
Text: Hey , you look like you're ready to handle hostile territory. Far away in the desert of Vol'dun, on the continent of Zandalar, there grows a plant called akunda's bite. You couldn't pay me enough to go there myself, and there's almost no mention of them in any of the books I've read, but all is not lost. I know of an herbalist who lives there in the desert and studies that plant. Find him, and I'm sure he'll be able to teach you a thing or two. Oh, and do be warned... He is a bit... eccentric.

Title: Break the Siege
Objective: Disrupt the Faithless assault on the Sanctuary of the Devoted.
Text: This isn't the first time the Faithless have attacked us, nor will it be the last, but the temple must be protected!Please, do whatever you can to destroy their siege equipment and push them back.

Title: Breaking Free
Objective: Find Private James and free him from his captors.
Text: Look, these guys are in a tough spot but let's not lose track of the mission. We've got to rescue Private James!I saw a bunch of cages down in the camp of those snakes that are besieging the temple, if James is going to be anywhere then it'll be there!

Title: Up In Your Drill
Objective: Use the Goblin Mining Machine to disrupt the excavation camp.

Title: Defang the Faithless
Objective: Kill 12 Faithless attackers within the Temple Grounds.
Text: Did you see them as we flew in? The Faithless are sieging the temple!Friend, I know we just met but I must ask for your aid once more. Please, help us break their ranks!

Title: WANTED: The Crimson Cutthroats
Objective: Slay the Crimson Cutthroats near Falconhurst.
Text: For numerous and sinister crimes against the Lord Admiral: smuggling, forgery, sailing under false colors, looting, poaching, brigandage, sacking, pillaging, vandalism, impersonating Kul Tiran Naval officers, arson, kidnapping, torture, piracy, perjury, theft and ransacking multiple mead shipments.A reward is placed on the heads of The Crimson Cutthroats to be paid in full upon proof of their demise.

Title: The Keepers' Keys
Objective: Speak to Private James and uncover the significance of Vorrik's Stone.
Text: It's good to see that your companion is back unharmed.But more importantly, let's see if he still has my stone hidden in his pockets.

Title: Battle Victorious
Objective: Ride Ai'twen and destroy the Venture Companies forces
Text: We have everything necessary to strike a blow against this Venture Company.Our plan is sound, we are well prepared and we have the element of surprise.We shall ride atop Ai'twen and reign chaos upon them with their very own weapons.

Title: WANTED: Quartermaster Ssylis
Objective: Kill Quartermaster Ssylis in Krakenbane Cove.
Text: Don't venture too far into the bay if you're not looking for a fight!A couple of Bilge Rats have taken up residence in a nearby cave, and they won't stand down from any challenge.They ain't harming anybody, 'long as you stay away. But if somebody wants to go take care of their leader, they will be rewarded.

Title: Back to Franklin
Objective: Speak with Franklin The Drunk.
Text: Oh, good! You are still here! I heard you had built a rapport with Franklin. I'd be lying if I said talking about him didn't make me reminisce when we worked together. If you're not busy, could you go talk to him? Ask him if he can show you anything else. I'm sure he remembers more, if you're still looking for more information. And tell him that if he were to get his life sorted out, I'd like to talk to him about working together again.

Title: Flavorable Offering
Objective: Gather 50 Seaweed.
Text: Ai'twen saved many Tortollans during the great purge of the Inky Grotto. He rests here in this tranquil bubble as a reward for his service. To entice him back to our world we'll need a flavorful offering.The seaweed that grows outside is Ai'twen's favorite meal. Its salty flavor will surely coax Ai'twen to leave the bubble for our world. Gather it from the creatures outside this cave, and where it grows wild on the reef.

Title: Friends in Strange Places
Objective: Fly to the Sanctuary of the Devoted.
Text: I saw a creature like your friend here. We both were being held captive by my ruthless kin, the Faithless.Before I was cast aside I gave him something to protect, something most precious. Naturally, I would also like to see your friend's safe return.My people will lend you their aid. Come, I will call for my pterrordax to take us. Together we shall find where your soldier friend was taken.

Title: Can't Teach on an Empty Stomach
Objective: Collect 7 Lane Snapper for Xun Xun Sweetflower. Lane Snapper can be fished from the ocean or purchased from the Auction House.
Text: I would love to teach you, but it's so hard for me to concentrate right now. I haven't eaten anything all day, so it's all I can think about. However, if a helpful adventurer were to fish up some lane snapper from the ocean just behind me, I would owe them a something in return. Perhaps something valuable, such as advice in regards to effectively picking the notorious winter's kiss. If you don't feel like fishing, you could just buy some on the auction house, I don't mind.

Title: WANTED: The Hornet
Objective: Kill The Hornet.
Text: That's it, I'm putting a bounty on that blasted hornet.Every time I try to do some good old fashioned bare-handed fishing, that son of a bear comes after me.Somebody take that bug down!

Title: WANTED: Raging Earthguard
Objective: Kill the Raging Earthguard west of Norwington Estate.
Text: Be careful when traveling toward Anglepoint!An immense creature of the earth has spawned on one of the hills, threatening all who go near.Any adventurers who take down this earthen guardian shall be rewarded greatly.

Title: Antidote Application
Objective: Administer the Antivenom to Vorrik.
Text: The antidote's ready.It smells like death and tastes worse, but it should be potent enough. Let's hope that we're not too late for it to do any good.Here, administer the salve to his wounds. It should work nearly instantly.

Title: Enormous Anchor Pod
Objective: Bring the Enormous Anchor Pod to Declan Senal.
Text: In all the gathering you've done, you have never come across an anchor pod of this size. Whatever the reason that it has gotten so large, there is much that can be learned from it. Your mind wanders back to Declan, and if there is anything about it in the book you picked up earlier.

Title: More Anchor Pods
Objective: Harvest 9 Mature Anchor Pods from anchor weed.
Text: Everyone in Kul Tiras knows that anchor weed is a blight that was brought here by merchants. It thrives in this weather and it leechs nutrients from other plants, so we work to keep it from spreading, but it also has a strong magical essence, keeping us from just eradicating it. However, if it has mutated so it can disperse more seeds, we may need to finally purge it. Bring me the biggest seed pods you can find, we need to see if this is a unique case. I'll dissect this one and learn what I can.

Title: An Explosive Exit
Objective: Find Nisha's wagon and ride it to safety.
Text: Alright. I think it's time we make a run for it.Hopefully my wagon's still nearby.I'll steer us to our hideaway. I just need you to lob explosives onto any sethrak who are brave enough to follow us.

Title: Cultural Significance
Objective: Learn the importance of sea stalks from people in Boralus.
Text: I've noticed your skill with harvesting plants has improved, but I also noticed that you just treat each flower and leaf as a commodity. The flora of these islands have a rich history, with a deep cultural significance to us. Take this sea stalk, go around town, and ask some of the men and women what it means to them. Humor me, and I'll make it worth your while.

Title: Armed and Ready
Objective: Choose a weapon for Nisha.
Text: You must be special if the sethrak didn't kill you right away.Either that, or you'd fetch a good price at the slave market.Don't worry though. We're getting out of here.I have a wagon at the entrance, but no weapon to fight with.Luckily, it seems the sethrak have plenty.

Title: WANTED: Sister Lilias
Objective: Collect Sister Lilias' head from Sister Lilias in Corlain.
Text: The Waycrest Guard seeks an able-bodied soldier to eliminate a threat in Corlain.A witch by the name of Sister Lilias is wanted for the torture and killing of many of our townsfolk. Her end would prove a boon to all of Drustvar.Present her head to claim your reward.

Title: Fragment of the Firelands
Objective: Stabilize the Unstable Magma then use the Magma Elemental to defeat 200 Bilgewater Goblins.
Text: The rumors o' yer capabilities seemed overblown, but it appears yer indeed a competent one, aren't ye?I underestimated ye. For that, I apologize. Don't tell Thaelin.The components for the ritual are now prepared. All ye need to do is add the Firelands Slag to the Unstable Magma an' a great bein' from the Firelands will heed our call.You'll gain control o' it and can eliminate the nearby goblin threat with nigh invincibility.

Title: Poisoned Barbs
Objective: Collect 8 Saltspine Barbs in Bonetrail Gulch.
Text: I'm surprised this snake-man is alive, let alone able to speak. Look at this!It looks like it came from one of those giant insects wandering about in the bottom of the gulch. I'll bet my stripes it's poisoned.You know what they say, that which kills can also cure.Go get a few more of these barbs, I bet if I mix it in with that cactus he's wanting we will get a good antivenom to treat his wounds.

Title: WANTED: Gryphon 'Nappers
Objective: Kill Lindel the Snatcher and Silent Boris.
Text: A warning to all gryphon owners!Do not let your feathered companions out of your sight. We have received numerous reports about gryphons in the area being stolen in the night.If anybody can track down and stop these thieves, a reward awaits!

Title: Anger in a Bottle
Objective: Collect 10 Foul-Smelling Samples.
Text: These quilboar are tougher than normal and I think I found out why. They carry vials of some sort, filled with this nasty orange liquid. They'll quaff it and gain tremendous strength and stamina. I'll bet if we get some of it Hobbs could whip up a counter-agent, or whatever it is that alchemists do. Either way, deprive them of their strength potions and it'll make getting around here easier!

Title: Don't Play with Matches
Objective: Eliminate 10 Venture Co. Flame Starters and 2 Venture Co. Oilers.
Text: These Venture Co. thugs set flame to the very oils they harvest. They hope to drive us from this land.Their plan has a flaw. If a great wave extinguished every torch, their oil could not be lit. You can be our great wave!Extinguish all the flames here, and we shall be victorious this day.

Title: Cave of Ai'twen
Objective: Seek out Loroja in the Cave of Ai'twen.
Text: Toki has researched a strategy that is historically sound. However to defeat the Venture Company, we will have to awaken Ai'twen from the bubble of tranquil waters.Seek out Loroja in the Cave of Ai'twen and we shall begin the process.

Title: Honor Bound
Objective: Find Sergeant Ermey in Vol'dun.
Text: Sergeant Ermey is a man of honor, he would never leave one of his men behind. But one of these days that sentiment is going to get himself killed.We don't even know what threats we face in this land. We certainly don't have the resources to spend searching for a missing private.I want you to go after him. Do whatever it takes to give up this fool's errand and return to the camp. He was last seen headed to the south-east, I'd start your search there.

Title: Unexpected Aid
Objective: Harvest 8 Prickly Pear Roots in Bonetrail Gulch.
Text: I was shadowing those sethrak when I saw this one left for dead beside the trail. I don't think he's like the others. Looks like they roughed him up pretty bad.I made contact and before he passed out he said he knew where our man was being taken!We need to find out what this thing knows!I'll need to make a salve for these wounds. There's some cactus I saw growing around here that should make a good base for it.

Title: Swimming Lessons
Objective: Collect the three scrolls.
Text: For millennia we have roamed Azeroth's depths, yet never has a land walker journeyed with us. In order to help us, you must learn to travel the waters as we do.The three scrolls of the sea shall grant you the energies to travel and survive underwater as we do.Bring me the Scrolls of Harmonious Fins, Endless Tides and Graceful Breaths.

Title: To Matters at Hand
Objective: Use the Teleport Pad to return to Zuldazar
Text: Ye need te get back te Zuldazar, Princess Talanji's people are in desperate need of help.Now that ye got the heart, ye can absorb Azerite from all kinds of sources.Use the teleporter pad behind ye te return te Zuldazar. I be disablin' it when yer done... no need te have the likes of Nathanos walkin' in here.Just remember. Ye got the Heart of Azeroth around yer neck. Whatever happens... we must save the planet.

Title: Drustvar Ho!
Objective: Speak with Eitrigg and Dread-Admiral Tattersail.
Text: Azerite's in the air. Can ya smell it?Drustvar--way over in Kul Tiras--apparently has a real big seam o' Azerite beneath it. Azerite means profit, and profit means winning this war against the Alliance... which means even more profit.We gotta get that Azerite!Check in with Eitrigg an' Tattersail so we can get going soon. Time is money!

Title: Cookies and Cream
Objective: Enjoy Marie's fresh baked cookies and milk.
Text: Thank you for helping me collect everything.I couldn't let you go out there and battle those mean ettins on an empty stomach. Now, I would be no better than those terrible monsters if I did that, would I?$p, you just feel free to take a load off while I make you a fresh batch of cookies and some warm milk!

Title: Daughter of the Sea
Objective: Accompany Jaina Proudmoore to an audience with Katherine Proudmoore.
Text: They're not letting us any closer to the keep. We'll have to walk from here.Returning to Boralus has stirred feelings I thought I'd left behind. Memories smoothed away by the years like stones in the tide.It all feels raw again.I do not know how this will end--only that we must try.

Title: A Trip Across the Ocean
Objective: Report to Trade Prince Gallywix in Zuldazar.
Text: I understand you are to be establishing our foothold in Drustvar. You will be assisted on this mission by Trade Prince Gallywix.I know, a strange choice, but I am told that there is Azerite in Drustvar, and the Trade Prince was insistent.

Title: Cleaning Bills
Objective: Clean 8 Oily Sandbill Pipers
Text: The Venture Company contaminates our pristine waters with toxic oil.My people are strong and will endure this until the time is right to strike back. The creatures with soft skins cannot wait. We must act now and save them from this danger.Collect and scrub clean any oily sandbill pipers you see. Quickly, before it's too late!

Title: Mole Machinations
Objective: Free 4 Dark Iron Earthbreakers from mole machines in Xibala.
Text: Seems the enemy's anticipated our moves. While we developed our refinin' techniques for Azerite, the goblins 'ave done the same.It wasn't five minutes after we established ourselves here that the Horde arrived to disrupt our progress.We've got several shaman of great import waitin' impatiently in the mole machines on that beach.You can take the key and clear the way so they arrive safely.

Title: Sealed Fate
Objective: Destroy the Tidemother's Wrath, Tidemother's Radiance, and Tidemother's Pride.
Text: Three wards ahead threaten to block our entry into the Shrine. We call them the Tidemother's Wrath, Radiance, and Pride.Legends say the wards were gifts from the sea itself. They once protected our flagships against even the fiercest storms. Ever since we settled here they have instead kept the Shrine of the Storm safe.It seems Lord Stormsong has turned their power against us. I can feel their energy radiating out even from here, protecting his forces from our magic.We must destroy them.

Title: The Final Ascent
Objective: Open the Tempest Gate.
Text: Beyond this gate lies Lord Stormsong... and our retribution. It seems he has sealed it tight, likely to buy himself time to finish whatever foul ritual awaits us.Release the souls within the Dead Ringer when you are ready. I will direct them into the binding holding the gate shut.From there, we find Stormsong and end this once and for all.

Title: Raiders of the Lost Crop
Objective: Slay 6 Orc Raiders.
Text: I could use a hand here! So there I was, mindin' my own business and collectin' my harvest when these big galoots show up on their wolves and start torching the town! Luckily I was delivering a sack o' grain, or they'd have caught me and run me down! I won't stand for having these orcs or their dogs chewing up my fields or my crop. What do you say, friend? Help a farmer run some looters off his land?

Title: Grain Drain
Objective: Collect 8 Sacks of Grain.
Text: We've got to salvage what we can. This valley is the breadbasket of Kul Tiras. We feed the citizens, the militia, the army, you name it! Perhaps you've heard of our famous Kul Tiran sourdough bread? Goes great with sausages. More importantly, those blasted Horde are getting in the way of our harvest! Lucky for us, the golems work 'round the clock to package the grain. I just need you to go out to the fields and grab as many bags as you can carry. I'll pay you for your trouble, of course.

Title: Learn From the Best
Objective: Drink Declan's potion and allow bees to harvest your pollen.
Text: You want to learn how these bees are so good at harvesting pollen, but if you show up, they'll start swarming you. What you've got is a problem that can be solved with a little alchemy. I just so happen to have this potion that, once drunk, will turn the imbiber into a plant. Here's the deal: you go out and drink the potion, and you'll see firsthand how the bees do what they do. After the potion wears off, you tell me what happened. Oh, and don't ask why I have that potion on me.

Title: Aromatic Pollenator
Objective: Bring the Dead Pollen-Covered Bee to Declan Senal.
Text: While gathering the pollen, you found a dead bug absolutely covered in pollen. You know that this little creature is the secret to harvesting pollen easier, but the answer seems just out grasp. Maybe if you ask Declan about it, he might have an idea.

Title: Rocks of Ragnaros
Objective: Recover 9 Firelands Slag from the beach in Xibala.
Text: With me shaman still in their conveyances, a vital component o' our upcomin' ritual remains scattered among the supplies.I can only hope the Horde haven't taken 'em. They're rare an' precious...If you see any glowin' objects out there, recover 'em. They're o' tremendous value.

Title: The Underrot: Sealing G'huun's Corruption
Objective: Enter the Underrot and defeat the Unbound Abomination.
Text: Massive leak of G'huun corruption located nearby. Substance surrounding us indicator of G'huun corruption, named underrot.Initial scans suggest a massive abomination composed of underrot is ahead, releasing more corruption into Nazmir.Must destroy Unbound Abomination, contain G'huun's corruption.Function clear. Proceed inside.

Title: Zuldazar Foothold
Objective: Listen to Commander Wyrmbane's battle plan, then speak with Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth to travel to Talanji's Rebuke in Zuldazar.
Text: King Wrynn passed along orders to dispatch our finest to establish a foothold in Zandalar. That means you.Fortunately, we have a few choices as to where we can set up camp.Stick around. I'll go over the battle plan.

Title: Stop the Evacuation
Objective: Stop the Alliance evacuation efforts.
Text: This is a complete disaster. The intelligence you gathered seems to indicate that they already have footholds on this island and this is just another one.They have a boat and we need to stall them. Here's some seaforium. Plant it on their boat and sabotage their hopes of escape. If possible, take out their Captain leading the evacuation.

Title: Zul'Nazman
Objective: Meet Brann Bronzebeard at Zul'Nazman in Nazmir.
Text: Not sure if I like this Harry fella. He's growin' on me, though. Got some wild ideas about the blood elves, but he's not all bad.What were we talkin' about? Ah, right.Captain Conrad. He said the Captain went to Zul'Nazman ta commune with the blood trolls there. Seems... less than well planned.Let's go see what there is to see, shall we?

Title: Voyage to the West
Objective: Speak with Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth and travel to Vol'dun.
Text: Reconnaissance reports that the Horde has made inroads into the desert of Vol'dun.We can't allow the Horde to continue to work there unchecked, so we're preparing an expedition to establish a beachhead., as one of our most accomplished soldiers I'd appreciate if you joined us. Your help will be essential for the success of our mission.Wrap up your affairs here in the harbor and report to Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth. We will set sail when you're ready.

Title: Captain Conrad
Objective: Meet with Captain Conrad at Tul'vor in Nazmir.
Text: Looks like there's couple o' guards posted by this hut. If I had ta guess, Captain Conrad'll be in there.Somethin' still feels off about this place, though. Why don't ya go on ahead and I'll hang here in case things go south fast?I got yer back.

Title: Offerings to G'huun
Objective: Destroy 8 Offerings to G'huun in Zul'Nazman.
Text: Been watchin' these cultists with both good eyes.Those big glowin' jars o' theirs look important.Opened one up and it sent a shiver down me spine, but nothin' seemed worth the takin'.If it ain't worth stealin', I guess it's worth smashin'.

Title: Nazmani Cultists
Objective: Kill 15 Nazmani trolls in Zul'Nazman.
Text: The rumors o' the blood trolls from back in Boralus don't line up with the letters from Captain Conrad.Open to trade? Willin' to work with us against the Horde? Ready to teach us their magic?Hogwash.Only time worth spendin' with these evil trolls is time killin' 'em.

Title: Basement Dwellers
Objective: Collect 8 Spider Silk from the Cellar Crawlers.
Text: Ever since the untimely passing of dear, sweet Lizzie, rest her soul, the pests have multiplied like crazy!In recent days, giant spiders have begun crawling out of the cellar underneath the southern mill.No one has been able to go down there, for fear of being wrapped in web and eaten alive!Would you mind squashing a few arachnids and collecting any silk you find?

Title: Lost and Forgotten
Objective: Fill the Dead Ringer with souls.
Text: We have seen firsthand the depravity that has taken hold of my former brethren. The time has come to put an end to it.The path ahead is no doubt packed with Lord Stormsong's cultists and their soulwrought elementals. I will absorb their souls as they fall with the Dead Ringer, as you once did.However, there will be no release for these fiends... not this time. We will need them to pry open the final door to the Shrine.

Title: Crabulous Feast
Objective: Gather 7 lumps of crab meat from the Derelict Hexopods.
Text: The Forsaken didn't bring any food with them. I think they might be cannibals. At the very least, they don't need to eat!Teekay and I are going to starve out here! , if you're not too busy, could you bring us something to eat?Maybe some fresh crab?

Title: Productive Pests
Objective: Gather 5 bugs
Text: This jungle is a whole new habitat for creatures and critters. A shame we're here to deal with Alliance driftwood.I've got an idea and I think it's genius. Two words: Poison bugs.First, I need some bugs. Crawling and flying ones, just to be thorough for our test.

Title: The Wreckoning
Objective: Kill 10 Shipwrecked 7th Legion.
Text: I can't believe any of them survived the wreck. We were told to prevent any survivors from gaining a foothold.There are far more of them than expected. We need to weaken their forces.Well? What are you waiting for? An engraved invitation?

Title: The Things They Carried
Objective: Acquire intelligence from the Alliance.
Text: We need to know more about these sailors before we report back.Ideally, we would invade their camp but there are too many for our small group to take on. Lucky for us, they are focused on their salvage operation over safety. See if you can find any intelligence on their leaders who are scavenging the derelicts.

Title: What Rots Beneath
Objective: Find Titan Keeper Hezrel within the Altar of Rot.
Text: Good job killin' Ateena and sendin' whatever dat construct was down ta da bottom of... whatever dis ting be.Me scouts be seein' Titan Keeper Hezrel marchin' down to sometin' called da Altar of Rot.Now dat we got rid of dat construct, we can be flyin' down dere ta see what Hezrel be up to.Dis be best handled by you and me. Da princess be havin' business back in da city.

Title: Breaking The Food Chain
Objective: Kill 12 Ravenous Jacunda.
Text: De extra riverbud you planted has helped, but it has not been enough. Some of de local beasts are consuming de riverbud before dey can mature. We need dese plants to germinate, or we could risk losing it entirely. The largest group of young riverbud consumers are de jacunda. If we are going to give de riverbud a chance to survive dis, you will need to thin their numbers. Do dat and I will teach you everything I know about riverbud.

Title: WANTED: Anchorface
Objective: Slay Anchorface in the waters near Anyport.
Text: Kill the blasted shark that ate me legs! And me crew! And me boat - even the anchor!He's been swimming around in the sea, looking for his next meal. Kill 'im.I've left a reward with Cesi Loosecannon if you do.

Title: Krazzlefrazz Outpost
Objective: Use the goblin devices in Krazzlefrazz Outpost to build your foothold in Drustvar.
Text: I already did a bunch of the leg-work for settin' up our foothold. All we gotta do is finish deploying all the instant-base technology, and we'll be good to go here in Drustvar.Why don't you go finish the base building. I'm gonna see if I can salvage any wolfercycle parts.

Title: I Hope There's No Witches in the Mountains
Objective: Drive Eitrigg and Gallywix to the mountains.
Text: You know, ah... I think maybe we better set up our foothold somewhere else. Maybe, up in the mountains? You know, like... not here, where the witches are?

Title: Emergency Transplants
Objective: Plant 10 Riverbud Seeds in rivermud.
Text: Riverbud is a precious resource for us. Not only does it have potent magical properties, but it also feeds many of de beasts we train or eat ourselves. However, de Blood Trolls have been dumping a lot of cursed blood in de rivers. It may not be their goal, but if we do not act soon, de pollution may wipe out all de riverbud. I need you to take dis handful of seeds, and plant dem in de rivermud. In exchange, I will teach you how to harvest it more effectively.

Title: Wiccaphobia
Objective: Investigate the shape up ahead, then protect Eitrigg and Gallywix.
Text: Do you see that... that shape up in the brambles up ahead? Is that...Is that goblin... wrapped up in that tree?

Title: What's Yours is Mined
Objective: Collect 10 Sea Mines
Text: During a visit to Pandaria, I witnessed the citizens of Halfhill defeat attacking hozen by flinging the hozen's excrement back at them.The hozen were unprepared to face the wrath of their own weaponry used against them. A similar strategy can be applied here. We will gather Venture Co. Sea Mines and use them against the invaders.You hook ropes to each mine, and Ai'twen and I will haul them up.

Title: Establish a Beachhead
Objective: Plant the Alliance banner and establish your base in Vol'dun.
Text: I won't allow Private Leonard's sacrifice be in vain. Let's get our men out here and fortify this place up before those... "sethrak" decide to come back.Here, plant this banner somewhere visible so the ship knows its safe. That platform over next to the dock should do the trick.

Title: Death from Two Sides
Objective: Kill 8 Brinefang Saurolisk.
Text: The overgrown lizards from down on the beach decided to swarm the camp suddenly.We're used to dealing with one or two each week, but it seems like the whole brood came up the cliff. Wonder if the smell of blood drew them in.They're putting our remaining men at risk, wipe them out!

Title: Response Required
Objective: Eliminate Lithia Costcutter
Text: Time is short and more creatures will die without your help. The Venture Company prepares a huge digging machine to tear the reef apart and destroy this cave. They've assigned a special operative to be sure the job is done right.You must act now $p, take out the operative in charge of the camp, this should buy us some time.

Title: Undelivered Package
Objective: Deliver the package to Marie Davenport.

Title: Deep Sea Venture
Objective: Eliminate 6 Seawrenches
Text: As mighty as Ai'twen is, this Venture Company is still a threat to him. I need you to watch over Ai'twen and Toki as you continue your great adventure.Eliminate the Venture Company Seawrenches that lurk the waters you travel to.

Title: WANTED: Yarsel'ghun
Objective: Find and kill Yarsel'ghun.
Text: By the decree of the Storm's Wake.Find and kill the foreign spy, Yarsel'ghun.A foreigner agent hiding on our soil, she is responsible for acts of terrorism against the citizens of Stormsong.The individual that ends her existence will earn a fitting reward.

Title: Milking Goats
Objective: Collect 6 Mountain Goat Milk.
Text: Unfortunately, Milbrooke's flock hasn't been producing lately. What with all the wolves about, the poor things must be terrified.Wild goats wander the hills, and they are quite fearless compared to the sheep.If you can find a few with young ones about, you may be able to persuade them to offer some fresh, delicious goat milk!

Title: Be A Dear
Objective: Collect a Water Bucket, Sack of Flour, and Logs then return them to Marie Davenport.
Text: As you can plainly see by the rocks falling from the sky, we are under siege by those terrible ettins!If you could be obliged to lend us a hand, I'd be most grateful. We can't possibly hope to defeat them unless we properly prepare you first.Could you be a dear and fetch a few things for me from around the Hamlet? Some water, a sack of flour and a bundle of logs should help.I've already sent my grandson, Charles, off to fetch a few other items. I've not seen him for quite a while though.

Title: Mighty Grokkfist
Objective: Use the Pack of Rats to kill Grokkfist.
Text: Grandma is always telling me I need to toughen up a little... how easy we've got it these days.I read a story about giants that are terrified of rats, so I thought, "Hey Charles, here's a great idea, let's take all those rats $p gathered and let 'em loose on the ettins."I tried to be tough for once, but look how it turned out. Now, I'm stuck out here, just hoping I don't get squashed.Their leader is just up the hill there. Here, take the rats with you and let's hope I was right!

Title: Wheat A Minute
Objective: Collect 10 Grain Sacks.
Text: With the storage shed ransacked by rats and the giants pillaging our shipments, we've been running low on food.When I was making my way out here, I saw a bunch of grain sacks littered about, near the wrecked wagons.I'd appreciate it if you could retrieve whatever you find while you're out here.

Title: Cry Wolf
Objective: Kill 10 Feral Razorclaws.
Text: Lately, the wolves have been terrorizing my flock. They weren't an issue until the giants moved in and pushed them out of their normal hunting grounds.I feel bad asking you to do this, but could you thin their ranks a bit? If there are fewer wolves competing for food, maybe they'll leave us alone.

Title: The Black Sheep
Objective: Find and rescue Millie.
Text: I'll admit, Millie has never really been one to follow the herd. Usually, it's no problem. She'll wander off for a bit, do her own thing and eventually make her way back to the flock.The hills have grown increasingly more dangerous lately, especially with the wolves and giants about. She's been gone awhile and I'm starting to worry.Could you please help me look for her?

Title: Ettin It Done
Objective: Use Flour Bombs to slay 8 Ettins.
Text: Okay, now here's a little something I whipped up for you with those extra ingredients.We don't have much around here in the way of weapons, but we've got gunpowder and plenty of flour. A surprisingly explosive combination!Toss one of these goodies at those nasty ettins, should disorient them long enough to give 'em a good whack upside the head!You thought I was just a sweet old lady, baking delicious cookies for any ol' passerby? Hah, I'll have you know I was quite the firecracker in my day.

Title: The Heart of Azeroth
Objective: Travel to the Chamber of Heart and commune with Azeroth.
Text: Our world's dyin'. Sargeras's sword has cut deep. Her pain is drivin' the elements into a frenzy!I can hear Azeroth's voice, but she needs more than her speaker.She needs her champion.Far below us lies an ancient titan vault called the Chamber of Heart. I sense she wishes tae speak tae ye there.Come with me into the chamber. It may be our only chance tae save her!

Title: Aww, Rats!
Objective: Collect 8 Bilge Rats.
Text: I didn't sign up for this! I just want to get back to the simple things, like grinding wheat and drinking mead.As if things couldn't get any worse around here, there's an army of rats ransacking the shed and I don't have the stomach to exterminate them.Here, I got this off some crazy gnome that stopped into port recently. I thought maybe it'd help with the bees. Maybe you can try it on the rats?

Title: WANTED: Razorclaw Alpha
Objective: Slay the Razorclaw Alpha.
Text: Adventurers Needed!The wolves have been attacking my flock! I don't have the means to fight them back.I've seen one, much larger than the rest, leading a few of the attacks.Please, if anyone can help, I'll gladly offer whatever reward I can muster.- Shepherd Mary Ann Milbrooke

Title: That One's Mine
Objective: Retrieve Degdod's Hammer from Alan Hawkins.
Text: Yer here to help? I donna have anything... Well, maybe I do.I know it's just a simple hammer. I know it's not special. But it's mine.That disgustin undead, Alan Hawkins, is taunting me wi'it. I promised Feorea I wouldna run off tae fight him, but ye made no such promises.Kill him and retrieve me hammer.

Title: The Glory of the Hunt
Objective: Meet Abbey Watkins at the edge of Foxhollow Woods.
Text: You here for the festival, friend?We're still settin' up here, but the hunt should've started by now!If ya want to take part, go meet Abbey in Foxhollow Woods. She'll get you all set up.Happy huntin'!

Title: The Troll's Tale
Objective: Speak with the Captured Zandalari Troll to find out how the Alliance fleet was sunk.
Text: You've arrived at an... interesting time. All of my ships have been destroyed. Half of my men are feeding the fishes, and the rest aren't doing much better. We're as good as doomed.And still, the Alliance prevails.These Zandalari trolls are to blame for this carnage. I need to know how they did it before we kill them all and escape from this Light-forsaken island.

Title: Granting a Reprieve
Objective: Slay 8 Forsaken and 8 Zandalari in Talanji's Rebuke.
Text: Now, on to more pressing matters.The Forsaken have shown up and are preventing us from saving our people. All my soldiers are either injured, exhausted, or in no shape for fighting.It seems these trollish natives have joined them as well. I am spread too thin.Kill the Horde. Kill the Zandalari. Kill them all.

Title: A Lack of Surplus
Objective: Collect supplies from the shipwreck.
Text: Food, wood, cloth... we're short on everything. Of course, I'm always short, but that donna stop me.Heh.See what ya can salvage from tha shipwrecks.

Title: Save Them All
Objective: Heal 8 injured sailors.
Text: Reinforcements? Ah thank tha Light!We done the best we can triaging the injured, but we need help. We need more hands that can heal wounds or at the verra least apply bandages.How are yer hands? Here, take these bandages and do what ye can tae treat tha injured.

Title: Lessons of the Damned
Objective: Learn of Captain Conrad's progress.
Text: When I arrived here in disguise, the blood trolls thought me some sort of messenger of their Blood God.I seized the advantage and played into their primitive beliefs.I came here intending to open trade and learn how we can work with them against the Horde.What I discovered was altogether more compelling. I will show you.

Title: Ooh Rah!
Objective: Capture Shatterstone Harbor.
Text: We're going to need a harbor for our base of operations. Those ruins across the way should be perfect for our needs.Unfortunately, it looks to be occupied by a hostile force so I'm sending the marines to secure the shore. As the most experienced soldier here I want you to go with them.I don't want to see a single hostile remain when our engineers arrive.Now, go take that harbor in the name of the Alliance!

Title: Flight from the Fall
Objective: Take a bat to Fort Victory.
Text: Let's get outta this hole! Hairs on the back o' me neck won't settle down. Was hopin' I'd find some artifacts, or treasures, or haggis, or at least a few worthwhile trinkets down here.Those bats look like the ones that we came on... hopefully they'll take us back to Fort Victory and not some rotten grotto with no valuables inside.

Title: Zealots of Zalamar
Objective: Slay 10 Zalamar Zealots in The Fall.
Text: We're surrounded by the enemy, and it's got me blood ragin'!I'm fit as a fi... instrument... and ready to help get us outta this forsaken cavern.Let's show 'em the end o' their miserable lives, eh?

Title: Blood of Hir'eek
Objective: Defeat Blood Witch Pakkala.
Text: Spooky chantin' in the next room can only mean one thing: someone's askin' for the ol' what-fer!I'd give ya a hand but I gotta drink a couple-a potions before I'm back on me feet.Take out that blood witch and I bet the magic'll dissipate.

Title: WANTED: Za'roco
Objective: Find and kill Za'roco the Grifter.
Text: To any with honor and a sharp blade:Find and kill the thief, Za'roco.Those that betray their fellow exile don't deserve to live.Any who can cross his name off this list will earn a fitting reward.

Title: WANTED: Sandscout Vesarik
Objective: Find and kill Sandscout Vesarik.
Text: To any and all who wish to see the Faithless empire fall:Sandscout Vesarik was spotted patrolling the dunes to the east. Gather a formidable force and strike him down!Those who succeed will be granted a fitting reward.

Title: WANTED: Cobra Excursion Participants
Objective: Kill Sevriss.
Text: Attention guests of the Goldtusk Inn:We're proud to announce a surprise new addition to our lineup of excursion activities!The new Giant Deadly Unstoppable Killer Cobra Experience is now available!There's no need to sign up, you've all been automatically volunteered for this activity.To participate, simply travel into the dunes north of the inn and try not to be killed by the massive cobra now patrolling the area.We are not currently offering guided tours for this activity. Have fun!

Title: Bring out the Big Gun
Objective: Cannon delivered.

Title: A Letter to the League
Objective: Find the Explorers' League members at the Thovas Base-Camp.
Text: A researcher at the Resort up the hill was hoping to get a letter out to a group called the "Explorers' League". He claims that they have a camp set up near some old Drust ruins on the other side of the sound.There's no official station so it will have to be delivered by hand. If you happen to head in that direction, can you take it with you?

Title: Honoring the Fallen
Objective: Recover 7 Dog Tags from Fort Victory soldiers.
Text: This is a shameful situation. Unforgivable! The soldiers weren't carryin' offerrin's to the blood trolls, they WERE the offerin'!It'd be right difficult to bury 'em proper in this hole. Best we can do is get their dog tags.Poor lads an' lassies.

Title: Left at the Port
Objective: Deliver the package to Dockmaster Tyndall.
Text: There was a mishap when we were loading the most recent shipment for the Southwind Station. Apparently some paperwork meant for the dockmaster was left behind.He can't hand over deliveries to the couriers without it, but the next cargo ferry won't be departing any time soon. Do you think you could deliver it by foot? The ferry dock is just a short ride down the road.

Title: WANTED: Taz'raka the Traitor
Objective: Find and kill Taz'raka the Traitor.
Text: To all caravans and travelers:Beware Taz'raka the Traitor, a skeleton ambushing travelers on the road near Port of Zem'lan. If you must travel on that road, move quickly, and avoid entering any of the ruins.Several caravans have combined resources to offer a reward for Taz'raka's death.To collect, speak with Norah in Camp Lastwind.

Title: A Bundle of Furs
Objective: Deliver the Bundle of Warm Furs to Dandy Jones in Hatherford.
Text: You there! Would you happen to be passing by Hatherford?I have a delivery to make there, but my normal delivery person fell ill after a trip to Anglepoint.Would you mind taking this bundle of furs to Dandy Jones in Hatherford for me? I would go myself, but I must hold down my stall.

Title: Pests
Objective: Slay 8 Thieving Snappers in the Alliance Docks.
Text: Confound it all! These rat-faced thieves keep getting into all of our supplies! I swear, anything that's not tied down, and even some things that are, they nip off with'. You want to make a difference for the war effort in Zandalar? Pop off as many of those buggers as you can find. Otherwise, get on with it!

Title: WANTED: Tojek
Objective: Hunt down Tojek.

Title: Share the Wealth
Objective: Take the gold to Shealds.

Title: Curse of Jani
Objective: Survive the Trial of Jani.
Text: Thief and killer, know dat ya be standin' before da Patron of Scavengers, da Lord of Thieves, da God of Garbage, Master of Minions, and da Keeper of Secrets. Ya be standin' before me in raiment worth entire kingdoms of gold, bearin' weapons dat cost more than even me most devout and renowned followers will ever earn. I tink now be a good time ta teach ya a lesson. Maybe show ya high and mighty greatness what it means ta be snappin' in da gutters.

Title: Kua'fon's Day Off
Objective: Stop Kua'fon from being a nuisance in the Port of Zandalar.
Text: You know, I think Kua'fon might be lonely when you are not here.What makes me say that? Well, I got a very angry scroll from a Tortollan indicating he was stealing shiny things from their stalls, but that could mean anything.You should probably stop him before he damages your reputation, hm?

Title: Kua'fon's Day Off
Objective: Find Kua'fon at the Terrace of the Chosen and send him home.
Text: A messenger came from de Terrace of de Chosen. Your companion is at it again.Not even de priests of Pa'ku seem to be able to convince him to leave. You should go and send him back home, where he belongs.

Title: Dubious Offering
Objective: Take a bat from Fort Victory to Zalamar in Nazmir.
Text: Cannae be sure o' the wisdom o' this Captain Conrad.Sendin' our own on these blood troll bats with offerin's?Somethin' about this stinks more'n an armpit after a bar fight.

Title: If Bones Could Talk
Objective: Collect a Pristine Rune-Etched Bone from Awakened Dead in Alpine Rise.

Title: King or Prey
Objective: Return to Baine in the Royal Chambers.
Text: My loa has seen fit to question my resolve.For my people, my pride, and my faith, we will correct dis. Return to your Horde. Ready your forces, and I will ready mine.When de time comes, we will strike back against de traitorous snake, Zul.

Title: The Wounded King
Objective: Meet Zolani in Zeb'ahari.
Text: I have things under control here... for now, at any rate.If we want to salvage this situation, Rastakhan must survive. Habutu is gone, but his other guardian, Zolani, has sent word.She is protecting the King at a small fishing village called Zeb'ahari. Find Zolani and do what you can to ensure Rastakhan lives.Be careful.

Title: WANTED: Ten'gor and Nol'ixwan
Objective: Slay Nol'ixwan and Ten'gor
