Text: To any hunters worthy of the challenge: Find and defeat the dueling giant direhorn and devilsaur, named Nol'ixwan and Ten'gor. Their never-ending battle has disrupted travel throughout Zuldazar. Glory for any that succeed!

Title: WANTED: Dark Chronicler
Objective: Slay Dark Chronicler
Text: Champion wanted for an expedition into the depths of Xibala. Strange noises and wails come from the bones at night and our workers are terrified. Seek out the source of the strange noises and destroy it, and a reward will be yours.

Title: WANTED: Tojek
Objective: Hunt down Tojek.
Text: A reward of gold be promised to de one dat slays da creature Tojek. You know what dey say, an eye for an eye!-Rovash

Title: Break's Over
Objective: Return 3 Lazy Peons to work.
Text: It's come to my attention a few of our peons have been caught sleeping instead of hauling iron from the mine. We can't let our supplies get low.Take this club and get those lazy peons back on track.

Title: WANTED: Prime Thumpknuckle
Objective: Slay a Prime Thumpknuckle
Text: To any and all brave enough to seek the challenge: Find and defeat a Prime Thumpknuckle, the largest and most dangerous of all the wild gorillas. They can be found up and down the road from the Village in the Vines. A reward for any that succeed!

Title: WANTED: Sabertusk Empress
Objective: Slay a Sabertusk Empress
Text: To any and all brave enough to seek the challenge: Find and defeat a ferocious Sabertusk Empress, the strongest and most vicious of all sabertusks in Zuldazar. They can be found up and down the road from the Village in the Vines. A reward for any that succeed!

Title: Iron Stores
Objective: Use the Heavy Iron Key to access the Iron Stores.
Text: While the mine is under Horde banners our peons ensure the iron supply never runs dry.This key provides access to the chest. Make sure it still works.

Title: Raiding the Boulderfist
Objective: Obtain 200 pieces of Unprocessed Iron Ore.
Text: The Boulderfist have recently raided Drywhisker Mine, and are sitting on a large amount of iron ore.We want it back.

Title: WANTED: Dark Chronicler
Objective: Slay Dark Chronicler
Text: Champion wanted for an expedition into the depths of Xibala. Strange noises and wails come from the bones at night and our workers are terrified. Seek out the source of the strange noises and destroy it, and a reward will be yours.

Title: Heart of Darkness
Objective: Accompany Brann to Fort Victory in Nazmir.
Text: We sent troops with Captain Conrad ahead to Nazmir to gain a foothold in that hellish jungle.The reports we've been receiving of the local troll population are... disconcerting.They're in over their heads. I have Brann Bronzebeard prepped and ready to head out.Accompany Brann to Nazmir so we can secure our position. The Wind's Redemption is at your disposal.

Title: WANTED: Darkspeaker Jo'la
Objective: Slay Darkspeaker Jo'la
Text: Wanted for atrocious crimes against the Zandalari: Darkspeaker Jo'la Defeat this powerful adherent of Zul, and a great reward shall be yours.

Title: Azerite Madness
Objective: Absorb Azerite from defeated Azerite Infused Elementals.
Text: There be a group of earth elementals nearby that be goin' crazy due te havin' Azerite infused onto 'em.We cannot allow this Azerite to spread to any more elementals. We need te put 'em down.Go and fight these Azerite infused elementals nearby. When they be down, use yer amulet to absorb their lingerin' Azerite.It be a shame te do this, but we're fightin' these things in order te save the planet.

Title: The First Time I Died
Objective: Place the idols on the altar and try to destroy them.
Text: Dis be it. Where Zem'lan cursed us all.It began with me death. De first of countless deaths I've had since. Each of dem spent fighting and dying for Pirate-King Zem'lan and his selfish treasure hoard.I don't know if de idols he used to curse us can even be destroyed, but we gotta try. Let's take dem to de altar where de ritual occurred and try to smash one.

Title: Escaping Zem'lan
Objective: Ride Jamboya's boat to the shore and lead the pirates to Camp Lastwind.
Text: Pirate-King Zem'lan was right about one thing: he won't stay dead for long.We gotta take our treasure and get out of here while we got de chance.We can take de boat, but we'll need a place to hide out for awhile. Are your vulpera friends open to housin' a few stowaways?Clearly, we can pay dem for their trouble.

Title: Raiding Their Stores
Objective: Obtain a Roast Boar, a Colossal Cheese Wheel, a Basket of Eggs, and a Keg of Applebrew.
Text: We're low on food supplies.Hit up Newstead and bring us whatever you can find.

Title: The Golden Isle
Objective: Ride in Jamboya's boat out to the Golden Isle.
Text: Pirate-King Zem'lan don't stay in de port with de rest of us. Too good to crack a jug with his crew no more.We gotta sail out to de Golden Isle to find him. That be de forbidden island where Zem'lan hoards all of de treasure we've pillaged and plundered, so only he can enjoy dem.Hop in my boat and we'll row out dere together.

Title: My Last Day Alive
Objective: Use First Mate Jamboya's Medallion to witness visions of his past.
Text: De curse came one fateful day, in ages past, when de sethrak attacked. Dere was no end to dem.In our desperation, I helped Pirate-King Zem'lan do de unthinkable.We became monsters. Even worse, we became eternal slaves to Zem'lan.De curse weighs heavy on me, but my guilt is heavier. I led me crew into dis.Before we confront de Pirate-King himself, you need to understand what we be up against.You need to see what happened de day dat de Port of Zem'lan fell.

Title: Maroon 'em with Fire
Objective: Use the Undying Torch to burn 8 Pillaging Canoes.
Text: We gonna have to sail out to de Golden Isle to face Pirate-King Zem'lan.Let's make sure de rest of de crew can't follow us once we go. Burn their boats in de harbor.

Title: The Day the Port Fell
Objective: Use First Mate Jamboya's Medallion to view a vision of his past.
Text: Dis be a cursed landr. Feel it in your bones: de cold chill of death... and undeath.De Pirate-King Zem'lan rules dis port, with his crew of de eternal damned.If you be lookin' for honor or noble adventure, you won't find it here. But if you can settle for vengeance and treasure, I got an offer for you.But you should know who you be allying with. My hands are not clean in dis.Take de medallion from my cloak and use it to reveal a vision of my past at de end of de dock.

Title: The Yard Arm of the Law
Objective: Free Quartermaster Tulmac, Gunner Bosanya, and Jukanga the Snitch.
Text: I'm not de only pirate Zem'lan has had strung up around de port. Hangin' on de yard arm is his favorite form of punishment for de crew.We can't feel pain and don't stay dead, so his options are limited.Look for more crewmates hangin' around town. Tell dem to meet me here after you free dem.After weeks of hanging helplessly while being mocked and abused by de rest of de crew, I bet dey be willin' to discuss mutiny.

Title: Our Share of the Plunder
Objective: Collect 12 Cursed Treasures of Zem'lan.
Text: Dis treasure belongs to de crew! We've fought every battle for Zem'lan, but he hoards all de booty for himself.And if ya try to take some for yourself, he turns ya into one of his goldslaves. Those be de mindless drones ya see tendin' to de treasure out here.We ain't leavin' here empty-handed after de mutiny. Collect all de treasure ya can!Beware de cursed bits. It don't hurt us, but I'm guessin' it'll hurt you.

Title: Overdue Mutiny
Objective: Free First Mate Jamboya.
Text: I used to be a Zandalari.Long ago, before dis curse. We were all Zandalari pirates, proudly sailing under de black flag of our captain, Zem'lan.Now look at us... undead monsters, forced to serve our eternal captain like slaves.Well, I be done with dis. De curse can't be broken, but we can still mutiny!What say you? It gonna be tough, but I promise treasure and a chance to kill de notorious Pirate-King Zem'lan who murdered your vulpera friend.Help me down, and we be gettin' started.

Title: Cutthroat Business Practices
Objective: Slay Gary Cofferdam in Anyport.
Text: I used to run the inn here. Was a nice gig. I got first crack a lot of good stuff and all the best gossip and information came through my place.And then that jerk, Gary Cofferdam, came in and kicked me out! The new Boss laughed!I'm lookin' at my last few silvers here. Business is not good!Tell ya what, you remove my problem and I'll side up with Cesi. She'd never kick me out.

Title: Asking for a Friend
Objective: Ask Xun Xun Sweetflower what she would like and acquire it in Anyport.
Text: Hey! Since you helped Cesi I thought maybe you might do a favor for me.Well, uh, y'see Miss Sweetflower over there? Sweet as honey, sharp as a tack, and cooks like a goddess.I'm not much to look at, but the lady might think kindly on me if I could surprise her with a gift. A really great gift! But I can't leave m'post or these red-coated jerks might run off with the merchandise.This is where you come in. Find out what Miss Sweetflower wants, get it and bring it back to me.

Title: She's Got it Where it Counts
Objective: Free Miranda the falcon.
Text: Word is you're looking to drum up support for Loosecannon. Well I'll buy in if you help me. They took my poor Miranda!Boss Tornsail says I had too much to drink and bet her in cards. I don't really remember what happened last night, but I can hold my liquor and I'd never bet my bird! I suspect funny business. She might not look like much, but Miranda's the fastest damn falcon you'll ever see.They're watching me, so you go free her. She'll fly someplace safe and I'll get her later. We got a deal?

Title: Seeking More Knowledge
Objective: Retrieve the Treatise on Anchor Weed from within Waycrest Manor.
Text: It pains me to admit that I don't know everything about plants. I've taught you everything I know about Anchor Weed, but I think I know where you could look to learn more. Unfortunately, it's in Waycrest Manor, and that whole area's been crawling with monsters as of late. If you find yourself inside that manor, keep an eye out for a book called, "The Treatise on Anchor Weed". Its author spent decades studying that forsaken weed.

Title: Every Day I'm Smugglin'
Objective: Collect 5 Smuggled Goods from the sea near the shipwreck close to Anyport.
Text: Hey! Wanna make some quick gold?See, I had a mishap a few weeks ago with a shipment. Too much grog, dark seas, sudden rocks. You know, that old story.Anyway, my cargo's been floating out there and no one will get it back for me. Can you believe it? You bring my cargo back and I'll pay you a generous recovery fee.We got a deal? Great!Oh, uh, watch out for the sharks. Did I forget to mention the sharks?

Title: An Economic Opportunity
Objective: Meet Cesi Loosecannon inside Anyport.
Text: You look savvy enough to jump on an opportunity when one comes by and, pal, do I have one for you.See that cove down there? It's run by entrepreneurs with an eye towards meeting the logistical shortfalls that might come up in your typical city or town situation. Well, it's normally run by them.We have a bit of an infestation by folks who are more mercenary minded if you catch my meaning.You help me win back control of the cove and I'll see you're treated well. Sound good?

Title: Cutting Edge Poultry Science
Objective: Take the Delicious Chicken to Dr. Oglethorpe in Booty Bay.

Title: Just a Nip
Objective: Get 10 samples of Atrivax Gel.
Text: My tough-guys-in-training are quick learners!They do seem to get a bit... bitey... when they're grouchy, though. Too many, and I start to get a little light-headed.The nearby atrivax plants have a medicinal gel. It is great to treat fresh wounds and nullify venom.They don't like sharing it. Could you harvest a bit for me?

Title: Out With the Old Boss
Objective: Slay Richard Tornsail.
Text: Right so I talked to some people. You talked to some people. No one likes the Irontide. They're cutting in to profits and scaring off good, honest scoundrel- er customers!We take out the guy in charge and we'll be able to run the rest outta town! So a little change of management is in order.I'm not usually one for stabbin' people, I'm a lover not a fighter, but I can pay. You do this for me and I'll make sure you're welcome here whenever ya want? Sound good?

Title: My Hungry Neighbor
Objective: Kill the Territorial Hydra.
Text: There is an angry hydra that has decided to make a nearby ridge his home.He keeps getting bigger, and meaner, and hungrier!My cobras are terrified.Please, take care of him before he comes after us!

Title: Proudmoore's Parley
Objective: Report to Genn Greymane in Boralus Harbor.
Text: So, we meet again.I... apologize for how you were treated last time. I trusted Priscilla like a sister and--Let us keep this brief, for I will make no promises nor any formal accords in this state.Return to your leaders. Tell them I wish to parley.That is all for now. My people have suffered a great deal today and I have much to reflect upon.

Title: The Heart's Power
Objective: Ask Magni Bronzebeard to empower the Heart of Azeroth.
Text: The world's soul grows stronger, but there's still trouble out there. Azerite surges from her wounds, and all sides fight tae claim its might.Ye have proven yerself tae be Azeroth's champion. And thanks tae all ye have done, I sense a great power stirrin' in that amulet ye wear.Azeroth calls tae us. She wants me tae help ye unlock even greater strength in her Heart. Are ye ready?

Title: An Ancient Curse
Objective: Activate the braziers of Xal'vor and defeat Aiji the Accursed.

Title: A Farmer's Fate
Objective: Empower the Everliving Branch.
Text: Old Jakob here was one of the few folks who were never wary of us. I have, on occasion, even helped him around his farm in return for supplies. It is an injustice just to ignore his plight even amidst our own problems.The corruption which holds him seems to be early in form. I believe I can cleanse it.Take this branch, and bring it to the three shrines around the Ashenwood. That should allow it to gather enough energy for the ritual.

Title: Those Who Remain
Objective: Collect 8 Ashenwood Relics.

Title: Lost in the Woods
Objective: Find Amalie Oakseeker.
Text: My student, Amalie, and I have taken it upon ourselves to act as the keepers of these woods. We were away from Drustvar briefly, and upon our return, found the grove infested and the surrounding land corrupted.Amalie decided that she could deal with the grove infestation alone.It's been some time since she ran off, could you look for her while you're in the Ashenwood?

Title: Of Dark Deeds and Dark Days
Objective: Speak with Princess Talanji in the Royal Chambers of Dazar'alor.
Text: I should have known better, and now Rezan is dead, and my own power is barely holding on. Soon Bwonsamdi himself will be coming to collect me. Talanji... she must know what has happened here. Go to her, tell her. Aid her where you can. I followed a god of strength and yet I have not de strength to face her with dis shame. For now, I must gather our forces and pursue Zul.

Title: Sweete's Orders
Objective: Bring Sweete's Orders to Lucille Waycrest in Drustvar.

Title: Walking-Around Money
Objective: Accept the money.
Text: This is a lot of gold! It's gonna take me a while to split this up. I can give you some walking-around money to hold you over until I am done.Come back tomorrow, maybe I will have it figured out.

Title: Greenstalker
Objective: Slay Greenstalker.
Text: The mighty wolf Greenstalker was once a protector of these forests. He has fallen under the sway of dark forces. My brother and I attempted to calm his spirit, but he is too far gone.Use the charm I have constructed to weaken him. I ask you , please, end his suffering.My brother is still weak and I must stay to protect him. Go now before the wolf consumes us all!

Title: We're Not Friends
Objective: Eliminate Calico McGee.
Text: I did some time in Tol Dagor with the captain of this crew, Calico McGee. He likes to hang back and direct his men from afar.I just happened to have spotted him across the flats. You and I should go pay him a visit!

Title: Zandalar Forever!
Objective: Complete the Zandalar Forever scenario.
Text: Bwonsamdi has whispered a warning to me: the enemy is on the move.I have gathered what defenses I could in the time allowed but we are dangerously under powered.I can only hope that, thanks to your efforts, the loa will be with us this day.Are you ready to defend Zandalar?

Title: Down, But Not Out
Objective: Accept Kua'fon as your new traveling companion.
Text: Skree! Skree!!

Title: Wisdom of the Wingless
Objective: Seek out Hexlord Raal.
Text: It's not going anywhere. Maybe it's time to seek someone without wings for advice.

Title: An Unfortunate Event
Objective: Discover what happened to the Imperial Guard.

Title: The Joy of Flight
Objective: Follow Hexlord Raal and fly Kua'fon back to the roost
Text: You be ready?Kua'fon is ready to fly. Whether or not he can is another question, but all the same I will see you two back to the roost.Climb aboard and guide him. I can't imagine he can see very well through that skull.Ata and I will lead the way.

Title: Dress for the Slide, Not the Ride
Objective: Collect a Berserker Skull and Lightweight Skyterror Barding.
Text: If Kua'fon is serious about flying, we're going to need to protect him.Go get a berserker skull and some armor for it. Meet me down in Talanji's Rebuke and we'll get him dressed for success.

Title: A Chance Sighting
Objective: Investigate the missing Zandalari.
Text: One of the lookouts said he saw a bunch of blood trolls chasing after a Zandalari on the other side of the river.He seemed to be dressed like your group. Why do you people keep running into trouble in this place?I'll mark on your map where he was last seen. Just don't bring a horde of blood trolls over here, alright?

Title: Powder to the People
Objective: Gather Azerite from 6 crates.
Text: The Horde filth up on that hill seem to be mining some kind of ore I've not seen before.If they've come all the way out here to find it, it must be valuable. Take what you can find!

Title: Akunda's Blessing
Objective: Commune at Akunda's Shrine.
Text: You have proven worthy of my blessing.This means should you choose me as your loa, you can call upon my power when needed.Commune at my shrine to receive my gift.Know that whatever you choose, you will always be welcome within these walls.

Title: Remix to Ignition
Objective: Find the ignition key.

Title: Falling With Style
Objective: Take Kua'fon on another flight on the Huge Dragon Kite.
Text: Skree.

Title: One Man Against the Horde
Objective: Kill 10 Horde forces.
Text: Me an' a few friends were trying to help some of the folks from Corlain flee safely to Arom's Stand after things started gettin' weird. I noticed some movement up the hill so I decided to come back and check it out. If the town goin' mad wasn't bad enough, now we have another problem to deal with.The Horde.Those fools have no place on our lands. Wash the snow with their blood.

Title: Never Outgunned
Objective: Find us 15 Rebel Weapons.
Text: This is our new home now, and we will fight to keep it!We may be outnumbered here, but we aren't going to be outgunned.Find us every axe, sword, spear, crossbow, and gun for our rebellion!

Title: Smells Like Trouble
Objective: Slay Force Commanders Ogarth and Durmok.
Text: The Horde spilled a lot of blood in Brennadam. Now it's time to spill some more.The scent of blood makes predators in these hills go crazy. We use it to lure animals when hunting.The Horde forces are occupying caves up in the hills. Toss these scent vials into the caves where the Force Commanders organize the attack. The smell should bring all the hills down upon them!

Title: Dangerous Game
Objective: Rid the hills of these Forsaken Keenblades.
Text: Most of these Horde don't scare us, but we lost two people today to a group of forsaken keenblades. We've had trouble tracking them down, we could really use your help.They're stealthy and dangerous fighters, so show no mercy.

Title: The Abandoned Passage
Objective: Find Bladeguard Kaja and Warguard Rakera in Atul'Aman.
Text: My people have known about this ancient passageway for generations, but none have dared enter before now.The tunnel leads to the tomb of Mythrax the Unraveler and it is said that his power still radiates within the cavern. Who knows what horrors await us inside...It appears that your friends have already gone inside to face Jakra'zet and stop him from raising Mythrax from the dead.We don't have time to waste. We must find Kaja and Rakera before they confront Jakra'zet on their own!

Title: A Missing Master
Objective: Find Master Ashton.
Text: Master Ashton had me grab some healing supplies and run to Mayor Royston when those things attacked town. He didn't make it behind the barricade.But if he's alive, and he's just crazy enough he might be, he's probably holed up in his cottage. With caustic compounds. And explosives.Look, why don't you go check out his basement and I'll stay out of the blast radi- I mean I'll go see if the garden can be salvaged.Try not to look flammable.

Title: Maybe When You're Older
Objective: Return to the nest at Pterror Rise.
Text: Well, I am out of ideas. My son will take you back to the nest. Do not worry, this one can fly.YOUR little one will need to get back on his own. It builds character.Maybe he will grow out of this absurd deficiency in time.

Title: Turn the Heat Around
Objective: Destroy 6 pieces of goblin machinery.

Title: Surrogate Wings
Objective: Acquire a Huge Dragon Kite.
Text: It is not my way to coddle the young of my brood. But I think I will make an exception for your little one.After all, I have seen you tend to him. It would be cruel to let your... efforts... go to waste.Venture into Zuldazar city proper and find something that can act as a surrogate wing for your young one.Wingminder Goja will know what to do next. Speak to him once you have it.

Title: All to Ash
Objective: Speak to Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner in Undercity.
Text: All throughout our campaign here, I understood the warchief's objective. I saw her strategy... believed in its necessity.With Darnassus in Horde hands, the Alliance would be paralyzed. Anger and fear would fester in their hearts until they cracked and splintered like deadwood.But this... this will unite them. They will come for us. All of them.Return to the Undercity. Speak to the warchief. We must make ready for what is to come.

Title: Ptrust Fall
Objective: Board the Huge Dragon Kite and take your pterrordax on a flight to build his confidence.
Text: I just want you to know how unusual this is for Pa'ku. She prefers to teach on the fly.What? It's true.This method might work. Sometimes when young pterrordax are not eager to fly, their mother will drag them from the nest and hold them in her claws until they are comfortable enough to spread their wings.Seeing as this little one has no mother, you will use the kite to act as one.Pa'ku has placed a trail for you to follow.Go and glide carefully- you may frighten your pterrordax more!

Title: Royal Report
Objective: Deliver Zolani's report to Habutu at the Golden Throne.
Text: Blood magics practiced in de city, guards missing, and our chief spy, Yazma, is acting suspicious. We must present dis to Rastakhan, but without Yazma interfering. Luckily, Rastakhan is a clever king, which is something his opponents often forget. I have prepared a report in a code made by King Rastakhan and known only to myself and my brother, Habutu. Bring it to Habutu and he will see dat it gets to de king's ear.

Title: An Unstoppable Force
Objective: Disrupt the Alliance forces in Darkshore.
Text: Now is the time to strike.Passing through the wall will not be easy, but I think it's something you can handle. Do what you must to prevail, and meet me on the other side. I will lead a squad of sturdy soldiers and as many demolishers as can survive the passing.We may not make it to Darnassus today, but the outcome of this war does not rest on one victory alone -- it will come as the result of a thousand small victories.So let's get started, shall we?

Title: The Trees Have Ears
Objective: Defeat the Burning Ancient.
Text: With the eyes of the forest shut, one thing remains: the ears. Ancients.They feel the vibrations of our footsteps and report our every move to Malfurion.Got that torch handy?

Title: Blurred Vision
Objective: Eliminate the Sentry Owls in the trees and slay the frenzied furbolg of Darkshore.
Text: Look up.See them, scattered among the trees? Those brightly glowing owls are not living, breathing denizens of the forest... they are Kaldorei magic. Sentries. A ruse -- reporting everything they see back to Malfurion.We can't have that, now can we?Deal with them. But take care -- they aren't the only enemies in the forest.We cannot allow anything or anyone to stand in our way.

Title: A Nose for Ptrouble
Objective: Find Kua'fon in the Savagelands and rescue him.
Text: Kua'fon is getting very large. Perhaps he thinks himself equal to de beasts of this jungle.He may well learn that he is not. You should find him before that lesson costs him his life.I heard a commotion to de north. Start there.

Title: SKREEEEE!
Objective: Feed Kua'fon.
Text: SKREEEEEEEEE!!

Title: SKREEEEE!
Objective: Feed Kua'fon.
Text: SKREEEEEEEEE!!

Title: The Port of Zandalar
Objective: Meet Zolani in the Grand Bazaar.
Text: King Rastakhan has given me orders to investigate de Harbor of Zandalar. De claim Princess Talanji has levied against General Jakra'zet for failing to maintain de safety of our kingdom is a serious accusation. For dis task, I would have you join me so dat I might have an outside perspective. When you are ready, meet me in de Grand Bazaar.

Title: A Nose for Ptrouble
Objective: Find Kua'fon in Atal'Gral and rescue him from danger.
Text: Ah, so you noticed he is missing again.I would check de east this time. I heard some screeching from that direction.I am sure he will be fine- after all, what sort of trouble could he get in with you looking after him?Best find out.

Title: Mast Effect
Objective: Find Kua'fon in Talanji's Rebuke and bribe him down with fish.
Text: Kua'fon was peering over de edge and managed to fall off de cliff again.Normally he gets back up here on his own, but it be taking too long this time.Best go down to de beach and find him. He is probably stuck up one of de ship masts out there.If he will not come down, you can try bribing him with more fish.

Title: Shrine of the Storm: Whispers Below
Objective: Defeat Lord Stormsong in the Shrine of the Storm.
Text: We must not let Lord Stormsong finish his work.If he delivers the fleet to Azshara, all of Kul Tiras will be vulnerable. Countless innocents will perish -- or worse.There is no time to wait for more of the Storm's Wake to arrive. We finish this now, for the good of all who call this valley home.We finish this for Samuel.

Title: A Quick Flyover
Objective: Use explosives to fend off the Alliance army in Darkshore.
Text: Malfurion knows that his wisp wall is a temporary measure. He is buying time for reinforcements to arrive in Teldrassil.It is imperative that we find a way through that wall, and quickly.I want you to take our explosive reserves and apply pressure. You will not be able to bring it down, but you may be able to find us an opening. I will have a squadron ready to strike once you break ground.Zarvik Blastwix should have a few bombardiers for the job.

Title: A Charming Tail
Objective: Send 15 cobras to Jenoh.
Text: I think they would make great guardians, when they get older... with the proper training.However, it seems some of my trainees have wandered off. There are so many things nearby that could harm them!Between the walking sandstorms and angry plants... it's been safer to hide out here and look at night.I'm so exhausted!Could you take this flute with you and play them a little tune? It will remind them to come back to me.

Title: Keep It Down!
Objective: Warn the goblins of danger.
Text: There is a lot of noise and light coming from those filthy mechs down by the shore. No wonder my little hatchlings get so cranky!They are shaking up a coast that is already unstable. You never know what one might wake up that way!Let them know they should be careful.

Title: Storm's End
Objective: Confront Lord Stormsong.
Text: I've no doubt he can feel our presence, but so long as Lord Stormsong maintains his spell the first move is ours.We have him surrounded, cornered like the rat he is. We must end this together.

Title: A Lost Flute
Objective: Find the owner of the Desert Flute.

Title: Awakened Elements
Objective: Investigate the disturbance.
Text: It seems that all of this infernal blasting and hammering has stirred up... something.I heard some screaming from over in that direction.If you could go take care of the situation, that would be most appreciated.

Title: A Horrible Place
Objective: Collect 6 Wetshell Turtles.
Text: This town is a horrible place full of bad people. All they care about is money! No one cares about the turtles!The turtles are out there, thirsty, drying up, and getting stepped on by monsters!You have to save the turtles for me!

Title: Iron Low Tide
Objective: Kill 10 Irontide Pirates.
Text: A few years ago I tried to join the Irontide. They said I wasn't "Irontide material", not cruel or heartless enough!So I teamed up with Nedly and Moxie here in Deadwash, and we started looking for treasure on our own.Let's show these Irontide they're not "Deadwash material".

Title: Halting the Empire's Fall
Objective: Speak to Baine Bloodhoof within Zuldazar.
Text: Nazmir be havin' problem after problem. I not be knowin' how it can get much worse dan an Old God tryin' ta take over.I be makin' me way back ta Zul'jan ta lead our efforts ta keep Nazmir safe.Ya should return ta Zuldazar and let Baine know what be goin' on here. Maybe he be likin' dis here underrot, who knows?I can get ya outta here and back ta Zul'jan, if ya be needin' it.

Title: Break 'Em Out
Objective: Free 10 workers.
Text: An Irontide captain "Calico McGee" has been trying to scare us off for days now, but it's not working.He's ordered his men to lock everyone up and sell us as slaves! They've brought enough chains for everyone!Break the chains and set our workers free.

Title: Ripe for the Picking
Objective: Meet with Saurfang and Sylvanas in the Zoram'gar Outpost.
Text: The kaldorei have finally halted our progress. In a perfect world, we could have marched all the way to Auberdine and taken Teldrassil before they could even slow us down - but it matters little.Malfurion will try to hold us back until his fleet returns from Silithus. Until then, his army is too small - if only we could find a path through these damned wisps.I have an idea. Let's have a chat with Saurfang.

Title: I Want It All Now
Objective: Collect 12 Irontide Coin Bags.
Text: These Irontide Raiders think they can just come in and take the treasure we've been hunting for months!By rights, that treasure is ours! Get in there and get our share of it, before it's gone.By share, I mean all of it!

Title: A Nose for Ptrouble
Objective: Find Kua'fon in the Slough and rescue him from danger.
Text: Ah, yes, I was wondering when you would come to check on your little one.As you have likely noticed, he is not here. Little ones are very curious and often seek to leave the nest before they are ready. It is often the brooding mother's job to keep them from wandering.What, did you think I was going to stop him?I heard some screeching to de west. Best hurry, or you may not have a hatchling to look after!

Title: Prepare for Trouble
Objective: Speak with 4 Proudmoore Guards in Unity Square.
Text: With the evidence you've gathered, we can prove that the Ashvane Company was behind the attack.I would have preferred to do this in private, but I don't think we'll have the luxury. Look around - company men everywhere.Priscilla's got something up her sleeve...Let's get some backup before we go in there and cause a scene.

Title: Out on a Limb
Objective: Find and rescue Kua'fon in the Slough.
Text: Ah, there you are.Kua'fon ran off into de jungle. I saw him head down de western path out of the Kraal but beyond that I could not say where he may have gone.This kind of thing happens with the young. Our winged companions have a keen sense of adventure!It would be helpful if yours could fly, but it is not yet time. I would check any reasonably high place that he could climb to, as a start.

Title: Seeking Shelter
Objective: Find Razgaji at the Scorched Sands Outpost.
Text: I must head back to de arena. Razgaji will want to know what happened here.If you seek shelter, you will find it at de outpost not too far from here.I will let our leader know you're coming.Be safe.

Title: SKREEEEE!
Objective: Feed Kua'fon.
Text: SKREEEEEEEEEEEEE!!!

Title: Into the Woods
Objective: Defeat the Alliance ambush.
Text: Careful,  -- the forest is still brimming with Stormrage's forces...Look out behind you!

Title: A Turtle's Invitation
Objective: Visit Maokka and the other Tortollans at the Jeweled Coast.
Text: You have been most helpful . Please visit me and the other Tortollans along the Jeweled Coast.We'll discuss soup and other pressing matters.

Title: Skree...
Objective: Soothe Kua'fon by picking him up.
Text: Skree...

Title: Cave Commotion
Objective: Meet up with Nedly and Moxie near the caves.
Text: Killing that worm stirred up a commotion in the caves below. The Irontide seem pretty excited. We better check it out.Nedly's on his way, meet us near the caves.

Title: Enemies Within
Objective: Slay 6 Ashvane combatants in Unity Square.
Text: We need to get Katherine to safety.Help us take out some of these traitors!

Title: Hot Pursuit
Objective: Mount a Proudmoore Charger and chase Priscilla Ashvane.
Text: Priscilla's escaping on horseback! Grab one of our chargers and chase her down!

Title: Clear the Air
Objective: Destroy 4 Smoking Payloads in Unity Square.
Text: Looks like Priscilla had a backup plan. Her goons set off some kind of smokescreen to cover her escape.Clear out that smoke so the civilians can evacuate and we can secure the area!

Title: Make Our Case
Objective: Reveal Lady Ashvane's treason to Katherine Proudmoore.
Text: Katherine has trusted Priscilla Ashvane as an advisor and a close friend for many years, even before they both lost their husbands at Theramore.She's heard the rumors about Ashvane, just like anyone. Whether by fear or loyalty, she's chosen to ignore them.It's time to finally open her eyes.

Title: Eye of the Storm
Objective: Escort Tideguard Victoria.
Text: If Lord Stormsong wasn't aware of you yet, he is now. Your best shot is to reach him at the Shrine of the Storm before more of his followers fall back to his defense.I can get you in, but you'll have to protect me. I'm in no shape to take down any more of these fiends.And try to keep a low profile. The closer we get to the Shrine, the more power Lord Stormsong has at his disposal.

Title: The Abyssal Council
Objective: Kill Wavespeaker Reid.
Text: The tidesages have a leading council beneath Lord Stormsong. They each oversee a different aspect of the order's work.Wavespeaker Reid trains initiates here in the oldest form of tidesage magic: communing with the sea.These deaths are on his hands. It's up to us to take him down.

Title: The Storm Awakens
Objective: Rally 12 Defectors.
Text: I must watch over Samuel for now. I fear for the darkness assaulting his mind.The fallen men and women around us were defectors from the house. There will be more like them within Sagehold.Find them, and tell them 'the storm awakens'. Knowledge of our cause has spread; we need to bring all we can to our side.

Title: A Bridge Too Far
Objective: Use the Rod of Tides to open the Path of Storms.
Text: The bridge that once crossed this span is the only land route to the Shrine.It appears Lord Stormsong has sealed it to buy himself more time. We have been attempting to reopen the way to no avail.However, the Rod of Tides you recovered may prove our solace. Veteran tideguards use it as a key of sorts to maintain the Path of Storms across these dangerous waters.We will begin the ritual once more... if you will wield the rod.

Title: Twisted Intentions
Objective: Kill the Bound Tempest and Enthralled Tidefury.
Text: Sails... in the fog...A light below... in the darkness.Water rising... given form... the pain...AHHHH, THE PAIN!Make it stop. Make it stop. Make the pain stop!

Title: Oathbound
Objective: Retrieve the Rod of Tides.
Text: I took oaths, damn it. We all did.When Lord Stormsong sent the first orders... well, you saw what happened. What matters is that our oaths are to our people, not Lord "Sells His Soul".You won't find him here - he's deep in the Shrine by now, and no outsider will make it across the channel alive...Not without a Tideguard to open the way.The Rod of Tides is the key to the front door, and it's kept here. Retrieve it and I can get you to him.

Title: Calldown: Cleaner
Objective: Identify and mark 5 Azerite deposits for the extraction team.
Text: With these dust blowin' siro-ma-whosits all over this beach front, it's a pain to get our cleaners out onto the nodes.Some of the crew wanted to check somewhere else, but no way we're leaving without those rocks for Gallywix.Between you and me, we're gonna be gettin' some serious hazard pay for this gig.

Title: Get Us Some Beach
Objective: Collect 20 piles of sand.
Text: These guys are running out of "ammo" faster than we can replace it!I tells 'em, we're on a beach, you're in a sandblaster, suck it up!They says it's against the cleaner driver rules for their local chapter.I'm not buyin' it.Grab us some more sand. Them sand monsters have gotta be full of the stuff!We'll make it worth your time.

Title: No Bot Left Behind
Objective: Help Earl-E.
Text: You left Earl-E behind, and a giant worm ate him! He's got sentimental, uh... monetary value.We don't leave any bots behind!Kill that worm and get Earl-E back.

Title: On The Prowl
Objective: Find Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner in Darkshore.
Text: Do you see all of the wisps about? I have seen this once before, when the demon Archimonde was felled by the sting of hundreds - no - thousands of wisps.This can mean only one thing. Malfurion is beckoning the aid of his ancestors.The Warchief has already taken a scouting party ahead to Darkshore to intercept him. Please. Find the Warchief and see if she has yet caught her prey.We have secured all of Ashenvale, but we must keep the pressure on.

Title: You're a Shark
Objective: Kill 20 murlocs.
Text: Have you ever been bitten by a shark? I have, numerous times. It stings.Murlocs don't usually survive shark attacks.The ritual I had in mind is ready to cast. Let me know when you're prepared.

Title: Effective Antivenom
Objective: Administer the Antivenom to Serrik.
Text: The salve is ready.I work fast. Hopefully faster than the scorpid poison.Take this antivenom to your friend and see that he swallows every last drop.You should know within moments if it's been effective.

Title: One Last Request
Objective: Bring Treadward's Ring to Lucille Waycrest at Watchman's Rise.
Text: I can feel my bonds to this place slipping, and I have you to thank.I would like to ask one more favor of you though. Please bring the ring you found to Lucille. It was meant for her to hold, not my dusty bones.And , do not tell her what has transpired here. She has enough tragedy weighing down her heart. I do not wish to add to it.

Title: The Stormwind Extraction
Objective: Complete "The Stormwind Extraction" scenario.
Text: My lady is shrewd indeed. If we are to infiltrate Stormwind City, we will need the very best the Horde has to offer, and yet a team so small as to be able to infiltrate the heart of Alliance territory unseen.Yes, I see.The path ahead is clear. Speak to me when you are ready to undertake the Warchief's mission.

Title: Blood in the Chapel
Objective: Defeat 10 Red Hand Assassins in Whitegrove Chapel.
Text: , you have helped me before and I beseech you to do so again.My guards are clearly outnumbered by these brigands. I must stay here to protect Lucille, so I will need you to assist in protecting the guests.Are you able?

Title: The Lady's Fate
Objective: Find Lady Meredith Waycrest in Whitegrove Chapel.
Text: Meredith never joined the ceremony. She might be in trouble!Lucy is in shock, and I cannot leave her here. You must go in my stead to the tower, and ensure the safety of your Lady.Do this for me, and you will be rewarded.

Title: Running Late
Objective: Speak with Lord Arthur Waycrest in Whitegrove Chapel.
Text: I beg your pardon, but I am a little concerned at Lord Waycrest's tardiness.I'd hate to be a bother, but would you mind checking on him? The ceremony awaits his presence.You can find him in the bride's room, at the top of the tower.

Title: From This Day Forward
Objective: Take a seat and observe the wedding ceremony in Whitegrove Chapel.
Text: Lord Waycrest is on his way? Excellent!You have my thanks. Please, take a seat.

Title: Untame Slaughter
Objective: Kill 8 Faithless within the Feeding Pits.
Text: The Faithless rely on their krolusks for everything. They are mounts, battle companions, beasts of burden, and often even food to fuel the sethrak empire.If we can disrupt their krolusks, we'll disrupt their whole empire. One broken wheel stops the caravan, eh?Take out as many of their krolusk tamers as you can. That'll have a longer impact than just killing the krolusks.

Title: Earl-E Bot Gets the Worm
Objective: Get Mud Worm Meat for Maokka.
Text: It could take you days to get that much meat, and I don't want to wait around. So, we'll use a Bot as bait!You send EARL-E towards any disturbances you see in the mud. He'll make enough noise to scare any worms out.Then kill the worms, get the meat. I'll watch from here.

Title: Relics of Sethraliss
Objective: Recover the Skull of the First Skycaller, Rebirth Creed, Sethraliss Sight Stone, and Blood of the Fallen Loa.
Text: It may surprise you to learn that the Faithless hoard ancient relics of Sethraliss. I assure you that they do not do so out of reverence or respect, as is proper.Korthek's brood is driven only by greed and an insatiable lust for power. They rip whatever magic they can from the relics, even if it means destroying them in the process.Rescue the ancient artifacts of Sethraliss in the Sacred Sands nearby. We will honor and preserve them in the Sanctuary of the Devoted.

Title: Painful Memories
Objective: Search the Forgotten Bones for Treadward's Ring in Whitegrove Chapel.
Text: A terrible thing happened in this place, and it has doomed me to an eternity of walking these grounds.All I remember is that Lucille and I were to be wed, but instead I met my end.If you have an ounce of sympathy in your heart, then I beg you to help me. Find out what happened that night, so I might leave here.I know my strongest memories are tied to the ring I bore for Lucy that day. Find it among my bones, and maybe it will lead you to the answer.

Title: A Meal for Birds
Objective: Kill wildlife within The Brine Basin so Mekaru's buzzards can eat.
Text: I don't know why I agreed to this. We weren't supposed to be scavenging.Kiro gave me specific instructions to head to the basin and feed the buzzards.I can't go back to camp until they eat, but I'm not heading into that basin while the sethrak are still swarming.Have you ever fed a buzzard? It's easy, I promise.You kill it, they eat it. That simple.

Title: Free Ride
Objective: Steal the Battle Krolusk mount and return to Meerah.
Text: One thing I've learned during my time in Vol'dun is to not stay in one place for too long. And doubly so when the Faithless are involved.We've done our damage here. Let's move before we get caught.I procured a mount to take us back to Meerah and the others in Vorrik's Sanctum quickly. Don't worry, this Faithless won't be needing it anymore.

Title: Sanctuary Under Siege
Objective: Meet Vorrik at the Sanctuary of the Devoted.
Text: I fear that Emperor Korthek was not lying when he boasted of his foolish plan.If General Jakra'zet attacked the Sanctuary of the Devoted while we were away, there is a good chance that he now has everything needed to resurrect Mythrax.We must hurry to the Sanctuary and stop Jakra'zet. Mythrax must not be reborn!

Title: Crater Conquered
Objective: Return to Vorrik.
Text: I can take it from here. I'll rally these vulpera and march through the trenches creating chaos. Korthek and his armies will be forced to deal with us!If you and Vorrik are going to make a move, you should do it now.

Title: Infuriating the Emperor
Objective: Use Vorrik's Bulwark to defeat 75 Faithless within the Sacred Sands.
Text: It seems I underestimated Korthek's cowardice. I expected him to be behind the barrier, ready to ambush us. Yet, still he hides.That allows us a few moments to prepare. We musn't waste them.While I siphon power off of these immense crystals, you must thin the numbers of the Faithless here. I will grant you a powerful boon to speed you in your task.When Korthek arrives, he will require our full attention.

Title: To Have Loved and Lost
Objective: Lay the Crimson Bouquet next to the Simple Gravestone in Whitegrove Chapel.
Text: I have a favor to ask you of a... personal nature.Whitegrove Chapel lies to the north, just past the town of Corlain. Someone... important to me rests in the graveyard on its grounds.I've been unable to visit his grave for some time, and I would like to pay my respects. If you come upon Whitegrove Chapel, could you lay these flowers next to his headstone?Just look for the most recent grave there...

Title: The Immediate Problem
Objective: Speak with Lieutenant Bauer.
Text: I sent one of my lieutenants, a woman by the name of Bauer, to the fishermen's hamlet just down the road. We received a few reports of naga activity spreading down the coast in that direction.We need those forces back as soon as possible. I would ask that you join her in assisting the villagers of the hamlet.

Title: Don't Drop It... Yet
Objective: Collect 6 Volatile Lightning Bombs from Faithless.
Text: The Faithless are training pterrordaxes as mounts so that they can rain down death from the skies.Their skycallers have developed a means of storing volatile lightning magic into fragile crystals. Lightning bombs, in the simplest sense. The magic behind it is quite brilliant, really.The bombs will be exceptionally useful if we can secure the aid of Rakjan, the powerful and fierce pterrordax at the top of this mountain.Acquire as many as you can carry, while I will do my best to recruit Rakjan.

Title: Infiltrating the Empire
Objective: Accompany Vorrik to his sanctum.
Text: The heart of the Faithless empire rests just beyond this ridge. We will need to move swiftly and quietly to avoid detection once inside.Thankfully, my former dwelling is nearby. I know a passage that should allow us to advance into the fortress with minimal resistance. When you are ready, speak with me and I will show you the way.I expected the Faithless to patrol this area... Keep your eyes open for anything suspicious along the path.

Title: Zoram'gar Outpost
Objective: Make the necessary preparations at the Zoram'gar Outpost.
Text: Saurfang shall establish our troops here, now that Astranaar is ours. I shall continue my hunt for the only creature that can stop our march to victory: Malfurion Stormrage.Our next order of business will be to establish a foothold at the base of Darkshore. Commander Grimfang of the Zoram'gar Outpost should be able to accommodate an incoming army.Inform him of our arrival and ensure the necessary preparations are made.

Title: Missing Business
Objective: Rescue 7 Sable Polecats.
Text: Poor little Coda has been in quite the tizzy since his friends vanished.I found him here, out cold, after a sting from one of those awful wasps. Just a tiny bit of our sandstinger remedy got Coda right up, though!Take some with you, and keep an eye out for other little ones out there.

Title: Don't Turtle
Objective: Speak with Moxie.
Text: There's a Tortollan who's trying to get our treasure! He's over on the west side of town. He's nosey and he may have found something!Talk to Moxie, come up with a plan to get rid of him.

Title: All Laid Out For Us
Objective: Get three treasure hunters to help you.

Title: A Timely Arrival
Objective: Greet Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner in Astranaar.
Text: My end of the bargain is done.I am going to check on the other outposts to make sure none of my brothers and sisters are in trouble. Meet with the Warchief and inform her that Astranaar has been secured. If everything has gone according to plan, she should be well on her way.Oh, and try not to hog all the glory, yeah?.

Title: A New Dawn
Objective: Meet Taelia in the Harbormaster's Office in Boralus.
Text: House Stormsong may be lost, but this valley still holds so much hope.Sam knew that from the beginning.We have to continue to help the Storm's Wake in any way we can. There are still remnants of the fallen house everywhere, and whoever turned them to this darkness is out there as well.Cyrus and the others will want to hear about everything that happened. We should tell them together.

Title: Drust in Time
Objective: Find the Explorers' League members at the Thovas Base-Camp.
Text: A few days ago, a band of Alliance researchers that called themselves the "Explorers' League" took a contingent of Kul Tiran soldiers to the old Drust ruins down the road.We haven't really heard from them since, and I'm growing a bit concerned. I can't leave my post, so can you check up on the team?

Title: Clearing the Delta
Objective: Kill 15 naga forces in the Eventide Delta.
Text: The greatest of the Zeth'jir offensive sits within the delta as we speak, waiting for the summoning ritual to be finished. If we can clear out a number of them, we'll finally have the upper hand.Get down there and cause as much chaos as you can!

Title: Anchors Aweigh Too Much
Objective: Find 12 Old Ship Parts.
Text: I got a little deal on the side, selling used ship parts to Addington Shipyards.While you're out looking for the treasure, see what sort of useful parts you can salvage from the mud: anchors, cannons, whatever!We'll sell them to Addington and cut you in for a share of the profits.

Title: Informing the Horde
Objective: Speak with Baine Bloodhoof.
Text: General Jakra'zet has been defeated, but his plan to summon Mythrax succeeded despite our best efforts.Were it not for the mercy of Sethraliss, I doubt we would have made it out of Atul'Aman alive.We must inform our allies of what has transpired in Vol'dun.I'll speak with princess Talanji myself. You should go and speak with the Horde. We need all the help we can get now.I'm sure our paths will cross again. It was an honor fighting with you.

Title: A Snake with Three Heads
Objective: Slay the three naga channelers.
Text: Now that all of the preparation has been done, it's time to tackle the main threat.You can use the channeling rod you just found in conjunction with this scroll I got from Rikal to break the shields around the naga leaders in the delta.Hurry! Stop them before they finish their summoning!

Title: Defeat Jakra'zet
Objective: Defeat Jakra'zet.
Text: Jakra'zet is summoning Mythrax the Unraveler!We cannot allow the ritual to continue. Jakra'zet must be stopped before it's too late!Lead the way. We'll be right behind you.Let's go!

Title: Worker's Rights
Objective: Talk to Maynard Algerson at Algerson Lumber Yard.
Text: Hey, you! You lookin' for work?I ain't got a job for ya, but I can tell ya to stay away from Algerson Lumber!Algerson'll promise ya some solid labor work and decent pay, but it's a lie I tell ya!The conditions are terrible, we're gettin' attacked, and Algerson ain't even battin' an eye!He don't care 'bout us little people. I'd stay away if I were you!

Title: Bomb Beats Rock
Objective: East and West Caves blown open!
Text: I stole an old treasure map off an Irontide pirate. The map marks several caves on it with circles.The caves are blocked by boulders, but now that you're here, we're going to open them up.You get to do all the dangerous stuff, plant explosives, kill things and cave exploring. I'll supervise.

Title: Problem Solving with Gunpowder
Objective: Set 5 Explosive Traps.
Text: Fort walls only go so far when it comes to defense. We've got cannons in position to fire if the naga get too close, but we need some fortifications further out.There should be a few good areas to set up some traps further down the beach. Those naga will never know what hit them!

Title: A Bloody Mess
Objective: Collect 20 Tideblood.
Text: My order blesses every Kul Tiran ship within the halls of the Shrine of the Storm. Our blessings make our ships the strongest in all of Azeroth; the fleet of legend.The ritual requires a substance known as tideblood. It is a viscous, powerful substance dredged from the depths of the sea and infused into the very hull of each ship.Something has caused the tideblood here to become animate. Studying it may help us better understand our enemy.

Title: Not On Our Payroll
Objective: Eliminate 10 Restless Stones.
Text: The workers are complaining about elementals coming into the area while they're digging for treasure.Just this morning, I had two people crushed to death! It's slowing down the hunt!You can earn your share by getting rid of those elementals!

Title: Fun With Magnets
Objective: Collect 60 Lost Coins.
Text: My last time in Tol Barad I had to leave in a big hurry, but I grabbed a few gadgets on the way out.This device is one of my favorites, so don't break it! It'll suck the treasure right out of the mud. It may make you tingle some, that's just the radiation.Find lost coins using the metal collector near the signs I've placed.

Title: Piercing the Shield
Objective: Find an intact Zeth'jir Channeling Rod.
Text: I've been talking with Rikal, and the tortollan says that our problem in the delta can probably be solved by turning the naga's magic back on them.A few of the sorceresses on the south coast have a channeling wand that we may be able to use to break the head priestesses' ritual channeling. Find one, and bring it back here.

Title: UNUSED
Objective: Speak with Moxie Botshiv
Text: Somewhere, buried in all that mud, is a Horde boat that sunk during the Second War. It was loaded with plundered gold, and we're going to find it!Go see Moxie. She handles the day-to-day search for the treasure. She'll put you to work.

Title: Treasure Hunting
Objective: Speak to Nedly.
Text: The workers are digging day and night out there to find the lost treasure. You'd get an equal share like everyone else, if ya wanna help out.Talk to Nedly about joining up.

Title: Any Ammo Will Do
Objective: Collect 20 Zeth'jir Harpoons on the coast south of Fort Daelin.
Text: I'll have some men move some cannons down to the sea wall in preparation of whatever ritual is going on down in that delta.We could use some extra ammo before we spread ourselves too thin though. Luckily, those naga harpoons work well enough with our mortars. Take down those lances and bring back any harpoons that you find.

Title: Tides of War
Objective: Speak with Nathanos Blightcaller in Orgrimmar.
Text: Champion, the Horde is now at open war with the Alliance.Our success in this conflict may depend on your skills.I require your immediate presence in Orgrimmar for a mission of the utmost urgency. Do not keep me waiting.

Title: Risky Rescue
Objective: Free 4 Temple Defenders.
Text: The Faithless incursion is just up ahead.We tried to get ahead of the siege by attacking their camp in the dead of night, but they knew we were coming.Our troops were quickly overwhelmed.We called for a retreat, but only a few of us made it out. The fate of those that didn't is unknown...We don't have the numbers to attempt a rescue ourselves. We can't afford to lose any more fighters.You're their only hope.

Title: Two Faced Pirate Scum
Objective: Eliminate Two Face Tom.
Text: We've been holding the Irontide off for days, but now they've brought in an ettin for reinforcements. We can't let him attack the town.A few of my best men just went up the hill to try and kill him. You look pretty capable, they could sure use your help?

Title: Reclaiming our Defenses
Objective: Save 8 stranded battalion soldiers.
Text: We were holding off the naga up until the latest attack. A few of our forces are still out there.The tidemaidens seem to be slowly torturing them to death. If you could save as many as you can find, we'd be one step closer to gaining the upper ground again.

Title: Filching from Thieves
Objective: Collect 7 Tidal Beacons.
Text: The naga oft take what they want with little care for who they are taking it from. Perhaps we should do the same for them.The sorceresses use powerful beacons to assist with their spellcasting. I could use these relics to strengthen my own ritual.

Title: Everybody Has a Price
Objective: Work with Lorash to disarm Astranaar.
Text: Hundreds of rogues have already attacked kaldorei outposts in Ashenvale. On my signal, they will begin the next phase of this war: sowing chaos.My colleague died not far from here, so I could use your help. If we stay out of sight, the town won't even know it's under attack before we have all of its guards down.I have a poison that will kill them quickly and silently. If you signal to me which targets are safe to attack without being noticed, I will put them down.What do you say?

Title: Facing the Invaders
Objective: Slay 15 of the naga forces invading Fort Daelin.
Text: While we try to figure out what to do with those channelers, we'll have to take shots where we can get them.Our men could use some assistance retaking parts of the lower walls. Kill some naga for me, would you?

Title: Break Their Ranks
Objective: Kill 10 Faithless attackers within the Temple Grounds.
Text: This temple is our last bastion against the Faithless. We need every able fighter to defend its walls.If you're offering to help, we won't turn you away.Head into battle and do what you can to break their ranks!

Title: Eeling in a Big One
Objective: Collect 16 Abyssal Fangs.
Text: If you are up to it, I have an idea to give the naga an amusing surprise.I need some teeth from marine predators to cast the spell though. Luckily, the naga brought some disgusting eels with them. Go gather their fangs, and bring them back to me.

Title: The Warchief Commands
Objective: Find Saurfang in the Northern Barrens.
Text: Silithus. That has been the name of the game... or rather, that is what I wanted the Alliance to believe.Make no mistake, Azerite is just as powerful as it is rumored to be but I have bigger plans in mind.High Overlord Saurfang is leading an army towards Silithus. By now, he should be in the Northern Barrens. I want you to intercept him and notify him that the preparations are complete.Preparations for what, you ask? Why, we are going to capture the World Tree.

Title: A Quick Diversion
Objective: Find Lorash in Astranaar.
Text: I have halted our march until I received word that we were ready to divert.What comes next will be a coordinated, synchronized attack on key outposts in Ashenvale. If we act quickly, we will destroy the kaldorei's defenses and clear a path all the way to Darkshore.Stormwind will surely send reinforcements to stop us. We have to conquer Teldrassil before they arrive.I will divert the troops. Meet with our operative, Lorash, outside Astranaar for further instruction.

Title: Waycrest Manor: The Fallen Mother
Objective: Defeat Lady Waycrest in Waycrest Manor.
Text: This is all a lot to process...The Marshal... gone? My mother... the leader of the coven? It's just too much......but we have come too far to turn back now. It is clear that my mother and father, as I knew them, are gone. It is time we cleansed the taint from this land.We must take the inquisitors and find them in Waycrest Manor. We will end this, once and for all.

Title: A Question of Quillpower
Objective: Ride the Ornery Battleboar out of Briarback Kraul and report to Mayor Roz.
Text: I can't believe you managed to kill that thing. You're quite impressive, you know that? Either way, we should be getting back to Roz with our report. We're stuck in the middle of the kraul, surrounded by angry quilboar. But I have a plan! Some of the boars seem reasonable enough. I gave them a bit of my rations and they've been following me around. I bet we can use them to hitch a ride out of this place. You in?

Title: The Shifting Tides
Objective: Speak with Rikal at Fort Daelin.
Text: I'm no tidesage, but even I can tell that whatever you have there is probably not a good sign for the bastion.There's one of those Tortollans, Rikal, who's been helping us figure out a solution to whatever the naga are planning in front of the levee. He'd probably like to see this.

Title: Battlefield Scavenging
Objective: Gather supplies from Newstead, High Perch and the Circle of Elements.
Text: The battle rages on, but our inventory suffers.Scavenge the camps for supplies. I'll make use of what you find.

Title: Atul'Aman
Objective: Meet Vorrik at Atul'Aman.
Text: Jakra'zet and his troops attacked while we were away.Serrik fought well, but it wasn't enough. The keys are gone, and it's only a matter of time before the barrier is broken.Your friends have already given chase.Jakra'zet must not be allowed to resurrect Mythrax the Unraveler. He must be stopped before it's too late!We don't have much time.Meet me at Atul'Aman! We must catch up with Kaja and Rakera and stop the ritual!

Title: Caught in the Net
Objective: Free 5 villagers.
Text: When the naga force first arrived, there were a handful of the local fishermen out on boats. One of our scouts reports that most of them have been captured and are currently being kept in cages around the beach.Free any of them you happen to find and point them back here. We'll get them armed and remind the naga that you don't mess with sailors!

Title: Deal's Off
Objective: Search the Deal Farmstead for any survivors.
Text: There's one more farm left, far to the west. They're real close to the kraul. Deal works the land by herself. If anyone got hit bad, it'd be her. It's just past the worst part of the collapse, so keep an eye out for the quilboar.

Title: A House Divided
Objective: Join Brother Pike outside Sagehold.
Text: Not all of House Stormsong have followed my Lord down this dark path. They know not - I knew not - the truth of his depravity.Sagehold looms above us. It is where all tidesages study to wield the sea's power.We will build upon the Storm's Wake and make my shattered home whole once more. We will save all who are willing.The rest will perish.

Title: Gathering Storm
Objective: Place 4 Focusing Rods on the Abyssal Melody.
Text: This depravity goes against every oath we take as tidesages. To protect our people... to guide and sustain them... to make our ships strong.This is nothing but darkness. It must all be destroyed.Board the Abyssal Melody and place these focusing rods at any critical points you find. I will prepare the ritual.

Title: A Bit of a Bind
Objective: Slay Binder Sa'thress.
Text: The naga sorceress leading this excursion seems to be in the process of binding a larger elemental. If she succeeds, we will no doubt lose our foothold here.Strike out at her, perhaps you can catch her off guard and interrupt the ritual. Remove the head from these snakes.

Title: Freedom for the Sea
Objective: Slay 6 Bound Seasurges.
Text: The naga along this coast appear to be trying to push the shoreline up the hill here. We've been able to keep them back at the beach so far, but they've been binding more elementals than we can keep up with.Without a tidesage, we have no way to free the elementals from their bindings, but we cannot allow them to push forward anymore. The spirit of the sea should not be contained by anything. Slay them, and let them return to the ocean.

Title: From the Maw of Madness
Objective: Find Samuel Williams.
Text: Sam is still out there somewhere. We can't just leave him to die!If he wasn't in the assembly yard, he must be on that ship. You have to find him!

Title: Storm's Vengeance
Objective: Destroy the Abyssal Melody.
Text: I know not what horrors await us ahead, but the Abyssal Melody must never follow its sister into the Shrine of the Storm.We will deny these monsters all that they have wrought here by burning it with the very magic they seek to corrupt.The ritual is ready, but requires a conduit to stabilize. If you are willing, your Azerite-infused armor will suffice.

Title: Alliance War Effort
Objective: Complete 4 world quests on Zandalar or occupied warfront zones.
Text: Assist the Alliance by completing 4 world quests on Zandalar or occupied warfront zones.

Title: Horde War Effort
Objective: Complete 4 world quests on Kul Tiras or occupied warfront zones.
Text: Assist the Horde by completing 4 world quests on Kul Tiras or occupied warfront zones.

Title: Forbidden Rites
Objective: Kill 15 K'thir and disrupt 6 rituals.
Text: These k'thir have been hiding among us, sewing the seeds of their dark masters with us none the wiser.With the barrier around the Abyssal Melody lowered I can peer within; its bowels toil with my own people giving themselves to the shadow!Take my tidal kris; its blade is now coated in purified tideblood. Put an end to these fiends and their foul rituals.

Title: Voldunai
Objective: Complete 4 Voldunai world quests.
Text: Assist the Voldunai by completing 4 world quests.

Title: Talanji's Expedition
Objective: Complete 4 Talanji's Expedition world quests.
Text: Assist Talanji's Expedition by completing 4 world quests.

Title: Proudmoore Admiralty
Objective: Complete any 4 world quests in Tiragarde Sound.
Text: Assist the Proudmoore Admiralty by completing 4 world quests.

Title: Tortollan Seekers
Objective: Complete 3 Tortollan world quests.
Text: Assist the Tortollan by completing 3 world quests.

Title: Zandalari Empire
Objective: Complete any 4 world quests in Zuldazar.
Text: Assist the Zandalari Empire in Zuldazar by completing 4 world quests.

Title: Storm's Wake
Objective: Complete any 4 world quests in Stormsong Valley.
Text: Assist Storm's Wake by completing 4 world quests.

Title: Exterminate the Vermin
Objective: Rescue 3 captive excavators.
Text: On top of the fury of the overseer, and this "key" not being here, we have a pest problem.Sneaky little vulperan thieves keep ransacking our site. We have taken some prisoner.We have them around the upper level of the dig site, working off their misdeeds. However, I believe a more permanent solution would be preferred.Please, oh mighty cobra, give us the honor of getting rid of our prisoners with your most potent venom!

Title: Order of Embers
Objective: Complete any 4 world quests in Drustvar.
Text: Assist the Order of Embers by completing 4 world quests.

Title: A Bloody Mess
Objective: Collect 20 Tideblood.

Title: Beneath the Veil
Objective: Use the Abyssal Beacon to dispel the Writhing Grasps.
Text: We must board the Abyssal Melody and save the myriad souls in her decks before they too disappear into the Shrine. We will not be able to enter so long as the barrier surrounding it stands.The tidesages are using forbidden magic to summon extensions of their will. It is these grasps that maintain the barrier.Take my beacon and mark each grasp. I will rain vengeance down upon them from here.

Title: No Quarter
Objective: Kill 8 Skeletal Sailors and 4 Tidesage Seacallers.
Text: We arrived just in time. These abominations have already taken control of the docks; we're all that's left to keep them at bay!You need to cull their numbers before we're overwhelmed. We don't exactly have an army here!

Title: The Fall of Corlain
Objective: Examine 6 Corlain Citizen's Journals in Upper Corlain.

Title: Hexecutioner
Objective: Kill 13 witches of the Heartsbane Coven in Upper Corlain.
Text: It would appear that this is where the coven is training their new acolytes. Our efforts may be for naught if they continue to expand their numbers.I cannot leave Lucille's side in this place, but you have already shown yourself a formidable combatant.Cut them down.

Title: Storming the Manor
Objective: Follow Lucille Waycrest toward Waycrest Manor in Upper Corlain.
Text: Now is our chance. Waycrest Manor is just up that hill, and hopefully inside we'll find my mother and father.If we also manage to find the "Mother" that's leading this horrible coven, then we will make her regret the day she ever set foot in Drustvar.Are you with me?

Title: To the Other Side
Objective: Open the Eastern, Southern and Western Gates in Upper Corlain.
Text: It looks like the coven is using Corlain as a base of operations. There's no way we'll be able to cut through this many of them without the rest of the Inquisitors.They must still be stuck behind the wall., there are three smaller footmen gates along the walls into Corlain. See if you can get them open so our allies can make their way through.

Title: Ruinous Rituals
Objective: Kill 4 Blighted Horrors in Upper Corlain.
Text: Take a look in the city square.It appears the coven has gone beyond dark constructs, and are now conjuring creatures of nightmare with their rituals. Let us not wait to see what these monsters are capable of. We should put an end to them right here.Fortunately, the disciples seem too focused on their spell to notice us. Maybe you can use that to your advantage.

Title: Message from the Management
Objective: Collect Priscilla's Orders from Forgemaster Farthing and Taskmaster Williams.

Title: Champions of Azeroth
Objective: Complete 4 Azerite world quests.
Text: Assist Magni by completing 4 Azerite world quests.

Title: Sulthis' Stone
Objective: Deliver Sulthis' Stone to Serrik within Zul'Ahjin.

Title: Back to the Lab
Objective: Meet Raimond Mildenhall in his Raimond's Laboratory.
Text: Our work here is done!Well, at least until another one of my humble experiments goes horribly awry, rapidly spiraling out of control into a chain reaction of catastrophic failures.But, let's worry about that another time.I'll meet you back at my lab!

Title: Temple of Sethraliss: Avatar of the Loa
Objective: Enter the Temple of Sethraliss and heal the avatar of the loa.
Text: We cannot let Mythrax bring his destruction upon this world once more.We need our loa now more than ever, but she has yet to return to us.The time of her rebirth has passed. Someone, or something, must be preventing her awakening.Enter her resting place and see what you can uncover.

Title: The Hunters of Kennings Lodge
Objective: Speak with Alanna Holton.
Text: HELP WANTED!As we turn into the busy season, Kennings Lodge is looking for recreational hunters to assist with fulfilling the ever growing list of orders from Boralus. These are short term positions which will be paid relative to performance.Kennings Lodge can be found by following the south road past the mining yard. Report to Alanna Holton on arrival.

Title: The Fall of Emperor Korthek
Objective: Defeat Emperor Korthek.
Text: Korthek finally approaches.It's been many years since I've faced him in battle. When he first rose to power, I failed my people. I will not falter again.I am prepared to do what must be done. What I should have done long ago.We must kill Korthek and take his key to prevent him, Jakra'zet, or anyone else from ever resurrecting Mythrax.When you are prepared, we will face him together.

Title: An Explosive Opportunity
Objective: Speak with Wulferd Fizzbracket at the Fizzsprings Resort.
Text: You there!Do I have the most AMAZING opportunity for you? A gnome named Wulferd Fizzbracket is on the eve of a breakthrough and could use an intrepid business partner that's on the brawnier side. Such as a  like yourself.Just follow the road east until you reach Fizzsprings Resort, the most fantastical wonder of nature. Wulferd is the type that stands out from the crowd.

Title: The Secrets of Zul'Ahjin
Objective: Investigate the statue.
Text: You're not the only one who came to Zul'Ahjin looking for answers. The place is crawling with looters and assassins, all searching for something...So far, they've come up empty handed, but that's because they don't know where to look.I do.Investigate the statue at the center of the ruins. It is the key to uncovering the city's ancient secrets.

Title: The Missing Handler
Objective: Look for Handler Bazkoji near Warbeast Kraal.
Text: I just received word from Warbeast Kraal dat one of their handlers is missing.Dis is not usually a problem, but dey are expecting a large hatching dis year. Dey will need all de hands dey can get!Go on and see if you can find de handler, name of Bazo or something, and tell him to get back to de Kraal.

Title: Power of the Overseer
Objective: Kill Overseer Nerzet and take her power rock.
Text: Overseer Nerzet is very cruel, and oh so easy to provoke!It makes her very angry when things go missing, or move, or change... my crew and I are having a yip of a time! That you got this device to work was certainly a bonus!It will be much easier for us to finish up what we need to do here, with her out of the way.Um, and maybe go ahead and grab that neat power rock she carries. It could come in handy.

Title: Magic Decoder Device
Objective: Examine the Keeper statues in the ruins.
Text: We retrieved this device from the sethrak in the ruins to the east, but have not been able to use it.When you approached, it started to glow. Something about you......or on you... is waking it up!Please, use the scepter and examine the statues of the Keepers, in the central courtyard of the ruins. Something there got their overseer very excited.

Title: Wendigo Away
Objective: Kill Bonerender.
Text: If the unearthly howls coming from the Highlands at night are any indication, the wendigos must have some sort of leader or alpha.I tell you, it's the sort of sound that could only come from some sort of massive, hulking, flesh-eating abomination.Definitely something that could tear us limb from limb, and munch on our frail bones, all without breaking a sweat. How exhilarating!I'm sure it'll be no problem for us to handle though.

Title: Under Their Noses
Objective: Speak with Flynn Fairwind in Bridgeport.
Text: Figures they wouldn't just put the destination on the crates for us.Nothing's ever easy, is it?If the weapons aren't moving on Cagney's ferry, they must be passing through Bridgeport, the shipping hub just up the road.Bridgeport is protected by a garrison of Proudmoore marines. The Ashvane Company has a lot of nerve moving illegal weapons right under their noses.Come on, let's check it out.

Title: Witch Way Out?
Objective: Free 10 Captive Villagers.
Text: There are other Falconhurst citizens to be freed before they become sacrifices.Free anyone you come across.The key used to free Master Ashton should still work. Good luck!

Title: Stick It To 'Em!
Objective: Use the Crimsonwood Demolisher to destroy witch forces in the Crimson Forest.
Text: We have been able to stop the Grand Rite but the witches will try again unless we act.We have to destroy them. Utterly.How kind of them to give us the means.You've helped us get this far. You control the Demolisher. Destroy everything you see!Once we've finished we can signal for help out of here!

Title: Honey Glazed Sam
Objective: Rescue Sam Robinson.
Text: Think I heard someone shouting down yonder., there might be trouble. Let's go!

Title: Fetching Wrex
Objective: Crack open Crystallized Honey to search for Wrex.
Text: When all the commotion started, Ancel's pup ran off. The poor thing was terrified!A couple farmhands went to look for him, but with all of these monsters terrorizing the farm, I fear the worst!Can you keep an eye out for Wrex while you're up in the hills? He might have gotten trapped in the honey too.

Title: In the Hall of the Drust King
Objective: Confront Gorak Tul.
Text: I've been watching a lot of activity going on at the ruins at the base of the massive tree by the lake. What Master Ashton reported is accurate - something important is going on down there.We've disrupted their rituals but I worry we might have been too late.We need to go over there. If there is anything remaining, we must destroy it.

Title: He's Gone Mad!
Objective: Kill Wildtusk.
Text: Ol' Wildtusk has withstood years of attacks by young hunters that are overeager and underskilled.None could take him.His wounds have finally done him in. He just won't go down. Find that crazy riverbeast bull, and help him let go of his mortal shell.

Title: Break On Through
Objective: Use the Ramparts Cannon to break the barrier at the gate to Upper Corlain.
Text: Cannon's ready, boss.Care to do the honors?

Title: The Warchief Awaits
Objective: Report to Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.
Text: ,There are important matters I would like to discuss with you, but discretion is of the utmost importance.Meet me in my chambers in the Undercity where I can assure our privacy has not been compromised.Ensure that you are not followed; Orgrimmar has become riddled with SI:7 spies. It would seem that that King Anduin and Mathias Shaw are desperate to know what our next move is. How admirable.

Title: Potent Protection
Objective: Deliver the Sack of Aromatic Onions to Lucille Waycrest at Watchman's Rise.
Text: Here ya go, I got them onions bundled up nicely for ya.Give my regards to Miss Waycrest, will ya? Her allies are welcome on my farm anytime.

Title: Leaving the Nest
Objective: Open 5 Falcon Cages in the Corlain Aviary.
Text: It looks like the coven hasn't managed to enthrall all of our falcons. I can see some untainted ones still in cages in the training yard.Our falcons are well trained, and should know to fly to one of our other yards if something happens to their handlers.If you can just release them from their cages, they should be able to make it to safety.

Title: Barrier Buster
Objective: Collect 5 Blasting Powder from Pikeman's Ridge and bring them to Inquisitor Sterntide outside the gate into Upper Corlain.
Text: Oy! I think I might have a solution te that pesky barrier keepin ye out of Corlain proper!I took the silver we had left 'ere an' doctored up one o' these cannonballs. The walls surroundin' Corlain are festooned with defensive cannons. Get one pointed at the gate, ye can send this beauty right into the barrier!Ye'll need a hefty pinch of powder te get this thing movin', though - it's a bit on the heavy side. Ye can likely find some in the camp outside the walls.

Title: Reeking Refuge
Objective: Investigate what is disabling the coven's minions in Hocking's Plot.
Text: Oh good, maybe you can make sense of this.I was just carving through a swath of the coven's lackeys when I stumbled across this field. Something here has knocked these guys completely out of commission!I can't seem to find the source, but maybe you'll have better luck. I'm more used to hitting things than investigating them.

Title: Eating Through the Defenses
Objective: Kill 8 Scavenging Boars in Hocking's Plot.
Text: Not sure why and don't rightly care, but for some reason the coven can't come near my onion field. So long as my crop doesn't give out, I can hole up in here as long as it takes.Unfortunately, those boars got the same idea and now they're eatin' up my harvest! If they keep that up, soon there'll be nothin' keepin' the coven at bay!If you can do me a favor and thin them out, I'd be happy to let you take some of these onions with you.

Title: Hexed Hatchlings
