Objective: Use the Falconer's Whistle to destroy 7 bewitching charms in the Corlain Aviary.
Text: I've found where those evil witches have been tainting our falcons! You see those charms?They're using those to infect our flock with their evil magic as they hatch. I think Winston can get up there to take out the charms, but someone will need to direct him.I'm not quite healed up enough to take on a whole camp of falconers. Can you help?

Title: A Traitor's Death
Objective: Kill Captain Goodspeed.
Text: It has come to my attention that you intend to assault the camp outside of the walls. If this is so, I have a request.Though most of the guardsmen who fight against us were turned to the coven against their will, Captain Goodspeed and his brigade of halberdiers gave their souls willingly to the Heartsbane. They are traitors and an affront to the Waycrest Guard.You will find Goodspeed and his men stationed at the camp. I would consider it a personal favor if you would cut them down to the last.

Title: An Offensive Harvest
Objective: Collect 7 Aromatic Onions from Hocking's Plot.
Text: So you're takin the fight to the coven with the Waycrest girl, eh? Ya might just be able to take advantage of their apparent onion aversion.While you're out rootin' in the field, keep an eye out for any onions bulging out of the ground. Those ones should be particularly aromatic, and should cause some fits in the coven's minions if you keep it on ya.Just try not to take too much, right? I need enough left in the fields to keep the farm safe.

Title: Zanchuli Disbanded
Objective: Speak with Baine Bloodhoof in Dazar'alor.
Text: I would like to say we are doing well, but we are not. De Zanchuli Council is broken. Raal and I are all dat remain who are still loyal to King Rastakhan. You best bring news to your Horde and tell dem what transpired here. Raal and I will rally what support we can and head for de Zocalo. And hero, thank you for saving my life and my loa.

Title: Remembering the Fallen
Objective: Collect 8 Personal Keepsakes from fallen Corlain Villagers in Corlain.

Title: Witchrending
Objective: Use Witchrend to defeat Matrons Ceridwen, Adeline and Letitia in Corlain.
Text: A blunderbuss? I'd have to say, I wasn't quite expecting that.Nonetheless, now that we have a weapon, we have an advantage. I think it's time we take the fight directly to the coven.Marshal Reade informed me that several of their Matrons have been spotted throughout Corlain. Let's show them what happens to an enemy of House Waycrest.

Title: Controlling the Situation
Objective: Collect 5 Control Charms from the Haunted Servitors.
Text: I have been observing this macabre army of, wood, flesh and bone and how the witches and servitors control the lesser creations with charms. I believe I can craft an even more powerful charm - one we can use.In the hearts of the servitors are the very strongest charms. They are used to anchor the Ancient Drust into their physical forms. They are precisely what we need.Good luck. It is doubtful that they will part with them easily.

Title: SKREEEEE!
Objective: Find out what is distressing your hatchling and address it.

Title: Aerial Aspirations
Objective: Fly?
Text: Skree.Skree!

Title: Deadliest Cache: Sink and Swim
Objective: "Listen" to "Sinker's" "tale".
Text: Mph mph!Mph mph mph mph mph. Mph mph mph.Mph.Mph mph? Mph!

Title: Fear of Falling
Objective: Find your hatchling and convince it to return to the nest.
Text: Some young find their wings sooner than others. At least yours had the sense to keep them open.I would not worry too much about its safety- little ones tend to bounce.As for this failure... the young must keep trying, and they must learn not to fear falling. It is now your task to teach it.If it is reluctant to learn, you might consider bribery.

Title: A Pterrible Fate
Objective: Ask Pa'ku for help.

Title: Ruin Has Come
Objective: Find the author of the Mysterious Letter.
Text: There is a terror beneath the waves. It seeks to destroy my family, my house, and my legacy. You must come, claim your destiny and deliver us from the terrors of the deep! Find our estate to the east, among the isles. We lived opulently in the shadow of the great fortress. We believed the priests would deliver us from the darkness below. Now that darkness has bubbled to the surface, whispering madness in our dreams. Hurry. The air turns the darkest I have seen in my cursed existence.

Title: Back to the Nest
Objective: Return Kua'fon to his nest in Pterror Rise.
Text: Now would be a good time to take him back to the nest.

Title: The Call of the Skies
Objective: Watch your hatchling take its first leap into the great unknown.
Text: It is time to leave the nest.

Title: Your Problem Now
Objective: Place the Pterrordax Egg at the empty nest and wait for it to hatch.
Text: Hm. This egg does not belong to one of my brood, and I have no broodlings that need another sibling.You will care for this little one. And you had better hurry.It will hatch very soon.Oh, and a little advice. If you want the little one to like you, you had better be the first thing it sees upon hatching.

Title: A Child of Pa'ku
Objective: Take the Pterrordax Egg to Pa'ku at Pterror Rise.
Text: Perhaps a certain pterrordax loa can help you.

Title: The Weight of My Ambition
Objective: Defeat the Drowned Captain.
Text: As with the other settlements, I too relied on the services of sailors and watercraft to deliver supplies. They proved very useful in their diligence, and their silence. Predictably, they drew the attention of enemies, including those below the waves. Their anchor was hexed, dragging them beneath the ocean before they could so much as cry out. I have seen them, hoisting ethereal sails and singing shanties of the damned. If these waters are to be safe again, they must be silenced again. For good.

Title: Malign Inspiration
Objective: Kill the Enchanting Siren.
Text: A long time ago, there was a maiden. A precocious child fond of song, she made it her hobby to shadow my every move. Charming at first. Walking on the pier's edge, she became entangled within the ropes surrounding a leering idol. At that time a tremor ran through the waves, giving the small push needed to send them both beneath the surface. I can hear her song still. At first I thought it a passing fancy, music upon the waves. I realize now the voice comes with sinister purpose. She must die.

Title: Deadliest Cache: Gun Fishin'
Objective: Listen to Master Gunner Line's tale.
Text: Hook's got a screw loose in her head, I tell ya. Sharks workin' together on somethin'... phooey!It does remind me of one of my favorite tales, though. Have I ever told ya 'bout the time I caught THE single largest, deadliest, most tentacled beast in all o' Azeroth?!Aye, I thought not. It's not a story I'd tell ya sober. It was a day unlike any other...

Title: Doug Test - Completable Quest
Objective: Speak with Baron Sablemane at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Text: , while you were out being one hell of a , Baron Sablemane sent his pet dragon up here with a message. He's asked for you personally. From what I understand, he wants you to head up his own fight against the gronn. I guess you're the most qualified person in all of Outland to help him, but if I were you, I'd get in contact with a couple of friends first and ask them to join you at the Circle of Blood.

Title: Trinkets and Baubles
Objective: Recover 3 crates of Stolen Supplies.
Text: Beneath the tides, these terrors do not see fit to stay within their warrens. They have emerged in the night, stealing away to the villages and indulging in their avarice. They will use the provisions against us, to serve in their rituals. Rituals of summoning and communion with powers too terrible to comprehend. The populace is no concern of mine anymore, but I would not see these briny thieves to have their way. Relieve them of their plunder, and let them learn a bitter lesson.

Title: Flush Them Out
Objective: Investigate and defeat what lies within 4 structures in the Forgotten Cove.
Text: They lurk in the shadows, in the salt-soaked caverns. The dark brine beneath the pure gleam of the surface. I have seen them. They plague my dreams, their whispers are maddening. They speak of their master, clawing at the barrier... Search the cliffs for their warrens. Find what lurks within and obliterate them all.

Title: A Recent Arrival
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar.
Text: The situation in Silithus appears to be gaining more attention.Archmage Khadgar just arrived while you were away. It seems that he is here to speak with you.It appears urgent. I would speak with him as soon as possible.

Title: Indefatigable Purpose
Objective: Cleanse 3 Drowned Altars.
Text: Its grip weakens, if only briefly. We must claim this place anew! Flopping, nightmarish horrors have infested the caves amongst the cove. Take the sacred blessings. Venture forth into the dark and find their altars. Purge their blasphemous constructions from our lands!

Title: Ride With Me
Objective: Ride Gonk as he investigates the source of corruption nearby.
Text: I have hunted many powerful foes. My pack has defended this island and its people from countless outside threats and foreign invaders.But there is a darkness growing in Zandalar. A corruption so deep and relentless that it consumes the minds of the Zandalari.I cannot hunt intangible darkness, but I can hunt those who wield it against my people.Come, ride with me and my pack. I smell the foul stench of blood trolls nearby. We will see how well you hunt with the pack.

Title: Deadliest Cache: Reel Big Fish
Objective: Listen to Coxswain Hook's tale.
Text: Can ye believe the nerve of these scallywags? Questioning the very Coxswain of this here wharf?Bah!Lend me your ear for a moment or three. I've got a tale that'll put brew in your mug and a quiver in your boots!It was the biggest, deadliest cache I ever did loot on these seas...

Title: The Blood of Azeroth
Objective: Deliver Magni Bronzebeard's message.
Text: Do the leaders of the Alliance and Horde even know what they're fightin' over?This substance that is risin' up from the wound is the lifeblood of Azeroth!We need ta heal the wound, not exploit it fer power! Azeroth is the only home we've got. We cannot allow her ta die!I trust ye, and I know that yer voice carries great weight among the Alliance. Ye must reason with 'em ta stop this madness!'Tis the only hope our world has...

Title: Summons to Stormwind
Objective: Meet with Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.
Text: King Wrynn has requested that you return to Stormwind as soon as possible. There is an urgent matter that requires your attention.I will fill you in on the details as soon as you arrive.You will find me at Lion's Rest. Be swift... our window of opportunity may already be closing!

Title: Desert Research
Objective: Speak with Tammy Tinkspinner.
Text: The dark blade of Sargeras has cast a shadow of destruction over this land.It seemed that the silithid hives were destroyed in the attack, but I have received reports that the silithid are returning.We need to find out how the silithid avoided destruction and what effect the blade is having on their hives.The crown wants the surviving silithid dissected and studied.Tammy Tinkspinner is conducting the research and is in need of a "collector."

Title: Run For the Hills
Objective: Destroy the stockpiles of supplies.
Text: The quilboar are up to something, something big. You need to stop it! They've been busy bringing supplies up to the caves above their sanctum. Preserved thorns, cauldrons of venom, giant totems... They're preparing for war. Get up there and destroy those stockpiles before they can be used against the citizens of the valley!

Title: Deeper into the Woods
Objective: Travel with Cleardawn, Ashton and Webb deeper into the forest.
Text: We need to go deeper into the forest. The witches are clearly up to something even worse than I'd imagined.As much as I have a duty to return to Lady Lucille with Master Ashton, I also have a duty to find out more about this threat to our people, and stop it if I can.Going further into the forest is not without risk, but I believe it is one worth taking.

Title: Terror of the Kraul
Objective: Defeat Bramblefist the Maddened.
Text: By all the gods of the sea, what a monster! I can barely believe what I am seeing. This ettin has undergone the same ritual that the brutes do, and it seems even angrier! If he gets out of here, we won't stand a chance. I know I ask the impossible, but I must: kill this monstrosity and save the whole valley from its wrath! Here, take one of the potion samples you brought me. It's probably dangerous, but you might need it to defeat this beast.

Title: The Blood of Azeroth
Objective: Deliver Magni Bronzebeard's message.
Text: Do the leaders of the Alliance and Horde even know what they're fightin' over?This substance that is risin' up from the wound is the lifeblood of Azeroth!We need ta heal the wound, not exploit it fer power! Azeroth is the only home we've got. We cannot allow her ta die!I trust ye, and I know that yer voice carries great weight among the Horde. Ye must reason with 'em ta stop this madness!'Tis the only hope our world has...

Title: Anger in a Bottle
Objective: Collect 10 Foul-Smelling Samples.

Title: Cleanup Duty
Objective: Kill 4 Flowing Honey and 4 Bubbling Mead.
Text: Wh...why, why is all of the honey alive and what happened to everybody?You don't think... oh no, please , tell me they haven't been eaten!Ahhhh! That would be terrible, please don't let me be eaten too!

Title: Khadgar's Request
Objective: Speak with Archmage Khadgar.
Text: Archmage Khadgar arrived while you were away. It seems that he is here to speak with you.Hurry and see what it is that he wants. I want him gone as soon as possible.The last thing we need is a human nosing around in Horde business!

Title: Desert Research
Objective: Speak with Pixni Rustbomb.
Text: The dark blade of Sargeras has cast a shadow of destruction over this land.It seemed that the silithid hives were destroyed in the attack, but I have received reports that the silithid are returning.If it were up to me, I'd burn those wretched hives once and for all! However, it is not up to me.The Dark Lady wants the surviving silithid dissected and studied.Pixni Rustbomb is conducting the research and is in need of a "collector."

Title: War Pigs
Objective: Collect 8 Grazing Battle-Piglets.
Text: They look cute enough now, but that's a new herd of battleboars in training. Farmers don't like waste, and it would be a shame to get rid of such useful creatures. Either way, we could use those pigs, and I'd rather have them with us rather than face a bloodthirsty one in a few years. You should find them up on top of the cliffs overlooking the center of the kraul. Go round up as many piglets as you can take with you and we'll make good use of them.

Title: Rock Meet Dynamite
Objective: Eliminate the source of the Azerite creatures.
Text: Thanks for your help out there, but we have to ask another favor from you.These elementals must be coming from somewhere in the mine and we need you to locate that source.You seem more than capable of handling yourself in there, but just for extra security I am going to send you with some of Prim's special dynamite. It has an extra kick from the Azerite dust that you gathered.Get in. Find the source. Put a stop to these elementals.

Title: Miner Operation
Objective: Locate Civil Technician Alena and Ordnance Handler Prim.
Text: The mine is in real trouble. We've been excavating for a short while, but never seen anything like this. Azerite doesn't just get up and walk around.If we are going to take the mine back, we're going to need more help. We'll need an engineer and an explosives expert. I have two in mind, sisters actually, but they are caught behind the river in all the chaos.Locate the sisters and they'll help you with the next phase of the plan.

Title: Look Out!
Objective: Kill 6 Briarback Lookouts.
Text: Some of these quilboar are clearly lookouts. Those horns make it obvious, almost like I could see their task floating above their heads. I was able to kill one, but not before he blew that horn of his and summoned backup. I suggest you keep them silent before they do the same with you. If we're going to get anywhere in there, you'll need to do it quietly. Here, Hobbs gave me a few of his sleeping darts. That should keep them quiet.

Title: We Need a Chemist
Objective: Find Head Chemist Walters.
Text: All this chaos started when we were picking at a large Azerite node deep in the mine. The mine began to rumble and all of these blasted creatures burst from the ground. If we could just get rid of that vein, I am sure we could retake the mine.First, we need a chemist. The best one we got is in his lab across the river. Find him and he'll give you more instructions.

Title: Boaring Company
Objective: Find and rescue 7 Captured Farmers and Farmer Deal.
Text: I don't see her body anywhere. That means she could still be alive. The Briarback have been taking prisoners, and anyone who has ever been taken by them was never seen again. We have a single chance here and we need to take it! Come with me into the kraul and free as many of the survivors as you can. And if you can, find Farmer Deal. See if she's still alive.

Title: Pinch of Azerite
Objective: Collect 45 Azerite Dust and Walters' Chemistry Kit.
Text: I don't have time for idle chit chat! If you haven't noticed, rocks are running around doing who knows what?!How about you help out and retrieve my chemistry kit. While you're out, smash some of those creatures and collect their dust. Prim will need both of those for the next step of the plan.Maybe we can figure out what has animated the Azerite.

Title: A Recent Discovery
Objective: Speak with Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: Earlier today, the leaders of the Horde gathered together for a feast in celebration of our victory over the Burning Legion.As the others were feasting, Gallywix requested a private audience with the Dark Lady.It seems that he has found a mysterious substance in Silithus... a magical ore unlike any we have ever encountered before.The warchief has ordered me to fill you in on the details, in preparation for a special assignment.

Title: An Overrun Mine
Objective: Find Chief Miner Theock at Winterdeep Mining Camp.
Text: It was horrible! I was in the mine nearby, just picking away at a rock and it jumped up and bit me in the neck! Since when can rocks walk around and bite people?I hightailed it outta there, but some crazy fools are sticking around trying to take the mine back. If you're eager to punch rocks you can find them down the road to the south.

Title: The G-Team
Objective: Kill the Electrocutioner 6000.
Text: That Murd Doc is crazy. Never, ever, let you find yourself in an aircraft with that gnome.Stealth usually isn't my thing, and it's certainly not going to be yours. Go down this hallway to the Launch Bay and dispose of the Electrocutioner 6000.The Electrocutioner is in charge of the aircraft......and I hate aircraft. I'm not getting in any sort of aircraft!Use this parachute to drop down afterwards and speak with Commando Face for your next job.

Title: The G-Team
Objective: Kill the Viscous Fallout.
Text: How did you get in here?I'm Murd Doc of the G-Team and we could use the help of a  like you.Help us defeat the irradiated inhabatants that now call Gnomeregan home, and I'll make you an honorary G-Team Commando!Take this parachute, jump down into the Hall of Gears, and take out the Viscous Fallout. After you're done, report to Commando B.E Barechus by the west hallway. You two will get along great, I'm sure.

Title: Mayhem at Mildenhall Meadery
Objective: Investigate the Mildenhall Meadery.
Text: Ahhhh! , please, I need some help!My dad hasn't come back from the meadery and, and... well, when I went to look, there were giant globs of honey everywhere.But... but, somehow, they were moving on their own. I even saw one eat a bunny, I swear!I'm scared to go back by myself, but I think dad is in trouble.Can you go with me?

Title: Steal Them Back
Objective: Retrieve 5 Stolen Crates.

Title: The G-Team
Objective: Kill Mekgineer Thermaplugg.
Text: I'd keep my distance from B.E Barechus and Murd Doc, neither is terribly stable.Let's get you to work! Go down into this tunnel until you get to Tinkers' Court. Hopefully you'll know what to do when you meet Mekgineer Thermaplugg.Our leader, Commando Hann Ibal waits somewhere in there. He'll reward you handsomely for all your work.Probably....

Title: Grant Me Revenge
Objective: Defeat Randolph Moloch, Lord Overheat, and Hogger.
Text: I don't care who you pledge allegiance to. I need Hogger dead!He--and the other cretins in this Light-forsaken place--have slain my men. The Alliance and the Horde may not see eyes-to-eye, but you must know that murdering my people in cold blood cannot stand.

Title: Unconventional Aromatics
Objective: Deliver the Batch of Bilewing "Honey" to Rhan'ka at the Goldtusk Inn.
Text: A deal's a deal. You got the stingers for me, so here's that big batch of honey I promised.I hope you and Rhan'ka enjoy it... slowly. Seriously, do not eat this all at once.Oh, and I'm always looking to trade. Swing by anytime you got something to sell or want to pick up some more honey!

Title: A Different Outcome
Objective: Find Rokor near Atal'Gral, to the north.
Text: There is no way to know when these orders were sent, or received.Rokor took some Seekers north some time ago. They must be in that region by now.If the temple still stands, warn Gral and his followers.If it is lost, we must do what we can.

Title: Matrons of the Crimsonwood
Objective: Kill Matrons Elsbeth Garrick, Stefania Denholm and Wilona Blackwood.
Text: The witches in charge, the matrons...The matrons are the one leading the Grand Rite. They are fearsome but not invulnerable. Removing some of them from the equation will bolster our chances of stopping this.Take this potion. It will be able to weaken the matrons so you might have a better chance of dispatching them.

Title: A Little 'Pick Me Up'
Objective: Give the mug to Master Ashton.
Text: Now to mix this up.I'm using some rather strong grog as a base, a drop of chilli extract and a handful of hearthbloom... There!It will taste worse than it smells, but it will bring Master Ashton to his senses. Please give this mug to him.

Title: Disturbance Detected: Ulduar
Objective: Relive the expedition to Ulduar.
Text: You're late. Don't you remember the last time we had to deal with the tampering that allowed Yogg-Saron to escape from his prison underneath Ulduar? You were late then too. You should really try to be more punctual.Well, get going! Old gods! Keepers! Titan stuff! Get this one checked off your list so we can move on. We've got times and places to be.

Title: Mojo Mischief
Objective: Destroy 6 Flasks of Viscous Mojo.
Text: De soldiers you rescued spoke of de raids on Zandalar. Blood troll raiders, frothing at de mouth and possessing supernatural strength, overwhelmed de defenders.Dey say dat their strength came from flasks of mojo dat de raiders drink before going into combat. We cannot allow de blood trolls to continue to possess them.Go down into de camp and destroy any of their flasks you may find.

Title: Stopping the Grand Rite
Objective: Destroy the Ritual Foci.
Text: The witches of the Crimsonwood are planning a Grand Rite, a powerful ritual. They intend to rip open reality and bring their dark master through!I suspect they may be in communion with Gorak Tul. We cannot allow their ritual to succeed.I need you to be the tip of the spear while I protect Master Ashton and Marten. Cause havoc and disrupt their rituals!

Title: Stranger in a Strange Land
Objective: Find the Warchief's Command board in Orgrimmar.
Text: Hi. I'm Ambassador Blackguard.On behalf of the warchief, I am honored to welcome you to Orgrimmar.As a lifetime of adventure unfolds before you, be assured that... uh...You know what? I've been reading this same greeting all day. Enough's enough.Talk to your emissary and find out where you can adventure. Run along.

Title: Odds and Ends
Objective: Collect 4 Organic Matter Samples and 3 Bags of Reagents.
Text: Master Ashton's going to probably need something bracing once we get him free. I know of a quick potion guaranteed to get anyone to snap out of it, but I'm going to need a few things first.Those wicker dogs down there have some organic parts I can use and the witches are carrying bags of reagents. They'll almost certainly have what I need.Bring those to me and I'll handle the rest once we get Master Ashton back.

Title: A Timely Summons from Northrend
Objective: Meet with Vormu in Dalaran above Crystalsong Forest.
Text: The blazing wanes in the shadow of a celestial mass, striking fear in to the seers. Seek out the sage Vormu in Dalaran, and lend her your aid.No, not this Dalaran, the other one. Yes I know, it's terribly confusing.

Title: Stranger in a Strange Land
Objective: Find the Hero's Call board in Stormwind City.
Text: Welcome to Stormwind. King Anduin Wrynn invites you to explore our fair city. Say, you look like the devout sort. We have a lovely cathedral that will no doubt be of interest!Ah, but that can wait. An emissary of the Lightforged is standing by to tell you of adventures that await beyond the city walls.Have a pleasant stay. Oh, and please excuse the occasional mess. I fear many of our citizens lack the discipline that you Army of the Light soldiers are so famous for!

Title: The Speaker's Call
Objective: Meet Magni Bronzebeard at the Wound in Silithus.
Text: I been travelin' the land, seekin' out anyone who might know how ta heal Azeroth. I've consulted ancient sages, druids, shamans... from dragons ta titan keepers. Nobody's seen anythin' like this before.Went ta Karazhan ta speak with Khadgar. Studyin' those old tomes o' his, we came up with an idea. No tellin' if it's gonna work, but we gotta try.Come ta Silithus. Meet me at the wound. Time is runnin' out fer Azeroth.

Title: The Head of Her Enemy
Objective: Place Gloomtail's head in front of Maka'fon so that she knows her territory is safe and that Ben'jin is the reason.
Text: You have done a wonderful thing. With de destruction of Gloomtail, Maka'fon is no longer bothered by de presence of de razorwings. It seems dat Gloomtail destroyed her eggs some time ago. Take Gloomtail's head to Maka'fon as proof dat he is gone. When she finds de scent of Ben'jin on it, she will once again seek a worthy mate. When Ben'jin senses dat, he will approach and nature will take over.

Title: Stranger in a Strange Land
Objective: Find the Warchief's Command board in Orgrimmar.
Text: Hi. I'm Ambassador Blackguard.On behalf of the warchief, I am honored to welcome you to Orgrimmar.As a lifetime of adventure unfolds... ugh!That's it! I'm tired of reading this same greeting day in and day out.Go figure out where you can fight things, then talk to your emissary.Please just leave me alone.

Title: Stranger in a Strange Land
Objective: Find the Hero's Call board in Stormwind City.
Text: Welcome to Stormwind. King Anduin Wrynn invites you to explore our fair city. Say, you look like someone who enjoys the night life. We have many popular taverns and a vibrant music scene!Ah, but that can wait. An emissary of the ren'dorei is standing by to tell you of adventures that await beyond the city walls.Have a pleasant stay. Oh, and a friendly word of advice... best to keep control of those shadowy powers you wield. Not everyone in Stormwind is as enlightened as I am!

Title: Deep In the Core
Objective: Travel to Orgrimmar and take the portal to Deepholm. Seek out Ormhun Stonehammer when you arrive.
Text: Look, ya gonna have ta travel ta Deepholm and convince dem ta be givin' up deir secrets. Dat's where da last anvil was made, or so I be hearin'. And I only be knowin' of one earten down dere who might be willin' ta work wit ya. His name be Ormhun Stonehamma'. He be kind of an outcast, but not too hard ta find.

Title: Therazane's Choice
Objective: Listen to Therazane's proposition.
Text: Interesting... I have a wonderful idea on how to solve this issue. Would you like to hear it?

Title: A Recipe For the Ages
Objective: Bring Forgemaster Zak'aal 30 pieces of Revlis Ore from Atal'Gral in Zuldazar.
Text: Say, ya look like you been swingin' da hammah around quite a bit. I can smell da flux on ya!  Listen, I've got a recipe for da most amazin' blacksmit hammah ya ever be layin' ya eyes on. And I'd be willing ta let it go for a bit of ore. Revlis ore ta be exact. It be a little rare, but ya can find some of it over at Atal'Gral. Da naga dere use it ta make deir weapons. Bring me back a haul of it, and da recipe be yours!

Title: Anvil's Away
Objective: Bring the anvil back to Forgemaster Zak'aal in Zuldazar.
Text: Take your anvil, and never speak of its methods of creation to anyone. Should I find out otherwise, you may find your next visit to my realm an unpleasant one.

Title: An Ear to the Ground
Objective: Go to the Jagged Wastes and look for signs of worms. They usually kick up lots of dirt as they move around.
Text: The next reagent ya need comes from the bellies of worms that burrow through this realm. While ya can find plenty o' worms all over, there's a certain type you'll need ta find. They're rarely seen above ground, but there are ways of coaxing 'em out. Namely making enough racket to piss 'em off! Ha ha! When ya see 'em rumblin' around beneath ya, use this thumper to draw 'em out. Deliver a killin' blow and get that metal from their wee bellies!

Title: Anvil's Away
Objective: Bring the anvil back to Grix Barlow in Boralus.
Text: Take your anvil, and never speak of its methods of creation to anyone. Should I find out otherwise, you may find your next visit to my realm an unpleasant one.

Title: Hammering Out Information
Objective: Press Forgemaster Zak'aal for more information about where to find a Khaz'gorian Smithing Anvil.
Text: Let me guess. You be lookin' at da recipe and noticed it require a Khaz'gorian Anvil ta make it. So now you be wantin' ta know where ta find a Khaz'gorian Smithing Anvil? Look, I never said anyting about bein' able ta craft da hamma. Now if ya don't mind, I have more of dese recipes ta be sellin'.

Title: Smash and Grab
Objective: Go to the Alabaster Shelf and smash Diaminium Pillars. Collect 60 Diaminium.
Text: Most of the materials we'll need can be found right down here in the Deepholm. We just need ta be discreet about it. If old Therazane catches wind of what we're up to, she might try ta put a stop ta it. But let's not worry 'bout that. The first thing you'll need is diaminium. There are pillars that grow in the Alabaster Shelf rich with 'em. Just use yer old blacksmithin' hammer and smash those pillars ta bits. Don't worry about breaking the diaminium. We'll meld it all back tagether.

Title: Titanic Forging
Objective: Meet Ormhun near the Shuddering Spires and help him craft a Khaz'gorian Anvil.
Text: Are ya ready? You'll be doing the hammerin' while I take care of the last reagent we'll need.

Title: Deep In the Core
Objective: Travel to Stormwind and take the portal to Deepholm. Seek out Ormhun Stonehammer when you arrive.
Text: Look, you're gonna have to travel to some place called Deepholm and find an earthen down there. The guy who sold the recipe to me said he got it from an earthen called...Ormhun! Ormhun something. I don't know too much about that place, but maybe you can ask the locals or something where he lives. Now if you don't mind, I have more recipes to sell.

Title: Atal'Dazar: Locking Horns
Objective: Go to Atal'Dazar and recover The Golden Horn of Rezan.
Text: We've got tha metal for tha base and tha body, but there's one last part... Tha horn of tha anvil was ta be made of ukrite. But that metal's been gone for ages. There is another metal tha's very close ta it in terms of its durability. A type of gold tha trolls mined in abundance. And I know where ye can find it. Tha trolls control an area called Atal'Dazar, a great city made o' tha stuff. If ye can find something horn-shaped in there, that'll save us tha trouble of shaping it from scratch.

Title: Give it a Little Juice
Objective: Put some voodoo on Cala's formula using Witchdoctor Jangalar's cauldron.
Text: Well, I admit that I feel a little better about this. If Witch Doctor Jangalar's voodoo can make Ben'jin react correctly, as the science says he should, then what do we have to lose? Bless my formula or hex it or whatever they call it with Jangalar's voodoo cauldron.

Title: Bittersweet
Objective: Free Samantha Sweet then recover her gear.
Text: Hey!I need to get out of here and get back to Falconhurst! My husband and I were looking for my daughter's favorite toy when I was taken. Please, I need to get out of here! I need to know my family is safe.They took my gear. It's all around camp. Get me out of here then bring back my gear, please!

Title: Free the Farmhands
Objective: Rescue the Honey Encased Farmhands.
Text: We were running around trying to get the farm under control, but the bees, oh my goodness, the bees!The giant monstrosities came out of nowhere and started dousing everyone in honey.I came up here to find Raimond, but before I knew it, I was covered too.Then, the strangest thing happened, the honey started growing around me!Please, the other farmhands are still in trouble, you've got to help them!

Title: A Second Ally For the Cause
Objective: Choose a second ally to pursue.
Text: One new ally will prove useful. A second will make us even stronger.Even now, the Alliance plots and schemes against us. We must move quickly, or they will strike before we are prepared to counter their aggression.Say the word when you are ready to begin pursuit of our next ally. There must be no hesitation.

Title: A Boralus Triple Threat
Objective: Take out Fernn's three lieutenants.
Text: If Tallis honestly thinks that offing a few random soldiers is going to force us to give up Southwatch, he's in for a surprise. The reason why we haven't chased out the sorry troops in this camp is simply because we have more pressing plans.Fernn has his lieutenants facing the Watch's cannons straight at Boralus as we speak. Those three are the real driving force of the attack.

Title: Saving Master Ashton
Objective: Take a key from a Hexwood Binder and free Master Ashton.
Text: I believe I see Master Ashton in a cage. He must be freed!Those witches with the long masks appear to be in charge. I bet they would have the means to open his cage.I will remain here to protect Apprentice Webb and keep the area secure.

Title: Spell Bound
Objective: Destroy 8 Binding Runes to free captive villagers.

Title: An Improvised Arsenal
Objective: Speak with Angus Ballaster to create a silver weapon at Watchman's Rise.
Text: I don't know much about blacksmithing, but I'm pretty sure this won't be enough silver to outfit all of the Inquisitors. We will need to find another way to use this.Let us hope that Ballaster can come up with something... creative.

Title: A Second Ally For the Cause
Objective: Choose a second ally to pursue.
Text: You have taken an important first step in strengthening the Alliance. Well done.But I fear a single new ally will not deter the Horde. The warchief will not rest until Orgrimmar's forces vastly outnumber the defenders of Stormwind.I must ask that you work to secure our next ally. We cannot afford any delay.

Title: A Choice of Allies
Objective: Learn more about potential allies.
Text: As ambassador, it is my duty to bolster the Horde's ranks and strengthen our numbers in the face of danger.Your adventures have led you to many different people who can aid the Horde if we can convince them to join our cause.I've kept a record of the most promising potential allies. The choice of which to approach first is yours.

Title: Mating Season Halftime
Objective: Strategize with Cala Cruzpot and Witch Doctor Janagalar on how to use voodoo and science to get the endangered brutosaurs to mate.
Text: Cala and I have both failed. Voodoo and science did not work. I am at a loss. I hope dat you can help us find a better path forward. De brutosaurs deserve a chance! Please spend a little time with both of us. Perhaps you can find de way dat we cannot.

Title: The Mail Must Flow
Objective: Help the Postmaster sort at least 15 letters within the time limit.
Text: Due to all of the recent shenanigans, I'm running short on mailementals to sort letters.It's a simple job, really - just toss the letter into the proper portal, where it will be whisked away to the far corners of Azeroth and beyond.I like to make a little game out of it. How many can you sort in one minute?

Title: A Choice of Allies
Objective: Learn more about potential allies.
Text: I was chosen to act as an ambassador to our new allies due to my experience with the pandaren joining the Alliance.I've made some notes about some potential allies that may be willing to join the Alliance.Learn more about them, then speak with me.

Title: A Slip of the Tongue
Objective: Steal a Pack of Pterrordax Snacks and use them to ride a pterrordax deeper into the city.
Text: It sounds like ya be headed somewhere in a hurry, little weed!Sit down and share a tale with an old troll before ya head out on ya next adventa.I went on many adventas with my pterrordax when I was young. Explored dis whole valley!My pterrordax died many years ago, but...Sometimes at night, I steal da guards' snacks to trick dese old pterrordaxes into lettin' me ride again. Ha!

Title: Bramblethorn
Objective: Slay Bramblethorn and retrieve Lord Sharptooth.
Text: I was playing with Lord and Lady Sharptooth when Papa made me come with him. I dropped poor Lord Sharptooth and one of those big mean monsters grabbed him!Papa said he'd try to get him back but he's been gone a long time. I think he got busy. Mama and all the adults are busy doing stuff for Mayor Royston.Lady Sharptooth and I are really sad. Can you beat up that mean monster and save my dino?

Title: The Source of Power
Objective: Collect 10 Silithid Brains.
Text: The silithid are all riled up and stronger than ever!My guess is that they are feeding off of some kind of power beneath the ground. Probably near the blade of Sargeras!I've been ordered to study the effects that this mysterious power is having on the sillithid.Bring me as many intact silithid brains as you can carry and I'll begin the research!

Title: A Wee Bit O' Cloth
Objective: Collect 8 scraps of Twilight Silk.
Text: , is that you I hear rustlin' about out there? It's me, Angus Stormbrew!There are cultists everywhere, so ye best keep yer voice down. Lean in close and cover yer nose while we talk!This is the only outhouse in all o' Silithus! Trust me I spent hours lookin' all through the night. I decided to sneak in for a wee drop-off before the cultists woke up, but I've got a uhh problem...There's no cloth to... you know...See if ye can find me a wee bit o' cloth and sneak it in through the door!

Title: No Safe Haven
Objective: Rescue 12 Zeb'ahari villagers.
Text: I brought Rastakhan to Zeb'ahari to hide him. I did not dream Zul's followers would find us so soon.De people of Zeb'ahari are being hunted by those who answer to de prophet. I have brought dis upon dem by keeping de king in their village.Help me save dem. Gather those who can still walk and send dem to me.I can do nothing for those who died, but we can still rescue de living.

Title: The Twilight Survivor
Objective: Retrieve Michiel Voidstrider's head.
Text: This land was once overrun with members of the Twilight's Hammer.The cult was presumed to be exterminated, but darkness always survives in the shadows.Most of the cultists were destroyed by Sargeras in the attack, but a few yet live. Their leader, Michiel Voidstrider has been emboldened by the destruction of Silithus.We cannot let this fanatic rally the remaining survivors to action! Bring me his head!

Title: Larvae By The Dozen
Objective: Collect 12 Silithid Broodlings.
Text: How did the silithid survive the blade of Sargeras?!I've never encountered a species that can adapt to changes in the environment as quickly as the silithid!There's gotta be a way to tame these suckers! Harness their evolutionary biology for our profit!We gotta start training 'em young! Forget about the old crusty adults, we need babies!Steal me as many of the silithid larvae as you can carry, and I'll find a way to train 'em!

Title: The Twilight Survivor
Objective: Retrieve Michiel Voidstrider's head.
Text: Silithus used to be overrun with members of the Twilight's Hammer.The cult was presumed to be exterminated, but it has always survived in the shadows. Their numbers have dwindled, but the cult remains no less fanatical than at their peak.Most of the cultists here were destroyed by Sargeras in the attack, but a few still remain. Their leader, Michiel Voidstrider has been emboldened by the destruction of Silithus.We cannot let Michiel rally the remaining survivors to action. He must be stopped!

Title: Larvae By The Dozen
Objective: Collect 12 Silithid Broodlings.
Text: How did the silithid survive the blade of Sargeras? I'm perplexed!I've never encountered a species that can adapt to changes in the environment as quickly as the silithid can.The larvae, or broodlings as they are often called, can evolve into a variety of silithid creature types based on the needs of the hive.Is it the hive mind that signals the evolutionary development of the larvae, or is some environmental factor at play?Science must find the answer!

Title: The Source of Power
Objective: Collect 10 Silithid Brains.
Text: Although the silithid disappeared for a time immediately following the destruction of Silithus, they have recently returned from beneath the ground.These new silithid seem stronger than before!My hypothesis is that the silithid are feeding on some kind of power source beneath the blade of Sargeras.I've been tasked with studying the effects that this mysterious power is having on the silithid hives.Bring me as many intact silithid brains as you can carry and I'll begin the research!

Title: Bilgemaul's Brigade
Objective: Defeat Captain Bilgemaul in the Brackish Coast and loot his War Spoils.

Title: Precious Metals
Objective: Collect 10 Silver Nuggets from the Bleak Hills Mine.
Text: , I have another objective we should consider.The Bleak Hills Mine is not too far from our location. Though the miners there principally extract iron, they do on occasion find silver among the veins.We do not know the current state of the mine, but it's unlikely that the coven has passed it over. However, it would be worth braving whatever dangers lie there to recover some silver to use against them.

Title: All Wrapped Up
Objective: Destroy Writhing Cocoons to rescue 8 Bleak Hills Miners in the Bleak Hills Mine.
Text: While I was able to get out of the mine, some of my friends weren't so lucky. I saw those spiders wrap them up in their webs... probably to save them for a snack.It was terrible, but all I could do was run.Will you help them?

Title: Hold The Barricade!
Objective: Defend the barricades from attack!
Text: they're rallying for a heavy assault!We'll need to defend these barricades from attack! Are you with me?

Title: An Eight-Legged Curse
Objective: Kill 20 Bilefang spiders in the Bleak Hills Mine.
Text: Some terrible old hag unleashed a swarm of these horrible spiders in the mine! I was barely able to make it out alive, but they've got me surrounded!You can't leave me here! Please kill those things!

Title: The Bee Team
Objective: Kill 12 Highland Maulers.
Text: We need to put things in order, and the next item on the list is these blasted wendigos terrorizing the farm.If we can cull their numbers, it should be enough to drive them off!I've synthesized a superb solution that might be just what we need to solvent this sticky situation!Toss these bottles at your foes and our friendly little apoideas should come to help.Whatever you do, please don't spill any on yourself...

Title: Into the Crimsonwood
Objective: Meet Inquisitor Cleardawn in the Crimson Forest.
Text: Master Ashton has been taken into the forest. He isn't the only one. Mayor Royston's headcount came up short.It seems our next steps are clear. We must go into the woods and save Master Ashton.Marten and I will sneak into the forest and meet you near some ruins further in.

Title: Royal Succession
Objective: Retrieve the Hive Mother's Stinger.
Text: I know, I know, okay... the farm is overrun by living honey and the bees have grown to massive proportions.I'll admit, things didn't quite go according to plan, but, extraordinary advancements in science do not come without some risk!I've been up here attempting to reduce aggression in the hive, an unfortunate side effect of my miscalculation, but I need another favor...You're going to have to kill the Hive Mother and retrieve her stinger for me.

Title: Digging for Scraps
Objective: Collect 10 Quality Salvage from the Corlain Armory.
Text: Well met.I hope you don't mind that I took the liberty to scout ahead and assess the situation at the armory.The good news is that there still seems to be some salvageable arms left in the armory. The bad news, of course, is that the coven is after them as well.Additional weapons could be a great boon to our cause. I recommend we take all we can carry.

Title: Sticky Situation
Objective: Collect 60 Royal Jelly.
Text: The scientific breakthroughs I've made, marvelous, absolutely marvelous... I'm so close to perfecting the formula!The way the honey grows and crystallizes, simply beautiful. Well, as you can see, that's also part of my current predicament.Perhaps you can lend me a hand? Just fetch some royal jelly from the hives outside.Oh, don't worry about the bees, they are sweet, gentle things.They don't sting... much.

Title: They Say It's a Delicacy
Objective: Obtain 25 Partially Digested Pods from the bellies of nearby diemetradons.
Text: A romantic meal is de way to set up an evening for love. Dis is true for us, so why not for Maka'fon? Bring her something rare and pleasing to her palate. Diemetrodons near de water eat hard seed pods and partially digest them. With a little voodoo, something magical can happen to de pods. It may be disgusting to you and I, but de brutosaurs consider it a rare delicacy. Such is life. Dere are plenty of diemetradons, so some must die dat de brutosaurs might live. Such is de purpose of death.

Title: Recovering Raimond
Objective: Find Raimond Mildenhall.
Text: The map we found earlier had some red markings, near the flower field.Do you think you could go up there and look for dad?I'm going to stay here and check out the rest of this stuff.I'd go with you... but, I'm sort of allergic to bees.Oh, and take his boot. Just in case!

Title: Checking Out the Collapse
Objective: Find Farmer Burton at his farm.
Text: If you've got a minute, there's a farmer out there who hasn't made it back yet. Name's Burton and he's out by a farm right next to Briarback Kraul. If the quilboar were to strike out, his farm is one of the first in their way. I haven't heard anything from Burton. He mostly relied on his mechanical farmers to help him, so we don't know the situation out there. Head to the west and keep an eye out for him, would you?

Title: There's Gold in Them There Fields
Objective: Find Farmer Goldfield at his farm.
Text: We've still got some folks missing, and I could use your help finding them. While Brennadam is now secure, I worry for some of our farms closer to the quilboar kraul. We relied on the militia in the past to keep the quilboar back, but now that they've retreated to the east I worry that our outlying farms are in danger. Goldfield's farm is almost directly south of us, up the hill by the falls. While it's not surprising that he hasn't left, I would feel better if you checked in.

Title: A Steady Ballast
Objective: Find Angus Ballaster at the Corlain Armory.
Text: The Armory presents us a ripe opportunity... one I suggest we take.If this battle were to draw out, we have little means to repair our arms and armor. A blacksmith is invaluable to any war effort, and Ballaster is one of our best.The Armory is but a short ride from here. I suggest you get to Ballaster before it's too late!

Title: The Missing Link
Objective: Obtain the Architect's Cipher from Tideguard Pontus.
Text: They are... everywhere... disguised...Encrypted... blueprints...Cipher...Pontus... watching me...

Title: A Weather Eye
Objective: Speak with Inquisitor Notley at Watchman's Rise to scout the areas surrounding Corlain.
Text: It would be wise to get a lay of the land before we put together a plan of action.Inquisitor Notley is an expert falconer, and a reliable scout. He utilizes an ancient relic to see through the eyes of his falcon, allowing him to survey great distances.Unfortunately, Notley was injured during the fighting. Nothing serious, but it's left him unable to concentrate enough to control his falcon.Perhaps you could help?

Title: Stop Vining!
Objective: Slay the three Vinemasters.
Text: You may have noticed that the fields are a little... unstable right now. The Briarback have been busy, growing those large bramble vines and boring tunnels underneath the farm. The vines have always been an important part of their borders, and they're expanding! Go down into the lower area and see if you can find who or what is making those vines grow. There's no way that they're growing like that naturally. If we can stop the vines we can retake this area!

Title: Setting the Mood
Objective: Place and light the Voodoo Love Incense near Irritable Maka'fon and offer her the Romantic Brutosaur Meal.
Text: De voodoo love incense and romantic meal are ready. Take dem and place dem at de feet of Maka'fon. Quickly, if you could. Dat smell is... overwhelmingly, horribly, disgusting. Could you move any faster? Away. From us. For de sake of de brutosaurs, of course.

Title: A Recipe for Success
Objective: Bring the torn paper back to Elric.
Text: Looking it over more closely, you're convinced that this must be the missing half of the recipe you came for. An odd signature completes the recipe, signed, "Silas Darkmoon". Elric should be very pleased to see this once again.

Title: The Battle of Bloodfire Ravine
Objective: Take Bloodfire Ravine from the Blood Trolls.
Text: It is time to strike out and end de blood troll threat once and for all!We travel back to Bloodfire Ravine, and dis time it is de blood trolls who will be sent running.Mount up, and together we will show dem we are a force to be reckoned with!

Title: Gadgets and Gizmos Aplenty
Objective: Collect 10 Harvester Gizmos.
Text: The militia may have given up on us, but we haven't given up on me! I'm a bit of a tinker, and I find that my harvest golems are better than any hired help I've ever had. They just need regular maintenance to keep running. Of course the Briarback are now taking over my fields, and my farmhands have gone into disrepair. If you head out into the fields, can you grab the inner mechanisms from any of them that you find? That will stop them from exploding as well as help me plan my revenge.

Title: A Friendly Gesture
Objective: Reach Friendly with Sporeggar.
Text: Life in the marsh has not been easy. We want to live in harmony with those that call it home, but our enemies out here threaten our existence.Work with us. Help the people of Sporeggar thrive.

Title: Farming Stimulator
Objective: Use the Piloted Farmhand to slay 30 enemies.
Text: The plants have gone amok since you defeated their masters! Don't worry though, I've got a plan. I've been busy fixing up one of the farmhands that didn't go completely haywire. It should have enough juice for one more trip through the fields. We've got some serious technology in these harvesters. Their tools should be more than enough to take care of some small plants and even a couple quilboar. What do you say? You up for some farming the Stormsong way? Hop on in and get to work!

Title: An Outside Perspective
Objective: Reach Neutral with Sporeggar.
Text: Thank you for everything you have done for my people, but they are still scared of outsiders.Fight the bog lords and rescue the spore sacs in the Spawning Glen. The future of my people is at stake!

Title: Changing the Scenery
Objective: Go to Stormsong Valley and transmute Barberry Shrubs into Shrubbery Bubbles and gather 6 of them.
Text: The stone this recipe becomes is a transmutation stone. What if the missing reagents to make it come from something that's gone through the transmutation process? I'm willing to try anything at this point. Here's an old recipe my ex-partner devised. He used to go out to Stormsong Valley, just south of the Highland Flats and change the shrubs there into bubbles. Bring back some of those bubbles and we'll see if they're what we've been missing.

Title: Chemically Compounded
Objective: Meet Quintin at the cave he mentioned. And be ready for anything to happen.
Text: That appears to be everything. This latest transmutation will be my finest yet. And your prize waits at its completion, apprentice. But I don't believe this is an appropriate place to test it out. It may draw too much attention. There's a cave not terribly far from here which would prove to be a more suitable setting for such a test. Meet me there when you're ready to witness why transmutation is the only branch of alchemy worth learning.

Title: A Deathly Draught
Objective: Collect 15 Deathshrooms.
Text: The first thing I'd like you to do for me is to gather some deathshroom. Don't worry if you're not skilled at herbalism, they're very easy to pick. They typically grow where death lingers in the air. I'd try to the Crimson Forest to the south. The creatures that have overrun it seem to be covered in deathly magics.

Title: A Stone's Throw
Objective: Use the Bag of Transmutation Stones on witches and kill them. Collect 8 Vials of Altered Blood from them.
Text: You may enjoy getting this next reagent for me. I have some special stones that have transmutative qualities, especially on living things. It's not too unlike the one you're trying to make. The witches that plague these lands are imbued with magic. As is their blood. I need their blood to finish my latest project, but in an altered form. These stones should turn them into weaker creatures. Although, sometimes the opposite occurs... I'd recommend handling them with care.

Title: A Possible Solution
Objective: Travel to Drustvar and seek out Quintin Whalgrene.
Text: Nothing appears to be working. I can't believe I'm proposing this but I actually think we need to contact Quintin. Well, you should, as I doubt he'll speak to me. Perhaps you could convince him to part with the other half of the recipe? Last time I heard, he was staying in Drustvar near Arom's Stand. There's a lot of alchemists in those parts, but he shouldn't be too hard to find. Best not to tell him I sent you. He may not be as forthcoming with the recipe.

Title: Casting the First Stone
Objective: Craft a Potion of Durability and a Potion of Shifting States using the recipes given to you. You can find the ingredients you need in Elric's shop.
Text: Would you mind helping me out with something?  You see, I have this recipe that, well, I only have half of currently. I've been trying to remember the other half but just can't seem to recall it. My EX-partner tore the recipe and ran off with the other half over a disagreement we were having. But the stone it makes is invaluable. How about you grab some vials and start mixing the ingredients on this list. Perhaps together we can figure this out.

Title: A Recipe For the Ages
Objective: Bring Grix Barlow back 30 pieces of Revlis Ore from Gol Koval in Drustvar.
Text: Yo, over here! You've look like you've been hammering away for a while. I can smell the flux on ya!  Listen, I've got a recipe for the most amazing blacksmith hammer you've ever laid your eyes on. And I'd be willing to let it go for a bit of ore. Revlis ore to be exact. It's a little rare, but you can find plenty of it over in Gol Koval in Drustvar. The elementals there are practically made of it. Bring me back a haul of it, and the recipe's yours!

Title: Ocular Extracts
Objective: Gather 10 Highlands Mauler Eyes and return them to Elric.
Text: My next idea involves a creature whose eyes are useful for certain alchemical recipes. At least for potions they are. Hopefully they're just what we need for this and there aren't any further... miscalculations. Although, I don't entirely recall seeing them on the recipe's ingredient list... but my memory isn't exactly as good as it used to be. Oh, you caught me rambling. How about you get those eyes and I'll start making the preparations for them.

Title: A Deathly Draught
Objective: Collect 15 Deathshrooms.
Text: De first thing I'd like you to do for me is to gather some deathshroom. Don't worry if you're not skilled at herbalism, they're very easy to pick. Dey typically grow where death lingers in the air. I'd try to de Frogmarsh to de southeast. De trolls dere have been making sacrifices of de creature dat inhabit de area.

Title: A Possible Solution
Objective: Travel to Nazmir and seek out Zukashi.
Text: None of dese things are working. I can't believe I'm saying dis, but I think you're gonna have to find Zukashi. Maybe you could convince him to give up de other half of de recipe. He's pretty full of himself, but he isn't unreasonable. Last time I heard, he's staying in Nazmir near Gloom Hollow. Maybe it's best to tell him dis isn't about me.

Title: A Recipe for Success
Objective: Bring the torn paper back to Kumali.
Text: Looking it over more closely, you're convinced that this must be the missing half of the recipe you came for. An odd signature completes the recipe, signed, "Silas Darkmoon". Kumali should be very pleased to see this once again.

Title: A Stone's Throw
Objective: Use the Bag of Transmutation Stones on blood trolls and kill them. Collect 8 Vials of Altered Blood from them.
Text: Now dis ingredient you might have some fun getting, little mixah. I'm gonna give you dese stones. They're able to turn things into other things. Dose blood trolls, de ones giving de rest of us a bad name? Dey drink de weirdest things and it taints their bodies. I need their blood to finish my work here, but without de taint. Dese stones will turn dem into weaker creatures. Although, sometimes de stones turn dem into other things... Be careful with dem.

Title: Chemically Compounded
Objective: Meet Zukashi at the cave he mentioned. And be ready for anything to happen.
Text: Now dat I have everything I need, I can finish dis project. My latest transmuation will be my finest yet! But dis is not de place to test it. It could draw too much attention. If you want to see it for yourself, little mixah, meet me to de north. Dere is a cave dere dat should be a safe spot for testing dis out.

Title: Hammering Out Information
Objective: Press Grix Barlow for more information about where to find a Khaz'gorian Smithing Anvil.
Text: I guess you noticed it requires a special anvil to make it. And I suppose you want to know where to find a Khaz'gorian Smithing Anvil? Well, I don't know where you can find one, not to mention I never said you'd be able to actually craft the dang thing. Now if you wouldn't mind, I have more of these recipes to sell.

Title: Ocular Extracts
Objective: Gather 10 Razorwing Eyes and return them to Kumali. Then observe as she tries to make the stone with them.
Text: So dere's a creature in dese lands whose eyes are perfect for alchemical recipes. Dey might just be de thing we need to finish dis project. Although, I don't remember seeing dem on de full recipe list de last time I saw it, ya see... But my memory isn't quite what it used to be. Gah! I'm rambling too much. Get me some eyes, will ya?

Title: Totems, Totems, Totems!
Objective: Destroy the Brambleguard Totems in Briarback Kraul.

Title: Changing the Scenery
Objective: Go to The Slough and transmute Barberry Shrubs into Shrubbery Bubbles and gather 6 of them.
Text: Or maybe de problem is dat we don't need regular reagents. Maybe we need something dat only comes from being transmuted. Anything's worth a shot at dis point. Here is a recipe my old partner left behind. He used to go out to de Slough and change de shrubs into bubbles, ya see. Why, you might ask? 'Cause he loved transmuting everything. Part of de reason we never saw eye to eye. Anyways, bring me back some of dose bubbles and we'll see if we can use dem to make dis stone.

Title: Bearers of Bad News
Objective: Return to Boralus with Taelia.
Text: We must report this attack to Lord Admiral Katherine Proudmoore and prove to her that Lady Ashvane is behind it.It won't be easy... Lady Ashvane and Katherine Proudmoore have been close friends for years.Quickly, let us make for Boralus!

Title: Casting the First Stone
Objective: Craft a Potion of Durability and a Potion of Shifting States using the recipes given to you. You can find the ingredients you need in Kumali's shop.
Text: Hey dere , gimme a hand with dis, would ya?  I got dis recipe dat I've been trying to remember de rest of, but I'm having de hardest time coming up with de right ingredients. Ya see, my partner ran off with de other half of de recipe on account of a disagreement we had. But dis stone, it's a treasure like no other. Grab some vials and start mixing dese ingredients together. Let's see if dey are de right ones.

Title: Golden Fields Forever
Objective: Lay Farmer Goldfield's family to rest.
Text: I can take care of the rest. That ettin would have given me trouble if I was by myself, so you have my thanks. I would ask you for one more favor. My wife, she loved the carnations that grow by the water's edge. If you could gather some, there's a nice spot under a tree by the river. We loved to go there when the sun set after our days in the fields. Our boy would run around, catching bugs, making reed whistles...

Title: Back On Your Feet, Soldier
Objective: Give weapons to 10 Zandalari Captives.
Text: I figured any soldiers we be coming across might be wantin' some revenge, so I brought along some extra weapons just in case.See up ahead? Dem cages be full of trolls awaitin' der turn ta die. We gonna swoop in der and be da answers to der prayers!Go and arm as many of dem as ya can, revenge gonna be sweet!

Title: The Crawg Ma'da
Objective: Obtain a Crawg Poison Gland and slay Amaka the Crawg Ma'da.
Text: No matter what we do, as long as dem blood trolls have their village here, dey gonna be a threat.We gonna put an end to dat threat!Amaka be da strongest blood troll I ever seen, and she be right across da way there. She be feedin' da bodies of da Zandalari ta her pet crawgs, makin' dem big, fat, and deadly. It be time for revenge, and we be doin' it wit' da help of her own pets.Go kill a crawg and cut its poison gland out of its belly. With it, ya can weaken Amaka and put an end to her.

Title: Building Defenses
Objective: Collect lumber to build forward barricades.
Text: We'll be able to push those monsters back now, but my defenders won't stand a chance unless we build a forward barricade for protection.There should be plenty of lumber to build a barricade near the entrance to town.

Title: A Message of Blood and Fire
Objective: Use the Wand of Embers to set ablaze 8 Blood Troll huts in Agwamar.
Text: Look at what I be findin' here. Dis one had a magic wand in his hand.Mmmmm... it be warm. Mojo of fire be within. Perfect!Take dis ting an' give 'em a taste of their own firepower.Burn da whole village down!

Title: Curiously Strong
Objective: Use the Frost Breath Potion to put out the fires.
Text: I imagine the fires spread while I was down here, yes? First order of business then; making sure the town doesn't burn down! Help solve that problem and I shall be free to assist you in... whatever it is?Let's see... Yes! Here! Take these. They proved to be bit too... intense for most people, but you seem like a stout sort.Just be sure you're facing the fires when you use them, and I'm certain those fires will be out in no time!

Title: Target of Opportunity
Objective: Confront Grand Ma'da Ateena.
Text: It seems our actions here have not gone unnoticed. I feel a dark presence ahead.Ateena is near!Dis is our chance! If we strike now, we can deal a huge blow to de blood trolls!We must move!

Title: Ateena's Fall
Objective: Slay Grand Ma'da Ateena.
Text: You have proven to be a much greater ally dan I could have ever hoped. Thanks to you and your Horde, we have come dis far. Now, there is only one thing dat remains.We must confront de leader of de blood trolls and put an end to their dark plot once and for all.Without Ateena's mojo to protect it, we can finally destroy dat monstrosity of theirs before it can be unleashed upon Zuldazar.You know what must be done.First, I must prepare myself. Go. I will join you when de battle has begun.

Title: Brutal Boost
Objective: Administer the Aggression Formula to Gentle Ben'jin.
Text: The Aggression Formula is ready and I need you to inject Ben'jin with it. Let's show the world, and the witch doctor, that well researched, dramatically overpowered, double-blind, peer-reviewed, super goblin science is the right way to do, uh, pretty much anything!

Title: Boom goes the Bomb
Objective: Call artillery strikes on the Blood Troll Barricades in Zul'Nazman.
Text: Just look at 'em... those blood trolls are holed up pretty good down there in that fortress of theirs. Multiple defensive lines, lots of equipment, they got everything.They're completely unprepared for us! I almost feel sorry for 'em!Let's start off by showing 'em what we think of their cute attempts at making barricades. Here, take these smoke grenades and put a signal right on top of them. We'll see how well they hold up to high explosives!

Title: The Road of Pain
Objective: Save 6 injured Zandalari Soldiers.
Text: My people continue to be captured and hauled into de blood trolls' village for de slaughter, to be used as fuel for their dark rituals.Just ahead, I can see some of de captives who fell along de path. I hear their cries as de blood trolls perform their vile rituals upon dem.We cannot leave my people to die in de swamp!Take dese bandages and save any Zandalari you encounter down dere.

Title: Undying Totems
Objective: Destroy 3 Reanimating Totems.
Text: De blood trolls are putting up quite de fight. Dey are raising de very dead to go against us!Their necromancers are raising de dead with de help of totems fueled with blood magic. Destroying dem should take de pressure off our troops.

Title: Rally the Warriors
Objective: Ring the Ancient Gong.
Text: We have learned so much and came so far thanks to you and de Horde, but all of it will amount to nothing if de blood trolls defeat us here.We've all worked hard since we first set foot within dis accursed swamp, without a chance to even get any sleep or have a decent meal. Dey are some of de finest soldiers I've ever encountered, but even dey have their limits.Let us remind dem what we are fighting for!

Title: A Reason to Stay
Objective: Search the Goldfield Farmstead for additional keepsakes.

Title: Fighting With Fire
Objective: Test the Liquid Fire flasks on 3 Briarwood Bulwarks.
Text: Excellent! Now that we have these lovely Liquid Fire flasks prepared we have one last thing to do:Test them out!There are some of those large abominations lurking about in the woods above my home. I think they would make excellent test subjects for our little alchemical experiment, wouldn't you say?

Title: Can't Hear A Thing
Objective: Kill Anthemusa.
Text: These snake wenches show up and everyone loses their minds! All my men are head over heels for these things. Personally, I don't see it. I mean, I sort of get the appeal, but the wings for arms and snake tails are a big turn off.There's a big one in a cave to the east. She's got a whole heap of suitors. I need them back to work. Go give her a wallop and get everyone back here.

Title: Detective Mildenhall
Objective: Search the Mildenhall Meadery for clues.
Text: Hmm... okay, okay, let's think.If you were my dad and you accidentally set loose a bunch of honey monsters all over the place, what would you do?Well, okay, you would probably beat all of them up. But he probably ran away.If he left in a hurry, maybe he left something for us to find.

Title: For the Light!
Objective: Return to Stormwind and speak with Aysa Cloudsinger to hear the end of his tale.
Text: The Lightforged Draenei will be happy to join the Alliance.Our cause is now yours.Let us return to Stormwind. Captain Fareeya will speak with our people.

Title: Goldfield's War
Objective: Defeat the quilboar invaders.
Text: I'm not leaving. I'm never leaving. Those quilboar, they killed them. I gave her the watch, told her to hurry. Grab our boy and get to the house while I got the gun...  I won't leave. Our family has our roots here. They would want me to stay, don't you understand? This is our farm. My boy, he wanted to join the militia. I made him a sword...  Now you know. Help me retake my farm. Grab a gun and let's kill every last one.

Title: Don't Go in the Basement
Objective: Enter the basement.
Text: We checked everywhere... well,  everywhere except the basement.B-b-but, dad told me never to go down there.He said it's dark, scary, and dangerous to go alone... I could be eaten by a brue!I don't even know what that is, but I don't wanna be eaten!, do you think you could go down first?

Title: The Witch's Pet
Objective: Kill the Mossfang Matriarch.
Text: I've seen her! The witch!Every once in a while she comes down to the cave, checking on her pet. I've never seen a spider so large!She spreads her spell, cursing all of the animals in these woods to follow her command and attack us.The broodmother laid all these eggs, and they're hatching into more possessed beasts!Take her out, and perhaps the infestation will stop.

Title: The Speaker's Call
Objective: Meet Magni Bronzebeard at the Wound in Silithus.
Text: I been travelin' the land, seekin' out anyone who might know how ta heal Azeroth. I've consulted ancient sages, druids, shamans... from dragons ta titan keepers. Nobody's seen anythin' like this before.Went ta Karazhan ta speak with Khadgar. Studyin' those old tomes o' his, we came up with an idea. No tellin' if it's gonna work, but we gotta try.Come ta Silithus. Meet me at the wound. Time is runnin' out fer Azeroth.

Title: No Spies Allowed
Objective: Kill 10 SI:7 Operatives in Silithus.
Text: Hey , I'm glad you're here.I'm in way over my head! Killer bugs, a strange substance... that GIANT sword sticking outta the ground... I don't have a good feelin' about this place!To make matters worse, I've been gettin' reports of Alliance spies snoopin' around the camp!Look kid, the Dark Lady has plans for this mysterious ore and I ain't going to be the one to dissapoint her, know what I mean?Get over to the mining camp and take out those SI:7 spies before they ruin the whole operation!

Title: The Power in Our Hands
Objective: Go to the Sword in Silithus and draw its power into your artifact.
Text: That sword of Sargeras is surgin' with dark energies. They're seepin' into Azeroth's heart like poison.The blade's power must be snuffed out.The Pillars o' Creation could do it, but they're keepin' the tomb sealed. So we need other vessels capable o' harnessin' vast energies.Vessels like those artifact weapons you and the other champions wield.It's a risk. We don't know what Sargeras' power will do ta those weapons. But unless we act now, the heart of Azeroth is sure ta die.

Title: The Seething Shore
Objective: Complete the Seething Shore battleground.
Text: We've received reports of an island off the coast of Silithus that is ripe with Azerite deposits.It is vital that we secure the island before the Alliance learns of its existence.Nathanos Blightcaller is personally leading the expedition force and has requested that you report for duty. Go with honor!

Title: The Speaker's Perspective
Objective: Deliver Khadgar's letter to Magni Bronzebeard in Silithus.
Text: Sargeras has left a scar upon our world. A scar that will not soon heal...It appears that the scars between the Alliance and Horde have yet to heal as well.Too many lives have already been lost fighting to save Azeroth from destruction. I will not stay and watch this world lose more.I have a request for you before I go. Take this letter to Magni Bronzebeard. He is in Silithus seeking a way to heal the wound.The letter contains information that may prove valuable to him.

Title: Lazy Prospectors!
Objective: Motivate 10 Lazy Prospectors.
Text: I've been around long enough to know you can never trust a goblin with an orc's work.Gallywix and his cartel may be serving the warchief, but we need to keep a close eye on them if we're going to get anything done!I've already noticed many of the workers loafing about and sleeping on the job. The Horde does not tolerate laziness!Get out there and put those lazy prospectors in their place!

Title: The Seething Shore
Objective: Complete the Seething Shore battleground.
Text: We've received reports of an island off the coast of Silithus that is ripe with Azerite deposits.It is vital that we secure the island before the Horde learns of its existence.Master Mathias Shaw is personally leading the expedition force and has requested that you report for duty. Good luck!

Title: The Speaker's Perspective
Objective: Deliver Khadgar's letter to Magni Bronzebeard in Silithus.
Text: Sargeras has left a scar upon our world. A scar that will not soon heal...It appears that the scars between the Alliance and Horde have yet to heal as well.Too many lives have already been lost fighting to save Azeroth from destruction. I will not stay and watch this world lose more.I have a request for you before I go. Take this letter to Magni Bronzebeard. He is in Silithus seeking a way to heal the wound.The letter contains information that may prove valuable to him.

Title: Archaeological Efficiency
Objective: Use the Elemental Summoning Stone to expose Xibalan fossils. Bring 50 Xibalan Fossil Fragments to Acadia Chistlestone.
Text: Suppose I owe the lass her bones if I'm tae be monopolizin' yer time. And I will be.Go on out into the ruins an' use this here stone to call one of my rumbly elemental friends. They'll blast away any dirt 'tween you an' the fossils.We could go about this the ol' fashion way, but do you really want to spend all day digging? Course ye don't.Acadia will see that a little efficiency gets everyone what they want.

Title: A Pocketful of Shells
Objective: Collect 20 Salvaged Azerite Ammunition.
Text: You see the problem? No you don't. Problem isn't all these dang quilboar. Quilboar I can shoot all day. Been shootin' em all my life, since my pappy gave me my first gun. Problem is these pigs are tough. Tougher'n they've been before. Can't kill em like I used to, see? My new modified bullets just get stuck in them and they refuse to die! Here, take my knife. Go out there and kill some of the quilboar and get my ammo back. Then I can shoot the rest! I won't stop 'till there's none left to shoot!

Title: Free Samples
Objective: Collect 8 Mysterious Ore samples.
Text: The crown has ordered SI:7 to infiltrate the goblin mining operation and collect any information we can find on this mysterious new substance.My agents have infiltrated the camp, but the clock is ticking and we need to get our hands on some extracted ore samples fast.In other words, I need someone who can take the direct approach. Someone who can handle a fight against overwhelming odds and come out alive.Take the ore samples to Khargus Stonemantle for analysis when you return.

Title: It's a Sabotage
Objective: Plant 10 dynamite bundles.
Text: The Horde has wasted no time in shamelessly extracting this mysterious ore from the great wound.Luckily for us, goblin engineering is not nearly as sophisticated as what we create in Gnomeregan! All it takes is a little bit of old fashioned dynamite to completely disable a goblin shredder.What unsophisticated machinery!Take these dynamite bundles and plant them on the inactive shredders around the mining camp.It'll take those greedy goblins weeks to get back up and running again!

Title: Archaeological Efficiency
Objective: Collect 50 Xibalan fossil fragments.
Text: Miss Tae'shara and I share a passion for uncovering hidden secrets and a deep, abiding respect for this ancient land.That said! If we were to continue at the pace to which she is accustomed, the Alliance would overtake us before we could make a single discovery.It is time to expedite our survey.The ruins hide many fossils. Take a beacon and use it to summon one of my sweepers. It will clear away the topsoil and allow you to collect samples.Gather what you can- we can assemble them later.

Title: The First Watch
Objective: Defeat Sister Adela at Watchman's Rise.
Text: As you can see, the coven has conscripted my own guardsmen into their service. Though I am loath to battle my own, these men are too corrupted by the coven's magic to be saved.For them, death is the only mercy we can give.The Inquisitors and I can handle the regiment stationed outside. We will need you to find and take out their leader.Your Inquisitors await your command. Are you ready to take the tower?

Title: A Weapon of Old
Objective: Help Master Ashton create the Liquid Fire potion.
Text: I've been studying the parchment Lady Lucielle sent with you and have translated some of the older language.They called it "Liquid Fire" and it was used to "burn away the Drust". Using this as a basis I believe we can adapt it to our needs. This is a complex recipe but it just so happens I have everything we need to make this potent alchemical weapon!I will need your assistance in creating this. Would you be so kind as to help?

Title: Save Our Shipmates
Objective: Find Henry Hardwick in Fogcliff Strand.
Text: Oh, thank the stars! Our ship ran aground and our men are in desperate need of help.Find Henry Hardwick down the hill at the shipwreck. He stayed behind to try and help the others.

Title: A Very Precious Cargo
Objective: Find the "Precious" cargo in Fogcliff Strand.
Text: We weren't the only ship in our convoy to get caught up in this mess. Our flagship ran aground to the east. It was holding a very precious cargo and I need you to bring it back here.

Title: Hold My Hand
Objective: Escort Penny back to her father.
Text: Take me to my daddy this instant!Waaaait! You have to hold my hand...

Title: Breaking Hag
Objective: Kill 15 Briarwood Creatures and Witches.
Text: The town is overrun!The guards have fallen back and what is worse, some of the villagers have been twisted by the witches' magic. They are little more than wretched beasts blindly following orders.We must release these poor souls and slay the monsters that twisted them!See what you can do to cut down the numbers of monsters in town!

Title: Fabricated Fabrications
Objective: Recover 8 Warship Blueprints.
Text: There was somethin' off with the ship we were building in the yard. I never saw the blueprints, but I've built enough ships in my day to know it wasn't business as usual.They've kept all the pages under tight guard in the Brineworks up the road lately. Full on militia.If you can get your hands on enough of them pages, we oughta be able to figure out what Lord Stormsong and his boys are schemin'.

Title: Voices Below
Objective: Help Brother Pike investigate his omen.
