Text: The others forged ahead to Port Fogtide. I doubt they will receive a warm welcome.We are to meet them there. However, there is something I must do first.Despite Reid's retreat I still feel a terrible darkness nearby; I wish to listen to the tides for answers. I would appreciate your joining me in case more danger strays into our path.

Title: Featherfeet's Fun Falling's Fun Fee!
Objective: Pay 100 gold to Quinsy Featherfeet and he'll cast Slow Fall on you whenever you're nearby.
Text: Welcome to Zuldazar, my fine $pr friend!I've explored every inch of this wonderful city with my own two feet. And let me tell you, they're tired!That's why I've decided to provide a service to my powerful friends in the Horde: Featherfeet's Fun Falling!Now, I know what you're thinking. You nomrally associate falling with screams, pain, and an untimely death.BUT NOT WITH FEATHERFEET!For a small one-time fee, I'll make sure you always float down this ziggurat shrouded in safety and fun.

Title: Witness to the Wound
Objective: Speak with Grol Warblade in Silithus.
Text: The Bilgewater Cartel have already begun mining operations in Silithus to extract this mysterious substance.The Warchief has insisted that you personally oversee the extraction efforts in Silithus and prevent the Alliance from interfering.Gallywix seemed less than pleased with your appointment, but nobody refuses Sylvanas...You must go to Silithus at once. The base commander is awaiting your arrival.

Title: Storm's Judgment
Objective: Confront Wavespeaker Reid.
Text: When I opened my mind to the currents during the ritual, I felt the presence of a member of Lord Stormsong's innermost circle.Wavespeaker Reid. If anyone can locate the missing fleet, it is him.I will not stand by while my brothers move against our own people. Oaths be damned.We must force Reid to see reason.

Title: Rearmament
Objective: Collect 12 Stormfused Weapons.
Text: The people of this valley have true hearts. They're eager to take back control of their home.We have to help them.The Brineworks up the road from here supplies most of House Stormsong's weapons. Our movement here could make great use of them.If you can collect enough to go around, I'll go over some basic training with our friends here.

Title: Return to Gloom Hollow
Objective: Meet Titan Keeper Hezrel outside of Atul'nazman to return to Gloom Hollow.
Text: Old God G'huun behind destruction of this seal. Commanding blood trolls to destroy final one within Zuldazar.Titan Keeper Hezrel must aid in destruction of blood trolls. Cannot allow Zuldazar seal to be destroyed and G'huun to be freed.Must leave interior of Atul'nazman. Meet Titan Keeper Hezrel outside of temple, will help return to Gloom Hollow.When task is complete, Titan Keeper Herzrel must establish contact with other keeper within G'huun containment chamber.

Title: Witness to the Wound
Objective: Meet with the SI:7 commander in Silithus.
Text: I've already sent operatives to Silithus to establish a base camp.Their orders are to monitor the operations of the Horde and gather any information they can find on this mysterious substance.One of my SI:7 commanders is currently awaiting your arrival. Go with speed.

Title: Summons to Orgrimmar
Objective: Speak with Nathanos Blightcaller.
Text: The Warchief has requested that you return to Orgrimmar as soon as possible. There is an urgent matter that requires your attention.I will fill you in on the details as soon as you arrive.You will find me near the entrance of Grommash Hold. The Dark Lady has plans for you. I would not keep her waiting...

Title: Containment Procedure
Objective: Observe Titan Keeper Hezrel scan for a solution to Nazmir's old god corruption.
Text: Scans indicate structure has become inoperable. No possibility for repair.Titan Keeper Hezrel's database fully restored. Believe solution may be within data.Require time to scan data, find solution to contain Old God corruption.Stand by while Titan Keeper Hezrel scans databanks for solution.

Title: Rest in the Depths
Objective: Complete the Ritual of Release.
Text: This passage flows through the Shrine of the Storm out into the open sea. We will release the souls of the fallen here.Legends say that as our spirits pass through the Shrine, they aid in the great blessing rituals that all Kul Tiran ships undergo.In that way, we Stormsong never stop serving our people.

Title: Thalyssra's Estate
Objective: Meet with Lady Liadrin at the Estate of the First Arcanist in Suramar.
Text: Would you like to hear how the nightborne came to join the Horde?We earned their trust when we aided them in liberating Suramar from the tyranny of Grand Magistrix Elisande and the Burning Legion.Lor'themar Theron later asked them to join him in Quel'Thalas. Lady Liadrin made the journey to extend the invitation to First Arcanist Thalyssra...

Title: Sic 'Em!
Objective: Defeat Foreman Razorgnarl.
Text: Humphrey's a good tracker, to be sure. He's also the orneriest, angriest, most dogged dog if he sets his eyes on a quilboar. This will certainly be useful. Below our very noses, the foreman organizes and directs the tunnelers to cause the most mayhem and destruction. If you can put an end to him, it should make things a lot easier for us to move around the farmlands. Humphrey looks a bit hungry, wouldn't you say? Why don't you bring him with you to take care of business?

Title: Gifts of the Fallen
Objective: Speak with Mathias Shaw.
Text: Earlier today, King Wrynn addressed the citizens of Stormwind at Lion's Rest in a speech given to formally announce the end of the war.After the crowd departed, I met privately with the King and his advisors to discuss a mysterious substance that has been found in Silithus.This glowing ore appears to be most powerful and the Horde has wasted no time in extracting it from the great wound.The king has ordered me to fill you in on the details, in preparation for an important mission.

Title: Awaken a God
Objective: Gather chunks of naga flesh as an offering to Gral.
Text: You see the sinking ruins to the east? They were, not long ago, a temple to the shark loa, Gral.The naga tore down his temple and are stealing his secrets. If it is for something good, I'll be a rock's uncle.It would be wise to let Gral know what's going on here. I do not think he would approve.Gral was quite powerful, and when it came to his knowledge of the sea, none could compare. It never hurts to have a fellow like that on your side.Some fresh, bloody naga meat may just lure him out.

Title: The Warpack
Objective: Ride with Gonk to the Temple of the Prophet.
Text: Zul began a coup, but he did not secure de pyramid for himself. Nor has he done anything to rally more to his banner outside of those who were already conspiring with him.Dis concerns me more than if he had carved his face into Dazar'alor itself.We must learn what he is up to. Join de disciples of Gonk and ride ahead to de Temple of the Prophet. Look to Wardruid Loti for further orders when you arrive.

Title: The Essence of G'huun
Objective: Have Titan Keeper Hezrel apply Synthetic Essence to allow safe passage past undead.
Text: Analysis of blood-infused bones complete. Will be able to create synthetic essence similar to G'huun.Will take a moment to apply essence, allow you to walk past undead without combat.Must hurry. More forces of G'huun are around temple. Must get inside to reactivate containment protocols.

Title: Protocol Recovery
Objective: Retrieve Containment Protocol from Overlord Kraxis.
Text: System repairs progressing. One key component needed: containment protocol.Containment protocol will fully reboot defensive systems. Allow Titan Keeper Hezrel to properly maintain containment.Scans indicate large creature within temple has absorbed slab containing containment protocol. Creature exists between this plane and Void.Request: destruction of creature and retrieval of protocol.

Title: Void is Prohibited
Objective: Seal 4 Void Portals.
Text: Scans indicate errors in reality surrounding nearby structure. Portals directly to the Void.Current theory, corruption has Old God as source. Void attracted to Old God corruption.Portals must be sealed to contain entities lured here by Old God corruption.Take this device. Titan Keeper Hezrel has forged it thanks to help in powering up systems.Use device to seal Void portals, prevent more void entities from entering area.

Title: Blood Purification
Objective: Destroy 4 Corrupted Energy.

Title: Unwelcome Undead
Objective: Kill 15 Nazwathan undead.
Text: Corruption reanimating dead creatures nearby. Morphing into monstrosities. Must be stopped.Cannot kill all, but can reduce numbers. Reduced numbers equates to less corruption outside of containment.Destroy undead in surrounding area. Keeper Hezrel's systems will continue rebooting while you do so.Reboot goal: recover data regarding nature of corruption.

Title: Lines In the Sand
Objective: Seek out Veriss at the Terrace of the Devoted in Vol'dun to begin your blood trials there.
Text: This was all I had to offer you, young scribe. But your journey is not yet at an end. If you're up for some traveling, and interested in some of the deadlier blood contracts, you're going to have to travel to Zandalar. Once there, seek out a sethrak by the name of Veriss in an area known as Vol'dun.  Pickled crocolisk eggs are my favorite. Would you like some?

Title: Drawing Blood
Objective: Sign the Bloodbound Ledger.
Text: Hey! I have something exciting to tell you about, but I need you to keep it secret. Just between us scribes.  Dis is de Bloodbound Ledger. Signing your name in it let's you learn how to craft "blood contracts" which are rather dangerous, but worth de risk. I only know one of dem and it is quite de rush when I use it because it... well, you'll see. So what do you say? Interested?

Title: Bone Procession
Objective: Weaken Reanimated Monstrosities with the Titan Manipulator and collect 15 of their bones.
Text: Undead entities influenced by corruption surround nearby structure. Impossible to approach. Plan required.Calculating.Plan achieved. Large creatures designated reanimated monstrosities focal gathering point of corruption.Take titan weapon forged from plating recovered. Use it to weaken monstrosities and collect bones.Will run process to destroy bones, prevent creation of further monstrosities.

Title: Sandscar Breach
Objective: Meet Bladeguard Sonji at Sandscar Breach.
Text: I heard some mutterings about sand and snakes. The plea comes from a tiny village on the very fringes of Zuldazar- hardly more than a few farms. Dol-something I think it was called. Don't know what they be calling it now. Go see what the fuss is about. Bladeguard Sonji was sent ahead some time ago. She should be able to get you up to speed on that... situation.

Title: Turn to Drust
Objective: Seek out Kronah at the Smuggler's Cove in Drustvar.
Text: Dere are blood scribe masters all over de place who'll teach you what you need to know. De first master I'd recommend seeking out is Kronah. She's a bit... eccentric to say de least. One of de few tortollan who've experienced a thing or two. She's de one who taught me de blood contract I know how to invoke! She prefers to hang out at de Smuggler's Cove on de western coast of Drustvar.

Title: So Long, Sister
Objective: Slay Sister Noella Briarwood.
Text: We have given the defenders some breathing room, but these creatures continue to lay siege to the barricade!The witch behind the attack fled from the field when we defeated her forces. I saw her go into the mansion on the hill. I will help keep the defenses going here.You must go into the mansion and slay the witch!

Title: For the Horde
Objective: Meet Ambassador Blackguard at the Orgrimmar Embassy.
Text: After ages standing alone, we are once again poised to become part of something greater. Our alliance with the Horde affords us a fresh start, a unique chance that must not be squandered.The warchief's ambassador awaits you in Orgrimmar. From there, you will set out on a journey across Azeroth. Fight to defend this land, and claim a place for the shal'dorei within it.Show the world who we are. Bring honor to the Horde, for in so doing, you will bring honor to Suramar.

Title: Corrupted Earth
Objective: Destroy 12 Blood-Infused Lashers.
Text: Unacceptable levels of corruption detected nearby. Scan indicates vegetation affected by corruption.All corruption must be eradicated. Request: destroy any vegetation affected by corruption.

Title: Slumber No More
Objective: Examine the deactivated titan keeper outside of Gloom Hollow.
Text: There's something you should look into. You've got the time anyway, those goblins aren't ready yet.There's a statue nearby. Only, it's not a statue to the trained tortollan eye. It's a deactivated titan keeper!Noises have been coming from that thing ever since you helped Krag'wa. It must be trying to reactivate itself.I bet that titan-looking amulet of yours could help restart it. We'd be unstoppable against the blood trolls with a titan keeper's help.Go see if you can restart this titan!

Title: Recovering Remnants
Objective: Recover 25 Titan Plating from Nazwathan Spectres.
Text: Scan of area indicates roaming spirits clad in armor plating. Purpose: defense of structure, animated by corruption.Detecting remnants of titan plating within spirits' armor. Request: recover remnants.Titan Keeper Hezrel capable of breaking down titan plating to reforge into weapon against forces drawn by corruption.

Title: How to Repair a Titan Keeper
Objective: Recover Titan Data Cores from fallen titan keepers.
Text: Major system repair possible within nearby structure. Preliminary goal: repair auxiliary systems.Scans detect three fallen titan keepers. Recover cores. Titan Keeper Hezrel able to retrieve data from cores.Titan Keeper Hezrel goal: reboot auxiliary systems, reach nearby structure, restore all primary systems, seal corruption.Result: corruption contained. Titan Keeper Hezrel able to aid against blood trolls.Blood troll definition not found in databanks.

Title: Not Fit for This Plane
Objective: Eliminate 6 Faceless Ones.
Text: System restoration in progress. Data recovered. Source of corruption is from an Old God entity.Multiple entities detected nearby, blocking goal of analyzing and containing corruption in Nazmir.Entities appear to be from the Void. Drawn here from Old God corruption.Request to destroy Void entities. Void presence inhibiting repair of systems.

Title: Heritage of the Void
Objective: Meet Alleria Windrunner at Telogrus Rift.
Text: Throughout your journeys across Azeroth, you have achieved mastery over the forces that constantly seek to control you.You have become a formidable weapon of the Alliance. Return to the void rift so that we may honor your accomplishment.

Title: Gorilla Warfare
Objective: Rescue 6 Pacifist Gorillas.
Text: Your timing is most fortuitous, stranger. I thank you for your assistance.Things are not peaceful in Gorilla Gorge. The kaja'mite has given us great intelligence and wit. With intelligence has come war.My brethren are those who do not wish to fight. Neither the Zandalari trolls nor each other. But for our passivity we have been persecuted.Please free my comrades. They will be in cages all throughout the gorge and under guard. Make haste!

Title: Kaja'mite Ore Bust
Objective: Scan Kaja'mite Steam Vents in Gorilla Gorge.
Text: Kaja'mite! Just saying the name gives my big beautiful ears a buzz.These Zandalari were sitting on a huge deposit of it all these years. And they abandoned it just because of a few talking gorillas. By goblin law it's ours for the taking!Let's see how concentrated a deposit we're talking about. Get a good peek at those vents that are steaming out kaja'mite vapors.Go into the gorge and plant my scanners on those steam vents. They'll do the rest.

Title: King Da'ka
Objective: Slay King Da'ka.
Text: These Zandalari won't go near Gorilla Gorge. All because they're afraid!It's just a few talking gorillas. And one 'big mon' in particular as the Zandalari call him.All we need to do is take out King Da'ka and the villagers will probably throw us a parade! Or at least let us mine that kaja'mite.Think you can handle one big gorilla, chum?

Title: The Road to Corlain
Objective: Meet with Marshal Reade at Watchman's Rise in Drustvar.
Text: Lord and Lady Waycrest lay trapped in Waycrest Manor. Before we can reach them, however, we must brave through the city of Corlain... which is firmly in the grasp of the Heartsbane.Our first course of action should be to set up a forward outpost. Our scouts have found that the tower at Watchman's Rise is only lightly guarded. I recommend we take the tower from them.This is now your command, Inquisitor. Say the word, and we ride.

Title: The Call for Allies
Objective: Meet Ji Firepaw at the Orgrimmar Embassy.
Text: Greetings, champion! I have been appointed as the Horde's diplomatic ambassador to our allies far and wide.It is my duty to seek out those of like mind and spirit, and speak to them about joining the Horde.As a renowned hero of the Horde yourself, your aid would be most appreciated! Come see me at the embassy in Orgrimmar when you are able.

Title: The Call for Allies
Objective: Meet Aysa Cloudsinger at the Stormwind Embassy.
Text: The Alliance has been beset by dangers growing throughout all of Azeroth.The only way we will keep our friends safe is if we seek out new allies.I have been tasked as an ambassador to help seek these allies. Come to our embassy in Stormwind, I could use your help.

Title: Kaja'mite? Kaja'must!
Objective: Travel to Village in the Vines.
Text: I been waitin' to talk to the King for a while now, but he not be seein' me! And this pompous lackey not be listenin' either.We got a problem brewin' in the Village of the Vines, just outside de city. With all the Horde landin' in the Harbor, some goblins got wind of our old kaja'mite quarry. They split outta here like the teeth of Deathwing himself behind 'em.But that quarry be dangerous. Wicked dangerous. Think you can go to de village an' talk some sense into them goblins?

Title: To Gloom Hollow
Objective: Recruit tortollans to your cause on the way to Gloom Hollow.
Text: There's only one safe area in Nazmir that this Rokhan and your other Horde friends could be in. Gloom Hollow.Lucky for you, it's also close to Krag'wa's den. We used Gloom Hollow as a last stop on our pilgrimage.Make your way to Gloom Hollow along the path I've marked on your map, and tell any tortollans along the way to meet us there.They'll be interested in seeing the end of this story. We'll make our way there and grab anyone else we find.

Title: Clear Victory
Objective: Slay 15 Drust Skeletons.
Text: What are you doing standing around? We've ground them down to their final warriors and those damnable runic constructs, but the war isn't over yet!Colonel Waycrest needs us to hold this line! Kill as many of those Drust as you can and we might see the end of this war, today. Get back out there!

Title: Making Mysteries
Objective: Catch 5 Unassuming Chickens.
Text: Do you know what people love? The unexplained! Problem is, everything here is explainable.So I have a plan to create our own phe-gnome-enon. There are stories that talk about some weird chicken-snake hybrids that can turn you to stone. I've already released the chickens, now we just need the snakes.The first problem can be solved easily. Just chase down the chickens, and stick one of these robotic tails on them.

Title: Atal'Dazar: Yazma the Fallen Priestess
Objective: Defeat Yazma in Atal'Dazar.
Text: Zul knows dat we cannot let de first king rise from his grave. Dazar would be more than a figure head for Zul's dream troll empire, he would be a force dat could rival de very loa.But I cannot just let Zul get away. I and mine will follow Zul, but I want you and yours to enter Atal'Dazar. Yazma is trying to buy time and keep de tombs sealed away. You will need to fight your way through to her and you will need some allies to do so. Slay her.

Title: Back to Brennadam
Objective: Report back to Squire Augustus III at Brennadam.
Text: The naga are mostly cleared out thanks to your help. They'll think twice before attacking again.Can you return to Brennadam and tell Squire Augustus III to return to his normal station?

Title: Forced Labor
Objective: Free Samuel Williams.
Text: H... help... us...Please...

Title: Plot Twist
Objective: Slay Vol'jamba.
Text: It is time to end Vol'jamba.I want to make one thing clear. He can still kill you. Your fate, moreso than mine, hangs on your ability to fight dis former student of mine.He will bring masks, and voodoo, and he will do everything within his power to end you. All we have done is taken away his ability to cheat.Good luck. For your sake, I hope you do not fail.

Title: Drustfall
Objective: Investigate the ice cavern.
Text: I believe I see more carvings at the entrance to that cave over there. Come, we should see what else was left behind.

Title: The Final Verse
Objective: Seek out Miju in southern Zuldazar to begin your final trial.
Text: It appears you are finished here. Thank you again for getting my book back. But between you and I, this was the easy part. Just wait till you meet the grandmaster. If you haven't noticed already, you'll need a special quill to invoke those contracts. And he'll be the one who shows you how to craft it. His name is Miju and he lives out on an island off the southern coast of Zuldazar. Good luck!

Title: To Falconhurst!
Objective: Meet Inquisitor Cleardawn outside of Falconhurst.
Text: Our time here was well spent. The guards in Arom's Stand can handle what few Drust forces remain and I suspect the Drust leader and his magic might have some greater part to play here.However we must continue on the mission to Falconhurst. The path on the far side of these ruins will take us there.I will ride ahead and meet you outside of town!

Title: Follow Your Nose
Objective: Use Humphrey to find and slay 5 Panicked Tunnelers.
Text: You there! I could use your help! The ground isn't safe. The quilboar have established a network of tunnels below us, allowing them to spring up to ambush people who aren't walking carefully. Luckily for us, Humphrey here has a nose for the Briarback, and can sniff 'em out even when they're underground. Root a few of them out and let's make the farms a little safer to walk through. There's a particularly large clump of them in the northeastern fields. Good hunting!

Title: Penning In Protection
Objective: Collect bones from Zem'lan pirates and mill them into a fine powder. Mix the powder with your blood to create a Vial of Ossien Ink. Then sign the Bloodguard Chronicles.
Text: "The creature within, a guardian of men, A mixture of blood and of bone inked with pen. The blood from the scribe, the bone from the land, Milled to perfection, and signed by the hand."

Title: A Test of Quills
Objective: Speak with Miju to begin your final trial and collect the knowledge to craft your quill.
Text: The recipe you're after, young one, is that of the Sanguine Feather Quill of Lana'thel. I...  Am the only other person I know of who has one... err... somewhere. But be warned, this trial may be your undoing! I shall have to invoke all four contracts against you. You must defeat each of the creatures, and from each one learn the rune needed to carve into your quill. Once you've learned all four runes, your trial shall be completed.

Title: Brush With Death
Objective: Pick up the quill and begin your trial.
Text: "A fatal bargain, in blood is struck, One inks their pledge, with strokes of luck. Stay true your lines, keep still your breath, Lest you stray too far, and summon death."

Title: Hope's Blue Light
Objective: Fly with Captain Grez'ko to light the signal fire on the tower.
Text: There is but one step left!De second tower means the fleet is ours again!Climb aboard and we will finish dis thing!

Title: Temple of Sethraliss: Booking on a Favor
Objective: Recover the Tome of Oblivion from the Temple of Sethraliss.
Text: When the Faithless came to power, we Devoted fled our sacred temple and took shelter here. However, in the midst of our exodus, many of us were forced to abandon some of our belongings. I myself left a tome that is used to learn the Oblivion contract. If you wish to proceed with the trials, you must retrieve that book for me. I trust you won't disappoint me.

Title: Size Matters
Objective: Administer the 'voodoo'-ed Aggression Formula to Ben'jin.
Text: So the unintended side-effect of Gentle Ben'jin being, shall we say 'fun-sized' is that he is now small enough to get into the cave where the alpha wind serpent is! The beast is called Gloomtail and if Ben'jin defeats it, he will feel like this territory is his and will want to fill it with little brutosaurs. So he will seek out a mate. If Maka'fon is receptive, everyone wins! Go give him another hit of the formula!

Title: To Pandaria!
Objective: Report to Rell Nightwind in Stormwind.
Text: Please come to Stormwind Keep immediately for a briefing with King Varian Wrynn. We have received word of a conflict in the seas to the south, and we need the help of an experienced  to assist in the investigation.

Title: Sacrificial Writes
Objective: Ask Kronah about the Writ of Sacrifice. Follow her directions after she gives you the information you need.
Text: "For blood to bond, one strikes a deal, A sacrifce which will appeal. Seek out the lame, and never yield, For in return, you shall be healed."

Title: Against the Tide
Objective: Kill Warlord Xiar, and light the signal fire.
Text: De mogu are growin' desperate. Ha! Maybe dey hope to get away from here before de fury of de loa rain down on dem!De warlord's pet sorcerer set up blockers and dey have taken de tower.If you can avoid the sting, de lightning rods can have ya feelin' pretty good. One could even say energized.Get to Warlord Xiar and relieve him of his life privileges.Then let our people know we have taken back de Breath of Pa'ku!Dis mojo is empowered to ignite de tower with a mighty blast.

Title: A Desperate Defense
Objective: Report to Lieutenant Tarenfold.
Text: The soldiers garrisoned here are doing their best to hold out, but they're struggling. Pirates haven't dared attack this gate in years, and never with such a large force.If you're handy in a fight, Lieutenant Tarenfold will want to meet you.He's organizing the militia up ahead.

Title: Cataclysm First Responder
Objective: Report to Naraat the Earthspeaker in Stormwind.
Text: Deathwing, the draconic aspect of death, has sent his minions out to scour Azeroth of life. Naraat the Earthspeaker can tell you more about Mount Hyjal, Vashj'ir, and other areas that Deathwing has targeted.

Title: Lines In the Sand
Objective: Seek out Veriss at the Terrace of the Devoted in Vol'dun to begin your blood trials there.
Text: This was all I had to offer you, young scribe. But your journey is not yet at an end. If you're up for some traveling, and interested in some of the deadlier blood contracts, you're going to have to travel to Zandalar. Once there, seek out a sethrak by the name of Veriss in an area known as Vol'dun.  Pickled crocolisk eggs are my favorite. Would you like some?

Title: Adventure Calls
Objective: Use the Special Duty Assignments to select your next adventuring destination.
Text: Tales of your heroism have spread to the ends of Azeroth... and beyond. Your skills have been requested elsewhere.Will you travel through the Dark Portal, fighting the Burning Legion on the sundered world of Outland?Or will you fly north, joining the battle against the Lich King in Northrend?The choice is yours, adventurer.

Title: By the Book
Objective: Investigate the Bloodshed Compendium further to begin your trial.
Text: As you open the book, you stare at a blank page, waiting for something to happen. Instinctively you flip to the next page only to find it blank as well. Perhaps your trial awaits you further into the book?

Title: Wars on Two Fronts
Objective: Use the Special Duty Assignments to select your next adventuring destination.
Text: ! You have been called upon once again to assist the Alliance in matters of great import.Will you assist the Alliance's efforts against Deathwing and the Twilight Hammer?Or will you fly south to Pandaria, claiming its resources before the Horde does first?Make your choice and head into battle!

Title: To Northrend!
Objective: Take a ship to Northrend.
Text: The Lich King stirs in the north. An undead army follows his command, marching across Northrend and spreading blight wherever they tread. We need you to stop them.

Title: Disaster at Mount Hyjal
Objective: Speak to Cenarion Emissary Blackhoof to secure transportation to Moonglade.
Text: Our brothers in the Cenarion Circle report that Deathwing's minions have launched a destructive offensive against the world tree and threaten to burn it to the ground! You can speak with Cenarion Emissary Blackhoof to gain entry into Moonglade. He is in the tauren district in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.

Title: Cataclysm First Responder
Objective: Report to Farseer Krogar in Orgrimmar.
Text: Deathwing, the draconic aspect of death, has sent his minions out to scour Azeroth of life. Farseer Krogar in Orgrimmar can tell you more about Mount Hyjal, Vashj'ir, and other areas that Deathwing has targeted.

Title: Wars on Two Fronts
Objective: Use the Special Duty Assignments to select your next adventuring destination.
Text: ! You have been called upon once again to assist the Horde in matters of great import.Will you assist the Horde's efforts against Deathwing and the Twilight Hammer?Or will you fly south to Pandaria, claiming its resources before the Alliance does first?Make your choice and head into battle!

Title: Trouble at Fort Daelin
Objective: Report to Lieutenant Bauer at Seabreeze Village.
Text: I was sent to Brennadam by my commanding officer to find a tidesage to help us at Fort Daelin to the west. The naga have started another attack on the bastion, and it's larger than any we have seen.Lieutenant Bauer is in the middle of helping out civilians at the village near the fort, and she could use any help possible.

Title: To Northrend!
Objective: Take a zeppelin to Northrend.
Text: The Lich King stirs in the north. An undead army follows his command, marching across Northrend and spreading blight wherever they tread. We need you to stop them.

Title: An Illegible Scroll
Objective: Take the scroll to the tortollans along the Windswept Coast.

Title: From the Depths
Objective: Defend the levee from the Azshara's assault.
Text: We must prepare for an attack.Man the cannons!Defend the levee at all costs!

Title: To Pandaria!
Objective: Report to Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
Text: You are hereby ordered to present yourself at Grommash Hold immediately. We have received word of a new, resource-rich continent in the south, and we intend to send you and a small contingent of soldiers to claim it for the Horde.

Title: The Scent for a Brutosaur
Objective: Find 7 Fragrant Rushes to make incense for Irritable Maka'fon.
Text: Mood is everything for love, and Maka'fon is not in de mood. Voodoo incense, specially formulated for brutosaurs by an expert witch doctor like myself, will surely spark de fire of de mother spirit in her heart. Certain fragrant rushes work best, and de jungle will provide. Zandalari rushes grow near de waters here. Get a good amount for me and I will make an incense bundle big enough to set de mood.

Title: Adventure Calls
Objective: Use the Special Duty Assignments to select your next adventuring destination.
Text: Tales of your heroism have spread to the ends of Azeroth... and beyond. Your skills have been requested elsewhere.Will you travel through the Dark Portal, fighting the Burning Legion on the sundered world of Outland?Or will you fly north, joining the battle against the Lich King in Northrend?The choice is yours, adventurer.

Title: Delas in Dalaran
Objective: Find Delas Moonfang at the Antonidas Memorial in Dalaran.
Text: Delas Moonfang needs our help. In-turn, she will aid us to decrypt the Codex of Command. I implore you to seek her out as soon as possible. She is known to enjoy the memorial dedicated to the fallen, great leader of the Kirin Tor, Antonidas.

Title: Monstrous Matchmaker
Objective: Place Witch Doctor Jangalar's Voodoo Totem near both brutosaurs.
Text: We have a problem, a matter of love, and you've come just in time. Two white brutosaurs, de male Ben'jin and de female Maka'fon, are de last of their kind. De rest have passed on. Dese two are not in de mood for love. If you can help my new friend Cala and myself, dis may be de only chance to give dem a future. Place my voodoo totem close to each one so dat I can feel what dey feel and learn how we can help.

Title: A New Order
Objective: Give the Inquisitors Regalia to the recruits in Arom's Stand.
Text: Before we leave, I have one more task to ask of you.While you were busy recruiting our inquisitors and driving the coven away from Arom's Stand, I took the liberty of placing an order with the local tailor.Using some of the sketches within the tome, I had him put together some uniforms reminiscent of those worn by the ancient order.Since you will be leading our inquisitors, I think it's only fitting that you present them with their new regalia.

Title: Hidden Dealings
Objective: Explore the location marked on the Crude Map.

Title: Implements of Ill Intent
Objective: Destroy 12 Heartsbane objects in Arom's Stand.

Title: Aggressive Mating Strategy
Objective: Harvest 8 Bile Sacs from Invasive Razorwings.
Text: Aggression is good. I agree with Jangalar that Ben'jin needs to be a lot less passive to succeed and I can prove science is the way to do it by making an injection for him. Alchemy tells us that, for this type of beast, aggression comes from a substance in their bile sacs. The local razorwings are invasive and, as such, have more than enough aggression for our purposes. Harvest some of their bile sacs and I'll make a treatment that will have our big boy ready to go again in no time.

Title: Sharp Thinking
Objective: Use Lucille's Sewing Needle on 10 Corlain Refugees to reveal the hidden witches in Arom's Stand.
Text: I have reason to believe that the coven has already infiltrated Arom's Stand. There are many unfamiliar faces here, with the refugees from Corlain, and we know they can use their magic to appear like one of us.This needle is fashioned of solid silver. If the witches are indeed vulnerable to silver, then a prick from this may be enough to break their spell.The refugees may not be keen on being prodded, but they must understand that this is for the good of the town... and perhaps all of Drustvar.

Title: Changing of the Guard
Objective: Deliver recruitment orders to Captain Cleardawn, Ensign Yorrick, Ensign Mace, Lieutenant Sterntide, and Falconer Notley in Arom's Stand.
Text: I have no doubt that you're a quite capable , mainlander, but we will need some help if we want to make it to Waycrest Manor in one piece. A small group would be ideal; strong enough to face the coven's threats, but small enough to remain largely unnoticed.I have written new orders to some of my finest soldiers to join your Order of Embers. They will report to you and the lady Waycrest. Please deliver these to them, so they can be prepared to move out.

Title: The Rising Tide
Objective: Seek revenge on Sister Ava.
Text: This mainspring wasn't altered by an engineer. These runes on the surface can only have come from a tidesage.Their aquatic magic is unmistakable. I'd bet whoever did this is also responsible for Addington's death.Whoever they are, they're likely still nearby. Keep an eye out... they won't be hard to find.

Title: Bound and Oppressed
Objective: Destroy 8 Anchors of Binding.
Text: We had our orders: ships, and lots of 'em. I led my boys as best I could.Everything changed when the tidesages showed up. We figured they was just checkin' on our progress, but the hood-wearin' bastards turned on us!These anchors bind us here, forcin' us to work to death. No one deserves a fate like that. You gotta free my boys!

Title: Means to an End
Objective: Retrieve Brother Addington's Tidal Kris, Abyssal Beacon, and Wavecaller's Mantle.
Text: In our haste to journey here I did not think to bring my ritual implements we tidesages use to augment our power.To be honest, I had never expected them necessary on what should have been a peaceful sojourn.Addington does not have his, either. I am sure the militia took him from his home before he had the chance to react.That means his implements should still be in the yard somewhere. We must find them before my power is of much real use.

Title: Lost, Not Forgotten
Objective: Recover 12 souls using the Dead Ringer.
Text: I know not what madness has overtaken my people, but we must stop it together.Take this bell. It calls the souls of the recently deceased to it for later release. We Stormsong do not bury our dead in the earth. The tides claim all.If they will not answer to reason, then we must give them eternal peace. Fallen or not, they are Stormsong.

Title: The Pledge
Objective: Return to Stormwind and speak with Anduin.
Text: The ethereals were lying in wait, anticipating someone strong enough in the void to be corrupted by the influence of the Old Gods.We arrived in time to save them, and I will help teach them how to resist the whispers.Umbric is ready to join the Alliance. Let us return to Stormwind and inform King Wrynn.

Title: For the Alliance
Objective: Meet Ambassador Moorgard at the Stormwind Embassy.
Text: Mastering the whispers requires constant focus and discipline. Your dedication inspires all who bear the name ren'dorei--for we have become children of the Void.You have learned many lessons here, but the time has come to venture beyond Telogrus Rift.Go to Stormwind, the heart of the Alliance. There, the king's ambassador will greet you and guide you along your journey.Azeroth must be defended. I can think of no one better suited to answer that call than you.

Title: Destroy the Weapon
Objective: Investigate the weapon.
Text: I did scout de next island. Rezan's Claw has a mighty weapon on board.I don't know what it is, but dey are confident in its ability to break de defenses of our home.Get to de ship. Destroy that weapon before dey can use it on Zuldazar!

Title: The Ghostlands
Objective: Locate Umbric's home in the Ghostlands.
Text: Are you familiar with how the Void elves joined the Alliance?It began with Alleria Windrunner finding out about a blood elf named Umbric.He and his followers were banished from Silvermoon City for researching void magic.Alleria believed she could convince Umbric and his followers to join the Alliance and prevent the void from corrupting them.It all began when she opened up a portal to go into the Ghostlands...

Title: Heritage of Highmountain
Objective: Meet Mayla Highmountain in Thunder Totem.
Text: Your sojourn through Azeroth has been long. And through it all, you have brought honor to Highmountain.Now Thunder Totem calls you home. It is time we thank you for all that you have done for us.

Title: Heritage of the Lightforged
Objective: Meet Captain Fareeya aboard the Vindicaar.
Text: Your service to the Alliance has been most impressive. I could not have done better myself. Well, I could... but not by much.Come, meet with me at the Vindicaar. It is time that we reward your diligence.

Title: Heritage of the Nightborne
Objective: Meet First Arcanist Thalyssra at the Nighthold.
Text: You are among the first shal'dorei to venture forth and explore the wilds of Azeroth. But now it is time to come home.Return to Suramar so that we may thank you for helping our people reclaim a place in this world.

Title: Bad To The Bone
Objective: Slay 10 Bone Raptors.
Text: I will not leave here without killing Zulajin, or else it will just go after de next caravan dat comes through.I have a plan, but we must work together to pull it off.Dere are skeletal raptors roaming in de area. I do not know what voodoo brought dem here, but we need dem gone.We are going to need as much space as possible for my plan to kill Zulajin.

Title: Recovering Ancient Fire
Objective: Absorb fire mojo from 4 Nazmani statues.
Text: Zaluto has a crazy plan to kill Zulajin. Never thought a guard could come up with something so clever.Dere is ancient mojo throughout dis place... who knows what it used to be? But I sense something I can use.De statues sinking in de tar pits have de fire mojo still burning in dem. We will need it to kill Zulajin.Take my fetish and use it to be absorb what's left of de fire in dese statues.Just don't get dat fire too close to de tar!

Title: Catch Me if You Can
Objective: Ride Zulato's raptor to lure Zulajin into the tar pits and set it on fire.
Text: Alright, de time has come for you to face Zulajin yourself!Jin'Tiki's fetish has de power of some ancient fire in it now. You will ride my raptor here to lure Zulajin into de tar pits.After dat... you will use de fetish to light de tar pits on fire! Dat should be enough to kill Zulajin....and if not, well, den you will have to improvise. Good luck!

Title: Don't Go into the Light
Objective: Hold Zaluto down while Jin'Tiki cures him.
Text: Okay, dis is de moment of truth! We will see if my voodoo can cure Zaluto.I should have been honest with you... dere is a chance dis won't work. Voodoo isn't a science, you know.I need you to hold Zaluto down, because dis here is going to hurt. A lot.

Title: Key to the Brig
Objective: Get the key from Quartermaster Garza.
Text: You can tell a lot about a troll by what they do when they learn who Zul truly is.That Garza is a mutinous, foul-tusked, ship stealin' traitor. She is the kind of zealot dat will follow de heretic into the maw of an Old God.I am more de type to rip out her tusks and beat her with dem.I'd settle for ya taking her key and getting our wavemaster and crew free!

Title: For the Alliance
Objective: Meet Ambassador Moorgard at the Stormwind Embassy.
Text: The Army of the Light was founded with one purpose: to defeat the Legion. Though we have achieved that goal, a new duty lies before us.Azeroth is a world beset by enemies. Use your training to battle the darkness and uphold the ideals of the Alliance.Go to Stormwind. Seek the king's ambassador at the embassy, then set out to spread the Light's justice across the land.Pheta thones gamera.

Title: No Problem Tar Can't Solve
Objective: Collect 6 Sticky Tar.
Text: I'm not going to lie... I did wicked things in my youth and I've been living with de shame ever since.But Zaluto is going to die without my healing, and we're all going to die if dat dino isn't taken care of.Dere is a lot of tar in dis area. I need it to cure Zaluto of whatever is infecting him here.Get me dat tar, and I'll be able to save Zaluto from dis fate.

Title: On The Run
Objective: Exile the escaped prisoners.
Text: We were... transporting prisoners when de ambush came... a giant devilsaur... tore through everything.Most of de prisoners escaped in de carnage... dese are hardened criminals. Dey cannot be allowed to roam free!I swore a blood oath dat I would deliver dem to Vol'dun... I am probably going to die here, but I will not die an oathbreaker!Find de escaped criminals and exile dem to Vol'dun.

Title: Won't Leaf Him to Die
Objective: Gather 8 Sweetleaf.
Text: I may have done some wicked things in my past, but I won't leave dis guard to die.Zulajin has taken a nasty bite outta Zaluto... and has also infected him with some weird voodoo.But don't worry, because today is our lucky day. I have a plan to cure him. Dere are sweetleaf bushes nearby!De leaves of dis bush are known for their healing properties. You get me some, and I will be able to save dis Zaluto.It's de only chance we have!

Title: For the Horde
Objective: Meet Ambassador Blackguard at the Orgrimmar Embassy.
Text: A new age dawns upon Highmountain.After centuries apart, the bond with our kin from Kalimdor has been reforged. And in the fight to save our land, we found new friends among the people of the Horde.To show the strength we bring to our allies, brave tauren like you must heed the call of adventure.You have been invited to Orgrimmar. Meet with the ambassador at the warchief's embassy, then begin your journey across Azeroth.Earthmother be with you.

Title: Wreckage of the Cataclysm
Objective: Find Rokor at Scavenger's Strand.
Text: In recent years one of the greatest Zandalari loa temples mysteriously fell into the sea. It is a topic of some debate what caused this, and what treasures might have been lost in the catastrophe. My cousin Rokor was in charge of the salvaging efforts. Within the temple were many great items of knowledge and power. I am sure he will have need of the services of someone like yourself with strong arms and working knees.

Title: Your Next Move
Objective: Choose your next move in Zandalar.
Text: We have some thoughts on the best way to win over the Zandalari.The princess is heading to Nazmir to take the fight to the blood trolls. Her voice carries much weight with the council and her father.General Jakra'zet detests the Horde. Removing his voice from the Zanchuli Council will greatly improve our chances here.We should also keep working on winning over the King here in Zuldazar. This city is vast and has many secrets.

Title: Nesingwary's Trek
Objective: Speak with Hemet Nesingwary at Nesingwary's Trek.
Text: De greatest hunter from your lands, de dwarf Nesingwary, has come to participate in de Great Hunt. If you are enough of a hunter to join him, den travel to de Nesingwary Trek along de northeastern region of Zuldazar.

Title: Not "Only Zul"
Objective: Purge Zul's forces.
Text: Our enemies here either follow de name of Zul, or dey want to use him to take Zandalar.He has the ego to allow either.Dey claim only Zul can lead us.Dissuade dem.

Title: Cat on a Hot Copper Roof
Objective: Climb the burning house and rescue Scratchy.
Text: My parents said we have to go, but I won't leave Scratchy behind! She's so gentle and precious and pure and kind and soft and cuddly! She must be so scared up there on the balcony! Please help her!

Title: Your Next Move
Objective: Choose your next move in Zandalar.
Text: We have some thoughts on the best way to win over the Zandalari.The princess is heading to Nazmir to take the fight to the blood trolls. Her voice carries much weight with the council and her father.General Jakra'zet detests the Horde. Removing his voice from the Zanchuli Council will greatly improve our chances here.We should also keep working on winning over the King here in Zuldazar. This city is vast and has many secrets.

Title: Send the Signal!
Objective: Get to the ship.
Text: My crew is not on board with de word of Zul. We saw too much of who he really is.Far out in de harbor, Zul's traitors have joined with de mogu to try to take my ships! If we lose de fleet and de harbor, we lose de city!We must let Zuldazar know we stand strong. We take back de ships. We drive de villains out.You must light de towers with loa-blessed flame. Dey will always see dat de Bay of Kings belongs to Zandalar!

Title: Dark Forces
Objective: Defeat Qy'telek, Herald of Uul'gyneth
Text: The Old Gods have inflicted one of their faceless ones upon Thunder Bluff. The fiend desecrates my people's city!We must fight together to rid this place of such filth.I believe that destroying this herald will drive our enemies from Mulgore. May our weapons strike true!

Title: Righteous Retribution
Objective: Help Taelia destroy the pirate ships in Daelin's Gate.
Text: Cyrus taught me how to deal with thugs, bullies, and scum like pirates.When they hit us, we hit back twice as hard.It's time to hit back.

Title: Dousing the Flames
Objective: Use the Water Bucket to put out 15 fires around the Ruins of Brennadam.
Text: The Horde have set fire to my town. I will make them pay for this. Stormsong Valley is the breadbasket of Kul Tiras, and our people need to be fed. The first thing we must do is damage control. Grab some buckets and help put those fires out!

Title: You Have Their Orders
Objective: Find the Warchief's Orders.
Text: The Horde is an army, make no mistake. And armies need orders. Someone must be giving orders here. They know the plan, and I want to know the plan too. Look for the people who seem to be in charge and see if you can uncover any intelligence so we know what to do next.

Title: Cease Fire!
Objective: Destroy 4 Captured Cannons.
Text: The enemy has turned our forward cannons around on us.Scuttle that equipment to stop the bombardments!

Title: Heavy Artillery
Objective: Slay Captain Wormwood and commandeer the Experimental War Machine.
Text: Bad news, friend. They're bringing in serious firepower now. We've spotted a tank on the northern hill by the windmill. They can reach the other side of the town from there. We can't let them set it up. What do you say to giving them a taste of their own medicine? If you can take out their commander, you'd have a fancy new tank all to yourself. Imagine the mayhem you could unleash on their invasion!

Title: Air Raid
Objective: Slay 6 Irontide Skyriders.
Text: Those pirates have air support! They're torching our farms and splitting our attention away from the front lines.Take 'em outta the sky!

Title: Fond Farewells
Objective: Deliver Jorak's Note to B'wizati in Zuldazar.
Text: Dis is where we part ways.I'm going to take de name Akunda, and start a new life here.Rakera saved my life, and I'm going to make sure to live a life dat was worth saving.If you find yourself back in de city, could you deliver dis note for me? I trust you not to open it, though I doubt you could read my scrawls anyway.

Title: Hands Off My Booty!
Objective: Man the Vigil Hill Cannon and use it to slay 20 looters.
Text: We are dealing with lawless, no-account thugs. As soon as they gained ground, they started looting! Looting right in the middle of a battle!Well I, for one, am not giving up our booty that easily.Get up to the top of Vigil Hill and man the main cannon. Rain hellfire down on those blaggards!Dismissed!

Title: WANTED: Thundersnout
Objective: Deliver Thundersnout's Snout to Mayor Roz.
Text: Thundersnout is the largest of the boars in the valley. She is wreaking havoc on the nearby farms and their crops. Mayor Roz of Brennadam has issued a bounty for proof of her demise. Thundersnout's location is near Briarback kraul, so be on the look out for quilboar!

Title: For Kul Tiras!
Objective: Use the Proudmoore Battle Standard to inspire 15 Vigil Hill Marines or Militia.
Text: Listen, I'll be frank with you; we're not at full strength here. Many of our soldiers recently left for Boralus on new orders.It's like they knew just when to hit us...But we're going to hit back! Every able-bodied man and woman in town has stepped up to mount a defense.Take this battle standard and remind them what they're fighting for!

Title: Patching Up the Rear
Objective: Bandage 5 injured marines.
Text: Most of my men were injured when we were escaping the fort, those that weren't were injured holding this position.All of our better supplies are behind those walls, so we've been forced to make do with what we have. Everything that's not being worn on a soldier's person as we speak has been shredded for use as bandages. We don't have the staffing to take care of everyone.Head out and replace the worst of our injured's bandages.

Title: Targeting a Turncoat
Objective: Slay Fernn the Turncoat.
Text: The instigator of this mutiny is a man named Fernn. He has always shown discontent with House Proudmoore and his position here. But to betray the men he works with? That seems beyond even my expectations of him.Take him out, and show this mutiny the mistake of crossing truly loyal marines.

Title: Protect the Nests
Objective: Kill 7 Hungry Dewscale.
Text: Now that Tagart is done with your hazing... I mean... trials, you can start helping us with some of the work around here.Some of the nearby gryphon nests have been overrun with saurolisk. I fear that the gryphons will make new roosts elsewhere if we don't clear them out.Head up the road towards the waterfall and take out those saurolisks. Report to Shawn when you're done. He's posted as a lookout there.

Title: Bombs, Away
Objective: Retrieve 8 Horde Explosives and use them against the Demolishers.
Text: By the sea's foamy beard, what a blast! They've brought goblins, and if there's one thing I know about goblins it's that they like to blow things up. I saw a few of them carrying large bombs, and I presume that they are going to blow up the town. I would like to keep the town, so how about you head out there and steal as many of those explosives as you can find? After that, let's blow up their demolishers and stop this infernal bombardment!

Title: Unnecessary Duress
Objective: Rejuvenate 8 Exhausted Laborers.
Text: Lord Stormsong has never taken kindly to dissent, but this is madness. These laborers are being worked to death!Addington was a good man. We cannot stand for such cruelty.Take this vial and apply it to the laborers. It contains blessed seawater that will rejuvenate their strength.Avoid engaging what troops you can. They are merely following orders. More death will only worsen matters.

Title: A Lesson on Trust
Objective: Retrieve 8 Marine Identification Badges.
Text: The men in the fort were once under my command, and so, they are now my responsibility. Each of them should have a badge we use for identifying individuals under certain circumstances. I would ask you to bring back a number of these as proof of thinning their ranks.These men are no longer soldiers of Boralus, and as such, no longer deserve to carry the Proudmoore anchor.

Title: Trouble at Greystone Keep
Objective: Speak with Tallis Skyheart.
Text: A friend of mine, a fellow military courier, had a job at Greystone Keep. The fort lies just outside of Boralus, so I would've expected him to be back by now.I have another job lined up, so could you go check out the fort for me? I'm probably just being paranoid.

Title: Getting Paid
Objective: Meet with Tagart at the Roughneck Camp.
Text: Now that we got our mitts good and bloody, I think it's time we head back to camp.I'll run ahead, so you can finish up whatever business you got. Just remember to meet Tagart for your pay.

Title: An Offering of Eggs
Objective: Collect 4 Spotted Gryphon Eggs.
Text: Our work isn't only to capture and tame gryphons, it's also to preserve them.Rescue any eggs remaining in nearby abandoned nests. Set them in one of the new nests we've built for the displaced gryphons. I am sure one of the gryphon females will adopt them.

Title: A Risky Ploy
Objective: Disperse the crowd surrounding Brother Pike.
Text: Things are worse than we thought. These people are about to tear Brennadam apart!We'll never get a chance to talk to Brother Pike in this mess.I have an idea, but if it doesn't work, well... I hope you have your running boots on.Trust me?

Title: Free Bird
Objective: Free 5 Juvenile Seahawks.
Text: Skyheart invited me here to teach some of his city boys how to train the local sea hawks. Some of my students went and sided with the mutiny force, seems these soft marines have forgotten what the consequence is for betraying a Drustvar soldier.Worse yet, they've locked up quite a few of the younger birds we were training. I've got my hands full with these hawks, so if you could free a few of the young'uns while you're in the fort, I'd appreciate it.

Title: House Stormsong
Objective: Meet Brother Pike and Taelia at Mariner's Strand.
Text: I have little information to offer, I'm afraid. I've scarcely left Brennadam as of late.What they said is true. Our militia now enter town only to collect rations rather than guard traders or keep the quilboar at bay.They say they are under orders, but those orders would only come from my brothers at the Shrine. We take oaths to serve our people... it simply does not add up.Brother Addington is nearby at Mariner's Strand. Perhaps he knows more than I.

Title: Turn to Drust
Objective: Seek out Kronah at the Smuggler's Cove in Drustvar.
Text: There are blood scribe masters all over the place who'll teach you what you need to know. The first master I'd recommend seeking out is Kronah. She's a bit... eccentric to say the least. One of the few tortollan who've experienced a thing or two. She's the one who taught me the blood contract I know how to invoke! She likes to hang out at the Smuggler's Cove on the western coast of Drustvar. Oh, and could you say hi for me when you see her?!

Title: Proclamation Investigation
Objective: Read 3 Stormsong Proclamations.
Text: My lord seldom leaves our holdings along the northern coast, and visitors are expressly forbidden. For most, tidesages like myself are their only connection to the house proper.Lord Stormsong usually delivers orders through proclamations posted throughout the valley. None have reached Brennadam, but if there are any posted here we may be able to find some answers.

Title: Lil' Tika
Objective: Rescue Lil' Tika.

Title: The Lightforged
Objective: Travel to the Vindicaar.
Text: Do you wish to hear how the Lightforged draenei joined the Alliance? It might be one of my favorite stories.Most likely since it involves seeing our beautiful world from space!It all began when High Exarch Turalyon invited members of the Alliance onto the Vindicaar...

Title: The Sethrak Incursion
Objective: Slay 12 sethrak in Sandscar Breach.
Text: Dol'watha be a small village. Got a few farms, some beasts, and a decent view of a swamp. Loa know we not be ready for this... De snake-men popped out of de ground by de hundreds. Slaughtered my beasts, my family, my friends. One minute de earth rumbling, de next we be running for our lives. I heard about snake-men from de deserts of Vol'dun but I never believed I would see them in my life... Help us fight back. Kill as many of them as you can. Dol'watha won't be beaten that easily!

Title: Plans for Attack
Objective: Recover Nisha's Attack Plans from Fangcaller Sraka.
Text: Before we were attacked, I had a plan to take the fight to the sethrak.It was devised with flawless intel. I know, because I gathered the information myself.I surveyed their entire compound and created a map based on my findings.My plan relies on that map, but it's now in the hands of Fangcaller Sraka, the brute who's leading this assault on my home.Help me kill her so I can take back what's mine!

Title: Haywire Harvesters
Objective: Obtain a Drenched Mainspring.
Text: See the golems down there? Farmers use their sharp claws to reap the harvest, but these are cutting timber...Why would they need them here when they have so many laborers on hand?I think the militia is using them to intimidate their own people!See if you can get ahold of an intact mainspring from one. I've helped repair a few back in Boralus. I should be able to figure out who is messing with their innards.

Title: Skycaller Soltok
Objective: Slay Skycaller Soltok.
Text: As if snake-men with swords not be bad enough, they brought a powerful skycaller along. I hear skycallers can tempt great storms into being. They be to blame for de spires and lightning flying everywhere. There be one who wear a bigger feather than most, likely de leader. Calls herself Soltok or something equally hissy. Don't care. Kill her.

Title: I Spy a Spire
Objective: Destroy 4 Sethrak Spires.
Text: It is good you have come. Dol'watha be under attack by these snake-men.Soon as they arrived they started pulling these weird spire-things out de ground. I seen a bunch of snake-mons with feathers in their caps getting zapped by them, but they not be dying.If it not be bad for them, that means it's good for them. And that be bad for us.Destroy those spires. Hopefully whatever boon they be getting will go away and they will be easier to kill.

Title: Dressed for Battle
Objective: Help Nisha find a war banner, a helmet, and explosives.
Text: Kiro's the leader of my caravan. He's always been far too passive.I warned him we needed to make a preemptive strike against the sethrak, but he insisted that we keep our heads down and continue to quietly do business.Look where that got us.Our caravan was completely unprepared for their attack.Now I'm ready to fight for what's ours, but I'm not exactly dressed for battle.Help me scavenge some suitable equipment here among our enemies. We will use their own tools against them.

Title: Light Up the Gulch
Objective: Torch the slave auction sites in Slithering Gulch.
Text: Don't mistake my caution for hesitance. I will defend the vulpera with my dying breath... I'd just prefer to avoid taking that breath today.While Nisha rushes to the front line, I work behind them to ensure our success.Meet me at the Faithless beast pens if you'd like to help.Oh, and take this torch. You'll be going through their marketplace, where they auction off slaves.Starting a few well-placed and metaphorically poignant fires along your route will make things easier for all of us.

Title: Ready to Riot
Objective: Free and arm 8 Vulpera Slaves in cages.
Text: Do you remember how we met? You were trapped in a Faithless cage, just like the ones in the crater below.Together, we slaughtered Faithless and earned your freedom in blood.The vulpera trapped in shackles below can do the same. They just need to be given the chance.Steal Faithless weapons and give them to the vulpera slaves below. They'll rise up and help you fight the Faithless.We're going to start a revolt right under their arrogant noses.

Title: Allies in Anarchy
Objective: Speak with Nisha.
Text: Even after all these years, I can feel the ancient power of Sethraliss in this place. My loa endures.Our task ahead is great and I will need a clear, focused mind to accomplish it. Allow me a few moments to meditate here, like I did in ages past.In the meantime, you should help the vulpera stir up trouble however you can. They seem to know you, and a large enough disturbance will distract the Faithless from our mission.Meet me back here when you're done and we'll proceed together.

Title: Make Them Fear Us
Objective: Plant 12 Vulpera Banners into dead Faithless.
Text: I carry this banner into every battle because I want the Faithless to fear it. To fear my people.If I die in the battlefield, surrounded by Faithless, I will die happy.On that day, I will not need a burial or prayers. But I will need someone to pick up my banner and carry it into the next battle.If you are of the same mind, plant these banners into the corpse of every Faithless you slay. Let the survivors know who's coming for them.

Title: The Missing Key
Objective: Meet Vorrik at Bwoljin's Fall.
Text: Korthek has grown spiteful and arrogant over the years, but I realize now that he has grown mad as well.Mythrax will kill all of us if he is released.For too long, I've held out hope that I could convince Korthek peacefully to abandon his heresy. I was wrong.All of Zandalar is at risk while Korthek and his allies hold even one key to Mythrax's prison.Meet me outside his fortress in the north. We will confront my old friend "Emperor" Korthek and end this together.

Title: The Little Ones
Objective: Kill Appraiser Versik and lead the vulpera kids back to Meerah.
Text: Just when I thought the Faithless couldn't get any worse, I find out that they're keeping vulpera children trapped down in that crater!The other vulpera we rescued told me that a big sethrak, Appraiser Versik, is inspecting them on the central platform to determine what he can sell them for.Selling vulpera kids! Oooh, those Faithless make me so angry!Please. I'm no fighter. I can't rescue those kids. But if you bring them up here to me, I promise I'll get them out of here safely.

Title: False Prophecies
Objective: Return to King Rastakhan at Dazar'alor.
Text: Now dat dis nuisance is out of de way, I can return my focus to de city. Zuldazar has languished while I was away. You should return to Rastakhan. Let de king know dat his will has been carried out and dat dis false prophet is no more. You might think to share Vol'jamba's prophecy with him, if you feel it worth his notice. I cannot say it will change anything at all.

Title: Trust of a King
Objective: Speak with King Rastakhan at the Golden Throne.
Text: Well, now dat you are settled in, you had best go speak with my father. You can find him up upon de throne, his advisors close at hand, pouring poison in his ear, no doubt.De lift behind you can take you to de Golden Throne above us.

Title: Unleash the Beasts
Objective: Kill Tamer Traskniss to release the crawgs.
Text: The Faithless are arrogant hoarders, capturing people and beasts that can never be truly tamed. All to fuel their endless lust for war.I've even seen their slavers dragging blood trolls and other dark monsters from the swamps of Nazmir.I heard terrible noises coming out of a cave while I was scouting the feeding pits up ahead.Whatever monsters they are hiding in there, find a way to free them and let them exact revenge on the Faithless.

Title: Silvermoon City
Objective: Meet with Lady Liadrin in Silvermoon City.
Text: The nightborne have been isolated from the world for thousands of years. Now that they have reemerged, it is up to us to guide them along the right path.Regent Lord Theron has extended an invitation to the nightborne to meet with us in Silvermoon.Come, let us travel to Silvermoon with Thalyssra.

Title: The Nightborne
Objective: Return to Ji Firepaw in Orgrimmar to hear the end of this tale.
Text: The Warchief will be pleased with our success.Thalyssra and her nightborne will prove strong allies, I am sure.

Title: The Shrine of the Dawning
Objective: Travel to the location marked on your map and investigate the shrine in Nazmir. Do what you can to repair the shrine, should the need arise.
Text: Yea, I believe there are a few here on Zandalar. You should find dem, investigate dem. See if what dis book says is true. Dis particular shrine sounds like it might be in Nazmir. If my calculations are correct, it should be just south of Torga's Rest. Dat loa was a mighty one. It is truly sad dat it is no longer with us. Here are de notes on dat one. And I've marked its location for you on your map. Loa be with you.

Title: The Shrine of the Sands
Objective: Travel to the location marked on your map and investigate the shrine in Vol'dun. Do what you can to repair the shrine, should the need arise.
Text: Dere are two more shrines here on Zandalar. Dis next one resides within Vol'dun, near Bonetrail Gulch. Hopefully de Faithless haven't defiled de shrine. Here are de notes on dat location. Should dat shrine also need fixing, I think your skills with jewels will probably be enough to fix it.

Title: The Missing Chapter
Objective: Travel to the location marked on your map and see what you can find.
Text: While trying to figure out where de shrines reside, I came across an entry dat mentioned him exploring an area dat sounds very similar to Dustwallow Marsh. It could be a long shot, given when dis earthen roamed Azeroth, but maybe if you retrace his final steps, you may find something. I'll mark his last location for you on your map.

Title: Locally Sourced Eggs
Objective: Collect 10 Coilscale Eggs from Coilscale Nests.
Text: There is nothing in the world greater than food made from the best, freshest ingredients! My good friend I am on a hunt. A hunt for the perfect eggs! I have heard tale of eel eggs. A delicate texture, a slight undersea saltiness... such a unique flavor profile! I must have them! The eels here lay their eggs on the land before returning to the sea. Please, gather these eggs for me so that I may create only the most elegant of omelets!

Title: The Shrine of Nature
Objective: Investigate the Shrine of Nature in Zuldazar.
Text: Another shrine resides right here in Zuldazar. According to de journal, de earthen talks about creating green hued jewels dere. I wonder if dat's anything like de viridium we find in de ore we mine. Go and see if de shrine still stands. Hopefully, we can still make use of it. I'll continue to study de journal for more information.

Title: Out With the Old
Objective: Cut 4 Insightful Rubellites and replace the old ones with the new.

Title: Digging Through the Past
Objective: Ask Examiner Alerinda for her book of Primordial Races: Runes and Writings. Ask Koatini for his Scrolls of the Stonefather. And ask Chronicler Shoopa for the The Dungard Codex.
Text: Let's see, Examiner Alerinda has a book on ancient runes and carvings. I think Koatini has a few scrolls he brought with him from Ulduar. OH! And Chronicler Shoopa found a codex de last time he ventured out. I remember seeing de runes on it and dey look a lot like de ones in dis book. Maybe you can convince dem to lend us dose books for a bit, and I think I can create a translation for you.

Title: Sun-Speckled Dunes
Objective: Go to the location on your map where you believe these gems to be and recover 8 of them. Polish and shape them when you've collected enough.

Title: High Prospects
Objective: Investigate Gol Osigr for clues about the jewels that were used to construct the shrine.

Title: A Rocky Start
Objective: Bring the book to Grazzul and see if he can translate the text.
Text: Ah, dat's been a treasure of mine for many years. Beautiful, isn't it? No clue what it says, but I've always reveled at de thought of something being written in jewels. Come to think of it, I wonder if Grazzul would know what it says. , would you mind taking it over to him and see if he can translate it?

Title: Atal'Dazar: Not All That Glitters...
Objective: Travel to Atal'Dazar and find a replacement for the broken jewel.

Title: The Missing Chapter
Objective: Travel to the location marked on your map and see what you can find.
Text: While trying to figure out where the shrines reside, I came across an entry that mentioned him exploring an area that sounds very similar to Dustwallow Marsh. He mentions hiding something of great importance there. It's a long shot, given when this earthen roamed Azeroth, but perhaps if you were to retrace his final steps you may find something. I'll mark the location on your map.

Title: Cracking the Surface
Objective: Go to the Windshorn Hills and gather 20 Shard of Golden Beryl.

Title: The Shrine of the Sea
Objective: Investigate the Shrine of the Sea in Tiragarde Sound.
Text: This next shrine is right here, in Tiragarde Sound. According to the journal, the earthen mentions creating bluish hued jewels. I wonder if that's anything like the kyanite we have here. Go and see if the shrine still stands. Hopefully it's still in a usable state. I'll continue to study the journal for more information.

Title: The Shrine of Storms
Objective: Travel to the location marked on your map and investigate the shrine in Stormsong Valley. Do what you can to repair the shrine, should the need arise.
Text: Yes, I believe there are a few here in Kul Tiras. You should visit them, investigate them. See if what this book says is true. This particular shrine he mentions sounds like it may reside near Brennadam, in Stormsong Valley. It should be fairly easy to find. If my calculations are correct, it should be just north of that town. Here are the notes on that one. And I've marked its location for you on your map. Good luck.

Title: The Shrine of the Eventide
Objective: Travel to the location marked on your map and investigate the shrine in Drustvar. Do what you can to repair the shrine, should the need arise.
Text: There are two more shrines here on Kul Tiras. I believe this next one resides within Drustvar, near the Bleak Hills Mine, southeast of Corlain. Here are the notes on that shrine. Should it also need mending, I'm positive your skills with jewels can meet the challenge of repairing it.

Title: Tol Dagor: Jewel of the Tides
Objective: Speak with "Slippery" Salton and learn what you can about the missing centerpiece.

Title: Hero's Call: Gorgrond!
Objective: Speak with Yrel in Gorgrond.
Text: All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Yrel in Gorgrond.Yrel and Maraad are requesting for a small expedition to be sent into the wilds of Gorgrond.We hope to gain a better understanding of the land in hopes that it will show us how to exploit weaknesses in the Iron Horde.Assist them with their expedition.Glory to the Alliance!

Title: A Rocky Start
Objective: Bring the book to Zooey Inksprocket and see if she can translate the text.
Text: Ah, now that's a treasure I've had for many years. Beautiful, isn't it? No clue what it says, but I've always reveled at the thought of something being transcribed in jewels. Come to think of it, I wonder if Zooey Inksprocket would be able to decipher it. Say, would you mind taking it over to her and see if she can translate it?

Title: Digging Through the Past
Objective: Ask Jane Hudson for her book of Primordial Races: Runes and Writings. Ask Tal'ana for his Scrolls of the Stonefather. And ask Toopa for the The Dungard Codex.
Text: Let's see, Jane Hudson probably still has her book on ancient runes and carvings. And I believe Tal'ana has a few scrolls he picked up from Ulduar. OH! And Toopa found what appeared to be some type of codex the last time he ventured out. I remember seeing the runes on it and they bear a striking resemblance to the ones in this book. If you could convince them to uh... lend us those items for a bit, I believe I just might be able to create a translation for you. I won't even charge you for it!

Title: Hero's Call: Shadowmoon Valley!
Objective: Speak with Prophet Velen in Shadowmoon Valley on Draenor.
Text: All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Prophet Velen in Shadowmoon Valley on Draenor.The destruction of the Dark Portal has stopped the Iron Horde invasion of Azeroth, but now we must to take the fight to them.With Prophet Velen's blessing, we will be able to establish a strategic position in Draenor to fight against the enemies of Azeroth.Glory to the Alliance!

Title: Hero's Call: Nagrand!
Objective: Speak with Lieutenant Balfor in Nagrand on Draenor.
Text: All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Lieutenant Balfor in Nagrand on Draenor.Yrel is recommending that the Alliance establish an outpost in Nagrand to help in our fight against the Warsong clan.Secure a flight to Nagrand and meet up with Lieutenant Balfor and the supply caravan.Glory to the Alliance!

Title: Hero's Call: Spires of Arak!
Objective: Speak with Azik in the Spires of Arak.
Text: All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Azik in Spires of Arak.There have been wingless arakkoa seen fleeing from Spires of Arak. Rumors suggest that they are running from an Iron Horde superweapon.We need to find out what is causing them to leave their homeland, and why their wings have withered.Glory to the Alliance!

Title: Down by the Riverside
Objective: Sail down the river with Talanji and defend the Gob Squad's A.M.O.D.
Text: We have de aid of Krag'wa and de Gob Squad. We must get back to Zul'jan and begin our plan to stop de blood trolls.We have one problem. De Gob Squad are unable to move their mech fast enough in de jungle. We must take it by boat.De two of us will ride with dem and ensure de blood trolls do not destroy de mech.I will run ahead and get de boat ready near de riverbank. Meet us dere.

Title: Hero's Call: Talador!
Objective: Speak with Foreman Eksos in Talador.
Text: All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Foreman Eksos in Talador.The Iron Horde seek to control Talador. The area is perfect to send reinforcements to any other part of Draenor quickly and without resistance.Foreman Eksos is currently establishing an outpost in Talador. Travel there and stop the Iron Horde.Glory to the Alliance!

Title: Hero's Call: Krasarang Wilds!
Objective: Speak with Ken-Ken in Krasarang Wilds.
Text: All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Zhu's Watch in Krasarang Wilds.There have been rumors that the pandaren living in Krasarang Wilds are not their usual self.Speak with Ken-Ken at Zhu's Watch. Perhaps he has a better idea of what has happened to cause the pandaren to become lethargic.

Title: Hero's Call: Dread Wastes!
Objective: Speak with Bowmistress Li on the Serpent's Spine.
Text: All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Bowmistress Li on the Serpent's Spine in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.The Shado-Pan are attempting to stop the mantid army from invading the entirety of Pandaria.You can reach Bowmistress Li by securing a kite and flying to the Serpent's Spine.Glory to the Alliance!

Title: Hero's Call: Kun-Lai Summit!
Objective: Speak to the Messenger Grummle in Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to assist Lorewalker Cho in Kun-Lai Summit.Speak with a messenger grummle in Valley of the Four Winds. They will show you the way to Kun-Lai Summit.Glory to the Alliance!

Title: Hero's Call: Valley of the Four Winds!
Objective: Speak with Chen Stormstout in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Text: All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Chen Stormstout in the Valley of the Four Winds.The adventuring spirit of the Stormstouts is something that the Alliance can learn from.Travel with the Stormstouts and discover what secrets Pandaria holds.Glory to the Alliance!

Title: Hero's Call: Townlong Steppes!
Objective: Speak with Taran Zhu in Townlong Steppes.
Text: All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Taran Zhu in Townlong Steppes.The Shado-Pan want to reclaim their land from the clutches of the yaungol, but lack the numbers to do so.Assist them with their assault against the yaungol.Glory to the Alliance!

Title: Hero's Call: Jade Forest!
Objective: Report to Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth in Stormwind Keep.
Text: All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Stormwind Keep in Stormwind.Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth is assembling a team for a high priority mission.Head to Stormwind Keep immediately to be briefed.Glory to the Alliance!

Title: Hero's Call: Icecrown!
Objective: Speak with Officer Van Rossem in Dalaran over Crystalsong Forest.
Text: All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Officer Van Rossem in Dalaran over Crystalsong Forest.The Valiance Expedition needs more adventurers to bolster their assault on assault Icecrown Citadel and Arthas himself.It is time to make the Lich King pay for his crimes.Glory to the Alliance!

Title: Hero's Call: Storm Peaks!
Objective: Speak with Rin Duoctane in Dalaran over Crystalsong Forest.
Text: All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Rin Duoctane in Dalaran over Crystalsong Forest.The goblins of K3 have built a city in Storm Peaks and have sent their ambassador to recruit adventurers.Speak with Rin and see what the people of K3 need. They would make valuable allies in our fight against the Lich King.Glory to the Alliance!

Title: Hero's Call: Howling Fjord!
Objective: Speak with Macalroy in Howling Fjord.
Text: All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Macalroy in Howling Fjord.The port town of Valgarde is located in the heart of the Howling Fjord, and it allows for the Alliance to have an advantageous position to strike at the Scourge.Assist the soldiers stationed there.Glory to the Alliance!

Title: Hero's Call: Sholazar Basin!
Objective: Speak with Archmage Pentarus in Dalaran over Crystalsong Forest.
