Title: Time Off Requests
Objective: Free 5 Entangled Lumberjacks in Algerson Lumber Yard.
Text: My father is incapable of seeing what's in front of his very nose. He holes himself up in his office, not leaving to go home until late at night...Here I am, his only son, trapped out here along with all of his workers. Are they in trouble? Yes! But father will never believe them.If he won't try to get to the bottom of this attack, I will do it myself!

Title: Pest Prevention
Objective: Destroy 12 Mossfang Eggs.
Text: These woods have never been so densely littered with spider eggs.If these are recent... they must also be corrupted! We cannot allow them to hatch into more of these aggressive spiders.While you are in the woods, destroy those eggs. Any more spiders could lead to an uncontainable infestation!

Title: Give a Dam
Objective: Shoo 6 Woodchewing Beavers back to the water.
Text: These loggers are destroying the forest, and harming the wildlife! Beavers need this wood for their dams, but have had to resort to scrounging for scraps. It's not safe for them anymore! Please, help me chase them back to the safety of the water.

Title: Bones - Rank 3 Unlock
Objective: Find someone on Argus who might be able to train you on how to handle Astral Glory.
Text: Amazed that anything so pure could continue to grow on this planet, you pick flower from the ground. You feel a small power radiate from it and then vanish. As it falls apart in your hands, you wonder if anyone on this Light-forsaken place knows how to handle this precious herb.

Title: Inventory Deficit
Objective: Collect 5 Reclaimed Axes from dead Algerson Lumberjacks.
Text: My employees say we're under attack. They say our workers are falling to beasts and men made of wood.I say we're losing precious inventory!Do you know how many company-issued axes must be getting dropped out there? That's a waste of my hard-earned money!I'm going to need you to get those back for me.

Title: Leather - Rank 3 Unlock
Objective: Find someone on Argus who might be able to train you on how to handle Astral Glory.
Text: Amazed that anything so pure could continue to grow on this planet, you pick flower from the ground. You feel a small power radiate from it and then vanish. As it falls apart in your hands, you wonder if anyone on this Light-forsaken place knows how to handle this precious herb.

Title: A Lesson in Witch Hunting
Objective: Assist Lucille Waycrest as she studies the Tome of Ash and Silver.
Text: While I appreciate the dedication that went into compiling this tome, this thing reads like engineering instructions for a siege engine!I'll need some time to comb through this information for anything that might be useful to us. I wouldn't mind some assistance, if you have a moment.For starters, I could use some more light in here...

Title: Incident Reports
Objective: Kill 10 Enthralled beasts in Fernwood Ridge.
Text: No wonder our workers are terrified to go into these woods. Generally the bears and spiders stay out of the way of humans...But these are no ordinary beasts!Father would be furious if productivity came to a halt. Please, cull these beasts so that the ridge can be safe once more!

Title: Boss' Revenge
Objective: Kill Whompus.
Text: Revenge has never really been my thing, but whatever is in there killed my crew and I am not going to let it stand.Everybody fights, nobody quits.

Title: Leather - Rank 1 Unlock
Objective: Find someone on Argus who might be able to train you on how to handle Astral Glory.
Text: Amazed that anything so pure could continue to grow on this planet, you pick flower from the ground. You feel a small power radiate from it and then vanish. As it falls apart in your hands, you wonder if anyone on this Light-forsaken place knows how to handle this precious herb.

Title: Blood Troll on the Outside
Objective: Help Witch Doctor Kejabu complete his ritual to disguise yourself as a blood troll.
Text: One of our scouts, Jo'chunga, has infiltrated de blood trolls, but we have not heard back from him.I need your help to find Jo'chunga and see what he has discovered about de blood trolls.If you are going to find him, you need to sneak in by looking like one of de blood troll women. Dey are de ones with de most freedom to move around. I have a ritual that can change you.Help me set up de ritual to make you look like a blood troll.

Title: Tattered Note
Objective: Slay Shath'kar in the Slithering Gulch.
Text: They captured me soon after I was exiled. I was too weak to be a slave and too starved to be food for the beasts.They were going to kill me, but one called Shath'kar intervened. He said it would be amusing to watch me starve to death among his prisoners.I have not lived a good life. I deserve nothing. But, to any fellow Zandalari who finds this, I have one request...Stick a blade in Shath'kar's belly and twist it until the snake is dead!

Title: Where'd They Go?
Objective: Locate clues regarding the missing Roughnecks.
Text: My boys are missing. You're going to help me find 'em.Got it?

Title: Wendies
Objective: Kill 10 wendigo.
Text: It's a mystery where these boys were taken, but it ain't much of a mystery who did it. Roughnecks believe an eye for an eye and then some.Let's put down some of those monstrosities.

Title: Warm and Cozy
Objective: Collect 99 Steamy Essences.
Text: Heya! Isn't this place a dream? I couldn't be more relaxed. Well, I could be if these annoying cloud jerks would leave me alone.Why don't you go punch some in their cloud faces. Oh, and bring back their essences, they help keep my tub warm.

Title: Heretics
Objective: Bring ruin to the Temple of the Prophet.
Text: Descend on Zul's fanatics and mogu allies. Hunt them down and slay them all with the fury of a true predator. Show them the true price of their betrayal.

Title: Not Our Purple Elves
Objective: Slay 8 Horde forces on the eastern shores of Xibala.
Text: Ye know, these elves might be purple, but they're no' with the Alliance.Leastwise, they're a lot more aggressive than this ol' Dark Iron is comfortable with.On the off chance it'll piss off the Horde, ye mind killin' a few of them?

Title: The Forlorn Soul
Objective: Help Keula locate her ma'da within the Necropolis.
Text: Where's my ma'da? You seen her?"I'll be right back," she said. I'm a good girl, I wait. I wait and wait, I'm not sure how long I've been waiting here for.It's cold and lonely here. Hey... could you help me find ma'da? I swear I won't cause you any trouble.

Title: Grand Theft Telemancy
Objective: Slay Third Telemancer Syranel and recover the Breath of Xibala.
Text: I'm not opposed to honest competition.But teleportin' it right out from under our noses leaves me feelin' dirty.Go teach that thievin' elf what it means t'steal from the Alliance. If they're fightin' dirty, then so will we.

Title: The King's Gambit
Objective: Join Rezan and Rastakhan in their siege of Atal'Dazar.
Text: Atal'Dazar is the tomb of kings. MY kings. My greatest followers.I will taste Zul's flesh before this day is done.Come, keep up. Our prey has neither the strength nor the numbers to block this entrance. Let us crush this heretic.

Title: City of Gold
Objective: Break Zul's forces on the road to Atal'Dazar.
Text: Rezan and Rastakhan did not wait for us. Dey are marching up de mountain to Atal'Dazar, de City of Gold. You, Loti, and I need to catch up quick and give dem some air support. Hop aboard.

Title: The Full Prophecy
Objective: Find and read the 3 Words of Zul.
Text: Dat snake of a prophet, Zul. I never trusted him. Always felt like he was never telling us de whole prophecy. Enter de Temple of dis "Prophet" and see if he recorded any of his visions. We must learn of what our prey intends, before our real hunt may begin.

Title: Big Boss
Objective: Meet Boss Tak at the Roughneck camp in Waning Glacier.
Text: With a performance like that, it's clear you're one of the top dogs here. Boss Tak will want to see you. He's up north checking on one of our camps in Waning Glacier. Head up that way and give him a hand.Oh, and I don't recommend looking him straight in the eye... or at his feet... or really anywhere near him. Best bet, close your eyes when you're talkin' to him.

Title: Roughneck Riders
Objective: Capture Greatfeather.
Text: Rulf sent word that you're needed for another job.A rich house cat is willing to pay top dollar for a male aerie alpha and there is only one that fits the bill, Greatfeather. I gotta head back to camp to help train a particularly wild female, so this is going to be a solo job.Find Greatfeather and hit him with the Tether Shot. From there, you'll have to wing it.

Title: Frozen
Objective: Find the source of heat in Longdrop Hot Springs.
Text: Hurp me pwease! Oh, it's woo. I can sill muv my wips a wittle.Fin me sumfin to 'et me owdda 'ere.

Title: Helping Henry
Objective: Kill Brawr.
Text: The Roughnecks told me to clear the rocks in the forest. I didn't know they meant THIS!You look tough, you have to help me! I'll get killed if I get anywhere near that thing. I'm also super allergic to bees...

Title: Hunting Zul
Objective: Meet King Rastakhan at the Zocalo.
Text: Zul is pulling all of his forces back to his stronghold at the Temple of the Prophet. Rastakhan has sent word that he is marshalling an army in the Zocalo with anyone still loyal that can carry a weapon. Looks like the old king had more loyalists than Zul expected. That, and he has three of their eldest loa gathered to his side. Go and lend your strength to their army.

Title: Fairwind's "Friends"
Objective: Rescue Flynn from the Ring of Booty.
Text: Someone must have recognized Flynn and ratted him out! A bunch of Irontide thugs dragged him off to the Ring of Booty for a "special audience" with Captain Harlan Sweete.Flynn doesn't like to talk about this, but he used to captain his own crew. With Harlan as his First Mate.The two had a falling out after a messy job and Flynn lost all taste for freebooting. Just disappeared one day.Harlan took the nastiest of the crew and formed the Irontide Raiders.In other words; it's personal.

Title: Flew the Coop
Objective: Feed 6 Runaway Macaws.
Text: Yes, yes, you can ride the pretties. They like it! They're good pretties. They like helping!Do you like helping, too? Maybe you can help me!Some of the loud men came here and threatened me. They don't scare me! But they made the pretties fly away.If you see any of my pretties out there, please feed this to them!It's my special treat. I know it will make them come home.

Title: Missing Treasure!
Objective: Ask Ned, Nance Barmy, and Nub Nub about the treasure, then find it.
Text: Which one o' you scurvy dogs dug up me treasure?!Was it you, Ned? I know you was in the Dead Man's Tale when I were talkin' about it!Or maybe it was ol' Nance Barmy, huh? Yer the one what fed me all them drinks in the first place!Oh and don't think I forgot about you, Nub Nub! I ain't trust a hozen as far as I can throw 'em... which I guess is PRETTY FAR, but--Someone stole me damn treasure!

Title: Defenders of Daelin's Gate
Objective: Ride with Taelia to Vigil Hill.
Text: Daelin's Gate has protected the southern channel for decades. If it falls, the pirate fleet can sail straight into Tiragarde Sound!The marines at Vigil Hill will need our help. Let's go!

Title: Trixie Business
Objective: Slay First Mate Trixie Tornsail.
Text: Usually this is the part where I hand you the scroll and send you on your way.Sadly, friend, these are unusual times.How's a man expected to run an honest business dealing in highly illegal goods when the Irontide Raiders are shaking down good folk like myself?I'm prepared to offer you a handsome sum - and the scroll for our shelled associate - if you rid me of the damnable woman who collects these tributes.You'll surely find her at Harlan's table at the bar, getting drunk on MY gold!

Title: Rodrigo's Revenge
Objective: Drop Vile Bombardment on 100 pirates in Freehold.
Text: The loud men are mean, but you seem nice!Want to have fun fun?The pretties love my special biscuits, but it makes them full full. Then they have to... go. You know?Let's prank the mean men! Fly fly on the pretties and make them go.

Title: Recruiting Efforts
Objective: Tear down 6 Irontide Recruiting Posters.
Text: The captain of the Irontide Raiders, Harlan Sweete, has it in his tiny head that he's in charge of Freehold now.He's been forcing the smaller crews to pledge their loyalty, and littering the whole town with his damn recruiting posters.Do me a favor and take down any of them posters you find. Just don't let them catch ya doin' it, or it's a long walk off a short plank.

Title: Rodrigo's Roost
Objective: Speak with Rodrigo in Freehold.
Text: We should check in with Cyrus and Taelia before we get in too deep.This is all of the evidence we've gathered so far linking the Ashvane Trading Company to the weapons and pirates here in Freehold.Take it to Rodrigo, on the rooftop just behind this tavern. He raises parrots that make great messengers. Some are even big enough to ride!Rodrigo's a few planks short of a poop deck, but he's trustworthy!

Title: The Big Job
Objective: Collect Bilge Rat Orders, Cutwater Corsair Orders, and Blacktooth Brawler Orders.
Text: So the Irontide Raiders are bringing the various outlaw crews together for a big job using weapons provided by the Ashvane Company.Something tells me they're not going fishing.We should see if members of the smaller crews are carrying any notes or orders. I trust you can handle it?I need to lay low and catch up with Venrik. If anyone else were to recognize me, the odds of them offering a friendly drink are precisely zero.

Title: Hold Still
Objective: Use the Goat Shears on 6 Gentle Goats.
Text: If you want to be a Roughneck, you're going to have to pass a few... trials. Every one of us has done 'em, so I don't want to hear any whining.Take these clippers and get me some goat fur. You have to clip 'em while they're alive, because thems the rules. Oh, and cover your bits when you do it, they like to kick.

Title: The Bears and the Bees
Objective: Kill 8 Scruffhide Bears and gather 6 Sticky Bee Honey from nearby Beehives.
Text: Hey, while you're out, would you grab some honey for me and the boys?Plenty of hives out in the woods, but I'd be careful if you don't want to dirty your delicate house cat hands. Bears out here tend to get pretty vicious when they smell honey.

Title: The Roughnecks
Objective: Speak with Tagart at the Roughneck Camp.
Text: NEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES!Do you seek danger? Beasts in great quantities? Perilous adventure?Do you also prefer the rugged outdoors to the dainty frilly froo-froo estate life?Well, you might be cutout to be a ROUGHNECK, suppliers of all gryphon mounts in Kul Tiras.Inquire at the Roughneck Camp in Westwind Weald about this exciting new opportunity.Applicants must NOT be afraid of heights, feathers, and/or death.

Title: Raise a Glass!
Objective: Order a drink from Venrik and drink it.
Text: Pleased to meet you. Name's Venrik. I been scrapin' out a living here in Freehold for years.Flynn used to be a regular back when he... well I shouldn't say too much. A man's past is his own.I'll help the two of you out, but first I demand that you let me give you a proper Freehold welcome: A drink!

Title: It Seems You've Made a Friend
Objective: Seek out Krag'wa.
Text: Dis young one has bonded with you.Bring him to Krag'wa.See if dere is anything to be done to heal him of de corruption.

Title: Crawg Free Zone
Objective: Kill 5 Battle Crawgs.
Text: Crawgs dat have been battle trained are already set in their ways.Cleansing dem from de camp may be de only way to give de young ones a chance.

Title: Off With Her Head
Objective: Bring back the head of Warmother Nagla.
Text: Warmother Nagla is driving her forces with a brutality and strength we did not expect.Blood trolls desecrate all dey touch, and are preparing to wreak havoc on all dat remain.As dey say, "cut off de head, and de beast will be dead".I will have her head as a trophy to show dat our brothers were avenged!

Title: Bad Juju
Objective: Drain the blood orbs.
Text: Look, between you and me, dere is no way we will drag my friend outta here without what got us into dis mess.We saw three orbs in dis camp. Dey are filled with de power of blood magic and are used in dirty rituals.Blood is drained from "volunteers" to corrupt de tadpoles of Krag'wa into vicious crawgs.If dis is a possible fate for children of loa, we must end it.Take dis vial and bleed de orbs dry. De chronicler will need to do research.

Title: Earn Their Trust
Objective: Feed the crawgling.
Text: If de young one can be taught to trust, dere is a chance for dis species.Dey may have been born of bad blood, but is dat what makes dem monsters? If you can build his confidence, a mighty ally he could one day be.A little care could be de thing, and don't forget food! I think some blood trolls may be extra tasty.

Title: Remember the Sunwell
Objective: Complete the scenario, "Remember the Sunwell."
Text: The Regent Lord intends to show First Arcanist Thalyssra our Sunwell.I do not know if he will allow Alleria Windrunner to attend the meeting, but we are invited to join them.

Title: Aid the Wounded
Objective: Treat the wounded Zandalari.

Title: Just One Thing
Objective: Capture a crawgling.
Text: You are just in time! Chance be high dat my blood was de next to spill.It is my fault we stopped here. Our team wanted to head back.Crawgs are de trouble, you see. De sanguinous birth of dese young be corrupted by cruel training. They are quite impressionable and dey will follow with just a little enticement.Capture the attention of one of de little squirmy ones nearby. We will see if my theory is correct.

Title: Rescue the Chronicler
Objective: Release Chronicler Jabari.
Text: Just ahead, Chronicler Jabari is being held in a cage, waiting to become a sacrifice.One by one, I see dem taken away, I hear de screams. Blood drained to feed blood magic, and what was left... was food for a beast.He is de only one left, and I don't have de strength to save him yet.Get Jabari out of dere, so we can return to Princess Talanji.

Title: Skycaller Slaughter
Objective: Kill 6 Sethrak Skycallers at the Temple Incursion.
Text: Some among the faithless are gifted with the ability to command the storm. They call themselves skycallers, and they use their magic to summon great spires that turn the earth into sand.Skycallers are the only ones capable of summoning these spires. If you kill the skycallers, you also kill the sethrak's ability to expand their warcamps.

Title: A Desecrated Temple
Objective: Destroy 5 Vile Desecration within the Necropolis.
Text: Da spirits of da faithful flock ta me temple. Ya see dem out dere, yes?Dey come ta enter da Other Side an' join me realm. However, spirits who've turned their backs upon Bwonsamdi, dey too have come to me temple grounds. Dey praise one called "G'huun," and spread their blood magic desecration across da Necropolis.Dis ends now!Go out dere and remove da desecrations dat be infesting me temple.

Title: The Keepers' Keys
Objective: Speak to Vorrik and uncover the significance of Sulthis' Stone.
Text: Serrik mentioned you might have uncovered something of significance at Zul'Ahjin?We don't have much time, I'm afraid.What is it you have found?

Title: Building Our Arsenal
Objective: Collect 20 Sethrak Weapons from within the Temple Incursion.
Text: Our fight against the faithless is an uphill battle we're bound to lose. We are outnumbered and out armed.What few weapons we have aren't enough to outfit the entire temple.With a few more spears and daggers, we might stand a chance fighting them off until our loa can be returned to us.

Title: A Powerful Prisoner
Objective: Find Vorrik and free him from his captors.
Text: It appears the Faithless broke through our defenses while I was away.They must be after Vorrik's key. It's the only reason they would have taken him alive.Please. You must secure our leader's safe return.

Title: Push Them Back!
Objective: Disrupt the Faithless assault on the Sanctuary of the Devoted.
Text: The faithless are laying siege to our home.This isn't the first time they've attacked, nor will it be the last, but we must protect the temple!Do whatever you can to disrupt their siege and push them back.

Title: Enemy Within
Objective: Kill Overseer Bates.
Text: I won't sugarcoat it, kid. It's a madhouse here. The leadership has fallen, selling their own souls as well as the souls of the workers to some darker forces. I will not give in. Overseer Bates surrendered the guard in his hunger for power. Show him that he is a fool.

Title: Hunting Zardrax
Objective: Find Shadow Hunter Da'jul in Burial Mound.
Text: , maybe you be helpin' me wit' sometin'.Talanji said dat Shadow Hunter Da'jul and her retainer, Kal'dran, ran off ta hunt down a lich named Zardrax.They be goin' off ta a place called Burial Mound. I be worried dey be in over dere heads.Can ya check ta see if dey be needin' help? We can't be losin' any of our allies in dis place.

Title: The Prophet's Ploy
Objective: Travel on Scarbeak to Dazar'alor.
Text: King Rastakhan's life is in grave danger. Zul is far more powerful than he appears.We do not have much time. You have to warn de king before Zul can act.Habutu and Zolani can take you dere. Now go!

Title: Thunder's Fall
Objective: Kill Warlord Kao.
Text: Warlord Kao commands de mogu from dis warship. It is time to put an end to dis incursion.I should be able to hold off any stragglers dat may come to Kao's aid, but I can only maintain dis barrier for so long.Be careful. Kao was one of de Thunder King's top generals. He will not fall without a fight.

Title: Aged to Perfection
Objective: Deliver the Hundred Year Bourbon to Carentan in Freehold.
Text: Greetings, young one. I am Roko. I trade in specialty goods and exotic wares.This bourbon is one hundred years old. I know, because I bought it one hundred years ago.A man in Freehold is prepared to trade me a rare scroll for this, but alas I am barred from entering. It seems this town is not so "free" anymore.If you can get in, perhaps you could make the trade on my behalf? I would be in your debt.

Title: Clear-Cutting
Objective: Kill 8 Curseformed Familiars in the Timbered Strand.
Text: We've managed to hold this hill, but the wicker creatures have moved in to surround us.We're not going to be able to move into the town if we don't get them off our flanks. This is where you come in.See if you can clear out some of their numbers in the lumber fields. That way, when we move in, we only need to worry about one front.

Title: Invasion Onslaught
Objective: Complete 3 standard Invasion Points.
Text: We must not yield even a single world to the Legion. Continue our Invasion Point offensive and crush the Legion beneath your heel.

Title: The Deadliest Catch
Objective: Accompany Okri to the sea gate, then kill Viq'Goth.
Text: Oi! No time to waste! Seems Deepwarden had one more thing up his sleeve... and it's the catch of the day! This'll be a hunt for the ages, and I won't let ya miss out. Okri will fly you out to the wall. Get ready!

Title: Scrollhunters
Objective: Collect 5 Seeker scrolls.
Text: When they captured us, they took everything we had - including our wonderful scrolls!Those naga witches are building storms. They try to hide what they do here, and seek power for their queen.We see past their madness, they are driven for a purpose.Retrieve our work from the Nazeshi Tempest-Wielders, else they may use them for nefarious gains.

Title: Algae Shakes
Objective: Dispense the Cleansing Tonic to 6 Nauseated Villagers in Anglepoint Wharf.
Text: Now that I have properly developed my tonic, it is of utmost importance that we dispense it amongst the ill at once. Please, take this tankard and distribute the remedy to the sick. I will try to calm the rest.

Title: A Special Stone
Objective: Defeat Tidemistress Nazesh and discover why the naga were sent here.
Text: Tidemistress Nazesh is right up this hill.There is something there. Something Azshara wants very badly.The naga must not succeed. If you can get a little piece of that stone, though, bring it back for us.Take this scroll with you, it will help you in your fight.It is time we push her forces, back into the waves for good.

Title: Lost Chelonians
Objective: Rescue tortollans captured by the Nazeshi.
Text: Tidemistress Nazesh has been channeling on a rock they found in one of the pools above. She has been trying for days. They grow desperate.The rest of my team was taken and locked up in cages. They want secrets from us that we do not know.When they realize we tortollan cannot be coerced, I expect the naga will do something most dire.Release the Seekers. We will thwart the naga plans together.

Title: Morgrum's Extended Survey
Objective: Assist Excavator Morgrum Emberflint with a survey.
Text: I've looked over the readings my little boxes gave an' I think I know where to look next. The Ashes of Xibala are practically mine.Ye'll want to meet me in the middle of the ruins, under that big ol' leerin' skull on the mountainside, to continue my survey.Readin' these contraptions is hard work, an' I don't think we'll be alone up there.Think ye can watch me back?

Title: Caged Wisdom
Objective: Take the key from Sli'thrus.
Text: Oh, hello, friend.It seems there is more here than for what we prepared.We sought. We found. We studied... and then we were taken. There are naga here. We did not expect this.There is a nasty fellow in this cave. If you could get the key from him, it would help us greatly.No need to fret, we'll wait here.

Title: Perfect Tidings
Objective: Use the attuned Scroll of the Missing to track and find the lost explorers.
Text: Your timing is most convenient.Our team had a check-in planned for this place, two days past. None have yet returned.I did not want to be brash and send word to the city too soon. However, I cannot leave this place empty, nor can I abandon young Koba.Take this scroll. See who, or what, you can find. Bring back those you can.

Title: Who Seeks the Seekers?
Objective: Locate the Seekers down the coast, to the southeast, and speak to Batu.
Text: Let me tell you, Zandalar is filled to the brim with ancient secrets. It's quite fascinating.We heard tales of a region, to the southeast, where ships were losing their way. Some even vanished!Raku, along with a team of particularly curious Seekers, has been exploring a cove near there for some time. Shipwrecks and mysteries, what isn't to like?We should have heard back by now. We tortollans may not be fast, but we are reliable.Will you check on them, and make sure they are well?

Title: Sharks in the Water
Objective: Kill 6 Invading Dreadmaws.
Text: Recently a large gam of sharks has moved into the shallower water in the harbor. I have dealt with minor illnesses before that were caused by creatures carrying foreign contaminants to shore. Perhaps the sharks have brought something in from the deeper waters? Cull some of the sharks that have wandered too close to the pier. I shall read the tides for any changes.

Title: Tiny Treasures
Objective: Collect all of Koba's treasures.
Text: My adults are in the field doing some research. So I stay here, patiently waiting, as they told me to do.These monsters came and took my special treasures! They took my best friend in the whole world, my slug, Spitzy!They took them all. They ran far. I do not move fast...Could you please get them back, and find my family?

Title: Spiritual Restoration
Objective: Use Hanzabu's charm to resurrect the spirits of Zo'bal.
Text: Dis is a sacred place to Bwonsamdi, but now it is little more than a ruin. Even de spirits are unable to escape de passage of time and have faded away, leaving only their drained husks behind. We will return dem to life. Here, I have been collecting de souls from my hunt into dis charm. Use it on de drained spirits, and we will bring dis place back to what it once was.

Title: Morgrum's Survey
Objective: Check on Excavator Morgrum Emberflint's survey equipment in the Ruins of Xibala.
Text: Oi. Since yer hands are already dirty, what do ye say we make a deal?To give it to ye straight, there's a relic here called the Breath of Xibala. I don't know who Xibala is or why the Alliance wants its breath, but there's a hefty sum of gold in it fer me if we deliver.That means there's somethin' in it for you, too, if ye get my meanin'.I started a survey with me equipment but haven't got me results yet. Go on out into the ruins an' give the boxes you see a little kick to hurry things along.

Title: Gang Bustin'
Objective: Confront 8 Shady Deckhands.
Text: It's difficult to run a tight ship when you're so far from home. The crew has a tendency to get restless when they've been landlocked for too long.I've heard reports of deckhands sneakin' around and stealin' supplies. If the crew thinks they can steal from our employer on my watch, they've got another thing comin'!I need someone to crack down on these shady deals and send a message to the crew.Thievin' won't be tolerated!

Title: The Thrill of Exploration
Objective: Help Acadia Chistlestone recover a Xibalan fossil.
Text: Name's Acadia, Acadia Chistlestone!I represent the interests of the Explorer's League at this site. Where there's dirt to be turned, we're happy to do the digging!These Dark Iron, though, they're keen on delving deeper and faster than I'm comfortable with. Since you're a strong, capable member of the Alliance, do you think you could ah... lead by example?Go on, there's a fresh fossil here that could use some attention.

Title: Backup While I Pack Up
Objective: Protect Archaeologist Firebreaker.
Text: I came in here tae try an' reclaim as many relics as possible. Sneakin' in was easy, but I'm worried about things noticin' me while I pack up. Mind watching me back while I get the relics stored in a safe place in my bag?

Title: Quill or Be Quilled
Objective: Kill 6 Territorial Quillrats in Hawthorne's Plot.
Text: Oh, hello there. Sorry, we don't get many mainlanders in these parts.This plot was my husband Sam's farm. He used to tend to the onion fields every day before the curse befell Glenbrook and took him with it.With my husband gone, this farm is all I have left, and these quillrats are making sure I don't get even that.I'd hate to bother a perfect stranger, but could you help quell this infestation?

Title: Forge of Aeons
Objective: Bear witness to the ritual of the Lightforged.
Text: The Lightforged have long stood as a beacon of hope against the Legion.But few truly know what it takes to become the embodiment of Light's wrath.These few champions among the Army of the Light are ready to undergo their final trial.Will you do us the honor of bearing witness?

Title: Crabby Crew Stew
Objective: Collect Lumpy Crab Meat from Sand Scuttlers.
Text: Shouldn't you be in the mines? Look, I won't tell Morrison if you won't. I wouldn't want to be stuck in those mines, either.We could use a hand out here, though. The crew is getting crabby. We've been eating nothing but slop and the occasional rat for weeks.I hear one of the deckhands makes a marvelous crab stew. Can I count on you to secure the meat?

Title: And Justice For All
Objective: Leave Hangman's Point with Lucille Waycrest.
Text: Thank you for helping to redeem me in the eyes of my people. I am in your debt, and I will be sure to let my father know.In the mean time, I think we should find out what this Heartsbane Coven is, and what they are doing in our lands. I hope the marshal will be able to enlighten us.First thing's first, though. Care to undo these ropes? They're starting to chafe.

Title: Salvaging a Disaster
Objective: Gather 6 Drust Relics.
Text: Birch and I are helping out the expedition with field studies. I'm not much of a fighter, but I can't make another mistake, they might demote me! Could you recover some of the relics we packed up in boxes around the cave?

Title: I'm a Druid, Not a Priest
Objective: Free 5 cursed raiders.
Text: The remains of previous trespassers also arose when we set off the main trap. Cranklefuse here has been demanding that I help them, and while I can't say I'm too familiar with turning the undead, I believe I have found a solution. I've modified my staff to remove their curse, take it, and see if you can't help them.

Title: Dress to Impress
Objective: Put on the Irontide Hat and enter Freehold with Flynn.
Text: Freehold used to be open to anyone, but now it seems the Irontide Raiders have declared themselves the owners. They're locking the place down and turning away anyone who isn't part of the crew.Fortunately, they're also hiring.Put this on. Don't think about where it came from.We'll pose as new recruits, get in, gather some information, and be back in Boralus in time for supper! Cyrus may be salty, but he's a decent cook.

Title: The Ruins Fought Back
Objective: Kill 6 Ancient Protectors.
Text: Something set off a trap in the cave, and then the ruins themselves came tae life. I expect that most of our lads still in that cave aren't in fightin' form. Could ye clear out some of the livin' ruins tae help them escape?

Title: The Master Key
Objective: Obtain Morrison's Master Key and use it to free 8 Vulpera Captives.
Text: None of the keys you found were the right fit! We're going to need another plan...I've heard that Overseer Morrison has a master key that can open any lock in the compound. It's dangerous, but I need you to get that key for me!You'll find her running the mining operation inside the cave. Once you get the key, make sure you rescue any vulpera captives that you find.Once you've rescued my friends, meet me back here and release me. Good luck!

Title: Local Flavor
Objective: Gather 5 Juicy Lurker Tails.
Text: I'm STARVING.Not actually starving, like when I first got here, but you know... Emotionally starving.Haven't had any luck with the oysters lately, and seaweed soup really upsets my guts. If I eat any more of that stuff, I think the other castaways might actually feed me to the sharks.How about them tidelurkers? They look pretty juicy. Bet you could steam those up real nice.Can you get me some? I'm not much of a hunter. But I'll share it with you!

Title: A Marine Out of Water
Objective: Kill the Awakened Guardian.
Text: A giant one of those stone creatures killed quite a few marines while we were trying to evacuate the cave. It didn't chase us too far, but ignoring it outright is too big of a risk.It needs to fall!

Title: Chasing the Leader
Objective: Find Hilde Firebreaker.
Text: The locals and the league have been working together tae reclaim relics in this here cave up the hill. But it seems that we've angered the previous residents. I think the marines can keep the expedition safe fer now, but I dinna how long they can keep it up. We need yer help before things go south! Find Hilde Firebreaker, the leader of our expedition. She ran back into the cave fer somethin' or another.

Title: The Netherlight Crucible
Objective: Imbue a relic with Netherlight Fortification using the Netherlight Crucible.
Text: The crucible thrums with power. Soon our weapons will shine like the stars themselves!We will need that strength if we are to have any hope of defeating the Legion here., you have endured great hardship to bring us to this moment. The honor of first tapping the crucible's power must be yours.

Title: The Castaways
Objective: Speak with Stabby Jane at Castaway Point.
Text: I see the sirens have made another catch. You're lucky they haven't stripped your bones yet.If you need to trade supplies or just warm yourself by the fire, there's a camp up the hill behind me.Everyone there washed up in the tides, just like you. Figure we've got folks from at least four or five shipwrecks now. All banded together, just tryin' to survive.Talk to Stabby Jane. Don't worry about her nickname, she's actually real nice.

Title: Silencing the Sisters
Objective: Slay Patheope and Nolpe.
Text: The sirens in this tideway have drawn countless ships to their doom. Wiping them out would be a boon to all seafaring folk.But you can't very well kill all of them. Only a fool would try that.The real dangerous ones are the elders. The "sisters" as they're known. Bigger, smarter, and stronger than the younger ones. Their voices carry far out to sea and bring in all the big "catches."I managed to track two of them to a den at the northern end of the tideway, but I can't take them alone.

Title: The Long Con
Objective: Slay Carentan.
Text: Hello again my young friend! I have good news.Our mutual acquaintance Carentan -- the man who scammed us in Freehold -- has finally come out of hiding.I have been communicating with him in letters delivered by various middlemen and even completed a few proxy trades to earn his trust. In our last correspondence, he agreed to meet for an in-person trade.He thinks he is meeting with a Ms. Pixy Spindlespark, gnomish hairdresser with a weakness for poached furs.But he'll be meeting you instead.

Title: Glimmering Locket
Objective: Return the Glimmering Locket to Stabby Jane.

Title: Crumbling Apart
Objective: Destroy 8 Stormbound Conquerors.
Text: De mogu army grows with each passing moment thanks to their animated stone warriors. It is only a matter of time before their forces are back at full strength.A thousand curses upon Zul. He was forbidden from bringing his pets here--and from resurrecting de Thunder King in Pandaria.We are de only thing standing between dem and de city. We've got to stop dis while we still can!

Title: Catching Up
Objective: Tell Talanji about your experience with Bwonsamdi and Hir'eek.
Text: Good to see you in one piece. Nazmir is a place of nightmares, but you seem to be surviving.Rokhan and I convinced your Horde dat we need more support. He is getting ready to meet with reinforcements.We still need to get de loa's aid. What happened with Bwonsamdi and Hir'eek?

Title: Embrace the Voodoo
Objective: Use the Rastari Skull Whistle to activate 5 Spirit Obelisks.
Text: Dese heathens think we are weak. Dey think we are broken.But Zandalari never truly die.I've blessed dat skull Habutu gave you with a bit of voodoo dat will let it break through to de Other Side. You will need to use my spirit obelisks to channel its power. Dey will take it from dere.

Title: Torga's Eternal Return
Objective: Use Lashk's Scroll of Eternal Return to put Torga's spirit to rest.
Text: Well, we did it. Doesn't make the plan we had any less crazy. But there's still one more thing left to do.I've been visiting Torga for years. He told me stories of powerful scrolls, one in particular that he said was meant to be used to put a loa's spirit to rest.I think you should be the one to read it. I mean, if you're SMART enough to read it.Bah! Just take the scroll and read it before I have second thoughts.

Title: My Favorite Things
Objective: Ask Friendly Pete, Hungry Sam and Handy Bill about their missing keepsakes, then collect those items from the Wailing Tideway.
Text: It's tough out here.Pirates. Deadly monsters.Hungry Sam's seemingly endless battle with indigestion.Nothing sets the nerves at ease like an old keepsake. Somethin' to remind you of home. Somethin' to keep you going.Ask around the camp. Find out what folks might have lost out there in the tideways. If you can bring any of it back, it'd be a mighty kind gesture.Me? Oh... I had a locket...Never mind, it's too small, you'd never find it. It's nothing. Don't worry about it.

Title: Spirits' Belongings
Objective: Find Kaza'jin's Reclaimed Bijous, Grimoire of the Other Side, and Venerated Remains.
Text: You are no Zandalari, but your spirit burns with a passion I have not seen in many years.I am de wavebinder. It is through me dat de loa bless our ships. I will not see my home tainted by dese talking rocks.Gather my bijous, my grimoire, and some of our fallen I set aside for just such an occasion.De brutes think dey have won. Dey will answer to Bwonsamdi soon enough.

Title: No Troll Left Behind
Objective: Rally 12 Rastari Defenders.
Text: Dis is de primary port for de Zandalari fleet. Thankfully most of our ships were out when de mogu came, but Rastari is still an active fortification for de city.De mogu did not land on abandoned shores. Dere are all manner of brave warriors stationed here, fighting for their lives.Take dis whistle and rally all you can. Our warriors will hear its scream and know dat dey are not alone.

Title: Show of Strength
Objective: Kill Jao-Ti the Thunderous and Subjugator Zheng.
Text: Their leader's time is coming soon now, but we need to dispose of his lieutenants first. Our momentum will be lost if dey reform ranks.Jao-Ti is de first. Legend has it Lei Shen himself said he showed a great connection to de storms. He is leading de mogu's stormbinders.De other is Subjugator Zheng, a slaver dat would make de Kul Tirans blush. You have never seen depravity like his.Kill dem both, and make dem suffer. De mogu are no strangers to war, but neither are we.

Title: Wrath of the Zandalari
Objective: Slay 8 Kao-Tien Marauders, Subjugators, or Charged Sentinels.
Text: Dere is no reasoning with de mogu. Dey only value one thing: strength.Dat is something de Zandalari have like no other, but our forces are spread thin. We are simply not prepared to fight dem.You have proven yourself a capable warrior, for |5. Would you be our "ambassador" to dese brutes? Show dem dat de Zandalari do not stand alone!

Title: Captain Gulnaku's Treasure
Objective: Search for Captain Gulnaku's treasure chest.

Title: Jungo, Herald of G'huun
Objective: Defeat Jungo, Herald of G'huun.
Text: Dis is it. De blood magic is weakened enough dat we can actually hurt de herald of G'huun.It is going to take all of us fighting dis thing to stop it. We will meet you inside of Torga.We cannot lose here. If de blood trolls control Torga's blood, den dere will be no way for us to stop dem.

Title: Essence of the Light Mother
Objective: Collect 3 Vestiges of Light.
Text: This is a crucial moment. Our campaign must not lose momentum.Though she has fallen, I still sense Xe'ra's presence all around us. The Light that shone within her heart can yet be a source of strength for our cause.No doubt the loss of Xe'ra has deeply wounded Turalyon. I will do what I can to ease his troubled spirit while you gather the vestiges of the naaru that remain.

Title: Antorus, the Burning Throne: The Heart of Argus
Objective: Collect 4 Sigils of the Dark Titan from Aggramar in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Mythic Difficulty.
Text: Hatuun tells me that after Argus fell, Sargeras ordered a temple of darkness to be built deep within the planet's core. Little is known of it, for only the titan's most devoted acolytes are given sigils that permit entrance.If we lay claim to these sigils, they could be infused into the Vindicaar. This would allow our forces to stage a direct assault upon the fetid heart of Argus.

Title: Diplomacy and Dominance
Objective: Use Vorrik's Staff to drain power from 6 Faithless Suppression Spires.
Text: May I entrust you with my staff? I do not offer this lightly, so do not accept it lightly either.We will need every advantage when we face Emperor Korthek, and I've identified an opportunity to increase the power at our disposal.The Faithless maintain a series of suppression spires on the ridge above us to subjugate the pterrordax. My staff can drain power from the spires to bolster its own potency.Meanwhile, I will recruit a much-needed ally for the next stage of our mission.

Title: Antorus, the Burning Throne: The Heart of Argus
Objective: Collect 4 Sigils of the Dark Titan from Aggramar in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Normal Difficulty.
Text: Hatuun tells me that after Argus fell, Sargeras ordered a temple of darkness to be built deep within the planet's core. Little is known of it, for only the titan's most devoted acolytes are given sigils that permit entrance.If we lay claim to these sigils, they could be infused into the Vindicaar. This would allow our forces to stage a direct assault upon the fetid heart of Argus.

Title: Antorus, the Burning Throne: The Heart of Argus
Objective: Collect 4 Sigils of the Dark Titan from Aggramar in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Heroic Difficulty.
Text: Hatuun tells me that after Argus fell, Sargeras ordered a temple of darkness to be built deep within the planet's core. Little is known of it, for only the titan's most devoted acolytes are given sigils that permit entrance.If we lay claim to these sigils, they could be infused into the Vindicaar. This would allow our forces to stage a direct assault upon the fetid heart of Argus.

Title: An Army's Arsenal
Objective: Kill the specters of Mugabu and Jam'jen, so Omi can ransack the storehouses.
Text: It's my job to scout out the ruins to identify threats and figure out the best way in.Two storehouses contain the majority of the valuable weaponry in the ruins.Unfortunately, they're guarded by specters, powerful Zandalari spirits bound to this place.I... we need those weapons. Take out the specters so I... we can get to them.

Title: Crushing the Skullcrushers
Objective: Kill 4 Blood Skullcrushers.
Text: Look, I'll be happy once we've killed this herald and we can have things go back to normal.Until then, you need to deal with these monstrous blood trolls called "skullcrushers". Lovely, right?As far as I can tell, these things have some sort of connection to this herald, might be why they're so huge.You kill these skullcrushers and maybe we weaken this herald a bit more. Or maybe it gets even angrier and kills us all.We'll have to see.

Title: Loa-Free Diet
Objective: Recover 6 Parts of Torga from the blood trolls.
Text: Princess Talanji thinks we're almost ready to kill this herald of G'huun. Maybe she's right, maybe we're all dead, who knows?What I do know is the blood trolls here are... are carving and carrying away parts of Torga. Ugh!From what I can tell, they're using poor Torga's meat to power their blood rituals. This has to stop!Go out there and steal those pieces of meat from the blood trolls. I'll figure out a way to dispose of it.

Title: Sanctifying Ground
Objective: Place 4 Sanctifying Totems down in the area.
Text: We are so close to weakening dis herald. Dis is our final push. De nearby area is brimming with blood magic.While you were fighting, I was working on creating totems dat can cleanse de area of blood magic.Take dese totems and place dem nearby. Dey should drain some of de blood magic out of de area.De herald should be weak enough for us to actually kill after all dis.

Title: Tortollan Rescue
Objective: Rescue 6 Tortollan Captives from the blood trolls using Lashk's Scroll of Purging.
Text: If Torga wants us to help you kill the herald of G'huun, then I guess we'll help. First, we need to rescue our people.I found out that the blood trolls are draining the blood of our friends nearby and then feeding them to crawgs!This is no way for a tortollan to die, not after hundred of years gathering stories on Azeroth.Take this scroll. It'll purge whatever blood magic the blood trolls using on my friends.Be careful with my scroll! I want it back in one piece.

Title: Killer Crawgs
Objective: Kill 12 Blood Crawgs or their riders.
Text: You heard Torga. We need to be taking de fight to de blood trolls if we want to stop dis herald of G'huun.De blood trolls have monstrous crawgs in a camp nearby. We destroy dem, we weaken de blood trolls!De rest of us will move ahead to find out what else de blood trolls have planned around dis place.

Title: Forcing Fate's Hand
Objective: Use the Scroll of Fate's Hand to summon the Hand of Fate to destroy 50 undead along the Blood Coast.
Text: I got some good news and bad news for you about this whole quest to destroy the herald of G'huun. Bad news first.There's an entire army of skeletons between us and the next area. I'm guessing they used Torga's blood to animate them.Good news is that scroll you recovered from Holbruk can summon the powerful Hand of Fate....and the bad news is that the scroll got damaged when Holbruk died and is only good for one more use.Meh. Take this scroll and destroy that skeleton army!

Title: Speaking with the Dead
Objective: Ask Bwonsamdi to summon Torga's spirit.
Text: Ya be livin' up ta ya part of da bargain. I be ready ta show ya what remains of Torga's soul.I gonna need a little part of ya ta act as a conduit ta be summonin' Torga. Don't worry, I be givin' ya all back.Mostly.After we be done, I be headin' out. Ya always welcome ta call on me again... but only if ya got another deal ready.

Title: Negative Blood
Objective: Destroy 8 Corrupted Loa's Blood with the Scroll of Purification and recover the Scroll of Fate's Hand.
Text: Okay, you want to kill the herald of a blood god? We can figure something out.There's corrupted blood nearby that's feeding this monster's power. Lucky for you, I've heard stories of this sort of thing before.Take this scroll, but be careful with it! It'll destroy the corrupted blood that's feeding Jungo.Oh, and I need you to find a scroll Holbruk was carrying, called the Scroll of Fate's Hand. It's REALLY powerful. We'll need it.

Title: A Port in Peril
Objective: Meet Habutu and Zolani at Warport Rastari.
Text: A group of mogu have taken hold of Warport Rastari and now threaten to encroach further into my city.It would seem Zul is losing his grip over his pets.Dat port is vital to our military fleet. If de brutes succeed, Zuldazar will fall, and dere won't be a fleet to aid your precious Horde.You wish to prove yourself an ally of de Zandalari? Meet my blade and shield at de port and clean up dis mess.

Title: Upward and Onward
Objective: Return to Zo'bal Ruins and inform Witch Doctor Kejabu as to what happened.
Text: It is sad dat Hir'eek had to die, but at least de blood trolls are weaker now.My potions are healing me up nicely. I did some looking around and came across dis guy.He's skittish, but not hostile. I think you can use him to get out of here.Hurry up and jump on, before he breaks de rope! I'll find my own way out; you don't have to worry.

Title: To Kill a Loa
Objective: Defeat Hir'eek, the loa of bats.
Text: I am badly hurt... I don't think I can move. Don't worry, I have some potions dat can heal me... slowly.Hir'eek is just down de cavern dere. De poison injured him, but he is a loa, and it will take more than dat to take him down.I can't believe we... YOU are going kill a loa. It's just not someting we do... but Hir'eek serves G'huun. We have no choice!It's all up to you, now. Kill Hir'eek and end dis madness!

Title: Cease all Summoning
Objective: Kill Summoner Yarz.
Text: I feel something dark and powerful being summoned in de husk of Torga. You need to stop it!Dere must be a summoner using Torga's blood to finish a ritual.Do what you can to stop dem. I will stay here to keep dese tortollans safe from de blood trolls.

Title: Antorus, the Burning Throne: Dark Passage
Objective: Collect 4 Runes of Passage from Imonar the Soulhunter in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Mythic Difficulty.
Text: Despite the dangerous energies pulsing out from the heart of Argus, the Soulhunter travels unhindered through the Burning Throne. Our scouts report that his vessel harnesses the power of demonic runes to safely reach the Hallowed Felworks.If we obtain those runes, it would allow the Vindicaar to follow the same route. This could save our forces valuable time.

Title: Hir'eek, the Bat Loa
Objective: Face Hir'eek with Jo'chunga.
Text: Hir'eek knows we are here. If my knowledge of Hir'eek is correct, he will personally kill us after we present ourselves.It is time, den. You and I will walk out dere into a horde of blood trolls who want to watch their loa kill us.Take dis dagger. It is coated with de poison I made. I trust you to survive longer than me to use it.You pretend to cower to Hir'eek, and I will do de talking. On my signal, you jump on Hir'eek and start stabbing!...And den we hope for de best.

Title: Moments of Reflection
Objective: Bring Illidan's crystal to the people and places closest to him.

Title: Poisoning the Brood
Objective: Use the Poisoned Mojo Flask to Poison 5 Tamed Warspawn.
Text: Now we have room for our plan to kill Hir'eek. You see, my specialty is in making potions and poisons.I am working on a poison to use on Hir'eek, when de time comes. I have no idea if it will work or not.I want you to take what I already made and use it on de bats around here. It should kill dem instantly.If it works, den I can make it stronger with my voodoo and give us a chance at killing Hir'eek.

Title: Ritualistic Denial
Objective: Disrupt 3 blood rituals with Kisha's scroll of purging.
Text: I can't believe we're dealing with a death loa, a DEAD loa, and blood trolls. This isn't what I had planned today!Look, some of the other tortollans have said there are some blood rituals going on. They were spooked and started heading for the coast when they saw it.Take this scroll and read it near any blood rituals. It should cause it to disperse.Be careful with my scroll! It's old and they don't make them like they used to.

Title: Westward Noble
Objective: Find Lord Kennings.
Text: While I loath to involve you in this further, I don't have the men to afford an escort for Lord Kennings. If he gets hurt, we'll all be out of a job. Can you make sure he at least made it to the west camp?

Title: Souls for the Death Loa
Objective: Claim 10 blood troll souls within Torga.
Text: Dere be blood trolls swarmin' all over dis place. Dey really be pickin' Torga clean, even eatin' his meat.Dat be dark, even for me.Da souls of dese blood trolls be corrupted by eatin' a loa. Somethin' ya should be rememberin' for future reference.Dese souls be worth a lot ta me, more dan just da normal souls of dese blood trolls.Get me da corrupted souls of dese blood trolls and I be callin' da spirit of Torga to ya.

Title: WANTED: Ol' Frostclaw
Objective: Slay Old Frostclaw.
Text: Old Frostclaw has once again been spotted near the edge of the pass. Hunters in the area are advised to keep caution. This larger than average bear has killed four people to date, I'd hate for you to make it a fifth. Any individual who kills the beast will be rewarded, regardless of their occupation. -Alanna

Title: Dreadtick Combustion
Objective: Blow up 5 Dreadtick Leechers with Lashk's Scroll of Combustion.
Text: This whole thing is crazy, you know that? I don't think any story can top this one...Bah! Do you hear that insufferable sound?It's those stupid dreadticks sucking on Torga's meat. Makes my skin crawl!What? You can't hear it? Meh, trust me, they're around, and they need to be taken care of.Here, take this scroll. We've had to deal with these dumb insects in the past. Read it near them and it'll cause them to explode.

Title: Antorus, the Burning Throne: Dark Passage
Objective: Collect 4 Runes of Passage from Imonar the Soulhunter in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Heroic Difficulty.
Text: Despite the dangerous energies pulsing out from the heart of Argus, the Soulhunter travels unhindered through the Burning Throne. Our scouts report that his vessel harnesses the power of demonic runes to safely reach the Hallowed Felworks.If we obtain those runes, it would allow the Vindicaar to follow the same route. This could save our forces valuable time.

Title: Encase of Emergency
Objective: Collect 20 Pristine Ice Chunks from ice elementals.
Text: The cliffs here are well known for the crystal clear ice which forms at their base, and even more so for the elementals that are responsible for such. The hunters in my lodge use shards from the primal bodies to keep their stock frozen for transport. More importantly, think of how useful it could be for making and serving drinks! Let's see if we can't find some elementals and gather shards from them.

Title: Beseeching Bwonsamdi
Objective: Summon Bwonsamdi to ask for his help.
Text: We must talk to Torga's spirit and find out what exactly happened here... and how we can stop it.Hrm, you mentioned dat you are linked to Bwonsamdi now.It is time to test dat link. We need Bwonsamdi to get us Torga's spirit.

Title: Torga, the Turtle Loa
Objective: Follow the tortollan pilgrimage path to reach Torga, loa of the turtles.
Text: Name's Lashk. We're not here to join any cause, we just want to hear Torga's legendary stories.I don't know if he'll help, but you can try persuading Torga, loa of the turtles, and see if he'll help you fight these blood trolls.You can join on our pilgrimage to Torga, just keep quiet. Follow the path and find Kisha, she'll tell you where to go.

Title: Xibalan Ecology
Objective: Slay 12 Xibalan predators.
Text: I want to take me boys out and really dig our picks in, but every scout I've sent into the ruins just came back half mauled to death.Some didn't come back at all.From what I can tell, the ruins are home to more'n just these spiky grass-eaters. Do you think you could be a peach an' thin their numbers a bit?I'd caution ye against tamperin' with the local ecology an' all, but in the interest of not gettin' eaten I think I'll let ye make the call.

Title: The Bones of Xibala
Objective: Travel to Xibala and meet with Acadia Chistlestone.
Text: Our allies in the Explorer's League have alerted us to an exciting find. They have set up camp in the Xibala region of Zuldazar.Make your way to the camp and help them uncover anything that may advance our cause.

Title: Fond Farewells
Objective: Deliver Jorak's Note to B'wizati in Zuldazar.
Text: Dis is where we part ways.I'm going to take de name Akunda, and start a new life here.When you find Rakera, and I know you will, give her my thanks.She saved my life, and I'm going to make sure to live a life dat was worth saving.If you find yourself back in de city, could you deliver dis note for me? I trust you not to open it, though I doubt you could read my scrawls anyway.

Title: The Start of a Monster Hunt
Objective: Investigate the camp wreckage.
Text: This is the closest I've been to a dead body, how exciting! What do you think murdered him? Regardless, it is my duty to ensure the safety of individuals under my employ. With a combination of my wit and bravery, and your practical skills, we should be able to track it down. This will be a tale for the ages! Let's start with looking around the camp, see if you can find any clues.

Title: Best In Show
Objective: Mount Cooper to begin your show and score at least 300 points.
Text: Now that the troggs have been taken care of, let's get on with the real show!You've more than proven yourself as a capable rider - ready to get back in the ring and go big?See if you can beat three hundred points!

Title: Antorus, the Burning Throne: Dark Passage
Objective: Collect 4 Runes of Passage from Imonar the Soulhunter in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Normal Difficulty.
Text: Despite the dangerous energies pulsing out from the heart of Argus, the Soulhunter travels unhindered through the Burning Throne. Our scouts report that his vessel harnesses the power of demonic runes to safely reach the Hallowed Felworks.If we obtain those runes, it would allow the Vindicaar to follow the same route. This could save our forces valuable time.

Title: Out With The Inquisitors
Objective: Slay $1oa Rare Elite inquisitors on Argus.
Text: Of all of the demons at the Legion's disposal, the inquisitors are some of the most terrible. Even feared by some of the lesser demons, these monsters delight in cruelty and torturing their captives. Inquisitors revel in the terror they cause, but perhaps we can make that work to our advantage. Find the most powerful inquisitors you can and defeat them. Their deaths will not only improve the morale of our troops, but also send a message to their lesser forces.

Title: Antorus, the Burning Throne: The Death of a Titan
Objective: Strike down the soul of Argus in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Text: There is no way to express the depth of my sorrow. My rage. What Sargeras has done... Argus, my home world, holds the soul of a titan. It has been twisted and corrupted beyond redemption, its power harnessed to fuel the Legion's infinite army. We must do the impossible... breach the depths of Antorus and sever the Legion's connection to the world soul. Please. End its pain, its suffering. In striking down the dark heart of Argus, we will defeat the Legion... and redeem the soul of my world.

Title: Invasion of Space
Objective: Defeat any $1oa commanders in Invasion Points.
Text: We are on the Legion home world, but we must not let ourselves get caught unawares. These invasion points can bolster their forces and ruin our plans. By defeating them on their territory we also damage their command and infrastructure. Slay the commanders and stop their invading forces. The fight to push the Legion back begins now!

Title: Fragments of the Abyss
Objective: Collect $1oa  from Rare Elites on Argus.
Text: Our scouts have delivered a disturbing report, champion. Some of the more powerful creatures of the Void are carrying powerful crystals that augment their abilities. They now pose a greater threat than before, and we can no longer ignore them. Find these void-tainted monstrosities and take their crystals. We will find a way to dispose of them safely.

Title: Commander on Deck!
Objective: Use Vishax's Portal.

Title: Targets of Opportunity: Terminus
Objective: Slay $1oa Rare Elites in Terminus.
Text: Those Legion ships are a problem. Even now they dock perilously close to the Vindicaar, threatening us with their presence. Sometimes when fighting the Legion it is better to go straight to the top rather than thinning their numbers. Go to the shipyards of Terminus and slay their officers and commanders. That should rattle their forces and put them back on the defensive.

Title: A Sweater for Rupert
Objective: Collect Kolta's materials.
Text: The nights are cold in this area, and I am worried my poor dog will freeze to death. I wish to sew him a sweater, but I have no materials to make one with. I would pay anyone who brings me a pair of porcupine quills and four raccoon tails. -Kolta

Title: The Burning Throne
Objective: Speak with Grand Artificer Romuul while above the Antoran Wastes to open the way to Antorus.
Text: The time has come, to begin our assault upon Antorus. Everything we have fought for, everything our friends and family have sacrificed, has brought us to this moment. We will fire Light's Judgment upon the walls of the accursed citadel and storm their seat of power. We will end the Legion. After all you have done, it is fitting that you have the honor. Speak to Romuul and let us finish our mission.

Title: Shattered and Broken
Objective: Kill Fractured and Distorted Memories.
Text: Something is terribly wrong.Unwanted memories have been released from their magical confines.Akunda's power is supposed to keep dem sealed away...De physical manifestation of our most haunting memories have no place in dis world.Dey must be destroyed.

Title: Vengeance From Above
Objective: Ride Rakjan the Unbroken and kill Faithless.
Text: Emperor Korthek hides deep in his stolen temple below ground. We must create such chaos that he has no choice but to emerge to face us.The vulpera riot is a good start, but it will not be enough. Alone, they are no match for the Faithless army.Thankfully, they are not alone.We will ride the mighty Rakjan through the skies. While you throw lightning bombs, I'll use my charged staff to blast the Faithless armies below.Let us hope that is enough to lure out Korthek. I am eager to finish this.

Title: A Jolt of Power
Objective: Use the Blessing of Akunda to revive Stormhide Lizards.
Text: I have you to thank for removing that usurper.My strength is returning, unfortunately, the damage to my children has already been done.They are weak and dying. I need you to restore them.My blessing will give you power over the storms.Use it to save my children, as you have saved me.

Title: Forced Grounding
Objective: Use the Faithless Trapper's Spear to pull Fangcaller Hrillik's pterrordax down from the sky above you, and kill him.

Title: Inconvenient Spirits
Objective: Kill 8 Tortured Spirits.
Text: The sethrak have oppressed vulpera like me for countless generations.You can't fight 'em. Trust mer. My caravan tried.I took that beating as a lesson, and then I found a new pack to run with.Here, we keep our distance from the sethrak and scavenge ruins like this one for anything valuable we can use or trade.You want in? We could use a fourth. This one's protected by nasty spirits that keep harassing us.Take them out and you're in.

Title: Valley of Sorrows
Objective: Find Meijani in the Valley of Sorrows.
Text: Your friend's memories are gone.Dat is Akunda's gift to us. He takes away our painful memories, but a lot more than dat has gone missing lately.I can't even remember what I had for breakfast, and it's getting worse by de day.Something's not right.Meijani and I had a plan. We were going to do... something... in de Valley of Sorrows. It's where Akunda keeps de forgotten memories.If you're looking for answers, finding Meijani is de best place to start.

Title: Ending the Madness
Objective: Defeat Akunda the Exalted.
Text: Akunda the Exalted is not who he seems.He poisoned the eternal spring, sickening all who drank from it. Even I was not immune to his abhorrent alchemy.Now he drains my power, abusing my gift to wipe the minds of all who might try to stop him.We will not let him succeed.What little power I have left, I will lend to you.Use it to call the storm and end the madness that has taken over my temple.

Title: Memory Breach
Objective: Look for clues within Unwanted Memories.
Text: De memories of Akunda's followers rest within dis valley.Most are best left forgotten, but dey may be our only chance to find out what happened to Akunda.Look back upon de memories here. See if you can find any clues about what happened to our loa.Be warned. Dis task is not for de weak. What you witness in dese memories can't be unseen.

Title: Sacred Remains
Objective: Collect 6 Sacred Remains.
Text: Dis area was once a lush jungle, home to many great and powerful thunder lizards.De bones of those ancient and powerful creatures are still buried around de temple.Great power lingers within those ancient remains... you will need such power to call upon Akunda.Search de area and return to me with de ancient bones of de thunder lizards.

Title: Powerful Conductors
Objective: Retrieve Rorgog's Antennae.
Text: Akunda offers us a chance to start anew.Through a sacred ritual, de loa enters our mind and removes de memories dat cause us pain.If you seek Akunda's blessing, den you must first prepare for de ritual.De pests dat feed on de wildlife here have antennae dat are great conductors for magic. De larger, de better.Their leader's antennae should do de trick. He's easily three times de size of de normal ranishu.

Title: Take the High Road
Objective: Meet with Lucille Waycrest at Arom's Stand in Drustvar.
Text: Let us continue to Arom's Stand. It will take some time to parse the knowledge of the tome and train more inquisitors for our cause.If the order's weapons are as effective against the coven as they were against the Drust, we may stand a chance of rescuing my family and restoring this land to its former glory.I will make my way there on foot. Until we meet again.

Title: Vile Infestation
Objective: Slay 12 ranishu in Redrock Mesa.
Text: Redemption must be earned.We do good works to show Akunda we are worthy of his blessing.De ranishu are a plague upon these lands. Dey devour everything in sight, with no regard for taste or texture.If dey go unchecked, those vile pests will eat their way straight to de temple.Rid de mesa of their presence. Show Akunda you are worthy of his gift.

Title: Supplies From the Argussian Reach
Objective: Speak with Toraan the Revered on the Vindicaar.
Text: t, thanks to your efforts, our forces have been able to locate resources and prevent them from falling into the Legion's hands.With your continued assistance, we will be able to provide additional resources.

Title: Supplies From the Army of the Light
Objective: Speak with Vindicator Jaelaana on the Vindicaar for your reward.
Text: Archenon poros, champion.The Army of the Light wishes to thank you for your aid against the Legion's forces on Argus.Please accept these supplies with our gratitude. Your continued support brings us ever closer to our ultimate goal of eradicating the Legion once and for all.

Title: Immortal Ace
Objective: Collect bones from the Antoran Wastes to form a bone effigy.
Text: An effigy. The Many-Faced One requires it.Steal from the Imps. Steal from the Fiends. Steal from the Ur'zul.He comes.

Title: Paragon of Argussian Reach
Objective: Speak with Toraan the Revered on the Vindicaar.
Text: Your allies among the Argussian Reach have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your continued efforts on their behalf.

Title: Paragon of the Army of the Light
Objective: Speak with Vindicator Jaelaana on the Vindicaar.
Text: Your allies in the Army of the Light would like to thank you for your continued support. They await you on the Vindicaar.

Title: Settle the Score
Objective: Kill Chartusk in Foxhollow Woods.
Text: A year ago I lost my daughter to the largest boar in the forest. I have tracked him since, trading blows back and forth. But this time... Let's just say I don't have much time left. All I wish for is vengeance. Please , avenge us so that my soul can leave this plane and join my daughter, wherever she may be.

Title: Diversionary Tactics
Objective: Defeat Frostmange in Alpine Rise.
Text: Our destination is that cottage up ahead. I know it doesn't look like much, but a great deal of history is hidden inside.First, though, we'll need to deal with that massive yeti camped just outside. I'd hate to ask it of you, but I'll need you to draw his attention so I can slip inside.Once you've taken care of him, I'll meet you within.

Title: Telogrus Rift
Objective: Travel to Telogrus Rift and complete the scenario.
Text: Umbric and his blood elves were cast out of their home for their pursuit of understanding.I know the dangers of the void better than most. We should lend them our aid and ensure they don't do anything too foolhardy.This rift will take us to their current location. I hope we are not too late to help them.

Title: Blood of a Titan
Objective: Bring the blood of Argus the Unmaker to Khadgar in Dalaran.

Title: The North Pass Caverns
Objective: Find Thaddeus Rifthold near the North Pass Caverns.
Text: Please, you must help!My grandson got lost around the caves to the north, and I'm so afraid that the troggs might have got him!My husband went after him, but he's getting on in years, and I fear he imagines himself tougher than he really is.Could you help them? You should be able to catch up with Thaddeus along the northern road.

Title: Weeds of the Mire
Objective: Collect 6 sprigs of Graveweed from the Dreadmire.
Text: Help me... weak... can't heal...Graveweed... help... more... please...

Title: Gol Koval
Objective: Find Rebecca Hale in Gol Koval.
Text: A group of hunters went up into the hills awhile ago and we haven't heard back from them.My niece is up there and it isn't like her to be out of touch for so long! Would you please find her?She was headed towards Gol Koval.

Title: The Ruins of Gol Var
Objective: Escort Lucille Waycrest into Gol Var.
Text: What lie beyond are more ruins, much like those the coven sought.However, these ruins served a different purpose, one that established the legacy of House Waycrest thousands of years ago.Let us head inside, and I will explain.

Title: Unlocking History
Objective: Find the secret passageway in the Forgotten Lodge.
Text: I'm sure you're wondering why I've brought you here.Located somewhere inside this cottage is a hidden door. If we can find a way to access it, the answer to your questions, and possibly our survival against the coven, should lie beyond.Help me search for it.

Title: Salvage Rights
Objective: Recover the Wrapped Supplies, Cask of Salted Fish, Hardened Lockbox, and Bucket of Grain from Alpine Rise.
Text: This poor trader was set upon by the yetis. There's nothing we can do for him now, but we would be remiss to let his supplies be laid to waste by these brutes.See if you can find any supplies worth salvaging. You can use Bella as a pack horse.Don't worry, she's a brave mare. She won't spook easily.

Title: The Order of Embers
Objective: Take the Tome of Silver and Ash in Gol Var.
Text: The Order of Embers was the name given to those who took up these arms against the Drust. Using the tools and methods uncovered by the scholars, they were able to counter the Drust's magic, and ensure our victory in the war.If the coven wants to use the Drust's magic against us, then we'll use the order's weapons against them.The knowledge of the order rests here, but without a hand to wield it, it will do us no good.Will you be that hand? Will you revive the Order of Embers?

Title: A Slight Detour
Objective: Meet with Lucille Waycrest at Highroad Pass in Drustvar.
Text: If this coven is drawing its power from these ancient ruins, then I may just know of something that could help us fight back.Meet me at the first fork along the Highroad Pass. There is something there I want you to see.

Title: Show Me What You've Got
Objective: Mount Cooper to begin your show and score at least 150 points.
Text: It looks like you understand the basics. Now it's time to put everything together.Head for the ring. Once you hear the starting pistol, you will have one minute to score as high as possible.Gnolls are worth one point. Run 'em through with the harpoon!If you see a paper zeppelin, bag it with your bolas for fifty points!Leaping fences gives you style. Style gives you more points when you skewer gnolls or down zeppelins. It's super important, so don't forget to keep jumping fences!

Title: Yeti to Rumble
Objective: Kill 8 Chillfur Yetis in Alpine Rise.
Text: It would seem that the guard have been lax in patrolling the Highroad Pass. The mountain yetis have taken advantage of their absence, and now lie directly in our path.I am no soldier, so I will need to ask that you take care of them while I try to sneak past. If we can drive them off the road, at least it will make the pass safe again for travelers.

Title: Sizing Up The Opposition
Objective: Speak with Turalyon.
Text: No doubt your High Exarch will fret at the news that we lack the resources to assault Antorus. He is not used to believing his vaunted Army of the Light to be inadequate.His pride is no concern of mine. While he plots a new strategy, I will bathe the ground in demon blood.Go. There is much to be done before we can achieve our final victory.

Title: Dyminium Seam - Rank 3 Unlock
Objective: Find someone on Argus who might be able to train you on how to handle Astral Glory.
Text: Amazed that anything so pure could continue to grow on this planet, you pick flower from the ground. You feel a small power radiate from it and then vanish. As it falls apart in your hands, you wonder if anyone on this Light-forsaken place knows how to handle this precious herb.

Title: Supplying the Antoran Campaign
Objective: Complete 10 Invasion Points.
Text: The Legion requires raw materials from conquered words to fuel their crusade. Travel through Legion portals, destroy demons you encounter, and deny them the resources required to maintain their war machine.

Title: Void Inoculation
Objective: Collect 100 Fragments of Condensed Void.
Text: All entities touched by shadow leave behind traces of void when they are defeated, If you collect enough in your travels through the city, return to me, and I will distill it into its undiluted form.We can save more of my kin.

Title: Take the Bait
Objective: Collect 15 Snapclaw Meat from Snapclaw crabs in Snapclaw Shore.
Text: The bait... almost gone now... must catch...The crabs... find them... get more...

Title: Unappreciated Scrolls
Objective: Recover 8 Tortollan Scrolls.
Text: Since you're here in Natha'vor, you might as well help out the rest of the pilgrimage with a problem.These trolls have stolen several of our scrolls. Why they would, I have no idea, I doubt they're smart enough to even read.I want you to get them back. I'm not young anymore, I can't just be casting magic off the top of my head!Especially healing magic... which I'm sure Shoak is going to need when you rescue his dumb shell.

Title: Noble Responsibilities
Objective: Track and kill the murdering monster.
Text: From the state of this body, I would say a beast with formidable claws or fangs ravaged this camp. You say the trail leads westward? This camp usually houses more than one of Alanna's hunters, I wonder if they are tracking the beast down as well. Hurry it up! I don't want to spend the day waiting around, track our dangerous quarry!

Title: Supplying Krokuun
Objective: Collect 150 Order Hall Resources.
Text: This desolate place offers little for my people. Every hour is spent scraping together enough to survive. If I had more supplies, I could offer you another ridgestalker.What say you, offworlder?

Title: The Perfect Horse, of Course
Objective: Assist Majo in choosing and mounting a horse.
Text: With all that you've collected for me... I guess it is time to mount, isn't it? Hoo! I haven't felt such nerves for three hundred years! Would you mind assisting me in finding a suitable equine partner? I could not trust myself to make the decision alone!

Title: Monstrous Energy
Objective: Collect 6 Pulsating Extract from Venomscale Slitherers in Rockskip Falls.
Text: Have you ever heard about eel juice? I don't know if it's safe for s like you, but tortollans love it! It gives us a burst of energy, and puts a spring in the step of even the oldest tortollan. I saw some eels to the north of the estate when we were traveling. Can you go collect some of their venom for my dad?

Title: The Bargain is Struck
Objective: Speak with King Rastakhan.
Text: Now dat you have declared a patron loa for your time here in Zuldazar, you should inform de king of your decision. He will appreciate dat you chose to follow de mighty Gonk.

Title: Safety First
Objective: Collect 8 Durable Seashells in Rockskip Falls.
Text: The connection between horse and rider is fascinating to me, and I will never truly understand until I experience it. But, well, you know... armor! How could I possibly even think to mount one of these beauties without some proper protection? I saw some waterfalls nearby. There must be shells near the banks of its pools! Would you entertain an old Tortollan by collecting some for his safety?

Title: Knowledge of the Past
Objective: Travel with Meerah's Caravan in search of Julwaba.
Text: An old friend of mine came to de sands willingly to gain knowledge of de past.If anyone can locate dis weapon, it would be Julwaba.Last I heard, she planned to excavate de ruins surrounding de great pyramid.

Title: The Perfect Offering
Objective: Deliver the offering to Akunda the Exalted at the Temple of Akunda.
Text: Dis offering is all dat I have to my name, but it wouldn't be right for me to use it for myself when I know your friend is in danger.She saved my life, now I can save hers.Take de offering. Don't make me ask twice.

Title: Lucky Charm
Objective: Collect Lucktail's Tail from Lucktail in Rockskip Falls.
Text: My daddy would never admit it, but he's really superstitious. I don't think he'll ever feel safe on a horse unless he has a lucky charm! I heard about a fox somewhere around here that's been eating a lot of chickens, and escaping everybody trying to catch him. I bet he's really lucky!
